	public class SankeyDataAggregator
	{
		public class SumCalculator
		{
			public double Calculate(List<ISankeyLink> links)
			{
				double num = 0.0;
				foreach (ISankeyLink link in links)
				{
					num += link.Weight;
				}
				return num;
			}
		}

		private readonly Dictionary<Tuple<object, object>, ISankeyLink> links;

		private readonly SumCalculator calculator;

		public SankeyDataAggregator()
		{
			links = new Dictionary<Tuple<object, object>, ISankeyLink>();
			calculator = new SumCalculator();
		}

		public ICollection<ISankeyLink> GetLinks(IEnumerable<ISankeyLink> platformLinks)
		{
			if (links.Count == 0 && platformLinks != null)
			{
				foreach (ISankeyLink platformLink in platformLinks)
				{
					Tuple<object, object> key = new Tuple<object, object>(platformLink.Source, platformLink.Target);
					if (!links.TryGetValue(key, out var value))
					{
						value = new SankeyAggregatedLink(platformLink.Source, platformLink.Target);
						links.Add(key, value);
					}
					((SankeyAggregatedLink)value).AddLink(platformLink);
				}
				foreach (SankeyAggregatedLink value2 in links.Values)
				{
					value2.EndUpdate(calculator);
				}
			}
			return links.Values;
		}

		public void Reset()
		{
			links.Clear();
		}
	}
	public class SankeyAggregatedLink : ISankeyLink, IEqualityComparer<Tuple<object, object>>
	{
		private readonly List<ISankeyLink> links = new List<ISankeyLink>();

		private double totalWeight;

		public object Source { get; }

		public object Target { get; }

		public IEnumerable<ISankeyLink> Links => links;

		object ISankeyLink.Source => Source;

		object ISankeyLink.Target => Target;

		double ISankeyLink.Weight => totalWeight;

		public SankeyAggregatedLink(object source, object target)
		{
			Source = source;
			Target = target;
		}

		bool IEqualityComparer<Tuple<object, object>>.Equals(Tuple<object, object> x, Tuple<object, object> y)
		{
			bool flag = ((x.Item1 != null) ? x.Item1.Equals(y.Item1) : (y.Item1 == null));
			bool flag2 = ((x.Item2 != null) ? x.Item2.Equals(y.Item2) : (y.Item2 == null));
			return flag && flag2;
		}

		int IEqualityComparer<Tuple<object, object>>.GetHashCode(Tuple<object, object> obj)
		{
			return HashCodeHelper.CalculateGeneric<object, object>(obj.Item1, obj.Item2);
		}

		public void AddLink(ISankeyLink link)
		{
			links.Add(link);
		}

		public void EndUpdate(SankeyDataAggregator.SumCalculator calculator)
		{
			totalWeight = calculator.Calculate(links);
		}
	}

		internal bool TryFindParent(SankeyNodeLayoutInfo targetNode)
		{
			if (Index == targetNode.Index)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (sourceLinks != null)
			{
				foreach (SankeyLinkLayoutInfo sourceLink in sourceLinks)
				{
					if (sourceLink.Source.TryFindParent(targetNode))
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void SpreadLevelIndexToChildren(int startingIndex)
		{
			LevelIndex = Math.Max(LevelIndex, startingIndex);
			if (targetLinks == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (SankeyLinkLayoutInfo targetLink in targetLinks)
			{
				targetLink.Target.SpreadLevelIndexToChildren(LevelIndex + 1);
			}
		}

		internal void AddTargetLink(SankeyLinkLayoutInfo link)
		{
			if (targetLinks == null)

		internal void RemoveSourceLink(SankeyLinkLayoutInfo buffLink)
		{
			SourceWeight -= buffLink.Weight;
			SourceLinks.Remove(buffLink);
		}

	public class SankeyLinkLayoutInfo : ISankeyLinkLayoutItem
	{
		private double sourceYOffsetCoordinate;

		private double targetYOffsetCoordinate;

		private List<object> tags;

		public IEnumerable<ISankeyLink> Links { get; }

		public List<object> Tags
		{
			get
			{
				if (tags == null)
				{
					tags = Links.Select((ISankeyLink x) => ((NativeLink)x).Tag).ToList();
				}
				return tags;
			}
		}

		public SankeyNodeLayoutInfo Source { get; set; }

		public SankeyNodeLayoutInfo Target { get; set; }

		public double Weight { get; }

		public double SourceYOffsetCoordinate
		{
			get
			{
				return sourceYOffsetCoordinate;
			}
			internal set
			{
				sourceYOffsetCoordinate = value;
			}
		}

		public double TargetYOffsetCoordinate
		{
			get
			{
				return targetYOffsetCoordinate;
			}
			internal set
			{
				targetYOffsetCoordinate = value;
			}
		}

		public double Width
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_000c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0011: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				double weight = Weight;
				DXRectangle bounds = Source.Bounds;
				return weight * (double)((DXRectangle)(ref bounds)).Height / Source.TotalWeight;
			}
		}

		ISankeyNodeLayoutItem ISankeyLinkLayoutItem.Source => Source;

		ISankeyNodeLayoutItem ISankeyLinkLayoutItem.Target => Target;

		double ISankeyLinkLayoutItem.Weight => Weight;

		public SankeyLinkLayoutInfo(SankeyNodeLayoutInfo source, SankeyNodeLayoutInfo target, ISankeyLink link)
		{
			Source = source;
			Target = target;
			Links = ((link is SankeyAggregatedLink) ? new List<ISankeyLink>(((SankeyAggregatedLink)link).Links) : new List<ISankeyLink> { link });
			Weight = link.Weight;
		}
	}

		public static void ResolveOverlapping(ICollection<SankeyNodeLayoutInfo> nodes, List<SankeyLayoutLevel> levels)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < levels.Count - 1; i++)

		}

		private void CreateLevels(IEnumerable<ISankeyNodeLayoutItem> nodes)
		{

		}

		}

		{

			//IL_007f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

	public class SankeyNodeCreator
	{
		private static void SwapTargetNode(SankeyNodeLayoutInfo targetNode, SankeyNodeLayoutInfo newTargetNode)
		{
			while (true)
			{
				List<SankeyLinkLayoutInfo> sourceLinks = targetNode.SourceLinks;
				if (sourceLinks != null && sourceLinks.Count > 0)
				{
					SankeyLinkLayoutInfo sankeyLinkLayoutInfo = targetNode.SourceLinks[0];
					targetNode.RemoveSourceLink(sankeyLinkLayoutInfo);
					sankeyLinkLayoutInfo.Target = newTargetNode;
					newTargetNode.AddSourceLink(sankeyLinkLayoutInfo);
					continue;
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		private static List<SankeyNodeLayoutInfo> CreateNodes(ICollection<ISankeyLink> links)
		{
			List<SankeyNodeLayoutInfo> list = new List<SankeyNodeLayoutInfo>();
			Dictionary<object, SankeyNodeLayoutInfo> dictionary = new Dictionary<object, SankeyNodeLayoutInfo>();
			Dictionary<object, SankeyNodeLayoutInfo> dictionary2 = new Dictionary<object, SankeyNodeLayoutInfo>();
			int num = 0;
			foreach (ISankeyLink link2 in links)
			{
				SankeyNodeLayoutInfo value;
				bool flag = dictionary.TryGetValue(link2.Source, out value);
				if (!flag)
				{
					value = new SankeyNodeLayoutInfo(num++, link2.Source);
					dictionary.Add(link2.Source, value);
				}
				SankeyNodeLayoutInfo value2;
				bool flag2 = dictionary2.TryGetValue(link2.Target, out value2);
				if (!flag2)
				{
					flag2 = dictionary.TryGetValue(link2.Target, out value2);
				}
				if (!flag2)
				{
					value2 = new SankeyNodeLayoutInfo(num++, link2.Target);
					dictionary.Add(link2.Target, value2);
				}
				if (link2.Source.Equals(link2.Target) || (flag2 && flag && value.TryFindParent(value2)))
				{
					if (!dictionary2.TryGetValue(link2.Target, out var value3))
					{
						value3 = new SankeyNodeLayoutInfo(value2.Index, link2.Target);
						dictionary2.Add(link2.Target, value3);
						SwapTargetNode(value2, value3);
					}
					value2 = value3;
				}
				SankeyLinkLayoutInfo link = new SankeyLinkLayoutInfo(value, value2, link2);
				value.AddTargetLink(link);
				value2.AddSourceLink(link);
			}
			list.AddRange(dictionary.Values);
			list.AddRange(dictionary2.Values);
			return list;
		}

		public static List<SankeyNodeLayoutInfo> GetNodes(ICollection<ISankeyLink> links)
		{
			return CreateNodes(links);
		}
	}
	public class SankeyLayoutCalculatorChooser<T>
	{
		public static bool CalculateNodes(DXRectangle bounds, ICollection<SankeyNodeLayoutInfo> nodes, INodesCreator<T> nodesCreator, ISankeyLayoutOptionsProvider<T> layoutOptions)
		{
			//IL_002c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (layoutOptions.LayoutAlgorithm is ISankeyLinearLayoutAlgorithm)
			{
				return new LinearLayoutCalculator<T>((ISankeyLinearLayoutAlgorithm)layoutOptions.LayoutAlgorithm).Calculate(bounds, nodes, nodesCreator, layoutOptions);
			}
			return new DefaultLayoutCalculator().Calculate(bounds, nodes, layoutOptions.LayoutAlgorithm);
		}
	}
	public class DefaultLayoutCalculator
	{
		public bool Calculate(DXRectangle bounds, ICollection<SankeyNodeLayoutInfo> nodes, ISankeyLayoutAlgorithm layoutAlgorithm)
		{
			//IL_0021: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (((DXRectangle)(ref bounds)).Width == 0 || ((DXRectangle)(ref bounds)).Height == 0 || (nodes != null && nodes.Count == 0))
			{
				return false;
			}
			layoutAlgorithm.CalculateNodeBounds(nodes, bounds);
			foreach (SankeyNodeLayoutInfo node in nodes)
			{
				node.InitLinkCoordinates();
			}
			foreach (SankeyNodeLayoutInfo node2 in nodes)
			{
				node2.SortTargetAndSourceLinksRecursive();
			}
			return true;
		}
	}
	public class LinearLayoutCalculator<T>
	{
		private ISankeyLinearLayoutAlgorithm linearLayoutAlgorithm;

		public LinearLayoutCalculator(ISankeyLinearLayoutAlgorithm layoutAlgorithm)
		{
			linearLayoutAlgorithm = layoutAlgorithm;
		}

		private void InitLinearLayoutAlgorithm(INodesCreator<T> nodesCreator, ISankeyLayoutOptionsProvider<T> layoutOptions)
		{
			Comparison<SankeyNodeLayoutInfo> nodeComparison = null;
			if (nodesCreator != null && layoutOptions.NodeComparer != null)
			{
				nodeComparison = delegate(SankeyNodeLayoutInfo x, SankeyNodeLayoutInfo y)
				{
					T node = nodesCreator.GetNode(x);
					T node2 = nodesCreator.GetNode(y);
					return layoutOptions.NodeComparer.Compare(node, node2);
				};
			}
			linearLayoutAlgorithm.NodeComparison = nodeComparison;
			linearLayoutAlgorithm.ViewOptions = layoutOptions.ViewOptions;
		}

		public bool Calculate(DXRectangle bounds, ICollection<SankeyNodeLayoutInfo> nodes, INodesCreator<T> nodesCreator, ISankeyLayoutOptionsProvider<T> layoutOptions)
		{
			//IL_002f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00b2: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (((DXRectangle)(ref bounds)).Width == 0 || ((DXRectangle)(ref bounds)).Height == 0 || (nodes != null && nodes.Count == 0))
			{
				return false;
			}
			InitLinearLayoutAlgorithm(nodesCreator, layoutOptions);
			if (!linearLayoutAlgorithm.CalculateNodeBoundsInternal(nodes, bounds))
			{
				return false;
			}
			foreach (SankeyNodeLayoutInfo node in nodes)
			{
				node.InitLinkCoordinates();
			}
			foreach (SankeyNodeLayoutInfo node2 in nodes)
			{
				node2.SortTargetAndSourceLinksRecursive();
			}
			if (linearLayoutAlgorithm.ResolveOverlapping)
			{
				SankeyOverlappingResolver.ResolveOverlapping(nodes, linearLayoutAlgorithm.Levels);
			}
			linearLayoutAlgorithm.CalculateNodeBounds(nodes, bounds);
			foreach (SankeyNodeLayoutInfo node3 in nodes)
			{
				node3.SortTargetAndSourceLinksRecursive();
			}
			return true;
		}
	}

	public class SankeyBindingProcedure : BindingProcedure
	{
		private readonly ISankeyDataSourceProvider dataProvider;

		public SankeyBindingProcedure(ISankeyDataSourceProvider dataProvider)
			: base(null, dataProvider.DataSource, string.Empty, null)
		{
			this.dataProvider = dataProvider;
		}

		private object GetValue(IDataMemberContainer container)
		{
			if (!container.IsEmpty)
			{
				return container.BoxedValue;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private bool TryGetWeightDataMember(RowDataReader dataReader, out double value)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(dataProvider.WeightDataMember))
			{
				IDataMemberContainer<double> dataMemberContainer = dataReader.AdditionalContainers[dataProvider.WeightDataMember] as IDataMemberContainer<double>;
				if (!dataMemberContainer.IsEmpty)
				{
					value = dataMemberContainer.Value;
					return true;
				}
			}
			value = 0.0;
			return false;
		}

		private ISankeyLink CreateLink(object source, object target, object tag)
		{
			return new NativeLink(source, target, tag);
		}

		private ISankeyLink CreateLink(object source, object target, double weight, object tag)
		{
			return new NativeLink(source, target, weight, tag);
		}

		protected override List<IDataMemberContainer> CreateDataMemberContainers()
		{
			List<IDataMemberContainer> list = new List<IDataMemberContainer>();
			list.Add(new ObjectDataMemberContainer(dataProvider.SourceDataMember, allowDBNull: false, supportEmptyValue: false));
			list.Add(new ObjectDataMemberContainer(dataProvider.TargetDataMember, allowDBNull: false, supportEmptyValue: false));
			return list;
		}

		protected override Dictionary<string, IDataMemberContainer> CreateAdditionalDataMemberContainers()
		{
			Dictionary<string, IDataMemberContainer> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, IDataMemberContainer>();
			string weightDataMember = dataProvider.WeightDataMember;
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(weightDataMember))
			{
				dictionary.Add(dataProvider.WeightDataMember, new ValueNumericDataMemberContainer(dataProvider.WeightDataMember, supportEmptyValue: true));
			}
			if (dictionary.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return dictionary;
		}

		public ICollection<ISankeyLink> Process()
		{
			List<ISankeyLink> list = new List<ISankeyLink>();
			RowDataReader rowDataReader = CreateDataReader();
			if (rowDataReader != null)
			{
				DataBrowser val = BindingHelperCore.CreateListBrowser(base.BindingEnvironment, "");
				if (val != null && rowDataReader.CreateBrowsers(base.BindingEnvironment))
				{
					int position = val.Position;
					for (int i = 0; i < val.Count; i++)
					{
						val.Position = i;
						if (rowDataReader.Read())
						{
							object value = GetValue(rowDataReader.DataMemberContainers[0]);
							object value2 = GetValue(rowDataReader.DataMemberContainers[1]);
							double value3;
							ISankeyLink sankeyLink = ((!TryGetWeightDataMember(rowDataReader, out value3)) ? CreateLink(value, value2, val.Current) : CreateLink(value, value2, value3, val.Current));
							if (sankeyLink.Weight > 0.0)
							{
								list.Add(sankeyLink);
							}
						}
					}
					val.Position = position;
				}
			}
			return list;
		}
	}

namespace DevExpress.Charts.ChartData

	public interface IMinMaxValuesCalculator
	{
		double GetMinAbsValue(ICollection<RefinedSeries> seriesCollection);

		MinMaxValues GetMinMaxValues(ICollection<RefinedSeries> seriesCollection, IMinMaxValues rangeForFiltering, List<IAffectsAxisRange> indicators);
	}
	public class InteractionManager : IMinMaxValuesCalculator
	{
		private readonly Dictionary<object, SeriesContainer> containers = new Dictionary<object, SeriesContainer>();

		private readonly Dictionary<object, SeriesInteractionContainer> seriesGroupsContainers = new Dictionary<object, SeriesInteractionContainer>();

		public ICollection<SeriesContainer> InteractionContainers => containers.Values;

		public ICollection<object> InteractionContainersKeys => containers.Keys;

		public ICollection<SeriesInteractionContainer> SeriesGroupsInteractionContainers => seriesGroupsContainers.Values;

		private void FindIndex(SortedArgumentRefinedPointCollection points, IMinMaxValues range, out int minIndex, out int maxIndex)
		{
			minIndex = 0;
			maxIndex = -1;
			if (points.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			int indexByArgument = points.GetIndexByArgument(range.Min, fromRight: false, out var pointIsFound);
			if (indexByArgument <= points.Count - 1 || pointIsFound)
			{
				minIndex = indexByArgument;
				indexByArgument = points.GetIndexByArgument(range.Max, fromRight: true, out pointIsFound);
				if (indexByArgument <= 0 && !pointIsFound)
				{
					minIndex = 0;
				}
				else if (indexByArgument >= points.Count - 1)
				{
					maxIndex = points.Count - 1;
				}
				else if (!pointIsFound)
				{
					maxIndex = indexByArgument - 1;
				}
				else
				{
					maxIndex = indexByArgument;
				}
			}
		}

		private List<object> FindInteractionKeys(ICollection<RefinedSeries> seriesCollection)
		{
			List<object> list = new List<object>();
			foreach (RefinedSeries item in seriesCollection)
			{
				object key = GetKey(item);
				if (!list.Contains(key) && containers.ContainsKey(key))
				{
					list.Add(key);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		private SeriesContainer GetContainer(RefinedSeries refinedSeries, bool onlyExisting)
		{
			object key = GetKey(refinedSeries);
			SeriesContainer seriesContainer = null;
			if (containers.ContainsKey(key))
			{
				seriesContainer = containers[key];
			}
			else if (!onlyExisting)
			{
				seriesContainer = refinedSeries.SeriesView.CreateContainer();
				containers.Add(key, seriesContainer);
			}
			return seriesContainer;
		}

		private object GetKey(RefinedSeries refinedSeries)
		{
			if (refinedSeries.SeriesView.NeedSeriesInteraction && refinedSeries.SeriesView is IXYSeriesView view)
			{
				return new InteractionKey(view, isSideBySideInteraction: false);
			}
			return refinedSeries;
		}

		double IMinMaxValuesCalculator.GetMinAbsValue(ICollection<RefinedSeries> seriesCollection)
		{
			List<object> list = FindInteractionKeys(seriesCollection);
			double num = double.MaxValue;
			foreach (object item in list)
			{
				if (containers[item] is ISupportMinMaxValues supportMinMaxValues)
				{
					double absMinValue = supportMinMaxValues.GetAbsMinValue();
					if (!double.IsNaN(absMinValue) && absMinValue != 0.0)
					{
						num = Math.Min(num, absMinValue);
					}
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		MinMaxValues IMinMaxValuesCalculator.GetMinMaxValues(ICollection<RefinedSeries> seriesCollection, IMinMaxValues rangeForFiltering, List<IAffectsAxisRange> indicators)
		{
			MinMaxValues result = ((!MinMaxValues.IsEmptyValue(rangeForFiltering)) ? GetMinMaxValuesWithFiltering(seriesCollection, rangeForFiltering) : GetMinMaxValuesForWholePoints(seriesCollection));
			foreach (IAffectsAxisRange indicator in indicators)
			{
				result = result.Union(indicator.GetMinMaxValues(rangeForFiltering));
			}
			return result;
		}

		private MinMaxValues GetMinMaxValuesForWholePoints(ICollection<RefinedSeries> seriesCollection)
		{
			List<object> list = FindInteractionKeys(seriesCollection);
			MinMaxValues result = MinMaxValues.Empty;
			foreach (object item in list)
			{
				SeriesContainer seriesContainer = containers[item];
				if (seriesContainer.SeriesView is ISplineSeriesView { ShouldCorrectRanges: not false })
				{
					GeometryCalculator geometryCalculator = new GeometryCalculator();
					foreach (RefinedSeries item2 in seriesContainer.Series)
					{
						IList<IGeometryStrip> list2 = geometryCalculator.CreateStrips(item2);
						foreach (IBezierStrip item3 in list2)
						{
							MinMaxValues value = item3.CalculateMinMaxValues();
							result = result.Union(value);
						}
					}
				}
				if (seriesContainer is ISupportMinMaxValues supportMinMaxValues)
				{
					result.Union(supportMinMaxValues.Min);
					result.Union(supportMinMaxValues.Max);
				}
				if (seriesContainer.Series.Count > 0 && seriesContainer.Series[0] is HeatmapRefinedSeries heatmapRefinedSeries)
				{
					return new MinMaxValues(heatmapRefinedSeries.MinValue, heatmapRefinedSeries.MaxValue);
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private SeriesRangeCalculatorBase CreateRangeCalculator(ISeriesView seriesView)
		{
			if (IsStackedSeries(seriesView))
			{
				return new StackedSeriesRangeCalculator();
			}
			if (seriesView.MinMaxValuesAreSame)
			{
				return new SingleValueSeriesRangeCalculator();
			}
			return new SeriesRangeCalculator();
		}

		private MinMaxValues GetMinMaxValuesWithFiltering(ICollection<RefinedSeries> seriesCollection, IMinMaxValues rangeForFiltering)
		{
			List<object> list = FindInteractionKeys(seriesCollection);
			MinMaxValues result = MinMaxValues.Empty;
			foreach (object item in list)
			{
				SeriesContainer seriesContainer = containers[item];
				ISupportMinMaxValues supportMinMaxValues = seriesContainer as ISupportMinMaxValues;
				MinMaxValues empty = MinMaxValues.Empty;
				if (supportMinMaxValues != null)
				{
					empty.Union(supportMinMaxValues.Min);
					empty.Union(supportMinMaxValues.Max);
					foreach (RefinedSeries item2 in seriesContainer.Series)
					{
						ISeriesView seriesView = item2.SeriesView;
						if (!IsFullStackedSeries(seriesView))
						{
							FindIndex(item2.FinalPointsSortedByArgument, rangeForFiltering, out var minIndex, out var maxIndex);
							if (minIndex == 0 && maxIndex == item2.Points.Count - 1)
							{
								result = result.Union(empty);
								continue;
							}
							SeriesRangeCalculatorBase seriesRangeCalculatorBase = CreateRangeCalculator(seriesView);
							result = result.Union(seriesRangeCalculatorBase.GetMinMaxFromSeries(empty, seriesView, item2.FinalPointsSortedByArgument, minIndex, maxIndex));
						}
					}
					continue;
				}
				empty.UpdateZeroRange();
				return empty;
			}
			result.UpdateZeroRange();
			return result;
		}

		private SeriesInteractionContainer GetSeriesGroupsContainer(RefinedSeries refinedSeries, bool onlyExisting)
		{
			object seriesGroupsKey = GetSeriesGroupsKey(refinedSeries);
			SeriesInteractionContainer seriesInteractionContainer = null;
			if (seriesGroupsKey != null)
			{
				if (seriesGroupsContainers.ContainsKey(seriesGroupsKey))
				{
					seriesInteractionContainer = seriesGroupsContainers[seriesGroupsKey];
				}
				else if (!onlyExisting)
				{
					seriesInteractionContainer = refinedSeries.SeriesView.CreateSeriesGroupsContainer();
					seriesGroupsContainers.Add(seriesGroupsKey, seriesInteractionContainer);
				}
			}
			return seriesInteractionContainer;
		}

		private object GetSeriesGroupsKey(RefinedSeries refinedSeries)
		{
			if (refinedSeries.SeriesView.NeedSeriesGroupsInteraction)
			{
				return new InteractionKey(refinedSeries.SeriesView, isSideBySideInteraction: true);
			}
			return null;
		}

		private bool IsFullStackedSeries(ISeriesView view)
		{
			Type pointInterfaceType = view.PointInterfaceType;
			return pointInterfaceType.Equals(typeof(IFullStackedPoint));
		}

		private bool IsStackedSeries(ISeriesView view)
		{
			Type pointInterfaceType = view.PointInterfaceType;
			if (!pointInterfaceType.Equals(typeof(IStackedPoint)))
			{
				return pointInterfaceType.Equals(typeof(IWaterfallPoint));
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal MinMaxValues GetSeriesValuesRange(RefinedSeries series)
		{
			if (!(GetContainer(series, onlyExisting: true) is ISupportMinMaxValues supportMinMaxValues))
			{
				return default(MinMaxValues);
			}
			return new MinMaxValues(supportMinMaxValues.Min, supportMinMaxValues.Max);
		}

		internal void UpdatePoints(RefinedSeriesPointsUpdateInfo updateResult)
		{
			GetContainer(updateResult.RefinedSeries, onlyExisting: true)?.UpdatePoints(updateResult);
			GetSeriesGroupsContainer(updateResult.RefinedSeries, onlyExisting: true)?.UpdatePoints(updateResult);
		}

		public void AddSeries(RefinedSeries refinedSeries)
		{
			SeriesContainer container = GetContainer(refinedSeries, onlyExisting: false);
			if (container is SeriesInteractionContainer seriesInteractionContainer)
			{
				seriesInteractionContainer.AddSeries(refinedSeries);
			}
			else
			{
				((SingleSeriesContainer)container).SetRefinedSeries(refinedSeries);
			}
			GetSeriesGroupsContainer(refinedSeries, onlyExisting: false)?.AddSeries(refinedSeries);
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			containers.Clear();
			seriesGroupsContainers.Clear();
		}

		public void RecalculateFor(ICollection<RefinedSeries> seriesCollection)
		{
			List<object> list = FindInteractionKeys(seriesCollection);
			foreach (object item in list)
			{
				if (containers.ContainsKey(item))
				{
					containers[item].Recalculate();
				}
			}
		}

		public void RemoveSeries(RefinedSeries refinedSeries)
		{
			foreach (object key in containers.Keys)
			{
				SeriesContainer seriesContainer = containers[key];
				if (!seriesContainer.Contains(refinedSeries))
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (seriesContainer is SeriesInteractionContainer seriesInteractionContainer && seriesInteractionContainer.Contains(refinedSeries))
				{
					seriesInteractionContainer.RemoveSeries(refinedSeries);
					if (seriesContainer.IsEmpty)
					{
						containers.Remove(key);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					containers.Remove(key);
				}
				break;
			}
			foreach (object key2 in seriesGroupsContainers.Keys)
			{
				SeriesInteractionContainer seriesInteractionContainer2 = seriesGroupsContainers[key2];
				if (seriesInteractionContainer2.Contains(refinedSeries))
				{
					seriesInteractionContainer2.RemoveSeries(refinedSeries);
					if (seriesInteractionContainer2.IsEmpty)
					{
						seriesGroupsContainers.Remove(key2);
					}
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		public void UpdateSeriesGroupsKeys()
		{
			Dictionary<object, object> dictionary = new Dictionary<object, object>();
			foreach (object key in seriesGroupsContainers.Keys)
			{
				object seriesGroupsKey = GetSeriesGroupsKey(seriesGroupsContainers[key].Series[0]);
				if (!object.Equals(key, seriesGroupsKey))
				{
					dictionary.Add(key, seriesGroupsKey);
				}
			}
			foreach (object key2 in dictionary.Keys)
			{
				SeriesInteractionContainer value = seriesGroupsContainers[key2];
				seriesGroupsContainers.Remove(key2);
				seriesGroupsContainers.Add(dictionary[key2], value);
			}
		}

		public SeriesContainer GetSeriesContainer(RefinedSeries refinedSeries)
		{
			if (refinedSeries.SeriesView.Is3DView)
			{
				foreach (SeriesInteractionContainer seriesGroupsInteractionContainer in SeriesGroupsInteractionContainers)
				{
					if (seriesGroupsInteractionContainer.Contains(refinedSeries))
					{
						return seriesGroupsInteractionContainer;
					}
				}
			}
			foreach (SeriesContainer interactionContainer in InteractionContainers)
			{
				if (interactionContainer.Contains(refinedSeries))
				{
					return interactionContainer;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
	internal abstract class SeriesRangeCalculatorBase
	{
		protected class MinMaxValuesContainer
		{
			private double min = double.MaxValue;

			private double max = double.MinValue;

			public double Min => min;

			public double Max => max;

			public void UpdateMinMax(double pointMin, double pointMax)
			{
				if (min > pointMin)
				{
					min = pointMin;
				}
				if (max < pointMax)
				{
					max = pointMax;
				}
			}
		}

		protected abstract void UpdateMinMaxValues(MinMaxValuesContainer minMaxValues, ISeriesView view, RefinedPoint point);

		public MinMaxValues GetMinMaxFromSeries(MinMaxValues totalRange, ISeriesView view, SortedArgumentRefinedPointCollection points, int minIndexX, int maxIndexX)
		{
			int num = minIndexX;
			int num2 = maxIndexX;
			MinMaxValuesContainer minMaxValuesContainer = new MinMaxValuesContainer();
			while (num <= num2)
			{
				RefinedPoint refinedPoint = points[num];
				if (!refinedPoint.IsEmpty)
				{
					UpdateMinMaxValues(minMaxValuesContainer, view, refinedPoint);
				}
				refinedPoint = points[num2];
				if (!refinedPoint.IsEmpty)
				{
					UpdateMinMaxValues(minMaxValuesContainer, view, refinedPoint);
				}
				if (minMaxValuesContainer.Min == totalRange.Min && minMaxValuesContainer.Max == totalRange.Max)
				{
					break;
				}
				num++;
				num2--;
			}
			return new MinMaxValues(minMaxValuesContainer.Min, minMaxValuesContainer.Max);
		}
	}
	internal class StackedSeriesRangeCalculator : SeriesRangeCalculatorBase
	{
		protected override void UpdateMinMaxValues(MinMaxValuesContainer minMaxValues, ISeriesView view, RefinedPoint point)
		{
			minMaxValues.UpdateMinMax(((IStackedPoint)point).TotalMinValue, ((IStackedPoint)point).TotalMaxValue);
		}
	}
	internal class SingleValueSeriesRangeCalculator : SeriesRangeCalculatorBase
	{
		protected override void UpdateMinMaxValues(MinMaxValuesContainer minMaxValues, ISeriesView view, RefinedPoint point)
		{
			double refinedPointMax = view.GetRefinedPointMax(point);
			minMaxValues.UpdateMinMax(refinedPointMax, refinedPointMax);
		}
	}
	internal class SeriesRangeCalculator : SeriesRangeCalculatorBase
	{
		protected override void UpdateMinMaxValues(MinMaxValuesContainer minMaxValues, ISeriesView view, RefinedPoint point)
		{
			minMaxValues.UpdateMinMax(view.GetRefinedPointMin(point), view.GetRefinedPointMax(point));
		}
	}
}
namespace DevExpress.Charts.Heatmap

	public class HeatmapCell : IEquatable<HeatmapCell>
	{
		internal CellIndex Index { get; }

		public object XArgument { get; }

		public object YArgument { get; }

		public object ColorValue { get; }

		public object Tag { get; }

		public static bool operator ==(HeatmapCell a, HeatmapCell b)
		{
			if ((object)a == b)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if ((object)a == null || (object)b == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return a.Equals(b);
		}

		public static bool operator !=(HeatmapCell a, HeatmapCell b)
		{
			return !(a == b);
		}

		internal HeatmapCell(object xArgument, object yArgument, object colorValue, object tag, CellIndex cellIndex)
		{
			XArgument = xArgument;
			YArgument = yArgument;
			ColorValue = colorValue;
			Tag = tag;
			Index = cellIndex;
		}

		private bool AreEqual(object a, object b)
		{
			return a?.Equals(b) ?? (b == null);
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			HeatmapCell heatmapCell = obj as HeatmapCell;
			if (heatmapCell == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return Equals(heatmapCell);
		}

		public bool Equals(HeatmapCell heatmapCell)
		{
			if (heatmapCell.Index == Index && AreEqual(heatmapCell.XArgument, XArgument) && AreEqual(heatmapCell.YArgument, YArgument) && AreEqual(heatmapCell.ColorValue, ColorValue))
			{
				return AreEqual(heatmapCell.Tag, Tag);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return HashCodeHelper.CalculateGeneric<CellIndex, object, object, object, object>(Index, XArgument, YArgument, ColorValue, Tag);
		}
	}

namespace DevExpress.Charts.Heatmap.Native

	public class HeatmapBindingProcedure : BindingProcedure
	{
		private IHeatmapDataSourceProvider dataSourceProvider;

		public HeatmapBindingProcedure(IHeatmapDataSourceProvider dataSourceProvider)
			: base(null, dataSourceProvider.DataSource, string.Empty, null)
		{
			this.dataSourceProvider = dataSourceProvider;
		}

		public IList<HeatmapItem> Process(out MinMaxValues valueRange)
		{
			List<HeatmapItem> list = new List<HeatmapItem>();
			RowDataReader rowDataReader = CreateDataReader();
			valueRange = MinMaxValues.Empty;
			if (rowDataReader != null)
			{
				DataBrowser val = BindingHelperCore.CreateListBrowser(base.BindingEnvironment, "");
				if (val != null && rowDataReader.CreateBrowsers(base.BindingEnvironment))
				{
					for (int i = 0; i < val.Count; i++)
					{
						val.Position = i;
						if (rowDataReader.Read())
						{
							object boxedValue = rowDataReader.DataMemberContainers[0].BoxedValue;
							object boxedValue2 = rowDataReader.DataMemberContainers[1].BoxedValue;
							object boxedValue3 = rowDataReader.DataMemberContainers[2].BoxedValue;
							valueRange.Union(ObjectToDoubleConverter.ObjectToDouble(boxedValue3));
							if (boxedValue != null && boxedValue2 != null)
							{
								list.Add(new HeatmapItem(boxedValue, boxedValue2, boxedValue3, val.Current));
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected override Dictionary<string, IDataMemberContainer> CreateAdditionalDataMemberContainers()
		{
			return null;
		}

		protected override List<IDataMemberContainer> CreateDataMemberContainers()
		{
			List<IDataMemberContainer> list = new List<IDataMemberContainer>();
			list.Add(new ObjectDataMemberContainer(dataSourceProvider.XArgumentDataMember, allowDBNull: false, supportEmptyValue: false));
			list.Add(new ObjectDataMemberContainer(dataSourceProvider.YArgumentDataMember, allowDBNull: false, supportEmptyValue: false));
			list.Add(new ObjectDataMemberContainer(dataSourceProvider.ColorDataMember, allowDBNull: true));
			return list;
		}
	}
	public class HeatmapData : IAdditionalValuesProvider
	{
		private class UserValueComparer : IComparer<object>
		{
			private readonly IComparer userComparer;

			public UserValueComparer(IComparer userComparer)
			{
				this.userComparer = userComparer;
			}

			public int Compare(object x, object y)
			{
				return userComparer.Compare(x, y);
			}
		}

		private readonly IHeatmapAdapter adapter;

		private readonly IHeatmapDataSourceProvider dataSourceAdapter;

		private object[,] tags;

		public static HeatmapData Empty { get; } = new HeatmapData();

		public IList<object> XCoords { get; }

		public IList<object> YCoords { get; }

		public int[,] Colors { get; set; }

		public MinMaxValues ValueRange { get; private set; }

		public bool IsEmpty => this == Empty;

		private static IList<T> ToList<T>(IEnumerable items)
		{
			List<T> list = new List<T>();
			foreach (object item in items)
			{
				list.Add((T)item);
			}
			return list;
		}

		private static MinMaxValues CalculateValueRange(double[,] values)
		{
			MinMaxValues empty = MinMaxValues.Empty;
			int length = values.GetLength(0);
			int length2 = values.GetLength(1);
			for (int i = 0; i < length; i++)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < length2; j++)
				{
					empty.Union(values[i, j]);
				}
			}
			return empty;
		}

		private static HeatmapData GenerateData(double[,] values, IList<object> xArguments, IList<object> yArguments, MinMaxValues valueRange, IHeatmapMatrixProvider matrixProvider)
		{
			int num = Math.Min(xArguments.Count, values.GetLength(1));
			int num2 = Math.Min(yArguments.Count, values.GetLength(0));
			if (num == 0 || num2 == 0)
			{
				return Empty;
			}
			IList<object> firstItems = GetFirstItems(xArguments, num);
			IList<object> firstItems2 = GetFirstItems(yArguments, num2);
			return new HeatmapData(CreateMatrix(values, firstItems, firstItems2, valueRange, matrixProvider.ColorProvider), firstItems, firstItems2, null, valueRange, matrixProvider);
		}

		private static int[,] CreateMatrix(double[,] values, IList<object> xArguments, IList<object> yArguments, MinMaxValues valueRange, IHeatmapColorProvider colorProvider)
		{
			int xCount = xArguments.Count;
			int count = yArguments.Count;
			int[,] matrix = new int[count, xCount];
			if (colorProvider != null)
			{
				bool shouldConvertColor = colorProvider.ShouldConvertColorForMatrix;
				Parallel.For(0, count, delegate(int i)
				{
					Parallel.For(0, xCount, delegate(int j)
					{
						matrix[i, j] = (shouldConvertColor ? colorProvider.GetItemColor(new HeatmapItem(xArguments[j], yArguments[i], values[i, j], null), valueRange) : ((int)values[i, j]));
					});
				});
			}
			return matrix;
		}

		private static IList<object> GetFirstItems(IList<object> items, int n)
		{
			if (items.Count <= n)
			{
				return items;
			}
			List<object> list = new List<object>();
			for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
			{
				list.Add(items[i]);
			}
			return list;
		}

		private static HeatmapData CreateHeatmapData(IList<HeatmapItem> items, MinMaxValues valueRange, IHeatmapDataSourceProvider adapter)
		{
			IList<object> list = CreateAxisValues(items, (HeatmapItem item) => item.XArgument, adapter.XArgumentComparer);
			IList<object> list2 = CreateAxisValues(items, (HeatmapItem item) => item.YArgument, adapter.YArgumentComparer);
			object[,] array;
			int[,] colors = CreateMatrix(items, list, list2, valueRange, adapter.ColorProvider, out array);
			return new HeatmapData(colors, list, list2, array, valueRange, adapter);
		}

		private static IList<object> CreateAxisValues(IList<HeatmapItem> items, Func<HeatmapItem, object> valueGetter, IComparer valuesComparer)
		{
			HashSet<object> hashSet = new HashSet<object>();
			foreach (HeatmapItem item in items)
			{
				hashSet.Add(valueGetter(item));
			}
			List<object> list = hashSet.ToList();
			if (valuesComparer != null)
			{
				list.Sort(new UserValueComparer(valuesComparer));
			}
			else
			{
				list.Sort();
			}
			return list;
		}

		private static int[,] CreateMatrix(IList<HeatmapItem> items, IList<object> axisXValues, IList<object> axisYValues, MinMaxValues valueRange, IHeatmapColorProvider colorProvider, out object[,] tags)
		{
			Dictionary<object, int> xMapping = CreateAxisMapping(axisXValues);
			Dictionary<object, int> yMapping = CreateAxisMapping(axisYValues);
			int[,] matrix = new int[axisYValues.Count, axisXValues.Count];
			object[,] tagItems = new object[axisYValues.Count, axisXValues.Count];
			if (colorProvider != null)
			{
				Parallel.ForEach(items, delegate(HeatmapItem item)
				{
					int num = yMapping[item.YArgument];
					int num2 = xMapping[item.XArgument];
					matrix[num, num2] = colorProvider.GetItemColor(item, valueRange);
					tagItems[num, num2] = item.Tag;
				});
			}
			tags = tagItems;
			return matrix;
		}

		private static Dictionary<object, int> CreateAxisMapping(IList<object> axisValues)
		{
			Dictionary<object, int> dictionary = new Dictionary<object, int>();
			for (int i = 0; i < axisValues.Count; i++)
			{
				dictionary.Add(axisValues[i], i);
			}
			return dictionary;
		}

		private static bool MembersAreValid(IHeatmapDataSourceProvider dataSourceProvider)
		{
			if (dataSourceProvider.DataSource != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(dataSourceProvider.XArgumentDataMember) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(dataSourceProvider.YArgumentDataMember))
			{
				return !string.IsNullOrEmpty(dataSourceProvider.ColorDataMember);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static bool MembersAreValid(IHeatmapMatrixProvider matrixProvider)
		{
			if (matrixProvider.Values != null && matrixProvider.XArguments != null)
			{
				return matrixProvider.YArguments != null;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static HeatmapData Create(IHeatmapMatrixProvider matrixProvider)
		{
			if (!MembersAreValid(matrixProvider))
			{
				return Empty;
			}
			return GenerateData(matrixProvider.Values, ToList<object>(matrixProvider.XArguments), ToList<object>(matrixProvider.YArguments), CalculateValueRange(matrixProvider.Values), matrixProvider);
		}

		public static HeatmapData Create(IHeatmapDataSourceProvider dataSourceProvider)
		{
			if (!MembersAreValid(dataSourceProvider))
			{
				return Empty;
			}
			using HeatmapBindingProcedure heatmapBindingProcedure = new HeatmapBindingProcedure(dataSourceProvider);
			MinMaxValues valueRange;
			return CreateHeatmapData(heatmapBindingProcedure.Process(out valueRange), valueRange, dataSourceProvider);
		}

		private HeatmapData()
		{
			Colors = new int[0, 0];
			XCoords = new List<object>();
			YCoords = new List<object>();
		}

		public HeatmapData(int[,] colors, IList<object> xCoords, IList<object> yCoords, object[,] tags, MinMaxValues valueRange, IHeatmapAdapter adapter)
		{
			this.tags = tags;
			this.adapter = adapter;
			dataSourceAdapter = this.adapter as IHeatmapDataSourceProvider;
			Colors = colors;
			XCoords = xCoords;
			YCoords = yCoords;
			ValueRange = valueRange;
		}

		public object GetTag(int x, int y)
		{
			if (tags == null || y < 0 || y >= tags.GetLength(0) || x < 0 || x >= tags.GetLength(1))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return tags[y, x];
		}

		public object GetColorValue(int x, int y)
		{
			return adapter.GetColorValue(x, y);
		}

		public object GetCustomValue(int x, int y, string constant)
		{
			return dataSourceAdapter?.GetValue(x, y, constant);
		}

		public bool IsCellEmpty(int x, int y)
		{
			return adapter.IsCellEmpty(x, y);
		}

		public HeatmapCell GetCell(int x, int y)
		{
			return new HeatmapCell(XCoords[x], YCoords[y], GetColorValue(x, y), GetTag(x, y), new CellIndex(x, y));
		}

		public List<HeatmapCell> GetCellsByTagList(IList selectedItems)
		{
			List<HeatmapCell> list = new List<HeatmapCell>();
			if (selectedItems == null)
			{
				return list;
			}
			foreach (object selectedItem in selectedItems)
			{
				HeatmapCell heatmapCell = selectedItem as HeatmapCell;
				if (heatmapCell != null)
				{
					list.Add(heatmapCell);
				}
				else
				{
					if (tags == null)
					{
						continue;
					}
					for (int i = 0; i < tags.GetLength(0); i++)
					{
						for (int j = 0; j < tags.GetLength(1); j++)
						{
							if (selectedItem == tags[i, j])
							{
								list.Add(new HeatmapCell(XCoords[j], YCoords[i], Colors[i, j], tags[i, j], new CellIndex(j, i)));
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return list;
		}
	}

		public object YArgument { get; }

		public object Value { get; }

		public object Tag { get; }

		public HeatmapItem(object xArgument, object yArgument, object value, object tag)
		{
			XArgument = xArgument;
			YArgument = yArgument;
			Value = value;
			Tag = tag;
		}
	}
	public class HeatmapGeometry
	{
		private readonly IAdditionalValuesProvider emptyCellsProvider;

		private readonly Func<int, int> getLeftIndex;

		private readonly Func<int, int> getTopIndex;

		private readonly Func<int, int> getRightIndex;

		private readonly Func<int, int> getBottomIndex;

		private bool ReverseX { get; }

		private bool ReverseY { get; }

		public IList<int> XSeparators { get; }

		public IList<int> YSeparators { get; }

		public int FirstVisibleXIndex { get; }

		public int FirstVisibleYIndex { get; }

		public DXRectangle Bounds { get; }

		public static HeatmapGeometry Calculate(HeatmapRefinedSeries series, IAxisData axisX, IAxisData axisY, Func<double, double, DXPoint> getScreenPoint)
		{
			//IL_00e5: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00ea: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00f4: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00f9: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01d2: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			double minValueX = axisX.AxisScaleTypeMap.InternalToRefined(axisX.VisualRange.Min);
			double num = axisX.AxisScaleTypeMap.InternalToRefined(axisX.VisualRange.Max);
			double minValueY = axisY.AxisScaleTypeMap.InternalToRefined(axisY.VisualRange.Min);
			double num2 = axisY.AxisScaleTypeMap.InternalToRefined(axisY.VisualRange.Max);
			Limits limits = CalculateVisualCellIndexes(series.CellXCoords, minValueX, num);
			Limits limits2 = CalculateVisualCellIndexes(series.CellYCoords, minValueY, num2);
			if (!limits.IsValid || !limits2.IsValid)
			{
				return null;
			}
			DXPoint val = getScreenPoint(minValueX, num2);
			DXPoint val2 = getScreenPoint(num, minValueY);
			int screenWidth = Math.Abs(((DXPoint)(ref val2)).X - ((DXPoint)(ref val)).X);
			int screenHeight = Math.Abs(((DXPoint)(ref val2)).Y - ((DXPoint)(ref val)).Y);
			double refinedScreenWidth = num - minValueX;
			double refinedScreenHeight = num2 - minValueY;
			IList<int> xSeparators = ConvertToScreenCoord(series.CellXCoords, limits.Start, limits.End + 1, (double x) => Math.Min(Math.Max(0, ToVisualRangePixelCoord(x, minValueX, refinedScreenWidth, screenWidth, axisX.Reverse)), screenWidth));
			IList<int> ySeparators = ConvertToScreenCoord(series.CellYCoords, limits2.Start, limits2.End + 1, (double y) => Math.Min(Math.Max(0, ToVisualRangePixelCoord(y, minValueY, refinedScreenHeight, screenHeight, !axisY.Reverse)), screenHeight));
			return new HeatmapGeometry(xSeparators, ySeparators, limits.Start, limits2.Start, new DXPoint(Math.Min(((DXPoint)(ref val)).X, ((DXPoint)(ref val2)).X), Math.Min(((DXPoint)(ref val)).Y, ((DXPoint)(ref val2)).Y)), series.HeatmapData);
		}

		private static IList<int> ConvertToScreenCoord(IList<double> coords, int start, int end, Func<double, int> convert)
		{
			List<int> list = new List<int>();
			for (int i = start; i <= end; i++)
			{
				list.Add(convert(coords[i]));
			}
			return list;
		}

		private static Limits CalculateVisualCellIndexes(IList<double> values, double minRangeValue, double maxRangeValue)
		{
			if (values.Count == 0 || values[values.Count - 1] <= minRangeValue || values[0] >= maxRangeValue)
			{
				return Limits.Invalid;
			}
			int num = int.MinValue;
			int num2 = int.MinValue;
			for (int i = 0; i < values.Count - 1; i++)
			{
				if (values[i] <= minRangeValue)
				{
					num = i;
				}
				if (values[i] <= maxRangeValue)
				{
					num2 = i;
				}
			}
			if (num == int.MinValue)
			{
				num = 0;
			}
			if (num2 == int.MinValue)
			{
				num2 = values.Count - 1;
			}
			return new Limits(num, num2);
		}

		private static int ToVisualRangePixelCoord(double value, double min, double size, int visualRangePixelWidth, bool reverse)
		{
			double num = (value - min) / size;
			return (int)((reverse ? (1.0 - num) : num) * (double)visualRangePixelWidth);
		}

		public HeatmapGeometry(IList<int> xSeparators, IList<int> ySeparators, int firstVisibleXIndex, int firstVisibleYIndex, DXPoint location, IAdditionalValuesProvider emptyCellsProvider)
		{
			//IL_0249: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_024e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0242: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			this.emptyCellsProvider = emptyCellsProvider;
			XSeparators = xSeparators;
			YSeparators = ySeparators;
			FirstVisibleXIndex = firstVisibleXIndex;
			FirstVisibleYIndex = firstVisibleYIndex;
			ReverseX = xSeparators[0] > xSeparators[xSeparators.Count - 1];
			ReverseY = ySeparators[0] > ySeparators[ySeparators.Count - 1];
			if (ReverseX)
			{
				getLeftIndex = (int x) => x + 1;
				getRightIndex = (int x) => x;
			}
			else
			{
				getLeftIndex = (int x) => x;
				getRightIndex = (int x) => x + 1;
			}
			if (ReverseY)
			{
				getTopIndex = (int y) => y + 1;
				getBottomIndex = (int y) => y;
			}
			else
			{
				getTopIndex = (int y) => y;
				getBottomIndex = (int y) => y + 1;
			}
			int num = xSeparators[ReverseX ? (xSeparators.Count - 1) : 0] + ((DXPoint)(ref location)).X;
			int num2 = ySeparators[ReverseY ? (ySeparators.Count - 1) : 0] + ((DXPoint)(ref location)).Y;
			int num3 = xSeparators[(!ReverseX) ? (xSeparators.Count - 1) : 0] + ((DXPoint)(ref location)).X;
			int num4 = ySeparators[(!ReverseY) ? (ySeparators.Count - 1) : 0] + ((DXPoint)(ref location)).Y;
			Bounds = (DXRectangle)((xSeparators.Count == 0 || ySeparators.Count == 0) ? DXRectangle.Empty : new DXRectangle(num, num2, num3 - num, num4 - num2));
		}

		private int CalculateViewportCellAxisIndex(IList<int> separators, double coord, bool isIncreasing)
		{
			int num = -1;
			for (int i = 0; i < separators.Count && (isIncreasing ? (coord >= (double)separators[i]) : (coord < (double)separators[i])); i++)
			{
				num++;
			}
			return num;
		}

		private bool AreBoundsCorrect(int leftSeparatorIndex, int topSeparatorIndex, int rightSeparatorIndex, int bottomSeparatorIndex)
		{
			if (leftSeparatorIndex >= 0 && leftSeparatorIndex < XSeparators.Count && rightSeparatorIndex >= 0 && rightSeparatorIndex < XSeparators.Count && topSeparatorIndex >= 0 && topSeparatorIndex < YSeparators.Count && bottomSeparatorIndex >= 0)
			{
				return bottomSeparatorIndex >= YSeparators.Count;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private DXRectangle GetAbsoluteBounds(int leftSeparatorIndex, int topSeparatorIndex, int rightSeparatorIndex, int bottomSeparatorIndex, bool shouldCalcRelative = false)
		{

			{
				result = default(DXRectangle);
				return result;
			}
			int num = XSeparators[leftSeparatorIndex];
			int num2;

				result = Bounds;
				num2 = ((DXRectangle)(ref result)).Left;
			}
			else

		}

		private void DrawRect(int[] heatmap, int left, int top, int right, int bottom, int color, int screenWidth)
		{
			for (int i = top; i < bottom; i++)
			{
				int num = i * screenWidth;
				for (int j = left; j < right; j++)
				{
					heatmap[num + j] = color;
				}
			}
		}

		private List<DXRectangle> MergeLineCells(List<DXRectangle> cells)
		{
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0017: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			//IL_0051: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			//IL_002f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0030: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0031: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0075: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0039: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			List<DXRectangle> list = new List<DXRectangle>();
			DXRectangle val = DXRectangle.Empty;
			foreach (DXRectangle cell in cells)
			{
				DXRectangle current = cell;
				if (!((DXRectangle)(ref current)).IsEmpty)
				{
					val = (((DXRectangle)(ref val)).IsEmpty ? current : DXRectangle.Union(val, current));
				}
				else if (!((DXRectangle)(ref val)).IsEmpty)
				{
					list.Add(val);
					val = DXRectangle.Empty;
				}
			}
			if (!((DXRectangle)(ref val)).IsEmpty)
			{
				list.Add(val);
			}
			return list;
		}

		public int[] CreateHeatmap(HeatmapData heatmapData)
		{

		public DXRectangle GetCellBounds(CellIndex cellIndex, bool shouldCalcRelative = false)
		{
			//IL_0087: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (emptyCellsProvider.IsCellEmpty(cellIndex.X, cellIndex.Y))
			{
				return DXRectangle.Empty;
			}
			return GetAbsoluteBounds(getLeftIndex(cellIndex.X - FirstVisibleXIndex), getTopIndex(cellIndex.Y - FirstVisibleYIndex), getRightIndex(cellIndex.X - FirstVisibleXIndex), getBottomIndex(cellIndex.Y - FirstVisibleYIndex), shouldCalcRelative);
		}

		public List<DXRectangle> GetRowBounds(int rowIndex, bool shouldCalcRelative = false)
		{
			//IL_0019: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			List<DXRectangle> list = new List<DXRectangle>();
			for (int i = FirstVisibleXIndex; i < FirstVisibleXIndex + XSeparators.Count - 1; i++)
			{
				list.Add(GetCellBounds(new CellIndex(i, rowIndex), shouldCalcRelative));
			}
			return MergeLineCells(list);
		}

		public List<DXRectangle> GetColumnBounds(int columnIndex, bool shouldCalcRelative = false)
		{
			//IL_0019: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			List<DXRectangle> list = new List<DXRectangle>();
			for (int i = FirstVisibleYIndex; i < FirstVisibleYIndex + YSeparators.Count - 1; i++)
			{
				list.Add(GetCellBounds(new CellIndex(columnIndex, i), shouldCalcRelative));
			}
			return MergeLineCells(list);
		}

		public CellIndex CalculateCellIndex(DXPoint point)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0009: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			DXRectangle bounds = Bounds;
			if (!((DXRectangle)(ref bounds)).Contains(point))
			{
				return CellIndex.Invalid;
			}
			int x = ((DXPoint)(ref point)).X;
			bounds = Bounds;
			int num = x - ((DXRectangle)(ref bounds)).Left;
			int y = ((DXPoint)(ref point)).Y;
			bounds = Bounds;
			DXPoint val = default(DXPoint);
			((DXPoint)(ref val))..ctor(num, y - ((DXRectangle)(ref bounds)).Top);
			return new CellIndex(FirstVisibleXIndex + CalculateViewportCellAxisIndex(XSeparators, ((DXPoint)(ref val)).X, !ReverseX), FirstVisibleYIndex + CalculateViewportCellAxisIndex(YSeparators, ((DXPoint)(ref val)).Y, !ReverseY));
		}

	public class HeatmapPatternDataProvider : PatternDataProvider
	{
		private readonly string patternConstant;

		private readonly HeatmapData heatmapData;

		private CellIndex CellIndex => (CellIndex)base.Context;

		public HeatmapPatternDataProvider(string patternConstant, HeatmapData heatmapData)
		{
			this.patternConstant = patternConstant;
			this.heatmapData = heatmapData;
		}

		private object GetValue()
		{
			return patternConstant switch
			{
				"X" => heatmapData.XCoords[CellIndex.X], 
				"Y" => heatmapData.YCoords[CellIndex.Y], 
				"V" => heatmapData.GetColorValue(CellIndex.X, CellIndex.Y), 
				_ => heatmapData.GetCustomValue(CellIndex.X, CellIndex.Y, patternConstant), 
			};
		}

		protected override bool TryGetValue(out object value)
		{
			value = null;
			if (CellIndex.IsValid)
			{
				value = GetValue();
			}
			return value != null;
		}

		public override bool CheckContext(object value)
		{
			return value is CellIndex;
		}
	}

	public struct CellIndex : IEquatable<CellIndex>
	{
		public static readonly CellIndex Invalid = new CellIndex(-1, -1);

		public int Y { get; private set; }

		public int X { get; private set; }

		public bool IsValid
		{
			get
			{
				if (X >= 0)
				{
					return Y >= 0;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public static bool operator ==(CellIndex a, CellIndex b)
		{
			if (a.X == b.X)
			{
				return a.Y == b.Y;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool operator !=(CellIndex a, CellIndex b)
		{
			return !(a == b);
		}

		public CellIndex(int xIndex, int yIndex)
		{
			X = xIndex;
			Y = yIndex;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is CellIndex cellIndex))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return this == cellIndex;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return HashCodeHelper.CalculateGeneric<int, int>(X, Y);
		}

		public bool Equals(CellIndex other)
		{
			return this == other;
		}
	}
	public class HeatmapRefinedSeries : RefinedSeries
	{
		private HeatmapData heatmapData;

		public HeatmapData HeatmapData
		{
			get
			{
				return heatmapData;
			}
			set
			{
				heatmapData = value;
				UpdateRefinedCoords();
			}
		}

		public IList<double> CellXCoords { get; private set; }

		public IList<double> CellYCoords { get; private set; }

		public double MinValue
		{
			get
			{
				if (CellYCoords.Count <= 0)
				{
					return double.NaN;
				}
				return CellYCoords[0];
			}
		}

		public double MaxValue
		{
			get
			{
				if (CellYCoords.Count <= 0)
				{
					return double.NaN;
				}
				return CellYCoords[CellYCoords.Count - 1];
			}
		}

		public override ActualScaleTypeCore ArgumentScaleType => ActualScaleTypeCore.Qualitative;

		public override ActualScaleTypeCore ValueScaleType => ActualScaleTypeCore.Qualitative;

		protected internal override bool IsEmpty => HeatmapData.XCoords.Count * HeatmapData.YCoords.Count == 0;

		public HeatmapRefinedSeries(HeatmapData heatmapData, ISeries series, IRefinedSeriesContainer seriesContainer)
			: base(series, seriesContainer)
		{
			HeatmapData = heatmapData;
			UpdateRefinedCoords();
		}

		private void UpdateRefinedCoords()
		{
			List<AxisScaleTypeMap> argumentScaleMaps = GetArgumentScaleMaps();
			if (argumentScaleMaps.Count != 0)
			{
				CellXCoords = CreateCellCoords(HeatmapData.XCoords, argumentScaleMaps[0]);
				if (base.ValueGroup.ScaleMap != null)
				{
					CellYCoords = CreateCellCoords(HeatmapData.YCoords, base.ValueGroup.ScaleMap);
				}
			}
		}

		private IList<double> CreateCellCoords(IList<object> axisCoords, AxisScaleTypeMap scaleMap)
		{
			if (axisCoords.Count == 0)
			{
				return new List<double>();
			}
			List<double> list = new List<double>(axisCoords.Count + 1);
			double num = CalculateCellSize(axisCoords, scaleMap) / 2.0;
			for (int i = 0; i < axisCoords.Count; i++)
			{
				list.Add(scaleMap.NativeToRefined(axisCoords[i]) - num);
			}
			list.Add(scaleMap.NativeToRefined(axisCoords[axisCoords.Count - 1]) + num);
			return list;
		}

		private double CalculateCellSize(IList<object> axisCoords, AxisScaleTypeMap scaleMap)
		{
			double num = scaleMap.NativeToRefined(axisCoords[0]);
			if (axisCoords.Count == 1)
			{
				return scaleMap.GetNextRefinedValueByMeasureUnit(num) - num;
			}
			return scaleMap.NativeToRefined(axisCoords[1]) - num;
		}

		protected internal override void PopulateArgumentAxisScaleMap(AxisQualitativeMap qualitativeMap)
		{
			foreach (object xCoord in HeatmapData.XCoords)
			{
				qualitativeMap.AddValue(xCoord);
			}
		}

		protected internal override void PopulateArgument2AxisScaleMap(AxisQualitativeMap qualitativeMap)
		{
		}

		protected internal override void PopulateValueAxisScaleMap(AxisQualitativeMap qualitativeMap)
		{
			foreach (object yCoord in HeatmapData.YCoords)
			{
				qualitativeMap.AddValue(yCoord);
			}
		}

		public override double GetMinArgument(AxisScaleTypeMap scaleMap)
		{
			if (CellXCoords.Count <= 0)
			{
				return double.NaN;
			}
			return CellXCoords[0];
		}

		public override double GetMaxArgument(AxisScaleTypeMap scaleMap)
		{
			if (CellXCoords.Count <= 0)
			{
				return double.NaN;
			}
			return CellXCoords[CellXCoords.Count - 1];
		}

		public override void UpdateData()
		{
			UpdateRefinedCoords();
		}
	}

	public static class SimpleDiagramAutoLayoutHelper
	{
		public const int MaxDimension = 99;

		public const int MinDimension = 1;

		public static int CalculateDimension(int width, int height, int seriesCount)
		{
			return CalculateDimension(width, height, seriesCount, 99, 1);
		}

		public static int CalculateDimension(int width, int height, int seriesCount, int maxDimension, int minDimension)
		{
			double num = (double)width / (double)height * 0.5;
			int num2 = (int)Math.Max(1.0, Math.Round(Math.Sqrt((double)seriesCount / num)));
			return (int)Math.Min(maxDimension, Math.Max(minDimension, Math.Ceiling((double)seriesCount / (double)num2)));
		}
	}
	public class VisibilityCalculator
	{
		private struct VisibilityLayerKey
		{
			private readonly int priority;

			private readonly VisibilityElementOrientation orientation;

			public int Priority => priority;

			public VisibilityElementOrientation Orientation => orientation;

			public VisibilityLayerKey(ISupportVisibilityControlElement element)
			{
				priority = element.Priority;
				orientation = element.Orientation;
			}
		}

		private class VisibilityLayerKeyComparer : IComparer<VisibilityLayerKey>
		{
			public int Compare(VisibilityLayerKey x, VisibilityLayerKey y)
			{
				if (x.Priority != y.Priority)
				{
					return x.Priority.CompareTo(y.Priority);
				}
				return ((int)x.Orientation).CompareTo((int)y.Orientation);
			}
		}

		private readonly GRealSize2D minimumSize;

		private readonly VisibilityLayerKeyComparer visibilityLayerKeyComparer = new VisibilityLayerKeyComparer();

		private static bool IsValidSize(double newSize, double size, double minimumSize)
		{
			if (newSize != size)
			{
				return newSize >= minimumSize;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal static GRealSize2D DecreaseSizeByWidth(GRealSize2D initialSize, GRealSize2D size)
		{
			if (size.IsEmpty || double.IsInfinity(size.Width))
			{
				return initialSize;
			}
			double num = initialSize.Width - size.Width;
			if (!(num > 0.0))
			{
				return GRealSize2D.Empty;
			}
			return new GRealSize2D(num, initialSize.Height);
		}

		internal static GRealSize2D DecreaseSizeByHeight(GRealSize2D initialSize, GRealSize2D size)
		{
			if (size.IsEmpty || double.IsInfinity(size.Height))
			{
				return initialSize;
			}
			double num = initialSize.Height - size.Height;
			if (!(num > 0.0))
			{
				return GRealSize2D.Empty;
			}
			return new GRealSize2D(initialSize.Width, num);
		}

		internal static GRealSize2D DecreaseSizeByWidthAndHeight(GRealSize2D initialSize, GRealSize2D size)
		{
			if (size.IsEmpty || double.IsInfinity(size.Height) || double.IsInfinity(size.Width))
			{
				return initialSize;
			}
			double num = initialSize.Width - size.Width;
			double num2 = initialSize.Height - size.Height;
			if (!(num > 0.0) || !(num2 > 0.0))
			{
				return GRealSize2D.Empty;
			}
			return new GRealSize2D(num, num2);
		}

		internal static GRealSize2D DecreaseSizeProportional(GRealSize2D initialSize, GRealSize2D size)
		{
			if (size.IsEmpty || double.IsInfinity(size.Height) || double.IsInfinity(size.Width))
			{
				return initialSize;
			}
			double num = initialSize.Width * initialSize.Height;
			double num2 = size.Width * size.Height;
			if (num2 == 0.0)
			{
				return initialSize;
			}
			if (num <= num2 || initialSize.Width <= size.Width || initialSize.Height <= size.Height)
			{
				return GRealSize2D.Empty;
			}
			double num3 = initialSize.Height / initialSize.Width;
			double num4 = Math.Sqrt((num - num2) * num3);
			return new GRealSize2D(num4 / num3, num4);
		}

		public VisibilityCalculator(GRealSize2D minimumSize)
		{
			this.minimumSize = minimumSize;
		}

		private void ApplyVisibility(Dictionary<ISupportVisibilityControlElement, bool> elementsVisibility)
		{
			foreach (KeyValuePair<ISupportVisibilityControlElement, bool> item in elementsVisibility)
			{
				item.Key.Visible = item.Value;
			}
		}

		private void SetVisibility(List<bool[]> visibility, int index, bool value)
		{
			int num = index;
			foreach (bool[] item in visibility)
			{
				if (num >= item.Length)
				{
					num -= item.Length;
					continue;
				}
				item[num] &= value;
				break;
			}
		}

		private bool IsValidSize(GRealSize2D initialLayoutSize, GRealSize2D layoutSize, GRealSize2D newLayoutSize)
		{
			double num = Math.Max(0.5 * initialLayoutSize.Width, minimumSize.Width);
			double num2 = Math.Max(0.5 * initialLayoutSize.Height, minimumSize.Height);
			if (IsValidSize(newLayoutSize.Width, layoutSize.Width, num))
			{
				return !IsValidSize(newLayoutSize.Height, layoutSize.Height, num2);
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool[] CreateVisibilityMask(int count)
		{
			bool[] array = new bool[count];
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				array[i] = true;
			}
			return array;
		}

		private List<ISupportVisibilityControlElement> GetChangedElements(Dictionary<ISupportVisibilityControlElement, bool> elementsVisibility)
		{
			List<ISupportVisibilityControlElement> list = new List<ISupportVisibilityControlElement>();
			foreach (KeyValuePair<ISupportVisibilityControlElement, bool> item in elementsVisibility)
			{
				if (item.Value != item.Key.Visible)
				{
					list.Add(item.Key);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		private SortedList<VisibilityLayerKey, List<ISupportVisibilityControlElement>> GetLayers(List<ISupportVisibilityControlElement> elements)
		{
			SortedList<VisibilityLayerKey, List<ISupportVisibilityControlElement>> sortedList = new SortedList<VisibilityLayerKey, List<ISupportVisibilityControlElement>>(visibilityLayerKeyComparer);
			foreach (ISupportVisibilityControlElement element in elements)
			{
				if (element != null)
				{
					VisibilityLayerKey key = new VisibilityLayerKey(element);
					List<ISupportVisibilityControlElement> list;
					if (sortedList.ContainsKey(key))
					{
						list = sortedList[key];
					}
					else
					{
						list = new List<ISupportVisibilityControlElement>();
						sortedList.Add(key, list);
					}
					list.Add(element);
				}
			}
			return sortedList;
		}

		private GRealSize2D CalculateVisibility(GRealSize2D layoutSize, List<ISupportVisibilityControlElement> elements, List<bool[]> visibility)
		{
			SortedList<VisibilityLayerKey, List<ISupportVisibilityControlElement>> layers = GetLayers(elements);
			List<VisibilityElementOrientation> list = new List<VisibilityElementOrientation>();
			GRealSize2D initialLayoutSize = layoutSize;
			if (!layoutSize.IsEmpty)
			{
				foreach (KeyValuePair<VisibilityLayerKey, List<ISupportVisibilityControlElement>> item in layers)
				{
					bool value = true;
					if (!list.Contains(item.Key.Orientation))
					{
						foreach (ISupportVisibilityControlElement item2 in item.Value)
						{
							GRealSize2D gRealSize2D = DecreaseLayoutSize(layoutSize, item2.Bounds, item2.Orientation);
							if (gRealSize2D.IsEmpty || IsValidSize(initialLayoutSize, layoutSize, gRealSize2D))
							{
								value = false;
								list.Add(item.Key.Orientation);
								break;
							}
							layoutSize = gRealSize2D;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						value = false;
					}
					foreach (ISupportVisibilityControlElement item3 in item.Value)
					{
						int index = elements.IndexOf(item3);
						SetVisibility(visibility, index, value);
					}
				}
			}
			return layoutSize;
		}

		private GRealSize2D DecreaseLayoutSize(GRealSize2D layoutSize, GRealRect2D elementBounds, VisibilityElementOrientation elementOrientation)
		{
			return elementOrientation switch
			{
				VisibilityElementOrientation.Horizontal => DecreaseSizeByHeight(layoutSize, elementBounds.Size), 
				VisibilityElementOrientation.Vertical => DecreaseSizeByWidth(layoutSize, elementBounds.Size), 
				VisibilityElementOrientation.Corner => DecreaseSizeByWidthAndHeight(layoutSize, elementBounds.Size), 
				VisibilityElementOrientation.Inside => DecreaseSizeProportional(layoutSize, elementBounds.Size), 
				_ => throw new ArgumentException("An unknown element orientation."), 
			};
		}

		public List<ISupportVisibilityControlElement> CalculateLayout(List<ISupportVisibilityControlElement> chartElements, List<VisibilityLayoutRegion> regions)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			Dictionary<object, bool> oldVisibility = new Dictionary<object, bool>();
			Dictionary<ISupportVisibilityControlElement, bool> dictionary = new Dictionary<ISupportVisibilityControlElement, bool>();
			List<ISupportVisibilityControlElement> list = new List<ISupportVisibilityControlElement>();
			bool[] array = CreateVisibilityMask(chartElements.Count);
			StoreVisibility(oldVisibility, chartElements);
			foreach (VisibilityLayoutRegion region in regions)
			{
				if (region.Size.IsEmpty)
				{
					continue;
				}
				flag = true;
				GRealSize2D layoutSize = region.Size;
				if (region.ElementsToRemove != null && region.ElementsToRemove.Count > 0)
				{
					foreach (ISupportVisibilityControlElement item in region.ElementsToRemove)
					{
						layoutSize = DecreaseLayoutSize(layoutSize, item.Bounds, item.Orientation);
					}
				}
				bool[] array2 = CreateVisibilityMask(region.Elements.Count);
				List<ISupportVisibilityControlElement> list2 = new List<ISupportVisibilityControlElement>();
				list2.AddRange(chartElements);
				list2.AddRange(region.Elements);
				StoreVisibility(oldVisibility, region.Elements);
				List<bool[]> list3 = new List<bool[]>();
				list3.Add(array);
				list3.Add(array2);
				CalculateVisibility(layoutSize, list2, list3);
				StoreVisibility(dictionary, region.Elements, array2);
				StoreVisibility(dictionary, chartElements, array);
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				list.AddRange(GetChangedElements(dictionary));
				ApplyVisibility(dictionary);
			}
			return list.FindAll((ISupportVisibilityControlElement x) => oldVisibility[x] != x.Visible);
		}

		private void StoreVisibility(Dictionary<object, bool> startVisibility, List<ISupportVisibilityControlElement> list)
		{
			foreach (ISupportVisibilityControlElement item in list)
			{
				if (!startVisibility.ContainsKey(item))
				{
					startVisibility.Add(item, item.Visible);
				}
			}
		}

		private void StoreVisibility(Dictionary<ISupportVisibilityControlElement, bool> visibilityElements, List<ISupportVisibilityControlElement> list, bool[] visibility)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
			{
				if (!visibilityElements.ContainsKey(list[i]))
				{
					visibilityElements.Add(list[i], visibility[i]);
					continue;
				}
				ISupportVisibilityControlElement key = list[i];
				visibilityElements[key] &= visibility[i];
			}
		}
	}

	public abstract class AxesLayoutInteractionManagerBase
	{
		private readonly IAxisData primaryAxisX;

		private readonly IAxisData primaryAxisY;

		private readonly List<GRealRect2D> insideAxesLabelBounds = new List<GRealRect2D>();

		private readonly bool isZeroMode;

		private double? intersectionValueX;

		private double? intersectionValueY;

		private IAxisLabelLayout intersectionLabelLayoutX;

		private bool labelXIsOutside = true;

		private AxisLabelOverlappingResolver axisXOverlappingResolver;

		protected IAxisData PrimaryAxisX => primaryAxisX;

		protected IAxisData PrimaryAxisY => primaryAxisY;

		protected AxesLayoutInteractionManagerBase(IAxisData axisX, IAxisData axisY, bool isZeroMode)
		{
			primaryAxisX = axisX;
			primaryAxisY = axisY;
			this.isZeroMode = isZeroMode;
		}

		private bool IsPrimaryAxis(IAxisData axis)
		{
			if (axis != primaryAxisX)
			{
				return axis == primaryAxisY;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected abstract double? GetIntersectionValueX();

		protected abstract double? GetIntersectionValueY();

		protected void ProcessIntersectionLabelLayout(IAxisData axis, IAxisLabelLayout intersectionLabelLayout, AxisLabelOverlappingResolver overlappingResolver, bool outsideLabels, int axisThickness, ITickmarksOwner tickmarks, double indentToAxis)
		{
			if (IsPrimaryAxis(axis))
			{
				if (axis == primaryAxisX)
				{
					intersectionLabelLayoutX = intersectionLabelLayout;
					labelXIsOutside = outsideLabels;
					axisXOverlappingResolver = overlappingResolver;
				}
				else
				{
					if (isZeroMode)
					{
						AxisLabelOffsetCalculator.CorrectLabelForZeroMode(intersectionLabelLayoutX, intersectionLabelLayout, primaryAxisX, primaryAxisY, axisThickness, tickmarks, 0.0, outsideLabels, intersectionIsVisible: true);
					}
					else
					{
						AxisLabelOffsetCalculator.CorrectSpecialLabelForCenterMode(intersectionLabelLayoutX, intersectionLabelLayout, primaryAxisX, primaryAxisY, labelXIsOutside, outsideLabels, indentToAxis);
					}
					overlappingResolver?.ProcessLabelsThinOut(GRealRect2D.Empty);
				}
				if (axisXOverlappingResolver != null)
				{
					axisXOverlappingResolver.ProcessLabelsThinOut(GRealRect2D.Empty);
				}
			}
			foreach (GRealRect2D insideAxesLabelBound in insideAxesLabelBounds)
			{
				overlappingResolver.ProcessLabelsThinOut(insideAxesLabelBound);
			}
		}

		protected double? GetIntersectionInternalValue(IAxisData axis)
		{
			if (IsPrimaryAxis(axis))
			{
				if (axis == primaryAxisX)
				{
					if (!intersectionValueX.HasValue)
					{
						double? num = GetIntersectionValueX();
						if (num.HasValue && GeometricUtils.IsValidDouble(num.Value))
						{
							intersectionValueX = num.Value;
						}
					}
					return intersectionValueX;
				}
				if (!intersectionValueY.HasValue)
				{
					double? num2 = GetIntersectionValueY();
					if (num2.HasValue && GeometricUtils.IsValidDouble(num2.Value))
					{
						intersectionValueY = num2.Value;
					}
				}
				return intersectionValueY;
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected void CacheAxisLabelBounds(GRealRect2D bounds)
		{
			if (!bounds.IsEmpty)
			{
				insideAxesLabelBounds.Add(bounds);
			}
		}

		protected void ClearAxesLabelBounds()
		{
			insideAxesLabelBounds.Clear();
		}
	}
	public class InterimValueCalculator
	{
		public static double? Calculate(double value, IAxisData axis, DXRectangle mappingBounds, List<AxisIntervalLayout> intervalsLayout, out bool outOfRange)
		{
			int num = (axis.IsVertical ? ((DXRectangle)(ref mappingBounds)).Height : ((DXRectangle)(ref mappingBounds)).Width);
			double? num2 = null;
			outOfRange = false;
			if (intervalsLayout != null && intervalsLayout.Count > 0)
			{
				double min = intervalsLayout[0].Range.Min;
				double max = intervalsLayout[intervalsLayout.Count - 1].Range.Max;
				if (min >= 0.0)
				{
					num2 = 0.0;
					outOfRange = true;
				}
				else if (max <= 0.0)
				{
					num2 = num;
					outOfRange = true;
				}
				else
				{
					num2 = GetCoord(value, axis, intervalsLayout);
				}
				if (num2.HasValue && axis.Reverse)
				{
					num2 = (double)num - num2;
				}
			}
			return num2;
		}

		private static double? GetCoord(double value, IAxisData axis, List<AxisIntervalLayout> intervalsLayout)
		{
			foreach (AxisIntervalLayout item in intervalsLayout)
			{
				if (item != null && item.ValueWithinRange(value))
				{
					AxisIntervalLayoutMapping axisIntervalLayoutMapping = new AxisIntervalLayoutMapping(item, axis.AxisScaleTypeMap.Transformation);
					return axisIntervalLayoutMapping.GetCoord(value);
				}
			}
			return null;
		}
	}

	public class AxisDateTimeGridMapping : AxisGridMapping
	{
		private readonly DateTimeMeasureUnitNative alignment;

		protected new AxisDateTimeMap Map => (AxisDateTimeMap)base.Map;

		public override double Offset => base.Offset / (double)Map.MeasureUnitMultiplier;

		public AxisDateTimeGridMapping(AxisDateTimeMap map, DateTimeGridAlignmentNative alignment, double offset)
			: base(map, offset)
		{
			//IL_000a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			this.alignment = (DateTimeMeasureUnitNative)alignment;
		}

		public override double InternalToAligned(double internalValue)
		{
			//IL_0043: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0021: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (internalValue >= 0.0)
			{
				double value = Map.InternalToRefined(internalValue);
				return Map.RefinedToInternal(value, alignment, 1);
			}
			double value2 = Map.InternalToRefined(0.0 - internalValue);
			return 0.0 - Map.RefinedToInternal(value2, alignment, 1);
		}

		public override double AlignedToInternal(double alignedValue)
		{
			//IL_0061: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0014: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (alignedValue >= 0.0)
			{
				object value = Map.InternalToNativeAligned(alignedValue, alignment, 1.0);
				double num = Map.NativeToRefined(value);
				if (num == 0.0)
				{
					return 0.0;
				}
				return Map.RefinedToInternalExact(num);
			}
			object value2 = Map.InternalToNativeAligned(0.0 - alignedValue, alignment, 1.0);
			double num2 = Map.NativeToRefined(value2);
			if (num2 == 0.0)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			return 0.0 - Map.RefinedToInternalExact(num2);
		}
	}
	public class AxisTimeSpanGridMapping : AxisGridMapping
	{
		private readonly TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative alignment;

		protected new AxisTimeSpanMap Map => (AxisTimeSpanMap)base.Map;

		public AxisTimeSpanGridMapping(AxisTimeSpanMap map, TimeSpanGridAlignmentNative alignment, double offset)

		public override double InternalToAligned(double internalValue)
		{
			if (internalValue >= 0.0)
			{
				double value = Map.InternalToRefined(internalValue);
				return Map.RefinedToInternal(value, alignment, 1.0);
			}
			double value2 = Map.InternalToRefined(0.0 - internalValue);
			return 0.0 - Map.RefinedToInternal(value2, alignment, 1.0);
		}

		public override double AlignedToInternal(double alignedValue)
		{
			if (alignedValue >= 0.0)
			{
				object value = Map.InternalToNative(alignedValue, alignment, 1.0);
				double num = Map.NativeToRefined(value);
				if (num == 0.0)
				{
					return 0.0;
				}
				return Map.RefinedToInternalExact(num);
			}
			object value2 = Map.InternalToNative(0.0 - alignedValue, alignment, 1.0);
			double num2 = Map.NativeToRefined(value2);
			if (num2 == 0.0)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			return 0.0 - Map.RefinedToInternalExact(num2);
		}
	}
	public class AxisNumericGridMapping : AxisGridMapping
	{
		private readonly double alignment;

		private readonly NumericStartPointCore gridAlignmentStartPoint;

		private AxisNumericalMap NumericMap => (AxisNumericalMap)base.Map;

		public override bool CanFloorAlignedValue => gridAlignmentStartPoint == NumericStartPointCore.Zero;

		public AxisNumericGridMapping(AxisNumericalMap map, double alignment, double offset, NumericStartPointCore gridAlignmentStartPoint)
			: base(map, offset)
		{
			this.alignment = alignment;
			this.gridAlignmentStartPoint = gridAlignmentStartPoint;
		}

		public override double InternalToAligned(double internalValue)
		{
			if (NumericMap.MeasureUnit.HasValue)
			{
				return internalValue / (alignment / NumericMap.MeasureUnit.Value);
			}
			return internalValue / alignment;
		}

		public override double AlignedToInternal(double alignedValue)
		{
			if (NumericMap.MeasureUnit.HasValue)
			{
				return alignedValue * (alignment / NumericMap.MeasureUnit.Value);
			}
			return alignedValue * alignment;
		}
	}

			: base(map, offset)

		}
