			string text = (string)base.Map.InternalToNative(alignedValue);
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return text;
		}

		public override double AlignedToInternal(double alignedValue)
		{
			return alignedValue;
		}
	}
	public class AxisIntervalLayout
	{
		private readonly AxisInterval axisInterval;

		private readonly Interval interval;

		public Interval Bounds => interval;

		public double End => interval.End;

		public AxisInterval Interval => axisInterval;

		public IMinMaxValues Range => axisInterval.Range;

		public double Start => interval.Start;

		private static AxisIntervalLayout CreateIntervalLayout(AxisInterval interval, double position, double nextPosition)
		{
			int num = GeometricUtils.StrongRound(position);
			int num2 = GeometricUtils.StrongRound(nextPosition);
			return new AxisIntervalLayout(interval, num, Math.Max(num2 - num, 0));
		}

		public static List<AxisIntervalLayout> CreateIntervalsLayout(IIntervalContainer intervalContainer, int totalLength)
		{
			return CreateIntervalsLayout(intervalContainer.Intervals, totalLength, intervalContainer.IntervalsDistance);
		}

		public static List<AxisIntervalLayout> CreateIntervalsLayout(IList<AxisInterval> intervals, int totalLength, int separator)
		{
			List<AxisIntervalLayout> list = new List<AxisIntervalLayout>();
			if (intervals == null || intervals.Count == 0)
			{
				ChartDebug.Fail("At least one interval expected.");
				return list;
			}
			if (separator < 0)
			{
				ChartDebug.Fail("The separator should be greater than or equal to zero.");
				separator = 0;
			}
			int num = totalLength - separator * (intervals.Count - 1);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				foreach (AxisInterval interval in intervals)
				{
					list.Add(new AxisIntervalLayout(interval, 0, 0));
				}
				return list;
			}
			double num2 = 0.0;
			foreach (AxisInterval interval2 in intervals)
			{
				num2 += interval2.Delta;
			}
			double num3 = 0.0;
			for (int i = 0; i < intervals.Count - 1; i++)
			{
				double num4 = num3 + (double)num * intervals[i].Delta / num2;
				list.Add(CreateIntervalLayout(intervals[i], num3, num4));
				num3 = num4 + (double)separator;
			}
			list.Add(CreateIntervalLayout(intervals[intervals.Count - 1], num3, totalLength));
			return list;
		}

		public AxisIntervalLayout(AxisInterval axisInterval, int position, int length)
		{
			this.axisInterval = axisInterval;
			interval = new Interval(position, position + length);
		}

		public bool ValueWithinRange(double value)
		{
			if (value >= axisInterval.Range.Min)
			{
				return value <= axisInterval.Range.Max;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	public interface IIntervalContainer
	{
		IList<AxisInterval> Intervals { get; set; }

		int IntervalsDistance { get; }
	}
	public class AxisIntervalLayoutMapping
	{
		private readonly AxisIntervalLayout axisIntervalLayout;

		private readonly double deltaRange;

		private readonly bool isIdentityTransform;

		private readonly bool isZeroRange;

		private readonly double min;

		private readonly MinMaxValues minMaxValue;

		private readonly double start;

		private readonly ITransformation transformation;

		private AxisInterval axisInterval;

		private Interval interval;

		private MinMaxValues minMax;

		public double Min => min;

		public double Max => minMaxValue.Max;

		public AxisIntervalLayoutMapping(AxisIntervalLayout axisIntervalLayout, ITransformation transformation)
		{
			this.axisIntervalLayout = axisIntervalLayout;
			this.transformation = transformation;
			minMaxValue = new MinMaxValues(transformation.TransformForward(axisIntervalLayout.Range.Min), transformation.TransformForward(axisIntervalLayout.Range.Max));
			isZeroRange = minMaxValue.IsZeroRange;
			if (isZeroRange)
			{
				deltaRange = 1.0;
			}
			else
			{
				deltaRange = 1.0 / minMaxValue.Delta * this.axisIntervalLayout.Bounds.Length;
			}
			start = this.axisIntervalLayout.Bounds.Start;
			min = minMaxValue.Min;
			isIdentityTransform = transformation is IdentityTransformation;
			UpdateTemporaryValues();
		}

		public double GetClampedCoordCore(double value)
		{
			Interval bounds = axisIntervalLayout.Bounds;
			return AxisCoordCalculator.GetClampedCoord(minMaxValue, transformation.TransformForward(value), bounds.Length) + bounds.Start;
		}

		private void UpdateTemporaryValues()
		{
			axisInterval = axisIntervalLayout.Interval;
			interval = axisIntervalLayout.Bounds;
			minMax = new MinMaxValues(transformation.TransformForward(axisInterval.Range.Min), transformation.TransformForward(axisInterval.Range.Max));
		}

		public double GetClampedCoord(double value)
		{
			return AxisCoordCalculator.GetClampedCoord(minMax, transformation.TransformForward(value), interval.Length) + interval.Start;
		}

		public double GetCoord(double value)
		{
			return AxisCoordCalculator.GetCoord(minMax, transformation.TransformForward(value), interval.Length) + interval.Start;
		}

		public double GetCoordCore(double value)
		{
			Interval bounds = axisIntervalLayout.Bounds;
			return AxisCoordCalculator.GetCoord(minMaxValue, transformation.TransformForward(value), bounds.Length) + bounds.Start;
		}

		public double GetCoordCoreRound(double value)
		{
			if (isIdentityTransform)
			{
				return Math.Round((value - min) * deltaRange + start);
			}
			double num = transformation.TransformForward(value);
			num = (num - min) * deltaRange + start;
			return Math.Round(num);
		}

		public double GetInterimCoord(double value, bool clip, bool round)
		{
			double num = (clip ? GetClampedCoord(value) : GetCoord(value));
			if (round)
			{
				num = Math.Round(num);
			}
			return num;
		}

		public double GetInterimCoordCore(double value, bool clip, bool round)
		{
			double num = (clip ? GetClampedCoordCore(value) : GetCoordCore(value));
			if (round)
			{
				num = Math.Round(num);
			}
			return num;
		}
	}
	public struct Interval : IEquatable<Interval>
	{
		private readonly double start;

		private readonly double end;

		private readonly double length;

		public double End => end;

		public double Length => length;

		public double Start => start;

		public static MinMaxValues operator -(Interval x, Interval y)
		{
			return new MinMaxValues(y.start - x.start, x.end - y.end);
		}

		public static bool operator !=(Interval x, Interval y)
		{
			return !(x == y);
		}

		public static Interval operator &(Interval x, Interval y)
		{
			if (x.Contains(y.start) || x.Contains(y.end))
			{
				double num = Math.Max(x.start, y.start);
				double num2 = Math.Min(x.end, y.end);
				return new Interval(num, num2);
			}
			return new Interval(0.0, 0.0);
		}

		public static Interval operator |(Interval x, Interval y)
		{
			double num = Math.Min(x.start, y.start);
			double num2 = Math.Max(x.end, y.end);
			return new Interval(num, num2);
		}

		public static bool operator ==(Interval x, Interval y)
		{
			return x.Equals(y);
		}

		public Interval(double start, double end)
		{
			this.start = start;
			this.end = end;
			length = end - start;
		}

		public bool Contains(double value)
		{
			if (start <= value)
			{
				return value <= end;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public double DistanceFrom(double value)
		{
			if (Contains(value))
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			if (value < start)
			{
				return start - value;
			}
			return value - end;
		}

		public bool Equals(Interval other)
		{
			if (other.start == start)
			{
				return other.length == length;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is Interval other))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return Equals(other);
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return HashCodeHelper.CalculateGeneric<double, double>(start, length);
		}
	}
	public struct RangeWrapper : IMinMaxValues
	{
		private readonly IMinMaxValues range;

		private double min;

		private double max;

		public double Max
		{
			get
			{
				if (!double.IsNaN(max))
				{
					return max;
				}
				return range.Max;
			}
			set
			{
				max = value;
				IsZeroRange = ComparingUtils.CompareDoubles(Delta, 0.0, double.Epsilon) == 0;
			}
		}

		public double Min
		{
			get
			{
				if (!double.IsNaN(min))
				{
					return min;
				}
				return range.Min;
			}
			set
			{
				min = value;
				IsZeroRange = ComparingUtils.CompareDoubles(Delta, 0.0, double.Epsilon) == 0;
			}
		}

		public bool IsZeroRange { get; set; }

		public double Delta => Max - Min;

		public RangeWrapper(IMinMaxValues range)
		{
			min = double.NaN;
			max = double.NaN;
			IsZeroRange = false;
			this.range = range;
		}

		public double CalculateCenter()
		{
			return (Max + Min) / 2.0;
		}

		public void Intersection(IMinMaxValues minMaxValues)
		{
			MinMaxValues minMaxValues2 = MinMaxValues.Intersection(this, minMaxValues);
			Max = minMaxValues2.Max;
			Min = minMaxValues2.Min;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return Min + "; " + Max;
		}
	}
	public struct AxisInterval : IEquatable<AxisInterval>
	{
		private readonly IMinMaxValues range;

		private readonly IMinMaxValues wholeRange;

		public IMinMaxValues Range => range;

		public IMinMaxValues WholeRange => wholeRange;

		public double Delta => range.Max - range.Min;

		public AxisInterval(IMinMaxValues range, IMinMaxValues wholeRange)
		{
			this.range = range;
			this.wholeRange = wholeRange;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return HashCodeHelper.CalculateGeneric<IMinMaxValues, IMinMaxValues>(range, wholeRange);
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is AxisInterval))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return Equals((AxisInterval)obj);
		}

		public bool Equals(AxisInterval other)
		{
			if (range == other.range)
			{
				return wholeRange == other.wholeRange;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

	public class AxisIntervalsGenerator
	{
		private struct Edge : IComparable<Edge>
		{
			private readonly double value;

			private readonly bool isMaxEdge;

			public double Value => value;

			public bool IsMaxEdge => isMaxEdge;

			public Edge(double value, bool isMaxEdge)
			{
				this.value = value;
				this.isMaxEdge = isMaxEdge;
			}

			int IComparable<Edge>.CompareTo(Edge edge)
			{
				int num = Comparer<double>.Default.Compare(value, edge.value);
				if (num == 0)
				{
					if (isMaxEdge && !edge.isMaxEdge)
					{
						num++;
					}
					else if (!isMaxEdge && edge.isMaxEdge)
					{
						num--;
					}
				}
				return num;
			}
		}

		private readonly IAxisData axis;

		private readonly IAutoScaleBreaksContainer autoScaleBreaksContainer;

		private readonly double minLimit;

		private readonly double maxLimit;

		public AxisIntervalsGenerator(IAxisData axis, IAutoScaleBreaksContainer autoScaleBreaksContainer, IMinMaxValues range)
		{
			this.axis = axis;
			this.autoScaleBreaksContainer = autoScaleBreaksContainer;
			minLimit = range.Min;
			maxLimit = range.Max;
		}

		private int GetEdgeCounter(Edge edge, int counter)
		{
			return counter + ((!edge.IsMaxEdge) ? 1 : (-1));
		}

		private IList<IMinMaxValues> EdgesToIntervalLimits(IList<Edge> edges)
		{
			List<IMinMaxValues> list = new List<IMinMaxValues>();
			int num = 1;
			double? num2 = null;
			foreach (Edge edge in edges)
			{
				num = GetEdgeCounter(edge, num);
				switch (num)
				{
				case 0:
					num2 = edge.Value;
					continue;
				case 1:
					if (num2.HasValue && num2 < edge.Value)
					{
						list.Add(new MinMaxValues(num2.Value, edge.Value));
					}
					break;
				}
				num2 = null;
			}
			return list;
		}

		private IList<Edge> CreateEdges()
		{
			IList<IScaleDiapason> list = ScaleDiapasonCalculator.CalculateScaleDiapasons(axis, autoScaleBreaksContainer);
			List<Edge> list2 = new List<Edge>();
			foreach (IScaleDiapason item in list)
			{
				if (!item.Visible)
				{
					continue;
				}
				double edge = item.Edge1;
				double edge2 = item.Edge2;
				double num = Math.Min(edge, edge2);
				double num2 = Math.Max(edge, edge2);
				if (num <= minLimit && num2 >= maxLimit)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if ((!(num <= minLimit) || !(num2 <= minLimit)) && (!(num >= maxLimit) || !(num2 >= maxLimit)))
				{
					if (num < minLimit)
					{
						num = minLimit;
					}
					if (num2 > maxLimit)
					{
						num2 = maxLimit;
					}
					list2.Add(new Edge(num, isMaxEdge: false));
					list2.Add(new Edge(num2, isMaxEdge: true));
				}
			}
			list2.Add(new Edge(maxLimit, isMaxEdge: false));
			list2.Add(new Edge(minLimit, isMaxEdge: true));
			list2.Sort();
			return list2;
		}

		public IList<IMinMaxValues> GenerateIntervalLimits()
		{
			if (minLimit == maxLimit)
			{
				return null;
			}
			IList<Edge> list = CreateEdges();
			if (list == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return EdgesToIntervalLimits(list);
		}

		public IList<AxisInterval> GenerateIntervals()
		{
			IList<IScaleDiapason> list = ScaleDiapasonCalculator.CalculateScaleDiapasons(axis, autoScaleBreaksContainer);
			if (list.Count < 1)
			{
				return null;
			}
			IList<IMinMaxValues> list2 = GenerateIntervalLimits();
			if (list2 == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			List<AxisInterval> list3 = new List<AxisInterval>();
			foreach (IMinMaxValues item in list2)
			{
				list3.Add(new AxisInterval(item, item));
			}
			return list3;
		}
	}

	public static class AxisLabelRotationHelper
	{
		private static double GetValueHalf(double value, bool useRounding)
		{
			if (!useRounding)
			{
				return value / 2.0;
			}
			return (int)(value / 2.0);
		}

		private static double GetStrongRoundedValue(double value, bool useRounding)
		{
			if (!useRounding)
			{
				return value;
			}
			return GeometricUtils.StrongRound(value);
		}

		public static GRealPoint2D CalculateLeftTopPointForBottomPosition(GRealRect2D bounds, double angleDegree, double angleRadian, bool useBoundsRounding)
		{
			GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D = new GRealPoint2D(bounds.Left, bounds.Top);
			if (angleDegree == 0.0 || angleDegree == 180.0)
			{
				return new GRealPoint2D(gRealPoint2D.X - GetValueHalf(bounds.Width, useBoundsRounding), gRealPoint2D.Y);
			}
			double num = bounds.Height / 2.0;
			if (!(angleDegree < 180.0))
			{
				return new GRealPoint2D(gRealPoint2D.X - bounds.Width, gRealPoint2D.Y - GetStrongRoundedValue(num * (1.0 - Math.Abs(Math.Cos(angleRadian - Math.PI))), useBoundsRounding));
			}
			return new GRealPoint2D(gRealPoint2D.X, gRealPoint2D.Y - GetStrongRoundedValue(num * (1.0 - Math.Abs(Math.Cos(angleRadian))), useBoundsRounding));
		}

		public static GRealPoint2D CalculateLeftTopPointForLeftPosition(GRealRect2D bounds, double angleDegree, double angleRadian, bool useBoundsRounding)
		{
			GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D = new GRealPoint2D(bounds.Left, bounds.Top);
			double valueHalf = GetValueHalf(bounds.Height, useBoundsRounding);
			if (angleDegree == 90.0 || angleDegree == 270.0)
			{
				return new GRealPoint2D(gRealPoint2D.X - GetValueHalf(bounds.Width, useBoundsRounding) - valueHalf, gRealPoint2D.Y - valueHalf);
			}
			if (!(angleDegree < 90.0) && !(angleDegree > 270.0))
			{
				return new GRealPoint2D(gRealPoint2D.X - GetStrongRoundedValue(Math.Abs(bounds.Height / 2.0 * Math.Cos(angleRadian - Math.PI / 2.0)), useBoundsRounding), gRealPoint2D.Y - valueHalf);
			}
			return new GRealPoint2D(gRealPoint2D.X - GetStrongRoundedValue(bounds.Width + Math.Abs(bounds.Height / 2.0 * Math.Sin(angleRadian)), useBoundsRounding), gRealPoint2D.Y - valueHalf);
		}

		public static GRealPoint2D CalculateLeftTopPointForRightPosition(GRealRect2D bounds, double angleDegree, double angleRadian, bool useBoundsRounding)
		{
			GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D = new GRealPoint2D(bounds.Left, bounds.Top);
			double valueHalf = GetValueHalf(bounds.Height, useBoundsRounding);
			if (angleDegree == 90.0 || angleDegree == 270.0)
			{
				return new GRealPoint2D(gRealPoint2D.X - GetValueHalf(bounds.Width, useBoundsRounding) + valueHalf, gRealPoint2D.Y - valueHalf);
			}
			if (!(angleDegree < 90.0) && !(angleDegree > 270.0))
			{
				return new GRealPoint2D(gRealPoint2D.X - bounds.Width + GetStrongRoundedValue(Math.Abs(bounds.Height / 2.0 * Math.Cos(angleRadian - Math.PI / 2.0)), useBoundsRounding), gRealPoint2D.Y - valueHalf);
			}
			return new GRealPoint2D(gRealPoint2D.X + GetStrongRoundedValue(Math.Abs(bounds.Height / 2.0 * Math.Sin(angleRadian)), useBoundsRounding), gRealPoint2D.Y - valueHalf);
		}

		public static GRealPoint2D CalculateLeftTopPointForTopPosition(GRealRect2D bounds, double angleDegree, double angleRadian, bool useBoundsRounding)
		{
			GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D = new GRealPoint2D(bounds.Left, bounds.Top);
			if (angleDegree == 0.0 || angleDegree == 180.0)
			{
				return new GRealPoint2D(gRealPoint2D.X - GetValueHalf(bounds.Width, useBoundsRounding), gRealPoint2D.Y - bounds.Height);
			}
			double num = bounds.Height / 2.0;
			if (!(angleDegree < 180.0))
			{
				return new GRealPoint2D(gRealPoint2D.X, gRealPoint2D.Y - GetStrongRoundedValue(num + Math.Abs(num * Math.Cos(angleRadian - Math.PI)), useBoundsRounding));
			}
			return new GRealPoint2D(gRealPoint2D.X - bounds.Width, gRealPoint2D.Y - GetStrongRoundedValue(num + Math.Abs(num * Math.Cos(angleRadian)), useBoundsRounding));
		}

		public static TextRotation CalculateRotationForBottomNearPosition(double degreeAngle)
		{
			if (degreeAngle == 0.0 || degreeAngle == 180.0)
			{
				return TextRotation.CenterCenter;
			}
			if (!(degreeAngle < 180.0))
			{
				return TextRotation.RightCenter;
			}
			return TextRotation.LeftCenter;
		}

		public static TextRotation CalculateRotationForLeftNearPosition(double degreeAngle)
		{
			if (degreeAngle == 90.0 || degreeAngle == 270.0)
			{
				return TextRotation.CenterCenter;
			}
			if (!(degreeAngle < 90.0) && !(degreeAngle > 270.0))
			{
				return TextRotation.LeftCenter;
			}
			return TextRotation.RightCenter;
		}

		public static TextRotation CalculateRotationForRightNearPosition(double degreeAngle)
		{
			if (degreeAngle == 90.0 || degreeAngle == 270.0)
			{
				return TextRotation.CenterCenter;
			}
			if (!(degreeAngle < 90.0) && !(degreeAngle > 270.0))
			{
				return TextRotation.RightCenter;
			}
			return TextRotation.LeftCenter;
		}

		public static TextRotation CalculateRotationForTopNearPosition(double degreeAngle)
		{
			if (degreeAngle == 0.0 || degreeAngle == 180.0)
			{
				return TextRotation.CenterCenter;
			}
			if (!(degreeAngle < 180.0))
			{
				return TextRotation.LeftCenter;
			}
			return TextRotation.RightCenter;
		}

		public static GRealPoint2D[] CalculateRotatedItemPoints(GRealRect2D bounds, double radianAngle)
		{
			double num = bounds.Width / 2.0;
			double num2 = bounds.Height / 2.0;
			double num3 = Math.Sin(radianAngle);
			double num4 = Math.Cos(radianAngle);
			return new GRealPoint2D[4]
			{
				new GRealPoint2D(bounds.Left + num2 * num3 + num * (1.0 - num4), bounds.Top + num2 * (1.0 - num4) - num * num3),
				new GRealPoint2D(bounds.Right + num2 * num3 - num * (1.0 - num4), bounds.Top + num2 * (1.0 - num4) + num * num3),
				new GRealPoint2D(bounds.Right - num2 * num3 - num * (1.0 - num4), bounds.Bottom - num2 * (1.0 - num4) + num * num3),
				new GRealPoint2D(bounds.Left - num2 * num3 + num * (1.0 - num4), bounds.Bottom - num2 * (1.0 - num4) - num * num3)
			};
		}

		public static GRealPoint2D CalculateOffset(TextRotation rotation, GRealRect2D rect, double radianAngle)
		{
			double num = rect.Width / 2.0;
			double num2 = rect.Height / 2.0;
			double num3 = Math.Sin(radianAngle);
			double num4 = Math.Cos(radianAngle);
			return rotation switch
			{
				TextRotation.LeftTop => new GRealPoint2D((0.0 - num) * (1.0 - num4) - num2 * num3, num * num3 - num2 * (1.0 - num4)), 
				TextRotation.CenterTop => new GRealPoint2D((0.0 - num2) * num3, (0.0 - num2) * (1.0 - num4)), 
				TextRotation.RightTop => new GRealPoint2D(num * (1.0 - num4) - num2 * num3, (0.0 - num) * num3 - num2 * (1.0 - num4)), 
				TextRotation.LeftCenter => new GRealPoint2D((0.0 - num) * (1.0 - num4), num * num3), 
				TextRotation.RightCenter => new GRealPoint2D(num * (1.0 - num4), (0.0 - num) * num3), 
				TextRotation.LeftBottom => new GRealPoint2D((0.0 - num) * (1.0 - num4) + num2 * num3, num * num3 + num2 * (1.0 - num4)), 
				TextRotation.CenterBottom => new GRealPoint2D(num2 * num3, num2 * (1.0 - num4)), 
				TextRotation.RightBottom => new GRealPoint2D(num * (1.0 - num4) + num2 * num3, (0.0 - num) * num3 + num2 * (1.0 - num4)), 
				_ => default(GRealPoint2D), 
			};
		}

		public static LineStrip RotateRectangleOverPoint(GRealRect2D rectangle, GRealPoint2D basePoint, double radianAngle)
		{
			rectangle.Offset(0.0 - basePoint.X, 0.0 - basePoint.Y);
			double num = Math.Sin(radianAngle);
			double num2 = Math.Cos(radianAngle);
			GRealPoint2D[] array = new GRealPoint2D[4]
			{
				new GRealPoint2D(rectangle.Left * num2 - rectangle.Top * num, rectangle.Left * num + rectangle.Top * num2),
				new GRealPoint2D(rectangle.Right * num2 - rectangle.Top * num, rectangle.Right * num + rectangle.Top * num2),
				new GRealPoint2D(rectangle.Right * num2 - rectangle.Bottom * num, rectangle.Right * num + rectangle.Bottom * num2),
				new GRealPoint2D(rectangle.Left * num2 - rectangle.Bottom * num, rectangle.Left * num + rectangle.Bottom * num2)
			};
			LineStrip lineStrip = new LineStrip(4);
			GRealPoint2D[] array2 = array;
			for (int i = 0; i < array2.Length; i++)
			{
				GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D = array2[i];
				lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(gRealPoint2D.X + basePoint.X, gRealPoint2D.Y + basePoint.Y));
			}
			return lineStrip;
		}
	}
	public class AxisLabelPositionHelper
	{
		public static NearTextPosition Opposite(NearTextPosition position)
		{
			return position switch
			{
				NearTextPosition.Left => NearTextPosition.Right, 
				NearTextPosition.Right => NearTextPosition.Left, 
				NearTextPosition.Bottom => NearTextPosition.Top, 
				NearTextPosition.Top => NearTextPosition.Bottom, 
				_ => NearTextPosition.None, 
			};
		}

		public static GRealPoint2D CalculateLeftTopPoint(NearTextPosition position, GRealRect2D bounds, double angleDegree, double angleRadian, bool useBoundsRounding)
		{
			GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D = default(GRealPoint2D);
			return position switch
			{
				NearTextPosition.Bottom => AxisLabelRotationHelper.CalculateLeftTopPointForBottomPosition(bounds, angleDegree, angleRadian, useBoundsRounding), 
				NearTextPosition.Left => AxisLabelRotationHelper.CalculateLeftTopPointForLeftPosition(bounds, angleDegree, angleRadian, useBoundsRounding), 
				NearTextPosition.Right => AxisLabelRotationHelper.CalculateLeftTopPointForRightPosition(bounds, angleDegree, angleRadian, useBoundsRounding), 
				NearTextPosition.Top => AxisLabelRotationHelper.CalculateLeftTopPointForTopPosition(bounds, angleDegree, angleRadian, useBoundsRounding), 
				_ => gRealPoint2D, 
			};
		}

		public static TextRotation CalculateRotation(NearTextPosition position, double angleDegree)
		{
			return position switch
			{
				NearTextPosition.Bottom => AxisLabelRotationHelper.CalculateRotationForBottomNearPosition(angleDegree), 
				NearTextPosition.Left => AxisLabelRotationHelper.CalculateRotationForLeftNearPosition(angleDegree), 
				NearTextPosition.Right => AxisLabelRotationHelper.CalculateRotationForRightNearPosition(angleDegree), 
				NearTextPosition.Top => AxisLabelRotationHelper.CalculateRotationForTopNearPosition(angleDegree), 
				_ => TextRotation.CenterCenter, 
			};
		}
	}

	internal class RotationMatrix
	{
		private double m00 = 1.0;

		private double m01;

		private double m10;

		private double m11 = 1.0;

		private double GetRadianAngle(double degreeAngle)
		{
			return degreeAngle % 360.0 * Math.PI / 180.0;
		}

		public void Rotate(double angle)
		{
			double radianAngle = GetRadianAngle(angle);
			m00 = Math.Cos(radianAngle);
			m01 = 0.0 - Math.Sin(radianAngle);
			m10 = Math.Sin(radianAngle);
			m11 = Math.Cos(radianAngle);
		}

		public GRealPoint2D TransformPoint(GRealPoint2D point)
		{
			double x = point.X * m00 + point.Y * m01;
			double y = point.X * m10 + point.Y * m11;
			return new GRealPoint2D(x, y);
		}
	}
	public class AxisLabelOverlappingResolver
	{
		private enum State
		{
			Check,
			Stagger,
			Rotate,
			ThinOut,
			Panic
		}

		private struct LabelItem
		{
			private readonly IAxisLabelLayout label;

			private GRealRect2D rect;

			private bool isOverlapped;

			public IAxisLabelLayout Label => label;

			public GRealRect2D Rect => rect;

			public bool IsOverlapped
			{
				get
				{
					return isOverlapped;
				}
				set
				{
					isOverlapped = value;
				}
			}

			public LabelItem(IAxisLabelLayout label, GRealRect2D rect)
			{
				this.label = label;
				this.rect = rect;
				isOverlapped = false;
			}
		}

		private struct OverlapState
		{
			public RotationMatrix Transform { get; set; }

			public LabelItem[] Items { get; set; }

			public LabelItem? FirstItem { get; set; }

			public void PushItem(LabelItem item)
			{
				if (!FirstItem.HasValue)
				{
					FirstItem = item;
				}
				for (int i = 0; i < Items.Length - 1; i++)
				{
					Items[i] = Items[i + 1];
				}
				Items[Items.Length - 1] = item;
			}

			public bool CheckRect(GRealRect2D rect)
			{
				bool flag = false;
				for (int i = 0; i < Items.Length; i++)
				{
					LabelItem labelItem = Items[i];
					if (labelItem.Label != null && GRealRect2D.IsIntersected(labelItem.Rect, rect))
					{
						Items[i].IsOverlapped = true;
						flag = true;
					}
					else
					{
						Items[i].IsOverlapped = false;
					}
				}
				if (!flag && FirstItem.HasValue)
				{
					flag = GRealRect2D.IsIntersected(FirstItem.Value.Rect, rect);
				}
				return flag;
			}

			public bool CheckLimitedRect(GRealRect2D rect)
			{
				bool flag = false;
				for (int i = 0; i < Items.Length; i++)
				{
					LabelItem labelItem = Items[i];
					IAxisLabelLayout label = labelItem.Label;
					Items[i].IsOverlapped = label != null && label.LimitsOffset != default(GRealPoint2D) && GRealRect2D.IsIntersected(labelItem.Rect, rect);
					flag |= Items[i].IsOverlapped;
				}
				return flag;
			}

			public void HideOverlappedItems()
			{
				LabelItem[] items = Items;
				for (int i = 0; i < items.Length; i++)
				{
					LabelItem labelItem = items[i];
					if (labelItem.Label != null && labelItem.IsOverlapped)
					{
						labelItem.Label.Visible = false;
					}
				}
			}

			public bool GetOverlappedState()
			{
				LabelItem[] items = Items;
				foreach (LabelItem labelItem in items)
				{
					if (labelItem.IsOverlapped)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private const float angleMax = 90f;

		private const float angleStep = 15f;

		private State state;

		private OverlapState overlapState;

		private double maxHeight;

		private double maxWidth;

		private double maxWidthWithoutOverlap;

		private double currentAngle;

		private bool staggered;

		private readonly bool isVertical;

		private readonly List<IAxisLabelLayout> totalLabels;

		private readonly List<IAxisLabelLayout> autoLabels = new List<IAxisLabelLayout>();

		private readonly List<IAxisLabelLayout> customLabels = new List<IAxisLabelLayout>();

		private readonly bool allowStagger;

		private readonly bool allowRotate;

		private readonly bool allowThinOut;

		private readonly bool mirrored;

		private readonly bool forceStagger;

		private readonly bool useBoundsRound;

		private readonly int indent;

		private readonly bool adaptive;

		private readonly bool canShowCustomWithAutoLabels;

		private readonly GRealRect2D paneBounds;

		private bool RotationLimit
		{
			get
			{
				if (!(currentAngle < 0.0))
				{
					return 90.0 - currentAngle < 15.0;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public AxisLabelOverlappingResolver(List<IAxisLabelLayout> labels, IAxisData axis, bool isRadar, bool mirrored, bool useBoundsRound, GRealRect2D paneBounds = default(GRealRect2D))
		{
			this.paneBounds = paneBounds;
			isVertical = axis.IsVertical;
			IAxisLabel label = axis.Label;
			IAxisLabelResolveOverlappingOptions resolveOverlappingOptions = label.ResolveOverlappingOptions;
			totalLabels = labels;
			currentAngle = ((!isRadar) ? label.Angle : 0);
			forceStagger = !isRadar && label.Staggered;
			allowStagger = !isRadar && resolveOverlappingOptions.AllowStagger && !isVertical && !forceStagger && currentAngle == 0.0;
			allowRotate = !isRadar && !isVertical && resolveOverlappingOptions.AllowRotate;
			allowThinOut = resolveOverlappingOptions.AllowHide;
			this.mirrored = mirrored;
			indent = resolveOverlappingOptions.MinIndent;
			adaptive = !isRadar;
			this.useBoundsRound = useBoundsRound;
			canShowCustomWithAutoLabels = axis.CanShowCustomWithAutoLabels;
			if (canShowCustomWithAutoLabels)
			{
				DivideLabels();
			}
			AnalyzeLabels();
			if (forceStagger)
			{
				state = State.Stagger;
				if (canShowCustomWithAutoLabels)
				{
					DoLabelsModifications(autoLabels, customLabels);
				}
				else
				{
					DoLabelsModifications(totalLabels);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				state = State.Check;
			}
		}

		private void DivideLabels()
		{
			foreach (IAxisLabelLayout totalLabel in totalLabels)
			{
				if (totalLabel.IsCustomLabel)
				{
					customLabels.Add(totalLabel);
				}
				else
				{
					autoLabels.Add(totalLabel);
				}
			}
		}

		private State NextState(State nextState)
		{
			switch (nextState)
			{
			case State.Check:
				if (allowStagger)
				{
					return State.Stagger;
				}
				return NextState(State.Stagger);
			case State.Stagger:
				if (allowRotate && !RotationLimit && IsCorrectLabelSizeForRotatingComplete())
				{
					return State.Rotate;
				}
				return NextState(State.Rotate);
			case State.Rotate:
				if (allowRotate && !RotationLimit && IsCorrectLabelSizeForRotatingComplete())
				{
					return State.Rotate;
				}
				if (allowThinOut)
				{
					return State.ThinOut;
				}
				return NextState(State.ThinOut);
			default:
				return State.Panic;
			}
		}

		private void ResetOverlapState()
		{
			overlapState = CreateOverlapState();
		}

		private OverlapState CreateOverlapState(int itemsCount)
		{
			OverlapState result = default(OverlapState);
			result.Transform = new RotationMatrix();
			result.Transform.Rotate(0.0 - currentAngle);
			result.Items = new LabelItem[itemsCount];
			return result;
		}

		private OverlapState CreateOverlapState()
		{
			return CreateOverlapState(2);
		}

		private GRealRect2D GetBounds(GRealRect2D bounds, bool roundBounds)
		{
			//IL_0004: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0009: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (roundBounds)
			{
				DXRectangle val = GeometricUtils.StrongRound(bounds);
				return new GRealRect2D(((DXRectangle)(ref val)).Left, ((DXRectangle)(ref val)).Top, ((DXRectangle)(ref val)).Width, ((DXRectangle)(ref val)).Height);
			}
			return bounds;
		}

		private double GetValue(double value)
		{
			if (!useBoundsRound)
			{
				return Math.Ceiling(value);
			}
			return GeometricUtils.StrongRound(value);
		}

		private GRealRect2D InflateLabel(GRealRect2D rect)
		{
			if ((state == State.Stagger || state == State.ThinOut) && adaptive)
			{
				if (!isVertical)
				{
					return GRealRect2D.Inflate(rect, indent, 0.0);
				}
				return GRealRect2D.Inflate(rect, 0.0, indent);
			}
			if (state == State.Rotate)
			{
				return GRealRect2D.Inflate(rect, 0.0, indent);
			}
			return GRealRect2D.Inflate(rect, indent, indent);
		}

		private bool IsOverlapped(List<IAxisLabelLayout> labels)
		{
			DetectOverlapping(labels);
			return overlapState.GetOverlappedState();
		}

		private bool IsLabelVisible(IAxisLabelLayout label)
		{
			if (label.Visible && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(label.Text))
			{
				return !label.Bounds.IsEmpty;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool IsCorrectLabelSizeForRotatingComplete()
		{
			if (paneBounds.IsEmpty)
			{
				return true;
			}
			double num = maxWidthWithoutOverlap * maxWidthWithoutOverlap;
			double num2 = paneBounds.Width * paneBounds.Width + paneBounds.Height * paneBounds.Height;
			return num / num2 < 0.2;
		}

		private GRealSize2D RotatedSize(RotationMatrix rotation, GRealSize2D size)
		{
			GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D = rotation.TransformPoint(new GRealPoint2D(0.0, size.Height));
			GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D2 = rotation.TransformPoint(new GRealPoint2D(size.Width, 0.0));
			GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D3 = rotation.TransformPoint(new GRealPoint2D(size.Width, size.Height));
			GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D4 = new GRealPoint2D(Math.Min(Math.Min(gRealPoint2D.X, gRealPoint2D2.X), gRealPoint2D3.X), Math.Min(Math.Min(gRealPoint2D.Y, gRealPoint2D2.Y), gRealPoint2D3.Y));
			GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D5 = new GRealPoint2D(Math.Max(Math.Max(gRealPoint2D.X, gRealPoint2D2.X), gRealPoint2D3.X), Math.Max(Math.Max(gRealPoint2D.Y, gRealPoint2D2.Y), gRealPoint2D3.Y));
			return new GRealSize2D(gRealPoint2D5.X - gRealPoint2D4.X, gRealPoint2D5.Y - gRealPoint2D4.Y);
		}

		private void AnalyzeLabels()
		{
			double? num = null;
			double? num2 = null;
			double? num3 = null;
			RotationMatrix rotationMatrix = null;
			if (currentAngle != 0.0)
			{
				rotationMatrix = new RotationMatrix();
				rotationMatrix.Rotate(currentAngle);
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < totalLabels.Count; i++)
			{
				GRealSize2D gRealSize2D = ((rotationMatrix != null) ? RotatedSize(rotationMatrix, totalLabels[i].Size) : totalLabels[i].Size);
				if (!num.HasValue || (num.Value < gRealSize2D.Height && (i & 1) == 0))
				{
					num = gRealSize2D.Height;
				}
				if (!num2.HasValue || (num2.Value < gRealSize2D.Width && (i & 1) == 0))
				{
					num2 = gRealSize2D.Width;
				}
				if (!num3.HasValue || num3.Value < totalLabels[i].Size.Width)
				{
					num3 = gRealSize2D.Width;
				}
			}
			maxHeight = (num.HasValue ? num.Value : 0.0);
			maxWidth = (num2.HasValue ? num2.Value : 0.0);
			maxWidthWithoutOverlap = (num3.HasValue ? num3.Value : 0.0);
		}

		private GRealPoint2D GetStaggerOffset(bool rollback)
		{
			if (isVertical)
			{
				double value = GetValue(rollback ? 0.0 : maxWidth);
				if (!mirrored)
				{
					return new GRealPoint2D(0.0 - value, 0.0);
				}
				return new GRealPoint2D(value, 0.0);
			}
			double value2 = GetValue(rollback ? 0.0 : maxHeight);
			if (!mirrored)
			{
				return new GRealPoint2D(0.0, value2);
			}
			return new GRealPoint2D(0.0, 0.0 - value2);
		}

		private void DoStagger(List<IAxisLabelLayout> labels, bool rollback)
		{
			int num = CalculateStaggerIndex(labels, forceStagger);
			GRealPoint2D staggerOffset = GetStaggerOffset(rollback);
			foreach (IAxisLabelLayout label in labels)
			{
				if ((label.Visible || forceStagger) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(label.Text))
				{
					if (num % 2 == 0)
					{
						label.Offset = staggerOffset;
					}
					num++;
				}
			}
		}

		private int CalculateStaggerIndex(List<IAxisLabelLayout> labels, bool forceStagger)
		{
			foreach (IAxisLabelLayout label in labels)
			{
				if ((label.Visible || forceStagger) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(label.Text))
				{
					return label.GridIndex;
				}
			}
			return 0;
		}

		private void DoRotate(List<IAxisLabelLayout> labels)
		{
			foreach (IAxisLabelLayout label in labels)
			{
				label.Angle = currentAngle;
			}
		}

		private void DetectOverlapping(List<IAxisLabelLayout> labels)
		{
			ResetOverlapState();
			foreach (IAxisLabelLayout label in labels)
			{
				if (IsLabelVisible(label))
				{
					GRealRect2D rect = CalculateLabelRect(label.Pivot, label.Size, overlapState.Transform);
					if (overlapState.CheckRect(InflateLabel(rect)))
					{
						break;
					}
					overlapState.PushItem(new LabelItem(label, rect));
				}
			}
		}

		private void DoLimitedLabelsThinOut(List<IAxisLabelLayout> labels)
		{
			OverlapState overlapState = CreateOverlapState();
			foreach (IAxisLabelLayout label in labels)
			{
				if (!IsLabelVisible(label))
				{
					continue;
				}
				GRealRect2D rect = CalculateLabelRect(label.Pivot, label.Size, overlapState.Transform);
				if (label.LimitsOffset != default(GRealPoint2D) && overlapState.CheckRect(rect))
				{
					label.Visible = false;
					continue;
				}
				if (overlapState.CheckLimitedRect(rect))
				{
					overlapState.HideOverlappedItems();
				}
				overlapState.PushItem(new LabelItem(label, rect));
			}
		}

		private void DoLabelsThinOut(List<IAxisLabelLayout> visibleLabels, List<IAxisLabelLayout> otherLabels, bool useIndent, GRealRect2D initialNonOverlappedRect = default(GRealRect2D))
		{
			OverlapState overlapState = CreateOverlapState(visibleLabels.Count);
			foreach (IAxisLabelLayout visibleLabel in visibleLabels)
			{
				GRealRect2D rect = CalculateLabelRect(visibleLabel.Pivot, visibleLabel.Size, overlapState.Transform);
				overlapState.PushItem(new LabelItem(visibleLabel, rect));
			}
			foreach (IAxisLabelLayout otherLabel in otherLabels)
			{
				if (IsLabelVisible(otherLabel))
				{
					GRealRect2D gRealRect2D = CalculateLabelRect(otherLabel.Pivot, otherLabel.Size, overlapState.Transform);
					if (overlapState.CheckRect(useIndent ? InflateLabel(gRealRect2D) : gRealRect2D) || (!initialNonOverlappedRect.IsEmpty && GRealRect2D.IsIntersected(initialNonOverlappedRect, otherLabel.Bounds)))
					{
						otherLabel.Visible = false;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private GRealRect2D CalculateLabelRect(GRealPoint2D location, GRealSize2D size, RotationMatrix transform)
		{
			GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D = transform.TransformPoint(location);
			gRealPoint2D = new GRealPoint2D(gRealPoint2D.X - size.Width * 0.5, gRealPoint2D.Y - size.Height * 0.5);
			return GetBounds(new GRealRect2D(gRealPoint2D.X, gRealPoint2D.Y, size.Width, size.Height), useBoundsRound);
		}

		private void DoThinOut(List<IAxisLabelLayout> labels)
		{
			ResetOverlapState();
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = 0;
			int num3 = 0;
			foreach (IAxisLabelLayout label in labels)
			{
				if (!IsLabelVisible(label))
				{
					continue;
				}
				GRealRect2D rect = CalculateLabelRect(label.Pivot, label.Size, overlapState.Transform);
				if (overlapState.CheckRect(InflateLabel(rect)) || (num3 > 0 && !label.IsCustomLabel))
				{
					label.Visible = false;
					if (adaptive && !allowStagger && !label.IsIntervalEdge)
					{
						num++;
						if (num3 > 0)
						{
							num3--;
						}
					}
					continue;
				}
				overlapState.PushItem(new LabelItem(label, rect));
				if (adaptive && !allowStagger)
				{
					if (num2 < num)
					{
						num2 = num;
					}
					num = 0;
					num3 = num2;
				}
			}
		}

		private void LimitBounds(GRealRect2D labelsLimits)
		{
			foreach (IAxisLabelLayout totalLabel in totalLabels)
			{
				if (!IsLabelVisible(totalLabel))
				{
					continue;
				}
				GRealRect2D bounds = totalLabel.Bounds;
				if (totalLabel.IsIntersectionAutoLabel)
				{
					if (totalLabel.Pivot.X < labelsLimits.Left || totalLabel.Pivot.X + bounds.Width > labelsLimits.Right || totalLabel.Pivot.Y - bounds.Height < labelsLimits.Top || totalLabel.Pivot.Y > labelsLimits.Bottom)
					{
						totalLabel.Visible = false;
					}
					continue;
				}
				if (isVertical)
				{
					if (bounds.Bottom > labelsLimits.Bottom || bounds.Top < labelsLimits.Top)
					{
						totalLabel.Visible = false;
					}
					continue;
				}
				double num = bounds.Left;
				if (bounds.Right > labelsLimits.Right)
				{
					num = labelsLimits.Right - bounds.Width;
				}
				if (num < labelsLimits.Left)
				{
					num = labelsLimits.Left;
				}
				double num2 = num - bounds.Left;
				if (num2 != 0.0)
				{
					totalLabel.LimitsOffset = new GRealPoint2D(num2, 0.0);
				}
			}
		}

		private void DoLabelsModifications(params List<IAxisLabelLayout>[] labels)
		{
			switch (state)
			{
			case State.Stagger:
				foreach (List<IAxisLabelLayout> labels3 in labels)
				{
					DoStagger(labels3, rollback: false);
				}
				staggered = true;
				break;
			case State.Rotate:
				if (staggered)
				{
					foreach (List<IAxisLabelLayout> labels4 in labels)
					{
						DoStagger(labels4, rollback: true);
					}
					staggered = false;
				}
				currentAngle += 15.0;
				foreach (List<IAxisLabelLayout> labels5 in labels)
				{
					DoRotate(labels5);
				}
				break;
			case State.ThinOut:
				foreach (List<IAxisLabelLayout> labels2 in labels)
				{
					DoThinOut(labels2);
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		private void ProcessWholeLabels()
		{
			while (IsOverlapped(totalLabels))
			{
				state = NextState(state);
				if (state != State.Panic)
				{
					DoLabelsModifications(totalLabels);
					continue;
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		private void ProcessSeparateLabels()
		{
			while (IsOverlapped(autoLabels) || IsOverlapped(customLabels))
			{
				state = NextState(state);
				if (state != State.Panic)
				{
					DoLabelsModifications(autoLabels, customLabels);
					continue;
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		public void ProcessCustomLabels()
		{
			if (canShowCustomWithAutoLabels && customLabels.Count != 0)
			{
				currentAngle = customLabels[0].Angle;
				DoLabelsThinOut(customLabels, autoLabels, useIndent: false);
			}
		}

		public void ProcessLabelsLimits(GRealRect2D labelsLimits)
		{
			LimitBounds(labelsLimits);
			if (canShowCustomWithAutoLabels)
			{
				DoLimitedLabelsThinOut(autoLabels);
				DoLimitedLabelsThinOut(customLabels);
			}
			else
			{
				DoLimitedLabelsThinOut(totalLabels);
			}
		}

		public void ProcessLabelsThinOut(GRealRect2D nonOverlappedRect = default(GRealRect2D))
		{
			List<IAxisLabelLayout> list = new List<IAxisLabelLayout>();
			List<IAxisLabelLayout> list2 = new List<IAxisLabelLayout>();
			foreach (IAxisLabelLayout totalLabel in totalLabels)
			{
				if (totalLabel.IsIntersectionAutoLabel)
				{
					list.Add(totalLabel);
				}
				else
				{
					list2.Add(totalLabel);
				}
			}
			DoLabelsThinOut(list, list2, useIndent: true, nonOverlappedRect);
		}

		public void Process()
		{
			if (canShowCustomWithAutoLabels)
			{
				ProcessSeparateLabels();
			}
			else
			{
				ProcessWholeLabels();
			}
		}
	}
	public class AxisLabelResolveOverlappingCache
	{
		private struct CacheItem
		{
			public double Angle { get; set; }

			public GRealPoint2D Offset { get; set; }

			public bool Visible { get; set; }
		}

		private readonly CacheItem[] items;

		private readonly IResolveLabelsOverlappingAxis axis;

		public int Count
		{
			get
			{
				if (items == null)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				return items.Length;
			}
		}

		public AxisLabelResolveOverlappingCache(IResolveLabelsOverlappingAxis axis, List<IAxisLabelLayout> labels)
		{
			this.axis = axis;
			if (labels.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			items = new CacheItem[labels.Count];
			int num = 0;
			foreach (IAxisLabelLayout label in labels)
			{
				items[num++] = new CacheItem
				{
					Angle = label.Angle,
					Offset = label.Offset,
					Visible = label.Visible
				};
			}
		}

		public void Apply(List<IAxisLabelLayout> labels)
		{
			if (items == null || items.Length != labels.Count)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = 0;
			foreach (IAxisLabelLayout label in labels)
			{
				label.Visible = items[num].Visible;
				label.Offset = items[num].Offset;
				label.Angle = items[num].Angle;
				num++;
			}
		}

		public void Store()
		{
			axis.OverlappingCache = this;
		}
	}
	public static class AxisLabelOffsetCalculator
	{
		public static void CorrectLabelWithAlignment(List<IAxisLabelLayout> labels, IAxisData axis, AxisLabelAlignmentCore labelAlignment)
		{
			if (labelAlignment == AxisLabelAlignmentCore.Center)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag = labelAlignment == AxisLabelAlignmentCore.Far;
			bool isVertical = axis.IsVertical;
			foreach (IAxisLabelLayout label in labels)
			{
				GRealSize2D size = label.Size;
				if (isVertical)
				{
					label.Offset = new GRealPoint2D(0.0, (int)Math.Ceiling(size.Height / 2.0) * ((!flag) ? 1 : (-1)));
				}
				else
				{
					label.Offset = new GRealPoint2D((int)Math.Ceiling(size.Width / 2.0) * (flag ? 1 : (-1)), 0.0);
				}
			}
		}

		public static void CorrectLabelForZeroMode(IAxisLabelLayout labelX, IAxisLabelLayout labelY, IAxisData axisX, IAxisData axisY, int axisYThickness, ITickmarksOwner axisYTickmarks, double indentToAxis, bool labelsYOutside, bool intersectionIsVisible)
		{
			if (labelY != null)
			{
				labelY.Visible = false;
			}
			if (labelX == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (!intersectionIsVisible)
			{
				labelX.Visible = false;
				return;
			}
			double num = axisYThickness;
			if (axisYTickmarks.TickmarksVisible || axisYTickmarks.TickmarksMinorVisible)
			{
				num += (double)Math.Max(axisYTickmarks.TickmarksVisible ? axisYTickmarks.TickmarksLength : 0, axisYTickmarks.TickmarksMinorVisible ? axisYTickmarks.TickmarksMinorLength : 0);
			}
			if (axisY.ShowLabels)
			{
				num += indentToAxis;
			}
			if (axisX.IsVertical)
			{
				labelX.Offset = new GRealPoint2D(0.0, ((double)GeometricUtils.StrongRound(labelX.Size.Height / 2.0) + num) * (double)(labelsYOutside ? 1 : (-1)));
			}
			else
			{
				labelX.Offset = new GRealPoint2D(((double)GeometricUtils.StrongRound(labelX.Size.Width / 2.0) + num) * (double)((!labelsYOutside) ? 1 : (-1)), 0.0);
			}
		}

		public static void CorrectSpecialLabelForCenterMode(IAxisLabelLayout labelX, IAxisLabelLayout labelY, IAxisData axisX, IAxisData axisY, bool labelsXOutside, bool labelsYOutside, double indentToAxis)
		{
			if (labelY != null)
			{
				if (axisY.IsVertical)
				{
					labelY.Offset = new GRealPoint2D(0.0, ((double)GeometricUtils.StrongRound(labelY.Size.Height / 2.0) + indentToAxis) * (double)((!labelsXOutside) ? 1 : (-1)));
				}
				else
				{
					labelY.Offset = new GRealPoint2D(((double)GeometricUtils.StrongRound(labelY.Size.Width / 2.0) + indentToAxis) * (double)(labelsXOutside ? 1 : (-1)), 0.0);
				}
			}
			if (labelX != null)
			{
				if (axisX.IsVertical)
				{
					labelX.Offset = new GRealPoint2D(0.0, ((double)GeometricUtils.StrongRound(labelX.Size.Height / 2.0) + indentToAxis) * (double)((!labelsYOutside) ? 1 : (-1)));
				}
				else
				{
					labelX.Offset = new GRealPoint2D(((double)GeometricUtils.StrongRound(labelX.Size.Width / 2.0) + indentToAxis) * (double)(labelsYOutside ? 1 : (-1)), 0.0);
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public abstract class AxisMappingCore : IAxisMappingCore
	{
		private readonly IAxisData axis;

		private readonly double axisLength;

		private readonly double cutAxisLength;

		protected IAxisData Axis => axis;

		protected double CutAxisLength => cutAxisLength;

		public double AxisLength => axisLength;

		public static IAxisMappingCore Create(IIntervalLayoutProvider intervalLayoutProvider, IAxisData axis, double length)
		{
			if (!(axis is IIntervalContainer { Intervals: not null } intervalContainer) || intervalContainer.Intervals.Count == 1 || intervalLayoutProvider.GetIntervalLayouts(axis) == null)
			{
				return new SingleIntervalMappingCore(axis, length);
			}
			return new MultiIntervalMappingCore(axis, intervalLayoutProvider, length);
		}

		protected AxisMappingCore(IAxisData axis, double axisLength)
		{
			this.axis = axis;
			this.axisLength = axisLength;
			cutAxisLength = Math.Max(0.0, axisLength - 1.0);
		}

		private double ApplyReverse(double value)
		{
			if (!axis.Reverse)
			{
				return value;
			}
			return cutAxisLength - value;
		}

		private double GetCoord(double min, double max, double value, double dimension)
		{
			if (max - min <= double.Epsilon)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			return (value - min) / (max - min) * dimension;
		}

		private double GetAxisValueInternal(double value, bool exactValue)
		{
			Transformation transformation = axis.AxisScaleTypeMap.Transformation;
			IntervalLayout intervalLayout = GetIntervalLayout(value, exactValue);
			if (intervalLayout == null)
			{
				return double.NaN;
			}
			IMinMaxValues range = intervalLayout.Interval.Range;
			double min = transformation.TransformForward(range.Min);
			double max = transformation.TransformForward(range.Max);
			return ApplyReverse(GetCoord(min, max, transformation.TransformForward(value), intervalLayout.Bounds.Length) + intervalLayout.Bounds.Start);
		}

		private double GetClampedAxisValueInternal(double value, bool exactValue)
		{
			Transformation transformation = axis.AxisScaleTypeMap.Transformation;
			IntervalLayout intervalLayout = GetIntervalLayout(value, exactValue);
			if (intervalLayout == null)
			{
				return double.NaN;
			}
			IMinMaxValues range = intervalLayout.Interval.Range;
			MinMaxValues minMaxValues = new MinMaxValues(transformation.TransformForward(range.Min), transformation.TransformForward(range.Max));
			return ApplyReverse(AxisCoordCalculator.GetClampedCoord(minMaxValues, transformation.TransformForward(value), intervalLayout.Bounds.Length) + intervalLayout.Bounds.Start);
		}

		protected abstract IntervalLayout GetIntervalLayout(double value, bool exactLayout);

		protected abstract IntervalLayout GetIntervalLayoutByCoordinate(double coordinate);

		protected virtual IntervalLayout GetNearestIntervalLayout(double coordinate)
		{
			return GetIntervalLayoutByCoordinate(coordinate);
		}

		public double GetAxisValue(double value)
		{
			return GetAxisValueInternal(value, exactValue: false);
		}

		public double GetExactAxisValue(double value)
		{
			return GetAxisValueInternal(value, exactValue: true);
		}

		public double GetRoundedAxisValue(double value)
		{
			double axisValue = GetAxisValue(value);
			return GeometricUtils.StrongRound(axisValue);
		}

		public double GetRoundedExactAxisValue(double value)
		{
			double exactAxisValue = GetExactAxisValue(value);
			if (!double.IsNaN(exactAxisValue))
			{
				return GeometricUtils.StrongRound(exactAxisValue);
			}
			return double.NaN;
		}

		public double GetClampedAxisValue(double value)
		{
			return GetClampedAxisValueInternal(value, exactValue: false);
		}

		public double GetClampedExactAxisValue(double value)
		{
			return GetClampedAxisValueInternal(value, exactValue: true);
		}

		public double GetRoundedClampedAxisValue(double value)
		{
			return GeometricUtils.StrongRound(GetClampedAxisValue(value));
		}

		public double GetInternalCoord(double value)
		{
			value = ApplyReverse(value);
			IntervalLayout intervalLayoutByCoordinate = GetIntervalLayoutByCoordinate(value);
			if (intervalLayoutByCoordinate == null)
			{
				return double.NaN;
			}
			double ratio = (value - intervalLayoutByCoordinate.Bounds.Start) / intervalLayoutByCoordinate.Bounds.Length;
			IMinMaxValues range = intervalLayoutByCoordinate.Interval.Range;
			Transformation transformation = axis.AxisScaleTypeMap.Transformation;
			return AxisCoordCalculator.GetInternalValue(transformation.TransformForward(range.Min), transformation.TransformForward(range.Max), ratio);
		}

		public int GetRoundedInterval(double interval)
		{
			return (int)Math.Abs(GetRoundedAxisValue(axis.WholeRange.Min + interval) - GetRoundedAxisValue(axis.WholeRange.Min));
		}

		public MinMaxValues GetCoordDiapasonInternal(double value, int diapason)
		{
			value = ApplyReverse(value);
			IntervalLayout nearestIntervalLayout = GetNearestIntervalLayout(value);
			if (nearestIntervalLayout == null)
			{
				return MinMaxValues.Empty;
			}
			IMinMaxValues range = nearestIntervalLayout.Interval.Range;
			Transformation transformation = axis.AxisScaleTypeMap.Transformation;
			Interval bounds = nearestIntervalLayout.Bounds;
			double min = transformation.TransformForward(range.Min);
			double max = transformation.TransformForward(range.Max);
			int num = diapason / 2;
			double ratio = (value - (double)num - bounds.Start) / bounds.Length;
			double internalValue = AxisCoordCalculator.GetInternalValue(min, max, ratio);
			if (diapason == 0)
			{
				return new MinMaxValues(transformation.TransformBackward(internalValue), transformation.TransformBackward(internalValue));
			}
			double ratio2 = (value + (double)num - bounds.Start) / bounds.Length;
			double internalValue2 = AxisCoordCalculator.GetInternalValue(min, max, ratio2);
			return new MinMaxValues(transformation.TransformBackward(internalValue), transformation.TransformBackward(internalValue2));
		}
	}
	public class SingleIntervalMappingCore : AxisMappingCore
	{

		public SingleIntervalMappingCore(IAxisData axis, double length)
			: base(axis, length)
		{
			AxisInterval interval = new AxisInterval(base.Axis.VisualRange, base.Axis.WholeRange);
			Interval bounds = new Interval(0.0, base.CutAxisLength);
			intervalLayout = new IntervalLayout(interval, bounds);
		}

		protected override IntervalLayout GetIntervalLayout(double value, bool exactLayout)
		{
			return intervalLayout;
		}

		protected override IntervalLayout GetIntervalLayoutByCoordinate(double coordinate)
		{
			return intervalLayout;
		}
	}

	public class MultiIntervalMappingCore : AxisMappingCore
	{
		private readonly IIntervalLayoutProvider intervalLayoutsProvider;

		public MultiIntervalMappingCore(IAxisData axis, IIntervalLayoutProvider intervalLayoutsProvider, double axisLength)
			: base(axis, axisLength)
		{
			this.intervalLayoutsProvider = intervalLayoutsProvider;
		}

		protected override IntervalLayout GetIntervalLayout(double value, bool exactLayout)
		{
			List<IntervalLayout> intervalLayouts = intervalLayoutsProvider.GetIntervalLayouts(base.Axis);
			for (int i = 0; i < intervalLayouts.Count - 1; i++)
			{
				if (intervalLayouts[i + 1].Interval.Range.Min > value)
				{
					if (exactLayout && !(intervalLayouts[i].Interval.Range.Max > value))
					{
						return null;
					}
					return intervalLayouts[i];
				}
			}
			if (exactLayout && !(intervalLayouts[intervalLayouts.Count - 1].Interval.Range.Max > value))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return intervalLayouts[intervalLayouts.Count - 1];
		}

		protected override IntervalLayout GetIntervalLayoutByCoordinate(double coordinate)
		{
			List<IntervalLayout> intervalLayouts = intervalLayoutsProvider.GetIntervalLayouts(base.Axis);
			for (int i = 0; i < intervalLayouts.Count; i++)
			{
				IntervalLayout intervalLayout = intervalLayouts[i];
				if (intervalLayout.Bounds.Contains(coordinate))
				{
					return intervalLayout;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected override IntervalLayout GetNearestIntervalLayout(double coordinate)
		{
			IntervalLayout result = null;
			double num = double.MaxValue;
			List<IntervalLayout> intervalLayouts = intervalLayoutsProvider.GetIntervalLayouts(base.Axis);
			for (int i = 0; i < intervalLayouts.Count; i++)
			{
				IntervalLayout intervalLayout = intervalLayouts[i];
				double num2 = intervalLayout.Bounds.DistanceFrom(coordinate);
				if (num2 == 0.0)
				{
					return intervalLayout;
				}
				if (num2 < num)
				{
					num = num2;
					result = intervalLayout;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}
	}
	public interface ICircularDiagram
	{
		double StartAngle { get; }

		CircularDiagramRotationDirectionCore RotationDirection { get; }

		CircularDiagramShapeStyleCore ShapeStyle { get; }

		GRealPoint2D AxisCenter { get; }
	}
	public enum CircularDiagramRotationDirectionCore
	{
		Counterclockwise,
		Clockwise
	}
	public enum CircularDiagramShapeStyleCore
	{
		Circle,
		Polygon
	}
	public class CircularAxisXMapping : SingleIntervalMappingCore
	{
		private class Segment
		{
			public double StartAngle { get; set; }

			public double FinishAngle { get; set; }

			public double MinValue { get; set; }

			public double MaxValue { get; set; }

			public double ValueDifference => MaxValue - MinValue;

			public double SweepAngle => FinishAngle - StartAngle;
		}

		private class EmptyCircularDiagram : ICircularDiagram
		{
			private static readonly EmptyCircularDiagram instance = new EmptyCircularDiagram();

			public static ICircularDiagram Instance => instance;

			double ICircularDiagram.StartAngle => 0.0;

			CircularDiagramRotationDirectionCore ICircularDiagram.RotationDirection => CircularDiagramRotationDirectionCore.Counterclockwise;

			CircularDiagramShapeStyleCore ICircularDiagram.ShapeStyle => CircularDiagramShapeStyleCore.Circle;

			GRealPoint2D ICircularDiagram.AxisCenter => new GRealPoint2D(0.0, 0.0);
		}

		private readonly List<Segment> segments = new List<Segment>();

		private readonly double axisRadius;

		private readonly GRealPoint2D axisCenter;

		private readonly double startAngleInRadian;

		private readonly CircularDiagramShapeStyleCore diagramShapeStyle;

		private readonly CircularDiagramRotationDirectionCore rotationDirection;

		private readonly bool looped;

		private readonly double maxAxisValue;

		private readonly double minAxisValue;

		public CircularAxisXMapping(IAxisData axis, ICircularDiagram circularDiagram, double radius, IList<double> values, bool looped)
			: base(axis, Math.PI * 2.0 * radius)
		{
			this.looped = looped;
			circularDiagram = circularDiagram ?? EmptyCircularDiagram.Instance;
			startAngleInRadian = circularDiagram.StartAngle;
			rotationDirection = circularDiagram.RotationDirection;
			diagramShapeStyle = circularDiagram.ShapeStyle;
			axisCenter = circularDiagram.AxisCenter;
			axisRadius = radius;
			double num = Math.PI * 2.0 / (double)(values.Count - 1);
			for (int i = 0; i < values.Count - 1; i++)
			{
				double startAngle;
				double finishAngle;
				if (rotationDirection == CircularDiagramRotationDirectionCore.Counterclockwise)
				{
					startAngle = num * (double)i + Math.PI / 2.0 + startAngleInRadian;
					finishAngle = num * (double)(i + 1) + Math.PI / 2.0 + startAngleInRadian;
				}
				else
				{
					startAngle = (0.0 - num) * (double)i + Math.PI / 2.0 - startAngleInRadian;
					finishAngle = (0.0 - num) * (double)(i + 1) + Math.PI / 2.0 - startAngleInRadian;
				}
				Segment item = new Segment
				{
					MinValue = Math.Min(values[i], values[i + 1]),
					MaxValue = Math.Max(values[i], values[i + 1]),
					StartAngle = startAngle,
					FinishAngle = finishAngle
				};
				segments.Add(item);
			}
			if (segments.Count > 0)
			{
				maxAxisValue = segments[segments.Count - 1].MaxValue;
				minAxisValue = segments[0].MinValue;
			}
		}

		private double GetNormalizedAngleRadian(Segment segment, double normalizedValue)
		{
			if (segment == null)
			{
				return startAngleInRadian;
			}
			double num = ((segment.ValueDifference > 0.0) ? ((normalizedValue - segment.MinValue) / segment.ValueDifference) : 0.0);
			return GeometricUtils.NormalizeRadian(segment.StartAngle + num * segment.SweepAngle);
		}

		private double GetValueScaleByAngle(Segment segment, double angle)
		{
			if (segment == null)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			GRealVector2D gRealVector2D = new GRealVector2D(Math.Cos(segment.StartAngle), Math.Sin(segment.StartAngle));
			GRealVector2D gRealVector2D2 = new GRealVector2D(Math.Cos(segment.FinishAngle), Math.Sin(segment.FinishAngle));
			GRealVector2D gRealVector2D3 = new GRealVector2D(Math.Cos(angle), Math.Sin(angle));
			GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D = axisCenter + gRealVector2D * axisRadius;
			GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D2 = axisCenter + gRealVector2D2 * axisRadius;
			GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D3 = axisCenter + gRealVector2D3 * axisRadius;
			GRealPoint2D line1P = new GRealPoint2D(gRealPoint2D.X, gRealPoint2D.Y);
			GRealPoint2D line1P2 = new GRealPoint2D(gRealPoint2D2.X, gRealPoint2D2.Y);
			GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D4 = new GRealPoint2D(axisCenter.X, axisCenter.Y);
			GRealPoint2D? gRealPoint2D5 = GeometricUtils.CalcLinesIntersection(line2P2: new GRealPoint2D(gRealPoint2D3.X, gRealPoint2D3.Y), line1P1: line1P, line1P2: line1P2, line2P1: gRealPoint2D4, intervalMode: false);
			if (!gRealPoint2D5.HasValue)
			{
				return 1.0;
			}
			GRealPoint2D value = gRealPoint2D5.Value;
			double num = GeometricUtils.CalcDistance(gRealPoint2D4, value);
			if (num != 0.0)
			{
				return num / axisRadius;
			}
			return 0.0;
		}

		private double GetValueScale(Segment segment, double normalizedValue)
		{
			if (segment == null)
			{
				return 1.0;
			}
			double normalizedAngleRadian = GetNormalizedAngleRadian(segment, normalizedValue);
			return GetValueScaleByAngle(segment, normalizedAngleRadian);
		}

		private Segment FindSegment(double value)
		{
			if (value > maxAxisValue || segments.Count == 0 || value < minAxisValue)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (ComparingUtils.CompareDoubles(value, maxAxisValue, 1E-07) == 0)
			{
				return segments[segments.Count - 1];
			}
			double valueDifference = segments[0].ValueDifference;
			int index = (int)((value - minAxisValue) / valueDifference);
			return segments[index];
		}

		private Segment FindSegmentByAngle(double angle)
		{
			if (segments.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			angle = GeometricUtils.NormalizeRadian(angle);
			double num = Math.PI * 2.0 / (double)segments.Count;
			int index = (int)(angle / num);
			return segments[index];
		}

		private GRealPoint2D GetPoint(double angle, double radius, GRealPoint2D center)
		{
			double num = Math.Cos(angle);
			double num2 = 0.0 - Math.Sin(angle);
			return new GRealPoint2D(center.X + num * radius, center.Y + num2 * radius);
		}

		public double NormalizeValue(double value)
		{
			if (segments.Count > 0)
			{
				double minValue = segments[0].MinValue;
				double maxValue = segments[segments.Count - 1].MaxValue;
				double num = maxValue - minValue;
				if (num > 0.0)
				{
					while (value < minValue)
					{
						value += num;
					}
					while (value > maxValue)
					{
						value -= num;
					}
				}
			}
			return value;
		}

		public double GetNormalizedAngleRadian(double value)
		{
			double num = (looped ? NormalizeValue(value) : value);
			Segment segment = FindSegment(num);
			return GetNormalizedAngleRadian(segment, num);
		}

		public double GetValueScale(double value)
		{
			if (diagramShapeStyle == CircularDiagramShapeStyleCore.Circle)
			{
				return 1.0;
			}
			double value2 = (looped ? NormalizeValue(value) : value);
			Segment segment = FindSegment(value2);
			return GetValueScale(segment, value);
		}

		public double GetValueScaleByAngle(double angle)
		{
			if (diagramShapeStyle == CircularDiagramShapeStyleCore.Circle)
			{
				return 1.0;
			}
			Segment segment = FindSegmentByAngle(angle);
			return GetValueScaleByAngle(segment, angle);
		}

		public GRealPoint2D GetPointOnCircularAxis(double value, GRealPoint2D center)
		{
			return GetPoint(GetNormalizedAngleRadian(value), axisRadius, center);
		}

		public GRealPoint2D GetPointOnCircularAxis(double value)
		{
			return GetPointOnCircularAxis(value, axisCenter);
		}

		public bool IsLastValue(double value)
		{
			if (segments.Count <= 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return segments[segments.Count - 1].MaxValue == value;
		}

		public List<GRealPoint2D> GetMeshPoints(double radius)
		{
			List<GRealPoint2D> list = new List<GRealPoint2D>();
			foreach (Segment segment in segments)
			{
				list.Add(GetPoint(segment.StartAngle, radius, axisCenter));
			}
			return list;
		}

		public bool ValueInRange(double value)
		{
			double value2 = (looped ? NormalizeValue(value) : value);
			return FindSegment(value2) != null;
		}
	}
	public class AxisIntervalLayoutCache : Dictionary<IXYDiagramPane, List<AxisIntervalLayout>>
	{
		public void SetAxisIntervalLayout(IXYDiagramPane pane, IEnumerable<AxisIntervalLayout> intervalLayouts)
		{
			if (pane != null)
			{
				List<AxisIntervalLayout> list;
				if (ContainsKey(pane))
				{
					list = base[pane];
					list.Clear();
				}
				else
				{
					list = new List<AxisIntervalLayout>();
					Add(pane, list);
				}
				list.AddRange(intervalLayouts);
			}
		}

		public double? GetAxisValue(IXYDiagramPane pane, ITransformation transformation, int coordinate)
		{
			AxisIntervalLayout intervalBounds = GetIntervalBounds(pane, coordinate);
			if (intervalBounds == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			AxisInterval interval = intervalBounds.Interval;
			Interval bounds = intervalBounds.Bounds;
			double ratio = ((double)coordinate - bounds.Start) / bounds.Length;
			return AxisCoordCalculator.GetInternalValue(transformation.TransformForward(interval.Range.Min), transformation.TransformForward(interval.Range.Max), ratio);
		}

		private AxisIntervalLayout GetIntervalBounds(IXYDiagramPane pane, int location)
		{
			if (ContainsKey(pane))
			{
				List<AxisIntervalLayout> list = base[pane];
				for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
				{
					AxisIntervalLayout axisIntervalLayout = list[i];
					if (axisIntervalLayout.Bounds.Contains(location))
					{
						return axisIntervalLayout;
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
