	internal class ScaleDiapasonCalculator
	{
		private static void Calculate(IAutoScaleBreaksContainer scaleBreaksContainer, IList<double> initialValues, Transformation transform)
		{
			IList<IScaleDiapason> scaleDiapasons = scaleBreaksContainer.ScaleDiapasons;
			scaleDiapasons.Clear();
			List<double> list = new List<double>(initialValues.Count);
			foreach (double initialValue in initialValues)
			{
				list.Add(transform.TransformForward(initialValue));
			}
			list.Sort();
			IAutoScaleBreaksCreator creator = scaleBreaksContainer.Creator;
			int maxCount = scaleBreaksContainer.MaxCount;
			IEnumerable<IScaleDiapason> enumerable = creator.Calculate(list, maxCount);
			foreach (IScaleDiapason item in enumerable)
			{
				if (scaleDiapasons.Count >= maxCount)
				{
					break;
				}
				double edge = transform.TransformBackward(item.Edge1);
				double edge2 = transform.TransformBackward(item.Edge2);
				scaleDiapasons.Add(creator.CreatePlatformAutoScaleBreak(edge, edge2));
			}
		}

		private static IEnumerable<double> CalculateInitialValuesCore(IAutoScaleBreaksContainer scaleBreaksContainer, ISeries series, RefinedPoint point)
		{
			if (scaleBreaksContainer.IsArgumentContainer)
			{
				return new double[1] { point.Argument };
			}
			ISeriesView seriesView = series.SeriesView;
			if (point.IsEmpty || seriesView == null)
			{
				return new double[0];
			}
			if (seriesView is IStackedView)
			{
				return new double[1] { ((IStackedPoint)point).MaxValue };
			}
			if (seriesView is IRangeSeriesView)
			{
				return new double[2]
				{
					((IRangePoint)point).Value1,
					((IRangePoint)point).Value2
				};
			}
			return new double[1] { point.GetValue(ValueLevelInternal.Value) };
		}

		internal static List<double> CalculateInitialValues(IAutoScaleBreaksContainer scaleBreaksContainer, IAxisData axis, IList<IRefinedSeries> refinedSeries)
		{
			List<double> list = new List<double>();
			foreach (IRefinedSeries item in refinedSeries)
			{
				if (!item.IsActive)
				{
					continue;
				}
				foreach (RefinedPoint point in item.Points)
				{
					list.AddRange(CalculateInitialValuesCore(scaleBreaksContainer, item.Series, point));
				}
			}
			if (axis.AxisScaleTypeMap.ScaleType == ActualScaleTypeCore.DateTime)
			{
				list.Add(axis.VisualRange.Min);
			}
			else
			{
				list.Add(0.0);
			}
			return list;
		}

		internal static bool IsCompatibleWithAxis(IAxisData axis, IAxisValueContainer container)
		{
			return axis.AxisScaleTypeMap.IsCompatible(container.AxisValue);
		}

		public static IList<IScaleDiapason> CalculateScaleDiapasons(IAxisData axis, IAutoScaleBreaksContainer autoScaleBreaksContainer)
		{
			List<IScaleDiapason> list = new List<IScaleDiapason>();
			if (axis.ScaleBreaks != null)
			{
				foreach (IScaleBreak scaleBreak in axis.ScaleBreaks)
				{
					if (IsCompatibleWithAxis(axis, scaleBreak.Edge1) && IsCompatibleWithAxis(axis, scaleBreak.Edge2))
					{
						list.Add((IScaleDiapason)scaleBreak);
					}
				}
			}
			if (autoScaleBreaksContainer != null)
			{
				foreach (IScaleDiapason scaleDiapason in autoScaleBreaksContainer.ScaleDiapasons)
				{
					list.Add(scaleDiapason);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		public static void UpdateAutomaticScaleBreaks(IAutoScaleBreaksContainer scaleBreaksContainer, IAxisData axis, List<IRefinedSeries> refinedSeries)
		{
			IList<double> initialValues = CalculateInitialValues(scaleBreaksContainer, axis, refinedSeries);
			Calculate(scaleBreaksContainer, initialValues, axis.AxisScaleTypeMap.Transformation);
		}
	}
	public static class DefaultAutomaticScaleBreaksCalculator
	{
		public static Func<List<double>, int, Clusters> CreateClusters { get; set; } = (List<double> axisValues, int maxScaleBreaksCount) => new Clusters(axisValues, maxScaleBreaksCount);

		public static IList<IScaleDiapason> Calculate(IAutoScaleBreaksCreator scaleBreaksCreator, List<double> axisValues, int maxScaleBreaksCount)
		{
			List<IScaleDiapason> list = new List<IScaleDiapason>();
			Clusters clusters = CreateClusters(axisValues, maxScaleBreaksCount + 1);
			if (clusters.Count > 1 && !double.IsNaN(clusters.MaxSize) && !double.IsNaN(clusters.MinDistance))
			{
				double num = Math.Min(clusters.MaxSize, clusters.MinDistance) / 10.0;
				for (int i = 0; i < clusters.Count - 1; i++)
				{
					double edge = clusters[i].LastValue + num;
					double edge2 = clusters[i + 1].FirstValue - num;
					list.Add(scaleBreaksCreator.CreatePlatformAutoScaleBreak(edge, edge2));
				}
			}
			return list;
		}
	}
	public class BoundPointsList : IList<IDataPoint>, ICollection<IDataPoint>, IEnumerable<IDataPoint>, IEnumerable, IReadOnlyList<IDataPoint>, IReadOnlyCollection<IDataPoint>
	{
		public sealed class BoundPointsEnumerator : IEnumerator<IDataPoint>, IDisposable, IEnumerator
		{
			private BoundPointsList points;

			private int index = -1;

			object IEnumerator.Current => points[index];

			IDataPoint IEnumerator<IDataPoint>.Current => points[index];

			public BoundPointsEnumerator(BoundPointsList points)
			{
				this.points = points;
			}

			public void Dispose()
			{
				points = null;
			}

			bool IEnumerator.MoveNext()
			{
				if (index < points.Count - 1)
				{
					index++;
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}

			void IEnumerator.Reset()
			{
				index = -1;
			}
		}

		private List<IDataPoint> points = new List<IDataPoint>();

		private int count;

		private int offset;

		public IDataPoint this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				return points[index + offset];
			}
			set
			{
				points[index + offset] = value;
			}
		}

		public int Count => count;

		bool ICollection<IDataPoint>.IsReadOnly => ((ICollection<IDataPoint>)points).IsReadOnly;

		bool ICollection<IDataPoint>.Contains(IDataPoint item)
		{
			return points.Contains(item);
		}

		void ICollection<IDataPoint>.CopyTo(IDataPoint[] array, int arrayIndex)
		{
			ClearOffset();
			points.CopyTo(array, arrayIndex);
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return new BoundPointsEnumerator(this);
		}

		IEnumerator<IDataPoint> IEnumerable<IDataPoint>.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return new BoundPointsEnumerator(this);
		}

		int IList<IDataPoint>.IndexOf(IDataPoint item)
		{
			return points.IndexOf(item) - offset;
		}

		bool ICollection<IDataPoint>.Remove(IDataPoint item)
		{
			ClearOffset();
			return points.Remove(item);
		}

		private void ClearOffset()
		{
			points.RemoveRange(0, offset);
			offset = 0;
		}

		private void CheckCapacity(int newItemsCount)
		{
			if (points.Count + newItemsCount >= points.Capacity)
			{
				ClearOffset();
			}
		}

		public void Add(IDataPoint item)
		{
			CheckCapacity(1);
			points.Add(item);
			count++;
		}

		public void AddRange(IList<IDataPoint> values)
		{
			CheckCapacity(values.Count);
			points.AddRange(values);
			count += values.Count;
		}

		public void Insert(int index, IDataPoint item)
		{
			CheckCapacity(1);
			points.Insert(index + offset, item);
			count++;
		}

		public void RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			if (index == 0)
			{
				points[index + offset] = null;
				offset++;
			}
			else
			{
				ClearOffset();
				points.RemoveAt(index);
			}
			count--;
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			points.Clear();
			count = 0;
			offset = 0;
		}

		public void SetPoints(List<IDataPoint> pointsList)
		{
			points = pointsList;
			count = pointsList.Count;
			offset = 0;
		}
	}
	public abstract class BindingProcedure : IDisposable
	{
		protected BindingEnvironment BindingEnvironment { get; private set; }

		protected string DataMember { get; }

		protected BindingProcedure(DataContextBase dataContext, object dataSource, string dataMember, IEnumerable<ICalculatedField> calculatedFields)
		{
			BindingEnvironment = new BindingEnvironment(dataContext, dataSource, calculatedFields);
			DataMember = dataMember;
		}

		protected abstract Dictionary<string, IDataMemberContainer> CreateAdditionalDataMemberContainers();

		protected abstract List<IDataMemberContainer> CreateDataMemberContainers();

		protected void AddArgumentContainer(List<IDataMemberContainer> containers, Scale scaleType, string argumentMember, bool supportEmpty)
		{
			string dataMember = BindingHelperCore.ConvertToActualDataMember(DataMember, argumentMember);
			switch (scaleType)
			{
			case Scale.Numerical:
				containers.Add(new ArgumentNumericDataMemberContainer(dataMember, supportEmpty));
				break;
			case Scale.DateTime:
				containers.Add(new ArgumentDateTimeDataMemberContainer(dataMember, supportEmpty));
				break;
			case Scale.TimeSpan:
				containers.Add(new ArgumentTimeSpanDataMemberContainer(dataMember, supportEmpty));
				break;
			default:
				containers.Add(new ArgumentQualitativeDataMemberContainer(dataMember, supportEmpty));
				break;
			}
		}

		protected void AddIndicatorContainer(Dictionary<string, IDataMemberContainer> containers, string dataMember)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(dataMember) && !containers.ContainsKey(dataMember))
			{
				string dataMember2 = BindingHelperCore.ConvertToActualDataMember(DataMember, dataMember);
				containers.Add(dataMember, new ValueNumericDataMemberContainer(dataMember2, supportEmptyValue: true));
			}
		}

		protected void AddObjectContainer(Dictionary<string, IDataMemberContainer> containers, string dataMember)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(dataMember) && !containers.ContainsKey(dataMember))
			{
				string dataMember2 = BindingHelperCore.ConvertToActualDataMember(DataMember, dataMember);
				containers.Add(dataMember, new ObjectDataMemberContainer(dataMember2, allowDBNull: true));
			}
		}

		protected void AddValueContainers(List<IDataMemberContainer> containers, Scale scaleType, IList<string> valueMembers, bool supportEmptyValue)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < valueMembers.Count; i++)
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(valueMembers[i]))
				{
					if (i == 5)
					{
						containers.Add(null);
					}
					continue;
				}
				string dataMember = BindingHelperCore.ConvertToActualDataMember(DataMember, valueMembers[i]);
				if (i == 6)
				{
					switch (scaleType)
					{
					case Scale.Numerical:
						containers.Add(new OutliersNumericDataMemberContainer(dataMember));
						break;
					case Scale.DateTime:
						containers.Add(new OutliersDateTimeDataMemberContainer(dataMember));
						break;
					case Scale.TimeSpan:
						containers.Add(new OutliersTimeSpanDataMemberContainer(dataMember));
						break;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					switch (scaleType)
					{
					case Scale.Numerical:
						containers.Add(new ValueNumericDataMemberContainer(dataMember, supportEmptyValue));
						break;
					case Scale.DateTime:
						containers.Add(new ValueDateTimeDataMemberContainer(dataMember, supportEmptyValue));
						break;
					case Scale.TimeSpan:
						containers.Add(new ValueTimeSpanDataMemberContainer(dataMember, supportEmptyValue));
						break;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		protected RowDataReader CreateDataReader()
		{
			List<IDataMemberContainer> list = CreateDataMemberContainers();
			Dictionary<string, IDataMemberContainer> additionalContainers = CreateAdditionalDataMemberContainers();
			if (list.Count <= 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new RowDataReader(list, additionalContainers);
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			IDisposable bindingEnvironment = BindingEnvironment;
			bindingEnvironment.Dispose();
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
		}
	}
	public abstract class BindingProcessorBase : IBindingProcessorBase
	{
		public const int maxUpdatesInQueue = 100000;

		protected IUpdateHelper ElementHelper { get; set; }

		protected virtual bool ShouldBreakUpdates => false;

		private static Tuple<bool, bool> ProcessBindingUpdates(Dictionary<IBindingProvider, DataSourceUpdateInfoCollection> updates, bool seriesCountChanged)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			bool seriesCountChanged2 = (seriesCountChanged = false);
			foreach (IBindingProvider key in updates.Keys)
			{
				Tuple<bool, bool> tuple = key.BindingProcessor.ProcessUpdates(updates[key], seriesCountChanged2);
				flag |= tuple.Item1;
				seriesCountChanged |= tuple.Item2;
			}
			return new Tuple<bool, bool>(flag, seriesCountChanged);
		}

		private static void SimplifyUpdate(DataSourceUpdateInfoCollection simplifyed, int updatesDelta, int batchDataCount, DataSourceUpdateInfoBase<IBindingProvider> firstBatchUpdate, ref int lastRemoveUpdateIndex)
		{
			DataSourceUpdateInfoBase<IBindingProvider> dataSourceUpdateInfoBase = ((updatesDelta == 1) ? firstBatchUpdate : new DataSourceUpdateInfoBase<IBindingProvider>(firstBatchUpdate.Sender, firstBatchUpdate.Type, firstBatchUpdate.Index, batchDataCount));
			if (dataSourceUpdateInfoBase.Type == ChartDataSourceUpdateType.Remove)
			{
				foreach (DataSourceUpdateInfoBase<IBindingProvider> item in simplifyed)
				{
					if (item.Index > dataSourceUpdateInfoBase.Index)
					{
						item.Index -= dataSourceUpdateInfoBase.Count;
					}
				}
			}
			if (dataSourceUpdateInfoBase.Type == ChartDataSourceUpdateType.Remove)
			{
				simplifyed.Insert(++lastRemoveUpdateIndex, dataSourceUpdateInfoBase);
			}
			else
			{
				simplifyed.Add(dataSourceUpdateInfoBase);
			}
		}

		protected static bool AllowUseResamplingBindingProcedure(IResamplingSupportSeries irss)
		{
			if (irss != null && irss.AllowResample)
			{
				return !irss.Require2dResampling;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static DataSourceUpdateInfoCollection SimplifyUpdates(DataSourceUpdateInfoCollectionBase<IBindingProvider> updates, int existItemsCount)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			DataSourceUpdateInfoCollection dataSourceUpdateInfoCollection = new DataSourceUpdateInfoCollection();
			int num = -1;
			int num2 = -1;
			int firstBatchUpdateIndex = -1;
			int batchDataCount = 0;
			int num3 = 0;
			int lastRemoveUpdateIndex = -1;
			bool isSinglePointChangedBatch = true;
			DataSourceUpdateInfoBase<IBindingProvider> firstBatchUpdate = null;
			Action<DataSourceUpdateInfoBase<IBindingProvider>, int> action = delegate(DataSourceUpdateInfoBase<IBindingProvider> update, int index)
			{
				firstBatchUpdate = update;
				firstBatchUpdateIndex = index;
				batchDataCount = firstBatchUpdate.Count;
				isSinglePointChangedBatch = firstBatchUpdate.Type == ChartDataSourceUpdateType.ItemChanged && firstBatchUpdate.Count == 1;
			};
			for (int num4 = 0; num4 < updates.Count; num4++)
			{
				switch (updates[num4].Type)
				{
				case ChartDataSourceUpdateType.Insert:
					num = ((num >= 0) ? Math.Min(num, updates[num4].Index) : updates[num4].Index);
					num3 += updates[num4].Count;
					flag = flag || num2 > num;
					break;
				case ChartDataSourceUpdateType.Remove:
					if (num >= 0 && updates[num4].Index > num)
					{
						flag = true;
					}
					else
					{
						num2 = Math.Max(num2, updates[num4].Index);
					}
					num3 += updates[num4].Count;
					break;
				case ChartDataSourceUpdateType.Reset:
					flag = true;
					break;
				case ChartDataSourceUpdateType.ItemChanged:
					if (firstBatchUpdate != null && (firstBatchUpdate.Index != updates[num4].Index || updates[num4].Count > 1))
					{
						isSinglePointChangedBatch = false;
					}
					break;
				}
				if (num3 > existItemsCount / 2)
				{
					flag = true;
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					break;
				}
				if (firstBatchUpdate == null)
				{
					action(updates[num4], num4);
				}
				else if (firstBatchUpdate.Type == ChartDataSourceUpdateType.ItemChanged && isSinglePointChangedBatch)
				{
					if (updates[num4].Type != firstBatchUpdate.Type)
					{
						dataSourceUpdateInfoCollection.Add(updates[num4 - 1]);
						action(updates[num4], num4);
					}
				}
				else if (updates[num4].Type != firstBatchUpdate.Type || (updates[num4].Index != firstBatchUpdate.Index + batchDataCount && (firstBatchUpdate.Type != ChartDataSourceUpdateType.Remove || updates[num4].Index != firstBatchUpdate.Index)))
				{
					SimplifyUpdate(dataSourceUpdateInfoCollection, num4 - firstBatchUpdateIndex, batchDataCount, firstBatchUpdate, ref lastRemoveUpdateIndex);
					action(updates[num4], num4);
				}
				else
				{
					batchDataCount += updates[num4].Count;
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				dataSourceUpdateInfoCollection.Clear();
				dataSourceUpdateInfoCollection.AddReset(updates[0].Sender);
			}
			else if (firstBatchUpdate.Type == ChartDataSourceUpdateType.ItemChanged && isSinglePointChangedBatch)
			{
				dataSourceUpdateInfoCollection.Add(updates[updates.Count - 1]);
			}
			else
			{
				SimplifyUpdate(dataSourceUpdateInfoCollection, updates.Count - firstBatchUpdateIndex, batchDataCount, firstBatchUpdate, ref lastRemoveUpdateIndex);
			}
			return dataSourceUpdateInfoCollection;
		}

		private DataSourceUpdateInfoCollection GetUpdatesCache(Dictionary<IBindingProvider, DataSourceUpdateInfoCollection> cache, IBindingProvider sender)
		{
			if (!cache.TryGetValue(sender, out var value))
			{
				value = new DataSourceUpdateInfoCollection();
				cache.Add(sender, value);
			}
			return value;
		}

		private bool UpdateBindingAsync(Dictionary<IBindingProvider, DataSourceUpdateInfoCollection> updates, IChartWithData chart)
		{
			ISeriesTemplateContainer diagram = chart.Diagram;
			bool flag = false;
			if (diagram == null)
			{
				return flag;
			}
			ISeriesTemplate seriesTemplate = diagram.SeriesTemplate;
			if (seriesTemplate != null)
			{
				seriesTemplate.ResetDataSourceScale();
				seriesTemplate.UpdateDataFilters();
			}
			bool flag2 = false;
			bool flag3 = false;
			Dictionary<IBindingProvider, DataSourceUpdateInfoCollection> dictionary = new Dictionary<IBindingProvider, DataSourceUpdateInfoCollection>();
			foreach (IBindingProvider key in updates.Keys)
			{
				DataSourceUpdateInfoCollection dataSourceUpdateInfoCollection = SimplifyUpdates(updates[key], key.ExistItemsCount);
				if (!flag3 && dataSourceUpdateInfoCollection.Count == 1 && dataSourceUpdateInfoCollection[0].Type == ChartDataSourceUpdateType.Reset)
				{
					flag3 = true;
				}
				dictionary.Add(key, dataSourceUpdateInfoCollection);
			}
			if (dictionary.Count > 0)
			{
				chart.ViewController.BeginUpdateData();
				Tuple<bool, bool> tuple = ProcessBindingUpdates(dictionary, flag2);
				flag |= tuple.Item1;
				flag2 |= tuple.Item2;
				updates.Clear();
				if (flag)
				{
					chart.Diagram.OnDataWasChanged();
				}
				chart.ViewController.EndUpdateData(flag3 || flag2);
				if (flag)
				{
					chart.RaiseBoundDataChangedEvent();
				}
			}
			return flag;
		}

		protected bool IsInsertAndRemoveUpdate(DataSourceUpdateInfoCollection updates)
		{
			if (updates.Count == 2)
			{
				if (updates[0].Type != ChartDataSourceUpdateType.Remove || updates[1].Type != ChartDataSourceUpdateType.Insert)
				{
					if (updates[0].Type == ChartDataSourceUpdateType.Insert)
					{
						return updates[1].Type == ChartDataSourceUpdateType.Remove;
					}
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected SeriesBindingProcedure CreateBindingProcedure(ISeries series)
		{
			IResamplingSupportSeries resamplingSupportSeries = series as IResamplingSupportSeries;
			SeriesDataAdapterSnapshot seriesDataAdapterSnapshot = new SeriesDataAdapterSnapshot(series);
			if (AllowUseResamplingBindingProcedure(resamplingSupportSeries))
			{
				RefinedSeries refinedSeries = resamplingSupportSeries.GetRefinedSeries();
				List<AxisScaleTypeMap> argumentMaps = refinedSeries?.GetArgumentScaleMaps();
				if (argumentMaps == null || refinedSeries == null)
				{
					resamplingSupportSeries.ForceInitialize();
					argumentMaps = resamplingSupportSeries.GetRefinedSeries()?.GetArgumentScaleMaps();
				}
				Func<double, IComparable> refinedToNativeCallback = (double argument) => (IComparable)((argumentMaps == null) ? ((object)argument) : ((IComparable)argumentMaps[0].RefinedToNative(argument)));
				Func<IComparable, double> argumentRefineCallback = (IComparable argument) => (argumentMaps == null) ? ((!(argument is DateTime)) ? Convert.ToDouble(argument) : 0.0) : argumentMaps[0].NativeToRefined(argument);
				return new ResamplingSeriesBindingProcedure(seriesDataAdapterSnapshot, resamplingSupportSeries.ResamplerData, argumentRefineCallback, refinedToNativeCallback)
				{
					MaximumAllowedPointCount = resamplingSupportSeries.MaximumPointCount
				};
			}
			return new SimpleSeriesBindingProcedure(seriesDataAdapterSnapshot);
		}

		protected void NotifyPointInsert(ISeries series, IDataPoint boundPoint, int index)

		protected void NotifyPointsInsert(ISeries series, ICollection<IDataPoint> insertedPoints, int index)

		}

		public abstract Tuple<bool, bool, bool> ProcessUpdate(DataSourceUpdateInfoBase<IBindingProvider> update);

		public virtual Tuple<bool, bool> ProcessUpdates(DataSourceUpdateInfoCollection updates, bool seriesCountChanged)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			foreach (DataSourceUpdateInfoBase<IBindingProvider> update in updates)
			{
				Tuple<bool, bool, bool> tuple = ProcessUpdate(update);
				if (ShouldBreakUpdates && !tuple.Item1)
				{
					return new Tuple<bool, bool>(item1: false, seriesCountChanged);
				}
				flag |= tuple.Item1;
				seriesCountChanged |= tuple.Item2;
				if (tuple.Item3)
				{
					break;
				}
			}
			return new Tuple<bool, bool>(flag, seriesCountChanged);
		}

		public bool RefreshData(DataSourceUpdateInfoCollectionBase<IBindingProvider> updates, IChartWithData chart)
		{
			if (chart == null)
			{
				Dictionary<IBindingProvider, DataSourceUpdateInfoCollection> dictionary = new Dictionary<IBindingProvider, DataSourceUpdateInfoCollection>();
				foreach (DataSourceUpdateInfoBase<IBindingProvider> update in updates)
				{
					if (!dictionary.ContainsKey(update.Sender))
					{
						dictionary.Add(update.Sender, new DataSourceUpdateInfoCollection());
					}
					dictionary[update.Sender].Add(update);
				}
				return ProcessBindingUpdates(dictionary, seriesCountChanged: false).Item1;
			}
			if (updates != null && updates.Count > 0)
			{
				foreach (DataSourceUpdateInfoBase<IBindingProvider> update2 in updates)
				{
					DataSourceUpdateInfoCollection updatesCache = GetUpdatesCache(chart.DataSourceUpdateCache, update2.Sender);
					updatesCache.Add(update2);
				}
			}
			return UpdateBindingAsync(chart.DataSourceUpdateCache, chart);
		}

		public void QueryUpdate(DataSourceUpdateInfoCollectionBase<IBindingProvider> updates, IChartWithData chart)
		{
			if (chart == null || (chart.Parent == null && !ShouldBreakUpdates) || (!chart.Loading && !chart.WasMeasured))
			{
				RefreshData(updates, chart);
				return;
			}
			foreach (DataSourceUpdateInfoBase<IBindingProvider> update in updates)
			{
				DataSourceUpdateInfoCollection updatesCache = GetUpdatesCache(chart.DataSourceUpdateCache, update.Sender);
				updatesCache.Add(update);
			}
			int num = 0;
			foreach (IBindingProvider key in chart.DataSourceUpdateCache.Keys)
			{
				num += chart.DataSourceUpdateCache[key].Count;
			}
			if (num > 100000)
			{
				foreach (IBindingProvider key2 in chart.DataSourceUpdateCache.Keys)
				{
					DataSourceUpdateInfoCollection dataSourceUpdateInfoCollection = chart.DataSourceUpdateCache[key2];
					dataSourceUpdateInfoCollection.Clear();
					dataSourceUpdateInfoCollection.AddReset(key2);
				}
			}
			chart.InvalidateMeasure();
		}
	}
	public abstract class SeriesBindingProcessorBase : BindingProcessorBase
	{
		protected BoundPointsList BoundPoints { get; }

		protected ISeriesBindingProvider SeriesBindingProvider { get; }

		protected ISeries Series => SeriesBindingProvider.Series;

		protected SeriesBindingProcessorBase(ISeriesBindingProvider seriesBindingProvider, BoundPointsList boundPoints)
		{
			SeriesBindingProvider = seriesBindingProvider;
			BoundPoints = boundPoints;
		}

		private bool ProcessInsert(int startIndex, int count)
		{
			if (startIndex < 0 || startIndex > BoundPoints.Count)
			{
				return false;
			}
			IList<IDataPoint> list = new List<IDataPoint>(count);
			startIndex = ((startIndex < 0) ? BoundPoints.Count : startIndex);
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				int index = startIndex + i;
				IDataPoint boundPoint = GetBoundPoint(index);
				if (boundPoint != null)
				{
					BoundPoints.Insert(index, boundPoint);
					list.Add(boundPoint);
				}
			}
			NotifyPointsInsert(Series, list, startIndex);
			return true;
		}

		private bool ProcessItemChanged(int startIndex, int count)
		{
			if (BoundPoints.Count < startIndex + count)
			{
				return false;
			}
			IList<IDataPoint> list = new List<IDataPoint>(count);
			IList<IDataPoint> list2 = new List<IDataPoint>(count);
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				int index = startIndex + i;
				IDataPoint boundPoint = GetBoundPoint(index);
				if (boundPoint == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				list2.Add(BoundPoints[index]);
				list.Add(boundPoint);
				BoundPoints[index] = boundPoint;
			}
			NotifyPointsChanged(Series, list2, list, startIndex);
			return true;
		}

		private bool ProcessRemove(int startIndex, int count)
		{
			if (startIndex < 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			IList<IDataPoint> list = new List<IDataPoint>(count);
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				if (BoundPoints.Count > startIndex)
				{
					IDataPoint item = BoundPoints[startIndex];
					BoundPoints.RemoveAt(startIndex);
					list.Add(item);
				}
			}
			NotifyPointsRemove(Series, list, startIndex);
			return true;
		}

		protected abstract bool ResetSeriesBinding();

		protected abstract IDataPoint GetBoundPoint(int index);

		protected Tuple<bool, bool, bool> ProcessUpdateCore(DataSourceUpdateInfoBase<IBindingProvider> update)
		{
			bool flag = update.Type switch
			{
				ChartDataSourceUpdateType.Insert => ProcessInsert(update.Index, update.Count), 
				ChartDataSourceUpdateType.Remove => ProcessRemove(update.Index, update.Count), 
				ChartDataSourceUpdateType.ItemChanged => ProcessItemChanged(update.Index, update.Count), 
				_ => false, 
			};
			if (!flag)
			{
				return new Tuple<bool, bool, bool>(ResetSeriesBinding(), item2: false, item3: true);
			}
			return new Tuple<bool, bool, bool>(flag, item2: false, item3: false);
		}

		protected Tuple<bool, bool> ProcessUpdatesCore(DataSourceUpdateInfoCollection updates, bool seriesCountChanged, bool isContinuousData)
		{
			if (isContinuousData && IsInsertAndRemoveUpdate(updates))
			{
				DataSourceUpdateInfoBase<IBindingProvider> dataSourceUpdateInfoBase = ((updates[0].Type == ChartDataSourceUpdateType.Remove) ? updates[0] : updates[1]);
				DataSourceUpdateInfoBase<IBindingProvider> dataSourceUpdateInfoBase2 = ((updates[0].Type == ChartDataSourceUpdateType.Insert) ? updates[0] : updates[1]);
				if (dataSourceUpdateInfoBase2.Index > dataSourceUpdateInfoBase.Index)
				{
					ProcessRemove(dataSourceUpdateInfoBase.Index, dataSourceUpdateInfoBase.Count);
					return new Tuple<bool, bool>(ProcessInsert(dataSourceUpdateInfoBase2.Index, dataSourceUpdateInfoBase2.Count), seriesCountChanged);
				}
			}
			return base.ProcessUpdates(updates, seriesCountChanged);
		}
	}

		}
	}

	public class ColorizerBindingProcedure : BindingProcedure
	{
		private readonly IDataSourceColorizer colorizer;

		public ColorizerBindingProcedure(IDataSourceColorizer colorizer, DataContextBase dataContext, object dataSource, string dataMember, IEnumerable<ICalculatedField> calculatedFields)
			: base(dataContext, dataSource, dataMember, calculatedFields)
		{
			this.colorizer = colorizer;
		}

		public void PopulateColorizer()
		{
			RowDataReader rowDataReader = CreateDataReader();
			if (rowDataReader == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			DataBrowser val = BindingHelperCore.CreateListBrowser(base.BindingEnvironment, BindingHelperCore.ConvertToActualDataMember(base.DataMember, colorizer.SeriesKeyMember));
			if (val == null || !rowDataReader.CreateBrowsers(base.BindingEnvironment))
			{
				return;
			}
			int position = val.Position;
			for (int i = 0; i < val.Count; i++)
			{
				val.Position = i;
				if (rowDataReader.Read())
				{
					object boxedValue = rowDataReader.DataMemberContainers[0].BoxedValue;
					if (boxedValue != null && !colorizer.IsColorMappingContainsKey(boxedValue))
					{
						object boxedValue2 = rowDataReader.DataMemberContainers[1].BoxedValue;
						colorizer.AddColorMappingElement(boxedValue, boxedValue2);
					}
				}
			}
			val.Position = position;
		}

		protected override List<IDataMemberContainer> CreateDataMemberContainers()
		{
			List<IDataMemberContainer> list = new List<IDataMemberContainer>();
			list.Add(new ObjectDataMemberContainer(BindingHelperCore.ConvertToActualDataMember(base.DataMember, colorizer.SeriesKeyMember)));
			list.Add(new ObjectDataMemberContainer(BindingHelperCore.ConvertToActualDataMember(base.DataMember, colorizer.SeriesColorMember)));
			return list;
		}

		protected override Dictionary<string, IDataMemberContainer> CreateAdditionalDataMemberContainers()
		{
			return null;
		}
	}

	public interface IDataFilter
	{
		bool Required { get; }

		object Value { get; }

		string ColumnName { get; }

		Type DataType { get; }

		Condition Condition { get; }

		CriteriaOperator ToCriteriaOperator();
	}
	public static class DataFilterToCriteriaConverter
	{
		public static BinaryOperatorType Convert(Condition condition)
		{
			return (BinaryOperatorType)(condition switch
			{
				Condition.Equal => 0, 
				Condition.GreaterThan => 2, 
				Condition.GreaterThanOrEqual => 5, 
				Condition.LessThan => 3, 
				Condition.LessThanOrEqual => 4, 
				Condition.NotEqual => 1, 
				_ => throw new ArgumentException(), 
			});
		}

		public static GroupOperatorType Convert(Conjunction conjunction)
		{
			return (GroupOperatorType)(conjunction switch
			{
				Conjunction.Or => 1, 
				Conjunction.And => 0, 
				_ => throw new ArgumentException(), 
			});
		}

		public static CriteriaOperator Convert(IDataFilter filter)
		{
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000c: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0012: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0018: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_001e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0023: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0026: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0027: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002d: Expected O, but got Unknown
			OperandProperty val = new OperandProperty(filter.ColumnName);
			OperandValue val2 = new OperandValue(filter.Value);
			BinaryOperatorType val3 = Convert(filter.Condition);
			return (CriteriaOperator)new BinaryOperator((CriteriaOperator)(object)val, (CriteriaOperator)(object)val2, val3);
		}

		public static CriteriaOperator Convert(IEnumerable<IDataFilter> filters, Conjunction conjunction)
		{
			//IL_0057: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0063: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (filters == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			List<CriteriaOperator> list = new List<CriteriaOperator>();
			foreach (IDataFilter filter in filters)
			{
				list.Add(filter.ToCriteriaOperator());
			}
			if (list.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (list.Count == 1)
			{
				return list[0];
			}
			return (CriteriaOperator)new GroupOperator(Convert(conjunction), (IEnumerable<CriteriaOperator>)list);
		}
	}

	public abstract class DataMemberContainer<T> : IDataMemberContainer<T>, IDataMemberContainer
	{
		private readonly string dataMember;

		private bool isTypedBrowser;

		private DataBrowser browser;

		protected virtual bool AllowDBNull => false;

		protected abstract T DefaultValue { get; }

		public abstract bool SupportEmptyValue { get; }

		public bool IsEmpty { get; private set; }

		public T Value { get; private set; }

		public string DataMember => dataMember;

		public virtual object BoxedValue
		{
			get
			{
				if (IsEmpty)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return Value;
			}
		}

		public DataMemberContainer(string dataMember)
		{
			this.dataMember = dataMember;
		}

		protected abstract bool IsCompatibleType(Type type);

		protected abstract bool IsEmptyValue(T value);

		protected abstract T ConvertValue(object value);

		protected abstract T ParseValue(object value);

		public void Read()
		{
			Value = DefaultValue;
			DataBrowser obj = browser;
			object obj2 = ((obj != null) ? obj.Current : null);
			if (obj2 != null && (AllowDBNull || obj2 != DBNull.Value))
			{
				if (isTypedBrowser || IsCompatibleType(obj2.GetType()))
				{
					Value = ConvertValue(obj2);
				}
				else
				{
					Value = ParseValue(obj2);
				}
				IsEmpty = IsEmptyValue(Value);
			}
			else
			{
				IsEmpty = true;
			}
		}

		public bool CreateDataBrowser(BindingEnvironment environment)
		{
			browser = environment.GetDataBrowser(dataMember, suppressException: true);
			if (browser != null)
			{
				isTypedBrowser = browser is ListBrowser || IsCompatibleType(browser.DataSourceType);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

	public class ValueNumericDataMemberContainer : ComparableDataMemberContainer<double>
	{
		protected override double DefaultValue => double.NaN;

		public ValueNumericDataMemberContainer(string dataMember, bool supportEmptyValue)
			: base(dataMember, supportEmptyValue)
		{
		}

		protected override bool IsCompatibleType(Type type)
		{
			return PredefinedTypesHelper.IsNumericalType(type);
		}

		protected override bool IsEmptyValue(double value)
		{
			return !GeometricUtils.IsValidDouble(value);
		}

		protected override double ConvertValue(object value)
		{
			return Convert.ToDouble(value);
		}

		protected override double ParseValue(object value)
		{
			string s = Convert.ToString(value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
			if (!double.TryParse(s, NumberStyles.Any, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out var result))
			{
				return DefaultValue;
			}
			return result;
		}
	}

	public abstract class OutliersDataMemberContainer<T> : IOutliersDataMemberContainer<T>, IDataMemberContainer where T : IComparable
	{
		private readonly string dataMember;

		private readonly List<T> values = new List<T>();

		private DataBrowser browser;

		private RelatedListBrowser listBrowser;

		public IList<T> Values => values;

		public bool SupportEmptyValue => true;

		public bool IsEmpty => false;

		public string DataMember => dataMember;

		public object BoxedValue => values;

		public OutliersDataMemberContainer(string dataMember)
		{
			this.dataMember = dataMember;
		}

		private void AddValue(object currentValue)
		{
			if (currentValue != null && currentValue != DBNull.Value)
			{
				T val = ParseValue(currentValue);
				if (!IsEmptyValue(val))
				{
					values.Add(val);
				}
			}
		}

		protected abstract bool IsEmptyValue(T value);

		protected abstract T ParseValue(object value);

		public void Read()
		{
			values.Clear();
			if (listBrowser != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < ((DataBrowser)listBrowser).Count; i++)
				{
					((DataBrowser)listBrowser).Position = i;
					AddValue(((DataBrowser)listBrowser).Current);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				AddValue(browser.Current);
			}
		}

		public bool CreateDataBrowser(BindingEnvironment environment)
		{
			browser = environment.GetDataBrowser(dataMember, suppressException: true);
			ref RelatedListBrowser reference = ref listBrowser;
			DataBrowser obj = browser;
			reference = (RelatedListBrowser)(object)((obj is RelatedListBrowser) ? obj : null);
			return browser != null;
		}
	}

	public class IntervalManager
	{
		public class IntervalManagerArgumentComparer : IComparer<IntervalData>
		{
			public IntervalData Result { get; set; }

			public int Compare(IntervalData x, IntervalData y)
			{
				if (x != null && y != null)
				{
					if (Result == null)
					{
						Result = x;
					}
					if (Math.Abs((double)(object)Result.Argument - (double)(object)y.Argument) > Math.Abs((double)(object)x.Argument - (double)(object)y.Argument))
					{
						Result = x;
					}
					return x.Argument.CompareTo(y.Argument);
				}
				return -1;
			}
		}

		public class IntervalManagerIndexComparer : IComparer<IntervalData>
		{
			public IntervalData Result { get; set; }

			public int Compare(IntervalData x, IntervalData y)
			{
				if (x != null && y != null)
				{
					if (x.EndIntervalDataIndex == y.EndIntervalDataIndex)
					{
						Result = x;
					}
					return x.EndIntervalDataIndex.CompareTo(y.EndIntervalDataIndex);
				}
				return -1;
			}
		}

		public const int DefaultCapacity = 2000;

		private readonly List<IntervalData> intervals = new List<IntervalData>();

		public IntervalManagerArgumentComparer ArgumentComparer { get; set; }

		public IntervalManagerIndexComparer IndexComparer { get; set; }

		public IList<IntervalData> Intervals => intervals;

		public IMinMaxValues WholeRange { get; set; }

		public IntervalManager()
		{
			ArgumentComparer = new IntervalManagerArgumentComparer();
			IndexComparer = new IntervalManagerIndexComparer();
		}

		private void InvalidateIntervals(int startIndex, int endIndex, int count, bool shouldReset)
		{
			for (int i = startIndex; i < endIndex; i++)
			{
				InvalidateInterval(intervals[i], count, shouldReset);
			}
		}

		private void InvalidateInterval(IntervalData interval, int count, bool shouldReset)
		{
			ResamplerData resamplerData = interval.ResamplerData;
			if (resamplerData != null)
			{
				if (shouldReset)
				{
					interval.ResamplerData = null;
				}
				else
				{
					resamplerData.StartIndex += count;
					resamplerData.EndIndex += count;
				}
			}
			interval.EndIntervalDataIndex += count;
		}

		private void CalculateVisibleIndexes(int rowCount, double minValue, double maxValue, out int startVisibleIndex, out int endVisibleIndex)
		{
			IntervalData nearest = GetNearest(ResamplingSeriesBindingProcedure.Compare(minValue, Intervals.First().Argument, getMin: false));
			startVisibleIndex = Math.Min(nearest.EndIntervalDataIndex, nearest.ResamplerData?.StartIndex ?? nearest.EndIntervalDataIndex);
			endVisibleIndex = GetNearest(ResamplingSeriesBindingProcedure.Compare(maxValue, Intervals.Last().Argument, getMin: true)).EndIntervalDataIndex;
			startVisibleIndex = Math.Max(startVisibleIndex - 1, 0);
			endVisibleIndex = Math.Min(endVisibleIndex + 1, rowCount);
		}

		public int GuessStepByIntervalData()
		{
			IntervalData intervalData = Intervals.Where((IntervalData i) => i.ResamplerData != null).Skip(20).FirstOrDefault();
			if (intervalData == null)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			return intervalData.ResamplerData.EndIndex - intervalData.ResamplerData.StartIndex;
		}

		public bool Invalidate(DataSourceUpdateInfoBase<IBindingProvider> update)
		{
			bool result = false;
			for (int i = update.Index; i < update.Index + update.Count; i++)
			{
				if (update.Type != ChartDataSourceUpdateType.ViewportChanged)
				{
					result = true;
					IntervalData intervalByDatasourceIndex = GetIntervalByDatasourceIndex(i);
					if (update.Type == ChartDataSourceUpdateType.Reset || intervalByDatasourceIndex == null)
					{
						InvalidateIntervals(0, intervals.Count, 0, shouldReset: true);
						break;
					}
					int intervalManagerIndex = intervalByDatasourceIndex.IntervalManagerIndex;
					if (update.Type == ChartDataSourceUpdateType.Remove || update.Type == ChartDataSourceUpdateType.Insert)
					{
						InvalidateIntervals(intervalManagerIndex, intervals.Count, update.Count * ((update.Type != ChartDataSourceUpdateType.Remove) ? 1 : (-1)), shouldReset: false);
					}
					if (intervalByDatasourceIndex.ResamplerData != null)
					{
						i += intervalByDatasourceIndex.ResamplerData.EndIndex - intervalByDatasourceIndex.ResamplerData.StartIndex;
					}
					InvalidateInterval(intervals[intervalManagerIndex], 0, shouldReset: true);
				}
			}
			int num = intervals.Count;
			bool flag = false;
			int num2 = 0;
			while (num2 < num && intervals[num2].EndIntervalDataIndex < 0)
			{
				intervals.RemoveAt(num2);
				num2--;
				num--;
				flag = true;
				num2++;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < num; j++)
				{
					intervals[j].IntervalManagerIndex = j;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		public void Populate(ResamplerData data)
		{
			intervals.Clear();
			intervals.AddRange(data.Offsets);
			WholeRange = data.WholeRange;
		}

		public void Add(int startDatasourceIndex, double startIntervalArgument, ResamplerData point)
		{
			intervals.Add(new IntervalData(startDatasourceIndex, startIntervalArgument, point, intervals.Count));
		}

		public int CalculateVisibleIndexesWithOffset(ResamplerData resampledData, int rowCount, out int startVisibleIndex, out int endVisibleIndex)
		{
			int num = Math.Max(1, rowCount / 2000);
			CalculateVisibleIndexes(rowCount, resampledData.VisibleRange.Min - (double)num, resampledData.VisibleRange.Max + (double)num, out startVisibleIndex, out endVisibleIndex);
			return num;
		}

		public int CalculatePointCount(ResamplerData resampledData, int rowCount)
		{
			CalculateVisibleIndexes(rowCount, resampledData.VisibleRange.Min, resampledData.VisibleRange.Max, out var startVisibleIndex, out var endVisibleIndex);
			return endVisibleIndex - startVisibleIndex;
		}

		public IntervalData GetIntervalByDatasourceIndex(int index)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < intervals.Count; i++)
			{
				if (intervals[i].EndIntervalDataIndex >= index)
				{
					return intervals[i];
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public IntervalData GetNearest(IComparable value)
		{
			if (intervals.Count <= 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			IntervalData intervalData = new IntervalData(-1, value, null, 0);
			if (ArgumentComparer.Result != null && ArgumentComparer.Result.IntervalManagerIndex < intervals.Count - 1)
			{
				int intervalManagerIndex = ArgumentComparer.Result.IntervalManagerIndex;
				IntervalData intervalData2 = intervals[intervalManagerIndex];
				IntervalData intervalData3 = intervals[intervalManagerIndex + 1];
				int num = ArgumentComparer.Compare(intervalData2, intervalData);
				int num2 = ArgumentComparer.Compare(intervalData3, intervalData);
				if (num2 != num)
				{
					ArgumentComparer.Result = intervals[intervalManagerIndex];
					if (Math.Abs((double)(object)intervalData2.Argument - (double)(object)value) < Math.Abs((double)(object)intervalData3.Argument - (double)(object)value))
					{
						if ((double)(object)intervalData2.Argument < (double)(object)value)
						{
							return intervalData3;
						}
						return intervalData2;
					}
					return intervalData3;
				}
			}
			ArgumentComparer.Result = null;
			intervals.BinarySearch(intervalData, ArgumentComparer);
			return ArgumentComparer.Result;
		}
	}

	public interface IRowData
	{
		bool IsEmpty { get; }

		List<IDataMemberContainer> DataMemberContainers { get; }

	}
	public class RowDataReader : IRowData
	{
		private readonly List<IDataMemberContainer> dataMemberContainers;

		private readonly Dictionary<string, IDataMemberContainer> additionalContainers;

		public bool IsEmpty { get; private set; }

		public List<IDataMemberContainer> DataMemberContainers => dataMemberContainers;

		public Dictionary<string, IDataMemberContainer> AdditionalContainers => additionalContainers;

		public RowDataReader(List<IDataMemberContainer> dataMemberContainers, Dictionary<string, IDataMemberContainer> additionalContainers)
		{
			this.dataMemberContainers = dataMemberContainers;
			this.additionalContainers = additionalContainers;
		}

		public bool Read()
		{
			IsEmpty = false;
			foreach (IDataMemberContainer dataMemberContainer in dataMemberContainers)
			{
				if (dataMemberContainer == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				dataMemberContainer.Read();
				if (dataMemberContainer.IsEmpty)
				{
					IsEmpty = true;
					if (!dataMemberContainer.SupportEmptyValue)
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
			}
			if (additionalContainers != null)
			{
				foreach (IDataMemberContainer value in additionalContainers.Values)
				{
					value.Read();
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public bool CreateBrowsers(BindingEnvironment environment)
		{
			foreach (IDataMemberContainer dataMemberContainer in dataMemberContainers)
			{
				if (dataMemberContainer != null && !dataMemberContainer.CreateDataBrowser(environment))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			if (additionalContainers != null)
			{
				foreach (IDataMemberContainer value in additionalContainers.Values)
				{
					value.CreateDataBrowser(environment);
				}
			}
			return true;
		}
	}
	public abstract class ChartBindingProcedure : BindingProcedure
	{
		private readonly string seriesDataMember;

		private IDataSourceColorizer seriesColorizer;

		protected List<ISeries> AutoCreatedSeries { get; }

		protected ISeriesDataAdapter DataAdapter => SeriesFactory.DataAdapter;

		protected ISeriesFactory SeriesFactory { get; }

		protected ISeriesBase SeriesTemplate => SeriesFactory.SeriesTemplate;

		protected string ActualSeriesDataMember => BindingHelperCore.ConvertToActualDataMember(base.DataMember, seriesDataMember);

		protected ChartBindingProcedure(string seriesDataMember, ISeriesFactory seriesTemplate)
			: base(seriesTemplate.DataAdapter.DataContext, seriesTemplate.DataAdapter.DataSource, seriesTemplate.DataAdapter.DataMember, seriesTemplate.DataAdapter.CalculatedFields)
		{
			this.seriesDataMember = seriesDataMember;
			SeriesFactory = seriesTemplate;
			AutoCreatedSeries = new List<ISeries>();
		}

		private void UpdateSeriesColorizer(RowDataReader dataReader, object seriesValue)
		{
			string key = ((!string.IsNullOrEmpty(seriesColorizer.SeriesColorMember)) ? seriesColorizer.SeriesColorMember : DataAdapter.ColorDataMember);
			object color = null;
			if (dataReader.AdditionalContainers.ContainsKey(key))
			{
				color = dataReader.AdditionalContainers[key].BoxedValue;
			}
			object obj = seriesValue;
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(seriesColorizer.SeriesKeyMember) && dataReader.AdditionalContainers.ContainsKey(seriesColorizer.SeriesKeyMember))
			{
				obj = dataReader.AdditionalContainers[seriesColorizer.SeriesKeyMember].BoxedValue;
			}
			if (!seriesColorizer.IsColorMappingContainsKey(obj))
			{
				seriesColorizer.AddColorMappingElement(obj, color);
			}
			seriesColorizer.SeriesValueToColorKeyMapping[seriesValue] = obj;
		}

		private IEnumerable<ISeries> CreateSortedSeriesList(Dictionary<object, ISeries> seriesList, SortMode sorting)
		{
			List<ISeries> list = new List<ISeries>();
			List<object> list2 = new List<object>();
			list2.AddRange(seriesList.Keys);
			list2.Sort(BindingHelperCore.CompareValues);
			if (sorting == SortMode.Descending)
			{
				list2.Reverse();
			}
			foreach (object item2 in list2)
			{
				ISeries item = seriesList[item2];
				list.Add(item);
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected abstract void OnDataWereRead();

		protected abstract void OnRowWasRead(ISeries series, object dataRow, RowDataReader dataReader);

		protected override Dictionary<string, IDataMemberContainer> CreateAdditionalDataMemberContainers()
		{
			Dictionary<string, IDataMemberContainer> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, IDataMemberContainer>();
			AddObjectContainer(dictionary, DataAdapter.ColorDataMember);
			AddObjectContainer(dictionary, DataAdapter.ToolTipHintDataMember);
			if (SeriesTemplate.Indicators != null && SeriesTemplate.ValueScaleType == Scale.Numerical)
			{
				foreach (IDataSourceIndicator indicator in SeriesTemplate.Indicators)
				{
					foreach (string valueDataMember in indicator.ValueDataMembers)
					{
						AddIndicatorContainer(dictionary, valueDataMember);
					}
				}
			}
			if (seriesColorizer != null)
			{
				AddObjectContainer(dictionary, seriesColorizer.SeriesColorMember);
				if (seriesColorizer.SeriesKeyMember != seriesDataMember)
				{
					AddObjectContainer(dictionary, seriesColorizer.SeriesKeyMember);
				}
			}
			if (dictionary.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return dictionary;
		}

		public IList<ISeries> CreateBindingSeries(SortMode sorting, IList<ISeries> autoCreatedSeries)
		{
			Dictionary<object, ISeries> dictionary = new Dictionary<object, ISeries>();
			Dictionary<object, ISeries> dictionary2 = new Dictionary<object, ISeries>();
			if (autoCreatedSeries != null)
			{
				foreach (ISeries item in autoCreatedSeries)
				{
					if (item.Tag != null && !dictionary2.ContainsKey(item.Tag) && item?.SeriesView?.GetType() == SeriesFactory?.SeriesTemplate?.GetType())
					{
						dictionary2.Add(item.Tag, item);
					}
				}
			}
			string actualSeriesDataMember = ActualSeriesDataMember;
			DataBrowser val = BindingHelperCore.CreateListBrowser(base.BindingEnvironment, actualSeriesDataMember);
			DataBrowser dataBrowser = base.BindingEnvironment.GetDataBrowser(actualSeriesDataMember, suppressException: true);
			RowDataReader rowDataReader = CreateDataReader();
			if (rowDataReader != null && val != null && dataBrowser != null && rowDataReader.CreateBrowsers(base.BindingEnvironment))
			{
				DataBrowser val2 = BindingHelperCore.CreateListBrowser(base.BindingEnvironment, rowDataReader.DataMemberContainers[0].DataMember);
				if (val2 != null)
				{
					int position = val.Position;
					for (int i = 0; i < val.Count; i++)
					{
						val.Position = i;
						val2.Position = i;
						object current2 = val2.Current;
						object current3 = dataBrowser.Current;
						if (current3 == null || !BindingHelperCore.IsFit(DataAdapter, current2) || !rowDataReader.Read())
						{
							continue;
						}
						dictionary.TryGetValue(current3, out var value);
						if (value == null || dictionary2.ContainsKey(current3))
						{
							string seriesName = $"{SeriesFactory.SeriesNameBeginText}{current3.ToString()}{SeriesFactory.SeriesNameEndText}";
							dictionary2.TryGetValue(current3, out value);
							if (value != null)
							{
								if (value is ISeriesBindingProvider seriesBindingProvider)
								{
									seriesBindingProvider.BindingClear(clearBoundPoints: true);
								}
								value = SeriesFactory.CreateSeriesForBinding(seriesName, current3, value);
								dictionary2.Remove(value.Tag);
							}
							else
							{
								value = SeriesFactory.CreateSeriesForBinding(seriesName, current3);
							}
							dictionary.Add(current3, value);
							if (seriesColorizer != null && rowDataReader.AdditionalContainers != null)
							{
								UpdateSeriesColorizer(rowDataReader, current3);
							}
						}
						OnRowWasRead(value, current2, rowDataReader);
					}
					OnDataWereRead();
					val.Position = position;
					IEnumerable<ISeries> enumerable;
					if (sorting == SortMode.None)
					{
						IEnumerable<ISeries> values = dictionary.Values;
						enumerable = values;
					}
					else
					{
						enumerable = CreateSortedSeriesList(dictionary, sorting);
					}
					IEnumerable<ISeries> collection = enumerable;
					AutoCreatedSeries.AddRange(collection);
				}
			}
			return AutoCreatedSeries;
		}

		public void SetSeriesColorizer(IDataSourceColorizer colorizer)
		{
			if (colorizer.DataSource == null)
			{
				seriesColorizer = colorizer;
			}
		}
	}
	public class SimpleChartBindingProcedure : ChartBindingProcedure
	{
		private readonly bool allowCachedUpdates;

		private readonly SeriesPointDataContainer templateContainer;

		public SimpleChartBindingProcedure(string seriesDataMember, ISeriesFactory seriesTemplate, bool allowCachedUpdates)
			: base(seriesDataMember, seriesTemplate)
		{
			this.allowCachedUpdates = allowCachedUpdates;
			templateContainer = seriesTemplate.CreateTemplateContainer();
		}

		private void AddPoint(ISeries series, object dataRow, RowDataReader dataReader)
		{
			IDataPoint point = series.CreateSeriesPoint(series, dataRow, templateContainer, dataReader);
			series.AddSeriesPoint(point);
		}

		private ISeries GetSeries(IList<ISeries> autocreatedSeries, object tag)
		{
			foreach (ISeries item in autocreatedSeries)
			{
				if (tag.Equals(item.Tag))
				{
					return item;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected override List<IDataMemberContainer> CreateDataMemberContainers()
		{
			List<IDataMemberContainer> list = new List<IDataMemberContainer>();
			AddArgumentContainer(list, base.SeriesTemplate.ArgumentScaleType, base.DataAdapter.ArgumentDataMember, base.SeriesTemplate.ProcessMissingArguments);
			if (base.SeriesTemplate.IsTwoArgumentsSeries)
			{
				AddArgumentContainer(list, base.SeriesTemplate.ArgumentScaleType2, base.DataAdapter.ArgumentDataMember2, base.SeriesTemplate.ProcessMissingArguments);
			}
			IList<string> seriesValueDataMembers = base.DataAdapter.GetSeriesValueDataMembers();
			AddValueContainers(list, base.SeriesTemplate.ValueScaleType, seriesValueDataMembers, base.SeriesTemplate.ProcessMissingValues);
			return list;
		}

		protected override void OnRowWasRead(ISeries series, object dataRow, RowDataReader dataReader)
		{
			AddPoint(series, dataRow, dataReader);
		}

		protected override void OnDataWereRead()
		{
		}

		public ISeries AddBoundPoint(IList<ISeries> autocreatedSeries, int index)
		{
			ISeries series = null;
			string actualSeriesDataMember = base.ActualSeriesDataMember;
			DataBrowser val = BindingHelperCore.CreateListBrowser(base.BindingEnvironment, actualSeriesDataMember);
			bool num;
			if (!allowCachedUpdates)
			{
				num = index == val.Count - 1;
			}
			else
			{
				if (index <= 0)
				{
					goto IL_00d4;
				}
				num = index <= val.Count - 1;
			}
			if (num)
			{
				DataBrowser dataBrowser = base.BindingEnvironment.GetDataBrowser(actualSeriesDataMember, suppressException: true);
				RowDataReader rowDataReader = CreateDataReader();
				if (rowDataReader != null && val != null && dataBrowser != null && rowDataReader.CreateBrowsers(base.BindingEnvironment))
				{
					int position = val.Position;
					val.Position = index;
					object current = dataBrowser.Current;
					object current2 = val.Current;
					if (BindingHelperCore.IsFit(base.DataAdapter, current2) && current != null && rowDataReader.Read())
					{
						series = GetSeries(autocreatedSeries, current);
						if (series != null)
						{
							AddPoint(series, current2, rowDataReader);
						}
					}
					val.Position = position;
				}
			}
			goto IL_00d4;
			IL_00d4:
			return series;
		}
	}
	public abstract class SummaryChartBindingProcedureBase : ChartBindingProcedure
	{
		private readonly ISummaryBindingProvider summaryBindingProvider;

		private readonly string[] summaryDataMembers;

		protected SummaryChartBindingProcedureBase(string seriesDataMember, ISeriesFactory seriesTemplate, ISummaryBindingProvider summaryBindingProvider)
			: base(seriesDataMember, seriesTemplate)
		{
			this.summaryBindingProvider = summaryBindingProvider;
			summaryDataMembers = SummaryBindingHelper.GetSummaryDataMembers(summaryBindingProvider, base.DataMember);
		}

		protected void AddPoints(ISeries series, BoundDataItem boundItem)
		{
			IDataPoint[] array = summaryBindingProvider.CreatePoints(series, boundItem.Argument, summaryDataMembers, boundItem.Values.ToArray(), boundItem.ColorKeys.ToArray());
			if (array != null)
			{
				IDataPoint[] array2 = array;
				foreach (IDataPoint dataPoint in array2)
				{
					dataPoint.Apply(series, boundItem.ToolTipHint);
					series.AddSeriesPoint(dataPoint);
				}
			}
		}

		protected abstract void SummarizeRow(ISeries series, object argument, DataSourceValuesCore values, RowDataReader dataReader);

		protected override void OnRowWasRead(ISeries series, object dataRow, RowDataReader dataReader)
		{
			if (dataReader.DataMemberContainers.Count != 0)
			{
				object summaryArgument = SummaryBindingHelper.GetSummaryArgument(dataReader.DataMemberContainers[0].BoxedValue, base.SeriesFactory.SeriesTemplate, summaryBindingProvider);
				if (summaryArgument != null)
				{
					DataSourceValuesCore summaryValues = SummaryBindingHelper.GetSummaryValues(summaryBindingProvider, dataReader.DataMemberContainers, dataRow);
					SummarizeRow(series, summaryArgument, summaryValues, dataReader);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override List<IDataMemberContainer> CreateDataMemberContainers()
		{
			List<IDataMemberContainer> list = new List<IDataMemberContainer>();
			AddArgumentContainer(list, base.SeriesTemplate.ArgumentScaleType, base.DataAdapter.ArgumentDataMember, supportEmpty: true);
			IList<string> list2 = BindingHelperCore.GetSummaryDataMembers(summaryBindingProvider);
			foreach (string item in list2)
			{
				list.Add(new ObjectDataMemberContainer(BindingHelperCore.ConvertToActualDataMember(base.DataMember, item)));
			}
			return list;
		}
	}
	public class SummaryChartBindingProcedure : SummaryChartBindingProcedureBase
	{
		private readonly Dictionary<ISeries, BoundData> boundData = new Dictionary<ISeries, BoundData>();

		public SummaryChartBindingProcedure(string seriesDataMember, ISeriesFactory seriesTemplate, ISummaryBindingProvider summaryBindingProvider)
			: base(seriesDataMember, seriesTemplate, summaryBindingProvider)
		{
		}

		protected override void SummarizeRow(ISeries series, object argument, DataSourceValuesCore values, RowDataReader dataReader)
		{
			if (!boundData.ContainsKey(series))
			{
				boundData.Add(series, new BoundData());
			}
			BoundDataItem boundDataItem;
			if (!boundData[series].ContainsArgument(argument))
			{
				boundData[series].Add(argument);
				boundDataItem = boundData[series][argument];
				SummaryBindingHelper.AddToolTipHint(boundDataItem, base.DataAdapter, dataReader);
			}
			else
			{
				boundDataItem = boundData[series][argument];
			}
			boundDataItem.Values.Add(values);
			SummaryBindingHelper.AddColor(boundDataItem, base.DataAdapter, dataReader);
		}

		protected override void OnDataWereRead()
		{
			foreach (ISeries key in this.boundData.Keys)
			{
				BoundData boundData = this.boundData[key];
				foreach (BoundDataItem item in boundData.Items)
				{
					AddPoints(key, item);
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public abstract class SeriesBindingProcedure : BindingProcedure
	{
		private int dataItemsCount;

		private SeriesDataAdapterSnapshot seriesDataAdapterSnapshot;

		protected SeriesDataAdapterSnapshot DataAdapter => seriesDataAdapterSnapshot;

		protected List<IDataPoint> Points { get; } = new List<IDataPoint>();

		public bool IsContinuousData => Points.Count == dataItemsCount;

		protected SeriesBindingProcedure(SeriesDataAdapterSnapshot seriesDataAdapterSnapshot)
			: base(seriesDataAdapterSnapshot.DataContext, seriesDataAdapterSnapshot.DataSource, seriesDataAdapterSnapshot.DataMember, seriesDataAdapterSnapshot.CalculatedFields)
		{
			this.seriesDataAdapterSnapshot = seriesDataAdapterSnapshot;
		}

		public virtual List<IDataPoint> CreateBindingPoints()
		{
			RowDataReader rowDataReader = CreateDataReader();
			if (rowDataReader != null && rowDataReader.DataMemberContainers.Count > 0)
			{
				DataBrowser val = BindingHelperCore.CreateListBrowser(base.BindingEnvironment, rowDataReader.DataMemberContainers[0].DataMember);
				if (val != null && rowDataReader.CreateBrowsers(base.BindingEnvironment))
				{
					dataItemsCount = val.Count;
					RangeIndexes range = new RangeIndexes(0, val.Count);
					range = DataReadStarted(range, dataItemsCount);
					int position = val.Position;
					for (int i = range.Min; i < range.Max; i++)
					{
						val.Position = i;
						object current = val.Current;
						if (BindingHelperCore.IsFit(DataAdapter, current) && rowDataReader.Read())
						{
							OnDataRowRead(current, rowDataReader, i);
						}
					}
					OnDataReadFinished();
					val.Position = position;
				}
			}
			return Points;
		}

		protected abstract void OnDataReadFinished();

		protected abstract void OnDataRowRead(object dataRow, RowDataReader dataReader, int position);

		protected virtual RangeIndexes DataReadStarted(RangeIndexes range, int itemsCount)
		{
			return range;
		}

		protected override Dictionary<string, IDataMemberContainer> CreateAdditionalDataMemberContainers()
		{
			Dictionary<string, IDataMemberContainer> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, IDataMemberContainer>();
			AddObjectContainer(dictionary, DataAdapter.ColorDataMember);
			AddObjectContainer(dictionary, DataAdapter.ToolTipHintDataMember);
			if (DataAdapter.Indicators != null && DataAdapter.ValueScaleType == Scale.Numerical)
			{
				foreach (IDataSourceIndicator indicator in DataAdapter.Indicators)
				{
					foreach (string valueDataMember in indicator.ValueDataMembers)
					{
						AddIndicatorContainer(dictionary, valueDataMember);
					}
				}
			}
			if (dictionary.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return dictionary;
		}
	}
	public class SimpleSeriesBindingProcedure : SeriesBindingProcedure
	{
		private readonly SeriesPointDataContainer templateContainer;

		public SimpleSeriesBindingProcedure(SeriesDataAdapterSnapshot dataAdapter)
			: base(dataAdapter)
		{
			templateContainer = SeriesPointDataContainer.Create(dataAdapter.ArgumentScaleType, dataAdapter.ValueScaleType, dataAdapter.SeriesView.PointDimension);
		}

		private IDataPoint GetPoint(object dataRow, RowDataReader dataReader)
		{
			return base.DataAdapter.Series.CreateSeriesPoint(base.DataAdapter.Series, dataRow, templateContainer, dataReader);
		}

		protected override void OnDataRowRead(object dataRow, RowDataReader dataReader, int position)
		{
			base.Points.Add(GetPoint(dataRow, dataReader));
		}

		protected override void OnDataReadFinished()
		{
		}

		protected override List<IDataMemberContainer> CreateDataMemberContainers()
		{
			List<IDataMemberContainer> list = new List<IDataMemberContainer>();
			AddArgumentContainer(list, base.DataAdapter.ArgumentScaleType, base.DataAdapter.ArgumentDataMember, base.DataAdapter.ProcessMissingArguments);
			if (base.DataAdapter.IsTwoArgumentsSeries)
			{
				AddArgumentContainer(list, base.DataAdapter.ArgumentScaleType2, base.DataAdapter.ArgumentDataMember2, base.DataAdapter.ProcessMissingArguments);
			}
			IList<string> seriesValueDataMembers = base.DataAdapter.GetSeriesValueDataMembers();
			AddValueContainers(list, base.DataAdapter.ValueScaleType, seriesValueDataMembers, base.DataAdapter.ProcessMissingValues);
			return list;
		}

		public IDataPoint CreateBindingPoint(int index)
		{
			IDataPoint result = null;
			RowDataReader rowDataReader = CreateDataReader();
			DataBrowser val = BindingHelperCore.CreateListBrowser(base.BindingEnvironment, base.DataMember);
			if (rowDataReader != null && val != null && val.Count > index && index >= 0 && rowDataReader.CreateBrowsers(base.BindingEnvironment))
			{
				int position = val.Position;
				val.Position = index;
				object current = val.Current;
				if (BindingHelperCore.IsFit(base.DataAdapter, current) && rowDataReader.Read())
				{
					result = GetPoint(current, rowDataReader);
				}
				val.Position = position;
			}
			return result;
		}
	}
	public abstract class SummarySeriesBindingProcedureBase : SimpleSeriesBindingProcedure
	{
		private readonly ISummaryBindingProvider summaryBindingProvider;

		private readonly string[] summaryDataMembers;

		protected SummarySeriesBindingProcedureBase(SeriesDataAdapterSnapshot seriesDataAdapterSnapshot, ISummaryBindingProvider summaryBindingProvider)
			: base(seriesDataAdapterSnapshot)
		{
			this.summaryBindingProvider = summaryBindingProvider;
			summaryDataMembers = SummaryBindingHelper.GetSummaryDataMembers(summaryBindingProvider, base.DataMember);
		}

		protected void AddPoints(BoundDataItem boundItem)
		{
			IDataPoint[] array = summaryBindingProvider.CreatePoints(base.DataAdapter.Series, boundItem.Argument, summaryDataMembers, boundItem.Values.ToArray(), boundItem.ColorKeys.ToArray());
			if (array != null)
			{
				IDataPoint[] array2 = array;
				foreach (IDataPoint dataPoint in array2)
				{
					dataPoint.Apply(base.DataAdapter.Series, boundItem.ToolTipHint);
					base.Points.Add(dataPoint);
				}
			}
		}

		protected abstract void SummarizeRow(object argument, DataSourceValuesCore values, RowDataReader dataReader);

		protected override void OnDataRowRead(object dataRow, RowDataReader dataReader, int position)
		{
			if (dataReader.DataMemberContainers.Count != 0)
			{
				object summaryArgument = SummaryBindingHelper.GetSummaryArgument(dataReader.DataMemberContainers[0].BoxedValue, base.DataAdapter.SeriesView, base.DataAdapter.ArgumentScaleType, summaryBindingProvider);
				if (summaryArgument != null)
				{
					DataSourceValuesCore summaryValues = SummaryBindingHelper.GetSummaryValues(summaryBindingProvider, dataReader.DataMemberContainers, dataRow);
					SummarizeRow(summaryArgument, summaryValues, dataReader);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override List<IDataMemberContainer> CreateDataMemberContainers()
		{
			List<IDataMemberContainer> list = new List<IDataMemberContainer>();
			AddArgumentContainer(list, base.DataAdapter.ArgumentScaleType, base.DataAdapter.ArgumentDataMember, supportEmpty: true);
			IList<string> list2 = BindingHelperCore.GetSummaryDataMembers(summaryBindingProvider);
			foreach (string item in list2)
			{
				list.Add(new ObjectDataMemberContainer(BindingHelperCore.ConvertToActualDataMember(base.DataMember, item)));
			}
			return list;
		}
	}

		}
	}

	public class SummaryFunctionParserCore
	{
		private readonly string incorrectSummaryFunctionMessage;

		private string functionString;

		private string[] arguments = new string[0];

		public string FunctionName { get; protected set; }

		public string[] Arguments => arguments;

		private static bool IsStartIdentifierCharacter(char c)
		{
			if (!char.IsLetter(c))
			{
				return c == '_';
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static bool IsIdentifierCharacter(char c)
		{
			if (!IsStartIdentifierCharacter(c))
			{
				return char.IsDigit(c);
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected static bool CheckIdentifier(string identifier)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(identifier) || !IsStartIdentifierCharacter(identifier[0]))
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int i = 1; i < identifier.Length; i++)
			{
				if (!IsIdentifierCharacter(identifier[i]))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public SummaryFunctionParserCore(string functionString, string incorrectMessage)
		{
			incorrectSummaryFunctionMessage = incorrectMessage;
			this.functionString = ((functionString == null) ? string.Empty : functionString);
			Parse();
		}

		public SummaryFunctionParserCore(ISummaryBindingProvider provider)
			: this(provider.FunctionString, provider.IncorrectSummaryFunctionMessage)
		{
		}

		private void ThrowException()
		{
			throw new ArgumentException(incorrectSummaryFunctionMessage);
		}

		private void Parse()
		{
			functionString = functionString.Trim();
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(functionString))
			{
				int num = functionString.IndexOf('(');
				int num2 = functionString.LastIndexOf(')');
				if (num <= 0 || num2 < num || !string.IsNullOrEmpty(functionString.Substring(num2 + 1).Trim()))
				{
					ThrowException();
				}
				FunctionName = functionString.Substring(0, num).Trim();
				if (!CheckIdentifier(FunctionName))
				{
					ThrowException();
				}
				string text = functionString.Substring(num + 1, num2 - num - 1).Trim();
				arguments = (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text) ? new string[0] : SplitArguments(text));
			}
		}

		private string[] SplitArguments(string argumentsString)
		{
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			while (true)
			{
				if (argumentsString.Length < 2)
				{
					ThrowException();
				}
				if (argumentsString[0] != '[')
				{
					ThrowException();
				}
				int num = argumentsString.IndexOf(']', 1);
				if (num < 0)
				{
					ThrowException();
				}
				string text = argumentsString.Substring(1, num - 1);
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
				{
					ThrowException();
				}
				list.Add(text);
				argumentsString = argumentsString.Substring(num + 1).Trim();
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(argumentsString))
				{
					break;
				}
				if (argumentsString[0] != ',')
				{
					ThrowException();
				}
				argumentsString = argumentsString.Substring(1).Trim();
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		protected void ResizeArguments(int length)
		{
			Array.Resize(ref arguments, length);
		}
	}

	public static class SummaryBindingHelper
	{
		public static void AddToolTipHint(BoundDataItem boundItem, ISeriesDataAdapter dataAdapter, RowDataReader dataReader)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(dataAdapter.ToolTipHintDataMember))
			{
				boundItem.ToolTipHint = dataReader.AdditionalContainers[dataAdapter.ToolTipHintDataMember].BoxedValue?.ToString();
			}
		}

		public static void AddColor(BoundDataItem boundItem, ISeriesDataAdapter dataAdapter, RowDataReader dataReader)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(dataAdapter.ColorDataMember))
			{
				object boxedValue = dataReader.AdditionalContainers[dataAdapter.ColorDataMember].BoxedValue;
				boundItem.ColorKeys.Add(boxedValue);
			}
		}

		public static double AlignNumericArgumentByMeasureUnit(double argument, double measureUnit)
		{
			return Math.Floor(argument / measureUnit) * measureUnit;
		}

		public static object GetDateTimeSummaryArgument(object initialArgument, IXYSeriesView view, IDateTimeSummaryOptions dateTimeOptions)
		{
			//IL_000b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0038: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0034: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (!(initialArgument is DateTime))
			{
				return null;
			}
			DateTimeMeasureUnitNative measureUnit = (DateTimeMeasureUnitNative)4;
			int measureUnitMultiplier = 1;
			if (dateTimeOptions == null || dateTimeOptions.UseAxisMeasureUnit)
			{
				if (view != null && view.AxisXData != null)
				{
					measureUnit = view.AxisXData.DateTimeScaleOptions.MeasureUnit;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				measureUnit = dateTimeOptions.MeasureUnit;
				measureUnitMultiplier = dateTimeOptions.MeasureUnitMultiplier;
			}
			DateTime? dateTime = DateTimeUtilsExt.Floor((DateTime)initialArgument, measureUnit, measureUnitMultiplier, DateTimeUtilsExt.FirstDayOfWeek);
			if (!dateTime.HasValue)
			{
				return initialArgument;
			}
			return dateTime.Value;
		}

		public static object GetTimeSpanSummaryArgument(object initialArgument, IXYSeriesView view, ITimeSpanSummaryOptions timeSpanOptions)
		{
			if (!(initialArgument is TimeSpan))
			{
				return null;
			}
			TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative measureUnit = TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative.Second;
			int measureUnitMultiplier = 1;
			if (timeSpanOptions == null || timeSpanOptions.UseAxisMeasureUnit)
			{
				if (view != null && view.AxisXData != null)
				{
					measureUnit = view.AxisXData.TimeSpanScaleOptions.MeasureUnit;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				measureUnit = timeSpanOptions.MeasureUnit;
				measureUnitMultiplier = timeSpanOptions.MeasureUnitMultiplier;
			}
			TimeSpan? timeSpan = DateTimeUtilsExt.Floor((TimeSpan)initialArgument, measureUnit, measureUnitMultiplier);
			if (!timeSpan.HasValue)
			{
				return initialArgument;
			}
			return timeSpan.Value;
		}

		public static object GetSummaryArgument(object initialArgument, ISeriesBase series, ISummaryBindingProvider summaryBindingProvider)
		{
			return GetSummaryArgument(initialArgument, series.SeriesView, series.ArgumentScaleType, summaryBindingProvider);
		}

		public static object GetSummaryArgument(object initialArgument, ISeriesView seriesView, Scale argumentScaleType, ISummaryBindingProvider summaryBindingProvider)
		{
			switch (argumentScaleType)
			{
			case Scale.DateTime:
				return GetDateTimeSummaryArgument(initialArgument, seriesView as IXYSeriesView, summaryBindingProvider.Options as IDateTimeSummaryOptions);
			case Scale.TimeSpan:
				return GetTimeSpanSummaryArgument(initialArgument, seriesView as IXYSeriesView, summaryBindingProvider.Options as ITimeSpanSummaryOptions);
			default:
				if (summaryBindingProvider.Options is INumericSummaryOptions { UseAxisMeasureUnit: false } numericSummaryOptions && argumentScaleType == Scale.Numerical)
				{
					if (!(initialArgument is double))
					{
						return null;
					}
					return AlignNumericArgumentByMeasureUnit((double)initialArgument, numericSummaryOptions.MeasureUnit);
				}
				return initialArgument;
			}
		}

		public static DataSourceValuesCore GetSummaryValues(ISummaryBindingProvider summaryBindingProvider, List<IDataMemberContainer> dataMemberContainers, object dataRow)
		{
			DataSourceValuesCore dataSourceValuesCore = summaryBindingProvider.CreateDataSourceValues();
			for (int i = 1; i < dataMemberContainers.Count; i++)
			{
				dataSourceValuesCore[dataMemberContainers[i].DataMember] = dataMemberContainers[i].BoxedValue;
			}
			dataSourceValuesCore[string.Empty] = dataRow;
			return dataSourceValuesCore;
		}

		public static string[] GetSummaryDataMembers(ISummaryBindingProvider summaryBindingProvider, string dataMember)
		{
			string[] arguments = new SummaryFunctionParserCore(summaryBindingProvider).Arguments;
			string[] array = new string[arguments.Length];
			for (int i = 0; i < arguments.Length; i++)
			{
				array[i] = BindingHelperCore.ConvertToActualDataMember(dataMember, arguments[i]);
			}
			return array;
		}
	}
