	public static class PredefinedTypesHelper
	{
		public static readonly Type[] NumericTypes = new Type[13]
		{
			typeof(double),
			typeof(float),
			typeof(int),
			typeof(decimal),
			typeof(uint),
			typeof(long),
			typeof(ulong),
			typeof(short),
			typeof(ushort),
			typeof(byte),
			typeof(sbyte),
			typeof(char),
			typeof(bool)
		};

		public static bool IsAssignableFrom(Type type, params Type[] types)
		{
			if (type == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (types == null || types.Length == 0)
			{
				return true;
			}
			Type type2 = Nullable.GetUnderlyingType(type);
			if (type2 == null)
			{
				type2 = type.UnderlyingSystemType;
			}
			foreach (Type type3 in types)
			{
				if (type3.IsAssignableFrom(type2))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool IsNumericalType(Type type)
		{
			return IsAssignableFrom(type, NumericTypes);
		}

		public static bool IsDateTimeType(Type type)
		{
			return IsAssignableFrom(type, typeof(DateTime));
		}

		public static bool IsTimeSpanType(Type type)
		{
			return IsAssignableFrom(type, typeof(TimeSpan));
		}
	}
	public static class BindingHelperCore
	{
		public static int CompareValues(object x, object y)
		{
			if (x is DBNull)
			{
				if (!(y is DBNull))
				{
					return -1;
				}
				return 0;
			}
			if (y is DBNull)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			if (!(x is IComparable comparable))
			{
				return 0;
			}
			return comparable.CompareTo(y);
		}

		public static bool IsValidDataParams(object dataSource, string dataMember)
		{
			if (dataSource != null)
			{
				return !string.IsNullOrEmpty(dataMember);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool IsFit(ISeriesDataAdapter dataAdapter, object dataRow)
		{
			if (dataAdapter != null && dataAdapter.FilterHelper != null && dataAdapter.FilterHelper.Enabled)
			{
				return ((ControlFilterHelper<object>)(object)dataAdapter.FilterHelper).IsFit(dataRow);
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static bool TryGetValue(DataContextBase context, object dataRow, string dataMember, ISeriesDataAdapter seriesDataAdapter, out object value)
		{
			using (BindingEnvironment bindingEnvironment = new BindingEnvironment(context, dataRow, seriesDataAdapter?.CalculatedFields))
			{
				DataBrowser dataBrowser = bindingEnvironment.GetDataBrowser(dataMember, suppressException: true);
				if (dataBrowser != null)
				{
					value = dataBrowser.Current;
					return true;
				}
				if (seriesDataAdapter != null)
				{
					PropertyDescriptor propertyDescriptor = bindingEnvironment.GetListItemProperties(seriesDataAdapter.DataMember).Find(dataMember, ignoreCase: true);
					if (propertyDescriptor == null)
					{
						using BindingEnvironment bindingEnvironment2 = new BindingEnvironment(seriesDataAdapter.DataContext, seriesDataAdapter.DataSource, seriesDataAdapter.CalculatedFields);
						propertyDescriptor = bindingEnvironment2.GetItemProperties(seriesDataAdapter.DataMember).Find(dataMember, ignoreCase: true);
					}
					if (propertyDescriptor != null)
					{
						value = propertyDescriptor.GetValue(dataRow);
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			value = null;
			return false;
		}

		public static object GetValue(object dataRow, object dataSource, string dataMember)
		{
			using (BindingEnvironment bindingEnvironment = new BindingEnvironment(null, dataRow, null))
			{
				DataBrowser dataBrowser = bindingEnvironment.GetDataBrowser(dataMember, suppressException: true);
				if (dataBrowser != null)
				{
					return dataBrowser.Current;
				}
			}
			using BindingEnvironment bindingEnvironment2 = new BindingEnvironment(null, dataSource);
			return bindingEnvironment2.GetItemProperties(null).Find(dataMember, ignoreCase: true)?.GetValue(dataRow);
		}

		public static object GetValue(DataContextBase context, object dataRow, string dataMember, ISeriesDataAdapter seriesDataAdapter)
		{
			TryGetValue(context, dataRow, dataMember, seriesDataAdapter, out var value);
			return value;
		}

		public static string ConvertToActualDataMember(string rootDataMember, string dataMember)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(rootDataMember) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(dataMember))
			{
				return rootDataMember + "." + dataMember;
			}
			return dataMember;
		}

		public static Type GetMemberType(DataContextBase dataContext, object dataSource, string dataMember, IEnumerable<ICalculatedField> calculatedFields)
		{
			Type result = null;
			if (dataSource != null)
			{
				using BindingEnvironment bindingEnvironment = new BindingEnvironment(dataContext, dataSource, calculatedFields);
				DataBrowser dataBrowser = bindingEnvironment.GetDataBrowser(dataMember, suppressException: true);
				if (dataBrowser != null)
				{
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(dataMember))
					{
						result = dataBrowser.DataSourceType;
					}
					else if (dataBrowser.DataSourceType != null && dataBrowser is ListBrowser)
					{
						Type type = dataBrowser.DataSourceType.GetElementType();
						if (dataBrowser.DataSourceType.GenericTypeArguments.Length == 1)
						{
							type = dataBrowser.DataSourceType.GenericTypeArguments[0];
						}
						if (type != null && (PredefinedTypesHelper.IsNumericalType(type) || PredefinedTypesHelper.IsAssignableFrom(type, typeof(DateTime), typeof(string), typeof(TimeSpan))))
						{
							result = type;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		public static Scale GetScaleType(DataContextBase dataContext, object dataSource, string dataMember, IEnumerable<ICalculatedField> calculatedFields)
		{
			Type memberType = GetMemberType(dataContext, dataSource, dataMember, calculatedFields);
			if (memberType != null)
			{
				if (PredefinedTypesHelper.IsDateTimeType(memberType))
				{
					return Scale.DateTime;
				}
				if (PredefinedTypesHelper.IsTimeSpanType(memberType))
				{
					return Scale.TimeSpan;
				}
				if (PredefinedTypesHelper.IsNumericalType(memberType))
				{
					return Scale.Numerical;
				}
				return Scale.Qualitative;
			}
			return Scale.Auto;
		}

		public static DataBrowser CreateListBrowser(BindingEnvironment environment, string dataMember)
		{
			return CreateListBrowser(environment.DataSource, environment.DataContext, dataMember);
		}

		public static DataBrowser CreateListBrowser(object dataSource, DataContextBase dataContext, string dataMember)
		{
			//IL_0077: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_007d: Expected O, but got Unknown
			DataBrowser dataBrowser = dataContext.GetDataBrowser(dataSource, string.Empty, true);
			if (dataBrowser == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			string text = dataMember;
			string text2 = string.Empty;
			ListBrowser val = (ListBrowser)(object)((dataBrowser is ListBrowser) ? dataBrowser : null);
			while (text != null && dataBrowser.FindItemProperty(text, false) == null)
			{
				try
				{
					int num = text.IndexOf('.');
					if (num == -1)
					{
						break;
					}
					if (text2 != string.Empty)
					{
						text2 += ".";
					}
					text2 += text.Substring(0, num);
					dataBrowser = dataContext.GetDataBrowser(dataSource, text2, true);
					if (dataBrowser == null)
					{
						break;
					}
					if (dataBrowser is ListBrowser)
					{
						val = (ListBrowser)dataBrowser;
					}
					text = text.Substring(num + 1, text.Length - num - 1);
					continue;
				}
				catch
				{
				}
				break;
			}
			if (val == null)
			{
				return dataBrowser;
			}
			return (DataBrowser)(object)val;
		}

		public static IList<string> GetSummaryDataMembers(ISummaryBindingProvider summaryBindingProvider)
		{
			return new SummaryFunctionParserCore(summaryBindingProvider).Arguments;
		}

		public static IIndicatorDataPoint CreateIndicatorPoint(IList<IDataSourceIndicator> indicators, Dictionary<string, IDataMemberContainer> additionalContainers)
		{
			if (indicators != null && indicators.Count > 0)
			{
				foreach (IDataSourceIndicator indicator in indicators)
				{
					int count = indicator.ValueDataMembers.Count;
					if (count <= 0)
					{
						continue;
					}
					double[] array = new double[count];
					for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
					{
						string text = indicator.ValueDataMembers[i];
						if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text) && additionalContainers[text] is IDataMemberContainer<double> { IsEmpty: false } dataMemberContainer)
						{
							array[i] = dataMemberContainer.Value;
						}
					}
					return indicator.CreatePoint(array);
				}
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
	public class ResamplingSeriesBindingProcedure : SimpleSeriesBindingProcedure
	{
		private int endVisibleIndex;

		private ResamplerData previousPoint;

		private int previousPos;

		private ResamplerData resamplerData;

		private int startVisibleIndex;

		public int? MaximumAllowedPointCount { get; set; }

		public int MaxOutputPointsCount => Math.Min(MaximumAllowedPointCount ?? 10000, ViewportWidth);

		public Func<IComparable, double> NativeToRefinedCallback { get; set; }

		public Func<double, IComparable> RefinedToNativeCallback { get; set; }

		public ResamplerData ResamplerData => resamplerData;

		public int ViewportWidth { get; set; }

		public ResamplingSeriesBindingProcedure(SeriesDataAdapterSnapshot sanpshot, ResamplerData data, Func<IComparable, double> argumentRefineCallback, Func<double, IComparable> refinedToNativeCallback)
			: base(sanpshot)
		{
			if (data != null && data.Offsets != null)
			{
				resamplerData = data;
			}
			ViewportWidth = int.MaxValue;
			NativeToRefinedCallback = argumentRefineCallback;
			RefinedToNativeCallback = refinedToNativeCallback;
		}

		private IntervalManager InvalidateIntervalManager(ResamplerData resampledPointData, IEnumerable<DataSourceUpdateInfoBase<IBindingProvider>> updates)
		{
			IntervalManager intervalManager = new IntervalManager();
			intervalManager.Populate(resampledPointData);
			bool flag = false;
			foreach (DataSourceUpdateInfoBase<IBindingProvider> update in updates)
			{
				flag |= intervalManager.Invalidate(update);
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				intervalManager.WholeRange = null;
			}
			return intervalManager;
		}

		private static bool IsEdgePos(int startVisibleIndex, int endVisibleIndex, int pos)
		{
			if (pos != startVisibleIndex)
			{
				return pos == endVisibleIndex - 1;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool TryGetMinMaxInfo(ResamplerData rdata, int pos, ref IComparable[] currentValues, out int newPos)
		{
			newPos = pos;
			if (rdata == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (rdata.ResampledIntervalValues == null || rdata.ResampledIntervalValues.Count <= 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int num = (rdata.EndIndex - rdata.StartIndex) / rdata.ResampledIntervalValues.Count;
			if (num <= 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int num2 = ((rdata == previousPoint) ? Math.Max(rdata.StartIndex, previousPos - 1) : rdata.StartIndex);
			int num3 = (num2 - rdata.StartIndex) / num;
			for (int i = num2; i < rdata.EndIndex; i += num)
			{
				if (rdata.ResampledIntervalValues.Count <= num3)
				{
					break;
				}
				Array.Copy(rdata.ResampledIntervalValues[num3], currentValues, currentValues.Length);
				newPos = i;
				if (i > pos)
				{
					break;
				}
				num3++;
				if (rdata.ResampledIntervalValues.Count <= num3)
				{
					newPos = rdata.EndIndex;
					break;
				}
			}
			previousPos = newPos;
			previousPoint = rdata;
			return true;
		}

		private IntervalManager UpdateIntervalManager(ResamplerData resampledPointData, DataBrowser listBrowser, int resamplingValuesCount)
		{
			IntervalManager intervalManager = new IntervalManager();
			bool flag = false;
			IntervalData intervalData = null;
			if (resampledPointData != null && resampledPointData.ValuesDimension == resamplingValuesCount)
			{
				intervalManager.Populate(resampledPointData);
				if (intervalManager.WholeRange != null)
				{
					return intervalManager;
				}
				flag = true;
			}
			double num = double.PositiveInfinity;
			double num2 = double.NegativeInfinity;
			List<IComparable[]> list = new List<IComparable[]>();
			int startIndex = 0;
			startVisibleIndex = 0;
			int count = listBrowser.Count;
			double num3 = double.MinValue;
			int num4 = Math.Max(1, listBrowser.Count / 2000);
			if (flag)
			{
				num4 = Math.Max(num4, intervalManager.GuessStepByIntervalData());
			}
			int position = listBrowser.Position;
			RowDataReader rowDataReader = CreateDataReader();
			if (rowDataReader != null && rowDataReader.CreateBrowsers(base.BindingEnvironment))
			{
				int num5 = 0;
				int num6 = (count - startVisibleIndex) / 100;
				IComparable[] prevValues = new IComparable[resamplingValuesCount];
				for (int i = startVisibleIndex; i < count; i++)
				{
					listBrowser.Position = i;
					if (!BindingHelperCore.IsFit(base.DataAdapter, listBrowser.Current) || !rowDataReader.Read())
					{
						continue;
					}
					double num7 = NativeToRefinedCallback(((IComparableDataMemberContainer)rowDataReader.DataMemberContainers[0]).ComparableValue);
					if (num7 < num3)
					{
						num5++;
						if (num6 < num5)
						{
							return null;
						}
					}
					num3 = num7;
					IComparable[] values = GetValues(rowDataReader);
					UpdateValues(ref prevValues, values);
					num = Math.Min(num, num3);
					num2 = Math.Max(num2, num3);
					if ((i % 25 == 0 || i % num4 == 0) && i > 0)
					{
						list.Add(prevValues);
						prevValues = new IComparable[resamplingValuesCount];
					}
					if (flag && intervalData == null)
					{
						IntervalData intervalData2 = intervalManager.GetNearest(num3);
						if (intervalData2 != null && intervalData2.ResamplerData == null)
						{
							intervalData = intervalData2;
						}
						else
						{
							bool flag2 = false;
							int num8 = 10;
							do
							{
								if (intervalData2 != null && intervalData2.ResamplerData == null)
								{
									intervalData = intervalData2;
								}
								else if (intervalData2.ResamplerData.EndIndex > i && intervalData2.ResamplerData.StartIndex <= i)
								{
									flag2 = true;
								}
								else
								{
									intervalData2 = intervalManager.Intervals[Math.Min(intervalManager.Intervals.Count - 1, intervalData2.IntervalManagerIndex + 1)];
								}
							}
							while (!flag2 && num8-- > 0 && intervalData == null);
							if (flag2)
							{
								i = Math.Max(i, intervalData2.ResamplerData.EndIndex);
								list = new List<IComparable[]>();
								startIndex = i;
								intervalData = null;
								continue;
							}
						}
					}
					if ((i % num4 == 0 || IsEdgePos(startVisibleIndex, count, i)) && i > 0)
					{
						ResamplerData point = new ResamplerData
						{
							EndIndex = i,
							StartIndex = startIndex,
							ResampledIntervalValues = list
						};
						if (intervalData == null)
						{
							intervalManager.Add(i, num3, point);
						}
						else
						{
							intervalManager.Intervals[intervalData.IntervalManagerIndex] = intervalData;
							intervalData.ResamplerData = point;
						}
						list = new List<IComparable[]>();
						startIndex = i;
						intervalData = null;
					}
				}
			}
			listBrowser.Position = position;
			intervalManager.WholeRange = new MinMaxValues
			{
				Min = num,
				Max = num2
			};
			return intervalManager;
		}

		private void UpdateResampledDataFromIntervalManager(IntervalManager intervalManager)
		{
			resamplerData.Offsets = intervalManager.Intervals;
			resamplerData.WholeRange = intervalManager.WholeRange;
		}

		protected override RangeIndexes DataReadStarted(RangeIndexes range, int itemsCount)
		{
			return new RangeIndexes(startVisibleIndex, endVisibleIndex);
		}

		public static IComparable Compare(IComparable a, IComparable b, bool getMin)
		{
			if (a == null)
			{
				return b;
			}
			if (b == null)
			{
				return a;
			}
			int num = (getMin ? 1 : (-1));
			if (a.CompareTo(b) * num > 0)
			{
				return b;
			}
			return a;
		}

		public override List<IDataPoint> CreateBindingPoints()
		{
			DataBrowser val = BindingHelperCore.CreateListBrowser(base.BindingEnvironment, base.DataMember);
			if (val == null)
			{
				return base.Points;
			}
			startVisibleIndex = 0;
			endVisibleIndex = val.Count;
			int num = Math.Max(1, (endVisibleIndex - startVisibleIndex) / Math.Max(1, MaxOutputPointsCount));
			IntervalManager intervalManager = null;
			int resamplingValuesCount = GetResamplingValuesCount();
			try
			{
				if (num == 1)
				{
					return base.CreateBindingPoints();
				}
				intervalManager = UpdateIntervalManager(resamplerData, val, resamplingValuesCount);
				if (intervalManager == null)
				{
					return base.CreateBindingPoints();
				}
				int num2 = 1;
				if (resamplerData != null && resamplerData.VisibleRange != null && resamplerData.ViewportWidth > 0 && intervalManager.Intervals.Count > 0)
				{
					num2 = intervalManager.CalculateVisibleIndexesWithOffset(resamplerData, val.Count, out startVisibleIndex, out endVisibleIndex);
					ViewportWidth = resamplerData.ViewportWidth;
				}
				else
				{
					resamplerData = null;
				}
				num = Math.Max(1, (resamplerData != null) ? intervalManager.CalculatePointCount(resamplerData, val.Count) : (endVisibleIndex - startVisibleIndex)) / Math.Max(1, MaxOutputPointsCount);
				if (num <= 15)
				{
					return base.CreateBindingPoints();
				}
				if (num > num2)
				{
					num = Math.Max(num2, num - num % num2);
				}
				startVisibleIndex = Math.Max(0, startVisibleIndex - startVisibleIndex % num);
				int num3 = 0;
				int position = val.Position;
				RowDataReader rowDataReader = CreateDataReader();
				if (rowDataReader == null || !rowDataReader.CreateBrowsers(base.BindingEnvironment))
				{
					return null;
				}
				bool flag = false;
				IComparable[] prevValues = new IComparable[resamplingValuesCount];
				IComparable[] currentValues = new IComparable[resamplingValuesCount];
				for (int i = startVisibleIndex; i < endVisibleIndex; i++)
				{
					val.Position = i;
					object current = val.Current;
					if (!BindingHelperCore.IsFit(base.DataAdapter, current) || !rowDataReader.Read())
					{
						continue;
					}
					if (num > 1)
					{
						IComparable value = NativeToRefinedCallback(((IComparableDataMemberContainer)rowDataReader.DataMemberContainers[0]).ComparableValue);
						IntervalData nearest = intervalManager.GetNearest(value);
						if (TryGetMinMaxInfo(nearest.ResamplerData, i, ref currentValues, out var newPos))
						{
							UpdateValuesFromCache(ref prevValues, currentValues);
							flag = newPos - num3 >= num;
							i = Math.Max(i, newPos);
						}
						if (flag && num > num2)
						{
							val.Position = i - i % num;
							current = val.Current;
							rowDataReader.Read();
						}
					}
					if (i % num == 0 || IsEdgePos(startVisibleIndex, endVisibleIndex, i) || flag || num < 25)
					{
						IComparable comparableValue = ((IComparableDataMemberContainer)rowDataReader.DataMemberContainers[0]).ComparableValue;
						IComparable[] values = GetValues(rowDataReader);
						UpdateValues(ref prevValues, values);
						if (i % num == 0 || IsEdgePos(startVisibleIndex, endVisibleIndex, i) || flag)
						{
							flag = false;
							num3 = i;
							AddPoints(comparableValue, prevValues);
							prevValues = new IComparable[resamplingValuesCount];
						}
					}
				}
				val.Position = position;
			}
			finally
			{
				if ((num > 1 || resamplerData != null) && (resamplerData == null || resamplerData.ValuesDimension != resamplingValuesCount || resamplerData.WholeRange == null) && intervalManager != null)
				{
					resamplerData = new ResamplerData
					{
						Offsets = intervalManager.Intervals,
						WholeRange = intervalManager.WholeRange,
						ValuesDimension = resamplingValuesCount,
						ViewportWidth = (resamplerData?.ViewportWidth ?? 0)
					};
				}
			}
			return base.Points;
		}

		public bool ProcessUpdates(IEnumerable<DataSourceUpdateInfoBase<IBindingProvider>> updates)
		{
			if (resamplerData != null)
			{
				IntervalManager intervalManager = InvalidateIntervalManager(resamplerData, updates);
				UpdateResampledDataFromIntervalManager(intervalManager);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private IComparable[] GetValues(RowDataReader reader)
		{
			int count = reader.DataMemberContainers.Count;
			IComparable[] array = new IComparable[count - 1];
			for (int i = 1; i < count; i++)
			{
				array[i - 1] = ((IComparableDataMemberContainer)reader.DataMemberContainers[i]).ComparableValue;
			}
			return array;
		}

		private int GetResamplingValuesCount()
		{
			int pointDimension = base.DataAdapter.SeriesView.PointDimension;
			if (pointDimension == 1)
			{
				return 3;
			}
			if (base.DataAdapter.SeriesView is IRangeSeriesView)
			{
				return 4;
			}
			return pointDimension;
		}

		private void UpdateValues(ref IComparable[] prevValues, IComparable[] dataSourceValues)
		{
			if (base.DataAdapter.SeriesView is IRangeSeriesView)
			{
				prevValues[0] = Compare(prevValues[0], dataSourceValues[0], getMin: true);
				prevValues[1] = Compare(prevValues[1], dataSourceValues[0], getMin: false);
				prevValues[2] = Compare(prevValues[2], dataSourceValues[1], getMin: true);
				prevValues[3] = Compare(prevValues[3], dataSourceValues[1], getMin: false);
			}
			else if (base.DataAdapter.SeriesView is IFinancialSeriesView)
			{
				prevValues[0] = Compare(prevValues[0], dataSourceValues[0], getMin: true);
				prevValues[1] = Compare(prevValues[1], dataSourceValues[1], getMin: false);
				if (prevValues[2] == null)
				{
					prevValues[2] = dataSourceValues[2];
				}
				prevValues[3] = dataSourceValues[3];
			}
			else
			{
				if (prevValues[0] == null)
				{
					prevValues[0] = dataSourceValues[0];
				}
				prevValues[1] = Compare(prevValues[1], dataSourceValues[0], getMin: true);
				prevValues[2] = Compare(prevValues[2], dataSourceValues[0], getMin: false);
			}
		}

		private void UpdateValuesFromCache(ref IComparable[] prevValues, IComparable[] cacheValues)
		{
			if (base.DataAdapter.SeriesView is IRangeSeriesView)
			{
				prevValues[0] = Compare(prevValues[0], cacheValues[0], getMin: true);
				prevValues[1] = Compare(prevValues[1], cacheValues[1], getMin: false);
				prevValues[2] = Compare(prevValues[2], cacheValues[2], getMin: true);
				prevValues[3] = Compare(prevValues[3], cacheValues[3], getMin: false);
			}
			else if (base.DataAdapter.SeriesView is IFinancialSeriesView)
			{
				prevValues[0] = Compare(prevValues[0], cacheValues[0], getMin: true);
				prevValues[1] = Compare(prevValues[1], cacheValues[1], getMin: false);
				if (prevValues[2] == null)
				{
					prevValues[2] = cacheValues[2];
				}
				prevValues[3] = cacheValues[3];
			}
			else
			{
				prevValues[0] = cacheValues[0];
				prevValues[1] = Compare(prevValues[1], cacheValues[1], getMin: true);
				prevValues[2] = Compare(prevValues[2], cacheValues[2], getMin: false);
			}
		}

		private void AddPoints(IComparable argument, IComparable[] values)
		{
			if (base.DataAdapter.SeriesView is IRangeSeriesView)
			{
				if (values[0].CompareTo(values[2]) > 0)
				{
					base.Points.Add(base.DataAdapter.Series.CreateSeriesPoint(base.DataAdapter.Series, argument, new object[2]
					{
						values[1],
						values[2]
					}, null, null));
				}
				else
				{
					base.Points.Add(base.DataAdapter.Series.CreateSeriesPoint(base.DataAdapter.Series, argument, new object[2]
					{
						values[0],
						values[3]
					}, null, null));
				}
			}
			else if (values.Length == 3)
			{
				base.Points.Add(base.DataAdapter.Series.CreateSeriesPoint(base.DataAdapter.Series, argument, new object[1] { values[0] }, null, null));
				if (values[0] != values[1])
				{
					base.Points.Add(base.DataAdapter.Series.CreateSeriesPoint(base.DataAdapter.Series, argument, new object[1] { values[1] }, null, null));
				}
				if (values[0] != values[2] && values[1] != values[2])
				{
					base.Points.Add(base.DataAdapter.Series.CreateSeriesPoint(base.DataAdapter.Series, argument, new object[1] { values[2] }, null, null));
				}
			}
			else
			{
				base.Points.Add(base.DataAdapter.Series.CreateSeriesPoint(base.DataAdapter.Series, argument, values, null, null));
			}
		}

		public void EnsureViewport(int viewport)
		{
			if (ViewportWidth == int.MaxValue && viewport > 0)
			{
				ViewportWidth = viewport;
			}
		}
	}
	public class SeriesFilterHelper : ControlFilterHelper, IControlFilterColumnsProvider
	{
		private class ValueFilterHelper : ControlFilterHelper
		{
			private readonly SeriesFilterHelper seriesHelper;

			private readonly CriteriaOperator criteria;

			public bool IsEnabled => criteria != null;

			public ValueFilterHelper(SeriesFilterHelper seriesHelper, CriteriaOperator criteria)
			{
				this.seriesHelper = seriesHelper;
				this.criteria = criteria;
			}

			protected override IControlFilterColumnsProvider GetFilterColumnsProvider()
			{
				return (IControlFilterColumnsProvider)(object)seriesHelper;
			}

			protected override CriteriaOperator GetFilterCriteria()
			{
				return criteria;
			}
		}

		private class OperandVisitor : IClientCriteriaVisitor<HashSet<OperandProperty>>, ICriteriaVisitor<HashSet<OperandProperty>>
		{
			HashSet<OperandProperty> IClientCriteriaVisitor<HashSet<OperandProperty>>.Visit(AggregateOperand theOperand)
			{
				HashSet<OperandProperty> hashSet = new HashSet<OperandProperty>();
				hashSet.Add(theOperand.CollectionProperty);
				hashSet.UnionWith(GetOperands(theOperand.Condition));
				hashSet.UnionWith(GetOperands(theOperand.AggregatedExpression));
				foreach (CriteriaOperator item in (List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)theOperand.CustomAggregateOperands)
				{
					hashSet.UnionWith(GetOperands(item));
				}
				return hashSet;
			}

			HashSet<OperandProperty> IClientCriteriaVisitor<HashSet<OperandProperty>>.Visit(OperandProperty theOperand)
			{
				HashSet<OperandProperty> hashSet = new HashSet<OperandProperty>();
				hashSet.Add(theOperand);
				return hashSet;
			}

			HashSet<OperandProperty> IClientCriteriaVisitor<HashSet<OperandProperty>>.Visit(JoinOperand theOperand)
			{
				HashSet<OperandProperty> hashSet = new HashSet<OperandProperty>();
				hashSet.UnionWith(GetOperands(theOperand.Condition));
				hashSet.UnionWith(GetOperands(theOperand.AggregatedExpression));
				foreach (CriteriaOperator item in (List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)theOperand.CustomAggregateOperands)
				{
					hashSet.UnionWith(GetOperands(item));
				}
				return hashSet;
			}

			HashSet<OperandProperty> ICriteriaVisitor<HashSet<OperandProperty>>.Visit(BetweenOperator theOperator)
			{
				HashSet<OperandProperty> hashSet = new HashSet<OperandProperty>();
				hashSet.UnionWith(GetOperands(theOperator.BeginExpression));
				hashSet.UnionWith(GetOperands(theOperator.EndExpression));
				hashSet.UnionWith(GetOperands(theOperator.TestExpression));
				return hashSet;
			}

			HashSet<OperandProperty> ICriteriaVisitor<HashSet<OperandProperty>>.Visit(BinaryOperator theOperator)
			{
				HashSet<OperandProperty> hashSet = new HashSet<OperandProperty>();
				hashSet.UnionWith(GetOperands(theOperator.LeftOperand));
				hashSet.UnionWith(GetOperands(theOperator.RightOperand));
				return hashSet;
			}

			HashSet<OperandProperty> ICriteriaVisitor<HashSet<OperandProperty>>.Visit(UnaryOperator theOperator)
			{
				return new HashSet<OperandProperty>(GetOperands(theOperator.Operand));
			}

			HashSet<OperandProperty> ICriteriaVisitor<HashSet<OperandProperty>>.Visit(InOperator theOperator)
			{
				HashSet<OperandProperty> hashSet = new HashSet<OperandProperty>();
				hashSet.UnionWith(GetOperands(theOperator.LeftOperand));
				foreach (CriteriaOperator item in (List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)theOperator.Operands)
				{
					hashSet.UnionWith(GetOperands(item));
				}
				return hashSet;
			}

			HashSet<OperandProperty> ICriteriaVisitor<HashSet<OperandProperty>>.Visit(GroupOperator theOperator)
			{
				HashSet<OperandProperty> hashSet = new HashSet<OperandProperty>();
				foreach (CriteriaOperator item in (List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)theOperator.Operands)
				{
					hashSet.UnionWith(GetOperands(item));
				}
				return hashSet;
			}

			HashSet<OperandProperty> ICriteriaVisitor<HashSet<OperandProperty>>.Visit(OperandValue theOperand)
			{
				return new HashSet<OperandProperty>();
			}

			HashSet<OperandProperty> ICriteriaVisitor<HashSet<OperandProperty>>.Visit(FunctionOperator theOperator)
			{
				HashSet<OperandProperty> hashSet = new HashSet<OperandProperty>();
				foreach (CriteriaOperator item in (List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)theOperator.Operands)
				{
					hashSet.UnionWith(GetOperands(item));
				}
				return hashSet;
			}

			public IEnumerable<OperandProperty> GetOperands(CriteriaOperator criteriaOperator)
			{
				//IL_0010: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_001a: Expected O, but got Unknown
				//IL_0025: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_002f: Expected O, but got Unknown
				//IL_003a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0044: Expected O, but got Unknown
				//IL_004f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0059: Expected O, but got Unknown
				//IL_0064: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_006e: Expected O, but got Unknown
				//IL_0079: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0083: Expected O, but got Unknown
				//IL_008e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0098: Expected O, but got Unknown
				//IL_00a3: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_00ad: Expected O, but got Unknown
				//IL_00b8: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_00c2: Expected O, but got Unknown
				//IL_00cd: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_00d7: Expected O, but got Unknown
				if (criteriaOperator != null)
				{
					if (criteriaOperator is AggregateOperand)
					{
						return ((IClientCriteriaVisitor<HashSet<OperandProperty>>)this).Visit((AggregateOperand)criteriaOperator);
					}
					if (criteriaOperator is OperandProperty)
					{
						return ((IClientCriteriaVisitor<HashSet<OperandProperty>>)this).Visit((OperandProperty)criteriaOperator);
					}
					if (criteriaOperator is JoinOperand)
					{
						return ((IClientCriteriaVisitor<HashSet<OperandProperty>>)this).Visit((JoinOperand)criteriaOperator);
					}
					if (criteriaOperator is BetweenOperator)
					{
						return ((ICriteriaVisitor<HashSet<OperandProperty>>)this).Visit((BetweenOperator)criteriaOperator);
					}
					if (criteriaOperator is BinaryOperator)
					{
						return ((ICriteriaVisitor<HashSet<OperandProperty>>)this).Visit((BinaryOperator)criteriaOperator);
					}
					if (criteriaOperator is UnaryOperator)
					{
						return ((ICriteriaVisitor<HashSet<OperandProperty>>)this).Visit((UnaryOperator)criteriaOperator);
					}
					if (criteriaOperator is InOperator)
					{
						return ((ICriteriaVisitor<HashSet<OperandProperty>>)this).Visit((InOperator)criteriaOperator);
					}
					if (criteriaOperator is GroupOperator)
					{
						return ((ICriteriaVisitor<HashSet<OperandProperty>>)this).Visit((GroupOperator)criteriaOperator);
					}
					if (criteriaOperator is OperandValue)
					{
						return ((ICriteriaVisitor<HashSet<OperandProperty>>)this).Visit((OperandValue)criteriaOperator);
					}
					if (criteriaOperator is FunctionOperator)
					{
						return ((ICriteriaVisitor<HashSet<OperandProperty>>)this).Visit((FunctionOperator)criteriaOperator);
					}
				}
				return new HashSet<OperandProperty>();
			}
		}

		private readonly ISeriesDataAdapter dataAdapter;

		private PropertyDescriptorCollection filteringUIDataProperties;

		public PropertyDescriptorCollection FilteringUIDataProperties
		{
			get
			{
				EnsureFilteringUIDataProperties();
				return filteringUIDataProperties;
			}
		}

		public bool Enabled => dataAdapter.Criteria != null;

		private static bool IsUniqueProperty(List<PropertyDescriptor> parentProperties, PropertyDescriptor property)
		{
			foreach (PropertyDescriptor parentProperty in parentProperties)
			{
				if (IsSameProperty(parentProperty, property))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static CriteriaOperator GetOperatorWithoutProperty(CriteriaOperator criteria, string propertyPath)
		{
			//IL_0062: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0068: Expected O, but got Unknown
			List<CriteriaOperator> list = new List<CriteriaOperator>();
			Tuple<CriteriaOperator, IDictionary<string, CriteriaOperator>> tuple = CriteriaColumnAffinityResolver.SplitByColumnNames(criteria, (IEqualityComparer<string>)null);
			foreach (string key in tuple.Item2.Keys)
			{
				if (key != propertyPath)
				{
					list.Add(tuple.Item2[key]);
				}
			}
			if (list.Count > 0)
			{
				return (CriteriaOperator)new GroupOperator((GroupOperatorType)0, (IEnumerable<CriteriaOperator>)list);
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static bool IsSameProperty(PropertyDescriptor parentProperty, PropertyDescriptor property)
		{
			if (parentProperty.Name == property.Name)
			{
				return parentProperty.PropertyType == property.PropertyType;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public SeriesFilterHelper(ISeriesDataAdapter dataAdapter)
		{
			this.dataAdapter = dataAdapter;
		}

		PropertyDescriptorCollection IControlFilterColumnsProvider.GetColumnDescriptors()
		{
			List<PropertyDescriptor> list = new List<PropertyDescriptor>();
			if (dataAdapter.DataSource != null)
			{
				BindingEnvironment bindingEnvironment = new BindingEnvironment(dataAdapter.DataContext, dataAdapter.DataSource, dataAdapter.CalculatedFields);
				PropertyDescriptorCollection itemProperties = bindingEnvironment.GetItemProperties(dataAdapter.DataMember);
				foreach (PropertyDescriptor item in itemProperties)
				{
					list.Add(item);
				}
				OperandVisitor operandVisitor = new OperandVisitor();
				IEnumerable<OperandProperty> operands = operandVisitor.GetOperands(dataAdapter.Criteria);
				foreach (OperandProperty item2 in operands)
				{
					string text = BindingHelperCore.ConvertToActualDataMember(dataAdapter.DataMember, item2.PropertyName);
					if (text.Contains("."))
					{
						list.Add((PropertyDescriptor)(object)new ChartComplexPropertyDescriptor(bindingEnvironment, text));
					}
				}
			}
			return new PropertyDescriptorCollection(list.ToArray());
		}

		private List<PropertyDescriptor> ConstructComplexProperties(List<PropertyDescriptor> parentProperties, BindingEnvironment environment, string dataMember)
		{
			List<PropertyDescriptor> list = new List<PropertyDescriptor>();
			PropertyDescriptorCollection itemProperties = environment.GetItemProperties(dataMember);
			foreach (PropertyDescriptor item in itemProperties)
			{
				string text = dataMember + "." + item.Name;
				if (DataContext.IsComplexType(item.PropertyType) && IsUniqueProperty(parentProperties, item))
				{
					List<PropertyDescriptor> list2 = new List<PropertyDescriptor>(parentProperties.Count + 1);
					list2.AddRange(parentProperties);
					list2.Add(item);
					list.AddRange(ConstructComplexProperties(list2, environment, text));
				}
				else
				{
					list.Add((PropertyDescriptor)(object)new ChartComplexPropertyDescriptor(environment, text));
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected override CriteriaOperator GetFilterCriteria()
		{
			return dataAdapter.Criteria;
		}

		protected override IControlFilterColumnsProvider GetFilterColumnsProvider()
		{
			return (IControlFilterColumnsProvider)(object)this;
		}

		public void OnUpdateCriteria()
		{
			((ControlFilterHelper<object>)this).ResetFilterFitPredicate();
		}

		public bool EnsureFilteringUIDataProperties()
		{
			if (filteringUIDataProperties == null)
			{
				filteringUIDataProperties = GetDataProperties();
			}
			return filteringUIDataProperties != null;
		}

		public IEnumerable<object> GetValues(string propertyPath)
		{
			if (dataAdapter.DataSource == null)
			{
				yield break;
			}
			using BindingEnvironment environment = new BindingEnvironment(dataAdapter.DataContext, dataAdapter.DataSource, dataAdapter.CalculatedFields);
			CriteriaOperator operatorWithoutProperty = GetOperatorWithoutProperty(dataAdapter.Criteria, propertyPath);
			ValueFilterHelper valueFilterHelper = new ValueFilterHelper(this, operatorWithoutProperty);
			DataBrowser browser = BindingHelperCore.CreateListBrowser(environment, propertyPath);
			ListBrowser listBrowser = (ListBrowser)(object)((browser is ListBrowser) ? browser : null);
			if (listBrowser != null)
			{
				browser = environment.GetDataBrowser(propertyPath, suppressException: true);
				if (((DataBrowser)listBrowser).Count <= 0)
				{
					yield break;
				}
				for (int i = 0; i < ((DataBrowser)listBrowser).Count; i++)
				{
					((DataBrowser)listBrowser).Position = i;
					if (!valueFilterHelper.IsEnabled || ((ControlFilterHelper<object>)(object)valueFilterHelper).IsFit(((DataBrowser)listBrowser).Current))
					{
						yield return browser.Current;
					}
				}
				yield break;
			}
			yield return browser.Current;
		}

		public PropertyDescriptorCollection GetDataProperties()
		{
			PropertyDescriptorCollection result = null;
			if (dataAdapter.DataSource != null)
			{
				using BindingEnvironment bindingEnvironment = new BindingEnvironment(dataAdapter.DataContext, dataAdapter.DataSource, dataAdapter.CalculatedFields);
				List<PropertyDescriptor> list = new List<PropertyDescriptor>();
				PropertyDescriptorCollection itemProperties = bindingEnvironment.GetItemProperties(dataAdapter.DataMember);
				foreach (PropertyDescriptor item in itemProperties)
				{
					if (DataContext.IsComplexType(item.PropertyType))
					{
						string dataMember = BindingHelperCore.ConvertToActualDataMember(dataAdapter.DataMember, item.Name);
						List<PropertyDescriptor> parentProperties = new List<PropertyDescriptor> { item };
						list.AddRange(ConstructComplexProperties(parentProperties, bindingEnvironment, dataMember));
					}
					else
					{
						list.Add(item);
					}
				}
				result = new PropertyDescriptorCollection(list.ToArray());
			}
			return result;
		}

		public ChartBoundPropertyCollection GetBoundProperties()
		{
			if (dataAdapter.DataSource == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new ChartBoundPropertyCollection(dataAdapter);
		}
	}
	public class ChartBoundProperty : IBoundProperty, ITreeSelectableItem
	{
		private readonly string displayName;

		private readonly PropertyDescriptor property;

		private readonly ChartBoundProperty parent;

		private readonly ISeriesDataAdapter dataAdapter;

		private readonly List<ChartBoundProperty> children;

		private ChartBoundProperty Parent => parent;

		private PropertyDescriptor PropertyDescriptor => property;

		bool IBoundProperty.HasChildren => children != null;

		bool IBoundProperty.IsAggregate => false;

		bool IBoundProperty.IsList => false;

		string IBoundProperty.Name => property.Name;

		string IBoundProperty.DisplayName
		{
			get
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(displayName))
				{
					return displayName;
				}
				return property.DisplayName;
			}
		}

		List<IBoundProperty> IBoundProperty.Children
		{
			get
			{
				if (children != null && children.Count == 0)
				{
					InitChildren();
				}
				List<IBoundProperty> list = new List<IBoundProperty>();
				foreach (ChartBoundProperty child in children)
				{
					list.Add((IBoundProperty)(object)child);
				}
				return list;
			}
		}

		IBoundProperty IBoundProperty.Parent => (IBoundProperty)(object)Parent;

		Type IBoundProperty.Type => property.PropertyType;

		ITreeSelectableItem ITreeSelectableItem.Parent => (ITreeSelectableItem)(object)Parent;

		List<ITreeSelectableItem> ITreeSelectableItem.Children
		{
			get
			{
				if (children != null && children.Count == 0)
				{
					InitChildren();
				}
				List<ITreeSelectableItem> list = new List<ITreeSelectableItem>();
				foreach (ChartBoundProperty child in children)
				{
					list.Add((ITreeSelectableItem)(object)child);
				}
				return list;
			}
		}

		bool ITreeSelectableItem.AllowSelect => !((IBoundProperty)this).HasChildren;

		string ITreeSelectableItem.Text => ((IBoundProperty)this).DisplayName;

		private static bool IsUniqueProperty(ChartBoundProperty property, PropertyDescriptor childProperty)
		{
			if (property != null)
			{
				if (SeriesFilterHelper.IsSameProperty(property.PropertyDescriptor, childProperty))
				{
					return false;
				}
				return IsUniqueProperty(property.Parent, childProperty);
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal static string GetDisplayName(BindingEnvironment environment, string prefixMember, string member)
		{
			string text = environment.GetDataMemberDisplayName(prefixMember + "." + member);
			string dataMemberDisplayName = environment.GetDataMemberDisplayName(prefixMember);
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(dataMemberDisplayName) && text.Length > dataMemberDisplayName.Length + 1)
			{
				text = text.Substring(dataMemberDisplayName.Length + 1, text.Length - (dataMemberDisplayName.Length + 1));
			}
			return text;
		}

		public ChartBoundProperty(ISeriesDataAdapter dataAdapter, ChartBoundProperty parent, PropertyDescriptor property, string displayName)
		{
			this.property = property;
			this.parent = parent;
			this.displayName = displayName;
			if (DataContext.IsComplexType(property.PropertyType))
			{
				this.dataAdapter = dataAdapter;
				children = new List<ChartBoundProperty>();
			}
		}

		private void InitChildren()
		{
			string fullName = GetFullName();
			using BindingEnvironment bindingEnvironment = new BindingEnvironment(dataAdapter.DataContext, dataAdapter.DataSource, dataAdapter.CalculatedFields, createDataContextBase: false);
			PropertyDescriptorCollection itemProperties = bindingEnvironment.GetItemProperties(fullName);
			foreach (PropertyDescriptor item in itemProperties)
			{
				if (IsUniqueProperty(this, item))
				{
					string text = GetDisplayName(bindingEnvironment, fullName, item.Name);
					children.Add(new ChartBoundProperty(dataAdapter, this, item, text));
				}
			}
		}

		protected string GetFullName()
		{
			string text = string.Empty;
			if (Parent != null)
			{
				text = Parent.GetFullName();
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				text += ".";
			}
			return text + property.Name;
		}
	}
	public class ChartBoundPropertyCollection : List<IBoundProperty>, IBoundPropertyCollection, IEnumerable
	{
		IBoundProperty IBoundPropertyCollection.this[string fieldName]
		{
			get
			{
				using (Enumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator())
				{
					while (enumerator.MoveNext())
					{
						IBoundProperty current = enumerator.Current;
						if (current.Name == fieldName)
						{
							return current;
						}
					}
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		IBoundProperty IBoundPropertyCollection.this[int index] => base[index];

		int IBoundPropertyCollection.Count => base.Count;

		public ChartBoundPropertyCollection(ISeriesDataAdapter dataAdapter)
		{
			using BindingEnvironment bindingEnvironment = new BindingEnvironment(dataAdapter.DataContext, dataAdapter.DataSource, dataAdapter.CalculatedFields, createDataContextBase: false);
			PropertyDescriptorCollection itemProperties = bindingEnvironment.GetItemProperties(dataAdapter.DataMember);
			if (itemProperties == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (PropertyDescriptor item in itemProperties)
			{
				string displayName = ChartBoundProperty.GetDisplayName(bindingEnvironment, dataAdapter.DataMember, item.Name);
				Add((IBoundProperty)(object)new ChartBoundProperty(dataAdapter, null, item, displayName));
			}
		}

		void IBoundPropertyCollection.Add(IBoundProperty property)
		{
			Add(property);
		}

		void IBoundPropertyCollection.Clear()
		{
			Clear();
		}

		IBoundPropertyCollection IBoundPropertyCollection.CreateChildrenProperties(IBoundProperty listProperty)
		{
			return null;
		}

		string IBoundPropertyCollection.GetDisplayPropertyName(OperandProperty property, string fullPath)
		{
			return fullPath;
		}

		string IBoundPropertyCollection.GetValueScreenText(OperandProperty property, object value)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			return value.ToString();
		}
	}
	public class ChartComplexPropertyDescriptor : ComplexPropertyDescriptor
	{
		private readonly BindingEnvironment environment;

		private List<PropertyDescriptor> descriptors;

		private PropertyDescriptor Root => Descriptors[0];

		private PropertyDescriptor Last => Descriptors[Descriptors.Count - 1];

		private List<PropertyDescriptor> Descriptors
		{
			get
			{
				((ComplexPropertyDescriptor)this).Prepare();
				return descriptors;
			}
		}

		public override bool IsReadOnly => true;

		public override Type PropertyType
		{
			get
			{
				if (Last != null)
				{
					return Last.PropertyType;
				}
				return typeof(object);
			}
		}

		public override Type ComponentType
		{
			get
			{
				if (Root != null)
				{
					return Root.ComponentType;
				}
				return typeof(object);
			}
		}

		public override string DisplayName => base.path;

		public ChartComplexPropertyDescriptor(BindingEnvironment environment, string path)
			: base(environment.DataSource, path)
		{
			this.environment = environment;
		}

		protected override AttributeCollection CreateAttributeCollection()
		{
			AttributeCollection attributeCollection = ((MemberDescriptor)this).CreateAttributeCollection();
			if (((ComplexPropertyDescriptor)this).IsReady)
			{
				Attribute[] array = new Attribute[attributeCollection.Count + Last.Attributes.Count];
				attributeCollection.CopyTo(array, 0);
				Last.Attributes.CopyTo(array, attributeCollection.Count);
				return new AttributeCollection(array);
			}
			return attributeCollection;
		}

		private PropertyDescriptor GetPropertyDescriptor(string path, string name)
		{
			PropertyDescriptorCollection itemProperties = environment.GetItemProperties(path);
			foreach (PropertyDescriptor item in itemProperties)
			{
				if (item.Name == name)
				{
					return item;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private int GetFirstNotIEnumerableMemberIndex()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < Descriptors.Count; i++)
			{
				if (Descriptors[i] != null && (Descriptors[i].PropertyType.GetInterface("IEnumerable") == null || Descriptors[i].PropertyType == typeof(string)))
				{
					return i;
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}

		protected override void Prepare()
		{
			if (((ComplexPropertyDescriptor)this).IsReady || environment == null || environment.DataContext == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			((ComplexPropertyDescriptor)this).PrepareSplit();
			if (base.split != null && base.split.Length != 0)
			{
				descriptors = new List<PropertyDescriptor>(base.split.Length);
				string text = string.Empty;
				for (int i = 0; i < base.split.Length; i++)
				{
					descriptors.Add(GetPropertyDescriptor(text, base.split[i]));
					text += (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text) ? base.split[i] : ("." + base.split[i]));
				}
				((ComplexPropertyDescriptor)this).IsReady = descriptors.Count > 0;
			}
		}

		public override void SetValue(object component, object value)
		{
		}

		public override object GetOwnerOfLast(object component)
		{
			return null;
		}

		public override object GetValue(object component)
		{
			object obj = null;
			int firstNotIEnumerableMemberIndex = GetFirstNotIEnumerableMemberIndex();
			if (component != null && firstNotIEnumerableMemberIndex >= 0)
			{
				for (int i = firstNotIEnumerableMemberIndex; i < Descriptors.Count; i++)
				{
					if (obj == null)
					{
						if (Descriptors[i].ComponentType.IsAssignableFrom(component.GetType()) || Descriptors[i] is CalculatedPropertyDescriptorBase)
						{
							obj = Descriptors[i].GetValue(component);
						}
					}
					else
					{
						obj = Descriptors[i].GetValue(obj);
					}
				}
			}
			return obj;
		}
	}

	public abstract class DataSourceUpdateInfoCollectionBase<TSender> : List<DataSourceUpdateInfoBase<TSender>>
	{
		protected DataSourceUpdateInfoCollectionBase(TSender sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs args)
		{
			switch (args.Action)
			{
			default:
				return;
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add:
				AddChild(sender, ChartDataSourceUpdateType.Insert, args.NewStartingIndex, args.NewItems.Count);
				return;
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove:
				if (args.OldStartingIndex >= 0)
				{
					AddChild(sender, ChartDataSourceUpdateType.Remove, args.OldStartingIndex, args.OldItems.Count);
					return;
				}
				break;
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Replace:
				AddChild(sender, ChartDataSourceUpdateType.ItemChanged, args.NewStartingIndex, args.NewItems.Count);
				return;
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Move:
				AddChild(sender, ChartDataSourceUpdateType.Remove, args.OldStartingIndex, args.OldItems.Count);
				AddChild(sender, ChartDataSourceUpdateType.Insert, args.NewStartingIndex, args.NewItems.Count);
				return;
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset:
				break;
			}
			AddReset(sender);
		}

		protected DataSourceUpdateInfoCollectionBase(TSender sender, ListChangedEventArgs args)
		{
			switch (args.ListChangedType)
			{
			case ListChangedType.ItemAdded:
				AddChild(sender, ChartDataSourceUpdateType.Insert, args.NewIndex, 1);
				break;
			case ListChangedType.ItemDeleted:
				AddChild(sender, ChartDataSourceUpdateType.Remove, args.NewIndex, 1);
				break;
			case ListChangedType.ItemChanged:
				AddChild(sender, ChartDataSourceUpdateType.ItemChanged, args.NewIndex, 1);
				break;
			case ListChangedType.ItemMoved:
				AddChild(sender, ChartDataSourceUpdateType.Remove, args.OldIndex, 1);
				AddChild(sender, ChartDataSourceUpdateType.Insert, args.NewIndex, 1);
				break;
			default:
				AddReset(sender);
				break;
			}
		}

		protected DataSourceUpdateInfoCollectionBase(TSender sender, ChartDataSourceUpdateType dataSourceUpdateType, int index, int count)
		{
			AddChild(sender, dataSourceUpdateType, index, count);
		}

		protected DataSourceUpdateInfoCollectionBase()
		{
		}

		protected void AddChild(TSender sender, ChartDataSourceUpdateType type, int index, int count)
		{
			DataSourceUpdateInfoBase<TSender> item = CreateChild(sender, type, index, count);
			Add(item);
		}

		protected abstract DataSourceUpdateInfoBase<TSender> CreateChild(TSender sender, ChartDataSourceUpdateType type, int index, int count);

		public void AddReset(TSender sender)
		{
			AddChild(sender, ChartDataSourceUpdateType.Reset, -1, 1);
		}

		public void AddResetView(TSender sender)
		{
			AddChild(sender, ChartDataSourceUpdateType.ViewportChanged, -1, 1);
		}

		public bool IsUpdatesTypeOf(ChartDataSourceUpdateType type)
		{
			using (Enumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator())
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					DataSourceUpdateInfoBase<TSender> current = enumerator.Current;
					if (current.Type != type)
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public bool IsExistUpdateTypeOf(ChartDataSourceUpdateType type)
		{
			using (Enumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator())
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					DataSourceUpdateInfoBase<TSender> current = enumerator.Current;
					if (current.Type == type)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

		public BindingEnvironment(DataContextBase dataContext, object dataSource, IEnumerable<ICalculatedField> calculatedFields, bool createDataContextBase)
		{
			globalDataSource = dataSource;
			actualDataContext = dataContext;
			if (dataContext != null)
			{
				return;
			}
			contextFields = new List<CalculatedFieldData>();
			if (calculatedFields != null)
			{
				foreach (IChartCalculatedField calculatedField in calculatedFields)
				{
					contextFields.Add(new CalculatedFieldData(calculatedField, dataSource));
				}
			}
			actualDataContext = ChartDataContext.CreateActualInstance((IEnumerable<ICalculatedField>)contextFields, createDataContextBase);
			shouldDisposeDataContext = true;
		}

		void IDisposable.Dispose()
		{
			if (shouldDisposeDataContext)
			{
				actualDataContext.Clear();
				actualDataContext.Dispose();
				actualDataContext = null;
			}
		}

		{

		public virtual double RefinedToInternal(double value, TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative measureUnit, double measureUnitMultiplier)
		{
			if (double.IsNaN(value) || value < DateTimeUtilsExt.MinTimeSpan.TotalMilliseconds || value > DateTimeUtilsExt.MaxTimeSpan.TotalMilliseconds)
			{
				value = 0.0;
			}
			double d = DateTimeUtilsExt.TimeSpanToMeasureUnit(TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(value), measureUnit, measureUnitMultiplier);
			return Math.Floor(d);
		}

		public virtual object InternalToNative(double value, TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative measureUnit, double measureUnitMultiplier)
		{
			TimeSpan? timeSpan = DateTimeUtilsExt.ToTimeSpan(value, measureUnit, measureUnitMultiplier);

				return DateTimeUtilsExt.Round(timeSpan.Value, measureUnit);
			}
			return null;
		}

		{

				return DateTimeUtilsExt.TimeSpanToMeasureUnit((TimeSpan)value, mapMeasureUnit, mapMeasureUnitMultiplier);

			return double.NaN;
		}

				timeSpan = ((TimeSpan?)value).Value;
			}
			if (timeSpan.HasValue)
			{
				return timeSpan.Value.TotalMilliseconds;
			}
			return double.NaN;
		}

		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!(value is string input))
			{
				return value;
			}
			if (TimeSpan.TryParse(input, culture, out var result))
			{
				return result;
			}
			return value;
		}

			if (!(value is DateTime))
			{
				return value is TimeSpan;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override bool IsCompatibleType(Type type)

		}

		public override double InternalToRefinedExact(double value)
		{
			double num = Math.Floor(value);
			double num2 = InternalToRefined(num);
			double num3 = value - num;
			double num4 = InternalToRefined(num + 1.0);
			if (double.IsNaN(num4))
			{
				return num2;
			}
			return num2 + (num4 - num2) * num3;
		}

		public override double RefinedToInternalExact(double value)
		{
			double num = RefinedToInternal(value);
			double num2 = InternalToRefined(num);

			double num4 = InternalToRefined(num + 1.0);
			if (double.IsNaN(num4))
			{
				return num;
			}
			double num5 = num4 - num2;
			return num + num3 / num5;
		}

	public class AxisDateTimeMap : AxisScaleTypeMap, IPriorScaleMap

				//IL_0024: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

				int num2 = DateTimeUtilsExt.SizeOfDay(measureUnit) - num;
				return (double)num2 / (double)DateTimeUtilsExt.SizeOfDay(measureUnit);
			}

			private double CalcWeekSumOfWorkTimePart()

				//IL_0036: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				return map.CalcExcludedMeasureUnitsInDay(workTimeRules[date.DayOfWeek], measureUnit) - map.CalcExcludedMeasureUnitsInDay(workTimeRules[date], measureUnit);

			public DateTime InternalToDateTime()
			{
				//IL_0094: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

				//IL_00f3: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				double num = CalcWeekSumOfWorkTimePart();
				int num2 = (int)(effectiveValue / ((double)sizeOfDay * num));
				double num3 = effectiveValue + (double)GetEffectiveValueCorrection() - (double)sizeOfDay * num * (double)num2;
				int num4 = 0;
				for (int i = 1; i < 8; i++)

					DayOfWeek dayOfWeek = (DayOfWeek)(i % 7);

					if ((double)workMeasureUnits <= num3)

						num3 -= (double)workMeasureUnits;
						continue;
					}
					int num5 = ((i == 0) ? 6 : (i - 1));

					TimeSpan timeSpan = map.CalcLastDayTime(num3, sortedRestIntervals, measureUnit);

		private long CalcExcludedMeasureUnitsInternal(DateTime dateTime, DateTimeMeasureUnitNative measureUnit)
		{
			//IL_0098: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00fc: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0136: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (!IsWorkTimeEnabled)
			{
				return 0L;
			}
			int num = (int)new TimeSpan(dateTime.Ticks).TotalDays / 7;
			long num2 = 0L;
			Dictionary<DayOfWeek, int> dictionary = new Dictionary<DayOfWeek, int>
			{
				{
					DayOfWeek.Sunday,
					0
				},
				{
					DayOfWeek.Monday,
					0
				},
				{
					DayOfWeek.Tuesday,
					0
				},
				{
					DayOfWeek.Wednesday,
					0
				},
				{
					DayOfWeek.Thursday,
					0
				},
				{
					DayOfWeek.Friday,
					0
				},
				{
					DayOfWeek.Saturday,
					0
				}
			};
			for (int i = 0; i < 7; i++)
			{
				DayOfWeek dayOfWeek = (DayOfWeek)i;
				int num3 = (IsEarlierOnThisWeek(dayOfWeek, dateTime.DayOfWeek) ? 1 : 0);
				int num4 = num + num3;
				int num5 = (dictionary[dayOfWeek] = CalcExcludedMeasureUnitsInDay(workTimeRules[dayOfWeek], measureUnit));
				num2 += (long)num5 * (long)num4;
			}
			foreach (KeyValuePair<DateTime, TimeIntervalSetCore> sortedByDateRestIntervalsForCustomDate in workTimeRules.SortedByDateRestIntervalsForCustomDates)
			{
				if (sortedByDateRestIntervalsForCustomDate.Key >= dateTime.Date)
				{
					break;
				}
				num2 += CalcExcludedMeasureUnitsInDay(sortedByDateRestIntervalsForCustomDate.Value, measureUnit) - dictionary[sortedByDateRestIntervalsForCustomDate.Key.DayOfWeek];
			}
			return num2 + CalcExcludedMeasureUnitsInLastDay(dateTime, measureUnit);
		}

		private unsafe TimeSpan CalcLastDayTime(double muFromBeginOfDay, TimeIntervalSetCore sortedRestIntervals, DateTimeMeasureUnitNative measureUnit)
		{
			//IL_0012: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0021: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (sortedRestIntervals == null || sortedRestIntervals.Count == 0)
			{
				return DateTimeUtilsExt.ToTimeSpan(muFromBeginOfDay, measureUnit);
			}
			TimeIntervalSetCore timeIntervalSetCore = sortedRestIntervals.Invert();
			List<TimeIntervalInMeasureUnits> list = timeIntervalSetCore.ExpandToMeasureUnits(measureUnit);
			double num = muFromBeginOfDay;
			foreach (TimeIntervalInMeasureUnits item in list)
			{
				if (num >= (double)item.Length)
				{
					num -= (double)item.Length;
					continue;
				}
				return DateTimeUtilsExt.ToTimeSpan((double)item.Begin + num, measureUnit);
			}
			throw new Exception("It's impossible to calculate time of day. Given measure units from begin of day: " + muFromBeginOfDay + ". Measure unit: " + ((object)(*(DateTimeMeasureUnitNative*)(&measureUnit))/*cast due to .constrained prefix*/).ToString());
		}

		private int CalcExcludedMeasureUnitsInDay(TimeIntervalSetCore restTimeIntervals, DateTimeMeasureUnitNative measureUnit)
		{
			//IL_000b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000d: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_001a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (restTimeIntervals == null)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			if ((int)measureUnit == 4 && restTimeIntervals.IsWholeDay())
			{
				return 1;
			}
			List<TimeIntervalInMeasureUnits> list = restTimeIntervals.NarrowToMeasureUnits(measureUnit);
			int num = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
			{
				num += list[i].Length;
			}
			return num;
		}

		private int CalcExcludedMeasureUnitsInLastDay(DateTime dateTime, DateTimeMeasureUnitNative measureUnit)
		{
			//IL_001a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0053: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_006a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			List<TimeIntervalInMeasureUnits> list;
			if (workTimeRules.CustomDateExists(dateTime))
			{
				list = workTimeRules[dateTime].NarrowToMeasureUnits(measureUnit);
			}
			else
			{
				TimeIntervalSetCore timeIntervalSetCore = workTimeRules[dateTime.DayOfWeek];
				if (!(timeIntervalSetCore != null))
				{
					return 0;
				}
				list = workTimeRules[dateTime.DayOfWeek].NarrowToMeasureUnits(measureUnit);
			}
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = new TimeCore(dateTime).FloorToMeasureUnits(measureUnit);
			for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
			{
				int length = list[i].Length;
				if (num2 >= list[i].End)
				{
					num += length;
				}
				else if (list[i].Contains(num2))
				{
					num += num2 - list[i].Begin + 1;
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		private bool IsEarlierOnThisWeek(DayOfWeek dayOfWeek1, DayOfWeek dayOfWeek2)
		{
			if (dayOfWeek1 == DayOfWeek.Sunday || dayOfWeek1 >= dayOfWeek2)
			{
				if (dayOfWeek2 == DayOfWeek.Sunday)
				{
					return dayOfWeek1 != DayOfWeek.Sunday;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private DateTime AlignToNextWorkday(DateTime value, DateTimeMeasureUnitNative measureUnit)
		{
			//IL_0008: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000a: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if (IsWorkdaysEnabled && (int)measureUnit <= 4)
			{
				while (DateTimeUtils.IsHoliday(workdaysOptions, value, applyHolidays: true, applyExactWorkdays: true))
				{
					value = value.AddDays(1.0);
				}
			}
			return value;
		}

		private void CreateInternalCoordsOfCustomDatesCache(DateTimeMeasureUnitNative measureUnit)
		{
			//IL_002a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			SortedList<DateTime, double> sortedList = new SortedList<DateTime, double>();
			foreach (KeyValuePair<DateTime, TimeIntervalSetCore> sortedByDateRestIntervalsForCustomDate in workTimeRules.SortedByDateRestIntervalsForCustomDates)
			{
				DateTime key = sortedByDateRestIntervalsForCustomDate.Key;
				double value = DateTimeToInternal(key, measureUnit, mapMeasureUnitMultiplier);
				sortedList.Add(key, value);
			}
			internalCoordsOfCustomDatesCache[measureUnit] = sortedList;
		}

		private double DateTimeToInternal(DateTime value, DateTimeMeasureUnitNative measureUnit, int measureUnitMultiplier)
		{
			//IL_0012: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			DayOfWeek firstDayOfWeek = DateTimeUtilsExt.GetFirstDayOfWeek(workdaysOptions);
			double num = DateTimeUtilsExt.Difference(DateTimeUtilsExt.MinDateTime, value, measureUnit, measureUnitMultiplier, firstDayOfWeek);
			long num2 = CalcExcludedMeasureUnits(value, measureUnit, measureUnitMultiplier);
			return num - (double)num2;
		}

		private WorkTimeStrategy CreateWorkTimeStrategy(DateTimeMeasureUnitNative measureUnit, double value)
		{
			//IL_0118: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0020: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0035: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0029: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0061: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0087: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00a5: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0108: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			double num = value;
			if (workTimeRules.HasCustomDate)
			{
				KeyValuePair<DayOfWeek, int>? keyValuePair = null;
				if (!internalCoordsOfCustomDatesCache.ContainsKey(measureUnit))
				{
					CreateInternalCoordsOfCustomDatesCache(measureUnit);
				}
				foreach (KeyValuePair<DateTime, double> item in internalCoordsOfCustomDatesCache[measureUnit])
				{
					if (item.Value >= Math.Floor(value))
					{
						break;
					}
					int num2 = DateTimeUtilsExt.SizeOfDay(measureUnit);
					int num3 = num2 - CalcExcludedMeasureUnitsInDay(workTimeRules[item.Key.DayOfWeek], measureUnit);
					int num4 = num2 - CalcExcludedMeasureUnitsInDay(workTimeRules[item.Key], measureUnit);
					num += (double)(num3 - num4);
					if (num3 == 0 && value - item.Value <= (double)num4)
					{
						keyValuePair = new KeyValuePair<DayOfWeek, int>(item.Key.DayOfWeek, num4);
					}
				}
				if (keyValuePair.HasValue)
				{
					return new WorkTimeExactCurrentDayStrategy(this, num, measureUnit, keyValuePair.Value);
				}
			}
			return new WorkTimeStrategy(this, num, measureUnit);
		}

		private DateTime? InternalToDateTime(double value, DateTimeMeasureUnitNative measureUnit)
		{
			//IL_0018: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (value < 0.0)
			{
				value = 0.0;
			}
			WorkTimeStrategy workTimeStrategy = CreateWorkTimeStrategy(measureUnit, value);
			return workTimeStrategy.InternalToDateTime();
		}

		private long CalcExcludedMeasureUnits(DateTime date, DateTimeMeasureUnitNative measureUnit, int measureUnitMultiplier)
		{
			//IL_0018: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001a: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0030: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (IsWorkTimeEnabled && workTimeRules.WholeTimeExcluded)
			{
				return 0L;
			}
			bool flag = (int)measureUnit <= 4 && measureUnitMultiplier == 1;
			if (IsWorkTimeEnabled && flag)
			{
				return CalcExcludedMeasureUnitsInternal(date, measureUnit);
			}
			if (IsWorkdaysEnabled && flag)
			{
				return (long)DateTimeUtilsExt.GetHolidaysCount(date, workdaysOptions) * (long)DateTimeUtilsExt.SizeOfDay(measureUnit);
			}
			return 0L;
		}

		public override double InternalToRefinedExact(double value)
		{
			double num = Math.Floor(value);
			double num2 = InternalToRefined(num);
			double num3 = value - num;
			double num4 = InternalToRefined(num + 1.0);
			if (double.IsNaN(num4))
			{
				return num2;
			}
			return num2 + (num4 - num2) * num3;
		}

			if (double.IsNaN(num4))
			{
				return num;
			}
			double num5 = num4 - num2;
			return num + num3 / num5;
		}

	public struct AxisGridItem : IComparable

		private readonly bool gridLineVisible;

		public double Value => value;

		public double LabelValue => labelValue;

		public bool IsAutogenerated => isAutogenerated;

		public bool Visible => visible;

		public bool GridLineVisible => gridLineVisible;

		int IComparable.CompareTo(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is AxisGridItem)
			{
				return SortingUtils.CompareDoubles(value, ((AxisGridItem)obj).value);
			}
			return 1;
		}

		public AxisGridItem(double value, double labelValue, bool isAutogenerated, bool visible, bool gridLineVisible)
		{
			this.value = value;
			this.labelValue = labelValue;
			this.isAutogenerated = isAutogenerated;
			this.visible = visible;
			this.gridLineVisible = gridLineVisible;
		}
	}
	public class AxisGridItemList : IEnumerable<AxisGridItem>, IEnumerable
	{
		private readonly List<AxisGridItem> innerItems = new List<AxisGridItem>();

		private double minVisibleValue = double.PositiveInfinity;

		private double maxVisibleValue = double.NegativeInfinity;

		private int visibleItemsCount;

		private int invisibleItemsCount;

		private List<double> visibleTickMarkValues;

		private List<double> visibleGridLineValues;

		public List<double> VisibleTickMarkValues
		{
			get
			{
				if (visibleTickMarkValues == null)
				{
					FillVisibleItems();
				}
				return visibleTickMarkValues;
			}
		}

		public List<double> VisibleGridLineValues
		{
			get
			{
				if (visibleGridLineValues == null)
				{
					FillVisibleItems();
				}
				return visibleGridLineValues;
			}
		}

		public int VisibleItemsCount => visibleItemsCount;

		public int InvisibleItemsCount => invisibleItemsCount;

		public double MinVisibleValue => minVisibleValue;

		public double MaxVisibleValue => maxVisibleValue;

		public AxisGridItem this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				return innerItems[index];
			}
			set
			{
				RemoveItem(innerItems[index]);
				innerItems[index] = value;
				UpdateValues(value);
			}
		}

		public int Count => innerItems.Count;

		public AxisGridItem First => innerItems[0];

		public AxisGridItem Last => innerItems[Count - 1];

		IEnumerator<AxisGridItem> IEnumerable<AxisGridItem>.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return innerItems.GetEnumerator();
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return innerItems.GetEnumerator();
		}

		private void UpdateValues(AxisGridItem newItem)
		{
			if (newItem.Visible)
			{
				minVisibleValue = Math.Min(newItem.Value, minVisibleValue);
				maxVisibleValue = Math.Max(newItem.Value, maxVisibleValue);
				visibleItemsCount++;
			}
			else
			{
				invisibleItemsCount++;
			}
			visibleTickMarkValues = null;
		}

		private void RemoveItem(AxisGridItem item)
		{
			if (item.Visible)
			{
				visibleItemsCount--;
			}
			else
			{
				invisibleItemsCount--;
			}
			visibleTickMarkValues = null;
			visibleGridLineValues = null;
		}

		private void FillVisibleItems()
		{
			visibleTickMarkValues = new List<double>();
			visibleGridLineValues = new List<double>();
			foreach (AxisGridItem innerItem in innerItems)
			{
				if (innerItem.Visible)
				{
					visibleTickMarkValues.Add(innerItem.Value);
					if (innerItem.GridLineVisible)
					{
						visibleGridLineValues.Add(innerItem.Value);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void Add(AxisGridItem item)
		{
			innerItems.Add(item);
			UpdateValues(item);
		}

		private void Insert(int index, AxisGridItem item)
		{
			innerItems.Insert(index, item);
			UpdateValues(item);
		}

		public void AddUniqueValue(AxisGridItem value)
		{
			if (Count != 0)
			{
				double value2 = Last.Value;
				double value3 = First.Value;
				if (value2 == value.Value || value3 == value.Value)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (value2 < value.Value)
				{
					Add(value);
					return;
				}
				if (value3 > value.Value)
				{
					Insert(0, value);
					return;
				}
				int num = innerItems.BinarySearch(value);
				if (num < 0)
				{
					Insert(~num, value);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				Add(value);
			}
		}

		public void AddValue(AxisGridItem value)
		{
			Add(value);
		}
	}

	public class DateTimeUnitSelector : DateTimeUnitSelectorBase<DateTimeMeasureUnitNative, DateTimeGridAlignmentNative>
	{
		private const double sizeMillisecond = 1.0;

		private const double sizeSecond = 1000.0;

		private const double sizeMinute = 60000.0;

		private const double sizeHour = 3600000.0;

		private const double sizeDay = 86400000.0;

		private const double sizeWeek = 604800000.0;

		private const double sizeMonth = 2629800000.0;

		private const double sizeQuarter = 7889400000.0;

		private const double sizeYear = 31557600000.0;

		public const double DefaultGridSpacing = 1.0;

		public static DateTimeMeasureUnitNative DefaultMeasureUnit => (DateTimeMeasureUnitNative)4;

		public static DateTimeGridAlignmentNative DefaultGridAlignment => DateTimeGridAlignmentNative.Day;

		private static DateTimeGridAlignmentNative GetPreviousAlignment(DateTimeGridAlignmentNative alignment)
		{
			if (alignment == DateTimeGridAlignmentNative.Millisecond)
			{
				return DateTimeGridAlignmentNative.Millisecond;
			}
			return alignment - 1;
		}

		public static double GetMeasureUnitValue(DateTimeGridAlignmentNative alignment)
		{
			return GetMeasureUnitValue((DateTimeMeasureUnitNative)alignment);
		}

		public static double GetMeasureUnitValue(DateTimeMeasureUnitNative measureUnit)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002a: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			return (int)measureUnit switch
			{
				0 => 1.0, 
				1 => 1000.0, 
				2 => 60000.0, 
				3 => 3600000.0, 
				4 => 86400000.0, 
				5 => 604800000.0, 
				6 => 2629800000.0, 
				7 => 7889400000.0, 
				8 => 31557600000.0, 
				_ => throw new ArgumentException(), 
			};
		}

		public static GridAlignment GetPreviousGridAlignment(GridAlignment gridAlignment)
		{
			DateTimeGridAlignmentNative previousAlignment = GetPreviousAlignment(gridAlignment.Unit);
			double measureUnitValue = GetMeasureUnitValue(previousAlignment);
			double measureUnitValue2 = GetMeasureUnitValue(gridAlignment.Unit);
			double spacing = UnitSelector<DateTimeMeasureUnitNative, DateTimeGridAlignmentNative>.CalculateSpacing((measureUnitValue2 - measureUnitValue) * 0.2 + measureUnitValue, measureUnitValue);
			return new GridAlignment(previousAlignment, spacing);
		}

		protected override List<UnitContainer<DateTimeMeasureUnitNative, DateTimeGridAlignmentNative>.MeasureItem> FillMeasureSteps()
		{
			return new List<UnitContainer<DateTimeMeasureUnitNative, DateTimeGridAlignmentNative>.MeasureItem>
			{
				new UnitContainer<DateTimeMeasureUnitNative, DateTimeGridAlignmentNative>.MeasureItem(1.0, (DateTimeMeasureUnitNative)0),
				new UnitContainer<DateTimeMeasureUnitNative, DateTimeGridAlignmentNative>.MeasureItem(1000.0, (DateTimeMeasureUnitNative)1),
				new UnitContainer<DateTimeMeasureUnitNative, DateTimeGridAlignmentNative>.MeasureItem(60000.0, (DateTimeMeasureUnitNative)2),
				new UnitContainer<DateTimeMeasureUnitNative, DateTimeGridAlignmentNative>.MeasureItem(3600000.0, (DateTimeMeasureUnitNative)3),
				new UnitContainer<DateTimeMeasureUnitNative, DateTimeGridAlignmentNative>.MeasureItem(86400000.0, (DateTimeMeasureUnitNative)4),
				new UnitContainer<DateTimeMeasureUnitNative, DateTimeGridAlignmentNative>.MeasureItem(604800000.0, (DateTimeMeasureUnitNative)5),
				new UnitContainer<DateTimeMeasureUnitNative, DateTimeGridAlignmentNative>.MeasureItem(2629800000.0, (DateTimeMeasureUnitNative)6),
				new UnitContainer<DateTimeMeasureUnitNative, DateTimeGridAlignmentNative>.MeasureItem(7889400000.0, (DateTimeMeasureUnitNative)7),
				new UnitContainer<DateTimeMeasureUnitNative, DateTimeGridAlignmentNative>.MeasureItem(31557600000.0, (DateTimeMeasureUnitNative)8)
			};
		}

		protected override List<UnitContainer<DateTimeMeasureUnitNative, DateTimeGridAlignmentNative>.AlignmentItem> FillAlignmentSteps()
		{
