	public class DateTimeMeasureUnitsCalculatorCore : MeasureUnitsCalculatorBase<DateTimeMeasureUnitNative, DateTimeGridAlignmentNative>
	{
		private double previousThreshold;

		private IDateTimeScaleOptions DateTimeScaleOptions => base.Axis.DateTimeScaleOptions;

		protected override bool UseMinMeasureUnit => false;

		protected override IScaleOptionsBase<DateTimeMeasureUnitNative> ScaleOptions => DateTimeScaleOptions;

		public DateTimeMeasureUnitsCalculatorCore(IAxisData axis)
			: base(axis)
		{
		}

		private UnitSelector<DateTimeMeasureUnitNative, DateTimeGridAlignmentNative>.GridAlignment AlignToRange(UnitSelector<DateTimeMeasureUnitNative, DateTimeGridAlignmentNative>.GridAlignment selectedAlignment, DateTime min, DateTime max)
		{
			DateTime dateTime = DateTimeUtils.Floor(min, (DateTimeMeasureUnitNative)selectedAlignment.Unit);
			DateTime dateTime2 = DateTimeUtils.Floor(max, (DateTimeMeasureUnitNative)selectedAlignment.Unit);
			if (dateTime2 != dateTime)
			{
				return selectedAlignment;
			}
			return DateTimeUnitSelector.GetPreviousGridAlignment(selectedAlignment);
		}

		private UnitSelector<DateTimeMeasureUnitNative, DateTimeGridAlignmentNative>.GridAlignment CalculateGridAlignment(double pixelsPerUnit, DateTime min, DateTime max)
		{
			//IL_0016: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0029: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			UnitSelector<DateTimeMeasureUnitNative, DateTimeGridAlignmentNative>.GridAlignment selectedAlignment;
			if (DateTimeScaleOptions.ScaleMode == ScaleModeNative.Interval)
			{
				selectedAlignment = new UnitSelector<DateTimeMeasureUnitNative, DateTimeGridAlignmentNative>.GridAlignment((DateTimeGridAlignmentNative)DateTimeScaleOptions.MeasureUnit, 1.0);
			}
			else
			{
				double value = base.CurrentMeasureUnit / pixelsPerUnit * (double)base.Axis.GridSpacingFactor;
				selectedAlignment = base.UnitSelector.SelectAlignment(value, previousThreshold);
			}
			selectedAlignment = AlignToRange(selectedAlignment, min, max);
			previousThreshold = DateTimeUnitSelector.GetMeasureUnitValue((DateTimeMeasureUnitNative)selectedAlignment.Unit);
			return selectedAlignment;
		}

		protected override UnitSelector<DateTimeMeasureUnitNative, DateTimeGridAlignmentNative> CreateUnitSelector()
		{
			return new DateTimeUnitSelector();
		}

		protected override void UpdateAutomaticGrid(double pixelsPerUnit, IMinMaxValues visualRange)
		{
			object obj = base.Axis.AxisScaleTypeMap.InternalToNative(visualRange.Min);
			object obj2 = base.Axis.AxisScaleTypeMap.InternalToNative(visualRange.Max);
			UnitSelector<DateTimeMeasureUnitNative, DateTimeGridAlignmentNative>.GridAlignment gridAlignment = CalculateGridAlignment(pixelsPerUnit, (obj is DateTime) ? ((DateTime)obj) : DateTime.MinValue, (obj2 is DateTime) ? ((DateTime)obj2) : DateTime.MaxValue);
			DateTimeScaleOptions.UpdateAutomaticGrid(gridAlignment.Unit, gridAlignment.Spacing);
		}

		protected override bool UpdateAutomaticUnits(DateTimeMeasureUnitNative measureUnit, int pixelsPerUnit)
		{
			//IL_0019: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			UnitSelector<DateTimeMeasureUnitNative, DateTimeGridAlignmentNative>.GridAlignment gridAlignment = CalculateGridAlignment(pixelsPerUnit, DateTime.MinValue, DateTime.MaxValue);
			return DateTimeScaleOptions.UpdateAutomaticUnits(measureUnit, gridAlignment.Unit, gridAlignment.Spacing);
		}
	}
	public abstract class MeasureUnitsCalculatorBase
	{
		public static double CalculateAutoMeasureUnit(double wholeRange, double visualRange, double visualRangeLength, int pixelsPerUnit)
		{
			if (GeometricUtils.IsValidDouble(wholeRange) && GeometricUtils.IsValidDouble(visualRange) && visualRangeLength > 0.0 && pixelsPerUnit > 0 && wholeRange != 0.0 && visualRange != 0.0)
			{
				double num = visualRangeLength * wholeRange / visualRange;
				double num2 = Math.Max(1.0, Math.Floor(num / (double)pixelsPerUnit));
				return wholeRange / num2;
			}
			return double.NaN;
		}

		public abstract bool UpdateAutomaticMeasureUnit(double axisLength, IEnumerable<ISeries> seriesList);
	}
	public abstract class MeasureUnitsCalculatorBase<TMeasureUnit, TGridAlignment> : MeasureUnitsCalculatorBase where TMeasureUnit : struct
	{
		private class MeasureUnitCalculationInfo
		{
			public double MeasureUnit { get; private set; }

			public double MinMeasureUnit { get; private set; }

			public double WholeRange { get; private set; }

			public MeasureUnitCalculationInfo(double measureUnit, double minMeasureUnit, double wholeRange)
			{
				MeasureUnit = measureUnit;
				MinMeasureUnit = minMeasureUnit;
				WholeRange = wholeRange;
			}
		}

		private class RefinedRangeAccessor
		{
			public virtual double GetRange(IAxisRangeData range)
			{
				return range.RefinedMax - range.RefinedMin;
			}
		}

		private class InternalRangeAccessor : RefinedRangeAccessor
		{
			private readonly IAxisData axis;

			public InternalRangeAccessor(IAxisData axis)
			{
				this.axis = axis;
			}

			public override double GetRange(IAxisRangeData range)
			{
				if (axis.AxisScaleTypeMap != null && GeometricUtils.IsValidDouble(range.Max - range.Min))
				{
					double num = axis.AxisScaleTypeMap.InternalToRefined(range.Max) - axis.AxisScaleTypeMap.InternalToRefined(range.Min);
					if (GeometricUtils.IsValidDouble(num))
					{
						return num;
					}
				}
				return base.GetRange(range);
			}
		}

		private readonly IAxisData axis;

		private readonly UnitSelector<TMeasureUnit, TGridAlignment> unitSelector;

		private double minMeasureUnit;

		private double currentMeasureUnit;

		protected IAxisData Axis => axis;

		protected UnitSelector<TMeasureUnit, TGridAlignment> UnitSelector => unitSelector;

		protected double CurrentMeasureUnit => currentMeasureUnit;

		protected abstract IScaleOptionsBase<TMeasureUnit> ScaleOptions { get; }

		protected abstract bool UseMinMeasureUnit { get; }

		public double MinMeasureUnit => minMeasureUnit;

		public IList<TMeasureUnit> MeasureUnitsList => unitSelector.SelectActiveMeasureUnits();

		protected MeasureUnitsCalculatorBase(IAxisData axis)
		{
			this.axis = axis;
			minMeasureUnit = double.NaN;
			unitSelector = CreateUnitSelector();
		}

		private int GetPixelsPerUnit(IEnumerable<ISeries> seriesList)
		{
			int num = 0;
			foreach (ISeries series in seriesList)
			{
				if (series.SeriesView is IXYSeriesView iXYSeriesView && (num == 0 || num < iXYSeriesView.PixelsPerArgument))
				{
					num = iXYSeriesView.PixelsPerArgument;
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		private MeasureUnitCalculationInfo CalculateMeasureUnitInfo(double axisLength, int pixelsPerUnit, IEnumerable<ISeries> seriesList, RefinedRangeAccessor rangeAccessor)
		{
			int num = 0;
			foreach (ISeries series in seriesList)
			{
				if (series.ActualPoints.Count > num)
				{
					num = series.ActualPoints.Count;
				}
			}
			double num2 = rangeAccessor.GetRange(axis.WholeRange);
			double num3 = (axis.VisualRange.Auto ? num2 : rangeAccessor.GetRange(axis.VisualRange));
			if (num3 > num2)
			{
				num2 = num3;
			}
			if (num2 != 0.0 && num3 != 0.0)
			{
				double num4 = MeasureUnitsCalculatorBase.CalculateAutoMeasureUnit(num2, num3, axisLength, pixelsPerUnit);
				if (GeometricUtils.IsValidDouble(num4) && num4 >= 0.0 && GeometricUtils.IsValidDouble(num2) && num2 > 0.0)
				{
					minMeasureUnit = ((UseMinMeasureUnit && num > 1) ? (num2 / (double)(num - 1)) : num4);
					return new MeasureUnitCalculationInfo(num4, minMeasureUnit, num2);
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private TMeasureUnit? CalculateAutoMeasureUnit(IEnumerable<ISeries> seriesList, double axisLength, int pixelsPerUnit, RefinedRangeAccessor rangeAccessor)
		{
			if (pixelsPerUnit > 0)
			{
				MeasureUnitCalculationInfo measureUnitCalculationInfo = CalculateMeasureUnitInfo(axisLength, pixelsPerUnit, seriesList, rangeAccessor);
				if (measureUnitCalculationInfo != null)
				{
					minMeasureUnit = measureUnitCalculationInfo.MinMeasureUnit;
					double measureUnit = measureUnitCalculationInfo.MeasureUnit;
					unitSelector.UpdateActiveUnits(minMeasureUnit, measureUnitCalculationInfo.WholeRange);
					TMeasureUnit value = unitSelector.SelectMeasureUnit(Math.Max(measureUnit, minMeasureUnit), currentMeasureUnit);
					currentMeasureUnit = measureUnit;
					return value;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private TMeasureUnit? CalculateCustomMeasureUnit(IEnumerable<ISeries> seriesList, double axisLength, int pixelsPerUnit)
		{
			IAxisRangeData visualRange = axis.VisualRange;
			IAxisRangeData wholeRange = axis.WholeRange;
			double num = wholeRange.RefinedMax - wholeRange.RefinedMin;
			double num2 = (visualRange.Auto ? num : (visualRange.RefinedMax - visualRange.RefinedMin));
			if (double.IsNaN(num2) || double.IsNaN(num) || num2 == 0.0 || num == 0.0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return ScaleOptions.CalculateCustomMeasureUnit(seriesList, axisLength, pixelsPerUnit, visualRange.RefinedMin, visualRange.RefinedMax, wholeRange.RefinedMin, wholeRange.RefinedMax);
		}

		protected abstract bool UpdateAutomaticUnits(TMeasureUnit measureUnit, int pixelsPerUnit);

		protected abstract void UpdateAutomaticGrid(double pixelsPerUnit, IMinMaxValues visualRange);

		protected abstract UnitSelector<TMeasureUnit, TGridAlignment> CreateUnitSelector();

		public override bool UpdateAutomaticMeasureUnit(double axisLength, IEnumerable<ISeries> seriesList)
		{
			int pixelsPerUnit = GetPixelsPerUnit(seriesList);
			RefinedRangeAccessor rangeAccessor = new RefinedRangeAccessor();
			TMeasureUnit? val;
			if (ScaleOptions.UseCustomMeasureUnit)
			{
				val = CalculateCustomMeasureUnit(seriesList, axisLength, pixelsPerUnit);
				currentMeasureUnit = CalculateMeasureUnitInfo(axisLength, pixelsPerUnit, seriesList, rangeAccessor)?.MeasureUnit ?? currentMeasureUnit;
			}
			else
			{
				val = CalculateAutoMeasureUnit(seriesList, axisLength, pixelsPerUnit, rangeAccessor);
			}
			if (val.HasValue)
			{
				return UpdateAutomaticUnits(val.Value, pixelsPerUnit);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void UpdateAutomaticGrid(double axisLength, IEnumerable<ISeries> seriesList, IMinMaxValues visualRange)
		{
			int pixelsPerUnit = GetPixelsPerUnit(seriesList);
			if (pixelsPerUnit > 0)
			{
				if (ScaleOptions.UseCustomMeasureUnit)
				{
					CalculateCustomMeasureUnit(seriesList, axisLength, pixelsPerUnit);
				}
				else
				{
					CalculateAutoMeasureUnit(seriesList, axisLength, pixelsPerUnit, new InternalRangeAccessor(axis));
				}
				UpdateAutomaticGrid(pixelsPerUnit, visualRange);
			}
		}
	}
	public class NumericUnitSelector : UnitSelector<double, double>
	{
		private const int autoMeasureUnitStep = 10;

		public static int AutoMeasureUnitStep => 10;

		private static double RoundMeasureUnit(double measureUnit)
		{
			if (measureUnit == 1.0)
			{
				return GeometricUtils.StrongRound(measureUnit);
			}
			if (measureUnit > 1.0)
			{
				int num = 0;
				while (measureUnit > 10.0)
				{
					measureUnit /= 10.0;
					num++;
				}
				return (double)GeometricUtils.StrongRound(measureUnit) * Math.Pow(10.0, num);
			}
			if (measureUnit > 0.0)
			{
				int num2 = 0;
				while (measureUnit < 1.0)
				{
					measureUnit *= 10.0;
					num2++;
				}
				return 1.0 / Math.Pow(10.0, num2) * (double)GeometricUtils.StrongRound(measureUnit);
			}
			throw new ArgumentException("Measure unit must be greater than zero.");
		}

		public override void UpdateActiveUnits(double min, double max)
		{
			double num = RoundMeasureUnit(min);
			double num2 = RoundMeasureUnit(max);
			List<UnitContainer<double, double>.MeasureItem> list = new List<UnitContainer<double, double>.MeasureItem>();
			double num3 = num;
			list.Add(new UnitContainer<double, double>.MeasureItem(num3, num3));
			while (num3 < num2)
			{
				num3 *= (double)AutoMeasureUnitStep;
				list.Add(new UnitContainer<double, double>.MeasureItem(num3, num3));
			}
			base.ActiveUnitContainer.UpdateActiveUnits(list, null);
		}
	}

		{
		}

	public class TimeSpanUnitSelector : DateTimeUnitSelectorBase<TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative, TimeSpanGridAlignmentNative>
	{
		private const double sizeMillisecond = 1.0;

		private const double sizeSecond = 1000.0;

		private const double sizeMinute = 60000.0;

		private const double sizeHour = 3600000.0;

		private const double sizeDay = 86400000.0;

		public const double DefaultGridSpacing = 1.0;

		public static TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative DefaultMeasureUnit => TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative.Second;

		public static TimeSpanGridAlignmentNative DefaultGridAlignment => TimeSpanGridAlignmentNative.Minute;

		private static TimeSpanGridAlignmentNative GetPreviousAlignment(TimeSpanGridAlignmentNative alignment)
		{
			if (alignment == TimeSpanGridAlignmentNative.Millisecond)
			{
				return TimeSpanGridAlignmentNative.Millisecond;
			}
			return alignment - 1;
		}

		public static double GetMeasureUnitValue(TimeSpanGridAlignmentNative alignment)
		{
			return GetMeasureUnitValue((TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative)alignment);
		}

		public static double GetMeasureUnitValue(TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative measureUnit)
		{
			return measureUnit switch
			{
				TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative.Millisecond => 1.0, 
				TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative.Second => 1000.0, 
				TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative.Minute => 60000.0, 
				TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative.Hour => 3600000.0, 
				TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative.Day => 86400000.0, 
				_ => throw new ArgumentException(), 
			};
		}

		public static GridAlignment GetPreviousGridAlignment(GridAlignment gridAlignment)
		{
			TimeSpanGridAlignmentNative previousAlignment = GetPreviousAlignment(gridAlignment.Unit);
			double measureUnitValue = GetMeasureUnitValue(previousAlignment);
			double measureUnitValue2 = GetMeasureUnitValue(gridAlignment.Unit);
			double spacing = UnitSelector<TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative, TimeSpanGridAlignmentNative>.CalculateSpacing((measureUnitValue2 - measureUnitValue) * 0.2 + measureUnitValue, measureUnitValue);
			return new GridAlignment(previousAlignment, spacing);
		}

		protected override List<UnitContainer<TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative, TimeSpanGridAlignmentNative>.MeasureItem> FillMeasureSteps()
		{
			return new List<UnitContainer<TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative, TimeSpanGridAlignmentNative>.MeasureItem>
			{
				new UnitContainer<TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative, TimeSpanGridAlignmentNative>.MeasureItem(1.0, TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative.Millisecond),
				new UnitContainer<TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative, TimeSpanGridAlignmentNative>.MeasureItem(1000.0, TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative.Second),
				new UnitContainer<TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative, TimeSpanGridAlignmentNative>.MeasureItem(60000.0, TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative.Minute),
				new UnitContainer<TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative, TimeSpanGridAlignmentNative>.MeasureItem(3600000.0, TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative.Hour),
				new UnitContainer<TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative, TimeSpanGridAlignmentNative>.MeasureItem(86400000.0, TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative.Day)
			};
		}

		protected override List<UnitContainer<TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative, TimeSpanGridAlignmentNative>.AlignmentItem> FillAlignmentSteps()
		{
			return new List<UnitContainer<TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative, TimeSpanGridAlignmentNative>.AlignmentItem>
			{
				new UnitContainer<TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative, TimeSpanGridAlignmentNative>.AlignmentItem(1.0, TimeSpanGridAlignmentNative.Millisecond),
				new UnitContainer<TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative, TimeSpanGridAlignmentNative>.AlignmentItem(1000.0, TimeSpanGridAlignmentNative.Second),
				new UnitContainer<TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative, TimeSpanGridAlignmentNative>.AlignmentItem(60000.0, TimeSpanGridAlignmentNative.Minute),
				new UnitContainer<TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative, TimeSpanGridAlignmentNative>.AlignmentItem(3600000.0, TimeSpanGridAlignmentNative.Hour),
				new UnitContainer<TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative, TimeSpanGridAlignmentNative>.AlignmentItem(86400000.0, TimeSpanGridAlignmentNative.Day)
			};
		}
	}
	public class TimeSpanMeasureUnitsCalculatorCore : MeasureUnitsCalculatorBase<TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative, TimeSpanGridAlignmentNative>
	{
		private double previousThreshold;

		private ITimeSpanScaleOptions TimeSpanScaleOptions => base.Axis.TimeSpanScaleOptions;

		protected override bool UseMinMeasureUnit => false;

		protected override IScaleOptionsBase<TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative> ScaleOptions => TimeSpanScaleOptions;

		public TimeSpanMeasureUnitsCalculatorCore(IAxisData axis)
			: base(axis)
		{
		}

		private UnitSelector<TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative, TimeSpanGridAlignmentNative>.GridAlignment AlignToRange(UnitSelector<TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative, TimeSpanGridAlignmentNative>.GridAlignment selectedAlignment, TimeSpan min, TimeSpan max)
		{
			if (min == TimeSpan.Zero)
			{
				return selectedAlignment;
			}
			TimeSpan timeSpan = DateTimeUtilsExt.Floor(min, (TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative)selectedAlignment.Unit);
			TimeSpan timeSpan2 = DateTimeUtilsExt.Floor(max, (TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative)selectedAlignment.Unit);
			if (timeSpan2 != timeSpan)
			{
				return selectedAlignment;
			}
			return TimeSpanUnitSelector.GetPreviousGridAlignment(selectedAlignment);
		}

		private UnitSelector<TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative, TimeSpanGridAlignmentNative>.GridAlignment CalculateGridAlignment(double pixelsPerUnit, TimeSpan min, TimeSpan max)
		{
			UnitSelector<TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative, TimeSpanGridAlignmentNative>.GridAlignment selectedAlignment;
			if (TimeSpanScaleOptions.ScaleMode == ScaleModeNative.Interval)
			{
				selectedAlignment = new UnitSelector<TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative, TimeSpanGridAlignmentNative>.GridAlignment((TimeSpanGridAlignmentNative)TimeSpanScaleOptions.MeasureUnit, 1.0);
			}
			else
			{
				double value = base.CurrentMeasureUnit / pixelsPerUnit * (double)base.Axis.GridSpacingFactor;
				selectedAlignment = base.UnitSelector.SelectAlignment(value, previousThreshold);
			}
			selectedAlignment = AlignToRange(selectedAlignment, min, max);
			previousThreshold = TimeSpanUnitSelector.GetMeasureUnitValue((TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative)selectedAlignment.Unit);
			return selectedAlignment;
		}

		protected override UnitSelector<TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative, TimeSpanGridAlignmentNative> CreateUnitSelector()
		{
			return new TimeSpanUnitSelector();
		}

		protected override void UpdateAutomaticGrid(double pixelsPerUnit, IMinMaxValues visualRange)
		{
			object obj = base.Axis.AxisScaleTypeMap.InternalToNative(visualRange.Min);
			object obj2 = base.Axis.AxisScaleTypeMap.InternalToNative(visualRange.Max);
			UnitSelector<TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative, TimeSpanGridAlignmentNative>.GridAlignment gridAlignment = CalculateGridAlignment(pixelsPerUnit, (obj is TimeSpan) ? ((TimeSpan)obj) : TimeSpan.Zero, (obj2 is TimeSpan) ? ((TimeSpan)obj2) : TimeSpan.FromDays(10000.0));
			TimeSpanScaleOptions.UpdateAutomaticGrid(gridAlignment.Unit, gridAlignment.Spacing);
		}

		protected override bool UpdateAutomaticUnits(TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative measureUnit, int pixelsPerUnit)
		{
			UnitSelector<TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative, TimeSpanGridAlignmentNative>.GridAlignment gridAlignment = CalculateGridAlignment(pixelsPerUnit, TimeSpan.Zero, TimeSpan.FromDays(10000.0));
			return TimeSpanScaleOptions.UpdateAutomaticUnits(measureUnit, gridAlignment.Unit, gridAlignment.Spacing);
		}
	}
	public class UnitContainer<TMeasureUnit, TGridAlignment>
	{
		public abstract class ThresholdItem
		{
			private readonly double threshold;

			public double Threshold => threshold;

			protected ThresholdItem(double threshold)
			{
				this.threshold = threshold;
			}
		}

		public abstract class UnitItem<T> : ThresholdItem
		{
			private readonly T unit;

			public T Unit => unit;

			protected UnitItem(double threshold, T unit)
				: base(threshold)
			{
				this.unit = unit;
			}
		}

		public class MeasureItem : UnitItem<TMeasureUnit>
		{
			public MeasureItem(double threshold, TMeasureUnit unit)
				: base(threshold, unit)
			{
			}
		}

		public class AlignmentItem : UnitItem<TGridAlignment>
		{
			public AlignmentItem(double threshold, TGridAlignment unit)
				: base(threshold, unit)
			{
			}
		}

		internal const double UnitChangeFactor = 0.2;

		private readonly List<MeasureItem> measureItems;

		private readonly List<AlignmentItem> alignmentItems;

		public int MeasureUnitCount => measureItems.Count;

		public int AlignmentUnitCount => alignmentItems.Count;

		public UnitContainer()
		{
			measureItems = new List<MeasureItem>();
			alignmentItems = new List<AlignmentItem>();
		}

		private T SelectUnit<T>(IList<T> list, double value, double previousValue) where T : ThresholdItem
		{
			double num = 1.0;
			if (!double.IsNaN(previousValue))
			{
				num = ((value > previousValue) ? 1.1 : 0.9);
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < list.Count - 1; i++)
			{
				if (value <= list[i].Threshold)
				{
					return list[i];
				}
				if (value < list[i + 1].Threshold)
				{
					double num2 = (value - list[i].Threshold) / (list[i + 1].Threshold - list[i].Threshold);
					if (!(num2 >= 0.2 * num))
					{
						return list[i];
					}
					return list[i + 1];
				}
			}
			return list[list.Count - 1];
		}

		private T SelectUnit<T>(double value, double previousValue) where T : ThresholdItem
		{
			if (typeof(T) == typeof(MeasureItem))
			{
				return SelectUnit((IList<T>)measureItems, value, previousValue);
			}
			if (typeof(T) == typeof(AlignmentItem))
			{
				return SelectUnit((IList<T>)alignmentItems, value, previousValue);
			}
			return null;
		}

		private T GetUnitAt<T>(int index) where T : ThresholdItem
		{
			if (typeof(T) == typeof(MeasureItem))
			{
				if (index < measureItems.Count)
				{
					return (T)(ThresholdItem)measureItems[index];
				}
			}
			else if (typeof(T) == typeof(AlignmentItem) && index < alignmentItems.Count)
			{
				return (T)(ThresholdItem)alignmentItems[index];
			}
			return null;
		}

		public MeasureItem SelectMeasureUnit(double value, double previousValue)
		{
			return SelectUnit<MeasureItem>(value, previousValue);
		}

		public AlignmentItem SelectAlignmentUnit(double value, double previousValue)
		{
			return SelectUnit<AlignmentItem>(value, previousValue);
		}

		public MeasureItem GetMeasureUnitAt(int index)
		{
			return GetUnitAt<MeasureItem>(index);
		}

		public AlignmentItem GetAlignmentUnitAt(int index)
		{
			return GetUnitAt<AlignmentItem>(index);
		}

		public void UpdateActiveUnits(IEnumerable<MeasureItem> measureItems, IEnumerable<AlignmentItem> alignmentItems)
		{
			this.measureItems.Clear();
			if (measureItems != null)
			{
				this.measureItems.AddRange(measureItems);
			}
			this.alignmentItems.Clear();
			if (alignmentItems != null)
			{
				this.alignmentItems.AddRange(alignmentItems);
			}
		}
	}
	public abstract class UnitSelector<TMeasureUnit, TGridAlignment>
	{
		protected class UnitContainer : UnitContainer<TMeasureUnit, TGridAlignment>
		{
		}

		public struct GridAlignment
		{
			private readonly TGridAlignment unit;

			private readonly double spacing;

			public TGridAlignment Unit => unit;

			public double Spacing => spacing;

			public GridAlignment(TGridAlignment unit, double spacing)
			{
				this.unit = unit;
				this.spacing = spacing;
			}
		}

		private readonly UnitContainer activeUnitContainer;

		protected UnitContainer ActiveUnitContainer => activeUnitContainer;

		public static double CalculateSpacing(double value, double threshold)
		{
			return Math.Max(1.0, Math.Ceiling(value / threshold));
		}

		protected UnitSelector()
		{
			activeUnitContainer = new UnitContainer();
		}

		internal IList<TMeasureUnit> SelectActiveMeasureUnits()
		{
			List<TMeasureUnit> list = new List<TMeasureUnit>();
			for (int i = 0; i < activeUnitContainer.MeasureUnitCount; i++)
			{
				list.Add(activeUnitContainer.GetMeasureUnitAt(i).Unit);
			}
			return list;
		}

		public TMeasureUnit SelectMeasureUnit(double value, double previousValue)
		{
			return activeUnitContainer.SelectMeasureUnit(value, previousValue).Unit;
		}

		public virtual GridAlignment SelectAlignment(double value, double previousValue)
		{
			UnitContainer<TMeasureUnit, TGridAlignment>.AlignmentItem alignmentItem = activeUnitContainer.SelectAlignmentUnit(value, previousValue);
			double spacing = CalculateSpacing(value, alignmentItem.Threshold);
			return new GridAlignment(alignmentItem.Unit, spacing);
		}

		public abstract void UpdateActiveUnits(double min, double max);
	}
	public abstract class DateTimeUnitSelectorBase<TMeasureUnit, TGridAlignment> : UnitSelector<TMeasureUnit, TGridAlignment>
	{
		private readonly UnitContainer commonUnitContainer;

		public DateTimeUnitSelectorBase()
		{
			List<UnitContainer<TMeasureUnit, TGridAlignment>.MeasureItem> measureItems = FillMeasureSteps();
			List<UnitContainer<TMeasureUnit, TGridAlignment>.AlignmentItem> alignmentItems = FillAlignmentSteps();
			commonUnitContainer = new UnitContainer();
			commonUnitContainer.UpdateActiveUnits(measureItems, alignmentItems);
			base.ActiveUnitContainer.UpdateActiveUnits(measureItems, alignmentItems);
		}

		private IList<UnitContainer<TMeasureUnit, TGridAlignment>.MeasureItem> FilterActiveMeasureUnits(double min, double max)
		{
			UnitContainer<TMeasureUnit, TGridAlignment>.MeasureItem measureItem = commonUnitContainer.SelectMeasureUnit(min, min);
			UnitContainer<TMeasureUnit, TGridAlignment>.MeasureItem measureItem2 = commonUnitContainer.SelectMeasureUnit(max, max);
			List<UnitContainer<TMeasureUnit, TGridAlignment>.MeasureItem> list = new List<UnitContainer<TMeasureUnit, TGridAlignment>.MeasureItem>();
			for (int i = 0; i < commonUnitContainer.MeasureUnitCount; i++)
			{
				UnitContainer<TMeasureUnit, TGridAlignment>.MeasureItem measureUnitAt = commonUnitContainer.GetMeasureUnitAt(i);
				if (measureUnitAt.Threshold >= measureItem.Threshold && measureUnitAt.Threshold <= measureItem2.Threshold)
				{
					list.Add(measureUnitAt);
				}
			}
			if (list.Count == 0)
			{
				if (measureItem2.Threshold <= commonUnitContainer.GetMeasureUnitAt(0).Threshold)
				{
					list.Add(commonUnitContainer.GetMeasureUnitAt(0));
				}
				else
				{
					list.Add(commonUnitContainer.GetMeasureUnitAt(commonUnitContainer.MeasureUnitCount - 1));
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		private IList<UnitContainer<TMeasureUnit, TGridAlignment>.AlignmentItem> FilterActiveAlignmentUnits(double min, double max)
		{
			UnitContainer<TMeasureUnit, TGridAlignment>.AlignmentItem alignmentItem = commonUnitContainer.SelectAlignmentUnit(min, min);
			UnitContainer<TMeasureUnit, TGridAlignment>.AlignmentItem alignmentItem2 = commonUnitContainer.SelectAlignmentUnit(max, max);
			List<UnitContainer<TMeasureUnit, TGridAlignment>.AlignmentItem> list = new List<UnitContainer<TMeasureUnit, TGridAlignment>.AlignmentItem>();
			for (int i = 0; i < commonUnitContainer.AlignmentUnitCount; i++)
			{
				UnitContainer<TMeasureUnit, TGridAlignment>.AlignmentItem alignmentUnitAt = commonUnitContainer.GetAlignmentUnitAt(i);
				if (alignmentUnitAt.Threshold >= alignmentItem.Threshold && alignmentUnitAt.Threshold <= alignmentItem2.Threshold)
				{
					list.Add(alignmentUnitAt);
				}
			}
			if (list.Count == 0)
			{
				if (alignmentItem2.Threshold <= commonUnitContainer.GetMeasureUnitAt(0).Threshold)
				{
					list.Add(commonUnitContainer.GetAlignmentUnitAt(0));
				}
				else
				{
					list.Add(commonUnitContainer.GetAlignmentUnitAt(commonUnitContainer.MeasureUnitCount - 1));
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected abstract List<UnitContainer<TMeasureUnit, TGridAlignment>.MeasureItem> FillMeasureSteps();

		protected abstract List<UnitContainer<TMeasureUnit, TGridAlignment>.AlignmentItem> FillAlignmentSteps();

		public override void UpdateActiveUnits(double min, double max)
		{
			base.ActiveUnitContainer.UpdateActiveUnits(FilterActiveMeasureUnits(min, max), FilterActiveAlignmentUnits(min, max));
		}
	}

	public enum WeekdayCore
	{
		None = 0,
		Sunday = 1,

		Tuesday = 4,

	public struct CustomDate
	{
		private readonly bool isHoliday;

		private readonly DateTime date;

		public bool IsHoliday => isHoliday;

		public DateTime Date => date;

		public CustomDate(bool isHoliday, DateTime date)
		{
			this.isHoliday = isHoliday;
			this.date = date;
		}
	}
	public class CustomDateCollection
	{
		private class CustomDateComparer : IComparer<CustomDate>
		{
			public int Compare(CustomDate x, CustomDate y)
			{
				return x.Date.CompareTo(y.Date);
			}
		}

		private readonly List<CustomDate> dates;

		private readonly CustomDateComparer comparer;

		public IEnumerable<CustomDate> Dates => dates;

		public CustomDateCollection()
		{
			dates = new List<CustomDate>();
			comparer = new CustomDateComparer();
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			dates.Clear();
		}

		public void SetDate(DateTime date, bool isHoliday)
		{
			CustomDate customDate = new CustomDate(isHoliday, date);
			int num = dates.BinarySearch(customDate, comparer);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				num = ~num;
				dates.Insert(num, customDate);
			}
			else if (dates[num].IsHoliday)
			{
				dates[num] = customDate;
			}
		}

		public void ResetDate(DateTime date)
		{
			CustomDate item = new CustomDate(isHoliday: false, date);
			int num = dates.BinarySearch(item, comparer);
			if (num > 0)
			{
				dates.RemoveAt(num);
			}
		}
	}

	public static class BoxPlotConventions
	{
		public static readonly double MissingNumericNativeValue = double.NaN;

		public static readonly DateTime MissingDateTimeNativeValue = DateTime.MinValue;

		public static readonly TimeSpan MissingTimeSpanNativeValue = TimeSpan.Zero;

		public static readonly double MissingRefinedValue = double.NaN;

		public static readonly string MissingDataMember = null;

		public const int BoxPlotOutliersMemberIndex = 6;

		public static bool IsMissingDateTimeNativeValue(DateTime dtValue)
		{
			return dtValue == MissingDateTimeNativeValue;
		}

		public static bool IsMissingTimeSpanNativeValue(TimeSpan tsValue)
		{
			return tsValue == MissingTimeSpanNativeValue;
		}

		public static bool IsMissingNumericNativeValue(double dValue)
		{
			return double.IsNaN(dValue);
		}

		public static bool IsMissingDataMember(string dataMember)
		{
			return string.IsNullOrEmpty(dataMember);
		}
	}
	public class TimeSpanAxisRangeUpdateStrategy : NumericalAxisRangeUpdateStrategy
	{
		public TimeSpanAxisRangeUpdateStrategy(IAxisData axis, MinMaxValues minMaxInternal, MinMaxValues minMaxRefined, ICollection<RefinedSeries> refinedSeries, bool scaleMapWasChanged)
			: base(axis, minMaxInternal, minMaxRefined, refinedSeries, scaleMapWasChanged)
		{
		}

		protected override InternalRange ApplySideMargins(MinMaxValues internalValues, MinMaxValues sideMargins, bool autoCorrectionMin, bool autoCorrectionMax)
		{
			InternalRange internalRange = base.ApplySideMargins(internalValues, sideMargins, autoCorrectionMin, autoCorrectionMax);
			if (!(base.Map is IIntervalScaleMap))
			{
				double num = base.Map.NativeToInternal(DateTimeUtilsExt.MaxTimeSpan);
				double num2 = base.Map.NativeToInternal(DateTimeUtilsExt.MinTimeSpan);
				bool flag = internalRange.Values.Min < num2;
				bool flag2 = internalRange.Values.Max > num;
				if (flag || flag2)
				{
					MinMaxValues values = internalRange.Values;
					MinMaxValues sideMargins2 = internalRange.SideMargins;
					if (flag)
					{
						values.Min = num2;
						sideMargins2.Min = Math.Max(internalValues.Min - num2, 0.0);
					}
					if (flag2)
					{
						values.Max = num;
						sideMargins2.Max = Math.Max(num - internalValues.Max, 0.0);
					}
					internalRange = new InternalRange(values, sideMargins2, sideMargins2);
				}
			}
			if (internalRange.Delta == 0.0)
			{
				return new InternalRange(new MinMaxValues(internalValues.Min - DefaultSideMarginsValue.Min, internalValues.Max + DefaultSideMarginsValue.Max), DefaultSideMarginsValue);
			}
			return internalRange;
		}
	}
	public interface IRefinedSeriesContainer
	{
		bool IsContainsProcessedPoints { get; }

		bool IsDesignMode { get; }

		MinMaxValues GetValuesRange(RefinedSeries series);
	}
	public class RefinedSeriesRepository : IRefinedSeriesContainer
	{
		private readonly List<RefinedSeries> refinedSeries = new List<RefinedSeries>();

		private readonly List<RefinedSeries> activeRefinedSeries = new List<RefinedSeries>();

		private readonly List<RefinedSeries> seriesForLegend = new List<RefinedSeries>();

		private readonly RefinedSeriesGroupController groupController;

		private readonly InteractionManager interactionManager;

		private readonly IChartDataContainer dataContainer;

		private readonly IRefinedSeriesFactory refinedSeriesFactory;

		internal RefinedSeriesGroupController GroupController => groupController;

		internal IList<RefinedSeries> ActiveRefinedSeries => activeRefinedSeries;

		internal IList<RefinedSeries> RefinedSeries => refinedSeries;

		internal IList<RefinedSeries> SeriesForLegend => seriesForLegend;

		internal InteractionManager InteractionManager => interactionManager;

		internal ISeriesBase SeriesTemplate => dataContainer.SeriesTemplate;

		public bool IsContainsProcessedSeries
		{
			get
			{
				if (activeRefinedSeries != null)
				{
					return activeRefinedSeries.Count > 0;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public bool IsContainsProcessedPoints
		{
			get
			{
				if (!IsContainsProcessedSeries)
				{
					return true;
				}
				foreach (RefinedSeries item in activeRefinedSeries)
				{
					if (item.IsContainsProcessedPoints)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public bool IsContainsProcessedNotEmptyPoints
		{
			get
			{
				foreach (RefinedSeries item in activeRefinedSeries)
				{
					if (item.IsContainsProcessedNotEmptyPoints)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		bool IRefinedSeriesContainer.IsContainsProcessedPoints => IsContainsProcessedPoints;

		bool IRefinedSeriesContainer.IsDesignMode => dataContainer.DesignMode;

		public RefinedSeriesRepository(IChartDataContainer dataContainer, IRefinedSeriesFactory factory)
		{
			groupController = new RefinedSeriesGroupController(this);
			interactionManager = new InteractionManager();
			this.dataContainer = dataContainer;
			refinedSeriesFactory = factory;
		}

		private RefinedSeries CreateRefinedSeries(ISeries series, IRefinedSeriesContainer seriesContainer)
		{
			if (refinedSeriesFactory != null)
			{
				return refinedSeriesFactory.Create(series, seriesContainer);
			}
			return new RefinedSeries(series, seriesContainer);
		}

		internal void AddToActive(RefinedSeries series, bool isVisibleAndCompatible, bool shouldBeDrawn)
		{
			if (isVisibleAndCompatible)
			{
				seriesForLegend.Add(series);
				if (shouldBeDrawn)
				{
					series.ActiveIndex = activeRefinedSeries.Count;
					activeRefinedSeries.Add(series);
				}
				else
				{
					series.ActiveIndex = -1;
				}
			}
		}

		internal void RemoveSeriesGroup(IAxisData axis)
		{
			List<RefinedSeries> list = groupController.RemoveSeriesGroup(axis);
			if (list == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (RefinedSeries item in list)
			{
				interactionManager.RemoveSeries(item);
			}
		}

		internal void RemoveSeries(RefinedSeries series)
		{
			RemoveFromSeriesGroups(series);
			refinedSeries.Remove(series);
		}

		internal RefinedSeries InsertSeries(int index, ISeries series)
		{
			RefinedSeries refinedSeries = CreateRefinedSeries(series, this);
			this.refinedSeries.Insert(index, refinedSeries);
			return refinedSeries;
		}

		internal void InsertSeries(int index, IEnumerable<ISeries> seriesList)
		{
			if (seriesList == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (ISeries series in seriesList)
			{
				InsertSeries(index++, series);
			}
		}

		internal void CleanRefinedSeries()
		{
			refinedSeries.Clear();
			interactionManager.Clear();
			groupController.RemoveAllSeries();
		}

		internal void SwapRefinedSeries(int newIndex, int oldIndex)
		{
			RefinedSeries value = refinedSeries[newIndex];
			refinedSeries[newIndex] = refinedSeries[oldIndex];
			refinedSeries[oldIndex] = value;
			RemoveFromSeriesGroups(refinedSeries[newIndex]);
			RemoveFromSeriesGroups(refinedSeries[oldIndex]);
		}

		internal void MoveRefinedSeries(int newIndex, int oldIndex)
		{
			RefinedSeries item = refinedSeries[oldIndex];
			refinedSeries.Remove(item);
			refinedSeries.Insert(newIndex, item);
			RemoveFromSeriesGroups(refinedSeries[newIndex]);
		}

		internal void ClearRefinedSeries()
		{
			activeRefinedSeries.Clear();
			seriesForLegend.Clear();
		}

		internal void ClearActiveRefinedSeries()
		{
			activeRefinedSeries.Clear();
			foreach (RefinedSeries item in RefinedSeries)
			{
				RemoveFromSeriesGroups(item);
			}
		}

		internal RefinedSeries FindRefinedSeries(Func<RefinedSeries, bool> predicate)
		{
			foreach (RefinedSeries item in refinedSeries)
			{
				if (predicate(item))
				{
					return item;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal RefinedSeries FindRefinedSeries(ISeriesBase series)
		{
			if (series == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return FindRefinedSeries((RefinedSeries x) => x.Series == series);
		}

		internal void RemoveFromSeriesGroups(RefinedSeries series)
		{
			groupController.RemoveFromSeriesGroups(series);
			interactionManager.RemoveSeries(series);
		}

		MinMaxValues IRefinedSeriesContainer.GetValuesRange(RefinedSeries refinedSeries)
		{
			return interactionManager.GetSeriesValuesRange(refinedSeries);
		}
	}
	public class RefinedSeriesGroupController
	{
		private readonly Dictionary<RefinedSeriesGroupKey, RefinedSeriesGroup> refinedSeriesGroups = new Dictionary<RefinedSeriesGroupKey, RefinedSeriesGroup>();

		private readonly RefinedSeriesRepository refinedSeriesRepository;

		internal Dictionary<RefinedSeriesGroupKey, RefinedSeriesGroup> RefinedSeriesGroups => refinedSeriesGroups;

		public RefinedSeriesGroupController(RefinedSeriesRepository refinedSeriesRepository)
		{
			this.refinedSeriesRepository = refinedSeriesRepository;
		}

		private RefinedSeriesGroup CreateGroup(RefinedSeriesGroupKey groupKey, IMinMaxValuesCalculator minMaxCalculator, AxisGroup axisGroup)
		{
			return axisGroup switch
			{
				AxisGroup.ArgumentX => new RefinedSeriesGroupByArgument(groupKey, refinedSeriesRepository.SeriesTemplate), 
				AxisGroup.ArgumentY => new RefinedSeriesGroupByArgument2(groupKey), 
				_ => new RefinedSeriesGroupByValue(groupKey, minMaxCalculator), 
			};
		}

		private RefinedSeriesGroup GetGroup(RefinedSeriesGroupKey groupKey, IMinMaxValuesCalculator minMaxCalculator, AxisGroup axisGroup)
		{
			if (!refinedSeriesGroups.TryGetValue(groupKey, out var value))
			{
				value = CreateGroup(groupKey, minMaxCalculator, axisGroup);
				refinedSeriesGroups.Add(groupKey, value);
			}
			return value;
		}

		private void RemoveFromSeriesGroup(RefinedSeriesGroup seriesGroup, RefinedSeries series)
		{
			if (seriesGroup != null)
			{
				seriesGroup.RemoveSeries(series);
				if (seriesGroup.IsEmpty)
				{
					refinedSeriesGroups.Remove(seriesGroup.GroupKey);
				}
			}
		}

		private RefinedSeriesGroup CreateFakeGroup(IAxisData axisData, IMinMaxValuesCalculator minMaxCalculator)
		{
			RefinedSeriesGroupKey groupKey = new RefinedSeriesGroupKey(axisData);
			if (axisData.IsArgumentAxis)
			{
				return new RefinedSeriesGroupByArgument(groupKey, refinedSeriesRepository.SeriesTemplate);
			}
			return new RefinedSeriesGroupByValue(groupKey, minMaxCalculator);
		}

		internal void RemoveFromSeriesGroups(RefinedSeries series)
		{
			if (series == null || series.ArgumentGroups == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (RefinedSeriesGroup argumentGroup in series.ArgumentGroups)
			{
				if (argumentGroup != null && argumentGroup.GroupKey != null)
				{
					RemoveFromSeriesGroup(argumentGroup, series);
				}
			}
			if (series.ValueGroup != null && series.ValueGroup.GroupKey != null)
			{
				RemoveFromSeriesGroup(series.ValueGroup, series);
			}
			series.BindToGroups(null, null);
		}

		internal void RemoveAllSeries()
		{
			foreach (RefinedSeriesGroup value in refinedSeriesGroups.Values)
			{
				value.RemoveAllSeries();
			}
		}

		internal RefinedSeriesGroup FindRefinedSeriesGroup(IAxisData axis)
		{
			foreach (RefinedSeriesGroupKey key in refinedSeriesGroups.Keys)
			{
				if (key != null && key.AxisData != null && key.AxisData == axis)
				{
					return refinedSeriesGroups[key];
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal RefinedSeriesGroup GetValueGroup(RefinedSeries series, IMinMaxValuesCalculator minMaxCalculator, AxisGroup axisGroup)
		{
			RefinedSeriesGroupKey groupKey = new RefinedSeriesGroupKey(series, axisGroup);
			return GetGroup(groupKey, minMaxCalculator, axisGroup);
		}

		internal RefinedSeriesGroup GetArgumentGroup(RefinedSeries series, AxisGroup axisGroup)
		{
			return GetValueGroup(series, null, axisGroup);
		}

		internal List<RefinedSeries> RemoveSeriesGroup(IAxisData axis)
		{
			RefinedSeriesGroup refinedSeriesGroup = FindRefinedSeriesGroup(axis);
			if (refinedSeriesGroup == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			List<RefinedSeries> list = new List<RefinedSeries>(refinedSeriesGroup.RefinedSeries);
			foreach (RefinedSeries item in list)
			{
				RemoveFromSeriesGroups(item);
			}
			return list;
		}

		internal RefinedSeriesGroup InsertGroup(IAxisData axis, IMinMaxValuesCalculator calculator)
		{
			RefinedSeriesGroup refinedSeriesGroup = FindRefinedSeriesGroup(axis);
			if (refinedSeriesGroup == null)
			{
				RefinedSeriesGroupKey groupKey = new RefinedSeriesGroupKey(axis);
				refinedSeriesGroup = GetGroup(groupKey, calculator, axis.AxisGroup);
				refinedSeriesGroup.UpdateScaleMap(forceCreate: false, shouldRecalculateArgumentScale: false);
			}
			return refinedSeriesGroup;
		}

		internal void RemoveGroup(IAxisData axis)
		{
			RemoveSeriesGroup(axis);
			RefinedSeriesGroup refinedSeriesGroup = FindRefinedSeriesGroup(axis);
			if (refinedSeriesGroup != null)
			{
				refinedSeriesGroups.Remove(refinedSeriesGroup.GroupKey);
			}
		}

		internal void ClearGroup()
		{
			List<RefinedSeriesGroupKey> list = new List<RefinedSeriesGroupKey>(refinedSeriesGroups.Keys);
			foreach (RefinedSeriesGroupKey item in list)
			{
				if (item != null && item.AxisData != null)
				{
					RemoveGroup(item.AxisData);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void CalculateFilteredIndexes()
		{
			foreach (RefinedSeriesGroup value in refinedSeriesGroups.Values)
			{
				if (value is RefinedSeriesGroupByArgument refinedSeriesGroupByArgument)
				{
					refinedSeriesGroupByArgument.CalculateFilteredIndexes(allowResamplerUpdates: true);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void UpdateAxisData(IEnumerable<IAxisData> axes, IMinMaxValuesCalculator minMaxCalculator)
		{
			foreach (IAxisData axis in axes)
			{
				RefinedSeriesGroup refinedSeriesGroup = FindRefinedSeriesGroup(axis);
				if (refinedSeriesGroup == null)
				{
					refinedSeriesGroup = CreateFakeGroup(axis, minMaxCalculator);
				}
				refinedSeriesGroup.UpdateSideMarginsEnable();
			}
			foreach (IAxisData axis2 in axes)
			{
				RefinedSeriesGroup refinedSeriesGroup2 = FindRefinedSeriesGroup(axis2);
				if (refinedSeriesGroup2 == null)
				{
					refinedSeriesGroup2 = CreateFakeGroup(axis2, minMaxCalculator);
				}
				refinedSeriesGroup2.UpdateTransformation();
				refinedSeriesGroup2.UpdateScaleBreaks();
				refinedSeriesGroup2.UpdateAxisData();
			}
		}

		internal void ClearSeparatePaneIndicators()
		{
			foreach (RefinedSeriesGroup value in refinedSeriesGroups.Values)
			{
				if (value is RefinedSeriesGroupByValue refinedSeriesGroupByValue)
				{
					refinedSeriesGroupByValue.ClearIndicators();
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public class SeriesController
	{
		internal class SeriesControllerTransaction
		{
			private const double maxRealTimeDelay = 10.0;

			private readonly DateTime createTime;

			private readonly SeriesController controller;

			private readonly ChartUpdateAggregator aggregator;

			private readonly IUpdateProcessor processor;

			private readonly UpdatesExecutor updatesProcessor;

			public SeriesControllerTransaction(SeriesController seriesController)
			{
				controller = seriesController;
				aggregator = new ChartUpdateAggregator();
				updatesProcessor = new UpdatesExecutor(controller);
				IUpdateProcessor updateProcessor = new GroupProcessor<CollectionUpdateInfo>(new SeriesCollectionBatchUpdateProcessor(), new SeriesCollectionUpdateProcessor(), new AxisCollectionUpdateProcessor(), new AxisCollectionBatchUpdateProcessor(), new SeriesPointCollectionBatchUpdateProcessor(), new SeriesPointCollectionUpdateProcessor());
				IUpdateProcessor updateProcessor2 = new GroupProcessor<PropertyUpdateInfo>(new GroupProcessor<PropertyUpdateInfo, ISeriesView>(new XYSeriesViewPropertyUpdateProcessor(), new BarSeriesViewPropertiesUpdateProcessor(), new NestedDoughnutSeriesViewPropertiesUpdateProcessor()), new DiagramPropertyUpdateProcessor(), new PropertyDiagramUpdateProcessor(), new PropertyDataSourceUpdateProcessor(), new SeriesPropertiesUpdateProcessor(), new AxisPropertiesUpdateProcessor(), new SeriesPointPropertiesUpdateProcessor(), new AxisElementUpdateProcessor(), new CrosshairOptionsPropertiesUpdateProcessor(), new CrosshairUpdateProcessor(), new UseCheckBoxesPropertyUpdateProcessor(), new SideBySideBarPropertiesUpdateProcessor(), new DataAdapterUpdateProcessor());
				processor = new GroupProcessor<ChartUpdateInfoBase>(new RangeChangedUpdateProcessor(), new SelectionUpdateProcessor(), new OnLoadEndUpdateProcessor(controller), updateProcessor2, updateProcessor, new ReplaceSeriesPointUpdateProcessor(), new IndicatorUpdateProcessor(), new EmptyUpdateProcessor());
				createTime = DateTime.Now;
			}

			public bool ShouldForceUpdate()
			{
				double totalSeconds = (DateTime.Now - createTime).TotalSeconds;
				if (totalSeconds > 10.0)
				{
					return processor.ShouldForceUpdate();
				}
				return false;
			}

			public void Process(ChartUpdateInfoBase updateInfo)
			{
				aggregator.AddRange(processor.Process(updateInfo));
			}

			public SeriesControllerChanges Commit(bool loading)
			{
				if (!loading)
				{
					return updatesProcessor.Execute(aggregator);
				}
				return SeriesControllerChanges.NoChanges;
			}
		}
