			internal class ActionsExecutor
			{
				private readonly SeriesController seriesController;

				private readonly RefinedSeriesRepository seriesRepository;

				private readonly ChartUpdateAggregator updateAggregator;

				private readonly ExecutorContext context;

				public static void Execute(SeriesController seriesController, RefinedSeriesRepository seriesRepository, ChartUpdateAggregator updateAggregator, ExecutorContext context)
				{
					ActionsExecutor actionsExecutor = new ActionsExecutor(seriesController, seriesRepository, updateAggregator, context);
					actionsExecutor.Execute();
				}

				private ActionsExecutor(SeriesController seriesController, RefinedSeriesRepository seriesRepository, ChartUpdateAggregator updateAggregator, ExecutorContext context)
				{
					this.seriesController = seriesController;
					this.seriesRepository = seriesRepository;
					this.updateAggregator = updateAggregator;
					this.context = context;
				}

				private void Execute()
				{
					foreach (SeriesCollectionAction update in updateAggregator.GetUpdates<SeriesCollectionAction>())
					{
						UpdateSeriesCollection(update);
					}
					foreach (UpdateSeriesAction update2 in updateAggregator.GetUpdates<UpdateSeriesAction>())
					{
						UpdateRefinedSeries(update2);
					}
					foreach (UpdateAxisAction update3 in updateAggregator.GetUpdates<UpdateAxisAction>())
					{
						UpdateAxis(update3);
					}
					foreach (SeriesPointsCollectionActionBase update4 in updateAggregator.GetUpdates<SeriesPointsCollectionActionBase>())
					{
						UpdateSeriesPointsCollection(update4);
					}
					foreach (UpdateSeriesPointAction update5 in updateAggregator.GetUpdates<UpdateSeriesPointAction>())
					{
						UpdateSeriesPoint(update5);
					}
					foreach (UpdateGroupAction update6 in updateAggregator.GetUpdates<UpdateGroupAction>())
					{
						UpdateGroups(update6);
					}
					foreach (UpdateAxisAction update7 in updateAggregator.GetUpdates<UpdateAxisAction>())
					{
						UpdateRefinedSeriesGroup(update7);
					}
				}

				private void UpdateSeriesCollection(SeriesCollectionAction update)
				{
					if (ActionTypeHelper.ShouldCleanCollection(update.UpdateType))
					{
						RefinedSeriesUpdateInfo info = new RefinedSeriesUpdateInfo(ChartCollectionOperation.Reset, seriesRepository.RefinedSeries);
						seriesRepository.CleanRefinedSeries();
						context.AddUpdatedSeriesInfo(info);
					}
					else if (ActionTypeHelper.ShouldInsertInCollection(update.UpdateType))
					{
						RefinedSeries item = seriesRepository.InsertSeries(update.Index, update.Series);
						context.AddUpdatedSeriesInfo(new RefinedSeriesUpdateInfo(ChartCollectionOperation.InsertItem, new List<RefinedSeries> { item }));
					}
					else if (ActionTypeHelper.ShouldRemoveFromCollection(update.UpdateType))
					{
						RefinedSeries refinedSeries = seriesRepository.FindRefinedSeries(update.Series);
						if (refinedSeries == null)
						{
							return;
						}
						if (refinedSeries.ArgumentGroups != null)
						{
							foreach (RefinedSeriesGroup argumentGroup in refinedSeries.ArgumentGroups)
							{
								argumentGroup?.ScaleMapInvalidate();
							}
						}
						seriesRepository.RemoveSeries(refinedSeries);
						context.AddUpdatedSeriesInfo(new RefinedSeriesUpdateInfo(ChartCollectionOperation.RemoveItem, new List<RefinedSeries> { refinedSeries }));
					}
					else if (ActionTypeHelper.ShouldMoveInCollection(update.UpdateType))
					{
						seriesRepository.MoveRefinedSeries(update.Index, update.OldIndex);
					}
					else if (ActionTypeHelper.ShouldSwapInCollection(update.UpdateType))
					{
						seriesRepository.SwapRefinedSeries(update.Index, update.OldIndex);
					}
				}

				private void UpdateRefinedSeries(UpdateSeriesAction update)
				{
					RefinedSeries refinedSeries = seriesRepository.FindRefinedSeries(update.Series);
					if (refinedSeries != null)
					{
						if (ActionTypeHelper.ShouldUpdateSeriesPointKey(update.UpdateType))
						{
							refinedSeries.ProcessSortingPointKeyUpdate();
						}
						if (ActionTypeHelper.ShouldUpdateSeriesPointMode(update.UpdateType))
						{
							refinedSeries.ProcessSortingPointModeUpdate();
						}
						if (ActionTypeHelper.ShouldUpdateRefinedSeriesData(update.UpdateType))
						{
							refinedSeries.UpdateData();
						}
						if (ActionTypeHelper.ShouldRemoveRefinedSeriesFromGroup(update.UpdateType))
						{
							seriesRepository.RemoveFromSeriesGroups(refinedSeries);
						}
						bool flag = ActionTypeHelper.ShouldUpdatePointsFilter(update.UpdateType) && refinedSeries.UpdateFilters();
						if ((flag || ActionTypeHelper.ShouldUpdateAutoScale(update.UpdateType)) && !ActionTypeHelper.ShouldRecalculateArgumentScale(updateAggregator.UpdateType))
						{
							refinedSeries.UpdateAutoScale();
						}
						if (flag)
						{
							context.AddSeriesGroupsInteractionUpdate();
						}
						if (ActionTypeHelper.ShouldUpdateInteraction(update.UpdateType))
						{
							context.AddUpdatedSeries(refinedSeries);
						}
					}
				}

				private void UpdateScaleMap(IAxisData axis)
				{
					if (axis != null && axis.AxisScaleTypeMap != null && axis.AxisScaleTypeMap.ScaleType == ActualScaleTypeCore.Qualitative)
					{
						seriesRepository.RemoveSeriesGroup(axis);
					}
				}

				private void UpdateAxis(UpdateAxisAction update)
				{
					if (ActionTypeHelper.ShouldUpdateScaleMap(update.UpdateType))
					{
						UpdateScaleMap(update.Axis);
					}
					if (ActionTypeHelper.ShouldRemoveSeriesGroup(update.UpdateType))
					{
						seriesRepository.RemoveSeriesGroup(update.Axis);
					}
				}

				private void AggregateSeriesPointsUpdateInfo(RefinedSeries refinedSeries, RefinedSeriesPointsUpdateInfo updateInfo)
				{
					if (refinedSeries.ActualIsActive && updateInfo != null)
					{
						if (refinedSeries.IsPointsFilterEnabled())
						{
							updateInfo.AddActionType(SeriesActionType.UpdateInteraction);
						}
						context.AddUpdatedPointInfo(updateInfo);
					}
				}

				private void UpdateSeriesPointsCollection(SeriesPointsCollectionActionBase update)
				{
					RefinedSeries refinedSeries = seriesRepository.FindRefinedSeries(update.Series);
					if (refinedSeries != null)
					{
						UpdateSeriesPointsCollection(refinedSeries, update as SeriesPointsCollectionAction);
						ReplaceSeriesPointsInCollection(refinedSeries, update as SeriesPointCollectionReplacePointAction);
					}
				}

				private void UpdateSeriesPointsCollection(RefinedSeries refinedSeries, SeriesPointsCollectionAction update)
				{
					if (update != null)
					{
						RefinedSeriesPointsUpdateInfo updateInfo = refinedSeries.UpdatePoints(update);
						AggregateSeriesPointsUpdateInfo(refinedSeries, updateInfo);
					}
				}

				private void ReplaceSeriesPointsInCollection(RefinedSeries refinedSeries, SeriesPointCollectionReplacePointAction update)
				{
					if (update != null)
					{
						refinedSeries.ReplacePoint(update.SeriesPoint, update.Index);
					}
				}

				private void UpdateSeriesPoint(UpdateSeriesPointAction update)
				{
					RefinedSeries refinedSeries = seriesRepository.FindRefinedSeries(update.Series);
					if (refinedSeries == null)
					{
						return;
					}
					ICollection<RefinedSeriesPointsUpdateInfo> collection = refinedSeries.UpdatePoint(update.SeriesPoint);
					if (collection == null || !refinedSeries.ActualIsActive)
					{
						return;
					}
					foreach (RefinedSeriesPointsUpdateInfo item in collection)
					{
						AggregateSeriesPointsUpdateInfo(refinedSeries, item);
					}
				}

				private void UpdateGroups(UpdateGroupAction update)
				{
					if (ActionTypeHelper.ShouldInsertInCollection(update.UpdateType))
					{
						seriesRepository.GroupController.InsertGroup(update.Axis, seriesRepository.InteractionManager);
					}
					else if (ActionTypeHelper.ShouldRemoveFromCollection(update.UpdateType))
					{
						seriesRepository.GroupController.RemoveGroup(update.Axis);
					}
					else if (ActionTypeHelper.ShouldCleanCollection(update.UpdateType))
					{
						seriesRepository.GroupController.ClearGroup();
					}
				}

				private void UpdateRefinedSeriesGroup(UpdateAxisAction update)
				{
					if (ActionTypeHelper.ShouldUpdatePointsAggregation(update.UpdateType))
					{
						RefinedSeriesGroup refinedSeriesGroup = seriesRepository.GroupController.FindRefinedSeriesGroup(update.Axis);
						if (refinedSeriesGroup != null && refinedSeriesGroup.RefinedSeries != null)
						{
							foreach (RefinedSeries item in refinedSeriesGroup.RefinedSeries)
							{
								context.AddUpdatedSeries(item);
							}
						}
					}
					if (!ActionTypeHelper.ShouldUpdatePointsFilter(update.UpdateType))
					{
						return;
					}
					RefinedSeriesGroup refinedSeriesGroup2 = seriesRepository.GroupController.FindRefinedSeriesGroup(update.Axis);
					if (refinedSeriesGroup2 == null)
					{
						return;
					}
					foreach (RefinedSeries item2 in refinedSeriesGroup2.RefinedSeries)
					{
						if (item2.UpdateFilters())
						{
							context.AddUpdatedSeries(item2);
						}
					}
				}
			}

			private readonly SeriesController seriesController;

			private readonly RefinedSeriesRepository seriesRepository;

			public static IExecutorContext CalculateContext(SeriesController seriesController, ChartUpdateAggregator updateAggregator)
			{
				ContextCalculator contextCalculator = new ContextCalculator(seriesController);
				return contextCalculator.CalculateContext(updateAggregator);
			}

			internal ContextCalculator(SeriesController seriesController)
			{
				this.seriesController = seriesController;
				seriesRepository = seriesController.SeriesRepository;
			}

			private IExecutorContext CalculateContext(ChartUpdateAggregator updateAggregator)
			{
				ExecutorContext executorContext = new ExecutorContext(ActionTypeHelper.ShouldCommit(updateAggregator.UpdateType), ActionTypeHelper.ShouldUpdateCrosshair(updateAggregator.UpdateType), ActionTypeHelper.ShouldUpdatePointsIndices(updateAggregator.UpdateType), ActionTypeHelper.ShouldUpdateVisualPointIndicesOnly(updateAggregator.UpdateType), ActionTypeHelper.ShouldRecalculateArgumentScale(updateAggregator.UpdateType), ActionTypeHelper.ShouldUpdateSeriesGroupsInteraction(updateAggregator.UpdateType), ActionTypeHelper.ShouldResetSelectedItems(updateAggregator.UpdateType), ActionTypeHelper.ShouldUpdateMeasureUnits(updateAggregator.UpdateType), ActionTypeHelper.ShouldDeserializeRange(updateAggregator.UpdateType), GetVisualRangeUpdateMode(updateAggregator), GetShouldUpdatePointValuesOnly(updateAggregator), ActionTypeHelper.ShouldUpdateSeriesGroupsInteractionKeys(updateAggregator.UpdateType), ActionTypeHelper.ShouldUpdateIndicators(updateAggregator.UpdateType), ActionTypeHelper.ShouldAnimateChart(updateAggregator.UpdateType));
				ActionsExecutor.Execute(seriesController, seriesRepository, updateAggregator, executorContext);
				CollectActiveRefinedSeries(executorContext);
				CollectChangedGroups(updateAggregator, executorContext);
				return executorContext;
			}

			private VisualRangeUpdateMode GetVisualRangeUpdateMode(ChartUpdateAggregator updateAggregator)
			{
				foreach (UpdateAxisAction update in updateAggregator.GetUpdates<UpdateAxisAction>())
				{
					if (ActionTypeHelper.ShouldUpdatePointsAggregation(update.UpdateType))
					{
						return VisualRangeUpdateMode.ProportionalFromWholeRange;
					}
				}
				return VisualRangeUpdateMode.Default;
			}

			private bool GetShouldUpdatePointValuesOnly(ChartUpdateAggregator updateAggregator)
			{
				foreach (UpdateSeriesAction update in updateAggregator.GetUpdates<UpdateSeriesAction>())
				{
					if (ActionTypeHelper.ShouldUpdatePointValuesOnly(update.UpdateType))
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				return false;
			}

			private ICollection<RefinedSeriesGroup> GetGroupsForUpdate(IEnumerable<RefinedSeriesGroup> changedGroups, ExecutorContext context)
			{
				HashSet<RefinedSeriesGroup> hashSet = new HashSet<RefinedSeriesGroup>();
				foreach (RefinedSeriesPointsUpdateInfo item in context.UpdatedPointsInfo)
				{
					if (item.RefinedSeries.ArgumentGroups != null)
					{
						foreach (RefinedSeriesGroup argumentGroup in item.RefinedSeries.ArgumentGroups)
						{
							hashSet.Add(argumentGroup);
						}
					}
					hashSet.Add(item.RefinedSeries.ValueGroup);
				}
				foreach (RefinedSeries item2 in context.ActiveChangedSeries)
				{
					if (item2.ArgumentGroups != null)
					{
						foreach (RefinedSeriesGroup argumentGroup2 in item2.ArgumentGroups)
						{
							hashSet.Add(argumentGroup2);
						}
					}
					hashSet.Add(item2.ValueGroup);
				}
				foreach (RefinedSeriesGroup value in seriesRepository.GroupController.RefinedSeriesGroups.Values)
				{
					if (value.ScaleMap == null)
					{
						hashSet.Add(value);
					}
				}
				hashSet.UnionWith(changedGroups);
				return hashSet;
			}

			private IList<RefinedSeriesGroup> GetChangedGroupsBySeriesAndAxis(ChartUpdateAggregator updateAggregator)
			{
				List<RefinedSeriesGroup> list = new List<RefinedSeriesGroup>();
				foreach (UpdateSeriesAction update in updateAggregator.GetUpdates<UpdateSeriesAction>())
				{
					RefinedSeries refinedSeries = seriesRepository.FindRefinedSeries(update.Series);
					if (refinedSeries == null || ActionTypeHelper.ShouldRemoveRefinedSeriesFromGroup(update.UpdateType) || ActionTypeHelper.ShouldUpdateRefinedSeriesData(update.UpdateType) || ActionTypeHelper.ShouldUpdateSeriesPointKey(update.UpdateType) || ActionTypeHelper.ShouldUpdateSeriesPointMode(update.UpdateType))
					{
						continue;
					}
					if (refinedSeries.ArgumentGroups != null)
					{
						foreach (RefinedSeriesGroup argumentGroup in refinedSeries.ArgumentGroups)
						{
							list.Add(argumentGroup);
						}
					}
					list.Add(refinedSeries.ValueGroup);
				}
				foreach (UpdateAxisAction update2 in updateAggregator.GetUpdates<UpdateAxisAction>())
				{
					if (ActionTypeHelper.ShouldUpdateSeriesGroup(update2.UpdateType))
					{
						RefinedSeriesGroup item = seriesRepository.GroupController.FindRefinedSeriesGroup(update2.Axis);
						list.Add(item);
					}
				}
				return list;
			}

			private List<IAxisData> GetAllAxes(IAxisProvider provider)
			{
				List<IAxisData> list = new List<IAxisData>();
				if (provider != null)
				{
					if (provider.AxesX != null)
					{
						list.AddRange(provider.AxesX);
					}
					if (provider.AxesY != null)
					{
						list.AddRange(provider.AxesY);
					}
					if (provider.AxesZ != null)
					{
						list.AddRange(provider.AxesZ);
					}
				}
				return list;
			}

			private void CreateScaleMap(IAxisData axis, Scale scaleType)
			{
				//IL_0079: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				if (scaleType != Scale.Auto && axis.AxisScaleTypeMap != null && axis.AxisScaleTypeMap.ScaleType != (ActualScaleTypeCore)scaleType)
				{
					AxisScaleTypeMap axisScaleTypeMap;
					switch (scaleType)
					{
					case Scale.Numerical:
						axisScaleTypeMap = ((axis.NumericScaleOptions.ScaleMode == ScaleModeNative.Continuous || double.IsNaN(axis.NumericScaleOptions.MeasureUnit)) ? new AxisNumericalMap() : new AxisNumericalMap(axis.NumericScaleOptions.MeasureUnit));
						break;
					case Scale.DateTime:
					{
						IDateTimeScaleOptions dateTimeScaleOptions = axis.DateTimeScaleOptions;
						axisScaleTypeMap = new AxisDateTimeMap(dateTimeScaleOptions.MeasureUnit, dateTimeScaleOptions.MeasureUnitMultiplier, dateTimeScaleOptions.WorkdaysOptions, dateTimeScaleOptions.WorkTimeRules);
						break;
					}
					case Scale.Qualitative:
						axisScaleTypeMap = RefinedSeriesGroupByArgument.ProcessAxis(new AxisQualitativeMap(new List<string>()), axis);
						break;
					case Scale.TimeSpan:
						axisScaleTypeMap = ((axis.TimeSpanScaleOptions.ScaleMode == ScaleModeNative.Continuous) ? new AxisTimeSpanMap() : new AxisTimeSpanMap(axis.TimeSpanScaleOptions.MeasureUnit, axis.TimeSpanScaleOptions.MeasureUnitMultiplier));
						break;
					default:
						axisScaleTypeMap = new AxisNumericalMap();
						break;
					}
					axis.AxisScaleTypeMap = axisScaleTypeMap;
				}
			}

			private void CheckAxesWithoutGroups(List<IAxisData> axes)
			{
				if (axes == null || axes.Count == 0)
				{
					return;
				}
				IAxisData axisData = null;
				IAxisData axisData2 = null;
				Scale scale = Scale.Auto;
				Scale scaleType = Scale.Auto;
				if (seriesController.DataContainer != null && seriesController.DataContainer.ShouldUseSeriesTemplate && seriesController.DataContainer.SeriesTemplate.SeriesView is IXYSeriesView iXYSeriesView)
				{
					axisData = iXYSeriesView.AxisXData;
					axisData2 = iXYSeriesView.AxisYData;
					scale = seriesController.DataContainer.SeriesTemplate.ActualUserArgumentScaleType;
					scaleType = seriesController.DataContainer.SeriesTemplate.ValueScaleType;
				}
				foreach (IAxisData axis in axes)
				{
					RefinedSeriesGroup refinedSeriesGroup = seriesRepository.GroupController.FindRefinedSeriesGroup(axis);
					if (refinedSeriesGroup == null)
					{
						if (axisData == axis)
						{
							CreateScaleMap(axis, (scale == Scale.Auto) ? Scale.Numerical : scale);
						}
						else if (axisData2 == axis)
						{
							CreateScaleMap(axis, scaleType);
						}
						else if (axis.AxisScaleTypeMap == null || axis.AxisScaleTypeMap.ScaleType != ActualScaleTypeCore.Numerical)
						{
							axis.AxisScaleTypeMap = new AxisNumericalMap();
						}
					}
				}
			}

			private void CollectChangedGroups(ChartUpdateAggregator updateAggregator, ExecutorContext context)
			{
				IEnumerable<RefinedSeriesGroup> groupsForUpdate = GetGroupsForUpdate(GetChangedGroupsBySeriesAndAxis(updateAggregator), context);
				List<IAxisData> allAxes = GetAllAxes(seriesController.Diagram as IAxisProvider);
				foreach (RefinedSeriesGroup item in groupsForUpdate)
				{
					if (item != null)
					{
						if (item.UpdateScaleMap(forceCreate: false, context.ShouldRecalculateArgumentScale))
						{
							context.AddUpdatedGroup(item);
						}
						if (item.GroupKey.AxisData != null)
						{
							allAxes.Remove(item.GroupKey.AxisData);
						}
					}
				}
				CheckAxesWithoutGroups(allAxes);
				foreach (UpdateAxisAction update in updateAggregator.GetUpdates<UpdateAxisAction>())
				{
					if (update.Axis != null && ActionTypeHelper.ShouldUpdatePointsAggregation(update.UpdateType))
					{
						update.Axis.UpdateAutoMeasureUnit();
						update.Axis.UpdateIntervals();
						seriesRepository.GroupController.FindRefinedSeriesGroup(update.Axis)?.UpdateScaleMap(forceCreate: true, shouldRecalculateArgumentScale: false);
					}
				}
			}

			private ISeries GetBaseSeries()
			{
				foreach (RefinedSeries item in seriesController.SeriesRepository.RefinedSeries)
				{
					if (item.Series != null && item.Series.SeriesView != null && item.Series.Visible && (!seriesController.CompatibleViewFormDiagram.HasValue || (seriesController.CompatibleViewFormDiagram == item.Series.SeriesView.CompatibleViewType && seriesController.DiagramProvider.IsDiagram3D == item.Series.SeriesView.Is3DView)))
					{
						return item.Series;
					}
				}
				return null;
			}

			private RefinedSeriesIncompatibilityCalculator CreateIncompatibilityCalculator(SeriesIncompatibilityStatistics incompatibilityStatistics)
			{
				incompatibilityStatistics.Clear();
				RefinedSeriesIncompatibilityCalculator refinedSeriesIncompatibilityCalculator = new RefinedSeriesIncompatibilityCalculator(incompatibilityStatistics);
				ISeriesView baseView = null;
				ISeries series = null;
				if (seriesController.DataContainer.ShouldUseSeriesTemplate)
				{
					baseView = seriesController.DataContainer.SeriesTemplate.SeriesView;
					if (seriesController.DataContainer.SeriesTemplate.SeriesView is IXYSeriesView view)
					{
						refinedSeriesIncompatibilityCalculator.AddTemplateView(view, seriesController.DataContainer.SeriesTemplate.ArgumentScaleType, seriesController.DataContainer.SeriesTemplate.ValueScaleType);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					series = GetBaseSeries();
					if (series != null)
					{
						baseView = series.SeriesView;
					}
				}
				refinedSeriesIncompatibilityCalculator.Initialize(series, baseView);
				return refinedSeriesIncompatibilityCalculator;
			}

			private List<RefinedSeriesGroup> GetArgumentSeriesGroup(RefinedSeries series)
			{
				List<RefinedSeriesGroup> list = new List<RefinedSeriesGroup>();
				list.Add(seriesController.SeriesRepository.GroupController.GetArgumentGroup(series, AxisGroup.ArgumentX));
				if (seriesController.Diagram != null && seriesController.Diagram.IsThreePlanesDiagram)
				{
					list.Add(seriesController.SeriesRepository.GroupController.GetArgumentGroup(series, AxisGroup.ArgumentY));
				}
				return list;
			}

			private bool TryUpdateGroupForSeries(RefinedSeries series, bool isVisibleAndCompatible, bool shouldBeDrawn)
			{
				bool flag = isVisibleAndCompatible && shouldBeDrawn;
				bool flag2 = (series.IsActive.HasValue ? series.IsActive.Value : (!flag));
				if (flag ^ flag2)
				{
					bool flag3 = !flag;
					if (flag2 && !isVisibleAndCompatible)
					{
						seriesController.SeriesRepository.RemoveFromSeriesGroups(series);
						series.Deactivate();
					}
					else if (!flag2 || flag3)
					{
						List<RefinedSeriesGroup> argumentSeriesGroup = GetArgumentSeriesGroup(series);
						RefinedSeriesGroup valueGroup = seriesController.SeriesRepository.GroupController.GetValueGroup(series, seriesController.InteractionManager, AxisGroup.Value);
						foreach (RefinedSeriesGroup item in argumentSeriesGroup)
						{
							item?.AddSeries(series, shouldBeDrawn);
						}
						valueGroup?.AddSeries(series, shouldBeDrawn);
						series.BindToGroups(argumentSeriesGroup, valueGroup);
						if (flag3)
						{
							series.Deactivate();
						}
					}
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}

			private void AddIndicatorsInRefinedSeriesGroup(IXYSeriesView xyView)
			{
				List<IAffectsAxisRange> indicatorsAffectRange = xyView.GetIndicatorsAffectRange();
				if (indicatorsAffectRange == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				foreach (IAffectsAxisRange item in indicatorsAffectRange)
				{
					RefinedSeriesGroupByValue refinedSeriesGroupByValue = (RefinedSeriesGroupByValue)seriesController.SeriesRepository.GroupController.FindRefinedSeriesGroup(item.AxisYData);
					if (refinedSeriesGroupByValue == null)
					{
						refinedSeriesGroupByValue = (RefinedSeriesGroupByValue)seriesController.SeriesRepository.GroupController.InsertGroup(item.AxisYData, seriesController.InteractionManager);
					}
					refinedSeriesGroupByValue.AddIndicator(item);
				}
			}

			internal void CollectActiveRefinedSeries(ExecutorContext context)
			{
				seriesController.SeriesRepository.ClearRefinedSeries();
				RefinedSeriesIncompatibilityCalculator refinedSeriesIncompatibilityCalculator = CreateIncompatibilityCalculator(seriesController.SeriesIncompatibilityStatistics);
				seriesController.SeriesRepository.GroupController.ClearSeparatePaneIndicators();
				if (!refinedSeriesIncompatibilityCalculator.CanCalculate)
				{
					return;
				}
				foreach (RefinedSeries item in seriesController.SeriesRepository.RefinedSeries)
				{
					bool flag = refinedSeriesIncompatibilityCalculator.IsVisibleAndCompatible(item);
					bool shouldBeDrawnOnDiagram = item.Series.ShouldBeDrawnOnDiagram;
					seriesController.SeriesRepository.AddToActive(item, flag, shouldBeDrawnOnDiagram);
					if (TryUpdateGroupForSeries(item, flag, shouldBeDrawnOnDiagram))
					{
						item.InvalidateData();
						context.AddActiveChangedSeries(item);
					}
					IXYSeriesView iXYSeriesView = item.SeriesView as IXYSeriesView;
					if (iXYSeriesView != null && flag && shouldBeDrawnOnDiagram)
					{
						AddIndicatorsInRefinedSeriesGroup(iXYSeriesView);
					}
				}
				foreach (RefinedSeries item2 in seriesController.SeriesRepository.RefinedSeries)
				{
					if (item2.NoArgumentScaleTypeX)
					{
						item2.SetArgumentScale(refinedSeriesIncompatibilityCalculator.GetAxisXMasterScaleType(item2), AxisGroup.ArgumentX);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private class UpdatesExecutor
		{
			private readonly SeriesController seriesController;

			private readonly IEnumerable<IUpdateActionExecutor> updateActionExecutors;

			public UpdatesExecutor(SeriesController seriesController)
			{
				this.seriesController = seriesController;
				updateActionExecutors = new List<IUpdateActionExecutor>
				{
					new UpdateRefinedSeriesDataExecutor(),
					new InteractionExecutor(seriesController),
					new SlaveSeriesExecutor(seriesController),
					new UpdateRangeExecutor(seriesController),
					new AggregatorUpdatesExecutor(seriesController)
				};
			}

			public SeriesControllerChanges Execute(ChartUpdateAggregator updateAggregator)
			{
				if (ActionTypeHelper.EndLoading(updateAggregator.UpdateType))
				{
					updateAggregator.Clear();
					if (seriesController.DataContainer != null)
					{
						seriesController.SeriesRepository.CleanRefinedSeries();
						seriesController.SeriesRepository.InsertSeries(0, seriesController.DataContainer.Series);
					}
				}
				SeriesControllerChanges seriesControllerChanges = updateAggregator.GetSeriesControllerChanges();
				IExecutorContext context = ContextCalculator.CalculateContext(seriesController, updateAggregator);
				foreach (IUpdateActionExecutor updateActionExecutor in updateActionExecutors)
				{
					seriesControllerChanges |= updateActionExecutor.Execute(context);
				}
				return seriesControllerChanges;
			}
		}

		private readonly SeriesIncompatibilityStatistics incompatibilityStatistics = new SeriesIncompatibilityStatistics();

		private readonly IChartDataContainer dataContainer;

		private readonly RefinedSeriesRepository seriesRepository;

		private readonly IDiagramProvider diagramProvider;

		private SeriesControllerTransaction transaction;

		internal IDiagramProvider DiagramProvider => diagramProvider;

		internal IDiagram Diagram
		{
			get
			{
				if (diagramProvider == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return diagramProvider.Diagram;
			}
		}

		internal CompatibleViewType? CompatibleViewFormDiagram
		{
			get
			{
				if (diagramProvider == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return diagramProvider.CompatibleViewFormDiagram;
			}
		}

		internal IChartDataContainer DataContainer => dataContainer;

		internal Dictionary<RefinedSeriesGroupKey, RefinedSeriesGroup> RefinedSeriesGroups => seriesRepository.GroupController.RefinedSeriesGroups;

		internal RefinedSeriesRepository SeriesRepository => seriesRepository;

		public IList<RefinedSeries> RefinedSeries => seriesRepository.RefinedSeries;

		public IList<RefinedSeries> ActiveRefinedSeries => seriesRepository.ActiveRefinedSeries;

		public IList<RefinedSeries> SeriesForLegend => seriesRepository.SeriesForLegend;

		public InteractionManager InteractionManager => seriesRepository.InteractionManager;

		public IEnumerable<RefinedSeriesGroup> RefinedSeriesGroupList => RefinedSeriesGroups.Values;

		public SeriesIncompatibilityStatistics SeriesIncompatibilityStatistics => incompatibilityStatistics;

		public bool IsContainsProcessedSeries => seriesRepository.IsContainsProcessedSeries;

		public bool IsContainsProcessedPoints => seriesRepository.IsContainsProcessedPoints;

		public bool IsContainsProcessedNotEmptyPoints => seriesRepository.IsContainsProcessedNotEmptyPoints;

		public bool IsTransactionOpen => transaction != null;

		public SeriesController(IChartDataContainer dataContainer, IDiagramProvider diagramProvider, IRefinedSeriesFactory factory)
		{
			seriesRepository = new RefinedSeriesRepository(dataContainer, factory);
			this.dataContainer = dataContainer;
			this.diagramProvider = diagramProvider;
		}

		public bool ShouldForceUpdate()
		{
			if (IsTransactionOpen)
			{
				return transaction.ShouldForceUpdate();
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void OpenTransaction()
		{
			if (transaction == null)
			{
				transaction = new SeriesControllerTransaction(this);
			}
		}

		public void ProcessUpdate(ChartUpdateInfoBase updateInfo, bool loading = false)
		{
			if (transaction == null)
			{
				transaction = new SeriesControllerTransaction(this);
				transaction.Process(updateInfo);
				transaction.Commit(loading);
				transaction = null;
			}
			else
			{
				transaction.Process(updateInfo);
			}
		}

		public SeriesControllerChanges CommitTransaction(bool loading)
		{
			if (transaction != null)
			{
				SeriesControllerChanges result = transaction.Commit(loading);
				transaction = null;
				return result;
			}
			return SeriesControllerChanges.NoChanges;
		}

		public IList<ISeries> GetSeriesByAxis(IAxisData axis)
		{
			IList<ISeries> list = new List<ISeries>();
			RefinedSeriesGroupKey refinedSeriesGroupKey = null;
			foreach (RefinedSeriesGroupKey key in RefinedSeriesGroups.Keys)
			{
				if (key.AxisData == axis)
				{
					refinedSeriesGroupKey = key;
					break;
				}
			}
			if (refinedSeriesGroupKey != null)
			{
				RefinedSeriesGroup refinedSeriesGroup = RefinedSeriesGroups[refinedSeriesGroupKey];
				foreach (RefinedSeries item in refinedSeriesGroup.RefinedSeries)
				{
					list.Add(((IRefinedSeries)item).Series);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		public IList<RefinedSeries> GetRefinedSeriesByAxis(IAxisData axis)
		{
			foreach (KeyValuePair<RefinedSeriesGroupKey, RefinedSeriesGroup> refinedSeriesGroup in RefinedSeriesGroups)
			{
				if (refinedSeriesGroup.Key.AxisData == axis)
				{
					return new List<RefinedSeries>(refinedSeriesGroup.Value.RefinedSeries);
				}
			}
			return new List<RefinedSeries>();
		}

		public IMinMaxValues GetAxisRange(IAxisData axis)
		{
			RefinedSeriesGroup refinedSeriesGroup = seriesRepository.GroupController.FindRefinedSeriesGroup(axis);
			if (refinedSeriesGroup == null)
			{
				return axis.WholeRange;
			}
			return refinedSeriesGroup.GetMinMaxValuesFromSeries();
		}
	}
	public class FullStackedInteractionContainer : StackedInteractionContainer
	{
		public FullStackedInteractionContainer(ISeriesView view)
			: base(view)
		{
		}

		public FullStackedInteractionContainer(ISeriesView view, bool isContinuousView)
			: base(view, isContinuousView)
		{
		}

		protected override StackedPointInteraction CreatePointInteraction(int seriesIndex, RefinedPoint point)
		{
			return new FullStackedPointInteraction(base.Series, seriesIndex, point);
		}
	}
	public struct InteractionKey : IEquatable<InteractionKey>
	{
		private readonly Type seriesViewType;

		private readonly IPane pane;

		private readonly IAxisData axisX;

		private readonly IAxisData axisY;

		private readonly object userKey;

		public object UserKey => userKey;

		public static bool operator ==(InteractionKey a, InteractionKey b)
		{
			return a.Equals(b);
		}

		public static bool operator !=(InteractionKey a, InteractionKey b)
		{
			return !a.Equals(b);
		}

		public InteractionKey(ISeriesView view, bool isSideBySideInteraction)
		{
			seriesViewType = view.GetType();
			axisX = null;
			axisY = null;
			pane = null;
			userKey = null;
			if (view is IXYSeriesView iXYSeriesView)
			{
				pane = iXYSeriesView.Pane;
				axisX = iXYSeriesView.AxisXData;
				if (!isSideBySideInteraction)
				{
					userKey = (view as ISideBySideStackedBarSeriesView)?.StackedGroup;
					axisY = iXYSeriesView.AxisYData;
				}
			}
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is InteractionKey)
			{
				return Equals((InteractionKey)obj);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool Equals(InteractionKey key)
		{
			if (object.Equals(seriesViewType, key.seriesViewType) && pane == key.pane && axisX == key.axisX && axisY == key.axisY)
			{
				return object.Equals(userKey, key.userKey);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			if (pane == null)
			{
				return seriesViewType.GetHashCode();
			}
			return HashCodeHelper.CalculateGeneric<IPane, Type, IAxisData, object>(pane, seriesViewType, axisY, userKey);
		}
	}
	public class RangeSeriesContainer : SingleSeriesContainer, ISupportMinMaxValues
	{
		private readonly RangePointInteraction interaction;

		public double Max => interaction.GetMaxValue(base.SeriesView);

		public double Min => interaction.GetMinValue(base.SeriesView);

		public override IList<IPointInteraction> PointInteractions => new List<IPointInteraction> { interaction };

		public RangeSeriesContainer(ISeriesView view)
			: base(view)
		{
			interaction = new RangePointInteraction();
		}

		protected override void InsertRefinedPoints(int seriesIndex, RefinedSeries refinedSeries)
		{
			foreach (RefinedPoint finalPoint in refinedSeries.FinalPoints)
			{
				InsertRefinedPoint(refinedSeries, finalPoint);
			}
		}

		protected override void RemoveRefinedPoints(int seriesIndex, RefinedSeries refinedSeries, bool removeAll = false)
		{
			interaction.Clear();
		}

		protected override void InsertRefinedPoint(RefinedSeries refinedSeries, RefinedPoint point)
		{
			if (!point.IsEmpty)
			{
				interaction.AddPoint(point);
			}
		}

		protected override void RemoveRefinedPoint(RefinedSeries refinedSeries, RefinedPoint point)
		{
			if (!point.IsEmpty)
			{
				interaction.RemovePoint(point);
			}
		}

		public double GetAbsMinValue()
		{
			return 0.0;
		}
	}
	public abstract class SeriesContainer
	{
		private readonly ISeriesView view;

		private readonly List<RefinedSeries> series = new List<RefinedSeries>();

		public ISeriesView SeriesView => view;

		public List<RefinedSeries> Series => series;

		public bool IsEmpty => series.Count == 0;

		public abstract IList<IPointInteraction> PointInteractions { get; }

		protected SeriesContainer(ISeriesView view)
		{
			if (view == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException();
			}
			this.view = view;
		}

		protected virtual void SuspendUpdate()
		{
		}

		protected virtual void ResumeUpdate()
		{
		}

		protected abstract void InsertRefinedPoints(int seriesIndex, RefinedSeries refinedSeries);

		protected abstract void RemoveRefinedPoints(int seriesIndex, RefinedSeries refinedSeries, bool removeAll = false);

		protected abstract void InsertRefinedPoint(RefinedSeries refinedSeries, RefinedPoint point);

		protected abstract void RemoveRefinedPoint(RefinedSeries refinedSeries, RefinedPoint point);

		protected abstract void ResetRefinedSeries(RefinedSeries refinedSeries);

		internal void UpdatePoints(RefinedSeriesPointsUpdateInfo update)
		{
			switch (update.Operation)
			{
			case ChartCollectionOperation.Reset:
				ResetRefinedSeries(update.RefinedSeries);
				break;
			case ChartCollectionOperation.InsertItem:
				SuspendUpdate();
				try
				{
					for (int j = 0; j < update.AffectedPoints.Length; j++)
					{
						InsertRefinedPoint(update.RefinedSeries, update.AffectedPoints[j]);
					}
					break;
				}
				finally
				{
					ResumeUpdate();
				}
			case ChartCollectionOperation.RemoveItem:
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < update.AffectedPoints.Length; i++)
				{
					RemoveRefinedPoint(update.RefinedSeries, update.AffectedPoints[i]);
				}
				break;
			}
			}
		}

		internal virtual void ApplySeriesViewData()
		{
		}

		public bool Contains(RefinedSeries refinedSeries)
		{
			return Series.Contains(refinedSeries);
		}

		public abstract void Recalculate();
	}
	public abstract class SeriesGroupsInteractionContainer : SeriesInteractionContainer, IPointInteraction
	{
		private readonly SeriesGroupsManager groupsManager;

		public override double Max => double.NaN;

		public override double Min => double.NaN;

		int IPointInteraction.Count => 0;

		double IPointInteraction.ArgumentX => double.NaN;

		double IPointInteraction.ArgumentY => double.NaN;

		protected SeriesGroupsInteractionContainer(ISeriesView view)
			: base(view)
		{
			groupsManager = new SeriesGroupsManager(base.Series);
		}

		double IPointInteraction.GetMinValue(ISeriesView seriesView)
		{
			return double.NaN;
		}

		double IPointInteraction.GetMaxValue(ISeriesView seriesView)
		{
			return double.NaN;
		}

		double IPointInteraction.GetMinAbsValue(ISeriesView seriesView)
		{
			return double.NaN;
		}

		protected int GetSeriesGroupIndex(RefinedSeries series)
		{
			return groupsManager.GetGroupIndexBySeries(series);
		}

		protected abstract void RecalculateCore(int groupsCount);

		protected override void RemoveRefinedPoints(int seriesIndex, RefinedSeries refinedSeries, bool removeAll = false)
		{
			IList<RefinedPoint> finalPoints = refinedSeries.FinalPoints;
			foreach (RefinedPoint item in finalPoints)
			{
				item.ResetSeriesGroupsInteraction();
			}
		}

		protected override void RemoveRefinedPoint(RefinedSeries refinedSeries, RefinedPoint point)
		{
			point.ResetSeriesGroupsInteraction();
		}

		public override void AddSeries(RefinedSeries refinedSeries)
		{
			int num = GetSeriesIndex(refinedSeries);
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				RemoveSeries(refinedSeries);
			}
			else
			{
				num = ~num;
			}
			base.Series.Insert(num, refinedSeries);
			Recalculate();
		}

		public override void RemoveSeries(RefinedSeries refinedSeries)
		{
			int seriesIndex = GetSeriesIndex(refinedSeries);
			if (seriesIndex >= 0)
			{
				base.Series.RemoveAt(seriesIndex);
				Recalculate();
			}
		}

		public override void Recalculate()
		{
			groupsManager.UpdateGroups();
			RecalculateCore(groupsManager.GroupsCount);
		}

		public override double GetAbsMinValue()
		{
			return 0.0;
		}
	}
	public class SeriesGroupsManager
	{
		private readonly Dictionary<RefinedSeries, int> groups = new Dictionary<RefinedSeries, int>();

		private readonly List<RefinedSeries> series;

		private int groupsCount;

		public int GroupsCount => groupsCount;

		public SeriesGroupsManager(List<RefinedSeries> series)
		{
			this.series = series;
		}

		private int GetGroupIndex(object groupKey)
		{
			foreach (RefinedSeries key in groups.Keys)
			{
				if (key.SeriesView is ISupportSeriesGroups supportSeriesGroups && object.Equals(supportSeriesGroups.SeriesGroup, groupKey))
				{
					return groups[key];
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}

		public void UpdateGroups()
		{
			groups.Clear();
			groupsCount = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < series.Count; i++)
			{
				if (series[i].SeriesView is ISupportSeriesGroups supportSeriesGroups)
				{
					int groupIndex = GetGroupIndex(supportSeriesGroups.SeriesGroup);
					if (groupIndex >= 0)
					{
						groups.Add(series[i], groupIndex);
						continue;
					}
				}
				groups.Add(series[i], groupsCount);
				groupsCount++;
			}
		}

		public int GetGroupIndexBySeries(RefinedSeries series)
		{
			return groups[series];
		}
	}
	public abstract class SeriesInteractionContainer : SeriesContainer, ISupportMinMaxValues
	{
		private readonly SeriesComparerByActiveIndex seriesComparer = new SeriesComparerByActiveIndex();

		protected bool LockRecalculate { get; set; }

		public abstract double Max { get; }

		public abstract double Min { get; }

		protected SeriesInteractionContainer(ISeriesView view)
			: base(view)
		{
		}

		protected override void ResetRefinedSeries(RefinedSeries refinedSeries)
		{
			RemoveSeries(refinedSeries);
			AddSeries(refinedSeries);
		}

		public abstract double GetAbsMinValue();

		public virtual void AddSeries(RefinedSeries refinedSeries)
		{
			int num = GetSeriesIndex(refinedSeries);
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				RemoveSeries(refinedSeries);
			}
			else
			{
				num = ~num;
			}
			refinedSeries.InteractionContainer = this;
			base.Series.Insert(num, refinedSeries);
			InsertRefinedPoints(num, refinedSeries);
		}

		public virtual void RemoveSeries(RefinedSeries refinedSeries)
		{
			int seriesIndex = GetSeriesIndex(refinedSeries);
			if (seriesIndex >= 0)
			{
				refinedSeries.InteractionContainer = null;
				base.Series.RemoveAt(seriesIndex);
				RemoveRefinedPoints(seriesIndex, refinedSeries, base.Series.Count == 0);
			}
		}

		public int GetSeriesIndex(RefinedSeries refinedSeries)
		{
			if (refinedSeries.ActiveIndex < 0)
			{
				return base.Series.FindIndex((RefinedSeries x) => refinedSeries == x);
			}
			return base.Series.BinarySearch(refinedSeries, seriesComparer);
		}

		public void SwapSeries(RefinedSeries series1, RefinedSeries series2)
		{
			int seriesIndex = GetSeriesIndex(series1);
			int seriesIndex2 = GetSeriesIndex(series2);
			if (seriesIndex >= 0 && seriesIndex2 >= 0)
			{
				base.Series[seriesIndex] = series2;
				base.Series[seriesIndex2] = series1;
				Recalculate();
			}
		}

		public virtual void EnsureInteractions()
		{
		}
	}
	public class SideBySideInteractionContainer : SeriesInteractionContainer
	{
		private readonly PointInteractionCollection sortedInteractionsByArgument;

		private bool EqualBarWidth => SideBySideBarSeriesView.EqualBarWidth;

		private ISideBySideBarSeriesView SideBySideBarSeriesView => (ISideBySideBarSeriesView)base.SeriesView;

		public override double Max => double.NaN;

		public override double Min => double.NaN;

		public override IList<IPointInteraction> PointInteractions => sortedInteractionsByArgument;

		public SideBySideInteractionContainer(ISeriesView view)
			: base(view)
		{
			if (!(view is ISideBySideBarSeriesView))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Unexpected series view.");
			}
			sortedInteractionsByArgument = new PointInteractionCollection(new InteractionComparerByArgument());
		}

		private void InsertRefinedPoint(RefinedSeries refinedSeries, RefinedPoint refinedPoint, bool changeInteractionLayout)
		{
			SideBySideInteractionBase sideBySideInteractionBase;
			if (base.Series.Count > 1 || changeInteractionLayout)
			{
				int num = sortedInteractionsByArgument.BinarySearch(refinedPoint);
				if (num < 0)
				{
					num = ~num;
					sideBySideInteractionBase = new SideBySidePointInteraction(refinedPoint.Argument, EqualBarWidth);
					int num2 = (changeInteractionLayout ? (GetSeriesIndex(refinedSeries) + 1) : base.Series.Count);
					for (int i = 0; i < num2; i++)
					{
						sideBySideInteractionBase.AddSeries(base.Series[i]);
					}
					sortedInteractionsByArgument.Insert(num, sideBySideInteractionBase);
				}
				else
				{
					sideBySideInteractionBase = (SideBySidePointInteraction)sortedInteractionsByArgument[num];
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (sortedInteractionsByArgument.Count == 0)
				{
					SideBySideSeriesInteraction sideBySideSeriesInteraction = new SideBySideSeriesInteraction();
					sideBySideSeriesInteraction.AddSeries(refinedSeries);
					sortedInteractionsByArgument.Add(sideBySideSeriesInteraction);
				}
				sideBySideInteractionBase = (SideBySideInteractionBase)sortedInteractionsByArgument[0];
			}
			sideBySideInteractionBase.InsertPoint(refinedSeries, refinedPoint);
			sideBySideInteractionBase.Invalidate();
		}

		private void InsertRefinedPoints(RefinedSeries refinedSeries, bool changeInteractionLayout)
		{
			foreach (SideBySideInteractionBase item in (IEnumerable<IPointInteraction>)sortedInteractionsByArgument)
			{
				item.AddSeries(refinedSeries);
			}
			IList<RefinedPoint> finalPoints = refinedSeries.FinalPoints;
			for (int i = 0; i < finalPoints.Count; i++)
			{
				InsertRefinedPoint(refinedSeries, finalPoints[i], changeInteractionLayout);
			}
		}

		protected override void InsertRefinedPoints(int seriesIndex, RefinedSeries refinedSeries)
		{
			base.LockRecalculate = true;
			if (seriesIndex > 0 && sortedInteractionsByArgument.Count > 0 && sortedInteractionsByArgument[0] is SideBySideSeriesInteraction)
			{
				sortedInteractionsByArgument.Clear();
				foreach (RefinedSeries item in base.Series)
				{
					InsertRefinedPoints(item, changeInteractionLayout: true);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				InsertRefinedPoints(refinedSeries, changeInteractionLayout: false);
			}
			base.LockRecalculate = false;
		}

		protected override void RemoveRefinedPoints(int seriesIndex, RefinedSeries refinedSeries, bool removeAll = false)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < sortedInteractionsByArgument.Count; i++)
			{
				SideBySideInteractionBase sideBySideInteractionBase = (SideBySideInteractionBase)sortedInteractionsByArgument[i];
				sideBySideInteractionBase.RemoveSeries(refinedSeries);
				if (sideBySideInteractionBase.IsEmpty)
				{
					sortedInteractionsByArgument.RemoveAt(i);
					i--;
				}
				else
				{
					sideBySideInteractionBase.Invalidate();
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void InsertRefinedPoint(RefinedSeries refinedSeries, RefinedPoint refinedPoint)
		{
			InsertRefinedPoint(refinedSeries, refinedPoint, changeInteractionLayout: false);
		}

		protected override void RemoveRefinedPoint(RefinedSeries refinedSeries, RefinedPoint point)
		{
			if (sortedInteractionsByArgument.Count > 0 && sortedInteractionsByArgument[0] is SideBySideSeriesInteraction)
			{
				((SideBySideInteractionBase)sortedInteractionsByArgument[0]).RemovePoint(refinedSeries, point);
				return;
			}
			int num = sortedInteractionsByArgument.BinarySearch(point);
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				SideBySideInteractionBase sideBySideInteractionBase = (SideBySideInteractionBase)sortedInteractionsByArgument[num];
				sideBySideInteractionBase.RemovePoint(refinedSeries, point);
				if (sideBySideInteractionBase.IsEmpty)
				{
					sortedInteractionsByArgument.RemoveAt(num);
				}
				else
				{
					sideBySideInteractionBase.Invalidate();
				}
			}
		}

		public override void Recalculate()
		{
			if (!base.LockRecalculate)
			{
				IList<RefinedSeries> range = base.Series.GetRange(0, base.Series.Count);
				base.Series.Clear();
				sortedInteractionsByArgument.Clear();
				for (int i = 0; i < range.Count; i++)
				{
					AddSeries(range[i]);
				}
			}
		}

		public override double GetAbsMinValue()
		{
			return double.NaN;
		}
	}
	public class SimpleSeriesContainer : SingleSeriesContainer
	{

		internal SimplePointInteraction Interaction => interaction;

		public override IList<IPointInteraction> PointInteractions => new List<IPointInteraction> { interaction };

		public SimpleSeriesContainer(ISeriesView view)

		}

		protected override void InsertRefinedPoints(int seriesIndex, RefinedSeries refinedSeries)

				InsertRefinedPoint(refinedSeries, finalPoint);
			}
		}

		protected override void RemoveRefinedPoints(int seriesIndex, RefinedSeries refinedSeries, bool removeAll = false)

			interaction.Clear();
		}

		protected override void InsertRefinedPoint(RefinedSeries refinedSeries, RefinedPoint point)

			interaction.AddPoint(point);

		}
	}
	public abstract class SingleSeriesContainer : SeriesContainer
	{
		protected SingleSeriesContainer(ISeriesView view)
			: base(view)
		{
		}

		protected override void ResetRefinedSeries(RefinedSeries refinedSeries)
		{
			if (base.Series.Count > 0 && base.Series[0] == refinedSeries)
			{
				RemoveRefinedPoints(0, refinedSeries);
			}
		}

		public void SetRefinedSeries(RefinedSeries refinedSeries)
		{
			if (base.Series.Count > 0)
			{
				RemoveRefinedPoints(0, base.Series[0]);
			}
			base.Series.Clear();
			base.Series.Add(refinedSeries);
			InsertRefinedPoints(0, refinedSeries);
		}

		public override void Recalculate()
		{
			if (base.Series.Count > 0)
			{
				RemoveRefinedPoints(0, base.Series[0]);
				InsertRefinedPoints(0, base.Series[0]);
			}
		}
	}
	public class StackedInteractionContainer : SeriesInteractionContainer
	{
		private readonly PointInteractionCollection sortedInteractionsByArgument;

		private readonly PointInteractionCollection sortedInteractionsByMinValue;

		private readonly PointInteractionCollection sortedInteractionsByMaxValue;

		private readonly PointInteractionCollection sortedInteractionsByMinAbsValue;

		private readonly bool isContinuousView;

		private bool shouldResort;

		private bool shouldUpdateSupplyInteractions;

		protected virtual bool ShouldUpdateOnChangePoint => isContinuousView;

		internal bool IsContinuousView => isContinuousView;

		internal PointInteractionCollection SortedInteractionsByArgument => sortedInteractionsByArgument;

		internal PointInteractionCollection SortedInteractionsByMinValue => sortedInteractionsByMinValue;

		internal PointInteractionCollection SortedInteractionsByMaxValue => sortedInteractionsByMaxValue;

		public override double Max
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.SeriesView != null && sortedInteractionsByMaxValue.Count > 0)
				{
					EnsureInteractions();
					UpdateSupplyPointsAndInteractions();
					Resort();
					return sortedInteractionsByMaxValue[0].GetMaxValue(base.SeriesView);
				}
				return double.NaN;
			}
		}

		public override double Min
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.SeriesView != null && sortedInteractionsByMinValue.Count > 0)
				{
					EnsureInteractions();
					UpdateSupplyPointsAndInteractions();
					Resort();
					return sortedInteractionsByMinValue[0].GetMinValue(base.SeriesView);
				}
				return double.NaN;
			}
		}

		public override IList<IPointInteraction> PointInteractions => sortedInteractionsByArgument;

		public StackedInteractionContainer(ISeriesView view, bool isContinuousView = false)
			: base(view)
		{
			sortedInteractionsByArgument = new PointInteractionCollection(new InteractionComparerByArgument());
			sortedInteractionsByMinValue = new PointInteractionCollection(new InteractionComparerByMinValue(view));
			sortedInteractionsByMaxValue = new PointInteractionCollection(new InteractionComparerByMaxValue(view));
			sortedInteractionsByMinAbsValue = new PointInteractionCollection(new InteractionComparerByMinAbsValue(view));
			this.isContinuousView = isContinuousView;
		}

		private void Resort()
		{
			if (shouldResort)
			{
				sortedInteractionsByMinValue.Sort();
				sortedInteractionsByMaxValue.Sort();
				sortedInteractionsByMinAbsValue.Sort();
				shouldResort = false;
			}
		}

		private void AddNewPointInteraction(int seriesIndex, RefinedPoint point)
		{
			StackedPointInteraction item = CreatePointInteraction(seriesIndex, point);
			sortedInteractionsByArgument.Add(item);
			sortedInteractionsByMaxValue.Add(item);
			sortedInteractionsByMinValue.Add(item);
			sortedInteractionsByMinAbsValue.Add(item);
		}

		private void InsertRefinedPoint(int seriesIndex, RefinedPoint point)
		{
			int num = sortedInteractionsByArgument.BinarySearch(point);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				AddNewPointInteraction(seriesIndex, point);
				return;
			}
			StackedPointInteraction stackedPointInteraction = (StackedPointInteraction)sortedInteractionsByArgument[num];
			stackedPointInteraction.InsertPoint(seriesIndex, point);
			Invalidate();
		}

		private void UpdateSupplyPointsAndInteractions()
		{
			if (shouldUpdateSupplyInteractions && isContinuousView)
			{
				ClearSupplyPoints();
				AddSupplyPoints();
				AddSupplyInteractions();
				shouldUpdateSupplyInteractions = false;
			}
		}

		private void ClearSupplyPoints()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < sortedInteractionsByArgument.Count; i++)
			{
				StackedPointInteraction stackedPointInteraction = (StackedPointInteraction)sortedInteractionsByArgument[i];
				if (stackedPointInteraction.IsSupplyInteraction)
				{
					sortedInteractionsByArgument.RemoveAt(i);
					sortedInteractionsByMinValue.Remove(stackedPointInteraction);
					sortedInteractionsByMaxValue.Remove(stackedPointInteraction);
					sortedInteractionsByMinAbsValue.Remove(stackedPointInteraction);
					i--;
					continue;
				}
				for (int j = 0; j < stackedPointInteraction.Count; j++)
				{
					if (stackedPointInteraction[j] != null && stackedPointInteraction[j].IsSupplyPoint)
					{
						stackedPointInteraction[j] = null;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void AddSupplyInteractions()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < sortedInteractionsByArgument.Count; i++)
			{
				StackedPointInteraction stackedPointInteraction = (StackedPointInteraction)sortedInteractionsByArgument[i];
				if (!stackedPointInteraction.HasEmptyPoints)
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (i > 0)
				{
					StackedPointInteraction stackedPointInteraction2 = (StackedPointInteraction)sortedInteractionsByArgument[i - 1];
					if (!stackedPointInteraction2.IsSupplyInteraction)
					{
						if (AddSupplyInteraction(i, stackedPointInteraction, stackedPointInteraction2))
						{
							i++;
						}
						if (AddSupplyInteraction(i, stackedPointInteraction2, stackedPointInteraction))
						{
							i++;
						}
					}
				}
				if (i < sortedInteractionsByArgument.Count - 1)
				{
					StackedPointInteraction stackedPointInteraction3 = (StackedPointInteraction)sortedInteractionsByArgument[i + 1];
					if (AddSupplyInteraction(i + 1, stackedPointInteraction3, stackedPointInteraction))
					{
						i++;
					}
					if (AddSupplyInteraction(i + 1, stackedPointInteraction, stackedPointInteraction3))
					{
						i++;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void AddSupplyPoints()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < base.Series.Count; i++)
			{
				List<RangeIndexes> list = new List<RangeIndexes>();
				int num = -1;
				for (int j = 0; j < sortedInteractionsByArgument.Count; j++)
				{
					StackedPointInteraction stackedPointInteraction = (StackedPointInteraction)sortedInteractionsByArgument[j];
					RefinedPoint refinedPoint = stackedPointInteraction[i];
					if (refinedPoint == null)
					{
						continue;
					}
					if (refinedPoint.IsEmpty)
					{
						num = -1;
						continue;
					}
					if (num > -1 && j - num > 0)
					{
						list.Add(new RangeIndexes(num, j));
					}
					num = j;
				}
				foreach (RangeIndexes item in list)
				{
					StackedPointInteraction stackedPointInteraction2 = (StackedPointInteraction)sortedInteractionsByArgument[item.Min];
					StackedPointInteraction stackedPointInteraction3 = (StackedPointInteraction)sortedInteractionsByArgument[item.Max];
					for (int k = item.Min + 1; k < item.Max; k++)
					{
						double argumentX = sortedInteractionsByArgument[k].ArgumentX;
						double value = ((IValuePoint)stackedPointInteraction2[i]).Value;
						double value2 = ((IValuePoint)stackedPointInteraction3[i]).Value;
						double value3 = CalculateSupplyValue(argumentX, stackedPointInteraction2.Argument, value, stackedPointInteraction3.Argument, value2);
						RefinedPoint refinedPoint2 = ObjectsFactory.Default.Create(argumentX, value3);
						refinedPoint2.IsSupplyPoint = true;
						((StackedPointInteraction)sortedInteractionsByArgument[k]).InsertPoint(i, refinedPoint2);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private int FindInteractionIndexByArgument(int startInteractionIndex, double exceptedArgument)
		{
			for (int i = startInteractionIndex; i < sortedInteractionsByArgument.Count; i++)
			{
				StackedPointInteraction stackedPointInteraction = (StackedPointInteraction)sortedInteractionsByArgument[i];
				if (!stackedPointInteraction.IsSupplyInteraction)
				{
					if (stackedPointInteraction.Argument == exceptedArgument)
					{
						return i;
					}
					if (stackedPointInteraction.Argument > exceptedArgument)
					{
						return ~i;
					}
				}
			}
			return ~sortedInteractionsByArgument.Count;
		}

		private bool AddSupplyInteraction(int index, StackedPointInteraction interaction, StackedPointInteraction supplyValues)
		{
			StackedPointInteraction stackedPointInteraction = null;
			for (int i = 0; i < interaction.Count; i++)
			{
				if (supplyValues[i] != null && !supplyValues[i].IsEmpty && interaction[i] != null && !interaction[i].IsEmpty)
				{
					RefinedPoint refinedPoint = ObjectsFactory.Default.Create(supplyValues.Argument, ((IValuePoint)supplyValues[i]).Value);
					refinedPoint.IsSupplyPoint = true;
					if (stackedPointInteraction == null)
					{
						stackedPointInteraction = CreatePointInteraction(i, refinedPoint);
						stackedPointInteraction.IsSupplyInteraction = true;
					}
					else
					{
						stackedPointInteraction.InsertPoint(i, refinedPoint);
					}
				}
			}
			if (stackedPointInteraction != null)
			{
				if ((index > 0 && IsEqualInteractions((StackedPointInteraction)sortedInteractionsByArgument[index - 1], stackedPointInteraction)) || IsEqualInteractions((StackedPointInteraction)sortedInteractionsByArgument[index], stackedPointInteraction))
				{
					return false;
				}
				sortedInteractionsByArgument.Insert(index, stackedPointInteraction);
				sortedInteractionsByMinValue.Add(stackedPointInteraction);
				sortedInteractionsByMaxValue.Add(stackedPointInteraction);
				sortedInteractionsByMinAbsValue.Add(interaction);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool IsEqualInteractions(StackedPointInteraction interaction1, StackedPointInteraction interaction2)
		{
			if (interaction1.Argument == interaction2.Argument && interaction1.IsEmpty == interaction2.IsEmpty)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < interaction1.Count; i++)
				{
					IStackedPoint stackedPoint = interaction1[i];
					IStackedPoint stackedPoint2 = interaction2[i];
					if ((stackedPoint != null || stackedPoint2 != null) && (stackedPoint == null || stackedPoint2 == null || (stackedPoint.Value != stackedPoint2.Value && stackedPoint.IsEmpty != stackedPoint2.IsEmpty)))
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected virtual double CalculateSupplyValue(double currentArgument, double anotherArgumentPrev, double anotherValuePrev, double anotherArgumentNext, double anotherValueNext)
		{
			return (currentArgument - anotherArgumentPrev) / (anotherArgumentNext - anotherArgumentPrev) * (anotherValueNext - anotherValuePrev) + anotherValuePrev;
		}

		protected virtual StackedPointInteraction CreatePointInteraction(int seriesIndex, RefinedPoint point)
		{
			return new StackedPointInteraction(base.Series, seriesIndex, point);
		}

		protected virtual void Invalidate()
		{
			shouldResort = true;
		}

		protected override void InsertRefinedPoints(int seriesIndex, RefinedSeries refinedSeries)
		{
			if (seriesIndex < 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			IList<RefinedPoint> finalPointsSortedByArgument = refinedSeries.FinalPointsSortedByArgument;
			if (sortedInteractionsByArgument.Count == 0)
			{
				foreach (RefinedPoint item in finalPointsSortedByArgument)
				{
					InsertRefinedPoint(seriesIndex, item);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				foreach (StackedPointInteraction item2 in (IEnumerable<IPointInteraction>)sortedInteractionsByArgument)
				{
					item2.InsertSeries(refinedSeries, seriesIndex, null);
				}
				int num = 0;
				for (int i = 0; i < finalPointsSortedByArgument.Count; i++)
				{
					RefinedPoint point = finalPointsSortedByArgument[i];
					num = FindInteractionIndexByArgument(num, finalPointsSortedByArgument[i].Argument);
					if (num >= 0)
					{
						((StackedPointInteraction)sortedInteractionsByArgument[num]).InsertPoint(seriesIndex, point);
						continue;
					}
					AddNewPointInteraction(seriesIndex, point);
					num = ~num;
				}
			}
			if (isContinuousView)
			{
				shouldUpdateSupplyInteractions = true;
			}
			Invalidate();
		}

		protected override void RemoveRefinedPoints(int seriesIndex, RefinedSeries refinedSeries, bool removeAll = false)
		{
			base.LockRecalculate = true;
			if (seriesIndex < 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (removeAll)
			{
				sortedInteractionsByArgument.Clear();
				sortedInteractionsByMinValue.Clear();
				sortedInteractionsByMaxValue.Clear();
				sortedInteractionsByMinAbsValue.Clear();
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < sortedInteractionsByArgument.Count; i++)
			{
				StackedPointInteraction stackedPointInteraction = (StackedPointInteraction)sortedInteractionsByArgument[i];
				stackedPointInteraction.RemoveSeries(seriesIndex);
				if (stackedPointInteraction.IsEmpty)
				{
					sortedInteractionsByArgument.RemoveAt(i);
					sortedInteractionsByMinValue.Remove(stackedPointInteraction);
					sortedInteractionsByMaxValue.Remove(stackedPointInteraction);
					sortedInteractionsByMinAbsValue.Remove(stackedPointInteraction);
					i--;
				}
			}
			if (isContinuousView)
			{
				shouldUpdateSupplyInteractions = true;
			}
			Invalidate();
			base.LockRecalculate = false;
		}

		protected override void InsertRefinedPoint(RefinedSeries refinedSeries, RefinedPoint point)
		{
			int seriesIndex = GetSeriesIndex(refinedSeries);
			if (seriesIndex < 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException();
			}
			InsertRefinedPoint(seriesIndex, point);
			if (ShouldUpdateOnChangePoint)
			{
				shouldUpdateSupplyInteractions = true;
				Invalidate();
			}
		}

		protected override void RemoveRefinedPoint(RefinedSeries refinedSeries, RefinedPoint point)
		{
			int seriesIndex = GetSeriesIndex(refinedSeries);
			if (seriesIndex < 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException();
			}
			int num = sortedInteractionsByArgument.BinarySearch(point);
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				StackedPointInteraction stackedPointInteraction = (StackedPointInteraction)sortedInteractionsByArgument[num];
				stackedPointInteraction.RemovePoint(seriesIndex);
				if (stackedPointInteraction.IsEmpty)
				{
					sortedInteractionsByArgument.RemoveAt(num);
					sortedInteractionsByMinValue.Remove(stackedPointInteraction);
					sortedInteractionsByMaxValue.Remove(stackedPointInteraction);
					sortedInteractionsByMinAbsValue.Remove(stackedPointInteraction);
				}
				else
				{
					Invalidate();
				}
				if (ShouldUpdateOnChangePoint)
				{
					shouldUpdateSupplyInteractions = true;
					Invalidate();
				}
			}
		}

		public override void Recalculate()
		{
			if (!base.LockRecalculate)
			{
				sortedInteractionsByArgument.Clear();
				sortedInteractionsByMinValue.Clear();
				sortedInteractionsByMaxValue.Clear();
				sortedInteractionsByMinAbsValue.Clear();
				for (int i = 0; i < base.Series.Count; i++)
				{
					InsertRefinedPoints(i, base.Series[i]);
				}
			}
		}

		public override double GetAbsMinValue()
		{
			if (base.SeriesView != null && sortedInteractionsByMinAbsValue.Count > 0)
			{
				return sortedInteractionsByMinAbsValue[0].GetMinAbsValue(base.SeriesView);
			}
			return double.NaN;
		}

		public IList<RefinedPoint> GetStackedPointsForDrawing(RefinedSeries refinedSeries)
		{
			UpdateSupplyPointsAndInteractions();
			List<RefinedPoint> list = new List<RefinedPoint>(sortedInteractionsByArgument.Count);
			int seriesIndex = GetSeriesIndex(refinedSeries);
			foreach (StackedPointInteraction item in (IEnumerable<IPointInteraction>)sortedInteractionsByArgument)
			{
				IStackedPoint stackedPoint = item[seriesIndex];
				IStackedPoint stackedPoint2 = ((list.Count > 0) ? list[list.Count - 1] : null);
				if (stackedPoint != null && (stackedPoint2 == null || stackedPoint2.Argument != stackedPoint.Argument || stackedPoint2.MaxValue != stackedPoint.MaxValue || stackedPoint2.MinValue != stackedPoint.MinValue))
				{
					list.Add(item[seriesIndex]);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		public bool ShouldCreateTotalLabel(int seriesIndex, RefinedPoint refinedPoint)
		{
			StackedPointInteraction stackedPointInteraction = (StackedPointInteraction)refinedPoint.Interaction;
			return stackedPointInteraction.IsTopPoint(seriesIndex);
		}
	}
	public class WaterfallInteractionContainer : StackedInteractionContainer
	{
		private readonly List<RefinedPoint> subTotalPoints = new List<RefinedPoint>();

		private bool needUpdatePrevInteractions = true;

		protected override bool ShouldUpdateOnChangePoint => true;

		public WaterfallInteractionContainer(ISeriesView view)
			: base(view)
		{
		}

		private void UpdateSubtotalPoints()
		{
			foreach (RefinedPoint subTotalPoint in subTotalPoints)
			{
				ISeriesPoint seriesPoint = subTotalPoint.SeriesPoint;
				if (seriesPoint != null)
				{
					object[] colors = ((!seriesPoint.ColorCore.HasValue || seriesPoint.ColorCore.Value == 0) ? null : new object[1] { seriesPoint.ColorCore.Value });
					IDataPoint seriesPoint2 = seriesPoint.Owner?.CreateSeriesPoint(seriesPoint.Owner, seriesPoint.ArgumentX.UserArgument, new object[1] { ((IWaterfallPoint)subTotalPoint).AbsoluteValue }, seriesPoint.Tag, colors);
					subTotalPoint.ReplaceSeriesPoint(seriesPoint2);
				}
			}
			subTotalPoints.Clear();
		}

		protected override void Invalidate()
		{
			base.Invalidate();
			needUpdatePrevInteractions = true;
		}

		protected override StackedPointInteraction CreatePointInteraction(int seriesIndex, RefinedPoint point)
		{
			if (((IWaterfallPoint)point).IsSubTotal)
			{
				subTotalPoints.Add(point);
			}
			return ((IWaterfallSeriesView)base.Series[0].SeriesView).ValueOptions.CreatePointInteraction(base.Series, seriesIndex, point);
		}

		public override void EnsureInteractions()
		{
			if (!needUpdatePrevInteractions)
			{
				return;
			}
			WaterfallPointInteraction waterfallPointInteraction = null;
			foreach (WaterfallPointInteraction item in (IEnumerable<IPointInteraction>)base.SortedInteractionsByArgument)
			{
				if (waterfallPointInteraction != null)
				{
					item.UpdatePrevValues(waterfallPointInteraction);
				}
				if (item.ShouldConsiderValue || waterfallPointInteraction == null)
				{
					waterfallPointInteraction = item;
				}
			}
			UpdateSubtotalPoints();
			needUpdatePrevInteractions = false;
		}
	}
