	public class XYSeriesContainer : SingleSeriesContainer, ISupportMinMaxValues
	{
		private double min;

		private double max;

		private double absMin;

		private bool needRecalculate = true;

		private bool needRecalculateAbsMin = true;

		private RefinedSeries actualSeries;

		private int suspendUpdateCounter;

		private IList<RefinedPoint> Interactions => ActualSeries.FinalPointsSortedByArgument;

		protected RefinedSeries ActualSeries
		{
			get
			{
				return actualSeries;
			}
			set
			{
				if (actualSeries != value)
				{
					actualSeries = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public double Max
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.SeriesView != null && Interactions.Count > 0)
				{
					if (needRecalculate)
					{
						Calculate();
					}
					return max;
				}
				return double.NaN;
			}
		}

		public double Min
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.SeriesView != null && Interactions.Count > 0)
				{
					if (needRecalculate)
					{
						Calculate();
					}
					return min;
				}
				return double.NaN;
			}
		}

		public override IList<IPointInteraction> PointInteractions => ActualSeries.FinalPointsSortedByArgument;

		public XYSeriesContainer(ISeriesView view)
			: base(view)
		{
		}

		private void Calculate()
		{
			min = double.NaN;
			max = double.NaN;
			bool minMaxValuesAreSame = base.SeriesView.MinMaxValuesAreSame;
			double num = 0.0;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			foreach (RefinedPoint interaction in Interactions)
			{
				IPointInteraction pointInteraction = interaction;
				if (!pointInteraction.IsEmpty)
				{
					num = pointInteraction.GetMinValue(base.SeriesView);
					num2 = (minMaxValuesAreSame ? num : pointInteraction.GetMaxValue(base.SeriesView));
					if (GeometricUtils.IsValidDouble(num))
					{
						min = (double.IsNaN(min) ? num : Math.Min(num, min));
					}
					if (GeometricUtils.IsValidDouble(num2))
					{
						max = (double.IsNaN(max) ? num2 : Math.Max(num2, max));
					}
				}
			}
			needRecalculate = false;
		}

		private void CalculateAbsMin()
		{
			absMin = double.MaxValue;
			foreach (RefinedPoint interaction in Interactions)
			{
				IPointInteraction pointInteraction = interaction;
				double num = Math.Abs(pointInteraction.GetMinValue(base.SeriesView));
				double num2 = Math.Abs(pointInteraction.GetMaxValue(base.SeriesView));
				if (num != 0.0)
				{
					absMin = Math.Min(num, absMin);
					needRecalculateAbsMin = false;
				}
				if (num2 != 0.0)
				{
					absMin = Math.Min(num2, absMin);
					needRecalculateAbsMin = false;
				}
			}
			if (needRecalculateAbsMin)
			{
				absMin = double.NaN;
			}
		}

		protected override void InsertRefinedPoints(int seriesIndex, RefinedSeries series)
		{
			ActualSeries = series;
			needRecalculate = true;
			needRecalculateAbsMin = true;
		}

		protected override void RemoveRefinedPoints(int seriesIndex, RefinedSeries series, bool removeAll = false)
		{
			ActualSeries = series;
			needRecalculate = true;
			needRecalculateAbsMin = true;
		}

		protected override void SuspendUpdate()
		{
			suspendUpdateCounter++;
		}

		protected override void ResumeUpdate()
		{
			if (--suspendUpdateCounter == 0 && needRecalculate)
			{
				Calculate();
			}
		}

		protected override void InsertRefinedPoint(RefinedSeries refinedSeries, RefinedPoint point)
		{
			ActualSeries = refinedSeries;
			if ((suspendUpdateCounter <= 0 || !needRecalculate) && !point.IsEmpty)
			{
				if (needRecalculate)
				{
					Calculate();
				}
				double minValue = ((IPointInteraction)point).GetMinValue(base.SeriesView);
				if (GeometricUtils.IsValidDouble(minValue))
				{
					min = (double.IsNaN(min) ? minValue : Math.Min(minValue, min));
				}
				double maxValue = ((IPointInteraction)point).GetMaxValue(base.SeriesView);
				if (GeometricUtils.IsValidDouble(maxValue))
				{
					max = (double.IsNaN(max) ? maxValue : Math.Max(maxValue, max));
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void RemoveRefinedPoint(RefinedSeries refinedSeries, RefinedPoint point)
		{
			ActualSeries = refinedSeries;
			if (point.IsEmpty)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (!needRecalculate)
			{
				double minValue = ((IPointInteraction)point).GetMinValue(base.SeriesView);
				double maxValue = ((IPointInteraction)point).GetMaxValue(base.SeriesView);
				if ((GeometricUtils.IsValidDouble(minValue) && !double.IsNaN(min) && minValue <= min) || (GeometricUtils.IsValidDouble(maxValue) && !double.IsNaN(max) && maxValue >= max))
				{
					needRecalculate = true;
				}
			}
			needRecalculateAbsMin = true;
		}

		public double GetAbsMinValue()
		{
			if (base.SeriesView != null && Interactions.Count > 0)
			{
				if (needRecalculateAbsMin)
				{
					CalculateAbsMin();
				}
				return absMin;
			}
			return double.NaN;
		}
	}
	public class XYWSeriesContainer : SingleSeriesContainer, ISupportMinMaxValues
	{
		private readonly XYWPointInteraction interaction;

		public double Max => interaction.GetMaxValue(base.SeriesView);

		public double Min => interaction.GetMinValue(base.SeriesView);

		public override IList<IPointInteraction> PointInteractions => new List<IPointInteraction> { interaction };

		public XYWSeriesContainer(ISeriesView view)
			: base(view)
		{
			if (!(view is IXYWSeriesView iXYWSeriesView))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("The XYWSeriesContainer can process only the IXYWView views.");
			}
			interaction = new XYWPointInteraction(iXYWSeriesView);
		}

		protected override void InsertRefinedPoints(int seriesIndex, RefinedSeries refinedSeries)
		{
			interaction.Lock();
			foreach (RefinedPoint finalPoint in refinedSeries.FinalPoints)
			{
				InsertRefinedPoint(refinedSeries, finalPoint);
			}
			interaction.Unlock();
		}

		protected override void RemoveRefinedPoints(int seriesIndex, RefinedSeries refinedSeries, bool removeAll = false)
		{
			interaction.Clear();
		}

		protected override void InsertRefinedPoint(RefinedSeries refinedSeries, RefinedPoint point)
		{
			if (point.HasValues)
			{
				interaction.AddPoint(point);
			}
		}

		protected override void RemoveRefinedPoint(RefinedSeries refinedSeries, RefinedPoint point)
		{
			if (point.HasValues)
			{
				interaction.RemovePoint(point);
			}
		}

		public double GetAbsMinValue()
		{
			return 0.0;
		}
	}
	internal class PointArgument
	{
		private readonly double argument;

		public double Argument => argument;

		public int OccurrenceCount { get; set; }

		public PointArgument(double argument)
		{
			this.argument = argument;
			OccurrenceCount = 1;
		}
	}
	internal class PointArgumentComparer : Comparer<PointArgument>
	{
		private const double Eps = 1E-06;

		public override int Compare(PointArgument argument1, PointArgument argument2)
		{
			if (Math.Abs(argument1.Argument - argument2.Argument) <= 1E-06)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			return argument1.Argument.CompareTo(argument2.Argument);
		}
	}
	internal class ArgumentCollectionContainer
	{
		private readonly SortedCollection<PointArgument> sortedCollection;

		private double minDelta;

		private int leftMinDeltaIndex;

		private int rightMinDeltaIndex;

		private bool needRecalculateDelta;

		public double MinDelta
		{
			get
			{
				if (needRecalculateDelta)
				{
					RecalculateMinDelta();
				}
				return minDelta;
			}
		}

		public ArgumentCollectionContainer()
		{
			sortedCollection = new SortedCollection<PointArgument>(new PointArgumentComparer());
			Invalidate();
		}

		private void UpdateMinDelta(int leftIndex, int rightIndex)
		{
			double num = Math.Abs(sortedCollection[leftIndex].Argument - sortedCollection[rightIndex].Argument);
			if (num < minDelta)
			{
				leftMinDeltaIndex = leftIndex;
				rightMinDeltaIndex = rightIndex;
				minDelta = num;
			}
		}

		private void CorrectIfNecessaryMinDelta(int insertedPointIndex)
		{
			if (needRecalculateDelta)
			{
				RecalculateMinDelta();
			}
			else if (sortedCollection.Count > 1)
			{
				if (insertedPointIndex > 0)
				{
					UpdateMinDelta(insertedPointIndex - 1, insertedPointIndex);
				}
				if (insertedPointIndex < sortedCollection.Count - 1)
				{
					UpdateMinDelta(insertedPointIndex, insertedPointIndex + 1);
				}
			}
		}

		private void RecalculateMinDelta()
		{
			minDelta = double.PositiveInfinity;
			for (int i = 0; i < sortedCollection.Count - 1; i++)
			{
				UpdateMinDelta(i, i + 1);
			}
			needRecalculateDelta = false;
		}

		public void Invalidate()
		{
			sortedCollection.Clear();
			minDelta = double.PositiveInfinity;
			leftMinDeltaIndex = -1;
			rightMinDeltaIndex = -1;
			needRecalculateDelta = false;
		}

		public void InsertPointToCollection(PointArgument pointArgument)
		{
			int num = sortedCollection.BinarySearch(pointArgument);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				num = ~num;
				sortedCollection.Insert(num, pointArgument);
				CorrectIfNecessaryMinDelta(num);
			}
			else
			{
				sortedCollection[num].OccurrenceCount++;
			}
		}

		public void RemovePointFromCollection(PointArgument pointArgument)
		{
			int num = sortedCollection.BinarySearch(pointArgument);
			if (num >= 0 && --sortedCollection[num].OccurrenceCount == 0)
			{
				sortedCollection.RemoveAt(num);
				if (num == leftMinDeltaIndex || num == rightMinDeltaIndex)
				{
					needRecalculateDelta = true;
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public class XYZBarSeriesContainer : XYSeriesContainer
	{
		private readonly IXYZBarSeriesView barView;

		private readonly ArgumentCollectionContainer sortedArgumentsX;

		private readonly ArgumentCollectionContainer sortedArgumentsY;

		public XYZBarSeriesContainer(IXYZBarSeriesView barView, ISeriesView view)
			: base(view)
		{
			this.barView = barView;
			sortedArgumentsX = new ArgumentCollectionContainer();
			sortedArgumentsY = new ArgumentCollectionContainer();
		}

		protected override void InsertRefinedPoints(int seriesIndex, RefinedSeries series)
		{
			base.ActualSeries = series;
			foreach (RefinedPoint finalPoint in series.FinalPoints)
			{
				InsertRefinedPoint(series, finalPoint);
			}
		}

		protected override void RemoveRefinedPoints(int seriesIndex, RefinedSeries series, bool removeAll = false)
		{
			base.RemoveRefinedPoints(seriesIndex, series, removeAll);
			sortedArgumentsX.Invalidate();
			sortedArgumentsY.Invalidate();
		}

		protected override void InsertRefinedPoint(RefinedSeries refinedSeries, RefinedPoint point)
		{
			base.InsertRefinedPoint(refinedSeries, point);
			if (!point.IsEmpty)
			{
				sortedArgumentsX.InsertPointToCollection(new PointArgument(point.Argument));
				sortedArgumentsY.InsertPointToCollection(new PointArgument(point.ArgumentY));
			}
		}

		protected override void RemoveRefinedPoint(RefinedSeries refinedSeries, RefinedPoint point)
		{
			base.RemoveRefinedPoint(refinedSeries, point);
			if (!point.IsEmpty)
			{
				sortedArgumentsX.RemovePointFromCollection(new PointArgument(point.Argument));
				sortedArgumentsY.RemovePointFromCollection(new PointArgument(point.ArgumentY));
			}
		}

		internal override void ApplySeriesViewData()
		{
			base.ApplySeriesViewData();
			barView.BarWidth = sortedArgumentsX.MinDelta / 2.0;
			barView.BarDepth = sortedArgumentsY.MinDelta / 2.0;
		}
	}
	internal interface IUpdateActionExecutor
	{
		SeriesControllerChanges Execute(SeriesController.IExecutorContext context);
	}
	internal class InteractionExecutor : IUpdateActionExecutor
	{
		private readonly SeriesController seriesController;

		public InteractionExecutor(SeriesController seriesController)
		{
			this.seriesController = seriesController;
		}

		private void UpdateSeriesGroupsInteraction()
		{
			foreach (SeriesInteractionContainer seriesGroupsInteractionContainer in seriesController.SeriesRepository.InteractionManager.SeriesGroupsInteractionContainers)
			{
				seriesGroupsInteractionContainer.Recalculate();
			}
		}

		private void ApplySeriesInteractionData()
		{
			foreach (SeriesContainer interactionContainer in seriesController.SeriesRepository.InteractionManager.InteractionContainers)
			{
				interactionContainer.ApplySeriesViewData();
			}
		}

		private void UpdateIndicators(bool shouldUpdateIndicators, ICollection<RefinedSeriesUpdateInfo> updatesSeriesInfo, ICollection<RefinedSeriesPointsUpdateInfo> updatedPointsInfo)
		{
			if (!(seriesController.Diagram is IIndicatorCalculator indicatorCalculator))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (shouldUpdateIndicators)
			{
				updatesSeriesInfo = new List<RefinedSeriesUpdateInfo>
				{
					new RefinedSeriesUpdateInfo(ChartCollectionOperation.Reset, seriesController.SeriesForLegend)
				};
				updatedPointsInfo = new List<RefinedSeriesPointsUpdateInfo>();
			}
			if (updatesSeriesInfo.Count == 0 && updatedPointsInfo.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			Dictionary<RefinedSeries, List<RefinedSeriesPointsUpdateInfo>> dictionary = new Dictionary<RefinedSeries, List<RefinedSeriesPointsUpdateInfo>>();
			foreach (RefinedSeriesPointsUpdateInfo item in updatedPointsInfo)
			{
				RefinedSeries refinedSeries = item.RefinedSeries;
				if (!dictionary.ContainsKey(refinedSeries))
				{
					dictionary.Add(refinedSeries, new List<RefinedSeriesPointsUpdateInfo>());
				}
				dictionary[refinedSeries].Add(item);
			}
			if (updatesSeriesInfo.Count > 0)
			{
				indicatorCalculator.Invalidate(seriesController.SeriesForLegend);
			}
			foreach (RefinedSeriesUpdateInfo item2 in updatesSeriesInfo)
			{
				ChartCollectionOperation operation = item2.Operation;
				if ((uint)operation > 1u && operation != ChartCollectionOperation.UpdateItem)
				{
					continue;
				}
				foreach (RefinedSeries item3 in item2.RefinedSeries)
				{
					indicatorCalculator.UpdateSeriesIndicators(item3, null);
				}
			}
			foreach (KeyValuePair<RefinedSeries, List<RefinedSeriesPointsUpdateInfo>> item4 in dictionary)
			{
				indicatorCalculator.UpdateSeriesIndicators(item4.Key, item4.Value);
			}
		}

		public SeriesControllerChanges Execute(SeriesController.IExecutorContext context)
		{
			if (context.IsHeavyUpdate)
			{
				if (context.ShouldUpdateSeriesGroupsInteractionKeys)
				{
					seriesController.SeriesRepository.InteractionManager.UpdateSeriesGroupsKeys();
				}
				HashSet<RefinedSeries> hashSet = new HashSet<RefinedSeries>(context.UpdatedSeries);
				foreach (RefinedSeriesPointsUpdateInfo item in context.UpdatedPointsInfo)
				{
					if (item.RefinedSeries != null && item.RefinedSeries.ActualIsActive)
					{
						if (ActionTypeHelper.ShouldUpdateInteraction(item.UpdateType))
						{
							hashSet.Add(item.RefinedSeries);
						}
						else
						{
							seriesController.SeriesRepository.InteractionManager.UpdatePoints(item);
						}
					}
				}
				foreach (RefinedSeries item2 in context.ActiveChangedSeries)
				{
					if (!item2.ActualIsActive)
					{
						seriesController.SeriesRepository.InteractionManager.RemoveSeries(item2);
					}
					else
					{
						seriesController.SeriesRepository.InteractionManager.AddSeries(item2);
					}
				}
				if (seriesController.DataContainer.DesignMode)
				{
					foreach (RefinedSeries item3 in seriesController.SeriesRepository.ActiveRefinedSeries)
					{
						if (!context.ActiveChangedSeries.Contains(item3))
						{
							hashSet.Add(item3);
						}
					}
				}
				else
				{
					foreach (RefinedSeriesGroup updatedGroup in context.UpdatedGroups)
					{
						foreach (RefinedSeries item4 in updatedGroup.RefinedSeries)
						{
							if (!context.ActiveChangedSeries.Contains(item4))
							{
								hashSet.Add(item4);
							}
						}
					}
				}
				bool flag = hashSet.Count() > 0;
				bool flag2 = context.ShouldUpdateSeriesGroupsInteraction || flag || context.ActiveChangedSeries.Count > 0;
				if (flag)
				{
					seriesController.SeriesRepository.InteractionManager.RecalculateFor(hashSet);
				}
				if (flag2)
				{
					UpdateSeriesGroupsInteraction();
				}
				if (flag2 || context.UpdatedPointsInfo.Count > 0)
				{
					ApplySeriesInteractionData();
				}
				UpdateIndicators(context.ShouldUpdateIndicators, context.UpdatedSeriesInfo, context.UpdatedPointsInfo);
				if (context.ActiveChangedSeries.Count > 0 || flag)
				{
					return SeriesControllerChanges.ShouldUpdateMeasureUnits;
				}
			}
			return SeriesControllerChanges.NoChanges;
		}
	}
	internal class UpdateRefinedSeriesDataExecutor : IUpdateActionExecutor
	{
		private readonly HashSet<RefinedSeries> updatedSeriesData = new HashSet<RefinedSeries>();

		private void UpdateSeriesData(IEnumerable<RefinedSeries> refinedSeries, bool shouldUpdateInternalArguments = false)
		{
			foreach (RefinedSeries item in refinedSeries)
			{
				if (!updatedSeriesData.Contains(item))
				{
					if (shouldUpdateInternalArguments)
					{
						item.UpdatePointsInternalArguments();
					}
					item.UpdateData();
					updatedSeriesData.Add(item);
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdateSeriesPointsValues(IEnumerable<RefinedSeries> refinedSeries)
		{
			foreach (RefinedSeries item in refinedSeries)
			{
				if (!updatedSeriesData.Contains(item))
				{
					item.UpdatePointsValues();
				}
			}
		}

		public SeriesControllerChanges Execute(SeriesController.IExecutorContext context)
		{
			if (context.IsHeavyUpdate)
			{
				if (context.ShouldUpdatePointsValuesOnly)
				{
					UpdateSeriesPointsValues(context.ActiveChangedSeries);
				}
				else
				{
					updatedSeriesData.Clear();
					foreach (RefinedSeriesGroup updatedGroup in context.UpdatedGroups)
					{
						UpdateSeriesData(updatedGroup.RefinedSeries, updatedGroup.ShouldUpdateInternalArguments);
					}
					UpdateSeriesData(context.ActiveChangedSeries);
					if (updatedSeriesData.Count > 0)
					{
						return SeriesControllerChanges.ShouldUpdateMeasureUnits;
					}
				}
			}
			return SeriesControllerChanges.NoChanges;
		}
	}
	internal class UpdateRangeExecutor : IUpdateActionExecutor
	{
		private readonly SeriesController seriesController;

		public UpdateRangeExecutor(SeriesController seriesController)
		{
			this.seriesController = seriesController;
		}

		private List<IAxisData> GetAxesForReset(IEnumerable<RefinedSeriesGroup> groupsWithChangedScaleMap)
		{
			List<IAxisData> list = new List<IAxisData>();
			foreach (RefinedSeriesGroup item in groupsWithChangedScaleMap)
			{
				if (item.GroupKey.AxisData != null && item.GroupKey.AxisData.WholeRange != null)
				{
					list.Add(item.GroupKey.AxisData);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		private void UpdateDiagramAxes(IXYDiagram diagram, bool shouldDeserializeRange)
		{
			if (diagram != null)
			{
				IEnumerable<IAxisData> allAxes = diagram.AllAxes;
				UpdateAxes(allAxes);
				if (shouldDeserializeRange)
				{
					DeserializeAxesRange(allAxes);
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdateAxes(IEnumerable<IAxisData> axes)
		{
			seriesController.SeriesRepository.GroupController.UpdateAxisData(axes, seriesController.InteractionManager);
			foreach (IAxisData axis in axes)
			{
				axis.UpdateUserValues();
			}
		}

		private void DeserializeAxesRange(IEnumerable<IAxisData> axes)
		{
			foreach (IAxisData axis in axes)
			{
				axis.Deserialize();
			}
		}

		private void UpdateRange(VisualRangeUpdateMode updateMode, List<IAxisData> axesForReset)
		{
			RangeUpdateEnqueuer.Update(seriesController.SeriesRepository.GroupController, updateMode, seriesController.Diagram as IXYDiagram, seriesController.SeriesForLegend, axesForReset);
			seriesController.SeriesRepository.GroupController.CalculateFilteredIndexes();
		}

		private MinMaxValues CopyValueAxisWholeRange(IXYDiagram diagram)
		{
			if (diagram != null && diagram.AxisX != null && diagram.AxisX.WholeRange != null)
			{
				return new MinMaxValues(diagram.AxisX.WholeRange);
			}
			return default(MinMaxValues);
		}

		public SeriesControllerChanges Execute(SeriesController.IExecutorContext context)
		{
			IXYDiagram iXYDiagram = seriesController.Diagram as IXYDiagram;
			if (context.IsHeavyUpdate || (iXYDiagram != null && iXYDiagram.DependentValueRange && context.ShouldUpdateVisualPointIndicesOnly))
			{
				MinMaxValues minMaxValues = CopyValueAxisWholeRange(iXYDiagram);
				UpdateDiagramAxes(iXYDiagram, context.ShouldDeserializeRange);
				List<IAxisData> axesForReset = GetAxesForReset(context.UpdatedGroups);
				UpdateRange(context.RangeUpdateMode, axesForReset);
				MinMaxValues other = CopyValueAxisWholeRange(iXYDiagram);
				if (!minMaxValues.Equals(other))
				{
					return SeriesControllerChanges.ValueRangeChanged;
				}
			}
			return SeriesControllerChanges.NoChanges;
		}
	}
	internal class AggregatorUpdatesExecutor : IUpdateActionExecutor
	{
		private readonly SeriesController seriesController;

		public AggregatorUpdatesExecutor(SeriesController seriesController)
		{
			this.seriesController = seriesController;
		}

		private void UpdateCrosshairData(bool shouldUpdateCrosshair, ICollection<RefinedSeriesUpdateInfo> seriesUpdateInfo, ICollection<RefinedSeriesPointsUpdateInfo> pointsUpdateInfo)
		{
			if (seriesController.Diagram is IXYDiagram iXYDiagram)
			{
				if (shouldUpdateCrosshair)
				{
					seriesUpdateInfo = new List<RefinedSeriesUpdateInfo>
					{
						new RefinedSeriesUpdateInfo(ChartCollectionOperation.UpdateItem, seriesController.ActiveRefinedSeries)
					};
					pointsUpdateInfo = null;
				}
				if (seriesUpdateInfo.Count > 0 || pointsUpdateInfo.Count > 0)
				{
					iXYDiagram.UpdateCrosshairData(seriesUpdateInfo, pointsUpdateInfo);
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdatePointsIndices()
		{
			foreach (RefinedSeries item in seriesController.RefinedSeries)
			{
				item.UpdatePointsIndices();
			}
		}

		private void UpdateArgumentScale()
		{
			foreach (RefinedSeries item in seriesController.RefinedSeries)
			{
				item.RecalculateArgumentScale();
			}
		}

		public SeriesControllerChanges Execute(SeriesController.IExecutorContext context)
		{
			SeriesControllerChanges seriesControllerChanges = SeriesControllerChanges.NoChanges;
			if (context.IsHeavyUpdate)
			{
				seriesControllerChanges = SeriesControllerChanges.RefinedDataUpdated;
				UpdateCrosshairData(context.ShouldUpdateCrosshair, context.UpdatedSeriesInfo, context.UpdatedPointsInfo);
				if (context.ShouldUpdatePointsIndices)
				{
					UpdatePointsIndices();
				}
				if (context.ShouldRecalculateArgumentScale)
				{
					UpdateArgumentScale();
				}
				if (context.ShouldResetSelectedItems)
				{
					seriesControllerChanges |= SeriesControllerChanges.ShouldResetSelectedItems;
				}
				if (seriesController.Diagram is IXYDiagram && context.ShouldUpdateMeasureUnits)
				{
					seriesControllerChanges |= SeriesControllerChanges.ShouldUpdateMeasureUnits;
				}
				if (context.ShouldAnimateChart)
				{
					seriesControllerChanges |= SeriesControllerChanges.ShouldAnimateChart;
				}
			}
			if (context.ShouldUpdateVisualPointIndicesOnly)
			{
				seriesController.SeriesRepository.GroupController.CalculateFilteredIndexes();
			}
			return seriesControllerChanges;
		}
	}
	internal class SlaveSeriesExecutor : IUpdateActionExecutor
	{
		private SeriesController seriesController;

		public SlaveSeriesExecutor(SeriesController seriesController)
		{
			this.seriesController = seriesController;
		}

		public SeriesControllerChanges Execute(SeriesController.IExecutorContext context)
		{
			return SeriesControllerChanges.NoChanges;
		}
	}
	internal abstract class CollectionUpdateProcessor<T> : TypedUpdateProcessor<T> where T : CollectionUpdateInfo
	{
		protected virtual CommonActionType AdditionalUpdates => CommonActionType.UpdateCrosshair;

		protected override IList<IUpdateAction> TypedProcess(T updateInfo)
		{
			return new AggregatorUpdateAction[1]
			{
				new AggregatorUpdateAction(AdditionalUpdates | CommonActionType.UpdateMeasureUnits | CommonActionType.ResetSelectedItems | CommonActionType.AnimateChart)
			};
		}
	}
	internal class SeriesPointCollectionUpdateProcessor : CollectionUpdateProcessor<SeriesPointCollectionUpdateInfo>, ICollectionUpdateProcessor
	{
		private bool hasInsertUpdates;

		private bool hasRemoveUpdates;

		protected override CommonActionType AdditionalUpdates => CommonActionType.Empty;

		bool ICollectionUpdateProcessor.HasInsertUpdates => hasInsertUpdates;

		bool ICollectionUpdateProcessor.HasRemoveUpdates => hasRemoveUpdates;

		internal IList<SeriesPointsCollectionAction> GenerateAction(SeriesPointCollectionUpdateInfo updateInfo)
		{
			IList<SeriesPointsCollectionAction> list = new List<SeriesPointsCollectionAction>();
			switch (updateInfo.Operation)
			{
			case ChartCollectionOperation.Reset:
				list.Add(SeriesPointsCollectionAction.CreateCleanInfo(updateInfo.Series));
				break;
			case ChartCollectionOperation.InsertItem:
				hasInsertUpdates = true;
				list.Add(SeriesPointsCollectionAction.CreateInsertInfo(updateInfo.Series, new List<IDataPoint> { updateInfo.NewItem }, updateInfo.NewIndex));
				break;
			case ChartCollectionOperation.RemoveItem:
				hasRemoveUpdates = true;
				list.Add(SeriesPointsCollectionAction.CreateRemoveInfo(updateInfo.Series, new List<IDataPoint> { updateInfo.OldItem }, updateInfo.OldIndex));
				break;
			case ChartCollectionOperation.UpdateItem:
				list.Add(SeriesPointsCollectionAction.CreateRemoveInfo(updateInfo.Series, new List<IDataPoint> { updateInfo.OldItem }, updateInfo.OldIndex));
				list.Add(SeriesPointsCollectionAction.CreateInsertInfo(updateInfo.Series, new List<IDataPoint> { updateInfo.NewItem }, updateInfo.OldIndex));
				break;
			case ChartCollectionOperation.MoveItem:
				list.Add(new SeriesPointsCollectionAction(updateInfo.Series, updateInfo.NewIndex, updateInfo.OldIndex, CollectionActionType.MoveInCollection));
				break;
			case ChartCollectionOperation.SwapItem:
				list.Add(new SeriesPointsCollectionAction(updateInfo.Series, updateInfo.NewIndex, updateInfo.OldIndex, CollectionActionType.SwapInCollection));
				break;
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected override IList<IUpdateAction> TypedProcess(SeriesPointCollectionUpdateInfo updateInfo)
		{
			List<IUpdateAction> list = new List<IUpdateAction>();
			list.AddRange(base.TypedProcess(updateInfo));
			list.AddRange(GenerateAction(updateInfo));
			return list;
		}
	}
	internal class SeriesPointCollectionBatchUpdateProcessor : CollectionUpdateProcessor<SeriesPointCollectionBatchUpdateInfo>, ICollectionUpdateProcessor
	{
		private bool hasInsertUpdates;

		private bool hasRemoveUpdates;

		protected override CommonActionType AdditionalUpdates => CommonActionType.Empty;

		bool ICollectionUpdateProcessor.HasInsertUpdates => hasInsertUpdates;

		bool ICollectionUpdateProcessor.HasRemoveUpdates => hasRemoveUpdates;

		internal IList<SeriesPointsCollectionAction> GenerateAction(SeriesPointCollectionBatchUpdateInfo updateInfo)
		{
			IList<SeriesPointsCollectionAction> list = new List<SeriesPointsCollectionAction>();
			switch (updateInfo.Operation)
			{
			case ChartCollectionOperation.Reset:
				list.Add(SeriesPointsCollectionAction.CreateCleanInfo(updateInfo.Series));
				break;
			case ChartCollectionOperation.InsertItem:
				hasInsertUpdates = true;
				list.Add(SeriesPointsCollectionAction.CreateInsertInfo(updateInfo.Series, updateInfo.NewItem, updateInfo.NewIndex));
				break;
			case ChartCollectionOperation.RemoveItem:
				hasRemoveUpdates = true;
				list.Add(SeriesPointsCollectionAction.CreateRemoveInfo(updateInfo.Series, updateInfo.OldItem, updateInfo.OldIndex));
				break;
			case ChartCollectionOperation.UpdateItem:
				list.Add(SeriesPointsCollectionAction.CreateRemoveInfo(updateInfo.Series, updateInfo.OldItem, updateInfo.OldIndex));
				list.Add(SeriesPointsCollectionAction.CreateInsertInfo(updateInfo.Series, updateInfo.NewItem, updateInfo.OldIndex));
				break;
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected override IList<IUpdateAction> TypedProcess(SeriesPointCollectionBatchUpdateInfo updateInfo)
		{
			List<IUpdateAction> list = new List<IUpdateAction>();
			list.AddRange(base.TypedProcess(updateInfo));
			list.AddRange(GenerateAction(updateInfo));
			return list;
		}
	}
	internal abstract class AxisCollectionUpdateProcessorBase<T> : CollectionUpdateProcessor<T> where T : CollectionUpdateInfo
	{
		private IUpdateAction UpdateAxis(IAxisData axis, ChartCollectionOperation operation)
		{
			return operation switch
			{
				ChartCollectionOperation.Reset => new UpdateGroupAction(axis, CollectionActionType.CleanCollection), 
				ChartCollectionOperation.InsertItem => new UpdateGroupAction(axis, CollectionActionType.InsertInCollection), 
				ChartCollectionOperation.RemoveItem => new UpdateGroupAction(axis, CollectionActionType.RemoveFromCollection), 
				_ => null, 
			};
		}

		protected IList<IUpdateAction> UpdateAxesCollection(IEnumerable<IAxisData> axesList, ChartCollectionOperation operation)
		{
			List<IUpdateAction> list = new List<IUpdateAction>();
			foreach (IAxisData axes in axesList)
			{
				IUpdateAction updateAction = UpdateAxis(axes, operation);
				if (updateAction != null)
				{
					list.Add(updateAction);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}
	}
	internal class AxisCollectionBatchUpdateProcessor : AxisCollectionUpdateProcessorBase<AxisCollectionBatchUpdateInfo>
	{
		protected override IList<IUpdateAction> TypedProcess(AxisCollectionBatchUpdateInfo updateInfo)
		{
			List<IUpdateAction> list = new List<IUpdateAction>();
			list.AddRange(base.TypedProcess(updateInfo));
			list.AddRange(UpdateAxesCollection(updateInfo.NewItem, updateInfo.Operation));
			if (updateInfo.OldItem != null)
			{
				list.AddRange(UpdateAxesCollection(updateInfo.OldItem, updateInfo.Operation));
			}
			return list;
		}
	}
	internal class AxisCollectionUpdateProcessor : AxisCollectionUpdateProcessorBase<AxisCollectionUpdateInfo>
	{
		protected override IList<IUpdateAction> TypedProcess(AxisCollectionUpdateInfo updateInfo)
		{
			List<IAxisData> list = new List<IAxisData> { updateInfo.NewItem };
			if (updateInfo.OldItem != null)
			{
				list.Add(updateInfo.OldItem);
			}
			List<IUpdateAction> list2 = new List<IUpdateAction>();
			list2.AddRange(base.TypedProcess(updateInfo));
			list2.AddRange(UpdateAxesCollection(list, updateInfo.Operation));
			return list2;
		}
	}
	internal class SeriesCollectionBatchUpdateProcessor : CollectionUpdateProcessor<SeriesCollectionBatchUpdateInfo>
	{
		protected override CommonActionType AdditionalUpdates => CommonActionType.Empty;

		protected override IList<IUpdateAction> TypedProcess(SeriesCollectionBatchUpdateInfo updateInfo)
		{
			List<IUpdateAction> list = new List<IUpdateAction>();
			list.AddRange(base.TypedProcess(updateInfo));
			switch (updateInfo.Operation)
			{
			case ChartCollectionOperation.InsertItem:
			{
				int num = 0;
				foreach (ISeries item in updateInfo.NewItem)
				{
					list.Add(new SeriesCollectionAction(updateInfo.NewIndex + num++, item, CollectionActionType.InsertInCollection));
				}
				break;
			}
			case ChartCollectionOperation.RemoveItem:
				if (updateInfo.OldIndex < 0 || updateInfo.OldItem == null)
				{
					break;
				}
				foreach (ISeries item2 in updateInfo.OldItem)
				{
					list.Add(new SeriesCollectionAction(item2, CollectionActionType.RemoveFromCollection));
				}
				break;
			default:
				throw new NotSupportedException("The batch " + updateInfo.Operation.ToString() + " operation doesn't supported");
			}
			return list;
		}
	}
	internal class SeriesCollectionUpdateProcessor : CollectionUpdateProcessor<SeriesCollectionUpdateInfo>
	{
		protected override CommonActionType AdditionalUpdates => CommonActionType.Empty;

		protected override IList<IUpdateAction> TypedProcess(SeriesCollectionUpdateInfo updateInfo)
		{
			List<IUpdateAction> list = new List<IUpdateAction>();
			list.AddRange(base.TypedProcess(updateInfo));
			switch (updateInfo.Operation)
			{
			case ChartCollectionOperation.Reset:
				list.Add(new SeriesCollectionAction(CollectionActionType.CleanCollection));
				break;
			case ChartCollectionOperation.InsertItem:
				list.Add(new SeriesCollectionAction(updateInfo.NewIndex, updateInfo.NewItem, CollectionActionType.InsertInCollection));
				break;
			case ChartCollectionOperation.RemoveItem:
				list.Add(new SeriesCollectionAction(updateInfo.OldItem, CollectionActionType.RemoveFromCollection));
				break;
			case ChartCollectionOperation.UpdateItem:
				list.Add(new SeriesCollectionAction(updateInfo.OldItem, CollectionActionType.RemoveFromCollection));
				list.Add(new SeriesCollectionAction(updateInfo.OldIndex, updateInfo.NewItem, CollectionActionType.InsertInCollection));
				break;
			case ChartCollectionOperation.MoveItem:
				list.Add(new SeriesCollectionAction(updateInfo.OldIndex, updateInfo.NewIndex, CollectionActionType.MoveInCollection));
				break;
			case ChartCollectionOperation.SwapItem:
				list.Add(new SeriesCollectionAction(updateInfo.OldIndex, updateInfo.NewIndex, CollectionActionType.SwapInCollection));
				break;
			}
			return list;
		}
	}

	internal class AxisElementUpdateProcessor : TypedUpdateProcessor<AxisElementUpdateInfo>
	{
		protected override IList<IUpdateAction> TypedProcess(AxisElementUpdateInfo updateInfo)
		{
			List<IUpdateAction> list = new List<IUpdateAction>();
			list.Add(new UpdateAxisAction(updateInfo.Axis, AxisActionType.UpdateScaleMap));
			list.Add(new AggregatorUpdateAction(CommonActionType.UpdateCrosshair));
			return list;
		}
	}
	internal class SeriesPointPropertiesUpdateProcessor : TypedUpdateProcessor<PropertyUpdateInfo<ISeries, IDataPoint>>
	{
		protected override bool CanProcess(ChartUpdateInfoBase updateInfo)
		{
			if (base.CanProcess(updateInfo))
			{
				string name = ((PropertyUpdateInfo)updateInfo).Name;
				if (name == "Values" || name == "Argument")
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override IList<IUpdateAction> TypedProcess(PropertyUpdateInfo<ISeries, IDataPoint> updateInfo)
		{
			List<IUpdateAction> list = new List<IUpdateAction>();
			list.Add(new UpdateSeriesPointAction(updateInfo.Owner, updateInfo.Sender as IDataPoint));
			list.Add(new AggregatorUpdateAction(CommonActionType.AnimateChart));
			return list;
		}
	}
	internal class AxisPropertiesUpdateProcessor : TypedUpdateProcessor<PropertyUpdateInfo, IAxisData>
	{
		protected override IList<IUpdateAction> TypedProcess(PropertyUpdateInfo updateInfo, IAxisData axis)
		{
			string name = updateInfo.Name;
			List<IUpdateAction> list = new List<IUpdateAction>();
			if (name == "QualitativeScaleComparer")
			{
				list.Add(new UpdateAxisAction(axis, AxisActionType.UpdateSeriesGroup));
				list.Add(new AggregatorUpdateAction(CommonActionType.UpdateCrosshair));
			}
			else if (name == "GridAlignment")
			{
				list.Add(new AggregatorUpdateAction(CommonActionType.UpdateCrosshair));
			}
			else
			{
				switch (name)
				{
				case "WorkdaysOnly":
				case "Workdays":
				case "Holidays":
				case "ExactWorkdays":
				case "WorkTimeOnly":
				case "WorkTimeRules":
				case "Weekdays":
				case "IsActive":
				case "Date":
				case "WorkIntervals":
				case "StartHour":
				case "StartMinute":
				case "StartSecond":
				case "EndHour":
				case "EndMinute":
				case "EndSecond":
					if (axis.IsArgumentAxis)
					{
						list.Add(new UpdateAxisAction(axis, AxisActionType.UpdatePointsFilter | AxisActionType.UpdatePointsAggregation));
						list.Add(new AggregatorUpdateAction(CommonActionType.UpdateSeriesGroupsInteraction | CommonActionType.UpdateCrosshair | CommonActionType.UpdateIndicators));
					}
					else if (axis.DateTimeScaleOptions.ScaleMode == ScaleModeNative.Continuous)
					{
						list.Add(new UpdateAxisAction(axis, AxisActionType.UpdateSeriesGroup));
						list.Add(new AggregatorUpdateAction(CommonActionType.UpdateCrosshair));
					}
					break;
				case "MeasureUnit":
				case "MeasureUnitMultiplier":
				case "AutoMeasureUnit":
				case "AutomaticMeasureUnitsCalculator":
				case "CustomMeasureUnit":
				case "DateTimeMeasureUnit":
				case "ActualDateTimeMeasureUnit":
				case "NumericScaleOptions":
				case "DateTimeScaleOptions":
				case "TimeSpanScaleOptions":
				case "GridAlignment":
				case "AggregateFunction":
				case "CustomAggregateFunction":
				case "ScaleMode":
				case "ProcessMissingPoints":
				case "DataAggregation":
				case "IntervalOptions":
				case "UnderflowValue":
				case "OverflowValue":
				case "Width":
				case "Count":
					if (axis.IsArgumentAxis)
					{
						list.Add(new UpdateAxisAction(axis, AxisActionType.UpdatePointsAggregation));
					}
					list.Add(new AggregatorUpdateAction(CommonActionType.UpdateSeriesGroupsInteraction | CommonActionType.UpdateCrosshair | CommonActionType.UpdateIndicators));
					break;
				case "SkipRangesWithoutPoints":
					if (axis.IsArgumentAxis)
					{
						list.Add(new UpdateAxisAction(axis, AxisActionType.UpdateSeriesGroup));
						list.Add(new AggregatorUpdateAction(CommonActionType.UpdateSeriesGroupsInteraction | CommonActionType.UpdateCrosshair | CommonActionType.UpdateIndicators));
					}
					break;
				}
			}
			if (list.Count > 0)
			{
				list.Add(new AggregatorUpdateAction(CommonActionType.UpdateMeasureUnits));
			}
			return list;
		}
	}
	internal class XYSeriesViewPropertyUpdateProcessor : TypedUpdateProcessor<PropertyUpdateInfo<IAxisData>, ISeriesView>
	{
		private bool IsQualitativeScaleType(IAxisData axis)
		{
			if (axis != null && axis.AxisScaleTypeMap != null)
			{
				return axis.AxisScaleTypeMap.ScaleType == ActualScaleTypeCore.Qualitative;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override IList<IUpdateAction> TypedProcess(PropertyUpdateInfo<IAxisData> updateInfo, ISeriesView sender)
		{
			List<IUpdateAction> list = new List<IUpdateAction>();
			if (updateInfo.OldValue != updateInfo.NewValue)
			{
				list.Add(new UpdateSeriesAction(sender.Owner, SeriesActionType.RemoveRefinedSeriesFromGroup));
				if (IsQualitativeScaleType(updateInfo.OldValue))
				{
					list.Add(new UpdateAxisAction(updateInfo.OldValue, AxisActionType.RemoveSeriesGroup));
				}
				if (IsQualitativeScaleType(updateInfo.NewValue))
				{
					list.Add(new UpdateAxisAction(updateInfo.NewValue, AxisActionType.RemoveSeriesGroup));
				}
			}
			if (updateInfo.Name == "Pane")
			{
				list.Add(new UpdateSeriesAction(sender.Owner, SeriesActionType.RemoveRefinedSeriesFromGroup));
			}
			list.Add(new AggregatorUpdateAction(CommonActionType.UpdateCrosshair | CommonActionType.UpdateMeasureUnits | CommonActionType.AnimateChart));
			return list;
		}
	}
	internal class DiagramPropertyUpdateProcessor : TypedUpdateProcessor<PropertyUpdateInfo<IAxisData>, IDiagram>
	{
		private bool IsQualitativeScaleType(IAxisData axis)
		{
			if (axis != null && axis.AxisScaleTypeMap != null)
			{
				return axis.AxisScaleTypeMap.ScaleType == ActualScaleTypeCore.Qualitative;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override IList<IUpdateAction> TypedProcess(PropertyUpdateInfo<IAxisData> updateInfo, IDiagram sender)
		{
			List<IUpdateAction> list = new List<IUpdateAction>();
			if (updateInfo.OldValue != updateInfo.NewValue)
			{
				list.Add(new UpdateAxisAction(updateInfo.OldValue, AxisActionType.RemoveSeriesGroup));
				if (IsQualitativeScaleType(updateInfo.NewValue))
				{
					list.Add(new UpdateAxisAction(updateInfo.NewValue, AxisActionType.RemoveSeriesGroup));
				}
			}
			else if (updateInfo.Name == "DefaultPane")
			{
				list.Add(new AggregatorUpdateAction(CommonActionType.UpdateSeriesGroupsInteractionKeys));
			}
			list.Add(new AggregatorUpdateAction(CommonActionType.UpdateCrosshair | CommonActionType.UpdateMeasureUnits | CommonActionType.AnimateChart));
			return list;
		}
	}
	internal class SeriesPropertiesUpdateProcessor : TypedUpdateProcessor<PropertyUpdateInfo, ISeriesBase>
	{
		protected override IList<IUpdateAction> TypedProcess(PropertyUpdateInfo updateInfo, ISeriesBase sender)
		{
			List<IUpdateAction> list = new List<IUpdateAction>();
			if (updateInfo.Name == "StackedGroup" || updateInfo.Name == "ValueScaleType" || updateInfo.Name == "ValueOptions")
			{
				list.Add(new UpdateSeriesAction(sender, SeriesActionType.RemoveRefinedSeriesFromGroup));
				list.Add(new AggregatorUpdateAction(CommonActionType.UpdateCrosshair | CommonActionType.AnimateChart));
			}
			else if (updateInfo.Name == "SeriesPointKey")
			{
				list.Add(new UpdateSeriesAction(sender, SeriesActionType.RemoveRefinedSeriesFromGroup | SeriesActionType.UpdateSeriesPointKey));
				list.Add(new AggregatorUpdateAction(CommonActionType.AnimateChart));
			}
			else if (updateInfo.Name == "CrosshairEnabled")
			{
				list.Add(new AggregatorUpdateAction(CommonActionType.UpdateCrosshair));
			}
			else if (updateInfo.Name == "SortingMode")
			{
				list.Add(new AggregatorUpdateAction(CommonActionType.UpdateCrosshair | CommonActionType.AnimateChart));
				list.Add(new UpdateSeriesAction(sender, SeriesActionType.RemoveRefinedSeriesFromGroup | SeriesActionType.UpdateSeriesPointMode));
			}
			else if (updateInfo.Name == "ArgumentScaleType")
			{
				list.Add(new AggregatorUpdateAction(CommonActionType.UpdateCrosshair | CommonActionType.UpdateIndicators | CommonActionType.AnimateChart));
				list.Add(new UpdateSeriesAction(sender, SeriesActionType.UpdateAutoScale | SeriesActionType.RemoveRefinedSeriesFromGroup));
			}
			else if (updateInfo.Name == "PointsFilterOptions")
			{
				list.Add(new AggregatorUpdateAction(CommonActionType.UpdateCrosshair | CommonActionType.AnimateChart));
				list.Add(new UpdateSeriesAction(sender, SeriesActionType.UpdatePointsFilter));
			}
			else if (updateInfo.Name == "Points")
			{
				list.Add(new AggregatorUpdateAction(CommonActionType.UpdateSeriesGroupsInteraction | CommonActionType.UpdateCrosshair | CommonActionType.UpdateMeasureUnits | CommonActionType.UpdateIndicators | CommonActionType.AnimateChart));
				list.Add(new UpdateSeriesAction(sender, SeriesActionType.UpdateAutoScale | SeriesActionType.RemoveRefinedSeriesFromGroup | SeriesActionType.UpdateRefinedSeriesData));
			}
			else if (updateInfo.Name == "CheckedInLegend" || updateInfo.Name == "Visible")
			{
				list.Add(new AggregatorUpdateAction(CommonActionType.UpdateSeriesGroupsInteraction | CommonActionType.UpdateCrosshair | CommonActionType.UpdateIndicators));
			}
			else if (updateInfo.Name == "View" || updateInfo.Name == "Pane")
			{
				list.Add(new AggregatorUpdateAction(CommonActionType.UpdateCrosshair | CommonActionType.AnimateChart));
				list.Add(new UpdateSeriesAction(sender, SeriesActionType.RemoveRefinedSeriesFromGroup));
			}
			else if (updateInfo.Name == "AggregateFunction" || updateInfo.Name == "CustomAggregateFunction")
			{
				list.Add(new UpdateSeriesAction(sender, SeriesActionType.UpdateInteraction));
				list.Add(new AggregatorUpdateAction(CommonActionType.UpdateSeriesGroupsInteraction | CommonActionType.UpdateCrosshair | CommonActionType.AnimateChart));
			}
			return list;
		}
	}

	{
		Empty = 0,
		UpdateSeriesGroupsInteraction = 1,
		UpdateCrosshair = 2,
		ResetSelectedItems = 4,
		DeserializeRange = 8,
		UpdatePointsIndices = 0x10,
		UpdateMeasureUnits = 0x20,
		Commit = 0x40,
		RaiseWholeRangeChanged = 0x80,
		RaiseVisualRangeChanged = 0x100,
		RecalculateArgumentScale = 0x200,
		UpdateVisualPointIndicesOnly = 0x400,
		EndLoading = 0x800,
		UpdateSeriesGroupsInteractionKeys = 0x1000,
		UpdateIndicators = 0x2000,
		AnimateChart = 0x4000
	}

	public enum SeriesActionType
	{
		Empty = 0,
		UpdateInteraction = 1,
		UpdateAutoScale = 2,
		RemoveRefinedSeriesFromGroup = 4,
		UpdateRefinedSeriesData = 8,
		UpdateSeriesPointKey = 0x10,
		UpdateSeriesPointMode = 0x20,
		UpdatePointsFilter = 0x40,
		UpdatePointsValuesOnly = 0x80
	}

	public enum AxisActionType
	{
		UpdateScaleMap = 1,
		RemoveSeriesGroup = 2,
		UpdatePointsFilter = 4,
		UpdateSeriesGroup = 8,
		UpdatePointsAggregation = 0x10
	}

	internal enum CollectionActionType
	{
		InsertInCollection = 1,
		RemoveFromCollection = 2,
		MoveInCollection = 4,
		SwapInCollection = 8,
		CleanCollection = 0x10
	}

	internal interface IUpdateAction
	{
	}
	internal interface ISeriesUpdateAction : IUpdateAction
	{
		ISeriesBase Series { get; }
	}
	internal class ChartUpdateAggregator
	{
		internal enum GroupAction
		{
			NotCompatibleAction,
			CompatibleActionOnlyBySender,
			CompatibleAction,
			RefreshGroup,
			RemoveGroup
		}

		internal class GroupInfo
		{
			public GroupAction GroupAction { get; private set; }

			public int SeriesIndex { get; private set; }

			public GroupInfo(GroupAction action)
				: this(action, -1)
			{
			}

			public GroupInfo(GroupAction action, int seriesIndex)
			{
				GroupAction = action;
				SeriesIndex = seriesIndex;
			}
		}

		internal abstract class UpdateActionsGroupBase
		{
			private readonly List<IUpdateAction> updates = new List<IUpdateAction>();

			public static UpdateActionsGroupBase CreateGroup(IUpdateAction action)
			{
				if (action is ISeriesUpdateAction)
				{
					return new UpdateSeriesActionsGroup(action);
				}
				if (action is UpdateAxisActionBase)
				{
					return new UpdateAxisActionsGroup((UpdateAxisActionBase)action);
				}
				throw new NotSupportedException($"Special group is not exist for {action.GetType().Name} action");
			}

			protected abstract GroupInfo NeedAddUpdate(IUpdateAction action);

			public abstract void RefreshAfterRemoveGroup(int seriesIndex);

			public GroupInfo TryAdd(IUpdateAction action)
			{
				GroupInfo groupInfo = NeedAddUpdate(action);
				if (groupInfo.GroupAction == GroupAction.CompatibleAction || groupInfo.GroupAction == GroupAction.RefreshGroup)
				{
					updates.Add(action);
				}
				return groupInfo;
			}

			protected void Add(IUpdateAction action)
			{
				updates.Add(action);
			}

			protected void Remove(IUpdateAction action)
			{
				updates.Remove(action);
			}

			public IEnumerable<T> GetUpdates<T>() where T : IUpdateAction
			{
				foreach (IUpdateAction update in updates)
				{
					if (update is T)
					{
						yield return (T)update;
					}
				}
			}

			public void Clear()
			{
				updates.Clear();
			}
		}

		internal class UpdateSeriesActionsGroup : UpdateActionsGroupBase
		{
			private readonly ISeriesBase series;

			public UpdateSeriesActionsGroup(IUpdateAction action)
			{
				series = ((ISeriesUpdateAction)action).Series;
				Add(action);
			}

			private void RemovePreviousPointsUpdates(SeriesPointsCollectionAction pointsAction)
			{
				if (pointsAction.UpdateType == CollectionActionType.CleanCollection)
				{
					RemovePreviousPointsUpdates(pointsAction.Series);
				}
			}

			private void RemovePreviousPointsUpdates(ISeries series)
			{
				List<IUpdateAction> list = new List<IUpdateAction>();
				foreach (SeriesPointsCollectionActionBase update in GetUpdates<SeriesPointsCollectionActionBase>())
				{
					if (update.Series == series)
					{
						list.Add(update);
					}
				}
				foreach (IUpdateAction item in list)
				{
					Remove(item);
				}
			}

			protected override GroupInfo NeedAddUpdate(IUpdateAction action)
			{
				if (!(action is ISeriesUpdateAction seriesUpdateAction))
				{
					return new GroupInfo(GroupAction.NotCompatibleAction);
				}
				if (action is SeriesCollectionAction && ActionTypeHelper.ShouldCleanCollection((action as SeriesCollectionAction).UpdateType))
				{
					Clear();
					return new GroupInfo(GroupAction.RemoveGroup);
				}
				if (seriesUpdateAction.Series != series || (action is SeriesCollectionAction && ActionTypeHelper.ShouldMoveInCollection((action as SeriesCollectionAction).UpdateType)))
				{
					return new GroupInfo(GroupAction.NotCompatibleAction);
				}
				if (action is SeriesCollectionAction && ActionTypeHelper.ShouldRemoveFromCollection((action as SeriesCollectionAction).UpdateType))
				{
					GroupInfo groupInfo = null;
					foreach (SeriesCollectionAction update in GetUpdates<SeriesCollectionAction>())
					{
						if (ActionTypeHelper.ShouldInsertInCollection(update.UpdateType))
						{
							groupInfo = new GroupInfo(GroupAction.RefreshGroup, update.Index);
						}
					}
					Clear();
					if (groupInfo != null)
					{
						return groupInfo;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					foreach (SeriesCollectionAction update2 in GetUpdates<SeriesCollectionAction>())
					{
						if (ActionTypeHelper.ShouldInsertInCollection(update2.UpdateType))
						{
							return new GroupInfo(GroupAction.CompatibleActionOnlyBySender);
						}
					}
					if (action is UpdateSeriesAction)
					{
						using IEnumerator<UpdateSeriesAction> enumerator3 = GetUpdates<UpdateSeriesAction>().GetEnumerator();
						if (enumerator3.MoveNext())
						{
							UpdateSeriesAction current3 = enumerator3.Current;
							current3.AddActionType(((UpdateSeriesAction)action).UpdateType);
							return new GroupInfo(GroupAction.CompatibleActionOnlyBySender);
						}
					}
					else if (action is UpdateSeriesPointAction)
					{
						foreach (UpdateSeriesPointAction update3 in GetUpdates<UpdateSeriesPointAction>())
						{
							if (((UpdateSeriesPointAction)action).SeriesPoint == update3.SeriesPoint)
							{
								return new GroupInfo(GroupAction.CompatibleActionOnlyBySender);
							}
						}
					}
					else if (action is SeriesPointsCollectionAction)
					{
						RemovePreviousPointsUpdates((SeriesPointsCollectionAction)action);
					}
					else if (action is SeriesCollectionAction && ActionTypeHelper.ShouldInsertInCollection(((SeriesCollectionAction)action).UpdateType))
					{
						RemovePreviousPointsUpdates(((SeriesCollectionAction)action).Series);
					}
				}
				return new GroupInfo(GroupAction.CompatibleAction);
			}

			public override void RefreshAfterRemoveGroup(int seriesIndex)
			{
				foreach (SeriesCollectionAction update in GetUpdates<SeriesCollectionAction>())
				{
					if (update.Index > seriesIndex)
					{
						update.Index--;
					}
					if (update.OldIndex > seriesIndex)
					{
						update.OldIndex--;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		internal class UpdateAxisActionsGroup : UpdateActionsGroupBase
		{
			private readonly IAxisData axis;

			public UpdateAxisActionsGroup(UpdateAxisActionBase action)
			{
				axis = action.Axis;
				Add(action);
			}

			protected override GroupInfo NeedAddUpdate(IUpdateAction action)
			{
				if (!(action is UpdateAxisActionBase updateAxisActionBase) || updateAxisActionBase.Axis != axis)
				{
					return new GroupInfo(GroupAction.NotCompatibleAction);
				}
				if (action is UpdateAxisAction)
				{
					using IEnumerator<UpdateAxisAction> enumerator = GetUpdates<UpdateAxisAction>().GetEnumerator();
					if (enumerator.MoveNext())
					{
						UpdateAxisAction current = enumerator.Current;
						current.AddActionType(((UpdateAxisAction)action).UpdateType);
						return new GroupInfo(GroupAction.CompatibleActionOnlyBySender);
					}
				}
				return new GroupInfo(GroupAction.CompatibleAction);
			}

			public override void RefreshAfterRemoveGroup(int seriesIndex)
			{
			}
		}

		private readonly List<UpdateActionsGroupBase> updateGroups = new List<UpdateActionsGroupBase>();

		private readonly List<UpdateActionsGroupBase> groupsToRemove = new List<UpdateActionsGroupBase>();

		private CommonActionType aggregatorActionType;

		public CommonActionType UpdateType => aggregatorActionType;

		private void Add(IUpdateAction update)
		{
			if (update == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (UpdateActionsGroupBase updateGroup in updateGroups)
			{
				GroupInfo groupInfo = updateGroup.TryAdd(update);
				switch (groupInfo.GroupAction)
				{
				case GroupAction.CompatibleActionOnlyBySender:
				case GroupAction.CompatibleAction:
					return;
				case GroupAction.RefreshGroup:
					RefreshGroups(groupInfo.SeriesIndex);
					return;
				case GroupAction.RemoveGroup:
					groupsToRemove.Add(updateGroup);
					break;
				}
			}
			updateGroups.Add(UpdateActionsGroupBase.CreateGroup(update));
		}

		private void Add(AggregatorUpdateAction update)
		{
			if (update != null)
			{
				aggregatorActionType |= update.UpdateType;
			}
		}

		private void RefreshGroups(int removedSeriesIndex)
		{
			foreach (UpdateActionsGroupBase updateGroup in updateGroups)
			{
				updateGroup.RefreshAfterRemoveGroup(removedSeriesIndex);
			}
		}

		private void RemoveGroups()
		{
			foreach (UpdateActionsGroupBase item in groupsToRemove)
			{
				updateGroups.Remove(item);
			}
			groupsToRemove.Clear();
		}

		public void AddRange(IEnumerable<IUpdateAction> updates)
		{
			foreach (IUpdateAction update2 in updates)
			{
				if (update2 is AggregatorUpdateAction update)
				{
					Add(update);
				}
				else
				{
					Add(update2);
				}
			}
			RemoveGroups();
		}

		public IEnumerable<T> GetUpdates<T>() where T : IUpdateAction
		{
			List<T> list = new List<T>();
			foreach (UpdateActionsGroupBase updateGroup in updateGroups)
			{
				list.AddRange(updateGroup.GetUpdates<T>());
			}
			return list;
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			foreach (UpdateActionsGroupBase updateGroup in updateGroups)
			{
				updateGroup.Clear();
			}
		}

		public SeriesControllerChanges GetSeriesControllerChanges()
		{
			SeriesControllerChanges seriesControllerChanges = SeriesControllerChanges.NoChanges;
			if (ActionTypeHelper.ShouldUpdateVisualPointIndicesOnly(aggregatorActionType))
			{
				if (ActionTypeHelper.ShouldRaiseWholeRangeChanged(aggregatorActionType))
				{
					seriesControllerChanges |= SeriesControllerChanges.WholeArgumentRangeUpdated;
				}
				if (ActionTypeHelper.ShouldRaiseVisualRangeChanged(aggregatorActionType))
				{
					seriesControllerChanges |= SeriesControllerChanges.VisualArgumentRangeUpdated;
				}
			}
			return seriesControllerChanges;
		}
	}

	internal interface IUpdateProcessor
	{
		IList<IUpdateAction> Process(ChartUpdateInfoBase updateInfo);

		bool CanProcess(ChartUpdateInfoBase updateInfo);

		bool ShouldForceUpdate();
	}
	internal interface ICollectionUpdateProcessor
	{
		bool HasInsertUpdates { get; }

		bool HasRemoveUpdates { get; }
	}
	internal abstract class TypedUpdateProcessor<T> : IUpdateProcessor where T : ChartUpdateInfoBase
	{
		protected virtual bool CanProcess(ChartUpdateInfoBase updateInfo)
		{
			if (updateInfo != null)
			{
				return updateInfo is T;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected virtual bool ShouldForceUpdate()
		{
			return false;
		}

		protected abstract IList<IUpdateAction> TypedProcess(T updateInfo);

		protected virtual IList<IUpdateAction> Process(ChartUpdateInfoBase updateInfo)
		{
			List<IUpdateAction> list = new List<IUpdateAction>();
			if (updateInfo is T)
			{
				list.AddRange(TypedProcess((T)updateInfo));
			}
			list.Add(new AggregatorUpdateAction(CommonActionType.Commit));
			return list;
		}

		IList<IUpdateAction> IUpdateProcessor.Process(ChartUpdateInfoBase updateInfo)
		{
			return Process(updateInfo);
		}

		bool IUpdateProcessor.CanProcess(ChartUpdateInfoBase updateInfo)
		{
			return CanProcess(updateInfo);
		}

		bool IUpdateProcessor.ShouldForceUpdate()
		{
			return ShouldForceUpdate();
		}
	}
	internal class GroupProcessor<T, S> : GroupProcessor<T> where T : ChartUpdateInfoBase
	{
		public GroupProcessor(params IUpdateProcessor[] children)
			: base(children)
		{
		}

		protected override bool CanProcess(ChartUpdateInfoBase updateInfo)
		{
			if (updateInfo != null && updateInfo.Sender is S)
			{
				return base.CanProcess(updateInfo);
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	internal class GroupProcessor<T> : TypedUpdateProcessor<T> where T : ChartUpdateInfoBase
	{
		private readonly IUpdateProcessor[] children;

		public GroupProcessor(params IUpdateProcessor[] children)
		{
			this.children = children;
		}

		protected override bool CanProcess(ChartUpdateInfoBase updateInfo)
		{
			if (base.CanProcess(updateInfo))
			{
				IUpdateProcessor[] array = children;
				foreach (IUpdateProcessor updateProcessor in array)
				{
					if (updateProcessor.CanProcess(updateInfo))
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override bool ShouldForceUpdate()
		{
			bool flag = false;
			bool flag2 = false;
			IUpdateProcessor[] array = children;
			foreach (IUpdateProcessor updateProcessor in array)
			{
				if (updateProcessor is ICollectionUpdateProcessor collectionUpdateProcessor)
				{
					flag = collectionUpdateProcessor.HasInsertUpdates || flag;
					flag2 = collectionUpdateProcessor.HasRemoveUpdates || flag2;
					if (flag && flag2)
					{
						break;
					}
				}
				else if (updateProcessor.ShouldForceUpdate())
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return flag && flag2;
		}

		protected override IList<IUpdateAction> TypedProcess(T updateInfo)
		{
			return new List<IUpdateAction>();
		}

		protected override IList<IUpdateAction> Process(ChartUpdateInfoBase updateInfo)
		{
			List<IUpdateAction> result = new List<IUpdateAction>();
			IUpdateProcessor[] array = children;
			foreach (IUpdateProcessor updateProcessor in array)
			{
				if (updateProcessor.CanProcess(updateInfo))
				{
					return updateProcessor.Process(updateInfo);
				}
			}
			return result;
		}
	}
	internal abstract class TypedUpdateProcessor<T, S> : TypedUpdateProcessor<T> where T : ChartUpdateInfoBase
	{
		protected override bool CanProcess(ChartUpdateInfoBase updateInfo)
		{
			if (base.CanProcess(updateInfo))
			{
				return updateInfo.Sender is S;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected abstract IList<IUpdateAction> TypedProcess(T updateInfo, S sender);

		protected override IList<IUpdateAction> TypedProcess(T updateInfo)
		{
			return TypedProcess(updateInfo, (S)updateInfo.Sender);
		}
	}

	internal class OnLoadEndUpdateProcessor : TypedUpdateProcessor<OnLoadEndUpdateInfo>
	{
		private readonly SeriesController controller;

		public OnLoadEndUpdateProcessor(SeriesController controller)
		{
			this.controller = controller;
		}

		protected override IList<IUpdateAction> TypedProcess(OnLoadEndUpdateInfo updateInfo)
		{
			List<IUpdateAction> list = new List<IUpdateAction>();
			controller.SeriesRepository.ClearActiveRefinedSeries();
			list.Add(new AggregatorUpdateAction(CommonActionType.UpdateCrosshair | CommonActionType.DeserializeRange | CommonActionType.UpdatePointsIndices | CommonActionType.RecalculateArgumentScale | CommonActionType.EndLoading | CommonActionType.UpdateIndicators | CommonActionType.AnimateChart));
			foreach (RefinedSeriesGroup value in controller.SeriesRepository.GroupController.RefinedSeriesGroups.Values)
			{
				if (value != null)
				{
					IAxisData axisData = value.GroupKey.AxisData;
					if (axisData != null && axisData.IsArgumentAxis)
					{
						list.Add(new UpdateAxisAction(axisData, AxisActionType.UpdatePointsAggregation));
						list.Add(new AggregatorUpdateAction(CommonActionType.UpdateSeriesGroupsInteraction | CommonActionType.UpdateCrosshair));
					}
				}
			}
			return list;
		}
	}

	public class Funnel2DLayoutCalculator
	{
		private readonly GRealSize2D bounds;

		private readonly IList<RefinedPoint> points;

		private readonly double centerX;

		private readonly double actualPointDistance;

		private readonly double heightOfPolygon;

		public static GRealPoint2D? CalcIntersectionPoint(GRealPoint2D p1, GRealPoint2D p2, double y)
		{
			if (p1 == p2)
			{
				return null;
			}
			double x = p1.X;
			double x2 = p2.X;
			double y2 = p1.Y;
			double y3 = p2.Y;
			if (y2 == y3)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (x2 == x)
			{
				return new GRealPoint2D(x, y);
			}
			double x3 = (y - y2) / (y3 - y2) * (x2 - x) + x;
			return new GRealPoint2D(x3, y);
		}

		public Funnel2DLayoutCalculator(GRealSize2D bounds, IList<RefinedPoint> points, double pointDistance)
		{
			this.points = points;
			this.bounds = bounds;
			centerX = bounds.Width / 2.0;
			if (points.Count > 0)
			{
				double num = bounds.Height - (double)points.Count;
				double num2 = (double)(points.Count - 1) * pointDistance;
				if (pointDistance != 0.0 && num < num2)
				{
					actualPointDistance = num / (double)(points.Count - 1);
					heightOfPolygon = 1.0;
				}
				else
				{
					heightOfPolygon = (bounds.Height - num2) / (double)points.Count;
					actualPointDistance = pointDistance;
				}
			}
		}

		private FunnelPointInfo CalculateSeriesPointLayout(IFunnelPoint point, IFunnelPoint bottomPoint, double topY)
		{
			double bottomY = topY + heightOfPolygon;
			if (point == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			double num = (double.IsNaN(point.NormalizedValue) ? 0.0 : (point.NormalizedValue * bounds.Width));
			double bottomWidth = ((bottomPoint == null) ? num : (double.IsNaN(bottomPoint.NormalizedValue) ? 0.0 : (bottomPoint.NormalizedValue * bounds.Width)));
			return new FunnelPointInfo
			{
				TopLeftPoint = new GRealPoint2D(centerX - num / 2.0, topY),
				TopRightPoint = new GRealPoint2D(centerX + num / 2.0, topY),
				BottomRightPoint = CalcBottomPoint(topY, bottomY, num, bottomWidth, isLeftPoint: false),
				BottomLeftPoint = CalcBottomPoint(topY, bottomY, num, bottomWidth, isLeftPoint: true)
			};
		}

		private GRealPoint2D CalcBottomPoint(double topY, double bottomY, double topWidth, double bottomWidth, bool isLeftPoint)
		{
			int num = ((!isLeftPoint) ? 1 : (-1));
			GRealPoint2D p = new GRealPoint2D(centerX + (double)num * topWidth / 2.0, topY);
			GRealPoint2D p2 = new GRealPoint2D(centerX + (double)num * bottomWidth / 2.0, bottomY + actualPointDistance);
			GRealPoint2D? gRealPoint2D = CalcIntersectionPoint(p, p2, bottomY);
			if (gRealPoint2D.HasValue)
			{
				return gRealPoint2D.Value;
			}
			return new GRealPoint2D(centerX - topWidth / 2.0, topY);
		}

		public List<FunnelPointInfo> Calculate(bool isRectanglePointShapesUsed)
		{
			if (points.Count == 0 || bounds.Height < (double)points.Count)
			{
				return null;
			}
			double num = 0.0;
			List<FunnelPointInfo> list = new List<FunnelPointInfo>();
			for (int i = 0; i < points.Count; i++)
			{
				list.Add(CalculateSeriesPointLayout(bottomPoint: (!isRectanglePointShapesUsed) ? ((i + 1 < points.Count) ? points[i + 1] : null) : null, point: points[i], topY: num));
				num += heightOfPolygon + actualPointDistance;
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected void NonProportionalResizeItems(IList<DXRectangle> bounds, DXRectangle maxBounds, int itemsDistance, List<LayoutItem> collapsedItems, Func<int, bool> isVisibleInLayout)

		private void HideInvisibleItems(IList<GridLayoutInfo> items, IList<ILinearLayoutItem> rowDefinitions, IList<ILinearLayoutItem> columnDefinitions)
		{
			IList<ILinearLayoutItem> primaryDefinitionCollection = base.LayoutHelper.GetPrimaryDefinitionCollection(rowDefinitions, columnDefinitions);
			foreach (GridLayoutInfo item in items)
			{
				if (item != null && !item.VisibleInLayout)
				{
					int primaryGridIndex = base.LayoutHelper.GetPrimaryGridIndex(item);
					int primaryGridSpan = base.LayoutHelper.GetPrimaryGridSpan(item);
					for (int i = primaryGridIndex; i < primaryGridIndex + primaryGridSpan && i < primaryDefinitionCollection.Count; i++)
					{
						primaryDefinitionCollection[i] = new LinearLayoutInfo(1.0, 0, canBeResized: false);
