					maxCollapsedLineWidth = Math.Max(((DXRectangle)(ref bounds)).Height, maxCollapsedLineWidth);
					bounds = collapsedItem.Bounds;
					num = Math.Max(((DXRectangle)(ref bounds)).Height, num);
					int num5 = num3;
					int num6 = num2;
					int num7 = num;
					bounds = collapsedItem.Bounds;
					list.Add(new DXRectangle(num5, num6, num7, ((DXRectangle)(ref bounds)).Width));
					int num8 = num2;
					bounds = collapsedItem.Bounds;
					num2 = num8 + (((DXRectangle)(ref bounds)).Width + itemsDistance);
				}
				maxCollapsedLineWidth += itemsDistance;
			}
			return list;
		}

		private List<LayoutItem> GenerateLayoutItems(int itemsDistance, DXRectangle maxBounds, List<LayoutItem> collapsedItems)
		{
			//IL_002a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_007d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_010c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00ec: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			GridPlacementStrategy gridPlacementStrategy = new GridPlacementStrategy(items, options, collapsedItems);
			gridPlacementStrategy.Calculate();
			int rowsCount = gridPlacementStrategy.RowsCount;
			int columnsCount = gridPlacementStrategy.ColumnsCount;
			int maxCollapsedLineWidth;
			List<DXRectangle> list = CalculateCollapsedItemsBounds(collapsedItems, itemsDistance, maxBounds, out maxCollapsedLineWidth);
			if (((DXRectangle)(ref maxBounds)).Width - maxCollapsedLineWidth <= 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			DXRectangle availableSize = default(DXRectangle);
			((DXRectangle)(ref availableSize))..ctor(((DXRectangle)(ref maxBounds)).Left + maxCollapsedLineWidth, ((DXRectangle)(ref maxBounds)).Top, ((DXRectangle)(ref maxBounds)).Width - maxCollapsedLineWidth, ((DXRectangle)(ref maxBounds)).Height);
			infos = gridPlacementStrategy.GetInfos();
			DXRectangle[] array = LayoutItemsCalculator.CalculateGridItemsBounds(infos, rowsCount, columnsCount, availableSize, itemsDistance, options.RowDefinitions, options.ColumnDefinitions, out rowsSizes, out columnsSizes);
			if (array == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			List<LayoutItem> list2 = new List<LayoutItem>();
			int i;
			for (i = 0; i < items.Count; i++)
			{
				LayoutItem layoutItem = collapsedItems.Find((LayoutItem x) => x.Index == i);
				LayoutItem item;
				if (layoutItem != null)
				{
					layoutItem.Bounds = list[collapsedItems.IndexOf(layoutItem)];
					item = layoutItem;
				}
				else
				{
					item = new GridLayoutItem(i, array[i], isFixedVertical: false, isFixedHorizontal: false);
				}
				list2.Add(item);
			}
			return list2;
		}

		protected override IList<DXRectangle> GetItemsBounds(int itemsDistance, DXRectangle maxBounds, List<LayoutItem> collapsedItems)
		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0021: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			List<LayoutItem> list = GenerateLayoutItems(itemsDistance, maxBounds, collapsedItems);
			if (list == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			List<DXRectangle> list2 = new List<DXRectangle>();
			for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
			{
				list2.Add(list[i].Bounds);
			}
			return list2;
		}

		protected override void UpdateSeparatorsInfos(List<SeparatorInfo> separators)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < separators.Count; i++)
			{
				GridLayoutInfo gridLayoutInfo = infos[separators[i].Item1Index];
				if (gridLayoutInfo != null)
				{
					separators[i].SetRowColumn(gridLayoutInfo.Row + gridLayoutInfo.RowSpan - 1, gridLayoutInfo.Column + gridLayoutInfo.ColumnSpan - 1);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override LayoutInfoList CreateLayoutInfo(List<LayoutInfo> list, List<SeparatorInfo> separators)
		{
			return new GridLayoutInfoList(list, rowsSizes, columnsSizes, separators);
		}

		protected override List<SeparatorInfo> GetSeparatorsBoundsInternal(List<SeparatorInfo> list)
		{
			//IL_003e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0044: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00aa: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00b0: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00b5: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
			{
				for (int j = i + 1; j < list.Count; j++)
				{
					SeparatorInfo separatorInfo = list[i];
					SeparatorInfo separatorInfo2 = list[j];
					if (separatorInfo != null && separatorInfo2 != null && separatorInfo.IsVerticalRelation == separatorInfo2.IsVerticalRelation && LayoutCalculator.CanUnionRectangles(separatorInfo.Bounds, separatorInfo2.Bounds))
					{
						bool isVerticalRelation = separatorInfo.IsVerticalRelation;
						GridLayoutInfo gridLayoutInfo = infos[separatorInfo.Item1Index];
						GridLayoutInfo gridLayoutInfo2 = infos[separatorInfo.Item2Index];
						GridLayoutInfo gridLayoutInfo3 = infos[separatorInfo2.Item1Index];
						GridLayoutInfo gridLayoutInfo4 = infos[separatorInfo2.Item2Index];
						list[i] = new SeparatorInfo(DXRectangle.Union(separatorInfo.Bounds, separatorInfo2.Bounds), ((isVerticalRelation && gridLayoutInfo.RowSpan > gridLayoutInfo3.RowSpan) || (!isVerticalRelation && gridLayoutInfo.ColumnSpan > gridLayoutInfo3.ColumnSpan)) ? separatorInfo2.Item1Index : separatorInfo.Item1Index, ((isVerticalRelation && gridLayoutInfo2.RowSpan > gridLayoutInfo4.RowSpan) || (!isVerticalRelation && gridLayoutInfo2.ColumnSpan > gridLayoutInfo4.ColumnSpan)) ? separatorInfo2.Item2Index : separatorInfo.Item2Index, isVerticalRelation);
						list[j] = null;
					}
				}
			}
			list.RemoveAll((SeparatorInfo x) => x == null);
			return list;
		}
	}
	public class GridPlacementStrategy
	{
		private readonly LayoutCalculatorHelper layoutHelper;

		private readonly IList<IGridLayoutItem> items;

		private readonly IGridLayoutOptions options;

		private readonly List<LayoutItem> collapsedItems;

		private readonly GridLayoutInfo[] infos;

		private readonly bool autoPrimaryDimension;

		private readonly bool autoSecondaryDimension;

		private readonly int primaryDefinitionsCount;

		private readonly int secondaryDefinitionsCount;

		private int[,] itemsMap;

		private int primaryFilledDimension;

		private int secondaryFilledDimension;

		private int primaryDimension;

		private int secondaryDimension;

		public int RowsCount => layoutHelper.GetVerticalValue(primaryDimension, secondaryDimension);

		public int ColumnsCount => layoutHelper.GetHorizontalValue(primaryDimension, secondaryDimension);

		public GridPlacementStrategy(IList<IGridLayoutItem> items, IGridLayoutOptions options)
			: this(items, options, new List<LayoutItem>())
		{
		}

		public GridPlacementStrategy(IList<IGridLayoutItem> items, IGridLayoutOptions options, List<LayoutItem> collapsedItems)
		{
			layoutHelper = LayoutCalculatorHelper.CreateInstance(options.Direction);
			this.items = items;
			this.options = options;
			this.collapsedItems = collapsedItems;
			primaryDefinitionsCount = layoutHelper.GetPrimaryDefinitionCollection(this.options).Count;
			secondaryDefinitionsCount = layoutHelper.GetSecondaryDefinitionCollection(this.options).Count;
			autoPrimaryDimension = primaryDefinitionsCount == 0;
			autoSecondaryDimension = secondaryDefinitionsCount == 0;
			infos = new GridLayoutInfo[items.Count];
		}

		private void CreateItemsMap()
		{
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = 0;
			foreach (IGridLayoutItem item in items)
			{
				num = Math.Max(num, layoutHelper.GetPrimaryGridIndex(item));
				num += layoutHelper.GetPrimaryGridSpan(item);
				num2 = Math.Max(num2, layoutHelper.GetSecondaryGridIndex(item));
				num2 += layoutHelper.GetSecondaryGridSpan(item);
			}
			num = Math.Max(primaryDefinitionsCount, num);
			num2 = Math.Max(secondaryDefinitionsCount, num2);
			itemsMap = new int[num, num2];
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < num2; j++)
				{
					itemsMap[i, j] = -1;
				}
			}
		}

		private List<IGridLayoutItem> FillItemsMap()
		{
			List<IGridLayoutItem> list = new List<IGridLayoutItem>();
			for (int i = 0; i < items.Count; i++)
			{
				IGridLayoutItem gridLayoutItem = items[i];
				int primaryGridIndex = layoutHelper.GetPrimaryGridIndex(gridLayoutItem);
				int secondaryGridIndex = layoutHelper.GetSecondaryGridIndex(gridLayoutItem);
				if (primaryGridIndex >= 0 && secondaryGridIndex >= 0)
				{
					int primaryGridSpan = layoutHelper.GetPrimaryGridSpan(gridLayoutItem);
					int secondaryGridSpan = layoutHelper.GetSecondaryGridSpan(gridLayoutItem);
					for (int j = 0; j < primaryGridSpan; j++)
					{
						for (int k = 0; k < secondaryGridSpan; k++)
						{
							itemsMap[primaryGridIndex + j, secondaryGridIndex + k] = i;
						}
					}
					infos[i] = new GridLayoutInfo(gridLayoutItem.Row, gridLayoutItem.Column, gridLayoutItem.RowSpan, gridLayoutItem.ColumnSpan, gridLayoutItem.VisibleInLayout);
					primaryFilledDimension = Math.Max(primaryFilledDimension, primaryGridIndex + primaryGridSpan);
					secondaryFilledDimension = Math.Max(secondaryFilledDimension, secondaryGridIndex + secondaryGridSpan);
				}
				else
				{
					list.Add(items[i]);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		private bool CanPlaceInGrid(int[,] itemsMap, int row, int column, int rowSpan, int columnSpan)
		{
			if (row + rowSpan > itemsMap.GetLength(0) || column + columnSpan > itemsMap.GetLength(1))
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < rowSpan; i++)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < columnSpan; j++)
				{
					if (itemsMap[row + i, column + j] >= 0)
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool TryPlaceItems(IList<IGridLayoutItem> initialUnplacedItems, int[,] itemsMap, int primaryVisibleDimension, int secondaryVisibleDimension, out GridLayoutInfo[] infos, out int linesCount)
		{
			List<IGridLayoutItem> list = new List<IGridLayoutItem>(initialUnplacedItems);
			infos = new GridLayoutInfo[initialUnplacedItems.Count];
			linesCount = 0;
			while (list.Count > 0)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < primaryVisibleDimension; i++)
				{
					if (itemsMap[i, linesCount] >= 0)
					{
						continue;
					}
					IGridLayoutItem gridLayoutItem = null;
					foreach (IGridLayoutItem item in list)
					{
						int primaryGridSpan = layoutHelper.GetPrimaryGridSpan(item);
						int secondaryGridSpan = layoutHelper.GetSecondaryGridSpan(item);
						if (!CanPlaceInGrid(itemsMap, i, linesCount, primaryGridSpan, secondaryGridSpan))
						{
							continue;
						}
						int num = items.IndexOf(item);
						for (int j = 0; j < primaryGridSpan; j++)
						{
							for (int k = 0; k < secondaryGridSpan; k++)
							{
								itemsMap[i + j, linesCount + k] = num;
							}
						}
						gridLayoutItem = item;
						infos[initialUnplacedItems.IndexOf(item)] = new GridLayoutInfo(layoutHelper.GetVerticalValue(i, linesCount), layoutHelper.GetHorizontalValue(i, linesCount), item.RowSpan, item.ColumnSpan, item.VisibleInLayout);
						primaryFilledDimension = Math.Max(primaryFilledDimension, i + primaryGridSpan);
						secondaryFilledDimension = Math.Max(secondaryFilledDimension, linesCount + secondaryGridSpan);
						break;
					}
					if (gridLayoutItem != null)
					{
						list.Remove(gridLayoutItem);
					}
				}
				linesCount++;
				if (secondaryVisibleDimension == linesCount)
				{
					break;
				}
			}
			return list.Count == 0;
		}

		private GridLayoutInfo[] PlaceItems(List<IGridLayoutItem> unplacedItems, out int primaryCalculatedDimension, out int secondaryCalculatedDimension)
		{
			GridLayoutInfo[] result = null;
			primaryCalculatedDimension = primaryDefinitionsCount;
			secondaryCalculatedDimension = secondaryDefinitionsCount;
			if (unplacedItems.Count == 0)
			{
				return result;
			}
			if (autoSecondaryDimension)
			{
				if (autoPrimaryDimension)
				{
					primaryCalculatedDimension = Math.Max(primaryFilledDimension, (int)Math.Ceiling(Math.Sqrt(items.Count)));
					foreach (IGridLayoutItem unplacedItem in unplacedItems)
					{
						primaryCalculatedDimension = Math.Max(primaryCalculatedDimension, Math.Max(0, layoutHelper.GetPrimaryGridIndex(unplacedItem)) + layoutHelper.GetPrimaryGridSpan(unplacedItem));
					}
				}
				TryPlaceItems(unplacedItems, itemsMap, primaryCalculatedDimension, 0, out result, out secondaryCalculatedDimension);
				return result;
			}
			if (autoPrimaryDimension)
			{
				primaryCalculatedDimension = Math.Max(primaryFilledDimension, (int)Math.Ceiling((double)unplacedItems.Count / (double)secondaryDefinitionsCount));
				int[,] array;
				while (true)
				{
					array = itemsMap.Clone() as int[,];
					if (TryPlaceItems(unplacedItems, array, primaryCalculatedDimension, secondaryDefinitionsCount, out result, out var _))
					{
						break;
					}
					primaryCalculatedDimension++;
				}
				itemsMap = array;
			}
			else
			{
				GridLayoutInfo[] array2 = null;
				List<IGridLayoutItem> initialUnplacedItems = new List<IGridLayoutItem>(unplacedItems);
				int[,] array3 = (int[,])itemsMap.Clone();
				if (!TryPlaceItems(initialUnplacedItems, array3, primaryDefinitionsCount, secondaryDefinitionsCount, out array2, out var linesCount2))
				{
					unplacedItems.Sort((IGridLayoutItem x, IGridLayoutItem y) => y.VisibleInLayout.CompareTo(x.VisibleInLayout));
					TryPlaceItems(unplacedItems, itemsMap, primaryDefinitionsCount, secondaryDefinitionsCount, out result, out linesCount2);
				}
				else
				{
					result = array2;
					itemsMap = array3;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private GridLayoutInfo TryUnionInfos(GridLayoutInfo info1, GridLayoutInfo info2)
		{
			if (info1 == null || info2 == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (info1.Row == info2.Row && info1.RowSpan == info2.RowSpan && (info1.Column + info1.ColumnSpan == info2.Column || info2.Column + info2.ColumnSpan == info1.Column))
			{
				return new GridLayoutInfo(info1.Row, Math.Min(info1.Column, info2.Column), info1.RowSpan, info1.ColumnSpan + info2.ColumnSpan);
			}
			if (info1.Column == info2.Column && info1.ColumnSpan == info2.ColumnSpan && (info1.Row + info1.RowSpan == info2.Row || info2.Row + info2.RowSpan == info1.Row))
			{
				return new GridLayoutInfo(Math.Min(info1.Row, info2.Row), info1.Column, info1.RowSpan + info2.RowSpan, info1.ColumnSpan);
			}
			return null;
		}

		private List<GridLayoutInfo> UnionAvailableSpaces(List<GridLayoutInfo> spaces)
		{
			bool flag;
			do
			{
				flag = false;
				for (int i = 0; i < spaces.Count; i++)
				{
					for (int j = i + 1; j < spaces.Count; j++)
					{
						GridLayoutInfo gridLayoutInfo = TryUnionInfos(spaces[i], spaces[j]);
						if (gridLayoutInfo != null)
						{
							spaces[i] = gridLayoutInfo;
							spaces[j] = null;
							flag = true;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			while (flag);
			if (spaces.RemoveAll((GridLayoutInfo x) => x == null) <= 0)
			{
				return new List<GridLayoutInfo>();
			}
			return spaces;
		}

		private int CheckPrimary(int pCell, int secondaryGridIndex, int secondaryGridSpan, int secondaryDimension)
		{
			int num = -1;
			for (int i = 0; i < secondaryGridSpan; i++)
			{
				int num2 = itemsMap[pCell, secondaryGridIndex + i];
				if (num != -1 && num2 != num)
				{
					num = -1;
					break;
				}
				num = num2;
			}
			if ((secondaryGridIndex > 0 && num == itemsMap[pCell, secondaryGridIndex - 1]) || (secondaryGridIndex + secondaryGridSpan < secondaryDimension && num == itemsMap[pCell, secondaryGridIndex + secondaryGridSpan]))
			{
				num = -1;
			}
			return num;
		}

		private int CheckSecondary(int sCell, int primaryGridIndex, int primaryGridSpan, int primaryDimension)
		{
			int num = -1;
			for (int i = 0; i < primaryGridSpan; i++)
			{
				int num2 = itemsMap[primaryGridIndex + i, sCell];
				if (num != -1 && num2 != num)
				{
					num = -1;
					break;
				}
				num = num2;
			}
			if ((primaryGridIndex > 0 && num == itemsMap[primaryGridIndex - 1, sCell]) || (primaryGridIndex + primaryGridSpan < primaryDimension && num == itemsMap[primaryGridIndex + primaryGridSpan, sCell]))
			{
				num = -1;
			}
			return num;
		}

		private bool ResizeItem(GridLayoutInfo availableArea)
		{
			int primaryGridIndex = layoutHelper.GetPrimaryGridIndex(availableArea);
			int primaryGridSpan = layoutHelper.GetPrimaryGridSpan(availableArea);
			int secondaryGridIndex = layoutHelper.GetSecondaryGridIndex(availableArea);
			int secondaryGridSpan = layoutHelper.GetSecondaryGridSpan(availableArea);
			int num = -1;
			int num2 = primaryGridIndex;
			if (num2 > 0)
			{
				num = CheckPrimary(num2 - 1, secondaryGridIndex, secondaryGridSpan, secondaryDimension);
			}
			num2 = primaryGridIndex + primaryGridSpan - 1;
			if (num == -1 && num2 < primaryDimension - 1)
			{
				num = CheckPrimary(num2 + 1, secondaryGridIndex, secondaryGridSpan, secondaryDimension);
			}
			num2 = secondaryGridIndex;
			if (num == -1 && num2 > 0)
			{
				num = CheckSecondary(num2 - 1, primaryGridIndex, primaryGridSpan, primaryDimension);
			}
			num2 = secondaryGridIndex + secondaryGridSpan - 1;
			if (num == -1 && num2 < secondaryDimension - 1)
			{
				num = CheckSecondary(num2 + 1, primaryGridIndex, primaryGridSpan, primaryDimension);
			}
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				GridLayoutInfo gridLayoutInfo = TryUnionInfos(infos[num], availableArea);
				if (gridLayoutInfo != null)
				{
					for (int i = primaryGridIndex; i < primaryGridIndex + primaryGridSpan; i++)
					{
						for (int j = secondaryGridIndex; j < secondaryGridIndex + secondaryGridSpan; j++)
						{
							itemsMap[i, j] = num;
						}
					}
					infos[num] = gridLayoutInfo;
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void CollapseItems()
		{
			List<GridLayoutInfo> list = new List<GridLayoutInfo>();
			int index;
			for (int i = 0; i < primaryDimension; i++)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < secondaryDimension; j++)
				{
					index = itemsMap[i, j];
					if (index == -1 || collapsedItems.Find((LayoutItem x) => x.Index == index) != null)
					{
						list.Add(new GridLayoutInfo(layoutHelper.GetVerticalValue(i, j), layoutHelper.GetHorizontalValue(i, j), 1, 1));
						itemsMap[i, j] = -1;
					}
				}
			}
			index = 0;
			while (list.Count > 0)
			{
				index %= list.Count;
				if (ResizeItem(list[index]))
				{
					list.RemoveAt(index);
					continue;
				}
				int num = index + 1;
				index = num;
				if (index == list.Count)
				{
					list = UnionAvailableSpaces(list);
				}
			}
		}

		public void Calculate()
		{
			CreateItemsMap();
			List<IGridLayoutItem> list = FillItemsMap();
			GridLayoutInfo[] array = PlaceItems(list, out primaryDimension, out secondaryDimension);
			for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
			{
				int num = items.IndexOf(list[i]);
				infos[num] = array[i];
			}
			if (autoPrimaryDimension)
			{
				primaryDimension = Math.Max(primaryDimension, primaryFilledDimension);
			}
			if (autoSecondaryDimension)
			{
				secondaryDimension = Math.Max(secondaryDimension, secondaryFilledDimension);
			}
			CollapseItems();
		}

		public IList<GridLayoutInfo> GetInfos()
		{
			return infos;
		}
	}
	public class LengthCalculator
	{
		private class LengthInfo
		{
			public readonly int Length;

			public readonly int Index;

			public LengthInfo(int length, int index)
			{
				Length = length;
				Index = index;
			}
		}

		private class WeightInfo
		{
			public readonly double Weight;

			public readonly int Index;

			public WeightInfo(double weight, int index)
			{
				Weight = weight;
				Index = index;
			}
		}

		private readonly IList<LinearLayoutInfo> itemsInfo;

		private readonly int length;

		public static bool Calculate(IList<LinearLayoutInfo> itemsInfo, int length)
		{
			LengthCalculator lengthCalculator = new LengthCalculator(itemsInfo, length);
			return lengthCalculator.Calculate();
		}

		private LengthCalculator(IList<LinearLayoutInfo> itemsInfo, int length)
		{
			this.itemsInfo = itemsInfo;
			this.length = Math.Max(length, 0);
		}

		private int CalculateFixedLength(out int noResizableLength, out bool allItemsFixed)
		{
			allItemsFixed = true;
			int num = 0;
			noResizableLength = 0;
			foreach (LinearLayoutInfo item in itemsInfo)
			{
				if (item.FixedSize)
				{
					if (item.CanBeResized)
					{
						num += item.SizeInPixels;
					}
					else
					{
						noResizableLength += item.SizeInPixels;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					allItemsFixed = false;
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		private int CalculateInitialItemsInfoListsWhenNormalCase(List<LengthInfo> fixedLengthList, List<WeightInfo> resizableWeightList)
		{
			int num = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < itemsInfo.Count; i++)
			{
				LinearLayoutInfo linearLayoutInfo = itemsInfo[i];
				if (linearLayoutInfo.FixedSize)
				{
					num += linearLayoutInfo.SizeInPixels;
					fixedLengthList.Add(new LengthInfo(linearLayoutInfo.SizeInPixels, i));
				}
				else
				{
					resizableWeightList.Add(new WeightInfo(linearLayoutInfo.Weight, i));
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		private int GetSizeInPixelsOfFirstFixedItem(out int index)
		{
			for (index = 0; index < itemsInfo.Count; index++)
			{
				LinearLayoutInfo linearLayoutInfo = itemsInfo[index];
				if (linearLayoutInfo.CanBeResized)
				{
					return linearLayoutInfo.SizeInPixels;
				}
			}
			return 0;
		}

		private void CalculateInitialItemInfoListsWhenOverflowCase(List<WeightInfo> resizableWeightList)
		{
			int index;
			int sizeInPixelsOfFirstFixedItem = GetSizeInPixelsOfFirstFixedItem(out index);
			if (sizeInPixelsOfFirstFixedItem == 0 || index >= itemsInfo.Count)
			{
				return;
			}
			resizableWeightList.Add(new WeightInfo(1.0, index));
			for (int i = index + 1; i < itemsInfo.Count; i++)
			{
				LinearLayoutInfo linearLayoutInfo = itemsInfo[i];
				if (linearLayoutInfo.CanBeResized)
				{
					double weight = (double)linearLayoutInfo.SizeInPixels / (double)sizeInPixelsOfFirstFixedItem;
					resizableWeightList.Add(new WeightInfo(weight, i));
				}
			}
		}

		private int CalculateInitialItemInfoLists(List<LengthInfo> fixedLengthList, List<WeightInfo> resizableWeightList)
		{
			int noResizableLength;
			bool allItemsFixed;
			int num = CalculateFixedLength(out noResizableLength, out allItemsFixed);
			int num2 = 0;
			if (num < length - noResizableLength)
			{
				if (allItemsFixed)
				{
					CalculateInitialItemInfoListsWhenOverflowCase(resizableWeightList);
				}
				else
				{
					num2 = CalculateInitialItemsInfoListsWhenNormalCase(fixedLengthList, resizableWeightList);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				CalculateInitialItemInfoListsWhenOverflowCase(resizableWeightList);
			}
			return length - noResizableLength - num2;
		}

		private double CalculateWeightSum(List<WeightInfo> resizableWeightList)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			foreach (WeightInfo resizableWeight in resizableWeightList)
			{
				num += resizableWeight.Weight;
			}
			return num;
		}

		private List<LengthInfo> CalculateResizableLengthList(List<WeightInfo> resizableWeightList, int resizableLength)
		{
			List<LengthInfo> list = new List<LengthInfo>(resizableWeightList.Count);
			if (resizableWeightList.Count == 0)
			{
				return list;
			}
			double num = CalculateWeightSum(resizableWeightList);
			num = ((num == 0.0) ? 1.0 : num);
			double value = 0.0;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			for (int i = 0; i < resizableWeightList.Count - 1; i++)
			{
				num2 += (double)resizableLength * resizableWeightList[i].Weight / num;
				int num3 = GeometricUtils.StrongRound(value);
				int num4 = GeometricUtils.StrongRound(num2);
				int num5 = num4 - num3;
				list.Add(new LengthInfo(num5, resizableWeightList[i].Index));
				value = num2;
			}
			int num6 = resizableLength - GeometricUtils.StrongRound(value);
			WeightInfo weightInfo = resizableWeightList[resizableWeightList.Count - 1];
			list.Add(new LengthInfo(num6, weightInfo.Index));
			return list;
		}

		private void CalculateTotalLength(List<LengthInfo> fixedLengthList, List<LengthInfo> resizableLengthList)
		{
			foreach (LinearLayoutInfo item in itemsInfo)
			{
				item.SizeInPixels = Math.Max(item.SizeInPixels, 0);
			}
			foreach (LengthInfo fixedLength in fixedLengthList)
			{
				itemsInfo[fixedLength.Index].SizeInPixels = fixedLength.Length;
			}
			foreach (LengthInfo resizableLength in resizableLengthList)
			{
				itemsInfo[resizableLength.Index].SizeInPixels = resizableLength.Length;
			}
		}

		private bool Calculate()
		{
			if (itemsInfo.Count == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (length == 0)
			{
				CalculateTotalLength(new List<LengthInfo>(), new List<LengthInfo>());
				return false;
			}
			List<LengthInfo> fixedLengthList = new List<LengthInfo>();
			List<WeightInfo> resizableWeightList = new List<WeightInfo>();
			int num = CalculateInitialItemInfoLists(fixedLengthList, resizableWeightList);
			if (num <= 0)
			{
				CalculateTotalLength(new List<LengthInfo>(), new List<LengthInfo>());
				return false;
			}
			List<LengthInfo> resizableLengthList = CalculateResizableLengthList(resizableWeightList, num);
			CalculateTotalLength(fixedLengthList, resizableLengthList);
			return true;
		}
	}
	public static class LayoutItemsCalculator
	{
		private static Limits[] CalculateCellsSizes(int count, IList<ILinearLayoutItem> definitions, int start, int length, int cellsDistance)
		{
			List<LinearLayoutInfo> list = new List<LinearLayoutInfo>();
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				list.Add(LinearLayoutInfo.Create((definitions != null && i < definitions.Count) ? definitions[i] : null));
			}
			if (!LengthCalculator.Calculate(list, length - cellsDistance * (count - 1)))
			{
				return null;
			}
			Limits[] array = new Limits[count];
			int num = start;
			int j;
			for (j = 0; j < count - 1; j++)
			{
				int num2 = GeometricUtils.StrongRound(num + list[j].SizeInPixels);
				array[j] = new Limits(num, num2);
				num = num2 + cellsDistance;
			}
			array[j] = new Limits(num, start + length);
			return array;
		}

		public static DXRectangle[] CalculateGridItemsBounds(IList<GridLayoutInfo> items, int rowsCount, int columnsCount, DXRectangle availableSize, int itemsDistance, IList<ILinearLayoutItem> rowDefinitions, IList<ILinearLayoutItem> columnDefinitions, out Limits[] firstColumn, out Limits[] firstRow)
		{
			//IL_0140: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0145: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_012a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_012f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			firstRow = null;
			firstColumn = null;
			if (rowsCount < 1 || columnsCount < 1 || ((DXRectangle)(ref availableSize)).IsCollapsed)
			{
				return null;
			}
			firstRow = CalculateCellsSizes(columnsCount, columnDefinitions, ((DXRectangle)(ref availableSize)).Left, ((DXRectangle)(ref availableSize)).Width, itemsDistance);
			firstColumn = CalculateCellsSizes(rowsCount, rowDefinitions, ((DXRectangle)(ref availableSize)).Top, ((DXRectangle)(ref availableSize)).Height, itemsDistance);
			if (firstRow == null || firstColumn == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			DXRectangle[] array = (DXRectangle[])(object)new DXRectangle[items.Count];
			int num = 0;
			foreach (GridLayoutInfo item in items)
			{
				if (item != null && item.Column < columnsCount && item.Row < rowsCount)
				{
					int start = firstRow[item.Column].Start;
					int start2 = firstColumn[item.Row].Start;
					int num2 = Math.Min(item.Column + item.ColumnSpan, columnsCount) - 1;
					int num3 = Math.Min(item.Row + item.RowSpan, rowsCount) - 1;
					int num4 = firstRow[num2].End - start;
					int num5 = firstColumn[num3].End - start2;
					array[num++] = new DXRectangle(start, start2, num4, num5);
				}
				else
				{
					array[num++] = new DXRectangle(-1, -1, 0, 0);
				}
			}
			return array;
		}

		public static IList<ILinearLayoutItem> EnsureDefinitions(int count, IList<ILinearLayoutItem> definitions)
		{
			IList<ILinearLayoutItem> list = new List<ILinearLayoutItem>(definitions);
			for (int i = definitions.Count; i < count; i++)
			{
				list.Add(LinearLayoutInfo.Create(null));
			}
			return list;
		}
	}

	public struct Limits
	{
		public static readonly Limits Invalid = new Limits(0, -1);

		public int Start;

		public int End;

		public int Length => End - Start;

		public bool IsValid => End >= Start;

		public Limits(int start, int end)
		{
			Start = start;
			End = end;
		}
	}
	public class DoubleLimits
	{
		public double Start;

		public double End;

		public DoubleLimits(double start, double end)
		{
			Start = Math.Min(start, end);
			End = Math.Max(start, end);
		}

		public DoubleLimits(double limit)
			: this(limit, limit)
		{
		}

		public bool IntersectWith(DoubleLimits limits)
		{
			if ((!(Start <= limits.End) || !(End >= limits.Start)) && Start != limits.End)
			{
				return End == limits.Start;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public DoubleLimits Union(DoubleLimits limits)
		{
			if (IntersectWith(limits))
			{
				return new DoubleLimits(Math.Min(Start, limits.Start), Math.Max(End, limits.End));
			}
			return null;
		}

		public bool Contains(DoubleLimits doubleLimits)
		{
			if (Start <= doubleLimits.Start)
			{
				return End >= doubleLimits.End;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return "[" + Start + ", " + End + "]";
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is DoubleLimits && ComparingUtils.CompareDoubles(Start, ((DoubleLimits)obj).Start, double.Epsilon) == 0)
			{
				return ComparingUtils.CompareDoubles(End, ((DoubleLimits)obj).End, double.Epsilon) == 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return base.GetHashCode();
		}
	}
	internal class DoubleLimitsStartComparer : IComparer<DoubleLimits>
	{
		public int Compare(DoubleLimits x, DoubleLimits y)
		{
			return x.Start.CompareTo(y.Start);
		}
	}
	internal class DoubleLimitsEndComparer : IComparer<DoubleLimits>
	{
		public int Compare(DoubleLimits x, DoubleLimits y)
		{
			return x.End.CompareTo(y.End);
		}
	}

		}

				return AxisYProjection.Value;
			}
			return AxisXProjection.Value;
		}

		public abstract void AddToCrosshairInfo(CrosshairInfo crosshairInfo);

		public abstract MinMaxValues CalculateMinMaxRange(double range, bool isHorizontalCrosshair, IXYDiagram xYDiagram, CrosshairPaneInfo crosshairPaneInfo, CrosshairSnapModeCore snapMode);

		public CrosshairPointsGroup CreateGroup(bool snapsToArgument)
		{
			CrosshairPointsGroup crosshairPointsGroup = new CrosshairPointsGroup(GetAnchorValue(snapsToArgument));
			AddToGroup(0, crosshairPointsGroup);
			return crosshairPointsGroup;
		}

		public bool TryAddToGroup(CrosshairPointsGroup group, bool snapsToArgument)
		{
			bool flag = group.AnchorValue == GetAnchorValue(snapsToArgument);
			if (flag)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < group.Points.Count; i++)
				{
					if (group.Points[i].RefinedSeries == RefinedSeries)
					{
						AddToGroup(GetCorrectPointIndex(i), group);
						return flag;
					}
				}
				AddToGroup(group.Points.Count, group);
			}
			return flag;
		}

		public void ConstructSeriesText(ICrosshairOptions options, bool isInGroup)
		{
			string actualPattern = GetActualPattern(options, isInGroup);
			crosshairSeriesText = ConstructTextCore(actualPattern, isGroupPattern: false);
		}

		public string ConstructGroupHeaderText(ICrosshairOptions crosshairOptions)
		{
			string actualGroupHeaderPattern = GetActualGroupHeaderPattern(crosshairOptions);
			return ConstructTextCore(actualGroupHeaderPattern, isGroupPattern: true);
		}
	}

	public abstract class CrosshairDataCalculator
	{
		public static CrosshairDataCalculator CreateCalculator(IXYSeriesView seriesView, bool snapToArgument, bool scrollingEnabled)
		{
			if (seriesView.AxisXData == null || seriesView.AxisYData == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			IEnumerable<IScaleBreak> scaleBreaks = seriesView.AxisXData.ScaleBreaks;
			IEnumerable<IScaleBreak> scaleBreaks2 = seriesView.AxisYData.ScaleBreaks;
			if (snapToArgument)
			{
				if (scrollingEnabled || ((scaleBreaks == null || scaleBreaks.Count() == 0) && (scaleBreaks2 == null || scaleBreaks2.Count() == 0)))
				{
					return new CrosshairDataCalculatorByArgument();
				}
				return new CrosshairDataCalculatorByArgumentWithScaleBreaks(seriesView, scaleBreaks, scaleBreaks2);
			}
			if (scrollingEnabled || scaleBreaks2 == null || scaleBreaks2.Count() == 0)
			{
				return new CrosshairDataCalculatorByValue(seriesView);
			}
			return new CrosshairDataCalculatorByValueWithScaleBreaks(seriesView, scaleBreaks2);
		}

		public static Func<int, double> GetSeriesPointArgumentAction(IList<RefinedPoint> points)
		{
			return (int i) => points[i].Argument;
		}

		public static Func<int, IEnumerable<double>> GetSeriesPointValuesAction(IList<RefinedPoint> points, IXYSeriesView seriesView)
		{
			return (int i) => seriesView.GetCrosshairValues(points[i]);
		}

		public static Func<int, double> GetIndicatorPointArgumentAction(IIndicator indicator)
		{
			return (int i) => indicator.GetArgumentByIndex(i, double.NaN, double.NaN);
		}

		public static Func<int, IEnumerable<double>> GetIndicatorPointValuesAction(IIndicator indicator)
		{
			return (int i) => indicator.GetValuesByIndex(i, double.NaN, double.NaN).Values;
		}

		public static bool IsValueInScaleBreak(IEnumerable<IScaleBreak> scaleBreaks, double value)
		{
			if (scaleBreaks != null)
			{
				foreach (IScaleBreak scaleBreak in scaleBreaks)
				{
					if (scaleBreak.Visible && ((scaleBreak.Edge1.Value < value && value < scaleBreak.Edge2.Value) || (scaleBreak.Edge2.Value < value && value < scaleBreak.Edge1.Value)))
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public abstract void ProcessPoints(CrosshairDataList crosshairSortedData, IList<RefinedPoint> pointsInfo, int startPointIndex, int endPointIndex);

		public abstract void ProcessIndicatorPoints(CrosshairDataList crosshairSortedData, IIndicator indicator, int startPointIndex, int endPointIndex);
	}
	public class CrosshairDataCalculatorByArgument : CrosshairDataCalculator
	{
		private void ProcessPointsCore(CrosshairDataList crosshairSortedData, Func<int, double> getArgument, int startPointIndex, int endPointIndex)
		{
			crosshairSortedData.Realloc(endPointIndex - startPointIndex);
			for (int i = startPointIndex; i <= endPointIndex; i++)
			{
				crosshairSortedData.Add(getArgument(i), i);
			}
		}

		public override void ProcessPoints(CrosshairDataList crosshairSortedData, IList<RefinedPoint> pointsInfo, int startPointIndex, int endPointIndex)
		{
			ProcessPointsCore(crosshairSortedData, CrosshairDataCalculator.GetSeriesPointArgumentAction(pointsInfo), startPointIndex, endPointIndex);
		}

		public override void ProcessIndicatorPoints(CrosshairDataList crosshairSortedData, IIndicator indicator, int startPointIndex, int endPointIndex)
		{
			ProcessPointsCore(crosshairSortedData, CrosshairDataCalculator.GetIndicatorPointArgumentAction(indicator), startPointIndex, endPointIndex);
		}
	}
	public class CrosshairDataCalculatorByValue : CrosshairDataCalculator
	{
		private readonly IXYSeriesView seriesView;

		public CrosshairDataCalculatorByValue(IXYSeriesView seriesView)
		{
			this.seriesView = seriesView;
		}

		private void ProcessPointsCore(CrosshairDataList crosshairSortedData, Func<int, IEnumerable<double>> getCrosshairValues, int startPointIndex, int endPointIndex)
		{
			for (int i = startPointIndex; i <= endPointIndex; i++)
			{
				IEnumerable<double> enumerable = getCrosshairValues(i);
				if (enumerable == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				foreach (double item in enumerable)
				{
					crosshairSortedData.Add(item, i);
				}
			}
		}

		public override void ProcessPoints(CrosshairDataList crosshairSortedData, IList<RefinedPoint> pointsInfo, int startPointIndex, int endPointIndex)
		{
			ProcessPointsCore(crosshairSortedData, CrosshairDataCalculator.GetSeriesPointValuesAction(pointsInfo, seriesView), startPointIndex, endPointIndex);
		}

		public override void ProcessIndicatorPoints(CrosshairDataList crosshairSortedData, IIndicator indicator, int startPointIndex, int endPointIndex)
		{
			ProcessPointsCore(crosshairSortedData, CrosshairDataCalculator.GetIndicatorPointValuesAction(indicator), startPointIndex, endPointIndex);
		}
	}
	public class CrosshairDataCalculatorByArgumentWithScaleBreaks : CrosshairDataCalculator
	{
		private readonly IXYSeriesView seriesView;

		private readonly IEnumerable<IScaleBreak> argumentScaleBreaks;

		private readonly IEnumerable<IScaleBreak> valueScaleBreaks;

		public CrosshairDataCalculatorByArgumentWithScaleBreaks(IXYSeriesView seriesView, IEnumerable<IScaleBreak> argumentScaleBreaks, IEnumerable<IScaleBreak> valueScaleBreaks)
		{
			this.seriesView = seriesView;
			this.argumentScaleBreaks = argumentScaleBreaks;
			this.valueScaleBreaks = valueScaleBreaks;
		}

		private void ProcessPointsCore(CrosshairDataList crosshairSortedData, Func<int, double> getArgument, Func<int, IEnumerable<double>> getValues, int startPointIndex, int endPointIndex)
		{
			for (int i = startPointIndex; i <= endPointIndex; i++)
			{
				double value = getArgument(i);
				if (!CrosshairDataCalculator.IsValueInScaleBreak(argumentScaleBreaks, value))
				{
					IEnumerable<double> enumerable = getValues(i);
					if (enumerable != null && enumerable.Any())
					{
						crosshairSortedData.Add(value, i);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public override void ProcessPoints(CrosshairDataList crosshairSortedData, IList<RefinedPoint> pointsInfo, int startPointIndex, int endPointIndex)
		{
			ProcessPointsCore(crosshairSortedData, CrosshairDataCalculator.GetSeriesPointArgumentAction(pointsInfo), CrosshairDataCalculator.GetSeriesPointValuesAction(pointsInfo, seriesView), startPointIndex, endPointIndex);
		}

		public override void ProcessIndicatorPoints(CrosshairDataList crosshairSortedData, IIndicator indicator, int startPointIndex, int endPointIndex)
		{
			ProcessPointsCore(crosshairSortedData, CrosshairDataCalculator.GetIndicatorPointArgumentAction(indicator), CrosshairDataCalculator.GetIndicatorPointValuesAction(indicator), startPointIndex, endPointIndex);
		}
	}
	public class CrosshairDataCalculatorByValueWithScaleBreaks : CrosshairDataCalculator
	{
		private readonly IXYSeriesView seriesView;

		private readonly IEnumerable<IScaleBreak> valueScaleBreaks;

		public CrosshairDataCalculatorByValueWithScaleBreaks(IXYSeriesView seriesView, IEnumerable<IScaleBreak> valueScaleBreaks)
		{
			this.seriesView = seriesView;
			this.valueScaleBreaks = valueScaleBreaks;
		}

		private void ProcessPointsCore(CrosshairDataList crosshairSortedData, Func<int, IEnumerable<double>> getValues, int startPointIndex, int endPointIndex)
		{
			for (int i = startPointIndex; i <= endPointIndex; i++)
			{
				IEnumerable<double> enumerable = getValues(i);
				if (enumerable == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				foreach (double item in enumerable)
				{
					if (!CrosshairDataCalculator.IsValueInScaleBreak(valueScaleBreaks, item))
					{
						crosshairSortedData.Add(item, i);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public override void ProcessPoints(CrosshairDataList crosshairSortedData, IList<RefinedPoint> pointsInfo, int startPointIndex, int endPointIndex)
		{
			ProcessPointsCore(crosshairSortedData, CrosshairDataCalculator.GetSeriesPointValuesAction(pointsInfo, seriesView), startPointIndex, endPointIndex);
		}

		public override void ProcessIndicatorPoints(CrosshairDataList crosshairSortedData, IIndicator indicator, int startPointIndex, int endPointIndex)
		{
			ProcessPointsCore(crosshairSortedData, CrosshairDataCalculator.GetIndicatorPointValuesAction(indicator), startPointIndex, endPointIndex);
		}
	}
	public class CrosshairDataList
	{
		private const int DefaultCapacity = 64;

		private const int MaxCapacityStep = 1048576;

		private CrosshairValueItem[] data = new CrosshairValueItem[0];

		private int capacity;

		private int count;

		public CrosshairValueItem this[int index] => data[index];

		public int Count => count;

		public CrosshairDataList()
		{
			Realloc(64);
		}

		private static int Closest(int value)
		{
			value--;
			value |= value >> 1;
			value |= value >> 2;
			value |= value >> 4;
			value |= value >> 8;
			value |= value >> 16;
			return value + 1;
		}

		private int CalculateCapacity(int initialCapacity, int newCount)
		{
			int num = Closest(newCount);
			if (num - initialCapacity > 1048576)
			{
				do
				{
					initialCapacity += 1048576;
				}
				while (initialCapacity < newCount);
			}
			else
			{
				initialCapacity = num;
			}
			return initialCapacity;
		}

		public void Realloc(int newCount)
		{
			if (newCount > capacity)
			{
				capacity = CalculateCapacity(capacity, newCount);
				CrosshairValueItem[] destinationArray = new CrosshairValueItem[capacity];
				Array.Copy(data, destinationArray, data.Length);
				data = destinationArray;
			}
		}

		public void Add(double value, int index)
		{
			Realloc(count + 1);
			data[count].UpdateItem(value, index);
			count++;
		}

		public void Sort(IComparer<CrosshairValueItem> comparer)
		{
			Array.Sort(data, 0, count, comparer);
		}

		public int BinarySearch(CrosshairValueItem value, IComparer<CrosshairValueItem> comparer)
		{
			return Array.BinarySearch(data, 0, count, value, comparer);
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			count = 0;
		}
	}
	public enum ErrorBarDirectionCore
	{
		Both,
		Minus,
		Plus
	}
	public static class CrosshairIndicatorPointsCalculator
	{
		private static double CalculateLineCoordinateCore(double cursorCoordinate1, double cursorCoordinate2, double minCoordinateAxis1, double maxCoordinateAxis1, double startCoordinateAxis2, double endCoordinateAxis2, bool extrapolateToNegativeInfinity, bool extrapolateToPositiveInfinity)
		{
			if (!extrapolateToNegativeInfinity && cursorCoordinate1 < minCoordinateAxis1)
			{
				return startCoordinateAxis2;
			}
			if (!extrapolateToPositiveInfinity && cursorCoordinate1 > maxCoordinateAxis1)
			{
				return endCoordinateAxis2;
			}
			if (minCoordinateAxis1 == maxCoordinateAxis1)
			{
				double num = Math.Min(endCoordinateAxis2, startCoordinateAxis2);
				double num2 = Math.Max(endCoordinateAxis2, startCoordinateAxis2);
				if (cursorCoordinate2 < num && !extrapolateToNegativeInfinity)
				{
					return num;
				}
				if (cursorCoordinate2 > num2 && !extrapolateToPositiveInfinity)
				{
					return num2;
				}
				return cursorCoordinate2;
			}
			return (cursorCoordinate1 - minCoordinateAxis1) * (endCoordinateAxis2 - startCoordinateAxis2) / (maxCoordinateAxis1 - minCoordinateAxis1) + startCoordinateAxis2;
		}

		public static Dictionary<IndicatorValueLevelCore, double> CalculateIndicatorValuesByType(Dictionary<IndicatorValueLevelCore, List<GRealPoint2D>> linesPoints, int index)
		{
			Dictionary<IndicatorValueLevelCore, double> dictionary = new Dictionary<IndicatorValueLevelCore, double>();
			foreach (KeyValuePair<IndicatorValueLevelCore, List<GRealPoint2D>> linesPoint in linesPoints)
			{
				if (linesPoint.Value.Count > index)
				{
					dictionary.Add(linesPoint.Key, linesPoint.Value[index].Y);
				}
			}
			return dictionary;
		}

		public static Dictionary<IndicatorValueLevelCore, double> CalculateErrorBarValuesByType(int index, List<ErrorBarData> errorBarData, ErrorBarDirectionCore direction)
		{
			Dictionary<IndicatorValueLevelCore, double> dictionary = new Dictionary<IndicatorValueLevelCore, double>();
			if (errorBarData != null && errorBarData.Count != 0)
			{
				switch (direction)
				{
				case ErrorBarDirectionCore.Minus:
					dictionary.Add(IndicatorValueLevelCore.Bottom, errorBarData[index].Bottom);
					break;
				case ErrorBarDirectionCore.Plus:
					dictionary.Add(IndicatorValueLevelCore.Top, errorBarData[index].Top);
					break;
				case ErrorBarDirectionCore.Both:
					dictionary.Add(IndicatorValueLevelCore.Bottom, errorBarData[index].Bottom);
					dictionary.Add(IndicatorValueLevelCore.Top, errorBarData[index].Top);
					break;
				}
			}
			return dictionary;
		}

		public static double CalculateLineCoordinate(double cursorCoordinate1, double cursorCoordinate2, double startCoordinateAxis1, double endCoordinateAxis1, double startCoordinateAxis2, double endCoordinateAxis2, bool extrapolateToNegativeInfinity, bool extrapolateToPositiveInfinity)
		{
			if (!(startCoordinateAxis1 <= endCoordinateAxis1))
			{
				return CalculateLineCoordinateCore(cursorCoordinate1, cursorCoordinate2, endCoordinateAxis1, startCoordinateAxis1, endCoordinateAxis2, startCoordinateAxis2, extrapolateToPositiveInfinity, extrapolateToNegativeInfinity);
			}
			return CalculateLineCoordinateCore(cursorCoordinate1, cursorCoordinate2, startCoordinateAxis1, endCoordinateAxis1, startCoordinateAxis2, endCoordinateAxis2, extrapolateToNegativeInfinity, extrapolateToPositiveInfinity);
		}
	}
	public class CrosshairCollectionSynchronizer<D, B> where D : class, B where B : class
	{
		public void Synchronize(IList<D> masterCollection, IList<B> slaveCollection)
		{
			for (int num = slaveCollection.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				if (slaveCollection[num] is D val && !masterCollection.Contains(val))
				{
					slaveCollection.Remove((B)val);
				}
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < masterCollection.Count; i++)
			{
				D val2 = masterCollection[i];
				int num2 = slaveCollection.IndexOf((B)val2);
				if (num2 != i)
				{
					if (num2 != -1)
					{
						slaveCollection.Remove((B)val2);
					}
					if (i >= slaveCollection.Count)
					{
						slaveCollection.Add((B)val2);
					}
					else
					{
						slaveCollection.Insert(i, (B)val2);
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public class CrosshairAxisInfo
	{

		public GRealPoint2D AnchorPoint => anchorPoint;

		public IAxisData Axis => axis;

		public GRealSize2D Size
		{
			get
			{
				return size;
			}
			set
			{
				size = value;
			}
		}

		public GRealSize2D MaxSize => maxSize;

		public GRealRect2D Bounds
		{
			get
			{
				GRealSize2D gRealSize2D = new GRealSize2D(Math.Min(maxSize.Width, size.Width), Math.Min(maxSize.Height, size.Height));
				return new GRealRect2D(anchorPoint.X - gRealSize2D.Width / 2.0, anchorPoint.Y - gRealSize2D.Height / 2.0, gRealSize2D.Width, gRealSize2D.Height);
			}
		}

		public object Value => value;

		public CrosshairAxisInfo(string text, GRealPoint2D anchorPoint, GRealSize2D maxSize, IAxisData axis, object value)
		{
			this.text = text;
			this.anchorPoint = anchorPoint;
			this.maxSize = maxSize;
			this.axis = axis;
			this.value = value;
		}
	}

		public static string ConstructAxisText(PointProjectionOnAxis axisValue)
		{
			IAxisData axis = axisValue.Axis;
			if (!(axis is ICrosshairAxis) || double.IsNaN(axisValue.Value))
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			string text = ((ICrosshairAxis)axis).LabelPattern;
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				text = axis.Label.TextPattern;
			}
			PatternParser patternParser = new PatternParser(text, (IPatternHolder)axis);
			patternParser.SetContext(axisValue.CalculateNativeValue());
			return patternParser.GetText();
		}

		public static string GetActualPattern(string crosshairLabelPattern, ToolTipPointDataToStringConverter converter)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(crosshairLabelPattern))
			{
				return crosshairLabelPattern;
			}
			return converter.ActualPointPattern;
		}

		public static string ConstructXYZSeriesText(XYZPointProjections pointProjections, IXYSeriesView view, RefinedPoint refinedPoint)
		{
			string actualPattern = GetActualPattern(view.CrosshairLabelPattern, view.CrosshairConverter);
			PatternParser patternParser = new PatternParser(actualPattern, (IPatternHolder)view);
			patternParser.SetContext(view.Owner, pointProjections, refinedPoint);
			return patternParser.GetText();
		}

		public CrosshairPaneInfo(IPane pane, bool isFocusedPane, GRealRect2D mappingBounds, GRealPoint2D cursorLocation, PointProjectionsForPane cursorCoords)
		{
			this.pane = pane;
			this.isFocusedPane = isFocusedPane;
			this.mappingBounds = mappingBounds;
			this.cursorLocation = cursorLocation;
			this.cursorCoords = cursorCoords;
		}

		public void AddValue(PointProjectionOnAxis axisValue)
		{
			if (!hashes.Contains(axisValue))
			{
				hashes.Add(axisValue);
				allPointProjections.Add(axisValue);
			}
		}

		public void AddSeriesPoint(CrosshairSeriesPointBase seriesPointBase)
		{
			if (seriesPointBase.CrosshairContentShowMode == CrosshairContentShowModeCore.Label)
			{
				labelSeriesPoints.Add(seriesPointBase);
			}
			else if (seriesPointBase.LegendItem.CrosshairLegendTextVisible)
			{
				legendSeriesPoints.Add(seriesPointBase);
			}
			if (seriesPointBase is CrosshairSeriesPoint item)
			{
				pointsForHighlight.Add(item);
			}
		}

		public void AddCrosshairLabel(List<CrosshairSeriesPointBase> seriesPoints, GRealPoint2D anchorPoint, AnnotationLocation defaultLocation, bool showTail, GRealPoint2D initOffset, ICrosshairOptions crosshairOptions)
		{
			if (seriesPoints.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			List<CrosshairPointsGroup> list = new List<CrosshairPointsGroup>();
			bool snapsToArgument = crosshairOptions.SnapMode == CrosshairSnapModeCore.NearestArgument;
			foreach (CrosshairSeriesPointBase seriesPoint in seriesPoints)
			{
				bool flag = false;
				if (crosshairOptions.ShowGroupHeaders)
				{
					foreach (CrosshairPointsGroup item in list)
					{
						if (seriesPoint.TryAddToGroup(item, snapsToArgument))
						{
							flag = true;
							break;
						}
					}
				}
				if (!flag)
				{
					list.Add(seriesPoint.CreateGroup(snapsToArgument));
				}
			}
			bool flag2 = (list.Count != seriesPoints.Count || !string.IsNullOrEmpty(crosshairOptions.GroupHeaderPattern)) && crosshairOptions.ShowGroupHeaders;
			foreach (CrosshairPointsGroup item2 in list)
			{
				CrosshairSeriesPointBase crosshairSeriesPointBase = item2.Points[0];
				item2.HeaderText = (flag2 ? crosshairSeriesPointBase.ConstructGroupHeaderText(crosshairOptions) : "");
				foreach (CrosshairSeriesPointBase point in item2.Points)
				{
					point.ConstructSeriesText(crosshairOptions, flag2);
				}
			}
			labelsInfo.Add(new CrosshairLabelInfo(list, anchorPoint, defaultLocation, showTail, initOffset));
		}

		public void AddCrosshairLabel(CrosshairSeriesPointBase seriesPoint, ICrosshairOptions crosshairOptions)
		{
			AddCrosshairLabel(new List<CrosshairSeriesPointBase> { seriesPoint }, seriesPoint.AnchorPoint, AnnotationLocation.TopRight, showTail: true, new GRealPoint2D(0.0, 0.0), crosshairOptions);
		}

		public void CompleteLabelsLayout()
		{
			List<IAnnotationLayout> list = new List<IAnnotationLayout>();
			foreach (CrosshairLabelInfo item in labelsInfo)
			{
				list.Add(item);
			}
			if (labelsConstraint.IsEmpty)
			{
				AnnotationLayoutCalculator.CalculateAutoLayout(list);
			}
			else
			{
				AnnotationLayoutCalculator.CalculateAutoLayout(list, labelsConstraint);
			}
		}
	}

	public abstract class EdgeGeometry
	{
		public static readonly int MaxCrosswiseStep = Math.Max(2, 4);

		private readonly bool shouldCutEdge;

		protected EdgeGeometry(bool shouldCutEdge)
		{
			this.shouldCutEdge = shouldCutEdge;
		}

		protected abstract IList<GRealPoint2D> CreateGraphicsPath(double startX, double startY, double length, bool vertical);

		public IList<GRealPoint2D> CreateLeftSideGraphicsPath(GRealRect2D bounds)
		{
			return CreateGraphicsPath(bounds.Left, bounds.Top, shouldCutEdge ? (bounds.Height - 1.0) : bounds.Height, vertical: true);
		}

		public IList<GRealPoint2D> CreateRightSideGraphicsPath(GRealRect2D bounds)
		{
			return CreateGraphicsPath(shouldCutEdge ? (bounds.Right - 1.0) : bounds.Right, bounds.Top, shouldCutEdge ? (bounds.Height - 1.0) : bounds.Height, vertical: true);
		}

		public IList<GRealPoint2D> CreateTopSideGraphicsPath(GRealRect2D bounds)
		{
			return CreateGraphicsPath(bounds.Left, bounds.Top, shouldCutEdge ? (bounds.Width - 1.0) : bounds.Width, vertical: false);
		}

		public IList<GRealPoint2D> CreateBottomSideGraphicsPath(GRealRect2D bounds)
		{
			return CreateGraphicsPath(bounds.Left, shouldCutEdge ? (bounds.Bottom - 1.0) : bounds.Bottom, shouldCutEdge ? (bounds.Width - 1.0) : bounds.Width, vertical: false);
		}
	}
	public class RaggedEdgeGeometry : EdgeGeometry
	{
		private const int lengthwiseStep = 10;

		public const int CrosswiseStep = 2;

		private readonly List<int> vertices = new List<int>();

		private readonly NonCryptographicRandom random = new NonCryptographicRandom(0);

		public List<int> Vertices => vertices;

		public RaggedEdgeGeometry(bool shouldCutEdge)
			: base(shouldCutEdge)
		{
		}//IL_000d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		//IL_0017: Expected O, but got Unknown


		protected override IList<GRealPoint2D> CreateGraphicsPath(double startX, double startY, double length, bool vertical)
		{
			List<GRealPoint2D> list = new List<GRealPoint2D>();
			list.Add(new GRealPoint2D(startX, startY));
			if (length > 10.0)
			{
				Update(length);
				int num = 10;
				for (int i = 0; i < vertices.Count; i++)
				{
					int num2 = vertices[i];
					double x = startX + (double)(vertical ? num2 : num);
					double y = startY + (double)(vertical ? num : num2);
					list.Add(new GRealPoint2D(x, y));
					num += 10;
					if ((double)num >= length)
					{
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			list.Add(new GRealPoint2D(startX + (vertical ? 0.0 : length), startY + (vertical ? length : 0.0)));
			return list;
		}

		public void Update(double length)
		{
			double num = 10 * vertices.Count;
			for (double num2 = length - num; num2 >= 10.0; num2 -= 10.0)
			{
				int num3 = (int)Math.Round(random.NextDouble() * 2.0);
				if (random.NextDouble() > 0.5)
				{
					num3 = -num3;
				}
				vertices.Add(num3);
			}
		}
	}
	public class WavedEdgeGeometry : EdgeGeometry
	{
		private const int stepCountByWave = 8;

		private const int minStepLength = 8;

		private const int minWaveLength = 64;

		private const double angleStep = Math.PI / 8.0;

		public const int CrosswiseStep = 4;

		public WavedEdgeGeometry(bool shouldCutEdge)
			: base(shouldCutEdge)
		{
		}

		protected override IList<GRealPoint2D> CreateGraphicsPath(double startX, double startY, double length, bool vertical)
		{
			List<GRealPoint2D> list = new List<GRealPoint2D>();
			list.Add(new GRealPoint2D(startX, startY));
			int num = (int)length / 64;
			if (num > 0)
			{
				double num2 = length / (double)num;
				double num3 = num2 / 8.0;
				double num4 = num3;
				double num5 = Math.PI / 8.0;
				while (num4 <= length)
				{
					int num6 = (int)Math.Round(Math.Sin(num5) * 4.0);
					double x;
					double y;
					if (vertical)
					{
						x = startX + (double)num6;
						y = (int)Math.Round(startY + num4);
					}
					else
					{
						x = (int)Math.Round(startX + num4);
						y = startY + (double)num6;
					}
					list.Add(new GRealPoint2D(x, y));
					num4 += num3;
					num5 += Math.PI / 8.0;
				}
			}
			list.Add(new GRealPoint2D(startX + (vertical ? 0.0 : length), startY + (vertical ? length : 0.0)));
			return list;
		}
	}
	public class PaneAreaSide
	{
		private readonly IScaleBreakOptions options;

		private readonly bool isInner;

		public IScaleBreakOptions Options => options;

		public bool IsInner => isInner;

		public static PaneAreaSide CreateInner(IScaleBreakOptions options)
		{
			return new PaneAreaSide(options, isInner: true);
		}

		public static PaneAreaSide CreateOuter()
		{
			return new PaneAreaSide(null, isInner: false);
		}

		public PaneAreaSide(IScaleBreakOptions options, bool isInner)
		{
			this.options = options;
			this.isInner = isInner;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is PaneAreaSide))
			{
				return false;
			}
			PaneAreaSide paneAreaSide = (PaneAreaSide)obj;
			if (object.Equals(paneAreaSide.options, options))
			{
				return paneAreaSide.isInner == isInner;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return base.GetHashCode();
		}
	}
	public class XYDiagramPaneArea
	{
		private readonly RaggedEdgeGeometry raggedGeometry;

		private readonly WavedEdgeGeometry wavedGeometry;

		private readonly PaneAreaSide leftSide;

		private readonly PaneAreaSide topSide;

		private readonly PaneAreaSide rightSide;

		private readonly PaneAreaSide bottomSide;

		private GRealRect2D bounds;

		private IList<GRealPoint2D> leftPath;

		private IList<GRealPoint2D> topPath;

		private IList<GRealPoint2D> rightPath;

		private IList<GRealPoint2D> bottomPath;

		private IList<GRealPoint2D> border;

		public PaneAreaSide LeftSide => leftSide;

		public PaneAreaSide TopSide => topSide;

		public PaneAreaSide RightSide => rightSide;

		public PaneAreaSide BottomSide => bottomSide;

		public IList<GRealPoint2D> LeftPath => leftPath;

		public IList<GRealPoint2D> TopPath => topPath;

		public IList<GRealPoint2D> RightPath => rightPath;

		public IList<GRealPoint2D> BottomPath => bottomPath;

		public GRealRect2D Bounds => bounds;

		public IList<GRealPoint2D> Border
		{
			get
			{
				if (border == null)
				{
					border = CreateBorder();
				}
				return border;
			}
		}

		private static PaneAreaSide GetIntersectedSide(double intersectedBound, double bound1, double bound2, PaneAreaSide side1, PaneAreaSide side2)
		{
			if (intersectedBound == bound1)
			{
				return side1;
			}
			if (intersectedBound == bound2)
			{
				return side2;
			}
			ChartDebug.Fail("Invalid intersection of pane areas.");
			return PaneAreaSide.CreateOuter();
		}

		public static XYDiagramPaneArea Intersect(XYDiagramPaneArea paneArea1, XYDiagramPaneArea paneArea2)
		{
			if (paneArea1 == null || paneArea2 == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (paneArea1.raggedGeometry != paneArea2.raggedGeometry)
			{
				ChartDebug.Fail("The same ragged geometry expected.");
				return null;
			}
			if (paneArea1.wavedGeometry != paneArea2.wavedGeometry)
			{
				ChartDebug.Fail("The same waved geometry expected.");
				return null;
			}
			GRealRect2D gRealRect2D = GRealRect2D.Intersect(paneArea1.bounds, paneArea2.bounds);
			if (gRealRect2D.IsEmpty)
			{
				return null;
			}
			PaneAreaSide intersectedSide = GetIntersectedSide(gRealRect2D.Left, paneArea1.bounds.Left, paneArea2.bounds.Left, paneArea1.leftSide, paneArea2.leftSide);
			PaneAreaSide intersectedSide2 = GetIntersectedSide(gRealRect2D.Top, paneArea1.bounds.Top, paneArea2.bounds.Top, paneArea1.topSide, paneArea2.topSide);
			PaneAreaSide intersectedSide3 = GetIntersectedSide(gRealRect2D.Right, paneArea1.bounds.Right, paneArea2.bounds.Right, paneArea1.rightSide, paneArea2.rightSide);
			PaneAreaSide intersectedSide4 = GetIntersectedSide(gRealRect2D.Bottom, paneArea1.bounds.Bottom, paneArea2.bounds.Bottom, paneArea1.bottomSide, paneArea2.bottomSide);
			return new XYDiagramPaneArea(paneArea1.raggedGeometry, paneArea1.wavedGeometry, gRealRect2D, intersectedSide, intersectedSide2, intersectedSide3, intersectedSide4);
		}

		public XYDiagramPaneArea(RaggedEdgeGeometry raggedGeometry, WavedEdgeGeometry wavedGeometry, GRealRect2D bounds)
			: this(raggedGeometry, wavedGeometry, bounds, PaneAreaSide.CreateOuter(), PaneAreaSide.CreateOuter(), PaneAreaSide.CreateOuter(), PaneAreaSide.CreateOuter())
		{
		}

		public XYDiagramPaneArea(RaggedEdgeGeometry raggedGeometry, WavedEdgeGeometry wavedGeometry, GRealRect2D bounds, PaneAreaSide leftSide, PaneAreaSide topSide, PaneAreaSide rightSide, PaneAreaSide bottomSide)
		{
			this.raggedGeometry = raggedGeometry;
			this.wavedGeometry = wavedGeometry;
			this.bounds = bounds;
			this.leftSide = leftSide;
			this.topSide = topSide;
			this.rightSide = rightSide;
			this.bottomSide = bottomSide;
		}

		public void Complete()
		{
			EdgeGeometry edgeGeometryByScaleBreakStyle = GetEdgeGeometryByScaleBreakStyle(leftSide.Options);
			if (edgeGeometryByScaleBreakStyle != null)
			{
				leftPath = edgeGeometryByScaleBreakStyle.CreateLeftSideGraphicsPath(bounds);
			}
			EdgeGeometry edgeGeometryByScaleBreakStyle2 = GetEdgeGeometryByScaleBreakStyle(topSide.Options);
			if (edgeGeometryByScaleBreakStyle2 != null)
			{
				topPath = edgeGeometryByScaleBreakStyle2.CreateTopSideGraphicsPath(bounds);
			}
			EdgeGeometry edgeGeometryByScaleBreakStyle3 = GetEdgeGeometryByScaleBreakStyle(rightSide.Options);
			if (edgeGeometryByScaleBreakStyle3 != null)
			{
				rightPath = edgeGeometryByScaleBreakStyle3.CreateRightSideGraphicsPath(bounds);
			}
			EdgeGeometry edgeGeometryByScaleBreakStyle4 = GetEdgeGeometryByScaleBreakStyle(bottomSide.Options);
			if (edgeGeometryByScaleBreakStyle4 != null)
			{
				bottomPath = edgeGeometryByScaleBreakStyle4.CreateBottomSideGraphicsPath(bounds);
			}
		}

		private EdgeGeometry GetEdgeGeometryByScaleBreakStyle(IScaleBreakOptions options)
		{
			if (options == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return options.Style switch
			{
				ScaleBreakStyleCore.Ragged => raggedGeometry, 
				ScaleBreakStyleCore.Waved => wavedGeometry, 
				_ => null, 
			};
		}

		private IList<GRealPoint2D> CreateBorder()
		{
			List<GRealPoint2D> list = new List<GRealPoint2D>();
			if (topPath != null)
			{
				list.AddRange(topPath);
			}
			else
			{
				list.Add(new GRealPoint2D(bounds.Left, bounds.Top));
				list.Add(new GRealPoint2D(bounds.Right, bounds.Top));
			}
			if (rightPath != null)
			{
				list.AddRange(rightPath);
			}
			else
			{
				list.Add(new GRealPoint2D(bounds.Right, bounds.Bottom));
			}
			if (bottomPath != null)
			{
				list.AddRange(bottomPath.Reverse());
			}
			else
			{
				list.Add(new GRealPoint2D(bounds.Left, bounds.Bottom));
			}
			if (leftPath != null)
			{
				list.AddRange(leftPath.Reverse());
			}
			else
			{
				list.Add(new GRealPoint2D(bounds.Left, bounds.Top));
			}
			return list;
		}
	}
	public class XYDiagramPaneAreaGenerator
	{
		private readonly RaggedEdgeGeometry raggedGeometry;

		private readonly WavedEdgeGeometry wavedGeometry;

		private readonly IScaleBreakOptions scaleBreakOptions;

		private readonly IAxisData axis;

		private readonly IList<GRealRect2D> intervalsBounds;

		public static List<XYDiagramPaneArea> GenerateAreas(RaggedEdgeGeometry raggedGeometry, WavedEdgeGeometry wavedGeometry, IAxisData axis, IScaleBreakOptions scaleBreakOptions, IList<GRealRect2D> intervalsBounds)
		{
			return new XYDiagramPaneAreaGenerator(raggedGeometry, wavedGeometry, scaleBreakOptions, axis, intervalsBounds).GenerateAreas();
		}

		private XYDiagramPaneAreaGenerator(RaggedEdgeGeometry raggedGeometry, WavedEdgeGeometry wavedGeometry, IScaleBreakOptions scaleBreakOptions, IAxisData axis, IList<GRealRect2D> intervalsBounds)
		{
			this.raggedGeometry = raggedGeometry;
			this.wavedGeometry = wavedGeometry;
			this.scaleBreakOptions = scaleBreakOptions;
			this.axis = axis;
			this.intervalsBounds = intervalsBounds;
		}

		public static DirectionCore CalculateAxisDirection(IAxisData axis)
		{
			if (axis.IsVertical)
			{
				if (!axis.Reverse)
				{
					return DirectionCore.BottomToTop;
				}
				return DirectionCore.TopToBottom;
			}
			if (!axis.Reverse)
			{
				return DirectionCore.LeftToRight;
			}
			return DirectionCore.RightToLeft;
		}

		private List<XYDiagramPaneArea> GenerateAreas()
		{
			List<XYDiagramPaneArea> list = new List<XYDiagramPaneArea>();
			if (intervalsBounds.Count > 0)
			{
				if (intervalsBounds.Count > 1)
				{
					switch (CalculateAxisDirection(axis))
					{
					case DirectionCore.LeftToRight:
						GenerateAreasLeftToRight(list);
						break;
					case DirectionCore.RightToLeft:
						GenerateAreasRightToLeft(list);
						break;
					case DirectionCore.TopToBottom:
						GenerateAreasTopToBottom(list);
						break;
					case DirectionCore.BottomToTop:
						GenerateAreasBottomToTop(list);
						break;
					default:
						ChartDebug.Fail("Unknown axis direction.");
						break;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					list.Add(new XYDiagramPaneArea(raggedGeometry, wavedGeometry, intervalsBounds[0]));
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		private void GenerateAreasLeftToRight(List<XYDiagramPaneArea> paneAreas)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < intervalsBounds.Count; i++)
			{
				GRealRect2D bounds = intervalsBounds[i];
				XYDiagramPaneArea item = ((!IsFirstInterval(i)) ? ((!IsLastInterval(i)) ? CreateHorizontalArea(bounds) : CreateRightArea(bounds)) : CreateLeftArea(bounds));
				paneAreas.Add(item);
			}
		}

		private void GenerateAreasRightToLeft(List<XYDiagramPaneArea> paneAreas)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < intervalsBounds.Count; i++)
			{
				GRealRect2D bounds = intervalsBounds[i];
				XYDiagramPaneArea item = ((!IsFirstInterval(i)) ? ((!IsLastInterval(i)) ? CreateHorizontalArea(bounds) : CreateLeftArea(bounds)) : CreateRightArea(bounds));
				paneAreas.Add(item);
			}
		}

		private void GenerateAreasTopToBottom(List<XYDiagramPaneArea> paneAreas)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < intervalsBounds.Count; i++)
			{
				GRealRect2D bounds = intervalsBounds[i];
				XYDiagramPaneArea item = ((!IsFirstInterval(i)) ? ((!IsLastInterval(i)) ? CreateVerticalArea(bounds) : CreateBottomArea(bounds)) : CreateTopArea(bounds));
				paneAreas.Add(item);
			}
		}

		private void GenerateAreasBottomToTop(List<XYDiagramPaneArea> paneAreas)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < intervalsBounds.Count; i++)
			{
				GRealRect2D bounds = intervalsBounds[i];
				XYDiagramPaneArea item = ((!IsFirstInterval(i)) ? ((!IsLastInterval(i)) ? CreateVerticalArea(bounds) : CreateTopArea(bounds)) : CreateBottomArea(bounds));
				paneAreas.Add(item);
			}
		}

		private static bool IsFirstInterval(int intervalIndex)
		{
			return intervalIndex == 0;
		}

		private bool IsLastInterval(int intervalIndex)
		{
			return intervalIndex == intervalsBounds.Count - 1;
		}

		private PaneAreaSide CreateInnerSide()
		{
			return PaneAreaSide.CreateInner(scaleBreakOptions);
		}

		private XYDiagramPaneArea CreateVerticalArea(GRealRect2D bounds)
		{
			return new XYDiagramPaneArea(raggedGeometry, wavedGeometry, bounds, PaneAreaSide.CreateOuter(), CreateInnerSide(), PaneAreaSide.CreateOuter(), CreateInnerSide());
		}

		private XYDiagramPaneArea CreateHorizontalArea(GRealRect2D bounds)
		{
			return new XYDiagramPaneArea(raggedGeometry, wavedGeometry, bounds, CreateInnerSide(), PaneAreaSide.CreateOuter(), CreateInnerSide(), PaneAreaSide.CreateOuter());
		}

		private XYDiagramPaneArea CreateLeftArea(GRealRect2D bounds)
		{
			return new XYDiagramPaneArea(raggedGeometry, wavedGeometry, bounds, PaneAreaSide.CreateOuter(), PaneAreaSide.CreateOuter(), CreateInnerSide(), PaneAreaSide.CreateOuter());
		}

		private XYDiagramPaneArea CreateRightArea(GRealRect2D bounds)
		{
			return new XYDiagramPaneArea(raggedGeometry, wavedGeometry, bounds, CreateInnerSide(), PaneAreaSide.CreateOuter(), PaneAreaSide.CreateOuter(), PaneAreaSide.CreateOuter());
		}

		private XYDiagramPaneArea CreateTopArea(GRealRect2D bounds)
		{
			return new XYDiagramPaneArea(raggedGeometry, wavedGeometry, bounds, PaneAreaSide.CreateOuter(), PaneAreaSide.CreateOuter(), PaneAreaSide.CreateOuter(), CreateInnerSide());
		}

		private XYDiagramPaneArea CreateBottomArea(GRealRect2D bounds)
		{
			return new XYDiagramPaneArea(raggedGeometry, wavedGeometry, bounds, PaneAreaSide.CreateOuter(), CreateInnerSide(), PaneAreaSide.CreateOuter(), PaneAreaSide.CreateOuter());
		}
	}
	public static class SplitHelper
	{
		public static double CalcPointByRangeAnchorValue(double x1, double y1, double x2, double y2, double value)
		{
			if (x1 == x2 || y1 == y2)
			{
				return x2;
			}
			double num = (y2 - y1) / (x2 - x1);
			return x2 - (y2 - value) / num;
		}
	}
	public class StripSplitter : IStripSplitter
	{
		public virtual bool NeedContinueFirstStrip => false;

		protected virtual int? GetColor(IList<RefinedPoint> points, int index, Func<RefinedPoint, double> getActualValue)
		{
			return null;
		}

		public virtual List<ColoredStripInfo> SplitStrip(IList<RefinedPoint> points, int index, IGeometryStrip strip, Func<RefinedPoint, double> getActualValue)
		{
			List<ColoredStripInfo> list = new List<ColoredStripInfo>();
			RefinedPoint refinedPoint = points[index];
			GeometryStripStyle geometryStripStyle = new GeometryStripStyle(GetColor(points, index, getActualValue));
			if (!geometryStripStyle.Equals(strip.Style))
			{
				list.Add(new ColoredStripInfo(new GRealPoint2D(refinedPoint.Argument, getActualValue(refinedPoint)), geometryStripStyle));
			}
			return list;
		}

		public virtual bool CanProcessPoint(RefinedPoint point)
		{
			return !point.IsEmpty;
		}
	}
	public class StripRangeSplitter : StripSplitter
	{
		private readonly IRangeSegmentColorizer rangeSegmentColorizer;

		private IList<double> RangeStops => rangeSegmentColorizer.RangeStops;

		public StripRangeSplitter(IRangeSegmentColorizer rangeSegmentColorizer)
		{
			this.rangeSegmentColorizer = rangeSegmentColorizer;
		}

		protected override int? GetColor(IList<RefinedPoint> points, int index, Func<RefinedPoint, double> getActualValue)
		{
			return rangeSegmentColorizer.GetColor(getActualValue(points[index]));
		}

		public override List<ColoredStripInfo> SplitStrip(IList<RefinedPoint> points, int index, IGeometryStrip strip, Func<RefinedPoint, double> getActualValue)
		{
			List<ColoredStripInfo> list = new List<ColoredStripInfo>();
			RefinedPoint refinedPoint = points[index];
			double num = getActualValue(refinedPoint);
			if (strip.Count == 0)
			{
				list.Add(new ColoredStripInfo(new GRealPoint2D(refinedPoint.Argument, num), rangeSegmentColorizer.GetColor(num)));
			}
			else
			{
				RefinedPoint refinedPoint2 = points[index - 1];
				double num2 = getActualValue(refinedPoint2);
				int num3 = rangeSegmentColorizer.GetRangeIndex(num2);
				int rangeIndex = rangeSegmentColorizer.GetRangeIndex(num);
				if (num3 < rangeIndex || (num3 == rangeIndex && RangeStops.Contains(num2)))
				{
					if (num3 < 0)
					{
						num3 = 0;
						AddSplitStripInfo(list, refinedPoint.Argument, num, refinedPoint2.Argument, num2, RangeStops[num3], null);
					}
					for (int i = num3; i <= rangeIndex; i++)
					{
						double y;
						double value;
						if (i == rangeIndex || i == RangeStops.Count - 1)
						{
							y = (value = num);
						}
						else
						{
							y = RangeStops[i + 1];
							value = RangeStops[i];
						}
						AddSplitStripInfo(list, refinedPoint.Argument, num, refinedPoint2.Argument, num2, y, rangeSegmentColorizer.GetColor(value));
					}
				}
				else if (num3 > rangeIndex)
				{
					if (num3 >= RangeStops.Count)
					{
						num3 = RangeStops.Count - 1;
						AddSplitStripInfo(list, refinedPoint.Argument, num, refinedPoint2.Argument, num2, RangeStops[num3], null);
					}
					for (int num4 = num3; num4 >= rangeIndex; num4--)
					{
						double num5 = ((num4 < 0 || num4 == rangeIndex) ? num : RangeStops[num4]);
						AddSplitStripInfo(list, refinedPoint.Argument, num, refinedPoint2.Argument, num2, num5, rangeSegmentColorizer.GetColor(num5));
					}
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		private void AddSplitStripInfo(List<ColoredStripInfo> result, double pointArgument, double pointValue, double prevPointArgument, double prevPointValue, double y, int? color)
		{
			double x = SplitHelper.CalcPointByRangeAnchorValue(prevPointArgument, prevPointValue, pointArgument, pointValue, y);
			result.Add(new ColoredStripInfo(new GRealPoint2D(x, y), color));
		}
	}
	public class StripTrendSplitter : StripSplitter

		}

	public class EmptyPointStripSplitter : StripSplitter
	{
		private readonly IEmptyPointColorizer emptyPointSegmentColorizer;

		public EmptyPointStripSplitter(IEmptyPointColorizer emptyPointSegmentColorizer)
		{
			this.emptyPointSegmentColorizer = emptyPointSegmentColorizer;
		}

		public override List<ColoredStripInfo> SplitStrip(IList<RefinedPoint> points, int index, IGeometryStrip strip, Func<RefinedPoint, double> getActualValue)
		{
			RefinedPoint refinedPoint = points[index];
			if (refinedPoint.IsEmpty)
			{
				int? color = emptyPointSegmentColorizer.Color;

				{
					new ColoredStripInfo(new GRealPoint2D(refinedPoint.Argument, getActualValue(refinedPoint)), color, GeometryStripStyleKey.EmptyPointStyle)
				};
			}
			return base.SplitStrip(points, index, strip, getActualValue);
		}

		public override bool CanProcessPoint(RefinedPoint point)
		{
			return true;
		}
	}
