	public class BezierSplitCalculator
	{
		private GRealPoint2D p1;

		private GRealPoint2D p2;

		private GRealPoint2D p3;

		private GRealPoint2D p4;

		private double cx1;

		private double cx2;

		private double cx3;

		private double cy1;

		private double cy2;

		private double cy3;

		public BezierSplitCalculator(List<GRealPoint2D> points)
			: this(points[0], points[1], points[2], points[3])
		{
		}

		public BezierSplitCalculator(GRealPoint2D p1, GRealPoint2D p2, GRealPoint2D p3, GRealPoint2D p4)
		{
			this.p1 = p1;
			this.p2 = p2;
			this.p3 = p3;
			this.p4 = p4;
			UpdateParameters();
		}

		private void UpdateParameters()
		{
			double y = p1.Y;
			double y2 = p2.Y;
			double y3 = p3.Y;
			double x = p1.X;
			double x2 = p2.X;
			double x3 = p3.X;
			cy1 = -3.0 * y + 3.0 * y2;
			cy2 = 3.0 * y - 6.0 * y2 + 3.0 * y3;
			cy3 = 0.0 - y + 3.0 * y2 - 3.0 * y3 + p4.Y;
			cx1 = -3.0 * x + 3.0 * x2;
			cx2 = 3.0 * x - 6.0 * x2 + 3.0 * x3;
			cx3 = 0.0 - x + 3.0 * x2 - 3.0 * x3 + p4.X;
		}

		private double[] SolveQuadraticEquation(double a, double b, double c)
		{
			double[] result = null;
			if (a == 0.0)
			{
				if (b != 0.0)
				{
					return new double[1] { (0.0 - c) / b };
				}
				return result;
			}
			double num = b * b - 4.0 * a * c;
			if (num < 0.0)
			{
				return result;
			}
			if (num != 0.0)
			{
				return new double[2]
				{
					(0.0 - b - Math.Sqrt(num)) / (2.0 * a),
					(0.0 - b + Math.Sqrt(num)) / (2.0 * a)
				};
			}
			return new double[1] { (0.0 - b) / (2.0 * a) };
		}

		private double CubicRoot(double n)
		{
			return Math.Pow(Math.Abs(n), 1.0 / 3.0) * (double)Math.Sign(n);
		}

		private double[] SolveCubicEquation(double a, double b, double c, double d)
		{
			if (Math.Round(a, 5) == 0.0)
			{
				return SolveQuadraticEquation(b, c, d);
			}
			double num = b / a;
			double num2 = c / a;
			double num3 = d / a;
			double num4 = 0.0 - num * num / 3.0 + num2;
			double num5 = 2.0 * num * num * num / 27.0 - num * num2 / 3.0 + num3;
			double num6 = Math.Round(num5 * num5 / 4.0 + num4 * num4 * num4 / 27.0, 10);
			if (num6 > 0.0)
			{
				double num7 = CubicRoot((0.0 - num5) / 2.0 + Math.Sqrt(num6));
				double num8 = CubicRoot((0.0 - num5) / 2.0 - Math.Sqrt(num6));
				return new double[1] { num7 + num8 - num / 3.0 };
			}
			if (num6 == 0.0)
			{
				double num9 = CubicRoot((0.0 - num5) / 2.0);
				return new double[2]
				{
					2.0 - num / 3.0,
					0.0 - num9 - num / 3.0
				};
			}
			double num10 = CubicRoot(Math.Sqrt(0.0 - num4 * num4 * num4 / 27.0));
			double num11 = Math.Atan(Math.Sqrt(0.0 - num6) / num5 * 2.0);
			if (num5 > 0.0)
			{
				num11 = Math.PI + num11;
			}
			return new double[3]
			{
				num10 * (Math.Cos(num11 / 3.0) + Math.Cos((Math.PI * 6.0 - num11) / 3.0)) - num / 3.0,
				num10 * (Math.Cos((Math.PI * 2.0 + num11) / 3.0) + Math.Cos((Math.PI * 4.0 - num11) / 3.0)) - num / 3.0,
				num10 * (Math.Cos((Math.PI * 4.0 + num11) / 3.0) + Math.Cos((Math.PI * 2.0 - num11) / 3.0)) - num / 3.0
			};
		}

		private List<double> CoerceParameterT(double[] roots, bool isLastSegment)
		{
			List<double> list = new List<double>();
			if (roots != null)
			{
				foreach (double value in roots)
				{
					double num = Math.Round(value, 7);
					if (0.0 < num && (num < 1.0 || (isLastSegment && num == 1.0)))
					{
						list.Add(Math.Round(value, 7));
					}
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		public IEnumerable<GRealPoint2D> GetCurrentPoints()
		{
			return new GRealPoint2D[3] { p2, p3, p4 };
		}

		public double CalcCoordinateX(double t)
		{
			return cx3 * t * t * t + cx2 * t * t + cx1 * t + p1.X;
		}

		public double CalcCoordinateY(double t)
		{
			return cy3 * t * t * t + cy2 * t * t + cy1 * t + p1.Y;
		}

		public List<double> CalcParameterTForX(double x)
		{
			return CoerceParameterT(SolveCubicEquation(cx3, cx2, cx1, p1.X - x), isLastSegment: true);
		}

		public List<double> CalcParameterTForY(double y)
		{
			return CoerceParameterT(SolveCubicEquation(cy3, cy2, cy1, p1.Y - y), isLastSegment: true);
		}

		public List<double> CalcParameterTExtremums()
		{
			return CoerceParameterT(SolveQuadraticEquation(3.0 * cy3, 2.0 * cy2, cy1), isLastSegment: false);
		}

		public GRealPoint2D[] Split(GRealPoint2D point, double t)
		{
			GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D = new GRealPoint2D((0.0 - p1.X + p2.X) * t + p1.X, (0.0 - p1.Y + p2.Y) * t + p1.Y);
			GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D2 = new GRealPoint2D((0.0 - p2.X + p3.X) * t + p2.X, (0.0 - p2.Y + p3.Y) * t + p2.Y);
			GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D3 = new GRealPoint2D((gRealPoint2D2.X - gRealPoint2D.X) * t + gRealPoint2D.X, (gRealPoint2D2.Y - gRealPoint2D.Y) * t + gRealPoint2D.Y);
			GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D4 = new GRealPoint2D((0.0 - p3.X + p4.X) * t + p3.X, (0.0 - p3.Y + p4.Y) * t + p3.Y);
			GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D5 = new GRealPoint2D((0.0 - gRealPoint2D2.X + gRealPoint2D4.X) * t + gRealPoint2D2.X, (0.0 - gRealPoint2D2.Y + gRealPoint2D4.Y) * t + gRealPoint2D2.Y);
			p1 = point;
			p2 = gRealPoint2D5;
			p3 = gRealPoint2D4;
			UpdateParameters();
			return new GRealPoint2D[3] { gRealPoint2D, gRealPoint2D3, point };
		}
	}
	public abstract class BezierColorizerSplitter : BezierSplitter
	{
		protected struct BezierPointInfo
		{
			public double PointParameterT { get; private set; }

			public GRealPoint2D Point { get; private set; }

			public BezierPointInfo(double pointParameterT, GRealPoint2D point)
			{
				PointParameterT = pointParameterT;
				Point = point;
			}
		}

		protected BezierSplitCalculator Calculator { get; private set; }

		private void AddBottomSplitPoints(List<GRealPoint2D> points, GRealPoint2D firstPoint, GRealPoint2D splitPoint, double t, bool isLast)
		{
			if (!points.Contains(firstPoint))
			{
				points.Add(firstPoint);
			}
			GRealPoint2D[] collection = Calculator.Split(splitPoint, t);
			points.AddRange(collection);
			if (!isLast)
			{
				points.AddRange(Calculator.GetCurrentPoints());
			}
		}

		protected double AdjustParameterT(double minT, double currentT)
		{
			if (minT == 1.0)
			{
				return 1.0;
			}
			return (currentT - minT) / (1.0 - minT);
		}

		protected double GetClosestParameterT(List<double> roots, double currentT)
		{
			double num = double.NaN;
			foreach (double root in roots)
			{
				if (double.IsNaN(num) || Math.Abs(num - currentT) > Math.Abs(root - currentT))
				{
					num = root;
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		protected abstract void SplitStrip(BezierPointInfo pointInfo, double prevPointValue, bool isExtremumValue, GeometryStripStyle style, ref bool needSplit, ref double currentT);

		protected GeometryStripStyle GetStripStyle(IList<RefinedPoint> points, double argument, double pointValue, double previousPointValue)
		{
			return new GeometryStripStyle(GetStripColor(points, argument, pointValue, previousPointValue));
		}

		protected abstract int? GetStripColor(IList<RefinedPoint> points, double argument, double pointValue, double previousPointValue);

		protected void UpdateBezierParametersState(GRealPoint2D point1, GRealPoint2D point2, GRealPoint2D point3, GRealPoint2D point4)
		{
			Calculator = new BezierSplitCalculator(point1, point2, point3, point4);
		}

		protected double SplitLastSegmentStrip(bool needUpdateExtremum, BezierPointInfo value, double currentT, GeometryStripStyle stripStyle)
		{
			if (needUpdateExtremum)
			{
				List<double> roots = Calculator.CalcParameterTExtremums();
				double closestParameterT = GetClosestParameterT(roots, value.PointParameterT);
				if (double.IsNaN(closestParameterT))
				{
					return currentT;
				}
				currentT = closestParameterT;
			}
			else
			{
				currentT = AdjustParameterT(currentT, value.PointParameterT);
			}
			AddSplitPoints(value.Point, currentT, stripStyle);
			return currentT;
		}

		protected void AddSplitPoints(GRealPoint2D point, double t, GeometryStripStyle stripStyle)
		{
			BezierStrip bezierStrip = base.StripContainer.Strips.Last();
			if (!bezierStrip.Style.Equals(stripStyle))
			{
				bezierStrip = ProcessNewStrip(stripStyle, bezierStrip.DrawingPoints.Last());
			}
			bezierStrip.DrawingPoints.AddRange(Calculator.Split(point, t));
		}

		public override bool SplitStrip(IList<RefinedPoint> points, List<GRealPoint2D> bezierPoints)
		{
			int num = bezierPoints.Count - 1;
			GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D = bezierPoints[num - 3];
			GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D2 = bezierPoints[num];
			UpdateBezierParametersState(gRealPoint2D, bezierPoints[num - 2], bezierPoints[num - 1], gRealPoint2D2);
			List<double> list = Calculator.CalcParameterTExtremums();
			List<BezierPointInfo> list2 = new List<BezierPointInfo>();
			if (list != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
				{
					list2.Add(new BezierPointInfo(list[i], new GRealPoint2D(Calculator.CalcCoordinateX(list[i]), Calculator.CalcCoordinateY(list[i]))));
				}
			}
			List<BezierPointInfo> list3 = new List<BezierPointInfo>
			{
				new BezierPointInfo(0.0, gRealPoint2D),
				new BezierPointInfo(1.0, gRealPoint2D2)
			};
			list3.AddRange(list2);
			list3.Sort((BezierPointInfo point1, BezierPointInfo point2) => point1.Point.X.CompareTo(point2.Point.X));
			BezierStrip bezierStrip = base.StripContainer.Strips.LastOrDefault();
			if (bezierStrip == null || bezierStrip.Count == 0)
			{
				bezierStrip = ProcessNewStrip(GetStripStyle(points, gRealPoint2D.X, gRealPoint2D.Y, double.NaN), gRealPoint2D);
			}
			bool needSplit = false;
			double currentT = 0.0;
			for (int num2 = 1; num2 < list3.Count; num2++)
			{
				BezierPointInfo bezierPointInfo = list3[num2];
				double y = list3[num2 - 1].Point.Y;
				GeometryStripStyle stripStyle = GetStripStyle(points, gRealPoint2D2.X, bezierPointInfo.Point.Y, y);
				SplitStrip(bezierPointInfo, y, list2.Contains(bezierPointInfo), stripStyle, ref needSplit, ref currentT);
			}
			if (!needSplit)
			{
				bezierStrip.DrawingPoints.AddRange(new GRealPoint2D[3]
				{
					bezierPoints[num - 2],
					bezierPoints[num - 1],
					gRealPoint2D2
				});
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override bool SplitBottomStrip(Dictionary<int, GRealPoint2D> currentPointByIndex, List<GRealPoint2D> resultDrawingPoints, List<GRealPoint2D> originalDrawingPoints, int index, double x, bool isLast)
		{
			for (int i = 3; i < originalDrawingPoints.Count; i += 3)
			{
				if (originalDrawingPoints[i].X >= Math.Round(x, 5))
				{
					index = i;
					break;
				}
			}
			GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D;
			List<double> list;
			GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D2;
			if (!currentPointByIndex.TryGetValue(index, out var value))
			{
				gRealPoint2D = originalDrawingPoints[index];
				UpdateBezierParametersState(gRealPoint2D, originalDrawingPoints[index + 1], originalDrawingPoints[index + 2], originalDrawingPoints[index + 3]);
				list = Calculator.CalcParameterTForX(x);
				gRealPoint2D2 = new GRealPoint2D(x, Math.Round(Calculator.CalcCoordinateY(list[0]), 5));
				currentPointByIndex.Add(index, gRealPoint2D2);
			}
			else
			{
				gRealPoint2D = value;
				list = Calculator.CalcParameterTForX(x);
				gRealPoint2D2 = (currentPointByIndex[index] = new GRealPoint2D(x, Math.Round(Calculator.CalcCoordinateY(list[0]), 5)));
			}
			AddBottomSplitPoints(resultDrawingPoints, gRealPoint2D, gRealPoint2D2, list[0], isLast);
			return true;
		}
	}
	public class BezierTrendSplitter : BezierColorizerSplitter
	{
		private readonly ITrendSegmentColorizer segmentColorizer;

		private GeometryStripStyle previousStripStyle;

		}

		protected override int? GetStripColor(IList<RefinedPoint> points, double argument, double pointValue, double previousPointValue)
		{
			return segmentColorizer.GetColor(pointValue, previousPointValue);
		}

		protected override void SplitStrip(BezierPointInfo pointInfo, double prevPointValue, bool isExtremumValue, GeometryStripStyle stripStyle, ref bool needSplit, ref double currentT)
		{
			if (previousStripStyle == null || !previousStripStyle.Equals(stripStyle))
			{
				currentT = SplitLastSegmentStrip(needUpdateExtremum: false, pointInfo, currentT, stripStyle);
				previousStripStyle = stripStyle;
				needSplit = true;
			}
			else if (isExtremumValue)
			{
				AddSplitPoints(pointInfo.Point, pointInfo.PointParameterT, previousStripStyle);
			}
		}
	}
	public class BezierPointSplitter : BezierSplitter
	{
		private readonly IPointSegmentColorizer segmentColorizer;

		public BezierPointSplitter(IPointSegmentColorizer segmentColorizer)
		{
			this.segmentColorizer = segmentColorizer;
		}

		private GeometryStripStyle GetStripStyle(IList<RefinedPoint> points, double argument)
		{
			int index = -1;
			for (int i = 0; i < points.Count; i++)
			{
				if (points[i].Argument == Math.Round(argument, 9))
				{
					index = i;
					break;
				}
			}
			return new GeometryStripStyle(segmentColorizer?.GetColor(points, index));
		}

		public override bool SplitStrip(IList<RefinedPoint> points, List<GRealPoint2D> bezierPoints)
		{
			int num = bezierPoints.Count - 1;
			GeometryStripStyle stripStyle = GetStripStyle(points, bezierPoints[num].X);
			BezierStrip bezierStrip = base.StripContainer.Strips.LastOrDefault();
			if (base.StripContainer.Strips.Count == 0 || !bezierStrip.Style.Equals(stripStyle))
			{
				bezierStrip = ProcessNewStrip(stripStyle, bezierPoints[num - 3]);
			}
			bezierStrip.DrawingPoints.AddRange(new GRealPoint2D[3]
			{
				bezierPoints[num - 2],
				bezierPoints[num - 1],
				bezierPoints[num]
			});
			return true;
		}
	}
	public class BezierEmptyPointSplitter : BezierSplitter
	{
		private readonly IEmptyPointColorizer emptyPointSegmentColorizer;

		public BezierEmptyPointSplitter(IEmptyPointColorizer emptyPointSegmentColorizer)
		{
			this.emptyPointSegmentColorizer = emptyPointSegmentColorizer;
		}

		private GeometryStripStyle GetStripStyle(IList<RefinedPoint> points, double argument)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < points.Count; i++)
			{
				if (points[i].Argument == argument)
				{
					if (!points[i].IsEmpty)
					{
						break;
					}
					return new GeometryStripStyle(emptyPointSegmentColorizer.Color, GeometryStripStyleKey.EmptyPointStyle);
				}
			}
			return new GeometryStripStyle();
		}

		public override bool SplitStrip(IList<RefinedPoint> points, List<GRealPoint2D> bezierPoints)
		{
			int num = bezierPoints.Count - 1;
			GeometryStripStyle stripStyle = GetStripStyle(points, bezierPoints[num].X);
			BezierStrip bezierStrip = base.StripContainer.Strips.LastOrDefault();
			if (bezierStrip == null)
			{
				GeometryStripStyle stripStyle2 = GetStripStyle(points, bezierPoints[0].X);
				if (!stripStyle2.Equals(stripStyle) && stripStyle2.ShouldAddNextSplitPoint)
				{
					bezierStrip = ProcessNewStrip(stripStyle2, bezierPoints[num - 3]);
				}
			}
			bool flag = bezierStrip?.Style.ShouldAddNextSplitPoint ?? false;
			if (bezierStrip == null || !bezierStrip.Style.Equals(stripStyle))
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					bezierStrip.DrawingPoints.AddRange(new GRealPoint2D[3]
					{
						bezierPoints[num - 2],
						bezierPoints[num - 1],
						bezierPoints[num]
					});
					bezierStrip = ProcessNewStrip(stripStyle, bezierPoints[num]);
				}
				else
				{
					bezierStrip = ProcessNewStrip(stripStyle, bezierPoints[num - 3]);
				}
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				bezierStrip?.DrawingPoints.AddRange(new GRealPoint2D[3]
				{
					bezierPoints[num - 2],
					bezierPoints[num - 1],
					bezierPoints[num]
				});
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override bool CanProcessPoint(RefinedPoint point)
		{
			return true;
		}
	}
	public class BezierRangeSplitter : BezierColorizerSplitter
	{
		private IRangeSegmentColorizer rangeSegmentColorizer;

		public BezierRangeSplitter(IRangeSegmentColorizer rangeSegmentColorizer)
		{
			this.rangeSegmentColorizer = rangeSegmentColorizer;
		}

		private bool SplitStripByRangeStopCore(bool isExtremumValue, BezierPointInfo pointInfo, bool needSplit, ref double currentT, int newIndex, int colorIndex, bool isDescending)
		{
			IList<double> rangeStops = rangeSegmentColorizer.RangeStops;
			bool flag = colorIndex == newIndex || (!isDescending && colorIndex + 1 >= rangeStops.Count);
			if (flag)
			{
				currentT = SplitLastSegmentStrip(isExtremumValue && needSplit, pointInfo, currentT, new GeometryStripStyle(rangeSegmentColorizer.GetColor(pointInfo.Point.Y)));
			}
			else
			{
				double y = (isDescending ? rangeStops[colorIndex] : rangeStops[colorIndex + 1]);
				currentT = SplitSegmentStrip(currentT, base.Calculator.CalcParameterTForY(y), y, rangeStops[colorIndex]);
			}
			return flag;
		}

		private double SplitSegmentStrip(double currentT, List<double> roots, double y, double colorValue)
		{
			if (roots.Count > 0)
			{
				double closestParameterT = GetClosestParameterT(roots, currentT);
				double x = base.Calculator.CalcCoordinateX(closestParameterT);
				currentT = AdjustParameterT(currentT, closestParameterT);
				GeometryStripStyle stripStyle = GetStripStyle(null, 0.0, colorValue, double.NaN);
				AddSplitPoints(new GRealPoint2D(x, y), closestParameterT, stripStyle);
			}
			return currentT;
		}

		private bool SplitStripByRangeStop(bool isExtremumValue, BezierPointInfo value, ref bool needSplit, ref double currentT, int newIndex, int colorIndex, bool isDescending)
		{
			bool result = Math.Round(currentT, 5) == 1.0 || SplitStripByRangeStopCore(isExtremumValue, value, needSplit, ref currentT, newIndex, colorIndex, isDescending);
			needSplit = true;
			return result;
		}

		private int ProcessOutOfRangeSegment(ref double currentT, IList<double> rangeStops, int index, bool isDescending)
		{
			if ((isDescending && index >= rangeStops.Count) || (!isDescending && index < 0))
			{
				index = Math.Min(rangeStops.Count - 1, Math.Max(0, index));
				currentT = SplitSegmentStrip(currentT, base.Calculator.CalcParameterTForY(rangeStops[index]), rangeStops[index], double.NaN);
			}
			return index;
		}

		protected override int? GetStripColor(IList<RefinedPoint> points, double argument, double pointValue, double previousPointValue)
		{
			return rangeSegmentColorizer.GetColor(pointValue);
		}

		protected override void SplitStrip(BezierPointInfo pointInfo, double prevPointValue, bool isExtremumValue, GeometryStripStyle style, ref bool needSplit, ref double currentT)
		{
			if (Math.Round(currentT, 5) == 1.0)
			{
				return;
			}
			int rangeIndex = rangeSegmentColorizer.GetRangeIndex(prevPointValue);
			int rangeIndex2 = rangeSegmentColorizer.GetRangeIndex(pointInfo.Point.Y);
			IList<double> rangeStops = rangeSegmentColorizer.RangeStops;
			if (rangeIndex < rangeIndex2)
			{
				int num = ProcessOutOfRangeSegment(ref currentT, rangeStops, rangeIndex, isDescending: false);
				for (int i = num; i <= rangeIndex2 && !SplitStripByRangeStop(isExtremumValue, pointInfo, ref needSplit, ref currentT, rangeIndex2, i, isDescending: false); i++)
				{
				}
			}
			else if (rangeIndex > rangeIndex2 || (rangeIndex == rangeIndex2 && rangeStops.Contains(prevPointValue)))
			{
				int index = ((rangeIndex > rangeIndex2 && rangeStops.Contains(prevPointValue)) ? (rangeIndex - 1) : rangeIndex);
				int num2 = ProcessOutOfRangeSegment(ref currentT, rangeStops, index, isDescending: true);
				int num3 = num2;
				while (num3 >= rangeIndex2 && !SplitStripByRangeStop(isExtremumValue, pointInfo, ref needSplit, ref currentT, rangeIndex2, num3, isDescending: true))
				{
					num3--;
				}
			}
			else if (needSplit)
			{
				AddSplitPoints(pointInfo.Point, pointInfo.PointParameterT, new GeometryStripStyle(rangeSegmentColorizer.GetColor(prevPointValue)));
			}
		}
	}

	public class BollingerBandsCalculator
	{
		private const int DesignTimePointsCount = 3;

		public bool Calculated { get; private set; }

		public MinMaxValues YRange { get; private set; }

		public LineStrip MovingAveragePoints { get; private set; }

		public LineStrip UpperBandPoints { get; private set; }

		public LineStrip LowerBandPoints { get; private set; }

		public BollingerBandsCalculator()
		{
			Calculated = false;
			YRange = MinMaxValues.Empty;
			MovingAveragePoints = ObjectsFactory.Default.CreateLineStrip();
			UpperBandPoints = ObjectsFactory.Default.CreateLineStrip();
			LowerBandPoints = ObjectsFactory.Default.CreateLineStrip();
		}

		private bool IsParametersCorrect(IRefinedSeries refinedSeries, IList<RefinedPoint> points, int pointsCount, double deviationMultiplier, ValueLevelInternal valueLevel)
		{
			if (refinedSeries != null && points != null && refinedSeries.SeriesView != null && points.Count > 1 && points.Count > pointsCount && refinedSeries.SeriesView.IsCorrectValueLevel(valueLevel) && pointsCount > 1 && !double.IsNaN(deviationMultiplier))
			{
				return !double.IsInfinity(deviationMultiplier);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private double CalcStdDeviation(IList<RefinedPoint> refinedPoints, double sma, int index, int pointsCount, ValueLevelInternal valueLevel)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			for (int i = index - pointsCount + 1; i < index + 1; i++)
			{
				double value = refinedPoints[i].GetValue(valueLevel);
				num += (value - sma) * (value - sma);
			}
			return Math.Sqrt(num / (double)pointsCount);
		}

		private double CalcStdDeviation(double[] values, double sma, int pointsCount)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			foreach (double num2 in values)
			{
				num += (num2 - sma) * (num2 - sma);
			}
			return Math.Sqrt(num / (double)pointsCount);
		}

		public void Calculate(IRefinedSeries refinedSeries, IList<RefinedPoint> points, int pointsCount, double deviationMultiplier, ValueLevelInternal valueLevel)
		{
			Calculated = false;
			MovingAveragePoints.Clear();
			UpperBandPoints.Clear();
			LowerBandPoints.Clear();
			int num = pointsCount;
			if (refinedSeries != null && refinedSeries.IsPointsAutoGenerated)
			{
				num = 3;
			}
			if (!IsParametersCorrect(refinedSeries, points, num, deviationMultiplier, valueLevel))
			{
				return;
			}
			double num2 = 0.0;
			Queue<double> queue = new Queue<double>(num);
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				double value = points[i].GetValue(valueLevel);
				num2 += value;
				queue.Enqueue(value);
			}
			double num3 = num2 / (double)num;
			double argument = points[num - 1].Argument;
			double num4 = CalcStdDeviation(points, num3, num - 1, num, valueLevel);
			double num5 = num3 + deviationMultiplier * num4;
			double num6 = num3 - deviationMultiplier * num4;
			MovingAveragePoints.Add(new GRealPoint2D(argument, num3));
			UpperBandPoints.Add(new GRealPoint2D(argument, num5));
			LowerBandPoints.Add(new GRealPoint2D(argument, num6));
			double num7 = num5;
			double num8 = num6;
			for (int j = num; j < points.Count; j++)
			{
				double value2 = points[j].GetValue(valueLevel);
				num3 = num3 - queue.Dequeue() / (double)num + value2 / (double)num;
				queue.Enqueue(value2);
				double num9 = CalcStdDeviation(points, num3, j, num, valueLevel);
				double argument2 = points[j].Argument;
				double num10 = num3 + deviationMultiplier * num9;
				double num11 = num3 - deviationMultiplier * num9;
				MovingAveragePoints.Add(new GRealPoint2D(argument2, num3));
				UpperBandPoints.Add(new GRealPoint2D(argument2, num10));
				LowerBandPoints.Add(new GRealPoint2D(argument2, num11));
				if (num11 < num7)
				{
					num7 = num11;
				}
				if (num10 > num8)
				{
					num8 = num10;
				}
			}
			Calculated = true;
			YRange = new MinMaxValues(num7, num8);
		}

		public void UpdateIndicatorData(int startUpdateIndex, IRefinedSeries refinedSeries, IList<RefinedPoint> points, int pointsCount, double deviationMultiplier, ValueLevelInternal valueLevel)
		{
			Calculated = false;
			int num = pointsCount;
			if (refinedSeries != null && refinedSeries.IsPointsAutoGenerated)
			{
				num = 3;
			}
			if (!IsParametersCorrect(refinedSeries, points, num, deviationMultiplier, valueLevel))
			{
				MovingAveragePoints.Clear();
				UpperBandPoints.Clear();
				LowerBandPoints.Clear();
				YRange = MinMaxValues.Empty;
				return;
			}
			double num2 = 0.0;
			int num3 = -1;
			int num4 = -1;
			int num5 = -1;
			double num6 = double.MaxValue;
			double num7 = double.MinValue;
			Queue<double> queue = new Queue<double>(num);
			if (MovingAveragePoints.Count == 0 || startUpdateIndex < num)
			{
				if (startUpdateIndex < num)
				{
					MovingAveragePoints.Clear();
					UpperBandPoints.Clear();
					LowerBandPoints.Clear();
				}
				for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
				{
					double value = points[i].GetValue(valueLevel);
					queue.Enqueue(value);
				}
				double num8 = 0.0;
				for (int j = 0; j < num; j++)
				{
					double value2 = points[j].GetValue(valueLevel);
					num8 += value2;
				}
				num2 = num8 / (double)num;
				double argument = points[num - 1].Argument;
				MovingAveragePoints.Insert(0, new GRealPoint2D(argument, num2));
				double num9 = CalcStdDeviation(queue.ToArray(), num2, num);
				double num10 = num2 + deviationMultiplier * num9;
				double num11 = num2 - deviationMultiplier * num9;
				UpperBandPoints.Insert(0, new GRealPoint2D(argument, num10));
				LowerBandPoints.Insert(0, new GRealPoint2D(argument, num11));
				num3 = num;
				num4 = points.Count - num;
				num5 = 1;
				num6 = num10;
				num7 = num11;
			}
			else
			{
				num3 = startUpdateIndex;
				num4 = num;
				num5 = Math.Min(MovingAveragePoints.Count, startUpdateIndex - num + 1);
				num2 = MovingAveragePoints[num5 - 1].Y;
				if (num5 < MovingAveragePoints.Count)
				{
					if (num5 + num4 > MovingAveragePoints.Count)
					{
						num4 = MovingAveragePoints.Count - num5;
					}
					MovingAveragePoints.RemoveRange(num5, num4);
					UpperBandPoints.RemoveRange(num5, num4);
					LowerBandPoints.RemoveRange(num5, num4);
				}
				for (int k = startUpdateIndex - num; k < startUpdateIndex; k++)
				{
					double value3 = points[k].GetValue(valueLevel);
					queue.Enqueue(value3);
				}
			}
			for (int l = num3; l < points.Count; l++)
			{
				double value4 = points[l].GetValue(valueLevel);
				num2 -= (points[l - num].GetValue(valueLevel) - value4) / (double)num;
				double argument2 = points[l].Argument;
				int index = num5 + (l - num3);
				MovingAveragePoints.Insert(index, new GRealPoint2D(argument2, num2));
				queue.Dequeue();
				queue.Enqueue(value4);
				double num12 = CalcStdDeviation(queue.ToArray(), num2, num);
				double num13 = num2 + deviationMultiplier * num12;
				double num14 = num2 - deviationMultiplier * num12;
				UpperBandPoints.Insert(index, new GRealPoint2D(argument2, num13));
				LowerBandPoints.Insert(index, new GRealPoint2D(argument2, num14));
				if (num14 < num6)
				{
					num6 = num14;
				}
				if (num13 > num7)
				{
					num7 = num13;
				}
			}
			Calculated = true;
			YRange = new MinMaxValues(num6, num7);
		}
	}
	public class ErrorBarData
	{
		public bool ShouldBeSkipped { get; }

		public double Center { get; }

		public double Top { get; }

		public double Bottom { get; }

		public RefinedPoint RefinedPoint { get; }

		public ErrorBarData(RefinedPoint refinedPoint, double center, double top, double bottom, bool shouldBeSkipped)
		{
			Center = center;
			Top = top;
			Bottom = bottom;
			RefinedPoint = refinedPoint;
			ShouldBeSkipped = shouldBeSkipped;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return $"ErrorBarData(RefPoint({RefinedPoint.Argument}, {RefinedPoint.Value1}), center: {Center}, top: {Top}, bottom: {Bottom}";
		}
	}
	public abstract class ErrorBarsCalculator
	{
		public bool? Calculated { get; protected set; }

		public MinMaxValues YRange { get; protected set; }

		public List<ErrorBarData> ErrorBarDataList { get; private set; }

		public static bool IsCompatible(ISeriesView view)
		{
			if (view is IXYSeriesView && !(view is IXYWSeriesView) && !(view is IFinancialSeriesView) && !(view is IStackedView))
			{
				return !view.PointInterfaceType.IsAssignableFrom(typeof(IRangePoint));
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected ErrorBarsCalculator()
		{
			Calculated = null;
			YRange = MinMaxValues.Empty;
			ErrorBarDataList = new List<ErrorBarData>();
		}

		protected virtual bool IsParametersCorrect(IRefinedSeries refinedSeries, IList<RefinedPoint> points)
		{
			if (refinedSeries != null && IsCompatible(refinedSeries.SeriesView) && points != null && refinedSeries.SeriesView != null)
			{
				return points.Count > 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected void CalculateForFixedErrors(IList<RefinedPoint> refinedPoints, double negativeError, double positiveError, double specialValue = double.NaN)
		{
			double num = double.MaxValue;
			double num2 = double.MinValue;
			bool flag = double.IsNaN(specialValue);
			foreach (RefinedPoint refinedPoint in refinedPoints)
			{
				double num3;
				if (flag)
				{
					if (refinedPoint.IsEmpty)
					{
						continue;
					}
					num3 = refinedPoint.GetValue(ValueLevelInternal.Value);
				}
				else
				{
					num3 = specialValue;
				}
				double num4 = num3 + positiveError;
				if (num4 > num2)
				{
					num2 = num4;
				}
				double num5 = num3 - negativeError;
				if (num5 < num)
				{
					num = num5;
				}
				ErrorBarData item = new ErrorBarData(refinedPoint, num3, num4, num5, shouldBeSkipped: false);
				ErrorBarDataList.Add(item);
			}
			YRange = new MinMaxValues(num, num2);
		}
	}
	public class FixedErrorBarsCalculator : ErrorBarsCalculator
	{
		private bool IsParametersCorrect(IRefinedSeries refinedSeries, IList<RefinedPoint> points, double negativeError, double positiveError)
		{
			if (base.IsParametersCorrect(refinedSeries, points) && !double.IsNaN(negativeError) && !double.IsNaN(positiveError) && !double.IsInfinity(negativeError))
			{
				return !double.IsInfinity(positiveError);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void Calculate(IRefinedSeries refinedSeries, IList<RefinedPoint> points, double negativeError, double positiveError)
		{
			base.Calculated = false;
			base.ErrorBarDataList.Clear();
			if (IsParametersCorrect(refinedSeries, points, negativeError, positiveError))
			{
				CalculateForFixedErrors(points, negativeError, positiveError);
				base.Calculated = true;
			}
		}
	}
	public class DataSourceBasedErrorBarsCalculator : ErrorBarsCalculator
	{
		public void Calculate(IRefinedSeries refinedSeries, IList<RefinedPoint> points)
		{
			base.Calculated = false;
			base.ErrorBarDataList.Clear();
			if (!IsParametersCorrect(refinedSeries, points))
			{
				return;
			}
			double num = double.MaxValue;
			double num2 = double.MinValue;
			bool isPointsAutoGenerated = refinedSeries.IsPointsAutoGenerated;
			foreach (RefinedPoint point in points)
			{
				if (!point.IsEmpty)
				{
					double value = point.GetValue(ValueLevelInternal.Value);
					bool shouldBeSkipped;
					double num3;
					double num4;
					if (!isPointsAutoGenerated)
					{
						double additionalValue = point.GetAdditionalValue(ErrorBarValueInternal.Low);
						double additionalValue2 = point.GetAdditionalValue(ErrorBarValueInternal.High);
						shouldBeSkipped = additionalValue == 0.0 && additionalValue2 == 0.0;
						num3 = value - additionalValue;
						num4 = value + additionalValue2;
					}
					else
					{
						NonCryptographicRandom system = NonCryptographicRandom.System;
						num3 = value - (double)system.Next(1, 3);
						num4 = value + (double)system.Next(1, 3);
						shouldBeSkipped = false;
					}
					num = Math.Min(num3, num);
					num2 = Math.Max(num4, num2);
					base.ErrorBarDataList.Add(new ErrorBarData(point, value, num4, num3, shouldBeSkipped));
				}
			}
			base.YRange = new MinMaxValues(num, num2);
			base.Calculated = true;
		}
	}
	public class StandardDeviationErrorBarsCalculator : ErrorBarsCalculator
	{
		private double CalculateStandardDeviation(IList<RefinedPoint> refinedPoints, out double arithmeticMean)
		{
			arithmeticMean = 0.0;
			int count = refinedPoints.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				arithmeticMean += refinedPoints[i].GetValue(ValueLevelInternal.Value) / (double)count;
			}
			double num = 0.0;
			for (int j = 0; j < count; j++)
			{
				num += Math.Pow(refinedPoints[j].GetValue(ValueLevelInternal.Value) - arithmeticMean, 2.0) / (double)(count - 1);
			}
			return Math.Sqrt(num);
		}

		public void Calculate(IRefinedSeries refinedSeries, IList<RefinedPoint> points, double multiplier)
		{
			base.Calculated = false;
			base.ErrorBarDataList.Clear();
			if (IsParametersCorrect(refinedSeries, points))
			{
				double arithmeticMean = double.NaN;
				double num = CalculateStandardDeviation(points, out arithmeticMean);
				CalculateForFixedErrors(points, num * multiplier, num * multiplier, arithmeticMean);
				base.Calculated = true;
			}
		}
	}
	public class StandardErrorBarsCalculator : ErrorBarsCalculator
	{
		private double CalculateStandardError(IList<RefinedPoint> refinedPoints)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			int count = refinedPoints.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				num += refinedPoints[i].GetValue(ValueLevelInternal.Value) / (double)count;
			}
			double num2 = 0.0;
			for (int j = 0; j < count; j++)
			{
				double value = refinedPoints[j].GetValue(ValueLevelInternal.Value);
				num2 += Math.Pow(value - num, 2.0) / (double)(count * (count - 1));
			}
			return Math.Sqrt(num2);
		}

		public void Calculate(IRefinedSeries refinedSeries, IList<RefinedPoint> points)
		{
			base.Calculated = false;
			base.ErrorBarDataList.Clear();
			if (IsParametersCorrect(refinedSeries, points))
			{
				double num = CalculateStandardError(points);
				CalculateForFixedErrors(points, num, num);
				base.Calculated = true;
			}
		}
	}
	public class PercentageErrorBarsCalculator : ErrorBarsCalculator
	{
		private bool IsParametersCorrect(IRefinedSeries refinedSeries, IList<RefinedPoint> points, double percent)

			}

		}

		public void Calculate(IRefinedSeries refinedSeries, IList<RefinedPoint> points, double percent)
		{
			base.Calculated = false;

			{
				return;
			}
			double num = double.MaxValue;
			double num2 = double.MinValue;
			foreach (RefinedPoint point in points)
			{
				double value = point.GetValue(ValueLevelInternal.Value);
				double num3 = 0.01 * percent * value;
				double num4 = value + num3;
				if (num4 > num2)
				{
					num2 = num4;
				}
				double num5 = value - num3;
				if (num5 < num)
				{
					num = num5;
				}
				ErrorBarData item = new ErrorBarData(point, value, num4, num5, shouldBeSkipped: false);
				base.ErrorBarDataList.Add(item);
			}
			base.YRange = new MinMaxValues(num, num2);
			base.Calculated = true;
		}
	}

	public class TripleExponentialMovingAverageTrixCalculator

	public class AverageTrueRangeCalculator
	{
		private const int DesignTimePointsCount = 3;

		public bool Calculated { get; private set; }

		public MinMaxValues YRange { get; private set; }

		public static bool IsCompatible(ISeriesView view)

			return view is IFinancialSeriesView;
		}

		public AverageTrueRangeCalculator()
		{
			Calculated = false;
			YRange = MinMaxValues.Empty;
		}

		private double CalcTrueRange(IFinancialPoint refinedPoint, IFinancialPoint preRefinedPoint)
		{
			double val = refinedPoint.High - refinedPoint.Low;
			double val2 = Math.Abs(refinedPoint.High - preRefinedPoint.Close);
			double val3 = Math.Abs(refinedPoint.Low - preRefinedPoint.Close);
			return Max(val, val2, val3);
		}

		private double Max(double val1, double val2, double val3)
		{
			double val4 = Math.Max(val1, val2);
			return Math.Max(val4, val3);
		}

		private bool IsParametersCorrect(IRefinedSeries refinedSeries, IList<RefinedPoint> points, int pointsCount)
		{
			if (refinedSeries != null && IsCompatible(refinedSeries.SeriesView) && points != null && pointsCount > 0)

				return points.Count > pointsCount;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public LineStrip Calculate(IRefinedSeries refinedSeries, IList<RefinedPoint> points, int pointsCount)
		{
			Calculated = false;
			int num = pointsCount;
			if (refinedSeries != null && refinedSeries.IsPointsAutoGenerated)
			{
				num = 3;
			}
			if (!IsParametersCorrect(refinedSeries, points, num))
			{
				return ObjectsFactory.Default.CreateLineStrip();
			}
			IFinancialPoint financialPoint = points[0];
			double num2 = financialPoint.High - financialPoint.Low;
			for (int i = 1; i < num; i++)
			{
				RefinedPoint refinedPoint = points[i];
				RefinedPoint preRefinedPoint = points[i - 1];
				double num3 = CalcTrueRange(refinedPoint, preRefinedPoint);
				num2 += num3;
			}
			double num4 = num2 / (double)num;
			LineStrip lineStrip = ObjectsFactory.Default.CreateLineStrip();
			double argument = points[num - 1].Argument;
			lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(argument, num4));
			double num5 = num4;
			double num6 = num4;
			for (int j = num; j < points.Count; j++)
			{
				RefinedPoint refinedPoint2 = points[j];
				RefinedPoint preRefinedPoint2 = points[j - 1];
				double num7 = CalcTrueRange(refinedPoint2, preRefinedPoint2);
				double num8 = (num4 * (double)(num - 1) + num7) / (double)num;
				lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(refinedPoint2.Argument, num8));
				if (num8 > num6)
				{
					num6 = num8;
				}
				if (num8 < num5)
				{
					num5 = num8;
				}
				num4 = num8;
			}
			Calculated = true;
			YRange = new MinMaxValues(num5, num6);
			return lineStrip;
		}
	}
	public class CommodityChannelIndexCalculator
	{
		private const int DesignTimePointsCount = 3;

		private const double ReductionFactor = 66.66666666666667;

		public bool Calculated { get; private set; }

		public MinMaxValues YRange { get; private set; }

		public static bool IsCompatible(ISeriesView view)
		{
			return view is IFinancialSeriesView;
		}

		public CommodityChannelIndexCalculator()
		{
			Calculated = false;
			YRange = MinMaxValues.Empty;
		}

		private double CalculateTypicalPrice(IFinancialPoint refinedPoint)
		{
			return (refinedPoint.High + refinedPoint.Low + refinedPoint.Close) / 3.0;
		}

		private double CalculateMad(Queue<double> typicalPriceQueue, double tpma)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			foreach (double item in typicalPriceQueue)
			{
				num += Math.Abs(item - tpma);
			}
			return num / (double)typicalPriceQueue.Count;
		}

		private double CalculateCCI(double typicalPrice, double tpma, double mad)
		{
			return 66.66666666666667 * ((typicalPrice - tpma) / mad);
		}

		private bool IsParametersCorrect(IRefinedSeries refinedSeries, IList<RefinedPoint> points, int pointsCount)
		{
			if (refinedSeries != null && IsCompatible(refinedSeries.SeriesView) && points != null && pointsCount > 1)
			{
				return points.Count > pointsCount;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public LineStrip Calculate(IRefinedSeries refinedSeries, IList<RefinedPoint> points, int pointsCount)
		{
			Calculated = false;
			int num = pointsCount;
			if (refinedSeries != null && refinedSeries.IsPointsAutoGenerated)
			{
				num = 3;
			}
			if (!IsParametersCorrect(refinedSeries, points, num))
			{
				return ObjectsFactory.Default.CreateLineStrip();
			}
			double num2 = 0.0;
			Queue<double> queue = new Queue<double>(num);
			double num3 = double.NaN;
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				num3 = CalculateTypicalPrice(points[i]);
				queue.Enqueue(num3);
				num2 += num3;
			}
			double num4 = num2 / (double)num;
			double mad = CalculateMad(queue, num4);
			double num5 = CalculateCCI(num3, num4, mad);
			LineStrip lineStrip = ObjectsFactory.Default.CreateLineStrip();
			lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(points[num - 1].Argument, num5));
			double num6 = num5;
			double num7 = num5;
			for (int j = num; j < points.Count; j++)
			{
				RefinedPoint refinedPoint = points[j];
				num3 = CalculateTypicalPrice(refinedPoint);
				num4 = num4 - queue.Dequeue() / (double)num + num3 / (double)num;
				queue.Enqueue(num3);
				mad = CalculateMad(queue, num4);
				num5 = CalculateCCI(num3, num4, mad);
				lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(refinedPoint.Argument, num5));
				if (num5 > num7)
				{
					num7 = num5;
				}
				if (num5 < num6)
				{
					num6 = num5;
				}
			}
			Calculated = true;
			YRange = new MinMaxValues(num6, num7);
			return lineStrip;
		}
	}

	public class MassIndexCalculator
	{
		private const int DesignTimeMaPointsCountCount = 3;

		private const int DesignTimeSumPointsCount = 4;

		public bool Calculated { get; private set; }

		public MinMaxValues YRange { get; private set; }

		public static bool IsCompatible(ISeriesView view)
		{
			return view is IFinancialSeriesView;
		}

		public MassIndexCalculator()
		{
			Calculated = false;
			YRange = MinMaxValues.Empty;
		}

		private bool IsParametersCorrect(IRefinedSeries refinedSeries, IList<RefinedPoint> points, int movingAveragePointsCount, int sumPointsCount)
		{
			if (refinedSeries != null && IsCompatible(refinedSeries.SeriesView) && points != null && movingAveragePointsCount > 1 && sumPointsCount > 0)
			{
				return points.Count >= sumPointsCount + 2 * movingAveragePointsCount - 3 + 1;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private double CalcNextEma(double value, double preEma, double smoothingFactor)
		{
			return smoothingFactor * value + (1.0 - smoothingFactor) * preEma;
		}

		public LineStrip Calculate(IRefinedSeries refinedSeries, IList<RefinedPoint> points, int movingAveragePointsCount, int sumPointsCount)
		{
			Calculated = false;
			int num = movingAveragePointsCount;
			int num2 = sumPointsCount;
			if (refinedSeries != null && refinedSeries.IsPointsAutoGenerated)
			{
				num = 3;
				num2 = 4;
			}
			if (!IsParametersCorrect(refinedSeries, points, num, num2))
			{
				return ObjectsFactory.Default.CreateLineStrip();
			}
			double smoothingFactor = 2.0 / (double)(num + 1);
			IFinancialPoint financialPoint = points[0];
			double num3 = financialPoint.High - financialPoint.Low;
			List<double> list = new List<double>(points.Count);
			list.Add(num3);
			for (int i = 1; i < points.Count; i++)
			{
				IFinancialPoint financialPoint2 = points[i];
				double value = financialPoint2.High - financialPoint2.Low;
				num3 = CalcNextEma(value, num3, smoothingFactor);
				list.Add(num3);
			}
			double num4 = list[num - 1];
			for (int j = num; j < 2 * num - 2; j++)
			{
				num4 = CalcNextEma(list[j], num4, smoothingFactor);
			}
			double num5 = 0.0;
			Queue<double> queue = new Queue<double>();
			for (int k = 2 * num - 2; k < num2 + 2 * num - 3 + 1; k++)
			{
				num4 = CalcNextEma(list[k], num4, smoothingFactor);
				double num6 = list[k] / num4;
				num5 += num6;
				queue.Enqueue(num6);
			}
			double num7 = num5;
			double num8 = num5;
			LineStrip lineStrip = ObjectsFactory.Default.CreateLineStrip();
			lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(points[num2 + 2 * num - 3].Argument, num5));
			for (int l = num2 + 2 * num - 3 + 1; l < points.Count; l++)
			{
				num4 = CalcNextEma(list[l], num4, smoothingFactor);
				double num9 = list[l] / num4;
				num5 = num5 - queue.Dequeue() + num9;
				queue.Enqueue(num9);
				lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(points[l].Argument, num5));
				if (num5 > num8)
				{
					num8 = num5;
				}
				if (num5 < num7)
				{
					num7 = num5;
				}
			}
			Calculated = true;
			YRange = new MinMaxValues(num7, num8);
			if (double.IsNaN(YRange.Delta))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return lineStrip;
		}
	}
	public class MovingAverageConvergenceDivergenceCalculator
	{
		private const int DesignTimeShortPeriod = 2;

		private const int DesignTimeLongPeriod = 4;

		private const int DesignTimeSmoothingPeriod = 2;

		public bool Calculated { get; private set; }

		public MinMaxValues YRange { get; private set; }

		public LineStrip MacdPoints { get; private set; }

		public LineStrip SignalPoints { get; private set; }

		public MovingAverageConvergenceDivergenceCalculator()
		{
			Calculated = false;
			YRange = MinMaxValues.Empty;
			MacdPoints = ObjectsFactory.Default.CreateLineStrip();
			SignalPoints = ObjectsFactory.Default.CreateLineStrip();
		}

		private double CalculateNextEma(double value, double preEma, double smoothingFactor)
		{
			return smoothingFactor * value + (1.0 - smoothingFactor) * preEma;
		}

		private bool IsParametersCorrect(IRefinedSeries refinedSeries, IList<RefinedPoint> points, int shortPeriod, int longPeriod, int smoothingPeriod, ValueLevelInternal valueLevel)
		{
			if (refinedSeries != null && points != null && shortPeriod > 0 && longPeriod > shortPeriod && smoothingPeriod > 0 && points.Count > longPeriod + smoothingPeriod)
			{
				return refinedSeries.SeriesView.IsCorrectValueLevel(valueLevel);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void Calculate(IRefinedSeries refinedSeries, IList<RefinedPoint> points, int shortPeriod, int longPeriod, int smoothingPeriod, ValueLevelInternal valueLevel)
		{
			Calculated = false;
			MacdPoints.Clear();
			SignalPoints.Clear();
			int num = shortPeriod;
			int num2 = longPeriod;
			int num3 = smoothingPeriod;
			if (refinedSeries != null && refinedSeries.IsPointsAutoGenerated)
			{
				num = 2;
				num2 = 4;
				num3 = 2;
			}
			if (!IsParametersCorrect(refinedSeries, points, num, num2, num3, valueLevel))
			{
				return;
			}
			double num4 = points[0].GetValue(valueLevel);
			double num5 = 1.0;
			for (int i = 1; i < num; i++)
			{
				num5 = 2.0 / ((double)i + 2.0);
				double value = points[i].GetValue(valueLevel);
				num4 = CalculateNextEma(value, num4, num5);
			}
			double num6 = num4;
			double smoothingFactor = num5;
			for (int j = num; j < num2; j++)
			{
				smoothingFactor = 2.0 / ((double)j + 2.0);
				double value2 = points[j].GetValue(valueLevel);
				num4 = CalculateNextEma(value2, num4, num5);
				num6 = CalculateNextEma(value2, num6, smoothingFactor);
			}
			double num7 = num4 - num6;
			double num8 = num7;
			double num9 = num7;
			MacdPoints.Add(new GRealPoint2D(points[num2 - 1].Argument, num7));
			double num10 = num7;
			double smoothingFactor2 = double.NaN;
			int num11 = num2;
			int num12 = 0;
			while (num11 < num2 + num3)
			{
				double value3 = points[num11].GetValue(valueLevel);
				num4 = CalculateNextEma(value3, num4, num5);
				num6 = CalculateNextEma(value3, num6, smoothingFactor);
				num7 = num4 - num6;
				smoothingFactor2 = 2.0 / ((double)num12 + 2.0);
				num10 = CalculateNextEma(num7, num10, smoothingFactor2);
				if (num7 > num9)
				{
					num9 = num7;
				}
				if (num7 < num8)
				{
					num8 = num7;
				}
				MacdPoints.Add(new GRealPoint2D(points[num11].Argument, num7));
				num11++;
				num12++;
			}
			if (num10 > num9)
			{
				num9 = num10;
			}
			if (num10 < num8)
			{
				num8 = num10;
			}
			SignalPoints.Add(new GRealPoint2D(points[num2 + num3 - 1].Argument, num10));
			for (int k = num2 + num3; k < points.Count; k++)
			{
				double value4 = points[k].GetValue(valueLevel);
				num4 = CalculateNextEma(value4, num4, num5);
				num6 = CalculateNextEma(value4, num6, smoothingFactor);
				num7 = num4 - num6;
				if (num7 > num9)
				{
					num9 = num7;
				}
				if (num7 < num8)
				{
					num8 = num7;
				}
				num10 = CalculateNextEma(num7, num10, smoothingFactor2);
				if (num10 > num9)
				{
					num9 = num10;
				}
				if (num10 < num8)
				{
					num8 = num10;
				}
				double argument = points[k].Argument;
				MacdPoints.Add(new GRealPoint2D(argument, num7));
				SignalPoints.Add(new GRealPoint2D(argument, num10));
			}
			Calculated = true;
			YRange = new MinMaxValues(num8, num9);
		}
	}
	public class RateOfChangeCalculator
	{
		private const int DesignTimePointsCount = 3;

		public bool Calculated { get; private set; }

		public MinMaxValues YRange { get; private set; }

		public RateOfChangeCalculator()
		{
			Calculated = false;
			YRange = MinMaxValues.Empty;
		}

		private double CalculateRoC(IList<RefinedPoint> refinedPoints, int currIndex, int usingPointsCount, ValueLevelInternal valueLevel)
		{
			double value = refinedPoints[currIndex].GetValue(valueLevel);
			double value2 = refinedPoints[currIndex - usingPointsCount].GetValue(valueLevel);
			if (value2 == 0.0)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			return (value - value2) / value2 * 100.0;
		}

		private bool IsParametersCorrect(IRefinedSeries refinedSeries, IList<RefinedPoint> points, int pointCount, ValueLevelInternal valueLevel)
		{
			if (pointCount > 1 && refinedSeries != null && points != null && points.Count > pointCount + 1 && refinedSeries.SeriesView != null)
			{
				return refinedSeries.SeriesView.IsCorrectValueLevel(valueLevel);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public LineStrip Calculate(IRefinedSeries refinedSeries, IList<RefinedPoint> points, int pointCount, ValueLevelInternal valueLevel)
		{
			Calculated = false;
			int num = pointCount;
			if (refinedSeries != null && refinedSeries.IsPointsAutoGenerated)
			{
				num = 3;
			}
			if (!IsParametersCorrect(refinedSeries, points, num, valueLevel))
			{
				return ObjectsFactory.Default.CreateLineStrip();
			}
			LineStrip lineStrip = ObjectsFactory.Default.CreateLineStrip();
			double num2 = CalculateRoC(points, num, num, valueLevel);
			double num3 = num2;
			double num4 = num2;
			for (int i = num; i < points.Count; i++)
			{
				double num5 = CalculateRoC(points, i, num, valueLevel);
				lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(points[i].Argument, num5));
				if (num5 > num4)
				{
					num4 = num5;
				}
				if (num5 < num3)
				{
					num3 = num5;
				}
			}
			Calculated = true;
			YRange = new MinMaxValues(num3, num4);
			return lineStrip;
		}
	}
	public class RelativeStrengthIndexCalculator
	{
		private const int DesignTimePointsCount = 3;

		public bool Calculated { get; private set; }

		public MinMaxValues YRange { get; private set; }

		public RelativeStrengthIndexCalculator()
		{
			Calculated = false;
			YRange = MinMaxValues.Empty;
		}

		private bool IsParametersCorrect(IRefinedSeries refinedSeries, IList<RefinedPoint> points, int pointsCount, ValueLevelInternal valueLevel)
		{
			if (refinedSeries != null && points != null && pointsCount > 0 && points.Count > pointsCount + 1 && refinedSeries.SeriesView != null)
			{
				return refinedSeries.SeriesView.IsCorrectValueLevel(valueLevel);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private double CalcNextEma(double value, double preEma, double smoothingFactor)
		{
			return smoothingFactor * value + (1.0 - smoothingFactor) * preEma;
		}

		public LineStrip Calculate(IRefinedSeries refinedSeries, IList<RefinedPoint> points, int pointCount, ValueLevelInternal valueLevel)
		{
			Calculated = false;
			int num = pointCount;
			if (refinedSeries != null && refinedSeries.IsPointsAutoGenerated)
			{
				num = 3;
			}
			if (!IsParametersCorrect(refinedSeries, points, num, valueLevel))
			{
				return ObjectsFactory.Default.CreateLineStrip();
			}
			LineStrip lineStrip = ObjectsFactory.Default.CreateLineStrip();
			List<double> list = new List<double>(points.Count);
			list.Add(double.NaN);
			List<double> list2 = new List<double>(points.Count);
			list2.Add(double.NaN);
			for (int i = 1; i < points.Count; i++)
			{
				double value = points[i].GetValue(valueLevel);
				double value2 = points[i - 1].GetValue(valueLevel);
				double num2 = value - value2;
				if (num2 > 0.0)
				{
					list.Add(num2);
					list2.Add(0.0);
				}
				else
				{
					list.Add(0.0);
					list2.Add(0.0 - num2);
				}
			}
			double smoothingFactor = 1.0 / (double)num;
			double num3 = list[1];
			double num4 = list2[1];
			for (int j = 2; j < num + 1; j++)
			{
				num3 = CalcNextEma(list[j], num3, smoothingFactor);
				num4 = CalcNextEma(list2[j], num4, smoothingFactor);
			}
			double num5 = double.NaN;
			if (num4 == 0.0)
			{
				num5 = 100.0;
			}
			else
			{
				double num6 = num3 / num4;
				num5 = 100.0 - 100.0 / (1.0 + num6);
			}
			lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(points[num].Argument, num5));
			double num7 = num5;
			double num8 = num5;
			for (int k = num + 1; k < points.Count; k++)
			{
				num3 = CalcNextEma(list[k], num3, smoothingFactor);
				num4 = CalcNextEma(list2[k], num4, smoothingFactor);
				double num9 = double.NaN;
				if (num4 == 0.0)
				{
					num9 = 100.0;
				}
				else
				{
					double num10 = num3 / num4;
					num9 = 100.0 - 100.0 / (1.0 + num10);
				}
				lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(points[k].Argument, num9));
				if (num9 > num8)
				{
					num8 = num9;
				}
				if (num9 < num7)
				{
					num7 = num9;
				}
			}
			Calculated = true;
			YRange = new MinMaxValues(num7, num8);
			return lineStrip;
		}
	}
	public class StandardDeviationCalculator
	{
		private const int DesignTimePointsCount = 3;

		public bool Calculated { get; private set; }

		public MinMaxValues YRange { get; private set; }

		public StandardDeviationCalculator()
		{
			Calculated = false;
			YRange = MinMaxValues.Empty;
		}

		private bool IsParametersCorrect(IRefinedSeries refinedSeries, IList<RefinedPoint> points, int pointCount, ValueLevelInternal valueLevel)
		{
			if (refinedSeries != null && refinedSeries.SeriesView != null && points != null && points.Count > 2 * pointCount - 1 && pointCount > 0)
			{
				return refinedSeries.SeriesView.IsCorrectValueLevel(valueLevel);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private double CalculateNextSma(double value, double preSma, int actualPointsCount, double firstInPeriodValue)
		{
			return preSma - firstInPeriodValue / (double)actualPointsCount + value / (double)actualPointsCount;
		}

		private double CalculateStandardDeviation(IList<RefinedPoint> refinedPoints, int actualPointsCount, ValueLevelInternal valueLevel, double sma, int currentRefinedPointIndex)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			for (int i = currentRefinedPointIndex - actualPointsCount + 1; i < currentRefinedPointIndex + 1; i++)
			{
				double value = refinedPoints[i].GetValue(valueLevel);
				num += (value - sma) * (value - sma);
			}
			return Math.Sqrt(num / (double)actualPointsCount);
		}

		public LineStrip Calculate(IRefinedSeries refinedSeries, IList<RefinedPoint> points, int pointCount, ValueLevelInternal valueLevel)
		{
			Calculated = false;
			int num = pointCount;
			if (refinedSeries != null && refinedSeries.IsPointsAutoGenerated)
			{
				num = 3;
			}
			if (!IsParametersCorrect(refinedSeries, points, num, valueLevel))
			{
				return ObjectsFactory.Default.CreateLineStrip();
			}
			LineStrip lineStrip = ObjectsFactory.Default.CreateLineStrip();
			Queue<double> queue = new Queue<double>(num);
			double num2 = 0.0;
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				double value = points[i].GetValue(valueLevel);
				queue.Enqueue(value);
				num2 += value;
			}
			double num3 = num2 / (double)num;
			for (int j = num; j < 2 * num - 1; j++)
			{
				double value2 = points[j].GetValue(valueLevel);
				double firstInPeriodValue = queue.Dequeue();
				num3 = CalculateNextSma(value2, num3, num, firstInPeriodValue);
				queue.Enqueue(value2);
			}
			double num4 = 0.0;
			for (int k = num - 1; k < 2 * num - 1; k++)
			{
				double value3 = points[k].GetValue(valueLevel);
				num4 += (value3 - num3) * (value3 - num3);
			}
			double num5 = Math.Sqrt(num4 / (double)num);
			double num6 = num5;
			double num7 = num5;
			double argument = points[2 * num - 2].Argument;
			lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(argument, num5));
			for (int l = 2 * num - 1; l < points.Count; l++)
			{
				double value4 = points[l].GetValue(valueLevel);
				double firstInPeriodValue2 = queue.Dequeue();
				num3 = CalculateNextSma(value4, num3, num, firstInPeriodValue2);
				queue.Enqueue(value4);
				double num8 = CalculateStandardDeviation(points, num, valueLevel, num3, l);
				lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(points[l].Argument, num8));
				if (num8 > num7)
				{
					num7 = num8;
				}
				if (num8 < num6)
				{
					num6 = num8;
				}
			}
			Calculated = true;
			YRange = new MinMaxValues(num6, num7);
			return lineStrip;
		}
	}
	public abstract class SimpleStandardDeviationCalculator
	{
		protected abstract double GetValue(RefinedPoint point);

		public bool Calculate(IList<RefinedSeries> seriesList, out double standardDeviation, out double average, out int pointsCount)
		{
			average = 0.0;
			standardDeviation = 0.0;
			pointsCount = 0;
			if (seriesList == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			double num = 0.0;
			foreach (RefinedSeries series in seriesList)
			{
				IList<RefinedPoint> points = series.Points;
				pointsCount += points.Count;
				for (int i = 0; i < points.Count; i++)
				{
					num += GetValue(points[i]);
				}
			}
			double num2 = num / (double)pointsCount;
			if (!GeometricUtils.IsValidDouble(num2))
			{
				return false;
			}
			average = num2;
			double num3 = 0.0;
			foreach (RefinedSeries series2 in seriesList)
			{
				IList<RefinedPoint> points2 = series2.Points;
				for (int j = 0; j < points2.Count; j++)
				{
					double value = GetValue(points2[j]);
					num3 += (value - num2) * (value - num2);
				}
			}
			standardDeviation = Math.Sqrt(num3 / (double)(pointsCount - 1));
			return true;
		}
	}
	public class NumericArgumentSimpleStandardDeviationCalculator : SimpleStandardDeviationCalculator
	{
		protected override double GetValue(RefinedPoint point)
		{
			return point.Argument;
		}
	}
	public class DateTimeArgumentSimpleStandardDeviationCalculator : SimpleStandardDeviationCalculator

		}

		protected override double GetValue(RefinedPoint point)

			//IL_002c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			double argument = point.Argument;
			if (map != null)
			{
				return map.NativeToRefined(DateTimeUtils.Floor((DateTime)map.RefinedToNative(argument), map.MeasureUnit));
			}
			return argument;
		}
	}

			this.map = map;

		protected override double GetValue(RefinedPoint point)

			double argument = point.Argument;
			if (map != null)
			{
				return map.NativeToRefined(DateTimeUtilsExt.Floor((TimeSpan)map.RefinedToNative(argument), map.MeasureUnit));
			}
			return argument;
		}
	}
	public class ChaikinsVolatilityCalculator
	{
		private const int DesignTimePointsCount = 3;

		private readonly LineStrip indicatorPoints = new LineStrip();

		private readonly List<double> emaValues = new List<double>();

		private MinMaxValues rangeByY = MinMaxValues.Empty;

		public MinMaxValues YRange
		{
			get
			{
				if (rangeByY.IsEmpty)
				{
					rangeByY = CalculateRange();
				}
				return rangeByY;
			}
		}

		public LineStrip IndicatorPoints => indicatorPoints;

		public static bool IsCompatible(ISeriesView view)
		{
			return view is IFinancialSeriesView;
		}

		private MinMaxValues CalculateRange()
		{
			if (indicatorPoints.Count == 0)
			{
				return MinMaxValues.Empty;
			}
			double num = indicatorPoints[0].Y;
			double num2 = num;
			for (int i = 1; i < indicatorPoints.Count; i++)
			{
				double y = indicatorPoints[i].Y;
				num = Math.Min(num, y);
				num2 = Math.Max(num2, y);
			}
			return new MinMaxValues(num, num2);
		}

		private double CalcChv(double ema, double oldEma)
		{
			return (ema - oldEma) / oldEma * 100.0;
		}

		private double CalcNextEma(IFinancialPoint point, double preEma, double smoothingFactor)
		{
			return smoothingFactor * (point.High - point.Low) + (1.0 - smoothingFactor) * preEma;
		}

		private bool IsParametersCorrect(IRefinedSeries refinedSeries, IList<RefinedPoint> points, int pointsCount)
		{
			if (refinedSeries != null && IsCompatible(refinedSeries.SeriesView) && points != null && pointsCount > 0)
			{
				return points.Count > pointsCount + 1;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void ResetData()
		{
			emaValues.Clear();
			indicatorPoints.Clear();
		}

		public void Calculate(IRefinedSeries refinedSeries, IList<RefinedPoint> points, int startUpdateIndex, int pointsCount)
		{
			lock (indicatorPoints)
			{
				int num = pointsCount;
				if (refinedSeries != null && refinedSeries.IsPointsAutoGenerated)
				{
					num = 3;
				}
				if (!IsParametersCorrect(refinedSeries, points, num))
				{
					ResetData();
					rangeByY = MinMaxValues.Empty;
					return;
				}
				if (startUpdateIndex < num)
				{
					ResetData();
					startUpdateIndex = 0;
				}
				else
				{
					emaValues.RemoveRange(startUpdateIndex, emaValues.Count - startUpdateIndex);
					indicatorPoints.RemoveRange(startUpdateIndex - num, indicatorPoints.Count - startUpdateIndex + num);
				}
				double smoothingFactor = 1.0;
				Queue<double> queue = new Queue<double>(num);
				double num2;
				if (startUpdateIndex < num)
				{
					IFinancialPoint financialPoint = points[0];
					num2 = financialPoint.High - financialPoint.Low;
					queue.Enqueue(num2);
					emaValues.Add(num2);
					for (int i = 1; i < num; i++)
					{
						IFinancialPoint point = points[i];
						smoothingFactor = 2.0 / ((double)i + 1.0);
						num2 = CalcNextEma(point, num2, smoothingFactor);
						queue.Enqueue(num2);
						emaValues.Add(num2);
					}
					startUpdateIndex = num;
				}
				else
				{
					smoothingFactor = 2.0 / (double)num;
					int index = ((startUpdateIndex <= num + 1) ? (num - 1) : (startUpdateIndex - 1));
					num2 = emaValues[index];
					for (int j = startUpdateIndex - num; j < startUpdateIndex; j++)
					{
						queue.Enqueue(emaValues[j]);
					}
				}
				if (startUpdateIndex == num)
				{
					IFinancialPoint financialPoint2 = points[num];
					double num3 = CalcNextEma(financialPoint2, num2, smoothingFactor);
					double num4 = CalcChv(num3, queue.Dequeue());
					queue.Enqueue(num3);
					emaValues.Add(num3);
					double y = ((indicatorPoints.Count > 0) ? indicatorPoints.Last().Y : 0.0);
					if (!double.IsInfinity(num4) && !double.IsNaN(num4))
					{
						indicatorPoints.Add(new GRealPoint2D(financialPoint2.Argument, num4));
					}
					else
					{
						indicatorPoints.Add(new GRealPoint2D(financialPoint2.Argument, y));
					}
					startUpdateIndex++;
				}
				for (int k = startUpdateIndex; k < points.Count; k++)
				{
					IFinancialPoint financialPoint3 = points[k];
					num2 = CalcNextEma(financialPoint3, num2, smoothingFactor);
					double num5 = CalcChv(num2, queue.Dequeue());
					queue.Enqueue(num2);
					emaValues.Add(num2);
					double y2 = ((indicatorPoints.Count > 0) ? indicatorPoints.Last().Y : 0.0);
					if (!double.IsInfinity(num5) && !double.IsNaN(num5))
					{
						indicatorPoints.Add(new GRealPoint2D(financialPoint3.Argument, num5));
					}
					else
					{
						indicatorPoints.Add(new GRealPoint2D(financialPoint3.Argument, y2));
					}
				}
				if (!rangeByY.IsEmpty && startUpdateIndex == points.Count - 1)
				{
					rangeByY.Union(indicatorPoints[indicatorPoints.Count - 1].Y);
				}
				else
				{
					rangeByY = MinMaxValues.Empty;
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public class WilliamsRCalculator
	{
		private const int DesignTimePointsCount = 3;

		private const double MeanValue = -50.0;

		public bool Calculated { get; private set; }

		public MinMaxValues YRange { get; private set; }

		public List<GRealPoint2D> IndicatorPoints { get; private set; }

		public static bool IsCompatible(ISeriesView view)
		{
			return view is IFinancialSeriesView;
		}

		public WilliamsRCalculator()
		{
			Calculated = false;
			YRange = MinMaxValues.Empty;
			IndicatorPoints = new List<GRealPoint2D>();
		}

		private void FindMinMax(IList<RefinedPoint> refinedPoints, int currentIndex, int usingPointsCount, out double maxHigh, out double minLow)
		{
			IFinancialPoint financialPoint = refinedPoints[currentIndex];
			maxHigh = financialPoint.High;
			minLow = financialPoint.Low;
			for (int num = currentIndex - 1; num > currentIndex - usingPointsCount; num--)
			{
				IFinancialPoint financialPoint2 = refinedPoints[num];
				if (maxHigh < financialPoint2.High)
				{
					maxHigh = financialPoint2.High;
				}
				if (minLow > financialPoint2.Low)
				{
					minLow = financialPoint2.Low;
				}
			}
		}

		private void FindMinMax(double[] highValues, double[] lowValues, out double maxHigh, out double minLow)
		{
			int num = highValues.Length;
			maxHigh = highValues[num - 1];
			minLow = lowValues[num - 1];
			for (int num2 = num - 2; num2 >= 0; num2--)
			{
				if (maxHigh < highValues[num2])
				{
					maxHigh = highValues[num2];
				}
				if (minLow > lowValues[num2])
				{
					minLow = lowValues[num2];
				}
			}
		}

		private bool IsParametersCorrect(IRefinedSeries refinedSeries, IList<RefinedPoint> points, int pointsCount)
		{
			if (refinedSeries != null && IsCompatible(refinedSeries.SeriesView) && points != null && pointsCount > 0)
			{
				return points.Count >= pointsCount;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public LineStrip Calculate(IRefinedSeries refinedSeries, IList<RefinedPoint> points, int pointCount)
		{
			Calculated = false;
			int num = pointCount;
			if (refinedSeries != null && refinedSeries.IsPointsAutoGenerated)
			{
				num = 3;
			}
			if (!IsParametersCorrect(refinedSeries, points, num))
			{
				return ObjectsFactory.Default.CreateLineStrip();
			}
			IFinancialPoint financialPoint = points[0];
			double num2 = (financialPoint.Close - financialPoint.High) / (financialPoint.High - financialPoint.Low) * 100.0;
			if (double.IsNaN(num2))
			{
				num2 = -50.0;
			}
			double num3 = num2;
			double num4 = num2;
			LineStrip lineStrip = ObjectsFactory.Default.CreateLineStrip();
			lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(financialPoint.Argument, num2));
			double high = financialPoint.High;
			double low = financialPoint.Low;
			for (int i = 1; i < num; i++)
			{
				IFinancialPoint financialPoint2 = points[i];
				if (high < financialPoint2.High)
				{
					high = financialPoint2.High;
				}
				if (low > financialPoint2.Low)
				{
					low = financialPoint2.Low;
				}
				double num5 = (financialPoint2.Close - high) / (high - low) * 100.0;
				if (num5 > num3)
				{
					num3 = num5;
				}
				if (num5 < num4)
				{
					num4 = num5;
				}
				lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(financialPoint2.Argument, double.IsNaN(num5) ? (-50.0) : num5));
			}
			for (int j = num; j < points.Count; j++)
			{
				double maxHigh = double.NaN;
				double minLow = double.NaN;
				FindMinMax(points, j, num, out maxHigh, out minLow);
				IFinancialPoint financialPoint3 = points[j];
				double num6 = (financialPoint3.Close - maxHigh) / (maxHigh - minLow) * 100.0;
				if (num6 > num3)
				{
					num3 = num6;
				}
				if (num6 < num4)
				{
					num4 = num6;
				}
				lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(financialPoint3.Argument, double.IsNaN(num6) ? (-50.0) : num6));
			}
			Calculated = true;
			YRange = new MinMaxValues(num4, num3);
			return lineStrip;
		}

		public void UpdateIndicatorData(int startUpdateIndex, IRefinedSeries refinedSeries, IList<RefinedPoint> points, int pointCount)
		{
			Calculated = false;
			int num = pointCount;
			if (refinedSeries != null && refinedSeries.IsPointsAutoGenerated)
			{
				num = 3;
			}
			if (!IsParametersCorrect(refinedSeries, points, num))
			{
				IndicatorPoints.Clear();
				YRange = MinMaxValues.Empty;
				return;
			}
			Queue<double> queue = new Queue<double>(num);
			Queue<double> queue2 = new Queue<double>(num);
			double num2 = double.MinValue;
			double num3 = double.MaxValue;
			double num4 = double.MinValue;
			double num5 = double.MaxValue;
			int num6 = -1;
			if (IndicatorPoints.Count == 0 || startUpdateIndex < num)
			{
				IndicatorPoints.Clear();
				IFinancialPoint financialPoint = points[0];
				double num7 = (financialPoint.Close - financialPoint.High) / (financialPoint.High - financialPoint.Low) * 100.0;
				if (double.IsNaN(num7) || double.IsInfinity(num7))
				{
					num7 = -50.0;
				}
				num2 = num7;
				num3 = num7;
				IndicatorPoints.Add(new GRealPoint2D(financialPoint.Argument, num7));
				num4 = financialPoint.High;
				num5 = financialPoint.Low;
				queue.Enqueue(financialPoint.High);
				queue2.Enqueue(financialPoint.Low);
				for (int i = 1; i < num; i++)
				{
					IFinancialPoint financialPoint2 = points[i];
					if (num4 < financialPoint2.High)
					{
						num4 = financialPoint2.High;
					}
					if (num5 > financialPoint2.Low)
					{
						num5 = financialPoint2.Low;
					}
					double num8 = (financialPoint2.Close - num4) / (num4 - num5) * 100.0;
					if (num8 > num2)
					{
						num2 = num8;
					}
					if (num8 < num3)
					{
						num3 = num8;
					}
					IndicatorPoints.Add(new GRealPoint2D(financialPoint2.Argument, double.IsNaN(num8) ? (-50.0) : num8));
					queue.Enqueue(financialPoint2.High);
					queue2.Enqueue(financialPoint2.Low);
				}
				num6 = num;
			}
			else
			{
				num2 = YRange.Max;
				num3 = YRange.Min;
				num6 = startUpdateIndex;
				IndicatorPoints.RemoveRange(startUpdateIndex, IndicatorPoints.Count - startUpdateIndex);
				for (int j = num6 - num; j < startUpdateIndex; j++)
				{
					IFinancialPoint financialPoint3 = points[j];
					queue.Enqueue(financialPoint3.High);
					queue2.Enqueue(financialPoint3.Low);
				}
			}
			for (int k = num6; k < points.Count; k++)
			{
				double maxHigh = double.NaN;
				double minLow = double.NaN;
				IFinancialPoint financialPoint4 = points[k];
				queue.Dequeue();
				queue2.Dequeue();
				queue.Enqueue(financialPoint4.High);
				queue2.Enqueue(financialPoint4.Low);
				FindMinMax(queue.ToArray(), queue2.ToArray(), out maxHigh, out minLow);
				double num9 = (financialPoint4.Close - maxHigh) / (maxHigh - minLow) * 100.0;
				if (num9 > num2)
				{
					num2 = num9;
				}
				if (num9 < num3)
				{
					num3 = num9;
				}
				IndicatorPoints.Add(new GRealPoint2D(financialPoint4.Argument, double.IsNaN(num9) ? (-50.0) : num9));
			}
			Calculated = true;
			YRange = new MinMaxValues(num3, num2);
		}
	}
