	public class GridSpacingCalculator
	{
		private readonly IAxisData axis;

		private readonly IAxisGridMapping mapping;

		private readonly IScaleOptionsBase actualScaleOptions;

		private readonly double axisLength;

		private readonly double delta;

		private bool IsLogarithmic
		{
			get
			{
				if (axis is ILogarithmic { Enabled: not false } && axis.AxisScaleTypeMap != null)
				{
					return axis.AxisScaleTypeMap.ScaleType == ActualScaleTypeCore.Numerical;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public static double Calculate(double axisRangeDelta, double screenDelta, double gridSpacingFactor)
		{
			ChartDebug.Assert(axisRangeDelta > 0.0, "axisRangeDelta must be > 0");
			ChartDebug.Assert(gridSpacingFactor > 0.0, "gridSpacingFactor must be > 0");
			if (axisRangeDelta <= 0.0)
			{
				return 1.0;
			}
			if (screenDelta <= 0.0)
			{
				return axisRangeDelta;
			}
			return MultiplierChooser.ChooseMultiplier(gridSpacingFactor * axisRangeDelta / screenDelta);
		}

		public static double Calculate(IAxisData axis, IAxisGridMapping mapping, IScaleOptionsBase actualScaleOptions, IMinMaxValues visualRange, double axisLength)
		{
			GridSpacingCalculator gridSpacingCalculator = new GridSpacingCalculator(axis, mapping, actualScaleOptions, visualRange, axisLength);
			return gridSpacingCalculator.CalculateGridSpacing();
		}

		private GridSpacingCalculator(IAxisData axis, IAxisGridMapping mapping, IScaleOptionsBase actualScaleOptions, IMinMaxValues visualRange, double axisLength)
		{
			this.axis = axis;
			this.mapping = mapping;
			this.actualScaleOptions = actualScaleOptions;
			this.axisLength = axisLength;
			delta = CalculateDelta(visualRange);
		}

		private double CalculateDelta(IMinMaxValues visualRange)
		{
			if (IsLogarithmic)
			{
				Transformation transformation = axis.AxisScaleTypeMap.Transformation;
				double num = transformation.TransformForward(visualRange.Max) - transformation.TransformForward(visualRange.Min);
				if (!(num > 0.0))
				{
					return 1.0;
				}
				return num;
			}
			return visualRange.Delta;
		}

		private double CalculateManualGridSpacing()
		{
			double num = actualScaleOptions.GridSpacing;
			double num2 = axisLength;
			if (num2 < 1.0)
			{
				num2 = 1.0;
			}
			double num3 = mapping.InternalToAligned(delta) / num2;
			if (num < num3)
			{
				num = ((num == 0.0) ? num3 : (Math.Floor(num3 / num) * num));
			}
			if (IsLogarithmic)
			{
				num = (int)(num + 0.5);
			}
			return num;
		}

		private double CalculateLogarithmicGridSpacing()
		{
			double num = ((!actualScaleOptions.GridSpacingAuto) ? CalculateManualGridSpacing() : Calculate(delta, axisLength, axis.GridSpacingFactor));
			if (delta <= 1.0)
			{
				if (num != 0.0)
				{
					return num;
				}
				return 1.0;
			}
			if (!(num < 1.0))
			{
				return Math.Floor(num);
			}
			return 1.0;
		}

		private double CalculateNumericGridSpacing()
		{
			double num = ((!actualScaleOptions.GridSpacingAuto) ? CalculateManualGridSpacing() : mapping.InternalToAligned(Calculate(delta, axisLength, axis.GridSpacingFactor)));
			if (axis.AxisScaleTypeMap.ScaleType == ActualScaleTypeCore.Numerical && axis.NumericScaleOptions.ScaleMode != ScaleModeNative.Continuous)
			{
				num = Math.Max(1.0, num);
			}
			return num;
		}

		private double CalculateQualitativeGridSpacing()
		{
			double value = ((!actualScaleOptions.GridSpacingAuto) ? actualScaleOptions.GridSpacing : mapping.InternalToAligned(Calculate(delta, axisLength, axis.GridSpacingFactor)));
			return Math.Max(1, GeometricUtils.StrongRound(value));
		}

		private double CalculateGridSpacing()
		{
			if (axis.AxisScaleTypeMap == null)
			{
				return 1.0;
			}
			if (IsLogarithmic)
			{
				return CalculateLogarithmicGridSpacing();
			}
			double num = 0.0;
			ActualScaleTypeCore scaleType = axis.AxisScaleTypeMap.ScaleType;
			if (scaleType == ActualScaleTypeCore.Numerical || ((scaleType == ActualScaleTypeCore.DateTime || scaleType == ActualScaleTypeCore.TimeSpan) && axis.IsRadarAxis))
			{
				num = CalculateNumericGridSpacing();
			}
			else
			{
				switch (scaleType)
				{
				case ActualScaleTypeCore.DateTime:
					num = (axis.DateTimeScaleOptions.GridSpacingAuto ? axis.DateTimeScaleOptions.GridSpacing : CalculateManualGridSpacing());
					break;
				case ActualScaleTypeCore.TimeSpan:
					num = (axis.TimeSpanScaleOptions.GridSpacingAuto ? axis.TimeSpanScaleOptions.GridSpacing : CalculateManualGridSpacing());
					break;
				case ActualScaleTypeCore.Qualitative:
					num = CalculateQualitativeGridSpacing();
					break;
				}
			}
			if (num == 0.0)
			{
				return 1.0;
			}
			return num;
		}
	}
	public class GridAndTextData
	{
		private readonly IAxisData axis;

		private readonly IMinMaxValues visualRange;

		private readonly bool scrollingEnabled;

		private readonly bool staggered;

		private readonly double axisLength;

		private readonly IAxisGridMapping mapping;

		private IScaleOptionsBase actualScaleOptions;

		private AxisGridData gridData;

		private AxisTextData textData;

		private IScaleOptionsBase ActualScaleOptions
		{
			get
			{
				if (actualScaleOptions == null)
				{
					actualScaleOptions = GetActualScaleOptions();
				}
				return actualScaleOptions;
			}
		}

		public double AxisLength => axisLength;

		public AxisGridData GridData => gridData;

		public GridAndTextData(IEnumerable<ISeries> seriesList, IAxisData axis, bool scrollingEnabled, IMinMaxValues visualRange, double axisLength, bool staggered)
		{
			this.axis = axis;
			this.visualRange = visualRange;
			this.axisLength = axisLength;
			this.scrollingEnabled = scrollingEnabled;
			this.staggered = staggered;
			mapping = GetAxisMapping(seriesList);
			gridData = CalculateGridData(mapping);
		}

		private AxisGridData CalculateGridData(IAxisGridMapping mapping)
		{
			double gridSpacing = CalculateGridSpacing();
			UpdateScaleOptionsGridSpacing(gridSpacing);
			return new AxisGridData(axis, mapping, visualRange, axis.IsRadarAxis, axis.MinorCount, gridSpacing, ActualScaleOptions.GridLayoutMode);
		}

		private AxisTextData CalculateTextData(IAxisGridMapping mapping, bool scrollingEnabled, double? intersectionAxisInternalValue)
		{
			return new AxisTextData(axis, mapping, visualRange, axis.IsRadarAxis, scrollingEnabled, staggered, gridData, intersectionAxisInternalValue);
		}

		private IAxisGridMapping GetAxisMapping(IEnumerable<ISeries> seriesList)
		{
			UpdateDateTimeAutomaticGrid(seriesList, axisLength);
			return axis.GridMapping;
		}

		private IScaleOptionsBase GetActualScaleOptions()
		{
			if (axis.AxisScaleTypeMap == null)
			{
				return axis.QualitativeScaleOptions;
			}
			switch (axis.AxisScaleTypeMap.ScaleType)
			{
			case ActualScaleTypeCore.DateTime:
				return axis.DateTimeScaleOptions;
			case ActualScaleTypeCore.Numerical:
				return axis.NumericScaleOptions;
			case ActualScaleTypeCore.Qualitative:
				return axis.QualitativeScaleOptions;
			case ActualScaleTypeCore.TimeSpan:
				return axis.TimeSpanScaleOptions;
			default:
				ChartDebug.Fail("Unknown scale type");
				return axis.QualitativeScaleOptions;
			}
		}

		private void UpdateDateTimeAutomaticGrid(IEnumerable<ISeries> seriesList, double axisLength)
		{
			if (!axis.IsRadarAxis)
			{
				if (axis.AxisScaleTypeMap.ScaleType == ActualScaleTypeCore.DateTime)
				{
					axis.DateTimeScaleOptions.Calculator.UpdateAutomaticGrid(axisLength, seriesList, visualRange);
				}
				if (axis.AxisScaleTypeMap.ScaleType == ActualScaleTypeCore.TimeSpan)
				{
					axis.TimeSpanScaleOptions.Calculator.UpdateAutomaticGrid(axisLength, seriesList, visualRange);
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdateScaleOptionsGridSpacing(double gridSpacing)
		{
			int num;
			switch (axis.AxisScaleTypeMap.ScaleType)
			{
			case ActualScaleTypeCore.DateTime:
			case ActualScaleTypeCore.TimeSpan:
				num = (axis.IsRadarAxis ? 1 : 0);
				break;
			default:
				num = 0;
				break;
			case ActualScaleTypeCore.Numerical:
				num = 1;
				break;
			}
			bool flag = (byte)num != 0;
			if (ActualScaleOptions.GridSpacingAuto && flag)
			{
				ActualScaleOptions.GridSpacing = gridSpacing;
			}
		}

		public AxisTextData GetTextData(double? intersectionAxisInternalValue = null)
		{
			if (textData == null)
			{
				textData = CalculateTextData(mapping, scrollingEnabled, intersectionAxisInternalValue);
			}
			return textData;
		}

		public double CalculateGridSpacing()
		{
			return GridSpacingCalculator.Calculate(axis, axis.GridMapping, ActualScaleOptions, visualRange, axisLength);
		}
	}
	public abstract class AxisGridTextDataBase
	{
		private readonly IAxisData axis;

		private readonly IAxisGridMapping mapping;

		private readonly IMinMaxValues visualRange;

		private readonly bool isRadarAxis;

		protected IAxisData Axis => axis;

		protected IAxisGridMapping Mapping => mapping;

		protected IMinMaxValues VisualRange => visualRange;

		protected bool IsRadarAxis => isRadarAxis;

		protected AxisGridTextDataBase(IAxisData axis, IAxisGridMapping mapping, IMinMaxValues visualRange, bool isRadarAxis)
		{
			this.axis = axis;
			this.mapping = mapping;
			this.visualRange = visualRange;
			this.isRadarAxis = isRadarAxis;
		}

		private double NormalizeStripValue(double value)
		{
			if (double.IsPositiveInfinity(value))
			{
				return visualRange.Max;
			}
			if (double.IsNegativeInfinity(value))
			{
				return visualRange.Min;
			}
			return Math.Max(Math.Min(value, visualRange.Max), visualRange.Min);
		}

		private bool IsStripVisible(IStrip strip)
		{
			if (!strip.Visible)
			{
				return false;
			}
			IStripLimit minLimit = strip.MinLimit;
			IStripLimit maxLimit = strip.MaxLimit;
			object obj = (minLimit.IsEnabled ? minLimit.AxisValue : null);
			object obj2 = (maxLimit.IsEnabled ? maxLimit.AxisValue : null);
			if ((obj != null && !mapping.IsCompatible(obj)) || (obj2 != null && !mapping.IsCompatible(obj2)))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (obj != null && obj2 != null)
			{
				return mapping.NativeToInternal(obj2) > mapping.NativeToInternal(obj);
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool IsAxisValueVisible(object axisValue)
		{
			if (!axis.AxisScaleTypeMap.IsCompatible(axisValue))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (axis.AxisScaleTypeMap.ScaleType == ActualScaleTypeCore.DateTime && axis.DateTimeScaleOptions.WorkdaysOptions != null && axis.DateTimeScaleOptions.WorkdaysOptions.WorkdaysOnly)
			{
				return !DateTimeUtils.IsHoliday(axis.DateTimeScaleOptions.WorkdaysOptions, (DateTime)axisValue, applyHolidays: true, applyExactWorkdays: true);
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool IsStripVisibleInGrid(IStrip strip)
		{
			if (IsStripVisible(strip) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(strip.AxisLabelText))
			{
				return !double.IsNaN(CalcStripGridValue(strip));
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected double CalcStripGridValue(IStrip strip)
		{
			double num = NormalizeStripValue(strip.MinLimit.ActualValue);
			double num2 = NormalizeStripValue(strip.MaxLimit.ActualValue);
			if (!(num < num2))
			{
				return double.NaN;
			}
			return (num + num2) / 2.0;
		}

		protected IEnumerable<IStrip> GetVisibleStrips()
		{
			if (Axis.Strips == null)
			{
				yield break;
			}
			foreach (IStrip strip in Axis.Strips)
			{
				if (IsStripVisibleInGrid(strip))
				{
					yield return strip;
				}
			}
		}

		protected IEnumerable<ICustomAxisLabel> GetVisibleLabels()
		{
			if (Axis.CustomLabels == null)
			{
				yield break;
			}
			foreach (ICustomAxisLabel customLabel in Axis.CustomLabels)
			{
				if (customLabel.Visible && IsAxisValueVisible(customLabel.AxisValue))
				{
					yield return customLabel;
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public class AxisTextData : AxisGridTextDataBase
	{
		private class AxisTextConstructor
		{
			public object ConstructAxisLabelText(AxisGridData gridData, double value, IAxisData axisData, IAxisGridMapping mapping)
			{
				object nativeValue = GetNativeValue(value, mapping);
				IAxisLabelFormatterCore formatter = axisData.Label.Formatter;
				if (formatter != null)
				{
					return formatter.GetAxisLabelText(nativeValue);
				}
				string pattern = GetPattern(axisData, nativeValue);
				PatternParser patternParser = new PatternParser(pattern, (IPatternHolder)axisData.Label);
				SetParserContext(patternParser, nativeValue, value, axisData, gridData.GridSpacing, mapping);
				return patternParser.GetText();
			}

			protected virtual object GetNativeValue(double value, IAxisGridMapping mapping)
			{
				return mapping.InternalToNative(value);
			}

			protected virtual string GetPattern(IAxisData axisData, object nativeValue)
			{
				if (nativeValue != null)
				{
					return axisData.Label.TextPattern;
				}
				return string.Empty;
			}

			protected virtual void SetParserContext(PatternParser patternParser, object nativeValue, double value, IAxisData axisData, double gridSpacing, IAxisGridMapping mapping)
			{
				patternParser.SetContext(nativeValue);
			}
		}

		private class ShiftedAxisTextConstructor : AxisTextConstructor
		{
			protected override void SetParserContext(PatternParser patternParser, object nativeValue, double value, IAxisData axisData, double gridSpacing, IAxisGridMapping mapping)
			{
				object item = mapping.InternalToNative(value + gridSpacing - 1.0);
				patternParser.SetContext(new Tuple<object, object>(nativeValue, item));
			}

			protected override object GetNativeValue(double value, IAxisGridMapping mapping)
			{
				return base.GetNativeValue(Math.Ceiling(value), mapping);
			}
		}

		private class IntervalShiftedAxisTextConstructor : AxisTextConstructor
		{
			protected override object GetNativeValue(double value, IAxisGridMapping mapping)
			{
				AxisAggregationInterval axisAggregationInterval = mapping.InternalToNative(Math.Ceiling(value)) as AxisAggregationInterval;
				if (axisAggregationInterval == null && mapping.InternalToNative(Math.Floor(value)) is AxisAggregationInterval axisAggregationInterval2)
				{
					return axisAggregationInterval2.NativeMax;
				}
				return axisAggregationInterval;
			}
		}

		private class IntervalTextConstructor : AxisTextConstructor
		{
			protected override string GetPattern(IAxisData axisData, object nativeValue)
			{
				return AxisAggregationInterval.GetActualPattern(axisData, nativeValue as AxisAggregationInterval);
			}
		}

		private class AxisTextItemValueComparer : IComparer<AxisTextItem>
		{
			public int Compare(AxisTextItem x, AxisTextItem y)
			{
				return x.Value.CompareTo(y.Value);
			}
		}

		private readonly bool scrollingEnabled;

		private readonly AxisGridData gridData;

		private readonly List<AxisTextItem> items = new List<AxisTextItem>();

		private readonly AxisTextConstructor textConstructor;

		private IList<AxisTextItem> primaryItems;

		private IList<AxisTextItem> staggeredItems;

		public AxisTextItem this[int index] => items[index];

		public int Count => items.Count;

		public IList<AxisTextItem> PrimaryItems => primaryItems;

		public IList<AxisTextItem> StaggeredItems => staggeredItems;

		public AxisTextData(IAxisData axis, IAxisGridMapping mapping, IMinMaxValues visualRange, bool isRadarAxis, bool scrollingEnabled, bool staggered, AxisGridData gridData, double? intersectionAxisValue = null)
			: base(axis, mapping, visualRange, isRadarAxis)
		{
			this.scrollingEnabled = scrollingEnabled;
			this.gridData = gridData;
			textConstructor = CreateTextConstructor(axis, gridData.GridLayoutMode);
			FillStripsAndCustomLabels();
			bool flag = base.Axis.CanShowCustomWithAutoLabels || items.Count == 0;
			if (flag)
			{
				GenerateItemsWithGridData();
			}
			items.Sort();
			if (flag)
			{
				GenerateIntersectionLabel(intersectionAxisValue);
			}
			Calculate(staggered);
		}

		private IList<AxisTextItem> CalculatePrimaryItems()
		{
			int num = Count / 2 + Count % 2;
			IList<AxisTextItem> list = new List<AxisTextItem>(num);
			int num2 = 0;
			int num3 = 0;
			while (num2 < num)
			{
				list.Add(items[num3]);
				num2++;
				num3 += 2;
			}
			return list;
		}

		private IList<AxisTextItem> CalculateStaggeredItems()
		{
			int num = Count / 2;
			IList<AxisTextItem> list = new List<AxisTextItem>(num);
			int num2 = 0;
			int num3 = 1;
			while (num2 < num)
			{
				list.Add(items[num3]);
				num2++;
				num3 += 2;
			}
			return list;
		}

		private object ConstructText(double value)
		{
			return textConstructor.ConstructAxisLabelText(gridData, value, base.Axis, base.Mapping);
		}

		private void FillStripsAndCustomLabels()
		{
			IEnumerable<IStrip> visibleStrips = GetVisibleStrips();
			foreach (IStrip item in visibleStrips)
			{
				AddItem(null, CalcStripGridValue(item), item.AxisLabelText, isCustom: true, isIntervalEdge: false);
			}
			IEnumerable<ICustomAxisLabel> visibleLabels = GetVisibleLabels();
			foreach (ICustomAxisLabel item2 in visibleLabels)
			{
				AddItem(item2, item2.Value, item2.Content, isCustom: true, isIntervalEdge: false);
			}
		}

		private void AddAutomaticValue(double value, bool isIntervalEdge)
		{
			AddItem(null, value, ConstructText(value), isCustom: false, isIntervalEdge);
		}

		private void AddItem(ICustomAxisLabel customAxisLabel, double value, object content, bool isCustom, bool isIntervalEdge)
		{
			if (content != null)
			{
				bool flag = gridData.IsValueInRange(value);
				if (flag || scrollingEnabled)
				{
					int gridIndex = gridData.GridIndex(value);
					AxisTextItem item = new AxisTextItem(customAxisLabel, gridIndex, value, content, flag, isCustom, isIntervalEdge, isIntersectionAutoLabel: false);
					items.Add(item);
				}
			}
		}

		private void GenerateItemsWithGridData()
		{
			if (base.IsRadarAxis)
			{
				foreach (AxisGridItem item in (IEnumerable<AxisGridItem>)gridData.Items)
				{
					if (item.Visible && item.IsAutogenerated)
					{
						items.Add(new AxisTextItem(null, gridData.GridIndex(item.LabelValue), item.LabelValue, ConstructText(item.LabelValue), visible: true, isCustomLabel: false, isIntervalEdge: false, isIntersectionAutoLabel: false));
					}
				}
				return;
			}
			if (scrollingEnabled)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < gridData.Items.Count; i++)
				{
					AxisGridItem axisGridItem = gridData.Items[i];
					if (axisGridItem.IsAutogenerated)
					{
						AddAutomaticValue(axisGridItem.LabelValue, i == 0 || i == gridData.Items.Count - 1);
					}
				}
				return;
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < gridData.Items.Count; j++)
			{
				AxisGridItem axisGridItem2 = gridData.Items[j];
				if (axisGridItem2.Visible && axisGridItem2.IsAutogenerated)
				{
					AddAutomaticValue(axisGridItem2.LabelValue, j == 0 || j == gridData.Items.Count - 1);
				}
			}
		}

		private void GenerateIntersectionLabel(double? intersectionAxisValue)
		{
			if (!intersectionAxisValue.HasValue)
			{
				return;
			}
			double value = intersectionAxisValue.Value;
			AxisTextItem axisTextItem = new AxisTextItem(null, gridData.GridIndex(value), value, ConstructText(value), visible: true, isCustomLabel: false, isIntervalEdge: false, isIntersectionAutoLabel: true);
			int num = items.BinarySearch(axisTextItem, new AxisTextItemValueComparer());
			if (num < 0)
			{
				num = ~num;
				if (num > 0 && items[num - 1].Content.Equals(axisTextItem.Content))
				{
					items.RemoveAt(num - 1);
					num--;
				}
				if (num < items.Count && items[num].Content.Equals(axisTextItem.Content))
				{
					items.RemoveAt(num);
				}
				items.Insert(num, axisTextItem);
			}
			else
			{
				items[num] = axisTextItem;
			}
		}

		private void Calculate(bool staggered)
		{
			if (staggered)
			{
				primaryItems = CalculatePrimaryItems();
				staggeredItems = CalculateStaggeredItems();
			}
			else
			{
				primaryItems = items;
				staggeredItems = new List<AxisTextItem>();
			}
		}

		private AxisTextConstructor CreateTextConstructor(IAxisData axisData, GridLayoutModeNative gridLayoutMode)
		{
			if (!axisData.IsValueAxis)
			{
				ActualScaleTypeCore scaleType = axisData.AxisScaleTypeMap.ScaleType;
				bool isIntervalMode = false;
				switch (scaleType)
				{
				case ActualScaleTypeCore.DateTime:
					isIntervalMode = axisData.DateTimeScaleOptions.ScaleMode == ScaleModeNative.Interval;
					break;
				case ActualScaleTypeCore.TimeSpan:
					isIntervalMode = axisData.TimeSpanScaleOptions.ScaleMode == ScaleModeNative.Interval;
					break;
				case ActualScaleTypeCore.Numerical:
					isIntervalMode = axisData.NumericScaleOptions.ScaleMode == ScaleModeNative.Interval;
					break;
				}
				return CreateTextConstructor(gridLayoutMode == GridLayoutModeNative.GridAndLabelShifted, isIntervalMode);
			}
			return new AxisTextConstructor();
		}

		private AxisTextConstructor CreateTextConstructor(bool labelShifted, bool isIntervalMode)
		{
			if (labelShifted)
			{
				if (isIntervalMode)
				{
					return new IntervalShiftedAxisTextConstructor();
				}
				return new ShiftedAxisTextConstructor();
			}
			if (isIntervalMode)
			{
				return new IntervalTextConstructor();
			}
			return new AxisTextConstructor();
		}
	}
	public class AxisGridData : AxisGridTextDataBase
	{
		private abstract class GridValueProvider
		{
			private readonly double gridSpacing;

			private readonly IMinMaxValues range;

			private readonly IAxisGridMapping map;

			internal double GridSpacing => gridSpacing;

			internal IMinMaxValues Range => range;

			internal IAxisGridMapping Map => map;

			public GridValueProvider(double gridSpacing, IMinMaxValues range, IAxisGridMapping map)
			{
				this.gridSpacing = gridSpacing;
				this.range = range;
				this.map = map;
			}

			internal abstract void GetGridAndLabelValues(int index, out double[] values, out double[] labelValues);
		}

		private class IdentityGridValueProvider : GridValueProvider
		{
			internal IdentityGridValueProvider(double gridSpacing, IMinMaxValues range, IAxisGridMapping map)
				: base(gridSpacing, range, map)
			{
			}

			internal override void GetGridAndLabelValues(int index, out double[] values, out double[] labelValues)
			{
				double num = base.Map.InternalToAligned(base.Range.Min);
				double num2 = num / base.GridSpacing;
				if (base.Map.CanFloorAlignedValue)
				{
					num2 = Math.Floor(num2);
				}
				double num3 = num2 + (double)index;
				labelValues = new double[1] { base.GridSpacing * num3 };
				values = new double[1] { base.GridSpacing * num3 };
			}
		}

		private class LogarithmicGridValueProvider : GridValueProvider
		{
			private readonly LogarithmicTransformation transformation;

			private readonly double delta;

			private readonly MinMaxValues range;

			private readonly double factor = 1.0;

			internal LogarithmicGridValueProvider(double gridSpacing, IMinMaxValues range, IAxisGridMapping map)
				: base(gridSpacing, range, map)
			{
				transformation = (LogarithmicTransformation)map.Transformation;
				delta = transformation.TransformForward(range.Max) - transformation.TransformForward(range.Min);
				delta = ((delta > 0.0) ? delta : 1.0);
				this.range = new MinMaxValues(range);
				factor = Math.Pow(2.0, Math.Floor(Math.Abs(Math.Log(delta, 2.0))));
			}

			private double GetCorrectedLogarithmicValue(double value)
			{
				double num = transformation.TransformForward(value);
				if (num == 0.0)
				{
					return num;
				}
				double num2 = transformation.TransformBackward(num);
				double num3 = value - num2;
				if (num3 < 0.0)
				{
					return Math.Floor(num);
				}
				if (num3 > 0.0)
				{
					return Math.Ceiling(num);
				}
				return num;
			}

			private double GetStartValue()
			{
				if (delta < 1.0)
				{
					if (Math.Abs(base.Range.Min) < 1.0)
					{
						return Math.Floor(base.Range.Min + 10.0) / 10.0;
					}
					return Math.Floor(base.Range.Min);
				}
				double num = Math.Sign(base.Range.Min);
				double internalValue = Math.Log(Math.Abs(base.Range.Min), transformation.LogarithmicBase);
				double num2 = base.Map.InternalToAligned(internalValue);
				double y = ((num > 0.0) ? Math.Floor(num2) : Math.Ceiling(num2));
				double num3 = Math.Pow(transformation.LogarithmicBase, y);
				return num * num3;
			}

			private List<double> CalculateValuesForRange(double value, double step, double max)
			{
				List<double> list = new List<double>();
				if (double.IsInfinity(value) || double.IsInfinity(step) || double.IsInfinity(max))
				{
					list.Add(double.PositiveInfinity);
					return list;
				}
				while (value <= max)
				{
					list.Add(value);
					value += step;
				}
				if (max > range.Max && list.Count > 0)
				{
					list.Add(list[list.Count - 1] + step);
				}
				return list;
			}

			private double[] GridValueForSmallRange(int gridIndex)
			{
				double num = Math.Floor(transformation.TransformForward(range.Min)) + (double)gridIndex;
				double num2 = num + 1.0;
				double num3 = transformation.TransformBackward(num);
				double val = Math.Max(transformation.TransformBackward(num2), range.Max);
				double num4 = num3 / factor;
				if (num4 == 0.0)
				{
					num4 = Math.Pow(transformation.LogarithmicBase, num2 + 3.0) / factor;
				}
				long num5 = (long)Math.Ceiling((range.Min - num3) / num4) - 1;
				long num6 = num5 + (long)Math.Ceiling(range.Delta / num4);
				val = Math.Min(num3 + (double)num6 * num4, val);
				return CalculateValuesForRange(num3 + (double)num5 * num4, Math.Abs(num4), val).ToArray();
			}

			internal override void GetGridAndLabelValues(int index, out double[] values, out double[] labelValues)
			{
				if (delta < 1.0 && base.Range.Min != 0.0)
				{
					values = GridValueForSmallRange(index);
				}
				else
				{
					double startValue = GetStartValue();
					if (index == 0)
					{
						values = new double[1] { startValue };
					}
					else
					{
						double correctedLogarithmicValue = GetCorrectedLogarithmicValue(startValue);
						double value = correctedLogarithmicValue + (double)index * base.GridSpacing;
						values = new double[1] { transformation.TransformBackward(value) };
					}
				}
				labelValues = new double[values.Length];
				Array.Copy(values, labelValues, values.Length);
			}
		}

		private const double Shift = 0.5;

		private double gridSpacing;

		private readonly int minorStep;

		private readonly int minorCount;

		private readonly AxisGridItemList items = new AxisGridItemList();

		private readonly AxisGridItemList minorItems = new AxisGridItemList();

		private readonly List<InterlacedData> interlacedData = new List<InterlacedData>();

		private readonly GridValueProvider gridValueProvider;

		public AxisGridItemList Items => items;

		public AxisGridItemList MinorItems => minorItems;

		public List<InterlacedData> InterlacedData => interlacedData;

		public GridLayoutModeNative GridLayoutMode { get; private set; }

		public double GridSpacing => gridSpacing;

		private static GridValueProvider CreateGridValueProvider(double gridSpacing, IAxisGridMapping mapping, IMinMaxValues visualRange)
		{
			if (mapping.Transformation.IsIdentity)
			{
				return new IdentityGridValueProvider(gridSpacing, visualRange, mapping);
			}
			return new LogarithmicGridValueProvider(gridSpacing, visualRange, mapping);
		}

		public AxisGridData(IAxisData axis, IAxisGridMapping mapping, IMinMaxValues visualRange, bool isRadarAxis, int minorCount, double gridSpacing, GridLayoutModeNative gridLayoutMode = GridLayoutModeNative.GridAndLabelCentered)
			: base(axis, mapping, visualRange, isRadarAxis)
		{
			GridLayoutMode = gridLayoutMode;
			gridValueProvider = CreateGridValueProvider(gridSpacing, mapping, visualRange);
			this.gridSpacing = gridSpacing;
			minorStep = minorCount + 1;
			this.minorCount = minorCount;
			bool canShowCustomWithAutoLabels = axis.CanShowCustomWithAutoLabels;
			if (canShowCustomWithAutoLabels || !CreateStripsAndCustomLabels())
			{
				FillAutomaticValues(gridLayoutMode);
				CreateInterlacedData();
				CreateMinorValues();
				if (canShowCustomWithAutoLabels)
				{
					CreateStripsAndCustomLabels();
				}
			}
			else
			{
				CreateCustomInterlacedData();
				CreateMinorValues();
			}
		}

		private void GetGridValue(GridValueProvider provider, int index, GridLayoutModeNative gridLayoutMode, out double[] values, out double[] labelValues)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			switch (gridLayoutMode)
			{
			case GridLayoutModeNative.GridShiftedLabelCentered:
				num = 0.5;
				num2 = 0.5 - gridSpacing / 2.0;
				break;
			case GridLayoutModeNative.GridAndLabelShifted:
				num = 0.5;
				num2 = 0.5;
				break;
			}
			provider.GetGridAndLabelValues(index, out values, out labelValues);
			for (int i = 0; i < values.Length; i++)
			{
				values[i] = base.Mapping.AlignedToInternal(values[i]) - num;
				labelValues[i] = base.Mapping.AlignedToInternal(labelValues[i]) - num2;
			}
		}

		private void ExtendRadarAxisRange()
		{
			double value = items.First.Value;
			double value2 = items.Last.Value;
			if (value < items.MinVisibleValue)
			{
				items[0] = new AxisGridItem(value, value, isAutogenerated: true, visible: true, gridLineVisible: true);
			}
			if (value2 > items.MaxVisibleValue)
			{
				items[items.Count - 1] = new AxisGridItem(value2, value2, isAutogenerated: true, visible: true, gridLineVisible: true);
			}
		}

		private void FillAutomaticValues(GridLayoutModeNative gridLayoutMode)
		{
			CreateMajorValues(gridLayoutMode);
			if (base.IsRadarAxis && items.VisibleItemsCount > 0 && items.InvisibleItemsCount > 0)
			{
				ExtendRadarAxisRange();
			}
		}

		private bool CreateStripsAndCustomLabels()
		{
			IEnumerable<IStrip> visibleStrips = GetVisibleStrips();
			foreach (IStrip item in visibleStrips)
			{
				AddCustomValue(item.MinLimit.ActualValue, gridLineVisible: true);
				AddCustomValue(item.MaxLimit.ActualValue, gridLineVisible: true);
			}
			IEnumerable<ICustomAxisLabel> visibleLabels = GetVisibleLabels();
			foreach (ICustomAxisLabel item2 in visibleLabels)
			{
				AddCustomValue(item2.Value, item2.GridLineVisible);
			}
			return items.Count > 0;
		}

		private void CreateMajorValues(GridLayoutModeNative gridLayoutMode)
		{
			double alignedValue = Math.Floor(base.Mapping.InternalToAligned(base.Mapping.Offset) / gridSpacing) * gridSpacing;
			double actualOffset = base.Mapping.Offset - base.Mapping.AlignedToInternal(alignedValue);
			int num = 0;
			while (true)
			{
				GetGridValue(gridValueProvider, num, gridLayoutMode, out var values, out var labelValues);
				if (AddMajorValues(actualOffset, gridLayoutMode, values, labelValues, num + 1))
				{
					num++;
					continue;
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		private bool AddMajorValues(double actualOffset, GridLayoutModeNative gridLayoutMode, double[] values, double[] labelValues, int index)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < values.Length; i++)
			{
				double num = values[i] + actualOffset;
				if (double.IsNaN(num) || double.IsInfinity(num))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (num > base.VisualRange.Max || (num == base.VisualRange.Max && items.Count > 2 && items[0].Value != gridValueProvider.Range.Min))
				{
					AddMajorValue(num, labelValues[i] + actualOffset);
					return false;
				}
				if (num > base.VisualRange.Min && num > 0.0 && items.Count == 0)
				{
					GetGridValue(gridValueProvider, index - 2, gridLayoutMode, out var values2, out var labelValues2);
					for (int j = 0; j < values2.Length; j++)
					{
						AddMajorValue(values2[j] + actualOffset, labelValues2[j] + actualOffset);
					}
				}
				AddMajorValue(num, labelValues[i] + actualOffset);
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void CreateMinorValues()
		{
			if (items.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			double alignedValue = Math.Floor(base.Mapping.InternalToAligned(base.VisualRange.Min) / gridSpacing) * gridSpacing;
			double num = base.Mapping.AlignedToInternal(alignedValue);
			int num2 = ((num == items[0].Value) ? 1 : 0);
			for (int i = num2; i < items.Count; i++)
			{
				double value = items[i].Value;
				double num3 = (value - num) / (double)minorStep;
				for (int j = 1; j <= minorCount; j++)
				{
					double num4 = num + num3 * (double)j;
					if (IsValueWithinRange(num4, base.VisualRange.Min, base.VisualRange.Max))
					{
						minorItems.AddValue(new AxisGridItem(num4, num4, isAutogenerated: true, visible: true, gridLineVisible: true));
					}
				}
				num = value;
			}
		}

		private void CreateInterlacedData()
		{
			if (items.Count >= 2)
			{
				double num = base.Mapping.InternalToAligned(items.First.Value);
				double num2 = base.Mapping.InternalToAligned(base.Mapping.Offset);
				int num3 = 1 - (int)Math.Abs(((long)(num / gridSpacing) + (long)(num2 / gridSpacing)) % 2);
				for (int i = num3; i < items.Count - 1; i += 2)
				{
					interlacedData.Add(new InterlacedData(items[i].Value, items[i + 1].Value));
				}
				if (num3 == items.Count % 2 && items.Last.Value < base.VisualRange.Max)
				{
					double value = items.Last.Value;
					double far = value + base.Mapping.AlignedToInternal(1.0) * gridSpacing;
					interlacedData.Add(new InterlacedData(value, far));
				}
			}
		}

		private void CreateCustomInterlacedData()
		{
			if (items.Count >= 2)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < items.Count - 1; i += 2)
				{
					interlacedData.Add(new InterlacedData(items[i].Value, items[i + 1].Value));
				}
				if (items.Count % 2 == 1)
				{
					interlacedData.Add(new InterlacedData(items[items.Count - 1].Value, double.PositiveInfinity));
				}
			}
		}

		private bool IsValueWithinRange(double value, double min, double max)
		{
			if (ComparingUtils.CompareDoubles(value, min, double.Epsilon) >= 0)
			{
				return ComparingUtils.CompareDoubles(value, max, double.Epsilon) <= 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool IsValidValue(double value)
		{
			if (!double.IsPositiveInfinity(value) && !double.IsNegativeInfinity(value))
			{
				return !double.IsNaN(value);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void AddCustomValue(double value, bool gridLineVisible)
		{
			if (IsValidValue(value))
			{
				AddValueCore(value, value, isAutogenerated: false, gridLineVisible);
			}
		}

		private void AddMajorValue(double value, double labelValue)
		{
			AddValueCore(value, labelValue, isAutogenerated: true);
		}

		private void AddValueCore(double value, double labelValue, bool isAutogenerated, bool gridLineVisible = true)
		{
			bool flag = IsValueWithinRange(value, base.VisualRange.Min, base.VisualRange.Max);
			AxisGridItem value2 = new AxisGridItem(value, labelValue, isAutogenerated, flag, flag && gridLineVisible);
			items.AddUniqueValue(value2);
		}

		public int GridIndex(double value)
		{
			double num = base.Mapping.AlignedToInternal(gridSpacing);
			return GeometricUtils.StrongRound(value / num);
		}

		public bool IsValueInRange(double value)
		{
			double min;
			double max;
			if (base.IsRadarAxis && items.Count > 0)
			{
				min = items.First.Value;
				max = items.Last.Value;
			}
			else
			{
				min = base.VisualRange.Min;
				max = base.VisualRange.Max;
			}
			return IsValueWithinRange(value, min, max);
		}
	}

	public interface IZoomablePane : IPane
	{
		bool Rotated { get; }

		bool ScrollingByXEnabled { get; }

		bool ScrollingByYEnabled { get; }

		bool ZoomingByXEnabled { get; }

		bool ZoomingByYEnabled { get; }

	public class ZoomItem
	{
		private readonly PaneAxesManager paneAxesManager;

		private readonly RangesSnapshot rangeSnapshot;

		internal PaneAxesManager PaneAxesManager => paneAxesManager;

		public ZoomItem(IAxisData axisX, IAxisData axisY, PaneAxesManager paneAxesData)
		{
			paneAxesManager = paneAxesData;
			rangeSnapshot = new RangesSnapshot(axisX, axisY);
		}

		public void RestoreCachedValues()
		{
			rangeSnapshot.XRange.ApplyState(rangeSnapshot.AxisX.VisualRange);
			rangeSnapshot.YRange.ApplyState(rangeSnapshot.AxisY.VisualRange);
		}
	}
	public class ZoomStack
	{
		private readonly Stack<ZoomItem> stack = new Stack<ZoomItem>();

		private ZoomingKind lastZoomingKind;

		public bool IsEmpty => stack.Count == 0;

		public void Push(IAxisData axisX, IAxisData axisY, PaneAxesManager paneAxesManager, ZoomingKind zoomingKind)
		{
			ZoomItem item = new ZoomItem(axisX, axisY, paneAxesManager);
			if (zoomingKind != lastZoomingKind || zoomingKind == ZoomingKind.ZoomIn || zoomingKind == ZoomingKind.ZoomOut)
			{
				lastZoomingKind = zoomingKind;
				stack.Push(item);
			}
		}

		public void Pop()
		{
			if (stack.Count > 0)
			{
				ZoomItem zoomItem = stack.Pop();
				zoomItem.PaneAxesManager.UndoZoom(zoomItem);
				lastZoomingKind = ZoomingKind.None;
			}
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			stack.Clear();
		}
	}
	public class GestureZoomManager
	{
		private readonly PaneAxesContainer axisContainer;

		private readonly double refinedMinX;

		private readonly double refinedMaxX;

		private readonly double refinedMinY;

		private readonly double refinedMaxY;

		public static GestureZoomManager Initialize(PaneAxesContainer axisContainer)
		{
			return new GestureZoomManager(axisContainer);
		}

		private GestureZoomManager(PaneAxesContainer axisContainer)
		{
			this.axisContainer = axisContainer;
			refinedMinX = axisContainer.PrimaryAxisX.AxisScaleTypeMap.InternalToRefined(axisContainer.PrimaryAxisX.VisualRange.Min);
			refinedMaxX = axisContainer.PrimaryAxisX.AxisScaleTypeMap.InternalToRefined(axisContainer.PrimaryAxisX.VisualRange.Max);
			refinedMinY = axisContainer.PrimaryAxisY.AxisScaleTypeMap.InternalToRefined(axisContainer.PrimaryAxisY.VisualRange.Min);
			refinedMaxY = axisContainer.PrimaryAxisY.AxisScaleTypeMap.InternalToRefined(axisContainer.PrimaryAxisY.VisualRange.Max);
		}

		public void Zoom(DXPoint center, double xZoomPercent, double yZoomPercent, bool dependentValueRange)
		{
			//IL_007f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			double axisXMin = axisContainer.PrimaryAxisX.AxisScaleTypeMap.RefinedToInternal(refinedMinX);
			double axisXMax = axisContainer.PrimaryAxisX.AxisScaleTypeMap.RefinedToInternal(refinedMaxX);
			double axisYMin = axisContainer.PrimaryAxisY.AxisScaleTypeMap.RefinedToInternal(refinedMinY);
			double axisYMax = axisContainer.PrimaryAxisY.AxisScaleTypeMap.RefinedToInternal(refinedMaxY);
			PaneAxesManager manager = axisContainer.GetManager();
			manager.ZoomGesture(center, axisXMin, axisXMax, axisYMin, axisYMax, xZoomPercent, yZoomPercent, ZoomingKind.Gesture, NavigationType.Gesture, dependentValueRange);
		}
	}
	public class PaneAxesManager
	{
		public const double DefaultMaximumZoomPercent = 100.0;

		private readonly PaneAxesContainer container;

		private readonly IZoomablePane zoomablePane;

		private bool ZoomableByY => ZoomablePane.ZoomingByYEnabled;

		private bool ZoomableByX => ZoomablePane.ZoomingByXEnabled;

		private bool ScrollableByY => ZoomablePane.ScrollingByYEnabled;

		private bool ScrollableByX => ZoomablePane.ScrollingByXEnabled;

		private IAxisData PrimaryAxisY => container.PrimaryAxisY;

		private IAxisData PrimaryAxisX => container.PrimaryAxisX;

		public bool ScrollingEnabled
		{
			get
			{
				if (!ScrollableByX || !CanScrollAxis(PrimaryAxisX))
				{
					if (ScrollableByY)
					{
						return CanScrollAxis(PrimaryAxisY);
					}
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public IZoomablePane ZoomablePane => zoomablePane;

		private static double ClampPosition(double value)
		{
			if (value < 0.0)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			if (value > 1.0)
			{
				return 1.0;
			}
			return value;
		}

		private static double CalcAxisOffset(IAxisData axis, int step, int size, bool accountAxisReverse)
		{
			if (!CanScrollAxis(axis) || step == 0)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			if (accountAxisReverse && axis.Reverse)
			{
				step = -step;
			}
			IMinMaxValues minMaxValues = TransformForward(axis, axis.WholeRange);
			IMinMaxValues minMaxValues2 = TransformForward(axis, axis.VisualRange);
			double num = minMaxValues2.Delta / (double)size * (double)step;
			if (num > 0.0)
			{
				if (minMaxValues2.Max + num > minMaxValues.Max)
				{
					num = minMaxValues.Max - minMaxValues2.Max;
				}
			}
			else if (minMaxValues2.Min + num < minMaxValues.Min)
			{
				num = minMaxValues.Min - minMaxValues2.Min;
			}
			return num;
		}

		private static void Scroll(IAxisData axis, double offset)
		{
			IMinMaxValues minMaxValues = TransformForward(axis, axis.VisualRange);
			IMinMaxValues minMaxValues2 = TransformBackward(axis, new MinMaxValues(minMaxValues.Min + offset, minMaxValues.Max + offset));
			if (!axis.RaiseBeforeScroll(minMaxValues2))
			{
				SetMinMax(axis, minMaxValues2.Min, minMaxValues2.Max);
			}
		}

		private static bool ScrollTo(IAxisData axis, double position)
		{
			position = ClampPosition(position);
			IMinMaxValues minMaxValues = TransformForward(axis, axis.VisualRange);
			IMinMaxValues minMaxValues2 = TransformForward(axis, axis.WholeRange);
			double delta = minMaxValues.Delta;
			double delta2 = minMaxValues2.Delta;
			if (axis.Reverse)
			{
				position = 1.0 - position;
			}
			double num;
			double num2;
			if (delta >= delta2)
			{
				num = minMaxValues2.Min;
				num2 = minMaxValues2.Max;
			}
			else
			{
				num = minMaxValues2.Min + (delta2 - delta) * position;
				num2 = num + delta;
			}
			if (num == minMaxValues.Min && num2 == minMaxValues.Max)
			{
				return false;
			}
			IMinMaxValues minMaxValues3 = TransformBackward(axis, new MinMaxValues(num, num2));
			if (axis.RaiseBeforeScroll(minMaxValues3))
			{
				return false;
			}
			SetMinMax(axis, minMaxValues3.Min, minMaxValues3.Max);
			return true;
		}

		private static IMinMaxValues TransformForward(IAxisData axis, IMinMaxValues minMaxValue)
		{
			ITransformation transformation = axis.AxisScaleTypeMap.Transformation;
			double min = transformation.TransformForward(minMaxValue.Min);
			double max = transformation.TransformForward(minMaxValue.Max);
			return new MinMaxValues(min, max);
		}

		private static IMinMaxValues TransformBackward(IAxisData axis, IMinMaxValues minMaxValue)
		{
			ITransformation transformation = axis.AxisScaleTypeMap.Transformation;
			double min = transformation.TransformBackward(minMaxValue.Min);
			double max = transformation.TransformBackward(minMaxValue.Max);
			return new MinMaxValues(min, max);
		}

		private static object InternalToNative(AxisScaleTypeMap scaleMap, double internalValue)
		{
			return scaleMap.RefinedToNative(scaleMap.InternalToRefinedExact(internalValue));
		}

		public static void SetMinMax(IAxisData axis, double min, double max)
		{
			IVisualAxisRangeData visualRange = axis.VisualRange;
			object min2 = null;
			object max2 = null;
			AxisScaleTypeMap axisScaleTypeMap = axis.AxisScaleTypeMap;
			if (axisScaleTypeMap.ScaleType == ActualScaleTypeCore.Qualitative)
			{
				double value = Math.Min(Math.Ceiling(min), Math.Floor(max));
				double value2 = Math.Max(Math.Ceiling(min), Math.Floor(max));
				min2 = axisScaleTypeMap.InternalToNative(value);
				max2 = axisScaleTypeMap.InternalToNative(value2);
				visualRange.ScrollOrZoomRange(min2, max2, min, max);
			}
			else
			{
				if (!double.IsNaN(min))
				{
					min2 = InternalToNative(axisScaleTypeMap, min);
				}
				if (!double.IsNaN(max))
				{
					max2 = InternalToNative(axisScaleTypeMap, max);
				}
				visualRange.ScrollOrZoomRange(min2, max2, min, max);
			}
			IWholeAxisRangeData wholeRange = axis.WholeRange;
			if (ComparingUtils.CompareDoubles(min, wholeRange.Min, 1E-09) == 0 && ComparingUtils.CompareDoubles(max, wholeRange.Max, 1E-09) == 0)
			{
				visualRange.Reset(needUpdate: false, resetMin: true, resetMax: true);
			}
		}

		public static bool CanZoomOutAxis(IAxisData axis)
		{
			if (axis.WholeRange.Min == axis.VisualRange.Min)
			{
				return axis.WholeRange.Max != axis.VisualRange.Max;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static bool CanScrollAxis(IAxisData axis)
		{
			return CanZoomOutAxis(axis);
		}

		public static double GetScrollBarPosition(IAxisData axis)
		{
			if (!CanZoomOutAxis(axis))
			{
				return 0.5;
			}
			IMinMaxValues minMaxValues = TransformForward(axis, axis.VisualRange);
			double num = (minMaxValues.Min + minMaxValues.Max) / 2.0;
			double delta = minMaxValues.Delta;
			double num2 = delta / 2.0;
			IMinMaxValues minMaxValues2 = TransformForward(axis, axis.WholeRange);
			double num3 = minMaxValues2.Min + num2;
			double num4 = num - num3;
			double num5 = minMaxValues2.Delta - delta;
			if (num4 + num5 != num4)
			{
				return num4 / num5;
			}
			return 0.5;
		}

		public static double GetScrollBarRelativeSize(IAxisData axis)
		{
			IMinMaxValues minMaxValues = TransformForward(axis, axis.VisualRange);
			IMinMaxValues minMaxValues2 = TransformForward(axis, axis.WholeRange);
			return minMaxValues.Delta / minMaxValues2.Delta;
		}

		public static double GetZoomPercent(int delta)
		{
			return 1.0 - 0.2 * (double)delta;
		}

		public static NavigationType GetNavigationType(int delta)
		{
			if (delta <= 0)
			{
				return NavigationType.ZoomOut;
			}
			return NavigationType.ZoomIn;
		}

		public PaneAxesManager(PaneAxesContainer container, IZoomablePane zoomablePane)
		{
			this.container = container;
			this.zoomablePane = zoomablePane;
		}

		private double GetMaximumZoomPercent(IAxisData axis)
		{
			double val = axis.WholeRange.Delta / axis.VisualRange.Delta;
			if (axis == PrimaryAxisX)
			{
				return Math.Max(val, ZoomablePane.AxisXMaxZoomPercent / 100.0);
			}
			if (axis == PrimaryAxisY)
			{
				return Math.Max(val, ZoomablePane.AxisYMaxZoomPercent / 100.0);
			}
			return 100.0;
		}

		private double GetCenterInPercent(double boundsMin, double boundsMax, double min, double max)
		{
			return ((min + max) / 2.0 - boundsMin) / (boundsMax - boundsMin);
		}

		private void BeginZooming(ZoomingKind zoomingKind)
		{
			ZoomablePane.ZoomStack?.Push(PrimaryAxisX, PrimaryAxisY, this, zoomingKind);
			ZoomablePane.BeginZooming();
		}

		private void FinishZooming(RangesSnapshot rangesSnapshot, NavigationType navigationType, IAxisData axisX, IAxisData axisY, bool synchronizeAxes = true)
		{
			ZoomablePane.RangeLimitsUpdated();
			if (synchronizeAxes)
			{
				if (ScrollableByX || ZoomableByX)
				{
					rangesSnapshot.CorrectAxesXPositions(container.TotalSecondaryAxesX, useDeltaFactor: false);
				}
				if (ScrollableByY || ZoomableByY)
				{
					rangesSnapshot.CorrectAxesYPositions(container.TotalSecondaryAxesY, useDeltaFactor: false);
				}
			}
			RangesSnapshot newRange = new RangesSnapshot(PrimaryAxisX, PrimaryAxisY);
			ZoomablePane.EndZooming(navigationType, rangesSnapshot, newRange, ZoomableByX ? axisX : null, ZoomableByY ? axisY : null);
		}

		private void FinishScrolling(ScrollingOrientation scrollingOrientation, RangesSnapshot rangesSnapshot, NavigationType navigationType, IAxisData axisX, IAxisData axisY)
		{
			ZoomablePane.RangeLimitsUpdated();
			if (ScrollableByX)
			{
				rangesSnapshot.CorrectAxesXPositions(container.TotalSecondaryAxesX, useDeltaFactor: true);
			}
			if (ScrollableByY)
			{
				rangesSnapshot.CorrectAxesYPositions(container.TotalSecondaryAxesY, useDeltaFactor: true);
			}
			RangesSnapshot newRange = new RangesSnapshot(PrimaryAxisX, PrimaryAxisY);
			bool flag = scrollingOrientation == (ScrollingOrientation)3;
			ZoomablePane.EndScrolling(scrollingOrientation, navigationType, rangesSnapshot, newRange, (ScrollableByX && (scrollingOrientation == ScrollingOrientation.AxisXScroll || flag)) ? axisX : null, (ScrollableByY && (scrollingOrientation == ScrollingOrientation.AxisYScroll || flag)) ? axisY : null);
		}

		private bool PerformZoom(IAxisData axis, IMinMaxValues range)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			IMinMaxValues visualRange = axis.VisualRange;
			if ((!(Math.Abs(visualRange.Delta - range.Delta) > 0.001)) ? ((visualRange.Min == range.Min && visualRange.Max == range.Max) || axis.RaiseBeforeScroll(range)) : axis.RaiseBeforeZoom(range))
			{
				return false;
			}
			IWholeAxisRangeData wholeRange = axis.WholeRange;
			if (range.Delta < 0.0)
			{
				range.Max = range.Min;
			}
			double num = wholeRange.Delta / GetMaximumZoomPercent(axis);
			double num2 = num / range.Delta;
			if (double.IsInfinity(num2) || num2 > 1.0)
			{
				if (!CanZoomInAxis(axis) && range.Delta < axis.VisualRange.Delta)
				{
					return false;
				}
				double num3 = (range.Min + range.Max) / 2.0;
				num /= 2.0;
				range.Min = num3 - num;
				range.Max = num3 + num;
			}
			double num4 = wholeRange.Min - range.Min;
			if (num4 > 0.0)
			{
				range.Min += num4;
				range.Max += num4;
			}
			else
			{
				double num5 = range.Max - wholeRange.Max;
				if (num5 > 0.0)
				{
					range.Min -= num5;
					range.Max -= num5;
				}
			}
			SetMinMax(axis, range.Min, range.Max);
			return true;
		}

		private bool Zoom(DXRectangle bounds, DXPoint center, double xZoomPercent, double yZoomPercent, bool zoomToCenter)
		{
			double position = (double)(((DXPoint)(ref center)).X - ((DXRectangle)(ref bounds)).Left) / (double)((DXRectangle)(ref bounds)).Width;
			double position2 = 1.0 - (double)(((DXPoint)(ref center)).Y - ((DXRectangle)(ref bounds)).Top) / (double)((DXRectangle)(ref bounds)).Height;
			IAxisData horizontalAxis = GetHorizontalAxis(ZoomableByX, ZoomableByY);
			IAxisData verticalAxis = GetVerticalAxis(ZoomableByX, ZoomableByY);
			bool flag = false;
			if (horizontalAxis != null)
			{
				flag |= Zoom(horizontalAxis, position, xZoomPercent, zoomToCenter);
			}
			if (verticalAxis != null)
			{
				flag |= Zoom(verticalAxis, position2, yZoomPercent, zoomToCenter);
			}
			return flag;
		}

		private void Zoom(IAxisData axis, double zoomPercent)
		{
			Zoom(axis, 0.5, zoomPercent, zoomToCenter: true);
		}

		private bool Zoom(IAxisData axis, double position, double zoomPercent, bool zoomToCenter)
		{
			if (zoomPercent < 1.0 || CanZoomOutAxis(axis))
			{
				IMinMaxValues minMaxValues = TransformForward(axis, axis.VisualRange);
				double num = (axis.Reverse ? (minMaxValues.Max - minMaxValues.Min - minMaxValues.Delta * position) : (minMaxValues.Delta * position));
				double num2 = minMaxValues.Min + num;
				MinMaxValues minMaxValues2;
				if (zoomToCenter)
				{
					double num3 = 0.5 * minMaxValues.Delta * zoomPercent;
					minMaxValues2 = new MinMaxValues(num2 - num3, num2 + num3);
				}
				else
				{
					double num4 = num * zoomPercent;
					double num5 = (minMaxValues.Delta - num) * zoomPercent;
					minMaxValues2 = new MinMaxValues(num2 - num4, num2 + num5);
				}
				IMinMaxValues minMaxValues3 = TransformBackward(axis, minMaxValues2);
				IWholeAxisRangeData wholeRange = axis.WholeRange;
				if (minMaxValues3.Min < wholeRange.Min)
				{
					minMaxValues3.Max += wholeRange.Min - minMaxValues3.Min;
					minMaxValues3.Min = wholeRange.Min;
					if (minMaxValues3.Max > wholeRange.Max)
					{
						minMaxValues3.Max = wholeRange.Max;
					}
				}
				else if (minMaxValues3.Max > wholeRange.Max)
				{
					minMaxValues3.Min -= minMaxValues3.Max - wholeRange.Max;
					minMaxValues3.Max = wholeRange.Max;
					if (minMaxValues3.Min < wholeRange.Min)
					{
						minMaxValues3.Min = wholeRange.Min;
					}
				}
				return PerformZoom(axis, minMaxValues3);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void ResetZoom(IAxisData axis)
		{
			IWholeAxisRangeData wholeRange = axis.WholeRange;
			SetMinMax(axis, wholeRange.Min, wholeRange.Max);
		}

		private void SetAxisZoom(double factor, NavigationType navigationType, IAxisData axis)
		{
			if (IsAxisZoomingEnabled(axis))
			{
				BeginZooming(ZoomingKind.ZoomPosition);
				RangesSnapshot rangesSnapshot = new RangesSnapshot(PrimaryAxisX, PrimaryAxisY);
				IMinMaxValues minMaxValues = TransformForward(axis, axis.VisualRange);
				IMinMaxValues minMaxValues2 = TransformForward(axis, axis.WholeRange);
				double num = (minMaxValues.Min + minMaxValues.Max) / 2.0;
				double num2 = minMaxValues2.Delta / GetMaximumZoomPercent(axis);
				double num3 = minMaxValues2.Delta - (minMaxValues2.Delta - num2) * ClampPosition(factor);
				IMinMaxValues range = TransformBackward(axis, new MinMaxValues(num - num3 / 2.0, num + num3 / 2.0));
				PerformZoom(axis, range);
				FinishZooming(rangesSnapshot, navigationType, axis.IsArgumentAxis ? axis : null, axis.IsValueAxis ? axis : null);
			}
		}

		private void SetRange(IAxisData axis, double position1, double position2)
		{
			position1 = ClampPosition(position1);
			position2 = ClampPosition(position2);
			if (position2 < position1)
			{
				double num = position1;
				position1 = position2;
				position2 = num;
			}
			IWholeAxisRangeData wholeRange = axis.WholeRange;
			IMinMaxValues range = (IMinMaxValues)((!axis.Reverse) ? ((object)new MinMaxValues(wholeRange.Min + wholeRange.Delta * position1, wholeRange.Min + wholeRange.Delta * position2)) : ((object)new MinMaxValues(wholeRange.Max - wholeRange.Delta * position2, wholeRange.Max - wholeRange.Delta * position1)));
			PerformZoom(axis, range);
		}

		private void SetAxisRange(double position1, double position2, NavigationType navigationType, IAxisData axis)
		{
			if (IsAxisZoomingEnabled(axis))
			{
				if (navigationType == NavigationType.SetRange)
				{
					BeginZooming(ZoomingKind.SetRange);
				}
				RangesSnapshot rangesSnapshot = new RangesSnapshot(PrimaryAxisX, PrimaryAxisY);
				SetRange(axis, position1, position2);
				if (navigationType == NavigationType.SetRange || navigationType == NavigationType.ZoomThumbRelease)
				{
					FinishZooming(rangesSnapshot, navigationType, axis.IsArgumentAxis ? axis : null, axis.IsValueAxis ? axis : null);
				}
				else
				{
					FinishScrolling(axis.IsArgumentAxis ? ScrollingOrientation.AxisXScroll : ScrollingOrientation.AxisYScroll, rangesSnapshot, navigationType, axis.IsArgumentAxis ? axis : null, axis.IsValueAxis ? axis : null);
				}
			}
		}

		private bool IsAxisZoomingEnabled(IAxisData axis)
		{
			if (!axis.IsArgumentAxis)
			{
				return ZoomableByY;
			}
			return ZoomableByX;
		}

		private IAxisData GetHorizontalAxis(bool isEnabledX, bool isEnabledY)
		{
			if (ZoomablePane.Rotated)
			{
				if (!isEnabledY)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return PrimaryAxisY;
			}
			if (!isEnabledX)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return PrimaryAxisX;
		}

		private IAxisData GetVerticalAxis(bool isEnabledX, bool isEnabledY)
		{
			if (ZoomablePane.Rotated)
			{
				if (!isEnabledX)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return PrimaryAxisX;
			}
			if (!isEnabledY)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return PrimaryAxisY;
		}

		internal void ZoomGesture(DXPoint center, double axisXMin, double axisXMax, double axisYMin, double axisYMax, double xZoomPercent, double yZoomPercent, ZoomingKind zoomingKind, NavigationType navigationType, bool dependentValueRange)
		{
			//IL_0017: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_007d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_007e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (!ZoomableByX && !ZoomableByY)
			{
				return;
			}
			DXRectangle bounds = ZoomablePane.Bounds;
			if (!((DXRectangle)(ref bounds)).IsCollapsed)
			{
				BeginZooming(zoomingKind);
				RangesSnapshot rangesSnapshot = new RangesSnapshot(PrimaryAxisX, PrimaryAxisY);
				if (!(PrimaryAxisX.IsValueAxis && dependentValueRange))
				{
					SetMinMax(PrimaryAxisX, axisXMin, axisXMax);
				}
				if (!(PrimaryAxisY.IsValueAxis && dependentValueRange))
				{
					SetMinMax(PrimaryAxisY, axisYMin, axisYMax);
				}
				Zoom(bounds, center, xZoomPercent, yZoomPercent, zoomToCenter: false);
				FinishZooming(rangesSnapshot, navigationType, PrimaryAxisX, PrimaryAxisY);
			}
		}

		public void Zoom(DXPoint center, double zoomPercent, ZoomingKind zoomingKind, NavigationType navigationType, bool zoomToCenter)
		{
			//IL_0017: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0040: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0041: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (!ZoomableByX && !ZoomableByY)
			{
				return;
			}
			DXRectangle bounds = ZoomablePane.Bounds;
			if (!((DXRectangle)(ref bounds)).IsCollapsed)
			{
				BeginZooming(zoomingKind);
				RangesSnapshot rangesSnapshot = new RangesSnapshot(PrimaryAxisX, PrimaryAxisY);
				if (Zoom(bounds, center, zoomPercent, zoomPercent, zoomToCenter))
				{
					FinishZooming(rangesSnapshot, navigationType, PrimaryAxisX, PrimaryAxisY);
				}
			}
		}

		public void Zoom(IAxisData axis, DXPoint center, double zoomPercent, ZoomingKind zoomingKind, NavigationType navigationType)
		{
			//IL_0027: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if ((!axis.IsArgumentAxis || ZoomableByX) && (!axis.IsValueAxis || ZoomableByY))
			{
				DXRectangle bounds = ZoomablePane.Bounds;
				if (!((DXRectangle)(ref bounds)).IsCollapsed)
				{
					BeginZooming(zoomingKind);
					IAxisData axisX = (axis.IsArgumentAxis ? axis : PrimaryAxisX);
					IAxisData axisY = (axis.IsValueAxis ? axis : PrimaryAxisY);
					RangesSnapshot rangesSnapshot = new RangesSnapshot(axisX, axisY);
					double position = ((axis.IsArgumentAxis ^ ZoomablePane.Rotated) ? ((double)(((DXPoint)(ref center)).X - ((DXRectangle)(ref bounds)).Left) / (double)((DXRectangle)(ref bounds)).Width) : (1.0 - (double)(((DXPoint)(ref center)).Y - ((DXRectangle)(ref bounds)).Top) / (double)((DXRectangle)(ref bounds)).Height));
					Zoom(axis, position, zoomPercent, zoomToCenter: false);
					FinishZooming(rangesSnapshot, navigationType, axis.IsArgumentAxis ? axis : null, axis.IsValueAxis ? axis : null, synchronizeAxes: false);
				}
			}
		}

		public void Zoom(int delta, ZoomingKind zoomingKind)
		{
			if (ZoomableByX || ZoomableByY)
			{
				BeginZooming(zoomingKind);
				RangesSnapshot rangesSnapshot = new RangesSnapshot(PrimaryAxisX, PrimaryAxisY);
				double zoomPercent = GetZoomPercent(delta);
				if (ZoomableByX)
				{
					Zoom(PrimaryAxisX, zoomPercent);
				}
				if (ZoomableByY)
				{
					Zoom(PrimaryAxisY, zoomPercent);
				}
				FinishZooming(rangesSnapshot, GetNavigationType(delta), PrimaryAxisX, PrimaryAxisY);
			}
		}

		public void ZoomIn(DXRectangle rect)
		{
			//IL_0017: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0027: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0028: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0029: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (!ZoomableByX && !ZoomableByY)
			{
				return;
			}
			DXRectangle bounds = ZoomablePane.Bounds;
			if (!((DXRectangle)(ref bounds)).IsCollapsed)
			{
				rect = DXRectangle.Intersect(rect, bounds);
				BeginZooming(ZoomingKind.ZoomIn);
				RangesSnapshot rangesSnapshot = new RangesSnapshot(PrimaryAxisX, PrimaryAxisY);
				double centerInPercent = GetCenterInPercent(((DXRectangle)(ref bounds)).Left, ((DXRectangle)(ref bounds)).Right, ((DXRectangle)(ref rect)).Left, ((DXRectangle)(ref rect)).Right);
				double position = 1.0 - GetCenterInPercent(((DXRectangle)(ref bounds)).Top, ((DXRectangle)(ref bounds)).Bottom, ((DXRectangle)(ref rect)).Top, ((DXRectangle)(ref rect)).Bottom);
				double zoomPercent = (double)((DXRectangle)(ref rect)).Width / (double)((DXRectangle)(ref bounds)).Width;
				double zoomPercent2 = (double)((DXRectangle)(ref rect)).Height / (double)((DXRectangle)(ref bounds)).Height;
				IAxisData horizontalAxis = GetHorizontalAxis(ZoomableByX, ZoomableByY);
				IAxisData verticalAxis = GetVerticalAxis(ZoomableByX, ZoomableByY);
				if (horizontalAxis != null)
				{
					Zoom(horizontalAxis, centerInPercent, zoomPercent, zoomToCenter: true);
				}
				if (verticalAxis != null)
				{
					Zoom(verticalAxis, position, zoomPercent2, zoomToCenter: true);
				}
				FinishZooming(rangesSnapshot, NavigationType.ZoomIn, PrimaryAxisX, PrimaryAxisY);
			}
		}

		public void UndoZoom(ZoomItem zoomItem)
		{
			ZoomablePane.BeginZooming();
			RangesSnapshot rangesSnapshot = new RangesSnapshot(PrimaryAxisX, PrimaryAxisY);
			zoomItem.RestoreCachedValues();
			FinishZooming(rangesSnapshot, NavigationType.ZoomUndo, PrimaryAxisX, PrimaryAxisY);
		}

		public bool ResetZoom()
		{
			if (!ZoomableByX && !ZoomableByY)
			{
				return false;
			}
			ZoomablePane.BeginZooming();
			RangesSnapshot rangesSnapshot = new RangesSnapshot(PrimaryAxisX, PrimaryAxisY);
			if (ZoomableByX)
			{
				ResetZoom(PrimaryAxisX);
			}
			if (ZoomableByY)
			{
				ResetZoom(PrimaryAxisY);
			}
			FinishZooming(rangesSnapshot, NavigationType.ZoomReset, PrimaryAxisX, PrimaryAxisY);
			return true;
		}

		public bool CanZoomInAxis(IAxisData axis)
		{
			double num = GetMaximumZoomPercent(axis) * 1E-05;
			double num2 = axis.WholeRange.Delta / axis.VisualRange.Delta;
			return ComparingUtils.CompareDoubles(num2, GetMaximumZoomPercent(axis), num) < 0;
		}

		public bool CanZoomIn()
		{
			if (!ZoomableByX || !CanZoomInAxis(PrimaryAxisX))
			{
				if (ZoomableByY)
				{
					return CanZoomInAxis(PrimaryAxisY);
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public bool CanZoomOut()
		{
			if (!ZoomableByX || !CanZoomOutAxis(PrimaryAxisX))
			{
				if (ZoomableByY)
				{
					return CanZoomOutAxis(PrimaryAxisY);
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public bool CanScroll(int dx, int dy, bool useReverse)
		{
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			DXRectangle bounds = ZoomablePane.Bounds;
			if (((DXRectangle)(ref bounds)).IsCollapsed)
			{
				return false;
			}
			IAxisData horizontalAxis = GetHorizontalAxis(ScrollableByX, ScrollableByY);
			IAxisData verticalAxis = GetVerticalAxis(ScrollableByX, ScrollableByY);
			if (horizontalAxis != null && CalcAxisOffset(horizontalAxis, -dx, ((DXRectangle)(ref bounds)).Width, useReverse) != 0.0)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (verticalAxis != null && CalcAxisOffset(verticalAxis, dy, ((DXRectangle)(ref bounds)).Height, useReverse) != 0.0)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool CanScrollTo(ScrollingOrientation orientation)
		{
			return orientation switch
			{
				ScrollingOrientation.AxisXScroll => ScrollableByX, 
				ScrollingOrientation.AxisYScroll => ScrollableByY, 
				_ => false, 
			};
		}

		public bool Scroll(int dx, int dy, bool useReverse, NavigationType navigationType)
		{
			//IL_0010: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0015: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (!ScrollingEnabled)
			{
				return false;
			}
			DXRectangle bounds = ZoomablePane.Bounds;
			if (((DXRectangle)(ref bounds)).IsCollapsed)
			{
				return false;
			}
			RangesSnapshot rangesSnapshot = new RangesSnapshot(PrimaryAxisX, PrimaryAxisY);
			ScrollingOrientation scrollingOrientation = ScrollingOrientation.None;
			IAxisData horizontalAxis = GetHorizontalAxis(ScrollableByX, ScrollableByY);
			IAxisData verticalAxis = GetVerticalAxis(ScrollableByX, ScrollableByY);
			if (horizontalAxis != null)
			{
				double num = CalcAxisOffset(horizontalAxis, (navigationType != NavigationType.Command) ? (-dx) : dx, ((DXRectangle)(ref bounds)).Width, useReverse);
				if (!double.IsNaN(num) && num != 0.0)
				{
					Scroll(horizontalAxis, num);
					scrollingOrientation = (ScrollingOrientation)((int)scrollingOrientation | ((!ZoomablePane.Rotated) ? 1 : 2));
				}
			}
			if (verticalAxis != null)
			{
				double num2 = CalcAxisOffset(verticalAxis, dy, ((DXRectangle)(ref bounds)).Height, useReverse);
				if (!double.IsNaN(num2) && num2 != 0.0)
				{
					Scroll(verticalAxis, num2);
					scrollingOrientation = (ScrollingOrientation)((int)scrollingOrientation | (ZoomablePane.Rotated ? 1 : 2));
				}
			}
			if (scrollingOrientation == ScrollingOrientation.None)
			{
				return false;
			}
			FinishScrolling(scrollingOrientation, rangesSnapshot, navigationType, PrimaryAxisX, PrimaryAxisY);
			return true;
		}

		public bool ScrollTo(double position, ScrollingOrientation orientation, NavigationType navigationType)
		{
			if (orientation == ScrollingOrientation.None)
			{
				return false;
			}
			RangesSnapshot rangesSnapshot = new RangesSnapshot(PrimaryAxisX, PrimaryAxisY);
			if (orientation == ScrollingOrientation.AxisXScroll)
			{
				if (!ScrollableByX || !ScrollTo(PrimaryAxisX, position))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			else if (!ScrollableByY || !ScrollTo(PrimaryAxisY, position))
			{
				return false;
			}
			FinishScrolling(orientation, rangesSnapshot, navigationType, PrimaryAxisX, PrimaryAxisY);
			return true;
		}

		public void SetAxisXRange(double position1, double position2, NavigationType navigationType)
		{
			SetAxisRange(position1, position2, navigationType, PrimaryAxisX);
		}

		public void SetAxisYRange(double position1, double position2, NavigationType navigationType)
		{
			SetAxisRange(position1, position2, navigationType, PrimaryAxisY);
		}

		public void SetAxisXZoom(double factor, NavigationType navigationType)
		{
			SetAxisZoom(factor, navigationType, PrimaryAxisX);
		}

		public void SetAxisYZoom(double factor, NavigationType navigationType)
		{
			SetAxisZoom(factor, navigationType, PrimaryAxisY);
		}
	}

		public IList<IAxisData> TotalSecondaryAxes => totalSecondaryAxes;

		public IAxisData PrimaryAxis => primaryAxis;

		public AxisContainer(IList<IAxisData> axes, IList<IAxisData> allSecondaryAxes)
		{
			if (axes.Count > 0)

				primaryAxis = axes[0];
				secondaryAxes = new List<IAxisData>(axes);
				secondaryAxes.RemoveAt(0);
			}
			totalSecondaryAxes = allSecondaryAxes;
			this.axes = axes;
		}
