	public class AxisPaneContainer : Dictionary<IAxisData, IList<IPane>>
	{
		public AxisPaneContainer(PaneAxesContainerRepository paneAxisRepository)
		{
			foreach (PaneAxesContainer value in paneAxisRepository.Values)
			{
				foreach (AxisContainer axisContainer in value.AxisContainers)
				{
					foreach (IAxisData axis in axisContainer.Axes)
					{
						RegisterAxis(axis, value.Pane);
					}
				}
			}
			using Enumerator enumerator4 = GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator4.MoveNext())
			{
				KeyValuePair<IAxisData, IList<IPane>> current4 = enumerator4.Current;
				current4.Key.AxisVisibilityInPanes?.UpdateVisibilityInPanes(current4.Value);
			}
		}

		public IList<IPane> GetPanes(IAxisData axis)
		{
			if (!TryGetValue(axis, out var value))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return value;
		}

		public IPane GetFirstPaneByAxes(IAxisData axisX, IAxisData axisY)
		{
			IList<IPane> panes = GetPanes(axisX);
			IList<IPane> panes2 = GetPanes(axisY);
			foreach (IPane item in panes)
			{
				foreach (IPane item2 in panes2)
				{
					if (item == item2)
					{
						return item;
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public bool IsScrollingZoomingEnabledForAxis(IAxisData axis)
		{
			bool flag = !axis.IsArgumentAxis;
			if (TryGetValue(axis, out var value))
			{
				foreach (IPane item in value)
				{
					if (!(item is IZoomablePane zoomablePane))
					{
						continue;
					}
					if (flag)
					{
						if (zoomablePane.ScrollingByYEnabled || zoomablePane.ZoomingByYEnabled)
						{
							return true;
						}
					}
					else if (zoomablePane.ScrollingByXEnabled || zoomablePane.ZoomingByXEnabled)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void RegisterAxis(IAxisData axis, IPane pane)
		{
			if (!TryGetValue(axis, out var value))
			{
				value = new List<IPane>();
				Add(axis, value);
			}
			value.Add(pane);
		}
	}
	public class PaneAxesContainerRepository
	{
		private class PaneComparer : IComparer<IPane>
		{
			public int Compare(IPane x, IPane y)
			{
				return x.PaneIndex.CompareTo(y.PaneIndex);
			}
		}

		private class PaneAxisComparer : IComparer<IAxisData>
		{
			private readonly IList<IAxisData> axisList;

			public PaneAxisComparer(IList<IAxisData> axisList)
			{
				this.axisList = axisList;
			}

			public int Compare(IAxisData x, IAxisData y)
			{
				return axisList.IndexOf(x).CompareTo(axisList.IndexOf(y));
			}
		}

		private struct AxesList : ICloneable
		{
			public static AxesList Empty = new AxesList(new List<IAxisData>(), new List<IAxisData>());

			private readonly List<IAxisData> axesX;

			private readonly List<IAxisData> axesY;

			public List<IAxisData> AxesX => axesX;

			public List<IAxisData> AxesY => axesY;

			public AxesList(List<IAxisData> axesX, List<IAxisData> axesY)
			{
				this.axesX = axesX;
				this.axesY = axesY;
			}

			public object Clone()
			{
				return new AxesList(new List<IAxisData>(AxesX), new List<IAxisData>(AxesY));
			}
		}

		private class PaneAxesDictionary : Dictionary<IPane, AxesList>
		{
			private readonly IList<IAxisData> unboundedAxesX;

			private readonly IList<IAxisData> unboundedAxesY;

			public PaneAxesDictionary(IList<IAxisData> allAxesX, IList<IAxisData> allAxesY)
			{
				unboundedAxesX = new List<IAxisData>(allAxesX);
				unboundedAxesY = new List<IAxisData>(allAxesY);
			}

			public void BindAxisToPane(IPane pane, IAxisData axisDataX, IAxisData axisDataY)
			{
				if (!ContainsKey(pane))
				{
					Add(pane, (AxesList)AxesList.Empty.Clone());
				}
				if (!base[pane].AxesX.Contains(axisDataX) && axisDataX != null)
				{
					base[pane].AxesX.Add(axisDataX);
				}
				if (!base[pane].AxesY.Contains(axisDataY) && axisDataY != null)
				{
					base[pane].AxesY.Add(axisDataY);
				}
				unboundedAxesX.Remove(axisDataX);
				unboundedAxesY.Remove(axisDataY);
			}

			public void BindUnboundedAxes()
			{
				if (base.Count != 0)
				{
					IPane key = this.First().Key;
					base[key].AxesX.AddRange(unboundedAxesX);
					base[key].AxesY.AddRange(unboundedAxesY);
				}
			}

			public void SortAxesInPanes(IComparer<IAxisData> forAxesX, IComparer<IAxisData> forAxesY)
			{
				foreach (IPane key in base.Keys)
				{
					base[key].AxesX.Sort(forAxesX);
					base[key].AxesY.Sort(forAxesY);
				}
			}

			public AxesList GetAllBoundedSecondaryAxes(IAxisData primaryAxisX, IAxisData primaryAxisY)
			{
				HashSet<IAxisData> hashSet = new HashSet<IAxisData>();
				HashSet<IAxisData> hashSet2 = new HashSet<IAxisData>();
				foreach (IPane key in base.Keys)
				{
					if (primaryAxisX != null && base[key].AxesX[0] == primaryAxisX)
					{
						hashSet.UnionWith(base[key].AxesX);
					}
					if (primaryAxisY != null && base[key].AxesY[0] == primaryAxisY)
					{
						hashSet2.UnionWith(base[key].AxesY);
					}
				}
				hashSet.Remove(primaryAxisX);
				hashSet2.Remove(primaryAxisY);
				return new AxesList(hashSet.ToList(), hashSet2.ToList());
			}
		}

		private SortedList<IPane, PaneAxesContainer> repository;

		public IList<PaneAxesContainer> Values => repository.Values;

		public PaneAxesContainerRepository(IAxisData primaryAxisX, IAxisData primaryAxisY, IEnumerable<IAxisData> secondaryAxesX, IEnumerable<IAxisData> secondaryAxesY, IList<IPane> actualPanes, IEnumerable<IRefinedSeries> seriesList)
		{
			repository = new SortedList<IPane, PaneAxesContainer>(new PaneComparer());
			IList<IAxisData> axesX = CreateAxesList(primaryAxisX, secondaryAxesX);
			IList<IAxisData> axesY = CreateAxesList(primaryAxisY, secondaryAxesY);
			PaneAxesDictionary paneAxesDictionary = MappingPaneToAxesViaSeries(axesX, axesY, actualPanes, seriesList);
			foreach (IPane key in paneAxesDictionary.Keys)
			{
				AxesList axesList = ((paneAxesDictionary[key].AxesX.Count <= 0 || paneAxesDictionary[key].AxesY.Count <= 0) ? AxesList.Empty : paneAxesDictionary.GetAllBoundedSecondaryAxes(paneAxesDictionary[key].AxesX[0], paneAxesDictionary[key].AxesY[0]));
				PaneAxesContainer value = new PaneAxesContainer(key, paneAxesDictionary[key].AxesX, paneAxesDictionary[key].AxesY, axesList.AxesX, axesList.AxesY);
				repository.Add(key, value);
			}
		}

		private IList<IAxisData> CreateAxesList(IAxisData primaryAxis, IEnumerable<IAxisData> secondaryAxis)
		{
			List<IAxisData> list = new List<IAxisData>();
			list.Add(primaryAxis);
			list.AddRange(secondaryAxis);
			return list;
		}

		private PaneAxesDictionary MappingPaneToAxesViaSeries(IList<IAxisData> axesX, IList<IAxisData> axesY, IList<IPane> actualPanes, IEnumerable<IRefinedSeries> seriesList)
		{
			PaneAxesDictionary paneAxesDictionary = new PaneAxesDictionary(axesX, axesY);
			foreach (IRefinedSeries series in seriesList)
			{
				if (!(series.SeriesView is IXYSeriesView iXYSeriesView))
				{
					continue;
				}
				paneAxesDictionary.BindAxisToPane(iXYSeriesView.Pane, iXYSeriesView.AxisXData, iXYSeriesView.AxisYData);
				List<ISeparatePaneIndicator> separatePaneIndicators = iXYSeriesView.GetSeparatePaneIndicators();
				if (separatePaneIndicators == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				foreach (ISeparatePaneIndicator item in separatePaneIndicators)
				{
					if (item.Pane != iXYSeriesView.Pane)
					{
						paneAxesDictionary.BindAxisToPane(item.Pane, iXYSeriesView.AxisXData, item.AxisYData);
					}
				}
			}
			if (paneAxesDictionary.Count == 0 && actualPanes.Count > 0)
			{
				paneAxesDictionary.BindAxisToPane(actualPanes[0], null, null);
			}
			paneAxesDictionary.SortAxesInPanes(new PaneAxisComparer(axesX), new PaneAxisComparer(axesY));
			paneAxesDictionary.BindUnboundedAxes();
			return paneAxesDictionary;
		}

		public PaneAxesContainer GetContainer(IPane pane)
		{
			if (!repository.TryGetValue(pane, out var value))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return value;
		}

		public void UpdateRanges()
		{
			foreach (PaneAxesContainer value in Values)
			{
				value.RangeLimitsUpdated();
			}
		}
	}
	public class AxisRangeInfo
	{
		public double Min { get; private set; }

		public double Max { get; private set; }

		public object MinValue { get; private set; }

		public object MaxValue { get; private set; }

		public AxisRangeInfo(IAxisRangeData axisRange)
		{
			Min = axisRange.Min;
			Max = axisRange.Max;
			MinValue = axisRange.MinValue;
			MaxValue = axisRange.MaxValue;
		}

		public void ApplyState(IVisualAxisRangeData axisRange)
		{
			axisRange.ScrollOrZoomRange(MinValue, MaxValue, Min, Max);
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is AxisRangeInfo axisRangeInfo))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (axisRangeInfo.Max == Max)
			{
				return axisRangeInfo.Min == Min;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return HashCodeHelper.CalculateGeneric<double, double>(Min, Max);
		}
	}
	public class RangesSnapshot
	{
		private readonly IAxisData axisX;

		private readonly IAxisData axisY;

		private readonly AxisRangeInfo xAxisRange;

		private readonly AxisRangeInfo yAxisRange;

		public IAxisData AxisX => axisX;

		public IAxisData AxisY => axisY;

		public AxisRangeInfo XRange => xAxisRange;

		public AxisRangeInfo YRange => yAxisRange;

		private static double CalculateEdgeChange(IWholeAxisRangeData wholeRange, double value, double oldValue)
		{
			double num = (value - wholeRange.Min) / wholeRange.Delta;
			double num2 = (oldValue - wholeRange.Min) / wholeRange.Delta;
			return num - num2;
		}

		private static double Correct(double value)
		{
			if (value < 0.0)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			if (value > 1.0)
			{
				return 1.0;
			}
			return value;
		}

		private static void CorrectSecondaryAxesPositions(IList<IAxisData> axes, AxisRangeInfo oldRange, IAxisData primaryAxis, bool useDeltaFactor)
		{
			double num = CalculateEdgeChange(primaryAxis.WholeRange, primaryAxis.VisualRange.Min, oldRange.Min);
			double num2 = CalculateEdgeChange(primaryAxis.WholeRange, primaryAxis.VisualRange.Max, oldRange.Max);
			foreach (IAxisData axis in axes)
			{
				if (axis.Reverse ^ primaryAxis.Reverse)
				{
					double num3 = 1.0 - num2;
					double num4 = 1.0 - num;
				}
				else
				{
					double num3 = num;
					double num4 = num2;
				}
				ITransformation transformation = axis.AxisScaleTypeMap.Transformation;
				double num5 = transformation.TransformForward(axis.WholeRange.Min);
				double num6 = transformation.TransformForward(axis.WholeRange.Max);
				double num7 = num6 - num5;
				double num8 = (transformation.TransformForward(axis.VisualRange.Min) - num5) / num7;
				double num9 = (transformation.TransformForward(axis.VisualRange.Max) - num5) / num7;
				double num10 = (useDeltaFactor ? (axis.VisualRange.Delta / axis.WholeRange.Delta / (primaryAxis.VisualRange.Delta / primaryAxis.WholeRange.Delta)) : 1.0);
				double num11 = Correct(num8 + num * num10);
				double num12 = Correct(num9 + num2 * num10);
				if (num11 > num12 || num11 == num12)
				{
					num11 = num8;
					num12 = num9;
				}
				double min = transformation.TransformBackward(num5 + num11 * num7);
				double max = transformation.TransformBackward(num5 + num12 * num7);
				PaneAxesManager.SetMinMax(axis, min, max);
			}
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is RangesSnapshot rangesSnapshot))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (xAxisRange.Equals(rangesSnapshot.xAxisRange))
			{
				return yAxisRange.Equals(rangesSnapshot.yAxisRange);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return HashCodeHelper.CalculateGeneric<AxisRangeInfo, AxisRangeInfo>(xAxisRange, yAxisRange);
		}

		public RangesSnapshot(IAxisData axisX, IAxisData axisY)
		{
			this.axisX = axisX;
			this.axisY = axisY;
			xAxisRange = new AxisRangeInfo(axisX.VisualRange);
			yAxisRange = new AxisRangeInfo(axisY.VisualRange);
		}

		public void CorrectAxesXPositions(IList<IAxisData> axes, bool useDeltaFactor)
		{
			CorrectSecondaryAxesPositions(axes, xAxisRange, axisX, useDeltaFactor);
		}

		public void CorrectAxesYPositions(IList<IAxisData> axes, bool useDeltaFactor)
		{
			CorrectSecondaryAxesPositions(axes, yAxisRange, axisY, useDeltaFactor);
		}
	}
	public class OutOfBoundsChecker
	{
		private IAxisData axis;

		private bool isHorizontal;

		private MinMaxValues bound;

		private MinMaxValues expandedBound;

		private IMinMaxValues range;

		public IAxisData Axis => axis;

		public bool NeedCorrection => expandedBound != bound;

		public OutOfBoundsChecker(IAxisData axis, bool isHorizontal, DXRectangle rangeBounds, IMinMaxValues range)
		{
			this.range = range;
			this.axis = axis;
			this.isHorizontal = isHorizontal;
			if (isHorizontal)
			{
				bound = GetWholeRangeBound(axis, ((DXRectangle)(ref rangeBounds)).Left, ((DXRectangle)(ref rangeBounds)).Right);
			}
			else
			{
				bound = GetWholeRangeBound(axis, ((DXRectangle)(ref rangeBounds)).Top, ((DXRectangle)(ref rangeBounds)).Bottom);
			}
			expandedBound = bound.Clone();
		}

		private MinMaxValues GetWholeRangeBound(IAxisData axis, int minBound, int maxBound)
		{
			if (axis.WholeRange.Min == axis.VisualRange.Min && axis.WholeRange.Max == axis.VisualRange.Max)
			{
				return new MinMaxValues(minBound, maxBound);
			}
			double num = (double)(maxBound - minBound) / axis.VisualRange.Delta;
			double num2 = Math.Ceiling((axis.VisualRange.Min - axis.WholeRange.Min) * num);
			double num3 = Math.Ceiling((axis.WholeRange.Max - axis.VisualRange.Max) * num);
			if (axis.IsVertical ^ axis.Reverse)
			{
				return new MinMaxValues((double)minBound - num3, (double)maxBound + num2);
			}
			return new MinMaxValues((double)minBound - num2, (double)maxBound + num3);
		}

		private MinMaxValues GetVertical(GRealRect2D bounds)
		{
			return new MinMaxValues(bounds.Top, bounds.Bottom);
		}

		private MinMaxValues GetHorizontal(GRealRect2D bounds)
		{
			return new MinMaxValues(bounds.Left, bounds.Right);
		}

		private MinMaxValues CalculateRange(bool reverse)
		{
			double num = range.Delta / (bound.Delta - (expandedBound.Delta - bound.Delta));
			if (double.IsPositiveInfinity(num) || num < 0.0)
			{
				num = 1.0;
			}
			MinMaxValues minMaxValues = new MinMaxValues(bound.Min - expandedBound.Min, expandedBound.Max - bound.Max);
			MinMaxValues minMaxValues2 = ((!reverse) ? new MinMaxValues(minMaxValues.Max * num, minMaxValues.Min * num) : new MinMaxValues(minMaxValues.Min * num, minMaxValues.Max * num));
			MinMaxValues result = new MinMaxValues(range.Min - minMaxValues2.Min, range.Max + minMaxValues2.Max);
			ChartDebug.Assert(result.HasValues && result.Delta > 0.0, "range delta must be > 0");
			return result;
		}

		public void CheckOutOfBounds(GRealRect2D bounds)
		{
			expandedBound = MinMaxValues.Union(expandedBound, isHorizontal ? GetHorizontal(bounds) : GetVertical(bounds));
		}

		public MinMaxValues GetCorrectedWholeRange()
		{
			if (NeedCorrection)
			{
				return CalculateRange(isHorizontal ^ axis.Reverse);
			}
			return MinMaxValues.Empty;
		}
	}
	public class AggregationIntervalsInfo
	{
		public bool UseUnderflow { get; private set; }

		public bool UseOverflow { get; private set; }

		public List<double> Intervals { get; private set; }

		public bool IsValid
		{
			get
			{
				if (Intervals != null)
				{
					return Intervals.Count > 0;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public double MinAxisValue { get; private set; }

		public double MaxAxisValue { get; private set; }

		public double IntervalWidth { get; private set; }

		public AggregationIntervalsInfo(List<double> intervals, double intervalWidth, double minAxisValue, double maxAxisValue, bool useUnderflow, bool useOverflow)
		{
			UseOverflow = useOverflow;
			UseUnderflow = useUnderflow;
			MinAxisValue = minAxisValue;
			MaxAxisValue = maxAxisValue;
			Intervals = intervals;
			IntervalWidth = intervalWidth;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is AggregationIntervalsInfo aggregationIntervalsInfo) || UseOverflow != aggregationIntervalsInfo.UseOverflow || UseUnderflow != aggregationIntervalsInfo.UseUnderflow || IsValid != aggregationIntervalsInfo.IsValid)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (IsValid)
			{
				if (Intervals.Count == aggregationIntervalsInfo.Intervals.Count)
				{
					for (int i = 0; i < Intervals.Count; i++)
					{
						if (Intervals[i] != aggregationIntervalsInfo.Intervals[i])
						{
							return false;
						}
					}
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return base.GetHashCode();
		}
	}
	public abstract class AxisAggregationIntervalsCalculatorBase
	{
		protected AggregationIntervalsInfo CalculateAutoHistogramMode(IAxisData axis, IList<RefinedSeries> refinedSeries, double? underflowValue, double? overflowValue)
		{
			SimpleStandardDeviationCalculator simpleStandardDeviationCalculator = CreateAutoHistogramCalculator(axis);
			if (!simpleStandardDeviationCalculator.Calculate(refinedSeries, out var standardDeviation, out var average, out var pointsCount))
			{
				return null;
			}
			double value = 3.5 * standardDeviation / Math.Pow(pointsCount, 1.0 / 3.0);
			if (!underflowValue.HasValue || !GeometricUtils.IsValidDouble(underflowValue.Value))
			{
				underflowValue = average - 3.0 * standardDeviation;
			}
			if (!overflowValue.HasValue || !GeometricUtils.IsValidDouble(overflowValue.Value))
			{
				overflowValue = average + 3.0 * standardDeviation;
			}
			value = RoundValue(axis, value);
			underflowValue = RoundValue(axis, underflowValue.Value);
			overflowValue = RoundUpValue(axis, overflowValue.Value);
			return CreateIntervals(value, underflowValue, overflowValue, axis);
		}

		protected AggregationIntervalsInfo CreateIntervals(double binWidth, double? underflowValue, double? overflowValue, IAxisData axis)
		{
			IWholeAxisRangeData wholeRange = axis.WholeRange;
			if (binWidth > 0.0)
			{
				bool flag = overflowValue.HasValue && GeometricUtils.IsValidDouble(overflowValue.Value) && wholeRange.RefinedMax >= overflowValue.Value;
				bool flag2 = underflowValue.HasValue && GeometricUtils.IsValidDouble(underflowValue.Value) && wholeRange.RefinedMin <= underflowValue.Value;
				double num = (flag2 ? underflowValue.Value : wholeRange.RefinedMin);
				double num2 = (flag ? overflowValue.Value : wholeRange.RefinedMax);
				List<double> list = new List<double>();
				double num3 = num;
				int num4 = 1;
				while (num3 < num2)
				{
					list.Add(num3);
					num3 = num + binWidth * (double)num4;
					num4++;
				}
				list.Add(flag ? num2 : num3);
				return new AggregationIntervalsInfo(list, binWidth, Math.Min(list[0], wholeRange.RefinedMin), Math.Max(list[list.Count - 1], wholeRange.RefinedMax), flag2, flag);
			}
			double refinedMin = wholeRange.RefinedMin;
			double refinedMax = wholeRange.RefinedMax;
			return new AggregationIntervalsInfo(new List<double> { refinedMin, refinedMax }, Math.Abs(refinedMax - refinedMin), refinedMin, refinedMax, useUnderflow: false, useOverflow: false);
		}

		protected abstract double RoundValue(IAxisData axis, double value);

		protected abstract double RoundUpValue(IAxisData axis, double value);

		protected abstract SimpleStandardDeviationCalculator CreateAutoHistogramCalculator(IAxisData axis);

		protected virtual bool IsInvalidScaleMode(ScaleModeNative scaleMode)
		{
			return scaleMode == ScaleModeNative.Continuous;
		}

		public abstract bool UpdateIntervals(IAxisData axis, IList<RefinedSeries> refinedSeries);
	}
	public abstract class MeasureUnitAxisAggregationIntervalsCalculator<TMeasureUnit> : AxisAggregationIntervalsCalculatorBase where TMeasureUnit : struct
	{
		protected bool UpdateIntervalsCore(IAxisData axis, IScaleOptionsBase<TMeasureUnit> scaleOptions, IList<RefinedSeries> refinedSeries)
		{
			if (axis == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			IWholeAxisRangeData wholeRange = axis.WholeRange;
			if (scaleOptions == null || IsInvalidScaleMode(scaleOptions.ScaleMode) || refinedSeries.Count == 0 || wholeRange == null || !GeometricUtils.IsValidDouble(wholeRange.RefinedMin) || !GeometricUtils.IsValidDouble(wholeRange.RefinedMax) || wholeRange.RefinedMin == wholeRange.RefinedMax)
			{
				return false;
			}
			AggregationIntervalsInfo aggregationIntervalsInfo = CreateAggregationIntervalsInfo(axis, scaleOptions, refinedSeries);
			if (aggregationIntervalsInfo != null && !aggregationIntervalsInfo.Equals(scaleOptions.AggregationIntervalsInfo))
			{
				scaleOptions.AggregationIntervalsInfo = aggregationIntervalsInfo;
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected virtual AggregationIntervalsInfo CreateAggregationIntervalsInfo(IAxisData axis, IScaleOptionsBase<TMeasureUnit> scaleOptions, IList<RefinedSeries> refinedSeries)
		{
			return CalculateAutoHistogramMode(axis, refinedSeries, scaleOptions.UnderflowValue, scaleOptions.OverflowValue);
		}
	}
	public abstract class DivisionModeAxisAggregationIntervalsCalculator<TMeasureUnit> : MeasureUnitAxisAggregationIntervalsCalculator<TMeasureUnit> where TMeasureUnit : struct
	{
		private AggregationIntervalsInfo CalculateIntervalWidthMode(IAxisData axis, IScaleOptionsDivisionModeSupport<TMeasureUnit> scaleOptions)
		{
			double num = CalcBinWidth(axis, scaleOptions.IntervalWidth.Value, scaleOptions.MeasureUnit);
			if (!GeometricUtils.IsValidDouble(num))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return CreateIntervals(num, scaleOptions.UnderflowValue, scaleOptions.OverflowValue, axis);
		}

		private AggregationIntervalsInfo CalculateIntervalsCountMode(IAxisData axis, IScaleOptionsDivisionModeSupport<TMeasureUnit> scaleOptions)
		{
			IWholeAxisRangeData wholeRange = axis.WholeRange;
			double? underflowValue = scaleOptions.UnderflowValue;
			double? overflowValue = scaleOptions.OverflowValue;
			int num = scaleOptions.IntervalCount.Value;
			bool flag = underflowValue.HasValue && GeometricUtils.IsValidDouble(underflowValue.Value) && wholeRange.RefinedMin <= underflowValue.Value;
			bool flag2 = overflowValue.HasValue && GeometricUtils.IsValidDouble(overflowValue.Value) && wholeRange.RefinedMax >= overflowValue.Value;
			double num2 = wholeRange.RefinedMin;
			if (flag)
			{
				num--;
				num2 = underflowValue.Value;
			}
			double num3 = wholeRange.RefinedMax;
			if (flag2)
			{
				num--;
				num3 = overflowValue.Value;
			}
			if (num <= 0 || num3 <= num2)
			{
				return null;
			}
			List<double> list = new List<double>();
			list.Add(num2);
			for (int i = 1; i < num; i++)
			{
				list.Add(num2 + (num3 - num2) * (double)i / (double)num);
			}
			list.Add(num3);
			double intervalWidth = (num3 - num2) / (double)num;
			return new AggregationIntervalsInfo(list, intervalWidth, Math.Min(list[0], wholeRange.RefinedMin), Math.Max(list[list.Count - 1], wholeRange.RefinedMax), flag, flag2);
		}

		protected abstract double CalcBinWidth(IAxisData axis, double intervalWidth, TMeasureUnit measureUnit);

		protected override AggregationIntervalsInfo CreateAggregationIntervalsInfo(IAxisData axis, IScaleOptionsBase<TMeasureUnit> scaleOptions, IList<RefinedSeries> refinedSeries)
		{
			IScaleOptionsDivisionModeSupport<TMeasureUnit> scaleOptionsDivisionModeSupport = (IScaleOptionsDivisionModeSupport<TMeasureUnit>)scaleOptions;
			if (scaleOptionsDivisionModeSupport.DivisionMode == IntervalDivisionModeNative.Width && scaleOptionsDivisionModeSupport.IntervalWidth.HasValue)
			{
				return CalculateIntervalWidthMode(axis, scaleOptionsDivisionModeSupport);
			}
			if (scaleOptionsDivisionModeSupport.DivisionMode == IntervalDivisionModeNative.Count && scaleOptionsDivisionModeSupport.IntervalCount.HasValue)
			{
				return CalculateIntervalsCountMode(axis, scaleOptionsDivisionModeSupport);
			}
			return base.CreateAggregationIntervalsInfo(axis, scaleOptions, refinedSeries);
		}
	}

	internal abstract class AxisIntervalsContainer
	{
		private readonly List<AxisAggregationInterval> intervals;

		private readonly double intervalWidth;

		public int Count => intervals.Count;

		public AxisIntervalsContainer(AggregationIntervalsInfo info)
		{
			intervals = new List<AxisAggregationInterval>();
			if (info != null && info.Intervals.Count > 0)
			{
				intervalWidth = info.IntervalWidth;
				bool useUnderflow = info.UseUnderflow;
				if (useUnderflow)
				{
					intervals.Add(CreateUnderflowInterval(info.MinAxisValue, info.Intervals[0], useUnderflow));
				}
				for (int i = 0; i < info.Intervals.Count - 1; i++)
				{
					intervals.Add(CreateInterval(info.Intervals[i], info.Intervals[i + 1], i == 0 && !useUnderflow));
				}
				if (info.UseOverflow)
				{
					intervals.Add(CreateOverflowInterval(info.Intervals[info.Intervals.Count - 1], info.MaxAxisValue));
				}
			}
		}

		private int GetIndex(double value)
		{
			int count = intervals.Count;
			if (count > 0)
			{
				AxisAggregationInterval axisAggregationInterval = intervals[0];
				if (axisAggregationInterval.ContainsValue(value))
				{
					return 0;
				}
				if (axisAggregationInterval.Min >= value)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				double max = axisAggregationInterval.Max;
				axisAggregationInterval = intervals[count - 1];
				if (axisAggregationInterval.ContainsValue(value))
				{
					return count - 1;
				}
				if (axisAggregationInterval.Max <= value)
				{
					return count;
				}
				int num = (int)((value - max) / intervalWidth) + 1;
				if (num > 0 && num < count)
				{
					if (intervals[num].ContainsValue(value))
					{
						return num;
					}
					if (intervals[num - 1].ContainsValue(value))
					{
						return num - 1;
					}
					if (intervals[num + 1].ContainsValue(value))
					{
						return num + 1;
					}
				}
			}
			return int.MinValue;
		}

		protected abstract double GetNextRefinedValue(double value);

		protected abstract double GetPrevRefinedValue(double value);

		protected abstract object GetNextNativeValue(object value);

		protected abstract object GetPrevNativeValue(object value);

		protected abstract AxisAggregationInterval CreateInterval(double min, double max, bool useUnderflow);

		protected abstract AxisAggregationInterval CreateUnderflowInterval(double min, double max, bool useUnderflow);

		protected abstract AxisAggregationInterval CreateOverflowInterval(double min, double max);

		public bool InternalToRefined(double value, out double result)
		{
			result = double.NaN;
			if (intervals.Count == 0 || value < -2147483648.0 || value > 2147483647.0 || !GeometricUtils.IsValidDouble(value))
			{
				return false;
			}
			int num = Convert.ToInt32(value);
			if (num >= 0 && intervals.Count > num)
			{
				result = (intervals[num].IncludeMin ? intervals[num].Min : GetNextRefinedValue(intervals[num].Min));
			}
			else if (num == -1)
			{
				result = GetPrevRefinedValue(intervals[0].Min);
			}
			else if (num == intervals.Count)
			{
				result = GetNextRefinedValue(intervals[intervals.Count - 1].Max);
			}
			return !double.IsNaN(result);
		}

		public bool RefinedToInternal(double value, out double result)
		{
			result = GetIndex(value);
			if ((int)result >= -1)
			{
				return (int)result <= intervals.Count;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool InternalToNativeInterval(double value, bool convertToString, IAxisData axis, out object result)
		{
			result = null;
			if (intervals.Count > 0 && GeometricUtils.IsValidDouble(value) && value >= -2147483648.0 && value <= 2147483647.0)
			{
				int num = Convert.ToInt32(value);
				if (num >= 0 && intervals.Count > num)
				{
					AxisAggregationInterval axisAggregationInterval = intervals[num];
					if (convertToString)
					{
						result = axisAggregationInterval.ToString(axis);
					}
					else
					{
						result = axisAggregationInterval;
					}
				}
			}
			return result != null;
		}

		public bool InternalToNativeValue(double value, out object result)
		{
			result = null;
			if (intervals.Count > 0 && GeometricUtils.IsValidDouble(value) && value >= -2147483648.0 && value <= 2147483647.0)
			{
				int num = Convert.ToInt32(value);
				if (num >= 0 && intervals.Count > num)
				{
					result = (intervals[num].IncludeMin ? intervals[num].NativeMin : GetNextNativeValue(intervals[num].NativeMin));
				}
				else if (num == -1)
				{
					result = GetPrevNativeValue(intervals[0].NativeMin);
				}
				else if (num == intervals.Count)
				{
					result = GetNextNativeValue(intervals[intervals.Count - 1].NativeMax);
				}
			}
			return result != null;
		}

		public bool NativeToInternal(object obj, IAxisData axis, out double result)
		{
			result = 0.0;
			if (obj is string && intervals.Count > 0)
			{
				string text = (string)obj;
				if (text.Equals(intervals[0].ToString(axis)))
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (text.Equals(intervals[intervals.Count - 1].ToString(axis)))
				{
					result = intervals.Count - 1;
					return true;
				}
				for (int i = 1; i < intervals.Count - 1; i++)
				{
					if (text.Equals(intervals[i].ToString(axis)))
					{
						result = i;
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	internal class NumericAxisIntervalsContainer : AxisIntervalsContainer
	{
		public NumericAxisIntervalsContainer(AggregationIntervalsInfo info)
			: base(info)
		{
		}

		protected override double GetNextRefinedValue(double value)
		{
			return ChartsCommonUtils.IncrementDouble(value);
		}

		protected override double GetPrevRefinedValue(double value)
		{
			return ChartsCommonUtils.DecrementDouble(value);
		}

		protected override object GetNextNativeValue(object value)
		{
			return ChartsCommonUtils.IncrementDouble((double)value);
		}

		protected override object GetPrevNativeValue(object value)
		{
			return ChartsCommonUtils.DecrementDouble((double)value);
		}

		protected override AxisAggregationInterval CreateInterval(double min, double max, bool useUnderflow)
		{
			return new NumericAxisAggregationInterval(min, max, useUnderflow, includeMax: true, isUnderflow: false, isOverflow: false);
		}

		protected override AxisAggregationInterval CreateOverflowInterval(double min, double max)
		{
			return new NumericAxisAggregationInterval(min, max, includeMin: false, includeMax: true, isUnderflow: false, isOverflow: true);
		}

	internal abstract class AxisAggregationInterval : IComparable<AxisAggregationInterval>
	{
		public abstract object NativeMin { get; }

		public abstract object NativeMax { get; }

		public double Min { get; private set; }

		public double Max { get; private set; }

		public bool IncludeMin { get; private set; }

		public bool IncludeMax { get; private set; }

		public bool IsUnderflow { get; private set; }

		public bool IsOverflow { get; private set; }

		public static string GetActualPattern(IAxisData axis, AxisAggregationInterval interval)
		{
			if (interval != null)
			{
				switch (axis.AxisScaleTypeMap.ScaleType)
				{
				case ActualScaleTypeCore.Numerical:
					if (interval.IsUnderflow)
					{
						return axis.NumericScaleOptions.UnderflowPattern;
					}
					if (interval.IsOverflow)
					{
						return axis.NumericScaleOptions.OverflowPattern;
					}
					return axis.NumericScaleOptions.IntervalPattern;
				case ActualScaleTypeCore.DateTime:
					if (interval.IsUnderflow)
					{
						return axis.DateTimeScaleOptions.UnderflowPattern;
					}
					if (interval.IsOverflow)
					{
						return axis.DateTimeScaleOptions.OverflowPattern;
					}
					return axis.DateTimeScaleOptions.IntervalPattern;
				case ActualScaleTypeCore.TimeSpan:
					if (interval.IsUnderflow)
					{
						return axis.TimeSpanScaleOptions.UnderflowPattern;
					}
					if (interval.IsOverflow)
					{
						return axis.TimeSpanScaleOptions.OverflowPattern;
					}
					return axis.TimeSpanScaleOptions.IntervalPattern;
				}
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}

		protected AxisAggregationInterval(double min, double max, bool includeMin, bool includeMax, bool isUnderflow, bool isOverflow)
		{
			Min = min;
			Max = max;
			IncludeMin = includeMin;
			IncludeMax = includeMax;
			IsUnderflow = isUnderflow;
			IsOverflow = isOverflow;
		}

		public bool ContainsValue(double value)
		{
			bool flag = (IncludeMin && Min <= value) || (!IncludeMin && Min < value);
			bool flag2 = (IncludeMax && Max >= value) || (!IncludeMax && Max > value);
			if (IsUnderflow)
			{
				return flag2;
			}
			if (IsOverflow)
			{
				return flag;
			}
			return flag && flag2;
		}

		public string ToString(IAxisData axis)
		{
			IAxisLabelFormatterCore formatter = axis.Label.Formatter;
			if (formatter != null)
			{
				return formatter.GetAxisLabelText(NativeMin);
			}
			string actualPattern = GetActualPattern(axis, this);
			PatternParser patternParser = new PatternParser(actualPattern, (IPatternHolder)axis.Label);
			patternParser.SetContext(this);
			return patternParser.GetText();
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return (IncludeMin ? "[" : "(") + NativeMin?.ToString() + ", " + NativeMax?.ToString() + (IncludeMax ? "]" : ")");
		}

		public int CompareTo(AxisAggregationInterval obj)
		{
			if (IsUnderflow)
			{
				if (obj.IsUnderflow)
				{
					return Max.CompareTo(obj.Max);
				}
				return -1;
			}
			return Min.CompareTo(obj.Min);
		}
	}

	internal abstract class MapWithoutGapsCalculator<T, Unit> where T : IComparable<T>
	{
		protected internal class ValuesContainer : IComparable<ValuesContainer>
		{
			public double InternalValue { get; private set; }

			public T NativeValue { get; private set; }

			public double Gap { get; private set; }

			public ValuesContainer(double internalValue, T nativeValue, double gap)
			{
				InternalValue = internalValue;
				NativeValue = nativeValue;
				Gap = gap;
			}

			public ValuesContainer(double internalValue)
				: this(internalValue, default(T), double.NaN)
			{
			}

			public int CompareTo(ValuesContainer other)
			{
				return InternalValue.CompareTo(other.InternalValue);
			}

			public override string ToString()
			{
				return InternalValue + " : " + NativeValue.ToString();
			}
		}

		private readonly List<DoubleLimits> dataLimits;

		private readonly Dictionary<Tuple<Unit, int>, List<ValuesContainer>> valuesCache;

		internal List<DoubleLimits> DataLimits => dataLimits;

		public MapWithoutGapsCalculator(List<DoubleLimits> dataLimits)
		{
			this.dataLimits = dataLimits;
			valuesCache = new Dictionary<Tuple<Unit, int>, List<ValuesContainer>>();
		}

		private List<ValuesContainer> GetValuesByMeasureUnit(Unit measureUnit, int measureUnitMultiplier)
		{
			List<ValuesContainer> value = null;
			Tuple<Unit, int> key = new Tuple<Unit, int>(measureUnit, measureUnitMultiplier);
			if (!valuesCache.TryGetValue(key, out value))
			{
				value = CalculateValuesByMeasureUnit(measureUnit, measureUnitMultiplier);
				valuesCache.Add(key, value);
			}
			return value;
		}

		protected abstract List<ValuesContainer> CalculateValuesByMeasureUnit(Unit measureUnit, int measureUnitMultiplier);

		protected abstract double NativeToRefinedSimple(T value);

		protected abstract double NativeToInternalSimple(T value, Unit measureUnit, int measureUnitMultiplier);

		protected abstract T InternalToNativeSimple(double value, Unit measureUnit, int measureUnitMultiplier);

		protected abstract T RefinedToNativeSimple(double value);

		protected double AlignToNextRefinedValue(double refinedValue)
		{
			if (refinedValue >= dataLimits[0].Start && dataLimits[dataLimits.Count - 1].End >= refinedValue)
			{
				int num = dataLimits.BinarySearch(new DoubleLimits(refinedValue), new DoubleLimitsStartComparer());
				if (num < 0)
				{
					num = ~num - 1;
					if (dataLimits[num].End < refinedValue)
					{
						return dataLimits[num + 1].Start;
					}
				}
			}
			return refinedValue;
		}

		protected double GetGapForInternalValue(double value, Unit measureUnit, int measureUnitMultiplier)
		{
			List<ValuesContainer> valuesByMeasureUnit = GetValuesByMeasureUnit(measureUnit, measureUnitMultiplier);
			if (value > valuesByMeasureUnit[1].InternalValue)
			{
				int num = valuesByMeasureUnit.BinarySearch(new ValuesContainer(value));
				if (num < 0)
				{
					num = ~num - 1;
				}
				return valuesByMeasureUnit[num].Gap;
			}
			return 0.0;
		}

		public double NativeToInternal(T value, Unit measureUnit, int measureUnitMultiplier)
		{
			List<ValuesContainer> valuesByMeasureUnit = GetValuesByMeasureUnit(measureUnit, measureUnitMultiplier);
			if (valuesByMeasureUnit[valuesByMeasureUnit.Count - 1].NativeValue.Equals(value))
			{
				return valuesByMeasureUnit[valuesByMeasureUnit.Count - 1].InternalValue;
			}
			double num = 0.0;
			double num2 = NativeToRefinedSimple(value);
			if (num2 >= dataLimits[0].Start)
			{
				int num3 = dataLimits.BinarySearch(new DoubleLimits(num2), new DoubleLimitsStartComparer());
				if (num3 >= 0)
				{
					return valuesByMeasureUnit[num3 * 2].InternalValue;
				}
				num3 = (~num3 - 1) * 2 + 1;
				ValuesContainer valuesContainer = valuesByMeasureUnit[num3];
				bool flag = num3 < valuesByMeasureUnit.Count - 2;
				int num4 = value.CompareTo(valuesContainer.NativeValue);
				if (num4 == 0 || (num4 > 0 && flag))
				{
					return valuesContainer.InternalValue;
				}
				num = valuesContainer.Gap;
			}
			return NativeToInternalSimple(value, measureUnit, measureUnitMultiplier) - num;
		}

		public T InternalToNative(double value, Unit measureUnit, int measureUnitMultiplier)
		{
			List<ValuesContainer> valuesByMeasureUnit = GetValuesByMeasureUnit(measureUnit, measureUnitMultiplier);
			if (valuesByMeasureUnit[valuesByMeasureUnit.Count - 1].InternalValue == value)
			{
				return valuesByMeasureUnit[valuesByMeasureUnit.Count - 1].NativeValue;
			}
			if (value >= valuesByMeasureUnit[0].InternalValue)
			{
				int num = valuesByMeasureUnit.BinarySearch(new ValuesContainer(value));
				if (num >= 0)
				{
					return valuesByMeasureUnit[num].NativeValue;
				}
				num = ~num - 1;
				if (num < valuesByMeasureUnit.Count - 2 && num % 2 > 0)
				{
					int index = num + (int)Math.Round(value - Math.Truncate(value));
					return valuesByMeasureUnit[index].NativeValue;
				}
				value += valuesByMeasureUnit[num].Gap;
			}
			return InternalToNativeSimple(value, measureUnit, measureUnitMultiplier);
		}

		public double RefinedToInternal(double value, Unit measureUnit, int measureUnitMultiplier)
		{
			return NativeToInternal(RefinedToNativeSimple(value), measureUnit, measureUnitMultiplier);
		}

		public bool IsAxisValueVisible(T axisValue)
		{
			double num = NativeToRefinedSimple(axisValue);
			if (num >= dataLimits[0].Start)
			{
				int num2 = dataLimits.BinarySearch(new DoubleLimits(num), new DoubleLimitsStartComparer());
				if (num2 < 0)
				{
					num2 = ~num2 - 1;
				}
				if (num2 < dataLimits.Count - 1)
				{
					return dataLimits[num2].End >= num;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal Dictionary<Tuple<Unit, int>, List<ValuesContainer>> ValuesCacheAccessor()
		{
			return valuesCache;
		}
	}

	public class NumericLabelFormatter : IFormatProvider, ICustomFormatter
	{
		object IFormatProvider.GetFormat(Type formatType)
		{
			if (formatType == typeof(ICustomFormatter))
			{
				return this;
			}
			return null;
		}

		string ICustomFormatter.Format(string format, object arg, IFormatProvider formatProvider)
		{
			if (!Equals(formatProvider))
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(format))
			{
				double num = Convert.ToDouble(arg);
				string text = "G";
				string text2 = "";
				if (num >= 1000.0 && num < 999999.0)
				{
					text = "F1";
					text2 = "K";
					num /= 1000.0;
				}
				else if (num >= 1000000.0 && num < 999999999.0)
				{
					text = "F1";
					text2 = "M";
					num /= 1000000.0;
				}
				else if (num >= 1000000000.0)
				{
					text = "F1";
					text2 = "B";
					num /= 1000000000.0;
				}
				return num.ToString(text, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) + text2;
			}
			try
			{
				return string.Format("{0:" + format + "}", arg);
			}
			catch
			{
				return $"{arg}";
			}
		}
	}
	public abstract class DateTimeLabelFormatterBase : IFormatProvider, ICustomFormatter
	{
		protected abstract DateTimeGridAlignmentNative GridAlignment { get; }

		object IFormatProvider.GetFormat(Type formatType)
		{
			if (formatType == typeof(ICustomFormatter))
			{
				return this;
			}
			return null;
		}

		string ICustomFormatter.Format(string format, object arg, IFormatProvider formatProvider)
		{
			if (!Equals(formatProvider))
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(format))
			{
				DateTime dateTime = Convert.ToDateTime(arg);
				switch (GridAlignment)
				{
				default:
				{
					string longTimePattern = DateTimeFormatInfo.CurrentInfo.LongTimePattern;
					longTimePattern = Regex.Replace(longTimePattern, "(:ss|:s)", "$1.fff");
					return "{" + dateTime.ToString("d") + "} {" + dateTime.ToString() + ": " + longTimePattern + "}";
				}
				case DateTimeGridAlignmentNative.Second:
					return dateTime.ToString("G") ?? "";
				case DateTimeGridAlignmentNative.Minute:
					return dateTime.ToString("g") ?? "";
				case DateTimeGridAlignmentNative.Hour:
					return dateTime.ToString("g") ?? "";
				case DateTimeGridAlignmentNative.Day:
				case DateTimeGridAlignmentNative.Week:
					return dateTime.ToString("d") ?? "";
				case DateTimeGridAlignmentNative.Month:
				case DateTimeGridAlignmentNative.Quarter:
					return dateTime.ToString("y") ?? "";
				case DateTimeGridAlignmentNative.Year:
					return dateTime.ToString("yyyy") ?? "";
				}
			}
			try
			{
				return string.Format("{0:" + format + "}", arg);
			}
			catch
			{
				return $"{arg}";
			}
		}
	}
	public abstract class TimeSpanLabelFormatterBase : IFormatProvider, ICustomFormatter
	{
		protected abstract TimeSpanGridAlignmentNative GridAlignment { get; }

		object IFormatProvider.GetFormat(Type formatType)
		{
			if (formatType == typeof(ICustomFormatter))
			{
				return this;
			}
			return null;
		}

		string ICustomFormatter.Format(string format, object arg, IFormatProvider formatProvider)
		{
			if (!Equals(formatProvider))
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(format))
			{
				TimeSpan timeSpan = (TimeSpan)arg;
				TimeSpanGridAlignmentNative gridAlignment = GridAlignment;
				_ = 4;
				return timeSpan.ToString("g") ?? "";
			}
			try
			{
				return string.Format("{0:" + format + "}", arg);
			}
			catch
			{
				return $"{arg}";
			}
		}
	}
	public class GridGenerator
	{
		public List<double> GenerateGridValues(double min, double max, RangeControlGridUnit gridUnit, RangeControlClientGridMapping gridMapping, RangeControlMapping map)
		{
			List<double> list = new List<double>();
			if (!gridUnit.IsValid)
			{
				return list;
			}
			RangeControlClientSnapCalculator rangeControlClientSnapCalculator = new RangeControlClientSnapCalculator(gridMapping, map);
			double num = min;
			while (num <= max)
			{
				double num2 = rangeControlClientSnapCalculator.RoundValue(gridUnit, num, limitByRangeBounds: false);
				if (map.IsCorrectGridValue(num2))
				{
					list.Add(num2);
				}
				num = num2 + gridUnit.Step;
			}
			return list;
		}
	}
	public class RangeControlClientSnapCalculator
	{
		private readonly RangeControlClientGridMapping gridMapping;

		private readonly double axisRangeMin;

		private readonly double axisRangeMax;

		private readonly RangeControlMapping rangeControlMapping;

		private double GetValue(double normalizedArgument)
		{
			double num = axisRangeMax - axisRangeMin;
			return normalizedArgument * num + axisRangeMin;
		}

		private double NormalizeArgument(double argument)
		{
			double num = axisRangeMax - axisRangeMin;
			double num2 = argument - axisRangeMin;
			return num2 / num;
		}

		private double Normalize(double value)
		{
			double num = NormalizeArgument(value);
			if (num < 0.0)
			{
				num = 0.0;
			}
			else if (num > 1.0)
			{
				num = 1.0;
			}
			return num;
		}

		private int GetCorrectionDirectionBySideMargin(double value)
		{
			if (rangeControlMapping.ChartSideMargin <= double.Epsilon)
			{
				if (value < rangeControlMapping.DataRange.Min)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				if (value > rangeControlMapping.DataRange.Max)
				{
					return 1;
				}
			}
			return 0;
		}

		private double CorrectValue(double value, int correction)
		{
			if (correction < 0)
			{
				return rangeControlMapping.DataRange.Min;
			}
			if (correction > 0)
			{
				return rangeControlMapping.DataRange.Max;
			}
			return value;
		}

		private double ShiftValue(RangeControlGridUnit unit, double value, double offset)
		{
			double index = gridMapping.FloorValue(unit, value, offset);
			return gridMapping.GetGridValue(unit, index);
		}

		public double FloorValue(RangeControlGridUnit unit, double value)
		{
			double index = gridMapping.FloorValue(unit, value, 0.0);
			return gridMapping.GetGridValue(unit, index);
		}

		public double CeilValue(RangeControlGridUnit unit, double value)
		{
			double index = gridMapping.CeilValue(unit, value, 0.0);
			return gridMapping.GetGridValue(unit, index);
		}

		public double RoundValue(RangeControlGridUnit unit, double value, bool limitByRangeBounds)
		{
			double gridValue = gridMapping.GetGridValue(unit, gridMapping.FloorValue(unit, value, 0.0));
			double gridValue2 = gridMapping.GetGridValue(unit, gridMapping.CeilValue(unit, value, 0.0));
			double num = (limitByRangeBounds ? Math.Max(axisRangeMin, gridValue) : gridValue);
			double num2 = (limitByRangeBounds ? Math.Min(axisRangeMax, gridValue2) : gridValue2);
			double num3 = num2 - num;
			double num4 = value - num;
			if (!(num4 / num3 > 0.5))
			{
				return gridValue;
			}
			return gridValue2;
		}

		public MinMaxValues SnapRange(double rangeMin, double rangeMax, RangeValidationBase validationBase, RangeControlGridUnit unit, bool limitValuesByWholeRange = false)
		{
			int correctionDirectionBySideMargin = GetCorrectionDirectionBySideMargin(rangeMin);
			int correctionDirectionBySideMargin2 = GetCorrectionDirectionBySideMargin(rangeMax);
			rangeMin = CorrectValue(rangeMin, correctionDirectionBySideMargin);
			rangeMax = CorrectValue(rangeMax, correctionDirectionBySideMargin2);
			double num = RoundValue(unit, rangeMin, limitByRangeBounds: true);
			double num2 = RoundValue(unit, rangeMax, limitByRangeBounds: true);
			if (limitValuesByWholeRange)
			{
				num = rangeControlMapping.LimitMinValueByWholeRange(num);
				num2 = rangeControlMapping.LimitMaxValueByWholeRange(num2);
			}
			if (num == num2)
			{
				double num3 = num;
				if (rangeMin == rangeMax)
				{
					switch (validationBase)
					{
					case RangeValidationBase.Average:
						if (num3 > rangeMin || correctionDirectionBySideMargin > 0 || correctionDirectionBySideMargin2 > 0)
						{
							num = ShiftValue(unit, num3, -1.0);
						}
						else
						{
							num2 = ShiftValue(unit, num3, 1.0);
						}
						break;
					case RangeValidationBase.Minimum:
						num = ShiftValue(unit, num3, -1.0);
						break;
					case RangeValidationBase.Maximum:
						num2 = ShiftValue(unit, num3, 1.0);
						break;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					double num4 = Math.Abs(num3 - rangeMin);
					double num5 = Math.Abs(num3 - rangeMax);
					if (num4 > num5)
					{
						num = FloorValue(unit, rangeMin);
					}
					else
					{
						num2 = CeilValue(unit, rangeMax);
					}
				}
			}
			return new MinMaxValues(num, num2);
		}

		public MinMaxValues SnapNormalRange(MinMaxValues range, RangeValidationBase validationBase, RangeControlGridUnit unit)
		{
			double value = GetValue(range.Min);
			double value2 = GetValue(range.Max);
			IMinMaxValues minMaxValues = SnapRange(value, value2, validationBase, unit);
			double min = Normalize(minMaxValues.Min);
			double max = Normalize(minMaxValues.Max);
			return new MinMaxValues(min, max);
		}

		public RangeControlClientSnapCalculator(RangeControlClientGridMapping gridMapping, RangeControlMapping mapping)
		{
			this.gridMapping = gridMapping;
			axisRangeMax = mapping.RangeControlRange.Max;
			axisRangeMin = mapping.RangeControlRange.Min;
			rangeControlMapping = mapping;
		}
	}
	public enum RangeValidationBase
	{
		Minimum,
		Maximum,
		Average
	}
	public abstract class RangeControlClientGridMapping
	{
		protected internal abstract double CeilValue(RangeControlGridUnit unit, double value, double offset);

		protected internal abstract double FloorValue(RangeControlGridUnit unit, double value, double offset);

		protected internal abstract double GetGridValue(RangeControlGridUnit unit, double index);
	}
	public abstract class NumericRangeControlClientGridMappingBase : RangeControlClientGridMapping
	{
		protected internal override double CeilValue(RangeControlGridUnit unit, double value, double offset)
		{
			return Math.Ceiling((value + unit.ReversedOffset) / unit.Step) + offset;
		}

		protected internal override double FloorValue(RangeControlGridUnit unit, double value, double offset)
		{
			return Math.Floor((value + unit.ReversedOffset) / unit.Step) + offset;
		}

		protected internal override double GetGridValue(RangeControlGridUnit unit, double index)
		{
			return index * unit.Step - unit.ReversedOffset;
		}
	}

	}

	}
	public class DateTimeRangeControlClientGridMapping : RangeControlClientGridMapping
	{
		private readonly IWorkdaysOptions workdaysOptions;

		protected DateTimeRangeControlClientGridMapping()
			: this(null)
		{
		}

		public DateTimeRangeControlClientGridMapping(IWorkdaysOptions workdaysOptions)
		{
			this.workdaysOptions = workdaysOptions;
		}

		protected double CorrectGridUnits(double gridUnits, RangeControlGridUnit unit, double offset, bool ceil)
		{
			double d = (gridUnits + unit.ReversedOffset) / unit.Spacing;
			double num = Math.Floor(d);
			double num2 = offset;
			if (ceil)
			{
				num2 += 1.0;
			}
			return (num + num2) * unit.Spacing - unit.ReversedOffset;
		}

		protected virtual double RoundValue(RangeControlGridUnit unit, double value, double offset, bool ceil)
		{
			//IL_0008: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0086: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			AlignedRangeControlGridUnit<DateTimeMeasureUnitNative> alignedRangeControlGridUnit = (AlignedRangeControlGridUnit<DateTimeMeasureUnitNative>)unit;
			DateTimeMeasureUnitNative alignment = alignedRangeControlGridUnit.Alignment;
			DayOfWeek firstDayOfWeek = DateTimeUtilsExt.GetFirstDayOfWeek(workdaysOptions);
			double measureUnitMultiplier = 1.0;
			DateTime dateTime = DateTime.MinValue.AddMilliseconds(value);
			double num = DateTimeUtilsExt.Difference(DateTime.MinValue, dateTime, alignment, measureUnitMultiplier, firstDayOfWeek);
			DateTime? dateTime2 = DateTimeUtilsExt.Add(DateTime.MinValue, alignment, measureUnitMultiplier, num, firstDayOfWeek);
			double range = CorrectGridUnits(num, alignedRangeControlGridUnit, offset, ceil && dateTime2.HasValue && dateTime2.Value < dateTime);
			DateTime? dateTime3 = DateTimeUtilsExt.Add(DateTime.MinValue, alignment, measureUnitMultiplier, range, firstDayOfWeek);
			if (!dateTime3.HasValue)
			{
				return value;
			}
			return DateTimeUtilsExt.Difference(DateTime.MinValue, dateTime3.Value, (DateTimeMeasureUnitNative)0, measureUnitMultiplier, firstDayOfWeek);
		}

		protected internal override double CeilValue(RangeControlGridUnit unit, double value, double offset)
		{
			return RoundValue(unit, value, offset, ceil: true);
		}

		protected internal override double FloorValue(RangeControlGridUnit unit, double value, double offset)
		{
			return RoundValue(unit, value, offset, ceil: false);
		}

		protected internal override double GetGridValue(RangeControlGridUnit unit, double index)
		{
			return index;
		}
	}
	public class TimeSpanRangeControlClientGridMapping : DateTimeRangeControlClientGridMapping
	{
		protected override double RoundValue(RangeControlGridUnit unit, double value, double offset, bool ceil)
		{
			AlignedRangeControlGridUnit<TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative> alignedRangeControlGridUnit = (AlignedRangeControlGridUnit<TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative>)unit;
			TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative alignment = alignedRangeControlGridUnit.Alignment;
			TimeSpan timeSpan = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(value);
			double num = DateTimeUtilsExt.TimeSpanToMeasureUnit(timeSpan, alignment, 1.0);
			TimeSpan timeSpan2 = DateTimeUtilsExt.AddRange(alignment, alignment, TimeSpan.Zero, (int)num);
			double num2 = CorrectGridUnits(num, alignedRangeControlGridUnit, offset, ceil && timeSpan2 < timeSpan);
			TimeSpan value2 = DateTimeUtilsExt.AddRange(alignment, alignment, TimeSpan.Zero, (int)num2);
			return Math.Floor(DateTimeUtilsExt.TimeSpanToMeasureUnit(value2, TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative.Millisecond, 1.0));
		}
	}
	public class RangeControlMapping
	{
		private readonly double sideMargin;

		private readonly IMinMaxValues wholeRange;

		private readonly IMinMaxValues dataRange;

		private readonly double rangeControlSideMargin;

		private readonly IMinMaxValues rangeControlRange;

		internal IMinMaxValues RangeControlRange => rangeControlRange;

		internal IMinMaxValues DataRange => dataRange;

		internal double ChartSideMargin => sideMargin;

		public static RangeControlMapping Create(IAxisData axisData, bool excludeSideMargins)
		{
			IWholeAxisRangeData wholeAxisRangeData = axisData.WholeRange;
			AxisScaleTypeMap axisScaleTypeMap = axisData.AxisScaleTypeMap;
			double num = axisScaleTypeMap.InternalToRefinedExact(wholeAxisRangeData.Min);
			double max = axisScaleTypeMap.InternalToRefinedExact(wholeAxisRangeData.Max);
			double num2 = (excludeSideMargins ? (axisScaleTypeMap.NativeToRefined(wholeAxisRangeData.MinValue) - num) : 0.0);
			return new RangeControlMapping(new MinMaxValues(num, max), num2);
		}

		protected RangeControlMapping(IMinMaxValues wholeRange, double sideMargin)
		{
			this.wholeRange = wholeRange;
			this.sideMargin = sideMargin;
			dataRange = new MinMaxValues(wholeRange.Min + sideMargin, wholeRange.Max - sideMargin);
			rangeControlSideMargin = ((dataRange.Delta > 0.0) ? (dataRange.Delta * 0.01) : 0.5);
			rangeControlRange = new MinMaxValues(dataRange.Min - rangeControlSideMargin, dataRange.Max + rangeControlSideMargin);
		}

		public double RangeValueToValue(double rangeValue)
		{
			if (rangeValue < rangeControlRange.Min)
			{
				return wholeRange.Min;
			}
			if (rangeValue < dataRange.Min)
			{
				return dataRange.Min - (dataRange.Min - rangeValue) / rangeControlSideMargin * sideMargin;
			}
			if (rangeValue >= dataRange.Min && rangeValue <= dataRange.Max)
			{
				return rangeValue;
			}
			if (rangeValue < rangeControlRange.Max)
			{
				return dataRange.Max + (rangeValue - dataRange.Max) / rangeControlSideMargin * sideMargin;
			}
			return wholeRange.Max;
		}

		public double ValueToRangeValue(double value)
		{
			if (value < wholeRange.Min)
			{
				return rangeControlRange.Min;
			}
			if (value < dataRange.Min)
			{
				return dataRange.Min - (dataRange.Min - value) / sideMargin * rangeControlSideMargin;
			}
			if (value >= dataRange.Min && value <= dataRange.Max)
			{
				return value;
			}
			if (value < wholeRange.Max)
			{
				return dataRange.Max + (value - dataRange.Max) / sideMargin * rangeControlSideMargin;
			}
			return rangeControlRange.Max;
		}

		public double ValueToNormalValue(double value)
		{
			return (ValueToRangeValue(value) - rangeControlRange.Min) / rangeControlRange.Delta;
		}

		public double LimitMinValueByWholeRange(double minValue)
		{
			return Math.Min(Math.Max(wholeRange.Min, minValue), wholeRange.Max);
		}

		public double LimitMaxValueByWholeRange(double maxValue)
		{
			return Math.Max(Math.Min(wholeRange.Max, maxValue), wholeRange.Min);
		}

		public double NormalValueToValue(double normalValue)
		{
			return RangeValueToValue(rangeControlRange.Min + rangeControlRange.Delta * normalValue);
		}

		public bool IsCorrectGridValue(double value)
		{
			if (value >= dataRange.Min)
			{
				return value <= dataRange.Max;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	public class RangeControlGridUnit
	{
		private readonly double step;

		private readonly double spacing;

		private readonly double offset;

		public double Step => step;

		public double Spacing => spacing;

		public double Offset => offset;

		public double ReversedOffset => spacing - offset;

		public bool IsValid
		{
			get
			{
				if (!double.IsNaN(spacing) && !double.IsNaN(offset))
				{
					return !double.IsNaN(step);
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public RangeControlGridUnit(double spacing, double step, double offset)
		{
			this.spacing = spacing;
			this.step = step;
			this.offset = offset;
		}
	}

	public abstract class AggregatedPointsCreatorBase
	{
		private readonly AxisScaleTypeMap axisXScaleTypeMap;

		private readonly AxisScaleTypeMap axisYScaleTypeMap;

		private readonly RefinedSeries series;

		public static AggregatedPointsCreatorBase Create(RefinedSeries series, AxisScaleTypeMap axisXScaleTypeMap, AxisScaleTypeMap axisYScaleTypeMap, IAggregationCalculator calculator, ErrorBarsPointsCalculator errorBarsPointsCalculator)
		{
			if (calculator != null)
			{
				return new AggregatedFunctionPointsCreator(series, axisXScaleTypeMap, axisYScaleTypeMap, calculator, errorBarsPointsCalculator);
			}
			return new AggregatedSourcePointsCreator(series, axisXScaleTypeMap, axisYScaleTypeMap);
		}

		public AggregatedPointsCreatorBase(RefinedSeries series, AxisScaleTypeMap axisXScaleTypeMap, AxisScaleTypeMap axisYScaleTypeMap)
		{
			this.series = series;
			this.axisXScaleTypeMap = axisXScaleTypeMap;
			this.axisYScaleTypeMap = axisYScaleTypeMap;
		}

		private T[] InternalToNative<T>(double[] values)
		{
			T[] array = new T[values.Length];
			for (int i = 0; i < values.Length; i++)
			{
				if (!double.IsNaN(values[i]))
				{
					array[i] = (T)axisYScaleTypeMap.InternalToNative(values[i]);
				}
			}
			return array;
		}

		protected RefinedPoint CreateAggregatedPoint(IList<RefinedPoint> sourcePoints, int clusterStartIndex, int clusterCount, double clusterArgument, double[] values, double[] errorBarsValues, CorePointState state)
		{
			Scale argumentScaleTypeX = DataItemsHelper.ConvertToScale(series.ArgumentScaleType);
			object argumentX = axisXScaleTypeMap.InternalToNative(clusterArgument);
			AggregatedSeriesPoint aggregatedSeriesPoint;
			if (axisYScaleTypeMap.ScaleType == ActualScaleTypeCore.DateTime)
			{
				DateTime[] values2 = InternalToNative<DateTime>(values);
				aggregatedSeriesPoint = new AggregatedSeriesPoint(series, argumentScaleTypeX, argumentX, values2, values, sourcePoints, clusterStartIndex, clusterCount, state);
			}
			else if (axisYScaleTypeMap.ScaleType == ActualScaleTypeCore.TimeSpan)
			{
				TimeSpan[] values3 = InternalToNative<TimeSpan>(values);
				aggregatedSeriesPoint = new AggregatedSeriesPoint(series, argumentScaleTypeX, argumentX, values3, values, sourcePoints, clusterStartIndex, clusterCount, state);
			}
			else
			{
				aggregatedSeriesPoint = new AggregatedSeriesPoint(series, argumentScaleTypeX, argumentX, values, sourcePoints, clusterStartIndex, clusterCount, state, isAuxiliary: false);
			}
			return ObjectsFactory.Default.Create(aggregatedSeriesPoint, clusterArgument, values, errorBarsValues, aggregatedSeriesPoint.State);
		}

		public abstract IEnumerable<RefinedPoint> CreateAggregatedPoints(IList<RefinedPoint> sourcePoints, int index, int count, double currentAlignedArgument);
	}
	public class AggregatedFunctionPointsCreator : AggregatedPointsCreatorBase
	{
		private readonly IAggregationCalculator calculator;

		private readonly ErrorBarsPointsCalculator errorBarsPointsCalculator;

		public AggregatedFunctionPointsCreator(RefinedSeries series, AxisScaleTypeMap axisXScaleTypeMap, AxisScaleTypeMap axisYScaleTypeMap, IAggregationCalculator calculator, ErrorBarsPointsCalculator errorBarsPointsCalculator)
			: base(series, axisXScaleTypeMap, axisYScaleTypeMap)
		{
			this.calculator = calculator;
			this.errorBarsPointsCalculator = errorBarsPointsCalculator;
		}

		private double[] CalculateClusterErrorBarValues(IAggregationCalculator calculator, IList<RefinedPoint> points, int index, int count)
		{
			if (count > 0 && calculator.CanSupportErrorBars && errorBarsPointsCalculator != null)
			{
				return errorBarsPointsCalculator.CalculateErrorBars(points, index, count);
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override IEnumerable<RefinedPoint> CreateAggregatedPoints(IList<RefinedPoint> sourcePoints, int clusterStartIndex, int clusterCount, double currentAlignedArgument)
		{
			if (calculator.CanKeepSinglePoint && clusterCount == 1 && sourcePoints[clusterStartIndex].Argument == currentAlignedArgument)
			{
				yield return sourcePoints[clusterStartIndex];
				yield break;
			}
			CorePointState pointState;
			double[] values = calculator.Calculate(sourcePoints, clusterStartIndex, clusterCount, out pointState);
			double[] errorBarsValues = CalculateClusterErrorBarValues(calculator, sourcePoints, clusterStartIndex, clusterCount);
			yield return CreateAggregatedPoint(sourcePoints, clusterStartIndex, clusterCount, currentAlignedArgument, values, errorBarsValues, pointState);
		}
	}
	public class AggregatedSourcePointsCreator : AggregatedPointsCreatorBase
	{
		public AggregatedSourcePointsCreator(RefinedSeries series, AxisScaleTypeMap axisXScaleTypeMap, AxisScaleTypeMap axisYScaleTypeMap)
			: base(series, axisXScaleTypeMap, axisYScaleTypeMap)
		{
		}

		private double[] GetErrorBarValues(IErrorBarPoint point)
		{
			return new double[2] { point.LowValue, point.HighValue };
		}

		public override IEnumerable<RefinedPoint> CreateAggregatedPoints(IList<RefinedPoint> sourcePoints, int clusterStartIndex, int clusterCount, double currentAlignedArgument)
		{
			for (int j = clusterStartIndex; j < clusterStartIndex + clusterCount; j++)
			{
				RefinedPoint refinedPoint = sourcePoints[j];
				double[] values = new double[4] { refinedPoint.Value1, refinedPoint.Value2, refinedPoint.Value3, refinedPoint.Value4 };
				double[] errorBarValues = GetErrorBarValues(refinedPoint);
				RefinedPoint refinedPoint2 = CreateAggregatedPoint(sourcePoints, j, 1, currentAlignedArgument, values, errorBarValues, refinedPoint.State);
				refinedPoint2.Index = refinedPoint.Index;
				yield return refinedPoint2;
			}
		}
	}

	{
		public override List<RefinedPoint> Process(IList<RefinedPoint> initialPoints)
		{
			List<RefinedPoint> list = new List<RefinedPoint>(initialPoints.Count);
			for (int i = 0; i < initialPoints.Count; i++)
			{
				RefinedPoint refinedPoint = initialPoints[i];
				if (!refinedPoint.IsEmpty)

					list.Add(refinedPoint);

			}
			return list;
		}

	public class EmptyPointsFilterSetZeroValueBehavior : EmptyPointsFilterBehaviorBase
	{
		private int valuesDimension;

		public EmptyPointsFilterSetZeroValueBehavior(int valuesDimension)
		{
			this.valuesDimension = valuesDimension;
		}

		public override List<RefinedPoint> Process(IList<RefinedPoint> initialPoints)
		{
			List<RefinedPoint> list = new List<RefinedPoint>(initialPoints.Count);
			List<double> list2 = new List<double>(valuesDimension);
			for (int i = 0; i < valuesDimension; i++)
			{
				list2.Add(0.0);
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < initialPoints.Count; j++)
			{
				RefinedPoint refinedPoint = initialPoints[j];
				list.Add(refinedPoint.IsEmpty ? ObjectsFactory.Default.Create(refinedPoint.SeriesPoint, refinedPoint.Argument, list2, CorePointState.EmptyWithNonDefaultValues) : refinedPoint);
			}
			return list;
		}
	}
	public class EmptyPointsFilterSetAverageValueBehavior : EmptyPointsFilterBehaviorBase
	{
		private int valuesDimension;

		public EmptyPointsFilterSetAverageValueBehavior(int valuesDimension)
		{
			this.valuesDimension = valuesDimension;
		}

		private double CalulateValue(RefinedPoint firstPoint, RefinedPoint lastPoint, RefinedPoint point, Func<RefinedPoint, double> getValue)
		{
			if (firstPoint != null)
			{
				if (lastPoint != null)
				{
					double argument = firstPoint.Argument;
					double num = getValue(firstPoint);
					double argument2 = lastPoint.Argument;
					double num2 = getValue(lastPoint);
					double num3 = argument - argument2;
					double argument3 = point.Argument;
					return argument * num2 / num3 - num * argument2 / num3 + (num - num2) * argument3 / num3;
				}
				return getValue(firstPoint);
			}
			if (lastPoint != null)
			{
				return getValue(lastPoint);
			}
			return 0.0;
		}

		public override List<RefinedPoint> Process(IList<RefinedPoint> initialPoints)
		{
			List<RefinedPoint> list = new List<RefinedPoint>(initialPoints.Count);
			RefinedPoint firstPoint = null;
			int num = -1;
			for (int i = 0; i < initialPoints.Count; i++)
			{
				RefinedPoint refinedPoint = initialPoints[i];
				if (refinedPoint.IsEmpty)
				{
					if (num < i)
					{
						num = -1;
						for (int j = i + 1; j < initialPoints.Count; j++)
						{
							if (!initialPoints[j].IsEmpty)
							{
								num = j;
								break;
							}
						}
					}
					RefinedPoint lastPoint = ((num > 0) ? initialPoints[num] : null);
					List<double> list2 = new List<double>(4);
					list2.Add(CalulateValue(firstPoint, lastPoint, refinedPoint, (RefinedPoint x) => x.Value1));
					if (valuesDimension > 1)
					{
						list2.Add(CalulateValue(firstPoint, lastPoint, refinedPoint, (RefinedPoint x) => x.Value2));
						if (valuesDimension > 2)
						{
							list2.Add(CalulateValue(firstPoint, lastPoint, refinedPoint, (RefinedPoint x) => x.Value3));
							if (valuesDimension > 3)
							{
								list2.Add(CalulateValue(firstPoint, lastPoint, refinedPoint, (RefinedPoint x) => x.Value4));
								if (valuesDimension > 4)
								{
									list2.Add(CalulateValue(firstPoint, lastPoint, refinedPoint, (RefinedPoint x) => x.Value5));
									if (valuesDimension > 5)
									{
										list2.Add(CalulateValue(firstPoint, lastPoint, refinedPoint, (RefinedPoint x) => x.Value6));
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}
					list.Add(ObjectsFactory.Default.Create(refinedPoint.SeriesPoint, refinedPoint.Argument, list2, CorePointState.EmptyWithNonDefaultValues));
				}
				else
				{
					firstPoint = initialPoints[i];
					list.Add(refinedPoint);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}
	}
	public class EmptyPointsFilter : PointsFilter
	{
		private IList<RefinedPoint> processedPoints;

		private EmptyPointProcessingMode lastProcessedMode = EmptyPointProcessingMode.NoAction;

		private EmptyPointsFilterBehaviorBase behavior;

		private EmptyPointProcessingMode ActualMode => base.RefinedSeries.SeriesView.EmptyPointProcessingMode;

		public override bool AffectsMapping => ActualMode == EmptyPointProcessingMode.Remove;

		private static EmptyPointsFilterBehaviorBase CreateBehavior(EmptyPointProcessingMode mode, int pointDimension)
		{
			return mode switch
			{
				EmptyPointProcessingMode.Remove => new EmptyPointsFilterRemoveBehavior(), 
				EmptyPointProcessingMode.SetZeroValue => new EmptyPointsFilterSetZeroValueBehavior(pointDimension), 
				EmptyPointProcessingMode.SetAverageValue => new EmptyPointsFilterSetAverageValueBehavior(pointDimension), 
				_ => null, 
			};
		}

		public static List<RefinedPoint> ProcessPointsWithoutCache(List<RefinedPoint> points, ISeriesView view)
		{
			EmptyPointsFilterBehaviorBase emptyPointsFilterBehaviorBase = CreateBehavior(view.EmptyPointProcessingMode, view.PointDimension);
			if (emptyPointsFilterBehaviorBase == null)
			{
				return points;
			}
			return emptyPointsFilterBehaviorBase.Process(points);
		}

		public EmptyPointsFilter(RefinedSeries series)
			: base(series)
		{
		}

		private IList<RefinedPoint> ProcessPoints(IList<RefinedPoint> initialPoints)
		{
			EmptyPointProcessingMode actualMode = ActualMode;
			if (lastProcessedMode != actualMode)
			{
				behavior = CreateBehavior(actualMode, base.RefinedSeries.SeriesView.PointDimension);
				lastProcessedMode = actualMode;
			}
			if (behavior != null)
			{
				return behavior.Process(initialPoints);
			}
			return initialPoints;
		}

		protected override IList<RefinedPoint> Recalculate(IList<RefinedPoint> initialPoints)
		{
			if (initialPoints != null)
			{
				processedPoints = ProcessPoints(initialPoints);
			}
			return processedPoints;
		}

		protected override IList<RefinedPoint> GetCachedPoints()
		{
			return processedPoints;
		}

		public override void ClearCache()
		{
			processedPoints = null;
			lastProcessedMode = EmptyPointProcessingMode.NoAction;
			behavior = null;
		}

		public override bool Update()
		{
			EmptyPointProcessingMode actualMode = ActualMode;
			bool flag = actualMode != EmptyPointProcessingMode.NoAction;
			if (base.Enable != flag || actualMode != lastProcessedMode)
			{
				base.Enable = flag;
				ClearCache();
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override PointsFilterUpdateInfo Update(PointsFilterUpdateInfo updateInfo)
		{
			return null;
		}
	}

	{
		Start,
		Subtotal,
		Total
	}
	public class WaterfallFilter : PointsFilter
	{
		private readonly IPointProcessorProvider processorProvider;

		private readonly WaterfallFilterBehavior filterBehavior;

		private List<RefinedPoint> cache;

		private IWaterfallSeriesView WaterfallSeriesView => base.RefinedSeries.SeriesView as IWaterfallSeriesView;

		public WaterfallFilter(RefinedSeries refinedSeries, IPointProcessorProvider pointsProcessor)
			: base(refinedSeries)
		{
			processorProvider = pointsProcessor;
			filterBehavior = WaterfallSeriesView.ValueOptions.CreateFilterBehavior(base.RefinedSeries);
		}

		protected override IList<RefinedPoint> Recalculate(IList<RefinedPoint> initialPoints)
		{
			cache = new List<RefinedPoint>();
			if (initialPoints.Count == 0)
			{
				return initialPoints;
			}
			cache.AddRange(initialPoints);
			if (WaterfallSeriesView == null)
			{
				return cache;
			}
			filterBehavior.ApplySubtotals(initialPoints, WaterfallSeriesView.ValueOptions, cache, processorProvider.Processor);
			return cache;
		}

		protected override IList<RefinedPoint> GetCachedPoints()
		{
			return cache;
		}

		public override void ClearCache()
		{
			cache = null;
		}

		public override bool Update()
		{
			base.Enable = WaterfallSeriesView?.ValueOptions != null && base.RefinedSeries.ArgumentScaleType == ActualScaleTypeCore.Qualitative && base.RefinedSeries.InteractionContainer != null && base.RefinedSeries.InteractionContainer.GetSeriesIndex(base.RefinedSeries) == 0;
			return true;
		}

		public override PointsFilterUpdateInfo Update(PointsFilterUpdateInfo updateInfo)
		{
			return null;
		}
	}
	public class WaterfallFilterBehavior
	{
		protected RefinedSeries RefinedSeries { get; private set; }

		protected IWaterfallSeriesView WaterfallSeriesView { get; private set; }

		public WaterfallFilterBehavior(RefinedSeries refinedSeries)
		{
			RefinedSeries = refinedSeries;
			WaterfallSeriesView = (IWaterfallSeriesView)refinedSeries.SeriesView;
		}

		private void AddSubtotalPoint(string argument, Func<List<RefinedPoint>, double> calcValue, int index, WaterfallPointTypeCore pointType, List<RefinedPoint> cache, IPointProcessor pointProcessor)
		{
			List<RefinedPoint> list = new List<RefinedPoint>();
			foreach (RefinedPoint item in cache)
			{
				if (item.SeriesPoint.ArgumentX.QualitativeArgument == argument)
				{
					list.Add(item);
				}
			}
			double value = calcValue(list);
			ISeriesPoint point = WaterfallSeriesView.CreateSubtotalPoint(RefinedSeries.Series, argument, value, null, pointType);
			RefinedPoint refinedPoint = ObjectsFactory.Default.Create(point, 0.0, value);
			pointProcessor.ProcessPoint(refinedPoint, RefinedSeries.GetArgumentScaleMaps(), RefinedSeries.ValueGroup.ScaleMap, isEmpty: false);
			foreach (RefinedPoint item2 in list)
			{
				cache.Remove(item2);
			}
			cache.Insert(Math.Min(index, cache.Count), refinedPoint);
		}

		public virtual void ApplySubtotals(IList<RefinedPoint> initialPoints, IWaterfallValueOptions valueOptions, List<RefinedPoint> cache, IPointProcessor pointProcessor)
		{
			int num = 0;
			if (valueOptions.StartValue != 0.0 || !string.IsNullOrEmpty(valueOptions.StartLabel))
			{
				double startValue = valueOptions.StartValue;
				AddSubtotalPoint(valueOptions.StartLabel, (List<RefinedPoint> points) => (startValue != 0.0 || points.Count <= 0) ? startValue : points[0].Value1, 0, WaterfallPointTypeCore.Start, cache, pointProcessor);
				num++;
			}
			IList<ISubtotal> sortedSubtotals = valueOptions.SortedSubtotals;
			for (int num2 = 0; num2 < sortedSubtotals.Count; num2++)
			{
				int num3 = sortedSubtotals[num2].PointIndex + num;
				if (num3 < cache.Count && sortedSubtotals[num2].Label != null)
				{
					AddSubtotalPoint(sortedSubtotals[num2].Label, (List<RefinedPoint> points) => 0.0, num3, WaterfallPointTypeCore.Subtotal, cache, pointProcessor);
					num++;
				}
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(valueOptions.TotalLabel))
			{
				AddSubtotalPoint(valueOptions.TotalLabel, (List<RefinedPoint> points) => 0.0, cache.Count, WaterfallPointTypeCore.Total, cache, pointProcessor);
			}
		}
	}
	public class XCelWaterfallFilterBehavior : WaterfallFilterBehavior
	{
		public XCelWaterfallFilterBehavior(RefinedSeries refinedSeries)
			: base(refinedSeries)
		{
		}

		public override void ApplySubtotals(IList<RefinedPoint> initialPoints, IWaterfallValueOptions valueOptions, List<RefinedPoint> cache, IPointProcessor pointProcessor)
		{
			IList<ISubtotal> sortedSubtotals = valueOptions.SortedSubtotals;
			for (int i = 0; i < sortedSubtotals.Count; i++)
			{
				if (sortedSubtotals[i].PointIndex < initialPoints.Count)
				{
					RefinedPoint refinedPoint = initialPoints[sortedSubtotals[i].PointIndex];
					ISeriesPoint seriesPoint = refinedPoint.SeriesPoint;
					ISeriesPoint seriesPoint2 = base.WaterfallSeriesView.CreateSubtotalPoint(base.RefinedSeries.Series, seriesPoint.ArgumentX.QualitativeArgument, refinedPoint.Value1, seriesPoint.ColorCore, seriesPoint.Tag);
					refinedPoint.ReplaceSeriesPoint((IDataPoint)seriesPoint2);
				}
			}
		}
	}
