	public class RefinedPointFinder
	{
		public struct PointArgumentDistance
		{
			private readonly RefinedPoint point;

			private readonly double argumentDistance;

			private readonly int zIndex;

			public RefinedPoint Point => point;

			public double ArgumentDistance => argumentDistance;

			public int ZIndex => zIndex;

			public PointArgumentDistance(RefinedPoint point, double argumentDistance, int zIndex)
			{
				this.point = point;
				this.argumentDistance = argumentDistance;
				this.zIndex = zIndex;
			}
		}

		protected RefinedSeries RefinedSeries { get; private set; }

		protected ISeriesView SeriesView => RefinedSeries.SeriesView;

		public RefinedPointFinder(RefinedSeries refinedSeries)
		{
			RefinedSeries = refinedSeries;
		}

		private void ProcessSearchBackward(SortedArgumentRefinedPointCollection points, int index, double nearestPointArgument, double argument, List<PointArgumentDistance> result, double markerWidth)
		{
			int num = index - 1;
			while (num >= 0 && AddEqualArgPoint(points[num], num, nearestPointArgument, argument, result, markerWidth))
			{
				num--;
			}
		}

		private void ProcessSearchForward(SortedArgumentRefinedPointCollection points, int index, double nearestPointArgument, double argument, List<PointArgumentDistance> result, double markerWidth)
		{
			for (int i = index + 1; i < points.Count && AddEqualArgPoint(points[i], i, nearestPointArgument, argument, result, markerWidth); i++)
			{
			}
		}

		private static int FindIndex(SortedArgumentRefinedPointCollection finalPoints, double argument)
		{
			bool pointIsFound;
			int num = finalPoints.GetIndexByArgument(argument, fromRight: false, out pointIsFound);
			if (!pointIsFound && num != 0)
			{
				if (num == finalPoints.Count)
				{
					num--;
				}
				else
				{
					double num2 = finalPoints[num].Argument - argument;
					double num3 = argument - finalPoints[num - 1].Argument;
					if (num3 <= num2)
					{
						num--;
					}
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		public static List<RefinedPoint> GetNearestPointsByArgument(SortedArgumentRefinedPointCollection finalPoints, double argument)
		{
			int num = FindIndex(finalPoints, argument);
			List<RefinedPoint> list = new List<RefinedPoint>();
			if (num > -1 && num < finalPoints.Count)
			{
				argument = finalPoints[num].Argument;
				for (int i = num; i < finalPoints.Count && finalPoints[i].Argument == argument; i++)
				{
					list.Add(finalPoints[i]);
				}
				int num2 = num - 1;
				while (num2 >= 0 && finalPoints[num2].Argument == argument)
				{
					list.Insert(0, finalPoints[num2]);
					num2--;
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected double CalcSquaredDistance(PointArgumentDistance argumentDistance, double value, double xRange, double yRange)
		{
			double num = (argumentDistance.Point.Value1 - value) / yRange;
			double num2 = argumentDistance.ArgumentDistance / xRange;
			return num * num + num2 * num2;
		}

		protected virtual double CalculateDistance(PointArgumentDistance argumentDistance, double value, double xRange, double yRange)
		{
			return CalcSquaredDistance(argumentDistance, value, xRange, yRange);
		}

		protected virtual bool AddEqualArgPoint(RefinedPoint point, int indexInCollection, double nearestPointArgument, double argument, List<PointArgumentDistance> result, double markerWidth)
		{
			double num = Math.Abs(point.Argument - nearestPointArgument);
			if (num < markerWidth)
			{
				result.Add(new PointArgumentDistance(point, num, indexInCollection));
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected virtual bool IsValueInPointRange(double value, RefinedPoint point, double xRange, double yRange)
		{
			if (point.ValuesDimension > 1 && point.Value1 < value)
			{
				return value < point.Value2;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public List<PointArgumentDistance> FindNearestPointsByArgument(MinMaxValues axisXRange)
		{
			SortedArgumentRefinedPointCollection finalPointsSortedByArgument = RefinedSeries.FinalPointsSortedByArgument;
			double num = axisXRange.CalculateCenter();
			int num2 = FindIndex(finalPointsSortedByArgument, num);
			List<PointArgumentDistance> list = new List<PointArgumentDistance>();
			if (num2 > -1 && num2 < finalPointsSortedByArgument.Count)
			{
				RefinedPoint refinedPoint = finalPointsSortedByArgument[num2];
				list.Add(new PointArgumentDistance(refinedPoint, Math.Abs(refinedPoint.Argument - num), num2));
				double markerWidth = ((axisXRange.IsEmpty || axisXRange.Delta == 0.0) ? double.Epsilon : axisXRange.Delta);
				ProcessSearchBackward(finalPointsSortedByArgument, num2, refinedPoint.Argument, num, list, markerWidth);
				ProcessSearchForward(finalPointsSortedByArgument, num2, refinedPoint.Argument, num, list, markerWidth);
			}
			return list;
		}

		public RefinedPoint FindNearestPoint(MinMaxValues? internalAxisXDiapason, double internalAxisYValue, double xRange, double yRange)
		{
			List<PointArgumentDistance> list = FindNearestPointsByArgument(internalAxisXDiapason.Value);
			if (list.Count < 1)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (list.Count == 1)
			{
				return list[0].Point;
			}
			int index = 0;
			double num = double.MaxValue;
			for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
			{
				if (IsValueInPointRange(internalAxisYValue, list[i].Point, xRange, yRange))
				{
					return list[i].Point;
				}
				double num2 = CalculateDistance(list[i], internalAxisYValue, xRange, yRange);
				if (ComparingUtils.CompareDoubles(num2, num, 1E-323) == -1)
				{
					index = i;
					num = num2;
				}
				if (num == 0.0)
				{
					break;
				}
			}
			return list[index].Point;
		}
	}
	public class XYWRefinedPointFinder : RefinedPointFinder
	{
		protected new IXYWSeriesView SeriesView => base.SeriesView as IXYWSeriesView;

		public XYWRefinedPointFinder(RefinedSeries refinedSeries)
			: base(refinedSeries)
		{
		}

		protected override bool AddEqualArgPoint(RefinedPoint point, int indexInCollection, double nearestPointArgument, double argument, List<PointArgumentDistance> result, double markerWidth)
		{
			double num = Math.Abs(point.Argument - argument);
			double markerSizeInAxisUnits = SeriesView.GetMarkerSizeInAxisUnits(point);
			if (num < markerSizeInAxisUnits)
			{
				if (indexInCollection < result[0].ZIndex)
				{
					result.Add(new PointArgumentDistance(point, num, indexInCollection));
				}
				else
				{
					result.Insert(0, new PointArgumentDistance(point, num, indexInCollection));
				}
				return true;
			}
			return num < markerWidth;
		}

		protected override bool IsValueInPointRange(double value, RefinedPoint point, double xRange, double yRange)
		{
			return false;
		}

		protected override double CalculateDistance(PointArgumentDistance argumentDistance, double value, double xRange, double yRange)
		{
			GRealRect2D value2 = SeriesView.Pane.MappingBounds.Value;
			double num = value2.Width / xRange;
			double num2 = value2.Height / yRange;
			double num3 = SeriesView.GetMarkerSizeInAxisUnits(argumentDistance.Point) / 2.0;
			double num4 = argumentDistance.ArgumentDistance * num;
			double num5 = (argumentDistance.Point.Value1 - value) * num2;
			if (num4 * num4 + num5 * num5 <= num3 * num * num3 * num)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			return 2147483647.0;
		}
	}
	public abstract class SeriesPointArgumentContainerBase : ISeriesPointArgument
	{
		private readonly ISeriesPoint seriesPoint;

		private string argument = string.Empty;

		private double? numericalArgument;

		private DateTime? dateTimeArgument;

		private TimeSpan? timeSpanArgument;

		private Scale argumentScaleType = Scale.Auto;

		protected ISeriesBase Series
		{
			get
			{
				if (seriesPoint == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return seriesPoint.Owner;
			}
		}

		protected abstract Scale SeriesArgumentScaleType { get; }

		protected object UserArgumentInternal
		{
			get
			{
				if (Series != null)
				{
					switch (SeriesArgumentScaleType)
					{
					case Scale.Numerical:
						return NumericalArgument;
					case Scale.DateTime:
						return DateTimeArgument;
					case Scale.TimeSpan:
						return TimeSpanArgument;
					}
				}
				return ActualArgument;
			}
		}

		public string Argument
		{
			get
			{
				return argument;
			}
			set
			{
				SetQualitativeArgument(value);
			}
		}

		public double NumericalArgument
		{
			get
			{
				if (!numericalArgument.HasValue)
				{
					return 0.0;
				}
				return numericalArgument.Value;
			}
			set
			{
				SetNumericalArgument(value);
			}
		}

		public DateTime DateTimeArgument
		{
			get
			{
				if (!dateTimeArgument.HasValue)
				{
					return DateTime.Today;
				}
				return dateTimeArgument.Value;
			}
			set
			{
				SetDateTimeArgument(value);
			}
		}

		public TimeSpan TimeSpanArgument
		{
			get
			{
				if (!timeSpanArgument.HasValue)
				{
					return TimeSpan.Zero;
				}
				return timeSpanArgument.Value;
			}
			set
			{
				SetTimeSpanArgument(value);
			}
		}

		public string ActualArgument
		{
			get
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(argument))
				{
					return argument;
				}
				if (Series == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (SeriesArgumentScaleType == Scale.DateTime)
				{
					return DateTime.Today.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				}
				if (SeriesArgumentScaleType == Scale.TimeSpan)
				{
					return TimeSpan.Zero.ToString();
				}
				return "0";
			}
		}

		public Scale ArgumentScaleType => argumentScaleType;

		Scale ISeriesPointArgument.ArgumentScaleType => argumentScaleType;

		object ISeriesPointArgument.UserArgument => UserArgumentInternal;

		string ISeriesPointArgument.QualitativeArgument => ActualArgument;

		double ISeriesPointArgument.NumericalArgument => NumericalArgument;

		DateTime ISeriesPointArgument.DateTimeArgument => DateTimeArgument;

		TimeSpan ISeriesPointArgument.TimeSpanArgument => TimeSpanArgument;

		public SeriesPointArgumentContainerBase(ISeriesPoint seriesPoint)
		{
			this.seriesPoint = seriesPoint;
		}

		public SeriesPointArgumentContainerBase(ISeriesPoint seriesPoint, double argument)
			: this(seriesPoint)
		{
			if (!double.IsInfinity(argument))
			{
				SetNumericalArgument(argument);
			}
		}

		public SeriesPointArgumentContainerBase(ISeriesPoint seriesPoint, DateTime argument)
			: this(seriesPoint)
		{
			SetDateTimeArgument(argument);
		}

		public SeriesPointArgumentContainerBase(ISeriesPoint seriesPoint, TimeSpan argument)
			: this(seriesPoint)
		{
			SetTimeSpanArgument(argument);
		}

		public SeriesPointArgumentContainerBase(ISeriesPoint seriesPoint, string argument)
			: this(seriesPoint)
		{
			SetQualitativeArgument(argument);
		}

		public SeriesPointArgumentContainerBase(ISeriesPoint seriesPoint, object argument)
			: this(seriesPoint)
		{
			SetArgument(argument);
		}

		private void ClearArguments()
		{
			argument = string.Empty;
			numericalArgument = null;
			dateTimeArgument = null;
			timeSpanArgument = null;
			argumentScaleType = Scale.Auto;
		}

		private void SetArgument(object argument)
		{
			if (argument != null)
			{
				Type type = argument.GetType();
				if (type == typeof(DateTime))
				{
					SetDateTimeArgument((DateTime)argument);
				}
				else if (type == typeof(TimeSpan))
				{
					SetTimeSpanArgument((TimeSpan)argument);
				}
				else if (PredefinedTypesHelper.IsNumericalType(type))
				{
					SetNumericalArgument(Convert.ToDouble(argument));
				}
				else
				{
					SetQualitativeArgument(argument.ToString());
				}
			}
		}

		private void SetNumericalArgument(double value)
		{
			numericalArgument = value;
			argument = value.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
			dateTimeArgument = null;
			timeSpanArgument = null;
			argumentScaleType = Scale.Numerical;
		}

		private void SetDateTimeArgument(DateTime value)
		{
			dateTimeArgument = value;
			argument = value.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
			numericalArgument = null;
			timeSpanArgument = null;
			argumentScaleType = Scale.DateTime;
		}

		private void SetTimeSpanArgument(TimeSpan value)
		{
			timeSpanArgument = value;
			argument = value.ToString();
			numericalArgument = null;
			dateTimeArgument = null;
			argumentScaleType = Scale.TimeSpan;
		}

		private void SetQualitativeArgument(string argument)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(argument))
			{
				ClearArguments();
				return;
			}
			DateTime result2;
			TimeSpan result3;
			if (double.TryParse(argument, NumberStyles.Float | NumberStyles.AllowThousands, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out var result))
			{
				SetNumericalArgument(result);
			}
			else if (DateTime.TryParse(argument, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, DateTimeStyles.None, out result2))
			{
				SetDateTimeArgument(result2);
			}
			else if (TimeSpan.TryParse(argument, out result3))
			{
				SetTimeSpanArgument(result3);
			}
			else
			{
				argumentScaleType = Scale.Qualitative;
			}
			this.argument = argument;
		}
	}

			public QualitativeMultiTimeSpanSeriesPointDataContainer(string argument, TimeSpan[] values)
				: base(argument)
			{
				this.values = values;
			}

			public QualitativeMultiTimeSpanSeriesPointDataContainer(string argument, int dimension)
				: base(argument)
			{
				values = new TimeSpan[dimension];
			}

			public override SeriesPointDataContainer SetDimension(int dimension)
			{
				TimeSpan[] array = SeriesPointDataContainer.UpdateDimension(values, dimension);
				if (array.Length == 1)
				{
					return new QualitativeSingleTimeSpanSeriesPointDataContainer(base.Argument, array[0]);
				}
				values = array;
				return this;
			}

			public override SeriesPointDataContainer Clone()
			{
				TimeSpan[] array = new TimeSpan[values.Length];
				values.CopyTo(array, 0);
				return new QualitativeMultiTimeSpanSeriesPointDataContainer(base.Argument, array);
			}
		}

		private string argument;

		protected string Argument => argument;

		public override Scale ArgumentScaleType => Scale.Qualitative;

		public override Scale ValueScaleType => Scale.TimeSpan;

		public override string QualitativeArgument
		{
			get
			{
				return argument;
			}
			set
			{
				argument = value;
			}
		}

		public override bool IsEmpty => false;

		public override bool IsValidArgument => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(argument);

		public static QualitativeTimeSpanSeriesPointDataContainer CreateContainer(string argument, TimeSpan[] values)
		{
			if (values.Length == 1)
			{
				return new QualitativeSingleTimeSpanSeriesPointDataContainer(argument, values[0]);
			}
			return new QualitativeMultiTimeSpanSeriesPointDataContainer(argument, values);
		}

		public static QualitativeTimeSpanSeriesPointDataContainer CreateContainer(string argument, int dimension)
		{
			if (dimension == 1)
			{
				return new QualitativeSingleTimeSpanSeriesPointDataContainer(argument);
			}
			return new QualitativeMultiTimeSpanSeriesPointDataContainer(argument, dimension);
		}

		protected QualitativeTimeSpanSeriesPointDataContainer(string argument)
		{
			this.argument = argument;
		}

		public override SeriesPointDataContainer Create(List<IDataMemberContainer> containers, bool isEmpty)
		{
			if (isEmpty || containers.Count < Math.Min(5, Dimension + 1))
			{
				return QualitativeSeriesPointDataContainer.Create(containers, Dimension);
			}
			string value = ((IDataMemberContainer<string>)containers[0]).Value;
			TimeSpan[] values = SeriesPointDataContainer.GetValues(Dimension, containers, 1, BoxPlotConventions.MissingTimeSpanNativeValue);
			return CreateContainer(value, values);
		}
	}

	{

		private static bool IsEmptyValues(double[] values)
		{
			int num = Math.Min(5, values.Length);
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				if (double.IsNaN(values[i]))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static SeriesPointDataContainer InitializeArgument(SeriesPointDataContainer dataContainer, string argument, DateTime dateTimeArgument)
		{
			if (dataContainer.IsEmpty)
			{
				return new QualitativeDateTimeArgSeriesPointDataContainer(argument, dateTimeArgument, dataContainer.Dimension);
			}
			switch (dataContainer.ValueScaleType)
			{
			case Scale.Numerical:
				return QualitativeDateTimeArgNumericValueSeriesPointDataContainer.CreateContainer(argument, dateTimeArgument, dataContainer.Values);
			case Scale.DateTime:
				return QualitativeDateTimeArgDateTimeValueSeriesPointDataContainer.CreateContainer(argument, dateTimeArgument, dataContainer.DateTimeValues);
			case Scale.TimeSpan:
				return QualitativeDateTimeArgTimeSpanValueSeriesPointDataContainer.CreateContainer(argument, dateTimeArgument, dataContainer.TimeSpanValues);
			default:
				dataContainer.DateTimeArgument = dateTimeArgument;
				return dataContainer;
			}
		}

		private static SeriesPointDataContainer InitializeArgument(SeriesPointDataContainer dataContainer, string argument, double numericArgument)
		{
			if (dataContainer.IsEmpty)
			{
				return new QualitativeNumericArgSeriesPointDataContainer(argument, numericArgument, dataContainer.Dimension);
			}
			switch (dataContainer.ValueScaleType)
			{
			case Scale.Numerical:
				return QualitativeNumericArgNumericValueSeriesPointDataContainer.CreateContainer(argument, numericArgument, dataContainer.Values);
			case Scale.DateTime:
				return QualitativeNumericArgDateTimeValueSeriesPointDataContainer.CreateContainer(argument, numericArgument, dataContainer.DateTimeValues);
			case Scale.TimeSpan:
				return QualitativeNumericArgTimeSpanValueSeriesPointDataContainer.CreateContainer(argument, numericArgument, dataContainer.TimeSpanValues);
			default:
				dataContainer.NumericalArgument = numericArgument;
				return dataContainer;
			}
		}

		private static SeriesPointDataContainer InitializeArgument(SeriesPointDataContainer dataContainer, string argument, TimeSpan timeSpanArgument)
		{
			if (dataContainer.IsEmpty)
			{
				return new QualitativeTimeSpanArgSeriesPointDataContainer(argument, timeSpanArgument, dataContainer.Dimension);
			}
			switch (dataContainer.ValueScaleType)
			{
			case Scale.Numerical:
				return QualitativeTimeSpanArgNumericValueSeriesPointDataContainer.CreateContainer(argument, timeSpanArgument, dataContainer.Values);
			case Scale.DateTime:
				return QualitativeTimeSpanArgDateTimeValueSeriesPointDataContainer.CreateContainer(argument, timeSpanArgument, dataContainer.DateTimeValues);
			case Scale.TimeSpan:
				return QualitativeTimeSpanArgTimeSpanValueSeriesPointDataContainer.CreateContainer(argument, timeSpanArgument, dataContainer.TimeSpanValues);
			default:
				dataContainer.TimeSpanArgument = timeSpanArgument;
				return dataContainer;
			}
		}

		private static T[] UpdateDimension<T>(T[] values, T defaultValue, int dimension)
		{
			if (values.Length < dimension)
			{
				T[] array = new T[dimension];
				T val = defaultValue;
				for (int i = 0; i < dimension; i++)
				{
					if (i < values.Length)
					{
						val = values[i];
					}
					if (i < 5)
					{
						array[i] = val;
					}
					else
					{
						array[i] = defaultValue;
					}
				}
				return array;
			}
			return values;
		}

		private static bool TryParseDouble(string argument, bool useInvariant, out double result)
		{
			if (useInvariant)
			{
				return double.TryParse(argument, NumberStyles.Any, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out result);
			}
			NumberStyles style = NumberStyles.Float;
			return double.TryParse(argument, style, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture, out result);
		}

		private static bool TryParseDateTime(string argument, bool useInvariant, out DateTime result)
		{
			if (useInvariant)
			{
				return DateTime.TryParse(argument, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, DateTimeStyles.None, out result);
			}
			return DateTime.TryParse(argument, out result);
		}

		private static bool TryParseTimeSpan(string argument, bool useInvariant, out TimeSpan result)
		{
			if (useInvariant)
			{
				return TimeSpan.TryParse(argument, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out result);
			}
			return TimeSpan.TryParse(argument, out result);
		}

		private static bool IsWrongContainerDimension(int containerDimension, int valuesCount)
		{
			if (containerDimension != 1 || valuesCount <= 1)
			{
				if (containerDimension > 1)
				{
					return valuesCount == 1;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected static double[] UpdateDimension(double[] values, int dimension)
		{
			return UpdateDimension(values, double.NaN, dimension);
		}

		protected static DateTime[] UpdateDimension(DateTime[] values, int dimension)
		{
			return UpdateDimension(values, DefaultDateTime, dimension);
		}

		protected static TimeSpan[] UpdateDimension(TimeSpan[] values, int dimension)
		{
			return UpdateDimension(values, DefaultTimeSpan, dimension);
		}

		protected static T[] GetValues<T>(int dimension, List<IDataMemberContainer> containers, int valuesOffset, T boxPlotMissingValue)
		{
			int num = containers.Count - valuesOffset;
			int num2 = Math.Max(dimension, num);
			if (num > 6)
			{
				num2 += ((IOutliersDataMemberContainer<T>)containers[num + valuesOffset - 1]).Values.Count - 1;
			}
			T[] array = new T[num2];
			int num3 = Math.Min(array.Length, 5);
			int i;
			for (i = 0; i < num3; i++)
			{
				array[i] = ((IDataMemberContainer<T>)containers[i + valuesOffset]).Value;
			}
			if (i < array.Length)
			{
				if (i + valuesOffset < containers.Count && containers[i + valuesOffset] != null)
				{
					array[i] = ((IDataMemberContainer<T>)containers[i + valuesOffset]).Value;
				}
				else
				{
					array[i] = boxPlotMissingValue;
				}
				i++;
				if (i < array.Length)
				{
					IOutliersDataMemberContainer<T> outliersDataMemberContainer = (IOutliersDataMemberContainer<T>)containers[num + valuesOffset - 1];
					for (int j = 0; j < outliersDataMemberContainer.Values.Count; j++)
					{
						array[i + j] = outliersDataMemberContainer.Values[j];
					}
				}
			}
			return array;
		}

		public static SeriesPointDataContainer InitializeArgument(SeriesPointDataContainer dataContainer, object argument, Scale seriesScaleType, bool parse)
		{
			Type type = argument.GetType();
			if (type == typeof(DateTime))
			{
				return InitializeArgument(dataContainer, (DateTime)argument);
			}
			if (type == typeof(TimeSpan))
			{
				return InitializeArgument(dataContainer, (TimeSpan)argument);
			}
			if (PredefinedTypesHelper.IsNumericalType(type))
			{
				return InitializeArgument(dataContainer, Convert.ToDouble(argument));
			}
			string text = argument.ToString();
			if (parse)
			{
				return InitializeArgument(dataContainer, text, seriesScaleType);
			}
			if (dataContainer.ArgumentScaleType != Scale.Qualitative)
			{
				switch (dataContainer.ValueScaleType)
				{
				case Scale.Numerical:
					return QualitativeNumericSeriesPointDataContainer.CreateContainer(text, dataContainer.Values);
				case Scale.DateTime:
					return QualitativeDateTimeSeriesPointDataContainer.CreateContainer(text, dataContainer.DateTimeValues);
				case Scale.TimeSpan:
					return QualitativeTimeSpanSeriesPointDataContainer.CreateContainer(text, dataContainer.TimeSpanValues);
				}
			}
			dataContainer.QualitativeArgument = text;
			return dataContainer;
		}

		public static SeriesPointDataContainer InitializeArgument(SeriesPointDataContainer dataContainer, string argument, Scale seriesScaleType)
		{
			bool flag = seriesScaleType == Scale.Auto;
			if ((flag || seriesScaleType == Scale.Numerical) && double.TryParse(argument, out var result))
			{
				if (!flag)
				{
					return InitializeArgument(dataContainer, result);
				}
				return InitializeArgument(dataContainer, argument, result);
			}
			if ((flag || seriesScaleType == Scale.DateTime) && DateTime.TryParse(argument, out var result2))
			{
				if (!flag)
				{
					return InitializeArgument(dataContainer, result2);
				}
				return InitializeArgument(dataContainer, argument, result2);
			}
			if ((flag || seriesScaleType == Scale.TimeSpan) && TimeSpan.TryParse(argument, out var result3))
			{
				if (!flag)
				{
					return InitializeArgument(dataContainer, result3);
				}
				return InitializeArgument(dataContainer, argument, result3);
			}
			if (dataContainer.ArgumentScaleType != Scale.Qualitative)
			{
				if (dataContainer.IsEmpty)
				{
					return new QualitativeSeriesPointDataContainer(argument, dataContainer.Dimension);
				}
				switch (dataContainer.ValueScaleType)
				{
				case Scale.Numerical:
					return QualitativeNumericSeriesPointDataContainer.CreateContainer(argument, dataContainer.Values);
				case Scale.DateTime:
					return QualitativeDateTimeSeriesPointDataContainer.CreateContainer(argument, dataContainer.DateTimeValues);
				case Scale.TimeSpan:
					return QualitativeTimeSpanSeriesPointDataContainer.CreateContainer(argument, dataContainer.TimeSpanValues);
				}
			}
			dataContainer.QualitativeArgument = argument;
			return dataContainer;
		}

		public static SeriesPointDataContainer InitializeArgument(SeriesPointDataContainer dataContainer, DateTime argument)
		{
			if (dataContainer.RecreateIfScaleTypeSet || dataContainer.ArgumentScaleType != Scale.DateTime)
			{
				if (dataContainer.IsEmpty)
				{
					return new DateTimeSeriesPointDataContainer(argument, dataContainer.Dimension);
				}
				switch (dataContainer.ValueScaleType)
				{
				case Scale.Numerical:
					return DateTimeNumericSeriesPointDataContainer.CreateContainer(argument, dataContainer.Values);
				case Scale.DateTime:
					return DateTimeDateTimeSeriesPointDataContainer.CreateContainer(argument, dataContainer.DateTimeValues);
				case Scale.TimeSpan:
					return DateTimeTimeSpanSeriesPointDataContainer.CreateContainer(argument, dataContainer.TimeSpanValues);
				}
			}
			dataContainer.DateTimeArgument = argument;
			return dataContainer;
		}

		public static SeriesPointDataContainer InitializeArgument(SeriesPointDataContainer dataContainer, double argument)
		{
			if (dataContainer.RecreateIfScaleTypeSet || dataContainer.ArgumentScaleType != Scale.Numerical)
			{
				if (dataContainer.IsEmpty)
				{
					return new NumericSeriesPointDataContainer(argument, dataContainer.Dimension);
				}
				switch (dataContainer.ValueScaleType)
				{
				case Scale.Numerical:
					return NumericNumericSeriesPointDataContainer.CreateContainer(argument, dataContainer.Values);
				case Scale.DateTime:
					return NumericDateTimeSeriesPointDataContainer.CreateContainer(argument, dataContainer.DateTimeValues);
				case Scale.TimeSpan:
					return NumericTimeSpanSeriesPointDataContainer.CreateContainer(argument, dataContainer.TimeSpanValues);
				}
			}
			dataContainer.NumericalArgument = argument;
			return dataContainer;
		}

		public static SeriesPointDataContainer InitializeArgument(SeriesPointDataContainer dataContainer, TimeSpan argument)
		{
			if (dataContainer.RecreateIfScaleTypeSet || dataContainer.ArgumentScaleType != Scale.TimeSpan)
			{
				if (dataContainer.IsEmpty)
				{
					return new TimeSpanSeriesPointDataContainer(argument, dataContainer.Dimension);
				}
				switch (dataContainer.ValueScaleType)
				{
				case Scale.Numerical:
					return TimeSpanNumericSeriesPointDataContainer.CreateContainer(argument, dataContainer.Values);
				case Scale.DateTime:
					return TimeSpanDateTimeSeriesPointDataContainer.CreateContainer(argument, dataContainer.DateTimeValues);
				case Scale.TimeSpan:
					return TimeSpanTimeSpanSeriesPointDataContainer.CreateContainer(argument, dataContainer.TimeSpanValues);
				}
			}
			dataContainer.TimeSpanArgument = argument;
			return dataContainer;
		}

		public static SeriesPointDataContainer InitializeValues(SeriesPointDataContainer dataContainer, double[] values, bool shouldBeNonEmpty = false)
		{
			if (dataContainer.ArgumentScaleType == Scale.Auto)
			{
				return NumericNumericSeriesPointDataContainer.CreateContainer(double.NaN, values);
			}
			if (!shouldBeNonEmpty && IsEmptyValues(values))
			{
				switch (dataContainer.ArgumentScaleType)
				{
				case Scale.Numerical:
					if (dataContainer.ArgumentIsParsed)
					{
						return new QualitativeNumericArgSeriesPointDataContainer(dataContainer.QualitativeArgument, dataContainer.NumericalArgument, values.Length);
					}
					return new NumericSeriesPointDataContainer(dataContainer.NumericalArgument, values.Length);
				case Scale.DateTime:
					if (dataContainer.ArgumentIsParsed)
					{
						return new QualitativeDateTimeArgSeriesPointDataContainer(dataContainer.QualitativeArgument, dataContainer.DateTimeArgument, values.Length);
					}
					return new DateTimeSeriesPointDataContainer(dataContainer.DateTimeArgument, values.Length);
				case Scale.Qualitative:
					return new QualitativeSeriesPointDataContainer(dataContainer.QualitativeArgument, values.Length);
				case Scale.TimeSpan:
					if (dataContainer.ArgumentIsParsed)
					{
						return new QualitativeTimeSpanArgSeriesPointDataContainer(dataContainer.QualitativeArgument, dataContainer.TimeSpanArgument, values.Length);
					}
					return new TimeSpanSeriesPointDataContainer(dataContainer.TimeSpanArgument, values.Length);
				}
			}
			if (dataContainer.ValueScaleType != Scale.Numerical || IsWrongContainerDimension(dataContainer.Dimension, values.Length) || dataContainer.IsEmpty)
			{
				switch (dataContainer.ArgumentScaleType)
				{
				case Scale.Numerical:
					if (dataContainer.ArgumentIsParsed)
					{
						return QualitativeNumericArgNumericValueSeriesPointDataContainer.CreateContainer(dataContainer.QualitativeArgument, dataContainer.NumericalArgument, values);
					}
					return NumericNumericSeriesPointDataContainer.CreateContainer(dataContainer.NumericalArgument, values);
				case Scale.DateTime:
					if (dataContainer.ArgumentIsParsed)
					{
						return QualitativeDateTimeArgNumericValueSeriesPointDataContainer.CreateContainer(dataContainer.QualitativeArgument, dataContainer.DateTimeArgument, values);
					}
					return DateTimeNumericSeriesPointDataContainer.CreateContainer(dataContainer.DateTimeArgument, values);
				case Scale.Qualitative:
					return QualitativeNumericSeriesPointDataContainer.CreateContainer(dataContainer.QualitativeArgument, values);
				case Scale.TimeSpan:
					if (dataContainer.ArgumentIsParsed)
					{
						return QualitativeTimeSpanArgNumericValueSeriesPointDataContainer.CreateContainer(dataContainer.QualitativeArgument, dataContainer.TimeSpanArgument, values);
					}
					return TimeSpanNumericSeriesPointDataContainer.CreateContainer(dataContainer.TimeSpanArgument, values);
				}
			}
			dataContainer.Values = values;
			return dataContainer;
		}

		public static SeriesPointDataContainer InitializeValues(SeriesPointDataContainer dataContainer, DateTime[] values)
		{
			if (dataContainer.ArgumentScaleType == Scale.Auto)
			{
				return NumericDateTimeSeriesPointDataContainer.CreateContainer(double.NaN, values);
			}
			if (dataContainer.ValueScaleType != Scale.DateTime || IsWrongContainerDimension(dataContainer.Dimension, values.Length) || dataContainer.IsEmpty)
			{
				switch (dataContainer.ArgumentScaleType)
				{
				case Scale.Numerical:
					if (dataContainer.ArgumentIsParsed)
					{
						return QualitativeNumericArgDateTimeValueSeriesPointDataContainer.CreateContainer(dataContainer.QualitativeArgument, dataContainer.NumericalArgument, values);
					}
					return NumericDateTimeSeriesPointDataContainer.CreateContainer(dataContainer.NumericalArgument, values);
				case Scale.DateTime:
					if (dataContainer.ArgumentIsParsed)
					{
						return QualitativeDateTimeArgDateTimeValueSeriesPointDataContainer.CreateContainer(dataContainer.QualitativeArgument, dataContainer.DateTimeArgument, values);
					}
					return DateTimeDateTimeSeriesPointDataContainer.CreateContainer(dataContainer.DateTimeArgument, values);
				case Scale.Qualitative:
					return QualitativeDateTimeSeriesPointDataContainer.CreateContainer(dataContainer.QualitativeArgument, values);
				case Scale.TimeSpan:
					if (dataContainer.ArgumentIsParsed)
					{
						return QualitativeTimeSpanArgDateTimeValueSeriesPointDataContainer.CreateContainer(dataContainer.QualitativeArgument, dataContainer.TimeSpanArgument, values);
					}
					return TimeSpanDateTimeSeriesPointDataContainer.CreateContainer(dataContainer.TimeSpanArgument, values);
				}
			}
			dataContainer.DateTimeValues = values;
			return dataContainer;
		}

		public static SeriesPointDataContainer InitializeValues(SeriesPointDataContainer dataContainer, TimeSpan[] values)
		{
			if (dataContainer.ArgumentScaleType == Scale.Auto)
			{
				return NumericTimeSpanSeriesPointDataContainer.CreateContainer(double.NaN, values);
			}
			if (dataContainer.ValueScaleType != Scale.TimeSpan || IsWrongContainerDimension(dataContainer.Dimension, values.Length) || dataContainer.IsEmpty)
			{
				switch (dataContainer.ArgumentScaleType)
				{
				case Scale.Numerical:
					if (dataContainer.ArgumentIsParsed)
					{
						return QualitativeNumericArgTimeSpanValueSeriesPointDataContainer.CreateContainer(dataContainer.QualitativeArgument, dataContainer.NumericalArgument, values);
					}
					return NumericTimeSpanSeriesPointDataContainer.CreateContainer(dataContainer.NumericalArgument, values);
				case Scale.DateTime:
					if (dataContainer.ArgumentIsParsed)
					{
						return QualitativeDateTimeArgTimeSpanValueSeriesPointDataContainer.CreateContainer(dataContainer.QualitativeArgument, dataContainer.DateTimeArgument, values);
					}
					return DateTimeTimeSpanSeriesPointDataContainer.CreateContainer(dataContainer.DateTimeArgument, values);
				case Scale.Qualitative:
					return QualitativeTimeSpanSeriesPointDataContainer.CreateContainer(dataContainer.QualitativeArgument, values);
				case Scale.TimeSpan:
					if (dataContainer.ArgumentIsParsed)
					{
						return QualitativeTimeSpanArgTimeSpanValueSeriesPointDataContainer.CreateContainer(dataContainer.QualitativeArgument, dataContainer.TimeSpanArgument, values);
					}
					return TimeSpanTimeSpanSeriesPointDataContainer.CreateContainer(dataContainer.TimeSpanArgument, values);
				}
			}
			dataContainer.TimeSpanValues = values;
			return dataContainer;
		}

		public static SeriesPointDataContainer InitializeValues(SeriesPointDataContainer dataContainer, Scale valueScaleType)
		{
			if (dataContainer.ValueScaleType != valueScaleType)
			{
				switch (dataContainer.ArgumentScaleType)
				{
				case Scale.Qualitative:
					return valueScaleType switch
					{
						Scale.DateTime => QualitativeDateTimeSeriesPointDataContainer.CreateContainer(dataContainer.QualitativeArgument, dataContainer.Dimension), 
						Scale.TimeSpan => QualitativeTimeSpanSeriesPointDataContainer.CreateContainer(dataContainer.QualitativeArgument, dataContainer.Dimension), 
						_ => QualitativeNumericSeriesPointDataContainer.CreateContainer(dataContainer.QualitativeArgument, dataContainer.Dimension), 
					};
				case Scale.DateTime:
					switch (valueScaleType)
					{
					case Scale.DateTime:
						if (dataContainer.ArgumentIsParsed)
						{
							return QualitativeDateTimeArgDateTimeValueSeriesPointDataContainer.CreateContainer(dataContainer.QualitativeArgument, dataContainer.DateTimeArgument, dataContainer.Dimension);
						}
						return DateTimeDateTimeSeriesPointDataContainer.CreateContainer(dataContainer.DateTimeArgument, dataContainer.Dimension);
					case Scale.TimeSpan:
						if (dataContainer.ArgumentIsParsed)
						{
							return QualitativeDateTimeArgTimeSpanValueSeriesPointDataContainer.CreateContainer(dataContainer.QualitativeArgument, dataContainer.DateTimeArgument, dataContainer.Dimension);
						}
						return DateTimeTimeSpanSeriesPointDataContainer.CreateContainer(dataContainer.DateTimeArgument, dataContainer.Dimension);
					default:
						if (dataContainer.ArgumentIsParsed)
						{
							return QualitativeDateTimeArgNumericValueSeriesPointDataContainer.CreateContainer(dataContainer.QualitativeArgument, dataContainer.DateTimeArgument, dataContainer.Dimension);
						}
						return DateTimeNumericSeriesPointDataContainer.CreateContainer(dataContainer.DateTimeArgument, dataContainer.Dimension);
					}
				case Scale.TimeSpan:
					switch (valueScaleType)
					{
					case Scale.DateTime:
						if (dataContainer.ArgumentIsParsed)
						{
							return QualitativeTimeSpanArgDateTimeValueSeriesPointDataContainer.CreateContainer(dataContainer.QualitativeArgument, dataContainer.TimeSpanArgument, dataContainer.Dimension);
						}
						return TimeSpanDateTimeSeriesPointDataContainer.CreateContainer(dataContainer.TimeSpanArgument, dataContainer.Dimension);
					case Scale.TimeSpan:
						if (dataContainer.ArgumentIsParsed)
						{
							return QualitativeTimeSpanArgTimeSpanValueSeriesPointDataContainer.CreateContainer(dataContainer.QualitativeArgument, dataContainer.TimeSpanArgument, dataContainer.Dimension);
						}
						return TimeSpanTimeSpanSeriesPointDataContainer.CreateContainer(dataContainer.TimeSpanArgument, dataContainer.Dimension);
					default:
						if (dataContainer.ArgumentIsParsed)
						{
							return QualitativeTimeSpanArgNumericValueSeriesPointDataContainer.CreateContainer(dataContainer.QualitativeArgument, dataContainer.TimeSpanArgument, dataContainer.Dimension);
						}
						return TimeSpanNumericSeriesPointDataContainer.CreateContainer(dataContainer.TimeSpanArgument, dataContainer.Dimension);
					}
				default:
					switch (valueScaleType)
					{
					case Scale.DateTime:
						if (dataContainer.ArgumentIsParsed)
						{
							return QualitativeNumericArgDateTimeValueSeriesPointDataContainer.CreateContainer(dataContainer.QualitativeArgument, dataContainer.NumericalArgument, dataContainer.Dimension);
						}
						return NumericDateTimeSeriesPointDataContainer.CreateContainer(dataContainer.NumericalArgument, dataContainer.Dimension);
					case Scale.TimeSpan:
						if (dataContainer.ArgumentIsParsed)
						{
							return QualitativeNumericArgTimeSpanValueSeriesPointDataContainer.CreateContainer(dataContainer.QualitativeArgument, dataContainer.NumericalArgument, dataContainer.Dimension);
						}
						return NumericTimeSpanSeriesPointDataContainer.CreateContainer(dataContainer.NumericalArgument, dataContainer.Dimension);
					default:
						if (dataContainer.ArgumentIsParsed)
						{
							return QualitativeNumericArgNumericValueSeriesPointDataContainer.CreateContainer(dataContainer.QualitativeArgument, dataContainer.NumericalArgument, dataContainer.Dimension);
						}
						return NumericNumericSeriesPointDataContainer.CreateContainer(dataContainer.NumericalArgument, dataContainer.Dimension);
					}
				}
			}
			return dataContainer;
		}

		public static SeriesPointDataContainer Create(Scale argumentScaleType, Scale valueScaleType, int dimension)
		{
			return argumentScaleType switch
			{
				Scale.Qualitative => valueScaleType switch
				{
					Scale.DateTime => QualitativeDateTimeSeriesPointDataContainer.CreateContainer(DefaultQualitative, dimension), 
					Scale.TimeSpan => QualitativeTimeSpanSeriesPointDataContainer.CreateContainer(DefaultQualitative, dimension), 
					_ => QualitativeNumericSeriesPointDataContainer.CreateContainer(DefaultQualitative, dimension), 
				}, 
				Scale.DateTime => valueScaleType switch
				{
					Scale.DateTime => DateTimeDateTimeSeriesPointDataContainer.CreateContainer(DefaultDateTime, dimension), 
					Scale.TimeSpan => DateTimeTimeSpanSeriesPointDataContainer.CreateContainer(DefaultDateTime, dimension), 
					_ => DateTimeNumericSeriesPointDataContainer.CreateContainer(DefaultDateTime, dimension), 
				}, 
				Scale.TimeSpan => valueScaleType switch
				{
					Scale.DateTime => TimeSpanDateTimeSeriesPointDataContainer.CreateContainer(DefaultTimeSpan, dimension), 
					Scale.TimeSpan => TimeSpanTimeSpanSeriesPointDataContainer.CreateContainer(DefaultTimeSpan, dimension), 
					_ => TimeSpanNumericSeriesPointDataContainer.CreateContainer(DefaultTimeSpan, dimension), 
				}, 
				_ => valueScaleType switch
				{
					Scale.DateTime => NumericDateTimeSeriesPointDataContainer.CreateContainer(double.NaN, dimension), 
					Scale.TimeSpan => NumericTimeSpanSeriesPointDataContainer.CreateContainer(double.NaN, dimension), 
					_ => NumericNumericSeriesPointDataContainer.CreateContainer(double.NaN, dimension), 
				}, 
			};
		}

		public static SeriesPointDataContainer CreateFromObject(object argument, bool parse, int dimension)
		{
			Type type = argument.GetType();
			if (type == typeof(DateTime))
			{
				return new DateTimeSeriesPointDataContainer((DateTime)argument, dimension);
			}
			if (PredefinedTypesHelper.IsNumericalType(type))
			{
				return new NumericSeriesPointDataContainer(Convert.ToDouble(argument), dimension);
			}
			if (type == typeof(TimeSpan))
			{
				return new TimeSpanSeriesPointDataContainer((TimeSpan)argument, dimension);
			}
			string argument2 = argument.ToString();
			if (parse)
			{
				return Create(argument2, dimension);
			}
			return new QualitativeSeriesPointDataContainer(argument.ToString(), dimension);
		}

		public static SeriesPointDataContainer CreateFromObject(object argument, ISeriesPointValues values, bool parse)
		{
			return values.ValueScaleType switch
			{
				Scale.Numerical => CreateFromObject(argument, values.NumericalValues, parse), 
				Scale.DateTime => CreateFromObject(argument, values.DateTimeValues, parse), 
				Scale.TimeSpan => CreateFromObject(argument, values.TimeSpanValues, parse), 
				_ => CreateFromObject(argument, parse, values.Dimension), 
			};
		}

		public static SeriesPointDataContainer CreateFromObject(object argument, double[] values, bool parse)
		{
			if (IsEmptyValues(values))
			{
				return CreateFromObject(argument, parse, values.Length);
			}
			Type type = argument.GetType();
			if (type == typeof(DateTime))
			{
				return DateTimeNumericSeriesPointDataContainer.CreateContainer((DateTime)argument, values);
			}
			if (PredefinedTypesHelper.IsNumericalType(type))
			{
				return NumericNumericSeriesPointDataContainer.CreateContainer(Convert.ToDouble(argument), values);
			}
			if (type == typeof(TimeSpan))
			{
				return TimeSpanNumericSeriesPointDataContainer.CreateContainer((TimeSpan)argument, values);
			}
			string argument2 = argument.ToString();
			if (parse)
			{
				return Create(argument2, values);
			}
			return QualitativeNumericSeriesPointDataContainer.CreateContainer(argument.ToString(), values);
		}

		{

			{

		public static SeriesPointDataContainer CreateFromObject(object argument, object[] values, bool parse, int dimension)
		{
			if (values != null && values.Length != 0)
			{
				Type type = values[0].GetType();
				if (type == typeof(DateTime))
				{
					DateTime[] values2 = Array.ConvertAll(values, (object item) => (DateTime)item);
					return CreateFromObject(argument, values2, parse);
				}
				if (type == typeof(TimeSpan))
				{
					TimeSpan[] values3 = Array.ConvertAll(values, (object item) => (TimeSpan)item);
					return CreateFromObject(argument, values3, parse);
				}
				double[] array = new double[values.Length];
				for (int num = 0; num < values.Length; num++)
				{
					double num2 = Convert.ToDouble(values[num]);
					if (!GeometricUtils.IsValidDouble(num2) && num < 5)
					{
						array = null;
						break;
					}
					array[num] = num2;
				}
				if (array != null)
				{
					return CreateFromObject(argument, array, parse);
				}
			}
			return CreateFromObject(argument, parse, dimension);
		}

		public static SeriesPointDataContainer Create(string argument, int dimension, bool useInvariant = false)
		{
			if (TryParseDouble(argument, useInvariant, out var result))
			{
				return new QualitativeNumericArgSeriesPointDataContainer(argument, result, dimension);
			}
			if (TryParseDateTime(argument, useInvariant, out var result2))
			{
				return new QualitativeDateTimeArgSeriesPointDataContainer(argument, result2, dimension);
			}
			if (TryParseTimeSpan(argument, useInvariant, out var result3))
			{
				return new QualitativeTimeSpanArgSeriesPointDataContainer(argument, result3, dimension);
			}
			return new QualitativeSeriesPointDataContainer(argument, dimension);
		}

		public static SeriesPointDataContainer Create(string argument, double[] values, bool useInvariant = false)
		{
			if (IsEmptyValues(values))
			{

			if (TryParseDouble(argument, useInvariant, out var result))
			{
				return QualitativeNumericArgNumericValueSeriesPointDataContainer.CreateContainer(argument, result, values);
			}
			if (TryParseDateTime(argument, useInvariant, out var result2))
			{
				return QualitativeDateTimeArgNumericValueSeriesPointDataContainer.CreateContainer(argument, result2, values);
			}
			if (TryParseTimeSpan(argument, useInvariant, out var result3))
			{
				return QualitativeTimeSpanArgNumericValueSeriesPointDataContainer.CreateContainer(argument, result3, values);
			}
			return QualitativeNumericSeriesPointDataContainer.CreateContainer(argument, values);
		}

	public class EmptySeriesPointDataContainer : SeriesPointDataContainer
	{
		private int dimension;

		public override Scale ArgumentScaleType => Scale.Auto;

		public override Scale ValueScaleType => Scale.Numerical;

		public override int Dimension => dimension;

		public override bool IsEmpty => true;

		public override bool IsValidArgument => false;

		public EmptySeriesPointDataContainer()
			: this(1)
		{
		}

		public EmptySeriesPointDataContainer(int dimension)
		{
			this.dimension = dimension;
		}

		public override SeriesPointDataContainer SetDimension(int dimension)
		{
			this.dimension = dimension;
			return this;
		}

		public override SeriesPointDataContainer Clone()
		{
			return new EmptySeriesPointDataContainer(dimension);
		}

		public override SeriesPointDataContainer Create(List<IDataMemberContainer> containers, bool isEmpty)
		{
			return null;
		}
	}
	public class SerializableSeriesPointDataContainer : SeriesPointDataContainer
	{
		public override bool IsEmpty
		{
			get
			{
				if (Values == null && DateTimeValues == null)
				{
					return TimeSpanValues == null;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public override bool IsValidArgument => true;

		public override int Dimension => 1;

		public override string QualitativeArgument { get; set; }

		public override double[] Values { get; set; }

		public override DateTime[] DateTimeValues { get; set; }

		public override TimeSpan[] TimeSpanValues { get; set; }

		public SerializableSeriesPointDataContainer(SeriesPointDataContainer dataContainer)
		{
			if (dataContainer == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (dataContainer.IsValidArgument)
			{
				QualitativeArgument = dataContainer.QualitativeArgument;
			}
			if (!dataContainer.IsEmpty)
			{
				if (dataContainer.ValueScaleType == Scale.Numerical)
				{
					Values = dataContainer.Values;
				}
				else if (dataContainer.ValueScaleType == Scale.DateTime)
				{
					DateTimeValues = dataContainer.DateTimeValues;
				}
				else if (dataContainer.ValueScaleType == Scale.TimeSpan)
				{
					TimeSpanValues = dataContainer.TimeSpanValues;
				}
			}
		}

		public override SeriesPointDataContainer SetDimension(int dimension)
		{
			return this;
		}

		public override SeriesPointDataContainer Clone()
		{
			return new SerializableSeriesPointDataContainer(this);
		}

		public override SeriesPointDataContainer Create(List<IDataMemberContainer> containers, bool isEmpty)
		{
			return null;
		}
	}
	public abstract class ViewportIntersectionHolder
	{
		private readonly List<GRealPoint2D> viewportIntersectionsLeft = new List<GRealPoint2D>();

		private readonly List<GRealPoint2D> viewportIntersectionsRight = new List<GRealPoint2D>();

		protected IXYSeriesView View { get; }

		protected IAxisRangeData RangeX => View.AxisXData.VisualRange;

		protected IAxisRangeData RangeY => View.AxisYData.VisualRange;

		protected Func<int, int, bool> ContinueCycle { get; private set; }

		protected int Step { get; private set; }

		protected int MinViewportIndex { get; set; }

		protected int MaxViewportIndex { get; set; }

		protected List<GRealPoint2D> ViewportIntersectionsLeft => viewportIntersectionsLeft;

		protected List<GRealPoint2D> ViewportIntersectionsRight => viewportIntersectionsRight;

		public ViewportIntersectionHolder(IXYSeriesView view)
		{
			View = view;
		}

		private bool IsIntersectionInViewport(List<GRealPoint2D> pointsOfIntersection, IAxisRangeData range, double intersectionCoord, double rangeCoord, bool isXIntersection)
		{
			bool flag = intersectionCoord <= range.Max && range.Min <= intersectionCoord;
			if (flag)
			{
				pointsOfIntersection.Add(isXIntersection ? new GRealPoint2D(intersectionCoord, rangeCoord) : new GRealPoint2D(rangeCoord, intersectionCoord));
			}
			return flag;
		}

		private double CalculateIntersection(double x, double y, double x1, double y1, double limit, bool isYIntersection)
		{
			if (!isYIntersection)
			{
				return CalculateIntersection(y, x, y1, x1, limit);
			}
			return CalculateIntersection(x, y, x1, y1, limit);
		}

		private double CalculateIntersection(double coord11, double coord12, double coord21, double coord22, double coord)
		{
			if (coord11 == coord21)
			{
				return double.NaN;
			}
			double num = (coord22 - coord12) * (coord - coord11) / (coord21 - coord11) + coord12;
			if ((!(num - coord22 >= 0.0) || !(coord12 - num >= 0.0)) && (!(num - coord22 < 0.0) || !(coord12 - num < 0.0)))
			{
				return double.NaN;
			}
			return num;
		}

		protected bool CollectViewportIntersectionByCoordinates(List<GRealPoint2D> pointsOfIntersection, double x, double y, double x1, double y1)
		{
			return CollectViewportIntersectionByCoordinates(pointsOfIntersection, x, y, x1, y1, (double limit, bool isYIntersection) => CalculateIntersection(x, y, x1, y1, limit, isYIntersection));
		}

		protected bool CollectViewportIntersectionByCoordinates(List<GRealPoint2D> pointsOfIntersection, double x, double y, double x1, double y1, Func<double, bool, double> calculateIntersection)
		{
			IAxisRangeData rangeX = RangeX;
			IAxisRangeData rangeY = RangeY;
			if (x < rangeX.Min && rangeX.Min <= x1 && IsIntersectionInViewport(pointsOfIntersection, rangeY, calculateIntersection(rangeX.Min, arg2: true), rangeX.Min, isXIntersection: false))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (rangeX.Max < x && x1 <= rangeX.Max && IsIntersectionInViewport(pointsOfIntersection, rangeY, calculateIntersection(rangeX.Max, arg2: true), rangeX.Max, isXIntersection: false))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (y < rangeY.Min && rangeY.Min <= y1 && IsIntersectionInViewport(pointsOfIntersection, rangeX, calculateIntersection(rangeY.Min, arg2: false), rangeY.Min, isXIntersection: true))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (rangeY.Max < y && y1 <= rangeY.Max && IsIntersectionInViewport(pointsOfIntersection, rangeX, calculateIntersection(rangeY.Max, arg2: false), rangeY.Max, isXIntersection: true))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected virtual int CollectViewportIntersection(List<GRealPoint2D> pointsOfIntersection, IList<RefinedPoint> points, int firstIndex, int lastIndex, bool isLeftIntersection, Action<int> setIndex)
		{
			for (int i = firstIndex; ContinueCycle(i, lastIndex); i += Step)
			{
				RefinedPoint refinedPoint = points[i];
				double pointValue = GetPointValue(refinedPoint);
				double argument = refinedPoint.Argument;
				if (RangeX.Contains(argument) && IsValueInRange(refinedPoint, pointValue))
				{
					AddPoints(refinedPoint, pointsOfIntersection, pointValue, argument);
					setIndex(i);
					return i;
				}
				if (CollectViewportIntersectionCore(pointsOfIntersection, points, isLeftIntersection, i, pointValue, argument))
				{
					setIndex(i);
					return i;
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}

		protected virtual double GetPointValue(RefinedPoint point)
		{
			return View.GetRefinedPointMax(point);
		}

		protected virtual void AddPoints(RefinedPoint point, List<GRealPoint2D> pointsOfIntersection, double y, double x)
		{
			pointsOfIntersection.Add(new GRealPoint2D(x, y));
		}

		protected virtual bool CollectViewportIntersectionCore(List<GRealPoint2D> pointsOfIntersection, IList<RefinedPoint> points, bool isLeftIntersection, int i, double y, double x)
		{
			return CollectViewportIntersectionByCoordinates(pointsOfIntersection, x, y, points[i + Step].Argument, GetPointValue(points[i + Step]));
		}

		protected virtual bool IsArgumentInRange(MinMaxValues pointRangeX)
		{
			return RangeX.Contains(pointRangeX.Min);
		}

		protected virtual bool IsValueInRange(RefinedPoint point, double y)
		{
			return RangeY.Contains(y);
		}

		protected virtual Func<int, int, bool> CreateContinueCycle(bool isLeftIntersection)
		{
			if (isLeftIntersection)
			{
				return (int index, int edgeIndex) => index < edgeIndex;
			}
			return (int index, int edgeIndex) => edgeIndex < index;
		}

		public int CalculateEdgePointIndexInViewport(IList<RefinedPoint> points, int minVisiblePointIndex, int maxVisiblePointIndex, bool isLeftIntersection)
		{
			ContinueCycle = CreateContinueCycle(isLeftIntersection);
			if (isLeftIntersection)
			{
				viewportIntersectionsLeft.Clear();
				Step = 1;
				return CollectViewportIntersection(viewportIntersectionsLeft, points, minVisiblePointIndex, maxVisiblePointIndex, isLeftIntersection, delegate(int index)
				{
					MinViewportIndex = index;
				});
			}
			viewportIntersectionsRight.Clear();
			Step = -1;
			return CollectViewportIntersection(viewportIntersectionsRight, points, maxVisiblePointIndex, minVisiblePointIndex, isLeftIntersection, delegate(int index)
			{
				MaxViewportIndex = index;
			});
		}

		public GRealPoint2D GetEdgePoint(double pointArgument, double pointValue, bool isValue1)
		{
			List<GRealPoint2D> list = null;
			if (viewportIntersectionsLeft.Count > 0 && pointArgument <= viewportIntersectionsLeft[0].X)
			{
				list = viewportIntersectionsLeft;
			}
			else if (viewportIntersectionsRight.Count > 0 && viewportIntersectionsRight[0].X <= pointArgument)
			{
				list = viewportIntersectionsRight;
			}
			if (list == null)
			{
				return new GRealPoint2D(pointArgument, pointValue);
			}
			if (!isValue1)
			{
				return list[1];
			}
			return list[0];
		}

		public GRealPoint2D GetEdgePointOnDiagram(double pointArgument, double pointValue, bool isValue1)
		{
			IList<AxisInterval> intervals = ((IIntervalContainer)View.AxisXData).Intervals;
			List<GRealPoint2D> list;
			double x;
			if (viewportIntersectionsLeft.Count > 0 && pointArgument <= viewportIntersectionsLeft[0].X)
			{
				list = viewportIntersectionsLeft;
				x = intervals[0].Range.Min;
			}
			else
			{
				if (viewportIntersectionsRight.Count <= 0 || !(viewportIntersectionsRight[0].X <= pointArgument))
				{
					return new GRealPoint2D(pointArgument, pointValue);
				}
				list = viewportIntersectionsRight;
				x = intervals[intervals.Count - 1].Range.Max;
			}
			if (!isValue1)
			{
				return new GRealPoint2D(x, list[1].Y);
			}
			return new GRealPoint2D(x, list[0].Y);
		}

		public List<GRealPoint2D> GetViewportEdgePoints(int index, bool isLeft)
		{
			if (!isLeft)
			{
				if (index != MaxViewportIndex)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return viewportIntersectionsRight;
			}
			if (index != MinViewportIndex)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return viewportIntersectionsLeft;
		}

		public virtual List<GRealPoint2D> CorrectValuesByViewport(double pointArgument, double zeroValue, double pointValue, bool alwaysOnDiagramEdge)
		{
			return new List<GRealPoint2D>
			{
				new GRealPoint2D(pointArgument, zeroValue),
				new GRealPoint2D(pointArgument, zeroValue)
			};
		}
	}
	public class DiscreteViewportIntersectionHolder : ViewportIntersectionHolder
	{
		public DiscreteViewportIntersectionHolder(IXYSeriesView view)
			: base(view)
		{
		}

		protected override bool IsArgumentInRange(MinMaxValues pointRangeX)
		{
			IAxisRangeData rangeX = base.RangeX;
			if (!rangeX.Contains(pointRangeX.Max) && !rangeX.Contains(pointRangeX.Min))
			{
				if (pointRangeX.Min < rangeX.Min)
				{
					return pointRangeX.Max > rangeX.Max;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override bool IsValueInRange(RefinedPoint point, double y)
		{
			return base.RangeY.Contains(y);
		}

		protected override int CollectViewportIntersection(List<GRealPoint2D> pointsOfIntersection, IList<RefinedPoint> points, int firstIndex, int lastIndex, bool isLeftIntersection, Action<int> setIndex)
		{
			for (int i = firstIndex; base.ContinueCycle(i, lastIndex); i += base.Step)
			{
				RefinedPoint point = points[i];
				double pointValue = GetPointValue(point);
				MinMaxValues pointRangeX = base.View.CalcArgumentRange(point);
				if (IsArgumentInRange(pointRangeX) && IsValueInRange(point, pointValue))
				{
					pointsOfIntersection.Add(new GRealPoint2D(pointRangeX.CalculateCenter(), pointValue));
					setIndex(i);
					return i;
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}

		protected override Func<int, int, bool> CreateContinueCycle(bool isLeftIntersection)
		{
			if (isLeftIntersection)
			{
				return (int index, int edgeIndex) => index <= edgeIndex;
			}
			return (int index, int edgeIndex) => edgeIndex <= index;
		}

		public override List<GRealPoint2D> CorrectValuesByViewport(double pointArgument, double zeroValue, double pointValue, bool alwaysOnDiagramEdge)
		{
			IAxisRangeData rangeX = base.RangeX;
			IAxisRangeData rangeY = base.RangeY;
			if (base.ViewportIntersectionsLeft.Count > 0 && pointArgument <= base.ViewportIntersectionsLeft[0].X)
			{
				double x = ((alwaysOnDiagramEdge || pointArgument < rangeX.Min) ? rangeX.Min : pointArgument);
				return new List<GRealPoint2D>
				{
					new GRealPoint2D(x, Math.Min(rangeY.Max, Math.Max(rangeY.Min, zeroValue))),
					new GRealPoint2D(x, Math.Min(rangeY.Max, Math.Max(rangeY.Min, pointValue)))
				};
			}
			if (base.ViewportIntersectionsRight.Count > 0 && base.ViewportIntersectionsRight[0].X <= pointArgument)
			{
				double x2 = ((alwaysOnDiagramEdge || pointArgument > rangeX.Max) ? rangeX.Max : pointArgument);
				return new List<GRealPoint2D>
				{
					new GRealPoint2D(x2, Math.Min(rangeY.Max, Math.Max(rangeY.Min, zeroValue))),
					new GRealPoint2D(x2, Math.Min(rangeY.Max, Math.Max(rangeY.Min, pointValue)))
				};
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
	public class FinancialViewportIntersectionHolder : DiscreteViewportIntersectionHolder
	{
		public FinancialViewportIntersectionHolder(IXYSeriesView view)
			: base(view)
		{
		}

		protected override bool IsValueInRange(RefinedPoint point, double y)
		{
			double refinedPointMin = base.View.GetRefinedPointMin(point);
			if (!base.RangeY.Contains(refinedPointMin) && !base.RangeY.Contains(y))
			{
				if (y >= base.RangeY.Max)
				{
					return refinedPointMin <= base.RangeY.Min;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}
	}
	public class BarViewportIntersectionHolder : DiscreteViewportIntersectionHolder
	{
		public BarViewportIntersectionHolder(IXYSeriesView view)
			: base(view)
		{
		}

		protected override bool IsValueInRange(RefinedPoint point, double y)
		{
			if (!(y > 0.0))
			{
				if (y < base.RangeY.Max)
				{
					return base.RangeY.Min <= 0.0;
				}
				return false;
			}
			if (y > base.RangeY.Min)
			{
				return base.RangeY.Max > 0.0;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

	public class StepLineViewportIntersectionHolder : LineViewportIntersectionHolder
	{
		private bool InvertedStep => ((IStepSeriesView)base.View).InvertedStep;

		public StepLineViewportIntersectionHolder(IXYSeriesView view)
			: base(view)
		{
		}

		protected override bool CollectViewportIntersectionCore(List<GRealPoint2D> pointsOfIntersection, IList<RefinedPoint> points, bool isLeftIntersection, int i, double y, double x)
		{
			if (isLeftIntersection ^ InvertedStep)
			{
				double argument = points[i + base.Step].Argument;
				if (CollectViewportIntersectionByCoordinates(pointsOfIntersection, x, y, argument, y))
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (CollectViewportIntersectionByCoordinates(pointsOfIntersection, argument, y, argument, GetPointValue(points[i + base.Step])))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				double pointValue = GetPointValue(points[i + base.Step]);
				if (CollectViewportIntersectionByCoordinates(pointsOfIntersection, x, y, x, pointValue))
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (CollectViewportIntersectionByCoordinates(pointsOfIntersection, x, pointValue, points[i + base.Step].Argument, pointValue))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

	public class RangeAreaViewportIntersectionHolder : LineViewportIntersectionHolder
	{
		public RangeAreaViewportIntersectionHolder(IXYSeriesView view)
			: base(view)
		{
		}

		protected override void AddPoints(RefinedPoint point, List<GRealPoint2D> pointsOfIntersection, double y, double x)
		{
			base.AddPoints(point, pointsOfIntersection, y, x);
			pointsOfIntersection.Add(new GRealPoint2D(x, ((IRangePoint)point).Value2));
		}

		protected override double GetPointValue(RefinedPoint point)
		{
			return ((IRangePoint)point).Value1;
		}

		protected override bool CollectViewportIntersectionCore(List<GRealPoint2D> pointsOfIntersection, IList<RefinedPoint> points, bool isLeftIntersection, int i, double y, double x)
		{
			RefinedPoint refinedPoint = points[i + base.Step];
			if (CollectViewportIntersectionByCoordinates(pointsOfIntersection, x, y, refinedPoint.Argument, GetPointValue(refinedPoint)))
			{
				if (!CollectViewportIntersectionByCoordinates(pointsOfIntersection, x, ((IRangePoint)points[i]).Value2, refinedPoint.Argument, ((IRangePoint)refinedPoint).Value2))
				{
					pointsOfIntersection.Add(new GRealPoint2D(x, ((IRangePoint)points[i]).Value2));
				}
				return true;
			}
			if (CollectViewportIntersectionByCoordinates(pointsOfIntersection, x, ((IRangePoint)points[i]).Value2, refinedPoint.Argument, ((IRangePoint)refinedPoint).Value2))
			{
				pointsOfIntersection.Insert(0, new GRealPoint2D(x, ((IRangePoint)points[i]).Value1));
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	public class SplineViewportIntersectionHolder : LineViewportIntersectionHolder
	{
		private SplineAlgorithmCore SplineAlgorithm => ((ISplineView)base.View).SplineAlgorithm;

		private double LineTension => (double)((ISplineView)base.View).LineTensionPercent / 100.0;

		private Func<double, bool, double> CalcIntersectionBezier(BezierSplitCalculator calculator)
		{
			return (double limit, bool isYIntersection) => isYIntersection ? calculator.CalcCoordinateY(calculator.CalcParameterTForX(limit)[0]) : calculator.CalcCoordinateX(calculator.CalcParameterTForY(limit)[0]);
		}

		public SplineViewportIntersectionHolder(IXYSeriesView view)
			: base(view)
		{
		}

		private List<GRealPoint2D> GetPointsForBezier(IList<RefinedPoint> points, int firstIndex)
		{
			List<GRealPoint2D> list = new List<GRealPoint2D>();
			for (int i = firstIndex; base.ContinueCycle(i, firstIndex + 4 * base.Step); i += base.Step)
			{
				if (i >= 0 && i <= points.Count - 1)
				{
					list.Add(new GRealPoint2D(points[i].Argument, GetPointValue(points[i])));
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		private BezierSplitCalculator CreateCalculator(double x, List<GRealPoint2D> gPoints)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < gPoints.Count; i++)
			{
				if (gPoints[i].X == x)
				{
					return new BezierSplitCalculator(gPoints.GetRange(i, 4));
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected override bool CollectViewportIntersectionCore(List<GRealPoint2D> pointsOfIntersection, IList<RefinedPoint> points, bool isLeftIntersection, int i, double y, double x)
		{
			List<GRealPoint2D> pointsForBezier = GetPointsForBezier(points, i - base.Step);
			BezierStrip bezierStrip = new BezierStrip(SplineAlgorithm, LineTension, new IdentityTransformation(), new IdentityTransformation());
			bezierStrip.AddRange(pointsForBezier);
			BezierSplitCalculator calculator = CreateCalculator(x, bezierStrip.CalculateBezierPoints(points, DefaultBezierSplitter.Instance));
			return CollectViewportIntersectionByCoordinates(pointsOfIntersection, x, y, points[i + base.Step].Argument, GetPointValue(points[i + base.Step]), CalcIntersectionBezier(calculator));
		}
	}

	public static class SummaryFunctionsCalculatorCore
	{
		private static T? CalcValue<T>(string functionArgument, DataSourceValuesCore[] values, Func<string, T> convertFunc, Func<T, T, bool> compareFunc, out int resultIndex) where T : struct
		{
			T? result = null;
			resultIndex = -1;
			for (int i = 0; i < values.Length; i++)
			{
				if (!values[i].TryGetValue(functionArgument, out var value) || value == DBNull.Value || value == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				string text = value.ToString();
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
				{
					T val = convertFunc(text);
					if (!result.HasValue || compareFunc(val, result.Value))
					{
						resultIndex = i;
						result = val;
					}
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		public static object CalcMin(ISeries series, string[] functionArguments, DataSourceValuesCore[] values, out int minIndex)
		{
			if (series.DataAdapter.ValueScaleType == Scale.DateTime)
			{
				return CalcValue(functionArguments[0], values, (string str) => Convert.ToDateTime(str), (DateTime v1, DateTime v2) => DateTime.Compare(v1, v2) < 0, out minIndex);
			}
			if (series.DataAdapter.ValueScaleType == Scale.TimeSpan)
			{
				return CalcValue(functionArguments[0], values, (string str) => TimeSpan.Parse(str), (TimeSpan v1, TimeSpan v2) => TimeSpan.Compare(v1, v2) < 0, out minIndex);
			}
			return CalcValue(functionArguments[0], values, (string str) => Convert.ToDouble(str), (double v1, double v2) => v1 < v2, out minIndex);
		}

		public static object CalcMax(ISeries series, string[] functionArguments, DataSourceValuesCore[] values, out int maxIndex)
		{
			if (series.DataAdapter.ValueScaleType == Scale.DateTime)
			{
				return CalcValue(functionArguments[0], values, (string str) => Convert.ToDateTime(str), (DateTime v1, DateTime v2) => DateTime.Compare(v1, v2) > 0, out maxIndex);
			}
			if (series.DataAdapter.ValueScaleType == Scale.TimeSpan)
			{
				return CalcValue(functionArguments[0], values, (string str) => TimeSpan.Parse(str), (TimeSpan v1, TimeSpan v2) => TimeSpan.Compare(v1, v2) > 0, out maxIndex);
			}
			return CalcValue(functionArguments[0], values, (string str) => Convert.ToDouble(str), (double v1, double v2) => v1 > v2, out maxIndex);
		}

		public static double CalcSum(string[] functionArguments, DataSourceValuesCore[] values)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			foreach (DataSourceValuesCore dataSourceValuesCore in values)
			{
				if (dataSourceValuesCore.TryGetValue(functionArguments[0], out var value) && value != DBNull.Value && value != null)
				{
					string value2 = value.ToString();
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(value2))
					{
						num += Convert.ToDouble(value2);
					}
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		public static TimeSpan CalcTimeSpanSum(string[] functionArguments, DataSourceValuesCore[] values)
		{
			TimeSpan result = default(TimeSpan);
			foreach (DataSourceValuesCore dataSourceValuesCore in values)
			{
				if (dataSourceValuesCore.TryGetValue(functionArguments[0], out var value) && value != DBNull.Value && value != null)
				{
					string text = value.ToString();
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
					{
						result += TimeSpan.Parse(text, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
					}
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		public static double CalcAverage(string[] functionArguments, DataSourceValuesCore[] values)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			int num2 = 0;
			foreach (DataSourceValuesCore dataSourceValuesCore in values)
			{
				if (dataSourceValuesCore.TryGetValue(functionArguments[0], out var value) && value != DBNull.Value && value != null)
				{
					string value2 = value.ToString();
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(value2))
					{
						num += Convert.ToDouble(value2);
						num2++;
					}
				}
			}
			if (num2 != 0)
			{
				return num / (double)num2;
			}
			return 0.0;
		}

		public static TimeSpan CalcTimeSpanAverage(string[] functionArguments, DataSourceValuesCore[] values)
		{
			long num = 0L;
			int num2 = 0;
			foreach (DataSourceValuesCore dataSourceValuesCore in values)
			{
				if (dataSourceValuesCore.TryGetValue(functionArguments[0], out var value) && value != DBNull.Value && value != null)
				{
					string text = value.ToString();
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
					{
						num += TimeSpan.Parse(text, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture).Ticks;
						num2++;
					}
				}
			}
			if (num2 > 0)
			{
				num /= num2;
			}
			return new TimeSpan(num);
		}

		public static int CalcCount(DataSourceValuesCore[] values)
		{
			return values.Length;
		}
	}

			foreach (FieldInfo item in constants)

		private static List<FieldInfo> GetConstants(Type type)
		{
			List<FieldInfo> list = new List<FieldInfo>();
			FieldInfo[] fields = type.GetFields(BindingFlags.Static | BindingFlags.Public);
			FieldInfo[] array = fields;
			foreach (FieldInfo fieldInfo in array)
			{
				if (fieldInfo.IsLiteral && !fieldInfo.IsInitOnly)
				{
					list.Add(fieldInfo);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		{
			return predefinedConstants.Contains(constant);
		}

	public abstract class PatternDataProvider
	{
		private object context;

		public object Context
		{
			get
			{
				return context;
			}
			set
			{
				SetContext(value);
			}
		}

		protected abstract bool TryGetValue(out object value);

		protected virtual void SetContext(object value)
		{
			if (context != value)
			{
				context = value;
			}
		}

		public abstract bool CheckContext(object value);

		public bool TryGetText(string format, out string text)
		{
			text = string.Empty;
			if (TryGetValue(out var value))
			{
				if (value != null)
				{
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(format))
					{
						text = PatternUtils.Format(value, format);
					}
					else
					{
						text = FormatUtils.ToString(value);
					}
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	public class SeriesPatternDataProvider : PatternDataProvider
	{
		private readonly string patternConstant;

		private ISeries Series => (ISeries)base.Context;

		public SeriesPatternDataProvider(string patternConstant)
		{
			this.patternConstant = patternConstant;
		}

		protected override bool TryGetValue(out object value)
		{
			if (base.Context != null)
			{
				if (patternConstant == "G")
				{
					value = (Series.SeriesView as ISupportSeriesGroups)?.SeriesGroup;
				}
				else
				{
					value = Series.Name;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				value = null;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override bool CheckContext(object value)
		{
			return value is ISeries;
		}
	}
	public class SimplePointPatternDataProvider : PatternDataProvider
	{
		private readonly string patternConstant;

		private readonly ISeriesPointEnsurer seriesPointEnsurer;

		protected RefinedPoint RefinedPoint => base.Context as RefinedPoint;

		public SimplePointPatternDataProvider(string patternConstant, ISeriesPointEnsurer seriesPointEnsurer)
		{
			this.patternConstant = patternConstant;
			this.seriesPointEnsurer = seriesPointEnsurer;
		}

		private ISeriesPoint GetSeriesPoint()
		{
			ISeriesPoint seriesPoint = RefinedPoint.SeriesPoint;
			if (seriesPoint == null)
			{
				seriesPoint = seriesPointEnsurer.Ensure(RefinedPoint);
			}
			return seriesPoint;
		}

		private object GetArgument()
		{
			ISeriesPoint seriesPoint = GetSeriesPoint();
			return seriesPoint.ArgumentX.UserArgument;
		}

		private object GetValue()
		{
			ISeriesPoint seriesPoint = GetSeriesPoint();
			return seriesPoint.Values.ValueScaleType switch
			{
				Scale.DateTime => seriesPoint.Values.DateTimeValues[0], 
				Scale.TimeSpan => seriesPoint.Values.TimeSpanValues[0], 
				_ => seriesPoint.Values.NumericalValues[0], 
			};
		}

		private object GetValueFormRefinedPoint()
		{
			return patternConstant switch
			{
				"A" => GetArgument(), 
				"V" => GetValue(), 
				"VP" => GetPercentValue(), 
				"HINT" => RefinedPoint.ToolTipHint, 
				"TV" => ((IPiePoint)RefinedPoint).TotalValue, 
				_ => null, 
			};
		}

		protected virtual object GetPercentValue()
		{
			return ((IPiePoint)RefinedPoint).NormalizedValue;
		}

		protected override bool TryGetValue(out object value)
		{
			if (RefinedPoint != null)
			{
				value = GetValueFormRefinedPoint();
			}
			else
			{
				value = null;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override bool CheckContext(object value)
		{
			return value is RefinedPoint;
		}
	}
