	public class PointPatternDataProvider : PatternDataProvider
	{
		private readonly string patternConstant;

		private readonly AxisScaleTypeMap AxisScaleTypeMap;

		protected string PatternConstant => patternConstant;

		protected RefinedPoint RefinedPoint => base.Context as RefinedPoint;

		protected ISeriesPoint SeriesPoint => base.Context as ISeriesPoint;

		public PointPatternDataProvider(string patternConstant, AxisScaleTypeMap axisScaleTypeMap)
		{
			this.patternConstant = patternConstant;
			AxisScaleTypeMap = axisScaleTypeMap;
		}

		private object GetDurationValue(RefinedPoint point)
		{
			if (double.IsNaN(point.Value1) || double.IsNaN(point.Value2) || AxisScaleTypeMap == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			object obj = AxisScaleTypeMap.InternalToNative(point.Value1);
			object obj2 = AxisScaleTypeMap.InternalToNative(point.Value2);
			if (obj is double && obj2 is double)
			{
				return Math.Abs((double)obj2 - (double)obj);
			}
			if (obj is DateTime && obj2 is DateTime)
			{
				return ((DateTime)obj2 - (DateTime)obj).Duration();
			}
			if (obj is TimeSpan && obj2 is TimeSpan)
			{
				return ((TimeSpan)obj2 - (TimeSpan)obj).Duration();
			}
			throw new ArgumentException();
		}

		private TimeSpan GetTimeSpanDuration(RefinedPoint point)
		{
			object durationValue = GetDurationValue(point);
			if (durationValue is TimeSpan)
			{
				return (TimeSpan)durationValue;
			}
			throw new ArgumentException();
		}

		protected virtual object GetValueFormSeriesPoint()
		{
			return patternConstant switch
			{
				"A" => SeriesPoint.ArgumentX.UserArgument, 
				"V" => (SeriesPoint.Values.NumericalValues.Length != 0) ? SeriesPoint.Values.NumericalValues[0] : 0.0, 
				"HV" => (SeriesPoint.Values.NumericalValues.Length > 1) ? SeriesPoint.Values.NumericalValues[1] : 0.0, 
				"LV" => (SeriesPoint.Values.NumericalValues.Length != 0) ? SeriesPoint.Values.NumericalValues[0] : 0.0, 
				"OV" => (SeriesPoint.Values.NumericalValues.Length > 2) ? SeriesPoint.Values.NumericalValues[2] : 0.0, 
				"CV" => (SeriesPoint.Values.NumericalValues.Length > 3) ? SeriesPoint.Values.NumericalValues[3] : 0.0, 
				"V1" => (SeriesPoint.Values.NumericalValues.Length != 0) ? SeriesPoint.Values.NumericalValues[0] : 0.0, 
				"V2" => (SeriesPoint.Values.NumericalValues.Length > 1) ? SeriesPoint.Values.NumericalValues[1] : 0.0, 
				"W" => (SeriesPoint.Values.NumericalValues.Length > 1) ? SeriesPoint.Values.NumericalValues[1] : 0.0, 
				"BP_MIN" => (SeriesPoint.Values.NumericalValues.Length != 0) ? SeriesPoint.Values.NumericalValues[0] : 0.0, 
				"BP_Q1" => (SeriesPoint.Values.NumericalValues.Length > 1) ? SeriesPoint.Values.NumericalValues[1] : 0.0, 
				"BP_MDN" => (SeriesPoint.Values.NumericalValues.Length > 2) ? SeriesPoint.Values.NumericalValues[2] : 0.0, 
				"BP_Q3" => (SeriesPoint.Values.NumericalValues.Length > 3) ? SeriesPoint.Values.NumericalValues[3] : 0.0, 
				"BP_MAX" => (SeriesPoint.Values.NumericalValues.Length > 4) ? SeriesPoint.Values.NumericalValues[4] : 0.0, 
				"BP_AVG" => (SeriesPoint.Values.NumericalValues.Length > 5) ? SeriesPoint.Values.NumericalValues[5] : 0.0, 
				"HINT" => SeriesPoint.ToolTipHint, 
				_ => null, 
			};
		}

		protected virtual object GetValueFromRefinedPoint()
		{
			double num = double.NaN;
			switch (patternConstant)
			{
			case "A":
			case "X":
				num = RefinedPoint.Argument;
				break;
			case "Y":
				num = RefinedPoint.ArgumentY;
				break;
			case "V":
			case "Z":
				num = ((IValuePoint)RefinedPoint).Value;
				break;
			case "VP":
				num = ((IFullStackedPoint)RefinedPoint).NormalizedValue;
				break;
			case "HV":
				num = ((IFinancialPoint)RefinedPoint).High;
				break;
			case "LV":
				num = ((IFinancialPoint)RefinedPoint).Low;
				break;
			case "OV":
				num = ((IFinancialPoint)RefinedPoint).Open;
				break;
			case "CV":
				num = ((IFinancialPoint)RefinedPoint).Close;
				break;
			case "V1":
				num = RefinedPoint.Value1;
				break;
			case "V2":
				num = RefinedPoint.Value2;
				break;
			case "W":
				num = ((IXYWPoint)RefinedPoint).Weight;
				break;
			case "BP_MIN":
				num = ((IBoxPlotPoint)RefinedPoint).Min;
				break;
			case "BP_Q1":
				num = ((IBoxPlotPoint)RefinedPoint).Quartile1;
				break;
			case "BP_MDN":
				num = ((IBoxPlotPoint)RefinedPoint).Median;
				break;
			case "BP_Q3":
				num = ((IBoxPlotPoint)RefinedPoint).Quartile3;
				break;
			case "BP_MAX":
				num = ((IBoxPlotPoint)RefinedPoint).Max;
				break;
			case "BP_AVG":
				num = ((IBoxPlotPoint)RefinedPoint).Mean;
				break;
			case "HINT":
				return RefinedPoint.ToolTipHint;
			case "VD":
				return GetDurationValue(RefinedPoint);
			case "VDTD":
				return GetTimeSpanDuration(RefinedPoint).TotalDays;
			case "VDTH":
				return GetTimeSpanDuration(RefinedPoint).TotalHours;
			case "VDTM":
				return GetTimeSpanDuration(RefinedPoint).TotalMinutes;
			case "VDTS":
				return GetTimeSpanDuration(RefinedPoint).TotalSeconds;
			case "VDTMS":
				return GetTimeSpanDuration(RefinedPoint).TotalMilliseconds;
			case "TV":
			{
				double totalValue = ((IFullStackedPoint)RefinedPoint).TotalValue;
				if (double.IsNaN(totalValue))
				{
					totalValue = ((IStackedPoint)RefinedPoint).TotalValue;
				}
				num = totalValue;
				break;
			}
			case "VABS":
				num = ((IWaterfallPoint)RefinedPoint).AbsoluteValue;
				break;
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(num) || AxisScaleTypeMap == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return AxisScaleTypeMap.InternalToNative(num);
		}

		protected override bool TryGetValue(out object value)
		{
			if (RefinedPoint != null)
			{
				value = GetValueFromRefinedPoint();
			}
			else if (SeriesPoint != null)
			{
				value = GetValueFormSeriesPoint();
			}
			else
			{
				value = null;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override bool CheckContext(object value)
		{
			if (!(value is RefinedPoint))
			{
				return value is ISeriesPoint;
			}
			return true;
		}
	}
	public class WaterfallPointPatternDataProvider : PointPatternDataProvider
	{
		public WaterfallPointPatternDataProvider(string patternConstant, AxisScaleTypeMap axisScaleTypeMap)
			: base(patternConstant, axisScaleTypeMap)
		{
		}

		protected override object GetValueFormSeriesPoint()
		{
			return base.GetValueFormSeriesPoint();
		}

		protected override object GetValueFromRefinedPoint()
		{
			IWaterfallPoint refinedPoint = base.RefinedPoint;
			if (refinedPoint.IsSubTotal && base.PatternConstant != "A")
			{
				return refinedPoint.MaxValue;
			}
			if (base.PatternConstant == "V")
			{
				return refinedPoint.RelativeValue;
			}
			return base.GetValueFromRefinedPoint();
		}
	}
	public interface ISeriesPointEnsurer
	{
		ISeriesPoint Ensure(RefinedPoint refinedPoint);
	}
	public class DataSourcePatternDataProvider : PatternDataProvider
	{
		private readonly string patternConstant;

		private readonly ISeriesPointEnsurer seriesPointEnsurer;

		private ISeriesPoint SeriesPoint => base.Context as ISeriesPoint;

		public DataSourcePatternDataProvider(string patternConstant, ISeriesPointEnsurer seriesPointEnsurer)
		{
			this.patternConstant = patternConstant;
			this.seriesPointEnsurer = seriesPointEnsurer;
		}

		protected override bool TryGetValue(out object value)
		{
			ISeriesPoint seriesPoint = SeriesPoint;
			if (seriesPoint != null)
			{
				ISeriesDataAdapter seriesDataAdapter = seriesPoint.Owner?.DataAdapter;
				if (seriesDataAdapter != null)
				{
					value = BindingHelperCore.GetValue(seriesPoint.DataContext, seriesPoint.Tag, patternConstant, seriesDataAdapter);
					return value != null;
				}
			}
			value = null;
			return false;
		}

		protected override void SetContext(object value)
		{
			if (value is RefinedPoint)
			{
				RefinedPoint refinedPoint = (RefinedPoint)value;
				ISeriesPoint seriesPoint = refinedPoint.SeriesPoint;
				if (seriesPoint == null)
				{
					seriesPoint = seriesPointEnsurer.Ensure(refinedPoint);
				}
				value = seriesPoint;
			}
			base.SetContext(value);
		}

		public override bool CheckContext(object value)
		{
			if (!(value is RefinedPoint))
			{
				return value is ISeriesPoint;
			}
			return true;
		}
	}
	public class ValuesSourcePatternDataProvider : PatternDataProvider
	{
		private readonly string patternConstant;

		private static bool IsCorrectDurationSource(IPatternValuesSource valuesSource)
		{
			if (valuesSource.ValueDuration != null)
			{
				return typeof(TimeSpan).IsAssignableFrom(valuesSource.ValueDuration.GetType());
			}
			return false;
		}

		public ValuesSourcePatternDataProvider(string patternConstant)
		{
			this.patternConstant = patternConstant;
		}

		private object GetValueFromValuesSource()
		{
			if (!(base.Context is IPatternValuesSource patternValuesSource))
			{
				return null;
			}
			switch (patternConstant)
			{
			case "A":
				return patternValuesSource.Argument;
			case "V":
				return patternValuesSource.Value;
			case "VP":
				return patternValuesSource.PercentValue;
			case "HV":
				return patternValuesSource.HighValue;
			case "LV":
				return patternValuesSource.LowValue;
			case "OV":
				return patternValuesSource.OpenValue;
			case "CV":
				return patternValuesSource.CloseValue;
			case "V1":
				return patternValuesSource.Value1;
			case "V2":
				return patternValuesSource.Value2;
			case "VD":
				return patternValuesSource.ValueDuration;
			case "VDTD":
				if (IsCorrectDurationSource(patternValuesSource))
				{
					return ((TimeSpan)patternValuesSource.ValueDuration).TotalDays;
				}
				return "";
			case "VDTH":
				if (IsCorrectDurationSource(patternValuesSource))
				{
					return ((TimeSpan)patternValuesSource.ValueDuration).TotalHours;
				}
				return "";
			case "VDTM":
				if (IsCorrectDurationSource(patternValuesSource))
				{
					return ((TimeSpan)patternValuesSource.ValueDuration).TotalMinutes;
				}
				return "";
			case "VDTS":
				if (IsCorrectDurationSource(patternValuesSource))
				{
					return ((TimeSpan)patternValuesSource.ValueDuration).TotalSeconds;
				}
				return "";
			case "VDTMS":
				if (IsCorrectDurationSource(patternValuesSource))
				{
					return ((TimeSpan)patternValuesSource.ValueDuration).TotalMilliseconds;
				}
				return "";
			case "W":
				return patternValuesSource.Weight;
			case "HINT":
				return patternValuesSource.PointHint;
			case "S":
				return patternValuesSource.Series;
			case "G":
				return patternValuesSource.SeriesGroup;
			case "TV":
				return patternValuesSource.TotalValue;
			case "A1":
				return patternValuesSource.IntervalArgumentMin;
			case "A2":
				return patternValuesSource.IntervalArgumentMax;
			case "OB":
				return patternValuesSource.OpeningBracket;
			case "CB":
				return patternValuesSource.ClosingBracket;
			case "US":
				return patternValuesSource.UnderflowSymbol;
			case "OS":
				return patternValuesSource.OverflowSymbol;
			default:
				return null;
			}
		}

		protected override bool TryGetValue(out object value)
		{
			value = GetValueFromValuesSource();
			return true;
		}

		public override bool CheckContext(object value)
		{
			return value is IPatternValuesSource;
		}
	}
	public class AxisPatternDataProvider : PatternDataProvider
	{
		private readonly string patternConstant;

		public AxisPatternDataProvider(string patternConstant)
		{
			this.patternConstant = patternConstant;
		}

		protected override bool TryGetValue(out object value)
		{
			value = base.Context;
			if (value is AxisAggregationInterval interval)
			{
				value = GetValueFromAxisAggregationInterval(interval);
			}
			else if (value is Tuple<object, object> tuple)
			{
				value = ((patternConstant == "A2") ? tuple.Item2 : tuple.Item1);
			}
			return true;
		}

		private object GetValueFromAxisAggregationInterval(AxisAggregationInterval interval)
		{
			switch (patternConstant)
			{
			case "A1":
			case "A":
				return interval.NativeMin;
			case "A2":
				return interval.NativeMax;
			case "OB":
				if (!interval.IncludeMin)
				{
					return "(";
				}
				return "[";
			case "CB":
				if (!interval.IncludeMax)
				{
					return ")";
				}
				return "]";
			case "US":
				if (!interval.IncludeMax)
				{
					return "<";
				}
				return "<=";
			case "OS":
				if (!interval.IncludeMin)
				{
					return ">";
				}
				return ">=";
			default:
				return interval;
			}
		}

		public override bool CheckContext(object value)
		{
			return true;
		}
	}
	public class ValueRangeLegendItemDataProvider : PatternDataProvider
	{
		private readonly string patternConstants;

		public ValueRangeLegendItemDataProvider(string patternConstants)
		{
			this.patternConstants = patternConstants;
		}

		protected override bool TryGetValue(out object value)
		{
			if (base.Context != null)
			{
				int num = ((!(patternConstants == "V1")) ? 1 : 0);
				value = ((double[])base.Context)[num];
			}
			else
			{
				value = null;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override bool CheckContext(object value)
		{
			if (value is double[])
			{
				return ((double[])value).Length > 1;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	public enum HeatmapRangeStopTypeCore
	{
		Absolute,
		Percentage
	}
	public class HeatmapRangeStopCore
	{
		public double Value { get; set; }

		public HeatmapRangeStopTypeCore Type { get; set; }

		public HeatmapRangeStopCore()
			: this(double.NaN)
		{
		}

		public HeatmapRangeStopCore(double value)
			: this(value, HeatmapRangeStopTypeCore.Absolute)
		{
		}

		public HeatmapRangeStopCore(double value, HeatmapRangeStopTypeCore type)
		{
			Value = value;
			Type = type;
		}

		public double GetAbsolute(MinMaxValues valueRange)
		{
			return GetAbsolute(valueRange.Min, valueRange.Max);
		}

		public double GetAbsolute(double min, double max)
		{
			if (Type == HeatmapRangeStopTypeCore.Absolute)
			{
				return Value;
			}
			return Math.Round(min + (max - min) * Value, 9);
		}

		public double GetPercentage(MinMaxValues valueRange)
		{
			return GetPercentage(valueRange.Min, valueRange.Max);
		}

		public double GetPercentage(double min, double max)
		{
			if (Type == HeatmapRangeStopTypeCore.Percentage)
			{
				return Value;
			}
			return (Value - min) / (max - min);
		}
	}
	public class UnitItemData
	{
		public MinMaxValues ValueRange { get; }

		public HeatmapRangeStopCore Value1 { get; }

		public HeatmapRangeStopCore Value2 { get; }

		public UnitItemData(MinMaxValues valueRange, HeatmapRangeStopCore value1, HeatmapRangeStopCore value2)
		{
			ValueRange = valueRange;
			Value1 = value1;
			Value2 = value2;
		}
	}
	public class UnitRangeLegendItemDataProvider : PatternDataProvider
	{
		private readonly string patternConstants;

		public UnitRangeLegendItemDataProvider(string patternConstants)
		{
			this.patternConstants = patternConstants;
		}

		protected override bool TryGetValue(out object value)
		{
			value = null;
			if (base.Context != null)
			{
				UnitItemData unitItemData = (UnitItemData)base.Context;
				MinMaxValues valueRange = unitItemData.ValueRange;
				switch (patternConstants)
				{
				case "V1":
					value = unitItemData.Value1.GetAbsolute(valueRange);
					break;
				case "V2":
					value = unitItemData.Value2.GetAbsolute(valueRange);
					break;
				case "VP1":
					value = unitItemData.Value1.GetPercentage(valueRange);
					break;
				case "VP2":
					value = unitItemData.Value2.GetPercentage(valueRange);
					break;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override bool CheckContext(object value)
		{
			return value is UnitItemData;
		}
	}

			return true;
		}

	public class XYZPatternDataProvider : PointPatternDataProvider
	{
		private readonly string patternConstant;

		private XYZPointProjections PointProjections => base.Context as XYZPointProjections;

		public XYZPatternDataProvider(string patternConstant, AxisScaleTypeMap axisScaleTypeMap)
			: base(patternConstant, axisScaleTypeMap)
		{
			this.patternConstant = patternConstant;
		}

		private object GetValueFormPointProjections()
		{
			switch (patternConstant)
			{
			case "X":
				return PointProjections.AxesXValue.CalculateNativeValue();
			case "Y":
				return PointProjections.AxesZValue.CalculateNativeValue();
			case "Z":
			case "V":
				return PointProjections.AxesYValue.CalculateNativeValue();
			default:
				return null;
			}
		}

		protected override bool TryGetValue(out object value)
		{
			value = null;
			if (base.CheckContext(base.Context))
			{
				base.TryGetValue(out value);
			}
			if (value == null && PointProjections != null)
			{
				value = GetValueFormPointProjections();
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override bool CheckContext(object value)
		{
			if (!base.CheckContext(value))
			{
				return value is XYZPointProjections;
			}
			return true;
		}
	}
	public class CrosshairIndicatorPatternHolder : IPatternHolder
	{
		public PatternDataProvider GetDataProvider(string patternConstant)
		{
			if (patternConstant == "I")
			{
				return new IndicatorPatternDataProvider();
			}
			if (patternConstant == "S")
			{
				return new IndicatorSeriesPatternDataProvider();
			}
			return new IndicatorPointPatternDataProvider(patternConstant);
		}
	}
	public class IndicatorPointPatternDataProvider : PatternDataProvider
	{
		private readonly string patternConstant;

		protected CrosshairIndicatorPoint CrosshairIndicatorPoint => base.Context as CrosshairIndicatorPoint;

		public IndicatorPointPatternDataProvider(string patternConstant)
		{
			this.patternConstant = patternConstant;
		}

		private object GetIndicatorValue()
		{
			CrosshairIndicatorPoint crosshairIndicatorPoint = CrosshairIndicatorPoint;
			IAxisData axisData = ((patternConstant != "A") ? crosshairIndicatorPoint.Indicator.AxisYData : crosshairIndicatorPoint.Indicator.AxisXData);
			if (axisData == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			double valueByType = GetValueByType();
			if (!double.IsInfinity(valueByType))
			{
				return axisData.AxisScaleTypeMap.InternalToNative(valueByType);
			}
			return null;
		}

		private double GetValueByType()
		{
			double value = double.PositiveInfinity;
			switch (patternConstant)
			{
			case "A":
				value = CrosshairIndicatorPoint.AxisXProjection.Value;
				break;
			case "AV":
				CrosshairIndicatorPoint.ValuesByType.TryGetValue(IndicatorValueLevelCore.Average, out value);
				break;
			case "LV":
				CrosshairIndicatorPoint.ValuesByType.TryGetValue(IndicatorValueLevelCore.Lower, out value);
				break;
			case "UV":
				CrosshairIndicatorPoint.ValuesByType.TryGetValue(IndicatorValueLevelCore.Upper, out value);
				break;
			case "T":
				CrosshairIndicatorPoint.ValuesByType.TryGetValue(IndicatorValueLevelCore.Top, out value);
				break;
			case "B":
				CrosshairIndicatorPoint.ValuesByType.TryGetValue(IndicatorValueLevelCore.Bottom, out value);
				break;
			case "SV":
				CrosshairIndicatorPoint.ValuesByType.TryGetValue(IndicatorValueLevelCore.Signal, out value);
				break;
			case "V":
				CrosshairIndicatorPoint.ValuesByType.TryGetValue(IndicatorValueLevelCore.Value, out value);
				break;
			}
			return value;
		}

		protected override bool TryGetValue(out object value)
		{
			value = GetIndicatorValue();
			return true;
		}

		public override bool CheckContext(object value)
		{
			return value is CrosshairIndicatorPoint;
		}
	}

	public class PatternEditorValuesSource : IPatternValuesSource, IPatternHolder

	public class PatternParser
	{
		private class PatternFragment
		{
			private readonly string fragment;

			private readonly string format;

			private readonly PatternDataProvider dataProvider;

			public string Fragment => fragment;

			public PatternFragment(string fragment, string format, PatternDataProvider dataProvider)
			{
				this.fragment = fragment;
				this.format = format;
				this.dataProvider = dataProvider;
			}

			public bool TryGetText(out string text)
			{
				return dataProvider.TryGetText(format, out text);
			}

			public void SetContext(object context)
			{
				if (dataProvider.CheckContext(context))
				{
					dataProvider.Context = context;
				}
			}
		}

		private readonly string template;

		private readonly IPatternHolder patternHolder;

		private readonly List<PatternFragment> fragments = new List<PatternFragment>();

		public static string FullStackedToolTipPattern(string argumentFormat, string valueFormat)
		{
			string text = "{A" + argumentFormat + "}";
			string text2 = "{V" + valueFormat + "} ({VP:P2})";
			return text + " : " + text2;
		}

		public PatternParser(string pattern, IPatternHolder patternHolder)
		{
			template = pattern;
			this.patternHolder = patternHolder;
			Parse();
		}

		private void Parse()
		{
			List<string> list = PatternUtils.SplitString(template, '{', '}');
			if (list == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (string item in list)
			{
				if (PatternUtils.PrepareFragment(item, out var patternConstant, out var format))
				{
					PatternDataProvider dataProvider = patternHolder.GetDataProvider(patternConstant);
					if (dataProvider != null)
					{
						fragments.Add(new PatternFragment(item, format, dataProvider));
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public void SetContext(params object[] contexts)
		{
			foreach (PatternFragment fragment in fragments)
			{
				foreach (object context in contexts)
				{
					fragment.SetContext(context);
				}
			}
		}

		public string GetText()
		{
			string text = template;
			foreach (PatternFragment fragment in fragments)
			{
				if (fragment.TryGetText(out var text2))
				{
					text = text.Replace(fragment.Fragment, text2);
				}
			}
			return text;
		}
	}
	public class DatetimeAxisRangeUpdateStrategy : RangeUpdateStrategy
	{
		public DatetimeAxisRangeUpdateStrategy(IAxisData axis, MinMaxValues minMaxInternal, MinMaxValues minMaxRefined, ICollection<RefinedSeries> refinedSeries, bool scaleMapWasChanged)
			: base(axis, minMaxInternal, minMaxRefined, refinedSeries, scaleMapWasChanged)
		{
		}

		protected override InternalRange CheckInternalValue(IAxisRangeData range, MinMaxValues internalValues)
		{
			if (double.IsNaN(internalValues.Min))
			{
				internalValues.Min = internalValues.Max - 1.0;
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(internalValues.Max) || internalValues.Min == internalValues.Max)
			{
				internalValues.Max = internalValues.Min + 1.0;
			}
			internalValues.Min -= base.VisualRange.SideMargins.Min;
			internalValues.Min += base.VisualRange.SideMargins.Max;
			return new InternalRange(internalValues, base.VisualRange.SideMargins, new MinMaxValues(base.VisualRange.ActualStartSideMargin, base.VisualRange.ActualEndSideMargin));
		}

		protected override InternalRange ApplySideMargins(MinMaxValues internalValues, MinMaxValues sideMargins, bool autoCorrectionMin, bool autoCorrectionMax)
		{
			InternalRange internalRange = base.ApplySideMargins(internalValues, sideMargins, autoCorrectionMin, autoCorrectionMax);
			if (!(base.Map is IIntervalScaleMap))
			{
				double num = base.Map.NativeToInternal(DateTimeUtilsExt.MaxDateTime);
				bool flag = internalRange.Values.Min < 0.0;
				bool flag2 = internalRange.Values.Max > num;
				if (flag || flag2)
				{
					MinMaxValues values = internalRange.Values;
					MinMaxValues sideMargins2 = internalRange.SideMargins;
					if (flag)
					{
						values.Min = 0.0;
						sideMargins2.Min = internalRange.SideMargins.Min + internalRange.Values.Min;
					}
					if (flag2)
					{
						values.Max = num;
						sideMargins2.Max = Math.Max(num - internalValues.Max, 0.0);
					}
					internalRange = new InternalRange(values, sideMargins2, sideMargins2);
				}
			}
			if (internalRange.Delta == 0.0)
			{
				return new InternalRange(new MinMaxValues(internalValues.Min - DefaultSideMarginsValue.Min, internalValues.Max + DefaultSideMarginsValue.Max), DefaultSideMarginsValue);
			}
			return internalRange;
		}

		protected override NativeRange GetNativeValues(MinMaxValues internalValues, MinMaxValues correctedInternalValues, IAxisRangeData range)
		{
			if (internalValues.Min < 0.0)
			{
				internalValues.Max -= internalValues.Min;
				internalValues.Min = 0.0;
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(internalValues.Max) || double.IsNaN(internalValues.Min))
			{
				MinMaxValues range2 = ((!double.IsNaN(internalValues.Max)) ? new MinMaxValues(internalValues.Max) : new MinMaxValues(internalValues.Min));
				return InternalToNative(range2);
			}
			if (internalValues.Min > internalValues.Max)
			{
				double min = (range.AutoCorrectMin ? correctedInternalValues.Min : internalValues.Min);
				double max = (range.AutoCorrectMax ? correctedInternalValues.Max : internalValues.Max);
				return InternalToNative(new MinMaxValues(min, max));
			}
			if (internalValues.Min == internalValues.Max)
			{
				if (base.VisualRange.MinValue != null && base.VisualRange.MaxValue != null && range.CorrectionMode != RangeCorrectionMode.Auto)
				{
					double value = base.Map.NativeToRefined(base.VisualRange.MaxValue) - base.Map.NativeToRefined(base.VisualRange.MinValue);
					value = Math.Abs(value);
					DateTime dateTime = (DateTime)base.Map.InternalToNative(internalValues.Min);
					DateTime dateTime2 = (DateTime)base.Map.InternalToNative(internalValues.Min + base.Map.RefinedToInternal(value));
					return new NativeRange(dateTime, dateTime2);
				}
				return InternalToNative(correctedInternalValues);
			}
			object max2 = ((range.AutoCorrectMax || range.MaxValue == null) ? base.Map.InternalToNative(internalValues.Max) : range.MaxValue);
			object min2 = ((range.AutoCorrectMin || range.MinValue == null) ? base.Map.InternalToNative(internalValues.Min) : range.MinValue);
			return new NativeRange(min2, max2);
		}

		protected override RangeSnapshot DefaultRange(IAxisRangeData range)
		{
			MinMaxValues minMaxValues = new MinMaxValues(base.Map.NativeToInternal(DateTime.Today), base.Map.NativeToInternal(DateTime.Today) + 1.0);
			NativeRange nativeValues = GetNativeValues(minMaxValues, minMaxValues, range);
			InternalRange internalRange = new InternalRange(minMaxValues, new MinMaxValues(0.0, 0.0), new MinMaxValues(range.ActualStartSideMargin, range.ActualEndSideMargin));
			return new RangeSnapshot(nativeValues, internalRange, default(MinMaxValues), range.SideMarginSizeUnit);
		}

		protected override MinMaxValues NarrowToActualWholeRange(MinMaxValues wholeRangeValues, IWholeAxisRangeData wholeRange)
		{
			AxisDateTimeMap axisDateTimeMap = (AxisDateTimeMap)base.Map;
			bool flag = axisDateTimeMap.IsWorkTimeEnabled || axisDateTimeMap.IsWorkdaysEnabled;
			double num = wholeRangeValues.Min;
			double num2 = wholeRangeValues.Max;
			if (!flag || !MinMaxValues.IsValid(wholeRangeValues) || wholeRange.CorrectionMode != RangeCorrectionMode.Values || num == num2)
			{
				return wholeRangeValues;
			}
			if (!wholeRange.AutoCorrectMin && base.Map.InternalToRefined(num) < base.Map.NativeToRefined(wholeRange.MinValue))
			{
				num += 1.0;
			}
			if (!wholeRange.AutoCorrectMax && base.Map.NativeToRefined(wholeRange.MaxValue) < base.Map.InternalToRefined(num2))
			{
				num2 -= 1.0;
			}
			return new MinMaxValues(num, num2);
		}
	}
	public class NumericalAxisRangeUpdateStrategy : RangeUpdateStrategy
	{
		public NumericalAxisRangeUpdateStrategy(IAxisData axis, MinMaxValues minMaxInternal, MinMaxValues minMaxRefined, ICollection<RefinedSeries> refinedSeries, bool scaleMapWasChanged)
			: base(axis, minMaxInternal, minMaxRefined, refinedSeries, scaleMapWasChanged)
		{
		}

		protected virtual MinMaxValues GetInternalForNativeValues(MinMaxValues internalValues, MinMaxValues correctedInternalValues, IAxisRangeData range)
		{
			if (base.Axis.IsArgumentAxis && !MinMaxValues.IsValid(internalValues))
			{
				return new MinMaxValues(double.IsNaN(internalValues.Max) ? internalValues.Min : internalValues.Max);
			}
			if (internalValues.Min > internalValues.Max)
			{
				double min = (range.AutoCorrectMin ? correctedInternalValues.Min : internalValues.Min);
				double max = (range.AutoCorrectMax ? correctedInternalValues.Max : internalValues.Max);
				return new MinMaxValues(min, max);
			}
			if (base.ShowZeroLevel && range.CorrectionMode != RangeCorrectionMode.InternalValues)
			{
				return CheckZeroLevel(internalValues, internalValues, range.AutoCorrectMin, range.AutoCorrectMax);
			}
			return internalValues;
		}

		protected override NativeRange GetNativeValues(MinMaxValues internalValues, MinMaxValues correctedInternalValues, IAxisRangeData range)
		{
			MinMaxValues internalForNativeValues = GetInternalForNativeValues(internalValues, correctedInternalValues, range);
			return InternalToNative(internalForNativeValues);
		}

		protected override InternalRange CheckInternalValue(IAxisRangeData range, MinMaxValues internalValues)
		{
			if (base.Axis.IsRadarAxis)
			{
				MinMaxValues values = CheckZeroLevel(internalValues, internalValues, range.AutoCorrectMin, range.AutoCorrectMin);
				if (values.Min == values.Max)
				{
					values.Max += 1.0;
				}
				return new InternalRange(values, range.SideMargins, new MinMaxValues(0.0));
			}
			if (internalValues.Min >= internalValues.Max)
			{
				if (range.AutoCorrectMin)
				{
					internalValues.Min -= DefaultSideMarginsValue.Min;
				}
				if (range.AutoCorrectMax)
				{
					internalValues.Max += DefaultSideMarginsValue.Max;
				}
				if (internalValues.Min == internalValues.Max)
				{
					internalValues.Min -= DefaultSideMarginsValue.Min;
					internalValues.Max += DefaultSideMarginsValue.Max;
				}
			}
			return new InternalRange(sideMargins: new MinMaxValues(range.SideMargins), values: internalValues, sideMarginsValue: new MinMaxValues(0.0));
		}
	}
	public class NumericalLogarithmicAxisRangeUpdateStrategy : NumericalAxisRangeUpdateStrategy
	{
		public NumericalLogarithmicAxisRangeUpdateStrategy(IAxisData axis, MinMaxValues minMaxInternal, MinMaxValues minMaxRefined, ICollection<RefinedSeries> refinedSeries, bool scaleMapWasChanged)
			: base(axis, minMaxInternal, minMaxRefined, refinedSeries, scaleMapWasChanged)
		{
		}

		private MinMaxValues ValidateRange(MinMaxValues values)
		{
			if (values.IsEmpty || (values.Min == 0.0 && values.Max == 0.0))
			{
				return new MinMaxValues(0.0, 1.0);
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(values.Min))
			{
				values.Min = values.Max;
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(values.Max))
			{
				values.Max = values.Min;
			}
			if (ComparingUtils.CompareDoubles(values.Delta, 0.0, double.Epsilon) == 0)
			{
				values.Min -= DefaultSideMarginsValue.Min;
				values.Max += DefaultSideMarginsValue.Max;
			}
			return values;
		}

		protected override SideMarginCalculatorBase CreateSideMarginCalculator(IAxisData axis, bool autoCorrectMin, bool autoCorrectMax)
		{
			return new SideMarginLogarithmicCalculator(axis);
		}

		protected override InternalRange ApplySideMargins(MinMaxValues internalValues, MinMaxValues sideMargins, bool autoCorrectionMin, bool autoCorrectionMax)
		{
			MinMaxValues newValues = new MinMaxValues(internalValues.Min, internalValues.Max);
			if (sideMargins.Min > 0.0 || sideMargins.Max > 0.0)
			{
				newValues.Min = base.Transformation.TransformBackward(base.Transformation.TransformForward(internalValues.Min) - sideMargins.Min);
				newValues.Max = base.Transformation.TransformBackward(base.Transformation.TransformForward(internalValues.Max) + sideMargins.Max);
			}
			newValues = CheckZeroLevel(newValues, internalValues, autoCorrectionMin, autoCorrectionMax);
			newValues = ValidateRange(newValues);
			return new InternalRange(newValues, new MinMaxValues(internalValues.Min - newValues.Min, newValues.Max - internalValues.Max), new MinMaxValues(0.0));
		}

		protected override MinMaxValues GetInternalForNativeValues(MinMaxValues internalValues, MinMaxValues correctedInternalValues, IAxisRangeData range)
		{
			if (base.Axis.IsArgumentAxis || range.CorrectionMode == RangeCorrectionMode.Values || range.CorrectionMode == RangeCorrectionMode.InternalValues)
			{
				return internalValues;
			}
			return CheckZeroLevel(internalValues, internalValues, range.AutoCorrectMin, range.AutoCorrectMin);
		}
	}
	public class QualitativeAxisRangeUpdateStrategy : RangeUpdateStrategy
	{
		private static readonly NativeRange DefaultNativeRange = new NativeRange("Min", "Max");

		public QualitativeAxisRangeUpdateStrategy(IAxisData axis, MinMaxValues minMaxInternal, MinMaxValues minMaxRefined, ICollection<RefinedSeries> refinedSeries, bool scaleMapWasChanged)
			: base(axis, minMaxInternal, minMaxRefined, refinedSeries, scaleMapWasChanged)
		{
		}

		private bool IsValueObject(object value)
		{
			double num = base.Map.NativeToInternal(value);
			if (!double.IsNaN(num))
			{
				return num != -1.0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override InternalRange ApplySideMargins(MinMaxValues internalValues, MinMaxValues sideMargins, bool autoCorrectionMin, bool autoCorrectionMax)
		{
			InternalRange internalRange = base.ApplySideMargins(internalValues, sideMargins, autoCorrectionMin, autoCorrectionMax);
			if (internalRange.Delta == 0.0)
			{
				return new InternalRange(new MinMaxValues(internalValues.Min - DefaultSideMarginsValue.Min, internalValues.Max + DefaultSideMarginsValue.Max), DefaultSideMarginsValue);
			}
			return internalRange;
		}

		protected override NativeRange GetNativeValues(MinMaxValues internalValues, MinMaxValues correctedInternalValues, IAxisRangeData range)
		{
			if ((!internalValues.HasValues && !correctedInternalValues.HasValues) || (internalValues.Min == internalValues.Max && range.CorrectionMode == RangeCorrectionMode.Auto))
			{
				return DefaultNativeRange;
			}
			object min;
			object max;
			switch (range.CorrectionMode)
			{
			default:
				min = (double.IsNaN(internalValues.Min) ? range.MinValue : base.Map.InternalToNative(internalValues.Min));
				max = (double.IsNaN(internalValues.Max) ? range.MaxValue : base.Map.InternalToNative(internalValues.Max));
				break;
			case RangeCorrectionMode.Values:
				min = (range.AutoCorrectMin ? base.Map.InternalToNative(internalValues.Min) : range.MinValue);
				max = (range.AutoCorrectMax ? base.Map.InternalToNative(internalValues.Max) : range.MaxValue);
				break;
			case RangeCorrectionMode.InternalValues:
				min = (IsValueObject(range.MinValue) ? range.MinValue : base.Map.InternalToNative(internalValues.Min));
				max = (IsValueObject(range.MaxValue) ? range.MaxValue : base.Map.InternalToNative(internalValues.Max));
				break;
			}
			return new NativeRange(min, max);
		}

		protected override RangeSnapshot DefaultRange(IAxisRangeData range)
		{
			NativeRange defaultNativeRange = DefaultNativeRange;
			InternalRange internalRange = new InternalRange(new MinMaxValues(0.0, 1.0), new MinMaxValues(0.0, 0.0), new MinMaxValues(range.ActualStartSideMargin, range.ActualEndSideMargin));
			return new RangeSnapshot(defaultNativeRange, internalRange, default(MinMaxValues), range.SideMarginSizeUnit);
		}

		protected override bool IncorrectRelationBetweenMinAndMax(MinMaxValues internalValues)
		{
			return internalValues.Max <= internalValues.Min;
		}

		protected override InternalRange CheckInternalValue(IAxisRangeData range, MinMaxValues internalValues)
		{
			double num = (double.IsNaN(internalValues.Min) ? internalValues.Max : internalValues.Min);
			double num2 = (double.IsNaN(internalValues.Max) ? internalValues.Min : internalValues.Max);
			num -= range.SideMargins.Min;
			num2 += range.SideMargins.Max;
			return new InternalRange(new MinMaxValues(num, num2), range.SideMargins, new MinMaxValues(range.ActualStartSideMargin, range.ActualEndSideMargin));
		}

		protected override MinMaxValues ConvertValuesToInternalValues(IAxisRangeData range, MinMaxValues defaultMinMax)
		{
			MinMaxValues result = base.ConvertValuesToInternalValues(range, defaultMinMax);
			if (double.IsNaN(result.Min) || result.Min == -1.0)
			{
				result.Min = base.MinMaxFromSeries.Min;
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(result.Max) || result.Max == -1.0)
			{
				result.Max = base.MinMaxFromSeries.Max;
			}
			return result;
		}
	}
	public class RangeUpdateEnqueuer
	{
		private class AxesGroup
		{
			private readonly List<IAxisData> axes;

			public IAxisData PrimaryAxis => axes[0];

			public List<IAxisData> SecondaryAxes
			{
				get
				{
					if (axes.Count <= 1)
					{
						return new List<IAxisData>();
					}
					return axes.GetRange(1, axes.Count - 1);
				}
			}

			public List<IAxisData> Axes => axes;

			public bool Auto
			{
				get
				{
					foreach (IAxisData axis in axes)
					{
						if (axis.VisualRange.CorrectionMode != RangeCorrectionMode.Auto || axis.WholeRange.CorrectionMode != RangeCorrectionMode.Auto)
						{
							return false;
						}
					}
					return true;
				}
			}

			public bool IsUpdated { get; set; }

			public AxesGroup(IAxisData primaryAxis)
			{
				axes = new List<IAxisData> { primaryAxis };
			}
		}

		private class RangeNonDependentUpdater
		{
			private readonly Dictionary<IAxisData, RefinedSeriesGroup> refinedSeriesGroups;

			private readonly VisualRangeUpdateMode visualRangeUpdateMode;

			private readonly List<IAxisData> axesForReset;

			public RangeNonDependentUpdater(Dictionary<IAxisData, RefinedSeriesGroup> refinedSeriesGroups, VisualRangeUpdateMode visualRangeUpdateMode, List<IAxisData> axesForReset)
			{
				this.refinedSeriesGroups = refinedSeriesGroups;
				this.visualRangeUpdateMode = visualRangeUpdateMode;
				this.axesForReset = axesForReset;
			}

			private IMinMaxValues CalculateSecondaryAxesRange(IAxisData primaryAxis, IAxisData secondaryAxis)
			{
				double num = (primaryAxis.VisualRange.Min - primaryAxis.WholeRange.Min) / primaryAxis.WholeRange.Delta;
				double num2 = (primaryAxis.VisualRange.Max - primaryAxis.WholeRange.Min) / primaryAxis.WholeRange.Delta;
				double num3 = secondaryAxis.WholeRange.Delta * num;
				double num4 = secondaryAxis.WholeRange.Delta * num2;
				double min = secondaryAxis.WholeRange.Min + num3;
				double max = secondaryAxis.WholeRange.Min + num4;
				return new MinMaxValues(min, max);
			}

			private void Update(IAxisData axis)
			{
				MinMaxValues internalValues = GetInternalValues(axis);
				UpdateRange(axis, internalValues);
			}

			protected void CorrectSecondaryAxis(IAxisData primaryAxis, IAxisData secondaryAxis)
			{
				if (primaryAxis.VisualRange.CorrectionMode != RangeCorrectionMode.Auto && secondaryAxis.VisualRange.CorrectionMode != RangeCorrectionMode.Values)
				{
					IMinMaxValues minMaxValues = CalculateSecondaryAxesRange(primaryAxis, secondaryAxis);
					AxisScaleTypeMap axisScaleTypeMap = secondaryAxis.AxisScaleTypeMap;
					secondaryAxis.VisualRange.UpdateRange(axisScaleTypeMap.InternalToNative(minMaxValues.Min), axisScaleTypeMap.InternalToNative(minMaxValues.Max), minMaxValues.Min, minMaxValues.Max);
					RangeHelper.ThrowRangeData(secondaryAxis, secondaryAxis.WholeRange, secondaryAxis.ScrollingRange);
					RangeHelper.ThrowRangeData(secondaryAxis, secondaryAxis.VisualRange, secondaryAxis.Range);
				}
			}

			protected RefinedSeriesGroup GetRefinedSeriesGroup(IAxisData axis)
			{
				if (!refinedSeriesGroups.ContainsKey(axis))
				{
					return null;
				}
				return refinedSeriesGroups[axis];
			}

			protected MinMaxValues GetInternalValues(IAxisData axis)
			{
				return GetRefinedSeriesGroup(axis)?.GetMinMaxValuesFromSeries() ?? new MinMaxValues(double.NaN);
			}

			protected void UpdateRange(IAxisData axis, MinMaxValues minMaxInternalValues)
			{
				RefinedSeriesGroup refinedSeriesGroup = GetRefinedSeriesGroup(axis);
				MinMaxValues minMaxRefined = refinedSeriesGroup?.GetMinMaxRefined() ?? new MinMaxValues(double.NaN);
				ICollection<RefinedSeries> refinedSeries = refinedSeriesGroup?.RefinedSeries;
				RangeUpdateStrategy.UpdateRange(axis, minMaxInternalValues, minMaxRefined, refinedSeries, visualRangeUpdateMode, axesForReset.Contains(axis));
			}

			public void UpdateGroup(AxesGroup group)
			{
				if (group == null || group.IsUpdated)
				{
					return;
				}
				IAxisData primaryAxis = group.PrimaryAxis;
				Update(primaryAxis);
				foreach (IAxisData secondaryAxis in group.SecondaryAxes)
				{
					Update(secondaryAxis);
					if (!secondaryAxis.IsUpdating)
					{
						CorrectSecondaryAxis(primaryAxis, secondaryAxis);
					}
				}
				group.IsUpdated = true;
			}
		}

		private class RangeDependentUpdater : RangeNonDependentUpdater
		{
			public RangeDependentUpdater(Dictionary<IAxisData, RefinedSeriesGroup> refinedSeriesGroups, VisualRangeUpdateMode visualRangeUpdateMode, List<IAxisData> axesForReset)
				: base(refinedSeriesGroups, visualRangeUpdateMode, axesForReset)
			{
			}

			private MinMaxValues GetMinMaxByFilteredPoints(RefinedSeriesGroup followerGroup, IAxisData leader)
			{
				RefinedSeriesGroup refinedSeriesGroup = GetRefinedSeriesGroup(leader);
				if (refinedSeriesGroup != null && followerGroup != null)
				{
					return followerGroup.GetMinMaxValuesFromSeries(leader.VisualRange, refinedSeriesGroup.RefinedSeries);
				}
				return MinMaxValues.Empty;
			}

			private MinMaxValues GetInternalValues(IAxisData axis, IEnumerable<IAxisData> leaders)
			{
				RefinedSeriesGroup refinedSeriesGroup = GetRefinedSeriesGroup(axis);
				MinMaxValues result = MinMaxValues.Empty;
				foreach (IAxisData leader in leaders)
				{
					result = result.Union(GetMinMaxByFilteredPoints(refinedSeriesGroup, leader));
				}
				if (result.HasValues)
				{
					return result;
				}
				return GetInternalValues(axis);
			}

			private void Update(IAxisData axis, IEnumerable<IAxisData> leaders)
			{
				MinMaxValues internalValues = GetInternalValues(axis, leaders);
				UpdateRange(axis, internalValues);
			}

			public void UpdateGroup(AxesGroup group, IEnumerable<IAxisData> leaderAxes)
			{
				if (group == null || group.IsUpdated)
				{
					return;
				}
				IAxisData primaryAxis = group.PrimaryAxis;
				Update(primaryAxis, leaderAxes);
				foreach (IAxisData secondaryAxis in group.SecondaryAxes)
				{
					Update(secondaryAxis, leaderAxes);
					if (!secondaryAxis.IsUpdating)
					{
						CorrectSecondaryAxis(primaryAxis, secondaryAxis);
					}
				}
				group.IsUpdated = true;
			}
		}

		private readonly Dictionary<IAxisData, RefinedSeriesGroup> refinedSeriesGroups;

		private readonly VisualRangeUpdateMode visualRangeUpdateMode;

		private readonly List<IAxisData> axesForReset;

		private readonly List<IPaneAxesContainer> containers;

		public static void Update(RefinedSeriesGroupController groupController, VisualRangeUpdateMode visualRangeUpdateMode, IXYDiagram diagram, IList<RefinedSeries> activeSeries, List<IAxisData> axesForReset)
		{
			if (diagram == null || diagram.AxisX == null || diagram.AxisY == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Dictionary<IAxisData, RefinedSeriesGroup> dictionary = new Dictionary<IAxisData, RefinedSeriesGroup>();
			foreach (RefinedSeriesGroup value in groupController.RefinedSeriesGroups.Values)
			{
				IAxisData axisData = value.GroupKey.AxisData;
				if (axisData != null)
				{
					dictionary.Add(axisData, value);
				}
			}
			List<IPaneAxesContainer> paneAxesContainers = diagram.GetPaneAxesContainers(activeSeries);
			RangeUpdateEnqueuer rangeUpdateEnqueuer = new RangeUpdateEnqueuer(dictionary, visualRangeUpdateMode, paneAxesContainers, axesForReset);
			Dictionary<IAxisData, AxesGroup> dictionary2 = rangeUpdateEnqueuer.CreateUpdateGroups();
			rangeUpdateEnqueuer.UpdateGroups(dictionary2, isAutoGroups: false);
			if (diagram.DependentValueRange && diagram.UseRangeDependentEnqueuer)
			{
				rangeUpdateEnqueuer.UpdateDependentGroups(dictionary2);
			}
			rangeUpdateEnqueuer.UpdateGroups(dictionary2, isAutoGroups: true);
			foreach (IAxisData key in dictionary2.Keys)
			{
				key.IsUpdating = false;
			}
		}

		private RangeUpdateEnqueuer(Dictionary<IAxisData, RefinedSeriesGroup> refinedSeriesGroups, VisualRangeUpdateMode visualRangeUpdateMode, List<IPaneAxesContainer> containers, List<IAxisData> axesForReset)
		{
			this.visualRangeUpdateMode = visualRangeUpdateMode;
			this.refinedSeriesGroups = refinedSeriesGroups;
			this.containers = containers;
			this.axesForReset = ((axesForReset != null) ? axesForReset : new List<IAxisData>());
		}

		private void AddGroup(Dictionary<IAxisData, AxesGroup> groups, IAxisData pAxis, IList<IAxisData> sAxes, HashSet<IAxisData> addedAxes)
		{
			if (!groups.TryGetValue(pAxis, out var value))
			{
				value = new AxesGroup(pAxis);
				groups.Add(pAxis, value);
				addedAxes.Add(pAxis);
			}
			foreach (IAxisData sAxis in sAxes)
			{
				if (!addedAxes.Contains(sAxis))
				{
					addedAxes.Add(sAxis);
					value.Axes.Add(sAxis);
				}
			}
		}

		private Dictionary<IAxisData, AxesGroup> CreateUpdateGroups()
		{
			Dictionary<IAxisData, AxesGroup> dictionary = new Dictionary<IAxisData, AxesGroup>();
			HashSet<IAxisData> hashSet = new HashSet<IAxisData>();
			foreach (PaneAxesContainer container in containers)
			{
				foreach (AxisContainer axisContainer in container.AxisContainers)
				{
					AddGroup(dictionary, axisContainer.PrimaryAxis, axisContainer.SecondaryAxes, hashSet);
				}
			}
			foreach (RefinedSeriesGroup value in refinedSeriesGroups.Values)
			{
				IAxisData axisData = value.GroupKey.AxisData;
				if (!hashSet.Contains(axisData))
				{
					AddGroup(dictionary, axisData, new List<IAxisData>(), hashSet);
				}
			}
			return dictionary;
		}

		private void UpdateGroups(Dictionary<IAxisData, AxesGroup> groups, bool isAutoGroups)
		{
			RangeNonDependentUpdater rangeNonDependentUpdater = new RangeNonDependentUpdater(refinedSeriesGroups, visualRangeUpdateMode, axesForReset);
			foreach (AxesGroup value in groups.Values)
			{
				if (value.Auto == isAutoGroups)
				{
					rangeNonDependentUpdater.UpdateGroup(value);
				}
			}
		}

		private Dictionary<IAxisData, HashSet<IAxisData>> GetDependentAxes(Dictionary<IAxisData, AxesGroup> groups)
		{
			Dictionary<IAxisData, HashSet<IAxisData>> dictionary = new Dictionary<IAxisData, HashSet<IAxisData>>();
			foreach (PaneAxesContainer container in containers)
			{
				AxesGroup axesGroup = groups[container.PrimaryAxisX];
				AxesGroup axesGroup2 = groups[container.PrimaryAxisY];
				bool auto = axesGroup.Auto;
				if (auto ^ axesGroup2.Auto)
				{
					IAxisData key = (auto ? container.PrimaryAxisX : container.PrimaryAxisY);
					IList<IAxisData> list = (auto ? axesGroup2.Axes : axesGroup.Axes);
					if (dictionary.TryGetValue(key, out var value))
					{
						value.UnionWith(list);
					}
					else
					{
						dictionary.Add(key, new HashSet<IAxisData>(list));
					}
				}
			}
			return dictionary;
		}

		private void UpdateDependentGroups(Dictionary<IAxisData, AxesGroup> groups)
		{
			Dictionary<IAxisData, HashSet<IAxisData>> dependentAxes = GetDependentAxes(groups);
			RangeDependentUpdater rangeDependentUpdater = new RangeDependentUpdater(refinedSeriesGroups, visualRangeUpdateMode, axesForReset);
			foreach (KeyValuePair<IAxisData, HashSet<IAxisData>> item in dependentAxes)
			{
				rangeDependentUpdater.UpdateGroup(groups[item.Key], item.Value);
			}
		}
	}
	public enum VisualRangeUpdateMode
	{
		Default,
		ProportionalFromWholeRange
	}
	public abstract class RangeUpdateStrategy
	{
		protected readonly MinMaxValues DefaultSideMarginsValue = new MinMaxValues(0.5);

		private readonly IAxisData axis;

		private readonly MinMaxValues minMaxInternal;

		private readonly MinMaxValues minMaxRefined;

		private readonly ICollection<RefinedSeries> refinedSeries;

		private readonly bool scaleMapWasChanged;

		protected IAxisData Axis => axis;

		protected IVisualAxisRangeData VisualRange => axis.VisualRange;

		protected IWholeAxisRangeData WholeRange => axis.WholeRange;

		protected AxisScaleTypeMap Map => axis.AxisScaleTypeMap;

		protected bool ShowZeroLevel
		{
			get
			{
				if (!axis.IsArgumentAxis)
				{
					return axis.WholeRange.AlwaysShowZeroLevel;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected MinMaxValues MinMaxFromSeries => minMaxInternal;

		protected Transformation Transformation => Axis.AxisScaleTypeMap.Transformation;

		public static void UpdateRange(IAxisData axis, MinMaxValues minMaxInternal, MinMaxValues minMaxRefined, ICollection<RefinedSeries> refinedSeries, VisualRangeUpdateMode updateMode, bool scaleMapWasChanged)
		{
			RangeUpdateStrategy rangeUpdateStrategy;
			switch (axis.AxisScaleTypeMap.ScaleType)
			{
			default:
				return;
			case ActualScaleTypeCore.Numerical:
				rangeUpdateStrategy = ((!axis.AxisScaleTypeMap.Transformation.IsIdentity) ? new NumericalLogarithmicAxisRangeUpdateStrategy(axis, minMaxInternal, minMaxRefined, refinedSeries, scaleMapWasChanged) : new NumericalAxisRangeUpdateStrategy(axis, minMaxInternal, minMaxRefined, refinedSeries, scaleMapWasChanged));
				break;
			case ActualScaleTypeCore.DateTime:
				rangeUpdateStrategy = new DatetimeAxisRangeUpdateStrategy(axis, minMaxInternal, minMaxRefined, refinedSeries, scaleMapWasChanged);
				break;
			case ActualScaleTypeCore.TimeSpan:
				rangeUpdateStrategy = new TimeSpanAxisRangeUpdateStrategy(axis, minMaxInternal, minMaxRefined, refinedSeries, scaleMapWasChanged);
				break;
			case ActualScaleTypeCore.Qualitative:
				rangeUpdateStrategy = new QualitativeAxisRangeUpdateStrategy(axis, minMaxInternal, minMaxRefined, refinedSeries, scaleMapWasChanged);
				break;
			}
			rangeUpdateStrategy.UpdateRange(updateMode);
		}

		protected RangeUpdateStrategy(IAxisData axis, MinMaxValues minMaxInternal, MinMaxValues minMaxRefined, ICollection<RefinedSeries> refinedSeries, bool scaleMapWasChanged)
		{
			this.axis = axis;
			this.minMaxInternal = Validate(minMaxInternal);
			this.minMaxRefined = Validate(minMaxRefined);
			this.refinedSeries = refinedSeries;
			this.scaleMapWasChanged = scaleMapWasChanged;
		}

		private MinMaxValues Validate(MinMaxValues values)
		{
			if (double.IsInfinity(values.Delta))
			{
				return MinMaxValues.Empty;
			}
			double min = values.Min;
			bool flag = min != double.MaxValue && min != double.MinValue && !double.IsInfinity(min);
			double max = values.Max;
			bool flag2 = max != double.MaxValue && max != double.MinValue && !double.IsInfinity(max);
			if (flag && flag2)
			{
				return values;
			}
			return new MinMaxValues(flag ? min : double.NaN, flag2 ? max : double.NaN);
		}

		private void UpdateDataRange(VisualRangeUpdateMode updateMode)
		{
			if (WholeRange != null && VisualRange != null)
			{
				if (scaleMapWasChanged)
				{
					TryResetRange(WholeRange);
					TryResetRange(VisualRange);
				}
				MinMaxValues internalValuesForWholeRange = GetInternalValuesForWholeRange();
				internalValuesForWholeRange = NarrowToActualWholeRange(internalValuesForWholeRange, WholeRange);
				RangeSnapshot rangeSnapshot = CalculateWholeRangeStage(internalValuesForWholeRange, GetRefinedValues(WholeRange));
				RangeSnapshot rangeSnapshot2;
				if (VisualRange.CorrectionMode == RangeCorrectionMode.Auto)
				{
					rangeSnapshot2 = rangeSnapshot;
					VisualRange.AutoSideMargins = WholeRange.AutoSideMargins;
				}
				else
				{
					rangeSnapshot2 = CalculateVisualRangeStage(GetInternalValuesForVisualRange(updateMode, internalValuesForWholeRange), GetRefinedValues(VisualRange));
					rangeSnapshot2 = SynchronizeVisualRange(rangeSnapshot, rangeSnapshot2, updateMode);
				}
				rangeSnapshot?.ApplyState(WholeRange);
				rangeSnapshot2?.ApplyState(VisualRange);
			}
		}

		private void UpdateRange(VisualRangeUpdateMode updateMode)
		{
			if (Axis != null)
			{
				if (Axis.FixedRange)
				{
					RefreshInternalValues();
				}
				else
				{
					UpdateDataRange(updateMode);
				}
				if (Axis.ScrollingRange != null && Axis.Range != null)
				{
					RangeHelper.ThrowRangeData(Axis, Axis.WholeRange, Axis.ScrollingRange);
					RangeHelper.ThrowRangeData(Axis, Axis.VisualRange, Axis.Range);
				}
			}
		}

		private void RefreshInternalValues()
		{
			double internalMin = axis.AxisScaleTypeMap.NativeToInternal(VisualRange.MinValue);
			double internalMax = axis.AxisScaleTypeMap.NativeToInternal(VisualRange.MaxValue);
			VisualRange.UpdateRange(VisualRange.MinValue, VisualRange.MaxValue, internalMin, internalMax);
			internalMin = axis.AxisScaleTypeMap.NativeToInternal(WholeRange.MinValue);
			internalMax = axis.AxisScaleTypeMap.NativeToInternal(WholeRange.MaxValue);
			WholeRange.UpdateRange(WholeRange.MinValue, WholeRange.MaxValue, internalMin, internalMax);
		}

		private bool CanShowZeroLevel(MinMaxValues range)
		{
			if (!ShowZeroLevel)
			{
				return false;
			}
			double zeroLevel = GetZeroLevel(range);
			if (range.Min >= zeroLevel && WholeRange.AutoCorrectMin && VisualRange.AutoCorrectMin)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (range.Max <= zeroLevel && WholeRange.AutoCorrectMax && VisualRange.AutoCorrectMax)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool NeedCorrect(IAxisRangeData range)
		{
			if (range.CorrectionMode == RangeCorrectionMode.InternalValues)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!Axis.IsValueAxis)
			{
				return !Axis.IsRadarAxis;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool AutoSideMarginEnable(IAxisRangeData range)
		{
			if (range.AutoSideMargins != SideMarginMode.Enable)
			{
				return range.AutoSideMargins == SideMarginMode.UserEnable;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void TryResetRange(IAxisRangeData rangeData)
		{
			bool flag = !TryConvertNativeValue(rangeData, rangeData.MinValue);
			bool flag2 = !TryConvertNativeValue(rangeData, rangeData.MaxValue);
			if (flag || flag2)
			{
				rangeData.Reset(needUpdate: false, flag, flag2);
			}
		}

		private bool TryConvertNativeValue(IAxisRangeData rangeData, object value)
		{
			if (rangeData.CorrectionMode != RangeCorrectionMode.Values)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (value != null && !Map.TryNativeToInternal(value, out var _))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private RangeSnapshot SynchronizeVisualRange(RangeSnapshot wholeRangeNewState, RangeSnapshot visualRangeNewState, VisualRangeUpdateMode updateMode)
		{
			if (WholeRange.CorrectionMode != RangeCorrectionMode.Values)
			{
				bool flag = VisualRange.CorrectionMode == RangeCorrectionMode.InternalValues && updateMode == VisualRangeUpdateMode.ProportionalFromWholeRange && (wholeRangeNewState.Min != visualRangeNewState.Min || wholeRangeNewState.Max != visualRangeNewState.Max);
				bool flag2 = Axis.AutoScroll && VisualRange.Max == visualRangeNewState.Max && VisualRange.Min == visualRangeNewState.Min && Math.Abs(WholeRange.Max - VisualRange.Max) < WholeRange.Delta / 100.0 && WholeRange.Min != VisualRange.Min;
				if (flag)
				{
					visualRangeNewState = CorrectProportionalVisualRange(wholeRangeNewState.RefinedValues, visualRangeNewState.RefinedValues, visualRangeNewState.RefinedValues);
				}
				if (flag2)
				{
					visualRangeNewState = CorrectAutoScrollVisualRange(wholeRangeNewState, visualRangeNewState);
				}
			}
			visualRangeNewState = AdjustVisualRangeByWholeRange(visualRangeNewState, wholeRangeNewState, Axis.AutoScroll);
			return visualRangeNewState;
		}

		private RangeSnapshot AdjustVisualRangeByWholeRange(RangeSnapshot visualRangeSnapshot, RangeSnapshot wholeRangeSnapshot, bool stickToEdge)
		{
			bool isCorrected;
			RangeSnapshot visualRangeSnapshot2 = AdjustInternalValue(visualRangeSnapshot, wholeRangeSnapshot, stickToEdge, out isCorrected);
			return AdjustRefinedValue(visualRangeSnapshot2, wholeRangeSnapshot, isCorrected);
		}

		private RangeSnapshot AdjustInternalValue(RangeSnapshot visualRangeSnapshot, RangeSnapshot wholeRangeSnapshot, bool stickToEdge, out bool isCorrected)
		{
			object max = visualRangeSnapshot.MaxValue;
			object min = visualRangeSnapshot.MinValue;
			double num = visualRangeSnapshot.Min;
			double num2 = visualRangeSnapshot.Max;
			double min2 = visualRangeSnapshot.RefinedValues.Min;
			double max2 = visualRangeSnapshot.RefinedValues.Max;
			isCorrected = false;
			if (!wholeRangeSnapshot.InternalValues.InRange(num2))
			{
				max = wholeRangeSnapshot.MaxValue;
				num2 = wholeRangeSnapshot.Max;
				max2 = wholeRangeSnapshot.RefinedValues.Max;
				if (stickToEdge)
				{
					double num3 = wholeRangeSnapshot.Max - visualRangeSnapshot.InternalValues.Delta;
					double num4 = wholeRangeSnapshot.Max - visualRangeSnapshot.RefinedValues.Delta;
					if (!wholeRangeSnapshot.InternalValues.InRange(num3))
					{
						min = wholeRangeSnapshot.MinValue;
						num = wholeRangeSnapshot.Min;
						min2 = wholeRangeSnapshot.RefinedValues.Min;
					}
					else
					{
						min = Map.InternalToNative(num3);
						num = num3;
						min2 = num4;
					}
				}
				isCorrected = true;
			}
			if (!wholeRangeSnapshot.InternalValues.InRange(num))
			{
				min = wholeRangeSnapshot.MinValue;
				num = wholeRangeSnapshot.Min;
				min2 = wholeRangeSnapshot.RefinedValues.Min;
				if (stickToEdge)
				{
					double num5 = wholeRangeSnapshot.Min + visualRangeSnapshot.InternalValues.Delta;
					double num6 = wholeRangeSnapshot.Min + visualRangeSnapshot.RefinedValues.Delta;
					if (!wholeRangeSnapshot.InternalValues.InRange(num5))
					{
						max = wholeRangeSnapshot.MaxValue;
						num2 = wholeRangeSnapshot.Max;
						max2 = wholeRangeSnapshot.RefinedValues.Max;
					}
					else
					{
						max = Map.InternalToNative(num5);
						num2 = num5;
						max2 = num6;
					}
				}
				isCorrected = true;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			if (num == num2)
			{
				num2 = wholeRangeSnapshot.Max;
				num = wholeRangeSnapshot.Min;
				max2 = wholeRangeSnapshot.RefinedValues.Max;
				min2 = wholeRangeSnapshot.RefinedValues.Min;
				flag = true;
			}
			if (isCorrected || flag)
			{
				return new RangeSnapshot(internalValues: new MinMaxValues(num, num2), refinedValues: new MinMaxValues(min2, max2), range: new NativeRange(min, max), sideMargins: visualRangeSnapshot.SideMargins, sideMarginsValue: visualRangeSnapshot.SideMarginsValue, sideMarginSizeUnit: VisualRange.SideMarginSizeUnit);
			}
			if (wholeRangeSnapshot.InternalValues == visualRangeSnapshot.InternalValues && wholeRangeSnapshot.RefinedValues == visualRangeSnapshot.RefinedValues && (wholeRangeSnapshot.MaxValue != visualRangeSnapshot.MaxValue || wholeRangeSnapshot.MinValue != visualRangeSnapshot.MinValue))
			{
				return new RangeSnapshot(new NativeRange(wholeRangeSnapshot.MinValue, wholeRangeSnapshot.MaxValue), visualRangeSnapshot.InternalValues, visualRangeSnapshot.RefinedValues, visualRangeSnapshot.SideMargins, visualRangeSnapshot.SideMarginsValue, VisualRange.SideMarginSizeUnit);
			}
			return visualRangeSnapshot;
		}

		private RangeSnapshot AdjustRefinedValue(RangeSnapshot visualRangeSnapshot, RangeSnapshot wholeRangeSnapshot, bool isCorrectedInternalValue)
		{
			if (visualRangeSnapshot.RefinedValues.Delta < 0.0)
			{
				object maxValue = visualRangeSnapshot.MaxValue;
				object minValue = visualRangeSnapshot.MinValue;
				double min = visualRangeSnapshot.Min;
				double max = visualRangeSnapshot.Max;
				double min2 = visualRangeSnapshot.RefinedValues.Min;
				double max2 = visualRangeSnapshot.RefinedValues.Max;
				if (isCorrectedInternalValue)
				{
					maxValue = wholeRangeSnapshot.MaxValue;
					max = wholeRangeSnapshot.Max;
					max2 = wholeRangeSnapshot.RefinedValues.Max;
					minValue = wholeRangeSnapshot.MinValue;
					min = wholeRangeSnapshot.Min;
					min2 = wholeRangeSnapshot.RefinedValues.Min;
				}
				else
				{
					if (!wholeRangeSnapshot.RefinedValues.InRange(visualRangeSnapshot.RefinedValues.Max))
					{
						max2 = wholeRangeSnapshot.RefinedValues.Max;
					}
					if (!wholeRangeSnapshot.RefinedValues.InRange(visualRangeSnapshot.RefinedValues.Min))
					{
						min2 = wholeRangeSnapshot.RefinedValues.Min;
					}
				}
				return new RangeSnapshot(internalValues: new MinMaxValues(min, max), refinedValues: new MinMaxValues(min2, max2), range: new NativeRange(minValue, maxValue), sideMargins: visualRangeSnapshot.SideMargins, sideMarginsValue: visualRangeSnapshot.SideMarginsValue, sideMarginSizeUnit: VisualRange.SideMarginSizeUnit);
			}
			return visualRangeSnapshot;
		}

		private RangeSnapshot CorrectAutoScrollVisualRange(RangeSnapshot wholeRangeNewState, RangeSnapshot visualRangeNewState)
		{
			double num = wholeRangeNewState.Max - WholeRange.Max;
			if (num > 0.0)
			{
				double num2 = visualRangeNewState.Min + num;
				double max = wholeRangeNewState.Max;
				double num3 = wholeRangeNewState.RefinedValues.Max - WholeRange.RefinedMax;
				double min = visualRangeNewState.RefinedValues.Min + num3;
				double max2 = wholeRangeNewState.RefinedValues.Max;
				return new RangeSnapshot(InternalToNative(new MinMaxValues(num2 + VisualRange.SideMargins.Min, max - VisualRange.SideMargins.Max)), new InternalRange(new MinMaxValues(num2, max), new MinMaxValues(VisualRange.SideMargins), new MinMaxValues(VisualRange.ActualStartSideMargin, VisualRange.ActualEndSideMargin)), new MinMaxValues(min, max2), VisualRange.SideMarginSizeUnit);
			}
			return visualRangeNewState;
		}

		private RangeSnapshot CorrectProportionalVisualRange(IMinMaxValues wholeRangeNewState, IMinMaxValues visualRangeNewState, IMinMaxValues refinedValues)
		{
			IMinMaxValues minMaxValues2;
			if (!MinMaxValues.IsEmptyValue(VisualRange))
			{
				IMinMaxValues minMaxValues = new MinMaxValues(VisualRange.RefinedMin, VisualRange.RefinedMax);
				minMaxValues2 = minMaxValues;
			}
			else
			{
				minMaxValues2 = visualRangeNewState;
			}
			IMinMaxValues minMaxValues3 = minMaxValues2;
			double num = 0.0;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			double num3 = WholeRange.RefinedMax - WholeRange.RefinedMin;
			if (num3 > 0.0)
			{
				num = (minMaxValues3.Min - WholeRange.RefinedMin) / num3 * wholeRangeNewState.Delta;
				num2 = (minMaxValues3.Max - WholeRange.RefinedMin) / num3 * wholeRangeNewState.Delta;
			}
			double min;
			double max;
			if (Transformation.IsIdentity)
			{
				min = wholeRangeNewState.Min + num;
				max = wholeRangeNewState.Min + num2;
			}
			else
			{
				min = Math.Min(minMaxValues3.Min, wholeRangeNewState.Min + num);
				max = Math.Max(minMaxValues3.Max, wholeRangeNewState.Min + num2);
			}
			return new RangeSnapshot(RefinedToNative(min, max), RefinedToInternal(min, max, new MinMaxValues(0.0), new MinMaxValues(0.0)), refinedValues, VisualRange.SideMarginSizeUnit);
		}

		private MinMaxValues GetRefinedValues(IAxisRangeData range)
		{
			double min = (range.AutoCorrectMin ? minMaxRefined.Min : (scaleMapWasChanged ? Map.NativeToRefined(range.MinValue) : range.RefinedMin));
			double max = (range.AutoCorrectMax ? minMaxRefined.Max : (scaleMapWasChanged ? Map.NativeToRefined(range.MaxValue) : range.RefinedMax));
			return new MinMaxValues(min, max);
		}

		private MinMaxValues GetInternalValuesForWholeRange()
		{
			switch (WholeRange.CorrectionMode)
			{
			case RangeCorrectionMode.Auto:
				return minMaxInternal;
			case RangeCorrectionMode.InternalValues:
			{
				double num = double.NaN;
				double num2 = double.NaN;
				num = ((!WholeRange.AutoCorrectMin || !minMaxInternal.HasValues) ? ((!double.IsNaN(WholeRange.Min)) ? (WholeRange.Min + WholeRange.SideMargins.Min) : Map.NativeToInternal(WholeRange.MinValue)) : minMaxInternal.Min);
				num2 = ((!WholeRange.AutoCorrectMax || !minMaxInternal.HasValues) ? ((!double.IsNaN(WholeRange.Max)) ? (WholeRange.Max + WholeRange.SideMargins.Max) : Map.NativeToInternal(WholeRange.MaxValue)) : minMaxInternal.Max);
				return new MinMaxValues(num, num2);
			}
			default:
				return ConvertValuesToInternalValues(WholeRange, minMaxInternal);
			}
		}

		private MinMaxValues GetInternalValuesForVisualRange(VisualRangeUpdateMode updateMode, MinMaxValues defaultMinMax)
		{
			switch ((VisualRange.CorrectionMode == RangeCorrectionMode.Auto && (double.IsNaN(minMaxInternal.Max) || double.IsNaN(minMaxInternal.Min))) ? RangeCorrectionMode.Values : VisualRange.CorrectionMode)
			{
			case RangeCorrectionMode.Auto:
				return minMaxInternal;
			case RangeCorrectionMode.InternalValues:
			{
				double num = ((updateMode == VisualRangeUpdateMode.Default || VisualRange.MinValue == null) ? VisualRange.Min : Map.NativeToInternal(VisualRange.MinValue));
				double num2 = ((updateMode == VisualRangeUpdateMode.Default || VisualRange.MaxValue == null) ? VisualRange.Max : Map.NativeToInternal(VisualRange.MaxValue));
				return new MinMaxValues(num + VisualRange.SideMargins.Min, num2 - VisualRange.SideMargins.Max);
			}
			default:
				return ConvertValuesToInternalValues(VisualRange, defaultMinMax);
			}
		}

		private MinMaxValues AddSideMargins(MinMaxValues value, MinMaxValues sideMargins)
		{
			return new MinMaxValues(value.Min - sideMargins.Min, value.Max + sideMargins.Max);
		}

		private MinMaxValues ApplySideMargins(MinMaxValues values, MinMaxValues sideMargins)
		{
			if (sideMargins.Min != 0.0 && sideMargins.Max != 0.0)
			{
				return AddSideMargins(values, sideMargins);
			}
			return AddSideMargins(values, DefaultSideMarginsValue);
		}

		private InternalRange GetCorrectedInternalValues(IAxisRangeData range, MinMaxValues internalValues)
		{
			if (NeedCorrect(range))
			{
				return CorrectWithSideMargins(range, internalValues);
			}
			return CheckInternalValue(range, internalValues);
		}

		private InternalRange CorrectWithSideMargins(IAxisRangeData range, MinMaxValues internalValues)
		{
			MinMaxValues sideMargins = new MinMaxValues(range.ActualStartSideMargin, range.ActualEndSideMargin);
			if (AutoSideMarginEnable(range) || (IncorrectRelationBetweenMinAndMax(internalValues) && sideMargins.Min == 0.0 && sideMargins.Max == 0.0))
			{
				sideMargins = new MinMaxValues(CalcSideMargin(internalValues, range));
			}
			else if (range.SideMarginSizeUnit == SideMarginSizeUnitNative.AxisRangePercentage)
			{
				sideMargins = new MinMaxValues(sideMargins.Min / 100.0 * internalValues.Delta, sideMargins.Max / 100.0 * internalValues.Delta);
			}
			InternalRange internalRange = ApplySideMargins(internalValues, sideMargins, range.AutoCorrectMin, range.AutoCorrectMax);
			MinMaxValues sideMarginsValue = new MinMaxValues(range.ActualStartSideMargin, range.ActualEndSideMargin);
			if (AutoSideMarginEnable(range))
			{
				sideMarginsValue = ((range.SideMarginSizeUnit != SideMarginSizeUnitNative.AxisRangePercentage) ? internalRange.SideMarginsValue : new MinMaxValues(sideMargins.Min / internalValues.Delta * 100.0, sideMargins.Max / internalValues.Delta * 100.0));
			}
			return new InternalRange(internalRange.Values, internalRange.SideMargins, sideMarginsValue);
		}

		private double GetInternalValue(bool isAutoCorrection, double defaultInternalValue, double internalValue, object nativeValue, double margin)
		{
			if (isAutoCorrection)
			{
				if (double.IsNegativeInfinity(defaultInternalValue) || double.IsPositiveInfinity(defaultInternalValue))
				{
					return double.NaN;
				}
				return defaultInternalValue;
			}
			if (nativeValue == null)
			{
				return internalValue + margin;
			}
			return Map.NativeToInternal(nativeValue);
		}

		private double GetZeroLevel(MinMaxValues internalValues)
		{
			if (Axis.AxisScaleTypeMap.ScaleType == ActualScaleTypeCore.DateTime)
			{
				return internalValues.Min;
			}
			return 0.0;
		}

		private RangeSnapshot CalculateVisualRangeStage(MinMaxValues internalValues, MinMaxValues refinedValues)
		{
			if (!internalValues.HasValues)
			{
				return DefaultRange(VisualRange);
			}
			InternalRange correctedInternalValues = GetCorrectedInternalValues(VisualRange, internalValues);
			NativeRange nativeValues = GetNativeValues(internalValues, correctedInternalValues.Values, VisualRange);
			return new RangeSnapshot(nativeValues, correctedInternalValues, refinedValues, VisualRange.SideMarginSizeUnit);
		}

		private RangeSnapshot CalculateWholeRangeStage(MinMaxValues internalValues, MinMaxValues refinedValues)
		{
			if (!internalValues.HasValues)
			{
				return DefaultRange(WholeRange);
			}
			InternalRange correctedInternalValues = GetCorrectedInternalValues(WholeRange, internalValues);
			NativeRange nativeValues = GetNativeValues(internalValues, correctedInternalValues.Values, WholeRange);
			if (nativeValues.Min == null && nativeValues.Max == null)
			{
				return DefaultRange(WholeRange);
			}
			MinMaxValues minMaxValues = CorrectRefinedValuesByZeroLevel(refinedValues);
			return new RangeSnapshot(nativeValues, correctedInternalValues, minMaxValues, WholeRange.SideMarginSizeUnit);
		}

		private MinMaxValues CorrectRefinedValuesByZeroLevel(MinMaxValues refinedValues)
		{
			if (ShowZeroLevel)
			{
				double zeroLevel = GetZeroLevel(minMaxInternal);
				if (!double.IsNaN(zeroLevel))
				{
					double num = axis.AxisScaleTypeMap.InternalToRefined(zeroLevel);
					double num2 = refinedValues.Min;
					double num3 = refinedValues.Max;
					if (num2 > 0.0 && WholeRange.AutoCorrectMin)
					{
						num2 = num;
					}
					if (num3 < 0.0 && WholeRange.AutoCorrectMax)
					{
						num3 = num;
					}
					return new MinMaxValues(num2, num3);
				}
			}
			return refinedValues;
		}

		protected double CalcSideMargin(MinMaxValues internalValues, IAxisRangeData range)
		{
			SideMarginCalculatorBase sideMarginCalculatorBase = CreateSideMarginCalculator(Axis, range.AutoCorrectMin, range.AutoCorrectMax);
			return sideMarginCalculatorBase.CalcSideMargin(internalValues, refinedSeries);
		}

		protected virtual SideMarginCalculatorBase CreateSideMarginCalculator(IAxisData axis, bool autoCorrectMin, bool autoCorrectMax)
		{
			return new SideMarginCalculator(axis, axis as IAutoScaleBreaksContainer, autoCorrectMin, autoCorrectMax);
		}

		protected virtual MinMaxValues ConvertValuesToInternalValues(IAxisRangeData range, MinMaxValues defaultMinMax)
		{
			double min;
			double max;
			if (scaleMapWasChanged)
			{
				min = ((range.AutoCorrectMin || !Map.TryNativeToRefined(range.MinValue, out var result)) ? defaultMinMax.Min : Map.RefinedToInternalExact(result));
				max = ((range.AutoCorrectMax || !Map.TryNativeToRefined(range.MaxValue, out var result2)) ? defaultMinMax.Max : Map.RefinedToInternalExact(result2));
			}
			else
			{
				min = GetInternalValue(range.AutoCorrectMin, defaultMinMax.Min, range.Min, range.MinValue, range.SideMargins.Min);
				max = GetInternalValue(range.AutoCorrectMax, defaultMinMax.Max, range.Max, range.MaxValue, range.SideMargins.Max);
			}
			return new MinMaxValues(min, max);
		}

		protected virtual RangeSnapshot DefaultRange(IAxisRangeData range)
		{
			InternalRange internalRange = new InternalRange(new MinMaxValues(0.0, 1.0), new MinMaxValues(0.0), new MinMaxValues(range.ActualStartSideMargin, range.ActualEndSideMargin));
			return new RangeSnapshot(InternalToNative(new MinMaxValues(0.0, 1.0)), internalRange, default(MinMaxValues), range.SideMarginSizeUnit);
		}

		protected virtual InternalRange ApplySideMargins(MinMaxValues internalValues, MinMaxValues sideMargins, bool autoCorrectionMin, bool autoCorrectionMax)
		{
			if (double.IsNaN(internalValues.Min) && double.IsNaN(internalValues.Max))
			{
				return new InternalRange(new MinMaxValues(0.0, 1.0), new MinMaxValues(0.0));
			}
			MinMaxValues minMaxValues = new MinMaxValues(0.0);
			if (internalValues.Min < internalValues.Max)
			{
				minMaxValues = CheckZeroLevel(AddSideMargins(internalValues, sideMargins), internalValues, autoCorrectionMin, autoCorrectionMax);
			}
			else if (internalValues.Min == internalValues.Max)
			{
				minMaxValues = AddSideMargins(internalValues, sideMargins);
				if (minMaxValues.Min != 0.0)
				{
					minMaxValues = CheckZeroLevel(minMaxValues, internalValues, autoCorrectionMin, autoCorrectionMax);
				}
				if (minMaxValues.Min == minMaxValues.Max)
				{
					minMaxValues = AddSideMargins(minMaxValues, DefaultSideMarginsValue);
				}
			}
			else if (internalValues.Min > internalValues.Max)
			{
				if (!autoCorrectionMin && autoCorrectionMax)
				{
					minMaxValues = new MinMaxValues(internalValues.Min);
				}
				else if (!autoCorrectionMax && autoCorrectionMin)
				{
					minMaxValues = new MinMaxValues(internalValues.Max);
				}
				else if (!autoCorrectionMin && !autoCorrectionMax)
				{
					minMaxValues = new MinMaxValues(internalValues.Max, internalValues.Min);
				}
				minMaxValues = ApplySideMargins(minMaxValues, sideMargins);
			}
			else if (double.IsNaN(internalValues.Min) || double.IsNaN(internalValues.Max))
			{
				if (double.IsNaN(internalValues.Min))
				{
					minMaxValues = new MinMaxValues(internalValues.Max);
				}
				else if (double.IsNaN(internalValues.Max))
				{
					minMaxValues = new MinMaxValues(internalValues.Min);
				}
				minMaxValues = ApplySideMargins(minMaxValues, sideMargins);
			}
			return new InternalRange(minMaxValues, new MinMaxValues(internalValues.Min - minMaxValues.Min, minMaxValues.Max - internalValues.Max), sideMargins);
		}

		protected virtual bool IncorrectRelationBetweenMinAndMax(MinMaxValues internalValues)
		{
			if (internalValues.Max <= internalValues.Min)
			{
				return !CanShowZeroLevel(internalValues);
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected virtual MinMaxValues NarrowToActualWholeRange(MinMaxValues wholeRangeValues, IWholeAxisRangeData wholeRange)
		{
			return wholeRangeValues;
		}

		protected abstract NativeRange GetNativeValues(MinMaxValues internalValues, MinMaxValues correctedInternalValues, IAxisRangeData range);

		protected abstract InternalRange CheckInternalValue(IAxisRangeData range, MinMaxValues internalValues);

		protected NativeRange InternalToNative(MinMaxValues range)
		{
			object min = Map.InternalToNative(range.Min);
			object max = Map.InternalToNative(range.Max);
			return new NativeRange(min, max);
		}

		protected NativeRange RefinedToNative(double min, double max)
		{
			object min2 = Map.RefinedToNative(min);
			object max2 = Map.RefinedToNative(max);
			return new NativeRange(min2, max2);
		}

		protected InternalRange RefinedToInternal(double min, double max, MinMaxValues sideMargins, MinMaxValues sideMarginsValue)
		{
			double min2 = Map.RefinedToInternal(min);
			double max2 = Map.RefinedToInternal(max);
			return new InternalRange(new MinMaxValues(min2, max2), sideMargins, sideMarginsValue);
		}

		protected MinMaxValues CheckZeroLevel(MinMaxValues newValues, MinMaxValues internalValues, bool autoCorrectionMin, bool autoCorrectionMax)
		{
			if (ShowZeroLevel)
			{
				double zeroLevel = GetZeroLevel(internalValues);
				if (internalValues.Min >= zeroLevel && autoCorrectionMin && newValues.Max != 0.0)
				{
					newValues.Min = zeroLevel;
				}
				if (internalValues.Max <= zeroLevel && autoCorrectionMax && newValues.Min != 0.0)
				{
					newValues.Max = zeroLevel;
				}
			}
			return newValues;
		}
	}
	public class RangeSnapshot
	{
		private NativeRange nativeMinMaxValues;

		private MinMaxValues internalValues;

		private MinMaxValues refinedValues;

		private readonly MinMaxValues sideMargins;

		private readonly MinMaxValues sideMarginsValue;

		private SideMarginSizeUnitNative sideMarginSizeUnit;

		public object MinValue => nativeMinMaxValues.Min;

		public object MaxValue => nativeMinMaxValues.Max;

		public double Min => internalValues.Min;

		public double Max => internalValues.Max;

		public MinMaxValues RefinedValues => refinedValues;

		public MinMaxValues InternalValues => internalValues;

		public MinMaxValues SideMargins => sideMargins;

		public MinMaxValues SideMarginsValue => sideMarginsValue;

		public RangeSnapshot(IAxisRangeData range)
		{
			nativeMinMaxValues = new NativeRange(range.MinValue, range.MaxValue);
			internalValues = new MinMaxValues(range.Min, range.Max);
			sideMargins = new MinMaxValues(range.SideMargins.Min, range.SideMargins.Max);
			refinedValues = new MinMaxValues(range.RefinedMin, range.RefinedMax);
			sideMarginsValue = new MinMaxValues(range.ActualStartSideMargin, range.ActualEndSideMargin);
			sideMarginSizeUnit = range.SideMarginSizeUnit;
		}

		public RangeSnapshot(NativeRange range, InternalRange internalRange, IMinMaxValues refinedValues, SideMarginSizeUnitNative sideMarginSizeUnit)
		{
			nativeMinMaxValues = range;
			internalValues = new MinMaxValues(internalRange.Values.Min, internalRange.Values.Max);
			sideMargins = new MinMaxValues(internalRange.SideMargins.Min, internalRange.SideMargins.Max);
			this.refinedValues = new MinMaxValues(refinedValues.Min, refinedValues.Max);
			sideMarginsValue = internalRange.SideMarginsValue;
			this.sideMarginSizeUnit = sideMarginSizeUnit;
		}

		public RangeSnapshot(NativeRange range, MinMaxValues internalValues, MinMaxValues refinedValues, MinMaxValues sideMargins, MinMaxValues sideMarginsValue, SideMarginSizeUnitNative sideMarginSizeUnit)
		{
			nativeMinMaxValues = range;
			this.internalValues = internalValues;
			this.refinedValues = refinedValues;
			this.sideMargins = sideMargins;
			this.sideMarginsValue = sideMarginsValue;
			this.sideMarginSizeUnit = sideMarginSizeUnit;
		}

		public bool IsSame(RangeSnapshot range)
		{
			if (range == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (((nativeMinMaxValues.Min == null) ^ (range.nativeMinMaxValues.Min == null)) || ((nativeMinMaxValues.Max == null) ^ (range.nativeMinMaxValues.Max == null)))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (nativeMinMaxValues.Min != null && range.nativeMinMaxValues.Min != null && nativeMinMaxValues.Max != null && range.nativeMinMaxValues.Max != null)
			{
				if (range.nativeMinMaxValues.Min.Equals(nativeMinMaxValues.Min) && range.nativeMinMaxValues.Max.Equals(nativeMinMaxValues.Max))
				{
					return range.internalValues == internalValues;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return range.internalValues == internalValues;
		}

		public void ApplyState(IAxisRangeData range)
		{
			range.SideMargins = sideMargins;
			range.ActualStartSideMargin = sideMarginsValue.Min;
			range.ActualEndSideMargin = sideMarginsValue.Max;
			range.UpdateRange(nativeMinMaxValues.Min, nativeMinMaxValues.Max, internalValues.Min, internalValues.Max);
			range.RefinedMax = refinedValues.Max;
			range.RefinedMin = refinedValues.Min;
			range.SideMarginSizeUnit = sideMarginSizeUnit;
		}
	}
	public struct NativeRange
	{
		private object min;

		private object max;

		public object Min => min;
