		public object Max => max;

		public NativeRange(object min, object max)
		{
			this.min = min;
			this.max = max;
		}
	}
	public class InternalRange
	{
		private readonly MinMaxValues values;

		private readonly MinMaxValues sideMargins;

		private readonly MinMaxValues sideMarginsValue;

		public double Delta => values.Delta;

		public MinMaxValues SideMarginsValue => sideMarginsValue;

		public MinMaxValues Values => values;

		public MinMaxValues SideMargins => sideMargins;

		public InternalRange(MinMaxValues values, MinMaxValues sideMarginsValue)
			: this(values, sideMarginsValue, sideMarginsValue)
		{
		}

		public InternalRange(MinMaxValues values, MinMaxValues sideMargins, MinMaxValues sideMarginsValue)
		{
			this.values = values;
			this.sideMargins = sideMargins;
			this.sideMarginsValue = sideMarginsValue;
		}
	}
	public abstract class SideMarginCalculatorBase
	{
		internal const double DefaultSideMarginValue = 0.5;

		protected const int ArgumentSideFactor = 15;

		protected const int ValueSideFactor = 10;

		private readonly IAxisData axis;

		protected IAxisData Axis => axis;

		protected ActualScaleTypeCore ScaleType => axis.AxisScaleTypeMap.ScaleType;

		protected bool ShowZeroLevel
		{
			get
			{
				if (!axis.IsArgumentAxis && axis.WholeRange.AlwaysShowZeroLevel)
				{
					return axis.VisualRange.AlwaysShowZeroLevel;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected abstract bool AutoCorrectMin { get; }

		protected abstract bool AutoCorrectMax { get; }

		protected SideMarginCalculatorBase(IAxisData axis)
		{
			this.axis = axis;
		}

		private double GetZeroLevel(IMinMaxValues internalValues)
		{
			if (axis.AxisScaleTypeMap.ScaleType == ActualScaleTypeCore.DateTime)
			{
				return internalValues.Min;
			}
			return 0.0;
		}

		protected double GetAxisSideMargin(IMinMaxValues range, int scaleFactor, bool isNotZero)
		{
			double num = range.Max - range.Min;
			if (isNotZero && num == 0.0)
			{
				num = Math.Abs(range.Max);
			}
			return num / (double)scaleFactor;
		}

		protected double CalcSideMarginForBubble(IMinMaxValues range, IRefinedSeries series)
		{
			ISeriesView seriesView = ((series.Series != null) ? series.SeriesView : null);
			if (seriesView is IXYWSeriesView iXYWSeriesView)
			{
				return 0.5 * iXYWSeriesView.GetSideMargins(Axis.AxisGroup, range.Min, range.Max);
			}
			return 0.0;
		}

		protected virtual IMinMaxValues CorrectInternalValues(IMinMaxValues internalValues)
		{
			if (!ShowZeroLevel)
			{
				return internalValues;
			}
			double zeroLevel = GetZeroLevel(internalValues);
			double min = (AutoCorrectMin ? Math.Min(internalValues.Min, zeroLevel) : internalValues.Min);
			double max = (AutoCorrectMax ? Math.Max(internalValues.Max, zeroLevel) : internalValues.Max);
			return new MinMaxValues(min, max);
		}

		protected abstract bool ValidateInternalValues(IMinMaxValues correctedValues);

		protected abstract double CalculateSideMarginCore(IMinMaxValues correctedValues, IEnumerable<IRefinedSeries> refinedSeries);

		protected abstract bool IsOverflow(IMinMaxValues correctedValues, double sideMargin);

		protected abstract double CalcOverflowedSideMargin(IMinMaxValues correctedValues, double sideMargin);

		public double CalcSideMargin(IMinMaxValues internalValues, IEnumerable<IRefinedSeries> refinedSeries)
		{
			IMinMaxValues correctedValues = CorrectInternalValues(internalValues);
			if (!ValidateInternalValues(correctedValues))
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			double num = CalculateSideMarginCore(correctedValues, refinedSeries);
			if (IsOverflow(correctedValues, num))
			{
				num = CalcOverflowedSideMargin(correctedValues, num);
			}
			return num;
		}
	}
	public class SideMarginCalculator : SideMarginCalculatorBase
	{
		private readonly bool autoCorrectMin;

		private readonly bool autoCorrectMax;

		private readonly IAutoScaleBreaksContainer autoScaleBreaksContainer;

		protected override bool AutoCorrectMin => autoCorrectMin;

		protected override bool AutoCorrectMax => autoCorrectMax;

		public SideMarginCalculator(IAxisData axis, IAutoScaleBreaksContainer autoScaleBreaksContainer, bool autoCorrectMin, bool autoCorrectMax)
			: base(axis)
		{
			this.autoCorrectMin = autoCorrectMin;
			this.autoCorrectMax = autoCorrectMax;
			this.autoScaleBreaksContainer = autoScaleBreaksContainer;
		}

		private double GetBarWidthCorrection(IRefinedSeries series)
		{
			ISeriesView seriesView = ((series.Series != null) ? series.SeriesView : null);
			if (seriesView is IXYZBarSeriesView iXYZBarSeriesView && base.Axis.AxisGroup == AxisGroup.ArgumentY)
			{
				return iXYZBarSeriesView.BarDepth / 2.0;
			}
			if (seriesView is IBarSeriesView barSeriesView)
			{
				return barSeriesView.BarWidth / 2.0;
			}
			return 0.0;
		}

		private double GetSideMargin(IMinMaxValues range, IEnumerable<IRefinedSeries> refinedSeries)
		{
			if (refinedSeries == null)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			double num = 0.0;
			foreach (IRefinedSeries item in refinedSeries)
			{
				if (item.Points.Count != 0)
				{
					double val = ((!base.Axis.IsValueAxis) ? GetBarWidthCorrection(item) : 0.0);
					double val2 = CalcSideMarginForBubble(range, item);
					num = Math.Max(num, Math.Max(val2, val));
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		private double GetSideMarginByView(IMinMaxValues viewRange, IEnumerable<IRefinedSeries> refinedSeries)
		{
			double sideMargin = GetSideMargin(viewRange, refinedSeries);
			if (base.Axis.IsValueAxis)
			{
				return Math.Max(sideMargin, viewRange.Delta * 0.01);
			}
			if (sideMargin != 0.0)
			{
				return Math.Max(sideMargin, 0.5);
			}
			return 0.0;
		}

		private double GetSideMarginByRange(IMinMaxValues values)
		{
			if (base.Axis.IsValueAxis)
			{
				return GetAxisSideMargin(values, 10, isNotZero: true);
			}
			if (base.ScaleType != ActualScaleTypeCore.Qualitative)
			{
				return GetAxisSideMargin(values, 15, isNotZero: false);
			}
			return 0.0;
		}

		private double GetSideMarginByRangeList(IMinMaxValues range, IList<IMinMaxValues> rangeLimitsList)
		{
			if (rangeLimitsList == null)
			{
				return GetSideMarginByRange(range);
			}
			double num = 0.0;
			foreach (IMinMaxValues rangeLimits in rangeLimitsList)
			{
				num += GetSideMarginByRange(rangeLimits);
			}
			return num;
		}

		private IMinMaxValues GetViewRange(IMinMaxValues range, IList<IMinMaxValues> rangeLimitsList)
		{
			if (rangeLimitsList == null || rangeLimitsList.Count == 0)
			{
				return range;
			}
			return rangeLimitsList[0];
		}

		protected override bool ValidateInternalValues(IMinMaxValues internalValues)
		{
			if (!double.IsNaN(internalValues.Min))
			{
				return !double.IsNaN(internalValues.Max);
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override double CalculateSideMarginCore(IMinMaxValues range, IEnumerable<IRefinedSeries> refinedSeries)
		{
			IList<IMinMaxValues> rangeLimitsList = CalculateIntervals(range);
			IMinMaxValues viewRange = GetViewRange(range, rangeLimitsList);
			double sideMarginByView = GetSideMarginByView(viewRange, refinedSeries);
			double sideMarginByRangeList = GetSideMarginByRangeList(range, rangeLimitsList);
			double num = Math.Max(sideMarginByView, sideMarginByRangeList);
			if (base.Axis.IsArgumentAxis)
			{
				if (base.ScaleType == ActualScaleTypeCore.Numerical && range.Min != range.Max)
				{
					return num;
				}
				return Math.Max(num, 0.5);
			}
			if (num != 0.0)
			{
				return num;
			}
			return 0.5;
		}

		private IList<IMinMaxValues> CalculateIntervals(IMinMaxValues range)
		{
			if (!base.Axis.ShouldCalculateRangeLimits)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new AxisIntervalsGenerator(base.Axis, autoScaleBreaksContainer, range).GenerateIntervalLimits();
		}

		protected override double CalcOverflowedSideMargin(IMinMaxValues internalValues, double sideMargin)
		{
			if (!double.IsInfinity(sideMargin))
			{
				return Math.Abs(internalValues.Max) * 1E-05;
			}
			double val = internalValues.Min - double.MinValue;
			double val2 = double.MaxValue - internalValues.Max;
			return Math.Min(val, val2);
		}

		protected override bool IsOverflow(IMinMaxValues internalValues, double sideMargin)
		{
			if (!double.IsInfinity(sideMargin) && internalValues.Min + sideMargin != internalValues.Min)
			{
				return internalValues.Max + sideMargin == internalValues.Max;
			}
			return true;
		}
	}
	public class SideMarginLogarithmicCalculator : SideMarginCalculatorBase
	{
		protected ITransformation Transformation => base.Axis.AxisScaleTypeMap.Transformation;

		protected override bool AutoCorrectMin => true;

		protected override bool AutoCorrectMax => true;

		public SideMarginLogarithmicCalculator(IAxisData axis)
			: base(axis)
		{
		}

		private IMinMaxValues TransformRange(IMinMaxValues range)
		{
			double min = Transformation.TransformForward(range.Min);
			double max = Transformation.TransformForward(range.Max);
			return new MinMaxValues(min, max);
		}

		private double GetSideMarginByViews(IMinMaxValues range, IEnumerable<IRefinedSeries> refinedSeries)
		{
			if (refinedSeries == null)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			double num = 0.0;
			foreach (IRefinedSeries item in refinedSeries)
			{
				if (item.Points.Count != 0)
				{
					double val = CalcSideMarginForBubble(range, item);
					num = Math.Max(num, val);
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		protected override IMinMaxValues CorrectInternalValues(IMinMaxValues internalValues)
		{
			IMinMaxValues range = base.CorrectInternalValues(internalValues);
			return TransformRange(range);
		}

		protected override bool ValidateInternalValues(IMinMaxValues internalValues)
		{
			return true;
		}

		protected override double CalculateSideMarginCore(IMinMaxValues internalValues, IEnumerable<IRefinedSeries> refinedSeries)
		{
			double sideMarginByViews = GetSideMarginByViews(internalValues, refinedSeries);
			int scaleFactor = (base.Axis.IsArgumentAxis ? 15 : 10);
			double axisSideMargin = GetAxisSideMargin(internalValues, scaleFactor, isNotZero: true);
			axisSideMargin = Math.Max(sideMarginByViews, axisSideMargin);
			if (axisSideMargin != 0.0)
			{
				return axisSideMargin;
			}
			return 1.0;
		}

		protected override bool IsOverflow(IMinMaxValues internalValues, double sideMargin)
		{
			if (!double.IsNegativeInfinity(Transformation.TransformBackward(internalValues.Min - sideMargin)))
			{
				return double.IsPositiveInfinity(Transformation.TransformBackward(internalValues.Max + sideMargin));
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override double CalcOverflowedSideMargin(IMinMaxValues internalValues, double sideMargin)
		{
			double num = Transformation.TransformForward(double.MinValue);
			double num2 = Transformation.TransformForward(double.MaxValue);
			double val = internalValues.Min - num;
			double val2 = num2 - internalValues.Max;
			return Math.Min(sideMargin, Math.Min(val, val2));
		}
	}
	public class RefinedSeriesGroupKey
	{
		private readonly IAxisData axisData;

		public IAxisData AxisData => axisData;

		public bool IsSeriesGroupKey => axisData == null;

		public static bool operator ==(RefinedSeriesGroupKey a, RefinedSeriesGroupKey b)
		{
			return object.Equals(a, b);
		}

		public static bool operator !=(RefinedSeriesGroupKey a, RefinedSeriesGroupKey b)
		{
			return !object.Equals(a, b);
		}

		public RefinedSeriesGroupKey(RefinedSeries series, AxisGroup axisGroup)
		{
			IXYSeriesView view = series.SeriesView as IXYSeriesView;
			axisData = GetAxisByGroup(view, axisGroup);
		}

		private IAxisData GetAxisByGroup(IXYSeriesView view, AxisGroup axisGroup)
		{
			if (view == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return axisGroup switch
			{
				AxisGroup.ArgumentX => view.AxisXData, 
				AxisGroup.ArgumentY => view.AxisZData, 
				_ => view.AxisYData, 
			};
		}

		public RefinedSeriesGroupKey(IAxisData axisData)
		{
			this.axisData = axisData;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			return Equals(obj as RefinedSeriesGroupKey);
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return HashCodeHelper.CalculateGeneric<IAxisData>(axisData);
		}

		public bool Equals(RefinedSeriesGroupKey key)
		{
			if (key != null)
			{
				if (axisData == null)
				{
					return base.Equals(key);
				}
				return axisData == key.axisData;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	public abstract class RefinedSeriesGroup
	{
		private readonly RefinedSeriesGroupKey groupKey;

		private readonly List<RefinedSeries> refinedSeries = new List<RefinedSeries>();

		private readonly HashSet<RefinedSeries> hiddenRefinedSeries = new HashSet<RefinedSeries>();

		private AxisScaleTypeMap scaleMap;

		private SeriesGroupArgumentIntervalsContainer argumentIntervalsContainer;

		internal bool IsEmpty => refinedSeries.Count == 0;

		internal ICollection<RefinedSeries> RefinedSeries => refinedSeries;

		public AxisScaleTypeMap ScaleMap => scaleMap;

		public RefinedSeriesGroupKey GroupKey => groupKey;

		public bool ShouldUpdateInternalArguments => argumentIntervalsContainer.ShouldUpdateDependentData;

		internal RefinedSeriesGroup(RefinedSeriesGroupKey groupKey)
		{
			this.groupKey = groupKey;
			argumentIntervalsContainer = new SeriesGroupArgumentIntervalsContainer(this);
		}

		private void BindScaleMapToAxis()
		{
			if (groupKey.AxisData != null)
			{
				if (scaleMap != null)
				{
					scaleMap.BuildTransformation(groupKey.AxisData);
				}
				groupKey.AxisData.AxisScaleTypeMap = scaleMap;
			}
		}

		private bool ShouldRecreateScaleMap(RefinedSeries mainSeries)
		{
			//IL_0095: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_009b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00a9: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			ActualScaleTypeCore scaleType = GetScaleType(mainSeries);
			if (scaleMap == null || scaleType != scaleMap.ScaleType)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (scaleMap.ScaleType == ActualScaleTypeCore.Qualitative)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (scaleMap.ScaleType == ActualScaleTypeCore.Numerical)
			{
				return GetNumericalMeasureUnit() != ((AxisNumericalMap)scaleMap).MeasureUnit;
			}
			if (scaleMap.ScaleType == ActualScaleTypeCore.DateTime)
			{
				AxisDateTimeMap axisDateTimeMap = scaleMap as AxisDateTimeMap;
				if (GetDateTimeMeasureUnit() == axisDateTimeMap.MeasureUnit && !argumentIntervalsContainer.NeedRecreate(axisDateTimeMap.MeasureUnit, axisDateTimeMap.MeasureUnitMultiplier))
				{
					return NeedUpdateContinuesAxisY();
				}
				return true;
			}
			if (scaleMap.ScaleType == ActualScaleTypeCore.TimeSpan)
			{
				return GetTimeSpanMeasureUnit() != ((AxisTimeSpanMap)scaleMap).MeasureUnit;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool ShouldRecalculateScaleMap()
		{
			if (scaleMap.ScaleType == ActualScaleTypeCore.DateTime)
			{
				return argumentIntervalsContainer.NeedRecalculate();
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void RecalculateScaleMap()
		{
			//IL_0016: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (scaleMap is AxisDateTimeMap axisDateTimeMap)
			{
				List<DoubleLimits> argumentsWithoutGaps = argumentIntervalsContainer.GetArgumentsWithoutGaps(axisDateTimeMap.MeasureUnit, axisDateTimeMap.MeasureUnitMultiplier);
				scaleMap.UpdateArgumentsWithoutGaps(argumentsWithoutGaps);
			}
		}

		private double GetMinAbsValueFromAxisElements(IAxisElementContainer elementContainer)
		{
			double num = double.MaxValue;
			AxisScaleTypeMap axisScaleTypeMap = scaleMap;
			if (axisScaleTypeMap == null)
			{
				return num;
			}
			if (elementContainer.Strips != null)
			{
				foreach (IStrip strip in elementContainer.Strips)
				{
					if (strip.Visible)
					{
						num = CheckMin(num, axisScaleTypeMap.NativeToRefined(strip.MinLimit.AxisValue));
						num = CheckMin(num, axisScaleTypeMap.NativeToRefined(strip.MaxLimit.AxisValue));
					}
				}
			}
			if (elementContainer.ScaleBreaks != null)
			{
				foreach (IScaleBreak scaleBreak in elementContainer.ScaleBreaks)
				{
					if (scaleBreak.Visible)
					{
						num = CheckMin(num, axisScaleTypeMap.NativeToRefined(scaleBreak.Edge1.AxisValue));
						num = CheckMin(num, axisScaleTypeMap.NativeToRefined(scaleBreak.Edge2.AxisValue));
					}
				}
			}
			if (elementContainer.ConstantLines != null)
			{
				foreach (IConstantLine constantLine in elementContainer.ConstantLines)
				{
					if (constantLine.Visible)
					{
						num = CheckMin(num, axisScaleTypeMap.NativeToRefined(constantLine.AxisValue));
					}
				}
			}
			if (elementContainer.CustomLabels != null)
			{
				foreach (ICustomAxisLabel customLabel in elementContainer.CustomLabels)
				{
					if (customLabel.Visible)
					{
						num = CheckMin(num, axisScaleTypeMap.NativeToRefined(customLabel.AxisValue));
					}
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		private double CheckMin(double min, double value)
		{
			if (value != 0.0)
			{
				return Math.Min(min, Math.Abs(value));
			}
			return min;
		}

		private double? GetNumericalMeasureUnit()
		{
			if (groupKey.AxisData != null && groupKey.AxisData.NumericScaleOptions.ScaleMode != ScaleModeNative.Continuous)
			{
				return groupKey.AxisData.NumericScaleOptions.MeasureUnit;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private DateTimeMeasureUnitNative GetDateTimeMeasureUnit()
		{
			//IL_0035: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (groupKey.AxisData == null || groupKey.AxisData.DateTimeScaleOptions.ScaleMode == ScaleModeNative.Continuous)
			{
				return (DateTimeMeasureUnitNative)0;
			}
			return groupKey.AxisData.DateTimeScaleOptions.MeasureUnit;
		}

		private TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative GetTimeSpanMeasureUnit()
		{
			if (groupKey.AxisData != null && groupKey.AxisData.TimeSpanScaleOptions.ScaleMode != ScaleModeNative.Continuous)
			{
				return groupKey.AxisData.TimeSpanScaleOptions.MeasureUnit;
			}
			return TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative.Millisecond;
		}

		private int GetDateTimeMeasureUnitMultiplier()
		{
			if (groupKey.AxisData != null && groupKey.AxisData.DateTimeScaleOptions.ScaleMode != ScaleModeNative.Continuous)
			{
				return groupKey.AxisData.DateTimeScaleOptions.MeasureUnitMultiplier;
			}
			return 1;
		}

		private int GetTimeSpanMeasureUnitMultiplier()
		{
			if (groupKey.AxisData != null && groupKey.AxisData.TimeSpanScaleOptions.ScaleMode != ScaleModeNative.Continuous)
			{
				return groupKey.AxisData.TimeSpanScaleOptions.MeasureUnitMultiplier;
			}
			return 1;
		}

		private bool NeedUpdateContinuesAxisY()
		{
			if (groupKey.AxisData != null && groupKey.AxisData.IsValueAxis)
			{
				AxisDateTimeMap axisDateTimeMap = (AxisDateTimeMap)scaleMap;
				bool workdaysOnly = groupKey.AxisData.DateTimeScaleOptions.WorkdaysOptions.WorkdaysOnly;
				bool workTimeOnly = groupKey.AxisData.DateTimeScaleOptions.WorkTimeRules.WorkTimeOnly;
				if (!(workdaysOnly || axisDateTimeMap.WorkdaysOptions != null || workTimeOnly))
				{
					return axisDateTimeMap.InitialWorkTimeRules != null;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private AxisNumericalMap CreateNumericalMap()
		{
			if (groupKey.AxisData != null && groupKey.AxisData.NumericScaleOptions.ScaleMode == ScaleModeNative.Interval)
			{
				AggregationIntervalsInfo aggregationIntervalsInfo = groupKey.AxisData.NumericScaleOptions.AggregationIntervalsInfo;
				if (aggregationIntervalsInfo != null && aggregationIntervalsInfo.IsValid)
				{
					return new AxisNumericalIntervalsMap(aggregationIntervalsInfo, groupKey.AxisData);
				}
			}
			double? numericalMeasureUnit = GetNumericalMeasureUnit();
			if (!numericalMeasureUnit.HasValue)
			{
				return new AxisNumericalMap();
			}
			return new AxisNumericalMap(numericalMeasureUnit.Value);
		}

		private AxisDateTimeMap CreateDateTimeMap()
		{
			//IL_0072: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0077: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0085: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0121: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_010c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00ea: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00c8: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (groupKey.AxisData == null)
			{
				return new AxisDateTimeMap();
			}
			IDateTimeScaleOptions dateTimeScaleOptions = groupKey.AxisData.DateTimeScaleOptions;
			if (dateTimeScaleOptions.ScaleMode == ScaleModeNative.Continuous)
			{
				if (!groupKey.AxisData.IsValueAxis || (!dateTimeScaleOptions.WorkdaysOptions.WorkdaysOnly && !dateTimeScaleOptions.WorkTimeRules.WorkTimeOnly))
				{
					return new AxisDateTimeMap();
				}
				return new AxisDateTimeMap(dateTimeScaleOptions.WorkdaysOptions, dateTimeScaleOptions.WorkTimeRules);
			}
			DateTimeMeasureUnitNative dateTimeMeasureUnit = GetDateTimeMeasureUnit();
			int dateTimeMeasureUnitMultiplier = GetDateTimeMeasureUnitMultiplier();
			List<DoubleLimits> argumentsWithoutGaps = argumentIntervalsContainer.GetArgumentsWithoutGaps(dateTimeMeasureUnit, dateTimeMeasureUnitMultiplier);
			if (dateTimeScaleOptions.ScaleMode == ScaleModeNative.Interval)
			{
				AggregationIntervalsInfo aggregationIntervalsInfo = groupKey.AxisData.DateTimeScaleOptions.AggregationIntervalsInfo;
				if (aggregationIntervalsInfo != null && aggregationIntervalsInfo.IsValid)
				{
					if (argumentsWithoutGaps != null)
					{
						return new AxisDateTimeIntervalsWithoutGapsMap(groupKey.AxisData, dateTimeMeasureUnit, dateTimeMeasureUnitMultiplier, dateTimeScaleOptions.WorkdaysOptions, dateTimeScaleOptions.WorkTimeRules, aggregationIntervalsInfo, argumentsWithoutGaps);
					}
					return new AxisDateTimeIntervalsMap(groupKey.AxisData, dateTimeMeasureUnit, dateTimeMeasureUnitMultiplier, dateTimeScaleOptions.WorkdaysOptions, dateTimeScaleOptions.WorkTimeRules, aggregationIntervalsInfo);
				}
			}
			if (argumentsWithoutGaps != null && argumentsWithoutGaps.Count > 0)
			{
				return new AxisDateTimeWithoutGapsMap(dateTimeMeasureUnit, dateTimeMeasureUnitMultiplier, dateTimeScaleOptions.WorkdaysOptions, dateTimeScaleOptions.WorkTimeRules, argumentsWithoutGaps);
			}
			return new AxisDateTimeMap(dateTimeMeasureUnit, dateTimeMeasureUnitMultiplier, dateTimeScaleOptions.WorkdaysOptions, dateTimeScaleOptions.WorkTimeRules);
		}

		private AxisTimeSpanMap CreateTimeSpanMap()
		{
			if (groupKey.AxisData == null || groupKey.AxisData.TimeSpanScaleOptions.ScaleMode == ScaleModeNative.Continuous)
			{
				return new AxisTimeSpanMap();
			}
			TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative timeSpanMeasureUnit = GetTimeSpanMeasureUnit();
			int timeSpanMeasureUnitMultiplier = GetTimeSpanMeasureUnitMultiplier();
			if (groupKey.AxisData.TimeSpanScaleOptions.ScaleMode == ScaleModeNative.Interval)
			{
				AggregationIntervalsInfo aggregationIntervalsInfo = groupKey.AxisData.TimeSpanScaleOptions.AggregationIntervalsInfo;
				if (aggregationIntervalsInfo != null && aggregationIntervalsInfo.IsValid)
				{
					return new AxisTimeSpanIntervalsMap(groupKey.AxisData, timeSpanMeasureUnit, timeSpanMeasureUnitMultiplier, aggregationIntervalsInfo);
				}
			}
			return new AxisTimeSpanMap(timeSpanMeasureUnit, timeSpanMeasureUnitMultiplier);
		}

		private AxisScaleTypeMap CreateScaleMap(RefinedSeries series)
		{
			if (series != null)
			{
				return CreateScaleMap((Scale)GetScaleType(series));
			}
			return null;
		}

		private RefinedSeries GetMainSeriesFromGroup(ICollection<RefinedSeries> seriesList)
		{
			RefinedSeries result = null;
			int num = int.MaxValue;
			foreach (RefinedSeries series in seriesList)
			{
				int activeIndex = series.ActiveIndex;
				if (num > activeIndex)
				{
					num = activeIndex;
					result = series;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private RefinedSeries FindMainSeries()
		{
			RefinedSeries mainSeriesFromGroup = GetMainSeriesFromGroup(refinedSeries);
			if (mainSeriesFromGroup != null)
			{
				return mainSeriesFromGroup;
			}
			return GetMainSeriesFromGroup(hiddenRefinedSeries);
		}

		private MinMaxValues GetMinMaxValues(IAxisData axisData)
		{
			MinMaxValues minMaxValuesFromSeries = GetMinMaxValuesFromSeries();
			MinMaxValues minMaxValuesFromAxisElements = GetMinMaxValuesFromAxisElements(axisData, axisData.AxisScaleTypeMap);
			double num = minMaxValuesFromSeries.Min;
			double num2 = minMaxValuesFromSeries.Max;
			if (minMaxValuesFromAxisElements.Min != 0.0)
			{
				num = Math.Min(num, minMaxValuesFromAxisElements.Min);
			}
			if (minMaxValuesFromAxisElements.Max != 0.0)
			{
				num2 = Math.Max(num2, minMaxValuesFromAxisElements.Max);
			}
			return new MinMaxValues(num, num2);
		}

		private MinMaxValues GetMinMaxValuesFromAxisElements(IAxisElementContainer elementContainer, IScaleMap map)
		{
			MinMaxValues minMaxValues = new MinMaxValues(double.MaxValue, double.MinValue);
			if (elementContainer.Strips != null)
			{
				foreach (IStrip strip in elementContainer.Strips)
				{
					if (strip.Visible)
					{
						minMaxValues.Union(map.NativeToInternal(strip.MinLimit.AxisValue));
						minMaxValues.Union(map.NativeToInternal(strip.MaxLimit.AxisValue));
					}
				}
			}
			if (elementContainer.ScaleBreaks != null)
			{
				foreach (IScaleBreak scaleBreak in elementContainer.ScaleBreaks)
				{
					if (scaleBreak.Visible)
					{
						minMaxValues = CheckAxisValueContainer(minMaxValues, scaleBreak.Edge1, map);
						minMaxValues = CheckAxisValueContainer(minMaxValues, scaleBreak.Edge2, map);
					}
				}
			}
			if (elementContainer.ConstantLines != null)
			{
				foreach (IConstantLine constantLine in elementContainer.ConstantLines)
				{
					if (constantLine.Visible)
					{
						minMaxValues = CheckAxisValueContainer(minMaxValues, constantLine, map);
					}
				}
			}
			if (elementContainer.CustomLabels != null)
			{
				foreach (ICustomAxisLabel customLabel in elementContainer.CustomLabels)
				{
					if (customLabel.Visible)
					{
						minMaxValues = CheckAxisValueContainer(minMaxValues, customLabel, map);
					}
				}
			}
			return minMaxValues;
		}

		private MinMaxValues CheckAxisValueContainer(MinMaxValues minMaxValues, IAxisValueContainer valueContainer, IScaleMap map)
		{
			if (valueContainer.IsEnabled)
			{
				double value = map.NativeToInternal(valueContainer.AxisValue);
				minMaxValues.Union(value);
			}
			return minMaxValues;
		}

		protected AxisScaleTypeMap CreateScaleMap(Scale scaleType)
		{
			return scaleType switch
			{
				Scale.DateTime => CreateDateTimeMap(), 
				Scale.Qualitative => CreateQualitativeMap(), 
				Scale.TimeSpan => CreateTimeSpanMap(), 
				_ => CreateNumericalMap(), 
			};
		}

		protected internal abstract ActualScaleTypeCore GetScaleType(RefinedSeries series);

		protected abstract AxisQualitativeMap CreateQualitativeMap();

		protected virtual AxisScaleTypeMap CreateDefaultScaleMap()
		{
			return CreateNumericalMap();
		}

		internal abstract MinMaxValues GetMinMaxRefined();

		internal abstract MinMaxValues GetMinMaxValuesFromSeries();

		internal abstract MinMaxValues GetMinMaxValuesFromSeries(IMinMaxValues rangeForFiltering, ICollection<RefinedSeries> seriesForFiltering);

		internal abstract double GetMinAbsValue();

		internal virtual void UpdateSideMarginsEnable()
		{
		}

		internal virtual void UpdateAxisData()
		{
			IAxisData axisData = GroupKey.AxisData;
			MinMaxValues minMaxValues = GetMinMaxValues(axisData);
			if (minMaxValues.HasValues && axisData.AxisScaleTypeMap is IPriorScaleMap)
			{
				((IPriorScaleMap)axisData.AxisScaleTypeMap).UpdateMin(minMaxValues.Min);
			}
		}

		internal void RemoveAllSeries()
		{
			refinedSeries.Clear();
			ScaleMapInvalidate();
			InvalidateArgumentIntervals();
		}

		internal void AddSeries(RefinedSeries series, bool visible)
		{
			if (visible && !refinedSeries.Contains(series))
			{
				int index = Math.Min(series.ActiveIndex, refinedSeries.Count);
				refinedSeries.Insert(index, series);
				hiddenRefinedSeries.Remove(series);
				InvalidateArgumentIntervals();
			}
			else
			{
				hiddenRefinedSeries.Add(series);
			}
		}

		internal void RemoveSeries(RefinedSeries series)
		{
			refinedSeries.Remove(series);
			hiddenRefinedSeries.Remove(series);
			InvalidateArgumentIntervals();
		}

		internal void UpdateTransformation()
		{
			if (GroupKey.AxisData == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			IAxisData axisData = GroupKey.AxisData;
			AxisScaleTypeMap axisScaleTypeMap = axisData.AxisScaleTypeMap;
			Transformation transformation = axisScaleTypeMap.Transformation;
			if (transformation.IsIdentity)
			{
				return;
			}
			transformation.Reset();
			MinMaxValues minMaxValues = GetMinMaxValues(axisData);
			if ((minMaxValues.Min > 0.0 && minMaxValues.Max > 0.0) || (minMaxValues.Min < 0.0 && minMaxValues.Max < 0.0) || (minMaxValues.Min == 0.0 && minMaxValues.Max == 1.0))
			{
				transformation.Update(axisScaleTypeMap.InternalToRefined(minMaxValues.Min));
				transformation.Update(axisScaleTypeMap.InternalToRefined(minMaxValues.Max));
			}
			else
			{
				double num = Math.Min(GetMinAbsValueFromAxisElements(axisData), GetMinAbsValue());
				if (double.MaxValue == num || double.MinValue == num)
				{
					num = 1.0;
				}
				transformation.Update(num);
			}
			transformation.Update(axisScaleTypeMap.NativeToRefined(axisData.WholeRange.MinValue));
			transformation.Update(axisScaleTypeMap.NativeToRefined(axisData.WholeRange.MaxValue));
			transformation.CompleteUpdate();
		}

		internal void UpdateScaleBreaks()
		{
			IAxisData axisData = GroupKey.AxisData;
			if (!(axisData is IAutoScaleBreaksContainer { Enabled: not false } autoScaleBreaksContainer))
			{
				return;
			}
			List<IRefinedSeries> list = new List<IRefinedSeries>(refinedSeries.Count);
			foreach (RefinedSeries item in refinedSeries)
			{
				list.Add(item);
			}
			ScaleDiapasonCalculator.UpdateAutomaticScaleBreaks(autoScaleBreaksContainer, axisData, list);
		}

		internal bool UpdateScaleMap(bool forceCreate, bool shouldRecalculateArgumentScale)
		{
			RefinedSeries refinedSeries = FindMainSeries();
			bool result = false;
			if (refinedSeries != null)
			{
				if (forceCreate || ShouldRecreateScaleMap(refinedSeries))
				{
					if (shouldRecalculateArgumentScale)
					{
						refinedSeries.Series.ResetDataSourceArgumentScaleType();
					}
					scaleMap = CreateScaleMap(refinedSeries);
					result = scaleMap != null;
				}
				else if (ShouldRecalculateScaleMap())
				{
					RecalculateScaleMap();
					result = true;
				}
			}
			else if (scaleMap == null || IsEmpty)
			{
				scaleMap = CreateDefaultScaleMap();
				result = true;
			}
			BindScaleMapToAxis();
			return result;
		}

		internal void ScaleMapInvalidate()
		{
			scaleMap = null;
		}

		internal void InvalidateArgumentIntervals()
		{
			argumentIntervalsContainer.Invalidate();
		}
	}
	public class RefinedSeriesGroupByValue : RefinedSeriesGroup
	{
		private readonly IMinMaxValuesCalculator minMaxCalculator;

		private readonly List<IAffectsAxisRange> indicators = new List<IAffectsAxisRange>();

		internal RefinedSeriesGroupByValue(RefinedSeriesGroupKey groupKey, IMinMaxValuesCalculator minMaxCalculator)
			: base(groupKey)
		{
			this.minMaxCalculator = minMaxCalculator;
		}

		protected internal override ActualScaleTypeCore GetScaleType(RefinedSeries series)
		{
			return series.ValueScaleType;
		}

		protected override AxisQualitativeMap CreateQualitativeMap()
		{
			AxisQualitativeMap axisQualitativeMap = new AxisQualitativeMap(new List<string>());
			foreach (RefinedSeries item in base.RefinedSeries)
			{
				item.PopulateValueAxisScaleMap(axisQualitativeMap);
			}
			return axisQualitativeMap;
		}

		internal override MinMaxValues GetMinMaxRefined()
		{
			MinMaxValues minMaxValuesFromSeries = GetMinMaxValuesFromSeries();
			if (!minMaxValuesFromSeries.HasValues)
			{
				return minMaxValuesFromSeries;
			}
			return new MinMaxValues(base.ScaleMap.InternalToRefinedExact(minMaxValuesFromSeries.Min), base.ScaleMap.InternalToRefinedExact(minMaxValuesFromSeries.Max));
		}

		internal override MinMaxValues GetMinMaxValuesFromSeries()
		{
			return minMaxCalculator.GetMinMaxValues(base.RefinedSeries, MinMaxValues.Empty, indicators);
		}

		internal override MinMaxValues GetMinMaxValuesFromSeries(IMinMaxValues rangeForFiltering, ICollection<RefinedSeries> seriesForFiltering)
		{
			if (seriesForFiltering == null)
			{
				return minMaxCalculator.GetMinMaxValues(base.RefinedSeries, rangeForFiltering, indicators);
			}
			List<RefinedSeries> list = new List<RefinedSeries>();
			foreach (RefinedSeries item in base.RefinedSeries)
			{
				if (seriesForFiltering.Contains(item))
				{
					list.Add(item);
				}
			}
			return minMaxCalculator.GetMinMaxValues(list, rangeForFiltering, indicators);
		}

		internal override double GetMinAbsValue()
		{
			return minMaxCalculator.GetMinAbsValue(base.RefinedSeries);
		}

		internal void AddIndicator(IAffectsAxisRange indicator)
		{
			indicators.Add(indicator);
		}

		internal void ClearIndicators()
		{
			indicators.Clear();
		}
	}
	public class RefinedSeriesGroupByArgument : RefinedSeriesGroup
	{
		private readonly ISeriesBase seriesTemplate;

		public static AxisQualitativeMap ProcessAxis(AxisQualitativeMap result, IAxisData axisElementContainer)
		{
			if (axisElementContainer != null)
			{
				if (axisElementContainer.ConstantLines != null)
				{
					foreach (IConstantLine constantLine in axisElementContainer.ConstantLines)
					{
						if (constantLine.IsEnabled)
						{
							object userValue = constantLine.UserValue;
							result.AddValue(userValue);
						}
					}
				}
				if (axisElementContainer.ScaleBreaks != null)
				{
					foreach (IScaleBreak scaleBreak in axisElementContainer.ScaleBreaks)
					{
						if (scaleBreak.Edge1.IsEnabled && scaleBreak.Edge2.IsEnabled)
						{
							object userValue = scaleBreak.Edge1.UserValue;
							result.AddValue(userValue);
							userValue = scaleBreak.Edge2.UserValue;
							result.AddValue(userValue);
						}
					}
				}
				if (axisElementContainer.CustomLabels != null)
				{
					foreach (ICustomAxisLabel customLabel in axisElementContainer.CustomLabels)
					{
						if (customLabel.IsEnabled)
						{
							object userValue = customLabel.UserValue;
							result.AddValue(userValue);
						}
					}
				}
				if (axisElementContainer.Strips != null)
				{
					foreach (IStrip strip in axisElementContainer.Strips)
					{
						if (strip.Visible)
						{
							if (strip.MinLimit.IsEnabled)
							{
								result.Insert(strip.MinLimit.UserValue);
							}
							if (strip.MaxLimit.IsEnabled)
							{
								result.AddValue(strip.MaxLimit.UserValue);
							}
						}
					}
				}
				result.SortValues(axisElementContainer.QualitativeScaleComparer);
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal RefinedSeriesGroupByArgument(RefinedSeriesGroupKey groupKey, ISeriesBase seriesTemplate = null)
			: base(groupKey)
		{
			this.seriesTemplate = seriesTemplate;
		}

		private bool HasFullStackedSeries(ICollection<RefinedSeries> refinedSeries)
		{
			foreach (RefinedSeries item in refinedSeries)
			{
				if (IsFullStackedSeries(item.SeriesView))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool IsFullStackedSeries(ISeriesView view)
		{
			Type pointInterfaceType = view.PointInterfaceType;
			return pointInterfaceType.Equals(typeof(IFullStackedPoint));
		}

		private bool CalcSideMarginsEnable()
		{
			if (base.RefinedSeries.Count == 0)
			{
				return true;
			}
			foreach (RefinedSeries item in base.RefinedSeries)
			{
				if (item.SeriesView is IXYSeriesView { SideMarginsEnabled: not false })
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool IsAutoMode(SideMarginMode mode)
		{
			if (mode != SideMarginMode.UserDisable)
			{
				return mode != SideMarginMode.UserEnable;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private MinMaxValues GetMinMaxByFilteredPoints(IMinMaxValues rangeForFiltering, ICollection<RefinedSeries> seriesList)
		{
			MinMaxValues result = new MinMaxValues(double.MaxValue, double.MinValue);
			MinMaxValues filter = new MinMaxValues(rangeForFiltering);
			foreach (RefinedSeries series in seriesList)
			{
				result = result.Union(FindFirstPoint(series, filter, 0, 1)).Union(FindFirstPoint(series, filter, series.FinalPointsSortedByArgument.Count - 1, -1));
			}
			return result;
		}

		private MinMaxValues FindFirstPoint(RefinedSeries series, MinMaxValues filter, int start, int increment)
		{
			int count = series.FinalPointsSortedByArgument.Count;
			int i = start;
			MinMaxValues result = MinMaxValues.Empty;
			for (; 0 <= i && i < count; i += increment)
			{
				if (!result.IsEmpty)
				{
					break;
				}
				result = Filter(i, series, filter);
			}
			return result;
		}

		private MinMaxValues Filter(int i, RefinedSeries series, MinMaxValues filter)
		{
			RefinedPoint refinedPoint = series.FinalPointsSortedByArgument[i];
			double refinedPointMax = series.SeriesView.GetRefinedPointMax(refinedPoint);
			double refinedPointMin = series.SeriesView.GetRefinedPointMin(refinedPoint);
			MinMaxValues minMaxValues = new MinMaxValues(refinedPointMin, refinedPointMax);
			if (MinMaxValues.Intersection(minMaxValues, filter).Delta >= 0.0 || refinedPoint.IsEmpty)
			{
				return new MinMaxValues(refinedPoint.Argument);
			}
			return MinMaxValues.Empty;
		}

		private void ProcessValueOptions(IWaterfallValueOptions valueOptions, AxisQualitativeMap qualitativeMap)
		{
			int num = 0;
			if (valueOptions.StartValue != 0.0 || !string.IsNullOrEmpty(valueOptions.StartLabel))
			{
				qualitativeMap.InsertOrReplace(valueOptions.StartLabel);
				num++;
			}
			IList<ISubtotal> sortedSubtotals = valueOptions.SortedSubtotals;
			if (sortedSubtotals != null && sortedSubtotals.Count > 0)
			{
				int uniqueValuesCount = qualitativeMap.UniqueValuesCount;
				for (int i = 0; i < sortedSubtotals.Count && sortedSubtotals[i].PointIndex < uniqueValuesCount; i++)
				{
					qualitativeMap.InsertOrReplace(sortedSubtotals[i].Label, sortedSubtotals[i].PointIndex + num++);
				}
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(valueOptions.TotalLabel))
			{
				qualitativeMap.InsertOrReplace(valueOptions.TotalLabel, qualitativeMap.UniqueValuesCount);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void ProcessPoints(RefinedSeries series, AxisQualitativeMap qualitativeMap)
		{
			series.PopulateArgumentAxisScaleMap(qualitativeMap);
		}

		protected internal override ActualScaleTypeCore GetScaleType(RefinedSeries series)
		{
			return series.ArgumentScaleType;
		}

		protected override AxisQualitativeMap CreateQualitativeMap()
		{
			AxisQualitativeMap axisQualitativeMap = new AxisQualitativeMap(new List<string>());
			List<RefinedSeries> list = new List<RefinedSeries>();
			IWaterfallValueOptions waterfallValueOptions = null;
			foreach (RefinedSeries item in base.RefinedSeries)
			{
				if (waterfallValueOptions == null && item.SeriesView is IWaterfallSeriesView)
				{
					waterfallValueOptions = ((IWaterfallSeriesView)item.SeriesView).ValueOptions;
				}
				if (!item.Series.ArePointsSorted)
				{
					list.Add(item);
				}
				else
				{
					ProcessPoints(item, axisQualitativeMap);
				}
			}
			foreach (RefinedSeries item2 in list)
			{
				ProcessPoints(item2, axisQualitativeMap);
			}
			if (waterfallValueOptions != null && waterfallValueOptions.ShouldUpdateScaleMap)
			{
				ProcessValueOptions(waterfallValueOptions, axisQualitativeMap);
			}
			IAxisData axisData = base.GroupKey.AxisData;
			return ProcessAxis(axisQualitativeMap, axisData);
		}

		protected override AxisScaleTypeMap CreateDefaultScaleMap()
		{
			if (seriesTemplate != null)
			{
				return CreateScaleMap(seriesTemplate.UserArgumentScaleType);
			}
			return base.CreateDefaultScaleMap();
		}

		internal override MinMaxValues GetMinMaxRefined()
		{
			double num = double.MaxValue;
			double num2 = double.MinValue;
			foreach (RefinedSeries item in base.RefinedSeries)
			{
				double minRefinedArgument = item.MinRefinedArgument;
				double maxRefinedArgument = item.MaxRefinedArgument;
				if (!double.IsNaN(minRefinedArgument) && !double.IsNaN(maxRefinedArgument))
				{
					num = Math.Min(num, minRefinedArgument);
					num2 = Math.Max(num2, maxRefinedArgument);
				}
			}
			if (GeometricUtils.IsValidDouble(num) && GeometricUtils.IsValidDouble(num2))
			{
				return new MinMaxValues(num, num2);
			}
			return MinMaxValues.Empty;
		}

		internal override MinMaxValues GetMinMaxValuesFromSeries()
		{
			return GetMinMaxValuesFromSeries(MinMaxValues.Empty, null);
		}

		internal override MinMaxValues GetMinMaxValuesFromSeries(IMinMaxValues rangeForFiltering, ICollection<RefinedSeries> seriesForFiltering)
		{
			ICollection<RefinedSeries> collection = new List<RefinedSeries>();
			if (seriesForFiltering != null)
			{
				foreach (RefinedSeries item in base.RefinedSeries)
				{
					if (seriesForFiltering.Contains(item))
					{
						collection.Add(item);
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				collection = base.RefinedSeries;
			}
			if (!MinMaxValues.IsEmptyValue(rangeForFiltering) && !HasFullStackedSeries(base.RefinedSeries))
			{
				return GetMinMaxByFilteredPoints(rangeForFiltering, collection);
			}
			MinMaxValues result = MinMaxValues.Empty;
			GeometryCalculator geometryCalculator = new GeometryCalculator();
			foreach (RefinedSeries item2 in collection)
			{
				if (!item2.ActualIsActive)
				{
					continue;
				}
				result.Union(item2.GetMinArgument(base.ScaleMap));
				result.Union(item2.GetMaxArgument(base.ScaleMap));
				if (!(item2.SeriesView is ISplineSeriesView { ShouldCorrectRanges: not false }))
				{
					continue;
				}
				IList<IGeometryStrip> list = geometryCalculator.CreateStrips(item2);
				foreach (IBezierStrip item3 in list)
				{
					MinMaxValues value = item3.CalculateMinMaxArguments();
					result = result.Union(value);
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal override double GetMinAbsValue()
		{
			double num = double.MaxValue;
			foreach (RefinedSeries item in base.RefinedSeries)
			{
				double minAbsArgument = item.GetMinAbsArgument();
				if (minAbsArgument > 0.0 && num > minAbsArgument)
				{
					num = minAbsArgument;
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		internal override void UpdateSideMarginsEnable()
		{
			if (base.GroupKey.AxisData == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag = CalcSideMarginsEnable();
			if (IsAutoMode(base.GroupKey.AxisData.VisualRange.AutoSideMargins))
			{
				base.GroupKey.AxisData.VisualRange.AutoSideMargins = ((!flag) ? SideMarginMode.Disable : SideMarginMode.Enable);
			}
			if (IsAutoMode(base.GroupKey.AxisData.WholeRange.AutoSideMargins))
			{
				base.GroupKey.AxisData.WholeRange.AutoSideMargins = ((!flag) ? SideMarginMode.Disable : SideMarginMode.Enable);
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				if (IsAutoMode(base.GroupKey.AxisData.VisualRange.AutoSideMargins))
				{
					base.GroupKey.AxisData.VisualRange.ActualStartSideMargin = 0.0;
					base.GroupKey.AxisData.VisualRange.ActualEndSideMargin = 0.0;
				}
				if (IsAutoMode(base.GroupKey.AxisData.WholeRange.AutoSideMargins))
				{
					base.GroupKey.AxisData.WholeRange.ActualStartSideMargin = 0.0;
					base.GroupKey.AxisData.WholeRange.ActualEndSideMargin = 0.0;
				}
			}
		}

		internal override void UpdateAxisData()
		{
			base.UpdateAxisData();
			CalculateFilteredIndexes();
		}

		internal void CalculateFilteredIndexes(bool allowResamplerUpdates = false)
		{
			foreach (RefinedSeries item in base.RefinedSeries)
			{
				IAxisData axisData = base.GroupKey.AxisData;
				if (axisData != null)
				{
					IMinMaxValues visualRange = axisData.VisualRange;
					double refinedMin = axisData.VisualRange.RefinedMin;
					double refinedMax = axisData.VisualRange.RefinedMax;
					IMinMaxValues refinedMinMax = new MinMaxValues(refinedMin, refinedMax);
					item.UpdateVisiblePointIndexes(visualRange, refinedMinMax, allowResamplerUpdates);
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public class RefinedSeriesGroupByArgument2 : RefinedSeriesGroupByArgument
	{
		internal RefinedSeriesGroupByArgument2(RefinedSeriesGroupKey groupKey)
			: base(groupKey)
		{
		}

		internal override MinMaxValues GetMinMaxRefined()
		{
			double num = double.MaxValue;
			double num2 = double.MinValue;
			foreach (RefinedSeries item in base.RefinedSeries)
			{
				foreach (RefinedPoint point in item.Points)
				{
					if (GeometricUtils.IsValidDouble(point.ArgumentY))
					{
						if (point.ArgumentY < num)
						{
							num = point.ArgumentY;
						}
						if (point.ArgumentY > num2)
						{
							num2 = point.ArgumentY;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return new MinMaxValues(num, num2);
		}

		internal override MinMaxValues GetMinMaxValuesFromSeries(IMinMaxValues rangeForFiltering, ICollection<RefinedSeries> seriesForFiltering)
		{
			ICollection<RefinedSeries> collection = base.RefinedSeries;
			MinMaxValues empty = MinMaxValues.Empty;
			foreach (RefinedSeries item in collection)
			{
				if (!item.ActualIsActive)
				{
					continue;
				}
				foreach (RefinedPoint finalPoint in item.FinalPoints)
				{
					if (!double.IsInfinity(finalPoint.ArgumentY))
					{
						empty.Union(finalPoint.ArgumentY);
					}
				}
			}
			return empty;
		}

		protected internal override ActualScaleTypeCore GetScaleType(RefinedSeries series)
		{
			return series.ArgumentScaleType2;
		}

		protected override void ProcessPoints(RefinedSeries series, AxisQualitativeMap qualitativeMap)
		{
			series.PopulateArgument2AxisScaleMap(qualitativeMap);
		}
	}
	public class SeriesGroupArgumentIntervalsContainer
	{
		private readonly RefinedSeriesGroup owner;

		private List<DoubleLimits> argumentsWithoutGaps;

		private bool isCalculated;

		private DateTimeMeasureUnitNative currentMeasureUnit;

		private int currentMeasureUnitMultiplier;

		private bool shouldUpdateDependentData;

		public bool ShouldUpdateDependentData
		{
			get
			{
				bool result = shouldUpdateDependentData;
				shouldUpdateDependentData = false;
				return result;
			}
		}

		public SeriesGroupArgumentIntervalsContainer(RefinedSeriesGroup group)
		{
			owner = group;
		}

		private void Recalculate(DateTimeMeasureUnitNative measureUnit, int measureUnitMultiplier)
		{
			//IL_000f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0010: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0098: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_009d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			isCalculated = false;
			argumentsWithoutGaps = null;
			currentMeasureUnit = measureUnit;
			currentMeasureUnitMultiplier = measureUnitMultiplier;
			if (owner.RefinedSeries.Count == 0 || !GetDateTimeSkipRangesWithoutPoints())
			{
				return;
			}
			List<List<DoubleLimits>> list = new List<List<DoubleLimits>>();
			foreach (RefinedSeries item in owner.RefinedSeries)
			{
				if (item.Points.Count != 0)
				{
					ArgumentsWithoutGapsInfo argumentsWithoutGapsInfo = item.ArgumentsWithoutGaps;
					if (argumentsWithoutGapsInfo == null || argumentsWithoutGapsInfo.ArgumentsWithoutGaps == null || argumentsWithoutGapsInfo.ArgumentsWithoutGaps.Count == 0 || !(argumentsWithoutGapsInfo.ScaleTypeMap is AxisDateTimeMap axisDateTimeMap) || axisDateTimeMap.MeasureUnit != measureUnit || axisDateTimeMap.MeasureUnitMultiplier != measureUnitMultiplier)
					{
						return;
					}
					list.Add(argumentsWithoutGapsInfo.ArgumentsWithoutGaps);
				}
			}
			argumentsWithoutGaps = LimitsCalculator.CalculateUnion(list).UnionResult;
			shouldUpdateDependentData = (isCalculated = argumentsWithoutGaps != null);
		}

		private bool GetDateTimeSkipRangesWithoutPoints()
		{
			IAxisData axisData = owner.GroupKey.AxisData;
			if (axisData != null && axisData.AxisScaleTypeMap != null && axisData.AxisScaleTypeMap.ScaleType == ActualScaleTypeCore.DateTime && axisData.DateTimeScaleOptions.ScaleMode != ScaleModeNative.Continuous)
			{
				return axisData.DateTimeScaleOptions.SkipRangesWithoutPoints;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool NeedRecreate(DateTimeMeasureUnitNative measureUnit, int measureUnitMultiplier)
		{
			//IL_0031: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0036: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (GetDateTimeSkipRangesWithoutPoints())
			{
				AxisScaleTypeMap axisScaleTypeMap = owner.GroupKey.AxisData?.AxisScaleTypeMap;
				if (axisScaleTypeMap != null && axisScaleTypeMap.SkipGaps && currentMeasureUnit == measureUnit)
				{
					return currentMeasureUnitMultiplier != measureUnitMultiplier;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return isCalculated;
		}

		public bool NeedRecalculate()
		{
			return GetDateTimeSkipRangesWithoutPoints() != isCalculated;
		}

		public List<DoubleLimits> GetArgumentsWithoutGaps(DateTimeMeasureUnitNative measureUnit, int measureUnitMultiplier)
		{
			//IL_0013: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0009: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (NeedRecalculate() || NeedRecreate(measureUnit, measureUnitMultiplier))
			{
				Recalculate(measureUnit, measureUnitMultiplier);
			}
			return argumentsWithoutGaps;
		}

		public void Invalidate()
		{
			isCalculated = false;
			argumentsWithoutGaps = null;
		}
	}

	public static class DataItemsHelper
	{
		public static readonly double DefaultNumericValue = double.NaN;

		public static readonly DateTime DefaultDateTimeValue = DateTime.MinValue;

		public static readonly TimeSpan DefaultTimeSpanValue = TimeSpan.Zero;

		public static readonly string DefaultQualitativeValue = null;

		private static TimeSpan? ParseTimeSpan(object value)
		{
			if (value != null)
			{
				if (PredefinedTypesHelper.IsTimeSpanType(value.GetType()))
				{
					return (TimeSpan)value;
				}
				if (TimeSpan.TryParse(Convert.ToString(value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture), CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out var result))
				{
					return result;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private static double? ParseNumerical(object value, NumberStyles numberStyles)
		{
			if (value != null)
			{
				if (PredefinedTypesHelper.IsNumericalType(value.GetType()))
				{
					return Convert.ToDouble(value);
				}
				if (double.TryParse(Convert.ToString(value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture), numberStyles, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out var result))
				{
					return result;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static bool IsValidNumeric(double value)
		{
			return GeometricUtils.IsValidDouble(value);
		}

		public static bool IsValidDateTime(DateTime value)
		{
			return value != DefaultDateTimeValue;
		}

		public static bool IsValidTimeSpan(TimeSpan value)
		{
			return value != DefaultTimeSpanValue;
		}

		public static bool IsValidQualitative(string value)
		{
			return !string.IsNullOrEmpty(value);
		}

		public static double? ParseNumerical(object value)
		{
			return ParseNumerical(value, NumberStyles.Number);
		}

		public static double ParseNumerical(object value, double defaultValue)
		{
			double? num = ParseNumerical(value, NumberStyles.Any);
			if (!num.HasValue)
			{
				return defaultValue;
			}
			return num.Value;
		}

		public static DateTime ParseDateTime(object value, DateTime defaultValue)
		{
			DateTime? dateTime = ParseDateTime(value);
			if (!dateTime.HasValue)
			{
				return defaultValue;
			}
			return dateTime.Value;
		}

		public static DateTime? ParseDateTime(object value)
		{
			if (value != null)
			{
				if (PredefinedTypesHelper.IsDateTimeType(value.GetType()))
				{
					return (DateTime)value;
				}
				if (DateTime.TryParse(Convert.ToString(value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture), CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, DateTimeStyles.None, out var result))
				{
					return result;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static TimeSpan ParseTimeSpan(object value, TimeSpan defaultValue)
		{
			TimeSpan? timeSpan = ParseTimeSpan(value);
			if (!timeSpan.HasValue)
			{
				return defaultValue;
			}
			return timeSpan.Value;
		}

		public static double ConvertToDouble(object value)
		{
			if (value != null && PredefinedTypesHelper.IsNumericalType(value.GetType()))
			{
				return Convert.ToDouble(value);
			}
			return DefaultNumericValue;
		}

		public static DateTime ConvertToDateTime(object value)
		{
			if (value != null && value is DateTime)
			{
				return (DateTime)value;
			}
			return DefaultDateTimeValue;
		}

		public static TimeSpan ConvertToTimeSpan(object value)
		{
			if (value != null && value is TimeSpan)
			{
				return (TimeSpan)value;
			}
			return DefaultTimeSpanValue;
		}

		public static Scale ConvertToScale(ActualScaleTypeCore scaleType)
		{
			return scaleType switch
			{
				ActualScaleTypeCore.Numerical => Scale.Numerical, 
				ActualScaleTypeCore.DateTime => Scale.DateTime, 
				ActualScaleTypeCore.TimeSpan => Scale.TimeSpan, 
				_ => Scale.Qualitative, 
			};
		}
	}

	public class NestedDoughnutInteractionContainer : SeriesGroupsInteractionContainer
	{
		private double[] totalGroupIndentsInPixels;

		private double[] holeRadiuses;

		private double[] startOffsets;

		private double[] startOffsetsInPixels;

		private double[] normalizedWeights;

		private double[] explodedFactors;

		private bool[] isExploded;

		public override IList<IPointInteraction> PointInteractions => new List<IPointInteraction> { this };

		public NestedDoughnutInteractionContainer(ISeriesView view)
			: base(view)
		{
		}

		private double GetDoubleArrayValue(IList<double> array, int index)
		{
			if (index < 0 || index >= array.Count)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			return array[index];
		}

		private void UpdateInteractionKeys()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < base.Series.Count; i++)
			{
				base.Series[i].SetGroupsInteraction(this, i);
			}
		}

		protected override void InsertRefinedPoints(int seriesIndex, RefinedSeries refinedSeries)
		{
		}

		protected override void RemoveRefinedPoints(int seriesIndex, RefinedSeries refinedSeries, bool removeAll = false)
		{
		}

		protected override void InsertRefinedPoint(RefinedSeries refinedSeries, RefinedPoint point)
		{
		}

		protected override void RemoveRefinedPoint(RefinedSeries refinedSeries, RefinedPoint point)
		{
		}

		protected override void RecalculateCore(int groupsCount)
		{
			int count = base.Series.Count;
			totalGroupIndentsInPixels = new double[count];
			holeRadiuses = new double[count];
			startOffsets = new double[count];
			startOffsetsInPixels = new double[count];
			normalizedWeights = new double[count];
			explodedFactors = new double[count];
			isExploded = new bool[count];
			double[] array = new double[groupsCount];
			double[] array2 = new double[groupsCount];
			double[] array3 = new double[groupsCount];
			double[] array4 = new double[groupsCount];
			double[] array5 = new double[groupsCount];
			double[] array6 = new double[groupsCount];
			double[] array7 = new double[groupsCount];
			bool[] array8 = new bool[groupsCount];
			bool[] array9 = new bool[groupsCount];
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				RefinedSeries refinedSeries = base.Series[i];
				INestedDoughnutSeriesView nestedDoughnutSeriesView = refinedSeries.SeriesView as INestedDoughnutSeriesView;
				int seriesGroupIndex = GetSeriesGroupIndex(refinedSeries);
				if (nestedDoughnutSeriesView != null)
				{
					array2[seriesGroupIndex] += nestedDoughnutSeriesView.Weight;
					array5[seriesGroupIndex] += nestedDoughnutSeriesView.InnerIndent;
					array6[seriesGroupIndex] = nestedDoughnutSeriesView.InnerIndent;
				}
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < count; j++)
			{
				RefinedSeries refinedSeries2 = base.Series[j];
				if (refinedSeries2.SeriesView is INestedDoughnutSeriesView nestedDoughnutSeriesView2)
				{
					int seriesGroupIndex2 = GetSeriesGroupIndex(refinedSeries2);
					startOffsetsInPixels[j] = array[seriesGroupIndex2];
					array[seriesGroupIndex2] += nestedDoughnutSeriesView2.InnerIndent;
					double num = array3[seriesGroupIndex2];
					startOffsets[j] = num;
					double num2 = nestedDoughnutSeriesView2.Weight / array2[seriesGroupIndex2];
					normalizedWeights[j] = num2;
					array3[seriesGroupIndex2] += num2;
					bool flag = false;
					if (num == 0.0 && !array9[seriesGroupIndex2])
					{
						flag = true;
						array9[seriesGroupIndex2] = true;
					}
					nestedDoughnutSeriesView2.IsOutside = flag;
					if (flag)
					{
						array4[seriesGroupIndex2] = nestedDoughnutSeriesView2.HoleRadiusPercent / 100.0;
						array7[seriesGroupIndex2] = nestedDoughnutSeriesView2.GetExplodedDistancePercentage(refinedSeries2) / 100.0;
						array8[seriesGroupIndex2] = nestedDoughnutSeriesView2.HasExplodedPoints(refinedSeries2);
					}
					holeRadiuses[j] = array4[seriesGroupIndex2];
					explodedFactors[j] = array7[seriesGroupIndex2];
					isExploded[j] = array8[seriesGroupIndex2];
					totalGroupIndentsInPixels[j] = array5[seriesGroupIndex2] - array6[seriesGroupIndex2];
				}
			}
			UpdateInteractionKeys();
		}

		public double GetTotalGroupIndentInPixels(int index)
		{
			return GetDoubleArrayValue(totalGroupIndentsInPixels, index);
		}

		public double GetHoleRadius(int index)
		{
			return GetDoubleArrayValue(holeRadiuses, index);
		}

		public double GetStartOffset(int index)
		{
			return GetDoubleArrayValue(startOffsets, index);
		}

		public double GetStartOffsetInPixels(int index)
		{
			return GetDoubleArrayValue(startOffsetsInPixels, index);
		}

		public double GetNormalizedWeight(int index)
		{
			return GetDoubleArrayValue(normalizedWeights, index);
		}

		public double GetExplodedFactor(int index)
		{
			return GetDoubleArrayValue(explodedFactors, index);
		}

		public bool GetIsExploded(int index)
		{
			if (index < 0 || index >= isExploded.Length)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return isExploded[index];
		}
	}

	public class SeriesComparerByActiveIndex : Comparer<RefinedSeries>
	{
		public override int Compare(RefinedSeries series1, RefinedSeries series2)
		{
			if (series1 == null || series2 == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException();
			}
			return series1.ActiveIndex.CompareTo(series2.ActiveIndex);
		}
	}
	public class InteractionComparerByArgument : Comparer<IPointInteraction>
	{
		public override int Compare(IPointInteraction interaction1, IPointInteraction interaction2)
		{
			if (interaction2 == null || interaction1 == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException();
			}
			return interaction1.ArgumentX.CompareTo(interaction2.ArgumentX);
		}
	}

	public static class RangeHelper
	{
		public static bool RangeDataSwitch = true;

		public static bool RangeCalculationSwitch = true;

		private static void SetSideMargins(IAxisRangeData range, MinMaxValues sideMargin)
		{
			range.SideMargins = sideMargin;
		}

		public static void SetDefaultRange(IAxisData axis)
		{
			if (axis != null && !axis.FixedRange)
			{
				IWholeAxisRangeData wholeAxisRangeData = axis?.WholeRange;
				IVisualAxisRangeData visualAxisRangeData = axis?.VisualRange;
				wholeAxisRangeData?.UpdateRange(0, 1, 0.0, 1.0);
				if (visualAxisRangeData != null && wholeAxisRangeData != null)
				{
					SynchronizeVisualRange(wholeAxisRangeData, visualAxisRangeData, needSyncWithWholeRange: true);
				}
			}
		}

		public static void ThrowRangeData(IAxisData axisData, IAxisRangeData pattern, IAxisRange target)
		{
			double min = pattern.Min;
			double max = pattern.Max;
			if (axisData.AxisScaleTypeMap.ScaleType == ActualScaleTypeCore.DateTime)
			{
				AxisDateTimeMap axisDateTimeMap = axisData.AxisScaleTypeMap as AxisDateTimeMap;
				min = (double)((decimal)pattern.Min - (decimal)axisDateTimeMap.Min);
				max = (double)((decimal)pattern.Max - (decimal)axisDateTimeMap.Min);
			}
			else
			{
				min = axisData.AxisScaleTypeMap.Transformation.TransformForward(min);
				max = axisData.AxisScaleTypeMap.Transformation.TransformForward(max);
			}
			target.Assign(pattern);
			target.UpdateRange(pattern.MinValue, pattern.MaxValue, min, max);
		}

		public static void SynchronizeVisualRange(IWholeAxisRangeData wholeRange, IVisualAxisRangeData visualRange, bool needSyncWithWholeRange)
		{
			if (needSyncWithWholeRange)
			{
				visualRange.UpdateRange(wholeRange.MinValue, wholeRange.MaxValue, wholeRange.Min, wholeRange.Max);
				SetSideMargins(visualRange, new MinMaxValues(wholeRange.SideMargins.Min, wholeRange.SideMargins.Max));
				return;
			}
			if (visualRange.Max > wholeRange.Max)
			{
				SetMax(wholeRange.MaxValue, wholeRange.Max, visualRange);
				visualRange.SideMargins = new MinMaxValues(visualRange.SideMargins.Min, wholeRange.SideMargins.Max);
			}
			if (visualRange.Min < wholeRange.Min)
			{
				SetMin(wholeRange.MinValue, wholeRange.Min, visualRange);
				visualRange.SideMargins = new MinMaxValues(wholeRange.SideMargins.Min, visualRange.SideMargins.Max);
			}
		}

		private static void SetMin(object minValue, double minValueInternal, IAxisRangeData range)
		{
			range.UpdateRange(minValue, range.MaxValue, minValueInternal, range.Max);
		}

		private static void SetMax(object maxValue, double maxValueInternal, IAxisRangeData range)
		{
			range.UpdateRange(range.MinValue, maxValue, range.Min, maxValueInternal);
		}
	}
	public class SortedCollection<T> : IEnumerable<T>, IEnumerable
	{
		private readonly Comparer<T> comparer;

		private readonly List<T> innerList;

		protected List<T> InnerList => innerList;

		public T this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				return innerList[index];
			}
			set
			{
				innerList[index] = value;
			}
		}

		public int Count => innerList.Count;

		public SortedCollection(Comparer<T> comparer)
		{
			innerList = new List<T>();
			this.comparer = comparer;
		}

		IEnumerator<T> IEnumerable<T>.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return innerList.GetEnumerator();
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return innerList.GetEnumerator();
		}

		public int BinarySearch(T item)
		{
			return innerList.BinarySearch(item, comparer);
		}

		public int IndexOf(T item)
		{
			int num = BinarySearch(item);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			for (int i = num; i < Count && comparer.Compare(innerList[num], innerList[i]) == 0; i++)
			{
				if ((object)item == (object)innerList[i])
				{
					return i;
				}
			}
			int num2 = num - 1;
			while (num2 >= 0 && comparer.Compare(innerList[num], innerList[num2]) == 0)
			{
				if ((object)item == (object)innerList[num2])
				{
					return num2;
				}
				num2--;
			}
			return -1;
		}

		public void RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			innerList.RemoveAt(index);
		}

		public void Add(T item)
		{
			int num = BinarySearch(item);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				num = ~num;
			}
			innerList.Insert(num, item);
		}

		public void Insert(int index, T interaction)
		{
			InnerList.Insert(index, interaction);
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			innerList.Clear();
		}

		public void Sort()
		{
			innerList.Sort(comparer);
		}

		public bool Contains(T item)
		{
			return IndexOf(item) >= 0;
		}

		public bool Remove(T item)
		{
			int num = IndexOf(item);
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				RemoveAt(num);
			}
			return num >= 0;
		}
	}
