	public abstract class BasePointInteraction : IPointInteraction
	{
		public abstract int Count { get; }

		public virtual bool IsEmpty => Count == 0;

		public virtual double Argument => double.NaN;

		int IPointInteraction.Count => Count;

		bool IPointInteraction.IsEmpty => IsEmpty;

		double IPointInteraction.ArgumentX => Argument;

		double IPointInteraction.ArgumentY => double.NaN;

		double IPointInteraction.GetMinValue(ISeriesView seriesView)
		{
			return GetMinValue(seriesView);
		}

		double IPointInteraction.GetMaxValue(ISeriesView seriesView)
		{
			return GetMaxValue(seriesView);
		}

		double IPointInteraction.GetMinAbsValue(ISeriesView seriesView)
		{
			return GetMinAbsValue(seriesView);
		}

		protected int InsertPointToList(List<RefinedPoint> list, Comparer<RefinedPoint> comparer, RefinedPoint point)
		{
			int num = list.BinarySearch(point, comparer);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				num = ~num;
			}
			list.Insert(num, point);
			return num;
		}

		protected int RemovePointFromList(List<RefinedPoint> list, Comparer<RefinedPoint> comparer, RefinedPoint point)
		{
			int num = list.BinarySearch(point, comparer);
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				list.RemoveAt(num);
			}
			return num;
		}

		protected void UpdatePointsInteractions(List<RefinedPoint> list)
		{
			UpdatePointsInteractions(list, 0);
		}

		protected void UpdatePointsInteractions(List<RefinedPoint> list, int startIndex)
		{
			for (int i = startIndex; i < list.Count; i++)
			{
				if (list[i] != null)
				{
					list[i].SetInteraction(this, i);
				}
			}
		}

		public abstract double GetMinValue(ISeriesView seriesView);

		public abstract double GetMaxValue(ISeriesView seriesView);

		public abstract double GetMinAbsValue(ISeriesView seriesView);
	}
	public class SimplePointInteraction : BasePointInteraction
	{
		private readonly RefinedPointsValueComparer comparer = new RefinedPointsValueComparer();

		private readonly List<RefinedPoint> points = new List<RefinedPoint>();

		private double positiveValuesSum = double.NaN;

		private double negativeValuesSum = double.NaN;

		public double MinValue
		{
			get
			{
				if (points.Count <= 0)
				{
					return double.NaN;
				}
				return ((IValuePoint)points[0]).Value;
			}
		}

		public double MaxValue
		{
			get
			{
				if (points.Count <= 0)
				{
					return double.NaN;
				}
				return ((IValuePoint)points[points.Count - 1]).Value;
			}
		}

		public double PositiveValuesSum => positiveValuesSum;

		public double NegativeValuesSum => negativeValuesSum;

		public override int Count => points.Count;

		public void AddPoint(RefinedPoint point)
		{
			int startIndex = InsertPointToList(points, comparer, point);
			UpdatePointsInteractions(points, startIndex);
			double value = ((IValuePoint)point).Value;
			if (!GeometricUtils.IsValidDouble(value))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (value < 0.0)
			{
				if (double.IsNaN(negativeValuesSum))
				{
					negativeValuesSum = 0.0;
				}
				negativeValuesSum += value;
			}
			else
			{
				if (double.IsNaN(positiveValuesSum))
				{
					positiveValuesSum = 0.0;
				}
				positiveValuesSum += value;
			}
		}

		public void RemovePoint(RefinedPoint point)
		{
			point.ResetInteraction();
			int num = RemovePointFromList(points, comparer, point);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			UpdatePointsInteractions(points, num);
			double value = ((IValuePoint)point).Value;
			if (GeometricUtils.IsValidDouble(value))
			{
				if (value < 0.0)
				{
					negativeValuesSum -= value;
				}
				else
				{
					positiveValuesSum -= value;
				}
			}
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			foreach (RefinedPoint point in points)
			{
				point.ResetInteraction();
			}
			points.Clear();
			positiveValuesSum = double.NaN;
			negativeValuesSum = double.NaN;
		}

		public override double GetMinValue(ISeriesView seriesView)
		{
			return double.NaN;
		}

		public override double GetMaxValue(ISeriesView seriesView)
		{
			return double.NaN;
		}

		public override double GetMinAbsValue(ISeriesView seriesView)
		{
			return double.NaN;
		}
	}
	public class RangePointInteraction : BasePointInteraction
	{
		private readonly RefinedPointsRangeValue1Comparer value1Comparer = new RefinedPointsRangeValue1Comparer();

		private readonly RefinedPointsRangeValue2Comparer value2Comparer = new RefinedPointsRangeValue2Comparer();

		private readonly List<RefinedPoint> pointsByValue1 = new List<RefinedPoint>();

		private readonly List<RefinedPoint> pointsByValue2 = new List<RefinedPoint>();

		public override int Count => pointsByValue1.Count;

		public void AddPoint(RefinedPoint point)
		{
			InsertPointToList(pointsByValue1, value1Comparer, point);
			InsertPointToList(pointsByValue2, value2Comparer, point);
			UpdatePointsInteractions(pointsByValue1);
		}

		public void RemovePoint(RefinedPoint point)
		{
			point.ResetInteraction();
			RemovePointFromList(pointsByValue1, value1Comparer, point);
			RemovePointFromList(pointsByValue2, value2Comparer, point);
			UpdatePointsInteractions(pointsByValue1);
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			foreach (RefinedPoint item in pointsByValue1)
			{
				item.ResetInteraction();
			}
			pointsByValue1.Clear();
			pointsByValue2.Clear();
		}

		public override double GetMinValue(ISeriesView seriesView)
		{
			double result = double.NaN;
			if (pointsByValue1.Count > 0)
			{
				result = Math.Min(((IRangePoint)pointsByValue1[0]).Value1, ((IRangePoint)pointsByValue2[0]).Value2);
			}
			return result;
		}

		public override double GetMaxValue(ISeriesView seriesView)
		{
			double result = double.NaN;
			if (pointsByValue1.Count > 0)
			{
				int index = pointsByValue1.Count - 1;
				result = Math.Max(((IRangePoint)pointsByValue1[index]).Value1, ((IRangePoint)pointsByValue2[index]).Value2);
			}
			return result;
		}

		public override double GetMinAbsValue(ISeriesView seriesView)
		{
			double result = double.NaN;
			if (pointsByValue1.Count > 0)
			{
				result = Math.Min(Math.Abs(((IRangePoint)pointsByValue1[0]).Value1), Math.Abs(((IRangePoint)pointsByValue2[0]).Value2));
			}
			return result;
		}
	}
	public class XYWPointInteraction : BasePointInteraction
	{
		private readonly RefinedPointsWeightComparer weightComparer = new RefinedPointsWeightComparer();

		private readonly RefinedPointsValueComparer valueComparer = new RefinedPointsValueComparer();

		private readonly List<RefinedPoint> pointsByWeights = new List<RefinedPoint>();

		private readonly List<RefinedPoint> pointsByValues = new List<RefinedPoint>();

		private readonly IXYWSeriesView view;

		private bool isUpdateLocked;

		public double MinWeight
		{
			get
			{
				if (pointsByWeights.Count <= 0)
				{
					return double.NaN;
				}
				return ((IXYWPoint)pointsByWeights[0]).Weight;
			}
		}

		public double MaxWeight
		{
			get
			{
				if (pointsByWeights.Count <= 0)
				{
					return double.NaN;
				}
				return ((IXYWPoint)pointsByWeights[pointsByWeights.Count - 1]).Weight;
			}
		}

		public override int Count => pointsByValues.Count;

		public XYWPointInteraction(IXYWSeriesView view)
		{
			this.view = view;
		}

		public void AddPoint(RefinedPoint point)
		{
			InsertPointToList(pointsByValues, valueComparer, point);
			InsertPointToList(pointsByWeights, weightComparer, point);
			if (!isUpdateLocked)
			{
				UpdatePointsInteractions(pointsByValues);
			}
		}

		public void RemovePoint(RefinedPoint point)
		{
			point.ResetInteraction();
			RemovePointFromList(pointsByValues, valueComparer, point);
			RemovePointFromList(pointsByWeights, weightComparer, point);
			if (!isUpdateLocked)
			{
				UpdatePointsInteractions(pointsByValues);
			}
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			foreach (RefinedPoint pointsByValue in pointsByValues)
			{
				pointsByValue.ResetInteraction();
			}
			pointsByValues.Clear();
			pointsByWeights.Clear();
		}

		public double GetXYWPointSize(IXYWPoint point)
		{
			double num = MaxWeight - MinWeight;
			if (num == 0.0)
			{
				return view.MaxSize;
			}
			double num2 = (point.Weight - MinWeight) / num;
			return (view.MaxSize - view.MinSize) * num2 + view.MinSize;
		}

		public override double GetMinValue(ISeriesView seriesView)
		{
			if (pointsByValues.Count <= 0)
			{
				return double.NaN;
			}
			return seriesView.GetRefinedPointMin(pointsByValues[0]);
		}

		public override double GetMaxValue(ISeriesView seriesView)
		{
			if (pointsByValues.Count <= 0)
			{
				return double.NaN;
			}
			return seriesView.GetRefinedPointMax(pointsByValues[pointsByValues.Count - 1]);
		}

		public override double GetMinAbsValue(ISeriesView seriesView)
		{
			if (pointsByValues.Count <= 0)
			{
				return double.NaN;
			}
			return seriesView.GetRefinedPointAbsMin(pointsByValues[0]);
		}

		public void Lock()
		{
			isUpdateLocked = true;
		}

		public void Unlock()
		{
			isUpdateLocked = false;
			UpdatePointsInteractions(pointsByValues);
		}
	}
	public class StackedPointInteraction : BasePointInteraction
	{
		private readonly List<RefinedSeries> series;

		private readonly List<Stack<RefinedPoint>> points;

		private readonly List<double> startValues;

		private readonly double argument;

		private double minValue;

		private double maxValue;

		private double positiveSum;

		private double negativeSum;

		private double minAbsValue;

		private bool shouldRecalculate;

		private bool isSupplyInteraction;

		private bool allSeriesNonPositive;

		protected ISeriesView SeriesView
		{
			get
			{
				if (series.Count <= 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return series[0].SeriesView;
			}
		}

		protected internal double PositiveSum => positiveSum;

		protected internal double NegativeSum => negativeSum;

		public virtual double MinValue
		{
			get
			{
				Recalculate();
				return minValue;
			}
		}

		public virtual double MaxValue
		{
			get
			{
				Recalculate();
				return maxValue;
			}
		}

		public virtual double MinAbsValue
		{
			get
			{
				Recalculate();
				return minAbsValue;
			}
		}

		public bool HasEmptyPoints
		{
			get
			{
				foreach (Stack<RefinedPoint> point in points)
				{
					if (point.Count == 0 || point.Peek() == null || point.Peek().IsEmpty)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public bool IsSupplyInteraction
		{
			get
			{
				return isSupplyInteraction;
			}
			set
			{
				isSupplyInteraction = value;
			}
		}

		public override int Count => points.Count;

		public override bool IsEmpty
		{
			get
			{
				foreach (Stack<RefinedPoint> point in points)
				{
					if (point.Count > 0 && point.Peek() != null)
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public override double Argument => argument;

		public RefinedPoint this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				if (points[index].Count <= 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return points[index].Peek();
			}
			set
			{
				InsertInPointsCollection(index, value);
			}
		}

		internal List<RefinedPoint> Points
		{
			get
			{
				List<RefinedPoint> list = new List<RefinedPoint>();
				for (int i = 0; i < points.Count; i++)
				{
					list.Add((points[i].Count > 0) ? points[i].Peek() : null);
				}
				return list;
			}
		}

		public StackedPointInteraction(List<RefinedSeries> series, int seriesIndex, RefinedPoint point)
		{
			argument = point.Argument;
			points = new List<Stack<RefinedPoint>>();
			for (int i = 0; i < series.Count; i++)
			{
				points.Add(new Stack<RefinedPoint>());
			}
			startValues = new List<double>(series.Count);
			this.series = new List<RefinedSeries>(series.Count);
			for (int j = 0; j < series.Count; j++)
			{
				this.series.Add(series[j]);
				if (j == seriesIndex)
				{
					InsertInPointsCollection(j, point);
					startValues.Add(0.0);
					point.SetInteraction(this, j);
				}
				else
				{
					InsertInPointsCollection(j, null);
					startValues.Add(double.NaN);
				}
			}
			shouldRecalculate = true;
		}

		private bool CalculateAllSeriesNonPositive()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < series.Count; i++)
			{
				if (series[i].SeriesView is IStackedView && !(series[i].SeriesView is IBarSeriesView) && series[i].HasPositivePoints)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void Recalculate()
		{
			if (!shouldRecalculate || SeriesView == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			minValue = double.PositiveInfinity;
			maxValue = double.NegativeInfinity;
			negativeSum = (positiveSum = GetAnchorValue());
			allSeriesNonPositive = CalculateAllSeriesNonPositive();
			for (int i = 0; i < points.Count; i++)
			{
				if (points[i].Count != 0 && points[i].Peek() != null)
				{
					double pointValue = GetPointValue(i);
					double num;
					if (pointValue < 0.0)
					{
						num = negativeSum;
						startValues[i] = negativeSum;
						negativeSum += pointValue;
					}
					else
					{
						num = positiveSum;
						startValues[i] = positiveSum;
						positiveSum += pointValue;
					}
					double val = num + pointValue;
					minValue = Math.Min(minValue, val);
					maxValue = Math.Max(maxValue, val);
				}
			}
			minAbsValue = double.MaxValue;
			for (int j = 0; j < points.Count; j++)
			{
				if (points[j].Count != 0 && points[j].Peek() != null)
				{
					minAbsValue = Math.Min(minAbsValue, Math.Abs(SeriesView.GetRefinedPointAbsMin(points[j].Peek())));
				}
			}
			shouldRecalculate = false;
		}

		private bool IsSeriesFirstWithPoint(int seriesIndex)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < seriesIndex; i++)
			{
				if (this[i] != null)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected double GetSeriesPointValue(RefinedPoint point)
		{
			if (point != null)
			{
				double refinedPointMax = SeriesView.GetRefinedPointMax(point);
				if (GeometricUtils.IsValidDouble(refinedPointMax) && (!(refinedPointMax < 0.0) || allSeriesNonPositive))
				{
					return refinedPointMax;
				}
			}
			return 0.0;
		}

		protected void Invalidate()
		{
			shouldRecalculate = true;
		}

		protected virtual void InsertInPointsCollection(int index, RefinedPoint point)
		{
			if (points[index].Count > 0)
			{
				if (points[index].Peek() != null)
				{
					points[index].Push(point);
					return;
				}
				points[index].Pop();
				points[index].Push(point);
			}
			else
			{
				points[index].Push(point);
			}
		}

		protected virtual double GetAnchorValue()
		{
			return 0.0;
		}

		protected virtual double GetPointValue(int pointIndex)
		{
			return GetSeriesPointValue(points[pointIndex].Peek());
		}

		public void InsertSeries(RefinedSeries series, int seriesIndex, RefinedPoint point)
		{
			if (seriesIndex < this.series.Count)
			{
				if (this.series[seriesIndex] != series)
				{
					this.series.Insert(seriesIndex, series);
					Stack<RefinedPoint> stack = new Stack<RefinedPoint>();
					stack.Push(point);
					points.Insert(seriesIndex, stack);
					startValues.Insert(seriesIndex, double.NaN);
				}
				else
				{
					InsertInPointsCollection(seriesIndex, point);
				}
				UpdatePointsInteractions(Points);
			}
			else
			{
				this.series.Add(series);
				Stack<RefinedPoint> stack2 = new Stack<RefinedPoint>();
				stack2.Push(point);
				points.Add(stack2);
				startValues.Add(double.NaN);
				point?.SetInteraction(this, seriesIndex);
			}
			shouldRecalculate = true;
		}

		public void RemoveSeries(int seriesIndex)
		{
			if (seriesIndex >= points.Count)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException();
			}
			this[seriesIndex]?.ResetInteraction();
			points[seriesIndex].Clear();
			points.RemoveAt(seriesIndex);
			startValues.RemoveAt(seriesIndex);
			series.RemoveAt(seriesIndex);
			UpdatePointsInteractions(Points);
			shouldRecalculate = true;
		}

		public void InsertPoint(int seriesIndex, RefinedPoint point)
		{
			if (seriesIndex >= points.Count)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException();
			}
			if (!point.IsEmpty || points[seriesIndex].Count == 0 || points[seriesIndex].Peek() == null)
			{
				InsertInPointsCollection(seriesIndex, point);
				point.SetInteraction(this, seriesIndex);
				shouldRecalculate = true;
			}
		}

		public void RemovePoint(int seriesIndex)
		{
			if (seriesIndex >= points.Count)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException();
			}
			if (points[seriesIndex].Count > 0)
			{
				points[seriesIndex].Pop()?.ResetInteraction();
			}
			shouldRecalculate = true;
		}

		public override double GetMinValue(ISeriesView seriesView)
		{
			return MinValue;
		}

		public override double GetMaxValue(ISeriesView seriesView)
		{
			return MaxValue;
		}

		public override double GetMinAbsValue(ISeriesView seriesView)
		{
			return MinAbsValue;
		}

		public virtual double GetStackedPointMinValue(int pointIndex)
		{
			Recalculate();
			if (pointIndex < startValues.Count)
			{
				return startValues[pointIndex];
			}
			return double.NaN;
		}

		public virtual double GetStackedPointMaxValue(int pointIndex)
		{
			Recalculate();
			if (SeriesView != null && pointIndex < startValues.Count)
			{
				return startValues[pointIndex] + GetPointValue(pointIndex);
			}
			return double.NaN;
		}

		public bool IsTopPoint(int seriesIndex)
		{
			double num = MinValue;
			double num2 = MaxValue;
			if (GetPointValue(seriesIndex) == 0.0)
			{
				if (num2 == 0.0 && num == 0.0)
				{
					return IsSeriesFirstWithPoint(seriesIndex);
				}
				return false;
			}
			double stackedPointMaxValue = GetStackedPointMaxValue(seriesIndex);
			if (stackedPointMaxValue != num2 || !(num2 > 0.0))
			{
				if (stackedPointMaxValue == num)
				{
					return num < 0.0;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}
	}
	public abstract class WaterfallPointInteraction : StackedPointInteraction
	{
		private double AnchorValue
		{
			get
			{
				double num = 0.0;
				if (PrevInteractionValues != null)
				{
					for (int i = 0; i < PrevInteractionValues.Length; i++)
					{
						num += PrevInteractionValues[i];
					}
				}
				return num;
			}
		}

		public bool HasOnlyEmptyPoints { get; private set; } = true;

		public bool IsSubtotal { get; }

		public double[] PrevInteractionValues { get; set; }

		public virtual bool ShouldConsiderValue => !IsSubtotal;

		public WaterfallPointInteraction(List<RefinedSeries> series, int seriesIndex, RefinedPoint point)
			: base(series, seriesIndex, point)
		{
			IsSubtotal = ((IWaterfallPoint)point).IsSubTotal;
		}

		private int FindFirstExistPontIndex()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				if (base[i] != null)
				{
					return i;
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}

		protected abstract double CalcPrevInteractionValue(WaterfallPointInteraction prevInteraction, int index);

		protected override double GetAnchorValue()
		{
			if (IsSubtotal)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			return AnchorValue;
		}

		protected override double GetPointValue(int pointIndex)
		{
			if (IsSubtotal)
			{
				return AnchorValue + GetSeriesPointValue(base[0]);
			}
			return base.GetPointValue(pointIndex);
		}

		protected override void InsertInPointsCollection(int index, RefinedPoint point)
		{
			base.InsertInPointsCollection(index, point);
			if (point != null)
			{
				HasOnlyEmptyPoints &= !point.HasValues;
			}
		}

		protected void UpdatePrevValuesCore(WaterfallPointInteraction prevInteraction)
		{
			int count = prevInteraction.Count;
			PrevInteractionValues = new double[count];
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				PrevInteractionValues[i] = CalcPrevInteractionValue(prevInteraction, i);
			}
		}

		public double GetTotalValue()
		{
			if (IsSubtotal)
			{
				return AnchorValue + GetSeriesPointValue(base[0]);
			}
			double num = AnchorValue;
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				num += GetPointValue(i);
			}
			return num;
		}

		public virtual void UpdatePrevValues(WaterfallPointInteraction prevInteraction)
		{
			if (!prevInteraction.IsSubtotal || GetSeriesPointValue(prevInteraction[0]) != 0.0)
			{
				UpdatePrevValuesCore(prevInteraction);
			}
			Invalidate();
		}

		public double GetPointAnchorValue(int pointIndex)
		{
			if (pointIndex == FindFirstExistPontIndex())
			{
				return AnchorValue;
			}
			return double.NaN;
		}

		public abstract double GetRelativeValue(int pointIndex);

		public abstract double GetAbsoluteValue(int pointIndex);
	}
	public class WaterfallRelativePointInteraction : WaterfallPointInteraction
	{
		public WaterfallRelativePointInteraction(List<RefinedSeries> series, int seriesIndex, RefinedPoint point)
			: base(series, seriesIndex, point)
		{
		}

		protected override double CalcPrevInteractionValue(WaterfallPointInteraction prevInteraction, int index)
		{
			return GetSeriesPointValue(prevInteraction[index]) + ((prevInteraction.PrevInteractionValues != null) ? prevInteraction.PrevInteractionValues[index] : 0.0);
		}

		public override double GetRelativeValue(int pointIndex)
		{
			return GetSeriesPointValue(base[pointIndex]);
		}

		public override double GetAbsoluteValue(int pointIndex)
		{
			RefinedPoint point = base[(!base.IsSubtotal) ? pointIndex : 0];
			double num = GetSeriesPointValue(point);
			if (base.PrevInteractionValues != null)
			{
				num += base.PrevInteractionValues[pointIndex];
			}
			return num;
		}
	}
	public class WaterfallAbsolutePointInteraction : WaterfallPointInteraction
	{
		public WaterfallAbsolutePointInteraction(List<RefinedSeries> series, int seriesIndex, RefinedPoint point)
			: base(series, seriesIndex, point)
		{
		}

		protected override double GetPointValue(int pointIndex)
		{
			RefinedPoint refinedPoint = base[pointIndex];
			if (refinedPoint == null)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			double num = base.GetPointValue(pointIndex);
			if (base.PrevInteractionValues != null && !base.IsSubtotal)
			{
				num -= base.PrevInteractionValues[pointIndex];
			}
			return num;
		}

		protected override double CalcPrevInteractionValue(WaterfallPointInteraction prevInteraction, int index)
		{
			RefinedPoint refinedPoint = prevInteraction.Points[index];
			if (refinedPoint != null || prevInteraction == null || prevInteraction.PrevInteractionValues == null)
			{
				return GetSeriesPointValue(refinedPoint);
			}
			return prevInteraction.PrevInteractionValues[index];
		}

		public override double GetRelativeValue(int pointIndex)
		{
			return GetSeriesPointValue(base.Points[pointIndex]) - ((base.PrevInteractionValues != null) ? base.PrevInteractionValues[pointIndex] : 0.0);
		}

		public override double GetAbsoluteValue(int pointIndex)
		{
			return GetSeriesPointValue(base.Points[pointIndex]);
		}
	}
	public class WaterfallXCelPointInteraction : WaterfallRelativePointInteraction
	{
		public override bool ShouldConsiderValue => true;

		public WaterfallXCelPointInteraction(List<RefinedSeries> series, int seriesIndex, RefinedPoint point)
			: base(series, seriesIndex, point)
		{
		}

		public override void UpdatePrevValues(WaterfallPointInteraction prevInteraction)
		{
			if (!base.IsSubtotal)
			{
				if (prevInteraction.IsSubtotal)
				{
					base.PrevInteractionValues = new double[1] { prevInteraction.GetAbsoluteValue(0) };
				}
				else if (GetSeriesPointValue(prevInteraction[0]) != 0.0)
				{
					UpdatePrevValuesCore(prevInteraction);
				}
				Invalidate();
			}
		}
	}
	public class FullStackedPointInteraction : StackedPointInteraction
	{
		public override double MaxValue
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.MaxValue <= 0.0 || base.PositiveSum - base.NegativeSum == 0.0)
				{
					return 0.0;
				}
				return base.PositiveSum / (base.PositiveSum - base.NegativeSum);
			}
		}

		public override double MinValue
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.MinValue >= 0.0 || base.PositiveSum - base.NegativeSum == 0.0)
				{
					return 0.0;
				}
				return base.NegativeSum / (base.PositiveSum - base.NegativeSum);
			}
		}

		public FullStackedPointInteraction(List<RefinedSeries> series, int seriesIndex, RefinedPoint point)
			: base(series, seriesIndex, point)
		{
		}

		private double GetNormalizedValue(double value)
		{
			if (base.SeriesView != null && GeometricUtils.IsValidDouble(value))
			{
				double result = 0.0;
				if (base.PositiveSum - base.NegativeSum != 0.0)
				{
					result = value / (base.PositiveSum - base.NegativeSum);
				}
				return result;
			}
			return double.NaN;
		}

		public override double GetStackedPointMinValue(int pointIndex)
		{
			double stackedPointMinValue = base.GetStackedPointMinValue(pointIndex);
			return GetNormalizedValue(stackedPointMinValue);
		}

		public override double GetStackedPointMaxValue(int pointIndex)
		{
			double stackedPointMaxValue = base.GetStackedPointMaxValue(pointIndex);
			return GetNormalizedValue(stackedPointMaxValue);
		}
	}
	public class SideBySideGroup : SideBySideGroupBase
	{
		private readonly Dictionary<RefinedPoint, RefinedSeries> points = new Dictionary<RefinedPoint, RefinedSeries>();

		public override bool IsEmpty => points.Count == 0;

		public SideBySideGroup(RefinedSeries series)
			: base(series)
		{
		}

		public void AddPoint(RefinedSeries series, RefinedPoint point)
		{
			if (!points.ContainsKey(point))
			{
				points.Add(point, series);
			}
		}

		public void RemovePoint(RefinedPoint point)
		{
			points.Remove(point);
		}

		public override void UpdateInteractionKeys(int index, SideBySideInteractionBase interaction)
		{
			foreach (RefinedPoint key in points.Keys)
			{
				key.SetSeriesGroupsInteraction(interaction, index);
			}
		}

		public override void RemoveSeries(RefinedSeries series)
		{
			List<RefinedPoint> list = new List<RefinedPoint>();
			foreach (RefinedPoint key in points.Keys)
			{
				if (points[key] == series)
				{
					list.Add(key);
				}
			}
			foreach (RefinedPoint item in list)
			{
				points.Remove(item);
				item.ResetSeriesGroupsInteraction();
			}
			base.RemoveSeries(series);
		}
	}
	public class SideBySideSeriesGroup : SideBySideGroupBase
	{
		public SideBySideSeriesGroup(RefinedSeries series)
			: base(series)
		{
		}

		public override void UpdateInteractionKeys(int index, SideBySideInteractionBase interaction)
		{
			foreach (RefinedSeries series in base.SeriesList)
			{
				IList<RefinedPoint> finalPoints = series.FinalPoints;
				foreach (RefinedPoint item in finalPoints)
				{
					item.SetSeriesGroupsInteraction(interaction, index);
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public abstract class SideBySideGroupBase
	{
		private readonly object groupKey;

		private readonly List<RefinedSeries> seriesList = new List<RefinedSeries>();

		public object GroupKey => groupKey;

		public double BarWidth { get; set; }

		public double BarDistance { get; set; }

		public int FixedOffset { get; set; }

		public virtual bool IsEmpty => seriesList.Count == 0;

		public List<RefinedSeries> SeriesList => seriesList;

		protected SideBySideGroupBase(RefinedSeries series)
		{
			if (series.SeriesView is ISideBySideStackedBarSeriesView sideBySideStackedBarSeriesView)
			{
				groupKey = sideBySideStackedBarSeriesView.StackedGroup;
			}
		}

		public void AddSeries(RefinedSeries series)
		{
			seriesList.Add(series);
		}

		public virtual void RemoveSeries(RefinedSeries series)
		{
			seriesList.Remove(series);
		}

		public abstract void UpdateInteractionKeys(int index, SideBySideInteractionBase interaction);
	}
	public abstract class SideBySideInteractionBase : IPointInteraction
	{
		private readonly List<SideBySideGroupBase> groups = new List<SideBySideGroupBase>();

		private List<RefinedSeries> series;

		private bool shouldRecalculate = true;

		private bool equalBarWidth;

		protected List<SideBySideGroupBase> Groups => groups;

		protected virtual double Argument => double.NaN;

		public bool IsEmpty
		{
			get
			{
				foreach (SideBySideGroupBase group in groups)
				{
					if (!group.IsEmpty)
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public List<RefinedSeries> Series
		{
			get
			{
				if (series == null)
				{
					series = new List<RefinedSeries>();
					foreach (SideBySideGroupBase group in groups)
					{
						foreach (RefinedSeries series in group.SeriesList)
						{
							this.series.Add(series);
						}
					}
				}
				return this.series;
			}
		}

		int IPointInteraction.Count => groups.Count;

		double IPointInteraction.ArgumentX => Argument;

		double IPointInteraction.ArgumentY => double.NaN;

		bool IPointInteraction.IsEmpty => IsEmpty;

		protected SideBySideInteractionBase(bool equalBarWidth)
		{
			this.equalBarWidth = equalBarWidth;
		}

		double IPointInteraction.GetMinValue(ISeriesView seriesView)
		{
			return double.NaN;
		}

		double IPointInteraction.GetMaxValue(ISeriesView seriesView)
		{
			return double.NaN;
		}

		double IPointInteraction.GetMinAbsValue(ISeriesView seriesView)
		{
			return double.NaN;
		}

		private SideBySideGroupBase FindSideBySideStackedGroup(RefinedSeries series)
		{
			if (series.SeriesView is ISideBySideStackedBarSeriesView sideBySideStackedBarSeriesView)
			{
				foreach (SideBySideGroupBase group in Groups)
				{
					if (object.Equals(group.GroupKey, sideBySideStackedBarSeriesView.StackedGroup))
					{
						return group;
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private void Recalculate()
		{
			if (shouldRecalculate && Groups.Count > 0)
			{
				double num = 0.0;
				double num2 = 0.0;
				int num3 = 0;
				List<SideBySideGroupBase> list = new List<SideBySideGroupBase>();
				for (int i = 0; i < Groups.Count; i++)
				{
					if (!Groups[i].IsEmpty)
					{
						list.Add(Groups[i]);
					}
				}
				if (list.Count > 0)
				{
					for (int j = 0; j < list.Count; j++)
					{
						ISideBySideBarSeriesView sideBySideBarSeriesView = (ISideBySideBarSeriesView)list[j].SeriesList[0].SeriesView;
						double num4 = ((!equalBarWidth) ? (sideBySideBarSeriesView.BarWidth / (double)list.Count) : (sideBySideBarSeriesView.BarWidth / (double)Groups.Count));
						int barDistanceFixed = sideBySideBarSeriesView.BarDistanceFixed;
						list[j].BarWidth = num4;
						list[j].BarDistance = ((j == 0) ? 0.0 : (num2 + 0.5 * num4));
						list[j].FixedOffset = num3;
						num += ((j == 0) ? 0.0 : (num4 + sideBySideBarSeriesView.BarDistance));
						num2 += ((j == 0) ? (0.5 * num4 + sideBySideBarSeriesView.BarDistance) : (num4 + sideBySideBarSeriesView.BarDistance));
						num3 += ((j < list.Count - 1) ? barDistanceFixed : 0);
					}
					double num5 = 0.5 * num;
					int num6 = GeometricUtils.StrongRound(0.5 * (double)num3);
					for (int k = 0; k < list.Count; k++)
					{
						list[k].BarDistance -= num5;
						list[k].FixedOffset -= num6;
					}
				}
			}
			shouldRecalculate = false;
		}

		private void UpdateInteractionKeys()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < Groups.Count; i++)
			{
				Groups[i].UpdateInteractionKeys(i, this);
			}
		}

		protected int GetGroupIndex(RefinedSeries series)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < groups.Count; i++)
			{
				if (groups[i].SeriesList.Contains(series))
				{
					return i;
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}

		protected abstract SideBySideGroupBase CreateGroup(RefinedSeries series);

		protected virtual void OnInsertPoint(int groupIndex, RefinedSeries series, RefinedPoint point)
		{
		}

		public void Invalidate()
		{
			shouldRecalculate = true;
		}

		public void AddSeries(RefinedSeries series)
		{
			SideBySideGroupBase sideBySideGroupBase = FindSideBySideStackedGroup(series);
			if (sideBySideGroupBase == null)
			{
				sideBySideGroupBase = CreateGroup(series);
				groups.Add(sideBySideGroupBase);
			}
			sideBySideGroupBase.AddSeries(series);
			UpdateInteractionKeys();
			this.series = null;
		}

		public void InsertPoint(RefinedSeries series, RefinedPoint point)
		{
			int groupIndex = GetGroupIndex(series);
			if (groupIndex >= 0)
			{
				point.SetSeriesGroupsInteraction(this, groupIndex);
			}
			OnInsertPoint(groupIndex, series, point);
			this.series = null;
		}

		public virtual void RemoveSeries(RefinedSeries series)
		{
			int groupIndex = GetGroupIndex(series);
			if (groupIndex >= 0)
			{
				SideBySideGroupBase sideBySideGroupBase = Groups[groupIndex];
				sideBySideGroupBase.RemoveSeries(series);
				if (sideBySideGroupBase.IsEmpty)
				{
					groups.Remove(sideBySideGroupBase);
				}
			}
			UpdateInteractionKeys();
			this.series = null;
		}

		public virtual void RemovePoint(RefinedSeries series, RefinedPoint point)
		{
			point.ResetSeriesGroupsInteraction();
			this.series = null;
		}

		public double GetBarWidth(int index)
		{
			Recalculate();
			if (index >= groups.Count)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			return groups[index].BarWidth;
		}

		public double GetBarDistance(int index)
		{
			Recalculate();
			if (index >= groups.Count)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			return groups[index].BarDistance;
		}

		public int GetFixedOffset(int index)
		{
			Recalculate();
			if (index >= groups.Count)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			return groups[index].FixedOffset;
		}
	}
	public class SideBySidePointInteraction : SideBySideInteractionBase
	{
		private readonly double argument;

		protected override double Argument => argument;

		public SideBySidePointInteraction(double argument, bool equalBarWidth)
			: base(equalBarWidth)
		{
			this.argument = argument;
		}

		protected override SideBySideGroupBase CreateGroup(RefinedSeries series)
		{
			return new SideBySideGroup(series);
		}

		protected override void OnInsertPoint(int groupIndex, RefinedSeries series, RefinedPoint point)
		{
			if (groupIndex >= 0)
			{
				((SideBySideGroup)base.Groups[groupIndex]).AddPoint(series, point);
			}
		}

		public override void RemovePoint(RefinedSeries series, RefinedPoint point)
		{
			int groupIndex = GetGroupIndex(series);
			if (groupIndex >= 0)
			{
				SideBySideGroup sideBySideGroup = (SideBySideGroup)base.Groups[groupIndex];
				sideBySideGroup.RemovePoint(point);
			}
			base.RemovePoint(series, point);
		}
	}
	public class SideBySideSeriesInteraction : SideBySideInteractionBase
	{
		public SideBySideSeriesInteraction()
			: base(equalBarWidth: true)
		{
		}

		protected override SideBySideGroupBase CreateGroup(RefinedSeries series)
		{
			return new SideBySideSeriesGroup(series);
		}
	}
	public abstract class ChartUpdateInfoBase
	{
		private readonly object sender;

		public object Sender => sender;

	public abstract class AxisScaleTypeMap : IScaleMap
	{
		private Transformation transformation;

		public abstract ActualScaleTypeCore ScaleType { get; }

		public Transformation Transformation
		{
			get
			{
				if (transformation == null)
				{
					transformation = new IdentityTransformation();
				}
				return transformation;
			}
		}

		public abstract object DefaultAxisValue { get; }

		public virtual bool SkipGaps => false;

		public static bool CheckArgumentScaleType(ISeriesPoint point, Scale scaleType)
		{
			switch (scaleType)
			{
			case Scale.Numerical:
			case Scale.DateTime:
			case Scale.TimeSpan:
				return point.ArgumentX.ArgumentScaleType == scaleType;
			default:
				return true;
			}
		}

		protected virtual Transformation CreateTransformation(IAxisData axis)
		{
			return new IdentityTransformation();
		}

		public void BuildTransformation(IAxisData axis)
		{
			transformation = CreateTransformation(axis);
		}

		public abstract AxisScaleTypeMap Clone();

		public abstract double NativeToInternal(object value);

		public abstract double NativeToRefined(object value);

		public abstract double SeriesPointToRefined(ISeriesPointArgument point);

		public abstract double SeriesPointToInternal(ISeriesPointArgument point);

		public abstract bool TryNativeToInternal(object value, out double result);

		public abstract bool TryNativeToRefined(object value, out double result);

		public abstract object InternalToNative(double value);

		public abstract double InternalToRefined(double value);

		public abstract double RefinedToInternal(double value);

		public abstract object ConvertValue(object value, CultureInfo culture);

		public abstract object TryParse(object value, CultureInfo culture);

		public abstract bool IsCompatible(object value);

		public abstract bool IsCompatibleType(Type type);

		public abstract double InternalToRefinedExact(double value);

		public abstract double RefinedToInternalExact(double value);

		public abstract object RefinedToNative(double value);

		public abstract double GetNextRefinedValueByMeasureUnit(double value);

		public virtual bool IsAxisValueVisible(object axisValue)
		{
			return true;
		}

		public double NativeToFinalWithConversion(object nativeValue, CultureInfo cultureInfo)
		{
			object value = ConvertValue(nativeValue, cultureInfo);
			return Transformation.TransformForward(NativeToInternal(value));
		}

		public virtual List<DoubleLimits> GetArgumentsWithoutGaps()
		{
			return null;
		}

		public virtual void UpdateArgumentsWithoutGaps(List<DoubleLimits> seriesArgumentsWithoutGaps)
		{
		}
	}
	public class AxisQualitativeMap : AxisScaleTypeMap, IPriorScaleMap
	{
		private struct ValueItem
		{
			private readonly string value;

			private int index;

			public string Value => value;

			public int Index
			{
				get
				{
					return index;
				}
				set
				{
					index = value;
				}
			}

			public ValueItem(string value)
			{
				this.value = value;
				index = -1;
			}

			public ValueItem(object value)
				: this(value.ToString())
			{
			}
		}

		private class ValueItemComparer : IComparer<ValueItem>
		{
			private StringComparer innerComparer = StringComparer.Ordinal;

			public int Compare(ValueItem x, ValueItem y)
			{
				return innerComparer.Compare(x.Value, y.Value);
			}
		}

		private class UserValueComparer : IComparer<string>
		{
			private readonly IComparer userComparer;

			public UserValueComparer(IComparer userComparer)
			{
				this.userComparer = userComparer;
			}

			public int Compare(string x, string y)
			{
				return userComparer.Compare(x, y);
			}
		}

		private readonly List<string> uniqueValues;

		private readonly List<ValueItem> sortedValues;

		private ValueItemComparer comparer = new ValueItemComparer();

		public override ActualScaleTypeCore ScaleType => ActualScaleTypeCore.Qualitative;

		public override object DefaultAxisValue => InternalToNative(0.0);

		public int UniqueValuesCount => uniqueValues.Count;

		public AxisQualitativeMap(List<string> uniqueValues)
		{
			this.uniqueValues = new List<string>(uniqueValues.Count);
			sortedValues = new List<ValueItem>(uniqueValues.Count);
			foreach (string uniqueValue in uniqueValues)
			{
				AddValue(uniqueValue);
			}
		}

		private void ModifyIndices(Predicate<int> shouldUpdateIndex, int dif)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < sortedValues.Count; i++)
			{
				ValueItem valueItem = sortedValues[i];
				if (shouldUpdateIndex(valueItem.Index))
				{
					sortedValues[i] = new ValueItem(valueItem.Value)
					{
						Index = valueItem.Index + dif
					};
				}
			}
		}

		private int IndexOf(object value)
		{
			int num = ((value != null) ? sortedValues.BinarySearch(new ValueItem(value), comparer) : (-1));
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				return sortedValues[num].Index;
			}
			return -1;
		}

		public void AddValue(object value)
		{
			if (value != null)
			{
				ValueItem valueItem = new ValueItem(value);
				valueItem.Index = uniqueValues.Count;
				ValueItem item = valueItem;
				int num = sortedValues.BinarySearch(item, comparer);
				if (num < 0)
				{
					num = ~num;
					sortedValues.Insert(num, item);
					uniqueValues.Add(item.Value);
				}
			}
		}

		public void Insert(object value, int index = 0)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			ValueItem valueItem = new ValueItem(value);
			valueItem.Index = index;
			ValueItem item = valueItem;
			int num = sortedValues.BinarySearch(item, comparer);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				num = ~num;
				ModifyIndices((int curIndex) => curIndex >= index, 1);
				sortedValues.Insert(num, item);
				uniqueValues.Insert(index, item.Value);
			}
		}

		public void InsertOrReplace(string value, int index = 0)
		{
			int num = sortedValues.FindIndex((ValueItem x) => x.Value == value);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				Insert(value, index);
				return;
			}
			ValueItem item = sortedValues[num];
			int oldItemIndex = item.Index;
			if (oldItemIndex > index)
			{
				ModifyIndices((int curIndex) => curIndex >= index && curIndex < oldItemIndex, 1);
			}
			else
			{
				ModifyIndices((int curIndex) => curIndex < index && curIndex > oldItemIndex, -1);
			}
			sortedValues.Remove(item);
			sortedValues.Insert(num, new ValueItem(value)
			{
				Index = Math.Min(index, sortedValues.Count)
			});
			uniqueValues.Remove(value);
			uniqueValues.Insert(Math.Min(index, uniqueValues.Count), value);
		}

		public void SortValues(IComparer comparer)
		{
			if (comparer == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			UserValueComparer userValueComparer = new UserValueComparer(comparer);
			uniqueValues.Sort(userValueComparer);
			for (int i = 0; i < uniqueValues.Count; i++)
			{
				string value = uniqueValues[i];
				int num = sortedValues.BinarySearch(new ValueItem(value), this.comparer);
				if (num >= 0)
				{
					ValueItem value2 = sortedValues[num];
					value2.Index = i;
					sortedValues[num] = value2;
				}
			}
		}

		public override double NativeToInternal(object value)
		{
			int num = IndexOf(value);
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				return num;
			}
			return double.NaN;
		}

		public override double NativeToRefined(object value)
		{
			return NativeToInternal(value);
		}

		public override bool TryNativeToInternal(object value, out double result)
		{
			result = IndexOf(value);
			return result >= 0.0;
		}

		public override bool TryNativeToRefined(object value, out double result)
		{
			return TryNativeToInternal(value, out result);
		}

		public override object InternalToNative(double value)
		{
			if (value > 2147483647.0)
			{
				value = 2147483647.0;
			}
			if (value < -2147483648.0)
			{
				value = -2147483648.0;
			}
			int num = Convert.ToInt32(value);
			if (num >= uniqueValues.Count || num < 0)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			return uniqueValues[num];
		}

		public override double RefinedToInternal(double value)
		{
			return value;
		}

		public override double InternalToRefined(double value)
		{
			return value;
		}

		public override double SeriesPointToRefined(ISeriesPointArgument point)
		{
			return NativeToRefined(point.QualitativeArgument);
		}

		public override double SeriesPointToInternal(ISeriesPointArgument point)
		{
			return NativeToInternal(point.QualitativeArgument);
		}

		public override object ConvertValue(object value, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			try
			{
				return Convert.ToString(value, culture);
			}
			catch
			{
				return value;
			}
		}

		public override object TryParse(object value, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (value is string result)
			{
				return result;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override bool IsCompatible(object value)
		{
			return value != null;
		}

		public override bool IsCompatibleType(Type type)
		{
			return type != null;
		}

		public override AxisScaleTypeMap Clone()
		{
			return new AxisQualitativeMap(uniqueValues);
		}

		public IList<string> GetValues()
		{
			return uniqueValues;
		}

		public override double InternalToRefinedExact(double value)
		{
			return value;
		}

		public override double RefinedToInternalExact(double value)
		{
			return value;
		}

		public override object RefinedToNative(double value)
		{
			return InternalToNative(RefinedToInternalExact(value));
		}

		public override double GetNextRefinedValueByMeasureUnit(double value)
		{
			return value + 1.0;
		}

		double IPriorScaleMap.NativeToInternal(object value)
		{
			return NativeToInternal(value);
		}

		object IPriorScaleMap.InternalToNative(double value)
		{
			return InternalToNative(value);
		}

		void IPriorScaleMap.UpdateMin(double min)
		{
		}
	}
	public class AxisNumericalMap : AxisScaleTypeMap, IPriorScaleMap
	{
		protected const double DoubleInaccuracy = 1E-10;

		private readonly double? measureUnit;

		public double? MeasureUnit => measureUnit;

		public override ActualScaleTypeCore ScaleType => ActualScaleTypeCore.Numerical;

		public override object DefaultAxisValue => 1.0;

		public AxisNumericalMap()
		{
			measureUnit = null;
		}

		public AxisNumericalMap(double measureUnit)
		{
			if (!double.IsNaN(measureUnit))
			{
				this.measureUnit = measureUnit;
			}
		}

		protected override Transformation CreateTransformation(IAxisData axis)
		{
			if (axis is ILogarithmic { Enabled: not false } logarithmic)
			{
				return new LogarithmicTransformation(logarithmic.Base);
			}
			return base.CreateTransformation(axis);
		}

		public override double NativeToInternal(object value)
		{
			if (value != null && PredefinedTypesHelper.IsNumericalType(value.GetType()))
			{
				return RefinedToInternal(Convert.ToDouble(value));
			}
			return 0.0;
		}

		public override double NativeToRefined(object value)
		{
			if (value == null || !PredefinedTypesHelper.IsNumericalType(value.GetType()))
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			return Convert.ToDouble(value);
		}

		public override bool TryNativeToInternal(object value, out double result)
		{
			double? num = DataItemsHelper.ParseNumerical(value);
			if (num.HasValue)
			{
				result = NativeToInternal(num.Value);
				return true;
			}
			result = 0.0;
			return false;
		}

		public override bool TryNativeToRefined(object value, out double result)
		{
			double? num = DataItemsHelper.ParseNumerical(value);
			if (num.HasValue)
			{
				result = NativeToRefined(num.Value);
				return true;
			}
			result = 0.0;
			return false;
		}

		public override object InternalToNative(double value)
		{
			return measureUnit.HasValue ? Math.Round(value * measureUnit.Value, 15) : value;
		}

		public override double InternalToRefined(double value)
		{
			if (!measureUnit.HasValue)
			{
				return value;
			}
			return Math.Round(value * measureUnit.Value, 15);
		}

		public override double RefinedToInternal(double value)
		{
			if (measureUnit.HasValue)
			{
				double num = value / measureUnit.Value;
				if (num > 0.0)
				{
					num += 1E-10;
				}
				return Math.Floor(num);
			}
			return value;
		}

		public override double SeriesPointToRefined(ISeriesPointArgument point)
		{
			return NativeToRefined(point.NumericalArgument);
		}

		public override double SeriesPointToInternal(ISeriesPointArgument point)
		{
			return NativeToInternal(point.NumericalArgument);
		}

		public override object ConvertValue(object value, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (value != null)
			{
				double result;
				if (!(value is string s))
				{
					if (value.GetType() == typeof(DateTime) || value.GetType() == typeof(TimeSpan))
					{
						return value;
					}
					try
					{
						return Convert.ToDouble(value, culture);
					}
					catch
					{
					}
				}
				else if (double.TryParse(s, NumberStyles.Float | NumberStyles.AllowThousands, culture, out result))
				{
					return result;
				}
			}
			return value;
		}

		public override object TryParse(object value, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!(value is string s))
			{
				return value;
			}
			if (double.TryParse(s, NumberStyles.Float | NumberStyles.AllowThousands, culture, out var result))
			{
				return result;
			}
			return value;
		}

		public override bool IsCompatible(object value)
		{
			if (!(value is double))
			{
				return value is int;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override bool IsCompatibleType(Type type)
		{
			if (type != null)
			{
				return type.IsAssignableFrom(typeof(double));
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override AxisScaleTypeMap Clone()
		{
			if (measureUnit.HasValue)
			{
				return new AxisNumericalMap(measureUnit.Value);
			}
			return new AxisNumericalMap();
		}

		public override double InternalToRefinedExact(double value)
		{
			return InternalToRefined(value);
		}

		public override double RefinedToInternalExact(double value)
		{
			if (!measureUnit.HasValue)
			{
				return value;
			}
			return value / measureUnit.Value;
		}

		public override object RefinedToNative(double value)
		{
			return InternalToNative(RefinedToInternalExact(value));
		}

		public override double GetNextRefinedValueByMeasureUnit(double value)
		{
			if (!measureUnit.HasValue)
			{
				return value;
			}
			return Math.Round(value + measureUnit.Value, 15);
		}

		double IPriorScaleMap.NativeToInternal(object value)
		{
			return NativeToInternal(value);
		}

		object IPriorScaleMap.InternalToNative(double value)

	public enum AnnotationLocation
	{
		TopRight,
		TopLeft,
		BottomRight,
		BottomLeft
	}
	public interface IAnnotationLayout
	{
		GRealPoint2D AnchorPoint { get; }

		double CursorOffset { get; }

		bool ShowTail { get; }

		GRealPoint2D InitOffset { get; }

		GRealSize2D Size { get; }

		AnnotationLocation Location { get; set; }

		GRealRect2D Bounds { get; set; }

		GRealPoint2D Offset { get; set; }
	}
	public static class AnnotationLayoutCalculator
	{
		private class CrosshairLabelsComparer : IComparer<IAnnotationLayout>
		{
			private readonly GRealPoint2D separator;

			public CrosshairLabelsComparer(GRealPoint2D separator)
			{
				this.separator = separator;
			}

			public int Compare(IAnnotationLayout layout1, IAnnotationLayout layout2)
			{
				GRealPoint2D anchorPoint = layout1.AnchorPoint;
				GRealPoint2D anchorPoint2 = layout2.AnchorPoint;
				if (Math.Sign(anchorPoint.X - separator.X) != Math.Sign(anchorPoint2.X - separator.X))
				{
					return (int)(anchorPoint.X - anchorPoint2.X);
				}
				return (int)(anchorPoint.Y - anchorPoint2.Y);
			}
		}

		private const int defaultTailOffset = 20;

		private static AnnotationLocation[] GetPriorityHorizontalLocations(AnnotationLocation location)
		{
			return location switch
			{
				AnnotationLocation.TopRight => new AnnotationLocation[4]
				{
					AnnotationLocation.TopRight,
					AnnotationLocation.TopLeft,
					AnnotationLocation.BottomRight,
					AnnotationLocation.BottomLeft
				}, 
				AnnotationLocation.TopLeft => new AnnotationLocation[4]
				{
					AnnotationLocation.TopLeft,
					AnnotationLocation.TopRight,
					AnnotationLocation.BottomLeft,
					AnnotationLocation.BottomRight
				}, 
				AnnotationLocation.BottomRight => new AnnotationLocation[4]
				{
					AnnotationLocation.BottomRight,
					AnnotationLocation.BottomLeft,
					AnnotationLocation.TopRight,
					AnnotationLocation.TopLeft
				}, 
				AnnotationLocation.BottomLeft => new AnnotationLocation[4]
				{
					AnnotationLocation.BottomLeft,
					AnnotationLocation.BottomRight,
					AnnotationLocation.TopLeft,
					AnnotationLocation.TopRight
				}, 
				_ => null, 
			};
		}

		private static AnnotationLocation[] GetPriorityVerticalLocations(AnnotationLocation location)
		{
			return location switch
			{
				AnnotationLocation.TopRight => new AnnotationLocation[4]
				{
					AnnotationLocation.TopRight,
					AnnotationLocation.BottomRight,
					AnnotationLocation.TopLeft,
					AnnotationLocation.BottomLeft
				}, 
				AnnotationLocation.TopLeft => new AnnotationLocation[4]
				{
					AnnotationLocation.TopLeft,
					AnnotationLocation.BottomLeft,
					AnnotationLocation.TopRight,
					AnnotationLocation.BottomRight
				}, 
				AnnotationLocation.BottomRight => new AnnotationLocation[4]
				{
					AnnotationLocation.BottomRight,
					AnnotationLocation.TopRight,
					AnnotationLocation.BottomLeft,
					AnnotationLocation.TopLeft
				}, 
				AnnotationLocation.BottomLeft => new AnnotationLocation[4]
				{
					AnnotationLocation.BottomLeft,
					AnnotationLocation.TopLeft,
					AnnotationLocation.BottomRight,
					AnnotationLocation.TopRight
				}, 
				_ => null, 
			};
		}

		private static double CalculateLayoutCriteria(GRealRect2D annotationBounds, List<GRealRect2D> reservedRects, GRealRect2D constraintBounds)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			if (!constraintBounds.Contains(annotationBounds))
			{
				GRealRect2D gRealRect2D = GRealRect2D.Intersect(constraintBounds, annotationBounds);
				num += annotationBounds.Width * annotationBounds.Height - gRealRect2D.Width * gRealRect2D.Height;
			}
			if (reservedRects != null)
			{
				foreach (GRealRect2D reservedRect in reservedRects)
				{
					GRealRect2D gRealRect2D2 = GRealRect2D.Intersect(reservedRect, annotationBounds);
					num += gRealRect2D2.Width * gRealRect2D2.Height;
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		public static GRealRect2D CalculateLocationBounds(GRealPoint2D anchorPoint, GRealSize2D size, AnnotationLocation location, GRealPoint2D offset, double cursorOffset)
		{
			double left = 0.0;
			double top = 0.0;
			switch (location)
			{
			case AnnotationLocation.TopRight:
			case AnnotationLocation.BottomRight:
				left = anchorPoint.X + offset.X;
				break;
			case AnnotationLocation.TopLeft:
			case AnnotationLocation.BottomLeft:
				left = anchorPoint.X - size.Width - offset.X;
				break;
			}
			switch (location)
			{
			case AnnotationLocation.TopRight:
			case AnnotationLocation.TopLeft:
				top = anchorPoint.Y - size.Height - offset.Y;
				break;
			case AnnotationLocation.BottomRight:
			case AnnotationLocation.BottomLeft:
				top = anchorPoint.Y + offset.Y + cursorOffset;
				break;
			}
			return new GRealRect2D(left, top, size.Width, size.Height);
		}

		private static GRealPoint2D CalculateLayoutOffset(GRealPoint2D initOffset, bool showTail)
		{
			GRealPoint2D result = initOffset;
			if (showTail)
			{
				result.X -= 20.0;
			}
			return result;
		}

		private static void ApplyLayoutParams(IAnnotationLayout layout, GRealRect2D bounds, AnnotationLocation location, GRealPoint2D offset)
		{
			layout.Bounds = bounds;
			layout.Location = location;
			layout.Offset = offset;
		}

		private static void CalculateAutoLayout(IAnnotationLayout layout, AnnotationLocation[] priorityLocations, GRealRect2D constraintBounds, List<GRealRect2D> reservedRects)
		{
			foreach (AnnotationLocation location in priorityLocations)
			{
				GRealPoint2D offset = CalculateLayoutOffset(layout.InitOffset, layout.ShowTail);
				GRealRect2D gRealRect2D = CalculateLocationBounds(layout.AnchorPoint, layout.Size, location, offset, layout.CursorOffset);
				bool flag = false;
				if (!flag && reservedRects != null)
				{
					foreach (GRealRect2D reservedRect in reservedRects)
					{
						flag = GRealRect2D.IsIntersected(gRealRect2D, reservedRect);
						if (flag)
						{
							break;
						}
					}
				}
				if (!flag && constraintBounds.Contains(gRealRect2D))
				{
					ApplyLayoutParams(layout, gRealRect2D, location, offset);
					return;
				}
				if (layout.Bounds.IsEmpty)
				{
					ApplyLayoutParams(layout, gRealRect2D, location, offset);
					continue;
				}
				double num = CalculateLayoutCriteria(layout.Bounds, reservedRects, constraintBounds);
				double num2 = CalculateLayoutCriteria(gRealRect2D, reservedRects, constraintBounds);
				if (num2 - num < 0.0)
				{
					ApplyLayoutParams(layout, gRealRect2D, location, offset);
				}
			}
			CorrectLayoutByConstraint(layout, constraintBounds);
		}

		private static void CorrectLayoutByConstraint(IAnnotationLayout layout, GRealRect2D constraintBounds)
		{
			double num = layout.Bounds.Left - constraintBounds.Left;
			double num2 = layout.Bounds.Top - constraintBounds.Top;
			double num3 = constraintBounds.Right - layout.Bounds.Right;
			double num4 = constraintBounds.Bottom - layout.Bounds.Bottom;
			double dx = 0.0;
			double dy = 0.0;
			if (!layout.ShowTail)
			{
				if (num < 0.0)
				{
					dx = 0.0 - num;
				}
				else if (num3 < 0.0)
				{
					dx = ((!(num + num3 >= 0.0)) ? (0.0 - num) : num3);
				}
				if (num2 < 0.0)
				{
					dy = 0.0 - num2;
				}
				else if (num4 < 0.0)
				{
					dy = ((!(num2 + num4 >= 0.0)) ? (0.0 - num2) : num4);
				}
			}
			else if (num < 0.0 && (layout.Location == AnnotationLocation.TopRight || layout.Location == AnnotationLocation.BottomRight))
			{
				dx = Math.Abs(layout.Offset.X);
				layout.Offset = new GRealPoint2D(0.0, layout.Offset.Y);
			}
			else if (num3 < 0.0 && (layout.Location == AnnotationLocation.TopLeft || layout.Location == AnnotationLocation.BottomLeft))
			{
				dx = 0.0 - Math.Abs(layout.Offset.X);
				layout.Offset = new GRealPoint2D(0.0, layout.Offset.Y);
			}
			GRealRect2D bounds = layout.Bounds;
			bounds.Offset(dx, dy);
			layout.Bounds = bounds;
		}

		public static void CalculateAutoLayout(IAnnotationLayout layout, AnnotationLocation defaultLocation, GRealRect2D constraintBounds)
		{
			CalculateAutoLayout(layout, GetPriorityHorizontalLocations(defaultLocation), constraintBounds, null);
		}

		public static void CalculateAutoLayout(List<IAnnotationLayout> labels, GRealRect2D constraintBounds)
		{
			List<GRealPoint2D> list = new List<GRealPoint2D>();
			foreach (IAnnotationLayout label in labels)
			{
				list.Add(label.AnchorPoint);
			}
			GRealPoint2D separator = GeometricUtils.CalcMean(list);
			labels.Sort(new CrosshairLabelsComparer(separator));
			List<GRealRect2D> list2 = new List<GRealRect2D>();
			foreach (IAnnotationLayout label2 in labels)
			{
				AnnotationLocation location = ((label2.AnchorPoint.X < separator.X) ? AnnotationLocation.TopLeft : AnnotationLocation.TopRight);
				CalculateAutoLayout(label2, GetPriorityVerticalLocations(location), constraintBounds, list2);
				list2.Add(label2.Bounds);
			}
		}

		public static void CalculateAutoLayout(List<IAnnotationLayout> labels)
		{
			foreach (IAnnotationLayout label in labels)
			{
				CalculateAutoLayout(label);
			}
		}

		public static void CalculateAutoLayout(IAnnotationLayout layout)
		{
			GRealPoint2D offset = CalculateLayoutOffset(layout.InitOffset, layout.ShowTail);
			GRealRect2D bounds = CalculateLocationBounds(layout.AnchorPoint, layout.Size, layout.Location, offset, layout.CursorOffset);
			ApplyLayoutParams(layout, bounds, layout.Location, offset);
		}
	}

	public class ResolveOverlappingByColumn : SimpleDiagramResolveOverlapping
	{
		private class LabelInfoComparer : IComparer<LabelInfo>
		{
			public int Compare(LabelInfo x, LabelInfo y)
			{
				//IL_0023: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0028: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0033: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0038: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_004f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0054: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_005f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0064: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				if (x == null)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				if (y == null)
				{
					return 1;
				}
				IPieLabelLayout pieLabelLayout = (IPieLabelLayout)x.Label;
				IPieLabelLayout pieLabelLayout2 = (IPieLabelLayout)y.Label;
				DXRectangle labelBounds = pieLabelLayout.LabelBounds;
				double num = ((DXRectangle)(ref labelBounds)).Top;
				labelBounds = pieLabelLayout.LabelBounds;
				double num2 = num + (double)((DXRectangle)(ref labelBounds)).Height * 0.5;
				labelBounds = pieLabelLayout2.LabelBounds;
				double num3 = ((DXRectangle)(ref labelBounds)).Top;
				labelBounds = pieLabelLayout2.LabelBounds;
				double value = num3 + (double)((DXRectangle)(ref labelBounds)).Height * 0.5;
				if (pieLabelLayout.Angle != pieLabelLayout2.Angle)
				{
					return Math.Sin(pieLabelLayout.Angle).CompareTo(Math.Sin(pieLabelLayout2.Angle));
				}
				return num2.CompareTo(value);
			}
		}

		private class LabelInfo
		{
			private readonly ILabelLayout label;

			private LabelInfo prev;

			private LabelInfo next;

			private GRealRect2D labelBounds;

			private GRealRect2D correctedLabelBounds;

			private GRealRect2D bounds;

			public GRealRect2D Bounds
			{
				get
				{
					return bounds;
				}
				set
				{
					bounds = value;
				}
			}

			public ILabelLayout Label => label;

			public double Center => labelBounds.Center.Y;

			public LabelInfo Prev
			{
				get
				{
					return prev;
				}
				set
				{
					prev = value;
				}
			}

			public LabelInfo Next
			{
				get
				{
					return next;
				}
				set
				{
					next = value;
				}
			}

			public GRealRect2D LabelBounds => labelBounds;

			public GRealRect2D CorrectedLabelBounds => correctedLabelBounds;

			public void Flush(GRealRect2D bounds)
			{
				//IL_0007: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				Label.LabelBounds = GeometricUtils.StrongRound(bounds);
			}

			public LabelInfo(IPieLabelLayout label, GRealRect2D bounds, int resolveOverlappingMinIndent)
			{
				//IL_000f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0014: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_001e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0023: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_002d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0032: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_003c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0041: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				this.label = label;
				DXRectangle val = label.LabelBounds;
				double left = ((DXRectangle)(ref val)).Left;
				val = label.LabelBounds;
				double top = ((DXRectangle)(ref val)).Top;
				val = label.LabelBounds;
				double width = ((DXRectangle)(ref val)).Width;
				val = label.LabelBounds;
				labelBounds = new GRealRect2D(left, top, width, ((DXRectangle)(ref val)).Height);
				correctedLabelBounds = GRealRect2D.Inflate(labelBounds, (double)resolveOverlappingMinIndent / 2.0, (double)resolveOverlappingMinIndent / 2.0);
				Bounds = bounds;
			}

			public double GetOverlap()
			{
				double num = ((Prev == null) ? (LabelBounds.Top - Bounds.Top) : (CorrectedLabelBounds.Top - Prev.CorrectedLabelBounds.Bottom));
				double num2 = ((Next == null) ? (Bounds.Bottom - LabelBounds.Bottom) : (Next.CorrectedLabelBounds.Top - CorrectedLabelBounds.Bottom));
				double num3 = 0.0;
				if (num < 0.0)
				{
					num3 += Math.Abs(num);
				}
				if (num2 < 0.0)
				{
					num3 += Math.Abs(num2);
				}
				return num3;
			}

			public void Offset(double offset)
			{
				labelBounds.Offset(0.0, offset);
				correctedLabelBounds.Offset(0.0, offset);
			}
		}

		public void ArrangeLabels(IList<IPieLabelLayout> labels, GRealRect2D bounds, int resolveOverlappingMinIndent)
		{
			if (labels != null && labels.Count != 0)
			{
				List<IPieLabelLayout> list = new List<IPieLabelLayout>();
				List<IPieLabelLayout> list2 = new List<IPieLabelLayout>();
				GroupLabelsByColumns(labels, list, list2);
				ArrangeGroup(list, bounds, resolveOverlappingMinIndent);
				ArrangeGroup(list2, bounds, resolveOverlappingMinIndent);
			}
		}

		public void ArrangeGroup(List<IPieLabelLayout> labels, GRealRect2D bounds, int resolveOverlappingMinIndent)
		{
			List<LabelInfo> labelsForArrangeByColumn = GetLabelsForArrangeByColumn(labels, bounds, resolveOverlappingMinIndent);
			double num = CalcWholeOverlap(labelsForArrangeByColumn, bounds);
			List<double> focuses = CalcFocuses(bounds);
			if (num > 0.0)
			{
				ArrangeOverlapping(labelsForArrangeByColumn, num);
			}
			else
			{
				ArrangeNonOverlapping(labelsForArrangeByColumn, focuses);
			}
			foreach (LabelInfo item in labelsForArrangeByColumn)
			{
				item.Flush(item.LabelBounds);
			}
		}

		private void GroupLabelsByColumns(IList<IPieLabelLayout> labels, List<IPieLabelLayout> left, List<IPieLabelLayout> right)
		{
			foreach (IPieLabelLayout label in labels)
			{
				if (Math.Cos(label.Angle) >= 0.0)
				{
					right.Add(label);
				}
				else
				{
					left.Add(label);
				}
			}
		}

		private bool Arrange(LabelInfo labelInfo, bool bottomPriority)
		{
			if (bottomPriority)
			{
				BottomArrange(labelInfo);
				TopArrange(labelInfo);
			}
			else
			{
				TopArrange(labelInfo);
				BottomArrange(labelInfo);
			}
			return labelInfo.GetOverlap() == 0.0;
		}

		private bool IsBottomPriority(LabelInfo label, IList<double> focuses)
		{
			double num = double.NaN;
			foreach (double focuse in focuses)
			{
				double num2 = Math.Abs(label.Center - focuse);
				if (double.IsNaN(num) || num2 < Math.Abs(label.Center - num))
				{
					num = focuse;
				}
			}
			if (!double.IsNaN(num))
			{
				return label.Center < num;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private List<LabelInfo> GetLabelsForArrangeByColumn(IList<IPieLabelLayout> labels, GRealRect2D bounds, int resolveOverlappingMinIndent)
		{
			List<LabelInfo> list = new List<LabelInfo>();
			foreach (IPieLabelLayout label in labels)
			{
				LabelInfo labelInfo = new LabelInfo(label, bounds, resolveOverlappingMinIndent);
				if (label.Visible && label.ResolveOverlapping && labelInfo.LabelBounds.Width > 0.0 && labelInfo.LabelBounds.Height > 0.0)
				{
					list.Add(labelInfo);
				}
			}
			list.Sort(new LabelInfoComparer());
			return list;
		}

		private List<double> CalcFocuses(GRealRect2D bounds)
		{
			List<double> list = new List<double>();
			list.Add(bounds.Top);
			list.Add(bounds.Top + bounds.Height);
			return list;
		}

		private double CalcWholeOverlap(IList<LabelInfo> labels, GRealRect2D bounds)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			for (int i = 0; i < labels.Count; i++)
			{
				num = ((i != 0 && i != labels.Count - 1) ? (num + labels[i].CorrectedLabelBounds.Height) : (num + (labels[i].LabelBounds.Height / 2.0 + labels[i].CorrectedLabelBounds.Height / 2.0)));
			}
			if (!(bounds.Height >= num))
			{
				return num - bounds.Height;
			}
			return 0.0;
		}

		private void ArrangeOverlapping(IList<LabelInfo> labels, double wholeOverlap)
		{
			if (labels.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			labels[0].Offset(0.0 - CalculateTopMargin(labels[0]));
			if (labels.Count == 1)
			{
				return;
			}
			double num = wholeOverlap / (double)(labels.Count - 1);
			for (int i = 1; i < labels.Count; i++)
			{
				LabelInfo labelInfo = labels[i - 1];
				LabelInfo labelInfo2 = labels[i];
				double num2 = labelInfo.CorrectedLabelBounds.Bottom + labelInfo2.CorrectedLabelBounds.Height / 2.0 - num;
				labelInfo2.Offset(num2 - labelInfo2.Center);
				if (CalculateBottomMargin(labelInfo2) < 0.0)
				{
					labelInfo2.Offset(CalculateBottomMargin(labelInfo2));
				}
				if (CalculateTopMargin(labelInfo2) < 0.0)
				{
					labelInfo2.Offset(0.0 - CalculateTopMargin(labelInfo2));
				}
			}
		}

		private void SetLabelItemPrevAndNext(LabelInfo label, LabelInfo prev, LabelInfo next)
		{
			label.Prev = prev;
			label.Next = next;
		}

		private void ArrangeNonOverlapping(IList<LabelInfo> labels, IList<double> focuses)
		{
			List<LabelInfo> list = new List<LabelInfo>(labels);
			LabelInfo labelInfo = null;
			LabelInfo labelInfo2 = null;
			for (int i = 0; i < labels.Count; i++)
			{
				bool flag = i % 2 == 0;
				int index = ((!flag) ? (list.Count - 1) : 0);
				LabelInfo labelInfo3 = list[index];
				list.RemoveAt(index);
				SetLabelItemPrevAndNext(labelInfo3, labelInfo, labelInfo2);
				if (labelInfo != null)
				{
					labelInfo.Next = labelInfo3;
				}
				if (labelInfo2 != null)
				{
					labelInfo2.Prev = labelInfo3;
				}
				bool bottomPriority = IsBottomPriority(labelInfo3, focuses);
				if (Arrange(labelInfo3, bottomPriority))
				{
					if (flag)
					{
						labelInfo = labelInfo3;
					}
					else
					{
						labelInfo2 = labelInfo3;
					}
					continue;
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		private void PushToBottom(LabelInfo labelInfo, double val)
		{
			if (CalculateBottomMargin(labelInfo) >= val)
			{
				labelInfo.Offset(val);
				return;
			}
			PushNextToBottom(labelInfo, val - CalculateBottomMargin(labelInfo));
			labelInfo.Offset(CalculateBottomMargin(labelInfo));
		}

		private double CalculateTopMargin(LabelInfo labelInfo)
		{
			if (labelInfo.Prev != null)
			{
				return labelInfo.CorrectedLabelBounds.Top - labelInfo.Prev.CorrectedLabelBounds.Bottom;
			}
			return labelInfo.LabelBounds.Top - labelInfo.Bounds.Top;
		}

		private double CalculateBottomMargin(LabelInfo labelInfo)
		{
			if (labelInfo.Next != null)
			{
				return labelInfo.Next.CorrectedLabelBounds.Top - labelInfo.CorrectedLabelBounds.Bottom;
			}
			return labelInfo.Bounds.Bottom - labelInfo.LabelBounds.Bottom;
		}

		private void PushToTop(LabelInfo labelInfo, double val)
		{
			if (CalculateTopMargin(labelInfo) >= val)
			{
				labelInfo.Offset(0.0 - val);
				return;
			}
			PushPrevToTop(labelInfo, val - CalculateTopMargin(labelInfo));
			labelInfo.Offset(0.0 - CalculateTopMargin(labelInfo));
		}

		private void PushNextToBottom(LabelInfo labelInfo, double val)
		{
			if (labelInfo.Next != null)
			{
				PushToBottom(labelInfo.Next, val);
			}
		}

		private void PushPrevToTop(LabelInfo labelInfo, double val)
		{
			if (labelInfo.Prev != null)
			{
				PushToTop(labelInfo.Prev, val);
			}
		}

		private void BottomArrange(LabelInfo labelInfo)
		{
			double overlap = labelInfo.GetOverlap();
			if (overlap != 0.0)
			{
				if (CalculateBottomMargin(labelInfo) < 0.0)
				{
					labelInfo.Offset(CalculateBottomMargin(labelInfo));
				}
				PushToBottom(labelInfo, overlap);
			}
		}

		private void TopArrange(LabelInfo labelInfo)
		{
			double overlap = labelInfo.GetOverlap();
			if (overlap != 0.0)
			{
				if (CalculateTopMargin(labelInfo) < 0.0)
				{
					labelInfo.Offset(CalculateTopMargin(labelInfo));
				}
				PushToTop(labelInfo, overlap);
			}
		}
	}
	public class ResolveOverlappingByEllipse : SimpleDiagramResolveOverlapping
	{
