			public LabelInfo(ILabelLayout label, GRealEllipse ellipse, int resolveOverlappingMinIndent)
			{
				//IL_001b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0020: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0032: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0037: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0049: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_004e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0057: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_005c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0071: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0076: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_007f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0084: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				this.label = label;
				center = ellipse.Center;
				DXRectangle labelBounds = label.LabelBounds;
				occupiedWidth = ((DXRectangle)(ref labelBounds)).Width + resolveOverlappingMinIndent;
				labelBounds = label.LabelBounds;
				occupiedHeight = ((DXRectangle)(ref labelBounds)).Height + resolveOverlappingMinIndent;
				labelBounds = label.LabelBounds;
				int left = ((DXRectangle)(ref labelBounds)).Left;
				labelBounds = label.LabelBounds;
				double x = (double)(left + ((DXRectangle)(ref labelBounds)).Right) / 2.0;
				labelBounds = label.LabelBounds;
				int top = ((DXRectangle)(ref labelBounds)).Top;
				labelBounds = label.LabelBounds;
				SetCenter(new GRealPoint2D(x, (double)(top + ((DXRectangle)(ref labelBounds)).Bottom) / 2.0));
			}

			public void Flush(GRealRect2D bounds, int resolveOverlappingMinIndent)
			{
				//IL_0036: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				Label.LabelBounds = new DXRectangle((int)Math.Round(bounds.Left), (int)Math.Round(bounds.Top), (int)(bounds.Width - (double)resolveOverlappingMinIndent), (int)(bounds.Height - (double)resolveOverlappingMinIndent));
			}

			public void SetCenter(GRealPoint2D point)
			{
				Bounds = new GRealRect2D(point.X - 0.5 * occupiedWidth, point.Y - 0.5 * occupiedHeight, occupiedWidth, occupiedHeight);
				refAngle = Math.Atan2(center.Y - Bounds.Center.Y, Bounds.Center.X - center.X);
			}

			int IComparable<LabelInfo>.CompareTo(LabelInfo other)
			{
				if (other == null)
				{
					return 1;
				}
				return refAngle.CompareTo(other.refAngle);
			}
		}

		private class LabelInfoGroup : List<LabelInfo>, IComparable<LabelInfoGroup>
		{
			public LabelInfoGroup()
			{
			}

			public LabelInfoGroup(LabelInfo info)
			{
				Add(info);
			}

			int IComparable<LabelInfoGroup>.CompareTo(LabelInfoGroup other)
			{
				return base.Count.CompareTo(other.Count);
			}
		}

		private List<LabelInfo> list;

		private List<LabelInfo> sortedList;

		private GRealPoint2D center;

		public void ArrangeLabels(IList<IPieLabelLayout> labels, GRealEllipse ellipse, int resolveOverlappingMinIndent, PointsSweepDirection direction, GRealRect2D diagramBounds)
		{
			center = ellipse.Center;
			List<LabelInfo> labelsInfoForArrangeByEllipse = GetLabelsInfoForArrangeByEllipse(labels, ellipse, resolveOverlappingMinIndent);
			if (labelsInfoForArrangeByEllipse.Count < 2)
			{
				return;
			}
			ArrangeByEllipseInternal(labelsInfoForArrangeByEllipse, direction, diagramBounds);
			foreach (LabelInfo item in labelsInfoForArrangeByEllipse)
			{
				item.Flush(item.Bounds, resolveOverlappingMinIndent);
			}
		}

		private List<LabelInfo> GetLabelsInfoForArrangeByEllipse(IList<IPieLabelLayout> labels, GRealEllipse ellipse, int resolveOverlappingMinIndent)
		{
			//IL_003e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0043: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0053: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0063: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_006e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0073: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			List<LabelInfo> list = new List<LabelInfo>();
			if (labels != null)
			{
				foreach (IPieLabelLayout label in labels)
				{
					if (label == null || !label.Visible || !label.ResolveOverlapping)
					{
						continue;
					}
					DXRectangle labelBounds = label.LabelBounds;
					double left = ((DXRectangle)(ref labelBounds)).Left;
					labelBounds = label.LabelBounds;
					double top = ((DXRectangle)(ref labelBounds)).Top;
					labelBounds = label.LabelBounds;
					double width = ((DXRectangle)(ref labelBounds)).Width;
					labelBounds = label.LabelBounds;
					GRealRect2D gRealRect2D = new GRealRect2D(left, top, width, ((DXRectangle)(ref labelBounds)).Height);
					if (gRealRect2D.Width > 0.0 && gRealRect2D.Height > 0.0)
					{
						gRealRect2D.Inflate((double)resolveOverlappingMinIndent / 2.0, (double)resolveOverlappingMinIndent / 2.0);
						if (gRealRect2D.Width > 0.0 && gRealRect2D.Height > 0.0)
						{
							list.Add(new LabelInfo(label, ellipse, resolveOverlappingMinIndent));
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		private List<LabelInfoGroup> CalcGroups(List<LabelInfo> labelsInfo)
		{
			List<LabelInfoGroup> list = new List<LabelInfoGroup>();
			LabelInfoGroup labelInfoGroup = new LabelInfoGroup();
			for (int i = 0; i < labelsInfo.Count; i++)
			{
				if (IsPositionValidByBounds(labelsInfo[i]))
				{
					if (labelInfoGroup.Count > 0)
					{
						list.Add(labelInfoGroup);
						labelInfoGroup = new LabelInfoGroup();
					}
					list.Add(new LabelInfoGroup(labelsInfo[i]));
				}
				else
				{
					labelInfoGroup.Add(labelsInfo[i]);
				}
			}
			if (labelInfoGroup.Count > 0)
			{
				if (list.Count == 0 || IsPositionValidByBounds(labelsInfo[0]))
				{
					list.Add(labelInfoGroup);
				}
				else
				{
					labelInfoGroup.AddRange(list[0]);
					list[0] = labelInfoGroup;
				}
			}
			list.Sort();
			return list;
		}

		private void ArrangeByEllipseInternal(List<LabelInfo> labelsInfo, PointsSweepDirection direction, GRealRect2D diagramBounds)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < labelsInfo.Count; i++)
			{
				int index = ((i != labelsInfo.Count - 1) ? (i + 1) : 0);
				int index2 = ((i == 0) ? (labelsInfo.Count - 1) : (i - 1));
				labelsInfo[i].Next = labelsInfo[index];
				labelsInfo[i].Prev = labelsInfo[index2];
			}
			List<LabelInfoGroup> list = CalcGroups(labelsInfo);
			this.list = new List<LabelInfo>();
			foreach (LabelInfoGroup item in list)
			{
				if (item.Count == 1)
				{
					Arrange(item[0], direction, diagramBounds);
					continue;
				}
				int num = 0;
				int num2 = item.Count - 1;
				while (num <= num2)
				{
					Arrange(item[num], direction, diagramBounds);
					if (num != num2)
					{
						Arrange(item[num2], direction, diagramBounds);
					}
					num++;
					num2--;
				}
			}
		}

		private bool Arrange(LabelInfo labelInfo, PointsSweepDirection direction, GRealRect2D diagramBounds)
		{
			list.Add(labelInfo);
			sortedList = list;
			sortedList.Sort();
			labelInfo.Arranged = true;
			if (IsPositionValid(labelInfo))
			{
				return true;
			}
			labelInfo.CurrentSrc = true;
			Push(GetArrangedNext(labelInfo), direction, diagramBounds, forward: true);
			Push(GetArrangedPrev(labelInfo), direction, diagramBounds, forward: false);
			labelInfo.CurrentSrc = false;
			return IsPositionValid(labelInfo);
		}

		private void Push(LabelInfo labelInfo, PointsSweepDirection direction, GRealRect2D diagramBounds, bool forward)
		{
			if (!labelInfo.CurrentSrc && !IsPositionValid(labelInfo, forward))
			{
				GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D = CalcCenter(labelInfo, forward, direction);
				labelInfo.SetCenter(gRealPoint2D);
				CorrectCenterByDiagramBounds(labelInfo, gRealPoint2D, diagramBounds, direction);
				if (sortedList != null)
				{
					sortedList.Sort();
				}
				if (forward)
				{
					Push(GetArrangedNext(labelInfo), direction, diagramBounds, forward);
				}
				else
				{
					Push(GetArrangedPrev(labelInfo), direction, diagramBounds, forward);
				}
			}
		}

		private void CorrectCenterByDiagramBounds(LabelInfo labelInfo, GRealPoint2D center, GRealRect2D diagramBounds, PointsSweepDirection direction)
		{
			GRealRect2D bounds = labelInfo.Prev.Bounds;
			GRealRect2D bounds2 = labelInfo.Next.Bounds;
			bool flag = labelInfo.Bounds.Top - diagramBounds.Top <= 0.0;
			bool flag2 = diagramBounds.Bottom - labelInfo.Bounds.Bottom <= 0.0;
			bool flag3 = direction == PointsSweepDirection.Clockwise;
			if (!(flag || flag2))
			{
				return;
			}
			GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D = (flag ? new GRealPoint2D(center.X, diagramBounds.Top + labelInfo.Bounds.Height / 2.0) : new GRealPoint2D(center.X, diagramBounds.Bottom - labelInfo.Bounds.Height / 2.0));
			labelInfo.SetCenter(gRealPoint2D);
			if (!labelInfo.NextLabelNearest.HasValue)
			{
				labelInfo.NextLabelNearest = NextLabelIsNearest(labelInfo);
			}
			if (!IsCorrectedPositionValid(labelInfo, !labelInfo.NextLabelNearest))
			{
				if (!flag3 ^ flag)
				{
					labelInfo.SetCenter(new GRealPoint2D(NextLabelIsNearest(labelInfo) ? (bounds2.Left - labelInfo.Bounds.Width / 2.0) : (bounds.Right + labelInfo.Bounds.Width / 2.0), gRealPoint2D.Y));
				}
				else
				{
					labelInfo.SetCenter(new GRealPoint2D(NextLabelIsNearest(labelInfo) ? (bounds2.Right + labelInfo.Bounds.Width / 2.0) : (bounds.Left - labelInfo.Bounds.Width / 2.0), gRealPoint2D.Y));
				}
			}
		}

		private bool NextLabelIsNearest(LabelInfo labelInfo)
		{
			double num = GeometricUtils.CalcDistance(labelInfo.Bounds.Center, labelInfo.Prev.Bounds.Center);
			double num2 = GeometricUtils.CalcDistance(labelInfo.Bounds.Center, labelInfo.Next.Bounds.Center);
			return num2 < num;
		}

		private GRealPoint2D CalcCenter(LabelInfo labelInfo, bool fromPrev, PointsSweepDirection direction)
		{
			GRealRect2D gRealRect2D = GRealRect2D.Inflate(fromPrev ? GetArrangedPrev(labelInfo).Bounds : GetArrangedNext(labelInfo).Bounds, labelInfo.Bounds.Width / 2.0, labelInfo.Bounds.Height / 2.0);
			double num = GeometricUtils.CalcDistance(center, labelInfo.Bounds.Center);
			GRealEllipse ellipse = new GRealEllipse(center, num, num);
			List<GRealPoint2D> list = GeometricUtils.CalcRectWithEllipseIntersection(gRealRect2D, ellipse);
			if (list.Count == 0)
			{
				return labelInfo.Bounds.Center;
			}
			return FindPoint(list, gRealRect2D, center, fromPrev, direction);
		}

		private GRealPoint2D FindPoint(IList<GRealPoint2D> points, GRealRect2D bounds, GRealPoint2D center, bool forward, PointsSweepDirection direction)
		{
			double num = CalcAngle(center, bounds.Center);
			double num2 = CalcAngle(center, new GRealPoint2D(center.X - (bounds.Center.X - center.X), center.Y + (center.Y - bounds.Center.Y)));
			double num3 = double.MinValue;
			GRealPoint2D result = bounds.Center;
			GRealVector2D v = new GRealVector2D(bounds.Center.X - center.X, bounds.Center.Y - center.Y);
			v.Normalize();
			foreach (GRealPoint2D point in points)
			{
				double angle = CalcAngle(center, point);
				GRealVector2D v2 = new GRealVector2D(point.X - bounds.Center.X, point.Y - bounds.Center.Y);
				v2.Normalize();
				double num4 = GeometricUtils.ScalarProduct(v, v2);
				bool flag = ((direction == PointsSweepDirection.Clockwise) ? (!forward) : forward);
				if (num4 > num3 && ((!flag && IsAngleInRange(angle, num, num2)) || (flag && IsAngleInRange(angle, num2, num))))
				{
					num3 = num4;
					result = point;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private bool IsAngleInRange(double angle, double angle1, double angle2)
		{
			if (!(angle1 < angle2))
			{
				if (!(angle <= angle2))
				{
					return angle >= angle1;
				}
				return true;
			}
			if (angle >= angle1)
			{
				return angle <= angle2;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private double CalcAngle(GRealPoint2D p1, GRealPoint2D p2)
		{
			return Math.Atan2(p2.Y - p1.Y, p2.X - p1.X);
		}

		private bool IsPositionValid(LabelInfo labelInfo, bool fromPrev)
		{
			if (!GRealRect2D.Inflate(fromPrev ? GetArrangedPrev(labelInfo).Bounds : GetArrangedNext(labelInfo).Bounds, labelInfo.Bounds.Width / 2.0, labelInfo.Bounds.Height / 2.0).Contains(labelInfo.Bounds.Center) && GetNextByRefAngle(labelInfo).Arranged)
			{
				return GetPrevByRefAngle(labelInfo).Arranged;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool IsCorrectedPositionValid(LabelInfo labelInfo, bool? fromPrev)
		{
			return !GRealRect2D.Inflate(fromPrev.Value ? GetArrangedPrev(labelInfo).Bounds : GetArrangedNext(labelInfo).Bounds, labelInfo.Bounds.Width / 2.0, labelInfo.Bounds.Height / 2.0).ContainsIncludeBounds(labelInfo.Bounds.Center);
		}

		private bool IsPositionValidByBounds(LabelInfo labelInfo)
		{
			double dx = labelInfo.Bounds.Width / 2.0;
			double dy = labelInfo.Bounds.Height / 2.0;
			GRealRect2D gRealRect2D = GRealRect2D.Inflate(labelInfo.Prev.Bounds, dx, dy);
			GRealRect2D gRealRect2D2 = GRealRect2D.Inflate(labelInfo.Next.Bounds, dx, dy);
			if (!gRealRect2D.Contains(labelInfo.Bounds.Center))
			{
				return !gRealRect2D2.Contains(labelInfo.Bounds.Center);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool IsPositionValid(LabelInfo labelInfo)
		{
			double dx = labelInfo.Bounds.Width / 2.0;
			double dy = labelInfo.Bounds.Height / 2.0;
			LabelInfo arrangedPrev = GetArrangedPrev(labelInfo);
			LabelInfo arrangedNext = GetArrangedNext(labelInfo);
			GRealRect2D gRealRect2D = GRealRect2D.Inflate(arrangedPrev.Bounds, dx, dy);
			GRealRect2D gRealRect2D2 = GRealRect2D.Inflate(arrangedNext.Bounds, dx, dy);
			if ((labelInfo == arrangedPrev || !gRealRect2D.Contains(labelInfo.Bounds.Center)) && (labelInfo == arrangedNext || !gRealRect2D2.Contains(labelInfo.Bounds.Center)) && GetNextByRefAngle(labelInfo).Arranged)
			{
				return GetPrevByRefAngle(labelInfo).Arranged;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private LabelInfo GetNextByRefAngle(LabelInfo labelInfo)
		{
			int num = sortedList.IndexOf(labelInfo);
			return sortedList[(num != sortedList.Count - 1) ? (num + 1) : 0];
		}

		private LabelInfo GetPrevByRefAngle(LabelInfo labelInfo)
		{
			int num = sortedList.IndexOf(labelInfo);
			return sortedList[(num == 0) ? (sortedList.Count - 1) : (num - 1)];
		}

		private LabelInfo GetArrangedPrev(LabelInfo labelInfo)
		{
			if (!labelInfo.Prev.Arranged)
			{
				return GetArrangedPrev(labelInfo.Prev);
			}
			return labelInfo.Prev;
		}

		private LabelInfo GetArrangedNext(LabelInfo labelInfo)
		{
			if (!labelInfo.Next.Arranged)
			{
				return GetArrangedNext(labelInfo.Next);
			}
			return labelInfo.Next;
		}
	}
	public class AxisVisibilityInPanes
	{
		private readonly IAxisData axis;

		private readonly HashSet<IPane> panesForHide = new HashSet<IPane>();

		private readonly Dictionary<IPane, bool> visibility = new Dictionary<IPane, bool>();

		protected IAxisData Axis => axis;

		public Dictionary<IPane, bool> Visibility => visibility;

		public HashSet<IPane> PanesForHide => panesForHide;

		public AxisVisibilityInPanes(IAxisData axis)
		{
			this.axis = axis;
		}

		public virtual bool IsPaneVisible(IPane pane)
		{
			return !panesForHide.Contains(pane);
		}

		public virtual bool GetVisibilityInPane(IPane pane)
		{
			return !panesForHide.Contains(pane);
		}

		public void SetVisibilityInPaneCore(IPane pane, bool visible)
		{
			if (pane != null)
			{
				if (!visible)
				{
					panesForHide.Add(pane);
				}
				else
				{
					panesForHide.Remove(pane);
				}
			}
		}

		public virtual void UpdateVisibilityInPanes(IList<IPane> newPanes)
		{
			foreach (KeyValuePair<IPane, bool> item in visibility)
			{
				if (!item.Value)
				{
					panesForHide.Add(item.Key);
				}
			}
		}

		protected void Reset(bool visible)
		{
			if (visible)
			{
				panesForHide.Clear();
			}
		}
	}

	public class CrosshairSortedPointsInfoComparer : IComparer<CrosshairValueItem>
	{
		public int Compare(CrosshairValueItem item1, CrosshairValueItem item2)
		{
			int num = SortingUtils.CompareDoubles(item1.Value, item2.Value);
			if (num != 0)
			{
				return num;
			}
			return SortingUtils.CompareDoubles(item1.PointIndex, item2.PointIndex);
		}
	}
	internal class CrosshairPointComparer : Comparer<CrosshairSeriesPointBase>
	{
		public override int Compare(CrosshairSeriesPointBase point1, CrosshairSeriesPointBase point2)
		{
			return ((RefinedSeries)point1.RefinedSeries).ActiveIndex.CompareTo(((RefinedSeries)point2.RefinedSeries).ActiveIndex);
		}
	}
	public class CrosshairManager
	{
		private abstract class InternalCoordinatesCalculator
		{
			public abstract InternalCoordinates CalculateCoordinates(IPane pane, GRealPoint2D paneLocation);
		}

		private class DiagramInternalCoordinatesCalculator : InternalCoordinatesCalculator
		{
			private readonly IXYDiagram diagram;

			public DiagramInternalCoordinatesCalculator(IXYDiagram diagram)
			{
				this.diagram = diagram;
			}

			public override InternalCoordinates CalculateCoordinates(IPane pane, GRealPoint2D paneLocation)
			{
				return diagram.MapPointToInternal(pane, paneLocation);
			}
		}

		private class AxesInternalCoordinatesCalculator : InternalCoordinatesCalculator
		{
			private readonly IAxisData axisX;

			private readonly IAxisData axisY;

			private readonly IXYDiagram diagram;

			private readonly double internalArgument;

			private readonly double internalValue;

			private readonly CrosshairManager manager;

			public AxesInternalCoordinatesCalculator(IAxisData axisX, IAxisData axisY, IXYDiagram diagram, double internalArgument, double internalValue, CrosshairManager manager)
			{
				this.axisX = axisX;
				this.axisY = axisY;
				this.diagram = diagram;
				this.internalArgument = internalArgument;
				this.internalValue = internalValue;
				this.manager = manager;
			}

			public override InternalCoordinates CalculateCoordinates(IPane pane, GRealPoint2D paneLocation)
			{
				InternalCoordinates internalCoordinates = new InternalCoordinates(pane);
				PaneAxesContainer paneAxesContainer = manager.GetPaneAxesContainer(pane);
				InternalCoordinates internalCoordinates2 = diagram.MapPointToInternal(pane, paneLocation);
				if (paneAxesContainer != null)
				{
					foreach (IAxisData item in paneAxesContainer.AxesX)
					{
						if (axisX == item)
						{
							internalCoordinates.AddAxisXValue(axisX, internalArgument);
						}
						else if (internalCoordinates2 != null)
						{
							internalCoordinates.AddAxisXValue(item, internalCoordinates2.GetArgumentByAxisX(item));
						}
					}
					foreach (IAxisData item2 in paneAxesContainer.AxesY)
					{
						if (item2 == axisY)
						{
							internalCoordinates.AddAxisYValue(axisY, internalValue);
						}
						else if (internalCoordinates2 != null)
						{
							internalCoordinates.AddAxisYValue(item2, internalCoordinates2.GetValueByAxisY(item2));
						}
					}
				}
				return internalCoordinates;
			}
		}

		private abstract class AxisScaleTypeCollectionManagerBase
		{
			private IAxisData axis;

			private object axisValue;

			private PointProjectionOnAxis pointProjection;

			private Func<CrosshairSeriesPointBase, PointProjectionOnAxis> getProjectionAction;

			protected IAxisData Axis => axis;

			protected object AxisValue => axisValue;

			protected PointProjectionOnAxis PointProjection => pointProjection;

			protected Func<CrosshairSeriesPointBase, PointProjectionOnAxis> GetProjectionAction => getProjectionAction;

			protected AxisScaleTypeCollectionManagerBase(CrosshairSnapModeCore snapMode, object axisValue, PointProjectionOnAxis pointProjection)
			{
				this.axisValue = axisValue;
				this.pointProjection = pointProjection;
				axis = pointProjection.Axis;
				ChooseGetProjectionAction(snapMode);
			}

			private void ChooseGetProjectionAction(CrosshairSnapModeCore snapMode)
			{
				switch (snapMode)
				{
				case CrosshairSnapModeCore.NearestArgument:
					getProjectionAction = (CrosshairSeriesPointBase x) => x.AxisXProjection;
					break;
				case CrosshairSnapModeCore.NearestValue:
					getProjectionAction = (CrosshairSeriesPointBase x) => x.AxisYProjection;
					break;
				}
			}

			public abstract List<CrosshairSeriesPointBase> FindDifferentPointFromCollection(IEnumerable<CrosshairSeriesPointBase> points);
		}

		private class QualitativeScaleTypeCollectionManager : AxisScaleTypeCollectionManagerBase
		{
			public QualitativeScaleTypeCollectionManager(CrosshairSnapModeCore snapMode, object axisValue, PointProjectionOnAxis pointProjection)
				: base(snapMode, axisValue, pointProjection)
			{
			}

			public override List<CrosshairSeriesPointBase> FindDifferentPointFromCollection(IEnumerable<CrosshairSeriesPointBase> points)
			{
				List<CrosshairSeriesPointBase> list = new List<CrosshairSeriesPointBase>();
				foreach (CrosshairSeriesPointBase point in points)
				{
					PointProjectionOnAxis pointProjectionOnAxis = base.GetProjectionAction(point);
					if (pointProjectionOnAxis.Axis == base.Axis && pointProjectionOnAxis.CalculateNativeValue() != base.AxisValue)
					{
						list.Add(point);
					}
				}
				return list;
			}
		}

		private abstract class AxisScaleTypeCollectionManager<T> : AxisScaleTypeCollectionManagerBase
		{
			protected AxisScaleTypeCollectionManager(CrosshairSnapModeCore snapMode, object axisValue, PointProjectionOnAxis pointProjection)
				: base(snapMode, axisValue, pointProjection)
			{
			}

			protected abstract double CalcDelta(T currentValue, T value);

			protected abstract bool IsValueEquals(T value1, T value2);

			public override List<CrosshairSeriesPointBase> FindDifferentPointFromCollection(IEnumerable<CrosshairSeriesPointBase> points)
			{
				List<CrosshairSeriesPointBase> list = new List<CrosshairSeriesPointBase>();
				T value = (T)base.AxisValue;
				T val = (T)base.PointProjection.CalculateNativeValue();
				foreach (CrosshairSeriesPointBase point in points)
				{
					PointProjectionOnAxis pointProjectionOnAxis = base.GetProjectionAction(point);
					if (point.AxisXProjection.Axis == base.Axis && Math.Abs(CalcDelta((T)pointProjectionOnAxis.CalculateNativeValue(), value)) < Math.Abs(CalcDelta(val, value)))
					{
						val = (T)pointProjectionOnAxis.CalculateNativeValue();
					}
				}
				foreach (CrosshairSeriesPointBase point2 in points)
				{
					PointProjectionOnAxis pointProjectionOnAxis2 = base.GetProjectionAction(point2);
					if (pointProjectionOnAxis2.Axis == base.Axis && !IsValueEquals((T)pointProjectionOnAxis2.CalculateNativeValue(), val))
					{
						list.Add(point2);
					}
				}
				return list;
			}
		}

		private class NumericScaleTypeCollectionManager : AxisScaleTypeCollectionManager<double>
		{
			public NumericScaleTypeCollectionManager(CrosshairSnapModeCore snapMode, object axisValue, PointProjectionOnAxis pointProjection)
				: base(snapMode, axisValue, pointProjection)
			{
			}

			protected override double CalcDelta(double currentValue, double value)
			{
				return currentValue - value;
			}

			protected override bool IsValueEquals(double value1, double value2)
			{
				return value1 == value2;
			}
		}

		private class DateTimeScaleTypeCollectionManager : AxisScaleTypeCollectionManager<DateTime>
		{
			public DateTimeScaleTypeCollectionManager(CrosshairSnapModeCore snapMode, object axisValue, PointProjectionOnAxis pointProjection)
				: base(snapMode, axisValue, pointProjection)
			{
			}

			protected override double CalcDelta(DateTime currentValue, DateTime value)
			{
				return (currentValue - value).TotalMilliseconds;
			}

			protected override bool IsValueEquals(DateTime value1, DateTime value2)
			{
				return value1 == value2;
			}
		}

		private readonly IXYDiagram xyDiagram;

		private readonly Dictionary<IRefinedSeries, CrosshairSeriesData> crosshairDataList = new Dictionary<IRefinedSeries, CrosshairSeriesData>();

		private IList<PaneAxesContainer> paneAxisRepositories;

		private bool IsHorizontalCrosshair => xyDiagram.Rotated ^ (xyDiagram.CrosshairOptions.SnapMode != CrosshairSnapModeCore.NearestValue);

		private ICrosshairFreePosition LabelPosition => xyDiagram.CrosshairOptions.LabelPosition;

		private bool SnapToArgument
		{
			get
			{
				if (CrosshairOptions != null)
				{
					return CrosshairOptions.SnapMode == CrosshairSnapModeCore.NearestArgument;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}
