		public static MinMaxValues CalculateMinMaxMarkerSeriesRangeValues(CrosshairSeriesPointBase point, double range, bool isHorizontalCrosshair)
		{
			MinMaxValues result = default(MinMaxValues);
			if (isHorizontalCrosshair)
			{
				result.Min = point.AnchorPoint.X - range;
				result.Max = point.AnchorPoint.X + range;
			}
			else
			{
				result.Min = point.AnchorPoint.Y - range;
				result.Max = point.AnchorPoint.Y + range;
			}
			return result;
		}

		public static MinMaxValues CalculateMinMaxContinuousSeriesRangeValues(CrosshairSeriesPoint point, double range, bool isHorizontalCrosshair, CrosshairPaneInfo crosshairPaneInfo, CrosshairSnapModeCore snapMode)
		{
			MinMaxValues result = new MinMaxValues(-1.0, -1.0);
			int count = point.RefinedSeries.Points.Count;
			if (count > 0)
			{
				GRealPoint2D anchorPoint = point.AnchorPoint;
				double num = (isHorizontalCrosshair ? crosshairPaneInfo.MappingBounds.Left : crosshairPaneInfo.MappingBounds.Top);
				double num2 = (isHorizontalCrosshair ? crosshairPaneInfo.MappingBounds.Right : crosshairPaneInfo.MappingBounds.Bottom);
				IAxisData axisData = ((snapMode == CrosshairSnapModeCore.NearestArgument) ? point.AxisXProjection.Axis : point.AxisYProjection.Axis);
				if (count > 1)
				{
					switch (point.Position)
					{
					case PointPositionInSeries.Left:
						if (isHorizontalCrosshair)
						{
							result.Min = ((!axisData.Reverse) ? (anchorPoint.X - range) : num);
							result.Max = ((!axisData.Reverse) ? num2 : (anchorPoint.X + range));
						}
						else
						{
							result.Min = ((!axisData.Reverse) ? num : (anchorPoint.Y - range));
							result.Max = ((!axisData.Reverse) ? (anchorPoint.Y + range) : num2);
						}
						break;
					case PointPositionInSeries.Center:
						result.Min = num;
						result.Max = num2;
						break;
					case PointPositionInSeries.Right:
						if (isHorizontalCrosshair)
						{
							result.Min = ((!axisData.Reverse) ? num : (anchorPoint.X - range));
							result.Max = ((!axisData.Reverse) ? (anchorPoint.X + range) : num2);
						}
						else
						{
							result.Min = ((!axisData.Reverse) ? (anchorPoint.Y - range) : num);
							result.Max = ((!axisData.Reverse) ? num2 : (anchorPoint.Y + range));
						}
						break;
					}
				}
				else if (isHorizontalCrosshair)
				{
					result.Min = anchorPoint.X - range;
					result.Max = anchorPoint.X + range;
				}
				else
				{
					result.Min = anchorPoint.Y - range;
					result.Max = anchorPoint.Y + range;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		public static MinMaxValues CalculateMinMaxBarRangeValues(CrosshairSeriesPoint point, double range, bool isHorizontalCrosshair, IXYDiagram diagram, IPane pane, CrosshairSnapModeCore snapMode, double minBarValue, double maxBarValue)
		{
			MinMaxValues result = default(MinMaxValues);
			if (snapMode == CrosshairSnapModeCore.NearestArgument)
			{
				double argument = point.RefinedPoint.Argument;
				IAxisData axis = point.AxisXProjection.Axis;
				IAxisData axis2 = point.AxisYProjection.Axis;
				ISideBySidePoint refinedPoint = point.RefinedPoint;
				IBarSeriesView barSeriesView = (IBarSeriesView)point.View;
				double num = ((refinedPoint.BarWidth != 0.0 && !double.IsNaN(refinedPoint.BarWidth)) ? refinedPoint.BarWidth : barSeriesView.BarWidth);
				double num2 = ((!double.IsNaN(refinedPoint.Offset)) ? refinedPoint.Offset : 0.0);
				double num3 = argument + num2;
				GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D = diagram.MapInternalToPoint(pane, axis, axis2, num3 - num * 0.5, 0.0);
				GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D2 = diagram.MapInternalToPoint(pane, axis, axis2, num3 + num * 0.5, 0.0);
				GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D3 = diagram.MapInternalToPoint(pane, axis, axis2, argument - barSeriesView.BarWidth * 0.5, 0.0);
				GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D4 = diagram.MapInternalToPoint(pane, axis, axis2, argument + barSeriesView.BarWidth * 0.5, 0.0);
				double num4 = ((axis.Reverse ^ !diagram.Rotated) ? refinedPoint.FixedOffset : (-refinedPoint.FixedOffset));
				GRealPoint2D anchorPoint = point.AnchorPoint;
				double num7;
				double num8;
				double num9;
				double num5;
				double num6;
				if (isHorizontalCrosshair)
				{
					num5 = Math.Min(gRealPoint2D.X, gRealPoint2D2.X);
					num6 = Math.Max(gRealPoint2D.X, gRealPoint2D2.X);
					num7 = Math.Min(gRealPoint2D3.X, gRealPoint2D4.X);
					num8 = Math.Max(gRealPoint2D3.X, gRealPoint2D4.X);
					num9 = anchorPoint.X;
				}
				else
				{
					num5 = Math.Min(gRealPoint2D.Y, gRealPoint2D2.Y);
					num6 = Math.Max(gRealPoint2D.Y, gRealPoint2D2.Y);
					num7 = Math.Min(gRealPoint2D3.Y, gRealPoint2D4.Y);
					num8 = Math.Max(gRealPoint2D3.Y, gRealPoint2D4.Y);
					num9 = anchorPoint.Y;
				}
				num5 = Math.Min(num5 + num4, num9 - range);
				num6 = Math.Max(num6 + num4, num9 + range);
				if (pane.MappingBounds.HasValue && barSeriesView is ISideBySideBarSeriesView)
				{
					GRealRect2D value = pane.MappingBounds.Value;
					ISideBySideBarSeriesView sideBySideBarSeriesView = (ISideBySideBarSeriesView)barSeriesView;
					double num10 = sideBySideBarSeriesView.BarDistance * (isHorizontalCrosshair ? value.Width : value.Height) + (double)sideBySideBarSeriesView.BarDistanceFixed;
					if (num10 <= range)
					{
						if (num5 - num10 >= num7)
						{
							num5 -= num10;
						}
						if (num6 + num10 <= num8)
						{
							num6 += num10;
						}
					}
				}
				result.Min = num5;
				result.Max = num6;
			}
			else
			{
				PointProjectionOnAxis axisXProjection = point.AxisXProjection;
				IAxisData axis3 = point.AxisYProjection.Axis;
				GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D5 = diagram.MapInternalToPoint(pane, axisXProjection.Axis, axis3, axisXProjection.Value, minBarValue);
				GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D6 = diagram.MapInternalToPoint(pane, axisXProjection.Axis, axis3, axisXProjection.Value, maxBarValue);
				if (isHorizontalCrosshair)
				{
					double num11 = Math.Abs(gRealPoint2D6.X - gRealPoint2D5.X);
					double num12 = ((num11 > range) ? 0.0 : range);
					result.Min = Math.Min(gRealPoint2D5.X, gRealPoint2D6.X) - num12;
					result.Max = Math.Max(gRealPoint2D5.X, gRealPoint2D6.X) + num12;
				}
				else
				{
					double num13 = Math.Abs(gRealPoint2D6.Y - gRealPoint2D5.Y);
					double num14 = ((num13 > range) ? 0.0 : range);
					result.Min = Math.Min(gRealPoint2D5.Y, gRealPoint2D6.Y) - num14;
					result.Max = Math.Max(gRealPoint2D5.Y, gRealPoint2D6.Y) + num14;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		public static CrosshairSeriesPoint CreateCrosshairSeriesPoint(IXYDiagram xyDiagram, IXYSeriesView seriesView, double pointArgument, double pointValue, CrosshairPaneInfo crosshairPaneInfo, IRefinedSeries refinedSeries, RefinedPoint nearestPointInfo, PointPositionInSeries pointPosition, int pointIndex)
		{
			PointProjectionOnAxis argument = new PointProjectionOnAxis(seriesView.AxisXData, pointArgument);
			PointProjectionOnAxis value = new PointProjectionOnAxis(seriesView.AxisYData, pointValue);
			double num = (double.IsNaN(((ISideBySidePoint)nearestPointInfo).Offset) ? 0.0 : ((ISideBySidePoint)nearestPointInfo).Offset);
			double num2 = ((!double.IsNaN(((ISideBySidePoint)nearestPointInfo).FixedOffset)) ? ((ISideBySidePoint)nearestPointInfo).FixedOffset : 0);
			GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D = xyDiagram.MapInternalToPoint(crosshairPaneInfo.Pane, argument.Axis, value.Axis, argument.Value + num, value.Value);
			GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D2 = (xyDiagram.Rotated ? new GRealPoint2D(gRealPoint2D.X, gRealPoint2D.Y - num2) : new GRealPoint2D(gRealPoint2D.X + num2, gRealPoint2D.Y));
			GRealPoint2D pointCenterLocation = gRealPoint2D2;
			if (seriesView is IRangeSeriesView)
			{
				GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D3 = xyDiagram.MapInternalToPoint(crosshairPaneInfo.Pane, argument.Axis, value.Axis, argument.Value + num, ((IRangePoint)nearestPointInfo).Min + (((IRangePoint)nearestPointInfo).Max - ((IRangePoint)nearestPointInfo).Min) / 2.0);
				pointCenterLocation = (xyDiagram.Rotated ? new GRealPoint2D(gRealPoint2D3.X, gRealPoint2D3.Y - num2) : new GRealPoint2D(gRealPoint2D3.X + num2, gRealPoint2D3.Y));
			}
			return new CrosshairSeriesPoint(argument, value, gRealPoint2D2, pointCenterLocation, nearestPointInfo, refinedSeries, (ILegendItem)refinedSeries.Series, pointPosition, pointIndex);
		}

		public static CrosshairIndicatorPoint CreateCrosshairIndicatorPoint(IXYDiagram xyDiagram, double pointArgument, double pointValue, IRefinedSeries refinedSeries, IIndicator indicator, Dictionary<IndicatorValueLevelCore, double> valuesByType)
		{
			PointProjectionOnAxis argument = new PointProjectionOnAxis(indicator.AxisXData, pointArgument);
			PointProjectionOnAxis value = new PointProjectionOnAxis(indicator.AxisYData, pointValue);
			GRealPoint2D anchorPoint = xyDiagram.MapInternalToPoint(indicator.Pane, argument.Axis, value.Axis, pointArgument, pointValue);
			return new CrosshairIndicatorPoint(argument, value, anchorPoint, refinedSeries, indicator, valuesByType);
		}

		public CrosshairManager(IXYDiagram diagram)
		{
			xyDiagram = diagram;
		}

		private CrosshairSeriesData GetCrosshairData(IRefinedSeries refinedSeries)
		{
			if (refinedSeries != null && crosshairDataList.ContainsKey(refinedSeries))
			{
				return crosshairDataList[refinedSeries];
			}
			return null;
		}

		private void CalculatePanesCrosshairPoints(List<CrosshairPaneInfo> crosshairPaneInfos, IList<IRefinedSeries> refinedSeries)
		{
			HashSet<IAxisData> qualitativeAxes = new HashSet<IAxisData>();
			Dictionary<CrosshairSeriesPointBase, CrosshairPaneInfo> dictionary = new Dictionary<CrosshairSeriesPointBase, CrosshairPaneInfo>();
			foreach (CrosshairPaneInfo crosshairPaneInfo in crosshairPaneInfos)
			{
				List<IRefinedSeries> calculatedSeries = new List<IRefinedSeries>();
				List<IIndicator> calculatedIndicators = new List<IIndicator>();
				List<CrosshairSeriesPointBase> list = new List<CrosshairSeriesPointBase>();
				foreach (IRefinedSeries item in refinedSeries)
				{
					CrosshairSeriesData crosshairData = GetCrosshairData(item);
					if (crosshairData != null)
					{
						FillCrosshairPoints(list, item, crosshairData, crosshairPaneInfo, calculatedSeries, calculatedIndicators, qualitativeAxes);
					}
				}
				if (CrosshairOptions.LabelMode == CrosshairLabelModeCore.ShowForNearestSeries)
				{
					list = CalculateNearestPoint(list, crosshairPaneInfo.CursorLocation);
				}
				foreach (CrosshairSeriesPointBase item2 in list)
				{
					dictionary.Add(item2, crosshairPaneInfo);
				}
				List<CrosshairSeriesPointBase> list2 = RemoveDifferentPointsByValueSelectionMode(qualitativeAxes, crosshairPaneInfo, dictionary.Keys);
				foreach (CrosshairSeriesPointBase item3 in list2)
				{
					dictionary.Remove(item3);
				}
			}
			foreach (KeyValuePair<CrosshairSeriesPointBase, CrosshairPaneInfo> item4 in dictionary)
			{
				item4.Value.AddSeriesPoint(item4.Key);
			}
		}

		private void AddCrosshairPoint(IList<CrosshairSeriesPointBase> crosshairPoints, CrosshairSeriesPoint crosshairSeriesPoint, List<IRefinedSeries> calculatedSeries, HashSet<IAxisData> qualitativeAxes)
		{
			crosshairPoints.Add(crosshairSeriesPoint);
			calculatedSeries.Add(crosshairSeriesPoint.RefinedSeries);
			IAxisData axis = crosshairSeriesPoint.AxisXProjection.Axis;
			if (axis.AxisScaleTypeMap is AxisQualitativeMap)
			{
				qualitativeAxes.Add(axis);
			}
		}

		private void FillCrosshairPoints(List<CrosshairSeriesPointBase> paneCrosshairPoints, IRefinedSeries refinedSeries, CrosshairSeriesData crosshairSeriesData, CrosshairPaneInfo crosshairPaneInfo, List<IRefinedSeries> calculatedSeries, List<IIndicator> calculatedIndicators, HashSet<IAxisData> qualitativeAxes)
		{
			if (calculatedSeries.Contains(refinedSeries))
			{
				return;
			}
			PointProjectionsForPane cursorCoords = crosshairPaneInfo.CursorCoords;
			IXYSeriesView iXYSeriesView = (IXYSeriesView)refinedSeries.SeriesView;
			double argumentByAxisX = cursorCoords.GetArgumentByAxisX(iXYSeriesView.AxisXData);
			IEnumerable<IIndicator> crosshairIndicators = iXYSeriesView.CrosshairIndicators;
			if (iXYSeriesView.CrosshairEnabled && iXYSeriesView.Pane == crosshairPaneInfo.Pane)
			{
				crosshairPaneInfo.ContainsSeriesForCrosshair = true;
				double valueByAxisY = cursorCoords.GetValueByAxisY(iXYSeriesView.AxisYData);
				CrosshairSeriesPoint crosshairSeriesPoint = crosshairSeriesData.GetCrosshairPoint(crosshairPaneInfo, argumentByAxisX, valueByAxisY);
				if (crosshairSeriesPoint != null)
				{
					AddCrosshairPoint(paneCrosshairPoints, crosshairSeriesPoint, calculatedSeries, qualitativeAxes);
					FillIndicatorPoints(paneCrosshairPoints, crosshairIndicators, calculatedIndicators, crosshairPaneInfo, argumentByAxisX, crosshairSeriesData, (CrosshairIndicatorPoint point) => !SnapToArgument || point.AxisXProjection.Value == crosshairSeriesPoint.AxisXProjection.Value, crosshairSeriesPointAdded: true);
					if (SnapToArgument && iXYSeriesView is IBarSeriesView && CrosshairOptions.LabelMode != CrosshairLabelModeCore.ShowForNearestSeries)
					{
						FillPointGroups(paneCrosshairPoints, crosshairSeriesPoint, crosshairPaneInfo, calculatedSeries, calculatedIndicators, qualitativeAxes, argumentByAxisX);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					FillIndicatorPoints(paneCrosshairPoints, crosshairIndicators, calculatedIndicators, crosshairPaneInfo, argumentByAxisX, crosshairSeriesData, (CrosshairIndicatorPoint point) => true, crosshairSeriesPointAdded: false);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				FillIndicatorPoints(paneCrosshairPoints, crosshairIndicators, calculatedIndicators, crosshairPaneInfo, argumentByAxisX, crosshairSeriesData, (CrosshairIndicatorPoint point) => true, crosshairSeriesPointAdded: false);
			}
		}

		private void FillIndicatorPoints(List<CrosshairSeriesPointBase> paneCrosshairPoints, IEnumerable<IIndicator> indicators, List<IIndicator> calculatedIndicators, CrosshairPaneInfo crosshairPaneInfo, double crosshairArgument, CrosshairSeriesData crosshairSeriesData, Func<CrosshairIndicatorPoint, bool> needAddPoint, bool crosshairSeriesPointAdded)
		{
			foreach (IIndicator indicator in indicators)
			{
				if (!calculatedIndicators.Contains(indicator) && indicator.Pane == crosshairPaneInfo.Pane)
				{
					crosshairPaneInfo.ContainsSeriesForCrosshair = true;
					double valueByAxisY = crosshairPaneInfo.CursorCoords.GetValueByAxisY(indicator.AxisYData);
					bool isStraightLine = indicator.IsStraightLine;
					CrosshairIndicatorPoint crosshairIndicatorPoint = (isStraightLine ? crosshairSeriesData.GetCrosshairStraightLineIndicatorPoint(crosshairPaneInfo, indicator, crosshairArgument, valueByAxisY) : crosshairSeriesData.GetCrosshairIndicatorPoint(indicator, crosshairPaneInfo, crosshairArgument, valueByAxisY, crosshairSeriesPointAdded));
					if (crosshairIndicatorPoint != null && (isStraightLine || needAddPoint(crosshairIndicatorPoint)))
					{
						paneCrosshairPoints.Add(crosshairIndicatorPoint);
						calculatedIndicators.Add(indicator);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void FillPointGroups(List<CrosshairSeriesPointBase> crosshairPoints, CrosshairSeriesPoint crosshairPoint, CrosshairPaneInfo crosshairPaneInfo, List<IRefinedSeries> calculatedSeries, List<IIndicator> calculatedIndicators, HashSet<IAxisData> qualitativeAxes, double crosshairArgument)
		{
			List<RefinedSeries> sideBySideSeries = crosshairPoint.RefinedPoint.GetSideBySideSeries();
			if (sideBySideSeries == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			foreach (RefinedSeries item in sideBySideSeries)
			{
				if (calculatedSeries.Contains(item) || !(item.SeriesView is IXYSeriesView { CrosshairEnabled: not false } iXYSeriesView) || crosshairPoint.RefinedSeries == item)
				{
					continue;
				}
				int index;
				RefinedPoint finalPointByArgument = item.GetFinalPointByArgument(crosshairPoint.RefinedPoint.Argument, out index);
				if (finalPointByArgument == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				double pointValue = finalPointByArgument.Value1;
				using (IEnumerator<double> enumerator2 = iXYSeriesView.GetCrosshairValues(finalPointByArgument).GetEnumerator())
				{
					if (enumerator2.MoveNext())
					{
						double current2 = enumerator2.Current;
						pointValue = current2;
					}
				}
				CrosshairSeriesPoint point = CreateCrosshairSeriesPoint(xyDiagram, iXYSeriesView, finalPointByArgument.Argument, pointValue, crosshairPaneInfo, item, finalPointByArgument, PointPositionInSeries.Center, index);
				AddCrosshairPoint(crosshairPoints, point, calculatedSeries, qualitativeAxes);
				FillIndicatorPoints(crosshairPoints, iXYSeriesView.CrosshairIndicators, calculatedIndicators, crosshairPaneInfo, crosshairArgument, GetCrosshairData(item), (CrosshairIndicatorPoint indicatorPoint) => indicatorPoint.AxisXProjection.Value == point.AxisXProjection.Value, crosshairSeriesPointAdded: true);
				flag = true;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				crosshairPoints.Sort(new CrosshairPointComparer());
			}
		}

		private List<CrosshairSeriesPointBase> FindDifferentPointsByValueSelectionMode(HashSet<IAxisData> qualitativeAxes, CrosshairPaneInfo crosshairPaneInfo, IEnumerable<CrosshairSeriesPointBase> crosshairSeriesPoints)
		{
			List<CrosshairSeriesPointBase> list = new List<CrosshairSeriesPointBase>();
			foreach (IAxisData qualitativeAxis in qualitativeAxes)
			{
				object obj = null;
				foreach (PointProjectionOnAxis axesXValue in crosshairPaneInfo.CursorCoords.AxesXValues)
				{
					if (axesXValue.Axis == qualitativeAxis)
					{
						obj = axesXValue.CalculateNativeValue();
					}
				}
				if (obj == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				foreach (CrosshairSeriesPointBase crosshairSeriesPoint in crosshairSeriesPoints)
				{
					if (crosshairSeriesPoint.AxisXProjection.Axis == qualitativeAxis && crosshairSeriesPoint.AxisXProjection.CalculateNativeValue() != obj)
					{
						list.Add(crosshairSeriesPoint);
					}
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		private PointProjectionOnAxis GetPointProjection(CrosshairSeriesPointBase point, CrosshairSnapModeCore snapMode)
		{
			return snapMode switch
			{
				CrosshairSnapModeCore.NearestArgument => point.AxisXProjection, 
				CrosshairSnapModeCore.NearestValue => point.AxisYProjection, 
				_ => point.AxisXProjection, 
			};
		}

		private List<CrosshairSeriesPointBase> RemoveDifferentPoints(CrosshairPaneInfo crosshairPaneInfo, IEnumerable<CrosshairSeriesPointBase> crosshairSeriesPoints)
		{
			List<IAxisData> list = new List<IAxisData>();
			CrosshairSnapModeCore snapMode = CrosshairOptions.SnapMode;
			List<CrosshairSeriesPointBase> list2 = new List<CrosshairSeriesPointBase>();
			foreach (CrosshairSeriesPointBase crosshairSeriesPoint in crosshairSeriesPoints)
			{
				PointProjectionOnAxis pointProjection = GetPointProjection(crosshairSeriesPoint, snapMode);
				IAxisData axis = pointProjection.Axis;
				if (list.Contains(axis))
				{
					continue;
				}
				list.Add(axis);
				object obj = null;
				List<PointProjectionOnAxis> list3 = null;
				switch (snapMode)
				{
				case CrosshairSnapModeCore.NearestArgument:
					list3 = crosshairPaneInfo.CursorCoords.AxesXValues;
					break;
				case CrosshairSnapModeCore.NearestValue:
					list3 = crosshairPaneInfo.CursorCoords.AxesYValues;
					break;
				}
				foreach (PointProjectionOnAxis item in list3)
				{
					if (item.Axis == axis)
					{
						obj = item.CalculateNativeValue();
						break;
					}
				}
				if (obj != null)
				{
					AxisScaleTypeCollectionManagerBase axisScaleTypeCollectionManagerBase = CreateCollectionManager(snapMode, pointProjection, axis, obj);
					list2.AddRange(axisScaleTypeCollectionManagerBase.FindDifferentPointFromCollection(crosshairSeriesPoints));
				}
			}
			return list2;
		}

		private AxisScaleTypeCollectionManagerBase CreateCollectionManager(CrosshairSnapModeCore snapMode, PointProjectionOnAxis pointProjection, IAxisData axis, object crosshairAxisValue)
		{
			if (axis.AxisScaleTypeMap is AxisQualitativeMap)
			{
				return new QualitativeScaleTypeCollectionManager(snapMode, crosshairAxisValue, pointProjection);
			}
			if (axis.AxisScaleTypeMap is AxisNumericalMap)
			{
				return new NumericScaleTypeCollectionManager(snapMode, crosshairAxisValue, pointProjection);
			}
			return new DateTimeScaleTypeCollectionManager(snapMode, crosshairAxisValue, pointProjection);
		}

		private List<CrosshairSeriesPointBase> RemoveDifferentPointsByValueSelectionMode(HashSet<IAxisData> qualitativeAxes, CrosshairPaneInfo crosshairPaneInfo, IEnumerable<CrosshairSeriesPointBase> crosshairSeriesPoints)
		{
			switch (CrosshairOptions.ValueSelectionMode)
			{
			case CrosshairValueSelectionModeCore.Default:
				if (CrosshairOptions.LabelMode == CrosshairLabelModeCore.ShowCommonForAllSeries && qualitativeAxes.Count > 0 && SnapToArgument)
				{
					return FindDifferentPointsByValueSelectionMode(qualitativeAxes, crosshairPaneInfo, crosshairSeriesPoints);
				}
				break;
			case CrosshairValueSelectionModeCore.Value:
				return RemoveDifferentPoints(crosshairPaneInfo, crosshairSeriesPoints);
			}
			return new List<CrosshairSeriesPointBase>();
		}

		private List<CrosshairSeriesPointBase> CalculateNearestPoint(List<CrosshairSeriesPointBase> crosshairSeriesPoints, GRealPoint2D crosshairLocation)
		{
			List<CrosshairSeriesPointBase> result = crosshairSeriesPoints;
			CrosshairSeriesPointBase crosshairSeriesPointBase = null;
			foreach (CrosshairSeriesPointBase crosshairSeriesPoint in crosshairSeriesPoints)
			{
				if (crosshairSeriesPointBase == null || GeometricUtils.CalcDistance(crosshairLocation, crosshairSeriesPoint.AnchorPoint) < GeometricUtils.CalcDistance(crosshairLocation, crosshairSeriesPointBase.AnchorPoint) || GeometricUtils.CalcDistance(crosshairLocation, crosshairSeriesPoint.PointCenter) < GeometricUtils.CalcDistance(crosshairLocation, crosshairSeriesPointBase.PointCenter))
				{
					crosshairSeriesPointBase = crosshairSeriesPoint;
				}
			}
			if (crosshairSeriesPointBase != null)
			{
				result = new List<CrosshairSeriesPointBase> { crosshairSeriesPointBase };
			}
			return result;
		}

		private void CreateCrosshairPaneInfos(CrosshairInfo crosshairInfo, GRealPoint2D crosshairLocation, IPane focusedPane, IXYDiagram diagram, InternalCoordinatesCalculator calculator)
		{
			List<IPane> list = new List<IPane>();
			if (diagram.CrosshairOptions.ShowOnlyInFocusedPane)
			{
				list.Add(focusedPane);
			}
			else
			{
				list.AddRange(diagram.GetCrosshairSyncPanes(focusedPane, IsHorizontalCrosshair));
			}
			GRealRect2D value = focusedPane.MappingBounds.Value;
			for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
			{
				IPane pane = list[i];
				if (!IsValidBounds(pane.MappingBounds))
				{
					continue;
				}
				GRealRect2D value2 = pane.MappingBounds.Value;
				bool flag = focusedPane == pane;
				GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D = crosshairLocation;
				if (!flag)
				{
					if (IsHorizontalCrosshair)
					{
						gRealPoint2D.Y = (value2.Top + value2.Bottom) / 2.0;
						if (!value2.Contains(gRealPoint2D))
						{
							gRealPoint2D.X = value2.Left + (gRealPoint2D.X - value.Left) / value.Width * value2.Width;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						gRealPoint2D.X = (value2.Left + value2.Right) / 2.0;
						if (!value2.Contains(gRealPoint2D))
						{
							gRealPoint2D.Y = value2.Top + (gRealPoint2D.Y - value.Top) / value.Height * value2.Height;
						}
					}
				}
				InternalCoordinates cursorCoordinates = calculator.CalculateCoordinates(pane, gRealPoint2D);
				PointProjectionsForPane cursorCoords = new PointProjectionsForPane(pane, cursorCoordinates);
				crosshairInfo.AddPaneInfo(new CrosshairPaneInfo(pane, flag, value2, gRealPoint2D, cursorCoords));
			}
		}

		private bool IsValidBounds(GRealRect2D? bounds)
		{
			if (bounds.HasValue && bounds.Value.Size.Width > 0.0)
			{
				return bounds.Value.Size.Height > 0.0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void CalculateAxisValues(CrosshairPaneInfo crosshairPaneInfo, IEnumerable<CrosshairSeriesPointBase> crosshairPoints, ICrosshairOptions options)
		{
			AddAxisValuesForCursorSnapAxes(crosshairPaneInfo, options);
			AddAxisValuesByPoints(crosshairPaneInfo, crosshairPoints, options);
		}

		private void AddAxisValuesForCursorSnapAxes(CrosshairPaneInfo crosshairPaneInfo, ICrosshairOptions options)
		{
			bool snapToArguments = options.SnapMode == CrosshairSnapModeCore.NearestArgument;
			List<PointProjectionOnAxis> axisValueForCursorSnapAxes = GetAxisValueForCursorSnapAxes(crosshairPaneInfo.CursorCoords, crosshairPaneInfo.Pane, crosshairPaneInfo.IsFocusedPane, snapToArguments);
			foreach (PointProjectionOnAxis item in axisValueForCursorSnapAxes)
			{
				crosshairPaneInfo.AddValue(item);
			}
		}

		private PaneAxesContainer GetPaneAxesContainer(IPane pane)
		{
			foreach (PaneAxesContainer paneAxisRepository in paneAxisRepositories)
			{
				if (paneAxisRepository.Pane == pane)
				{
					return paneAxisRepository;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private List<PointProjectionOnAxis> GetAxisValueForCursorSnapAxes(PointProjectionsForPane crosshairCoords, IPane pane, bool isFocusedPane, bool snapToArguments)
		{
			List<PointProjectionOnAxis> list = new List<PointProjectionOnAxis>();
			if (snapToArguments || (CrosshairOptions.LinesMode == CrosshairLinesModeCore.Free && isFocusedPane))
			{
				PaneAxesContainer paneAxesContainer = GetPaneAxesContainer(pane);
				if (paneAxesContainer != null)
				{
					foreach (IAxisData item in paneAxesContainer.AxesX)
					{
						if (crosshairCoords.AxesXValues.Count > 0)
						{
							double argumentByAxisX = crosshairCoords.GetArgumentByAxisX(item);
							if (!double.IsNaN(argumentByAxisX))
							{
								list.Add(new PointProjectionOnAxis(item, argumentByAxisX));
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if (!snapToArguments || (CrosshairOptions.LinesMode == CrosshairLinesModeCore.Free && isFocusedPane))
			{
				PaneAxesContainer paneAxesContainer2 = GetPaneAxesContainer(pane);
				if (paneAxesContainer2 != null)
				{
					foreach (IAxisData item2 in paneAxesContainer2.AxesY)
					{
						list.Add(new PointProjectionOnAxis(item2, crosshairCoords.GetValueByAxisY(item2)));
					}
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		private void AddAxisValuesByPoints(CrosshairPaneInfo crosshairPaneInfo, IEnumerable<CrosshairSeriesPointBase> crosshairPoints, ICrosshairOptions options)
		{
			bool flag = options.SnapMode == CrosshairSnapModeCore.NearestArgument;
			foreach (CrosshairSeriesPointBase crosshairPoint in crosshairPoints)
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					crosshairPaneInfo.AddValue(crosshairPoint.AxisYProjection);
				}
				else
				{
					crosshairPaneInfo.AddValue(crosshairPoint.AxisXProjection);
				}
			}
		}

		private Dictionary<PointProjectionOnAxis, GRealPoint2D> BindAxisValueAndScreenCoords(ICrosshairOptions options, CrosshairPaneInfo crosshairPaneInfo)
		{
			IPane pane = crosshairPaneInfo.Pane;
			IXYDiagram iXYDiagram = xyDiagram;
			PointProjectionsForPane cursorCoords = crosshairPaneInfo.CursorCoords;
			GRealPoint2D cursorLocation = crosshairPaneInfo.CursorLocation;
			Dictionary<PointProjectionOnAxis, GRealPoint2D> dictionary = new Dictionary<PointProjectionOnAxis, GRealPoint2D>();
			if (options.SnapMode == CrosshairSnapModeCore.NearestValue || options.LinesMode == CrosshairLinesModeCore.Free)
			{
				PaneAxesContainer paneAxesContainer = GetPaneAxesContainer(pane);
				if (paneAxesContainer != null)
				{
					IAxisData primaryAxisY = paneAxesContainer.PrimaryAxisY;
					double valueByAxisY = cursorCoords.GetValueByAxisY(primaryAxisY);
					foreach (PointProjectionOnAxis allAxesValue in crosshairPaneInfo.AllAxesValues)
					{
						GRealPoint2D value = cursorLocation;
						if (!allAxesValue.Axis.IsValueAxis)
						{
							value = iXYDiagram.MapInternalToPoint(pane, allAxesValue.Axis, primaryAxisY, allAxesValue.Value, valueByAxisY);
						}
						if (!dictionary.ContainsKey(allAxesValue))
						{
							dictionary.Add(allAxesValue, value);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if (options.SnapMode == CrosshairSnapModeCore.NearestArgument || options.LinesMode == CrosshairLinesModeCore.Free)
			{
				PaneAxesContainer paneAxesContainer2 = GetPaneAxesContainer(pane);
				if (paneAxesContainer2 != null)
				{
					IAxisData primaryAxisX = paneAxesContainer2.PrimaryAxisX;
					double argumentByAxisX = cursorCoords.GetArgumentByAxisX(primaryAxisX);
					foreach (PointProjectionOnAxis allAxesValue2 in crosshairPaneInfo.AllAxesValues)
					{
						GRealPoint2D value2 = cursorLocation;
						if (allAxesValue2.Axis.IsValueAxis)
						{
							value2 = iXYDiagram.MapInternalToPoint(pane, primaryAxisX, allAxesValue2.Axis, argumentByAxisX, allAxesValue2.Value);
						}
						if (!dictionary.ContainsKey(allAxesValue2))
						{
							dictionary.Add(allAxesValue2, value2);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return dictionary;
		}

		private void CalculateCrossLines(CrosshairPaneInfo crosshairPaneInfo, IEnumerable<CrosshairSeriesPointBase> crosshairPoints, Dictionary<PointProjectionOnAxis, GRealPoint2D> screenCoords)
		{
			if (CrosshairOptions.LinesMode == CrosshairLinesModeCore.Auto)
			{
				foreach (CrosshairSeriesPointBase crosshairPoint in crosshairPoints)
				{
					PointProjectionOnAxis axisValuePair = GetAxisValuePair(CrosshairOptions, crosshairPoint);
					CrosshairLine crosshairLine = CreateCrossLine(screenCoords, crosshairPaneInfo.MappingBounds, axisValuePair);
					if (crosshairPoint != null && crosshairLine != null)
					{
						crosshairPoint.CrosshairLine = crosshairLine;
					}
				}
			}
			bool snapToArguments = CrosshairOptions.SnapMode == CrosshairSnapModeCore.NearestArgument;
			List<PointProjectionOnAxis> axisValueForCursorSnapAxes = GetAxisValueForCursorSnapAxes(crosshairPaneInfo.CursorCoords, crosshairPaneInfo.Pane, crosshairPaneInfo.IsFocusedPane, snapToArguments);
			foreach (PointProjectionOnAxis item in axisValueForCursorSnapAxes)
			{
				if (item.Axis.IsArgumentAxis && crosshairPaneInfo.CursorArgumentCrossLine == null)
				{
					CrosshairLine crosshairLine = CreateCrossLine(screenCoords, crosshairPaneInfo.MappingBounds, item);
					crosshairPaneInfo.CursorArgumentCrossLine = crosshairLine;
				}
				if (item.Axis.IsValueAxis && crosshairPaneInfo.CursorValueCrossLine == null)
				{
					CrosshairLine crosshairLine = CreateCrossLine(screenCoords, crosshairPaneInfo.MappingBounds, item);
					crosshairPaneInfo.CursorValueCrossLine = crosshairLine;
				}
			}
		}

		private void CalculateAxisLabels(CrosshairPaneInfo crosshairPaneInfo, IEnumerable<CrosshairSeriesPointBase> crosshairPoints, Dictionary<PointProjectionOnAxis, GRealPoint2D> screenCoords, bool needGenerateFullInfo)
		{
			bool snapToArguments = CrosshairOptions.SnapMode == CrosshairSnapModeCore.NearestArgument;
			if (CrosshairOptions.LinesMode == CrosshairLinesModeCore.Auto)
			{
				foreach (CrosshairSeriesPointBase crosshairPoint in crosshairPoints)
				{
					PointProjectionOnAxis axisValuePair = GetAxisValuePair(CrosshairOptions, crosshairPoint);
					if (needGenerateFullInfo || IsAxisLabelVisible(axisValuePair))
					{
						CrosshairAxisInfo crosshairAxisInfo = CreateCrosshairAxisInfo(crosshairPaneInfo, screenCoords, axisValuePair);
						if (crosshairAxisInfo != null && crosshairPoint != null)
						{
							crosshairPoint.CrosshairAxisInfo = crosshairAxisInfo;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			List<PointProjectionOnAxis> axisValueForCursorSnapAxes = GetAxisValueForCursorSnapAxes(crosshairPaneInfo.CursorCoords, crosshairPaneInfo.Pane, crosshairPaneInfo.IsFocusedPane, snapToArguments);
			foreach (PointProjectionOnAxis item in axisValueForCursorSnapAxes)
			{
				if (IsAxisLabelVisible(item))
				{
					CrosshairAxisInfo crosshairAxisInfo2 = CreateCrosshairAxisInfo(crosshairPaneInfo, screenCoords, item);
					if (crosshairAxisInfo2 != null && crosshairAxisInfo2.Axis.AxisVisibilityInPanes.GetVisibilityInPane(crosshairPaneInfo.Pane) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(crosshairAxisInfo2.Text))
					{
						crosshairPaneInfo.CursorAxesInfo.Add(crosshairAxisInfo2);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void CreateCrosshairLabels(GRealRect2D labelsConstraint, IPane focusedPane, ICrosshairOptions options, CrosshairInfo crosshairInfo)
		{
			if (options.LabelMode == CrosshairLabelModeCore.ShowCommonForAllSeries)
			{
				List<CrosshairSeriesPointBase> list = new List<CrosshairSeriesPointBase>();
				foreach (CrosshairPaneInfo crosshairPaneInfo in crosshairInfo.CrosshairPaneInfos)
				{
					list.AddRange(crosshairPaneInfo.LabelSeriesPoints);
				}
				CrosshairPaneInfo byPane = crosshairInfo.GetByPane(focusedPane);
				if (byPane != null)
				{
					GRealPoint2D anchorPoint = byPane.CursorLocation;
					AnnotationLocation annotationLocation = AnnotationLocation.TopRight;
					if (!LabelPosition.IsMousePosition)
					{
						CalculateAnchorLocation(xyDiagram, LabelPosition, out anchorPoint, out annotationLocation);
					}
					else
					{
						byPane.LabelsConstraint = labelsConstraint;
					}
					byPane.AddCrosshairLabel(list, anchorPoint, annotationLocation, showTail: false, LabelPosition.Offset, options);
				}
				return;
			}
			foreach (CrosshairPaneInfo crosshairPaneInfo2 in crosshairInfo.CrosshairPaneInfos)
			{
				crosshairPaneInfo2.LabelsConstraint = labelsConstraint;
				foreach (CrosshairSeriesPointBase labelSeriesPoint in crosshairPaneInfo2.LabelSeriesPoints)
				{
					crosshairPaneInfo2.AddCrosshairLabel(labelSeriesPoint, options);
				}
			}
		}

		private void CreateCrosshairLegendInfos(ICrosshairOptions options, CrosshairInfo crosshairInfo, IEnumerable<ILegendItem> legendCrosshairItems)
		{
			List<ILegendItem> list = new List<ILegendItem>();
			foreach (CrosshairPaneInfo crosshairPaneInfo in crosshairInfo.CrosshairPaneInfos)
			{
				foreach (CrosshairSeriesPointBase legendSeriesPoint in crosshairPaneInfo.LegendSeriesPoints)
				{
					legendSeriesPoint.ConstructSeriesText(options, isInGroup: false);
					legendSeriesPoint.AddToCrosshairInfo(crosshairInfo);
					list.Add(legendSeriesPoint.LegendItem);
				}
			}
			foreach (ILegendItem legendCrosshairItem in legendCrosshairItems)
			{
				if (legendCrosshairItem.CrosshairLegendTextVisible && !list.Contains(legendCrosshairItem))
				{
					crosshairInfo.EmptyLegendPoints.Add(new CrosshairLegendPoint(legendCrosshairItem));
				}
			}
		}

		private PointProjectionOnAxis GetAxisValuePair(ICrosshairOptions options, CrosshairSeriesPointBase point)
		{
			if (options.SnapMode != CrosshairSnapModeCore.NearestArgument)
			{
				return point.AxisXProjection;
			}
			return point.AxisYProjection;
		}

		private CrosshairAxisInfo CreateCrosshairAxisInfo(CrosshairPaneInfo crosshairPaneInfo, Dictionary<PointProjectionOnAxis, GRealPoint2D> screenCoords, PointProjectionOnAxis axisValue)
		{
			GRealPoint2D screenCoord = screenCoords[axisValue];
			if (IsScreenCoordInBounds(axisValue.Axis.IsVertical, screenCoord, crosshairPaneInfo.MappingBounds))
			{
				GRealRect2D labelBounds = axisValue.Axis.GetLabelBounds(crosshairPaneInfo.Pane);
				GRealPoint2D anchorPoint = (axisValue.Axis.IsVertical ? new GRealPoint2D((labelBounds.Left + labelBounds.Right) / 2.0, screenCoord.Y) : new GRealPoint2D(screenCoord.X, (labelBounds.Top + labelBounds.Bottom) / 2.0));
				string text = CrosshairPaneInfo.ConstructAxisText(axisValue);
				GRealSize2D maxSize = new GRealSize2D(labelBounds.Width, labelBounds.Height);
				object value = axisValue.CalculateNativeValue();
				return new CrosshairAxisInfo(text, anchorPoint, maxSize, axisValue.Axis, value);
			}
			return null;
		}

		private bool IsAxisLabelVisible(PointProjectionOnAxis axisValuePair)
		{
			return ((ICrosshairAxis)axisValuePair.Axis).LabelVisible;
		}

		private CrosshairLine CreateCrossLine(Dictionary<PointProjectionOnAxis, GRealPoint2D> screenCoords, GRealRect2D mappingBounds, PointProjectionOnAxis axisValue)
		{
			CrosshairLine result = null;
			GRealPoint2D screenCoord = screenCoords[axisValue];
			if (IsScreenCoordInBounds(axisValue.Axis.IsVertical, screenCoord, mappingBounds))
			{
				if (axisValue.Axis.IsVertical)
				{
					double y = screenCoord.Y;
					result = CreateCrossLine(mappingBounds.Left, y, mappingBounds.Right, y, axisValue.Axis.IsValueAxis);
				}
				else
				{
					double x = screenCoord.X;
					result = CreateCrossLine(x, mappingBounds.Top, x, mappingBounds.Bottom, axisValue.Axis.IsValueAxis);
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private CrosshairLine CreateCrossLine(double startX, double startY, double endX, double endY, bool isValueLine)
		{
			return new CrosshairLine(new GRealLine2D(new GRealPoint2D(startX, startY), new GRealPoint2D(endX, endY)), isValueLine);
		}

		private bool IsScreenCoordInBounds(bool axisIsVertical, GRealPoint2D screenCoord, GRealRect2D mappingBounds)
		{
			if (!axisIsVertical || !(screenCoord.Y >= mappingBounds.Top) || !(screenCoord.Y <= mappingBounds.Bottom))
			{
				if (!axisIsVertical && screenCoord.X >= mappingBounds.Left)
				{
					return screenCoord.X <= mappingBounds.Right;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool IsSeriesForCrosshair(ISeries series)
		{
			if (series.ShouldBeDrawnOnDiagram)
			{
				return series.SeriesView is IXYSeriesView;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void ProcessSeriesUpdateInfo(RefinedSeriesUpdateInfo updateInfo)
		{
			switch (updateInfo.Operation)
			{
			case ChartCollectionOperation.InsertItem:
			{
				foreach (RefinedSeries item in updateInfo.RefinedSeries)
				{
					if (IsSeriesForCrosshair(item.Series))
					{
						CrosshairSeriesData crosshairSeriesData = new CrosshairSeriesData(xyDiagram, item);
						crosshairSeriesData.UpdatePoints();
						if (crosshairDataList.ContainsKey(item))
						{
							crosshairDataList.Remove(item);
						}
						crosshairDataList.Add(item, crosshairSeriesData);
					}
				}
				break;
			}
			case ChartCollectionOperation.RemoveItem:
			{
				foreach (RefinedSeries item2 in updateInfo.RefinedSeries)
				{
					crosshairDataList.Remove(item2);
				}
				break;
			}
			case ChartCollectionOperation.Reset:
				crosshairDataList.Clear();
				break;
			case ChartCollectionOperation.UpdateItem:
				UpdateDataForSeries(updateInfo.RefinedSeries);
				break;
			}
		}

		public void UpdateIndicatorsData()
		{
			foreach (KeyValuePair<IRefinedSeries, CrosshairSeriesData> crosshairData in crosshairDataList)
			{
				crosshairData.Value.UpdateIndicatorData();
			}
		}

		public void ClearCrosshairData()
		{
			paneAxisRepositories = null;
			UpdateDataForSeries(new RefinedSeries[0]);
		}

		public void UpdateDataForSeries(IList<RefinedSeries> seriesCollection)
		{
			HashSet<IRefinedSeries> hashSet = new HashSet<IRefinedSeries>(crosshairDataList.Keys);
			foreach (RefinedSeries item in seriesCollection)
			{
				if (IsSeriesForCrosshair(((IRefinedSeries)item).Series))
				{
					CrosshairSeriesData value = null;
					if (!crosshairDataList.TryGetValue(item, out value))
					{
						value = new CrosshairSeriesData(xyDiagram, item);
						crosshairDataList.Add(item, value);
					}
					else
					{
						value.UpdateSeriesData();
					}
					value.UpdatePoints();
					hashSet.Remove(item);
				}
			}
			foreach (IRefinedSeries item2 in hashSet)
			{
				crosshairDataList.Remove(item2);
			}
		}

		public void UpdateCrosshairData(ICollection<RefinedSeriesUpdateInfo> seriesUpdateInfo, ICollection<RefinedSeriesPointsUpdateInfo> pointsUpdateInfo)
		{
			foreach (RefinedSeriesUpdateInfo item in seriesUpdateInfo)
			{
				ProcessSeriesUpdateInfo(item);
			}
			if (pointsUpdateInfo == null || pointsUpdateInfo.Count <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			HashSet<RefinedSeries> hashSet = new HashSet<RefinedSeries>();
			Dictionary<RefinedSeries, List<RefinedPoint>> dictionary = new Dictionary<RefinedSeries, List<RefinedPoint>>();
			foreach (RefinedSeriesPointsUpdateInfo item2 in pointsUpdateInfo)
			{
				if (!item2.RefinedSeries.ActualIsActive || hashSet.Contains(item2.RefinedSeries))
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (SnapToArgument && item2.Operation == ChartCollectionOperation.InsertItem)
				{
					if (!dictionary.ContainsKey(item2.RefinedSeries))
					{
						dictionary.Add(item2.RefinedSeries, new List<RefinedPoint>());
					}
					dictionary[item2.RefinedSeries].AddRange(item2.AffectedPoints);
					continue;
				}
				CrosshairSeriesData crosshairSeriesData = GetCrosshairData(item2.RefinedSeries);
				if (crosshairSeriesData == null)
				{
					crosshairSeriesData = new CrosshairSeriesData(xyDiagram, item2.RefinedSeries);
					crosshairDataList.Add(item2.RefinedSeries, crosshairSeriesData);
				}
				crosshairSeriesData.UpdatePoints();
				hashSet.Add(item2.RefinedSeries);
			}
			foreach (KeyValuePair<RefinedSeries, List<RefinedPoint>> item3 in dictionary)
			{
				CrosshairSeriesData crosshairData = GetCrosshairData(item3.Key);
				if (crosshairData != null && !crosshairData.InsertPoints(item3.Value))
				{
					crosshairData.UpdatePoints();
				}
			}
		}

		public static void CalculateAnchorLocation(IXYDiagram diagram, ICrosshairFreePosition labelPosition, out GRealPoint2D anchorPoint, out AnnotationLocation annotationLocation)
		{
			GRealRect2D gRealRect2D = labelPosition.DockBounds;
			if (gRealRect2D.IsEmpty)
			{
				gRealRect2D = diagram.ChartBounds;
			}
			anchorPoint = default(GRealPoint2D);
			annotationLocation = AnnotationLocation.BottomRight;
			switch (labelPosition.DockCorner)
			{
			case DockCornerCore.TopLeft:
				anchorPoint = new GRealPoint2D(gRealRect2D.Left, gRealRect2D.Top);
				annotationLocation = AnnotationLocation.BottomRight;
				break;
			case DockCornerCore.TopRight:
				anchorPoint = new GRealPoint2D(gRealRect2D.Right, gRealRect2D.Top);
				annotationLocation = AnnotationLocation.BottomLeft;
				break;
			case DockCornerCore.BottomLeft:
				anchorPoint = new GRealPoint2D(gRealRect2D.Left, gRealRect2D.Bottom);
				annotationLocation = AnnotationLocation.TopRight;
				break;
			case DockCornerCore.BottomRight:
				anchorPoint = new GRealPoint2D(gRealRect2D.Right, gRealRect2D.Bottom);
				annotationLocation = AnnotationLocation.TopLeft;
				break;
			default:
				ChartDebug.Fail("Unexpected dock position");
				break;
			}
		}

		public CrosshairInfo CalculateCrosshairInfoForLegends(IEnumerable<ILegendItem> legendCrosshairItems)
		{
			CrosshairInfo crosshairInfo = new CrosshairInfo();
			CreateCrosshairLegendInfos(CrosshairOptions, crosshairInfo, legendCrosshairItems);
			return crosshairInfo;
		}

		public CrosshairInfo CalculateCrosshairInfo(GRealPoint2D crosshairLocation, bool crosshairLocationIsEmpty, GRealRect2D labelsConstraint, IList<PaneAxesContainer> paneAxisRepositories, IPane focusedPane, IList<IRefinedSeries> refinedSeries, IEnumerable<ILegendItem> legendCrosshairItems, bool needGenerateFullInfo)
		{
			this.paneAxisRepositories = paneAxisRepositories;
			CrosshairInfo crosshairInfo = new CrosshairInfo();
			if (!crosshairLocationIsEmpty && CrosshairOptions != null && focusedPane != null && focusedPane.MappingBounds.HasValue)
			{
				DiagramInternalCoordinatesCalculator calculator = new DiagramInternalCoordinatesCalculator(xyDiagram);
				CreateCrosshairPaneInfos(crosshairInfo, crosshairLocation, focusedPane, xyDiagram, calculator);
				CalculateCrosshairInfoElements(crosshairInfo, refinedSeries, labelsConstraint, focusedPane, needGenerateFullInfo);
			}
			CreateCrosshairLegendInfos(CrosshairOptions, crosshairInfo, legendCrosshairItems);
			return crosshairInfo;
		}

		public CrosshairInfo CalculateCrosshairInfo(object argument, object value, bool outOfRange, GRealRect2D labelsConstraint, IList<PaneAxesContainer> paneAxisRepositories, IPane focusedPane, IAxisData axisX, IAxisData axisY, IList<IRefinedSeries> refinedSeries, IEnumerable<ILegendItem> legendCrosshairItems, bool needGenerateFullInfo)
		{
			this.paneAxisRepositories = paneAxisRepositories;
			CrosshairInfo crosshairInfo = new CrosshairInfo();
			if (!outOfRange && CrosshairOptions != null && focusedPane != null && focusedPane.MappingBounds.HasValue)
			{
				double num = axisX.AxisScaleTypeMap.NativeToInternal(argument);
				double num2 = axisY.AxisScaleTypeMap.NativeToInternal(value);
				GRealPoint2D crosshairLocation = xyDiagram.MapInternalToPoint(focusedPane, axisX, axisY, num, num2);
				AxesInternalCoordinatesCalculator calculator = new AxesInternalCoordinatesCalculator(axisX, axisY, xyDiagram, num, num2, this);
				CreateCrosshairPaneInfos(crosshairInfo, crosshairLocation, focusedPane, xyDiagram, calculator);
				CalculateCrosshairInfoElements(crosshairInfo, refinedSeries, labelsConstraint, focusedPane, needGenerateFullInfo);
			}
			CreateCrosshairLegendInfos(CrosshairOptions, crosshairInfo, legendCrosshairItems);
			return crosshairInfo;
		}

		private void CalculateCrosshairInfoElements(CrosshairInfo crosshairInfo, IList<IRefinedSeries> refinedSeries, GRealRect2D labelsConstraint, IPane focusedPane, bool needGenerateFullInfo)
		{
			CalculatePanesCrosshairPoints(crosshairInfo.CrosshairPaneInfos, refinedSeries);
			bool flag = crosshairInfo.CrosshairPaneInfos.Count > 1 || CrosshairOptions.LinesMode == CrosshairLinesModeCore.Free;
			foreach (CrosshairPaneInfo crosshairPaneInfo in crosshairInfo.CrosshairPaneInfos)
			{
				IEnumerable<CrosshairSeriesPointBase> allPoints = crosshairPaneInfo.AllPoints;
				if (!flag && !crosshairPaneInfo.ContainsSeriesForCrosshair)
				{
					break;
				}
				CalculateAxisValues(crosshairPaneInfo, allPoints, CrosshairOptions);
				Dictionary<PointProjectionOnAxis, GRealPoint2D> screenCoords = BindAxisValueAndScreenCoords(CrosshairOptions, crosshairPaneInfo);
				CalculateCrossLines(crosshairPaneInfo, allPoints, screenCoords);
				CalculateAxisLabels(crosshairPaneInfo, allPoints, screenCoords, needGenerateFullInfo);
			}
			CreateCrosshairLabels(labelsConstraint, focusedPane, CrosshairOptions, crosshairInfo);
		}

		public CrosshairDataList GetCrosshairSortedData(IRefinedSeries refinedSeries)
		{
			return GetCrosshairData(refinedSeries)?.CrosshairSortedData;
		}

		public CrosshairDataList GetCrosshairSortedData(IIndicator indicator, IRefinedSeries refinedSeries)
		{
			CrosshairSeriesData crosshairData = GetCrosshairData(refinedSeries);
			if (crosshairData != null && crosshairData.CrosshairIndicatorPointsSortedData.TryGetValue(indicator, out var value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
	public class CrosshairSeriesData
	{
		private const double crosshairRange = 0.16;

		private const int crosshairPixelsRange = 20;

		private static readonly CrosshairSortedPointsInfoComparer crosshairComparer = new CrosshairSortedPointsInfoComparer();

		private readonly IXYDiagram diagram;

		private readonly IRefinedSeries series;

		private readonly CrosshairDataList crosshairSeriesPointsSortedData;

		private readonly Dictionary<IIndicator, CrosshairDataList> crosshairIndicatorPointsSortedData;

		private IXYSeriesView seriesView;

		private IList<RefinedPoint> pointsInfo;

		private int prevPointsCount;

		private bool ShowCrosshair
		{
			get
			{
				if (diagram != null)
				{
					return diagram.CrosshairOptions != null;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private bool ShowSeriesCrosshair
		{
			get
			{
				if (seriesView != null)
				{
					return seriesView.CrosshairEnabled;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private bool SnapToArgument => diagram.CrosshairOptions.SnapMode == CrosshairSnapModeCore.NearestArgument;

		private bool IsHorizontalCrosshair => diagram.Rotated ^ (diagram.CrosshairOptions.SnapMode != CrosshairSnapModeCore.NearestValue);

		public Dictionary<IIndicator, CrosshairDataList> CrosshairIndicatorPointsSortedData => crosshairIndicatorPointsSortedData;

		public CrosshairDataList CrosshairSortedData => crosshairSeriesPointsSortedData;

		public CrosshairSeriesData(IXYDiagram diagram, IRefinedSeries series)
		{
			this.diagram = diagram;
			this.series = series;
			seriesView = series.SeriesView as IXYSeriesView;
			crosshairSeriesPointsSortedData = ObjectsFactory.Default.CreateCrosshairDataList();
			crosshairIndicatorPointsSortedData = new Dictionary<IIndicator, CrosshairDataList>();
		}

		private int CheckPointsWithSameValue(CrosshairDataList crosshairSortedData, int crosshairValueItemIndex, double cursorPoint, Func<int, IEnumerable<double>> getValues, Func<int, double> getArgument, out double nearestValue)
		{
			int result = crosshairValueItemIndex;
			double num = GetMinDistance(crosshairSortedData, cursorPoint, crosshairValueItemIndex, getValues, getArgument, out nearestValue);
			double value = crosshairSortedData[crosshairValueItemIndex].Value;
			for (int i = crosshairValueItemIndex + 1; i < crosshairSortedData.Count && crosshairSortedData[i].Value == value; i++)
			{
				double value2;
				double minDistance = GetMinDistance(crosshairSortedData, cursorPoint, i, getValues, getArgument, out value2);
				if (minDistance < num)
				{
					result = i;
					nearestValue = value2;
					num = minDistance;
				}
			}
			int num2 = crosshairValueItemIndex - 1;
			while (num2 >= 0 && crosshairSortedData[num2].Value == value)
			{
				double value3;
				double minDistance2 = GetMinDistance(crosshairSortedData, cursorPoint, num2, getValues, getArgument, out value3);
				if (minDistance2 < num)
				{
					result = num2;
					nearestValue = value3;
					num = minDistance2;
				}
				num2--;
			}
			return result;
		}

		private double GetMinDistance(CrosshairDataList crosshairSortedData, double cursorPoint, int crosshairValueItemIndex, Func<int, IEnumerable<double>> getValues, Func<int, double> getArgument, out double value)
		{
			if (SnapToArgument)
			{
				return GetMinValueDistance(crosshairSortedData, cursorPoint, crosshairValueItemIndex, getValues, out value);
			}
			return GetMinArgumentDistance(crosshairSortedData, cursorPoint, crosshairValueItemIndex, getArgument, out value);
		}

		private double GetMinValueDistance(CrosshairDataList crosshairSortedData, double value, int crosshairValueItemIndex, Func<int, IEnumerable<double>> getValues, out double pointValue)
		{
			pointValue = double.NaN;
			int pointIndex = crosshairSortedData[crosshairValueItemIndex].PointIndex;
			double num = double.NaN;
			if (seriesView == null)
			{
				return double.NaN;
			}
			foreach (double item in getValues(pointIndex))
			{
				if (double.IsNaN(num))
				{
					pointValue = item;
					num = Math.Abs(pointValue - value);
					continue;
				}
				double num2 = Math.Abs(item - value);
				if (num2 < num)
				{
					num = num2;
					pointValue = item;
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		private double GetMinArgumentDistance(CrosshairDataList crosshairSortedData, double argument, int crosshairValueItemIndex, Func<int, double> getArgument, out double pointArgument)
		{
			int pointIndex = crosshairSortedData[crosshairValueItemIndex].PointIndex;
			pointArgument = getArgument(pointIndex);
			return Math.Abs(pointArgument - argument);
		}

		private PointPositionInSeries CalculatePointPositionInSeries(int pointIndex)
		{
			if (pointIndex == 0 || (pointIndex - 1 >= 0 && pointsInfo[crosshairSeriesPointsSortedData[pointIndex - 1].PointIndex].IsEmpty))
			{
				return PointPositionInSeries.Left;
			}
			if (pointIndex == crosshairSeriesPointsSortedData.Count - 1 || (pointIndex + 1 < crosshairSeriesPointsSortedData.Count && pointsInfo[crosshairSeriesPointsSortedData[pointIndex + 1].PointIndex].IsEmpty))
			{
				return PointPositionInSeries.Right;
			}
			return PointPositionInSeries.Center;
		}

		private bool IsPointsArgumentGreater(IEnumerable<RefinedPoint> points, double maxArgument)
		{
			foreach (RefinedPoint point in points)
			{
				double num = seriesView.AxisXData.AxisScaleTypeMap.RefinedToInternal(point.Argument);
				if (num < maxArgument)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void ProcessIndicatorPoints(CrosshairDataCalculator calculator, bool force)
		{
			foreach (IIndicator crosshairIndicator in seriesView.CrosshairIndicators)
			{
				if (crosshairIndicator.IsStraightLine || pointsInfo.Count < crosshairIndicator.StartIndex)
				{
					continue;
				}
				lock (crosshairIndicator)
				{
					if (!crosshairIndicatorPointsSortedData.TryGetValue(crosshairIndicator, out var value))
					{
						value = ObjectsFactory.Default.CreateCrosshairDataList();
						crosshairIndicatorPointsSortedData[crosshairIndicator] = value;
						calculator.ProcessIndicatorPoints(value, crosshairIndicator, value.Count, pointsInfo.Count - crosshairIndicator.StartIndex - 1);
					}
					else if (force)
					{
						calculator.ProcessIndicatorPoints(value, crosshairIndicator, value.Count, pointsInfo.Count - crosshairIndicator.StartIndex - 1);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private int[] GetCrosshairPointIndices(CrosshairDataList crosshairSortedData, double argument, double value)
		{
			if (double.IsNaN(argument) || double.IsNaN(value) || crosshairSortedData == null || crosshairSortedData.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			double num = (SnapToArgument ? argument : value);
			CrosshairValueItem value2 = new CrosshairValueItem(num, 0);
			int num2 = crosshairSortedData.BinarySearch(value2, crosshairComparer);
			if (num2 < 0)
			{
				num2 = ~num2;
				if (num2 != 0)
				{
					if (num2 != crosshairSortedData.Count)
					{
						if (seriesView is IStepSeriesView { SnapCrosshairToActualStep: not false } stepSeriesView)
						{
							return new int[1] { stepSeriesView.InvertedStep ? num2 : (num2 - 1) };
						}
						double num3 = crosshairSortedData[num2].Value - num;
						double num4 = num - crosshairSortedData[num2 - 1].Value;
						if (!(num4 < num3))
						{
							return new int[2]
							{
								num2,
								num2 - 1
							};
						}
						return new int[2]
						{
							num2 - 1,
							num2
						};
					}
					return new int[1] { crosshairSortedData.Count - 1 };
				}
			}
			return new int[1] { num2 };
		}

		private RefinedPoint GetCrosshairPoint(int valueItemIndex, double argument, double value, out double pointArgument, out double pointValue, out int pointIndex)
		{
			Func<int, IEnumerable<double>> seriesPointValuesAction = CrosshairDataCalculator.GetSeriesPointValuesAction(pointsInfo, seriesView);
			Func<int, double> seriesPointArgumentAction = CrosshairDataCalculator.GetSeriesPointArgumentAction(pointsInfo);
			if (SnapToArgument)
			{
				valueItemIndex = CheckPointsWithSameValue(crosshairSeriesPointsSortedData, valueItemIndex, value, seriesPointValuesAction, seriesPointArgumentAction, out pointValue);
				pointArgument = crosshairSeriesPointsSortedData[valueItemIndex].Value;
			}
			else
			{
				valueItemIndex = CheckPointsWithSameValue(crosshairSeriesPointsSortedData, valueItemIndex, argument, seriesPointValuesAction, seriesPointArgumentAction, out pointArgument);
				pointValue = crosshairSeriesPointsSortedData[valueItemIndex].Value;
			}
			pointIndex = crosshairSeriesPointsSortedData[valueItemIndex].PointIndex;
			RefinedPoint refinedPoint = pointsInfo[pointIndex];
			ISideBySidePoint sideBySidePoint = refinedPoint;
			double num = (double.IsNaN(sideBySidePoint.Offset) ? 0.0 : sideBySidePoint.Offset);
			double num2 = ((double.IsNaN(sideBySidePoint.BarWidth) || sideBySidePoint.BarWidth == 0.0) ? 0.0 : (sideBySidePoint.BarWidth / 2.0));
			double minPointArgument = pointArgument + num - num2;
			double maxPointArgument = pointArgument + num + num2;
			if (IsPointInVisualRange(minPointArgument, maxPointArgument, pointValue, seriesView.AxisYData))
			{
				return refinedPoint;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private Dictionary<IndicatorValueLevelCore, double> GetIndicatorInfo(CrosshairDataList indicatorSortedData, IIndicator indicator, int valueItemIndex, double argument, double value, out double pointArgument, out double pointValue)
		{
			Func<int, IEnumerable<double>> indicatorPointValuesAction = CrosshairDataCalculator.GetIndicatorPointValuesAction(indicator);
			Func<int, double> indicatorPointArgumentAction = CrosshairDataCalculator.GetIndicatorPointArgumentAction(indicator);
			if (SnapToArgument)
			{
				valueItemIndex = CheckPointsWithSameValue(indicatorSortedData, valueItemIndex, value, indicatorPointValuesAction, indicatorPointArgumentAction, out pointValue);
				pointArgument = indicatorSortedData[valueItemIndex].Value;
			}
			else
			{
				valueItemIndex = CheckPointsWithSameValue(indicatorSortedData, valueItemIndex, argument, indicatorPointValuesAction, indicatorPointArgumentAction, out pointArgument);
				pointValue = indicatorSortedData[valueItemIndex].Value;
			}
			if (IsPointInVisualRange(pointArgument, pointArgument, pointValue, indicator.AxisYData))
			{
				return indicator.GetValuesByIndex(indicatorSortedData[valueItemIndex].PointIndex, pointArgument, pointValue);
			}
			return null;
		}

		private bool IsPointInVisualRange(double minPointArgument, double maxPointArgument, double pointValue, IAxisData axisYData)
		{
			IAxisRangeData visualRange = seriesView.AxisXData.VisualRange;
			if (maxPointArgument < visualRange.Min || minPointArgument > visualRange.Max)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!diagram.CrosshairOptions.ShowOutOfRangePoints || diagram.CrosshairOptions.LabelMode != CrosshairLabelModeCore.ShowCommonForAllSeries)
			{
				IAxisRangeData visualRange2 = axisYData.VisualRange;
				if (pointValue < visualRange2.Min || pointValue > visualRange2.Max)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool IsPointInCrosshairRange(CrosshairSeriesPointBase point, CrosshairPaneInfo crosshairPaneInfo)
		{
			if (point != null)
			{
				GRealRect2D mappingBounds = crosshairPaneInfo.MappingBounds;
				double val = 0.16 * (IsHorizontalCrosshair ? mappingBounds.Width : mappingBounds.Height);
				val = Math.Min(val, 20.0);
				if (!mappingBounds.Contains(point.AnchorPoint) && (!diagram.CrosshairOptions.ShowOutOfRangePoints || diagram.CrosshairOptions.LabelMode != CrosshairLabelModeCore.ShowCommonForAllSeries))
				{
					return false;
				}
				MinMaxValues minMaxValues = point.CalculateMinMaxRange(val, IsHorizontalCrosshair, diagram, crosshairPaneInfo, diagram.CrosshairOptions.SnapMode);
				GRealPoint2D cursorLocation = crosshairPaneInfo.CursorLocation;
				if (IsHorizontalCrosshair)
				{
					if (cursorLocation.X >= minMaxValues.Min)
					{
						return cursorLocation.X <= minMaxValues.Max;
					}
					return false;
				}
				if (cursorLocation.Y >= minMaxValues.Min)
				{
					return cursorLocation.Y <= minMaxValues.Max;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool InsertPoints(IEnumerable<RefinedPoint> points)
		{
			if (ShowCrosshair)
			{
				if (!seriesView.ShouldSortPoints || !SnapToArgument)
				{
					return false;
				}
				double maxArgument = ((crosshairSeriesPointsSortedData.Count > 0) ? crosshairSeriesPointsSortedData[crosshairSeriesPointsSortedData.Count - 1].Value : double.MinValue);
				if (pointsInfo != series.Points || !IsPointsArgumentGreater(points, maxArgument))
				{
					return false;
				}
				CrosshairDataCalculator crosshairDataCalculator = CrosshairDataCalculator.CreateCalculator(seriesView, SnapToArgument, diagram.ScrollingEnabled);
				if (ShowSeriesCrosshair)
				{
					crosshairDataCalculator.ProcessPoints(crosshairSeriesPointsSortedData, pointsInfo, prevPointsCount, pointsInfo.Count - 1);
				}
				if (pointsInfo.Count > 1)
				{
					ProcessIndicatorPoints(crosshairDataCalculator, force: false);
				}
				prevPointsCount = pointsInfo.Count;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public void UpdatePoints()
		{
			pointsInfo = series.Points;
			if (ShowCrosshair && seriesView.AxisXData != null && seriesView.AxisYData != null)
			{
				crosshairSeriesPointsSortedData.Clear();
				foreach (CrosshairDataList value in crosshairIndicatorPointsSortedData.Values)
				{
					ObjectsFactory.Default.Free(value);
				}
				crosshairIndicatorPointsSortedData.Clear();
				CrosshairDataCalculator crosshairDataCalculator = CrosshairDataCalculator.CreateCalculator(seriesView, SnapToArgument, diagram.ScrollingEnabled);
				if (ShowSeriesCrosshair)
				{
					crosshairDataCalculator.ProcessPoints(crosshairSeriesPointsSortedData, pointsInfo, 0, pointsInfo.Count - 1);
				}
				if (pointsInfo.Count > 1)
				{
					ProcessIndicatorPoints(crosshairDataCalculator, force: false);
				}
				if (!SnapToArgument || !seriesView.ShouldSortPoints)
				{
					crosshairSeriesPointsSortedData.Sort(crosshairComparer);
					foreach (CrosshairDataList value2 in crosshairIndicatorPointsSortedData.Values)
					{
						value2.Sort(crosshairComparer);
					}
				}
				prevPointsCount = pointsInfo.Count;
				return;
			}
			crosshairSeriesPointsSortedData.Clear();
			foreach (CrosshairDataList value3 in crosshairIndicatorPointsSortedData.Values)
			{
				value3.Clear();
			}
		}

		public void UpdateSeriesData()
		{
			seriesView = series.SeriesView as IXYSeriesView;
		}

		public CrosshairSeriesPoint GetCrosshairPoint(CrosshairPaneInfo crosshairPaneInfo, double crosshairArgument, double crosshairValue)
		{
			int[] crosshairPointIndices = GetCrosshairPointIndices(crosshairSeriesPointsSortedData, crosshairArgument, crosshairValue);
			if (crosshairPointIndices != null)
			{
				int[] array = crosshairPointIndices;
				foreach (int num in array)
				{
					PointPositionInSeries pointPosition = CalculatePointPositionInSeries(num);
					double pointArgument;
					double pointValue;
					int pointIndex;
					RefinedPoint crosshairPoint = GetCrosshairPoint(num, crosshairArgument, crosshairValue, out pointArgument, out pointValue, out pointIndex);
					if (crosshairPoint != null && !crosshairPoint.IsEmpty)
					{
						CrosshairSeriesPoint crosshairSeriesPoint = CrosshairManager.CreateCrosshairSeriesPoint(diagram, seriesView, pointArgument, pointValue, crosshairPaneInfo, series, crosshairPoint, pointPosition, pointIndex);
						if (IsPointInCrosshairRange(crosshairSeriesPoint, crosshairPaneInfo))
						{
							return crosshairSeriesPoint;
						}
						continue;
					}
					return null;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public CrosshairIndicatorPoint GetCrosshairIndicatorPoint(IIndicator indicator, CrosshairPaneInfo crosshairPaneInfo, double crosshairArgument, double crosshairValue, bool crosshairSeriesPointAdded)
		{
			if (!crosshairIndicatorPointsSortedData.TryGetValue(indicator, out var value))
			{
				return null;
			}
			int[] crosshairPointIndices = GetCrosshairPointIndices(value, crosshairArgument, crosshairValue);
			if (crosshairPointIndices != null)
			{
				int[] array = crosshairPointIndices;
				foreach (int valueItemIndex in array)
				{
					double pointArgument;
					double pointValue;
					Dictionary<IndicatorValueLevelCore, double> indicatorInfo = GetIndicatorInfo(value, indicator, valueItemIndex, crosshairArgument, crosshairValue, out pointArgument, out pointValue);
					if (indicatorInfo != null)
					{
						CrosshairIndicatorPoint crosshairIndicatorPoint = CrosshairManager.CreateCrosshairIndicatorPoint(diagram, pointArgument, pointValue, series, indicator, indicatorInfo);
						if (crosshairSeriesPointAdded || IsPointInCrosshairRange(crosshairIndicatorPoint, crosshairPaneInfo))
						{
							return crosshairIndicatorPoint;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public CrosshairIndicatorPoint GetCrosshairStraightLineIndicatorPoint(CrosshairPaneInfo crosshairPaneInfo, IIndicator indicator, double crosshairArgument, double crosshairValue)
		{
			Dictionary<IndicatorValueLevelCore, double> valuesByIndex;
			double num;
			double num2;
			if (SnapToArgument)
			{
				valuesByIndex = indicator.GetValuesByIndex(-1, crosshairArgument, crosshairValue);
				num = valuesByIndex[IndicatorValueLevelCore.Value];
				num2 = Math.Round(indicator.GetArgumentByIndex(-1, num, crosshairArgument), 5);
			}
			else
			{
				num2 = Math.Round(indicator.GetArgumentByIndex(-1, crosshairValue, crosshairArgument), 5);
				valuesByIndex = indicator.GetValuesByIndex(-1, num2, crosshairValue);
				num = crosshairValue;
			}
			CrosshairIndicatorPoint crosshairIndicatorPoint = CrosshairManager.CreateCrosshairIndicatorPoint(diagram, num2, num, series, indicator, valuesByIndex);
			if (IsPointInCrosshairRange(crosshairIndicatorPoint, crosshairPaneInfo) && IsPointInVisualRange(num2, num2, num, indicator.AxisYData))
			{
				return crosshairIndicatorPoint;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public void UpdateIndicatorData()
		{
			if (pointsInfo.Count > 1)
			{
				ProcessIndicatorPoints(CrosshairDataCalculator.CreateCalculator(seriesView, SnapToArgument, diagram.ScrollingEnabled), force: true);
			}
		}
	}

	public class InternalCoordinates
	{
		private readonly IPane pane;

		private readonly List<AxisValuePair> axesXValues;

		private readonly List<AxisValuePair> axesYValues;

		public List<AxisValuePair> AxesXValues => axesXValues;

		public List<AxisValuePair> AxesYValues => axesYValues;

		public InternalCoordinates(IPane pane)

		private double GetValueByAxis(IAxisData axis, List<AxisValuePair> axesValues)
		{
			foreach (AxisValuePair axesValue in axesValues)
			{
				if (axesValue.Axis == axis)

					return axesValue.Value;

		}

		public void AddAxisXValue(IAxisData axis, double argument)

		{
			return GetValueByAxis(axis, axesYValues);
		}

		public double GetArgumentByAxisX(IAxisData axis)

			return GetValueByAxis(axis, axesXValues);
		}
	}

	public class PointProjectionsForPane
	{
		private readonly IPane pane;

		private readonly List<PointProjectionOnAxis> axesXValues = new List<PointProjectionOnAxis>();

		private readonly List<PointProjectionOnAxis> axesYValues = new List<PointProjectionOnAxis>();

		public List<PointProjectionOnAxis> AxesXValues => axesXValues;

		public List<PointProjectionOnAxis> AxesYValues => axesYValues;

		public PointProjectionsForPane(IPane pane, InternalCoordinates cursorCoordinates)
		{
			this.pane = pane;
			if (cursorCoordinates != null)
			{
				SetValues(cursorCoordinates.AxesXValues, cursorCoordinates.AxesYValues);
			}
		}

		private double GetValueByAxis(IAxisData axis, List<PointProjectionOnAxis> axesValues)
		{
			foreach (PointProjectionOnAxis axesValue in axesValues)
			{
				if (axesValue.Axis == axis)
				{
					return axesValue.Value;
				}
			}
			return double.NaN;
		}

		private void SetValues(List<AxisValuePair> axesXValues, List<AxisValuePair> axesYValues)
		{
			foreach (AxisValuePair axesXValue in axesXValues)
			{
				IAxisData axis = axesXValue.Axis;
				double value = axis.AxisScaleTypeMap.Transformation.TransformBackward(axesXValue.Value);
				this.axesXValues.Add(new PointProjectionOnAxis(axis, value));
			}
			foreach (AxisValuePair axesYValue in axesYValues)
			{
				IAxisData axis2 = axesYValue.Axis;
				double value2 = axis2.AxisScaleTypeMap.Transformation.TransformBackward(axesYValue.Value);
				this.axesYValues.Add(new PointProjectionOnAxis(axis2, value2));
			}
		}

		public double GetValueByAxisY(IAxisData axis)
		{
			return GetValueByAxis(axis, axesYValues);
		}

		public double GetArgumentByAxisX(IAxisData axis)
		{
			return GetValueByAxis(axis, axesXValues);
		}
	}
