	public class BezierRangeStrip : RangeStrip, IBezierStrip
	{
		private readonly SplineAlgorithmCore splineAlgorithm;

		private readonly double lineTension;

		private readonly ITransformation transformationX;

		private readonly ITransformation transformationY;

		public override bool IsEmpty => base.TopStrip.IsEmpty;

		public BezierRangeStrip(SplineAlgorithmCore splineAlgorithm, double lineTension)
			: this(splineAlgorithm, lineTension, null, null)
		{
		}

		public BezierRangeStrip(SplineAlgorithmCore splineAlgorithm, double lineTension, ITransformation transformationX, ITransformation transformationY)
		{
			this.splineAlgorithm = splineAlgorithm;
			this.lineTension = lineTension;
			this.transformationX = transformationX;
			this.transformationY = transformationY;
		}

		private void GetPointsForDrawingInternal(out LineStrip topPoints, out LineStrip bottomPoints)
		{
			topPoints = new LineStrip();
			bottomPoints = new LineStrip();
			topPoints.AddRange(((BezierStrip)base.TopStrip).GetPointsForDrawing(completeFilling: true, clip: true));
			bottomPoints.AddRange(((BezierStrip)base.BottomStrip).GetPointsForDrawing(completeFilling: true, clip: true));
			bottomPoints.Reverse();
		}

		protected override LineStrip CreateBorderStrip()
		{
			return new BezierStrip(splineAlgorithm, lineTension, transformationX, transformationY);
		}

		public void GetPointsForDrawing(out LineStrip topPoints, out LineStrip bottomPoints)
		{
			GetPointsForDrawing(out topPoints, out bottomPoints, 0.5);
		}

		public void GetPointsForDrawing(out LineStrip topPoints, out LineStrip bottomPoints, double border)
		{
			GRealRect2D boundingRectangle = GetBoundingRectangle();
			if (boundingRectangle.Width < border || boundingRectangle.Height < border)
			{
				if (boundingRectangle.Width < border)
				{
					boundingRectangle.Inflate(border, 0.0);
				}
				if (boundingRectangle.Height < border)
				{
					boundingRectangle.Inflate(0.0, border);
				}
				topPoints = new LineStrip(4);
				topPoints.Add(new GRealPoint2D(boundingRectangle.Left, boundingRectangle.Top));
				topPoints.Add(new GRealPoint2D(boundingRectangle.Left + boundingRectangle.Width / 3.0, boundingRectangle.Top));
				topPoints.Add(new GRealPoint2D(boundingRectangle.Left + boundingRectangle.Width / 1.5, boundingRectangle.Top));
				topPoints.Add(new GRealPoint2D(boundingRectangle.Left + boundingRectangle.Width, boundingRectangle.Top));
				bottomPoints = new LineStrip(4);
				bottomPoints.Add(new GRealPoint2D(boundingRectangle.Left + boundingRectangle.Width, boundingRectangle.Top + boundingRectangle.Height));
				bottomPoints.Add(new GRealPoint2D(boundingRectangle.Left + boundingRectangle.Width / 1.5, boundingRectangle.Top + boundingRectangle.Height));
				bottomPoints.Add(new GRealPoint2D(boundingRectangle.Left + boundingRectangle.Width / 3.0, boundingRectangle.Top + boundingRectangle.Height));
				bottomPoints.Add(new GRealPoint2D(boundingRectangle.Left, boundingRectangle.Top + boundingRectangle.Height));
			}
			else
			{
				GetPointsForDrawingInternal(out topPoints, out bottomPoints);
			}
		}

		public GRealRect2D GetBoundingRectangle()
		{
			if (base.Count == 0 && IsEmpty)
			{
				return GRealRect2D.Empty;
			}
			if (base.Count == 1)
			{
				GRealRect2D result = GeometricUtils.CalcBounds(new GRealPoint2D[2]
				{
					base.TopStrip[0],
					base.BottomStrip[0]
				});
				if (result.Width < 0.5)
				{
					result.Inflate(0.5, 0.0);
				}
				if (result.Height < 0.5)
				{
					result.Inflate(0.0, 0.5);
				}
				return result;
			}
			GetPointsForDrawingInternal(out var topPoints, out var bottomPoints);
			topPoints.AddRange(bottomPoints);
			return GeometricUtils.CalcBounds(topPoints);
		}

		public override RangeStrip CreateInstance()
		{
			return new BezierRangeStrip(splineAlgorithm, lineTension, transformationX, transformationY);
		}

		public override void CompleteFilling(IList<RefinedPoint> points, IBezierStripSplitter splitter = null)
		{
			EnsureStrips();
			List<GRealPoint2D> list = new List<GRealPoint2D>();
			list.AddRange(base.TopStrip);
			list.AddRange(base.BottomStrip);
			base.CompleteFilling(points, splitter);
		}

		public MinMaxValues CalculateMinMaxValues()
		{
			GetPointsForRangeCorrection(out var topPoints, out var _);
			double num = double.MaxValue;
			double num2 = double.MinValue;
			MinMaxValues minMaxValues = BezierStrip.CalculateMinMaxValues(topPoints);
			if (minMaxValues.Min < num)
			{
				num = minMaxValues.Min;
			}
			if (minMaxValues.Max > num2)
			{
				num2 = minMaxValues.Max;
			}
			return new MinMaxValues(num, num2);
		}

		public MinMaxValues CalculateMinMaxArguments()
		{
			GetPointsForRangeCorrection(out var topPoints, out var bottomPoints);
			double num = double.MaxValue;
			double num2 = double.MinValue;
			MinMaxValues minMaxValues = BezierStrip.CalculateMinMaxArguments(topPoints);
			if (minMaxValues.Min < num)
			{
				num = minMaxValues.Min;
			}
			if (minMaxValues.Max > num2)
			{
				num2 = minMaxValues.Max;
			}
			minMaxValues = BezierStrip.CalculateMinMaxArguments(bottomPoints);
			if (minMaxValues.Min < num)
			{
				num = minMaxValues.Min;
			}
			if (minMaxValues.Max > num2)
			{
				num2 = minMaxValues.Max;
			}
			return new MinMaxValues(num, num2);
		}

		private void GetPointsForRangeCorrection(out LineStrip topPoints, out LineStrip bottomPoints)
		{
			topPoints = new LineStrip();
			bottomPoints = new LineStrip();
			topPoints.AddRange(((BezierStrip)base.TopStrip).GetPointsForDrawingWithoutValidate(completeFilling: true, clip: true));
			bottomPoints.AddRange(((BezierStrip)base.BottomStrip).GetPointsForDrawingWithoutValidate(completeFilling: true, clip: true));
			bottomPoints.Reverse();
		}
	}
	public static class LargeScaleHelper
	{
		private const int mistakeCriterion = 8388600;

		private static bool IsValid(double value)
		{
			if (value <= 8388600.0)
			{
				return value >= -8388600.0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static bool IsValid(GRealPoint2D point)
		{
			if (IsValid(point.X))
			{
				return IsValid(point.Y);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static double Validate(double value)
		{
			if (!(value > 8388600.0))
			{
				if (!(value < -8388600.0))
				{
					return value;
				}
				return -8388600.0;
			}
			return 8388600.0;
		}

		private static GRealPoint2D Validate(GRealPoint2D point)
		{
			if (IsValid(point.X))
			{
				if (!IsValid(point.Y))
				{
					return new GRealPoint2D(point.X, Validate(point.Y));
				}
				return point;
			}
			if (IsValid(point.Y))
			{
				return new GRealPoint2D(Validate(point.X), point.Y);
			}
			if (!(Math.Abs(point.X) > Math.Abs(point.Y)))
			{
				return new GRealPoint2D(point.X * Math.Abs(8388600.0 / point.Y), Validate(point.Y));
			}
			return new GRealPoint2D(Validate(point.X), point.Y * Math.Abs(8388600.0 / point.X));
		}

		public static void Validate(List<GRealPoint2D> points)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < points.Count; i++)
			{
				if (!IsValid(points[i]))
				{
					points[i] = Validate(points[i]);
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public enum SplineAlgorithmCore
	{
		StrictMinMax,
		Cardinal
	}
	public class BezierStrip : LineStrip, IBezierStrip
	{
		private readonly SplineAlgorithmCore splineAlgorithm;

		private readonly double lineTension;

		private readonly ITransformation transformationX;

		private readonly ITransformation transformationY;

		private bool clipLargeValues = true;

		private List<GRealPoint2D> drawingPoints;

		public bool ClipLargeValues
		{
			get
			{
				return clipLargeValues;
			}
			set
			{
				clipLargeValues = value;
			}
		}

		public SplineAlgorithmCore SplineAlgorithm => splineAlgorithm;

		public double LineTension => lineTension;

		public List<GRealPoint2D> DrawingPoints => drawingPoints;

		public override bool IsEmpty
		{
			get
			{
				if (drawingPoints != null)
				{
					return drawingPoints.Count < 2;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private static GRealPoint2D CalculateCurveBezierEndPoint(GRealPoint2D endPoint, GRealPoint2D adjPoint, double tension)
		{
			return new GRealPoint2D(tension * (adjPoint.X - endPoint.X) + endPoint.X, tension * (adjPoint.Y - endPoint.Y) + endPoint.Y);
		}

		private static bool IsVecticallyBetweenPoints(int i, List<GRealPoint2D> points)
		{
			if (i > 0 && i < points.Count - 1)
			{
				if (!(points[i].Y > points[i - 1].Y) || !(points[i + 1].Y > points[i].Y))
				{
					if (points[i].Y < points[i - 1].Y)
					{
						return points[i + 1].Y < points[i].Y;
					}
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static MinMaxValues CalculateMinMaxValues(IList<GRealPoint2D> points)
		{
			double num = double.MaxValue;
			double num2 = double.MinValue;
			for (int i = 0; i < points.Count; i++)
			{
				double y = points[i].Y;
				if (y < num)
				{
					num = y;
				}
				if (y > num2)
				{
					num2 = y;
				}
			}
			return new MinMaxValues(num, num2);
		}

		public static MinMaxValues CalculateMinMaxArguments(IList<GRealPoint2D> points)
		{
			double num = double.MaxValue;
			double num2 = double.MinValue;
			for (int i = 0; i < points.Count; i++)
			{
				double x = points[i].X;
				if (x < num)
				{
					num = x;
				}
				if (x > num2)
				{
					num2 = x;
				}
			}
			return new MinMaxValues(num, num2);
		}

		public BezierStrip()
		{
			splineAlgorithm = SplineAlgorithmCore.StrictMinMax;
			lineTension = 0.8;
		}

		public BezierStrip(SplineAlgorithmCore splineAlgorithm, double lineTension, ITransformation transformationX, ITransformation transformationY)
			: this(splineAlgorithm, lineTension)
		{
			this.transformationX = transformationX;
			this.transformationY = transformationY;
		}

		public BezierStrip(SplineAlgorithmCore splineAlgorithm, double lineTension)
		{
			this.lineTension = lineTension;
			this.splineAlgorithm = splineAlgorithm;
		}

		private List<GRealPoint2D> TransformPointsForward(List<GRealPoint2D> points)
		{
			List<GRealPoint2D> list = new List<GRealPoint2D>();
			foreach (GRealPoint2D point in points)
			{
				list.Add(new GRealPoint2D(transformationX?.TransformForward(point.X) ?? point.X, transformationY?.TransformForward(point.Y) ?? point.Y));
			}
			return list;
		}

		private GRealPoint2D TransformPointBackward(GRealPoint2D point)
		{
			return new GRealPoint2D(transformationX?.TransformBackward(point.X) ?? point.X, transformationY?.TransformBackward(point.Y) ?? point.Y);
		}

		private void TransformBackwardAndAdd(GRealPoint2D point, IList<GRealPoint2D> points)
		{
			points.Add(TransformPointBackward(point));
		}

		private List<GRealPoint2D> CalculateBezierPoints(IList<RefinedPoint> refinedPoints, List<GRealPoint2D> points, IBezierStripSplitter splitter)
		{
			return splineAlgorithm switch
			{
				SplineAlgorithmCore.StrictMinMax => CalculateStrictMinMaxBezierPoints(refinedPoints, points, splitter), 
				SplineAlgorithmCore.Cardinal => CalculateCardinalBezierPoints(refinedPoints, points, splitter), 
				_ => null, 
			};
		}

		private List<GRealPoint2D> CalculateStrictMinMaxBezierPoints(IList<RefinedPoint> refinedPoints, List<GRealPoint2D> points, IBezierStripSplitter splitter)
		{
			points = TransformPointsForward(points);
			List<GRealPoint2D> list = new List<GRealPoint2D>();
			if (points.Count > 0)
			{
				TransformBackwardAndAdd(points[0], list);
			}
			if (points.Count > 1)
			{
				TransformBackwardAndAdd(points[0], list);
				for (int i = 1; i < points.Count - 1; i++)
				{
					GRealVector2D gRealVector2D = points[i] - points[i - 1];
					GRealVector2D gRealVector2D2 = points[i + 1] - points[i];
					double num = gRealVector2D.X * lineTension;
					double num2 = gRealVector2D2.X * lineTension;
					if (IsVecticallyBetweenPoints(i, points))
					{
						double num3 = gRealVector2D.Y / (gRealVector2D + gRealVector2D2).Y;
						if (!IsVecticallyBetweenPoints(i - 1, points))
						{
							double lerpValue = Math.Min(num3 * 2.0, 1.0);
							gRealVector2D = GeometricUtils.LinearInterpolation(end: new GRealVector2D(gRealVector2D.X - num * lineTension, gRealVector2D.Y), start: gRealVector2D, lerpValue: lerpValue);
						}
						if (!IsVecticallyBetweenPoints(i + 1, points))
						{
							double lerpValue2 = Math.Min((1.0 - num3) * 2.0, 1.0);
							gRealVector2D2 = GeometricUtils.LinearInterpolation(end: new GRealVector2D(gRealVector2D2.X - num2 * lineTension, gRealVector2D2.Y), start: gRealVector2D2, lerpValue: lerpValue2);
						}
						GRealVector2D gRealVector2D3 = GeometricUtils.LinearInterpolation(gRealVector2D, gRealVector2D2, num3);
						TransformBackwardAndAdd(points[i] - gRealVector2D3 * num3 * lineTension, list);
						TransformBackwardAndAdd(points[i], list);
						splitter.SplitStrip(refinedPoints, list);
						TransformBackwardAndAdd(points[i] + gRealVector2D3 * (1.0 - num3) * lineTension, list);
					}
					else
					{
						TransformBackwardAndAdd(new GRealPoint2D(points[i].X - num * lineTension, points[i].Y), list);
						TransformBackwardAndAdd(points[i], list);
						splitter.SplitStrip(refinedPoints, list);
						TransformBackwardAndAdd(new GRealPoint2D(points[i].X + num2 * lineTension, points[i].Y), list);
					}
				}
				TransformBackwardAndAdd(points[points.Count - 1], list);
				TransformBackwardAndAdd(points[points.Count - 1], list);
				splitter.SplitStrip(refinedPoints, list);
			}
			return list;
		}

		private List<GRealPoint2D> CalculateCardinalBezierPoints(IList<RefinedPoint> refinedPoints, List<GRealPoint2D> points, IBezierStripSplitter splitter)
		{
			points = TransformPointsForward(points);
			List<GRealPoint2D> list = new List<GRealPoint2D>();
			if (points.Count > 1)
			{
				int count = points.Count;
				double num = lineTension / 6.0;
				TransformBackwardAndAdd(points[0], list);
				TransformBackwardAndAdd(CalculateCurveBezierEndPoint(points[0], points[1], num), list);
				for (int i = 0; i < count - 2; i++)
				{
					GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D = new GRealPoint2D(points[i + 2].X - points[i].X, points[i + 2].Y - points[i].Y);
					double num2 = GeometricUtils.CalcDistance(points[i], points[i + 1]);
					double num3 = GeometricUtils.CalcDistance(points[i + 1], points[i + 2]);
					if (num2 > 0.0)
					{
						TransformBackwardAndAdd(new GRealPoint2D(points[i + 1].X - num * gRealPoint2D.X, points[i + 1].Y - num * gRealPoint2D.Y), list);
					}
					else
					{
						TransformBackwardAndAdd(points[i + 1], list);
					}
					TransformBackwardAndAdd(points[i + 1], list);
					splitter.SplitStrip(refinedPoints, list);
					if (num3 > 0.0)
					{
						TransformBackwardAndAdd(new GRealPoint2D(points[i + 1].X + num * gRealPoint2D.X, points[i + 1].Y + num * gRealPoint2D.Y), list);
					}
					else
					{
						TransformBackwardAndAdd(points[i + 1], list);
					}
				}
				TransformBackwardAndAdd(CalculateCurveBezierEndPoint(points[count - 1], points[count - 2], num), list);
				TransformBackwardAndAdd(points[count - 1], list);
				splitter.SplitStrip(refinedPoints, list);
			}
			else if (points.Count > 0)
			{
				TransformBackwardAndAdd(points[0], list);
			}
			return list;
		}

		public List<GRealPoint2D> GetPointsForDrawing(bool completeFilling, bool clip)
		{
			if (completeFilling)
			{
				CompleteFilling(null, DefaultBezierSplitter.Instance);
			}
			if (clip && clipLargeValues)
			{
				List<GRealPoint2D> range = drawingPoints.GetRange(0, drawingPoints.Count);
				LargeScaleHelper.Validate(range);
				return range;
			}
			return drawingPoints;
		}

		public List<GRealPoint2D> GetPointsForDrawingWithoutValidate(bool completeFilling, bool clip)
		{
			if (completeFilling)
			{
				CompleteFilling(null, DefaultBezierSplitter.Instance);
			}
			if (clip)
			{
				return drawingPoints.GetRange(0, drawingPoints.Count);
			}
			return drawingPoints;
		}

		public void SetPointsForDrawing(List<GRealPoint2D> points)
		{
			drawingPoints = points;
		}

		public override LineStrip CreateInstance()
		{
			return new BezierStrip(splineAlgorithm, lineTension, transformationX, transformationY);
		}

		public override void CompleteFilling(IList<RefinedPoint> points, IBezierStripSplitter splitter)
		{
			if (drawingPoints == null)
			{
				drawingPoints = CalculateBezierPoints(points, this, splitter);
			}
		}

		public List<GRealPoint2D> CalculateBezierPoints(IList<RefinedPoint> refinedPoints, IBezierStripSplitter splitter)
		{
			return CalculateBezierPoints(refinedPoints, this, splitter);
		}

		public override void Extend(GRealPoint2D point, bool toLeft)
		{
			if (IsEmpty)
			{
				base.Extend(point, toLeft);
			}
			if (toLeft)
			{
				Insert(0, base[0]);
				Insert(0, point);
				Insert(0, point);
			}
			else
			{
				Add(base[base.Count - 1]);
				Add(point);
				Add(point);
			}
			if (drawingPoints != null)
			{
				if (toLeft)
				{
					GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D = drawingPoints[0];
					drawingPoints.Insert(0, gRealPoint2D);
					drawingPoints.Insert(0, gRealPoint2D);
					drawingPoints.Insert(0, gRealPoint2D);
					drawingPoints.Insert(0, GeometricUtils.CalcPointInLine(gRealPoint2D, point, 1.0 / 3.0));
					drawingPoints.Insert(0, GeometricUtils.CalcPointInLine(gRealPoint2D, point, 2.0 / 3.0));
					drawingPoints.Insert(0, point);
					drawingPoints.Insert(0, point);
					drawingPoints.Insert(0, point);
					drawingPoints.Insert(0, point);
				}
				else
				{
					GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D2 = drawingPoints[drawingPoints.Count - 1];
					drawingPoints.Add(gRealPoint2D2);
					drawingPoints.Add(gRealPoint2D2);
					drawingPoints.Add(gRealPoint2D2);
					drawingPoints.Add(GeometricUtils.CalcPointInLine(gRealPoint2D2, point, 1.0 / 3.0));
					drawingPoints.Add(GeometricUtils.CalcPointInLine(gRealPoint2D2, point, 2.0 / 3.0));
					drawingPoints.Add(point);
					drawingPoints.Add(point);
					drawingPoints.Add(point);
					drawingPoints.Add(point);
				}
			}
		}

		public override LineStrip ExtractSubStrip(int startIndex, int endIndex)
		{
			LineStrip lineStrip = base.ExtractSubStrip(startIndex, endIndex);
			if (lineStrip is BezierStrip bezierStrip && drawingPoints != null && drawingPoints.Count > 0)
			{
				int num = startIndex * 3;
				int num2 = endIndex * 3 - num + 1;
				List<GRealPoint2D> list = new List<GRealPoint2D>(num2);
				list.AddRange(drawingPoints.GetRange(num, num2));
				bezierStrip.drawingPoints = list;
			}
			return lineStrip;
		}

		public override void Substitute(int startIndex, int endIndex, LineStrip lineStrip)
		{
			base.Substitute(startIndex, endIndex, lineStrip);
			if (lineStrip is BezierStrip bezierStrip && drawingPoints != null && bezierStrip.drawingPoints != null)
			{
				int num = startIndex * 3;
				drawingPoints.RemoveRange(num, endIndex * 3 - num + 1);
				drawingPoints.InsertRange(num, bezierStrip.drawingPoints);
			}
			else
			{
				drawingPoints = null;
			}
		}

		public override LineStrip CreateUniqueStrip()
		{
			CompleteFilling(null, DefaultBezierSplitter.Instance);
			BezierStrip bezierStrip = new BezierStrip(splineAlgorithm, lineTension, transformationX, transformationY);
			bezierStrip.Style.Assign(base.Style);
			bezierStrip.AddRange(this);
			if (drawingPoints != null)
			{
				bezierStrip.drawingPoints = new List<GRealPoint2D>(drawingPoints);
			}
			return bezierStrip;
		}

		public MinMaxValues CalculateMinMaxValues()
		{
			List<GRealPoint2D> pointsForDrawing = GetPointsForDrawing(completeFilling: true, clip: false);
			return CalculateMinMaxValues(pointsForDrawing);
		}

		public MinMaxValues CalculateMinMaxArguments()
		{
			List<GRealPoint2D> pointsForDrawing = GetPointsForDrawing(completeFilling: true, clip: false);
			return CalculateMinMaxArguments(pointsForDrawing);
		}
	}
	public class SeriesGeometry
	{
		private readonly StackedGeometry stackedGeometry;

		private readonly ISeries series;

		private IList<IGeometryStrip> geometry;

		public IList<IGeometryStrip> Geometry => geometry;

		public SeriesGeometry(StackedGeometry stackedGeometry, ISeries series)
		{
			this.stackedGeometry = stackedGeometry;
			this.series = series;
		}

		private LineStrip CreateConstantStrip(IGeometryStripCreator stripCreator, double constant, IList<double> arguments)
		{
			if (stripCreator == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!(stripCreator.CreateStrip() is RangeStrip rangeStrip))
			{
				return null;
			}
			LineStrip lineStrip = rangeStrip.BottomStrip.CreateInstance();
			foreach (double argument in arguments)
			{
				lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(argument, constant));
			}
			lineStrip.CompleteFilling(null, DefaultBezierSplitter.Instance);
			return lineStrip;
		}

		public void SetGeometry(IList<IGeometryStrip> geometry, IList<double> arguments)
		{
			this.geometry = geometry;
			LineStrip lineStrip = stackedGeometry.BorderStrip;
			if (lineStrip == null)
			{
				lineStrip = CreateConstantStrip(series.SeriesView as IGeometryStripCreator, 0.0, arguments);
				stackedGeometry.BorderStrip = lineStrip;
			}
			if (lineStrip == null || lineStrip.Count <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (RangeStrip item in geometry)
			{
				stackedGeometry.UpdateBottomSegment(item);
			}
			foreach (RangeStrip item2 in geometry)
			{
				stackedGeometry.ModifyBorderStrip(item2);
			}
		}
	}
	public class StackedGeometry
	{
		private LineStrip borderStrip;

		public LineStrip BorderStrip
		{
			get
			{
				return borderStrip;
			}
			set
			{
				borderStrip = value;
			}
		}

		public void UpdateBottomSegment(RangeStrip strip)
		{
			int count = strip.Count;
			if (count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			double x = strip.TopStrip[0].X;
			double x2 = strip.TopStrip[count - 1].X;
			if (x2 == x)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = -1;
			int num2 = -1;
			for (int i = 0; i < borderStrip.Count; i++)
			{
				GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D = borderStrip[i];
				if (num == -1 && gRealPoint2D.X == x)
				{
					num = i;
				}
				if (gRealPoint2D.X > x2)
				{
					break;
				}
				if (gRealPoint2D.X == x2)
				{
					num2 = i;
				}
			}
			if (num2 - num > 0)
			{
				strip.BottomStrip = borderStrip.ExtractSubStrip(num, num2);
			}
		}

		public void ModifyBorderStrip(RangeStrip strip)
		{
			LineStrip topStrip = strip.TopStrip;
			if (topStrip.Count < 2 || borderStrip.Count < 2)
			{
				return;
			}
			double x = topStrip[0].X;
			double x2 = topStrip[topStrip.Count - 1].X;
			double x3 = borderStrip[0].X;
			double x4 = borderStrip[borderStrip.Count - 1].X;
			LineStrip lineStrip = topStrip.ExtractSubStrip(0, topStrip.Count - 1);
			if (x3 != x)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < borderStrip.Count; i++)
				{
					GRealPoint2D point = borderStrip[i];
					if (point.X == x)
					{
						lineStrip.Extend(point, toLeft: true);
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			if (x4 != x2)
			{
				for (int num = borderStrip.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
				{
					GRealPoint2D point2 = borderStrip[num];
					if (point2.X == x2)
					{
						lineStrip.Extend(point2, toLeft: false);
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			int num2 = -1;
			int j;
			for (j = 0; j < borderStrip.Count; j++)
			{
				GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D = borderStrip[j];
				if (!(gRealPoint2D.X < x))
				{
					if (num2 < 0)
					{
						num2 = j;
					}
					else if (gRealPoint2D.X > x2)
					{
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			if (num2 >= 0)
			{
				borderStrip.Substitute(num2, j - 1, lineStrip);
			}
		}
	}
	public class GeometryCalculator
	{
		private readonly Dictionary<StackedInteractionContainer, SplineStackedAreaGeometryStripCreator> stackedSplineCreators = new Dictionary<StackedInteractionContainer, SplineStackedAreaGeometryStripCreator>();

		internal static IList<IGeometryStrip> CreateStrips(IRefinedSeries refinedSeries, GeometryStripCreator stripCreator)
		{
			IList<RefinedPoint> continuesDrawingPoints = refinedSeries.GetContinuesDrawingPoints();
			List<IGeometryStrip> list = new List<IGeometryStrip>(continuesDrawingPoints.Count);
			if (stripCreator != null && continuesDrawingPoints.Count > 0)
			{
				bool flag = stripCreator.HasStripMaxCapacityLimit && stripCreator.StripMaxCapacity < continuesDrawingPoints.Count;
				int num = ((!stripCreator.ShouldAddEmptyStrip) ? 1 : 0);
				RefinedPoint refinedPoint = (stripCreator.Closed ? continuesDrawingPoints[0] : null);
				IGeometryStrip geometryStrip = stripCreator.CreateStrip();
				int num2 = (stripCreator.FilteringPointsSupported ? stripCreator.GetMinVisiblePointIndex(refinedSeries) : 0);
				int num3 = (stripCreator.FilteringPointsSupported ? stripCreator.GetMaxVisiblePointIndex(refinedSeries, continuesDrawingPoints) : (continuesDrawingPoints.Count - 1));
				for (int i = num2; i <= num3 && i < continuesDrawingPoints.Count; i++)
				{
					RefinedPoint refinedPoint2 = continuesDrawingPoints[i];
					bool flag2 = refinedSeries.SeriesView.PointDimension == 6 && double.IsNaN(((IBoxPlotPoint)refinedPoint2).Mean);
					if (!stripCreator.CanProcessPoint(refinedPoint2) || flag2)
					{
						if (geometryStrip.Count > num)
						{
							stripCreator.CompleteFillingStrip(continuesDrawingPoints, list, geometryStrip);
						}
						geometryStrip = stripCreator.CreateStrip();
					}
					else
					{
						geometryStrip = stripCreator.AddStripElement(continuesDrawingPoints, i, geometryStrip, list);
						if (flag && geometryStrip.Count >= stripCreator.StripMaxCapacity && Math.Min(num3, continuesDrawingPoints.Count - 1) - i > 0)
						{
							stripCreator.CompleteFillingStrip(continuesDrawingPoints, list, geometryStrip);
							geometryStrip = stripCreator.CreateStrip();
							geometryStrip = stripCreator.AddStripElement(continuesDrawingPoints, i, geometryStrip, null);
						}
					}
					if (refinedPoint2.IsSupplyPoint || refinedPoint2.Argument < refinedSeries.Points[num2].Argument)
					{
						num3++;
					}
				}
				if (refinedPoint != null && !refinedPoint.IsEmpty)
				{
					geometryStrip = stripCreator.AddStripElement(continuesDrawingPoints, 0, geometryStrip, null);
				}
				if (geometryStrip.Count > num)
				{
					stripCreator.CompleteFillingStrip(continuesDrawingPoints, list, geometryStrip);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		private IList<IGeometryStrip> CreateStackedSplineStrips(RefinedSeries series, IGeometryHolder geometryHolder)
		{
			StackedInteractionContainer stackedInteractionContainer = (StackedInteractionContainer)series.InteractionContainer;
			SplineStackedAreaGeometryStripCreator splineStackedAreaGeometryStripCreator;
			if (!stackedSplineCreators.ContainsKey(stackedInteractionContainer))
			{
				splineStackedAreaGeometryStripCreator = (SplineStackedAreaGeometryStripCreator)geometryHolder.CreateStripCreator();
				splineStackedAreaGeometryStripCreator.Calculate(stackedInteractionContainer);
				stackedSplineCreators.Add(stackedInteractionContainer, splineStackedAreaGeometryStripCreator);
			}
			else
			{
				splineStackedAreaGeometryStripCreator = stackedSplineCreators[stackedInteractionContainer];
			}
			return splineStackedAreaGeometryStripCreator.GetStrips(series);
		}

		public IList<IGeometryStrip> CreateStrips(IRefinedSeries refinedSeries)
		{
			RefinedSeries refinedSeries2 = (RefinedSeries)refinedSeries;
			if (refinedSeries2.SeriesView is IGeometryHolder geometryHolder)
			{
				if (refinedSeries2.SeriesView is IStackedSplineView)
				{
					return CreateStackedSplineStrips(refinedSeries2, geometryHolder);
				}
				GeometryStripCreator stripCreator = geometryHolder.CreateStripCreator();
				return CreateStrips(refinedSeries, stripCreator);
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
	public abstract class GeometryStripCreator
	{
		protected internal abstract bool Closed { get; }

		protected internal abstract bool ShouldAddEmptyStrip { get; }

		protected internal virtual bool FilteringPointsSupported => true;

		protected internal virtual int StripMaxCapacity => 0;

		protected internal virtual bool HasStripMaxCapacityLimit => false;

		public GeometryStripCreator()
		{
		}

		protected internal abstract IGeometryStrip CreateStrip();

		protected internal IGeometryStrip CreateStrip(GeometryStripStyle style)
		{
			IGeometryStrip geometryStrip = CreateStrip();
			geometryStrip.Style.Assign(style);
			return geometryStrip;
		}

		protected internal virtual int GetMinVisiblePointIndex(IRefinedSeries refinedSeries)
		{
			return refinedSeries.GetMinVisiblePointIndex();
		}

		protected internal virtual int GetMaxVisiblePointIndex(IRefinedSeries refinedSeries, IList<RefinedPoint> points)
		{
			return refinedSeries.GetMaxVisiblePointIndex();
		}

		protected internal virtual GRealPoint2D GetPreviousPoint(IGeometryStrip strip)
		{
			LineStrip lineStrip = (LineStrip)strip;
			return lineStrip[lineStrip.Count - 1];
		}

		internal virtual void CompleteFillingStrip(IList<RefinedPoint> points, List<IGeometryStrip> strips, IGeometryStrip currentStrip)
		{
			currentStrip.CompleteFilling();
			strips.Add(currentStrip);
		}

		internal abstract IGeometryStrip AddStripElement(IList<RefinedPoint> points, int index, IGeometryStrip strip, List<IGeometryStrip> strips);

		internal virtual bool CanProcessPoint(RefinedPoint point)
		{
			return !point.IsEmpty;
		}
	}
	public class LineGeometryStripCreator : GeometryStripCreator
	{
		private readonly bool closed;

		private readonly bool shouldAddEmptyStrip;

		protected internal override bool Closed => closed;

		protected internal override bool ShouldAddEmptyStrip => shouldAddEmptyStrip;

		protected internal override bool FilteringPointsSupported => !closed;

		protected virtual double GetActualValue(RefinedPoint refinedPoint)
		{
			return ((IValuePoint)refinedPoint).Value;
		}

		protected virtual double GetPointMinValue(RefinedPoint refinedPoint)
		{
			return 0.0;
		}

		public LineGeometryStripCreator(bool closed, bool shouldAddEmptyStrip = true)
		{
			this.closed = closed;
			this.shouldAddEmptyStrip = shouldAddEmptyStrip;
		}

		protected IGeometryStrip ProcessSplitStrip(IStripSplitter stripSplitter, IList<RefinedPoint> points, int index, IGeometryStrip strip, List<IGeometryStrip> strips)
		{
			List<ColoredStripInfo> list = stripSplitter.SplitStrip(points, index, strip, (RefinedPoint rPoint) => GetActualValue(rPoint));
			if (list == null || list.Count == 0)
			{
				return AddStripElementCore(points, index, strip);
			}
			if (strip.Count == 0)
			{
				strip.Style.Assign(list.Last().Style);
				return AddStripElementCore(points, index, strip);
			}
			return ProcessIntervalsStrip(strip, strips, points, index, list);
		}

		protected virtual IGeometryStrip ProcessIntervalsStrip(IGeometryStrip strip, List<IGeometryStrip> strips, IList<RefinedPoint> points, int index, List<ColoredStripInfo> coloredStripInfos)
		{
			return null;
		}

		protected virtual IGeometryStrip AddStripElementCore(IList<RefinedPoint> points, int index, IGeometryStrip strip)
		{
			RefinedPoint refinedPoint = points[index];
			((LineStrip)strip).Add(new GRealPoint2D(refinedPoint.Argument, GetActualValue(refinedPoint)));
			return strip;
		}

		internal override IGeometryStrip AddStripElement(IList<RefinedPoint> points, int index, IGeometryStrip strip, List<IGeometryStrip> strips)
		{
			return AddStripElementCore(points, index, strip);
		}

		protected internal override IGeometryStrip CreateStrip()
		{
			return new LineStrip();
		}
	}
	public class MeanLineGeometryStripCreator : GeometryStripCreator

		protected internal override bool Closed => false;

		protected internal override bool ShouldAddEmptyStrip => false;

		internal override IGeometryStrip AddStripElement(IList<RefinedPoint> points, int index, IGeometryStrip strip, List<IGeometryStrip> strips)

	public class LineGeometrySplittedStripCreator : LineGeometryStripCreator
	{
		private readonly IStripSplitter stripSplitter;

		public LineGeometrySplittedStripCreator(IStripSplitter stripSplitter, bool closed, bool shouldAddEmptyStrip)
			: base(closed, shouldAddEmptyStrip)
		{
			this.stripSplitter = stripSplitter;
		}

		protected override IGeometryStrip ProcessIntervalsStrip(IGeometryStrip strip, List<IGeometryStrip> strips, IList<RefinedPoint> points, int index, List<ColoredStripInfo> coloredStripInfos)
		{
			LineStrip lineStrip = (LineStrip)strip;
			foreach (ColoredStripInfo coloredStripInfo in coloredStripInfos)
			{
				if (lineStrip[lineStrip.Count - 1] == coloredStripInfo.SplitPoint)
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (lineStrip.Style.Equals(coloredStripInfo.Style))
				{
					lineStrip.Add(coloredStripInfo.SplitPoint);
					continue;
				}
				if (lineStrip.Count == 1 && !lineStrip.Style.ShouldAddNextSplitPoint)
				{
					lineStrip.Add(coloredStripInfo.SplitPoint);
					lineStrip.Style.Assign(coloredStripInfo.Style);
					continue;
				}
				bool shouldAddNextSplitPoint = lineStrip.Style.ShouldAddNextSplitPoint;
				if (shouldAddNextSplitPoint)
				{
					lineStrip.Add(coloredStripInfo.SplitPoint);
				}
				lineStrip.CompleteFilling();
				strips.Add(lineStrip);
				GRealPoint2D item = lineStrip.Last();
				lineStrip = (LineStrip)CreateStrip(coloredStripInfo.Style);
				lineStrip.Add(item);
				if (!shouldAddNextSplitPoint)
				{
					lineStrip.Add(coloredStripInfo.SplitPoint);
				}
			}
			return lineStrip;
		}

		internal override IGeometryStrip AddStripElement(IList<RefinedPoint> points, int index, IGeometryStrip strip, List<IGeometryStrip> strips)
		{
			return ProcessSplitStrip(stripSplitter, points, index, strip, strips);
		}

		internal override bool CanProcessPoint(RefinedPoint point)
		{
			return stripSplitter.CanProcessPoint(point);
		}
	}

	public class SplineGeometryStripCreator : LineGeometryStripCreator
	{
		private const int FilterPointsAddition = 2;

		public const int GDIErrorLimit = 2704;

		private readonly SplineAlgorithmCore splineAlgorithm;

		private readonly double lineTension;

		private readonly ITransformation transformationX;

		private readonly ITransformation transformationY;

		private readonly bool hasStripMaxCapacityLimit;

		private readonly IBezierStripSplitter stripSplitter;

		protected IBezierStripSplitter StripSplitter => stripSplitter;

		protected SplineAlgorithmCore SplineAlgorithm => splineAlgorithm;

		protected double LineTension => lineTension;

		protected ITransformation TransformationX => transformationX;

		protected ITransformation TransformationY => transformationY;

		protected internal override int StripMaxCapacity => 2703;

		protected internal override bool HasStripMaxCapacityLimit => hasStripMaxCapacityLimit;

		public SplineGeometryStripCreator(SplineAlgorithmCore splineAlgorithm, double lineTension, ITransformation transformationX, ITransformation transformationY, IBezierStripSplitter stripSplitter, bool shouldAddEmptyStrip = true, bool hasStripMaxCapacityLimit = false)
			: base(closed: false, shouldAddEmptyStrip)
		{
			this.stripSplitter = stripSplitter;
			this.splineAlgorithm = splineAlgorithm;
			this.lineTension = lineTension;
			this.transformationX = transformationX;
			this.transformationY = transformationY;
			this.hasStripMaxCapacityLimit = hasStripMaxCapacityLimit;
			this.stripSplitter = stripSplitter;
		}

		protected internal override int GetMaxVisiblePointIndex(IRefinedSeries refinedSeries, IList<RefinedPoint> points)
		{
			return base.GetMaxVisiblePointIndex(refinedSeries, points) + 2;
		}

		protected internal override int GetMinVisiblePointIndex(IRefinedSeries refinedSeries)
		{
			int num = base.GetMinVisiblePointIndex(refinedSeries) - 2;
			if (num < 0)
			{
				num = 0;
			}
			return num;
		}

		protected internal override IGeometryStrip CreateStrip()
		{
			return new BezierStrip(splineAlgorithm, lineTension, transformationX, transformationY);
		}

		internal override void CompleteFillingStrip(IList<RefinedPoint> points, List<IGeometryStrip> strips, IGeometryStrip currentStrip)
		{
			BezierStrip bezierStrip = (BezierStrip)currentStrip;
			bezierStrip.CompleteFilling(points, stripSplitter);
			if (stripSplitter.Strips.Count > 0)
			{
				strips.AddRange(stripSplitter.Strips);
				return;
			}
			currentStrip.CompleteFilling(points, DefaultBezierSplitter.Instance);
			strips.Add(currentStrip);
		}

		internal override bool CanProcessPoint(RefinedPoint point)
		{
			return stripSplitter.CanProcessPoint(point);
		}
	}

		}
	}
	public class StepLineGeometrySplittedStripCreator : StepLineGeometryStripCreator
	{
		private readonly IStripSplitter stripSplitter;

		public StepLineGeometrySplittedStripCreator(IStripSplitter stripSplitter, bool invertedStep, bool shouldAddEmptyStrip)
			: base(invertedStep, shouldAddEmptyStrip)
		{
			this.stripSplitter = stripSplitter;
		}

		private LineStrip RecreateStrip(LineStrip lineStrip, List<IGeometryStrip> strips, GeometryStripStyle style, GRealPoint2D prevPoint)
		{
			lineStrip.CompleteFilling();
			strips.Add(lineStrip);
			lineStrip = (LineStrip)CreateStrip(style);
			lineStrip.Add(prevPoint);
			return lineStrip;
		}

		internal override IGeometryStrip AddStripElement(IList<RefinedPoint> points, int index, IGeometryStrip strip, List<IGeometryStrip> strips)
		{
			return ProcessSplitStrip(stripSplitter, points, index, strip, strips);
		}

		protected override IGeometryStrip ProcessIntervalsStrip(IGeometryStrip strip, List<IGeometryStrip> strips, IList<RefinedPoint> points, int index, List<ColoredStripInfo> coloredStripInfos)
		{
			LineStrip lineStrip = (LineStrip)strip;
			ColoredStripInfo coloredStripInfo = coloredStripInfos.First();
			GRealPoint2D prevPoint = lineStrip.Last();
			bool flag = lineStrip.Count == 1;
			bool shouldAddNextSplitPoint = lineStrip.Style.ShouldAddNextSplitPoint;
			if (coloredStripInfo.Style.StyleKey != lineStrip.Style.StyleKey && !shouldAddNextSplitPoint)
			{
				lineStrip = RecreateStrip(lineStrip, strips, coloredStripInfo.Style, prevPoint);
				shouldAddNextSplitPoint = lineStrip.Style.ShouldAddNextSplitPoint;
			}
			if (!base.InvertedStep)
			{
				lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(points[index].Argument, prevPoint.Y));
			}
			foreach (ColoredStripInfo coloredStripInfo3 in coloredStripInfos)
			{
				prevPoint = lineStrip.Last();
				if (prevPoint.Y == coloredStripInfo3.SplitPoint.Y)
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (lineStrip.Style.Equals(coloredStripInfo3.Style) || flag)
				{
					if (!lineStrip.Style.HasColor)
					{
						lineStrip.Style.Assign(coloredStripInfo3.Style);
					}
					flag = false;
				}
				else if (!shouldAddNextSplitPoint)
				{
					lineStrip = RecreateStrip(lineStrip, strips, coloredStripInfo3.Style, prevPoint);
				}
				lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(prevPoint.X, coloredStripInfo3.SplitPoint.Y));
			}
			if (base.InvertedStep)
			{
				lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(points[index].Argument, GetActualValue(points[index])));
			}
			ColoredStripInfo coloredStripInfo2 = coloredStripInfos.Last();
			if (shouldAddNextSplitPoint)
			{
				prevPoint = lineStrip.Last();
				lineStrip = RecreateStrip(lineStrip, strips, coloredStripInfo2.Style, prevPoint);
			}
			return lineStrip;
		}

		internal override bool CanProcessPoint(RefinedPoint point)
		{
			return stripSplitter.CanProcessPoint(point);
		}
	}
	public class StepLineGeometrySplittedPointStripCreator : StepLineGeometrySplittedStripCreator
	{
		public StepLineGeometrySplittedPointStripCreator(IStripSplitter stripSplitter, bool invertedStep, bool shouldAddEmptyStrip)
			: base(stripSplitter, invertedStep, shouldAddEmptyStrip)
		{
		}

		private void AddStripPoints(LineStrip lineStrip, RefinedPoint point, GRealPoint2D lastPoint, ColoredStripInfo item)
		{
			if (base.InvertedStep)
			{
				lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(lastPoint.X, item.SplitPoint.Y));
				lineStrip.Add(item.SplitPoint);
			}
			else
			{
				double argument = point.Argument;
				lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(argument, lastPoint.Y));
				lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(argument, item.SplitPoint.Y));
			}
		}

		protected override IGeometryStrip ProcessIntervalsStrip(IGeometryStrip strip, List<IGeometryStrip> strips, IList<RefinedPoint> points, int index, List<ColoredStripInfo> coloredStripInfos)
		{
			LineStrip lineStrip = (LineStrip)strip;
			ColoredStripInfo coloredStripInfo = coloredStripInfos.First();
			bool shouldAddNextSplitPoint = lineStrip.Style.ShouldAddNextSplitPoint;
			GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D = lineStrip.Last();
			foreach (ColoredStripInfo coloredStripInfo2 in coloredStripInfos)
			{
				if (shouldAddNextSplitPoint)
				{
					AddStripPoints(lineStrip, points[index], gRealPoint2D, coloredStripInfo2);
				}
				if (!lineStrip.Style.Equals(coloredStripInfo2.Style))
				{
					if (lineStrip.Count != 1)
					{
						lineStrip.CompleteFilling();
						strips.Add(lineStrip);
						lineStrip = (LineStrip)CreateStrip();
						lineStrip.Add(gRealPoint2D);
					}
					lineStrip.Style.Assign(coloredStripInfo2.Style);
				}
				if (!shouldAddNextSplitPoint)
				{
					AddStripPoints(lineStrip, points[index], gRealPoint2D, coloredStripInfo2);
				}
			}
			return lineStrip;
		}
	}

	public class AreaGeometrySplittedStripCreator : AreaGeometryStripCreator
	{
		private readonly IStripSplitter stripSplitter;

		public AreaGeometrySplittedStripCreator(IStripSplitter stripSplitter)
		{
			this.stripSplitter = stripSplitter;
		}

		protected override IGeometryStrip ProcessIntervalsStrip(IGeometryStrip strip, List<IGeometryStrip> strips, IList<RefinedPoint> points, int index, List<ColoredStripInfo> coloredStripInfos)
		{
			RangeStrip rangeStrip = (RangeStrip)strip;
			ColoredStripInfo coloredStripInfo = coloredStripInfos.First();
			GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D = rangeStrip.BottomStrip.Last();
			RefinedPoint refinedPoint = points[index];
			double pointMinValue = GetPointMinValue(refinedPoint);
			foreach (ColoredStripInfo coloredStripInfo2 in coloredStripInfos)
			{
				if (rangeStrip.TopStrip.Last() == coloredStripInfo2.SplitPoint)
				{
					continue;
				}
				double y = SplitHelper.CalcPointByRangeAnchorValue(gRealPoint2D.Y, gRealPoint2D.X, pointMinValue, refinedPoint.Argument, coloredStripInfo2.SplitPoint.X);
				StripRange range = new StripRange(coloredStripInfo2.SplitPoint, new GRealPoint2D(coloredStripInfo2.SplitPoint.X, y));
				if ((rangeStrip.Style.Equals(coloredStripInfo2.Style) || rangeStrip.Count == 1) && !rangeStrip.Style.ShouldAddNextSplitPoint)
				{
					if (!rangeStrip.Style.HasColor)
					{
						rangeStrip.Style.Assign(coloredStripInfo2.Style);
					}
					rangeStrip.Add(range);
					continue;
				}
				bool shouldAddNextSplitPoint = rangeStrip.Style.ShouldAddNextSplitPoint;
				if (shouldAddNextSplitPoint)
				{
					rangeStrip.Add(range);
				}
				rangeStrip.CompleteFilling();
				strips.Add(rangeStrip);
				StripRange range2 = new StripRange(rangeStrip.TopStrip.Last(), rangeStrip.BottomStrip.Last());
				rangeStrip = (RangeStrip)CreateStrip(coloredStripInfo2.Style);
				rangeStrip.Add(range2);
				if (!shouldAddNextSplitPoint)
				{
					rangeStrip.Add(range);
				}
			}
			return rangeStrip;
		}

		internal override IGeometryStrip AddStripElement(IList<RefinedPoint> points, int index, IGeometryStrip strip, List<IGeometryStrip> strips)
		{
			return ProcessSplitStrip(stripSplitter, points, index, strip, strips);
		}

		internal override bool CanProcessPoint(RefinedPoint point)
		{
			return stripSplitter.CanProcessPoint(point);
		}
	}

	public class SplineAreaGeometryStripCreator : SplineGeometryStripCreator
	{
		protected virtual bool NeedCompleteFillingBottomStrip => false;

		public SplineAreaGeometryStripCreator(SplineAlgorithmCore splineAlgorithm, double lineTension, ITransformation transformationX, ITransformation transformationY, IBezierStripSplitter stripSplitter, bool hasStripMaxCapacityLimit = false)
			: base(splineAlgorithm, lineTension, transformationX, transformationY, stripSplitter, shouldAddEmptyStrip: true, hasStripMaxCapacityLimit)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void FillBottomStripDrawingPoints(Dictionary<int, GRealPoint2D> currentPointByIndex, BezierStrip currentBottomStrip, ref bool needSplit, List<GRealPoint2D> drawingPoints, BezierStrip bottomStrip)
		{
			foreach (GRealPoint2D drawingPoint in drawingPoints)
			{
				bottomStrip.DrawingPoints.Add(new GRealPoint2D(drawingPoint.X, 0.0));
			}
		}

		protected internal override IGeometryStrip CreateStrip()
		{
			return new BezierRangeStrip(base.SplineAlgorithm, base.LineTension, base.TransformationX, base.TransformationY);
		}

		internal override void CompleteFillingStrip(IList<RefinedPoint> points, List<IGeometryStrip> strips, IGeometryStrip currentStrip)
		{
			base.StripSplitter.Clear();
			BezierRangeStrip bezierRangeStrip = (BezierRangeStrip)currentStrip;
			BezierStrip bezierStrip = (BezierStrip)bezierRangeStrip.TopStrip;
			bezierStrip.CompleteFilling(points, base.StripSplitter);
			BezierStrip bezierStrip2 = (BezierStrip)bezierRangeStrip.BottomStrip;
			Dictionary<int, GRealPoint2D> currentPointByIndex = new Dictionary<int, GRealPoint2D>();
			if (base.StripSplitter.Strips.Count > 0)
			{
				if (NeedCompleteFillingBottomStrip)
				{
					bezierStrip2.CompleteFilling(points, DefaultBezierSplitter.Instance);
				}
				bool needSplit = false;
				{
					foreach (BezierStrip strip in base.StripSplitter.Strips)
					{
						BezierRangeStrip bezierRangeStrip2 = new BezierRangeStrip(bezierStrip.SplineAlgorithm, bezierStrip.LineTension, base.TransformationX, base.TransformationY);
						bezierRangeStrip2.Style.Assign(strip.Style);
						bezierRangeStrip2.TopStrip.Style.Assign(strip.Style);
						List<GRealPoint2D> drawingPoints = strip.DrawingPoints;
						((BezierStrip)bezierRangeStrip2.TopStrip).SetPointsForDrawing(drawingPoints);
						BezierStrip bezierStrip3 = (BezierStrip)bezierRangeStrip2.BottomStrip;
						bezierStrip3.SetPointsForDrawing(new List<GRealPoint2D>());
						FillBottomStripDrawingPoints(currentPointByIndex, bezierStrip2, ref needSplit, drawingPoints, bezierStrip3);
						strips.Add(bezierRangeStrip2);
					}
					return;
				}
			}
			currentStrip.CompleteFilling(points, DefaultBezierSplitter.Instance);
			strips.Add(currentStrip);
		}

		internal override IGeometryStrip AddStripElement(IList<RefinedPoint> points, int index, IGeometryStrip strip, List<IGeometryStrip> strips)
		{
			IXYPoint iXYPoint = points[index];
			GRealPoint2D top = new GRealPoint2D(iXYPoint.Argument, iXYPoint.Value);
			GRealPoint2D bottom = new GRealPoint2D(iXYPoint.Argument, 0.0);
			((RangeStrip)strip).Add(new StripRange(top, bottom));
			return strip;
		}
	}
	public class SplineStackedAreaGeometryStripCreator : SplineAreaGeometryStripCreator
	{
		private readonly List<IList<IGeometryStrip>> stripsCache = new List<IList<IGeometryStrip>>();

		private StackedInteractionContainer interactionContainer;

		protected override bool NeedCompleteFillingBottomStrip => true;

		private static bool IsSameVertical(GRealPoint2D point1, GRealPoint2D point2)
		{
			if (point1.X == point2.X)
			{
				return point1.Y != point2.Y;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static bool ShouldSplitByVertical(LineStrip lineStrip, GRealPoint2D newPoint)
		{
			if (lineStrip.Count >= 2)
			{
				GRealPoint2D point = lineStrip[lineStrip.Count - 1];
				return IsSameVertical(point, newPoint) ^ IsSameVertical(point, lineStrip[lineStrip.Count - 2]);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public SplineStackedAreaGeometryStripCreator(SplineAlgorithmCore splineAlgorithm, double lineTension, ITransformation transformationX, ITransformation transformationY, IBezierStripSplitter stripSplitter, bool hasStripMaxCapacityLimit = false)
			: base(splineAlgorithm, lineTension, transformationX, transformationY, stripSplitter, hasStripMaxCapacityLimit)
		{
		}

		protected override void FillBottomStripDrawingPoints(Dictionary<int, GRealPoint2D> currentPointByIndex, BezierStrip currentBottomStrip, ref bool needSplit, List<GRealPoint2D> drawingPoints, BezierStrip bottomStrip)
		{
			for (int i = 3; i < drawingPoints.Count; i += 3)
			{
				bool flag = i == drawingPoints.Count - 1;
				int num = -1;
				for (int j = 0; j < currentBottomStrip.DrawingPoints.Count; j++)
				{
					if (Math.Round(drawingPoints[i].X - currentBottomStrip.DrawingPoints[j].X, 5) == 0.0 && j % 3 == 0)
					{
						num = j;
						break;
					}
				}
				if (needSplit || num == -1)
				{
					needSplit = true;
					base.StripSplitter.SplitBottomStrip(currentPointByIndex, bottomStrip.DrawingPoints, currentBottomStrip.DrawingPoints, i, drawingPoints[i].X, flag || !currentBottomStrip.DrawingPoints.Contains(drawingPoints[i + 3]));
				}
				else
				{
					bottomStrip.DrawingPoints.AddRange(currentBottomStrip.DrawingPoints.GetRange(num - 3, flag ? 4 : 3));
				}
			}
		}

		internal void Calculate(StackedInteractionContainer interactionContainer)
		{
			this.interactionContainer = interactionContainer;
			List<double> list = new List<double>();
			for (int i = 0; i < interactionContainer.SortedInteractionsByArgument.Count; i++)
			{
				double argumentX = interactionContainer.SortedInteractionsByArgument[i].ArgumentX;
				list.Add(argumentX);
			}
			StackedGeometry stackedGeometry = new StackedGeometry();
			for (int j = 0; j < interactionContainer.Series.Count; j++)
			{
				RefinedSeries refinedSeries = interactionContainer.Series[j];
				SeriesGeometry seriesGeometry = new SeriesGeometry(stackedGeometry, refinedSeries.Series);
				seriesGeometry.SetGeometry(GeometryCalculator.CreateStrips(refinedSeries, this), list);
				stripsCache.Add(seriesGeometry.Geometry);
			}
		}

		internal IList<IGeometryStrip> GetStrips(RefinedSeries series)
		{
			int seriesIndex = interactionContainer.GetSeriesIndex(series);
			return stripsCache[seriesIndex];
		}

		internal override IGeometryStrip AddStripElement(IList<RefinedPoint> points, int index, IGeometryStrip strip, List<IGeometryStrip> strips)
		{
			IStackedPoint stackedPoint = points[index];
			GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D = new GRealPoint2D(stackedPoint.Argument, stackedPoint.MaxValue);
			GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D2 = new GRealPoint2D(stackedPoint.Argument, stackedPoint.MinValue);
			BezierRangeStrip bezierRangeStrip = (BezierRangeStrip)strip;
			if (ShouldSplitByVertical(bezierRangeStrip.TopStrip, gRealPoint2D) || ShouldSplitByVertical(bezierRangeStrip.BottomStrip, gRealPoint2D2))
			{
				bezierRangeStrip.Add(new StripRange(bezierRangeStrip.TopStrip[bezierRangeStrip.TopStrip.Count - 1], bezierRangeStrip.BottomStrip[bezierRangeStrip.BottomStrip.Count - 1]));
			}
			((RangeStrip)strip).Add(new StripRange(gRealPoint2D, gRealPoint2D2));
			return strip;
		}
	}
	public class StepAreaGeometryStripCreator : AreaGeometryStripCreator
	{
		private readonly bool invertedStep;

		protected internal override bool Closed => false;

		protected internal override bool ShouldAddEmptyStrip => true;

		protected bool InvertedStep => invertedStep;

		public StepAreaGeometryStripCreator(bool invertedStep)
		{
			this.invertedStep = invertedStep;
		}

		protected internal override IGeometryStrip CreateStrip()
		{
			return new RangeStrip();
		}

		protected override IGeometryStrip AddStripElementCore(IList<RefinedPoint> points, int index, IGeometryStrip strip)
		{
			RefinedPoint refinedPoint = points[index];
			RangeStrip rangeStrip = (RangeStrip)strip;
			rangeStrip.TopStrip.AddStepToPoint(new GRealPoint2D(refinedPoint.Argument, GetActualValue(refinedPoint)), invertedStep);
			AddBottomStrip(refinedPoint, rangeStrip);
			return strip;
		}

		protected virtual void AddBottomStrip(RefinedPoint refinedPoint, RangeStrip rangeStrip)
		{
			rangeStrip.BottomStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(refinedPoint.Argument, GetPointMinValue(refinedPoint)));
		}
	}
	public class StepAreaGeometrySplittedStripCreator : StepAreaGeometryStripCreator
	{
		private readonly IStripSplitter stripSplitter;

		protected virtual bool ShouldColorNewStrip => true;

		public StepAreaGeometrySplittedStripCreator(IStripSplitter stripSplitter, bool invertedStep)
			: base(invertedStep)
		{
			this.stripSplitter = stripSplitter;
		}

		protected override IGeometryStrip ProcessIntervalsStrip(IGeometryStrip strip, List<IGeometryStrip> strips, IList<RefinedPoint> points, int index, List<ColoredStripInfo> coloredStripInfos)
		{
			RangeStrip rangeStrip = (RangeStrip)strip;
			ColoredStripInfo coloredStripInfo = coloredStripInfos.Last();
			bool flag = index == 1 && stripSplitter.NeedContinueFirstStrip;
			if (rangeStrip.Style.Equals(coloredStripInfo.Style) || flag)
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					rangeStrip.Style.Assign(coloredStripInfo.Style);
				}
				return AddStripElementCore(points, index, strip);
			}
			RefinedPoint refinedPoint = points[index];
			double argument = refinedPoint.Argument;
			GRealPoint2D lastTopPoint = rangeStrip.TopStrip.Last();
			GRealPoint2D lastBottomPoint = rangeStrip.BottomStrip.Last();
			double actualValue = GetActualValue(refinedPoint);
			double pointMinValue = GetPointMinValue(refinedPoint);
			bool flag2 = rangeStrip.Style.Equals(coloredStripInfo.Style) || coloredStripInfo.Style.StyleKey == GeometryStripStyleKey.OwnerStyle;
			if (flag2 && !base.InvertedStep)
			{
				rangeStrip = ProcessNotInverted(strips, rangeStrip, argument, lastTopPoint, lastBottomPoint, coloredStripInfo.Style);
			}
			rangeStrip.CompleteFilling();
			strips.Add(rangeStrip);
			rangeStrip = (RangeStrip)CreateStrip();
			if (ShouldColorNewStrip)
			{
				rangeStrip.Style.Assign(coloredStripInfo.Style);
			}
			if (!flag2)
			{
				rangeStrip = ProcessNotInverted(strips, rangeStrip, lastTopPoint.X, lastTopPoint, lastBottomPoint, coloredStripInfo.Style);
				if (!base.InvertedStep)
				{
					rangeStrip = ProcessNotInverted(strips, rangeStrip, argument, lastTopPoint, lastBottomPoint, coloredStripInfo.Style);
				}
			}
			if (base.InvertedStep)
			{
				rangeStrip.TopStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(lastTopPoint.X, actualValue));
				rangeStrip.BottomStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(lastTopPoint.X, pointMinValue));
			}
			rangeStrip.TopStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(argument, actualValue));
			rangeStrip.BottomStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(argument, pointMinValue));
			return rangeStrip;
		}

		protected virtual RangeStrip ProcessNotInverted(List<IGeometryStrip> strips, RangeStrip rangeStrip, double pointArgument, GRealPoint2D lastTopPoint, GRealPoint2D lastBottomPoint, GeometryStripStyle stripStyle)
		{
			rangeStrip.TopStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(pointArgument, lastTopPoint.Y));
			rangeStrip.BottomStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(pointArgument, lastBottomPoint.Y));
			return rangeStrip;
		}

		internal override IGeometryStrip AddStripElement(IList<RefinedPoint> points, int index, IGeometryStrip strip, List<IGeometryStrip> strips)
		{
			return ProcessSplitStrip(stripSplitter, points, index, strip, strips);
		}

		internal override bool CanProcessPoint(RefinedPoint point)
		{
			return stripSplitter.CanProcessPoint(point);
		}
	}
	public class StepAreaGeometrySplittedPointStripCreator : StepAreaGeometrySplittedStripCreator
	{
		protected override bool ShouldColorNewStrip => base.InvertedStep;

		public StepAreaGeometrySplittedPointStripCreator(IStripSplitter stripSplitter, bool invertedStep)
			: base(stripSplitter, invertedStep)
		{
		}

		protected override RangeStrip ProcessNotInverted(List<IGeometryStrip> strips, RangeStrip rangeStrip, double pointArgument, GRealPoint2D lastTopPoint, GRealPoint2D lastBottomPoint, GeometryStripStyle stripStyle)
		{
			if (!base.InvertedStep)
			{
				if (rangeStrip.TopStrip.Count > 1)
				{
					rangeStrip.CompleteFilling();
					strips.Add(rangeStrip);
					rangeStrip = (RangeStrip)CreateStrip();
					rangeStrip.TopStrip.Add(lastTopPoint);
					rangeStrip.BottomStrip.Add(lastBottomPoint);
				}
				rangeStrip.Style.Assign(stripStyle);
			}
			return base.ProcessNotInverted(strips, rangeStrip, pointArgument, lastTopPoint, lastBottomPoint, stripStyle);
		}
	}

	public struct GRealVector2D : IEquatable<GRealVector2D>
	{
		private double x;

		private double y;

		public double X => x;

		public double Y => y;

		public double SquaredLength => x * x + y * y;

		public double Length => Math.Sqrt(SquaredLength);

		public GRealVector2D UnitVector => this / Length;

		public static bool operator ==(GRealVector2D v1, GRealVector2D v2)
		{
			if (v1.X == v2.X)
			{
				return v1.Y == v2.Y;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool operator !=(GRealVector2D v1, GRealVector2D v2)
		{
			return !(v1 == v2);
		}

		public static GRealVector2D operator +(GRealVector2D v1, GRealVector2D v2)
		{
			return new GRealVector2D
			{
				x = v1.X + v2.X,
				y = v1.Y + v2.Y
			};
		}

		public static GRealVector2D operator -(GRealVector2D v1, GRealVector2D v2)
		{
			return new GRealVector2D
			{
				x = v1.X - v2.X,
				y = v1.Y - v2.Y
			};
		}

		public static GRealPoint2D operator +(GRealPoint2D point, GRealVector2D vector)
		{
			return new GRealPoint2D
			{
				X = point.X + vector.X,
				Y = point.Y + vector.Y
			};
		}

		public static GRealPoint2D operator -(GRealPoint2D point, GRealVector2D vector)
		{
			return new GRealPoint2D
			{
				X = point.X - vector.X,
				Y = point.Y - vector.Y
			};
		}

		public static GRealVector2D operator *(GRealVector2D vector, double scalar)
		{
			return new GRealVector2D(vector.X * scalar, vector.Y * scalar);
		}

		public static GRealVector2D operator *(double scalar, GRealVector2D vector)
		{
			return new GRealVector2D(vector.X * scalar, vector.Y * scalar);
		}

		public static GRealVector2D operator /(GRealVector2D vector, double scalar)
		{
			return new GRealVector2D(vector.X / scalar, vector.Y / scalar);
		}

		public GRealVector2D(double x, double y)
		{
			this.x = x;
			this.y = y;
		}

		public GRealVector2D(GRealPoint2D start, GRealPoint2D end)
		{
			x = end.X - start.X;
			y = end.Y - start.Y;
		}

		public void Normalize()
		{
			double length = Length;
			if (length > 0.0)
			{
				x /= length;
				y /= length;
			}
			else
			{
				x = 0.0;
				y = 0.0;
			}
		}

		public bool Equals(GRealVector2D other)
		{
			return this == other;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is GRealVector2D)
			{
				return this == (GRealVector2D)obj;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return HashCodeHelper.CalculateGeneric<double, double>(x, y);
		}
	}
	public struct GRealSize2D : IEquatable<GRealSize2D>
	{
		private double width;

		private double height;

		public static GRealSize2D Empty => new GRealSize2D(double.NaN, double.NaN);

		public double Width
		{
			get
			{
				return width;
			}
			set
			{
				width = value;
			}
		}

		public double Height
		{
			get
			{
				return height;
			}
			set
			{
				height = value;
			}
		}

		public bool IsEmpty
		{
			get
			{
				if (GeometricUtils.IsValidDouble(width))
				{
					return !GeometricUtils.IsValidDouble(height);
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public static bool operator ==(GRealSize2D size1, GRealSize2D size2)
		{
			if (size1.width == size2.width)
			{
				return size1.height == size2.height;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool operator !=(GRealSize2D size1, GRealSize2D size2)
		{
			return !(size1 == size2);
		}

		public GRealSize2D(double width, double height)
		{
			this.width = width;
			this.height = height;
		}

		public bool Equals(GRealSize2D other)
		{
			if (!(this == other))
			{
				if (IsEmpty)
				{
					return other.IsEmpty;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is GRealSize2D)
			{
				return Equals((GRealSize2D)obj);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return HashCodeHelper.CalculateGeneric<double, double>(width, height);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return $"Width: {width}; Height: {height}";
		}
	}
	public struct RangeStripTriangulationResult
	{
		private readonly IList<GPolygon2D> polygons;

		private readonly LineStrip borderStrip;

		public IList<GPolygon2D> Polygons => polygons;

		public LineStrip BorderStrip => borderStrip;

		public RangeStripTriangulationResult(IList<GPolygon2D> polygons, LineStrip borderStrip)
		{
			this.polygons = polygons;
			this.borderStrip = borderStrip;
		}
	}
	public class RangeStripTriangulation
	{
		private readonly double epsilon;

		private readonly double epsilonSquare;

		private readonly LineStrip topStrip;

		private readonly LineStrip bottomStrip;

		private readonly int topStripLength;

		private readonly int bottomStripLength;

		private readonly List<GPolygon2D> polygons = new List<GPolygon2D>();

		private readonly LineStrip topBorderStrip = new LineStrip();

		private readonly LineStrip bottomBorderStrip = new LineStrip();

		public static RangeStripTriangulationResult Triangulate(RangeStrip strip, double epsilon)
		{
			RangeStripTriangulation rangeStripTriangulation = new RangeStripTriangulation(strip, epsilon);
			rangeStripTriangulation.Process();
			rangeStripTriangulation.bottomBorderStrip.Reverse();
			rangeStripTriangulation.topBorderStrip.AddRange(rangeStripTriangulation.bottomBorderStrip);
			return new RangeStripTriangulationResult(rangeStripTriangulation.polygons, rangeStripTriangulation.topBorderStrip);
		}

		private RangeStripTriangulation(RangeStrip strip, double epsilon)
		{
			this.epsilon = epsilon;
			epsilonSquare = epsilon * epsilon;
			topStrip = strip.TopStrip.CreateUniqueStrip();
			bottomStrip = strip.BottomStrip.CreateUniqueStrip();
			topStripLength = topStrip.Count;
			bottomStripLength = bottomStrip.Count;
		}

		private bool ArePointsEquals(GRealPoint2D p1, GRealPoint2D p2)
		{
			double num = p2.X - p1.X;
			double num2 = p2.Y - p1.Y;
			return ComparingUtils.CompareDoubles(num * num + num2 * num2, 0.0, epsilonSquare) == 0;
		}

		private void ProcessEmptyStrip()
		{
			if (topStripLength <= 0 || bottomStripLength != 1)
			{
				return;
			}
			GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D = bottomStrip[0];
			bool flag = false;
			foreach (GRealPoint2D item in topStrip)
			{
				if (!ArePointsEquals(item, gRealPoint2D))
				{
					topBorderStrip.Add(item);
					flag = true;
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				topBorderStrip.Add(gRealPoint2D);
			}
		}

		private void AddPointsToBorderStrips(GRealPoint2D topPoint, GRealPoint2D bottomPoint)
		{
			if (bottomPoint.Y > topPoint.Y)
			{
				topBorderStrip.Add(bottomPoint);
				bottomBorderStrip.Add(topPoint);
			}
			else
			{
				topBorderStrip.Add(topPoint);
				bottomBorderStrip.Add(bottomPoint);
			}
		}

		private GRealPoint2D MakeStep(LineStrip strip, ref GRealPoint2D point, ref int stripIndex)
		{
			int count = strip.Count;
			while (stripIndex < count)
			{
				GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D = strip[stripIndex++];
				if (ComparingUtils.CompareDoubles(point.X, gRealPoint2D.X, epsilon) != 0)
				{
					return gRealPoint2D;
				}
				GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D2 = topBorderStrip[topBorderStrip.Count - 1];
				GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D3 = ((bottomBorderStrip.Count == 0) ? topBorderStrip[0] : bottomBorderStrip[bottomBorderStrip.Count - 1]);
				if (point == gRealPoint2D3)
				{
					if (gRealPoint2D.Y > gRealPoint2D2.Y)
					{
						if (gRealPoint2D2 != gRealPoint2D3)
						{
							bottomBorderStrip.Add(gRealPoint2D2);
						}
						topBorderStrip.Add(gRealPoint2D);
					}
					else
					{
						bottomBorderStrip.Add(gRealPoint2D);
					}
				}
				else if (gRealPoint2D.Y < gRealPoint2D3.Y)
				{
					if (gRealPoint2D3 != gRealPoint2D2)
					{
						topBorderStrip.Add(gRealPoint2D3);
					}
					bottomBorderStrip.Add(gRealPoint2D);
				}
				else
				{
					topBorderStrip.Add(gRealPoint2D);
				}
				point = gRealPoint2D;
			}
			return point;
		}

		private void ProcessRegularStrip()
		{
			GRealPoint2D point = topStrip[0];
			GRealPoint2D point2 = bottomStrip[0];
			if (ArePointsEquals(point, point2))
			{
				topBorderStrip.Add(point2);
			}
			else
			{
				AddPointsToBorderStrips(point, point2);
			}
			int stripIndex = 1;
			int stripIndex2 = 1;
			do
			{
				GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D = MakeStep(topStrip, ref point, ref stripIndex);
				if (stripIndex2 >= bottomStripLength)
				{
					break;
				}
				GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D2 = MakeStep(bottomStrip, ref point2, ref stripIndex2);
				bool flag = ArePointsEquals(gRealPoint2D, gRealPoint2D2);
				if (ArePointsEquals(point, point2))
				{
					if (!flag)
					{
						if (gRealPoint2D2.Y > gRealPoint2D.Y)
						{
							polygons.Add(new GPolygon2D(new GRealPoint2D[3] { gRealPoint2D2, point, gRealPoint2D }));
						}
						else
						{
							polygons.Add(new GPolygon2D(new GRealPoint2D[3] { gRealPoint2D, point, gRealPoint2D2 }));
						}
					}
				}
				else
				{
					bool flag2 = point2.Y > point.Y;
					if (flag)
					{
						if (flag2)
						{
							polygons.Add(new GPolygon2D(new GRealPoint2D[3] { gRealPoint2D, point2, point }));
						}
						else
						{
							polygons.Add(new GPolygon2D(new GRealPoint2D[3] { gRealPoint2D, point, point2 }));
						}
					}
					else
					{
						GRealPoint2D? gRealPoint2D3 = GeometricUtils.CalcLinesIntersection(point, gRealPoint2D, point2, gRealPoint2D2, intervalMode: true);
						if (!gRealPoint2D3.HasValue)
						{
							if (flag2)
							{
								polygons.Add(new GPolygon2D(new GRealPoint2D[4] { gRealPoint2D2, point2, point, gRealPoint2D }));
							}
							else
							{
								polygons.Add(new GPolygon2D(new GRealPoint2D[4] { gRealPoint2D, point, point2, gRealPoint2D2 }));
							}
						}
						else
						{
							topBorderStrip.Add(gRealPoint2D3.Value);
							bottomBorderStrip.Add(gRealPoint2D3.Value);
							if (flag2)
							{
								polygons.Add(new GPolygon2D(new GRealPoint2D[3] { gRealPoint2D3.Value, point2, point }));
								polygons.Add(new GPolygon2D(new GRealPoint2D[3] { gRealPoint2D, gRealPoint2D3.Value, gRealPoint2D2 }));
							}
							else
							{
								polygons.Add(new GPolygon2D(new GRealPoint2D[3] { gRealPoint2D3.Value, point, point2 }));
								polygons.Add(new GPolygon2D(new GRealPoint2D[3] { gRealPoint2D2, gRealPoint2D3.Value, gRealPoint2D }));
							}
						}
					}
				}
				point = gRealPoint2D;
				point2 = gRealPoint2D2;
				if (flag)
				{
					topBorderStrip.Add(point);
					if (stripIndex < topStripLength)
					{
						bottomBorderStrip.Add(point2);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					AddPointsToBorderStrips(point, point2);
				}
			}
			while (stripIndex < topStripLength);
		}

		private void Process()
		{
			if (topStripLength < 2 || bottomStripLength < 2)
			{
				ProcessEmptyStrip();
			}
			else
			{
				ProcessRegularStrip();
			}
		}
	}
	public static class AxisCoordCalculator
	{
		public static double GetCoord(IMinMaxValues range, double value, double dimension)
		{
			if (range.IsZeroRange)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			double min = range.Min;
			return (value - min) / (range.Max - min) * dimension;
		}

		public static double GetClampedCoord(IMinMaxValues range, double value, double dimension)
		{
			if (double.IsNegativeInfinity(value) || value < range.Min)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			if (double.IsPositiveInfinity(value) || value > range.Max)
			{
				return dimension;
			}
			return GetCoord(range, value, dimension);
		}

		public static double GetInternalValue(double min, double max, double ratio)
		{
			if (ratio < 1.0)
			{
				if (ratio > 0.0)
				{
					return min + (max - min) * ratio;
				}
				return min;
			}
			return max;
		}

		public static double GetCoord(IMinMaxValues range, double value, double dimension, bool clamped)
		{
			if (clamped)
			{
				return GetClampedCoord(range, value, dimension);
			}
			return GetCoord(range, value, dimension);
		}
	}
	public interface IAxisValueContainer
	{
		IAxisData Axis { get; }

		bool IsEnabled { get; }

		CultureInfo Culture { get; }

		object UserValue { get; }

		object AxisValue { get; set; }

		double Value { get; set; }
	}
	public static class AxisValueContainerHelper
	{
		private const bool DisableScaleBreaksOnScrolling = true;

		private static bool IsCompatibleWith(IAxisValueContainer container, IScaleMap map)
		{
			return map.IsCompatible(container.AxisValue);
		}

		private static void UpdateAxisValueContainer(IAxisValueContainer container, IScaleMap map)
		{
			if (container.AxisValue == null)
			{
				double value = container.Value;
				if (!double.IsNaN(value))
				{
					container.AxisValue = map.InternalToNative(value);
				}
			}
			else if (IsCompatibleWith(container, map))
			{
				container.Value = map.NativeToInternal(container.AxisValue);
			}
		}

		internal static void UpdateAxisElements(IAxisData axis)
		{
			AxisScaleTypeMap axisScaleTypeMap = axis.AxisScaleTypeMap;
			if (axis.ScaleBreaks != null)
			{
				foreach (IScaleBreak scaleBreak in axis.ScaleBreaks)
				{
					UpdateAxisValue(scaleBreak.Edge1, axisScaleTypeMap);
					UpdateAxisValue(scaleBreak.Edge2, axisScaleTypeMap);
					UpdateAxisValueContainer(scaleBreak.Edge1, axisScaleTypeMap);
					UpdateAxisValueContainer(scaleBreak.Edge2, axisScaleTypeMap);
				}
			}
			if (axis.Strips != null)
			{
				foreach (IStrip strip in axis.Strips)
				{
					UpdateAxisValue(strip.MinLimit, strip.MaxLimit, axisScaleTypeMap);
					UpdateAxisValueContainer(strip.MinLimit, axisScaleTypeMap);
					UpdateAxisValueContainer(strip.MaxLimit, axisScaleTypeMap);
					strip.CorrectLimits();
				}
			}
			if (axis.ConstantLines != null)
			{
				foreach (IConstantLine constantLine in axis.ConstantLines)
				{
					UpdateAxisValue(constantLine, axisScaleTypeMap);
					UpdateAxisValueContainer(constantLine, axisScaleTypeMap);
				}
			}
			if (axis.CustomLabels == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (ICustomAxisLabel customLabel in axis.CustomLabels)
			{
				UpdateAxisValue(customLabel, axisScaleTypeMap);
				UpdateAxisValueContainer(customLabel, axisScaleTypeMap);
			}
		}

		private static IMinMaxValues GetRangeMinMax(IAxisRangeData range)
		{
			if (double.IsNaN(range.Min) && double.IsNaN(range.Max))
			{
				range.UpdateRange(range.MinValue, range.MaxValue, 0.0, 1.0);
			}
			return new RangeWrapper(range);
		}

		public static void UpdateAxisValue(IAxisValueContainer container, AxisScaleTypeMap map)
		{
			object obj = map.ConvertValue(container.AxisValue, container.Culture);
			if (obj != null)
			{
				container.AxisValue = obj;
				if (obj is double)
				{
					container.Value = (double)obj;
				}
			}
		}

		public static void UpdateAxisValue(IAxisValueContainer container1, IAxisValueContainer container2, AxisScaleTypeMap map)
		{
			object obj = map.ConvertValue(container1.AxisValue, container1.Culture);
			object obj2 = map.ConvertValue(container2.AxisValue, container2.Culture);
			if (obj != null && obj2 != null && !(obj.GetType() == obj2.GetType()))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (obj != null)
			{
				container1.AxisValue = obj;
				if (obj is double)
				{
					container1.Value = (double)obj;
				}
			}
			if (obj2 != null)
			{
				container2.AxisValue = obj2;
				if (obj2 is double)
				{
					container2.Value = (double)obj2;
				}
			}
		}

		private static bool IsZoomIn(IAxisData axis)
		{
			return axis.VisualRange.Delta != axis.WholeRange.Delta;
		}

		private static void UpdateIntervals(bool scrollingEnabled, IAxisData axis)
		{
			scrollingEnabled = scrollingEnabled;
			if (axis is IIntervalContainer intervalContainer)
			{
				IMinMaxValues rangeMinMax = GetRangeMinMax(axis.VisualRange);
				IMinMaxValues rangeMinMax2 = GetRangeMinMax(axis.WholeRange);
				IList<AxisInterval> list = null;
				if (!scrollingEnabled)
				{
					list = new AxisIntervalsGenerator(axis, axis as IAutoScaleBreaksContainer, rangeMinMax).GenerateIntervals();
				}
				if (list == null)
				{
					list = new AxisInterval[1]
					{
						new AxisInterval(rangeMinMax, rangeMinMax2)
					};
				}
				intervalContainer.Intervals = list;
			}
		}

		public static void UpdateAxisElementsAndIntervals(IXYDiagram diagram)
		{
			foreach (IAxisData allAxis in diagram.AllAxes)
			{
				UpdateAxisElements(allAxis);
				UpdateIntervals(diagram.ScrollingEnabled, allAxis);
			}
		}

		public static void UpdateIntervals(bool performRangeCorrection, IXYDiagram diagram)
		{
			if (performRangeCorrection || IsZoomIn(diagram.AxisX))
			{
				UpdateIntervals(diagram.ScrollingEnabled, diagram.AxisX);
			}
			if (performRangeCorrection || IsZoomIn(diagram.AxisY))
			{
				UpdateIntervals(diagram.ScrollingEnabled, diagram.AxisY);
			}
			if (!performRangeCorrection)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (IAxisData item in diagram.SecondaryAxesY)
			{
				UpdateIntervals(diagram.ScrollingEnabled, item);
			}
			foreach (IAxisData item2 in diagram.SecondaryAxesX)
			{
				UpdateIntervals(diagram.ScrollingEnabled, item2);
			}
		}
	}

	{
		private static bool IsAxisValueContainerVisible(IAxisValueContainer container)
		{
			return IsAxisValueVisible(container.Axis, container.AxisValue);
		}

		public static bool IsAxisValueVisible(IAxisData axis, object axisValue)
		{
			bool? flag = axis?.AxisScaleTypeMap?.IsCompatible(axisValue);
			bool? flag2 = axis?.AxisScaleTypeMap?.IsAxisValueVisible(axisValue);
			if (flag ?? false)
			{
				return flag2 ?? false;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool IsStripVisible(IScaleMap map, IStrip strip)
		{
			if (!strip.Visible)
			{
				return false;
			}
			IStripLimit minLimit = strip.MinLimit;
			IStripLimit maxLimit = strip.MaxLimit;
			object obj = (minLimit.IsEnabled ? minLimit.AxisValue : null);
			object obj2 = (maxLimit.IsEnabled ? maxLimit.AxisValue : null);
			if ((obj != null && !map.IsCompatible(obj)) || (obj2 != null && !map.IsCompatible(obj2)))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (obj != null && obj2 != null)
			{
				return map.NativeToInternal(obj2) > map.NativeToInternal(obj);
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static bool IsConstantLineVisible(IConstantLine constantLine)
		{
			if (constantLine.Visible)
			{
				return IsAxisValueContainerVisible(constantLine);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool IsCustomLabelVisible(ICustomAxisLabel label)
		{
			if (label.Visible)
			{
				return IsAxisValueContainerVisible(label);
			}
			return false;
		}
