	public abstract class NormalizedValuesCalculator
	{
		private readonly ISeries series;

		private readonly double[] normValues;

		protected ISeries Series => series;

		protected IList<IDataPoint> Points => series.ActualPoints;

		protected static double GetPointValue(IDataPoint point)
		{
			if (!point.IsEmpty)
			{
				return point.NumericalValue;
			}
			return 0.0;
		}

		protected NormalizedValuesCalculator(ISeries series)
		{
			this.series = series;
			if (Points.Count > 0)
			{
				normValues = CalculateNormValues();
			}
		}

		public double CalculateNormalizedValue(IDataPoint point)
		{
			int num = Points.IndexOf(point);
			if (num != -1)
			{
				return normValues[num];
			}
			ChartDebug.Fail("The point doesn't exist in the Normalize calculator.");
			return 0.0;
		}

		protected abstract double[] CalculateNormValues();
	}
	public class PieNormalizedValuesCalculator : NormalizedValuesCalculator
	{
		public PieNormalizedValuesCalculator(ISeries series)
			: base(series)
		{
		}

		protected override double[] CalculateNormValues()
		{
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = 0;
			double[] array = new double[base.Points.Count];
			double[] array2 = new double[base.Points.Count];
			for (int i = 0; i < base.Points.Count; i++)
			{
				double pointValue = NormalizedValuesCalculator.GetPointValue(base.Points[i]);
				if (pointValue < 0.0)
				{
					num++;
					array[i] = 0.0;
					array2[i] = pointValue;
					continue;
				}
				array[i] = pointValue;
				array2[i] = 0.0;
				if (pointValue > 0.0)
				{
					num2++;
				}
			}
			double[] array3;
			if (num2 > 0)
			{
				array3 = array;
			}
			else if (num > 0)
			{
				array3 = array2;
			}
			else
			{
				array3 = array;
				for (int j = 0; j < array3.Length; j++)
				{
					array3[j] = 1.0;
				}
			}
			double num3 = 0.0;
			double[] array4 = array3;
			foreach (double num4 in array4)
			{
				num3 += num4;
			}
			for (int l = 0; l < array3.Length; l++)
			{
				array3[l] /= num3;
			}
			return array3;
		}
	}
	public class FunnelNormalizedValuesCalculator : NormalizedValuesCalculator
	{
		public FunnelNormalizedValuesCalculator(ISeries series)
			: base(series)
		{
		}

		protected override double[] CalculateNormValues()
		{
			Scale valueScaleType = base.Series.ValueScaleType;
			bool flag = false;
			foreach (ISeriesPoint point in base.Points)
			{
				if (!point.IsEmpty(valueScaleType) && point.Values.NumericalValues[0] >= 0.0)
				{
					flag = true;
					break;
				}
			}
			double[] array = new double[base.Points.Count];
			double num = 0.0;
			if (flag)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < base.Points.Count; i++)
				{
					double pointValue = NormalizedValuesCalculator.GetPointValue(base.Points[i]);
					if (pointValue >= 0.0)
					{
						array[i] = pointValue;
						num = Math.Max(num, array[i]);
					}
					else
					{
						array[i] = double.NaN;
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < base.Points.Count; j++)
				{
					double pointValue2 = NormalizedValuesCalculator.GetPointValue(base.Points[j]);
					array[j] = pointValue2;
					num = Math.Min(num, array[j]);
				}
			}
			if (num != 0.0)
			{
				for (int k = 0; k < array.Length; k++)
				{
					if (!double.IsNaN(array[k]))
					{
						array[k] /= num;
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				for (int l = 0; l < array.Length; l++)
				{
					if (!double.IsNaN(array[l]))
					{
						array[l] = 1.0;
					}
				}
			}
			return array;
		}
	}
	public struct GRealRect2D
	{
		public static readonly GRealRect2D Empty = new GRealRect2D(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0);

		private double left;

		private double right;

		private double top;

		private double bottom;

		private double width;

		private double height;

		public double Left => left;

		public double Right => right;

		public double Top => top;

		public double Bottom => bottom;

		public double Width => width;

		public double Height => height;

		public GRealPoint2D Center => new GRealPoint2D(0.5 * (left + Right), 0.5 * (bottom + top));

		public bool IsEmpty => Equals(Empty);

		public GRealSize2D Size => new GRealSize2D(width, height);

		public static bool IsIntersected(GRealRect2D rect1, GRealRect2D rect2)
		{
			if (rect1.left < rect2.right && rect1.right > rect2.left && rect1.top < rect2.bottom)
			{
				return rect1.bottom > rect2.top;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static GRealRect2D Intersect(GRealRect2D rect1, GRealRect2D rect2)
		{
			if (!IsIntersected(rect1, rect2))
			{
				return Empty;
			}
			double num = Math.Max(rect1.left, rect2.Left);
			double num2 = Math.Min(rect1.right, rect2.right);
			double num3 = Math.Max(rect1.top, rect2.top);
			double num4 = Math.Min(rect1.bottom, rect2.bottom);
			return new GRealRect2D(num, num3, num2 - num, num4 - num3);
		}

		public static GRealRect2D Inflate(GRealRect2D rect, double dx, double dy)
		{
			GRealRect2D result = rect;
			result.Inflate(dx, dy);
			return result;
		}

		public GRealRect2D(GRealPoint2D p1, GRealPoint2D p2)
		{
			left = Math.Min(p1.X, p2.X);
			top = Math.Min(p1.Y, p2.Y);
			width = Math.Abs(p1.X - p2.X);
			height = Math.Abs(p1.Y - p2.Y);
			right = left + width;
			bottom = top + height;
		}

		public GRealRect2D(double left, double top, double width, double height)
		{
			ChartDebug.Assert(width >= 0.0);
			ChartDebug.Assert(height >= 0.0);
			this.left = left;
			this.top = top;
			this.width = width;
			this.height = height;
			right = left + width;
			bottom = top + height;
		}

		private void CalcRightBottom()
		{
			right = left + width;
			bottom = top + height;
		}

		public void Offset(double dx, double dy)
		{
			left += dx;
			top += dy;
			CalcRightBottom();
		}

		public void Inflate(double dx, double dy)
		{
			Offset(0.0 - dx, 0.0 - dy);
			width += dx * 2.0;
			if (width < 0.0)
			{
				width = 0.0;
			}
			height += dy * 2.0;
			if (height < 0.0)
			{
				height = 0.0;
			}
			CalcRightBottom();
		}

		public bool Contains(GRealPoint2D point)
		{
			if (point.X < left || point.X > right)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (point.Y < top || point.Y > bottom)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public bool ContainsIncludeBounds(GRealPoint2D point)
		{
			if (point.X <= left || point.X >= right)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (point.Y <= top || point.Y >= bottom)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public bool Contains(GRealRect2D rect)
		{
			if (Contains(new GRealPoint2D(rect.left, rect.top)))
			{
				return Contains(new GRealPoint2D(rect.right, rect.bottom));
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return $"Location: {left}, {top}; Size: {width}, {height}";
		}
	}

	public abstract class Transformation : ITransformation
	{
		public abstract bool IsIdentity { get; }

		public abstract double TransformForward(double value);

		public abstract double TransformBackward(double value);

		public virtual void Reset()
		{
		}

		public virtual void Update(params double[] values)
		{
		}

		public virtual void CompleteUpdate()
		{
		}

		public void Update(IAxisValueContainer container)
		{
			object axisValue = container.AxisValue;
			if (axisValue != null)
			{
				try
				{
					Update(Convert.ToDouble(axisValue));
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public class IdentityTransformation : Transformation
	{
		public override bool IsIdentity => true;

		public override double TransformForward(double value)
		{
			return value;
		}

		public override double TransformBackward(double value)
		{
			return value;
		}
	}
	public class LogarithmicTransformation : Transformation
	{
		private const double defaultIndentFromZero = 1.0;

		private readonly bool coerenceNegative;

		private readonly double logarithmicBase;

		private readonly double indentFromZero;

		private double minAbsValue;

		private double minLogValue;

		public double LogarithmicBase => logarithmicBase;

		public double MinLogValue => minLogValue;

		public override bool IsIdentity => false;

		public LogarithmicTransformation(double logarithmicBase)
			: this(logarithmicBase, 1.0)
		{
		}

		public LogarithmicTransformation(double logarithmicBase, double indentFromZero)
			: this(logarithmicBase, indentFromZero, coerenceNegative: true)
		{
		}

		internal LogarithmicTransformation(double logarithmicBase, double indentFromZero, bool coerenceNegative)
		{
			this.logarithmicBase = logarithmicBase;
			this.indentFromZero = indentFromZero;
			this.coerenceNegative = coerenceNegative;
		}

		public override double TransformForward(double value)
		{
			if (IsSpecialValue(value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			double num = Math.Log(Math.Abs(value), logarithmicBase) - minLogValue;
			if (num < 0.0 && coerenceNegative)
			{
				num = 0.0;
			}
			return (double)Math.Sign(value) * num;
		}

		public override double TransformBackward(double value)
		{
			if (!IsSpecialValue(value))
			{
				return Math.Pow(logarithmicBase, Math.Abs(value) + minLogValue) * (double)Math.Sign(value);
			}
			return value;
		}

		public override void Reset()
		{
			minAbsValue = double.NaN;
		}

		public override void Update(params double[] values)
		{
			foreach (double value in values)
			{
				double num = Math.Abs(value);
				if (num > 0.0 && (double.IsNaN(minAbsValue) || num < minAbsValue))
				{
					minAbsValue = num;
				}
			}
		}

		public override void CompleteUpdate()
		{
			if (double.IsNaN(minAbsValue))
			{
				minAbsValue = 1.0;
			}
			minLogValue = Math.Floor(Math.Log(minAbsValue, logarithmicBase)) - indentFromZero;
		}

		private bool IsSpecialValue(double value)
		{
			if (value != 0.0 && !double.IsNaN(value) && !double.IsNegativeInfinity(value))
			{
				return double.IsPositiveInfinity(value);
			}
			return true;
		}
	}

	public class SimpleDiagramLayout
	{
		private delegate DXRectangle TransformRectangle(DXRectangle rect);

		private readonly DXRectangle bounds;

		private readonly TransformRectangle transformRectangle;

		private readonly List<DXRectangle> domainBounds;

		private static DXRectangle PassRectangle(DXRectangle rect)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			return rect;
		}

		private static DXRectangle RotateRectangle(DXRectangle rect)
		{
			//IL_001c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			return new DXRectangle(((DXRectangle)(ref rect)).Top, ((DXRectangle)(ref rect)).Left, ((DXRectangle)(ref rect)).Height, ((DXRectangle)(ref rect)).Width);
		}

		public static List<DXRectangle> Calculate(ISimpleDiagram diagram, DXRectangle bounds, int domainCount)
		{
			//IL_0024: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			TransformRectangle transformRectangle = ((diagram.LayoutDirection == SimpleDiagramLayoutDirection.Vertical) ? new TransformRectangle(RotateRectangle) : new TransformRectangle(PassRectangle));
			return new SimpleDiagramLayout(bounds, diagram.Dimension, domainCount, transformRectangle).domainBounds;
		}

		private SimpleDiagramLayout(DXRectangle bounds, int dimension, int domainCount, TransformRectangle transformRectangle)
		{
			//IL_0009: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			this.bounds = transformRectangle(bounds);
			this.transformRectangle = transformRectangle;
			domainBounds = new List<DXRectangle>(domainCount);
			Calculate(Math.Min(dimension, domainCount), domainCount);
		}

		private void FillRow(int count, int position, int height)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0012: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0017: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0027: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0060: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			DXRectangle val = bounds;
			int num = ((DXRectangle)(ref val)).Width / count;
			val = bounds;
			int num2 = ((DXRectangle)(ref val)).Width - num * count;
			int i = 0;
			val = bounds;
			int num3 = ((DXRectangle)(ref val)).Left;
			for (; i < count; i++)
			{
				int num4 = num;
				if (num2 > 0)
				{
					num4++;
					num2--;
				}
				domainBounds.Add(transformRectangle(new DXRectangle(num3, position, num4, height)));
				num3 += num4;
			}
		}

		private void Calculate(int dimension, int domainCount)
		{
			//IL_0013: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0018: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0025: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0089: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_008e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_009b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00a0: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			int num = domainCount / dimension;
			int num2 = domainCount % dimension;
			int num3 = num;
			if (num2 > 0)
			{
				num3++;
			}
			DXRectangle val = bounds;
			int num4 = ((DXRectangle)(ref val)).Height / num3;
			val = bounds;
			int num5 = ((DXRectangle)(ref val)).Height - num4 * num3;
			val = bounds;
			int num6 = ((DXRectangle)(ref val)).Top;
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				int num7 = num4;
				if (num5 > 0)
				{
					num7++;
					num5--;
				}
				FillRow(dimension, num6, num7);
				num6 += num7;
			}
			if (num2 > 0)
			{
				int position = num6;
				val = bounds;
				int num8 = ((DXRectangle)(ref val)).Height - num6;
				val = bounds;
				FillRow(num2, position, num8 + ((DXRectangle)(ref val)).Top);
			}
		}
	}

	internal static class SegmentKindHelper
	{
		public static SegmentKind GetKindForLineSegment(int index)
		{
			return index switch
			{
				0 => SegmentKind.Left, 
				1 => SegmentKind.Bottom, 
				2 => SegmentKind.Right, 
				3 => SegmentKind.Top, 
				_ => SegmentKind.None, 
			};
		}

		public static SegmentKind GetKindForArcSegment(int index)
		{
			return index switch
			{
				0 => SegmentKind.RightBottom, 
				1 => SegmentKind.LeftBottom, 
				2 => SegmentKind.LeftTop, 
				3 => SegmentKind.RightTop, 
				_ => SegmentKind.None, 
			};
		}

		private SegmentKind segmentKind;

		public bool HasIntersection => intersectionPoint.HasValue;

		public GRealPoint2D IntersectionPoint
		{
			get
			{
				return intersectionPoint.Value;
			}
			set
			{
				intersectionPoint = value;
			}
		}

		public SegmentKind SegmentKind
		{
			get
			{
				return segmentKind;
			}
			set
			{
				segmentKind = value;
			}
		}

		public IntersectionInfo(GRealPoint2D intersectionPoint, SegmentKind segmentKind)
		{
			this.intersectionPoint = intersectionPoint;
			this.segmentKind = segmentKind;
		}
	}
	public static class GeometricUtils
	{
		public static int StrongRound(double value)
		{
			return Math.Sign(value) * (int)(Math.Abs(value) + 0.5);
		}

		public static double CalcDistance(GRealPoint2D point1, GRealPoint2D point2)
		{
			double num = point1.X - point2.X;
			double num2 = point1.Y - point2.Y;
			return Math.Sqrt(num * num + num2 * num2);
		}

		public static GRealPoint2D CalcPointInLine(GRealPoint2D start, GRealPoint2D end, double ration)
		{
			double num = end.X - start.X;
			double num2 = end.Y - start.Y;
			return new GRealPoint2D(start.X + num * ration, start.Y + num2 * ration);
		}

		public static GRealVector2D LinearInterpolation(GRealVector2D start, GRealVector2D end, double lerpValue)
		{
			return new GRealVector2D(start.X + (end.X - start.X) * lerpValue, start.Y + (end.Y - start.Y) * lerpValue);
		}

		private static List<GRealPoint2D> CalcLineWithEllipseIntersection(GRealPoint2D segmentPoint1, GRealPoint2D segmentPoint2, GRealPoint2D leftTopEllipseRect, GRealPoint2D rightBottomEllipseRect)
		{
			double num = segmentPoint2.X - segmentPoint1.X;
			double num2 = segmentPoint2.Y - segmentPoint1.Y;
			double num3 = (leftTopEllipseRect.X + rightBottomEllipseRect.X) / 2.0;
			double num4 = (leftTopEllipseRect.Y + rightBottomEllipseRect.Y) / 2.0;
			segmentPoint1 = new GRealPoint2D(segmentPoint1.X - num3, segmentPoint1.Y - num4);
			double num5 = (rightBottomEllipseRect.Y - leftTopEllipseRect.Y) * (rightBottomEllipseRect.Y - leftTopEllipseRect.Y) / 4.0;
			double num6 = (rightBottomEllipseRect.X - leftTopEllipseRect.X) * (rightBottomEllipseRect.X - leftTopEllipseRect.X) / 4.0;
			double a = num5 * num * num + num6 * num2 * num2;
			double b = (segmentPoint1.X * num * num5 + segmentPoint1.Y * num2 * num6) * 2.0;
			double c = segmentPoint1.X * segmentPoint1.X * num5 + segmentPoint1.Y * segmentPoint1.Y * num6 - num6 * num5;
			List<GRealPoint2D> list = new List<GRealPoint2D>();
			List<double> list2 = CalcQuadraticEquation(a, b, c);
			double num7 = double.MaxValue;
			foreach (double item in list2)
			{
				if (!(item < 0.0) && !(item > 1.0))
				{
					GRealPoint2D point = new GRealPoint2D(segmentPoint1.X + item * num, segmentPoint1.Y + item * num2);
					double num8 = CalcDistance(segmentPoint1, point);
					if (list.Count == 0 || num8 < num7)
					{
						list.Insert(0, new GRealPoint2D(point.X + num3, point.Y + num4));
						num7 = num8;
					}
					else
					{
						list.Add(new GRealPoint2D(point.X + num3, point.Y + num4));
					}
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		private static List<GRealPoint2D> CalcLineSegmentWithArcIntersection(GRealPoint2D segmentPoint1, GRealPoint2D segmentPoint2, GRealPoint2D leftTopEllipseRect, GRealPoint2D rightBottomEllipseRect, double startAngle, double sweepAngle)
		{
			List<GRealPoint2D> list = CalcLineWithEllipseIntersection(segmentPoint1, segmentPoint2, leftTopEllipseRect, rightBottomEllipseRect);
			if (list.Count == 0)
			{
				return list;
			}
			startAngle = NormalizeRadian(startAngle);
			double num = NormalizeRadian(startAngle + sweepAngle);
			GRealPoint2D p = new GRealPoint2D((leftTopEllipseRect.X + rightBottomEllipseRect.X) / 2.0, (leftTopEllipseRect.Y + rightBottomEllipseRect.Y) / 2.0);
			foreach (GRealPoint2D item in list.GetRange(0, list.Count))
			{
				double num2 = CalcBetweenPointsAngle(p, item);
				if ((num2 < startAngle || num2 > startAngle + sweepAngle) && (num2 < num - sweepAngle || num2 > num))
				{
					list.Remove(item);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		public static double CalcBetweenPointsAngle(GRealPoint2D p1, GRealPoint2D p2)
		{
			double angleRadian = Math.Atan2(p2.Y - p1.Y, p2.X - p1.X);
			return NormalizeRadian(angleRadian);
		}

		public static List<double> CalcQuadraticEquation(double a, double b, double c)
		{
			List<double> list = new List<double>();
			if (b - a == b)
			{
				if (c - b != c)
				{
					list.Add((0.0 - c) / b);
				}
				return list;
			}
			double num = b * b - 4.0 * a * c;
			if (num < 0.0)
			{
				return list;
			}
			if (num == 0.0)
			{
				list.Add((0.0 - b) / (2.0 * a));
				return list;
			}
			list.Add((0.0 - b - Math.Sqrt(num)) / (2.0 * a));
			list.Add((0.0 - b + Math.Sqrt(num)) / (2.0 * a));
			return list;
		}

		public static GRealRect2D CalcBounds(IList<GRealPoint2D> points)
		{
			if (points.Count == 0)
			{
				return GRealRect2D.Empty;
			}
			double x = points[0].X;
			double x2 = points[0].X;
			double y = points[0].Y;
			double y2 = points[0].Y;
			for (int i = 1; i < points.Count; i++)
			{
				GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D = points[i];
				if (gRealPoint2D.X < x)
				{
					x = gRealPoint2D.X;
				}
				else if (gRealPoint2D.X > x2)
				{
					x2 = gRealPoint2D.X;
				}
				if (gRealPoint2D.Y < y)
				{
					y = gRealPoint2D.Y;
				}
				else if (gRealPoint2D.Y > y2)
				{
					y2 = gRealPoint2D.Y;
				}
			}
			return new GRealRect2D(new GRealPoint2D(x, y), new GRealPoint2D(x2, y2));
		}

		public static GRealPoint2D? CalcLinesIntersection(GRealPoint2D line1P1, GRealPoint2D line1P2, GRealPoint2D line2P1, GRealPoint2D line2P2, bool intervalMode)
		{
			if (line1P1 == line2P1 || line1P1 == line2P2)
			{
				return line1P1;
			}
			if (line1P2 == line2P2 || line1P2 == line2P1)
			{
				return line1P2;
			}
			double num = (line2P2.Y - line2P1.Y) * (line1P2.X - line1P1.X) - (line2P2.X - line2P1.X) * (line1P2.Y - line1P1.Y);
			double num2 = (line2P2.X - line2P1.X) * (line1P1.Y - line2P1.Y) - (line2P2.Y - line2P1.Y) * (line1P1.X - line2P1.X);
			if (num2 + num == num2)
			{
				return null;
			}
			double num3 = num2 / num;
			if (intervalMode && (num3 < 0.0 || num3 > 1.0))
			{
				return null;
			}
			double num4 = (line1P2.X - line1P1.X) * (line1P1.Y - line2P1.Y) - (line1P2.Y - line1P1.Y) * (line1P1.X - line2P1.X);
			if (num4 + num == num4)
			{
				return null;
			}
			double num5 = num4 / num;
			if (intervalMode && (num5 < 0.0 || num5 > 1.0))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new GRealPoint2D(line1P1.X + num3 * (line1P2.X - line1P1.X), line1P1.Y + num3 * (line1P2.Y - line1P1.Y));
		}

		public static IntersectionInfo CalcLineSegmentWithRectIntersection(GRealPoint2D segmentPoint1, GRealPoint2D segmentPoint2, GRealPoint2D leftTopRectPoint, GRealPoint2D rightBottomRectPoint)
		{
			IntersectionInfo result = default(IntersectionInfo);
			double num = double.MaxValue;
			GRealPoint2D[] array = new GRealPoint2D[5]
			{
				leftTopRectPoint,
				new GRealPoint2D(leftTopRectPoint.X, rightBottomRectPoint.Y),
				rightBottomRectPoint,
				new GRealPoint2D(rightBottomRectPoint.X, leftTopRectPoint.Y),
				leftTopRectPoint
			};
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length - 1; i++)
			{
				GRealPoint2D? gRealPoint2D = CalcLinesIntersection(segmentPoint1, segmentPoint2, array[i], array[i + 1], intervalMode: true);
				if (gRealPoint2D.HasValue)
				{
					double num2 = CalcDistance(segmentPoint1, gRealPoint2D.Value);
					if (!result.HasIntersection || num2 < num)
					{
						result = new IntersectionInfo(gRealPoint2D.Value, SegmentKindHelper.GetKindForLineSegment(i));
						num = num2;
					}
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		public static IntersectionInfo CalcLineSegmentWithRoundedRectIntersection(GRealPoint2D startPoint, GRealPoint2D endPoint, GRealPoint2D leftTopRectPoint, GRealPoint2D rightBottomRectPoint, double fillet)
		{
			return CalcLineSegmentWithRoundedRectIntersection(startPoint, endPoint, leftTopRectPoint, rightBottomRectPoint, fillet, fillet, fillet, fillet);
		}

		public static IntersectionInfo CalcLineSegmentWithRoundedRectIntersection(GRealPoint2D startPoint, GRealPoint2D endPoint, GRealPoint2D leftTopRectPoint, GRealPoint2D rightBottomRectPoint, double leftBottomFillet, double leftTopFillet, double rightTopFillet, double rightBottomFillet)
		{
			GRealPoint2D[] array = new GRealPoint2D[8]
			{
				new GRealPoint2D(leftTopRectPoint.X, leftTopRectPoint.Y + leftTopFillet),
				new GRealPoint2D(leftTopRectPoint.X, rightBottomRectPoint.Y - leftBottomFillet),
				new GRealPoint2D(leftTopRectPoint.X + leftBottomFillet, rightBottomRectPoint.Y),
				new GRealPoint2D(rightBottomRectPoint.X - rightBottomFillet, rightBottomRectPoint.Y),
				new GRealPoint2D(rightBottomRectPoint.X, rightBottomRectPoint.Y - rightBottomFillet),
				new GRealPoint2D(rightBottomRectPoint.X, leftTopRectPoint.Y + rightTopFillet),
				new GRealPoint2D(rightBottomRectPoint.X - rightTopFillet, leftTopRectPoint.Y),
				new GRealPoint2D(leftTopRectPoint.X + leftTopFillet, leftTopRectPoint.Y)
			};
			List<IntersectionInfo> list = new List<IntersectionInfo>();
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length - 1; i += 2)
			{
				GRealPoint2D? gRealPoint2D = CalcLinesIntersection(startPoint, endPoint, array[i], array[i + 1], intervalMode: true);
				if (gRealPoint2D.HasValue)
				{
					list.Add(new IntersectionInfo(gRealPoint2D.Value, SegmentKindHelper.GetKindForLineSegment(i / 2)));
				}
			}
			array = new GRealPoint2D[8]
			{
				new GRealPoint2D(rightBottomRectPoint.X - rightBottomFillet * 2.0, rightBottomRectPoint.Y - rightBottomFillet * 2.0),
				new GRealPoint2D(rightBottomRectPoint.X, rightBottomRectPoint.Y),
				new GRealPoint2D(leftTopRectPoint.X, rightBottomRectPoint.Y - leftBottomFillet * 2.0),
				new GRealPoint2D(leftTopRectPoint.X + leftBottomFillet * 2.0, rightBottomRectPoint.Y),
				new GRealPoint2D(leftTopRectPoint.X, leftTopRectPoint.Y),
				new GRealPoint2D(leftTopRectPoint.X + leftTopFillet * 2.0, leftTopRectPoint.Y + leftTopFillet * 2.0),
				new GRealPoint2D(rightBottomRectPoint.X - rightTopFillet * 2.0, leftTopRectPoint.Y),
				new GRealPoint2D(rightBottomRectPoint.X, leftTopRectPoint.Y + rightTopFillet * 2.0)
			};
			for (int j = 0; j < array.Length; j += 2)
			{
				List<GRealPoint2D> list2 = CalcLineSegmentWithArcIntersection(startPoint, endPoint, array[j], array[j + 1], (double)j * Math.PI / 4.0, Math.PI / 2.0);
				foreach (GRealPoint2D item in list2)
				{
					list.Add(new IntersectionInfo(item, SegmentKindHelper.GetKindForArcSegment(j / 2)));
				}
			}
			double num = double.MaxValue;
			IntersectionInfo result = default(IntersectionInfo);
			foreach (IntersectionInfo item2 in list)
			{
				double num2 = CalcDistance(startPoint, item2.IntersectionPoint);
				if (!result.HasIntersection || num2 < num)
				{
					num = num2;
					result = item2;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		public static IntersectionInfo CalcLineSegmentWithEllipseIntersection(GRealPoint2D segmentPoint1, GRealPoint2D segmentPoint2, GRealPoint2D leftTopEllipseRect, GRealPoint2D rightBottomEllipseRect)
		{
			List<GRealPoint2D> list = CalcLineWithEllipseIntersection(segmentPoint1, segmentPoint2, leftTopEllipseRect, rightBottomEllipseRect);
			if (list.Count <= 0)
			{
				return default(IntersectionInfo);
			}
			return new IntersectionInfo(list[0], SegmentKind.None);
		}

		public static List<GRealPoint2D> CalcRectWithEllipseIntersection(GRealRect2D rect, GRealEllipse ellipse)
		{
			List<GRealPoint2D> list = new List<GRealPoint2D>();
			GRealPoint2D leftTopEllipseRect = new GRealPoint2D(ellipse.Center.X - ellipse.RadiusX, ellipse.Center.Y - ellipse.RadiusY);
			GRealPoint2D rightBottomEllipseRect = new GRealPoint2D(ellipse.Center.X + ellipse.RadiusX, ellipse.Center.Y + ellipse.RadiusY);
			list.AddRange(CalcLineWithEllipseIntersection(new GRealPoint2D(rect.Left, rect.Top), new GRealPoint2D(rect.Right, rect.Top), leftTopEllipseRect, rightBottomEllipseRect));
			list.AddRange(CalcLineWithEllipseIntersection(new GRealPoint2D(rect.Right, rect.Top), new GRealPoint2D(rect.Right, rect.Bottom), leftTopEllipseRect, rightBottomEllipseRect));
			list.AddRange(CalcLineWithEllipseIntersection(new GRealPoint2D(rect.Right, rect.Bottom), new GRealPoint2D(rect.Left, rect.Bottom), leftTopEllipseRect, rightBottomEllipseRect));
			list.AddRange(CalcLineWithEllipseIntersection(new GRealPoint2D(rect.Left, rect.Bottom), new GRealPoint2D(rect.Left, rect.Top), leftTopEllipseRect, rightBottomEllipseRect));
			return list;
		}

		public static double NormalizeRadian(double angleRadian)
		{
			int num = (int)(0.5 * angleRadian / Math.PI);
			if (angleRadian >= 0.0)
			{
				return angleRadian - (double)num * Math.PI * 2.0;
			}
			return Math.PI * 2.0 + angleRadian - (double)num * Math.PI * 2.0;
		}

		public static double ScalarProduct(GRealVector2D v1, GRealVector2D v2)
		{
			return v1.X * v2.X + v1.Y * v2.Y;
		}

		public static DXPoint StrongRound(GRealPoint2D point)
		{
			//IL_0018: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			return new DXPoint(StrongRound(point.X), StrongRound(point.Y));
		}

		public static DXRectangle StrongRound(GRealRect2D rect)
		{
			//IL_0013: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0018: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0031: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0080: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			DXPoint val = StrongRound(new GRealPoint2D(rect.Left, rect.Top));
			DXPoint val2 = StrongRound(new GRealPoint2D(rect.Right, rect.Bottom));
			return new DXRectangle(Math.Min(((DXPoint)(ref val)).X, ((DXPoint)(ref val2)).X), Math.Min(((DXPoint)(ref val)).Y, ((DXPoint)(ref val2)).Y), Math.Abs(((DXPoint)(ref val2)).X - ((DXPoint)(ref val)).X), Math.Abs(((DXPoint)(ref val2)).Y - ((DXPoint)(ref val)).Y));
		}

		public static GRealPoint2D CalcMean(ICollection<GRealPoint2D> points)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			foreach (GRealPoint2D point in points)
			{
				num += point.X;
				num2 += point.Y;
			}
			return new GRealPoint2D(num / (double)points.Count, num2 / (double)points.Count);
		}

		public static bool IsValidDouble(double value)
		{
			if (!double.IsNaN(value))
			{
				return !double.IsInfinity(value);
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	public enum GeometryStripStyleKey
	{
		OwnerStyle,
		EmptyPointStyle
	}
	public class GeometryStripStyle
	{
		public int? Color { get; private set; }

		public GeometryStripStyleKey StyleKey { get; private set; }

		public bool HasColor => Color.HasValue;

		public bool ShouldAddNextSplitPoint => StyleKey != GeometryStripStyleKey.OwnerStyle;

		public bool IsEmptyPointStyle => StyleKey == GeometryStripStyleKey.EmptyPointStyle;

		public GeometryStripStyle()
			: this(null, GeometryStripStyleKey.OwnerStyle)
		{
		}

		public GeometryStripStyle(int? stripColor)
			: this(stripColor, GeometryStripStyleKey.OwnerStyle)
		{
		}

		public GeometryStripStyle(int? stripColor, GeometryStripStyleKey styleKey)
		{
			Color = stripColor;
			StyleKey = styleKey;
		}

		public void Assign(GeometryStripStyle other)
		{
			if (other != null)
			{
				Color = other.Color;
				StyleKey = other.StyleKey;
			}
		}

		public bool Equals(GeometryStripStyle obj)
		{
			if (obj != null && Color == obj.Color)
			{
				return StyleKey == obj.StyleKey;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	public class StripSplitterContainer : IStripSplitter
	{
		private readonly IEnumerable<IStripSplitter> splitters;

		bool IStripSplitter.NeedContinueFirstStrip => splitters.Any((IStripSplitter x) => x.NeedContinueFirstStrip);

		public StripSplitterContainer(params IStripSplitter[] splitters)
		{
			this.splitters = splitters.Where((IStripSplitter x) => x != null);
		}

		List<ColoredStripInfo> IStripSplitter.SplitStrip(IList<RefinedPoint> points, int index, IGeometryStrip strip, Func<RefinedPoint, double> getActualValue)
		{
			foreach (IStripSplitter splitter in splitters)
			{
				List<ColoredStripInfo> list = splitter.SplitStrip(points, index, strip, getActualValue);
				if (list != null && list.Count > 0)
				{
					return list;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		bool IStripSplitter.CanProcessPoint(RefinedPoint point)
		{
			return splitters.Any((IStripSplitter x) => x.CanProcessPoint(point));
		}
	}
	public class BezierStripSplitterContainer : IBezierStripSplitter
	{
		private readonly IEnumerable<IBezierStripSplitter> splitters;

		private readonly BezierStripsContainer sharedStripsContainer;

		List<BezierStrip> IBezierStripSplitter.Strips => sharedStripsContainer.Strips;

		public BezierStripSplitterContainer(params IBezierStripSplitter[] splitters)
		{
			this.splitters = splitters.Where((IBezierStripSplitter x) => x != null);
			sharedStripsContainer = new BezierStripsContainer();
			foreach (IBezierStripSplitter splitter in this.splitters)
			{
				splitter.SetSharedStripsContainer(sharedStripsContainer);
			}
		}

		void IBezierStripSplitter.Clear()
		{
			foreach (IBezierStripSplitter splitter in splitters)
			{
				splitter.Clear();
			}
		}

		bool IBezierStripSplitter.SplitStrip(IList<RefinedPoint> points, List<GRealPoint2D> bezierPoints)
		{
			foreach (IBezierStripSplitter splitter in splitters)
			{
				if (splitter.SplitStrip(points, bezierPoints))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		bool IBezierStripSplitter.SplitBottomStrip(Dictionary<int, GRealPoint2D> currentPointByIndex, List<GRealPoint2D> resultDrawingPoints, List<GRealPoint2D> originalDrawingPoints, int index, double x, bool isLast)
		{
			foreach (IBezierStripSplitter splitter in splitters)
			{
				if (splitter.SplitBottomStrip(currentPointByIndex, resultDrawingPoints, originalDrawingPoints, index, x, isLast))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		bool IBezierStripSplitter.CanProcessPoint(RefinedPoint point)
		{
			return splitters.Any((IBezierStripSplitter x) => x.CanProcessPoint(point));
		}

		void IBezierStripSplitter.SetSharedStripsContainer(BezierStripsContainer container)
		{
		}
	}

		public List<BezierStrip> Strips { get; } = new List<BezierStrip>();
	}

	public struct GRealPoint2D : IEquatable<GRealPoint2D>
	{
		private double x;

		private double y;

		public double X
		{
			get
			{
				return x;
			}
			set
			{
				x = value;
			}
		}

		public double Y
		{
			get
			{
				return y;
			}
			set
			{
				y = value;
			}
		}

		public GRealPoint2D(double x, double y)
		{
			this.x = x;
			this.y = y;
		}

		public static bool operator !=(GRealPoint2D p1, GRealPoint2D p2)
		{
			return !(p1 == p2);
		}

		public static bool operator ==(GRealPoint2D p1, GRealPoint2D p2)
		{
			if (p1.X == p2.X)
			{
				return p1.Y == p2.Y;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static GRealVector2D operator -(GRealPoint2D p1, GRealPoint2D p2)
		{
			return new GRealVector2D(p1.X - p2.X, p1.Y - p2.Y);
		}

		public static explicit operator GRealPoint2D(DXPoint point)
		{
			return new GRealPoint2D(((DXPoint)(ref point)).X, ((DXPoint)(ref point)).Y);
		}

		public static double CalculateDistance(GRealPoint2D point1, GRealPoint2D point2)
		{
			return Math.Sqrt(Math.Pow(point1.x - point2.x, 2.0) + Math.Pow(point1.y - point2.y, 2.0));
		}

		public bool Equals(GRealPoint2D other)
		{
			return this == other;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is GRealPoint2D)
			{
				return Equals((GRealPoint2D)obj);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return HashCodeHelper.CalculateGeneric<double, double>(x, y);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return "(" + x + "; " + y + ")";
		}
	}

	public class LineStrip : List<GRealPoint2D>, IGeometryStrip
	{
		private readonly GeometryStripStyle customStyle = new GeometryStripStyle();

		public virtual bool IsEmpty => base.Count < 2;

		public GeometryStripStyle Style => customStyle;

		public LineStrip()
		{
		}

		public LineStrip(int pointsCount)
			: base(pointsCount)
		{
		}

		public LineStrip(IList<GRealPoint2D> points)
			: base((IEnumerable<GRealPoint2D>)points)
		{
		}

		public LineStrip(IList<GRealPoint2D> points, int? color)
			: base((IEnumerable<GRealPoint2D>)points)
		{
			customStyle = new GeometryStripStyle(color);
		}

		public void AddUniquePoint(GRealPoint2D point)
		{
			int count = base.Count;
			if (count == 0 || point != base[count - 1])
			{
				Add(point);
			}
		}

		public void AddStepToPoint(GRealPoint2D point, bool invertedStep)
		{
			int count = base.Count;
			if (count > 0)
			{
				GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D = base[count - 1];
				if (invertedStep)
				{
					Add(new GRealPoint2D(gRealPoint2D.X, point.Y));
				}
				else
				{
					Add(new GRealPoint2D(point.X, gRealPoint2D.Y));
				}
			}
			Add(point);
		}

		public virtual LineStrip CreateInstance()
		{
			return new LineStrip();
		}

		public virtual void CompleteFilling(IList<RefinedPoint> points = null, IBezierStripSplitter splitter = null)
		{
		}

		public virtual LineStrip CreateUniqueStrip()
		{
			LineStrip lineStrip = CreateInstance();
			int num = -1;
			using Enumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				GRealPoint2D current = enumerator.Current;
				if (num < 0 || lineStrip[num] != current)
				{
					lineStrip.Add(current);
					num++;
				}
			}
			return lineStrip;
		}

		public virtual void Extend(GRealPoint2D point, bool toLeft)
		{
			if (toLeft)
			{
				Insert(0, point);
			}
			else
			{
				Add(point);
			}
		}

		public virtual LineStrip ExtractSubStrip(int startIndex, int endIndex)
		{
			LineStrip lineStrip = CreateInstance();
			for (int i = startIndex; i <= endIndex; i++)
			{
				lineStrip.Add(base[i]);
			}
			return lineStrip;
		}

		public virtual void Substitute(int startIndex, int endIndex, LineStrip lineStrip)
		{
			RemoveRange(startIndex, endIndex - startIndex + 1);
			InsertRange(startIndex, lineStrip);
		}
	}

			return optimizedLineStrip;
		}
	}

	public class RangeStrip : IGeometryStrip
	{
		private readonly GeometryStripStyle customStyle = new GeometryStripStyle();

		private LineStrip topStrip;

		private LineStrip bottomStrip;

		public int Count
		{
			get
			{
				EnsureStrips();
				return Math.Min(topStrip.Count, bottomStrip.Count);
			}
		}

		public virtual bool IsEmpty => Count < 2;

		public LineStrip TopStrip
		{
			get
			{
				EnsureStrips();
				return topStrip;
			}
			set
			{
				topStrip = value;
			}
		}

		public LineStrip BottomStrip
		{
			get
			{
				EnsureStrips();
				return bottomStrip;
			}
			set
			{
				bottomStrip = value;
			}
		}

		public GeometryStripStyle Style => customStyle;

		protected virtual LineStrip CreateBorderStrip()
		{
			return new LineStrip();
		}

		protected void EnsureStrips()
		{
			if (topStrip == null)
			{
				topStrip = CreateBorderStrip();
			}
			if (bottomStrip == null)
			{
				bottomStrip = CreateBorderStrip();
			}
		}

		public virtual RangeStrip CreateInstance()
		{
			return new RangeStrip();
		}

		public virtual void CompleteFilling(IList<RefinedPoint> points = null, IBezierStripSplitter splitter = null)
		{
			EnsureStrips();
			topStrip.CompleteFilling(points, splitter);
			bottomStrip.CompleteFilling(points, splitter);
		}

		public void Add(StripRange range)
		{
			EnsureStrips();
			topStrip.Add(range.Top);
			bottomStrip.Add(range.Bottom);
		}
	}

	public abstract class RegressionCalculator
	{
		protected Tuple<double, double> CalculateKAndB(IRefinedSeries series, double minArgument, ValueLevelInternal valueLevel, IIndicatorValueProvider valueProvider)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			if (series.Points.Count > 1)
			{
				double num3 = 0.0;
				double num4 = 0.0;
				double num5 = 0.0;
				double num6 = 0.0;
				int num7 = 0;
				foreach (RefinedPoint point in series.Points)
				{
					if (!point.IsEmpty)
					{
						double num8 = point.Argument - minArgument;
						double valueForIndicator = valueProvider.GetValueForIndicator(point, valueLevel);
						num3 += num8;
						num4 += num8 * num8;
						num5 += valueForIndicator;
						num6 += num8 * valueForIndicator;
						num7++;
					}
				}
				double num9 = num4 * (double)num7 - num3 * num3;
				if (num9 != 0.0)
				{
					num = (num6 * (double)num7 - num5 * num3) / num9;
					num2 = (num5 * num4 - num3 * num6) / num9 - minArgument * num;
					return new Tuple<double, double>(num, num2);
				}
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
	public class RegressionLineCalculator : RegressionCalculator
	{
		public Tuple<GRealPoint2D, GRealPoint2D> Calculate(IRefinedSeries series, double x1, double x2, ValueLevelInternal valueLevel, IIndicatorValueProvider valueProvider)
		{
			double minArgument = series.GetMinArgument(((IXYSeriesView)series.SeriesView).AxisXData.AxisScaleTypeMap);
			Tuple<double, double> tuple = CalculateKAndB(series, minArgument, valueLevel, valueProvider);
			if (tuple != null)
			{
				double y = tuple.Item1 * x1 + tuple.Item2;
				double y2 = tuple.Item1 * x2 + tuple.Item2;
				return new Tuple<GRealPoint2D, GRealPoint2D>(new GRealPoint2D(x1, y), new GRealPoint2D(x2, y2));
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
	internal class ExponentialRegressionCalculator
	{
		public Tuple<double, double> Calculate(IList<RefinedPoint> points, ValueLevelInternal valueLevel, IIndicatorValueProvider valueProvider)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			double num3 = 0.0;
			double num4 = 0.0;
			foreach (RefinedPoint point in points)
			{
				double num5 = point.Argument + 1.0;
				double valueForIndicator = valueProvider.GetValueForIndicator(point, valueLevel);
				if (valueForIndicator <= 0.0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				double num6 = Math.Log(valueForIndicator);
				num += num5;
				num2 += num6;
				num3 += num5 * num5;
				num4 += num5 * num6;
			}
			double num7 = num / (double)points.Count;
			double num8 = num2 / (double)points.Count;
			num3 -= (double)points.Count * num7 * num7;
			num4 -= (double)points.Count * num7 * num8;
			double num9 = num4 / num3;
			double item = Math.Exp(num8 - num9 * num7);
			return new Tuple<double, double>(item, num9);
		}
	}
	internal class LogarithmicRegressionCalculator
	{
		public Tuple<double, double> Calculate(IList<RefinedPoint> points, ValueLevelInternal valueLevel, IIndicatorValueProvider valueProvider)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			double num3 = 0.0;
			double num4 = 0.0;
			foreach (RefinedPoint point in points)
			{
				double num5 = point.Argument + 1.0;
				double valueForIndicator = valueProvider.GetValueForIndicator(point, valueLevel);
				if (num5 <= 0.0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				double num6 = Math.Log(num5);
				num += num6;
				num2 += valueForIndicator;
				num3 += num6 * num6;
				num4 += num6 * valueForIndicator;
			}
			double num7 = num / (double)points.Count;
			double num8 = num2 / (double)points.Count;
			num3 -= (double)points.Count * num7 * num7;
			num4 -= (double)points.Count * num7 * num8;
			double num9 = num4 / num3;
			double item = num8 - num9 * num7;
			return new Tuple<double, double>(item, num9);
		}
	}
	internal class PowerRegressionCalculator
	{
		public Tuple<double, double> Calculate(IList<RefinedPoint> points, ValueLevelInternal valueLevel, IIndicatorValueProvider valueProvider)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			double num3 = 0.0;
			double num4 = 0.0;
			foreach (RefinedPoint point in points)
			{
				double num5 = point.Argument + 1.0;
				double valueForIndicator = valueProvider.GetValueForIndicator(point, valueLevel);
				if (num5 <= 0.0 || valueForIndicator <= 0.0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				double num6 = Math.Log(num5);
				double num7 = Math.Log(valueForIndicator);
				num += num6;
				num2 += num7;
				num3 += num6 * num6;
				num4 += num6 * num7;
			}
			double num8 = num / (double)points.Count;
			double num9 = num2 / (double)points.Count;
			num3 -= (double)points.Count * num8 * num8;
			num4 -= (double)points.Count * num8 * num9;
			double num10 = num4 / num3;
			double item = Math.Exp(num9 - num10 * num8);
			return new Tuple<double, double>(item, num10);
		}
	}
	internal class PolynomialRegressionCalculator
	{
		public static double Hypotenuse(double a, double b)
		{
			if (Math.Abs(a) > Math.Abs(b))
			{
				double num = b / a;
				return Math.Abs(a) * Math.Sqrt(1.0 + num * num);
			}
			if (b != 0.0)
			{
				double num2 = a / b;
				return Math.Abs(b) * Math.Sqrt(1.0 + num2 * num2);
			}
			return 0.0;
		}

		public double[] Calculate(int degree, IList<RefinedPoint> points, ValueLevelInternal valueLevel, IIndicatorValueProvider valueProvider)
		{
			if (degree >= points.Count)
			{
				return null;
			}
			int count = points.Count;
			int num = degree + 1;
			double[,] array = new double[count, num];
			double[] array2 = new double[count];
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				double x = points[i].Argument + 1.0;
				double valueForIndicator = valueProvider.GetValueForIndicator(points[i], valueLevel);
				array[i, 0] = 1.0;
				for (int j = 1; j < num; j++)
				{
					array[i, j] = Math.Pow(x, j);
				}
				array2[i] = valueForIndicator;
			}
			double[] array3 = new double[num];
			for (int k = 0; k < num; k++)
			{
				double num2 = 0.0;
				for (int l = k; l < count; l++)
				{
					num2 = Hypotenuse(num2, array[l, k]);
				}
				if (num2 != 0.0)
				{
					if (array[k, k] < 0.0)
					{
						num2 = 0.0 - num2;
					}
					for (int m = k; m < count; m++)
					{
						array[m, k] /= num2;
					}
					array[k, k] += 1.0;
					for (int n = k + 1; n < num; n++)
					{
						double num3 = 0.0;
						for (int num4 = k; num4 < count; num4++)
						{
							num3 += array[num4, k] * array[num4, n];
						}
						num3 = (0.0 - num3) / array[k, k];
						for (int num5 = k; num5 < count; num5++)
						{
							array[num5, n] += num3 * array[num5, k];
						}
					}
				}
				array3[k] = 0.0 - num2;
			}
			for (int num6 = 0; num6 < num; num6++)
			{
				double num7 = 0.0;
				for (int num8 = num6; num8 < count; num8++)
				{
					num7 += array[num8, num6] * array2[num8];
				}
				num7 = (0.0 - num7) / array[num6, num6];
				for (int num9 = num6; num9 < count; num9++)
				{
					array2[num9] += num7 * array[num9, num6];
				}
			}
			for (int num10 = num - 1; num10 >= 0; num10--)
			{
				array2[num10] /= array3[num10];
				for (int num11 = 0; num11 < num10; num11++)
				{
					array2[num11] -= array2[num10] * array[num11, num10];
				}
			}
			double[] array4 = new double[num];
			for (int num12 = 0; num12 < array4.Length; num12++)
			{
				array4[num12] = array2[num12];
			}
			return array4;
		}
	}
	public abstract class FinancialIndicatorCalculator
	{
		public bool Calculated { get; protected set; }

		protected bool IsStartPointAboveEndPoint(GRealPoint2D startPoint, GRealPoint2D endPoint)
		{
			return startPoint.Y > endPoint.Y;
		}

		internal static RefinedPoint GetPointByArgument(bool fromEnd, AxisScaleTypeMap axisXScaleTypeMap, IRefinedSeries seriesInfo, object argument, CultureInfo cultureInfo)
		{
			double num = axisXScaleTypeMap.NativeToFinalWithConversion(argument, cultureInfo);
			if (!double.IsNaN(num))
			{
				List<RefinedPoint> list = seriesInfo.FindFinalPointsWithNearestArgument(num);
				if (list.Count == 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (fromEnd)
				{
					return list[list.Count - 1];
				}
				return list[0];
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected void CompareRefinedPointsByArgument(RefinedPoint refinedPoint1, ValueLevelInternal valueLevel1, RefinedPoint refinedPoint2, ValueLevelInternal valueLevel2, out RefinedPoint leftPointInfo, out ValueLevelInternal leftValueLevel, out RefinedPoint rightPointInfo, out ValueLevelInternal rightValueLevel)
		{
			if (refinedPoint1.Argument < refinedPoint2.Argument)
			{
				leftPointInfo = refinedPoint1;
				leftValueLevel = valueLevel1;
				rightPointInfo = refinedPoint2;
				rightValueLevel = valueLevel2;
			}
			else
			{
				leftPointInfo = refinedPoint2;
				leftValueLevel = valueLevel2;
				rightPointInfo = refinedPoint1;
				rightValueLevel = valueLevel1;
			}
		}
	}
	public class FibonacciRetracementCalculator : FinancialIndicatorCalculator
	{
		public List<FibonacciLine> CalculateLines(GRealPoint2D startPoint, GRealPoint2D endPoint, IList<double> levels)
		{
			List<FibonacciLine> list = new List<FibonacciLine>();
			double num = Math.Abs(startPoint.Y - endPoint.Y);
			double num2 = ((!IsStartPointAboveEndPoint(startPoint, endPoint)) ? 1 : (-1));
			foreach (double level in levels)
			{
				double num3 = endPoint.Y - num2 * num * level;
				FibonacciLine item = new FibonacciLine(level, startPoint.X, num3, endPoint.X, num3);
				list.Add(item);
			}
			base.Calculated = true;
			return list;
		}

		public List<FibonacciLine> Calculate(IRefinedSeries seriesInfo, AxisScaleTypeMap axisXScaleTypeMap, CultureInfo cultureInfo, object argument1, ValueLevelInternal valueLevel1, object argument2, ValueLevelInternal valueLevel2, double axisXMaxValueInternal, IList<double> levels)
		{
			base.Calculated = false;
			if (seriesInfo == null || axisXScaleTypeMap == null || argument1 == null || argument2 == null || levels == null)
			{
				return new List<FibonacciLine>();
			}
			RefinedPoint pointByArgument = FinancialIndicatorCalculator.GetPointByArgument(fromEnd: false, axisXScaleTypeMap, seriesInfo, argument1, cultureInfo);
			RefinedPoint pointByArgument2 = FinancialIndicatorCalculator.GetPointByArgument(fromEnd: true, axisXScaleTypeMap, seriesInfo, argument2, cultureInfo);
			if (pointByArgument == null || pointByArgument2 == null || pointByArgument.Argument == pointByArgument2.Argument)
			{
				return new List<FibonacciLine>();
			}
			CompareRefinedPointsByArgument(pointByArgument, valueLevel1, pointByArgument2, valueLevel2, out var leftPointInfo, out var leftValueLevel, out var rightPointInfo, out var rightValueLevel);
			double value = leftPointInfo.GetValue(leftValueLevel);
			double value2 = rightPointInfo.GetValue(rightValueLevel);
			GRealPoint2D startPoint = new GRealPoint2D(leftPointInfo.Argument, value);
			GRealPoint2D endPoint = new GRealPoint2D(axisXMaxValueInternal, value2);
			return CalculateLines(startPoint, endPoint, levels);
		}
	}
	public class FibonacciFansCalculator : FinancialIndicatorCalculator
	{
		public List<FibonacciLine> CalculateLines(GRealPoint2D startPoint, GRealPoint2D endPoint, IList<double> levels)
		{
			List<FibonacciLine> list = new List<FibonacciLine>();
			double num = Math.Abs(startPoint.Y - endPoint.Y);
			double num2 = ((!IsStartPointAboveEndPoint(startPoint, endPoint)) ? 1 : (-1));
			foreach (double level in levels)
			{
				double endPointY = endPoint.Y - num2 * num * level;
				FibonacciLine item = new FibonacciLine(level, startPoint, endPoint.X, endPointY);
				list.Add(item);
			}
			base.Calculated = true;
			return list;
		}

		public List<FibonacciLine> Calculate(IRefinedSeries seriesInfo, AxisScaleTypeMap axisXScaleTypeMap, CultureInfo cultureInfo, object argument1, ValueLevelInternal valueLevel1, object argument2, ValueLevelInternal valueLevel2, IList<double> levels)
		{
			base.Calculated = false;
			if (seriesInfo == null || axisXScaleTypeMap == null || argument1 == null || argument2 == null || levels == null)
			{
				return new List<FibonacciLine>();
			}
			RefinedPoint pointByArgument = FinancialIndicatorCalculator.GetPointByArgument(fromEnd: false, axisXScaleTypeMap, seriesInfo, argument1, cultureInfo);
			RefinedPoint pointByArgument2 = FinancialIndicatorCalculator.GetPointByArgument(fromEnd: true, axisXScaleTypeMap, seriesInfo, argument2, cultureInfo);
			if (pointByArgument == null || pointByArgument2 == null)
			{
				return new List<FibonacciLine>();
			}
			CompareRefinedPointsByArgument(pointByArgument, valueLevel1, pointByArgument2, valueLevel2, out var leftPointInfo, out var _, out var rightPointInfo, out var _);
			double value = leftPointInfo.GetValue(valueLevel1);
			double value2 = rightPointInfo.GetValue(valueLevel2);
			GRealPoint2D startPoint = new GRealPoint2D(leftPointInfo.Argument, value);
			GRealPoint2D endPoint = new GRealPoint2D(rightPointInfo.Argument, value2);
			return CalculateLines(startPoint, endPoint, levels);
		}
	}
	public class FibonacciArcsCalculator : FinancialIndicatorCalculator
	{
		public List<FibonacciCircle> Calculate(IRefinedSeries seriesInfo, AxisScaleTypeMap axisXScaleTypeMap, CultureInfo cultureInfo, object argument1, ValueLevelInternal valueLevel1, object argument2, ValueLevelInternal valueLevel2, IList<double> levels)
		{
			base.Calculated = false;
			List<FibonacciCircle> list = new List<FibonacciCircle>();
			if (seriesInfo == null || axisXScaleTypeMap == null || argument1 == null || argument2 == null || levels == null)
			{
				return list;
			}
			RefinedPoint pointByArgument = FinancialIndicatorCalculator.GetPointByArgument(fromEnd: false, axisXScaleTypeMap, seriesInfo, argument1, cultureInfo);
			RefinedPoint pointByArgument2 = FinancialIndicatorCalculator.GetPointByArgument(fromEnd: true, axisXScaleTypeMap, seriesInfo, argument2, cultureInfo);
			if (pointByArgument == null || pointByArgument2 == null)
			{
				return list;
			}
			CompareRefinedPointsByArgument(pointByArgument, valueLevel1, pointByArgument2, valueLevel2, out var leftPointInfo, out var _, out var rightPointInfo, out var _);
			double value = leftPointInfo.GetValue(valueLevel1);
			double value2 = rightPointInfo.GetValue(valueLevel2);
			GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D = new GRealPoint2D(leftPointInfo.Argument, value);
			GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D2 = new GRealPoint2D(rightPointInfo.Argument, value2);
			double num = GRealPoint2D.CalculateDistance(gRealPoint2D, gRealPoint2D2);
			GRealVector2D gRealVector2D = new GRealVector2D(gRealPoint2D2, gRealPoint2D);
			gRealVector2D.Normalize();
			foreach (double level in levels)
			{
				double num2 = level * num;
				GRealPoint2D pointInCircle = gRealPoint2D2 + gRealVector2D * num2;
				FibonacciCircle item = new FibonacciCircle(gRealPoint2D2, pointInCircle, level);
				list.Add(item);
			}
			base.Calculated = true;
			return list;
		}
	}
	public class TrendLineCalculator : FinancialIndicatorCalculator
	{
		public GRealLine2D Calculate(IRefinedSeries seriesInfo, AxisScaleTypeMap axisXScaleTypeMap, CultureInfo cultureInfo, object argument1, ValueLevelInternal valueLevel1, object argument2, ValueLevelInternal valueLevel2, bool extrapolateToInfinity, double axisXMaxValue, bool extrapolateToNegativeInfinity, double axisXMinValue, IIndicatorValueProvider valueProvider)
		{
			base.Calculated = false;
			GRealLine2D result = default(GRealLine2D);
			if (seriesInfo == null || axisXScaleTypeMap == null || argument1 == null || argument2 == null)
			{
				return result;
			}
			RefinedPoint pointByArgument = FinancialIndicatorCalculator.GetPointByArgument(fromEnd: false, axisXScaleTypeMap, seriesInfo, argument1, cultureInfo);
			RefinedPoint pointByArgument2 = FinancialIndicatorCalculator.GetPointByArgument(fromEnd: true, axisXScaleTypeMap, seriesInfo, argument2, cultureInfo);
			if (pointByArgument == null || pointByArgument2 == null)
			{
				return result;
			}
			double valueForIndicator = valueProvider.GetValueForIndicator(pointByArgument, valueLevel1);
			double valueForIndicator2 = valueProvider.GetValueForIndicator(pointByArgument2, valueLevel2);
			GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D = new GRealPoint2D(pointByArgument.Argument, valueForIndicator);
			GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D2 = new GRealPoint2D(pointByArgument2.Argument, valueForIndicator2);
			base.Calculated = true;
			if (!extrapolateToInfinity && !extrapolateToNegativeInfinity)
			{
				return new GRealLine2D(gRealPoint2D, gRealPoint2D2);
			}
			GRealPoint2D start;
			GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D3;
			if (gRealPoint2D.X < gRealPoint2D2.X)
			{
				start = gRealPoint2D;
				gRealPoint2D3 = gRealPoint2D2;
			}
			else
			{
				start = gRealPoint2D2;
				gRealPoint2D3 = gRealPoint2D;
			}
			if (extrapolateToInfinity)
			{
				double y = ((!(start.Y < gRealPoint2D3.Y)) ? ((0.0 - (axisXMaxValue - start.X)) * (start.Y - gRealPoint2D3.Y) / (gRealPoint2D3.X - start.X) + start.Y) : ((axisXMaxValue - start.X) * (gRealPoint2D3.Y - start.Y) / (gRealPoint2D3.X - start.X) + start.Y));
				gRealPoint2D3 = new GRealPoint2D(axisXMaxValue, y);
			}
			if (extrapolateToNegativeInfinity)
			{
				double y2 = ((!(start.Y < gRealPoint2D3.Y)) ? ((0.0 - (axisXMinValue - gRealPoint2D3.X)) * (start.Y - gRealPoint2D3.Y) / (gRealPoint2D3.X - start.X) + gRealPoint2D3.Y) : ((axisXMinValue - gRealPoint2D3.X) * (gRealPoint2D3.Y - start.Y) / (gRealPoint2D3.X - start.X) + gRealPoint2D3.Y));
				start = gRealPoint2D3;
				gRealPoint2D3 = new GRealPoint2D(axisXMinValue, y2);
			}
			return new GRealLine2D(start, gRealPoint2D3);
		}
	}
	public class MedianPriceCalculator
	{
		public bool Calculated { get; private set; }

		public static bool IsCompatible(ISeriesView view)
		{
			return view is IFinancialSeriesView;
		}

		public MedianPriceCalculator()
		{
			Calculated = false;
		}

		private bool IsParameterCorrect(IRefinedSeries refinedSeries, IList<RefinedPoint> points)
		{
			if (refinedSeries != null && IsCompatible(refinedSeries.SeriesView) && points != null)
			{
				return points.Count > 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public LineStrip Calculate(IRefinedSeries refinedSeries, IList<RefinedPoint> points)
		{
			Calculated = false;
			if (!IsParameterCorrect(refinedSeries, points))
			{
				return ObjectsFactory.Default.CreateLineStrip();
			}
			LineStrip lineStrip = ObjectsFactory.Default.CreateLineStrip();
			for (int i = 0; i < points.Count; i++)
			{
				IFinancialPoint financialPoint = points[i];
				double y = (financialPoint.High + financialPoint.Low) / 2.0;
				lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(financialPoint.Argument, y));
			}
			Calculated = true;
			return lineStrip;
		}
	}

	public abstract class MovingAverageCalculator
	{
		private readonly LineStrip movingAverageData = ObjectsFactory.Default.CreateLineStrip();

		private readonly LineStrip upperEnvelopeData = ObjectsFactory.Default.CreateLineStrip();

		private readonly LineStrip lowerEnvelopeData = ObjectsFactory.Default.CreateLineStrip();

		public LineStrip MovingAverageData => movingAverageData;

		public LineStrip UpperEnvelopeData => upperEnvelopeData;

		public LineStrip LowerEnvelopeData => lowerEnvelopeData;

		public abstract void UpdateMovingAverageData(IList<RefinedPoint> refinedPoints, int startUpdateIndex, int pointsCount, ValueLevelInternal valueLevel, IIndicatorValueProvider valueProvider);

		public void CalculateEnvelopeData(double envelopePercent, int startUpdateIndex)
		{
			bool flag = upperEnvelopeData.Count == movingAverageData.Count && lowerEnvelopeData.Count == movingAverageData.Count;
			if (!flag)
			{
				if (startUpdateIndex == 0)
				{
					upperEnvelopeData.Clear();
					lowerEnvelopeData.Clear();
				}
				else
				{
					upperEnvelopeData.RemoveRange(startUpdateIndex, upperEnvelopeData.Count - startUpdateIndex);
					lowerEnvelopeData.RemoveRange(startUpdateIndex, upperEnvelopeData.Count - startUpdateIndex);
				}
			}
			double num = envelopePercent / 100.0;
			for (int i = startUpdateIndex; i < movingAverageData.Count; i++)
			{
				GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D = movingAverageData[i];
				double num2 = gRealPoint2D.Y * num;
				GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D2 = new GRealPoint2D(gRealPoint2D.X, gRealPoint2D.Y + num2);
				GRealPoint2D gRealPoint2D3 = new GRealPoint2D(gRealPoint2D.X, gRealPoint2D.Y - num2);
				if (flag)
				{
					upperEnvelopeData[i] = gRealPoint2D2;
					lowerEnvelopeData[i] = gRealPoint2D3;
				}
				else
				{
					upperEnvelopeData.Add(gRealPoint2D2);
					lowerEnvelopeData.Add(gRealPoint2D3);
				}
			}
		}

		public void Calculate(IList<RefinedPoint> points, int pointsCount, ValueLevelInternal valueLevel, double envelopePercent, IIndicatorValueProvider valueProvider)
		{
			UpdateMovingAverageData(points, 0, pointsCount, valueLevel, valueProvider);
			CalculateEnvelopeData(envelopePercent, 0);
		}
	}
	public class SimpleMovingAverageCalculator : MovingAverageCalculator
	{
		internal bool IgnoreEmptyValues { get; set; }

		internal bool StartFromFirstPoint { get; set; } = true;

		public override void UpdateMovingAverageData(IList<RefinedPoint> refinedPoints, int startUpdateIndex, int pointsCount, ValueLevelInternal valueLevel, IIndicatorValueProvider valueProvider)
		{
			List<GRealPoint2D> list = base.MovingAverageData;
			if (startUpdateIndex == 0 || startUpdateIndex > list.Count)
			{
				list.Clear();
			}
			else
			{
				list.RemoveRange(startUpdateIndex, list.Count - startUpdateIndex);
			}
			int num = ((!StartFromFirstPoint) ? (pointsCount - 1) : 0);
			if (pointsCount <= 0 || refinedPoints == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			int count = refinedPoints.Count;
			if (count <= 1)
			{
				return;
			}
			double num2 = 0.0;
			Queue<RefinedPoint> queue = new Queue<RefinedPoint>(pointsCount);
			int num3 = 0;
			int num4 = Math.Max(0, startUpdateIndex + 1 - pointsCount);
			for (int i = num4; i < count; i++)
			{
				if (queue.Count > 0 && i + 1 - pointsCount > startUpdateIndex)
				{
					RefinedPoint refinedPoint = queue.Dequeue();
					num2 -= valueProvider.GetValueForIndicator(refinedPoint, valueLevel);
					if (!IgnoreEmptyValues || refinedPoint.HasValues)
					{
						num3--;
					}
					if (num3 == 0)
					{
						num2 = 0.0;
					}
				}
				RefinedPoint refinedPoint2 = refinedPoints[i];
				queue.Enqueue(refinedPoint2);
				num2 += valueProvider.GetValueForIndicator(refinedPoint2, valueLevel);
				if (!IgnoreEmptyValues || refinedPoint2.HasValues)
				{
					num3++;
				}
				if (i >= startUpdateIndex && i >= num && num3 > 0)
				{
					list.Add(new GRealPoint2D(refinedPoint2.Argument, num2 / (double)num3));
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public class WeightedMovingAverageCalculator : MovingAverageCalculator
	{
		public override void UpdateMovingAverageData(IList<RefinedPoint> refinedPoints, int startUpdateIndex, int pointsCount, ValueLevelInternal valueLevel, IIndicatorValueProvider valueProvider)
		{
			List<GRealPoint2D> list = base.MovingAverageData;
			list.Clear();
			if (pointsCount <= 0 || refinedPoints == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			int count = refinedPoints.Count;
			if (count <= 1)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = Math.Min(pointsCount, count);
			double num2 = 0.0;
			double num3 = 0.0;
			int num4 = 0;
			Queue<double> queue = new Queue<double>(num);
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				RefinedPoint refinedPoint = refinedPoints[i];
				double valueForIndicator = valueProvider.GetValueForIndicator(refinedPoint, valueLevel);
				queue.Enqueue(valueForIndicator);
				num2 += valueForIndicator;
				num3 = 0.0;
				num4 = 0;
				int num5 = 1;
				foreach (double item in queue)
				{
					num3 += item * (double)num5;
					num4 += num5;
					num5++;
				}
				list.Add(new GRealPoint2D(refinedPoint.Argument, num3 / (double)num4));
			}
			for (int j = num; j < count; j++)
			{
				RefinedPoint refinedPoint2 = refinedPoints[j];
				double valueForIndicator2 = valueProvider.GetValueForIndicator(refinedPoint2, valueLevel);
				num3 += valueForIndicator2 * (double)num - num2;
				num2 += valueForIndicator2 - queue.Dequeue();
				queue.Enqueue(valueForIndicator2);
				list.Add(new GRealPoint2D(refinedPoint2.Argument, num3 / (double)num4));
			}
		}
	}
	public class ExponentialMovingAverageCalculator : MovingAverageCalculator
	{
		public override void UpdateMovingAverageData(IList<RefinedPoint> refinedPoints, int startUpdateIndex, int pointsCount, ValueLevelInternal valueLevel, IIndicatorValueProvider valueProvider)
		{
			List<GRealPoint2D> list = base.MovingAverageData;
			if (pointsCount <= 0 || refinedPoints == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			int count = refinedPoints.Count;
			if (count <= 1)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = Math.Min(pointsCount, count);
			double num2 = 0.0;
			double num3 = 1.0;
			if (startUpdateIndex == 0)
			{
				list.Clear();
			}
			else
			{
				list.RemoveRange(startUpdateIndex, list.Count - startUpdateIndex);
			}
			if (startUpdateIndex > 0)
			{
				num2 = list[startUpdateIndex - 1].Y;
				if (startUpdateIndex >= num)
				{
					num3 = 2.0 / (double)(pointsCount + 1);
				}
			}
			for (int i = startUpdateIndex; i < count; i++)
			{
				if (i < num)
				{
					num3 = 2.0 / (double)(i + 2);
				}
				RefinedPoint refinedPoint = refinedPoints[i];
				double valueForIndicator = valueProvider.GetValueForIndicator(refinedPoint, valueLevel);
				num2 += (valueForIndicator - num2) * num3;
				list.Add(new GRealPoint2D(refinedPoint.Argument, num2));
			}
		}
	}
	public class TriangularMovingAverageCalculator : MovingAverageCalculator
	{
		public override void UpdateMovingAverageData(IList<RefinedPoint> refinedPoints, int startUpdateIndex, int pointsCount, ValueLevelInternal valueLevel, IIndicatorValueProvider valueProvider)
		{
			List<GRealPoint2D> list = base.MovingAverageData;
			list.Clear();
			if (pointsCount <= 0 || refinedPoints == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			int count = refinedPoints.Count;
			if (count > 1)
			{
				int num = Math.Min(pointsCount, count);
				double num2 = 0.0;
				double num3 = 0.0;
				Queue<double> queue = new Queue<double>(num);
				Queue<double> queue2 = new Queue<double>(num);
				int num4 = 0;
				int num5 = 1;
				while (num4 < num)
				{
					RefinedPoint refinedPoint = refinedPoints[num4];
					double valueForIndicator = valueProvider.GetValueForIndicator(refinedPoint, valueLevel);
					num2 += valueForIndicator;
					double num6 = num2 / (double)num5;
					num3 += num6;
					list.Add(new GRealPoint2D(refinedPoint.Argument, num3 / (double)num5));
					queue.Enqueue(valueForIndicator);
					queue2.Enqueue(num6);
					num4++;
					num5++;
				}
				num2 /= (double)num;
				num3 /= (double)num;
				for (int i = num; i < count; i++)
				{
					RefinedPoint refinedPoint2 = refinedPoints[i];
					double valueForIndicator2 = valueProvider.GetValueForIndicator(refinedPoint2, valueLevel);
					num2 += (valueForIndicator2 - queue.Dequeue()) / (double)num;
					num3 += (num2 - queue2.Dequeue()) / (double)num;
					list.Add(new GRealPoint2D(refinedPoint2.Argument, num3));
					queue.Enqueue(valueForIndicator2);
					queue2.Enqueue(num2);
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public class TripleExponentialMovingAverageCalculator : MovingAverageCalculator
	{
		public override void UpdateMovingAverageData(IList<RefinedPoint> refinedPoints, int startUpdateIndex, int pointsCount, ValueLevelInternal valueLevel, IIndicatorValueProvider valueProvider)
		{
			LineStrip lineStrip = base.MovingAverageData;
			lineStrip.Clear();
			if (pointsCount <= 0 || refinedPoints == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			int count = refinedPoints.Count;
			if (count > 1)
			{
				int num = Math.Min(pointsCount, count);
				double num2 = 0.0;
				double num3 = 0.0;
				double num4 = 0.0;
				double num5 = 1.0;
				int num6 = 0;
				int num7 = 2;
				while (num6 < num)
				{
					num5 = 2.0 / (double)num7;
					RefinedPoint refinedPoint = refinedPoints[num6];
					double valueForIndicator = valueProvider.GetValueForIndicator(refinedPoint, valueLevel);
					num2 += (valueForIndicator - num2) * num5;
					num3 = num5 * num2 + (1.0 - num5) * num3;
					num4 = num5 * num3 + (1.0 - num5) * num4;
					lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(refinedPoint.Argument, num4));
					num6++;
					num7++;
				}
				for (int i = num; i < count; i++)
				{
					RefinedPoint refinedPoint2 = refinedPoints[i];
					double value = refinedPoint2.GetValue(valueLevel);
					num2 += (value - num2) * num5;
					num3 = num5 * num2 + (1.0 - num5) * num3;
					num4 = num5 * num3 + (1.0 - num5) * num4;
					lineStrip.Add(new GRealPoint2D(refinedPoint2.Argument, num4));
				}
			}
		}
	}

		{
			get
			{
				return userArgument;
			}
			set
			{
				userArgument = value;
			}
		}

		protected abstract Scale Scale { get; }

		protected abstract string QualitativeArgument { get; }

		protected abstract double NumericalArgument { get; }

		protected abstract DateTime DateTimeArgument { get; }

		protected abstract TimeSpan TimeSpanArgument { get; }

		Scale ISeriesPointArgument.ArgumentScaleType => Scale;

		object ISeriesPointArgument.UserArgument => Argument;

		string ISeriesPointArgument.QualitativeArgument => QualitativeArgument;

		double ISeriesPointArgument.NumericalArgument => NumericalArgument;

		DateTime ISeriesPointArgument.DateTimeArgument => DateTimeArgument;

		TimeSpan ISeriesPointArgument.TimeSpanArgument => TimeSpanArgument;

		public static AggregatedSeriesArgumentContainerBase CreateInstance(Scale argumentScaleType, object argument)
		{
			return argumentScaleType switch
			{
				Scale.Qualitative => new QualitativeAggregatedSeriesArgumentContainer(argument), 
				Scale.Numerical => new NumericAggregatedSeriesArgumentContainer(argument), 
				Scale.DateTime => new DateTimeAggregatedSeriesArgumentContainer(argument), 
				Scale.TimeSpan => new TimeSpanAggregatedSeriesArgumentContainer(argument), 
				_ => null, 
			};
		}

		protected AggregatedSeriesArgumentContainerBase(object argument)
		{
			userArgument = argument;
		}
	}
	public abstract class AggregatedSeriesArgumentContainer<T> : AggregatedSeriesArgumentContainerBase
	{
		private readonly T typedArgument;

		protected T TypedArgument => typedArgument;

		protected override double NumericalArgument => 0.0;

		protected override DateTime DateTimeArgument => DateTime.MinValue;

		protected override TimeSpan TimeSpanArgument => TimeSpan.Zero;

		protected AggregatedSeriesArgumentContainer(object argument)
			: base(argument)
		{
			typedArgument = Convert(argument);
		}

		protected abstract T Convert(object value);
	}

		private AggregatedSeriesPoint(RefinedSeries owner, Scale argumentScaleTypeX, object argumentX, IList<RefinedPoint> sourcePoints, int index, int count, CorePointState state, bool isAuxiliary)
		{
			sourcePointsStartIndex = index;
			sourcePointsCount = count;
			this.owner = owner;
			this.sourcePoints = sourcePoints;
			pointState = state;
			this.isAuxiliary = isAuxiliary;
			this.argumentX = AggregatedSeriesArgumentContainerBase.CreateInstance(argumentScaleTypeX, argumentX);
		}

		public AggregatedSeriesPoint(RefinedSeries owner, Scale argumentScaleTypeX, object argumentX, double[] values, IList<RefinedPoint> sourcePoints, int index, int count, CorePointState state, bool isAuxiliary)
			: this(owner, argumentScaleTypeX, argumentX, sourcePoints, index, count, state, isAuxiliary)
		{
			double[] valuesArrayByDimension = GetValuesArrayByDimension(values, sourcePoints);
			this.values = new NumericalSeriesPointValuesContainer(valuesArrayByDimension);
		}

		public AggregatedSeriesPoint(RefinedSeries owner, Scale argumentScaleTypeX, object argumentX, DateTime[] values, double[] userValues, IList<RefinedPoint> sourcePoints, int index, int count, CorePointState state)
			: this(owner, argumentScaleTypeX, argumentX, sourcePoints, index, count, state, isAuxiliary: false)
		{
			this.values = new DateTimeSeriesPointValuesContainer(values, userValues);
		}

		public AggregatedSeriesPoint(RefinedSeries owner, Scale argumentScaleTypeX, object argumentX, TimeSpan[] values, double[] userValues, IList<RefinedPoint> sourcePoints, int index, int count, CorePointState state)
			: this(owner, argumentScaleTypeX, argumentX, sourcePoints, index, count, state, isAuxiliary: false)
		{
			this.values = new TimeSpanSeriesPointValuesContainer(values, userValues);
		}

		public AggregatedSeriesPoint(RefinedSeries owner, Scale argumentScaleTypeX, Scale argumentScaleTypeY, object argumentX, object argumentY, double[] values, IList<RefinedPoint> sourcePoints, int index, int count, CorePointState state)
			: this(owner, argumentScaleTypeX, argumentX, values, sourcePoints, index, count, state, isAuxiliary: false)
		{
			this.argumentY = AggregatedSeriesArgumentContainerBase.CreateInstance(argumentScaleTypeY, argumentY);
		}

		private T[] GetValuesArrayByDimension<T>(T[] values, IList<RefinedPoint> sourcePoints)
		{
			T[] array = values;
			if (sourcePoints != null && sourcePoints.Count > 0)
			{
				int num = sourcePoints[0].ValuesDimension;
				if (!IsEmpty && num == 0)
				{
					num = owner.SeriesView.PointDimension;
				}
				array = new T[num];
				num = Math.Min(values.Length, num);
				Array.Copy(values, 0, array, 0, num);
			}
			return array;
		}

		public RefinedPoint GetRefinedPoint(int index)
		{
			if (sourcePointsCount <= index)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return sourcePoints[sourcePointsStartIndex + index];
		}
	}
	public class ErrorBarsPointsCalculator
	{
		public double[] CalculateErrorBars(IList<RefinedPoint> points, int index, int count)
		{
			double[] array = new double[2]
			{
				double.MaxValue,
				double.MinValue
			};
			for (int i = index; i < index + count; i++)
			{
				if (!points[i].IsEmpty)
				{
					IErrorBarPoint errorBarPoint = points[i];
					array[0] = Math.Min(array[0], errorBarPoint.LowValue);
					array[1] = Math.Max(array[1], errorBarPoint.HighValue);
				}
			}
			return array;
		}
	}
	public interface IAggregationCalculator
	{
		bool CanKeepSinglePoint { get; }

		bool CanSupportErrorBars { get; }

		double[] Calculate(IList<RefinedPoint> points, int index, int count, out CorePointState pointState);
	}
	public interface ICustomAggregateFunction
	{
		double[] Calculate(object nativeArgument, IEnumerable<double> values1, IEnumerable<double> values2, IEnumerable<double> values3, IEnumerable<double> values4);
	}
	public static class AggregationCalculator
	{
		public const int ValuesCount = 4;

		public static double[] CreateArray()
		{
			return CreateArray(0.0);
		}

		public static double[] CreateArray(double defaultValue)
		{
			double[] array = new double[4];
			for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
			{
				array[i] = defaultValue;
			}
			return array;
		}

		public static double[] CreateArray(double value1, double value2, double value3, double value4)
		{
			return new double[4] { value1, value2, value3, value4 };
		}

		public static IAggregationCalculator Create(AggregateFunctionNative aggregationFunction, int valuesDimension, Type pointInterfaceType, bool isAggregationSupportedBySeries = true)
		{
			if (!isAggregationSupportedBySeries)
			{
				return new FirstEntryReturningAggregationCalculator();
			}
			switch (aggregationFunction)
			{
			case AggregateFunctionNative.Minimum:
				if (valuesDimension == 1)
				{
					return new MinAggregationSingleValueCalculator();
				}
				return new MinAggregationCalculator();
			case AggregateFunctionNative.Maximum:
				if (valuesDimension == 1)
				{
					return new MaxAggregationSingleValueCalculator();
				}
				return new MaxAggregationCalculator();
			case AggregateFunctionNative.Sum:
				if (valuesDimension == 1)
				{
					return new SumAggregationSingleValueCalculator();
				}
				return new SumAggregationCalculator();
			case AggregateFunctionNative.Average:
				if (valuesDimension == 1)
				{
					return new AverageAggregationSingleValueCalculator();
				}
				return new AverageAggregationCalculator();
			case AggregateFunctionNative.Count:
				return new CountAggregationCalculator();
			case AggregateFunctionNative.Histogram:
				return new HistogramAggregationCalculator(pointInterfaceType.IsAssignableFrom(typeof(IRangePoint)));
			case AggregateFunctionNative.Financial:
				return new FinancialAggregationCalculator();
			default:
				return null;
			}
		}
	}
	public class MinAggregationSingleValueCalculator : IAggregationCalculator
	{
		bool IAggregationCalculator.CanKeepSinglePoint => true;

		bool IAggregationCalculator.CanSupportErrorBars => true;

		double[] IAggregationCalculator.Calculate(IList<RefinedPoint> points, int index, int count, out CorePointState state)
		{
			double[] array = AggregationCalculator.CreateArray(double.MaxValue);
			if (count == 1)
			{
				RefinedPoint refinedPoint = points[index];
				array[0] = refinedPoint.Value1;
				state = refinedPoint.State;
			}
			else
			{
				state = CorePointState.Empty;
				for (int i = index; i < index + count; i++)
				{
					if (!points[i].IsEmpty)
					{
						array[0] = Math.Min(array[0], points[i].Value1);
						state = CorePointState.HasValues;
					}
				}
			}
			return array;
		}
	}
	public class MinAggregationCalculator : IAggregationCalculator
	{
		bool IAggregationCalculator.CanKeepSinglePoint => true;

		bool IAggregationCalculator.CanSupportErrorBars => true;

		double[] IAggregationCalculator.Calculate(IList<RefinedPoint> points, int index, int count, out CorePointState state)

			{
				RefinedPoint refinedPoint = points[index];
				array[0] = refinedPoint.Value1;
				array[1] = refinedPoint.Value2;
				array[2] = refinedPoint.Value3;
				array[3] = refinedPoint.Value4;
				state = refinedPoint.State;
			}
			else
			{
				state = CorePointState.Empty;
				for (int i = index; i < index + count; i++)
				{
					if (!points[i].IsEmpty)
					{
						array[0] = Math.Min(array[0], points[i].Value1);
						array[1] = Math.Min(array[1], points[i].Value2);
						array[2] = Math.Min(array[2], points[i].Value3);
						array[3] = Math.Min(array[3], points[i].Value4);
						state = CorePointState.HasValues;
					}
				}
			}
			return array;
		}
	}
