	public class AverageAggregationSingleValueCalculator : IAggregationCalculator
	{
		bool IAggregationCalculator.CanKeepSinglePoint => true;

		bool IAggregationCalculator.CanSupportErrorBars => true;

		private double[] CalculateWithParts(IList<RefinedPoint> points, int index, int count, out CorePointState state)
		{
			state = CorePointState.Empty;
			double[] array = AggregationCalculator.CreateArray();
			for (int i = index; i < index + count; i++)
			{
				if (!points[i].IsEmpty)
				{
					array[0] += points[i].Value1 / (double)count;
					state = CorePointState.HasValues;
				}
			}
			return array;
		}

		private double[] CalculateWithSumAccumulation(IList<RefinedPoint> points, int index, int count, out CorePointState state)
		{
			state = CorePointState.Empty;
			int num = 0;
			double[] array = AggregationCalculator.CreateArray();
			for (int i = index; i < index + count; i++)
			{
				if (!points[i].IsEmpty)
				{
					array[0] += points[i].Value1;
					state = CorePointState.HasValues;
					num++;
				}
			}
			array[0] /= num;
			return array;
		}

		double[] IAggregationCalculator.Calculate(IList<RefinedPoint> points, int index, int count, out CorePointState state)
		{
			double[] array;
			if (count == 1)
			{
				array = AggregationCalculator.CreateArray();
				RefinedPoint refinedPoint = points[index];
				array[0] = refinedPoint.Value1;
				state = refinedPoint.State;
			}
			else
			{
				array = CalculateWithSumAccumulation(points, index, count, out state);
				double[] array2 = array;
				foreach (double d in array2)
				{
					if (double.IsInfinity(d))
					{
						return CalculateWithParts(points, index, count, out state);
					}
				}
			}
			return array;
		}
	}
	public class AverageAggregationCalculator : IAggregationCalculator
	{
		bool IAggregationCalculator.CanKeepSinglePoint => true;

		bool IAggregationCalculator.CanSupportErrorBars => true;

		private double[] CalculateWithParts(IList<RefinedPoint> points, int index, int count, out CorePointState state)
		{
			state = CorePointState.Empty;
			double[] array = AggregationCalculator.CreateArray();
			for (int i = index; i < index + count; i++)
			{
				if (!points[i].IsEmpty)
				{
					array[0] += points[i].Value1 / (double)count;
					array[1] += points[i].Value2 / (double)count;
					array[2] += points[i].Value3 / (double)count;
					array[3] += points[i].Value4 / (double)count;
					state = CorePointState.HasValues;
				}
			}
			return array;
		}

		private double[] CalculateWithSumAccumulation(IList<RefinedPoint> points, int index, int count, out CorePointState state)
		{
			state = CorePointState.Empty;
			double[] array = AggregationCalculator.CreateArray();
			for (int i = index; i < index + count; i++)
			{
				if (!points[i].IsEmpty)
				{
					array[0] += points[i].Value1;
					array[1] += points[i].Value2;
					array[2] += points[i].Value3;
					array[3] += points[i].Value4;
					state = CorePointState.HasValues;
				}
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < array.Length; j++)
			{
				array[j] /= count;
			}
			return array;
		}

		double[] IAggregationCalculator.Calculate(IList<RefinedPoint> points, int index, int count, out CorePointState state)
		{
			double[] array;
			if (count == 1)
			{
				array = AggregationCalculator.CreateArray();
				RefinedPoint refinedPoint = points[index];
				array[0] = refinedPoint.Value1;
				array[1] = refinedPoint.Value2;
				array[2] = refinedPoint.Value3;
				array[3] = refinedPoint.Value4;
				state = refinedPoint.State;
			}
			else
			{
				array = CalculateWithSumAccumulation(points, index, count, out state);
				double[] array2 = array;
				foreach (double d in array2)
				{
					if (double.IsInfinity(d))
					{
						return CalculateWithParts(points, index, count, out state);
					}
				}
			}
			return array;
		}
	}
	public class CountAggregationCalculator : IAggregationCalculator

		bool IAggregationCalculator.CanKeepSinglePoint => false;

		bool IAggregationCalculator.CanSupportErrorBars => false;

		double[] IAggregationCalculator.Calculate(IList<RefinedPoint> points, int index, int count, out CorePointState state)

	public class FinancialAggregationCalculator : IAggregationCalculator
	{
		bool IAggregationCalculator.CanKeepSinglePoint => true;

		bool IAggregationCalculator.CanSupportErrorBars => false;

		double[] IAggregationCalculator.Calculate(IList<RefinedPoint> points, int index, int count, out CorePointState state)
		{
			state = CorePointState.Empty;
			RefinedPoint refinedPoint = ObjectsFactory.Default.Create();
			IFinancialPoint financialPoint = refinedPoint;
			if (count > 0)
			{
				int num = index + count - 1;
				financialPoint.Open = ((IFinancialPoint)points[index]).Open;
				financialPoint.Close = ((IFinancialPoint)points[num]).Close;
				double num2 = double.MaxValue;
				double num3 = double.MinValue;
				for (int i = index; i <= num; i++)
				{
					if (!points[i].IsEmpty)
					{
						num2 = Math.Min(num2, ((IFinancialPoint)points[i]).Low);
						num3 = Math.Max(num3, ((IFinancialPoint)points[i]).High);
						state = CorePointState.HasValues;
					}
				}
				financialPoint.High = num3;
				financialPoint.Low = num2;
			}
			return new double[4] { refinedPoint.Value1, refinedPoint.Value2, refinedPoint.Value3, refinedPoint.Value4 };
		}
	}
	public class FirstEntryReturningAggregationCalculator : IAggregationCalculator
	{
		bool IAggregationCalculator.CanKeepSinglePoint => true;

		bool IAggregationCalculator.CanSupportErrorBars => false;

		double[] IAggregationCalculator.Calculate(IList<RefinedPoint> points, int index, int count, out CorePointState state)
		{
			state = points[index].State;
			int num = 6;
			if (points[index].AdditionalValues != null)
			{
				num += points[index].AdditionalValues.Length;
			}
			double[] array = new double[num];
			array[0] = points[index].Value1;
			array[1] = points[index].Value2;
			array[2] = points[index].Value3;
			array[3] = points[index].Value4;
			array[4] = points[index].Value5;
			array[5] = points[index].Value6;
			if (points[index].AdditionalValues != null)
			{
				for (int i = 6; i < num; i++)
				{
					array[i] = points[index].AdditionalValues[i - 6];
				}
			}
			return array;
		}
	}
	public class UserAggregateFunctionCalculator : IAggregationCalculator
	{
		private readonly AxisScaleTypeMap axisXScaleTypeMap;

		private readonly ICustomAggregateFunction userCalculator;

		bool IAggregationCalculator.CanKeepSinglePoint => false;

		bool IAggregationCalculator.CanSupportErrorBars => true;

		double[] IAggregationCalculator.Calculate(IList<RefinedPoint> points, int index, int count, out CorePointState state)
		{
			state = CorePointState.Empty;
			List<double> list = new List<double>(count);
			List<double> list2 = new List<double>(count);
			List<double> list3 = new List<double>(count);
			List<double> list4 = new List<double>(count);
			for (int i = index; i < index + count; i++)
			{
				RefinedPoint refinedPoint = points[i];
				if (!points[i].IsEmpty)
				{
					list.Add(refinedPoint.Value1);
					list2.Add(refinedPoint.Value2);
					list3.Add(refinedPoint.Value3);
					list4.Add(refinedPoint.Value4);
					state = CorePointState.HasValues;
				}
			}
			if (state == CorePointState.HasValues)
			{
				object nativeArgument = axisXScaleTypeMap.RefinedToInternal(points[0].Argument);
				double[] array = userCalculator.Calculate(nativeArgument, list, list2, list3, list4);
				if (array != null)
				{
					return array;
				}
				state = CorePointState.Empty;
			}
			return AggregationCalculator.CreateArray();
		}

		public UserAggregateFunctionCalculator(AxisScaleTypeMap axisXScaleTypeMap, ICustomAggregateFunction userCalculator)
		{
			this.axisXScaleTypeMap = axisXScaleTypeMap;
			this.userCalculator = userCalculator;
		}
	}
	public class MissingArgumentsCalculator
	{
		private readonly AxisScaleTypeMap axisXScaleMap;

		private readonly ISeries series;

		private readonly int valuesCount;

		private readonly ProcessMissingPointsModeNative processMissingPoints;

		public static MissingArgumentsCalculator Create(AxisScaleTypeMap axisXScaleMap, ISeries series, int valuesCount, ProcessMissingPointsModeNative processMissingPoints)
		{
			if (processMissingPoints != ProcessMissingPointsModeNative.Skip)
			{
				return new MissingArgumentsCalculator(axisXScaleMap, series, valuesCount, processMissingPoints);
			}
			return null;
		}

		private MissingArgumentsCalculator(AxisScaleTypeMap axisXScaleMap, ISeries series, int valuesCount, ProcessMissingPointsModeNative processMissingPoints)
		{
			this.axisXScaleMap = axisXScaleMap;
			this.series = series;
			this.valuesCount = valuesCount;
			this.processMissingPoints = processMissingPoints;
		}

		public RefinedPoint CreatePointForMissingArgument(double internalArgument)
		{
			object argument = axisXScaleMap.InternalToNative(internalArgument);
			double argument2 = axisXScaleMap.InternalToRefined(internalArgument);
			ISeriesPoint point = series.CreateSeriesPoint(series, argument);
			List<double> list = new List<double>();
			for (int i = 0; i < valuesCount; i++)
			{
				list.Add(0.0);
			}
			bool flag = processMissingPoints == ProcessMissingPointsModeNative.InsertEmptyPoints || series.ValueScaleType == Scale.DateTime || series.ValueScaleType == Scale.TimeSpan;
			return ObjectsFactory.Default.Create(point, argument2, list, flag ? CorePointState.Empty : CorePointState.HasValues);
		}
	}
	public struct RefinedPointsCluster3D
	{
		private readonly double argumentX;

		private readonly double argumentY;

		private readonly List<RefinedPoint> clusterPoints;

		public double ArgumentX => argumentX;

		public double ArgumentY => argumentY;

		public List<RefinedPoint> Points => clusterPoints;

		public RefinedPointsCluster3D(double argumentX, double argumentY)
		{
			this.argumentX = argumentX;
			this.argumentY = argumentY;
			clusterPoints = new List<RefinedPoint>();
		}

		public void AddPoint(RefinedPoint point)
		{
			clusterPoints.Add(point);
		}

		public double GetAverageX()
		{
			return clusterPoints.Average((RefinedPoint point) => point.Argument);
		}

		public double GetAverageY()
		{
			return clusterPoints.Average((RefinedPoint point) => point.ArgumentY);
		}
	}
	public class RefinedPointsGridCluster
	{
		private readonly IList<RefinedPoint> points;

		private double cumulativeArgumentX;

		private double cumulativeArgumentY;

		private double cumulativeValue;

		private int nonEmptyPointsCount;

		public double AverageArgumentX => cumulativeArgumentX / (double)nonEmptyPointsCount;

		public double AverageArgumentY => cumulativeArgumentY / (double)nonEmptyPointsCount;

		public double AverageValue => cumulativeValue / (double)nonEmptyPointsCount;

		public double CumulativeValue => cumulativeValue;

		public int NonEmptyPointsCount => nonEmptyPointsCount;

		public IList<RefinedPoint> Points => points;

		public RefinedPointsGridCluster()
		{
			points = new List<RefinedPoint>();
		}

		public void AddPoint(RefinedPoint point)
		{
			points.Add(point);
			if (!point.IsEmpty)
			{
				cumulativeArgumentX += point.Argument;
				cumulativeArgumentY += point.ArgumentY;
				cumulativeValue += point.Value1;
				nonEmptyPointsCount++;
			}
		}
	}
	public interface IPointsFilterOptions
	{
		bool Enable { get; }

		PointsFilterType FilterType { get; }

		double ThresholdValue { get; }

		bool ShowOthers { get; }

		string OthersArgument { get; }
	}
	public class MaxValueFilterBehavior : ValueThresholdFilterBehavior
	{
		protected override IList<RefinedPoint> FilterPoints(IList<RefinedPoint> initialPoints, double thresholdValue)
		{
			IList<RefinedPoint> list = new List<RefinedPoint>();
			for (int i = 0; i < initialPoints.Count; i++)
			{
				if (GetValue(initialPoints[i]) >= thresholdValue && !IsRefinedPointArgumentOthers(initialPoints[i]))
				{
					list.Add(initialPoints[i]);
				}
				else
				{
					AddToOthersPoints(initialPoints[i]);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}
	}
	public class PercentMaxValueFilterBehavior : ValueThresholdFilterBehavior
	{
		protected override IList<RefinedPoint> FilterPoints(IList<RefinedPoint> initialPoints, double thresholdValue)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			for (int i = 0; i < initialPoints.Count; i++)
			{
				num += GetValue(initialPoints[i]);
			}
			double num2 = num * thresholdValue / 100.0;
			IList<RefinedPoint> list = new List<RefinedPoint>();
			for (int j = 0; j < initialPoints.Count; j++)
			{
				if (GetValue(initialPoints[j]) >= num2 && !IsRefinedPointArgumentOthers(initialPoints[j]))
				{
					list.Add(initialPoints[j]);
				}
				else
				{
					AddToOthersPoints(initialPoints[j]);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}
	}

	public class PointsFilterUpdateInfo
	{
		private readonly SortedArgumentRefinedPointCollection points;

		private readonly double firstUpdatedArgument = double.NaN;

		private readonly double lastUpdatedArgument = double.NaN;

		public bool IsRemoveAction { get; }

		public SortedArgumentRefinedPointCollection Points => points;

		public double FirstUpdatedArgument => firstUpdatedArgument;

		public double LastUpdatedArgument => lastUpdatedArgument;

		public PointsFilterUpdateInfo(SortedArgumentRefinedPointCollection points)
		{
			this.points = points;
		}

		public PointsFilterUpdateInfo(SortedArgumentRefinedPointCollection points, double firstUpdatedArgument, double lastUpdatedArgument)
			: this(points)
		{
			this.firstUpdatedArgument = firstUpdatedArgument;
			this.lastUpdatedArgument = lastUpdatedArgument;
		}

		public PointsFilterUpdateInfo(SortedArgumentRefinedPointCollection points, IList<RefinedPoint> affectedPoints, bool isRemoveAction)
			: this(points)
		{
			foreach (RefinedPoint affectedPoint in affectedPoints)
			{
				if (double.IsNaN(firstUpdatedArgument) || firstUpdatedArgument > affectedPoint.Argument)
				{
					firstUpdatedArgument = affectedPoint.Argument;
				}
				if (double.IsNaN(lastUpdatedArgument) || lastUpdatedArgument < affectedPoint.Argument)
				{
					lastUpdatedArgument = affectedPoint.Argument;
				}
			}
			IsRemoveAction = isRemoveAction;
		}
	}
	public abstract class PointsFilter
	{
		private readonly RefinedSeries refinedSeries;

		protected IXYSeriesView XYSeriesView => RefinedSeries.SeriesView as IXYSeriesView;

		protected IAxisData AxisDataX => XYSeriesView?.AxisXData;

		protected IAxisData AxisDataY => XYSeriesView?.AxisYData;

		protected IAxisData AxisDataZ => XYSeriesView?.AxisZData;

		protected RefinedSeries RefinedSeries => refinedSeries;

		public bool Enable { get; protected set; }

		public virtual bool AffectsMapping => false;

		protected PointsFilter(RefinedSeries refinedSeries)
		{
			this.refinedSeries = refinedSeries;
			Update();
		}

		protected abstract IList<RefinedPoint> Recalculate(IList<RefinedPoint> initialPoints);

		protected abstract IList<RefinedPoint> GetCachedPoints();

		public virtual IList<RefinedPoint> GetFilteredPoints(IList<RefinedPoint> initialPoints, bool needProcessNewPoint = false)
		{
			IList<RefinedPoint> cachedPoints = GetCachedPoints();
			if (cachedPoints == null)
			{
				return Recalculate(initialPoints);
			}
			return cachedPoints;
		}

		public abstract void ClearCache();

		public abstract bool Update();

		public abstract PointsFilterUpdateInfo Update(PointsFilterUpdateInfo updateInfo);
	}
	public class PointsProcessor : IPointProcessorProvider
	{
		private class BasePointProcessor : IPointProcessor
		{
			private double GetIndicatorPointValue(IIndicatorDataPoint point, int valueIndex, AxisScaleTypeMap valueMap)
			{
				if (valueMap.ScaleType == ActualScaleTypeCore.Numerical)
				{
					return valueMap.NativeToInternal(point.Values[valueIndex]);
				}
				return double.NaN;
			}

			protected virtual double GetValue(ISeriesPoint seriesPoint, int valueIndex, AxisScaleTypeMap valueMap)
			{
				if (valueMap.ScaleType == ActualScaleTypeCore.DateTime)
				{
					return valueMap.NativeToInternal(seriesPoint.Values.DateTimeValues[valueIndex]);
				}
				if (valueMap.ScaleType == ActualScaleTypeCore.TimeSpan)
				{
					return valueMap.NativeToInternal(seriesPoint.Values.TimeSpanValues[valueIndex]);
				}
				return valueMap.NativeToInternal(seriesPoint.Values.NumericalValues[valueIndex]);
			}

			protected bool CanProcess(IList<AxisScaleTypeMap> argumentMaps, int expectedCount, ISeriesPoint seriesPoint)
			{
				if (seriesPoint == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (argumentMaps.Count < expectedCount)
				{
					return false;
				}
				for (int i = 0; i < argumentMaps.Count; i++)
				{
					if (argumentMaps[i] == null)
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				return true;
			}

			protected bool CanProcess(AxisScaleTypeMap valueMap, IList<AxisScaleTypeMap> argumentMaps, int expectedCount, ISeriesPoint seriesPoint)
			{
				if (seriesPoint == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (argumentMaps.Count < expectedCount)
				{
					return false;
				}
				for (int i = 0; i < argumentMaps.Count; i++)
				{
					if (argumentMaps[i] == null)
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				return valueMap != null;
			}

			protected void ProcessErrorBarPoint(RefinedPoint point, ISeriesPoint seriesPoint, AxisScaleTypeMap argumentMap, AxisScaleTypeMap valueMap)
			{
				if (seriesPoint.IndicatorPoint != null)
				{
					((IArgumentPoint)point).Argument = argumentMap.NativeToRefined(seriesPoint.ArgumentX.UserArgument);
					((IErrorBarPoint)point).LowValue = GetIndicatorPointValue(seriesPoint.IndicatorPoint, 0, valueMap);
					((IErrorBarPoint)point).HighValue = GetIndicatorPointValue(seriesPoint.IndicatorPoint, 1, valueMap);
				}
			}

			public virtual void ProcessPoint(RefinedPoint point, IList<AxisScaleTypeMap> argumentMaps, AxisScaleTypeMap valueMap, bool isEmpty)
			{
			}

			public virtual void ProcessPointValues(RefinedPoint point, AxisScaleTypeMap valueMap, bool isEmpty)
			{
			}

			public virtual void UpdatePointInternalArguments(RefinedPoint point, IList<AxisScaleTypeMap> argumentMaps)
			{
				ISeriesPoint seriesPoint = point.SeriesPoint;
				if (CanProcess(argumentMaps, 1, seriesPoint))
				{
					((IArgumentPoint)point).Argument = argumentMaps[0].SeriesPointToInternal(seriesPoint.ArgumentX);
				}
			}
		}

		private class ValuePointProcessor : BasePointProcessor
		{
			public override void ProcessPoint(RefinedPoint point, IList<AxisScaleTypeMap> argumentMaps, AxisScaleTypeMap valueMap, bool isEmpty)
			{
				ISeriesPoint seriesPoint = point.SeriesPoint;
				if (CanProcess(valueMap, argumentMaps, 1, seriesPoint))
				{
					((IArgumentPoint)point).Argument = argumentMaps[0].SeriesPointToRefined(seriesPoint.ArgumentX);
					if (isEmpty)
					{
						point.MakeEmpty();
					}
					else
					{
						((IValuePoint)point).Value = GetValue(seriesPoint, 0, valueMap);
					}
					ProcessErrorBarPoint(point, seriesPoint, argumentMaps[0], valueMap);
				}
			}
		}

		private class XYPointProcessor : BasePointProcessor
		{
			public override void ProcessPoint(RefinedPoint point, IList<AxisScaleTypeMap> argumentMaps, AxisScaleTypeMap valueMap, bool isEmpty)
			{
				ISeriesPoint seriesPoint = point.SeriesPoint;
				if (CanProcess(valueMap, argumentMaps, 1, seriesPoint))
				{
					((IArgumentPoint)point).Argument = argumentMaps[0].SeriesPointToRefined(seriesPoint.ArgumentX);
					if (isEmpty)
					{
						point.MakeEmpty();
					}
					else
					{
						((IValuePoint)point).Value = GetValue(seriesPoint, 0, valueMap);
					}
					ProcessErrorBarPoint(point, seriesPoint, argumentMaps[0], valueMap);
				}
			}
		}

		private class XYWPointProcessor : BasePointProcessor
		{
			public override void ProcessPoint(RefinedPoint point, IList<AxisScaleTypeMap> argumentMaps, AxisScaleTypeMap valueMap, bool isEmpty)
			{
				ISeriesPoint seriesPoint = point.SeriesPoint;
				if (CanProcess(valueMap, argumentMaps, 1, seriesPoint))
				{
					((IArgumentPoint)point).Argument = argumentMaps[0].SeriesPointToRefined(seriesPoint.ArgumentX);
					if (isEmpty)
					{
						point.MakeEmpty();
					}
					else
					{
						((IValuePoint)point).Value = GetValue(seriesPoint, 0, valueMap);
						((IXYWPoint)point).Weight = GetValue(seriesPoint, 1, valueMap);
					}
					ProcessErrorBarPoint(point, seriesPoint, argumentMaps[0], valueMap);
				}
			}
		}

		private class XYZPointProcessor : BasePointProcessor
		{
			public override void ProcessPoint(RefinedPoint point, IList<AxisScaleTypeMap> argumentMaps, AxisScaleTypeMap valueMap, bool isEmpty)
			{
				ISeriesPoint seriesPoint = point.SeriesPoint;
				if (CanProcess(valueMap, argumentMaps, 2, seriesPoint))
				{
					((IArgumentPoint)point).Argument = argumentMaps[0].SeriesPointToRefined(seriesPoint.ArgumentX);
					((IXYZPoint)point).ArgumentY = argumentMaps[1].SeriesPointToRefined(seriesPoint.ArgumentY);
					((IValuePoint)point).Value = GetValue(seriesPoint, 0, valueMap);
					if (isEmpty)
					{
						point.MakeEmpty();
					}
				}
			}

			public override void UpdatePointInternalArguments(RefinedPoint point, IList<AxisScaleTypeMap> argumentMaps)
			{
				ISeriesPoint seriesPoint = point.SeriesPoint;
				if (CanProcess(argumentMaps, 2, seriesPoint))
				{
					((IArgumentPoint)point).Argument = argumentMaps[0].SeriesPointToInternal(seriesPoint.ArgumentX);
					((IXYZPoint)point).ArgumentY = argumentMaps[0].SeriesPointToInternal(seriesPoint.ArgumentY);
				}
			}

			public override void ProcessPointValues(RefinedPoint point, AxisScaleTypeMap valueMap, bool isEmpty)
			{
				ISeriesPoint seriesPoint = point.SeriesPoint;
				if (valueMap != null && seriesPoint != null)
				{
					if (isEmpty)
					{
						point.MakeEmpty();
					}
					else
					{
						((IValuePoint)point).Value = GetValue(seriesPoint, 0, valueMap);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private class XYZWPointProcessor : BasePointProcessor
		{
			public override void ProcessPoint(RefinedPoint point, IList<AxisScaleTypeMap> argumentMaps, AxisScaleTypeMap valueMap, bool isEmpty)
			{
				ISeriesPoint seriesPoint = point.SeriesPoint;
				if (CanProcess(valueMap, argumentMaps, 2, seriesPoint))
				{
					((IArgumentPoint)point).Argument = argumentMaps[0].SeriesPointToRefined(seriesPoint.ArgumentX);
					((IXYZPoint)point).ArgumentY = argumentMaps[1].SeriesPointToRefined(seriesPoint.ArgumentY);
					if (isEmpty)
					{
						point.MakeEmpty();
						return;
					}
					((IValuePoint)point).Value = GetValue(seriesPoint, 0, valueMap);
					((IXYZWPoint)point).Weight = GetValue(seriesPoint, 1, valueMap);
				}
			}

			public override void UpdatePointInternalArguments(RefinedPoint point, IList<AxisScaleTypeMap> argumentMaps)
			{
				ISeriesPoint seriesPoint = point.SeriesPoint;
				if (CanProcess(argumentMaps, 2, seriesPoint))
				{
					((IArgumentPoint)point).Argument = argumentMaps[0].SeriesPointToInternal(seriesPoint.ArgumentX);
					((IXYZPoint)point).ArgumentY = argumentMaps[0].SeriesPointToInternal(seriesPoint.ArgumentY);
				}
			}

			public override void ProcessPointValues(RefinedPoint point, AxisScaleTypeMap valueMap, bool isEmpty)
			{
				ISeriesPoint seriesPoint = point.SeriesPoint;
				if (valueMap != null && seriesPoint != null)
				{
					if (isEmpty)
					{
						point.MakeEmpty();
						return;
					}
					((IValuePoint)point).Value = GetValue(seriesPoint, 0, valueMap);
					((IXYZWPoint)point).Weight = GetValue(seriesPoint, 1, valueMap);
				}
			}
		}

		private class RangeBarPointProcessor : BasePointProcessor
		{
			public override void ProcessPoint(RefinedPoint point, IList<AxisScaleTypeMap> argumentMaps, AxisScaleTypeMap valueMap, bool isEmpty)
			{
				ISeriesPoint seriesPoint = point.SeriesPoint;
				if (CanProcess(valueMap, argumentMaps, 1, seriesPoint))
				{
					((IArgumentPoint)point).Argument = argumentMaps[0].SeriesPointToRefined(seriesPoint.ArgumentX);
					if (isEmpty)
					{
						point.MakeEmpty();
						return;
					}
					((IRangePoint)point).Value1 = GetValue(seriesPoint, 0, valueMap);
					((IRangePoint)point).Value2 = GetValue(seriesPoint, 1, valueMap);
				}
			}
		}

		private class FinancialPointProcessor : BasePointProcessor
		{
			public override void ProcessPoint(RefinedPoint point, IList<AxisScaleTypeMap> argumentMaps, AxisScaleTypeMap valueMap, bool isEmpty)
			{
				ISeriesPoint seriesPoint = point.SeriesPoint;
				if (CanProcess(valueMap, argumentMaps, 1, seriesPoint))
				{
					((IArgumentPoint)point).Argument = argumentMaps[0].SeriesPointToRefined(seriesPoint.ArgumentX);
					if (isEmpty)
					{
						point.MakeEmpty();
						return;
					}
					((IFinancialPoint)point).Low = GetValue(seriesPoint, 0, valueMap);
					((IFinancialPoint)point).High = GetValue(seriesPoint, 1, valueMap);
					((IFinancialPoint)point).Open = GetValue(seriesPoint, 2, valueMap);
					((IFinancialPoint)point).Close = GetValue(seriesPoint, 3, valueMap);
				}
			}
		}

		private class BoxPlotPointProcessor : BasePointProcessor
		{
			private const int BoxPlotValuesCount = 6;

			private double[] GetOutliersScaleTypeSpecific<T>(T[] values, AxisScaleTypeMap valueMap)
			{
				if (values.Length <= 6)
				{
					return null;
				}
				double[] array = new double[values.Length - 6];
				int num = 6;
				int num2 = 0;
				while (num < values.Length)
				{
					array[num2] = valueMap.NativeToInternal(values[num]);
					num++;
					num2++;
				}
				return array;
			}

			private double[] GetOutliers(ISeriesPoint seriesPoint, AxisScaleTypeMap valueMap)
			{
				return valueMap.ScaleType switch
				{
					ActualScaleTypeCore.DateTime => GetOutliersScaleTypeSpecific(seriesPoint.Values.DateTimeValues, valueMap), 
					ActualScaleTypeCore.TimeSpan => GetOutliersScaleTypeSpecific(seriesPoint.Values.TimeSpanValues, valueMap), 
					ActualScaleTypeCore.Numerical => GetOutliersScaleTypeSpecific(seriesPoint.Values.NumericalValues, valueMap), 
					_ => throw new NotSupportedException(), 
				};
			}

			protected override double GetValue(ISeriesPoint seriesPoint, int valueIndex, AxisScaleTypeMap valueMap)
			{
				switch (valueMap.ScaleType)
				{
				case ActualScaleTypeCore.DateTime:
				{
					DateTime dateTime = seriesPoint.Values.DateTimeValues[valueIndex];
					if (!BoxPlotConventions.IsMissingDateTimeNativeValue(dateTime))
					{
						return valueMap.NativeToInternal(dateTime);
					}
					return BoxPlotConventions.MissingRefinedValue;
				}
				case ActualScaleTypeCore.TimeSpan:
				{
					TimeSpan timeSpan = seriesPoint.Values.TimeSpanValues[valueIndex];
					if (!BoxPlotConventions.IsMissingTimeSpanNativeValue(timeSpan))
					{
						return valueMap.NativeToInternal(timeSpan);
					}
					return BoxPlotConventions.MissingRefinedValue;
				}
				case ActualScaleTypeCore.Numerical:
				{
					double num = seriesPoint.Values.NumericalValues[valueIndex];
					if (!BoxPlotConventions.IsMissingNumericNativeValue(num))
					{
						return valueMap.NativeToInternal(num);
					}
					return BoxPlotConventions.MissingRefinedValue;
				}
				default:
					throw new ArgumentException("Incorrect scale type");
				}
			}

			public override void ProcessPoint(RefinedPoint point, IList<AxisScaleTypeMap> argumentMaps, AxisScaleTypeMap valueMap, bool isEmpty)
			{
				ISeriesPoint seriesPoint = point.SeriesPoint;
				if (!CanProcess(valueMap, argumentMaps, 1, seriesPoint))
				{
					return;
				}
				((IArgumentPoint)point).Argument = argumentMaps[0].SeriesPointToRefined(seriesPoint.ArgumentX);
				if (isEmpty)
				{
					point.MakeEmpty();
					return;
				}
				((IBoxPlotPoint)point).Min = GetValue(seriesPoint, 0, valueMap);
				((IBoxPlotPoint)point).Quartile1 = GetValue(seriesPoint, 1, valueMap);
				((IBoxPlotPoint)point).Median = GetValue(seriesPoint, 2, valueMap);
				((IBoxPlotPoint)point).Quartile3 = GetValue(seriesPoint, 3, valueMap);
				((IBoxPlotPoint)point).Max = GetValue(seriesPoint, 4, valueMap);
				if (seriesPoint.Values.Dimension > 5)
				{
					((IBoxPlotPoint)point).Mean = GetValue(seriesPoint, 5, valueMap);
					((IBoxPlotPoint)point).Outliers = GetOutliers(seriesPoint, valueMap);
				}
				else
				{
					((IBoxPlotPoint)point).Mean = double.NaN;
					((IBoxPlotPoint)point).Outliers = null;
				}
			}
		}

		private readonly CollectionManager realCollections;

		private readonly IList<ScaleCountersCalculatorBase> scaleCalculators;

		private readonly List<PointsFilter> filters = new List<PointsFilter>();

		private readonly RefinedSeries refinedSeries;

		private readonly Dictionary<object, SortedArgumentRefinedPointCollection> sortedPointsCache;

		private CollectionManager randomCollections;

		private BasePointProcessor pointProcessor;

		private RandomPointsState randomPointsState;

		private bool? hasPositivePoint;

		protected ISeries Series => refinedSeries.Series;

		private ISeriesView SeriesView => Series.SeriesView;

		protected RefinedSeries RefinedSeries => refinedSeries;

		internal IList<ScaleCountersCalculatorBase> ScaleCalculators => scaleCalculators;

		internal ArgumentsWithoutGapsInfo ArgumentWithoutGaps
		{
			get
			{
				if (!(filters.FirstOrDefault((PointsFilter x) => x is AggregationPointFilter) is AggregationPointFilter aggregationPointFilter))
				{
					return null;
				}
				return aggregationPointFilter.GetArgumentsWithoutGaps();
			}
		}

		internal List<PointsFilter> ActualFilters => filters;

		public bool NoArgumentScaleTypeX => scaleCalculators[0].NoArgumentScaleType;

		public bool HasPositivePoints
		{
			get
			{
				if (hasPositivePoint.HasValue)
				{
					return hasPositivePoint.Value;
				}
				for (int i = 0; i < refinedSeries.FinalPoints.Count; i++)
				{
					if (((IValuePoint)refinedSeries.Points[i]).Value > 0.0)
					{
						hasPositivePoint = true;
						return hasPositivePoint.Value;
					}
				}
				hasPositivePoint = false;
				return hasPositivePoint.Value;
			}
		}

		public CollectionManager RealCollections => realCollections;

		public CollectionManager RandomCollections
		{
			get
			{
				UpdateRandomPoints();
				return randomCollections;
			}
		}

		public CollectionManager ActualCollectionManager
		{
			get
			{
				if (!RefinedSeries.IsPointsAutoGenerated)
				{
					return RealCollections;
				}
				return RandomCollections;
			}
		}

		public bool IsContainsProcessedPoints
		{
			get
			{
				if (realCollections.Points != null)
				{
					return realCollections.Points.Count > 0;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public bool IsContainsProcessedNotEmptyPoints
		{
			get
			{
				if (realCollections.Points != null)
				{
					foreach (RefinedPoint point in realCollections.Points)
					{
						if (!point.IsEmpty)
						{
							return true;
						}
					}
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		IPointProcessor IPointProcessorProvider.Processor => pointProcessor;

		public PointsProcessor(RefinedSeries refinedSeries)
		{
			this.refinedSeries = refinedSeries;
			realCollections = CreateCollectionManager(refinedSeries);
			sortedPointsCache = new Dictionary<object, SortedArgumentRefinedPointCollection>();
			scaleCalculators = new List<ScaleCountersCalculatorBase>();
			InitScaleCalculators();
			InsurePointProcessor();
			InitFilters();
			InitCollections();
		}

		private void InitScaleCalculators()
		{
			scaleCalculators.Add(new ScaleCountersCalculatorX(refinedSeries.Series));
			if (refinedSeries.Series.IsTwoArgumentsSeries)
			{
				scaleCalculators.Add(new ScaleCountersCalculatorY(refinedSeries.Series));
			}
		}

		private void InitFilters()
		{
			filters.Add(new EmptyPointsFilter(refinedSeries));
			filters.Add(new PointsValueThresholdFilter(refinedSeries, this));
			filters.Add(new WorkPeriodsPointsFilter(refinedSeries));
			if (refinedSeries.Series.IsTwoArgumentsSeries)
			{
				filters.Add(new AggregationPointFilter3D(refinedSeries));
				filters.Add(new PointsCountThresholdFilter(refinedSeries));
			}
			else
			{
				filters.Add(new AggregationPointFilter(refinedSeries));
			}
			if (refinedSeries.SeriesView is IWaterfallSeriesView)
			{
				filters.Add(new WaterfallFilter(refinedSeries, this));
			}
			UpdateFilters();
		}

		private void InitCollections()
		{
			ICollection<IDataPoint> item = Series.ActualPoints ?? new Collection<IDataPoint>();
			realCollections.UpdateCollections(pointProcessor, SeriesPointsCollectionAction.CreateInsertInfo(Series, item, 0));
			UpdateArgumentScale();
		}

		private void ClearCache()
		{
			foreach (PointsFilter filter in filters)
			{
				filter.ClearCache();
			}
			sortedPointsCache.Clear();
		}

		private void UpdateRandomPoints()
		{
			if (randomCollections == null)
			{
				randomCollections = new CollectionManager(refinedSeries);
			}
			RandomPointsState obj = new RandomPointsState(Series);
			if (randomPointsState == null || !randomPointsState.Equals(obj))
			{
				InsurePointProcessor();
				randomPointsState = obj;
				ICollection<IDataPoint> item = null;
				if (Series.SeriesView != null)
				{
					item = Series.SeriesView.GenerateRandomPoints(Series.ArgumentScaleType, Series.ValueScaleType);
				}
				randomCollections.UpdateCollections(pointProcessor, SeriesPointsCollectionAction.CreateCleanInfo(Series));
				randomCollections.UpdateCollections(pointProcessor, SeriesPointsCollectionAction.CreateInsertInfo(Series, item, 0));
			}
		}

		private void InsurePointProcessor()
		{
			if (SeriesView != null)
			{
				Type pointInterfaceType = SeriesView.PointInterfaceType;
				if (pointInterfaceType == typeof(IValuePoint))
				{
					pointProcessor = new ValuePointProcessor();
				}
				else if (pointInterfaceType == typeof(IXYPoint) || pointInterfaceType == typeof(IStackedPoint) || pointInterfaceType == typeof(IFullStackedPoint))
				{
					pointProcessor = new XYPointProcessor();
				}
				else if (pointInterfaceType == typeof(IXYWPoint))
				{
					pointProcessor = new XYWPointProcessor();
				}
				else if (pointInterfaceType == typeof(IXYZPoint))
				{
					pointProcessor = new XYZPointProcessor();
				}
				else if (pointInterfaceType == typeof(IXYZWPoint))
				{
					pointProcessor = new XYZWPointProcessor();
				}
				else if (pointInterfaceType == typeof(IRangePoint))
				{
					pointProcessor = new RangeBarPointProcessor();
				}
				else if (pointInterfaceType == typeof(IFinancialPoint))
				{
					pointProcessor = new FinancialPointProcessor();
				}
				else if (pointInterfaceType == typeof(IBoxPlotPoint))
				{
					pointProcessor = new BoxPlotPointProcessor();
				}
			}
			else
			{
				pointProcessor = null;
			}
		}

		private SortedArgumentRefinedPointCollection GetSortedByArgumentPoints(IList<RefinedPoint> intermediate)
		{
			SortedArgumentRefinedPointCollection sortedArgumentRefinedPointCollection;
			if (!sortedPointsCache.ContainsKey(intermediate))
			{
				sortedArgumentRefinedPointCollection = intermediate as SortedArgumentRefinedPointCollection;
				if (sortedArgumentRefinedPointCollection == null)
				{
					sortedArgumentRefinedPointCollection = new SortedArgumentRefinedPointCollection(intermediate.Count, new RefinedPointsArgumentAndIndexComparer());
					bool flag = (Series as IPointsFilterOptions)?.Enable ?? false;
					sortedArgumentRefinedPointCollection.AddRange(intermediate, !refinedSeries.Series.ArePointsSorted || flag);
				}
				sortedPointsCache.Add(intermediate, sortedArgumentRefinedPointCollection);
			}
			else
			{
				sortedArgumentRefinedPointCollection = sortedPointsCache[intermediate];
			}
			return sortedArgumentRefinedPointCollection;
		}

		private PointsFilterUpdateInfo UpdateFilters(SortedArgumentRefinedPointCollection initialPoints, RefinedSeriesPointsUpdateInfo updateInfo)
		{
			PointsFilterUpdateInfo pointsFilterUpdateInfo = new PointsFilterUpdateInfo(initialPoints, updateInfo.AffectedPoints, updateInfo.Operation == ChartCollectionOperation.RemoveItem);
			if (pointsFilterUpdateInfo != null)
			{
				foreach (PointsFilter filter in filters)
				{
					if (filter.Enable)
					{
						pointsFilterUpdateInfo = filter.Update(pointsFilterUpdateInfo);
						if (pointsFilterUpdateInfo == null)
						{
							return null;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return pointsFilterUpdateInfo;
		}

		protected virtual IList<RefinedPoint> GetInitialPoints(bool needProcessNewPoint)
		{
			IList<RefinedPoint> list = refinedSeries.PointsSortedBySettings;
			foreach (PointsFilter filter in filters)
			{
				if (filter.Enable && filter.AffectsMapping)
				{
					list = filter.GetFilteredPoints(list, needProcessNewPoint);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected virtual CollectionManager CreateCollectionManager(RefinedSeries refinedSeries)
		{
			return new CollectionManager(refinedSeries);
		}

		internal void UpdateArgumentScale()
		{
			foreach (ScaleCountersCalculatorBase scaleCalculator in scaleCalculators)
			{
				scaleCalculator.UpdateScaleCounters(realCollections.Points);
				scaleCalculator.DetectScale();
			}
		}

		internal bool IsFilterEnabled()
		{
			foreach (PointsFilter filter in filters)
			{
				if (filter.Enable)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void DetectScale()
		{
			foreach (ScaleCountersCalculatorBase scaleCalculator in scaleCalculators)
			{
				scaleCalculator.DetectScale();
			}
		}

		internal void Invalidate()
		{
			hasPositivePoint = null;
			ClearCache();
		}

		internal virtual RefinedSeriesPointsUpdateInfo UpdatePoints(SeriesPointsCollectionAction updateAction)
		{
			InsurePointProcessor();
			RefinedSeriesPointsUpdateInfo refinedSeriesPointsUpdateInfo = realCollections.UpdateCollections(pointProcessor, updateAction);
			if (refinedSeriesPointsUpdateInfo != null)
			{
				foreach (ScaleCountersCalculatorBase scaleCalculator in scaleCalculators)
				{
					scaleCalculator.UpdateScaleCounters(realCollections.Points, refinedSeriesPointsUpdateInfo);
					scaleCalculator.DetectScale();
				}
			}
			if (refinedSeriesPointsUpdateInfo != null && refinedSeriesPointsUpdateInfo.AffectedPoints != null && UpdateFilters(realCollections.PointsSortedByArgument, refinedSeriesPointsUpdateInfo) != null)
			{
				sortedPointsCache.Clear();
			}
			else
			{
				Invalidate();
			}
			return refinedSeriesPointsUpdateInfo;
		}

		internal ICollection<RefinedSeriesPointsUpdateInfo> UpdatePoint(IDataPoint seriesPoint)
		{
			InsurePointProcessor();
			List<AxisScaleTypeMap> argumentScaleMaps = refinedSeries.GetArgumentScaleMaps();
			ICollection<RefinedSeriesPointsUpdateInfo> collection = realCollections.UpdatePoint(pointProcessor, seriesPoint, argumentScaleMaps);
			if (collection != null)
			{
				foreach (ScaleCountersCalculatorBase scaleCalculator in scaleCalculators)
				{
					scaleCalculator.UpdateScaleCounters(realCollections.Points, collection);
					scaleCalculator.DetectScale();
				}
				Invalidate();
			}
			return collection;
		}

		internal void ReplacePoint(IDataPoint seriesPoint, int indexInCollection)
		{
			realCollections.ReplacePoint(seriesPoint, indexInCollection);
		}

		public IList<RefinedPoint> GetPointsForMap()
		{
			foreach (PointsFilter filter in filters)
			{
				if (filter.AffectsMapping)
				{
					filter.Update();
				}
			}
			return GetInitialPoints(needProcessNewPoint: false);
		}

		public virtual IList<RefinedPoint> GetProcessedPoints()
		{
			UpdateFilters();
			IList<RefinedPoint> initialPoints = GetInitialPoints(needProcessNewPoint: true);
			IList<RefinedPoint> list = initialPoints;
			if (list != null)
			{
				foreach (PointsFilter filter in filters)
				{
					if (filter.Enable)
					{
						IList<RefinedPoint> initialPoints2 = ((list != initialPoints) ? GetSortedByArgumentPoints(list) : refinedSeries.PointsSortedByArgument);
						list = filter.GetFilteredPoints(initialPoints2);
					}
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		public SortedArgumentRefinedPointCollection GetSortedProcessedPoints()
		{
			IList<RefinedPoint> processedPoints = GetProcessedPoints();
			if (processedPoints == refinedSeries.PointsSortedBySettings)
			{
				return refinedSeries.PointsSortedByArgument;
			}
			return GetSortedByArgumentPoints(processedPoints);
		}

		public virtual void UpdateData()
		{
			InsurePointProcessor();
			realCollections.ProcessPoints(pointProcessor);
			if (RefinedSeries.IsPointsAutoGenerated)
			{
				RandomCollections.ProcessPoints(pointProcessor);
			}
			Invalidate();
		}

		public void UpdateValues()
		{
			realCollections.ProcessPointsValues(pointProcessor);
		}

		public bool UpdateFilters()
		{
			bool flag = false;
			foreach (PointsFilter filter in filters)
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					filter.ClearCache();
					filter.Update();
				}
				else
				{
					flag |= filter.Update();
				}
			}
			return flag;
		}

		public void ProcessSortingPointKeyUpdate(SeriesPointKeyNative newSortingKey, SortMode pointsSortingMode)
		{
			realCollections.ProcessSortingPointKeyUpdate(newSortingKey, pointsSortingMode);
			if (RefinedSeries.IsPointsAutoGenerated)
			{
				RandomCollections.ProcessSortingPointKeyUpdate(newSortingKey, pointsSortingMode);
			}
			Invalidate();
		}

		public void ProcessSortingPointModeUpdate(SortMode newSortingMode, SeriesPointKeyNative sortingKey)
		{
			realCollections.ProcessSortingPointModeUpdate(newSortingMode, sortingKey);
			if (RefinedSeries.IsPointsAutoGenerated)
			{
				RandomCollections.ProcessSortingPointModeUpdate(newSortingMode, sortingKey);
			}
			Invalidate();
		}

		public void UpdatePointsInternalArguments(IList<RefinedPoint> points)
		{
			List<AxisScaleTypeMap> argumentScaleMaps = refinedSeries.GetArgumentScaleMaps();
			for (int i = 0; i < points.Count; i++)
			{
				pointProcessor.UpdatePointInternalArguments(points[i], argumentScaleMaps);
			}
		}
	}
	public interface IPointProcessor
	{
		void ProcessPoint(RefinedPoint point, IList<AxisScaleTypeMap> argumentMaps, AxisScaleTypeMap valueMap, bool isEmpty);

		void UpdatePointInternalArguments(RefinedPoint point, IList<AxisScaleTypeMap> argumentMaps);

		void ProcessPointValues(RefinedPoint point, AxisScaleTypeMap valueMap, bool isEmpty);
	}
	public abstract class ValueThresholdFilterBehavior
	{
		private readonly IList<RefinedPoint> othersPoints = new List<RefinedPoint>();

		private IList<RefinedPoint> filteredPoints;

		private string otherArgument;

		private bool showOthers;

		public IList<RefinedPoint> FilteredPoints => filteredPoints;

		public IList<RefinedPoint> OthersPoints => othersPoints;

		public void Calculate(IList<RefinedPoint> initialPoints, double valueThreshold, string otherArgument, bool showOthers)
		{
			this.showOthers = showOthers;
			this.otherArgument = otherArgument;
			othersPoints.Clear();
			filteredPoints = FilterPoints(initialPoints, valueThreshold);
		}

		protected abstract IList<RefinedPoint> FilterPoints(IList<RefinedPoint> initialPoints, double valueThreshold);

		protected double GetValue(RefinedPoint point)
		{
			return Math.Abs(point.GetNumericalValue(0));
		}

		protected void AddToOthersPoints(RefinedPoint point)
		{
			othersPoints.Add(point);
		}

		protected bool IsRefinedPointArgumentOthers(RefinedPoint point)
		{
			if (showOthers)
			{
				return point.SeriesPoint?.ArgumentX.UserArgument.ToString() == otherArgument;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	public class PointsValueThresholdFilter : PointsFilter
	{
		private readonly IPointProcessorProvider processorProvider;

		private IList<RefinedPoint> filteredPoints;

		private AggregatedSeriesPoint othersSeriesPoint;

		private RefinedPoint othersPoint;

		private double ThresholdValue { get; set; }

		private bool ShowOthers { get; set; }

		private string OthersArgument { get; set; }

		private PointsFilterType FilterType { get; set; }

		public override bool AffectsMapping => true;

		public PointsValueThresholdFilter(RefinedSeries series, IPointProcessorProvider processorProvider)
			: base(series)
		{
			this.processorProvider = processorProvider;
		}

		private void UpdateOthersPoint()
		{
			if (ShowOthers && othersPoint != null)
			{
				filteredPoints.Remove(othersPoint);
			}
			if (othersSeriesPoint != null)
			{
				othersSeriesPoint.ArgumentX.Argument = OthersArgument;
				othersPoint = ObjectsFactory.Default.Create(othersSeriesPoint, filteredPoints.Count, othersSeriesPoint.Values.NumericalValues[0]);
			}
			else
			{
				othersPoint = null;
			}
			if (ShowOthers && othersPoint != null)
			{
				filteredPoints.Add(othersPoint);
			}
		}

		private ValueThresholdFilterBehavior CreateBehavior()
		{
			return FilterType switch
			{
				PointsFilterType.TopN => new TopNFilterBehavior(), 
				PointsFilterType.MoreOrEqualValue => new MaxValueFilterBehavior(), 
				PointsFilterType.MoreOrEqualPercentValue => new PercentMaxValueFilterBehavior(), 
				_ => new TopNFilterBehavior(), 
			};
		}

		private IPointsFilterOptions GetOptions()
		{
			return base.RefinedSeries.Series as IPointsFilterOptions;
		}

		private IList<RefinedPoint> FilterPoints(IList<RefinedPoint> initialPoints)
		{
			othersPoint = null;
			ValueThresholdFilterBehavior valueThresholdFilterBehavior = CreateBehavior();
			valueThresholdFilterBehavior.Calculate(initialPoints, ThresholdValue, OthersArgument, ShowOthers);
			if (valueThresholdFilterBehavior.OthersPoints.Count > 0)
			{
				double[] array = CalculateSum(valueThresholdFilterBehavior.OthersPoints);
				if (array.Length != 0)
				{
					othersSeriesPoint = new AggregatedSeriesPoint(base.RefinedSeries, Scale.Qualitative, OthersArgument, array, valueThresholdFilterBehavior.OthersPoints, 0, valueThresholdFilterBehavior.OthersPoints.Count, CorePointState.HasValues, isAuxiliary: true);
				}
			}
			return valueThresholdFilterBehavior.FilteredPoints;
		}

		private double[] CalculateSum(IList<RefinedPoint> list)
		{
			double[] array = new double[4];
			foreach (RefinedPoint item in list)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
				{
					if (i < item.ValuesDimension)
					{
						array[i] += item.GetNumericalValue(i);
					}
					else
					{
						array[i] += double.NaN;
					}
				}
			}
			return array;
		}

		private void ProcessOthersPoint(IPointProcessor processor, List<AxisScaleTypeMap> argumentMaps, AxisScaleTypeMap valueMap)
		{
			if (processor != null && othersPoint != null)
			{
				processor.ProcessPoint(othersPoint, argumentMaps, valueMap, othersPoint.IsEmpty);
			}
		}

		protected override IList<RefinedPoint> Recalculate(IList<RefinedPoint> initialPoints)
		{
			if (initialPoints != null)
			{
				filteredPoints = FilterPoints(initialPoints);
				UpdateOthersPoint();
			}
			return filteredPoints;
		}

		protected override IList<RefinedPoint> GetCachedPoints()
		{
			return filteredPoints;
		}

		public override void ClearCache()
		{
			filteredPoints = null;
			othersPoint = null;
			othersSeriesPoint = null;
		}

		public override bool Update()
		{
			bool result = false;
			IPointsFilterOptions options = GetOptions();
			bool flag = options?.Enable ?? false;
			if (base.Enable != flag)
			{
				base.Enable = flag;
				ClearCache();
				result = true;
			}
			else if (base.Enable)
			{
				if (options.ShowOthers != ShowOthers)
				{
					ShowOthers = options.ShowOthers;
					if (filteredPoints != null && othersPoint != null)
					{
						if (ShowOthers)
						{
							filteredPoints.Add(othersPoint);
						}
						else
						{
							filteredPoints.Remove(othersPoint);
						}
					}
					result = true;
				}
				if (options.OthersArgument != OthersArgument)
				{
					OthersArgument = options.OthersArgument;
					UpdateOthersPoint();
					result = true;
				}
				if (options.ThresholdValue != ThresholdValue || options.FilterType != FilterType)
				{
					ThresholdValue = options.ThresholdValue;
					FilterType = options.FilterType;
					ClearCache();
					result = true;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		public override PointsFilterUpdateInfo Update(PointsFilterUpdateInfo updateInfo)
		{
			return null;
		}

		public override IList<RefinedPoint> GetFilteredPoints(IList<RefinedPoint> initialPoints, bool needProcessNewPoint = false)
		{
			IList<RefinedPoint> result = base.GetFilteredPoints(initialPoints, needProcessNewPoint);
			if (needProcessNewPoint)
			{
				List<AxisScaleTypeMap> argumentScaleMaps = base.RefinedSeries.GetArgumentScaleMaps();
				AxisScaleTypeMap valueMap = ((base.RefinedSeries.ValueGroup != null) ? base.RefinedSeries.ValueGroup.ScaleMap : null);
				ProcessOthersPoint(processorProvider.Processor, argumentScaleMaps, valueMap);
			}
			return result;
		}
	}
	public abstract class ScaleCountersCalculatorBase
	{
		private readonly ISeries series;

		private readonly Dictionary<Scale, int> scaleCounters = new Dictionary<Scale, int>();

		private bool noArgumentScaleType;

		protected abstract AxisGroup AxisGroup { get; }

		protected abstract Scale UserScaleType { get; }

		protected ISeries Series => series;

		public bool NoArgumentScaleType => noArgumentScaleType;

		public Dictionary<Scale, int> ScaleCounters => scaleCounters;

		protected ScaleCountersCalculatorBase(ISeries series)
		{
			this.series = series;
			ResetScaleCounters();
		}

		private void ResetScaleCounters()
		{
			foreach (Scale value in Enum.GetValues(typeof(Scale)))
			{
				scaleCounters[value] = 0;
			}
		}

		private Scale DetectScaleWithCounters(Dictionary<Scale, int> counter, Scale initialScale)
		{
			if (initialScale == Scale.Auto)
			{
				if (counter[Scale.Qualitative] != 0 || (counter[Scale.DateTime] != 0 && counter[Scale.Numerical] != 0) || (counter[Scale.TimeSpan] != 0 && counter[Scale.Numerical] != 0) || (counter[Scale.DateTime] != 0 && counter[Scale.TimeSpan] != 0))
				{
					return Scale.Qualitative;
				}
				if (counter[Scale.DateTime] != 0)
				{
					return Scale.DateTime;
				}
				if (counter[Scale.Numerical] != 0)
				{
					return Scale.Numerical;
				}
				if (counter[Scale.TimeSpan] != 0)
				{
					return Scale.TimeSpan;
				}
				return Scale.Auto;
			}
			return initialScale;
		}

		protected bool CountScaleCounter(Scale scale, int value)
		{
			bool flag = true;
			foreach (Scale key in ScaleCounters.Keys)
			{
				if (key != scale && ScaleCounters[key] != 0)
				{
					flag = false;
					break;
				}
			}
			if (value > 0 || flag)
			{
				ScaleCounters[scale] += value;
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected abstract bool CountScaleCounter(RefinedPoint point, int value);

		public void UpdateScaleCounters(RefinedPointCollectionBase points)
		{
			ResetScaleCounters();
			for (int i = 0; i < points.Count; i++)
			{
				CountScaleCounter(points[i], 1);
			}
		}

		public void UpdateScaleCounters(RefinedPointCollectionBase points, RefinedSeriesPointsUpdateInfo pointsUpdateInfo)
		{
			switch (pointsUpdateInfo.Operation)
			{
			case ChartCollectionOperation.Reset:
				ResetScaleCounters();
				break;
			case ChartCollectionOperation.InsertItem:
			{
				RefinedPoint[] affectedPoints = pointsUpdateInfo.AffectedPoints;
				for (int j = 0; j < affectedPoints.Length; j++)
				{
					CountScaleCounter(affectedPoints[j], 1);
				}
				break;
			}
			case ChartCollectionOperation.RemoveItem:
			{
				RefinedPoint[] affectedPoints = pointsUpdateInfo.AffectedPoints;
				for (int i = 0; i < affectedPoints.Length; i++)
				{
					if (!CountScaleCounter(affectedPoints[i], -1))
					{
						UpdateScaleCounters(points);
						break;
					}
				}
				break;
			}
			}
		}

		public void UpdateScaleCounters(RefinedPointCollectionBase points, ICollection<RefinedSeriesPointsUpdateInfo> updates)
		{
			foreach (RefinedSeriesPointsUpdateInfo update in updates)
			{
				switch (update.Operation)
				{
				case ChartCollectionOperation.Reset:
					ResetScaleCounters();
					break;
				case ChartCollectionOperation.InsertItem:
				{
					RefinedPoint[] affectedPoints = update.AffectedPoints;
					for (int j = 0; j < affectedPoints.Length; j++)
					{
						CountScaleCounter(affectedPoints[j], 1);
					}
					break;
				}
				case ChartCollectionOperation.RemoveItem:
				{
					RefinedPoint[] affectedPoints = update.AffectedPoints;
					for (int i = 0; i < affectedPoints.Length; i++)
					{
						if (!CountScaleCounter(affectedPoints[i], -1))
						{
							UpdateScaleCounters(points);
							return;
						}
					}
					break;
				}
				}
			}
		}

		public void DetectScale()
		{
			noArgumentScaleType = false;
			Scale scale = UserScaleType;
			if (scale == Scale.Auto)
			{
				scale = DetectScaleWithCounters(scaleCounters, scale);
				if (scale == Scale.Auto)
				{
					scale = Scale.Numerical;
					noArgumentScaleType = true;
				}
			}
			series.SetArgumentScaleType(scale, AxisGroup);
		}
	}

		}

	public class WorkPeriodsPointsFilter : PointsFilter
	{
		private readonly List<DateTime> holidays = new List<DateTime>();

		private readonly List<DateTime> exactWorkdays = new List<DateTime>();

		private WeekdayCore workdays;

		private SortedArgumentRefinedPointCollection filteredPoints;

		private WorkTimeRuleSetCore workTimeRuleSet;

		private static int GetPointIndex(SortedArgumentRefinedPointCollection points, double argument, bool isFirst)
		{
			RefinedPoint item = ObjectsFactory.Default.Create(argument, 0.0);
			int num = points.BinarySearch(item);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				num = ~num;
			}
			if (num < points.Count)
			{
				if (isFirst)
				{
					argument = points[num].Argument;
					int num2 = num - 1;
					while (num2 >= 0 && points[num2].Argument == argument)
					{
						num = num2;
						num2--;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					argument = points[num].Argument;
					for (int i = num + 1; i < points.Count && points[i].Argument == argument; i++)
					{
						num = i;
					}
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		private static int GetInitialPointIndex(PointsFilterUpdateInfo updateInfo, double argument)
		{
			RefinedPoint item = ObjectsFactory.Default.Create(argument, 0.0);
			int num = updateInfo.Points.BinarySearch(item);
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				return num;
			}
			return ~num;
		}

		public WorkPeriodsPointsFilter(RefinedSeries refinedSeries)
			: base(refinedSeries)
		{
		}

		private bool IsEnabled(IAxisData axisData)
		{
			if (base.RefinedSeries.ArgumentScaleType == ActualScaleTypeCore.DateTime)
			{
				bool flag = GetWorkdaysOptions(axisData)?.WorkdaysOnly ?? false;
				IWorkTimeRuleCollection workTimeRules = GetWorkTimeRules(axisData);
				bool flag2 = workTimeRules != null && workTimeRules.Count > 0 && workTimeRules.WorkTimeOnly;
				return flag || flag2;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool IsHoliday(DateTime dateTime)
		{
			bool result = false;
			switch (dateTime.DayOfWeek)
			{
			case DayOfWeek.Sunday:
				if ((workdays & WeekdayCore.Sunday) == 0)
				{
					result = true;
				}
				break;
			case DayOfWeek.Monday:
				if ((workdays & WeekdayCore.Monday) == 0)
				{
					result = true;
				}
				break;
			case DayOfWeek.Tuesday:
				if ((workdays & WeekdayCore.Tuesday) == 0)
				{
					result = true;
				}
				break;
			case DayOfWeek.Wednesday:
				if ((workdays & WeekdayCore.Wednesday) == 0)
				{
					result = true;
				}
				break;
			case DayOfWeek.Thursday:
				if ((workdays & WeekdayCore.Thursday) == 0)
				{
					result = true;
				}
				break;
			case DayOfWeek.Friday:
				if ((workdays & WeekdayCore.Friday) == 0)
				{
					result = true;
				}
				break;
			case DayOfWeek.Saturday:
				if ((workdays & WeekdayCore.Saturday) == 0)
				{
					result = true;
				}
				break;
			}
			foreach (DateTime holiday in holidays)
			{
				if (dateTime.Date == holiday.Date)
				{
					result = true;
					break;
				}
			}
			foreach (DateTime exactWorkday in exactWorkdays)
			{
				if (dateTime.Date == exactWorkday.Date)
				{
					result = false;
					break;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private bool InExcludedTimeInterval(DateTime dateTime)
		{
			if (workTimeRuleSet == null || !workTimeRuleSet.Enabled)
			{
				return false;
			}
			TimeIntervalSetCore timeIntervalSetCore = ((!workTimeRuleSet.CustomDateExists(dateTime)) ? workTimeRuleSet[dateTime.DayOfWeek] : workTimeRuleSet[dateTime.Date]);
			TimeCore time = new TimeCore(dateTime);
			if (timeIntervalSetCore != null)
			{
				return timeIntervalSetCore.Contains(time);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private IWorkdaysOptions GetWorkdaysOptions(IAxisData axisData)
		{
			return axisData?.DateTimeScaleOptions.WorkdaysOptions;
		}

		private IWorkTimeRuleCollection GetWorkTimeRules(IAxisData axisData)
		{
			return axisData?.DateTimeScaleOptions.WorkTimeRules;
		}

		private SortedArgumentRefinedPointCollection FilterPoints(SortedArgumentRefinedPointCollection initialPoints)
		{
			if (initialPoints != null && IsEnabled(base.AxisDataX))
			{
				SortedArgumentRefinedPointCollection sortedArgumentRefinedPointCollection = new SortedArgumentRefinedPointCollection(initialPoints.Count, new RefinedPointsArgumentComparer());
				for (int i = 0; i < initialPoints.Count; i++)
				{
					RefinedPoint refinedPoint = initialPoints[i];
					DateTime dateTimeArgument = refinedPoint.DateTimeArgument;
					if (workTimeRuleSet == null || !workTimeRuleSet.Enabled)
					{
						if (!IsHoliday(dateTimeArgument))
						{
							sortedArgumentRefinedPointCollection.Add(refinedPoint);
						}
					}
					else if (!InExcludedTimeInterval(dateTimeArgument))
					{
						sortedArgumentRefinedPointCollection.Add(refinedPoint);
					}
				}
				return sortedArgumentRefinedPointCollection;
			}
			return initialPoints;
		}

		protected override IList<RefinedPoint> Recalculate(IList<RefinedPoint> initialPoints)
		{
			if (initialPoints != null)
			{
				SortedArgumentRefinedPointCollection sortedArgumentRefinedPointCollection = initialPoints as SortedArgumentRefinedPointCollection;
				if (sortedArgumentRefinedPointCollection == null)
				{
					sortedArgumentRefinedPointCollection = new SortedArgumentRefinedPointCollection(initialPoints.Count, new RefinedPointsArgumentComparer());
					sortedArgumentRefinedPointCollection.AddRange(initialPoints, !base.RefinedSeries.Series.DataSourceSorted);
				}
				if (sortedArgumentRefinedPointCollection != null)
				{
					filteredPoints = FilterPoints(sortedArgumentRefinedPointCollection);
				}
			}
			return filteredPoints;
		}

		protected override IList<RefinedPoint> GetCachedPoints()
		{
			return filteredPoints;
		}

		public override bool Update()
		{
			bool flag = false;
			IAxisData axisDataX = base.AxisDataX;
			if (base.Enable != IsEnabled(axisDataX))
			{
				base.Enable = IsEnabled(axisDataX);
				flag = true;
			}
			if (base.Enable)
			{
				IWorkdaysOptions workdaysOptions = GetWorkdaysOptions(axisDataX);
				if (workdays != workdaysOptions.Workdays)
				{
					workdays = workdaysOptions.Workdays;
					flag = true;
				}
				if (!workdaysOptions.Holidays.SequenceEqual(holidays))
				{
					holidays.Clear();
					foreach (DateTime holiday in workdaysOptions.Holidays)
					{
						holidays.Add(holiday);
					}
					flag = true;
				}
				if (!workdaysOptions.ExactWorkdays.SequenceEqual(exactWorkdays))
				{
					exactWorkdays.Clear();
					foreach (DateTime exactWorkday in workdaysOptions.ExactWorkdays)
					{
						exactWorkdays.Add(exactWorkday);
					}
					flag = true;
				}
				IWorkTimeRuleCollection workTimeRules = GetWorkTimeRules(axisDataX);
				WorkTimeRuleSetCore workTimeRuleSetCore = new WorkTimeRuleSetCore(workTimeRules, workdaysOptions);
				if (workTimeRuleSet != workTimeRuleSetCore)
				{
					workTimeRuleSet = workTimeRuleSetCore;
					flag = true;
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				ClearCache();
			}
			return flag;
		}

		public override PointsFilterUpdateInfo Update(PointsFilterUpdateInfo updateInfo)
		{
			if (filteredPoints == null || filteredPoints.Count == 0 || updateInfo.Points == null || updateInfo.Points.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(updateInfo.FirstUpdatedArgument) || double.IsNaN(updateInfo.LastUpdatedArgument))
			{
				return new PointsFilterUpdateInfo(filteredPoints);
			}
			int pointIndex = GetPointIndex(filteredPoints, updateInfo.FirstUpdatedArgument, isFirst: true);
			int pointIndex2 = GetPointIndex(filteredPoints, updateInfo.LastUpdatedArgument, isFirst: false);
			double num = updateInfo.FirstUpdatedArgument;
			double num2 = updateInfo.LastUpdatedArgument;
			if (pointIndex < filteredPoints.Count)
			{
				pointIndex2 = Math.Min(filteredPoints.Count - 1, pointIndex2 + 1);
				num = Math.Min(num, filteredPoints[pointIndex].Argument);
				num2 = Math.Max(num2, filteredPoints[pointIndex2].Argument);
				filteredPoints.RemoveRange(pointIndex, pointIndex2 - pointIndex + 1);
			}
			int initialPointIndex = GetInitialPointIndex(updateInfo, num);
			int initialPointIndex2 = GetInitialPointIndex(updateInfo, num2);
			SortedArgumentRefinedPointCollection sortedArgumentRefinedPointCollection = new SortedArgumentRefinedPointCollection(initialPointIndex2 - initialPointIndex + 1, new RefinedPointsArgumentComparer());
			if (initialPointIndex < updateInfo.Points.Count)
			{
				for (int i = initialPointIndex; i < Math.Min(updateInfo.Points.Count, initialPointIndex2 + 1); i++)
				{
					sortedArgumentRefinedPointCollection.Add(updateInfo.Points[i]);
				}
			}
			IList<RefinedPoint> list = FilterPoints(sortedArgumentRefinedPointCollection);
			if (list.Count > 0)
			{
				filteredPoints.InsertRangeWithoutTesting(list);
			}
			return new PointsFilterUpdateInfo(filteredPoints, num, num2);
		}

		public override void ClearCache()
		{
			filteredPoints = null;
		}
	}
	public class GridClusterPointsFactory
	{
		private readonly RefinedSeries refinedSeries;

		private readonly AxisScaleTypeMap scaleMapArgumentX;

		private readonly AxisScaleTypeMap scaleMapArgumentY;

		public GridClusterPointsFactory(RefinedSeries refinedSeries, AxisScaleTypeMap scaleMapArgumentX, AxisScaleTypeMap scaleMapArgumentY)
		{
			this.refinedSeries = refinedSeries;
			this.scaleMapArgumentX = scaleMapArgumentX;
			this.scaleMapArgumentY = scaleMapArgumentY;
		}

		public RefinedPoint CreateAggregatedPoint(double argumentX, double argumentY, double value, IList<RefinedPoint> sourcePoints)
		{
			Scale argumentScaleTypeX = DataItemsHelper.ConvertToScale(refinedSeries.ArgumentScaleType);
			Scale argumentScaleTypeY = DataItemsHelper.ConvertToScale(refinedSeries.ArgumentScaleType2);
			object argumentX2 = scaleMapArgumentX.RefinedToNative(argumentX);
			object argumentY2 = scaleMapArgumentY.RefinedToNative(argumentY);
			double[] values = new double[1] { value };
			CorePointState state = ((!GeometricUtils.IsValidDouble(value)) ? CorePointState.Empty : CorePointState.HasValues);
			AggregatedSeriesPoint point = new AggregatedSeriesPoint(refinedSeries, argumentScaleTypeX, argumentScaleTypeY, argumentX2, argumentY2, values, sourcePoints, 0, sourcePoints.Count, state);
			return ObjectsFactory.Default.Create(point, argumentX, argumentY, values, state);
		}
	}
	public abstract class GridPointsCalculatorBase
	{
		private readonly GridClusterPointsFactory pointFactory;

		private RefinedPointsGridCluster[,] clusters;

		private MinMaxValues rangeX;

		private MinMaxValues rangeY;

		private double stepX = 1.0;

		private double stepY = 1.0;

		private int countX;

		private int countY;

		protected GridClusterPointsFactory PointFactory => pointFactory;

		protected double MinX => rangeX.Min;

		protected double MinY => rangeY.Min;

		protected double StepX => stepX;

		protected double StepY => stepY;

		protected internal int ClusterSizeX => countX;

		protected internal int ClusterSizeY => countY;

		protected internal RefinedPointsGridCluster[,] Clusters => clusters;

		protected GridPointsCalculatorBase(GridClusterPointsFactory factory)
		{
			pointFactory = factory;
		}

		private MinMaxValues GetRangeX(IList<RefinedPoint> points)
		{
			return new MinMaxValues(points[0].Argument, points[points.Count - 1].Argument);
		}

		private MinMaxValues GetRangeY(IList<RefinedPoint> points)
		{
			double num = double.MaxValue;
			double num2 = double.MinValue;
			foreach (RefinedPoint point in points)
			{
				num = Math.Min(num, point.ArgumentY);
				num2 = Math.Max(num2, point.ArgumentY);
			}
			return new MinMaxValues(num, num2);
		}

		private int CorrectGridNodesCount(int realCount, int thresholdCount)
		{
			if (thresholdCount <= 0 || thresholdCount > realCount)
			{
				return realCount;
			}
			return thresholdCount;
		}

		private void UpdateMetrics(IList<RefinedPoint> points, int gridNodesCount)
		{
			rangeX = GetRangeX(points);
			rangeY = GetRangeY(points);
			if (rangeX.Delta == 0.0 && rangeY.Delta == 0.0)
			{
				countX = (countY = 0);
			}
			else if (rangeX.Delta == 0.0)
			{
				countX = 1;
				stepX = 1.0;
				countY = gridNodesCount;
				stepY = rangeY.Delta / (double)countY;
			}
			else if (rangeY.Delta == 0.0)
			{
				countY = 1;
				stepY = 1.0;
				countX = gridNodesCount;
				stepX = rangeX.Delta / (double)countX;
			}
			else
			{
				double num = rangeX.Delta / rangeY.Delta;
				double num2 = Math.Sqrt((double)gridNodesCount / num);
				countX = (int)(num2 * num);
				countY = gridNodesCount / countX;
				stepX = rangeX.Delta / (double)countX;
				stepY = rangeY.Delta / (double)countY;
			}
		}

		protected RefinedPoint CreateAggregatedPoint(RefinedPointsGridCluster cluster)
		{
			if (cluster.NonEmptyPointsCount == 1)
			{
				return cluster.Points[0];
			}
			return PointFactory.CreateAggregatedPoint(cluster.AverageArgumentX, cluster.AverageArgumentY, cluster.AverageValue, cluster.Points);
		}

		protected virtual RefinedPointsGridCluster[,] CreateEmptyClusters(int countX, int countY)
		{
			RefinedPointsGridCluster[,] array = new RefinedPointsGridCluster[countX, countY];
			for (int i = 0; i < countX; i++)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < countY; j++)
				{
					array[i, j] = new RefinedPointsGridCluster();
				}
			}
			return array;
		}

		protected virtual void ProcessPointForCluster(int indexX, int indexY, RefinedPoint point)
		{
			clusters[indexX, indexY].AddPoint(point);
		}

		protected abstract IList<RefinedPoint> CreateClusterPoints();

		protected internal abstract bool CanProcessPoints(int pointsCount, int gridNodesCount);

		public IList<RefinedPoint> Calculate(IList<RefinedPoint> points, int thresholdPointsCount)
		{
			int count = points.Count;
			int gridNodesCount = CorrectGridNodesCount(count, thresholdPointsCount);
			if (!CanProcessPoints(count, gridNodesCount))
			{
				return points;
			}
			UpdateMetrics(points, gridNodesCount);
			if (countX == 0 || countY == 0)
			{
				return points;
			}
			clusters = CreateEmptyClusters(countX, countY);
			foreach (RefinedPoint point in points)
			{
				int indexX = Math.Min((int)((point.Argument - MinX) / stepX), countX - 1);
				int indexY = Math.Min((int)((point.ArgumentY - MinY) / stepY), countY - 1);
				ProcessPointForCluster(indexX, indexY, point);
			}
			return CreateClusterPoints();
		}
	}
	public class SimpleGridPointsCalculator : GridPointsCalculatorBase
	{
		public SimpleGridPointsCalculator(GridClusterPointsFactory factory)
			: base(factory)
		{
		}

		protected override IList<RefinedPoint> CreateClusterPoints()
		{
			List<RefinedPoint> list = new List<RefinedPoint>();
			RefinedPointsGridCluster[,] array = base.Clusters;
			foreach (RefinedPointsGridCluster refinedPointsGridCluster in array)
			{
				if (refinedPointsGridCluster.NonEmptyPointsCount != 0)
				{
					RefinedPoint item = CreateAggregatedPoint(refinedPointsGridCluster);
					list.Add(item);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected internal override bool CanProcessPoints(int pointsCount, int gridNodesCount)
		{
			if (gridNodesCount > 0)
			{
				return gridNodesCount < pointsCount;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	public class StrictPointsCalculator : GridPointsCalculatorBase
	{
		private const int StartAroundLength = 1;

		private bool[] usedClustersRows;

		private bool[] usedClustersColumns;

		private int unusedRowsInClusters;

		private int unusedColumnsInClusters;

		public int GridSizeX => base.ClusterSizeX - unusedRowsInClusters;

		public int GridSizeY => base.ClusterSizeY - unusedColumnsInClusters;

		public StrictPointsCalculator(GridClusterPointsFactory factory)
			: base(factory)
		{
		}

		private double GetAroundValuesAverage(int indexX, int indexY)
		{
			int num = 0;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			int num3 = 1;
			double num4 = Math.Max((double)base.ClusterSizeX / 2.0, (double)base.ClusterSizeY / 2.0);
			do
			{
				int num5 = Math.Max(indexX - num3, 0);
				int num6 = Math.Min(indexX + num3, base.ClusterSizeX - 1);
				int num7 = Math.Max(indexY - num3, 0);
				int num8 = Math.Min(indexY + num3, base.ClusterSizeY - 1);
				for (int i = num5; i <= num6; i++)
				{
					for (int j = num7; j <= num8; j++)
					{
						if (base.Clusters[i, j].NonEmptyPointsCount > 0)
						{
							num2 += base.Clusters[i, j].CumulativeValue;
							num += base.Clusters[i, j].NonEmptyPointsCount;
						}
					}
				}
				num3++;
			}
			while (num == 0 && (double)num3 <= num4);
			if (num == 0)
			{
				return double.NaN;
			}
			return num2 / (double)num;
		}

		private RefinedPoint CalculateAveragePoint(int indexX, int indexY)
		{
			double aroundValuesAverage = GetAroundValuesAverage(indexX, indexY);
			double argumentX = base.MinX + base.StepX * ((double)indexX + 0.5);
			double argumentY = base.MinY + base.StepY * ((double)indexY + 0.5);
			return base.PointFactory.CreateAggregatedPoint(argumentX, argumentY, aroundValuesAverage, new List<RefinedPoint>());
		}

		protected override RefinedPointsGridCluster[,] CreateEmptyClusters(int countX, int countY)
		{
			usedClustersRows = new bool[base.ClusterSizeX];
			usedClustersColumns = new bool[base.ClusterSizeY];
			return base.CreateEmptyClusters(countX, countY);
		}

		protected override void ProcessPointForCluster(int indexX, int indexY, RefinedPoint point)
		{
			base.ProcessPointForCluster(indexX, indexY, point);
			usedClustersRows[indexX] = true;
			usedClustersColumns[indexY] = true;
		}

		protected override IList<RefinedPoint> CreateClusterPoints()
		{
			List<RefinedPoint> list = new List<RefinedPoint>();
			for (int i = 0; i < base.ClusterSizeX; i++)
			{
				if (!usedClustersRows[i])
				{
					continue;
				}
				for (int j = 0; j < base.ClusterSizeY; j++)
				{
					if (usedClustersColumns[j])
					{
						RefinedPoint item = ((base.Clusters[i, j].NonEmptyPointsCount <= 0) ? CalculateAveragePoint(i, j) : CreateAggregatedPoint(base.Clusters[i, j]));
						list.Add(item);
					}
				}
			}
			unusedRowsInClusters = usedClustersRows.Count((bool value) => !value);
			unusedColumnsInClusters = usedClustersColumns.Count((bool value) => !value);
			return list;
		}

		protected internal override bool CanProcessPoints(int pointsCount, int gridNodesCount)
		{
			return gridNodesCount > 0;
		}
	}
	public enum SurfaceDataSourceMode
	{
		Triangulation,
		Grid,
		Matrix
	}
	public class PointsCountThresholdFilter : PointsFilter
	{
		private IList<RefinedPoint> filteredPoints;

		private SurfaceDataSourceMode dataMode;

		private int thresholdPointsCount;

		private ISurfaceSeriesView SurfaceView => base.RefinedSeries.SeriesView as ISurfaceSeriesView;

		public PointsCountThresholdFilter(RefinedSeries refinedSeries)
			: base(refinedSeries)
		{
		}

		private bool IsEnabled()
		{
			if (SurfaceView == null || SurfaceView.ThresholdPointsCount < 0 || SurfaceView.DataMode == SurfaceDataSourceMode.Matrix || (SurfaceView.DataMode == SurfaceDataSourceMode.Triangulation && SurfaceView.ThresholdPointsCount == 0))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private GridPointsCalculatorBase CreateGridPointsCalculator()
		{
			GridClusterPointsFactory factory = new GridClusterPointsFactory(base.RefinedSeries, base.AxisDataX.AxisScaleTypeMap, base.AxisDataY.AxisScaleTypeMap);
			return dataMode switch
			{
				SurfaceDataSourceMode.Grid => new StrictPointsCalculator(factory), 
				SurfaceDataSourceMode.Triangulation => new SimpleGridPointsCalculator(factory), 
				_ => null, 
			};
		}

		private void ProvideGridSizeToSurfaceView(GridPointsCalculatorBase gridCalculator)
		{
			if (gridCalculator is StrictPointsCalculator strictPointsCalculator)
			{
				SurfaceView.DimensionX = strictPointsCalculator.GridSizeX;
				SurfaceView.DimensionY = strictPointsCalculator.GridSizeY;
			}
		}

		protected override IList<RefinedPoint> Recalculate(IList<RefinedPoint> initialPoints)
		{
			if (initialPoints == null || initialPoints.Count == 0)
			{
				filteredPoints = initialPoints;
				return filteredPoints;
			}
			GridPointsCalculatorBase gridPointsCalculatorBase = CreateGridPointsCalculator();
			filteredPoints = gridPointsCalculatorBase.Calculate(initialPoints, thresholdPointsCount);
			ProvideGridSizeToSurfaceView(gridPointsCalculatorBase);
			return filteredPoints;
		}

		protected override IList<RefinedPoint> GetCachedPoints()
		{
			return filteredPoints;
		}

		public override void ClearCache()
		{
			filteredPoints = null;
		}

		public override bool Update()
		{
			bool result = false;
			if (base.Enable != IsEnabled())
			{
				base.Enable = IsEnabled();
				result = true;
				ClearCache();
			}
			else if (base.Enable && (dataMode != SurfaceView.DataMode || thresholdPointsCount != SurfaceView.ThresholdPointsCount))
			{
				result = true;
				ClearCache();
			}
			if (base.Enable)
			{
				dataMode = SurfaceView.DataMode;
				thresholdPointsCount = SurfaceView.ThresholdPointsCount;
			}
			return result;
		}

		public override PointsFilterUpdateInfo Update(PointsFilterUpdateInfo updateInfo)
		{
			return null;
		}
	}

			private static IRefinedDataContainer CreateCore(IList<double> values, CorePointState state)
			{
				bool flag = state == CorePointState.EmptyWithNonDefaultValues;
				if ((state == CorePointState.HasValues || flag) && values != null && values.Count > 0)
				{
					if (values.Count == 1)
					{
						if (flag)
						{
							return new ValueEmptyRefinedDataContainer(values[0]);
						}
						return new ValueRefinedDataContainer(values[0]);
					}
					if (values.Count == 2)
					{
						if (flag)
						{
							return new DoubleValueEmptyRefinedDataContainer(values[0], values[1]);
						}
						return new DoubleValueRefinedDataContainer(values[0], values[1]);
					}
					if (values.Count == 4)
					{
						if (flag)
						{
							return new FourValuesEmptyDataContainer(values[0], values[1], values[2], values[3]);
						}
						return new FourValuesDataContainer(values[0], values[1], values[2], values[3]);
					}
					if (flag)
					{
						return new SixAndAdditionalValuesEmptyDataContainer(values);
					}
					return new SixAndAdditionalValuesDataContainer(values);
				}
				return new RefinedDataContainer();
			}

			public static IRefinedDataContainer Create(ISeriesPoint point, IList<double> values, CorePointState emptyMode)
			{
				IRefinedDataContainer refinedDataContainer = CreateCore(values, emptyMode);
				if (point != null)
				{
					return new SeriesPointDataContainer(refinedDataContainer, point);
				}
				return refinedDataContainer;
			}

			public static SimpleRefinedDataContainer Create(IRefinedDataContainer container, int argumentsCount, int valuesCount)
			{
				if (argumentsCount == 2)
				{
					return new FullRefinedDataContainer(container.ArgumentY, container.Value1, container.Value2);
				}
				switch (valuesCount)
				{
				case 1:
					return new ValueRefinedDataContainer(container.Value1);
				case 2:
					return new DoubleValueRefinedDataContainer(container.Value1, container.Value2);
				case 4:
					return new FourValuesDataContainer(container.Value1, container.Value2, container.Value3, container.Value4);
				default:
				{
					double[] additionalValues = null;
					if (container is SixAndAdditionalValuesDataContainer)
					{
						additionalValues = ((SixAndAdditionalValuesDataContainer)container).AdditionalValues;
					}
					return new SixAndAdditionalValuesDataContainer(container.Value1, container.Value2, container.Value3, container.Value4, container.Value5, container.Value6, additionalValues);
				}
				}
			}

			public override bool Equals(IRefinedDataContainer container)
			{
				return container is RefinedDataContainer;
			}
		}
