			{
				get
				{
					return value6;
				}
				set
				{
					value6 = value;
				}
			}

			public override double[] AdditionalValues
			{
				get
				{
					if (additionalValues != null)
					{
						return (double[])additionalValues.Clone();
					}
					return null;
				}
				set
				{
					additionalValues = value;
				}
			}

			public SixAndAdditionalValuesDataContainer(IList<double> values)
			{
				value1 = ((values.Count > 0) ? values[0] : double.NaN);
				value2 = ((values.Count > 1) ? values[1] : double.NaN);
				value3 = ((values.Count > 2) ? values[2] : double.NaN);
				value4 = ((values.Count > 3) ? values[3] : double.NaN);
				value5 = ((values.Count > 4) ? values[4] : double.NaN);
				value6 = ((values.Count > 5) ? values[5] : double.NaN);
				if (values.Count > 6)
				{
					int num = values.Count - 6;
					additionalValues = new double[num];
					int num2 = 6;
					int num3 = 0;
					while (num2 < values.Count)
					{
						additionalValues[num3] = values[num2];
						num2++;
						num3++;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					additionalValues = null;
				}
			}

			public SixAndAdditionalValuesDataContainer(double value1, double value2, double value3, double value4, double value5, double value6, double[] additionalValues = null)
			{
				this.value1 = value1;
				this.value2 = value2;
				this.value3 = value3;
				this.value4 = value4;
				this.value5 = value5;
				this.value6 = value6;
				this.additionalValues = additionalValues;
			}

			public override bool Equals(IRefinedDataContainer container)
			{
				if (!(container is SixAndAdditionalValuesDataContainer sixAndAdditionalValuesDataContainer) || value1 != sixAndAdditionalValuesDataContainer.value1 || value2 != sixAndAdditionalValuesDataContainer.value2 || value3 != sixAndAdditionalValuesDataContainer.value3 || value4 != sixAndAdditionalValuesDataContainer.value4 || value5 != sixAndAdditionalValuesDataContainer.value5 || value6 != sixAndAdditionalValuesDataContainer.value6)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (additionalValues != null && sixAndAdditionalValuesDataContainer.additionalValues != null)
				{
					if (additionalValues.Length != sixAndAdditionalValuesDataContainer.additionalValues.Length)
					{
						return false;
					}
					for (int i = 0; i < additionalValues.Length; i++)
					{
						if (additionalValues[i] != sixAndAdditionalValuesDataContainer.additionalValues[i])
						{
							return false;
						}
					}
					return true;
				}
				if (additionalValues == null)
				{
					return sixAndAdditionalValuesDataContainer.additionalValues == null;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		double IFunnelPoint.NormalizedValue
		{
			get
			{
				if (dataContainer.Interaction is SimplePointInteraction simplePointInteraction)
				{
					if (!double.IsNaN(simplePointInteraction.PositiveValuesSum) && simplePointInteraction.PositiveValuesSum != 0.0)
					{
						if (Value1 >= 0.0)
						{
							if (!(simplePointInteraction.MaxValue > 0.0))
							{
								return 1.0;
							}
							return Value1 / simplePointInteraction.MaxValue;
						}
						return double.NaN;
					}
					if (!double.IsNaN(simplePointInteraction.NegativeValuesSum))
					{
						if (!(Value1 < 0.0))
						{
							return double.NaN;
						}
						return Value1 / simplePointInteraction.MinValue;
					}
				}
				return double.NaN;
			}
		}

		double IPiePoint.NormalizedValue
		{
			get
			{
				if (dataContainer.Interaction is SimplePointInteraction simplePointInteraction)
				{
					if (simplePointInteraction.PositiveValuesSum > 0.0)
					{
						if (!(Value1 > 0.0))
						{
							return 0.0;
						}
						return Value1 / simplePointInteraction.PositiveValuesSum;
					}
					if (simplePointInteraction.NegativeValuesSum < 0.0)
					{
						return Value1 / simplePointInteraction.NegativeValuesSum;
					}
					if (simplePointInteraction.PositiveValuesSum == 0.0)
					{
						return 0.0;
					}
				}
				return double.NaN;
			}
		}

		double IPiePoint.TotalValue

				{
					if (simplePointInteraction.PositiveValuesSum > 0.0)
					{
						return simplePointInteraction.PositiveValuesSum;
					}
					if (simplePointInteraction.NegativeValuesSum < 0.0)
					{
						return simplePointInteraction.NegativeValuesSum;
					}
					if (simplePointInteraction.PositiveValuesSum == 0.0)
					{
						return 0.0;
					}
				}
				return double.NaN;
			}
		}

		private static bool PointIsEmpty(CorePointState mode)
		{
			return mode != CorePointState.HasValues;
		}

		private static CorePointState GetPointState(ISeriesPoint point)
		{
			if (point == null || !point.IsEmpty(point.Values.ValueScaleType))
			{
				return CorePointState.HasValues;
			}
			return CorePointState.Empty;
		}

		}

		internal RefinedPoint(ISeriesPoint point, double argumentX, double argumentY, IList<double> values, CorePointState valuesState)
		{
			argument = argumentX;
			FullRefinedDataContainer fullRefinedDataContainer = new FullRefinedDataContainer(argumentY, values, PointIsEmpty(valuesState));
			IRefinedDataContainer refinedDataContainer2;
			if (point != null)
			{
				IRefinedDataContainer refinedDataContainer = new SeriesPointDataContainer(fullRefinedDataContainer, point);
				refinedDataContainer2 = refinedDataContainer;
			}
			else
			{
				IRefinedDataContainer refinedDataContainer = fullRefinedDataContainer;
				refinedDataContainer2 = refinedDataContainer;
			}
			dataContainer = refinedDataContainer2;
		}

		internal RefinedPoint(ISeriesPoint point, double argument, IList<double> values, IList<double> errorBarsValues, CorePointState valuesState)
			: this(point, argument, values, valuesState)

		}

		}

		void IDataPoint.SetDateTimeValues(DateTime[] value)
		{
			double[] array = new double[value.Length];
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				array[i] = DateTimeUtilsExt.DateTimeToDouble(value[i]);
				if (i >= 5 && BoxPlotConventions.IsMissingDateTimeNativeValue(value[i]))
				{
					array[i] = BoxPlotConventions.MissingRefinedValue;
				}
			}
			dataContainer = RefinedDataContainer.Create(SeriesPoint, array, CorePointState.HasValues);
		}

		void IDataPoint.SetTimeSpanValues(TimeSpan[] value)
		{
			double[] array = new double[value.Length];
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				array[i] = value[i].TotalMilliseconds;
				if (i >= 5 && BoxPlotConventions.IsMissingTimeSpanNativeValue(value[i]))
				{
					array[i] = BoxPlotConventions.MissingRefinedValue;
				}
			}
			dataContainer = RefinedDataContainer.Create(SeriesPoint, array, CorePointState.HasValues);
		}

		private void EnsureAdditionalContainer()
		{
			if (!dataContainer.IsAdditional)
			{
				LightAdditionalRefinedDataContainer lightAdditionalRefinedDataContainer = new LightAdditionalRefinedDataContainer((SimpleRefinedDataContainer)dataContainer.GetInnerContainer());
				IRefinedDataContainer refinedDataContainer2;
				if (SeriesPoint != null)
				{
					IRefinedDataContainer refinedDataContainer = new SeriesPointDataContainer(lightAdditionalRefinedDataContainer, SeriesPoint);
					refinedDataContainer2 = refinedDataContainer;
				}
				else
				{
					IRefinedDataContainer refinedDataContainer = lightAdditionalRefinedDataContainer;
					refinedDataContainer2 = refinedDataContainer;
				}
				dataContainer = refinedDataContainer2;
			}
		}

		private IRefinedDataContainer CreateDataContainer(int argumentsCount, int valuesCount)
		{
			SimpleRefinedDataContainer container = RefinedDataContainer.Create(dataContainer, argumentsCount, valuesCount);
			IRefinedDataContainer container2 = dataContainer.GetContainer(container);
			if (SeriesPoint != null)
			{
				return new SeriesPointDataContainer(container2, SeriesPoint);
			}
			return container2;
		}

		private void EnsureDataContainerType(int argumentsCount, int valuesCount)
		{
			if (argumentsCount > 1 || dataContainer.ValuesCount < valuesCount)
			{
				dataContainer = CreateDataContainer(argumentsCount, valuesCount);
			}
		}

		private void EnsureFullAdditionalContainer()
		{
			if (!dataContainer.IsFullAdditional)
			{
				FullAdditionalRefinedDataContainer fullAdditionalRefinedDataContainer = new FullAdditionalRefinedDataContainer(dataContainer.GetInnerContainer());
				IRefinedDataContainer refinedDataContainer2;
				if (SeriesPoint != null)
				{
					IRefinedDataContainer refinedDataContainer = new SeriesPointDataContainer(fullAdditionalRefinedDataContainer, SeriesPoint);
					refinedDataContainer2 = refinedDataContainer;
				}
				else
				{
					IRefinedDataContainer refinedDataContainer = fullAdditionalRefinedDataContainer;
					refinedDataContainer2 = refinedDataContainer;
				}
				dataContainer = refinedDataContainer2;
			}
		}

		private double GetValue(int index)
		{
			return index switch
			{
				0 => Value1, 
				1 => Value2, 
				2 => Value3, 
				3 => Value4, 
				4 => Value5, 
				5 => Value6, 
				_ => AdditionalValues[index - 6], 
			};
		}

		private void SetTag(object tag)
		{
			this.tag = tag;
		}

		protected void ApplyErrorBars(IList<double> errorBarsValues)
		{
			if (errorBarsValues != null)
			{
				EnsureFullAdditionalContainer();
				FullAdditionalRefinedDataContainer fullAdditionalRefinedDataContainer = (FullAdditionalRefinedDataContainer)dataContainer.GetInnerContainer();
				fullAdditionalRefinedDataContainer.ErrorBarValueLow = errorBarsValues[0];
				fullAdditionalRefinedDataContainer.ErrorBarValueHigh = errorBarsValues[1];
			}
		}

		public double GetAdditionalValue(ErrorBarValueInternal valueLevel)
		{
			if (dataContainer.IsFullAdditional)
			{
				FullAdditionalRefinedDataContainer fullAdditionalRefinedDataContainer = (FullAdditionalRefinedDataContainer)dataContainer.GetInnerContainer();
				switch (valueLevel)
				{
				case ErrorBarValueInternal.Low:
					return fullAdditionalRefinedDataContainer.ErrorBarValueLow;
				case ErrorBarValueInternal.High:
					return fullAdditionalRefinedDataContainer.ErrorBarValueHigh;
				}
			}
			return 0.0;
		}

		public double GetPercentValue()
		{
			double normalizedValue = ((IFullStackedPoint)this).NormalizedValue;
			if (!double.IsNaN(normalizedValue))
			{
				return normalizedValue;
			}
			return ((IPiePoint)this).NormalizedValue;
		}

		public List<RefinedSeries> GetSideBySideSeries()
		{
			return (dataContainer.IsFullAdditional ? (((FullAdditionalRefinedDataContainer)dataContainer.GetInnerContainer()).SideBySideData as SideBySideInteractionBase) : null)?.Series;
		}

		public double GetTotalValue()
		{
			double totalValue = ((IFullStackedPoint)this).TotalValue;
			if (!double.IsNaN(totalValue))
			{
				return totalValue;
			}
			totalValue = ((IStackedPoint)this).TotalValue;
			if (!double.IsNaN(totalValue))
			{
				return totalValue;
			}
			return ((IPiePoint)this).TotalValue;
		}

		public double GetValue(ValueLevelInternal valueLevel)
		{
			switch (valueLevel)
			{
			case ValueLevelInternal.Value:
			case ValueLevelInternal.Value_1:
			case ValueLevelInternal.Low:
			case ValueLevelInternal.BoxPlotMin:
				return Value1;
			case ValueLevelInternal.Value_2:
			case ValueLevelInternal.High:
			case ValueLevelInternal.Weight:
			case ValueLevelInternal.BoxPlotQuartile_1:
				return Value2;
			case ValueLevelInternal.Open:
			case ValueLevelInternal.BoxPlotMedian:
				return Value3;
			case ValueLevelInternal.Close:
			case ValueLevelInternal.BoxPlotQuartile_3:
				return Value4;
			case ValueLevelInternal.BoxPlotMax:
				return Value5;
			case ValueLevelInternal.BoxPlotMean:
				return Value6;
			default:
				throw new ArgumentException("The RefinedPoint can't return value because the given ValueLevelInternal is unknown.");
			}
		}

		public void MakeEmpty()
		{
			dataContainer = dataContainer.MakeEmpty();
		}

		public void ReplaceSeriesPoint(IDataPoint seriesPoint)
		{
			IRefinedDataContainer innerContainer = dataContainer.GetInnerContainer();
			IRefinedDataContainer refinedDataContainer2;
			if (seriesPoint != null)
			{
				IRefinedDataContainer refinedDataContainer = new SeriesPointDataContainer(innerContainer, (ISeriesPoint)seriesPoint);
				refinedDataContainer2 = refinedDataContainer;
			}
			else
			{
				refinedDataContainer2 = innerContainer;
			}
			dataContainer = refinedDataContainer2;
		}

		public void ResetInteraction()
		{
			if (dataContainer.IsAdditional)
			{
				dataContainer.Interaction = null;
				dataContainer.Index = -1;
			}
		}

		public void ResetSeriesGroupsInteraction()
		{
			if (dataContainer.IsFullAdditional)
			{
				FullAdditionalRefinedDataContainer fullAdditionalRefinedDataContainer = (FullAdditionalRefinedDataContainer)dataContainer.GetInnerContainer();
				if (fullAdditionalRefinedDataContainer != null)
				{
					fullAdditionalRefinedDataContainer.SideBySideData = null;
					fullAdditionalRefinedDataContainer.SideBySideIndex = -1;
				}
			}
		}

		public void SetInteraction(IPointInteraction data, int index)
		{
			EnsureAdditionalContainer();
			dataContainer.Interaction = data;
			dataContainer.Index = index;
		}

		public void SetSeriesGroupsInteraction(IPointInteraction interaction, int index)
		{
			EnsureFullAdditionalContainer();
			FullAdditionalRefinedDataContainer fullAdditionalRefinedDataContainer = (FullAdditionalRefinedDataContainer)dataContainer.GetInnerContainer();
			fullAdditionalRefinedDataContainer.SideBySideData = interaction;
			fullAdditionalRefinedDataContainer.SideBySideIndex = index;
		}

		public bool IsValueEmpty(Scale scale)
		{
			if (SeriesPoint == null)
			{
				return IsEmpty;
			}
			return SeriesPoint.IsEmpty(scale);
		}

		public double GetRefinedArgument(AxisScaleTypeMap scaleMap)
		{
			if (SeriesPoint == null)
			{
				return Argument;
			}
			return scaleMap.NativeToRefined(SeriesPoint.ArgumentX.UserArgument);
		}

		public object GetUserArgument(AxisScaleTypeMap scaleMap)
		{
			if (SeriesPoint == null)
			{
				return scaleMap.RefinedToNative(Argument);
			}
			return SeriesPoint.ArgumentX.UserArgument;
		}

		public double GetNumericalValue(int index)
		{
			if (SeriesPoint == null)
			{
				return GetValue(index);
			}
			return SeriesPoint.Values.NumericalValues[index];
		}

		public DateTime GetDateTimeValue(int index)
		{
			if (SeriesPoint == null)
			{
				return DateTimeUtilsExt.DoubleToDateTime(GetValue(index));
			}
			return SeriesPoint.Values.DateTimeValues[index];
		}

		public TimeSpan GetTimeSpanValue(int index)
		{
			if (SeriesPoint == null)
			{
				return TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(Math.Round(GetValue(index)));
			}
			return SeriesPoint.Values.TimeSpanValues[index];
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is RefinedPoint refinedPoint))
			{
				return false;
			}
			SeriesPointDataContainer seriesPointDataContainer = dataContainer as SeriesPointDataContainer;
			SeriesPointDataContainer seriesPointDataContainer2 = refinedPoint.dataContainer as SeriesPointDataContainer;
			if (seriesPointDataContainer == null && seriesPointDataContainer2 != null)
			{
				return seriesPointDataContainer2.Equals(dataContainer);
			}
			if (argument == refinedPoint.argument)
			{
				return dataContainer.Equals(refinedPoint.dataContainer);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return base.GetHashCode();
		}
	}
	public abstract class RefinedPointCollectionBase : IList<RefinedPoint>, ICollection<RefinedPoint>, IEnumerable<RefinedPoint>, IEnumerable
	{
		public sealed class Enumerator : IEnumerator<RefinedPoint>, IDisposable, IEnumerator, IEnumerator<IBasePoint>
		{
			private const int startIndexValue = -1;

			private readonly int actualCount;

			private readonly int offset;

			private readonly RefinedPoint[] points;

			private int currentIndex;

			object IEnumerator.Current => points[currentIndex + offset];

			RefinedPoint IEnumerator<RefinedPoint>.Current => points[currentIndex + offset];

			IBasePoint IEnumerator<IBasePoint>.Current => points[currentIndex + offset];

			public Enumerator(RefinedPoint[] points, int count, int offset)
			{
				this.points = points;
				this.offset = offset;
				currentIndex = -1;
				actualCount = count;
			}

			void IDisposable.Dispose()
			{
			}

			bool IEnumerator.MoveNext()
			{
				if (currentIndex < actualCount - 1)
				{
					currentIndex++;
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}

			void IEnumerator.Reset()
			{
				currentIndex = -1;
			}
		}

		private const int minCollapsedCount = 32;

		private const int defaultCapacity = 4;

		private const int maxCapacityIncrease = 1048576;

		private int count = -1;

		private RefinedPoint[] points;

		private bool IsReadOnly => true;

		protected int Offset { get; set; }

		protected RefinedPoint[] Points => points;

		public int Count => count;

		public RefinedPoint this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				if (index < count)
				{
					index += Offset;
					if (points[index] == null)
					{
						points[index] = ObjectsFactory.Default.Create();
					}
					return points[index];
				}
				throw new IndexOutOfRangeException("Invalid index value: " + index);
			}
			set
			{
				if (index < count)
				{
					points[index + Offset] = value;
					return;
				}
				throw new IndexOutOfRangeException("Invalid index value: " + index);
			}
		}

		RefinedPoint IList<RefinedPoint>.this[int index]

			set

		private int GetCapacityForCollapse()
		{
			int num;
			for (num = points.Length >> 1; num > count << 2; num >>= 1)
			{
			}
			return Math.Max(32, num);
		}

		private int GetCapacityForExpand()
		{
			int num;
			for (num = points.Length; num < count; num = ((num <= 1048576) ? (num << 1) : (num + 1048576)))
			{
			}
			return num;
		}

		private void CollapsePoints(int newSize)
		{
			RefinedPoint[] destinationArray = new RefinedPoint[GetCapacityForCollapse()];
			Array.Copy(points, Offset, destinationArray, 0, newSize);
			Offset = 0;
			points = destinationArray;
		}

		private void ExpandPoints()
		{
			RefinedPoint[] destinationArray = new RefinedPoint[GetCapacityForExpand()];
			Array.Copy(points, Offset, destinationArray, 0, points.Length - Offset);
			Offset = 0;
			points = destinationArray;
		}

		protected void Realloc(int newCount)
		{
			if (count == newCount)
			{
				return;
			}
			count = newCount;
			if (points == null)
			{
				int num = ((count < 4) ? 4 : count);
				points = new RefinedPoint[num];
			}
			else if (points.Length < count + Offset)
			{
				if (count <= points.Length)
				{
					Array.Copy(points, Offset, points, 0, points.Length - Offset);
					Offset = 0;
				}
				else
				{
					ExpandPoints();
				}
			}
			else if (points.Length > count + Offset << 2 && points.Length > 32)
			{
				CollapsePoints(newCount);
			}
		}

		protected void MovePoint(int oldIndex, int newIndex)
		{
			if (oldIndex < 0 || oldIndex >= count || newIndex < 0 || newIndex >= count)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("Invalid index");
			}
			if (oldIndex != newIndex)
			{
				int num = newIndex + Offset;
				int num2 = oldIndex + Offset;
				RefinedPoint refinedPoint = points[num2];
				if (oldIndex > newIndex)
				{
					Array.Copy(points, num, points, num + 1, oldIndex - newIndex);
					points[num] = refinedPoint;
				}
				else
				{
					Array.Copy(points, num2 + 1, points, num2, newIndex - oldIndex);
					points[num] = refinedPoint;
				}
			}
		}

		public abstract int IndexOf(RefinedPoint item);

		public abstract bool Contains(RefinedPoint item);

		public abstract void Add(RefinedPoint item);

		public abstract void AddRange(IList<RefinedPoint> collection, bool shouldSort = true);

		public IEnumerator GetEnumerator()
		{
			return new Enumerator(points, count, Offset);
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			Realloc(0);
			Offset = 0;
		}

		public bool Remove(RefinedPoint item)
		{
			int num = IndexOf(item);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int num2 = count - 1;
			if (num == 0)
			{
				points[num + Offset] = null;
				Offset++;
			}
			else
			{
				Array.Copy(points, num + Offset + 1, points, num + Offset, num2 - num);
			}
			Realloc(num2);
			return true;
		}

		public bool RemoveRange(int index, int countToRemove)
		{
			if (index < 0 || countToRemove < 0 || countToRemove + index > count)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int num = count - countToRemove;
			if (index == 0)
			{
				points[index + Offset] = null;
				Offset += countToRemove;
			}
			else
			{
				Array.Copy(points, index + Offset + countToRemove, points, index + Offset, num - index);
			}
			Realloc(num);
			return true;
		}

		public void CopyTo(IBasePoint[] array, int index)
		{
			Array.Copy(points, Offset, array, index, count);
		}
	}
	public class RefinedPointCollection : RefinedPointCollectionBase
	{
		public RefinedPointCollection(int capacity)
			: base(capacity)
		{
		}

		public void Swap(int index1, int index2)
		{
			if (index1 < 0 || index1 >= base.Count || index2 < 0 || index2 >= base.Count)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("Invalid index");
			}
			if (index1 != index2)
			{
				RefinedPoint value = base[index1];
				base[index1] = base[index2];
				base[index2] = value;
			}
		}

		public void Move(int oldIndex, int newIndex)
		{
			MovePoint(oldIndex, newIndex);
		}

		public void Insert(int index, RefinedPoint item)
		{
			if (index < 0 || index > base.Count)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("Invalid index value: " + index);
			}
			int num = base.Count;
			Realloc(base.Count + 1);
			if (index < num)
			{
				Array.Copy(base.Points, index + base.Offset, base.Points, index + base.Offset + 1, num - index);
			}
			base.Points[index + base.Offset] = item;
		}

		public void InsertRange(int index, ICollection<RefinedPoint> collection)
		{
			if (index < 0 || index > base.Count)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("Invalid index value: " + index);
			}
			if (collection == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException();
			}
			if (collection.Count != 0)
			{
				int num = base.Count;
				Realloc(base.Count + collection.Count);
				Array.Copy(base.Points, index + base.Offset, base.Points, index + base.Offset + collection.Count, num - index);
				collection.CopyTo(base.Points, index + base.Offset);
			}
		}

		public override int IndexOf(RefinedPoint item)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < base.Count; i++)
			{
				if (item == base.Points[i + base.Offset])
				{
					return i;
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}

		public override bool Contains(RefinedPoint item)
		{
			return IndexOf(item) >= 0;
		}

		public override void Add(RefinedPoint item)
		{
			Insert(base.Count, item);
		}

		public override void AddRange(IList<RefinedPoint> collection, bool shouldSort = true)
		{
			InsertRange(base.Count, collection);
		}
	}
	public abstract class SortedRefinedPointCollectionBase : RefinedPointCollectionBase
	{
		protected RefinedPointComparerBase Comparer { get; set; }

		protected SortedRefinedPointCollectionBase(int capacity, RefinedPointComparerBase comparer)
			: base(capacity)
		{
			Comparer = comparer;
		}

		public int BinarySearch(RefinedPoint item)
		{
			return BinarySearch(item, Comparer);
		}

		public int BinarySearch(RefinedPoint item, Comparer<RefinedPoint> comparer)
		{
			int num = Array.BinarySearch(base.Points, base.Offset, base.Count, item, comparer);
			if (num > 0)
			{
				return num - base.Offset;
			}
			return ~(~num - base.Offset);
		}

		public void Sort()
		{
			Array.Sort(base.Points, base.Offset, base.Count, Comparer);
		}

		public void Initialize(RefinedPointCollectionBase pointsCollection, bool shouldSort)
		{
			Realloc(pointsCollection.Count);
			IBasePoint[] array = base.Points;
			pointsCollection.CopyTo(array, 0);
			base.Offset = 0;
			if (shouldSort)
			{
				Sort();
			}
		}

		public void Update(RefinedPoint oldItem, RefinedPoint newItem)
		{
			int num = IndexOf(oldItem);
			int num2 = BinarySearch(newItem);
			if (num2 < 0)
			{
				num2 = ~num2;
				if (num2 >= base.Count)
				{
					num2 = base.Count - 1;
				}
			}
			base.Points[num + base.Offset] = newItem;
			MovePoint(num, num2);
		}

		public override int IndexOf(RefinedPoint item)
		{
			int num = BinarySearch(item);
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				for (int i = num; i < base.Count && Comparer.Compare(base.Points[num + base.Offset], base.Points[i + base.Offset]) == 0; i++)
				{
					if (item == base.Points[i + base.Offset])
					{
						return i;
					}
				}
				int num2 = num - 1;
				while (num2 >= 0 && Comparer.Compare(base.Points[num + base.Offset], base.Points[num2 + base.Offset]) == 0)
				{
					if (item == base.Points[num2 + base.Offset])
					{
						return num2;
					}
					num2--;
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}

		public override bool Contains(RefinedPoint item)
		{
			return BinarySearch(item) >= 0;
		}

		public override void Add(RefinedPoint item)
		{
			if (!Comparer.IsSupportedPoint(item))
			{
				Realloc(base.Count + 1);
				base.Points[base.Count - 1 + base.Offset] = item;
				return;
			}
			int num = base.Count;
			int num2 = BinarySearch(item);
			Realloc(base.Count + 1);
			if (num2 < 0)
			{
				num2 = ~num2;
			}
			Array.Copy(base.Points, num2 + base.Offset, base.Points, num2 + 1 + base.Offset, num - num2);
			base.Points[num2 + base.Offset] = item;
		}

		public override void AddRange(IList<RefinedPoint> collection, bool shouldSort = true)
		{
			if (collection == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException();
			}
			if (collection.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (base.Count == 0)
			{
				base.Offset = 0;
				Realloc(collection.Count);
				collection.CopyTo(base.Points, 0);
				if (shouldSort)
				{
					Sort();
				}
				return;
			}
			foreach (RefinedPoint item in collection)
			{
				Add(item);
			}
		}
	}

		public int GetIndexByArgument(double argument, bool fromRight, out bool pointIsFound)
		{
			RefinedPoint item = ObjectsFactory.Default.Create(argument, 0.0);
			RefinedPointsArgumentComparer refinedPointsArgumentComparer = new RefinedPointsArgumentComparer();
			int num = BinarySearch(item, refinedPointsArgumentComparer);
			pointIsFound = true;
			if (num < 0)
			{
				num = ~num;
				pointIsFound = false;
			}
			if (num >= 0 && num < base.Count - 1)
			{
				if (fromRight)
				{
					for (int i = num + 1; i < base.Count && refinedPointsArgumentComparer.Compare(base.Points[num + base.Offset], base.Points[i + base.Offset]) == 0; i++)
					{
						num++;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					int num2 = num - 1;
					while (num2 >= 0 && refinedPointsArgumentComparer.Compare(base.Points[num + base.Offset], base.Points[num2 + base.Offset]) == 0)
					{
						num--;
						num2--;
					}
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		public void InsertRangeWithoutTesting(IList<RefinedPoint> newPoints)
		{
			if (newPoints.Count <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			int i = BinarySearch(newPoints[0]);
			if (i < 0)
			{
				i = ~i;
			}
			else
			{
				for (; i < base.Count && base[i].Argument == newPoints[0].Argument; i++)
				{
				}
			}
			int num = base.Count;
			Realloc(base.Count + newPoints.Count);
			Array.Copy(base.Points, i + base.Offset, base.Points, i + newPoints.Count + base.Offset, num - i);
			for (int j = 0; j < newPoints.Count; j++)
			{
				base.Points[i + base.Offset + j] = newPoints[j];
			}
		}

	public abstract class AggregationPointFilterBase : PointsFilter
	{
		protected internal class PointsCacheEntry
		{
			private readonly SortedArgumentRefinedPointCollection points;

			private readonly AxisScaleTypeMap scaleMap;

			private List<DoubleLimits> argumentsWithoutGaps;

			public SortedArgumentRefinedPointCollection Points => points;

			public AxisScaleTypeMap ScaleMap => scaleMap;

			public List<DoubleLimits> ArgumentsWithoutGaps
			{
				get
				{
					return argumentsWithoutGaps;
				}
				set
				{
					argumentsWithoutGaps = value;
				}
			}

			public static PointsCacheEntry Create(IList<RefinedPoint> points, AxisScaleTypeMap scaleMap, List<DoubleLimits> argumentsWithoutGaps = null)
			{
				SortedArgumentRefinedPointCollection sortedArgumentRefinedPointCollection = new SortedArgumentRefinedPointCollection(points.Count, new RefinedPointsArgumentComparer());
				sortedArgumentRefinedPointCollection.InsertRangeWithoutTesting(points);
				return new PointsCacheEntry(sortedArgumentRefinedPointCollection, scaleMap, argumentsWithoutGaps);
			}

			public PointsCacheEntry(SortedArgumentRefinedPointCollection points, AxisScaleTypeMap scaleMap, List<DoubleLimits> argumentIntervals)
			{
				this.points = points;
				this.scaleMap = scaleMap;
				argumentsWithoutGaps = argumentIntervals;
			}
		}

		private readonly Dictionary<object, PointsCacheEntry> pointsCache = new Dictionary<object, PointsCacheEntry>();

		private ICustomAggregateFunction userCalculator;

		private AggregateFunctionNative aggregateFunction;

		private ProcessMissingPointsModeNative processMissingPoints;

		private bool isAutogeneratedPoints;

		protected internal Dictionary<object, PointsCacheEntry> PointsCache => pointsCache;

		protected ICustomAggregateFunction UserCalculator => userCalculator;

		protected AggregateFunctionNative AggregateFunction => aggregateFunction;

		protected ProcessMissingPointsModeNative ProcessMissingPoints => processMissingPoints;

		private static int GetAggregatedPointIndex(PointsCacheEntry cacheEntry, double argument, bool isFirst)
		{
			RefinedPoint item = ObjectsFactory.Default.Create(cacheEntry.ScaleMap.RefinedToInternal(argument), 0.0);
			int num = cacheEntry.Points.BinarySearch(item);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				num = ~num;
			}
			if (isFirst)
			{
				num = Math.Min(cacheEntry.Points.Count - 1, Math.Max(0, num--));
				argument = cacheEntry.Points[num].Argument;
				int num2 = num - 1;
				while (num2 >= 0 && cacheEntry.Points[num2].Argument == argument)
				{
					num = num2;
					num2--;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				num = Math.Min(cacheEntry.Points.Count - 1, num + 1);
				argument = cacheEntry.Points[num].Argument;
				for (int i = num + 1; i < cacheEntry.Points.Count && cacheEntry.Points[i].Argument == argument; i++)
				{
					num = i;
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		private static int GetPointIndex(PointsFilterUpdateInfo updateInfo, double argument, bool isFirst)
		{
			int num = updateInfo.Points.BinarySearch(ObjectsFactory.Default.Create(argument, 0.0));
			if (num < 0)
			{
				num = ~num;
				if (num == updateInfo.Points.Count)
				{
					return num;
				}
			}
			if (isFirst)
			{
				int num2 = num;
				while (num2 >= 0 && updateInfo.Points[num2].Argument == argument)
				{
					num = num2;
					num2--;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				for (int i = num; i < updateInfo.Points.Count && updateInfo.Points[i].Argument == argument; i++)
				{
					num = i;
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		private static double FindRealPointArgument(AxisScaleTypeMap scaleMap, RefinedPoint point, bool isFirst)
		{
			if (point.Children == null)
			{
				return scaleMap.InternalToRefined(point.Argument);
			}
			RefinedPoint refinedPoint = null;
			foreach (RefinedPoint child in point.Children)
			{
				if (isFirst)
				{
					if (refinedPoint == null || child.Argument < refinedPoint.Argument)
					{
						refinedPoint = child;
					}
				}
				else if (refinedPoint == null || child.Argument > refinedPoint.Argument)
				{
					refinedPoint = child;
				}
			}
			return refinedPoint.Argument;
		}

		public AggregationPointFilterBase(RefinedSeries refinedSeries)
			: base(refinedSeries)
		{
		}

		private ProcessMissingPointsModeNative GetProcessMissingPoints()
		{
			IAxisData axisDataX = base.AxisDataX;
			if (axisDataX != null)
			{
				switch (base.RefinedSeries.ArgumentScaleType)
				{
				case ActualScaleTypeCore.Numerical:
					return axisDataX.NumericScaleOptions.ProcessMissingPoints;
				case ActualScaleTypeCore.DateTime:
					return axisDataX.DateTimeScaleOptions.ProcessMissingPoints;
				case ActualScaleTypeCore.TimeSpan:
					return axisDataX.TimeSpanScaleOptions.ProcessMissingPoints;
				}
			}
			return ProcessMissingPointsModeNative.Skip;
		}

		private AggregateFunctionNative GetAggregateFunction()
		{
			AggregateFunctionNative aggregateFunctionNative = base.XYSeriesView.AggregateFunction;
			if (aggregateFunctionNative != AggregateFunctionNative.Default)
			{
				return aggregateFunctionNative;
			}
			IAxisData axisDataX = base.AxisDataX;
			if (axisDataX.AggregateFunctionProvider != null)
			{
				return axisDataX.AggregateFunctionProvider.AggregateFunction;
			}
			if (axisDataX.AxisScaleTypeMap.ScaleType == ActualScaleTypeCore.Numerical)
			{
				return axisDataX.NumericScaleOptions.AggregateFunction;
			}
			if (axisDataX.AxisScaleTypeMap.ScaleType == ActualScaleTypeCore.DateTime)
			{
				return axisDataX.DateTimeScaleOptions.AggregateFunction;
			}
			if (axisDataX.AxisScaleTypeMap.ScaleType == ActualScaleTypeCore.TimeSpan)
			{
				return axisDataX.TimeSpanScaleOptions.AggregateFunction;
			}
			return axisDataX.QualitativeScaleOptions.AggregateFunction;
		}

		private ICustomAggregateFunction GetCustomAggregateFunction()
		{
			ICustomAggregateFunction customAggregateFunction = base.XYSeriesView.CustomAggregateFunction;
			if (customAggregateFunction != null)
			{
				return customAggregateFunction;
			}
			IAxisData axisDataX = base.AxisDataX;
			if (axisDataX.AxisScaleTypeMap.ScaleType == ActualScaleTypeCore.Numerical)
			{
				return axisDataX.NumericScaleOptions.CustomAggregateFunction;
			}
			if (axisDataX.AxisScaleTypeMap.ScaleType == ActualScaleTypeCore.DateTime)
			{
				return axisDataX.DateTimeScaleOptions.CustomAggregateFunction;
			}
			if (axisDataX.AxisScaleTypeMap.ScaleType == ActualScaleTypeCore.TimeSpan)
			{
				return axisDataX.TimeSpanScaleOptions.CustomAggregateFunction;
			}
			return axisDataX.QualitativeScaleOptions.CustomAggregateFunction;
		}

		private PointsFilterUpdateInfo ProcessUpdate(PointsCacheEntry cacheEntry, PointsFilterUpdateInfo updateInfo)
		{
			if (cacheEntry.Points.Count == 0 || updateInfo.Points == null || updateInfo.Points.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(updateInfo.FirstUpdatedArgument) && double.IsNaN(updateInfo.LastUpdatedArgument))
			{
				return new PointsFilterUpdateInfo(cacheEntry.Points);
			}
			int aggregatedPointIndex = GetAggregatedPointIndex(cacheEntry, updateInfo.FirstUpdatedArgument, isFirst: true);
			int aggregatedPointIndex2 = GetAggregatedPointIndex(cacheEntry, updateInfo.LastUpdatedArgument, isFirst: false);
			AxisScaleTypeMap scaleMap = cacheEntry.ScaleMap;
			double num = Math.Min(updateInfo.FirstUpdatedArgument, FindRealPointArgument(scaleMap, cacheEntry.Points[aggregatedPointIndex], isFirst: true));
			double num2 = Math.Max(updateInfo.LastUpdatedArgument, FindRealPointArgument(scaleMap, cacheEntry.Points[aggregatedPointIndex2], isFirst: false));
			cacheEntry.Points.RemoveRange(aggregatedPointIndex, aggregatedPointIndex2 - aggregatedPointIndex + 1);
			if (updateInfo.IsRemoveAction)
			{
				int num3 = cacheEntry.ArgumentsWithoutGaps.BinarySearch(new DoubleLimits(num2), new DoubleLimitsEndComparer());
				if (num3 > -1 && num3 < cacheEntry.ArgumentsWithoutGaps.Count - 1)
				{
					cacheEntry.ArgumentsWithoutGaps.RemoveRange(0, num3 + 1);
				}
			}
			int pointIndex = GetPointIndex(updateInfo, num, isFirst: true);
			int pointIndex2 = GetPointIndex(updateInfo, num2, isFirst: false);
			List<RefinedPoint> list = new List<RefinedPoint>(pointIndex2 - pointIndex + 1);
			if (pointIndex < updateInfo.Points.Count)
			{
				for (int i = pointIndex; i < Math.Min(updateInfo.Points.Count, pointIndex2 + 1); i++)
				{
					list.Add(updateInfo.Points[i]);
				}
			}
			if (list.Count > 0)
			{
				SortedArgumentRefinedPointCollection points = cacheEntry.Points;
				double num4 = cacheEntry.ScaleMap.RefinedToInternal(list[list.Count - 1].Argument);
				if (aggregatedPointIndex < points.Count && points[aggregatedPointIndex].Argument == num4)
				{
					points.Remove(points[aggregatedPointIndex]);
				}
			}
			PointsCacheEntry aggregatedPointsEntry = GetAggregatedPointsEntry(list, scaleMap);
			cacheEntry.Points.InsertRangeWithoutTesting(aggregatedPointsEntry.Points);
			cacheEntry.ArgumentsWithoutGaps = UpdateArgumentIntervals(cacheEntry.ArgumentsWithoutGaps, aggregatedPointsEntry.ArgumentsWithoutGaps);
			double firstUpdatedArgument = scaleMap.RefinedToInternal(num);
			double lastUpdatedArgument = scaleMap.RefinedToInternal(num2);
			return new PointsFilterUpdateInfo(cacheEntry.Points, firstUpdatedArgument, lastUpdatedArgument);
		}

		private List<DoubleLimits> UpdateArgumentIntervals(List<DoubleLimits> argumentsWithoutGaps, List<DoubleLimits> newArgumentIntervals)
		{
			if (argumentsWithoutGaps != null && newArgumentIntervals != null && argumentsWithoutGaps.Count > 0 && newArgumentIntervals.Count > 0)
			{
				DoubleLimitsUnionInfo doubleLimitsUnionInfo = LimitsCalculator.CalculateUnion(new List<List<DoubleLimits>> { argumentsWithoutGaps, newArgumentIntervals });
				if (doubleLimitsUnionInfo.FirstIntervalWasChanged && base.RefinedSeries != null)
				{
					base.RefinedSeries.InvalidateGroupsArgumentIntervals();
					return doubleLimitsUnionInfo.UnionResult;
				}
			}
			return argumentsWithoutGaps;
		}

		protected ScaleOptionsInfo GetScaleOptionsInfo(IAxisData axisData)
		{
			//IL_0057: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			switch (base.RefinedSeries.ArgumentScaleType)
			{
			case ActualScaleTypeCore.Numerical:
			{
				INumericScaleOptions numericScaleOptions = axisData.NumericScaleOptions;
				return new ScaleOptionsInfo(numericScaleOptions.ScaleMode, numericScaleOptions.MeasureUnit, 1, numericScaleOptions.AggregationIntervalsInfo);
			}
			case ActualScaleTypeCore.DateTime:
			{
				IDateTimeScaleOptions dateTimeScaleOptions = axisData.DateTimeScaleOptions;
				return new ScaleOptionsInfo(dateTimeScaleOptions.ScaleMode, dateTimeScaleOptions.MeasureUnit, dateTimeScaleOptions.MeasureUnitMultiplier, dateTimeScaleOptions.AggregationIntervalsInfo);
			}
			case ActualScaleTypeCore.TimeSpan:
			{
				ITimeSpanScaleOptions timeSpanScaleOptions = axisData.TimeSpanScaleOptions;
				return new ScaleOptionsInfo(timeSpanScaleOptions.ScaleMode, timeSpanScaleOptions.MeasureUnit, timeSpanScaleOptions.MeasureUnitMultiplier, timeSpanScaleOptions.AggregationIntervalsInfo);
			}
			default:
				return new ScaleOptionsInfo(axisData.QualitativeScaleOptions.ScaleMode, string.Empty, 1);
			}
		}

		protected bool IsAxisAggregationEnabled(IAxisData axisData, ISeriesView seriesView, ActualScaleTypeCore seriesScaleType)
		{
			if (axisData != null)
			{
				if (seriesView is IXYSeriesView)
				{
					AggregateFunctionNative aggregateFunctionNative = ((IXYSeriesView)seriesView).AggregateFunction;
					if (aggregateFunctionNative != AggregateFunctionNative.Default && aggregateFunctionNative != AggregateFunctionNative.None)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				switch (seriesScaleType)
				{
				case ActualScaleTypeCore.Numerical:
					if (axisData.NumericScaleOptions.ScaleMode != ScaleModeNative.Continuous)
					{
						return !double.IsNaN(axisData.NumericScaleOptions.MeasureUnit);
					}
					return false;
				case ActualScaleTypeCore.DateTime:
					return axisData.DateTimeScaleOptions.ScaleMode != ScaleModeNative.Continuous;
				case ActualScaleTypeCore.TimeSpan:
					return axisData.TimeSpanScaleOptions.ScaleMode != ScaleModeNative.Continuous;
				case ActualScaleTypeCore.Qualitative:
					return axisData.QualitativeScaleOptions.ScaleMode != ScaleModeNative.Continuous;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected abstract PointsCacheEntry GetAggregatedPointsEntry(IList<RefinedPoint> points, AxisScaleTypeMap axisXScaleTypeMap);

		protected abstract object GetPointsCacheKey();

		protected abstract bool IsEnabled();

		protected abstract bool IsNeedInvalidate();

		protected virtual bool IsNeedClearCache()
		{
			if (userCalculator == GetCustomAggregateFunction() && aggregateFunction == GetAggregateFunction() && processMissingPoints == GetProcessMissingPoints())
			{
				return isAutogeneratedPoints != base.RefinedSeries.IsPointsAutoGenerated;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected virtual void SaveParameters()
		{
			userCalculator = GetCustomAggregateFunction();
			aggregateFunction = GetAggregateFunction();
			processMissingPoints = GetProcessMissingPoints();
			isAutogeneratedPoints = base.RefinedSeries.IsPointsAutoGenerated;
		}

		protected override IList<RefinedPoint> Recalculate(IList<RefinedPoint> initialPoints)
		{
			if (initialPoints == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			PointsCacheEntry pointsCacheEntry = ((initialPoints.Count <= 0) ? PointsCacheEntry.Create(initialPoints, base.AxisDataX.AxisScaleTypeMap) : GetAggregatedPointsEntry(initialPoints, base.AxisDataX.AxisScaleTypeMap));
			object pointsCacheKey = GetPointsCacheKey();
			pointsCache.Add(pointsCacheKey, pointsCacheEntry);
			UpdateArgumentIntervals(pointsCacheEntry.ScaleMap.GetArgumentsWithoutGaps(), pointsCacheEntry.ArgumentsWithoutGaps);
			base.RefinedSeries.InteractionContainer?.Recalculate();
			return pointsCacheEntry.Points;
		}

		protected override IList<RefinedPoint> GetCachedPoints()
		{
			object pointsCacheKey = GetPointsCacheKey();
			if (pointsCache.ContainsKey(pointsCacheKey))
			{
				return pointsCache[pointsCacheKey].Points;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override void ClearCache()
		{
			pointsCache.Clear();
		}

		public override bool Update()
		{
			bool result = false;
			if (base.Enable != IsEnabled())
			{
				base.Enable = IsEnabled();
				result = true;
				ClearCache();
			}
			else if (base.Enable)
			{
				if (IsNeedClearCache())
				{
					result = true;
					ClearCache();
				}
				if (IsNeedInvalidate())
				{
					result = true;
				}
			}
			if (base.Enable)
			{
				SaveParameters();
			}
			return result;
		}

		public override PointsFilterUpdateInfo Update(PointsFilterUpdateInfo updateInfo)
		{
			PointsFilterUpdateInfo result = null;
			object pointsCacheKey = GetPointsCacheKey();
			foreach (object key in pointsCache.Keys)
			{
				PointsCacheEntry cacheEntry = pointsCache[key];
				PointsFilterUpdateInfo pointsFilterUpdateInfo = ProcessUpdate(cacheEntry, updateInfo);
				if (object.Equals(pointsCacheKey, key))
				{
					result = pointsFilterUpdateInfo;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}
	}
	public class AggregationPointFilter : AggregationPointFilterBase
	{
		private ActualScaleTypeCore scaleTypeX;

		private ScaleOptionsInfo scaleOptionsInfo;

		public AggregationPointFilter(RefinedSeries refinedSeries)
			: base(refinedSeries)
		{
		}

		private bool IsSeriesContainsErrorBars()
		{
			IList<IDataSourceIndicator> indicators = base.RefinedSeries.Series.Indicators;
			if (indicators != null)
			{
				return indicators.Count > 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool ShouldAddMissingPoints(AxisScaleTypeMap axisXScaleMap, MissingArgumentsCalculator missingPointsCreator, double nextInternalArg, double refinedArg)
		{
			if (missingPointsCreator == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return refinedArg >= axisXScaleMap.GetNextRefinedValueByMeasureUnit(axisXScaleMap.InternalToRefined(nextInternalArg));
		}

		private double AlignArgument(double argument, AxisScaleTypeMap axisXScaleMap)
		{
			double value;
			if (axisXScaleMap is AxisDateTimeWithoutGapsMap axisDateTimeWithoutGapsMap)
			{
				value = axisDateTimeWithoutGapsMap.RefinedToInternalWithGaps(argument);
				return axisDateTimeWithoutGapsMap.InternalToRefinedWithGaps(value);
			}
			value = axisXScaleMap.RefinedToInternal(argument);
			return axisXScaleMap.InternalToRefined(value);
		}

		private PointsCacheEntry ClusterPoints(IList<RefinedPoint> points, AxisScaleTypeMap axisXScaleMap, AggregatedPointsCreatorBase aggregatedPointsCreator, MissingArgumentsCalculator missingPointsCreator)
		{
			List<RefinedPoint> list = new List<RefinedPoint>();
			List<DoubleLimits> list2 = new List<DoubleLimits>();
			if (points.Count > 0)
			{
				List<RefinedPoint> list3 = new List<RefinedPoint> { points[0] };
				int num = 1;
				int num2 = 1;
				int index = 0;
				double num3 = axisXScaleMap.RefinedToInternal(list3[0].Argument);
				double num4 = AlignArgument(list3[0].Argument, axisXScaleMap);
				double nextRefinedValueByMeasureUnit = axisXScaleMap.GetNextRefinedValueByMeasureUnit(num4);
				while (num < points.Count)
				{
					RefinedPoint refinedPoint = points[num];
					double argument = refinedPoint.Argument;
					if (argument < nextRefinedValueByMeasureUnit)
					{
						num2++;
					}
					else
					{
						list.AddRange(aggregatedPointsCreator.CreateAggregatedPoints(list3, index, num2, num3));
						index = list3.Count;
						num2 = 1;
						if (argument >= axisXScaleMap.GetNextRefinedValueByMeasureUnit(nextRefinedValueByMeasureUnit))
						{
							if (ShouldAddMissingPoints(axisXScaleMap, missingPointsCreator, num3 += 1.0, argument))
							{
								refinedPoint = missingPointsCreator.CreatePointForMissingArgument(num3);
								num--;
								nextRefinedValueByMeasureUnit = axisXScaleMap.GetNextRefinedValueByMeasureUnit(nextRefinedValueByMeasureUnit);
							}
							else
							{
								num3 = axisXScaleMap.RefinedToInternal(argument);
								double num5 = AlignArgument(argument, axisXScaleMap);
								list2.Add(new DoubleLimits(num4, list3[list3.Count - 1].Argument));
								num4 = num5;
								nextRefinedValueByMeasureUnit = axisXScaleMap.GetNextRefinedValueByMeasureUnit(num5);
							}
						}
						else
						{
							num3 += 1.0;
							nextRefinedValueByMeasureUnit = axisXScaleMap.GetNextRefinedValueByMeasureUnit(nextRefinedValueByMeasureUnit);
						}
					}
					num++;
					list3.Add(refinedPoint);
				}
				list.AddRange(aggregatedPointsCreator.CreateAggregatedPoints(list3, index, num2, num3));
				list2.Add(new DoubleLimits(num4, list3[list3.Count - 1].Argument));
			}
			list = EmptyPointsFilter.ProcessPointsWithoutCache(list, base.RefinedSeries.SeriesView);
			return PointsCacheEntry.Create(list, axisXScaleMap, list2);
		}

		private IAggregationCalculator CreateAggregationCalculator(AxisScaleTypeMap axisXScaleTypeMap)
		{
			if (base.AggregateFunction == AggregateFunctionNative.Custom && base.UserCalculator != null)
			{
				return new UserAggregateFunctionCalculator(axisXScaleTypeMap, base.UserCalculator);
			}
			ISeriesView seriesView = base.RefinedSeries.SeriesView;
			return AggregationCalculator.Create(base.AggregateFunction, seriesView.PointDimension, seriesView.PointInterfaceType, seriesView.IsPointAggregationSupported);
		}

		protected override PointsCacheEntry GetAggregatedPointsEntry(IList<RefinedPoint> points, AxisScaleTypeMap axisXScaleTypeMap)
		{
			AxisScaleTypeMap axisScaleTypeMap = base.AxisDataX.AxisScaleTypeMap;
			MissingArgumentsCalculator missingPointsCreator = MissingArgumentsCalculator.Create(axisScaleTypeMap, base.RefinedSeries.Series, base.RefinedSeries.SeriesView.PointDimension, base.ProcessMissingPoints);
			ErrorBarsPointsCalculator errorBarsPointsCalculator = (IsSeriesContainsErrorBars() ? new ErrorBarsPointsCalculator() : null);
			IAggregationCalculator calculator = CreateAggregationCalculator(axisXScaleTypeMap);
			AggregatedPointsCreatorBase aggregatedPointsCreator = AggregatedPointsCreatorBase.Create(base.RefinedSeries, axisXScaleTypeMap, base.AxisDataY.AxisScaleTypeMap, calculator, errorBarsPointsCalculator);
			return ClusterPoints(points, axisXScaleTypeMap, aggregatedPointsCreator, missingPointsCreator);
		}

		protected override object GetPointsCacheKey()
		{
			return scaleOptionsInfo;
		}

		protected override bool IsEnabled()
		{
			return IsAxisAggregationEnabled(base.AxisDataX, base.RefinedSeries.SeriesView, base.RefinedSeries.ArgumentScaleType);
		}

		protected override bool IsNeedInvalidate()
		{
			return false;
		}

		protected override bool IsNeedClearCache()
		{
			if (!base.IsNeedClearCache())
			{
				return scaleTypeX != base.RefinedSeries.ArgumentScaleType;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override void SaveParameters()
		{
			base.SaveParameters();
			scaleTypeX = base.RefinedSeries.ArgumentScaleType;
			scaleOptionsInfo = GetScaleOptionsInfo(base.AxisDataX);
		}

		public ArgumentsWithoutGapsInfo GetArgumentsWithoutGaps()
		{
			object pointsCacheKey = GetPointsCacheKey();
			if (base.PointsCache.TryGetValue(pointsCacheKey, out var value))
			{
				return new ArgumentsWithoutGapsInfo
				{
					ArgumentsWithoutGaps = value.ArgumentsWithoutGaps,
					ScaleTypeMap = value.ScaleMap
				};
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
	public class AggregationPointFilter3D : AggregationPointFilterBase
	{
		private ScaleOptionsInfo measureUnitX;

		private ScaleOptionsInfo measureUnitZ;

		private ActualScaleTypeCore scaleTypeX;

		private ActualScaleTypeCore scaleTypeZ;

		public AggregationPointFilter3D(RefinedSeries refinedSeries)
			: base(refinedSeries)
		{
		}

		private RefinedPoint CreateAggregatedPoint(RefinedPointsCluster3D cluster, double[] values, AxisScaleTypeMap axisXScaleTypeMap, CorePointState state)
		{
			if (state != CorePointState.HasValues)
			{
				return null;
			}
			AxisScaleTypeMap axisScaleTypeMap = base.AxisDataZ.AxisScaleTypeMap;
			Scale argumentScaleTypeX = DataItemsHelper.ConvertToScale(base.RefinedSeries.ArgumentScaleType);
			Scale argumentScaleTypeY = DataItemsHelper.ConvertToScale(base.RefinedSeries.ArgumentScaleType2);
			double num = axisXScaleTypeMap.RefinedToInternalExact(cluster.GetAverageX());
			double num2 = axisScaleTypeMap.RefinedToInternalExact(cluster.GetAverageY());
			object argumentX = ((axisXScaleTypeMap.ScaleType != ActualScaleTypeCore.Qualitative) ? axisXScaleTypeMap.InternalToNative(num) : string.Empty);
			object argumentY = ((axisScaleTypeMap.ScaleType != ActualScaleTypeCore.Qualitative) ? axisScaleTypeMap.InternalToNative(num2) : string.Empty);
			AggregatedSeriesPoint point = new AggregatedSeriesPoint(base.RefinedSeries, argumentScaleTypeX, argumentScaleTypeY, argumentX, argumentY, values, cluster.Points, 0, cluster.Points.Count, state);
			return ObjectsFactory.Default.Create(point, num, num2, values, state);
		}

		private IList<RefinedPoint> GetAggregatedFunctionPoints(IList<RefinedPointsCluster3D> clusteredPoints, IAggregationCalculator calculator, AxisScaleTypeMap axisXScaleTypeMap)
		{
			List<RefinedPoint> list = new List<RefinedPoint>(clusteredPoints.Count);
			for (int i = 0; i < clusteredPoints.Count; i++)
			{
				List<RefinedPoint> points = clusteredPoints[i].Points;
				if (calculator.CanKeepSinglePoint && points.Count == 1 && points[0].Argument == clusteredPoints[i].ArgumentX && points[0].ArgumentY == clusteredPoints[i].ArgumentY)
				{
					list.Add(points[0]);
					continue;
				}
				CorePointState pointState;
				double[] values = calculator.Calculate(points, 0, points.Count, out pointState);
				RefinedPoint refinedPoint = CreateAggregatedPoint(clusteredPoints[i], values, axisXScaleTypeMap, pointState);
				if (refinedPoint != null)
				{
					list.Add(refinedPoint);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		private IList<RefinedPoint> GetAggregatedSourcePoints(IList<RefinedPointsCluster3D> clusteredPoints, AxisScaleTypeMap axisXScaleTypeMap)
		{
			List<RefinedPoint> list = new List<RefinedPoint>();
			for (int i = 0; i < clusteredPoints.Count; i++)
			{
				foreach (RefinedPoint point in clusteredPoints[i].Points)
				{
					RefinedPointsCluster3D cluster = new RefinedPointsCluster3D(clusteredPoints[i].ArgumentX, clusteredPoints[i].ArgumentY);
					cluster.AddPoint(point);
					RefinedPoint refinedPoint = CreateAggregatedPoint(cluster, new double[4] { point.Value1, point.Value2, point.Value3, point.Value4 }, axisXScaleTypeMap, point.State);
					refinedPoint.Index = point.Index;
					list.Add(refinedPoint);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected override PointsCacheEntry GetAggregatedPointsEntry(IList<RefinedPoint> points, AxisScaleTypeMap axisXScaleTypeMap)
		{
			IAggregationCalculator aggregationCalculator = AggregationCalculator.Create(base.AggregateFunction, base.RefinedSeries.SeriesView.PointDimension, base.RefinedSeries.SeriesView.PointInterfaceType);
			RefinedPointsAggregator3D refinedPointsAggregator3D = new RefinedPointsAggregator3D(base.AxisDataX.AxisScaleTypeMap, base.AxisDataZ.AxisScaleTypeMap);
			IList<RefinedPointsCluster3D> clusteredPoints = refinedPointsAggregator3D.ClusterPoints(points);
			IList<RefinedPoint> points2 = ((aggregationCalculator != null) ? GetAggregatedFunctionPoints(clusteredPoints, aggregationCalculator, axisXScaleTypeMap) : GetAggregatedSourcePoints(clusteredPoints, axisXScaleTypeMap));
			return PointsCacheEntry.Create(points2, axisXScaleTypeMap);
		}

		protected override object GetPointsCacheKey()
		{
			return new MeasureUnitPair(measureUnitX, measureUnitZ);
		}

		protected override bool IsEnabled()
		{
			if (!IsAxisAggregationEnabled(base.AxisDataX, base.RefinedSeries.SeriesView, base.RefinedSeries.ArgumentScaleType))
			{
				return IsAxisAggregationEnabled(base.AxisDataZ, base.RefinedSeries.SeriesView, base.RefinedSeries.ArgumentScaleType2);
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override bool IsNeedInvalidate()
		{
			if (object.Equals(measureUnitX, GetScaleOptionsInfo(base.AxisDataX)))
			{
				return !object.Equals(measureUnitZ, GetScaleOptionsInfo(base.AxisDataZ));
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override bool IsNeedClearCache()
		{
			if (!base.IsNeedClearCache() && scaleTypeX == base.RefinedSeries.ArgumentScaleType)
			{
				return scaleTypeZ != base.RefinedSeries.ArgumentScaleType2;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override void SaveParameters()
		{
			base.SaveParameters();
			scaleTypeX = base.RefinedSeries.ArgumentScaleType;
			measureUnitX = GetScaleOptionsInfo(base.AxisDataX);
			scaleTypeZ = base.RefinedSeries.ArgumentScaleType2;
			measureUnitZ = GetScaleOptionsInfo(base.AxisDataZ);
		}
	}
	public class RefinedPointsAggregator3D
	{
		private readonly AxisScaleTypeMap axisXScaleMap;

		private readonly AxisScaleTypeMap axisZScaleMap;

		public RefinedPointsAggregator3D(AxisScaleTypeMap axisXScaleMap, AxisScaleTypeMap axisZScaleMap)
		{
			this.axisXScaleMap = axisXScaleMap;
			this.axisZScaleMap = axisZScaleMap;
		}

		public IList<RefinedPointsCluster3D> ClusterPoints(IList<RefinedPoint> points)
		{
			List<RefinedPointsCluster3D> list = new List<RefinedPointsCluster3D>();
			double num = double.NaN;
			int num2 = -1;
			for (int i = 0; i < points.Count; i++)
			{
				double num3 = axisXScaleMap.RefinedToInternal(points[i].Argument);
				double num4 = axisZScaleMap.RefinedToInternal(points[i].ArgumentY);
				int num5 = -1;
				if (num3 != num)
				{
					list.Add(new RefinedPointsCluster3D(num3, num4));
					num2 = list.Count - 1;
					num5 = num2;
					num = num3;
				}
				else
				{
					for (int j = num2; j < list.Count; j++)
					{
						if (list[j].ArgumentY == num4)
						{
							num5 = j;
							break;
						}
					}
					if (num5 == -1)
					{
						list.Add(new RefinedPointsCluster3D(num3, num4));
						num5 = list.Count - 1;
					}
				}
				list[num5].AddPoint(points[i]);
			}
			return list;
		}
	}
	public struct ScaleOptionsInfo : IEquatable<ScaleOptionsInfo>
	{
		private readonly ScaleModeNative scaleMode;

		private readonly object measureUnit;

		private readonly int measureUnitMultiplier;

		private readonly AggregationIntervalsInfo aggregationIntervalsInfo;

		public static bool operator ==(ScaleOptionsInfo a, ScaleOptionsInfo b)
		{
			return a.Equals(b);
		}

		public static bool operator !=(ScaleOptionsInfo a, ScaleOptionsInfo b)
		{
			return !(a == b);
		}

		public ScaleOptionsInfo(ScaleModeNative scaleMode, object measureUnit, int measureUnitMultiplier)
			: this(scaleMode, measureUnit, measureUnitMultiplier, null)
		{
		}

		public ScaleOptionsInfo(ScaleModeNative scaleMode, object measureUnit, int measureUnitMultiplier, AggregationIntervalsInfo aggregationIntervalsInfo)
		{
			this.measureUnit = measureUnit;
			this.measureUnitMultiplier = measureUnitMultiplier;
			this.aggregationIntervalsInfo = aggregationIntervalsInfo;
			this.scaleMode = scaleMode;
		}

		public bool Equals(ScaleOptionsInfo other)
		{
			if (object.Equals(other.measureUnit, measureUnit) && object.Equals(other.measureUnitMultiplier, measureUnitMultiplier))
			{
				if (scaleMode == ScaleModeNative.Interval)
				{
					return object.Equals(other.aggregationIntervalsInfo, aggregationIntervalsInfo);
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			ScaleOptionsInfo other = (ScaleOptionsInfo)obj;
			return Equals(other);
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return base.GetHashCode();
		}
	}
	public struct MeasureUnitPair : IEquatable<MeasureUnitPair>
	{
		private readonly ScaleOptionsInfo measureUnitX;

		private readonly ScaleOptionsInfo measureUnitZ;

		public static bool operator ==(MeasureUnitPair a, MeasureUnitPair b)
		{
			return a.Equals(b);
		}

		public static bool operator !=(MeasureUnitPair a, MeasureUnitPair b)
		{
			return !(a == b);
		}

		public MeasureUnitPair(ScaleOptionsInfo measureUnitX, ScaleOptionsInfo measureUnitZ)
		{
			this.measureUnitX = measureUnitX;
			this.measureUnitZ = measureUnitZ;
		}

		public bool Equals(MeasureUnitPair other)
		{
			if (object.Equals(other.measureUnitX, measureUnitX))
			{
				return object.Equals(other.measureUnitZ, measureUnitZ);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			MeasureUnitPair other = (MeasureUnitPair)obj;
			return Equals(other);
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return base.GetHashCode();
		}
	}
	public class ArgumentsWithoutGapsInfo
	{
		public AxisScaleTypeMap ScaleTypeMap { get; set; }

		public List<DoubleLimits> ArgumentsWithoutGaps { get; set; }
	}
	public abstract class RefinedPointComparerBase : Comparer<RefinedPoint>
	{
		public virtual bool IsSupportedPoint(RefinedPoint point)
		{
			return true;
		}
	}
	public class SeriesPointSettingsComparer : RefinedPointComparerBase
	{
		private readonly bool isAscending;

		private readonly SeriesPointKeyNative sortingPointKey;

		private readonly ISeriesBase series;

		public SeriesPointSettingsComparer(bool isAscending, SeriesPointKeyNative sortingKey, ISeries series)
		{
			this.isAscending = isAscending;
			sortingPointKey = sortingKey;
			this.series = series;
		}

		private Scale GetScale()
		{
			if (sortingPointKey == SeriesPointKeyNative.Argument)
			{
				return series.ArgumentScaleType;
			}
			return series.ValueScaleType;
		}

		public override int Compare(RefinedPoint pointInArray, RefinedPoint newPoint)
		{
			if (newPoint == null)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			if (pointInArray == null)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			int num;
			switch (GetScale())
			{
			case Scale.Qualitative:
			{
				string qualitativeValue = GetQualitativeValue(pointInArray);
				string qualitativeValue2 = GetQualitativeValue(newPoint);
				num = (isAscending ? qualitativeValue.CompareTo(qualitativeValue2) : qualitativeValue2.CompareTo(qualitativeValue));
				break;
			}
			case Scale.Numerical:
			{
				double value = GetValue(pointInArray);
				double value2 = GetValue(newPoint);
				num = (isAscending ? value.CompareTo(value2) : value2.CompareTo(value));
				break;
			}
			case Scale.DateTime:
			{
				DateTime dateTimeValue = GetDateTimeValue(pointInArray);
				DateTime dateTimeValue2 = GetDateTimeValue(newPoint);
				num = (isAscending ? dateTimeValue.CompareTo(dateTimeValue2) : dateTimeValue2.CompareTo(dateTimeValue));
				break;
			}
			case Scale.TimeSpan:
			{
				TimeSpan timeSpanValue = GetTimeSpanValue(pointInArray);
				TimeSpan timeSpanValue2 = GetTimeSpanValue(newPoint);
				num = (isAscending ? timeSpanValue.CompareTo(timeSpanValue2) : timeSpanValue2.CompareTo(timeSpanValue));
				break;
			}
			default:
				num = 0;
				break;
			}
			if (num != 0)
			{
				return num;
			}
			return pointInArray.Index.CompareTo(newPoint.Index);
		}

		private double GetValue(RefinedPoint refinedPoint)
		{
			return sortingPointKey switch
			{
				SeriesPointKeyNative.Argument => refinedPoint.NumericalArgument, 
				SeriesPointKeyNative.Value_1 => refinedPoint.GetNumericalValue(0), 
				SeriesPointKeyNative.Value_2 => refinedPoint.GetNumericalValue(1), 
				SeriesPointKeyNative.Value_3 => refinedPoint.GetNumericalValue(2), 
				SeriesPointKeyNative.Value_4 => refinedPoint.GetNumericalValue(3), 
				SeriesPointKeyNative.Value_5 => refinedPoint.GetNumericalValue(4), 
				SeriesPointKeyNative.Value_6 => refinedPoint.GetNumericalValue(5), 
				_ => refinedPoint.NumericalArgument, 
			};
		}

		private string GetQualitativeValue(RefinedPoint refinedPoint)
		{
			return refinedPoint.SeriesPoint.ArgumentX.QualitativeArgument;
		}

		private DateTime GetDateTimeValue(RefinedPoint refinedPoint)
		{
			return sortingPointKey switch
			{
				SeriesPointKeyNative.Argument => refinedPoint.DateTimeArgument, 
				SeriesPointKeyNative.Value_1 => refinedPoint.GetDateTimeValue(0), 
				SeriesPointKeyNative.Value_2 => refinedPoint.GetDateTimeValue(1), 
				SeriesPointKeyNative.Value_3 => refinedPoint.GetDateTimeValue(2), 
				SeriesPointKeyNative.Value_4 => refinedPoint.GetDateTimeValue(3), 
				_ => refinedPoint.GetDateTimeValue(0), 
			};
		}

		private TimeSpan GetTimeSpanValue(RefinedPoint refinedPoint)
		{
			return sortingPointKey switch
			{
				SeriesPointKeyNative.Argument => refinedPoint.TimeSpanArgument, 
				SeriesPointKeyNative.Value_1 => refinedPoint.GetTimeSpanValue(0), 
				SeriesPointKeyNative.Value_2 => refinedPoint.GetTimeSpanValue(1), 
				SeriesPointKeyNative.Value_3 => refinedPoint.GetTimeSpanValue(2), 
				SeriesPointKeyNative.Value_4 => refinedPoint.GetTimeSpanValue(3), 
				_ => refinedPoint.GetTimeSpanValue(0), 
			};
		}
	}
	public class RefinedPointsArgumentComparer : RefinedPointComparerBase
	{
		public override bool IsSupportedPoint(RefinedPoint point)
		{
			return !double.IsNaN(point.Argument);
		}

		public override int Compare(RefinedPoint pointInArray, RefinedPoint newPoint)
		{
			if (newPoint == null)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			if (pointInArray == null)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(pointInArray.Argument) ^ double.IsNaN(newPoint.Argument))
			{
				if (!double.IsNaN(pointInArray.Argument))
				{
					return -1;
				}
				return 1;
			}
			return pointInArray.Argument.CompareTo(newPoint.Argument);
		}
	}
	public class RefinedPointsArgumentAndIndexComparer : RefinedPointsArgumentComparer
	{
		public override int Compare(RefinedPoint pointInArray, RefinedPoint newPoint)
		{
			if (newPoint == null)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			if (pointInArray == null)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(pointInArray.Argument) || double.IsNaN(newPoint.Argument))
			{
				if (double.IsNaN(pointInArray.Argument) && double.IsNaN(newPoint.Argument))
				{
					return 0;
				}
				if (!double.IsNaN(pointInArray.Argument))
				{
					return -1;
				}
				return 1;
			}
			int num = pointInArray.Argument.CompareTo(newPoint.Argument);
			if (num != 0)
			{
				return num;
			}
			return pointInArray.Index.CompareTo(newPoint.Index);
		}
	}
	public class RefinedPointsValueComparer : RefinedPointComparerBase
	{
		public override bool IsSupportedPoint(RefinedPoint point)
		{
			return !double.IsNaN(((IValuePoint)point).Value);
		}

		public override int Compare(RefinedPoint pointInArray, RefinedPoint newPoint)
		{
			if (newPoint == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException();
			}
			return ((IValuePoint)pointInArray)?.Value.CompareTo(((IValuePoint)newPoint).Value) ?? 1;
		}
	}
	public class RefinedPointsRangeValue1Comparer : RefinedPointComparerBase

		public override bool IsSupportedPoint(RefinedPoint point)
		{
			return !double.IsNaN(((IRangePoint)point).Value1);
		}

		public override int Compare(RefinedPoint pointInArray, RefinedPoint newPoint)
		{
			if (newPoint == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException();
			}
			return ((IRangePoint)pointInArray)?.Value1.CompareTo(((IRangePoint)newPoint).Value1) ?? 1;
		}
	}
	public class RefinedPointsRangeValue2Comparer : RefinedPointComparerBase
	{
		public override bool IsSupportedPoint(RefinedPoint point)
		{
			return !double.IsNaN(((IRangePoint)point).Value2);
		}

		public override int Compare(RefinedPoint pointInArray, RefinedPoint newPoint)
		{
			if (newPoint == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException();
			}
			return ((IRangePoint)pointInArray)?.Value2.CompareTo(((IRangePoint)newPoint).Value2) ?? 1;
		}
	}

		public override bool IsSupportedPoint(RefinedPoint point)

			return !double.IsNaN(((IXYWPoint)point).Weight);
		}

		public override int Compare(RefinedPoint pointInArray, RefinedPoint newPoint)
