	public interface IRefinedPointCreator
	{
		RefinedPoint CreateRefinedPoint(IPointProcessor processor, ISeriesPoint seriesPoint, List<AxisScaleTypeMap> argumentMaps);
	}
	public interface ISeriesPointCreator
	{
		ISeriesPoint CreateSeriesPoint(RefinedPoint point);
	}
	public class CollectionManager : IRefinedPointCreator
	{
		private readonly RefinedSeries refinedSeries;

		private readonly RefinedPointCollection points;

		private readonly RefinedPointsArgumentComparer argumentComparer = new RefinedPointsArgumentComparer();

		private readonly List<SortedRefinedPointCollectionBase> sortedCollections = new List<SortedRefinedPointCollectionBase>();

		private readonly SortedArgumentRefinedPointCollection pointsSortedByArgument;

		private SortedRefinedPointCollection pointsSortedBySettings;

		private int minUpdatePointIndex = -1;

		private bool ShouldSort => !refinedSeries.ActualDataSourceSorted;

		public RefinedPointCollectionBase Points => points;

		public RefinedPointCollectionBase PointsSortedBySettings => pointsSortedBySettings ?? Points;

		public SortedArgumentRefinedPointCollection PointsSortedByArgument => pointsSortedByArgument;

		public CollectionManager(RefinedSeries refinedSeries)
		{
			int capacity = 0;
			this.refinedSeries = refinedSeries;
			ISeries series = refinedSeries.Series;
			if (series.ActualPoints != null)
			{
				capacity = series.ActualPoints.Count;
			}
			points = new RefinedPointCollection(capacity);
			pointsSortedByArgument = new SortedArgumentRefinedPointCollection(points.Count, new RefinedPointsArgumentAndIndexComparer());
			if (series.SeriesPointsSortingMode != SortMode.None)
			{
				SeriesPointSettingsComparer comparer = new SeriesPointSettingsComparer(series.SeriesPointsSortingMode == SortMode.Ascending, series.SeriesPointsSortingKey, series);
				pointsSortedBySettings = new SortedRefinedPointCollection(points.Count, comparer);
			}
			UpdateCollectionsList();
		}

		RefinedPoint IRefinedPointCreator.CreateRefinedPoint(IPointProcessor processor, ISeriesPoint seriesPoint, List<AxisScaleTypeMap> argumentMaps)
		{
			RefinedPoint refinedPoint = ObjectsFactory.Default.Create(seriesPoint);
			ProcessPoint(processor, refinedPoint, argumentMaps);
			return refinedPoint;
		}

		private void UpdateCollectionsList()
		{
			sortedCollections.Clear();
			sortedCollections.Add(pointsSortedByArgument);
			if (pointsSortedBySettings != null)
			{
				sortedCollections.Add(pointsSortedBySettings);
			}
		}

		private RefinedPoint RefinePoint(IPointProcessor processor, IDataPoint seriesPoint, List<AxisScaleTypeMap> argumentMaps)
		{
			return seriesPoint?.GetRefinedPoint(this, processor, argumentMaps);
		}

		private void ProcessPoint(IPointProcessor processor, RefinedPoint point, List<AxisScaleTypeMap> argumentMaps)
		{
			if (processor != null)
			{
				AxisScaleTypeMap valueMap = ((refinedSeries.ValueGroup == null) ? null : refinedSeries.ValueGroup.ScaleMap);
				bool isEmpty = point.IsValueEmpty((Scale)refinedSeries.ValueScaleType);
				processor.ProcessPoint(point, argumentMaps, valueMap, isEmpty);
			}
		}

		private void ProcessPointValues(IPointProcessor processor, RefinedPoint point)
		{
			if (processor != null)
			{
				AxisScaleTypeMap valueMap = ((refinedSeries.ValueGroup == null) ? null : refinedSeries.ValueGroup.ScaleMap);
				bool isEmpty = point.IsValueEmpty((Scale)refinedSeries.ValueScaleType);
				processor.ProcessPointValues(point, valueMap, isEmpty);
			}
		}

		private void CleanSeriesPoints()
		{
			points.Clear();
			sortedCollections.ForEach(delegate(SortedRefinedPointCollectionBase pointsCollection)
			{
				pointsCollection.Clear();
			});
		}

		private RefinedPoint[] InsertSeriesPoints(IPointProcessor processor, int insertIndex, ICollection<IDataPoint> insertPoints)
		{
			if (insertPoints == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			RefinedPoint[] array = new RefinedPoint[insertPoints.Count];
			int num = 0;
			List<AxisScaleTypeMap> argumentScaleMaps = refinedSeries.GetArgumentScaleMaps();
			foreach (IDataPoint insertPoint in insertPoints)
			{
				array[num++] = RefinePoint(processor, insertPoint, argumentScaleMaps);
			}
			TryUpdatePointsIndices(insertIndex, array);
			points.InsertRange(insertIndex, array);
			if (refinedSeries.ArgumentGroups != null)
			{
				UpdatePointsIndices();
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < sortedCollections.Count; i++)
			{
				sortedCollections[i].AddRange(array, ShouldSort);
			}
			return array;
		}

		private RefinedPoint[] RemoveSeriesPoints(int removeIndex, int pointsCount)
		{
			if (removeIndex < 0 || pointsCount <= 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			RefinedPoint[] array = new RefinedPoint[pointsCount];
			for (int i = 0; i < pointsCount; i++)
			{
				array[i] = points[removeIndex + i];
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < pointsCount; j++)
			{
				pointsSortedByArgument.Remove(array[j]);
				if (pointsSortedBySettings != null)
				{
					pointsSortedBySettings.Remove(array[j]);
				}
			}
			points.RemoveRange(removeIndex, pointsCount);
			return array;
		}

		private void MoveSeriesSinglePoint(int oldIndex, int newIndex)
		{
			TryUpdatePointsIndices(newIndex, points[oldIndex]);
			points.Move(oldIndex, newIndex);
			if (refinedSeries.ArgumentGroups != null)
			{
				UpdatePointsIndices();
			}
			if (ShouldSort)
			{
				pointsSortedByArgument.Sort();
			}
		}

		private void SwapSeriesSinglePoint(int index1, int index2)
		{
			points.Swap(index1, index2);
			if (points[index1].Argument == points[index2].Argument)
			{
				int index3 = points[index1].Index;
				points[index1].Index = points[index2].Index;
				points[index2].Index = index3;
				if (ShouldSort)
				{
					pointsSortedByArgument.Sort();
				}
			}
		}

		private bool DetectPointIndexOverflow(int pointsCount, int pointIndex)
		{
			if (pointIndex < 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return int.MaxValue - pointIndex < pointsCount;
		}

		private void TryUpdatePointsIndices(int sourceCollectionStartIndex, params RefinedPoint[] refinedPoints)
		{
			if (minUpdatePointIndex < 0)
			{
				if (sourceCollectionStartIndex == points.Count)
				{
					int num = ((sourceCollectionStartIndex == 0) ? (-1) : points[sourceCollectionStartIndex - 1].Index);
					int num2 = num + 1;
					if (!DetectPointIndexOverflow(refinedPoints.Length, num))
					{
						for (int i = 0; i < refinedPoints.Length; i++)
						{
							refinedPoints[i].Index = num2 + i;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						minUpdatePointIndex = 0;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					minUpdatePointIndex = sourceCollectionStartIndex;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				minUpdatePointIndex = Math.Min(minUpdatePointIndex, sourceCollectionStartIndex);
			}
		}

		private RefinedPoint FindRefinePointBySeriesPoint(IDataPoint seriesPoint)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < points.Count; i++)
			{
				if (points[i].SeriesPoint == seriesPoint)
				{
					return points[i];
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private RefinedSeriesPointsUpdateInfo CreateResetInfo()
		{
			CleanSeriesPoints();
			return new RefinedSeriesPointsUpdateInfo(ChartCollectionOperation.Reset, refinedSeries, null);
		}

		internal virtual RefinedSeriesPointsUpdateInfo UpdateCollections(IPointProcessor processor, SeriesPointsCollectionAction updateAction)
		{
			if (ActionTypeHelper.ShouldCleanCollection(updateAction.UpdateType))
			{
				return CreateResetInfo();
			}
			if (ActionTypeHelper.ShouldInsertInCollection(updateAction.UpdateType))
			{
				RefinedPoint[] array = InsertSeriesPoints(processor, updateAction.NewIndex, updateAction.NewItem);
				if (array == null)
				{
					return CreateResetInfo();
				}
				return new RefinedSeriesPointsUpdateInfo(ChartCollectionOperation.InsertItem, refinedSeries, array);
			}
			if (ActionTypeHelper.ShouldRemoveFromCollection(updateAction.UpdateType))
			{
				RefinedPoint[] array2 = RemoveSeriesPoints(updateAction.OldIndex, updateAction.OldItem.Count);
				if (array2 == null)
				{
					return CreateResetInfo();
				}
				return new RefinedSeriesPointsUpdateInfo(ChartCollectionOperation.RemoveItem, refinedSeries, array2);
			}
			if (ActionTypeHelper.ShouldMoveInCollection(updateAction.UpdateType))
			{
				MoveSeriesSinglePoint(updateAction.OldIndex, updateAction.NewIndex);
			}
			else if (ActionTypeHelper.ShouldSwapInCollection(updateAction.UpdateType))
			{
				SwapSeriesSinglePoint(updateAction.OldIndex, updateAction.NewIndex);
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal List<RefinedSeriesPointsUpdateInfo> UpdatePoint(IPointProcessor processor, IDataPoint seriesPoint, List<AxisScaleTypeMap> argumentMaps)
		{
			RefinedPoint oldPoint = FindRefinePointBySeriesPoint(seriesPoint);
			if (oldPoint == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			RefinedPoint newPoint = ObjectsFactory.Default.Create(oldPoint.SeriesPoint);
			newPoint.Index = oldPoint.Index;
			ProcessPoint(processor, newPoint, argumentMaps);
			int index = points.IndexOf(oldPoint);
			points[index] = newPoint;
			RefinedSeriesPointsUpdateInfo item = new RefinedSeriesPointsUpdateInfo(ChartCollectionOperation.RemoveItem, refinedSeries, new RefinedPoint[1] { oldPoint });
			RefinedSeriesPointsUpdateInfo item2 = new RefinedSeriesPointsUpdateInfo(ChartCollectionOperation.InsertItem, refinedSeries, new RefinedPoint[1] { newPoint });
			sortedCollections.ForEach(delegate(SortedRefinedPointCollectionBase pointsCollection)
			{
				pointsCollection.Remove(oldPoint);
			});
			sortedCollections.ForEach(delegate(SortedRefinedPointCollectionBase pointsCollection)
			{
				pointsCollection.Add(newPoint);
			});
			return new List<RefinedSeriesPointsUpdateInfo> { item, item2 };
		}

		internal List<RefinedPoint> FindAllPointsWithSameArgument(RefinedPoint refinedPoint)
		{
			List<RefinedPoint> list = new List<RefinedPoint>();
			int num = pointsSortedByArgument.BinarySearch(refinedPoint, argumentComparer);
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				for (int i = num; i < pointsSortedByArgument.Count && refinedPoint.Argument == pointsSortedByArgument[i].Argument; i++)
				{
					if (refinedPoint != pointsSortedByArgument[i])
					{
						list.Add(pointsSortedByArgument[i]);
					}
				}
				int num2 = num - 1;
				while (num2 >= 0 && refinedPoint.Argument == pointsSortedByArgument[num2].Argument)
				{
					if (refinedPoint != pointsSortedByArgument[num2])
					{
						list.Add(pointsSortedByArgument[num2]);
					}
					num2--;
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		internal void ReplacePoint(IDataPoint seriesPoint, int indexInCollection)
		{
			points[indexInCollection].ReplaceSeriesPoint(seriesPoint);
		}

		public void UpdatePointsIndices()
		{
			if (minUpdatePointIndex >= 0)
			{
				int num = ((minUpdatePointIndex != 0) ? (points[minUpdatePointIndex - 1].Index + 1) : 0);
				for (int i = minUpdatePointIndex; i < points.Count; i++)
				{
					points[i].Index = num;
					num++;
				}
			}
			minUpdatePointIndex = -1;
		}

		public void ProcessPoints(IPointProcessor processor)
		{
			List<AxisScaleTypeMap> argumentScaleMaps = refinedSeries.GetArgumentScaleMaps();
			for (int i = 0; i < points.Count; i++)
			{
				ProcessPoint(processor, points[i], argumentScaleMaps);
			}
			if (ShouldSort)
			{
				pointsSortedByArgument.Sort();
			}
		}

		public void ProcessPointsValues(IPointProcessor processor)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < points.Count; i++)
			{
				ProcessPointValues(processor, points[i]);
			}
		}

		public void ProcessSortingPointModeUpdate(SortMode newSortingMode, SeriesPointKeyNative pointsSortingKey)
		{
			if (newSortingMode == SortMode.None)
			{
				if (pointsSortedBySettings != null)
				{
					pointsSortedBySettings = null;
					UpdateCollectionsList();
				}
				return;
			}
			bool isAscending = newSortingMode == SortMode.Ascending;
			bool shouldSort = ShouldSort;
			SeriesPointSettingsComparer comparer = new SeriesPointSettingsComparer(isAscending, pointsSortingKey, refinedSeries.Series);
			if (pointsSortedBySettings == null)
			{
				pointsSortedBySettings = new SortedRefinedPointCollection(points.Count, comparer);
				pointsSortedBySettings.Initialize(points, shouldSort);
				UpdateCollectionsList();
			}
			else
			{
				pointsSortedBySettings.SetComparer(comparer);
			}
			if (shouldSort)
			{
				pointsSortedBySettings.Sort();
			}
		}

		public void ProcessSortingPointKeyUpdate(SeriesPointKeyNative newSortingKey, SortMode pointsSortingMode)
		{
			if (pointsSortedBySettings != null && pointsSortingMode != SortMode.None && ShouldSort)
			{
				SeriesPointSettingsComparer comparer = new SeriesPointSettingsComparer(pointsSortingMode == SortMode.Ascending, newSortingKey, refinedSeries.Series);
				pointsSortedBySettings.SetComparer(comparer);
				pointsSortedBySettings.Sort();
			}
		}

		public double GetMinAbsArgument()
		{
			double argument = 0.0;
			if (pointsSortedByArgument.Count == 0)
			{
				return double.MaxValue;
			}
			RefinedPoint item = ObjectsFactory.Default.Create(argument, 0.0);
			int num = pointsSortedByArgument.BinarySearch(item, argumentComparer);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				num = ~num;
				if (num == 0)
				{
					return pointsSortedByArgument[0].Argument;
				}
				if (num >= pointsSortedByArgument.Count)
				{
					return pointsSortedByArgument[pointsSortedByArgument.Count - 1].Argument;
				}
				return Math.Min(Math.Abs(pointsSortedByArgument[num].Argument), Math.Abs(pointsSortedByArgument[num - 1].Argument));
			}
			if (num >= pointsSortedByArgument.Count - 1)
			{
				return pointsSortedByArgument[pointsSortedByArgument.Count - 1].Argument;
			}
			double argument2 = pointsSortedByArgument[num].Argument;
			if (argument2 == 0.0)
			{
				for (int i = num + 1; i < pointsSortedByArgument.Count; i++)
				{
					double argument3 = pointsSortedByArgument[i].Argument;
					if (argument3 > 0.0)
					{
						return argument3;
					}
				}
			}
			return pointsSortedByArgument[num].Argument;
		}

		public RefinedPoint GetMinPoint(double argument)
		{
			List<RefinedPoint> nearestPointsByArgument = RefinedPointFinder.GetNearestPointsByArgument(pointsSortedByArgument, argument);
			if (nearestPointsByArgument == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			double num = double.MaxValue;
			RefinedPoint result = null;
			foreach (RefinedPoint item in nearestPointsByArgument)
			{
				double refinedPointMin = refinedSeries.Series.SeriesView.GetRefinedPointMin(item);
				if (num > refinedPointMin)
				{
					num = refinedPointMin;
					result = item;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		public RefinedPoint GetMaxPoint(double argument)
		{
			List<RefinedPoint> nearestPointsByArgument = RefinedPointFinder.GetNearestPointsByArgument(pointsSortedByArgument, argument);
			if (nearestPointsByArgument == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			double num = double.MinValue;
			RefinedPoint result = null;
			foreach (RefinedPoint item in nearestPointsByArgument)
			{
				double refinedPointMax = refinedSeries.Series.SeriesView.GetRefinedPointMax(item);
				if (num < refinedPointMax)
				{
					num = refinedPointMax;
					result = item;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}
	}

		int IRefinedSeries.GetMaxVisiblePointIndex(bool onlyByArgument)
		{
			if (SeriesView != null && SeriesView.ShouldSortPoints)
			{
				if (onlyByArgument)
				{
					return CorrectVisiblePointIndex(FinalPointsSortedByArgument, MaxVisiblePointIndex);
				}
				return SeriesView.ViewportIntersectionHolder.CalculateEdgePointIndexInViewport(FinalPointsSortedByArgument, MinVisiblePointIndex, MaxVisiblePointIndex, isLeftIntersection: false);
			}
			return FinalPoints.Count - 1;
		}

		int IRefinedSeries.GetMinVisiblePointIndex(bool onlyByArgument)

			{

				}
				return SeriesView.ViewportIntersectionHolder.CalculateEdgePointIndexInViewport(FinalPointsSortedByArgument, MinVisiblePointIndex, MaxVisiblePointIndex, isLeftIntersection: true);
			}
			return 0;
		}

		RefinedPoint IRefinedSeries.GetRefinedPoint(IScaleMap scaleMap, ISeriesPoint seriesPoint)
		{

		private int CorrectVisiblePointIndex(SortedArgumentRefinedPointCollection points, int index)
		{
			if (points.MinPointIndex != -1 && index < points.MinPointIndex)
			{
				return points.MinPointIndex;
			}
			if (points.MaxPointIndex != -1 && index > points.MaxPointIndex)
			{
				return points.MaxPointIndex;
			}
			return index;
		}

		private RefinedPoint CreateViewportIntersectionPoint(RefinedPoint refinedPoint, List<GRealPoint2D> intersectionPoints)
		{
			List<double> list = new List<double>();
			foreach (GRealPoint2D intersectionPoint in intersectionPoints)
			{
				list.Add(intersectionPoint.Y);
			}
			return ObjectsFactory.Default.CreateFromRefined(refinedPoint, intersectionPoints[0].X, list);
		}

		private RefinedPoint GetRefinedPoint(RefinedPoint refinedPoint, ISeriesPoint seriesPoint)
		{
			if (seriesPoint.IsSamePoints(refinedPoint.SeriesPoint))
			{
				return refinedPoint;
			}
			if (refinedPoint.Children != null)
			{
				foreach (RefinedPoint child in refinedPoint.Children)
				{
					if (seriesPoint.IsSamePoints(child.SeriesPoint))
					{
						return refinedPoint;
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private RefinedPoint GetRefinedPoint(IScaleMap scaleMap, ISeriesPoint seriesPoint)
		{
			double argument = scaleMap.NativeToInternal(seriesPoint.ArgumentX.UserArgument);
			RefinedPoint item = ObjectsFactory.Default.Create(argument, 0.0);
			SortedArgumentRefinedPointCollection finalPointsSortedByArgument = FinalPointsSortedByArgument;
			if (finalPointsSortedByArgument.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			int num = finalPointsSortedByArgument.BinarySearch(item, argumentComparer);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				num = ~num;
				if (num > finalPointsSortedByArgument.Count - 1)
				{
					num = finalPointsSortedByArgument.Count - 1;
					return GetRefinedPoint(finalPointsSortedByArgument, num, seriesPoint);
				}
				RefinedPoint refinedPoint = GetRefinedPoint(finalPointsSortedByArgument, num, seriesPoint);
				if (refinedPoint != null || num == 0)
				{
					return refinedPoint;
				}
				return GetRefinedPoint(finalPointsSortedByArgument, num - 1, seriesPoint);
			}
			return GetRefinedPoint(finalPointsSortedByArgument, num, seriesPoint);
		}

		private RefinedPoint GetRefinedPoint(SortedArgumentRefinedPointCollection sortedPoints, int index, ISeriesPoint seriesPoint)
		{
			RefinedPoint refinedPoint = GetRefinedPoint(sortedPoints[index], seriesPoint);
			if (refinedPoint == null)
			{
				for (int i = index; i < sortedPoints.Count && sortedPoints[i].Argument == sortedPoints[index].Argument; i++)
				{
					refinedPoint = GetRefinedPoint(sortedPoints[i], seriesPoint);
					if (refinedPoint != null)
					{
						return refinedPoint;
					}
				}
				int num = index - 1;
				while (num >= 0 && sortedPoints[num].Argument == sortedPoints[index].Argument)
				{
					refinedPoint = GetRefinedPoint(sortedPoints[num], seriesPoint);
					if (refinedPoint != null)
					{
						return refinedPoint;
					}
					num--;
				}
			}
			return refinedPoint;
		}

		private bool SetVisibleMinMaxResamplerInfo(IMinMaxValues maxValues)
		{
			bool result = false;
			IMinMaxValues visibleRange = ResamplerData.VisibleRange;
			ResamplerData.VisibleRange = new MinMaxValues
			{
				Min = maxValues.Min,
				Max = maxValues.Max
			};
			if (SeriesView is IXYSeriesView { Pane: not null } iXYSeriesView && iXYSeriesView.Pane.MappingBounds.HasValue)
			{
				int num = (int)iXYSeriesView.Pane.MappingBounds.Value.Width;
				if (num > ResamplerData.ViewportWidth)
				{
					ResamplerData.ViewportWidth = num;
					result = true;
				}
				if (visibleRange == null || visibleRange.Min != maxValues.Min || visibleRange.Max != maxValues.Max)
				{
					result = true;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private void UpdateIndexesCore(IMinMaxValues visualRangeValues)
		{
			if (visualRangeValues != null && !double.IsNaN(visualRangeValues.Min) && !double.IsNaN(visualRangeValues.Max))
			{
				CalculateVisiblePointIndexes(visualRangeValues, out minVisibleIndex, out maxVisibleIndex);
				return;
			}
			minVisibleIndex = 0;
			maxVisibleIndex = Points.Count - 1;
		}

		private void UpdateResampler(IMinMaxValues visualRangeValues)
		{
			IResamplingSupportSeries irss = Series as IResamplingSupportSeries;
			if (irss == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			isInUpdateVisibleFromDataSource = true;
			double min = visualRangeValues.Min;
			double max = visualRangeValues.Max;
			irss.Invoke(delegate
			{
				try
				{
					if (ResamplerData == null || ResamplerData.VisibleRange == null || (ResamplerData.VisibleRange.Min == min && ResamplerData.VisibleRange.Max == max))
					{
						if (Series is IViewportChangedNotifiable viewportChangedNotifiable)
						{
							viewportChangedNotifiable.Notify();
						}
						irss.UpdateVisibleFromDataSource(this);
						UpdatePoints(new SeriesPointsCollectionAction(Series, CollectionActionType.CleanCollection));
						UpdatePoints(SeriesPointsCollectionAction.CreateInsertInfo(Series, Series.ActualPoints ?? new Collection<IDataPoint>(), 0));
						UpdateIndexesCore(visualRangeValues);
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					isInUpdateVisibleFromDataSource = false;
				}
			});
		}

		internal List<AxisScaleTypeMap> GetArgumentScaleMaps()
		{
			List<AxisScaleTypeMap> list = new List<AxisScaleTypeMap>();
			if (ArgumentGroups != null)

					list.Add(argumentGroup.ScaleMap);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		internal RefinedPoint GetFinalPointByArgument(double argument, out int index)
		{
			SortedArgumentRefinedPointCollection finalPointsSortedByArgument = FinalPointsSortedByArgument;
			index = finalPointsSortedByArgument.GetIndexByArgument(argument, fromRight: false, out var pointIsFound);
			if (!pointIsFound)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return finalPointsSortedByArgument[index];
		}

			}
		}

			RefinedSeriesPointsUpdateInfo refinedSeriesPointsUpdateInfo = pointsProcessor.UpdatePoints(updateAction);
			if (updateAction.UpdateType == CollectionActionType.CleanCollection || updateAction.UpdateType == CollectionActionType.RemoveFromCollection)
			{
				series.PointsRemoved(refinedSeriesPointsUpdateInfo.AffectedPoints);
			}
			return refinedSeriesPointsUpdateInfo;
		}

		public void CalculateVisiblePointIndexes(IMinMaxValues visualRangeValues, out int minIndex, out int maxIndex)
		{
			SortedArgumentRefinedPointCollection finalPointsSortedByArgument = FinalPointsSortedByArgument;
			minIndex = 0;
			maxIndex = -1;
			if (finalPointsSortedByArgument.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			int indexByArgument = finalPointsSortedByArgument.GetIndexByArgument(visualRangeValues.Min, fromRight: false, out var pointIsFound);
			int num = finalPointsSortedByArgument.Count - 1;
			if (indexByArgument > num && !pointIsFound)
			{
				minIndex = num;
				maxIndex = num;
				return;
			}
			if (indexByArgument > 0 && !pointIsFound)
			{
				minIndex = indexByArgument - 1;
			}
			else
			{
				minIndex = indexByArgument;
			}
			indexByArgument = finalPointsSortedByArgument.GetIndexByArgument(visualRangeValues.Max, fromRight: true, out pointIsFound);
			if (indexByArgument <= 0 && !pointIsFound)
			{
				minIndex = 0;
				maxIndex = 0;
			}
			else if (indexByArgument >= num)
			{
				maxIndex = num;
			}
			else
			{
				maxIndex = indexByArgument;
			}
		}

		{

		}

		public void ProcessSortingPointKeyUpdate()
		{

	public class TopNFilterBehavior : ValueThresholdFilterBehavior
	{
		private int CalculateMinPointIndex(IList<RefinedPoint> points)
		{
			int num = 0;
			for (int i = 1; i < points.Count; i++)
			{
				if (GetValue(points[num]) >= GetValue(points[i]))
				{
					num = i;
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		protected override IList<RefinedPoint> FilterPoints(IList<RefinedPoint> initialPoints, double valueThreshold)
		{
			int num = (int)valueThreshold;
			IList<RefinedPoint> list = new List<RefinedPoint>();
			int num2 = -1;
			for (int i = 0; i < initialPoints.Count; i++)
			{
				if (list.Count < num && !IsRefinedPointArgumentOthers(initialPoints[i]))
				{
					list.Add(initialPoints[i]);
					num2 = -1;
					continue;
				}
				if (!IsRefinedPointArgumentOthers(initialPoints[i]))
				{
					if (num2 < 0)
					{
						num2 = CalculateMinPointIndex(list);
					}
					if (num2 >= 0 && num2 < list.Count)
					{
						double value = GetValue(list[num2]);
						double value2 = GetValue(initialPoints[i]);
						if ((double.IsNaN(value) && !double.IsNaN(value2)) || value < value2)
						{
							AddToOthersPoints(list[num2]);
							list.RemoveAt(num2);
							list.Add(initialPoints[i]);
							num2 = -1;
							continue;
						}
					}
				}
				AddToOthersPoints(initialPoints[i]);
			}
			return list;
		}
	}
	public static class TypeConversion
	{
		public static object ConvertToCompatibleValue(object value, Type type)
		{
			TypeConverter converter = TypeDescriptor.GetConverter(type);
			if (converter == null)
			{
				return value;
			}
			try
			{
				return converter.ConvertTo(value, type);
			}
			catch
			{
				try
				{
					return converter.ConvertFrom(value);
				}
				catch
				{
					return value;
				}
			}
		}
	}

	public class Clusters : List<Cluster>
	{
		protected const double DefaultFactor = 50.0;

		private readonly double topHoleLimit;

		private double maxSize = double.NaN;

		private double minDistance = double.NaN;

		public double MaxSize => maxSize;

		public double MinDistance => minDistance;

		public Clusters(List<double> initialValues)
			: this(initialValues, int.MaxValue)
		{
		}

		public Clusters(List<double> initialValues, int clusterMaxCount, double factor = 50.0)
		{
			if (initialValues.Count == 0 || clusterMaxCount < 2)
			{
				return;
			}
			initialValues.Sort();
			Cluster cluster = new Cluster(initialValues);
			topHoleLimit = cluster.MinHole * factor;
			Add(cluster);
			while (true)
			{
				int indexOfClusterWithMaxHole = GetIndexOfClusterWithMaxHole();
				if (indexOfClusterWithMaxHole == -1)
				{
					break;
				}
				Cluster cluster2 = base[indexOfClusterWithMaxHole];
				if (cluster2.MaxHole < topHoleLimit)
				{
					break;
				}
				cluster2.Split(out var cluster3, out var cluster4);
				if (cluster3 != null && cluster4 != null)
				{
					RemoveAt(indexOfClusterWithMaxHole);
					Insert(indexOfClusterWithMaxHole, cluster4);
					Insert(indexOfClusterWithMaxHole, cluster3);
					if (base.Count == clusterMaxCount)
					{
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			CalculateMaxSize();
			CalculateMinDistance();
		}

		private void CalculateMaxSize()
		{
			using Enumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				Cluster current = enumerator.Current;
				maxSize = (double.IsNaN(maxSize) ? current.Size : Math.Max(maxSize, current.Size));
			}
		}

		private void CalculateMinDistance()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < base.Count - 1; i++)
			{
				double num = base[i + 1].FirstValue - base[i].LastValue;
				minDistance = (double.IsNaN(minDistance) ? num : Math.Min(minDistance, num));
			}
		}

		private int GetIndexOfClusterWithMaxHole()
		{
			int result = -1;
			double num = double.NaN;
			for (int i = 0; i < base.Count; i++)
			{
				Cluster cluster = base[i];
				if (!double.IsNaN(cluster.MaxHole) && (double.IsNaN(num) || cluster.MaxHole > num))
				{
					num = cluster.MaxHole;
					result = i;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}
	}
	public class Cluster
	{
		private readonly List<double> values = new List<double>();

		private double minHole = double.NaN;

		private double maxHole = double.NaN;

		private int maxHoleIndex = -1;

		public List<double> Values => values;

		public double FirstValue
		{
			get
			{
				if (values.Count <= 0)
				{
					return double.NaN;
				}
				return values[0];
			}
		}

		public double LastValue
		{
			get
			{
				if (values.Count <= 0)
				{
					return double.NaN;
				}
				return values[values.Count - 1];
			}
		}

		public double MinHole => minHole;

		public double MaxHole => maxHole;

		public int MaxHoleIndex => maxHoleIndex;

		public double Size => LastValue - FirstValue;

		public Cluster()
		{
		}

		public Cluster(IEnumerable<double> sortedValues)
		{
			foreach (double sortedValue in sortedValues)
			{
				AddValue(sortedValue);
			}
		}

		private void AddValue(double value)
		{
			if (values.Count > 0)
			{
				double num = value - LastValue;
				if (num > 0.0)
				{
					minHole = (double.IsNaN(minHole) ? num : Math.Min(minHole, num));
					if (double.IsNaN(maxHole) || num > maxHole)
					{
						maxHole = num;
						maxHoleIndex = values.Count - 1;
					}
				}
			}
			values.Add(value);
		}

		public void Split(out Cluster cluster1, out Cluster cluster2)
		{
			if (values.Count > 1 && maxHoleIndex != -1)
			{
				cluster1 = new Cluster();
				cluster2 = new Cluster();
				for (int i = 0; i <= maxHoleIndex; i++)
				{
					cluster1.AddValue(values[i]);
				}
				for (int j = maxHoleIndex + 1; j < values.Count; j++)
				{
					cluster2.AddValue(values[j]);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				cluster1 = null;
				cluster2 = null;
			}
		}
	}
	public static class DateTimeUtilsExt
	{
		private const int DaysInWeek = 7;

		private const int MonthsInQuarter = 3;

		private const int MonthsInYear = 12;

		private const int HoursInDay = 24;

		private const int MinutesInDay = 1440;

		private const int SecondsInDay = 86400;

		private const int MillisecondsInDay = 86400000;

		private const int MillisecondsInHour = 3600000;

		private const int MillisecondsInMinute = 60000;

		private const int MillisecondsInSecond = 1000;

		private static double MaxMonths = DateTime.MaxValue.Year * 12 - 1;

		public static double MaxMilliseconds => DateTime.MaxValue.Ticks / 10000 - 1;

		public static DateTime MinDateTime => DateTime.MinValue;

		public static DateTime MaxDateTime => DateTime.MaxValue;

		public static TimeSpan MinTimeSpan => TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(TimeSpan.MinValue.TotalMilliseconds + 1.0);

		public static TimeSpan MaxTimeSpan => TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(TimeSpan.MaxValue.TotalMilliseconds - 1.0);

		public static DayOfWeek FirstDayOfWeek => CultureInfo.CurrentCulture.DateTimeFormat.FirstDayOfWeek;

		private static int MondayBasedDay(DayOfWeek day)
		{
			int num = (int)(day - 1);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				num = 6;
			}
			return num;
		}

		public static bool MaskDay(DayOfWeek day, WeekdayCore flags)
		{
			return (((int)flags >> (int)day) & 1) == 1;
		}

		public static WeekdayCore Invert(WeekdayCore flags)
		{
			return ~flags & (WeekdayCore.Sunday | WeekdayCore.Monday | WeekdayCore.Tuesday | WeekdayCore.Wednesday | WeekdayCore.Thursday | WeekdayCore.Friday | WeekdayCore.Saturday);
		}

		private static double TotalFloorMonths(DateTime dateTime)
		{
			return dateTime.Year * 12 + dateTime.Month - 13;
		}

		private static double GetMonthMilliseconds(DateTimeMeasureUnitNative measureUnit, DateTime date, double range, double factor)
		{
			//IL_000f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			DateTime dateTime = Floor(date, (DateTimeMeasureUnitNative)6, 1, DayOfWeek.Monday);
			double num = range * factor + Difference(dateTime, date, measureUnit, 1.0, FirstDayOfWeek);
			int num2 = (int)Math.Min(MaxMonths, Math.Floor(num));
			double num3 = num - (double)num2;
			DateTime dateTime2 = dateTime.AddMonths(num2);
			double num4 = (double)DateTime.DaysInMonth(dateTime2.Year, dateTime2.Month) * num3;
			return (dateTime2 - dateTime).TotalMilliseconds + num4 * 86400000.0;
		}

		public static DateTime RestoreCustomDays(DateTime baseDate, IEnumerable<CustomDate> customDays, WeekdayCore workdays)
		{
			DateTime dateTime = baseDate;
			foreach (CustomDate customDay in customDays)
			{
				if (!(customDay.Date <= dateTime))
				{
					continue;
				}
				bool flag = MaskDay(customDay.Date.DayOfWeek, workdays);
				if (customDay.IsHoliday && flag)
				{
					do
					{
						dateTime = dateTime.AddDays(1.0);
					}
					while (IsHoliday(dateTime, workdays));
				}
				else if (!customDay.IsHoliday && !flag)
				{
					do
					{
						dateTime = dateTime.AddDays(-1.0);
					}
					while (IsHoliday(dateTime, workdays) && dateTime != customDay.Date);
				}
			}
			return dateTime;
		}

				6 => 2592000000.0, 
				7 => 7776000000.0, 
				8 => 31104000000.0, 
				_ => 1.0, 
			};
		}

		public static DateTime Floor(DateTime dateTime, DateTimeMeasureUnitNative measureUnit, int measureUnitMultiplier, DayOfWeek firstDayOfWeek)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002a: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			switch ((int)measureUnit)
			{
			case 8:
				return new DateTime(new DateTime(dateTime.Year - (dateTime.Year - 1) % measureUnitMultiplier, 1, 1).Year, 1, 1);
			case 6:
			{
				DateTime dateTime2 = new DateTime(dateTime.Year, dateTime.Month - (dateTime.Month - 1) % measureUnitMultiplier, 1);
				return new DateTime(dateTime2.Year, dateTime2.Month, 1);
			}
			case 4:
			{
				DateTime dateTime2 = new DateTime(dateTime.Year, dateTime.Month, dateTime.Day - (dateTime.Day - 1) % measureUnitMultiplier);
				return new DateTime(dateTime2.Year, dateTime2.Month, dateTime2.Day);
			}
			case 3:
			{
				DateTime dateTime2 = new DateTime(dateTime.Year, dateTime.Month, dateTime.Day, dateTime.Hour - dateTime.Hour % measureUnitMultiplier, 0, 0);
				return new DateTime(dateTime2.Year, dateTime2.Month, dateTime2.Day, dateTime2.Hour, 0, 0);
			}
			case 2:
			{
				DateTime dateTime2 = new DateTime(dateTime.Year, dateTime.Month, dateTime.Day, dateTime.Hour, dateTime.Minute - dateTime.Minute % measureUnitMultiplier, 0);
				return new DateTime(dateTime2.Year, dateTime2.Month, dateTime2.Day, dateTime2.Hour, dateTime2.Minute, 0);
			}
			case 1:
			{
				DateTime dateTime2 = new DateTime(dateTime.Year, dateTime.Month, dateTime.Day, dateTime.Hour, dateTime.Minute, dateTime.Second - dateTime.Second % measureUnitMultiplier);
				return new DateTime(dateTime2.Year, dateTime2.Month, dateTime2.Day, dateTime2.Hour, dateTime2.Minute, dateTime2.Second);
			}
			case 0:
			{
				DateTime dateTime2 = new DateTime(dateTime.Year, dateTime.Month, dateTime.Day, dateTime.Hour, dateTime.Minute, dateTime.Second, dateTime.Millisecond - dateTime.Millisecond % measureUnitMultiplier);
				return new DateTime(dateTime2.Year, dateTime2.Month, dateTime2.Day, dateTime2.Hour, dateTime2.Minute, dateTime2.Second, dateTime2.Millisecond);
			}
			case 5:
			{
				int num = MondayBasedDay(dateTime.DayOfWeek) + (7 - MondayBasedDay(firstDayOfWeek));
				if (num >= 7)
				{
					num -= 7;
				}
				if ((dateTime - DateTime.MinValue).TotalDays < (double)num)
				{
					return DateTime.MinValue;
				}
				DateTime dateTime3 = dateTime.AddDays(-num);
				return new DateTime(dateTime3.Year, dateTime3.Month, dateTime3.Day);
			}
			case 7:
			{
				DateTime dateTime2 = dateTime.AddMonths(-((dateTime.Month - 1) % (3 * measureUnitMultiplier)));
				return new DateTime(dateTime2.Year, dateTime2.Month, 1);
			}
			default:
				return dateTime;
			}
		}

		public static DateTime Round(DateTime dateTime, DateTimeMeasureUnitNative measureUnit, DayOfWeek firstDayOfWeek)
		{
			//IL_002a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0054: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			int num = ((dateTime.Month == 2) ? 14 : 15);
			double num2 = MaxMilliseconds * 10000.0 - (double)dateTime.Ticks;
			switch ((int)measureUnit)
			{
			case 8:
				if (dateTime.Month > 6 && dateTime.Year < DateTime.MaxValue.Year)
				{
					dateTime = dateTime.AddYears(1);
				}
				return new DateTime(dateTime.Year, 1, 1);
			case 6:
				if (dateTime.Day > num && num2 > 26784000000000.0)
				{
					dateTime = dateTime.AddMonths(1);
				}
				return new DateTime(dateTime.Year, dateTime.Month, 1);
			case 4:
				if ((dateTime.Hour > 12 || (dateTime.Hour == 12 && (dateTime.Minute > 0 || dateTime.Second > 0 || dateTime.Millisecond > 0))) && num2 > 864000000000.0)
				{
					dateTime = dateTime.AddDays(1.0);
				}
				return new DateTime(dateTime.Year, dateTime.Month, dateTime.Day);
			case 3:
				if (dateTime.Minute >= 30)
				{
					dateTime = dateTime.AddHours(1.0);
				}
				return new DateTime(dateTime.Year, dateTime.Month, dateTime.Day, dateTime.Hour, 0, 0);
			case 2:
				if (dateTime.Second >= 30)
				{
					dateTime = dateTime.AddMinutes(1.0);
				}
				return new DateTime(dateTime.Year, dateTime.Month, dateTime.Day, dateTime.Hour, dateTime.Minute, 0);
			case 1:
				if (dateTime.Millisecond >= 500)
				{
					dateTime = dateTime.AddSeconds(1.0);
				}
				return new DateTime(dateTime.Year, dateTime.Month, dateTime.Day, dateTime.Hour, dateTime.Minute, dateTime.Second);
			case 0:
				return new DateTime(dateTime.Year, dateTime.Month, dateTime.Day, dateTime.Hour, dateTime.Minute, dateTime.Second, dateTime.Millisecond);
			case 5:
			{
				int num3 = MondayBasedDay(dateTime.DayOfWeek) + (7 - MondayBasedDay(firstDayOfWeek));
				if (num3 >= 7)
				{
					num3 -= 7;
				}
				DateTime dateTime3 = ((num3 > 3) ? dateTime.AddDays(7 - num3) : ((!((dateTime - DateTime.MinValue).TotalDays >= (double)num3)) ? DateTime.MinValue : dateTime.AddDays(-num3)));
				return new DateTime(dateTime3.Year, dateTime3.Month, dateTime3.Day);
			}
			case 7:
			{
				if (dateTime.Day > num && num2 > 80352000000000.0)
				{
					dateTime = dateTime.AddMonths(1);
				}
				DateTime dateTime2 = dateTime.AddMonths(-1 * ((dateTime.Month - 1) % 3));
				return new DateTime(dateTime2.Year, dateTime2.Month, 1);
			}
			default:
				return dateTime;
			}
		}

		public static double GetAdditionalMilliseconds(DateTime dateTime, DateTime roundedDate, DateTimeMeasureUnitNative measureUnit, double measureUnitMultiplier, double range, DayOfWeek firstDayOfWeek)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002a: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			//IL_0059: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0044: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			switch ((int)measureUnit)
			{
			case 8:
				return GetMonthMilliseconds(measureUnit, roundedDate, range, 12.0 * measureUnitMultiplier);
			case 7:
				return GetMonthMilliseconds(measureUnit, roundedDate, range, 3.0 * measureUnitMultiplier);
			case 6:
				return GetMonthMilliseconds(measureUnit, roundedDate, range, 1.0 * measureUnitMultiplier);
			case 5:
			{
				int num = ((roundedDate == DateTime.MinValue) ? GetActualDayOfWeek(dateTime, firstDayOfWeek) : 0);
				double num2 = Math.Max(range * 7.0 - (double)num, 0.0);
				return num2 * 86400000.0 * measureUnitMultiplier;
			}
			case 4:
				return range * 86400000.0 * measureUnitMultiplier;
			case 3:
				return range * 3600000.0 * measureUnitMultiplier;
			case 2:
				return range * 60000.0 * measureUnitMultiplier;
			case 1:
				return range * 1000.0 * measureUnitMultiplier;
			case 0:
				return range * measureUnitMultiplier;
			default:
				return 0.0;
			}
		}

		public static DateTime? Add(DateTime dateTime, DateTimeMeasureUnitNative measureUnit, double measureUnitMultiplier, double range, DayOfWeek firstDayOfWeek)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0044: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			DateTime dateTime2 = Floor(dateTime, measureUnit, (int)measureUnitMultiplier, firstDayOfWeek);
			double additionalMilliseconds = GetAdditionalMilliseconds(dateTime, dateTime2, measureUnit, measureUnitMultiplier, range, firstDayOfWeek);
			if (additionalMilliseconds >= (MaxDateTime - dateTime2).TotalMilliseconds)
			{
				return null;
			}
			DateTime dateTime3 = dateTime2.AddMilliseconds(additionalMilliseconds);
			return Round(dateTime3, measureUnit, firstDayOfWeek);
		}

		private static double GetDiffInMonths(DateTime fromDate, DateTime toDate)
		{
			return TotalFloorMonths(toDate) - TotalFloorMonths(fromDate);
		}

		private static int GetActualDayOfWeek(DateTime dateTime, DayOfWeek firstDayOfWeek)
		{
			int num = dateTime.DayOfWeek - firstDayOfWeek;
			if (num < 0)
			{
				num += 7;
			}
			return num;
		}

		public unsafe static TimeSpan ToTimeSpan(double value, DateTimeMeasureUnitNative measureUnit)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001a: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			return (int)measureUnit switch
			{
				0 => TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(value), 
				1 => TimeSpan.FromSeconds(value), 
				2 => TimeSpan.FromMinutes(value), 
				3 => TimeSpan.FromHours(value), 
				4 => TimeSpan.FromDays(value), 
				_ => throw new InvalidOperationException("Incorrect measure unit: " + ((object)(*(DateTimeMeasureUnitNative*)(&measureUnit))/*cast due to .constrained prefix*/).ToString()), 
			};
		}

		public static double TimeSpanToMeasureUnit(TimeSpan value, TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative measureUnit, double measureUnitMultiplier)
		{
			return measureUnit switch
			{
				TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative.Day => value.TotalDays / measureUnitMultiplier, 
				TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative.Hour => value.TotalHours / measureUnitMultiplier, 
				TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative.Minute => value.TotalMinutes / measureUnitMultiplier, 
				TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative.Second => value.TotalSeconds / measureUnitMultiplier, 
				TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative.Millisecond => value.TotalMilliseconds / measureUnitMultiplier, 
				_ => 0.0, 
			};
		}

		public static TimeSpan? ToTimeSpan(double value, TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative measureUnit, double measureUnitMultiplier)
		{
			double num = value * measureUnitMultiplier;
			switch (measureUnit)
			{
			case TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative.Day:
				if (num < MinTimeSpan.TotalDays || num > MaxTimeSpan.TotalDays)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return TimeSpan.FromDays(num);
			case TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative.Hour:
				if (num < MinTimeSpan.TotalHours || num > MaxTimeSpan.TotalHours)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return TimeSpan.FromHours(num);
			case TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative.Minute:
				if (num < MinTimeSpan.TotalMinutes || num > MaxTimeSpan.TotalMinutes)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return TimeSpan.FromMinutes(num);
			case TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative.Second:
				if (num < MinTimeSpan.TotalSeconds || num > MaxTimeSpan.TotalSeconds)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return TimeSpan.FromSeconds(num);
			case TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative.Millisecond:
				if (num < MinTimeSpan.TotalMilliseconds || num > MaxTimeSpan.TotalMilliseconds)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(num);
			default:
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Incorrect measure unit: " + measureUnit);
			}
		}

		public static TimeSpan Floor(TimeSpan timeSpan, TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative measureUnit)
		{
			return Floor(timeSpan, measureUnit, 1);
		}

		public static TimeSpan Floor(TimeSpan timeSpan, TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative measureUnit, int measureUnitMultiplier)
		{
			switch (measureUnit)
			{
			case TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative.Day:
				return new TimeSpan(timeSpan.Days - timeSpan.Days % measureUnitMultiplier, 0, 0, 0);
			case TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative.Hour:
				return new TimeSpan(timeSpan.Days, timeSpan.Hours - timeSpan.Hours % measureUnitMultiplier, 0, 0);
			case TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative.Minute:
				return new TimeSpan(timeSpan.Days, timeSpan.Hours, timeSpan.Minutes - timeSpan.Minutes % measureUnitMultiplier, 0);
			case TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative.Second:
				return new TimeSpan(timeSpan.Days, timeSpan.Hours, timeSpan.Minutes, timeSpan.Seconds - timeSpan.Seconds % measureUnitMultiplier);
			case TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative.Millisecond:
				return new TimeSpan(timeSpan.Days, timeSpan.Hours, timeSpan.Minutes, timeSpan.Seconds, timeSpan.Milliseconds - timeSpan.Milliseconds % measureUnitMultiplier);
			default:
				ChartDebug.Fail("Invalid MeasureUnit.");
				return timeSpan;
			}
		}

		public static TimeSpan Round(TimeSpan timeSpan, TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative measureUnit)
		{
			TimeSpan ts = TimeSpan.Zero;
			switch (measureUnit)
			{
			case TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative.Day:
				if (timeSpan.Hours > 12 || (timeSpan.Hours == 12 && (timeSpan.Minutes > 0 || timeSpan.Seconds > 0 || timeSpan.Milliseconds > 0)))
				{
					ts = new TimeSpan(1, 0, 0, 0);
				}
				break;
			case TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative.Hour:
				if (timeSpan.Minutes >= 30)
				{
					ts = new TimeSpan(0, 1, 0, 0);
				}
				break;
			case TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative.Minute:
				if (timeSpan.Seconds >= 30)
				{
					ts = new TimeSpan(0, 0, 1, 0);
				}
				break;
			case TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative.Second:
				if (timeSpan.Milliseconds >= 500)
				{
					ts = new TimeSpan(0, 0, 0, 1);
				}
				break;
			}
			timeSpan = timeSpan.Add(ts);
			return Floor(timeSpan, measureUnit);
		}

		public static TimeSpan AddRange(TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative measureUnit, TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative gridAlignment, TimeSpan value, int range)
		{
			value = Floor(value, measureUnit);
			TimeSpan ts;
			switch (gridAlignment)
			{
			case TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative.Day:
				ts = new TimeSpan(range, 0, 0, 0);
				break;
			case TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative.Hour:
				ts = new TimeSpan(0, range, 0, 0);
				break;
			case TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative.Minute:
				ts = new TimeSpan(0, 0, range, 0);
				break;
			case TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative.Second:
				ts = new TimeSpan(0, 0, 0, range);
				break;
			case TimeSpanMeasureUnitNative.Millisecond:
				ts = new TimeSpan(0, 0, 0, 0, range);
				break;
			default:
				ChartDebug.Fail("Invalid MeasureUnit.");
				ts = TimeSpan.Zero;
				break;
			}
			ts = value.Add(ts);
			return Round(ts, measureUnit);
		}

		public static DateTime AddRange(DateTime dateTime, DateTimeMeasureUnitNative measureUnit, int range)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002a: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			switch ((int)measureUnit)
			{
			case 8:
				return dateTime.AddYears(range);
			case 7:
				return dateTime.AddMonths(range * 3);
			case 6:
				return dateTime.AddMonths(range);
			case 5:
				return dateTime.AddDays(range * 7);
			case 4:
				return dateTime.AddDays(range);
			case 3:
				return dateTime.AddHours(range);
			case 2:
				return dateTime.AddMinutes(range);
			case 1:
				return dateTime.AddSeconds(range);
			case 0:
				return dateTime.AddMilliseconds(range);
			default:
				ChartDebug.Fail("Unknown DateTimeMeasureUnit");
				return dateTime;
			}
		}

		public static double Difference(DateTime fromDate, DateTime toDate, DateTimeMeasureUnitNative measureUnit, double measureUnitMultiplier, DayOfWeek firstDayOfWeek)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002a: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			switch ((int)measureUnit)
			{
			case 8:
				return Math.Floor((double)(toDate.Year - fromDate.Year) / measureUnitMultiplier);
			case 7:
				return Math.Floor(GetDiffInMonths(fromDate, toDate) / (3.0 * measureUnitMultiplier));
			case 6:
				return Math.Floor(GetDiffInMonths(fromDate, toDate) / measureUnitMultiplier);
			case 5:
			{
				int num = 0;
				if (fromDate == DateTime.MinValue)
				{
					num = GetActualDayOfWeek(fromDate, firstDayOfWeek);
				}
				else if (toDate == DateTime.MinValue)
				{
					num = GetActualDayOfWeek(toDate, firstDayOfWeek);
				}
				return Math.Floor(((toDate - fromDate).TotalDays + (double)num) / (7.0 * measureUnitMultiplier));
			}
			case 4:
				return Math.Floor((toDate - fromDate).TotalDays / measureUnitMultiplier);
			case 3:
				return Math.Floor((toDate - fromDate).TotalHours / measureUnitMultiplier);
			case 2:
				return Math.Floor((toDate - fromDate).TotalMinutes / measureUnitMultiplier);
			case 1:
				return Math.Floor((toDate - fromDate).TotalSeconds / measureUnitMultiplier);
			case 0:
				return Math.Floor(GetMilliseconds(toDate - fromDate) / measureUnitMultiplier);
			default:
				return 0.0;
			}
		}

		public static DayOfWeek GetFirstDayOfWeek(IWorkdaysOptions workdaysOptions)
		{
			return workdaysOptions?.FirstDayOfWeek ?? FirstDayOfWeek;
		}

		internal static DateTime GetMonday(DateTime date)
		{
			DayOfWeek dayOfWeek = date.DayOfWeek;
			int num = (int)(((dayOfWeek == DayOfWeek.Sunday) ? ((DayOfWeek)7) : dayOfWeek) - 1);
			return date.AddDays(-num);
		}

		internal static int GetNumberOfHolidaysInWeek(WeekdayCore holidays)
		{
			int num = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < 32; i++)
			{
				num += ((int)holidays >> i) & 1;
			}
			return num;
		}

		internal static int GetHolidaysCountInWeek(DayOfWeek day, WeekdayCore holidays)
		{
			int num = (int)((day == DayOfWeek.Sunday) ? DayOfWeek.Saturday : (day - 1));
			int num2 = (((int)holidays >> 1) & 0x3F) | ((int)(holidays & WeekdayCore.Sunday) << 6);
			int num3 = 0;
			if (num2 != 127)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i <= num; i++)
				{
					num3 += (num2 >> i) & 1;
				}
			}
			return num3;
		}

		internal static int RestoreDay(int day, WeekdayCore holidays)
		{
			int num = (((int)holidays >> 1) & 0x3F) | ((int)(holidays & WeekdayCore.Sunday) << 6);
			int i;
			for (i = 0; i < 7; i++)
			{
				day -= (1 - (num >> i)) & 1;
				if (day < 0)
				{
					break;
				}
			}
			return i;
		}

		internal static int GetHolidaysCount(DateTime date, WeekdayCore holidays)
		{
			TimeSpan timeSpan = GetMonday(date) - MinDateTime;
			int numberOfHolidaysInWeek = GetNumberOfHolidaysInWeek(holidays);
			return (int)(timeSpan.TotalDays / 7.0) * numberOfHolidaysInWeek + GetHolidaysCountInWeek(date.DayOfWeek, holidays);
		}

		internal static int GetHolidaysCount(DateTime date, IWorkdaysOptions options)
		{
			if (options != null && options.WorkdaysOnly)
			{
				WeekdayCore workdays = options.Workdays;
				int num = GetHolidaysCount(date, Invert(workdays));
				{
					foreach (CustomDate customDate in options.CustomDates)
					{
						if (customDate.Date <= date)
						{
							bool flag = MaskDay(customDate.Date.DayOfWeek, workdays);
							if (customDate.IsHoliday && flag)
							{
								num++;
							}
							else if (!customDate.IsHoliday && !flag)
							{
								num--;
							}
						}
					}
					return num;
				}
			}
			return 0;
		}

		internal static bool IsHoliday(DateTime date, WeekdayCore workdays)
		{
			int dayOfWeek = (int)date.DayOfWeek;
			return (((int)workdays >> dayOfWeek) & 1) == 0;
		}

		internal static DateTime? ReverseHolidays(double value, IWorkdaysOptions options, DateTimeMeasureUnitNative measureUnit, double measureUnitMultiplier)
		{
			//IL_0103: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0018: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001a: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_003c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_006e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0077: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			DayOfWeek firstDayOfWeek = GetFirstDayOfWeek(options);
			if (options != null && options.WorkdaysOnly && (int)measureUnit <= 4 && measureUnitMultiplier == 1.0)
			{
				WeekdayCore workdays = options.Workdays;
				if (workdays != WeekdayCore.None)
				{
					double num = Math.Floor(value / (double)SizeOfDay(measureUnit));
					double num2 = 7 - GetHolidaysCountInWeek(DayOfWeek.Sunday, Invert(workdays));
					double num3 = Math.Floor(num / num2);
					double num4 = num - num3 * num2;
					double num5 = (value - num * (double)SizeOfDay(measureUnit)) / (double)SizeOfDay(measureUnit);
					double range = num3 * 7.0 + (double)RestoreDay((int)num4, Invert(options.Workdays));
					DateTime? dateTime = Add(MinDateTime, (DateTimeMeasureUnitNative)4, measureUnitMultiplier, range, firstDayOfWeek);
					if (!dateTime.HasValue)
					{
						return null;
					}
					DateTime dateTime2 = RestoreCustomDays(dateTime.Value, options.CustomDates, workdays);
					return Add(dateTime2, (DateTimeMeasureUnitNative)0, measureUnitMultiplier, num5 * (double)SizeOfDay((DateTimeMeasureUnitNative)0), firstDayOfWeek);
				}
				return MinDateTime;
			}
			return Add(MinDateTime, measureUnit, measureUnitMultiplier, value, firstDayOfWeek);
		}

		public static DateTimeFormatParts SelectFormat(DateTimeGridAlignmentNative measureUnit)
		{
			switch (measureUnit)
			{
			case DateTimeGridAlignmentNative.Year:
				return new DateTimeFormatParts(DateTimeOptionsFormat.Custom, "yyyy");
			case DateTimeGridAlignmentNative.Month:
			case DateTimeGridAlignmentNative.Quarter:
				return new DateTimeFormatParts(DateTimeOptionsFormat.MonthAndYear, string.Empty);
			case DateTimeGridAlignmentNative.Day:
			case DateTimeGridAlignmentNative.Week:
				return new DateTimeFormatParts(DateTimeOptionsFormat.ShortDate, string.Empty);
			case DateTimeGridAlignmentNative.Minute:
			case DateTimeGridAlignmentNative.Hour:
				return new DateTimeFormatParts(DateTimeOptionsFormat.Custom, "t");
			case DateTimeGridAlignmentNative.Second:
				return new DateTimeFormatParts(DateTimeOptionsFormat.Custom, "T");
			case DateTimeGridAlignmentNative.Millisecond:
				return new DateTimeFormatParts(DateTimeOptionsFormat.Custom, CreateLongTimePatternWithMillisecond());
			default:
				return new DateTimeFormatParts(DateTimeOptionsFormat.General, string.Empty);
			}
		}

		public static string CreateLongTimePatternWithMillisecond()
		{
			string longTimePattern = DateTimeFormatInfo.CurrentInfo.LongTimePattern;
			return Regex.Replace(longTimePattern, "(:ss|:s)", "$1.ffff");
		}

		public static double GetMilliseconds(TimeSpan value)
		{
			if (!FrameworkVersions.IsNetCore3AndAbove())
			{
				return Math.Min(MaxMilliseconds, value.TotalMilliseconds);
			}
			long num = value.Ticks / 10000;
			return Math.Min(MaxMilliseconds, num);
		}

		public static double DateTimeToDouble(DateTime dateTime)
		{
			return Math.Floor(GetMilliseconds(dateTime - MinDateTime));
		}

		public static DateTime DoubleToDateTime(double value)
		{
			return DateTime.MinValue.AddMilliseconds(Math.Min(MaxMilliseconds, value));
		}
	}

	public interface IMinMaxValues
	{
		double Delta { get; }

		bool IsZeroRange { get; }

		double Max { get; set; }

		double Min { get; set; }

		double CalculateCenter();

		void Intersection(IMinMaxValues minMaxValues);
	}
	public struct MinMaxValues : IMinMaxValues, IEquatable<MinMaxValues>
	{
		private double min;

		private double max;

		private bool isZeroRangeDirty;

		private bool isZeroRange;

		public static MinMaxValues Empty => new MinMaxValues(double.NaN, double.NaN);

		public double Delta => Max - Min;

		public bool HasValues
		{
			get
			{
				if (!IsEmpty && min != double.MaxValue && max != double.MinValue && min != double.NegativeInfinity)
				{
					return max != double.PositiveInfinity;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public bool IsEmpty
		{
			get
			{
				if (double.IsNaN(max))
				{
					return double.IsNaN(min);
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public bool IsZeroRange
		{
			get
			{
				if (isZeroRangeDirty)
				{
					isZeroRange = max - min <= double.Epsilon;
					isZeroRangeDirty = false;
				}
				return isZeroRange;
			}
		}

		public double Max
		{
			get
			{
				return max;
			}
			set
			{
				max = value;
				UpdateZeroRange();
			}
		}

		public double Min
		{
			get
			{
				return min;
			}
			set
			{
				min = value;
				UpdateZeroRange();
			}
		}

		public static bool IsEmptyValue(IMinMaxValues value)
		{
			if (double.IsNaN(value.Max))
			{
				return double.IsNaN(value.Min);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool IsValid(IMinMaxValues value)
		{
			if (!double.IsNaN(value.Min))
			{
				return !double.IsNaN(value.Max);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static double CalculateCenter(IMinMaxValues minMaxValues)
		{
			if (double.IsNaN(minMaxValues.Min) || double.IsNaN(minMaxValues.Max))
			{
				return double.NaN;
			}
			return (minMaxValues.Max + minMaxValues.Min) / 2.0;
		}

		public static MinMaxValues Intersection(IMinMaxValues first, IMinMaxValues second)
		{
			if (!IsValid(first) && !IsValid(second))
			{
				return Empty;
			}
			if (!IsValid(first))
			{
				return Clone(second);
			}
			if (!IsValid(second))
			{
				return Clone(first);
			}
			double num = Math.Max(first.Min, second.Min);
			double num2 = Math.Min(first.Max, second.Max);
			MinMaxValues result = new MinMaxValues(num, num2);
			if (result.Delta <= first.Delta && result.Delta <= second.Delta)
			{
				return result;
			}
			return Empty;
		}

		public static MinMaxValues Union(MinMaxValues a, MinMaxValues b)
		{
			if (!a.HasValues)
			{
				return b;
			}
			if (!b.HasValues)
			{
				return a;
			}
			double num = Math.Min(a.min, b.min);
			double num2 = Math.Max(a.max, b.max);
			return new MinMaxValues(num, num2);
		}

		public static bool operator !=(MinMaxValues a, MinMaxValues b)
		{
			return !(a == b);
		}

		public static bool operator ==(MinMaxValues a, MinMaxValues b)
		{
			if (a.IsEmpty ^ b.IsEmpty)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (a.Min == b.min)
			{
				return a.Max == b.Max;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public MinMaxValues(double value)
			: this(value, value)
		{
		}

		public MinMaxValues(IMinMaxValues values)
			: this(values.Min, values.Max)
		{
		}

		public MinMaxValues(double min, double max)
		{
			this.min = min;
			this.max = max;
			isZeroRange = false;
			isZeroRangeDirty = true;
		}

		private static MinMaxValues Clone(IMinMaxValues value)
		{
			return new MinMaxValues(value.Min, value.Max);
		}

		internal void UpdateZeroRange()
		{
			isZeroRangeDirty = true;
		}

		public double CalculateCenter()
		{
			return CalculateCenter(this);
		}

		public MinMaxValues Clone()
		{
			return new MinMaxValues(min, max);
		}

		public bool Equals(MinMaxValues other)
		{
			if (Min == other.Min)
			{
				return Max == other.Max;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is MinMaxValues other))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return Equals(other);
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return HashCodeHelper.CalculateGeneric<double, double>(min, max);
		}

		public bool InRange(double value)
		{
			if (min <= value)
			{
				return value <= max;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void Intersection(IMinMaxValues minMaxValues)
		{
			MinMaxValues minMaxValues2 = Intersection(this, minMaxValues);
			max = minMaxValues2.max;
			min = minMaxValues2.min;
			UpdateZeroRange();
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return $"{min}; {max}";
		}

		public void Union(double value)
		{
			if (!double.IsNaN(value))
			{
				min = (double.IsNaN(min) ? value : Math.Min(min, value));
				max = (double.IsNaN(max) ? value : Math.Max(max, value));
				UpdateZeroRange();
			}
		}

		public MinMaxValues Union(MinMaxValues value)
		{
			return Union(this, value);
		}
	}
	public enum DateTimeOptionsFormat
	{
		ShortDate,
		LongDate,
		ShortTime,
		LongTime,
		General,
		MonthAndDay,
		MonthAndYear,
		QuarterAndYear,
		Custom
	}
	public interface IDateTimeOptions
	{
		DateTimeOptionsFormat Format { get; }

		string FormatString { get; }

		string QuarterFormat { get; }
	}
	public static class DateTimeOptionsHelper
	{
		public static string GetValueText(DateTime dateTime, IDateTimeOptions options)
		{
			switch (options?.Format ?? DateTimeOptionsFormat.General)
			{
			case DateTimeOptionsFormat.ShortDate:
				return dateTime.ToShortDateString();
			case DateTimeOptionsFormat.LongDate:
				return dateTime.ToLongDateString();
			case DateTimeOptionsFormat.ShortTime:
				return dateTime.ToShortTimeString();
			case DateTimeOptionsFormat.LongTime:
				return dateTime.ToLongTimeString();
			case DateTimeOptionsFormat.General:
				return dateTime.ToString();
			case DateTimeOptionsFormat.MonthAndDay:
				return dateTime.ToString("m");
			case DateTimeOptionsFormat.MonthAndYear:
				return dateTime.ToString("y");
			case DateTimeOptionsFormat.QuarterAndYear:
				return dateTime.ToString(QuarterFormatter.FormatDateTime(dateTime, "QQ ", options.QuarterFormat) + "yyyy");
			case DateTimeOptionsFormat.Custom:
				try
				{
					return dateTime.ToString(QuarterFormatter.FormatDateTime(dateTime, options.FormatString, options.QuarterFormat), CultureInfo.CurrentCulture);
				}
				catch (FormatException)
				{
					return dateTime.ToString(string.Empty, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture);
				}
			default:
				ChartDebug.Fail("Incorrect format.");
				return dateTime.ToString(string.Empty, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture);
			}
		}

		public static string GetFormatString(IDateTimeOptions options)
		{
			return (options?.Format ?? DateTimeOptionsFormat.General) switch
			{
				DateTimeOptionsFormat.ShortDate => "d", 
				DateTimeOptionsFormat.LongDate => "D", 
				DateTimeOptionsFormat.ShortTime => "t", 
				DateTimeOptionsFormat.LongTime => "T", 
				DateTimeOptionsFormat.MonthAndDay => "m", 
				DateTimeOptionsFormat.MonthAndYear => "y", 
				DateTimeOptionsFormat.Custom => options.FormatString, 
				DateTimeOptionsFormat.QuarterAndYear => "q", 
				_ => "g", 
			};
		}
	}
	public enum NumericOptionsFormat
	{
		General,
		Scientific,
		FixedPoint,
		Currency,
		Percent,
		Number
	}
	public interface INumericOptions
	{
		NumericOptionsFormat Format { get; }

		int Precision { get; }
	}
	public static class NumericOptionsHelper
	{
		public static string GetFormatString(INumericOptions options)
		{
			string text = Convert.ToString(options.Precision);
			switch (options.Format)
			{
			case NumericOptionsFormat.General:
				return "G";
			case NumericOptionsFormat.Scientific:
				return "E" + text;
			case NumericOptionsFormat.FixedPoint:
				return "F" + text;
			case NumericOptionsFormat.Currency:
				return "C" + text;
			case NumericOptionsFormat.Percent:
				return "P" + text;
			case NumericOptionsFormat.Number:
				return "N" + text;
			default:
				ChartDebug.Fail("Incorrect format.");
				return "G";
			}
		}

		public static string GetValueText(double value, INumericOptions options)
		{
			return value.ToString(GetFormatString(options), CultureInfo.CurrentCulture);
		}
	}
	public enum PointViewKind
	{
		Argument,
		Values,
		ArgumentAndValues,
		SeriesName,
		Undefined
	}
	public static class PointOptionsHelper
	{
		public const string DefaultPattern = "{V}";

		public const PointViewKind DefaultPointView = PointViewKind.Values;

		public static string ConvertToPattern(PointViewKind pointView)
		{
			return pointView switch
			{
				PointViewKind.Argument => "{A}", 
				PointViewKind.Values => "{V}", 
				PointViewKind.ArgumentAndValues => "{A}: {V}", 
				PointViewKind.SeriesName => "{S}", 
				_ => string.Empty, 
			};
		}

		public static PointViewKind ConvertToPointView(string pattern)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(pattern))
			{
				return PointViewKind.Values;
			}
			bool flag = pattern.IndexOf("{A}") >= 0 || pattern.IndexOf("{A" + "}".ToLower()) >= 0;
			bool flag2 = pattern.IndexOf("{V}") >= 0 || pattern.IndexOf("{V" + "}".ToLower()) >= 0;
			if (pattern.IndexOf("{S}") >= 0 || pattern.IndexOf("{S" + "}".ToLower()) >= 0)
			{
				if (!(flag || flag2))
				{
					return PointViewKind.SeriesName;
				}
				return PointViewKind.Undefined;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				if (!flag2)
				{
					return PointViewKind.Argument;
				}
				return PointViewKind.ArgumentAndValues;
			}
			if (!flag2)
			{
				return PointViewKind.Undefined;
			}
			return PointViewKind.Values;
		}
	}
	public class ValueToStringConverter
	{
		private readonly INumericOptions numericOptions;

		private readonly IDateTimeOptions dateTimeOptions;

		protected INumericOptions NumericOptions => numericOptions;

		public ValueToStringConverter(INumericOptions numericOptions, IDateTimeOptions dateTimeOptions)
		{
			this.numericOptions = numericOptions;
			this.dateTimeOptions = dateTimeOptions;
		}

		protected string GetValueText(object value)
		{
			if (value is double)
			{
				return NumericOptionsHelper.GetValueText((double)value, numericOptions);
			}
			if (value is DateTime)
			{
				return DateTimeOptionsHelper.GetValueText((DateTime)value, dateTimeOptions);
			}
			ChartDebug.Fail("Incorrect value type.");
			if (value != null)
			{
				return value.ToString();
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}

		protected virtual object GetValue(object[] values)
		{
			return values[0];
		}

		public virtual string ConvertTo(object[] values)
		{
			return GetValueText(GetValue(values));
		}
	}

		private bool IsAlgorithmEnd()
		{
			Step[] array = steps;

		private DXRectangle RunAlgorithm(DXRectangle allocationRect)
		{
			//IL_00c4: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00c9: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00d4: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			//IL_00fe: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			int num = 0;
			DXRectangle val = default(DXRectangle);
			while (true)
			{
				if (IsAlgorithmEnd() && testContainer.Count == 0)
				{
					unallocatableWidth = Math.Min(unallocatableWidth, ((DXRectangle)(ref allocationRect)).Width);
					unallocatableHeight = Math.Min(unallocatableHeight, ((DXRectangle)(ref allocationRect)).Height);
					return allocationRect;
				}
				if (num >= testContainer.Count)
				{
					Step[] array = steps;
					foreach (Step step in array)
					{
						step.Next();
					}
					Step[] array2 = steps;
					foreach (Step step2 in array2)
					{
						step2.Update();
					}
					UpdateTestContainer();
					num = 0;
					continue;
				}

				DXPoint position = testPosition.Position;

				position = testPosition.Position;
				((DXRectangle)(ref val))..ctor(x, ((DXPoint)(ref position)).Y, ((DXRectangle)(ref allocationRect)).Width, ((DXRectangle)(ref allocationRect)).Height);

					if (step3.IsTestingEnd() && !step3.IsEnd)

		private void UpdateTestContainer()
		{

			Step[] array = steps;
			foreach (Step step in array)

				testContainer.AddRange(step.TestPositions);
			}
			testContainer.Sort(TestPosition.CompareByDistance);
		}

		public void UpdateSteps(DXRectangle rect)

		public void UpdateValidRect(DXRectangle rect)

	public abstract class Step
	{
		private readonly DXRectangle allocationRect;

		private readonly RectanglesLayout layout;

		private readonly double centerX;

		private readonly double centerY;

		private readonly List<TestPosition> primaryTestPositions = new List<TestPosition>();

		private readonly List<TestPosition> testPositions = new List<TestPosition>();

		private bool isEnd;

		private int position;

		private double maxDistance;

		protected DXRectangle AllocationRect => allocationRect;

		protected abstract int Increment { get; }

		protected RectanglesLayout Layout => layout;

		public bool IsEnd => isEnd;

		public int Position => position;

		public List<TestPosition> TestPositions => testPositions;

		protected Step(int position, DXRectangle rect, RectanglesLayout layout)
		{
			//IL_002b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			this.position = position;
			this.layout = layout;
			allocationRect = rect;
			centerX = (double)((DXRectangle)(ref rect)).Left + (double)((DXRectangle)(ref rect)).Width * 0.5;
			centerY = (double)((DXRectangle)(ref rect)).Top + (double)((DXRectangle)(ref rect)).Height * 0.5;
		}

		protected void AddPrimaryTestPosition(DXPoint position)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			double num = CalcDistanceToAllocationRect(position);
			if (num > maxDistance)
			{
				maxDistance = num;
			}
			TestPosition item = new TestPosition(position, num);
			primaryTestPositions.Add(item);
			testPositions.Add(item);
		}

		protected void AddSecondaryTestPosition(DXPoint position)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0017: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			double num = CalcDistanceToAllocationRect(position);
			if (num <= maxDistance)
			{
				testPositions.Add(new TestPosition(position, num));
			}
		}

		protected double CalcDistanceToAllocationRect(DXPoint position)
		{
			//IL_0009: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0031: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			double num = ((DXPoint)(ref position)).X;
			DXRectangle val = allocationRect;
			double num2 = num + (double)((DXRectangle)(ref val)).Width * 0.5;
			double num3 = ((DXPoint)(ref position)).Y;
			val = allocationRect;
			double num4 = num3 + (double)((DXRectangle)(ref val)).Height * 0.5;
			return (num2 - centerX) * (num2 - centerX) + (num4 - centerY) * (num4 - centerY);
		}

		protected bool IsUpdateEnd(double distance)
		{
			return distance > maxDistance;
		}

		protected abstract void UpdatePrimaryTestPositions();

		protected abstract void UpdateSecondaryTestPositions();

		protected abstract bool IsEndPosition(int position);

		public bool IsTestingEnd()
		{
			foreach (TestPosition primaryTestPosition in primaryTestPositions)
			{
				if (!primaryTestPosition.Check)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public void Update()
		{
			maxDistance = 0.0;
			testPositions.Clear();
			primaryTestPositions.Clear();
			if (!IsEnd)
			{
				UpdatePrimaryTestPositions();
				UpdateSecondaryTestPositions();
			}
		}

		public void Next()
		{
			if (!isEnd)
			{
				if (!IsEndPosition(position + Increment))
				{
					position += Increment;
				}
				else
				{
					isEnd = true;
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public abstract class HorizontalStep : Step
	{
		private readonly int startRowIndex;

		protected int StartRowIndex => startRowIndex;

		protected HorizontalStep(int position, int startRowIndex, DXRectangle rect, RectanglesLayout layout)
			: base(position, rect, layout)
		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			this.startRowIndex = startRowIndex;
		}

		protected abstract DXPoint CalcNearPosition(Cell cell);

		protected abstract void CalcFarPositions(Cell cell, out DXPoint point1, out DXPoint point2);

		protected override void UpdatePrimaryTestPositions()
		{
			//IL_0023: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0067: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_006e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			Cell cell = base.Layout.GetCell(startRowIndex, base.Position);
			if (cell.IsEmpty)
			{
				AddPrimaryTestPosition(CalcNearPosition(cell));
			}
			for (int i = base.Layout.StepToBottom.Position; i <= base.Layout.StepToTop.Position; i++)
			{
				cell = base.Layout.GetCell(i, base.Position);
				if (cell.IsEmpty)
				{
					CalcFarPositions(cell, out var point, out var point2);
					AddPrimaryTestPosition(point);
					AddPrimaryTestPosition(point2);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void UpdateSecondaryTestPositions()
		{
			//IL_0028: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0088: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0090: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			for (int i = base.Position + Increment; !IsEndPosition(i); i += Increment)
			{
				Cell cell = base.Layout.GetCell(startRowIndex, i);
				DXPoint val = CalcNearPosition(cell);
				double distance = CalcDistanceToAllocationRect(val);
				if (IsUpdateEnd(distance))
				{
					break;
				}
				if (cell.IsEmpty)
				{
					AddSecondaryTestPosition(val);
				}
				for (int j = base.Layout.StepToBottom.Position; j <= base.Layout.StepToTop.Position; j++)
				{
					cell = base.Layout.GetCell(j, i);
					if (cell.IsEmpty)
					{
						CalcFarPositions(cell, out var point, out var point2);
						AddSecondaryTestPosition(point);
						AddSecondaryTestPosition(point2);
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	public abstract class VerticalStep : Step
	{

			if (cell.IsEmpty)
			{
				AddPrimaryTestPosition(CalcNearPosition(cell));
			}
			for (int i = base.Layout.StepToLeft.Position; i <= base.Layout.StepToRight.Position; i++)
			{
				cell = base.Layout.GetCell(base.Position, i);
				if (cell.IsEmpty)

					CalcFarPositions(cell, out var point, out var point2);
					AddPrimaryTestPosition(point);
					AddPrimaryTestPosition(point2);
				}
			}
		}

		{

				if (IsUpdateEnd(distance))

					break;

				if (cell.IsEmpty)

					AddSecondaryTestPosition(val);
				}
				for (int j = base.Layout.StepToLeft.Position; j <= base.Layout.StepToRight.Position; j++)
				{

					}

	{

		Default,
		HideOverlapped,

	public interface IXYDiagramLabelLayout : ILabelLayout
	{
