		DXRectangle ValidRectangle { get; }

		DXRectangle ExcludedRectangle { get; }
	}
	public class XYDiagramResolveOverlappingAlgorithm
	{
		private readonly List<IXYDiagramLabelLayout> actualLabels = new List<IXYDiagramLabelLayout>();

		private readonly RectanglesLayoutAlgorithm layoutAlgorithm;

		private static bool OldContains(DXPoint point, DXRectangle rect)
		{
			if (((DXRectangle)(ref rect)).Left <= ((DXPoint)(ref point)).X && ((DXPoint)(ref point)).X <= ((DXRectangle)(ref rect)).Right && ((DXRectangle)(ref rect)).Top <= ((DXPoint)(ref point)).Y)
			{
				return ((DXPoint)(ref point)).Y <= ((DXRectangle)(ref rect)).Bottom;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static bool IsVisible(IXYDiagramLabelLayout label, DXPoint point)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0010: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0012: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			DXRectangle validRectangle = label.ValidRectangle;
			if (!((DXRectangle)(ref validRectangle)).IsCollapsed)
			{
				return OldContains(point, label.ValidRectangle);
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static void Process(IEnumerable<IXYDiagramLabelLayout> labels, DXRectangle bounds, int overlappingIndent)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			new XYDiagramResolveOverlappingAlgorithm(labels, bounds, overlappingIndent).Process();
		}

		private XYDiagramResolveOverlappingAlgorithm(IEnumerable<IXYDiagramLabelLayout> labels, DXRectangle bounds, int overlappingIndent)
		{
			//IL_0012: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_007d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0050: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_006a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			layoutAlgorithm = new RectanglesLayoutAlgorithm(bounds, overlappingIndent);
			foreach (IXYDiagramLabelLayout label in labels)
			{
				if (!label.Visible)
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (label.ResolveOverlappingMode != ResolveOverlappingModeCore.None)
				{
					actualLabels.Add(label);
					DXRectangle excludedRectangle = label.ExcludedRectangle;
					if (!((DXRectangle)(ref excludedRectangle)).IsCollapsed && label.ResolveOverlappingMode != ResolveOverlappingModeCore.HideOverlapped)
					{
						layoutAlgorithm.AddExcludedRectangle(label.ExcludedRectangle);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					layoutAlgorithm.AddOccupiedRectangle(label.LabelBounds);
				}
			}
		}

		private void Process()
		{
			if (actualLabels.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (IXYDiagramLabelLayout actualLabel in actualLabels)
			{
				Arrange(actualLabel);
			}
		}

		private void Arrange(IXYDiagramLabelLayout label)
		{
			//IL_0003: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0008: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0012: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0017: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0024: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0029: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0033: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0038: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0059: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_006c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0071: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_007b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0080: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0092: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0097: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00a1: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00a6: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00d7: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0125: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_015c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01b1: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01b3: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01b9: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00fb: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0101: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0107: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00e6: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0134: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_017f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0181: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0188: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_018d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_016b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0119: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0150: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_019f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			DXRectangle labelBounds = label.LabelBounds;
			int left = ((DXRectangle)(ref labelBounds)).Left;
			labelBounds = label.LabelBounds;
			int num = left + ((DXRectangle)(ref labelBounds)).Width / 2;
			labelBounds = label.LabelBounds;
			int top = ((DXRectangle)(ref labelBounds)).Top;
			labelBounds = label.LabelBounds;
			DXPoint point = default(DXPoint);
			((DXPoint)(ref point))..ctor(num, top + ((DXRectangle)(ref labelBounds)).Height / 2);
			DXPoint anchorPoint = label.AnchorPoint;
			int x = ((DXPoint)(ref anchorPoint)).X;
			labelBounds = label.LabelBounds;
			int num2 = x - ((DXRectangle)(ref labelBounds)).Width / 2;
			anchorPoint = label.AnchorPoint;
			int y = ((DXPoint)(ref anchorPoint)).Y;
			labelBounds = label.LabelBounds;
			int num3 = y - ((DXRectangle)(ref labelBounds)).Height / 2;
			labelBounds = label.LabelBounds;
			int width = ((DXRectangle)(ref labelBounds)).Width;
			labelBounds = label.LabelBounds;
			DXRectangle rect = default(DXRectangle);
			((DXRectangle)(ref rect))..ctor(num2, num3, width, ((DXRectangle)(ref labelBounds)).Height);
			switch (label.ResolveOverlappingMode)
			{
			case ResolveOverlappingModeCore.Default:
				if (!IsVisible(label, point) || !layoutAlgorithm.IsEmptyRegion(label.LabelBounds, useExcludedRegions: false))
				{
					label.LabelBounds = layoutAlgorithm.ArrangeRectangle(label.LabelBounds, label.ValidRectangle, useExcludedRegions: true);
				}
				else
				{
					layoutAlgorithm.AddOccupiedRectangle(label.LabelBounds);
				}
				break;
			case ResolveOverlappingModeCore.HideOverlapped:
				if (!IsVisible(label, point) || !layoutAlgorithm.IsEmptyRegionByList(label.LabelBounds, useExcludedRegions: false))
				{
					label.Visible = false;
				}
				else
				{
					layoutAlgorithm.AddOccupiedRectangle(label.LabelBounds);
				}
				break;
			case ResolveOverlappingModeCore.JustifyAroundPoint:
				if (!IsVisible(label, point) || !layoutAlgorithm.IsEmptyRegion(label.LabelBounds, useExcludedRegions: false))
				{
					label.LabelBounds = layoutAlgorithm.ArrangeRectangle(rect, label.ValidRectangle, useExcludedRegions: false, label.ExcludedRectangle);
				}
				else
				{
					layoutAlgorithm.AddOccupiedRectangle(label.LabelBounds);
				}
				break;
			case ResolveOverlappingModeCore.JustifyAllAroundPoint:
				label.LabelBounds = layoutAlgorithm.ArrangeRectangle(rect, label.ValidRectangle, useExcludedRegions: true);
				break;
			}
		}
	}
	public class LabelLayoutByAreaComparer : Comparer<IXYDiagramLabelLayout>
	{
		public override int Compare(IXYDiagramLabelLayout x, IXYDiagramLabelLayout y)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0014: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0024: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0032: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			DXRectangle validRectangle = x.ValidRectangle;
			int width = ((DXRectangle)(ref validRectangle)).Width;
			validRectangle = x.ValidRectangle;
			int num = width * ((DXRectangle)(ref validRectangle)).Height;
			validRectangle = y.ValidRectangle;
			int width2 = ((DXRectangle)(ref validRectangle)).Width;
			validRectangle = y.ValidRectangle;
			int num2 = width2 * ((DXRectangle)(ref validRectangle)).Height;
			if (num < num2)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			if (num == num2)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			return 1;
		}
	}
	public static class DateTimeUtils
	{
		private const int DaysInWeek = 7;

		private const int MonthsInYear = 12;

		private const int HoursInDay = 24;

		private const int MinutesInDay = 1440;

		private const int SecondsInDay = 86400;

		private const int MillisecondsInDay = 86400000;

		private const double TicksInDay = 864000000000.0;

		public const int MonthsInQuarter = 3;

		private static DateTime Add(DateTime dateTime, DateTimeMeasureUnitNative measureUnit, bool isNegative)
		{
			//IL_0008: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0032: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			int num = ((!isNegative) ? 1 : (-1));
			switch ((int)measureUnit)
			{
			case 8:
				return dateTime.AddYears(num);
			case 7:
				return dateTime.AddMonths(num * 3);
			case 6:
				return dateTime.AddMonths(num);
			case 5:
				return dateTime.AddDays(num * 7);
			case 4:
				return dateTime.AddDays(num);
			case 3:
				return dateTime.AddHours(num);
			case 2:
				return dateTime.AddMinutes(num);
			case 1:
				return dateTime.AddSeconds(num);
			case 0:
				return dateTime.AddMilliseconds(num);
			default:
				ChartDebug.Fail("Unknown DateTimeMeasureUnit");
				return dateTime;
			}
		}

		private static int CalcHolidaysCountInWeek(IWorkdaysOptions workdaysOptions)
		{
			int num = 0;
			WeekdayCore workdays = workdaysOptions.Workdays;
			if ((workdays & WeekdayCore.Sunday) == 0)
			{
				num++;
			}
			if ((workdays & WeekdayCore.Monday) == 0)
			{
				num++;
			}
			if ((workdays & WeekdayCore.Tuesday) == 0)
			{
				num++;
			}
			if ((workdays & WeekdayCore.Wednesday) == 0)
			{
				num++;
			}
			if ((workdays & WeekdayCore.Thursday) == 0)
			{
				num++;
			}
			if ((workdays & WeekdayCore.Friday) == 0)
			{
				num++;
			}
			if ((workdays & WeekdayCore.Saturday) == 0)
			{
				num++;
			}
			return num;
		}

		private static double TotalUnits(DateTime dateTime, bool workdaysOnly, IWorkdaysOptions workdaysOptions, int majorUnit)
		{
			DateTime dateTime2 = Floor(dateTime, (DateTimeMeasureUnitNative)6);
			DateTime dateTime3 = Floor(dateTime, (DateTimeMeasureUnitNative)4);
			int num = (dateTime2.AddMonths(1) - dateTime2).Days;
			double num4;
			if (workdaysOnly)
			{
				int num2 = 0;
				int num3 = 0;
				DateTime dateTime4 = dateTime2;
				for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
				{
					if (!IsHoliday(workdaysOptions, dateTime4, applyHolidays: true, applyExactWorkdays: true))
					{
						num3++;
						if (dateTime4 < dateTime3)
						{
							num2++;
						}
					}
					dateTime4 = dateTime4.AddDays(1.0);
				}
				num4 = ((num3 == 0) ? 0.0 : ((double)num2 / (double)num3));
				num = num3;
			}
			else
			{
				num4 = (double)(dateTime3 - dateTime2).Days / (double)num;
			}
			double num5 = 864000000000.0 * (double)num;
			double num6 = ((num == 0) ? 0.0 : ((double)(dateTime.Ticks - dateTime3.Ticks) / num5));
			return ((double)(dateTime2.Year * 12 + dateTime2.Month - 1) + num4 + num6) / (double)majorUnit;
		}

		private static double CalcWeekAddition(IWorkdaysOptions workdaysOptions, DateTime date, DateTime roundedToWeek)
		{
			DateTime dateTime = Floor(date, (DateTimeMeasureUnitNative)4);
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = 0;
			DateTime dateTime2 = roundedToWeek;
			for (int i = 0; i < 7; i++)
			{
				if (!IsHoliday(workdaysOptions, dateTime2, applyHolidays: true, applyExactWorkdays: true))
				{
					num++;
					if (dateTime2 < dateTime)
					{
						num2++;
					}
				}
				dateTime2 = dateTime2.AddDays(1.0);
			}
			if (num != 0)
			{
				return ((double)num2 + (date - dateTime).TotalDays) / (double)num;
			}
			return 0.0;
		}

		private static double CorrectDifferenceBasedOnHolidays(IWorkdaysOptions workdaysOptions, DateTime fromDate, double value, int multiplier)
		{
			int num = CalcHolidaysCountInWeek(workdaysOptions);
			if (num == 7)
			{
				return value;
			}
			DateTime dateTime = fromDate.Date;
			int num2 = (int)Math.Floor((value + (fromDate - dateTime).TotalDays * (double)multiplier) / (double)multiplier);
			int num3 = num2 / 7;
			value -= (double)(num3 * CalcHolidaysCountInWeek(workdaysOptions) * multiplier);
			int num4 = num2 % 7;
			if (num4 > 0)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < num4; i++)
				{
					if (IsHoliday(workdaysOptions, dateTime, applyHolidays: false, applyExactWorkdays: false))
					{
						value -= (double)multiplier;
					}
					dateTime = dateTime.AddDays(1.0);
				}
			}
			else if (num4 < 0)
			{
				for (int num5 = 0; num5 > num4; num5--)
				{
					if (IsHoliday(workdaysOptions, dateTime, applyHolidays: false, applyExactWorkdays: false))
					{
						value += (double)multiplier;
					}
					dateTime = dateTime.AddDays(-1.0);
				}
			}
			dateTime = fromDate.Date;
			DateTime dateTime2 = dateTime.AddDays(num2);
			if (dateTime2 < dateTime)
			{
				foreach (DateTime holiday in workdaysOptions.Holidays)
				{
					if (holiday <= dateTime && holiday > dateTime2 && !IsHoliday(workdaysOptions, holiday, applyHolidays: false, applyExactWorkdays: false))
					{
						value += (double)multiplier;
					}
				}
				foreach (DateTime exactWorkday in workdaysOptions.ExactWorkdays)
				{
					if (exactWorkday <= dateTime && exactWorkday > dateTime2 && IsHoliday(workdaysOptions, exactWorkday, applyHolidays: true, applyExactWorkdays: false))
					{
						value -= (double)multiplier;
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				foreach (DateTime holiday2 in workdaysOptions.Holidays)
				{
					if (holiday2 >= dateTime && holiday2 < dateTime2 && !IsHoliday(workdaysOptions, holiday2, applyHolidays: false, applyExactWorkdays: false))
					{
						value -= (double)multiplier;
					}
				}
				foreach (DateTime exactWorkday2 in workdaysOptions.ExactWorkdays)
				{
					if (exactWorkday2 >= dateTime && exactWorkday2 < dateTime2 && IsHoliday(workdaysOptions, exactWorkday2, applyHolidays: true, applyExactWorkdays: false))
					{
						value += (double)multiplier;
					}
				}
			}
			return value;
		}

		private static DateTime AddUnits(DateTimeMeasureUnitNative measureUnit, DateTime date, double range, double factor, IWorkdaysOptions workdaysOptions)
		{
			//IL_001d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			bool flag = workdaysOptions?.WorkdaysOnly ?? false;
			range *= factor;
			DateTime fromDate = Floor(date, (DateTimeMeasureUnitNative)6);
			range += GetDifference(measureUnit, (DateTimeMeasureUnitNative)6, fromDate, date, workdaysOptions);
			int num = (int)Math.Floor(range);
			double num2 = range - (double)num;
			DateTime dateTime = fromDate.AddMonths(num);
			int days = (dateTime.AddMonths(1) - dateTime).Days;
			if (!flag)
			{
				return dateTime.AddDays((double)days * num2);
			}
			int num3 = 0;
			DateTime dateTime2 = dateTime;
			for (int i = 0; i < days; i++)
			{
				if (!IsHoliday(workdaysOptions, dateTime2, applyHolidays: true, applyExactWorkdays: true))
				{
					num3++;
				}
				dateTime2 = dateTime2.AddDays(1.0);
			}
			num2 *= (double)num3;
			while (num2 >= 0.5)
			{
				if (!IsHoliday(workdaysOptions, dateTime, applyHolidays: true, applyExactWorkdays: true))
				{
					num2 -= 1.0;
				}
				dateTime = dateTime.AddDays(1.0);
			}
			if (num2 > 0.0)
			{
				while (IsHoliday(workdaysOptions, dateTime, applyHolidays: true, applyExactWorkdays: true))
				{
					dateTime = dateTime.AddDays(1.0);
				}
			}
			return dateTime.AddDays(num2);
		}

		private static double CorrectRangeBasedOnHolidays(IWorkdaysOptions workdaysOptions, DateTime date, double range, int multiplier)
		{
			if (range == 0.0)
			{
				return range;
			}
			int num = CalcHolidaysCountInWeek(workdaysOptions);
			if (num == 7)
			{
				return range;
			}
			int num2 = 7 - num;
			DateTime date2 = date.Date;
			DateTime dateTime = date2;
			int num3 = (int)Math.Floor((range + (date - dateTime).TotalDays * (double)multiplier) / (double)multiplier);
			double num4 = range - (double)(num3 * multiplier);
			int num5 = num3 / num2;
			int num6 = num3 % num2;
			if (num3 > 0)
			{
				while (num6 > 0)
				{
					if (IsHoliday(workdaysOptions, dateTime, applyHolidays: false, applyExactWorkdays: false))
					{
						num3++;
					}
					else
					{
						num6--;
					}
					dateTime = dateTime.AddDays(1.0);
				}
				num3 += num5 * num;
				dateTime = date2.AddDays(num3);
				while (IsHoliday(workdaysOptions, dateTime, applyHolidays: false, applyExactWorkdays: false))
				{
					num3++;
					dateTime = dateTime.AddDays(1.0);
				}
				foreach (DateTime holiday in workdaysOptions.Holidays)
				{
					if (holiday >= date2 && holiday <= dateTime && !IsHoliday(workdaysOptions, holiday, applyHolidays: false, applyExactWorkdays: false))
					{
						do
						{
							num3++;
							dateTime = dateTime.AddDays(1.0);
						}
						while (IsHoliday(workdaysOptions, dateTime, applyHolidays: false, applyExactWorkdays: false));
					}
				}
				foreach (DateTime exactWorkday in workdaysOptions.ExactWorkdays)
				{
					if (exactWorkday >= date2 && exactWorkday <= dateTime && IsHoliday(workdaysOptions, exactWorkday, applyHolidays: true, applyExactWorkdays: false))
					{
						do
						{
							num3--;
							dateTime = dateTime.AddDays(-1.0);
						}
						while (IsHoliday(workdaysOptions, dateTime, applyHolidays: true, applyExactWorkdays: true));
					}
				}
				range = (double)(num3 * multiplier) + num4;
			}
			else
			{
				while (num6 < 0)
				{
					if (IsHoliday(workdaysOptions, dateTime, applyHolidays: false, applyExactWorkdays: false))
					{
						num3--;
					}
					else
					{
						num6++;
					}
					dateTime = dateTime.AddDays(-1.0);
				}
				num3 += num5 * num;
				dateTime = date2.AddDays(num3);
				while (IsHoliday(workdaysOptions, dateTime, applyHolidays: false, applyExactWorkdays: false))
				{
					num3--;
					dateTime = dateTime.AddDays(-1.0);
				}
				List<DateTime> list = new List<DateTime>();
				foreach (DateTime holiday2 in workdaysOptions.Holidays)
				{
					list.Insert(0, holiday2);
				}
				foreach (DateTime item in list)
				{
					if (item >= dateTime && item <= date2 && !IsHoliday(workdaysOptions, item, applyHolidays: false, applyExactWorkdays: false))
					{
						do
						{
							num3--;
							dateTime = dateTime.AddDays(-1.0);
						}
						while (IsHoliday(workdaysOptions, dateTime, applyHolidays: false, applyExactWorkdays: false));
					}
				}
				foreach (DateTime exactWorkday2 in workdaysOptions.ExactWorkdays)
				{
					if (exactWorkday2 >= dateTime && exactWorkday2 <= date2 && IsHoliday(workdaysOptions, exactWorkday2, applyHolidays: true, applyExactWorkdays: false))
					{
						do
						{
							num3++;
							dateTime = dateTime.AddDays(1.0);
						}
						while (IsHoliday(workdaysOptions, dateTime, applyHolidays: true, applyExactWorkdays: true));
					}
				}
				range = (double)(num3 * multiplier) + num4;
			}
			return range;
		}

		public static bool IsHoliday(IWorkdaysOptions workdaysOptions, DateTime dateTime, bool applyHolidays, bool applyExactWorkdays)
		{
			bool result = false;
			switch (dateTime.DayOfWeek)
			{
			case DayOfWeek.Sunday:
				if ((workdaysOptions.Workdays & WeekdayCore.Sunday) == 0)
				{
					result = true;
				}
				break;
			case DayOfWeek.Monday:
				if ((workdaysOptions.Workdays & WeekdayCore.Monday) == 0)
				{
					result = true;
				}
				break;
			case DayOfWeek.Tuesday:
				if ((workdaysOptions.Workdays & WeekdayCore.Tuesday) == 0)
				{
					result = true;
				}
				break;
			case DayOfWeek.Wednesday:
				if ((workdaysOptions.Workdays & WeekdayCore.Wednesday) == 0)
				{
					result = true;
				}
				break;
			case DayOfWeek.Thursday:
				if ((workdaysOptions.Workdays & WeekdayCore.Thursday) == 0)
				{
					result = true;
				}
				break;
			case DayOfWeek.Friday:
				if ((workdaysOptions.Workdays & WeekdayCore.Friday) == 0)
				{
					result = true;
				}
				break;
			case DayOfWeek.Saturday:
				if ((workdaysOptions.Workdays & WeekdayCore.Saturday) == 0)
				{
					result = true;
				}
				break;
			}
			if (!applyHolidays)
			{
				return result;
			}
			foreach (DateTime holiday in workdaysOptions.Holidays)
			{
				if (dateTime.Date == holiday.Date)
				{
					result = true;
					break;
				}
			}
			if (!applyExactWorkdays)
			{
				return result;
			}
			foreach (DateTime exactWorkday in workdaysOptions.ExactWorkdays)
			{
				if (dateTime.Date == exactWorkday.Date)
				{
					result = false;
					break;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		public static DateTime SkipHoliday(IWorkdaysOptions workdaysOptions, DateTime dateTime)
		{
			if (workdaysOptions.Workdays == WeekdayCore.None)
			{
				return dateTime;
			}
			while (IsHoliday(workdaysOptions, dateTime, applyHolidays: true, applyExactWorkdays: true))
			{
				dateTime = dateTime.Date.AddDays(1.0);
			}
			return dateTime;
		}

		public static DateTime SkipHolidayReverted(IWorkdaysOptions workdaysOptions, DateTime dateTime)
		{
			if (workdaysOptions.Workdays == WeekdayCore.None)
			{
				return dateTime;
			}
			while (IsHoliday(workdaysOptions, dateTime, applyHolidays: true, applyExactWorkdays: true))
			{
				dateTime = dateTime.Date.AddMilliseconds(-1.0);
			}
			return dateTime;
		}

		public static DateTime Floor(DateTime dateTime, DateTimeMeasureUnitNative measureUnit)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002a: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			switch ((int)measureUnit)
			{
			case 8:
				return new DateTime(dateTime.Year, 1, 1);
			case 6:
				return new DateTime(dateTime.Year, dateTime.Month, 1);
			case 4:
				return new DateTime(dateTime.Year, dateTime.Month, dateTime.Day);
			case 3:
				return new DateTime(dateTime.Year, dateTime.Month, dateTime.Day, dateTime.Hour, 0, 0);
			case 2:
				return new DateTime(dateTime.Year, dateTime.Month, dateTime.Day, dateTime.Hour, dateTime.Minute, 0);
			case 1:
				return new DateTime(dateTime.Year, dateTime.Month, dateTime.Day, dateTime.Hour, dateTime.Minute, dateTime.Second);
			case 0:
				return new DateTime(dateTime.Year, dateTime.Month, dateTime.Day, dateTime.Hour, dateTime.Minute, dateTime.Second, dateTime.Millisecond);
			case 5:
			{
				int num = dateTime.DayOfWeek - DateTimeUtilsExt.FirstDayOfWeek;
				num = ((num >= 0) ? num : (num + 7));
				TimeSpan timeSpan = new TimeSpan(num, 0, 0, 0);
				DateTime dateTime3 = ((dateTime.Ticks >= timeSpan.Ticks) ? (dateTime - timeSpan) : DateTime.MinValue);
				return new DateTime(dateTime3.Year, dateTime3.Month, dateTime3.Day);
			}
			case 7:
			{
				DateTime dateTime2 = dateTime.AddMonths(-((dateTime.Month - 1) % 3));
				return new DateTime(dateTime2.Year, dateTime2.Month, 1);
			}
			default:
				ChartDebug.Fail("Invalid MeasureUnit.");
				return dateTime;
			}
		}

		public static DateTime AddRange(DateTimeMeasureUnitNative measureUnit, DateTimeMeasureUnitNative gridAlignment, DateTime date, double range, IWorkdaysOptions workdaysOptions)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0029: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0053: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			//IL_001b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001d: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_008a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0071: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0058: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00b2: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00b3: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0233: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			date = Floor(date, measureUnit);
			bool flag = workdaysOptions?.WorkdaysOnly ?? false;
			if (flag && (int)gridAlignment <= 4)
			{
				date = SkipHoliday(workdaysOptions, date);
			}
			DateTime dateTime;
			switch ((int)gridAlignment)
			{
			case 8:
				dateTime = AddUnits(measureUnit, date, range, 12.0, workdaysOptions);
				break;
			case 7:
				dateTime = AddUnits(measureUnit, date, range, 3.0, workdaysOptions);
				break;
			case 6:
				dateTime = AddUnits(measureUnit, date, range, 1.0, workdaysOptions);
				break;
			case 5:
				if (flag)
				{
					DateTime fromDate = Floor(date, (DateTimeMeasureUnitNative)5);
					range += GetDifference(measureUnit, gridAlignment, fromDate, date, workdaysOptions);
					int num = (int)Math.Floor(range);
					double num2 = range - (double)num;
					dateTime = fromDate.AddDays(num * 7);
					int num3 = 0;
					for (int i = 0; i < 7; i++)
					{
						if (!IsHoliday(workdaysOptions, dateTime.AddDays(i), applyHolidays: true, applyExactWorkdays: true))
						{
							num3++;
						}
					}
					num2 *= (double)num3;
					while (num2 >= 0.5)
					{
						if (!IsHoliday(workdaysOptions, dateTime, applyHolidays: true, applyExactWorkdays: true))
						{
							num2 -= 1.0;
						}
						dateTime = dateTime.AddDays(1.0);
					}
					dateTime = dateTime.AddDays(num2);
				}
				else
				{
					dateTime = date.AddDays(range * 7.0);
				}
				break;
			case 4:
				dateTime = (flag ? date.AddDays(CorrectRangeBasedOnHolidays(workdaysOptions, date, range, 1)) : date.AddDays(range));
				break;
			case 3:
				dateTime = (flag ? date.AddHours(CorrectRangeBasedOnHolidays(workdaysOptions, date, range, 24)) : date.AddHours(range));
				break;
			case 2:
				dateTime = (flag ? date.AddMinutes(CorrectRangeBasedOnHolidays(workdaysOptions, date, range, 1440)) : date.AddMinutes(range));
				break;
			case 1:
				dateTime = (flag ? date.AddSeconds(CorrectRangeBasedOnHolidays(workdaysOptions, date, range, 86400)) : date.AddSeconds(range));
				break;
			case 0:
				dateTime = (flag ? date.AddMilliseconds(CorrectRangeBasedOnHolidays(workdaysOptions, date, range, 86400000)) : date.AddMilliseconds(range));
				break;
			default:
				ChartDebug.Fail("Invalid MeasureUnit.");
				dateTime = date;
				break;
			}
			dateTime = DateTimeUtilsExt.Round(dateTime, measureUnit, DateTimeUtilsExt.FirstDayOfWeek);
			if (flag)
			{
				dateTime = SkipHoliday(workdaysOptions, dateTime);
			}
			return dateTime;
		}

		public static DateTime Increase(DateTime dateTime, DateTimeMeasureUnitNative measureUnit)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			return Add(dateTime, measureUnit, isNegative: false);
		}

		public static DateTime Decrease(DateTime dateTime, DateTimeMeasureUnitNative measureUnit)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			return Add(dateTime, measureUnit, isNegative: true);
		}

		public static double GetDifference(DateTimeMeasureUnitNative measureUnit, DateTimeMeasureUnitNative gridAlignment, DateTime fromDate, DateTime toDate, IWorkdaysOptions workdaysOptions)
		{
			//IL_0027: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0036: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0060: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			bool flag = workdaysOptions?.WorkdaysOnly ?? false;
			if (flag)
			{
				fromDate = SkipHoliday(workdaysOptions, fromDate);
				toDate = SkipHoliday(workdaysOptions, toDate);
			}
			DateTime dateTime = Floor(fromDate, measureUnit);
			DateTime dateTime2 = Floor(toDate, measureUnit);
			switch ((int)gridAlignment)
			{
			case 8:
				return TotalUnits(dateTime2, flag, workdaysOptions, 12) - TotalUnits(dateTime, flag, workdaysOptions, 12);
			case 7:
				return TotalUnits(dateTime2, flag, workdaysOptions, 3) - TotalUnits(dateTime, flag, workdaysOptions, 3);
			case 6:
				return TotalUnits(dateTime2, flag, workdaysOptions, 1) - TotalUnits(dateTime, flag, workdaysOptions, 1);
			case 5:
			{
				if (!flag)
				{
					return (dateTime2 - dateTime).TotalDays / 7.0;
				}
				DateTime dateTime3 = Floor(dateTime, (DateTimeMeasureUnitNative)5);
				DateTime dateTime4 = Floor(dateTime2, (DateTimeMeasureUnitNative)5);
				return (dateTime4 - dateTime3).TotalDays / 7.0 + CalcWeekAddition(workdaysOptions, dateTime2, dateTime4) - CalcWeekAddition(workdaysOptions, dateTime, dateTime3);
			}
			case 4:
			{
				double num4 = (dateTime2 - dateTime).TotalDays;
				if (flag)
				{
					num4 = CorrectDifferenceBasedOnHolidays(workdaysOptions, dateTime, num4, 1);
				}
				return num4;
			}
			case 3:
			{
				double num2 = (dateTime2 - dateTime).TotalHours;
				if (flag)
				{
					num2 = CorrectDifferenceBasedOnHolidays(workdaysOptions, dateTime, num2, 24);
				}
				return num2;
			}
			case 2:
			{
				double num5 = (dateTime2 - dateTime).TotalMinutes;
				if (flag)
				{
					num5 = CorrectDifferenceBasedOnHolidays(workdaysOptions, dateTime, num5, 1440);
				}
				return num5;
			}
			case 1:
			{
				double num3 = (dateTime2 - dateTime).TotalSeconds;
				if (flag)
				{
					num3 = CorrectDifferenceBasedOnHolidays(workdaysOptions, dateTime, num3, 86400);
				}
				return num3;
			}
			case 0:
			{
				double num = (dateTime2 - dateTime).TotalMilliseconds;
				if (flag)
				{
					num = CorrectDifferenceBasedOnHolidays(workdaysOptions, dateTime, num, 86400000);
				}
				return num;
			}
			default:
				ChartDebug.Fail("Invalid MeasureUnit.");
				return 0.0;
			}
		}
	}
	public static class PatternUtils
	{
		private const string DefaultTimeSpanFormatString = "g";

		public const string DefaultDateTimeFormat = ":d";

		public const string DefaultTimeSpanFormat = ":g";

		public static string QuarterFormat { get; set; } = "Q{0}";

		private static int ExtractElement(string pattern, out string element)
		{
			element = string.Empty;
			int num = pattern.IndexOf('{');
			if (num == -1 || num == pattern.Length - 1)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			if (pattern[num + 1] == '{')
			{
				element = "{{";
				return num;
			}
			int num2 = pattern.IndexOf('}', num + 1);
			if (num2 == -1)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			int num3 = pattern.IndexOf("{", num + 1);
			if (num3 >= 0 && num3 < num2)
			{
				return num3;
			}
			element = pattern.Substring(num, num2 - num + 1);
			return num;
		}

		private static string FormatTimeSpan(TimeSpan value, string format)
		{
			return format.ToUpperInvariant() switch
			{
				"TD" => value.TotalDays.ToString(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture), 
				"TH" => value.TotalHours.ToString(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture), 
				"TM" => value.TotalMinutes.ToString(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture), 
				"TS" => value.TotalSeconds.ToString(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture), 
				"TMS" => value.TotalMilliseconds.ToString(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture), 
				_ => value.ToString(format, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture), 
			};
		}

		private static bool IsIntervalLabel(IScaleOptionsBase scaleOptions)
		{
			if (scaleOptions.GridLayoutMode == GridLayoutModeNative.GridShiftedLabelCentered)
			{
				return scaleOptions.GridSpacing > 1.0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static string GetDefaultArgumentPattern(string defaultArgFormatWithColon = "")
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			stringBuilder.Append('{');
			stringBuilder.Append("A");
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(defaultArgFormatWithColon))
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(defaultArgFormatWithColon);
			}
			stringBuilder.Append('}');
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		public static string SelectFormat(DateTimeGridAlignmentNative gridAlignment)
		{
			switch (gridAlignment)
			{
			case DateTimeGridAlignmentNative.Year:
				return "yyyy";
			case DateTimeGridAlignmentNative.Month:
			case DateTimeGridAlignmentNative.Quarter:
				return "y";
			case DateTimeGridAlignmentNative.Day:
			case DateTimeGridAlignmentNative.Week:
				return "d";
			case DateTimeGridAlignmentNative.Minute:
			case DateTimeGridAlignmentNative.Hour:
				return "t";
			case DateTimeGridAlignmentNative.Second:
				return "T";
			case DateTimeGridAlignmentNative.Millisecond:
				return DateTimeUtilsExt.CreateLongTimePatternWithMillisecond();
			default:
				return "g";
			}
		}

		public static string GetTimeSpanFormat()
		{
			return "g";
		}

		public static List<string> SplitString(string splittingString, char leftSeparator, char rightSeparator)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(splittingString))
			{
				List<string> list = new List<string>();
				int num = 0;
				int num2 = 0;
				foreach (char c in splittingString)
				{
					if (c == leftSeparator)
					{
						num = num2;
					}
					else if (c == rightSeparator)
					{
						list.Add(splittingString.Substring(num, num2 - num + 1));
					}
					num2++;
				}
				return list;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static bool PrepareFragment(string fragment, out string patternConstant, out string format)
		{
			patternConstant = null;
			format = string.Empty;
			if (!fragment.StartsWith("{") || !fragment.EndsWith("}"))
			{
				return false;
			}
			string text = fragment.Substring(1, fragment.Length - 2);
			int num = text.IndexOf(":");
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				format = text.Substring(num + 1).Trim();
				text = text.Substring(0, num);
			}
			text = text.Trim().ToUpper();
			patternConstant = text;
			return true;
		}

		public static int GetPrecision(double value, out int integralPartLength)
		{
			string text = value.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
			int num = text.IndexOf(".");
			if (num < 0)
			{
				integralPartLength = text.Length;
				return 0;
			}
			int length = text.Substring(num + 1).Length;
			integralPartLength = text.Length - length - 1;
			return Math.Min(length, 14);
		}

		private static int GetDigitsForRounding(IAxisData axis)
		{
			int integralPartLength;
			int precision = GetPrecision(axis.NumericScaleOptions.GridSpacing * axis.NumericScaleOptions.GridAlignment, out integralPartLength);
			int num = ((integralPartLength <= 1) ? 1 : 0);
			return precision + num;
		}

		private static double RoundNativeDoubleAxisValue(IAxisData axis, double value)
		{
			int digitsForRounding = GetDigitsForRounding(axis);
			return Math.Round(value, digitsForRounding);
		}

		public static object RoundNativeAxisValue(IAxisData axis, object value)
		{
			if (value is double)
			{
				return RoundNativeDoubleAxisValue(axis, (double)value);
			}
			if (value is NumericAxisAggregationInterval)
			{
				NumericAxisAggregationInterval numericAxisAggregationInterval = value as NumericAxisAggregationInterval;
				return new NumericAxisAggregationInterval(RoundNativeDoubleAxisValue(axis, numericAxisAggregationInterval.Min), RoundNativeDoubleAxisValue(axis, numericAxisAggregationInterval.Max), numericAxisAggregationInterval.IncludeMin, numericAxisAggregationInterval.IncludeMax, numericAxisAggregationInterval.IsUnderflow, numericAxisAggregationInterval.IsOverflow);
			}
			return value;
		}

		public static object RoundUpNativeAxisValue(IAxisData axis, object value)
		{
			if (value is double)
			{
				int digitsForRounding = GetDigitsForRounding(axis);
				double num = Math.Pow(10.0, digitsForRounding);
				return Math.Ceiling((double)value * num) / num;
			}
			return value;
		}

		public static List<string> ParsePattern(string pattern)
		{
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			if (pattern == null)
			{
				return list;
			}
			while (pattern.Length > 0)
			{
				string element;
				int num = ExtractElement(pattern, out element);
				if (num == -1)
				{
					list.Add(pattern);
					return list;
				}
				if (num > 0)
				{
					list.Add(pattern.Substring(0, num));
				}
				if (element.Length > 0)
				{
					list.Add((element == "{{") ? "{" : element);
				}
				pattern = pattern.Substring(num + element.Length);
			}
			return list;
		}

		public static string ReplacePlaceholder(string pattern, string oldPlaceholder, string newPlaceholder)
		{
			string text = pattern;
			MatchCollection matchCollection = Regex.Matches(pattern, "{" + oldPlaceholder + "(:[^}]*)?}");
			foreach (Match item in matchCollection)
			{
				string value = item.Groups[1].Value;
				string text2 = string.Empty;
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(item.Groups[0].Value))
				{
					text2 = newPlaceholder + value;
				}
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text2))
				{
					text = text.Replace(item.Groups[0].Value, "{" + text2 + "}");
				}
			}
			return text;
		}

		public static string ReplacePlaceholder(string pattern, string oldPlaceholder, string newPlaceholder1, string newPlaceholder2)
		{
			return ReplacePlaceholder(pattern, oldPlaceholder, newPlaceholder1, newPlaceholder2, ", ");
		}

		public static string ReplacePlaceholder(string pattern, string oldPlaceholder, string newPlaceholder1, string newPlaceholder2, string separator)
		{
			string text = pattern;
			MatchCollection matchCollection = Regex.Matches(pattern, "{" + oldPlaceholder + "(:[^}]*)?}");
			foreach (Match item in matchCollection)
			{
				string value = item.Groups[1].Value;
				string text2 = string.Empty;
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(item.Groups[0].Value))
				{
					text2 = newPlaceholder1 + value + "}" + separator + "{" + newPlaceholder2 + value;
				}
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text2))
				{
					text = text.Replace(item.Groups[0].Value, "{" + text2 + "}");
				}
			}
			return text;
		}

		public static string GetMinValuePlaceholder(RefinedPoint refinedPoint, Scale valueScaleType)
		{
			if (refinedPoint.ValuesDimension < 2)
			{
				return "V";
			}
			switch (valueScaleType)
			{
			case Scale.Numerical:
				if (refinedPoint.GetNumericalValue(1) > refinedPoint.GetNumericalValue(0))
				{
					return "V1";
				}
				return "V2";
			case Scale.DateTime:
				if (refinedPoint.GetDateTimeValue(1) > refinedPoint.GetDateTimeValue(0))
				{
					return "V1";
				}
				return "V2";
			case Scale.TimeSpan:
				if (refinedPoint.GetTimeSpanValue(1) > refinedPoint.GetTimeSpanValue(0))
				{
					return "V1";
				}
				return "V2";
			default:
				return string.Empty;
			}
		}

		public static string GetMaxValuePlaceholder(RefinedPoint refinedPoint, Scale valueScaleType)
		{
			if (refinedPoint.ValuesDimension < 2)
			{
				return "V";
			}
			switch (valueScaleType)
			{
			case Scale.Numerical:
				if (refinedPoint.GetNumericalValue(1) < refinedPoint.GetNumericalValue(0))
				{
					return "V1";
				}
				return "V2";
			case Scale.DateTime:
				if (refinedPoint.GetDateTimeValue(1) < refinedPoint.GetDateTimeValue(0))
				{
					return "V1";
				}
				return "V2";
			case Scale.TimeSpan:
				if (refinedPoint.GetTimeSpanValue(1) < refinedPoint.GetTimeSpanValue(0))
				{
					return "V1";
				}
				return "V2";
			default:
				return string.Empty;
			}
		}

		public static string Format(object value, string format)
		{
			IFormattable formattable = value as IFormattable;
			try
			{
				if (formattable != null)
				{
					if (value is DateTime && format == "q")
					{
						DateTime dateTime = (DateTime)value;
						return dateTime.ToString(QuarterFormatter.FormatDateTime(dateTime, "QQ ", QuarterFormat) + "yyyy");
					}
					if (value is TimeSpan)
					{
						return FormatTimeSpan((TimeSpan)value, format);
					}
					return formattable.ToString(format, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture);
				}
			}
			catch
			{
			}
			if (!(value is string))
			{
				return value.ToString() + ":" + format;
			}
			return (string)value;
		}

		public static string GetArgumentFormat(string pattern)
		{
			Match match = Regex.Match(pattern, "{A(:[^}]*)?}");
			return match.Groups[1].Value.Replace(":", string.Empty);
		}

		public static string ConstructDefaultPattern(IAxisData axis, string argumentPattern = "A")
		{
			if (axis != null && axis.AxisScaleTypeMap != null)
			{
				string text = string.Empty;
				bool flag = false;
				switch (axis.AxisScaleTypeMap.ScaleType)
				{
				case ActualScaleTypeCore.Numerical:
					text = ":" + FormatUtils.Format;
					break;
				case ActualScaleTypeCore.DateTime:
					flag = IsIntervalLabel(axis.DateTimeScaleOptions);
					text = ":" + SelectFormat(axis.DateTimeScaleOptions.GridAlignment);
					break;
				case ActualScaleTypeCore.TimeSpan:
					flag = IsIntervalLabel(axis.TimeSpanScaleOptions);
					text = ":" + GetTimeSpanFormat();
					break;
				case ActualScaleTypeCore.Qualitative:
					flag = IsIntervalLabel(axis.QualitativeScaleOptions);
					break;
				}
				if (axis.IsValueAxis)
				{
					return "{V" + text + "}";
				}
				if (!flag)
				{
					return "{" + argumentPattern + text + "}";
				}
				return "{A1" + text + "} - {A2" + text + "}";
			}
			return "{V}";
		}

		public static string ConstructDefaultIntervalPattern(IAxisData axis)
		{
			string text = ConstructDefaultPattern(axis, "A1");
			string text2 = ConstructDefaultPattern(axis, "A2");
			return "{OB}" + text + ", " + text2 + "{CB}";
		}

		public static string ConstructDefaultUnderflowPattern(IAxisData axis)
		{
			string text = ConstructDefaultPattern(axis, "A2");
			return "{US}" + text;
		}

		public static string ConstructDefaultOverflowPattern(IAxisData axis)
		{
			string text = ConstructDefaultPattern(axis, "A1");
			return "{OS}" + text;
		}

		public static IEnumerable<string> GetCustomDateTimeFormats()
		{
			return new string[2] { "q", "%d" };
		}
	}

	{

	public abstract class ToolTipPointDataToStringConverter
	{
		private const string defaultStackedGroupPattern = " : {G}";

		private readonly string defaultPointPattern;

		private readonly string defaultLegendPattern;

		private readonly ISeries series;

		private readonly bool showOpen;

		private readonly bool showClose;

		private readonly bool allowArgument;

		private readonly bool allowValue;

		private object hint;

		protected abstract string DefaultValuePattern { get; }

		protected virtual string DefaultArgumentPattern => "{A" + GetDefaultArgumentFormat() + "}";

		protected virtual string GroupedPointValuePattern => "";

		protected virtual string DefaultNumericFormat
		{
			get
			{
				if (!IsTextInLegend)
				{
					return string.Empty;
				}
				return DefaultLegendNumericFormat;
			}
		}

		protected virtual string DefaultLegendNumericFormat => ":g6";

		protected virtual string DefaultCrosshairLegendPattern => defaultLegendPattern;

		protected ISeries Series => series;

		protected bool ShowOpen => showOpen;

		protected bool ShowClose => showClose;

		protected bool IsTextInLegend
		{
			get
			{
				if (series != null && series.SeriesView is IXYSeriesView)
				{
					return ((IXYSeriesView)series.SeriesView).CrosshairContentShowMode == CrosshairContentShowModeCore.Legend;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public object Hint
		{
			get
			{
				return hint;
			}
			set
			{
				hint = value;
			}
		}

		public string ActualPointPattern
		{
			get
			{
				if (!IsTextInLegend)
				{
					return defaultPointPattern;
				}
				return DefaultCrosshairLegendPattern;
			}
		}

		public string DefaultPointPattern => defaultPointPattern;

		protected ToolTipPointDataToStringConverter(ISeries series, bool showOpen, bool showClose, bool showStackedGroup, bool allowArgument, bool allowValue)
		{
			this.showOpen = showOpen;
			this.showClose = showClose;
			this.series = series;
			this.allowArgument = allowArgument;
			this.allowValue = allowValue;
			string text = (showStackedGroup ? " : {G}" : "");
			defaultPointPattern = (allowArgument ? DefaultArgumentPattern : "") + text + (allowValue ? DefaultValuePattern : "");
			defaultLegendPattern = GroupedPointValuePattern;
		}

		protected ToolTipPointDataToStringConverter(ISeries series, bool showOpen, bool showClose, bool showStackedGroup)
			: this(series, showOpen, showClose, showStackedGroup, allowArgument: true, allowValue: true)
		{
		}

		protected ToolTipPointDataToStringConverter(ISeries series)
			: this(series, showStackedGroup: false)
		{
		}

		protected ToolTipPointDataToStringConverter(ISeries series, bool showStackedGroup)
			: this(series, showOpen: true, showClose: true, showStackedGroup)
		{
		}

		private string GetDefaultArgumentFormat()
		{
			//IL_0049: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (series.SeriesView is IXYSeriesView { AxisXData: not null } iXYSeriesView && iXYSeriesView.AxisXData.Label != null)
			{
				if (series.ArgumentScaleType == Scale.DateTime)
				{
					return ":" + GetFormatString(GetActualMeasureUnit(iXYSeriesView.AxisXData.DateTimeScaleOptions));
				}
				if (series.ArgumentScaleType == Scale.TimeSpan)
				{
					return ":" + PatternUtils.GetTimeSpanFormat();
				}
			}
			return GetDefaultFormat(series.ArgumentScaleType);
		}

		protected string GetDefaultFormat(Scale scaleType)
		{
			return scaleType switch
			{
				Scale.DateTime => ":d", 
				Scale.TimeSpan => ":g", 
				Scale.Numerical => DefaultNumericFormat, 
				_ => "", 
			};
		}

		protected DateTimeMeasureUnitNative GetActualMeasureUnit(IDateTimeScaleOptions scaleOptions)
		{
			//IL_000a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (scaleOptions.ScaleMode != ScaleModeNative.Continuous)
			{
				return scaleOptions.MeasureUnit;
			}
			return (DateTimeMeasureUnitNative)scaleOptions.GridAlignment;
		}

		protected string GetFormatString(DateTimeMeasureUnitNative dateTimeMeasureUnitNative)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002a: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			return (int)dateTimeMeasureUnitNative switch
			{
				4 => "d", 
				3 => "t", 
				0 => DateTimeUtilsExt.CreateLongTimePatternWithMillisecond(), 
				2 => "t", 
				6 => "MMMM yyyy", 
				7 => "MMMM yyyy", 
				1 => "T", 
				5 => "d", 
				8 => "yyyy", 
				_ => "", 
			};
		}

		protected string GetDefaultValueFormat()
		{
			return GetDefaultFormat(series.ValueScaleType);
		}

		public string GetGroupedPointPattern(bool allowArgument, bool allowValue)
		{
			string text = (allowArgument ? DefaultArgumentPattern : "");
			string text2 = (allowValue ? GroupedPointValuePattern : "");
			return "{S} : " + text + text2;
		}
	}

		{
			//IL_001c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (axisData != null && axisData.Label != null)
			{
				switch (scale)
				{
				case Scale.DateTime:
					return ":" + GetFormatString(GetActualMeasureUnit(axisData.DateTimeScaleOptions));
				case Scale.TimeSpan:
					return ":" + PatternUtils.GetTimeSpanFormat();
				}
			}
			return GetDefaultFormat(scale);
		}

	public class IndicatorPointToStringConverter
	{
		private const string defaultLegendNumericFormat = ":g6";

		private const string defaultNumericFormat = ":0.##";

		private readonly ISeries series;

		private readonly bool isTextInLegend;

		private string DefaultNumericFormat
		{
			get
			{
				if (!isTextInLegend)
				{
					return ":0.##";
				}
				return ":g6";
			}
		}

		private string DefaultLabelPattern => DefaultArgumentPart + DefaultValuePart;

		protected virtual string DefaultArgumentPart => "{A} : ";

		protected virtual string DefaultGroupArgumentPart => "{I} : ";

		protected virtual string DefaultValuePart => "{V" + GetDefaultValueFormat() + "}";

		protected virtual string DefaultLegendValuePart => DefaultValuePart;

		public string DefaultLegendPattern => DefaultLegendValuePart;

		public string DefaultGroupPattern => DefaultGroupArgumentPart + DefaultValuePart;

		public IndicatorPointToStringConverter(ISeries series, bool isTextInLegend)
		{
			this.series = series;
			this.isTextInLegend = isTextInLegend;
		}

		protected string GetDefaultValueFormat()
		{
			if (series.ValueScaleType == Scale.DateTime)
			{
				return ":d";
			}
			if (series.ValueScaleType == Scale.TimeSpan)
			{
				return ":g";
			}
			if (series.ValueScaleType == Scale.Numerical)
			{
				return DefaultNumericFormat;
			}
			return "";
		}

		public string GetDefaultPattern(bool isInGroup)
		{
			if (isInGroup)
			{
				return DefaultGroupPattern;
			}
			if (!isTextInLegend)
			{
				return DefaultLabelPattern;
			}
			return DefaultLegendValuePart;
		}
	}
