	public enum SeriesIncompatibilityType
	{
		ByViewType,
		ByArgumentScaleType,
		ByValueScaleType,
		Invisible
	}
	public class SeriesIncompatibilityInfo : Dictionary<SeriesIncompatibilityType, ISeries>
	{
		public void AddIncompatibility(SeriesIncompatibilityType type, ISeries masterSeries)
		{
			if (!ContainsKey(type))
			{
				Add(type, masterSeries);
			}
		}
	}
	public class SeriesIncompatibilityStatistics
	{
		private readonly Dictionary<ISeries, SeriesIncompatibilityInfo> dictionary = new Dictionary<ISeries, SeriesIncompatibilityInfo>();

		public SeriesIncompatibilityInfo this[ISeries series]
		{
			get
			{
				if (!dictionary.TryGetValue(series, out var value))
				{
					return null;
				}
				return value;
			}
		}

		public bool IsSeriesIncompatible(ISeries series)
		{
			return dictionary.ContainsKey(series);
		}

		public void Add(ISeries series, SeriesIncompatibilityType type, ISeries masterSeries)
		{
			ChartDebug.Assert(series != null);
			SeriesIncompatibilityInfo seriesIncompatibilityInfo = this[series];
			if (seriesIncompatibilityInfo == null)
			{
				seriesIncompatibilityInfo = new SeriesIncompatibilityInfo();
				dictionary.Add(series, seriesIncompatibilityInfo);
			}
			seriesIncompatibilityInfo.AddIncompatibility(type, masterSeries);
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			dictionary.Clear();
		}
	}
	public abstract class SeriesIncompatibilityCalculatorBase<VIEW, AXISKEY>
	{
		private class MasterSeriesInfo
		{
			private readonly ISeries series;

			private readonly Scale scaleType;

			public ISeries Series => series;

			public Scale ScaleType => scaleType;

			public MasterSeriesInfo(ISeries series, Scale scaleType)
			{
				this.series = series;
				this.scaleType = scaleType;
			}

			public MasterSeriesInfo(Scale scaleType)
				: this((ISeries)null, scaleType)
			{
			}
		}

		private readonly SeriesIncompatibilityStatistics statistics;

		private readonly Dictionary<AXISKEY, MasterSeriesInfo> masterSeriesForAxisXDictionary = new Dictionary<AXISKEY, MasterSeriesInfo>();

		private readonly Dictionary<AXISKEY, MasterSeriesInfo> masterSeriesForAxisYDictionary = new Dictionary<AXISKEY, MasterSeriesInfo>();

		protected SeriesIncompatibilityCalculatorBase()
			: this(new SeriesIncompatibilityStatistics())
		{
		}

		protected SeriesIncompatibilityCalculatorBase(SeriesIncompatibilityStatistics statistics)
		{
			this.statistics = statistics;
		}

		protected abstract VIEW GetView(ISeries series);

		protected abstract AXISKEY GetAxisXKey(VIEW view);

		protected abstract AXISKEY GetAxisYKey(VIEW view);

		protected abstract bool CheckIncompatibleViewType(ISeries series, bool is3DView, CompatibleViewType diagramClass);

		public bool IsVisibleAndCompatible(RefinedSeries refinedSeries, bool is3DView, CompatibleViewType diagramClass, ISeries baseSeries)
		{
			if (!IsVisible(refinedSeries.Series))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return IsCompatible(refinedSeries, is3DView, diagramClass, baseSeries);
		}

		public bool IsVisible(ISeries series)
		{
			if (!series.Visible)
			{
				statistics.Add(series, SeriesIncompatibilityType.Invisible, null);
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public bool IsCompatible(RefinedSeries refinedSeries, bool is3DView, CompatibleViewType diagramClass, ISeries baseSeries)
		{
			ISeries series = refinedSeries.Series;
			if (!CheckIncompatibleViewType(series, is3DView, diagramClass))
			{
				statistics.Add(series, SeriesIncompatibilityType.ByViewType, baseSeries);
				return false;
			}
			VIEW view = GetView(series);
			if (view == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			AXISKEY axisXKey = GetAxisXKey(view);
			AXISKEY axisYKey = GetAxisYKey(view);
			if (axisXKey == null || axisYKey == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			bool result = true;
			MasterSeriesInfo value;
			if (!refinedSeries.NoArgumentScaleTypeX)
			{
				if (masterSeriesForAxisXDictionary.TryGetValue(axisXKey, out value))
				{
					if (value.ScaleType != series.ArgumentScaleType)
					{
						statistics.Add(series, SeriesIncompatibilityType.ByArgumentScaleType, value.Series);
						result = false;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					masterSeriesForAxisXDictionary.Add(axisXKey, new MasterSeriesInfo(series, series.ArgumentScaleType));
				}
			}
			if (masterSeriesForAxisYDictionary.TryGetValue(axisYKey, out value))
			{
				if (value.ScaleType != series.ValueScaleType)
				{
					statistics.Add(series, SeriesIncompatibilityType.ByValueScaleType, value.Series);
					result = false;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				masterSeriesForAxisYDictionary.Add(axisYKey, new MasterSeriesInfo(series, series.ValueScaleType));
			}
			return result;
		}

		public Scale GetAxisXMasterScaleType(RefinedSeries refinedSeries)
		{
			VIEW view = GetView(refinedSeries.Series);
			if (view != null)
			{
				AXISKEY axisXKey = GetAxisXKey(view);
				if (axisXKey != null && masterSeriesForAxisXDictionary.TryGetValue(axisXKey, out var value))
				{
					return value.ScaleType;
				}
			}
			return Scale.Numerical;
		}

		public void AddTemplateView(VIEW view, Scale argumentScaleType, Scale valueScaleType)
		{
			AXISKEY axisXKey = GetAxisXKey(view);
			AXISKEY axisYKey = GetAxisYKey(view);
			if (axisXKey != null && axisYKey != null)
			{
				masterSeriesForAxisXDictionary.Add(axisXKey, new MasterSeriesInfo(argumentScaleType));
				masterSeriesForAxisYDictionary.Add(axisYKey, new MasterSeriesInfo(valueScaleType));
			}
		}
	}
	public class RefinedSeriesIncompatibilityCalculator : SeriesIncompatibilityCalculatorBase<IXYSeriesView, IAxisData>
	{
		private ISeriesView baseView;

		private ISeries baseSeries;

		public bool CanCalculate => baseView != null;

		public RefinedSeriesIncompatibilityCalculator(SeriesIncompatibilityStatistics statistics)
			: base(statistics)
		{
		}

		protected override IXYSeriesView GetView(ISeries series)
		{
			return series.SeriesView as IXYSeriesView;
		}

		protected override IAxisData GetAxisXKey(IXYSeriesView view)
		{
			return view.AxisXData;
		}

		protected override IAxisData GetAxisYKey(IXYSeriesView view)
		{
			return view.AxisYData;
		}

		protected override bool CheckIncompatibleViewType(ISeries series, bool is3DView, CompatibleViewType diagramClass)
		{
			if (series.SeriesView != null && series.SeriesView.Is3DView == is3DView)
			{
				return series.SeriesView.CompatibleViewType == diagramClass;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void Initialize(ISeries baseSeries, ISeriesView baseView)
		{
			this.baseSeries = baseSeries;
			this.baseView = baseView;
		}

		public bool IsVisibleAndCompatible(RefinedSeries refinedSeries)
		{
			return IsVisibleAndCompatible(refinedSeries, baseView.Is3DView, baseView.CompatibleViewType, baseSeries);
		}
	}
	public struct TimeCore : IEquatable<TimeCore>
	{
		private const int FakeYear = 1;

		private const int FakeMonth = 1;

		private const int FakeDay = 1;

		public static readonly TimeCore DayBegin = new TimeCore(0, 0);

		public static readonly TimeCore DayEnd = new TimeCore(24, 0);

		private readonly int hour;

		private readonly int minute;

		private readonly int second;

		public int Hour => hour;

		public int Minute => minute;

		public int Second => second;

		public static bool operator >(TimeCore t1, TimeCore t2)
		{
			if (t1.hour > t2.hour || (t1.hour == t2.hour && t1.minute > t2.minute) || (t1.hour == t2.hour && t1.minute == t2.minute && t1.second > t2.second))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool operator <(TimeCore t1, TimeCore t2)
		{
			if (!(t1 > t2))
			{
				return !t1.Equals(t2);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool operator <=(TimeCore t1, TimeCore t2)
		{
			if (!(t1 < t2))
			{
				return t1.Equals(t2);
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static bool operator >=(TimeCore t1, TimeCore t2)
		{
			if (!(t1 > t2))
			{
				return t1.Equals(t2);
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static bool operator ==(TimeCore t1, TimeCore t2)
		{
			return t1.Equals(t2);
		}

		public static bool operator !=(TimeCore t1, TimeCore t2)
		{
			return !t1.Equals(t2);
		}

		public static TimeSpan operator -(TimeCore t1, TimeCore t2)
		{
			DateTime dateTime = ((t1.hour >= 24) ? new DateTime(1, 1, 2, 0, 0, 0) : new DateTime(1, 1, 1, t1.hour, t1.minute, t1.second));
			DateTime dateTime2 = ((t2.hour >= 24) ? new DateTime(1, 1, 2, 0, 0, 0) : new DateTime(1, 1, 1, t2.hour, t2.minute, t2.second));
			return dateTime - dateTime2;
		}

		public static explicit operator TimeSpan(TimeCore t)
		{
			return new TimeSpan(t.hour, t.minute, t.second);
		}

		public TimeCore(int hour, int minute, int second = 0)
		{
			if (hour < 0 || minute < 0 || second < 0 || hour > 24 || minute > 59 || second > 59 || (hour == 24 && (minute > 0 || second > 0)))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException($"The specified time {hour}:{minute}:{second} is incorrect.");
			}
			this.hour = hour;
			this.minute = minute;
			this.second = second;
		}

		public TimeCore(DateTime date)
			: this(date.Hour, date.Minute, date.Second)
		{
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return $"{hour:00}:{minute:00}:{second:00}";
		}

		public bool Equals(TimeCore other)
		{
			if (hour == other.hour && minute == other.minute)
			{
				return second == other.second;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj.GetType() != typeof(TimeCore))
			{
				return false;
			}
			TimeCore other = (TimeCore)obj;
			return Equals(other);
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return HashCodeHelper.CalculateGeneric<int, int, int>(hour, minute, second);
		}

		public unsafe int FloorToMeasureUnits(DateTimeMeasureUnitNative mu)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002a: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			switch ((int)mu)
			{
			case 3:
				return hour;
			case 2:
				return hour * 60 + minute;
			case 1:
				return hour * 60 * 60 + minute * 60 + second;
			case 0:
				return hour * 60 * 60 * 1000 + minute * 60 * 1000 + second * 1000;
			case 4:
			case 5:
			case 6:
			case 7:
			case 8:
				return 0;
			default:
				throw new Exception("Unknown measure unit: " + ((object)(*(DateTimeMeasureUnitNative*)(&mu))/*cast due to .constrained prefix*/).ToString());
			}
		}

		public unsafe int CeilToMeasureUnits(DateTimeMeasureUnitNative mu)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002a: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			switch ((int)mu)
			{
			case 3:
				if (minute == 0 && second == 0)
				{
					return hour;
				}
				return hour + 1;
			case 2:
				if (second == 0)
				{
					return hour * 60 + minute;
				}
				return hour * 60 + minute + 1;
			case 1:
				return hour * 60 * 60 + minute * 60 + second;
			case 0:
				return hour * 60 * 60 * 1000 + minute * 60 * 1000 + second * 1000;
			case 4:
			case 5:
			case 6:
			case 7:
			case 8:
				return 0;
			default:
				throw new Exception("Unknown measure unit: " + ((object)(*(DateTimeMeasureUnitNative*)(&mu))/*cast due to .constrained prefix*/).ToString());
			}
		}
	}
	public class TimeIntervalCore
	{
		private readonly TimeCore begin;

		private readonly TimeCore end;

		public TimeCore Begin => begin;

		public TimeCore End => end;

		public static bool operator ==(TimeIntervalCore ti1, TimeIntervalCore ti2)
		{
			if ((object)ti1 == ti2)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if ((object)ti1 == null || (object)ti2 == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return ti1.Equals(ti2);
		}

		public static bool operator !=(TimeIntervalCore ti1, TimeIntervalCore ti2)
		{
			return !(ti1 == ti2);
		}

		public TimeIntervalCore(TimeCore begin, TimeCore end)
		{
			if (end >= begin)
			{
				this.begin = begin;
				this.end = end;
			}
			else
			{
				this.begin = end;
				this.end = begin;
			}
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return Begin.ToString() + " - " + end.ToString();
		}

		public bool Contains(TimeCore time)
		{
			if (begin <= time)
			{
				return time < end;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			TimeIntervalCore timeIntervalCore = obj as TimeIntervalCore;
			if (timeIntervalCore == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (begin.Equals(timeIntervalCore.begin) && end.Equals(timeIntervalCore.end))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return HashCodeHelper.CalculateGeneric<TimeCore, TimeCore>(begin, end);
		}
	}
	public class TimeIntervalSetCore
	{
		private class TimeIntervalByBeginComparer : IComparer<TimeIntervalCore>
		{
			public int Compare(TimeIntervalCore x, TimeIntervalCore y)
			{
				if (x.Begin < y.Begin)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				if (x.Begin > y.Begin)
				{
					return 1;
				}
				return 0;
			}
		}

		private static TimeIntervalSetCore wholeDay = new TimeIntervalSetCore(new List<TimeIntervalCore>(1)
		{
			new TimeIntervalCore(new TimeCore(0, 0), new TimeCore(24, 0))
		});

		private readonly List<TimeIntervalCore> sortedNotIntersectedIntervals;

		private readonly bool isWholeDay;

		public static TimeIntervalSetCore WholeDay => wholeDay;

		public TimeIntervalCore this[int i] => sortedNotIntersectedIntervals[i];

		public int Count => sortedNotIntersectedIntervals.Count;

		public static bool operator ==(TimeIntervalSetCore tis1, TimeIntervalSetCore tis2)
		{
			if ((object)tis1 == tis2)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if ((object)tis1 == null || (object)tis2 == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return tis1.Equals(tis2);
		}

		public static bool operator !=(TimeIntervalSetCore tis1, TimeIntervalSetCore tis2)
		{
			return !(tis1 == tis2);
		}

		private TimeIntervalSetCore(List<TimeIntervalCore> notIntersectedIntervals)
		{
			sortedNotIntersectedIntervals = notIntersectedIntervals;
			isWholeDay = CalcIsWholeDay();
		}

		public TimeIntervalSetCore(ITimeIntervalCollection intervals)
		{
			List<TimeIntervalCore> list = new List<TimeIntervalCore>(intervals.Count);
			if (intervals.Count == 0)
			{
				sortedNotIntersectedIntervals = list;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < intervals.Count; i++)
			{
				ITimeInterval timeInterval = intervals[i];
				TimeCore begin = new TimeCore(timeInterval.StartHour, timeInterval.StartMinute, timeInterval.StartSecond);
				TimeCore end = new TimeCore(timeInterval.EndHour, timeInterval.EndMinute, timeInterval.EndSecond);
				TimeIntervalCore item = new TimeIntervalCore(begin, end);
				list.Add(item);
				list.Sort(new TimeIntervalByBeginComparer());
				sortedNotIntersectedIntervals = HandleIntersections(list);
			}
			isWholeDay = CalcIsWholeDay();
		}

		private List<TimeIntervalCore> HandleIntersections(List<TimeIntervalCore> sortedByBeginTimeIntervals)
		{
			List<TimeIntervalCore> list = new List<TimeIntervalCore>();
			if (sortedByBeginTimeIntervals.Count == 1)
			{
				if (sortedByBeginTimeIntervals[0].Begin != sortedByBeginTimeIntervals[0].End)
				{
					return sortedByBeginTimeIntervals;
				}
				return list;
			}
			TimeCore begin = sortedByBeginTimeIntervals[0].Begin;
			for (int i = 1; i < sortedByBeginTimeIntervals.Count; i++)
			{
				if (!IsIntersected(sortedByBeginTimeIntervals[i - 1], sortedByBeginTimeIntervals[i]))
				{
					TimeCore end = sortedByBeginTimeIntervals[i - 1].End;
					if (begin != end)
					{
						list.Add(new TimeIntervalCore(begin, end));
					}
					begin = sortedByBeginTimeIntervals[i].Begin;
				}
				if (i == sortedByBeginTimeIntervals.Count - 1)
				{
					TimeCore end2 = sortedByBeginTimeIntervals[i].End;
					if (begin != end2)
					{
						list.Add(new TimeIntervalCore(begin, end2));
					}
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		private bool IsIntersected(TimeIntervalCore beginEarlier, TimeIntervalCore beginLater)
		{
			return beginEarlier.End > beginLater.Begin;
		}

		private bool CalcIsWholeDay()
		{
			if (Count == 1)
			{
				TimeIntervalCore timeIntervalCore = sortedNotIntersectedIntervals[0];
				TimeCore begin = timeIntervalCore.Begin;
				if (begin.Hour == 0 && begin.Minute == 0 && begin.Second == 0 && timeIntervalCore.End.Hour == 24)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool Contains(TimeCore time)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < sortedNotIntersectedIntervals.Count; i++)
			{
				if (sortedNotIntersectedIntervals[i].Contains(time))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public TimeIntervalSetCore Invert()
		{
			List<TimeIntervalCore> list = new List<TimeIntervalCore>();
			if (sortedNotIntersectedIntervals.Count != 0)
			{
				TimeCore timeCore;
				int num;
				if (sortedNotIntersectedIntervals[0].Begin != TimeCore.DayBegin)
				{
					timeCore = TimeCore.DayBegin;
					num = 0;
				}
				else
				{
					timeCore = sortedNotIntersectedIntervals[0].End;
					num = 1;
				}
				for (int i = num; i < sortedNotIntersectedIntervals.Count; i++)
				{
					TimeCore begin = sortedNotIntersectedIntervals[i].Begin;
					list.Add(new TimeIntervalCore(timeCore, begin));
					timeCore = ((!(sortedNotIntersectedIntervals[i].End < TimeCore.DayEnd)) ? TimeCore.DayEnd : sortedNotIntersectedIntervals[i].End);
				}
				if (timeCore < TimeCore.DayEnd)
				{
					list.Add(new TimeIntervalCore(timeCore, TimeCore.DayEnd));
				}
			}
			else
			{
				list.Add(new TimeIntervalCore(TimeCore.DayBegin, TimeCore.DayEnd));
			}
			return new TimeIntervalSetCore(list);
		}

		public List<TimeIntervalInMeasureUnits> NarrowToMeasureUnits(DateTimeMeasureUnitNative measureUnit)
		{
			//IL_001f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			List<TimeIntervalInMeasureUnits> list = new List<TimeIntervalInMeasureUnits>();
			for (int i = 0; i < sortedNotIntersectedIntervals.Count; i++)
			{
				int num = sortedNotIntersectedIntervals[i].Begin.CeilToMeasureUnits(measureUnit);
				int num2 = sortedNotIntersectedIntervals[i].End.FloorToMeasureUnits(measureUnit);
				if (num2 > num)
				{
					list.Add(new TimeIntervalInMeasureUnits(num, num2));
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		public List<TimeIntervalInMeasureUnits> ExpandToMeasureUnits(DateTimeMeasureUnitNative measureUnit)
		{
			//IL_001f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			List<TimeIntervalInMeasureUnits> list = new List<TimeIntervalInMeasureUnits>();
			for (int i = 0; i < sortedNotIntersectedIntervals.Count; i++)
			{
				int num = sortedNotIntersectedIntervals[i].Begin.FloorToMeasureUnits(measureUnit);
				int num2 = sortedNotIntersectedIntervals[i].End.CeilToMeasureUnits(measureUnit);
				if (num2 >= num)
				{
					list.Add(new TimeIntervalInMeasureUnits(num, num2));
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			TimeIntervalSetCore timeIntervalSetCore = obj as TimeIntervalSetCore;
			if (timeIntervalSetCore == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (sortedNotIntersectedIntervals.Count != timeIntervalSetCore.sortedNotIntersectedIntervals.Count)
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < sortedNotIntersectedIntervals.Count; i++)
			{
				if (sortedNotIntersectedIntervals[i] != timeIntervalSetCore.sortedNotIntersectedIntervals[i])
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return HashCodeHelper.CalculateGenericList<TimeIntervalCore>((IList<TimeIntervalCore>)sortedNotIntersectedIntervals);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			foreach (TimeIntervalCore sortedNotIntersectedInterval in sortedNotIntersectedIntervals)
			{
				stringBuilder.AppendFormat("({0}) ", sortedNotIntersectedInterval.ToString());
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		public bool IsWholeDay()
		{
			return isWholeDay;
		}
	}
	public class WorkTimeRuleSetCore
	{
		private class AuxWorkTimeRule : IWorkTimeRule
		{
			private DateTime? date;

			private WeekdayCore weekdays;

			private TimeIntervalSetCore restIntervals;

			public DateTime? Date => date;

			public WeekdayCore Weekdays => weekdays;

			public ITimeIntervalCollection WorkIntervals => null;

			public TimeIntervalSetCore RestIntervals => restIntervals;

			public bool IsActive => true;

			public AuxWorkTimeRule(DateTime date, TimeIntervalSetCore restIntervals)
			{
				this.date = date;
				this.restIntervals = restIntervals;
			}

			public AuxWorkTimeRule(WeekdayCore weekendDays, TimeIntervalSetCore restIntervals)
			{
				weekdays = weekendDays;
				this.restIntervals = restIntervals;
			}
		}

		private TimeIntervalSetCore genericRestIntervals;

		private readonly SortedList<DayOfWeek, TimeIntervalSetCore> byDayOfWeekRestIntervalSets = new SortedList<DayOfWeek, TimeIntervalSetCore>(7);

		private readonly SortedList<DateTime, TimeIntervalSetCore> byDateRestIntervalSets = new SortedList<DateTime, TimeIntervalSetCore>();

		private readonly bool workTimeOnly;

		private readonly bool wholeTimeExcluded;

		private WeekdayCore genericIntervalsNotAppliedTo;

		public bool WholeTimeExcluded => wholeTimeExcluded;

		public bool Enabled
		{
			get
			{
				if (workTimeOnly)
				{
					if ((!(genericRestIntervals != null) || genericRestIntervals.Count <= 0) && byDayOfWeekRestIntervalSets.Count <= 0)
					{
						return byDateRestIntervalSets.Count > 0;
					}
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public TimeIntervalSetCore this[DayOfWeek day] => byDayOfWeekRestIntervalSets[day];

		public TimeIntervalSetCore this[DateTime dateTime] => byDateRestIntervalSets[dateTime.Date];

		public bool HasCustomDate => byDateRestIntervalSets.Count > 0;

		public IEnumerable<KeyValuePair<DateTime, TimeIntervalSetCore>> SortedByDateRestIntervalsForCustomDates
		{
			get
			{
				foreach (KeyValuePair<DateTime, TimeIntervalSetCore> byDateRestIntervalSet in byDateRestIntervalSets)
				{
					yield return byDateRestIntervalSet;
				}
			}
		}

		public static bool operator ==(WorkTimeRuleSetCore wtrs1, WorkTimeRuleSetCore wtrs2)
		{
			if ((object)wtrs1 == wtrs2)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if ((object)wtrs1 == null || (object)wtrs2 == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return wtrs1.Equals(wtrs2);
		}

		public static bool operator !=(WorkTimeRuleSetCore wtrs1, WorkTimeRuleSetCore wtrs2)
		{
			return !(wtrs1 == wtrs2);
		}

		public WorkTimeRuleSetCore(IWorkTimeRuleCollection workTimeRules, IWorkdaysOptions workdaysOptions = null)
		{
			genericIntervalsNotAppliedTo = WeekdayCore.None;
			if (workdaysOptions != null && workdaysOptions.WorkdaysOnly)
			{
				WeekdayCore weekendDays = DateTimeUtilsExt.Invert(workdaysOptions.Workdays);
				SetRule(new AuxWorkTimeRule(weekendDays, TimeIntervalSetCore.WholeDay));
				foreach (DateTime holiday in workdaysOptions.Holidays)
				{
					SetRule(new AuxWorkTimeRule(holiday.Date, TimeIntervalSetCore.WholeDay));
				}
			}
			if (workTimeRules != null)
			{
				workTimeOnly = workTimeRules.WorkTimeOnly;
				for (int i = 0; i < workTimeRules.Count; i++)
				{
					SetRule(workTimeRules[i]);
				}
			}
			if (workdaysOptions != null && workdaysOptions.WorkdaysOnly)
			{
				foreach (DateTime exactWorkday in workdaysOptions.ExactWorkdays)
				{
					if (!byDateRestIntervalSets.ContainsKey(exactWorkday.Date))
					{
						SetRule(new AuxWorkTimeRule(exactWorkday.Date, genericRestIntervals));
					}
				}
			}
			WeekdayCore weekdayCore = DateTimeUtilsExt.Invert(genericIntervalsNotAppliedTo);
			if (weekdayCore != WeekdayCore.None)
			{
				if (weekdayCore.HasFlag(WeekdayCore.Sunday))
				{
					byDayOfWeekRestIntervalSets[DayOfWeek.Sunday] = genericRestIntervals;
				}
				if (weekdayCore.HasFlag(WeekdayCore.Monday))
				{
					byDayOfWeekRestIntervalSets[DayOfWeek.Monday] = genericRestIntervals;
				}
				if (weekdayCore.HasFlag(WeekdayCore.Tuesday))
				{
					byDayOfWeekRestIntervalSets[DayOfWeek.Tuesday] = genericRestIntervals;
				}
				if (weekdayCore.HasFlag(WeekdayCore.Wednesday))
				{
					byDayOfWeekRestIntervalSets[DayOfWeek.Wednesday] = genericRestIntervals;
				}
				if (weekdayCore.HasFlag(WeekdayCore.Thursday))
				{
					byDayOfWeekRestIntervalSets[DayOfWeek.Thursday] = genericRestIntervals;
				}
				if (weekdayCore.HasFlag(WeekdayCore.Friday))
				{
					byDayOfWeekRestIntervalSets[DayOfWeek.Friday] = genericRestIntervals;
				}
				if (weekdayCore.HasFlag(WeekdayCore.Saturday))
				{
					byDayOfWeekRestIntervalSets[DayOfWeek.Saturday] = genericRestIntervals;
				}
			}
			wholeTimeExcluded = IsWholeTimeExcluded();
		}

		private void SetRule(IWorkTimeRule rule)
		{
			if (IsEmpty(rule) || !rule.IsActive)
			{
				return;
			}
			TimeIntervalSetCore timeIntervalSetCore = null;
			if (rule is AuxWorkTimeRule auxWorkTimeRule)
			{
				timeIntervalSetCore = auxWorkTimeRule.RestIntervals;
				if (timeIntervalSetCore == null)
				{
					DayOfWeek dayOfWeek = auxWorkTimeRule.Date.Value.DayOfWeek;
					timeIntervalSetCore = (byDayOfWeekRestIntervalSets.ContainsKey(dayOfWeek) ? byDayOfWeekRestIntervalSets[dayOfWeek] : null);
					if (timeIntervalSetCore == null || timeIntervalSetCore == TimeIntervalSetCore.WholeDay)
					{
						timeIntervalSetCore = TimeIntervalSetCore.WholeDay.Invert();
					}
				}
			}
			else if (rule.WorkIntervals != null)
			{
				TimeIntervalSetCore timeIntervalSetCore2 = new TimeIntervalSetCore(rule.WorkIntervals);
				timeIntervalSetCore = timeIntervalSetCore2.Invert();
			}
			else if (rule.WorkIntervals == null)
			{
				timeIntervalSetCore = TimeIntervalSetCore.WholeDay;
			}
			if (rule.Date.HasValue)
			{
				byDateRestIntervalSets[rule.Date.Value.Date] = timeIntervalSetCore;
			}
			else if (rule.Weekdays != WeekdayCore.None)
			{
				if ((rule.Weekdays & WeekdayCore.Sunday) != WeekdayCore.None)
				{
					byDayOfWeekRestIntervalSets[DayOfWeek.Sunday] = timeIntervalSetCore;
					genericIntervalsNotAppliedTo |= WeekdayCore.Sunday;
				}
				if ((rule.Weekdays & WeekdayCore.Monday) != WeekdayCore.None)
				{
					byDayOfWeekRestIntervalSets[DayOfWeek.Monday] = timeIntervalSetCore;
					genericIntervalsNotAppliedTo |= WeekdayCore.Monday;
				}
				if ((rule.Weekdays & WeekdayCore.Tuesday) != WeekdayCore.None)
				{
					byDayOfWeekRestIntervalSets[DayOfWeek.Tuesday] = timeIntervalSetCore;
					genericIntervalsNotAppliedTo |= WeekdayCore.Tuesday;
				}
				if ((rule.Weekdays & WeekdayCore.Wednesday) != WeekdayCore.None)
				{
					byDayOfWeekRestIntervalSets[DayOfWeek.Wednesday] = timeIntervalSetCore;
					genericIntervalsNotAppliedTo |= WeekdayCore.Wednesday;
				}
				if ((rule.Weekdays & WeekdayCore.Thursday) != WeekdayCore.None)
				{
					byDayOfWeekRestIntervalSets[DayOfWeek.Thursday] = timeIntervalSetCore;
					genericIntervalsNotAppliedTo |= WeekdayCore.Thursday;
				}
				if ((rule.Weekdays & WeekdayCore.Friday) != WeekdayCore.None)
				{
					byDayOfWeekRestIntervalSets[DayOfWeek.Friday] = timeIntervalSetCore;
					genericIntervalsNotAppliedTo |= WeekdayCore.Friday;
				}
				if ((rule.Weekdays & WeekdayCore.Saturday) != WeekdayCore.None)
				{
					byDayOfWeekRestIntervalSets[DayOfWeek.Saturday] = timeIntervalSetCore;
					genericIntervalsNotAppliedTo |= WeekdayCore.Saturday;
				}
			}
			else if (!rule.Date.HasValue && rule.Weekdays == WeekdayCore.None)
			{
				genericRestIntervals = timeIntervalSetCore;
			}
		}

		private bool IsEmpty(IWorkTimeRule rule)
		{
			if ((rule.WorkIntervals == null || rule.WorkIntervals.Count == 0) && !rule.Date.HasValue && rule.Weekdays == WeekdayCore.None)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool CollectionEquals<TKey>(SortedList<TKey, TimeIntervalSetCore> timeIntervalSets1, SortedList<TKey, TimeIntervalSetCore> timeIntervalSets2)
		{
			if (timeIntervalSets1 == null && timeIntervalSets2 == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if ((timeIntervalSets1 == null && timeIntervalSets2 != null) || (timeIntervalSets1 != null && timeIntervalSets2 == null))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (timeIntervalSets1.Count != timeIntervalSets2.Count)
			{
				return false;
			}
			foreach (TKey key in timeIntervalSets1.Keys)
			{
				TimeIntervalSetCore timeIntervalSetCore = timeIntervalSets1[key];
				TimeIntervalSetCore value;
				TimeIntervalSetCore timeIntervalSetCore2 = (timeIntervalSets2.TryGetValue(key, out value) ? value : null);
				if ((object)timeIntervalSetCore == timeIntervalSetCore2)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (timeIntervalSetCore == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (!timeIntervalSetCore.Equals(timeIntervalSetCore2))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool IsWholeTimeExcluded()
		{
			foreach (KeyValuePair<DayOfWeek, TimeIntervalSetCore> byDayOfWeekRestIntervalSet in byDayOfWeekRestIntervalSets)
			{
				if (byDayOfWeekRestIntervalSet.Value != TimeIntervalSetCore.WholeDay)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			foreach (KeyValuePair<DateTime, TimeIntervalSetCore> byDateRestIntervalSet in byDateRestIntervalSets)
			{
				if (byDateRestIntervalSet.Value != TimeIntervalSetCore.WholeDay)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public bool CustomDateExists(DateTime dateTime)
		{
			return byDateRestIntervalSets.ContainsKey(dateTime.Date);
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			WorkTimeRuleSetCore workTimeRuleSetCore = obj as WorkTimeRuleSetCore;
			if (workTimeRuleSetCore == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (workTimeOnly == workTimeRuleSetCore.workTimeOnly && genericIntervalsNotAppliedTo == workTimeRuleSetCore.genericIntervalsNotAppliedTo && wholeTimeExcluded == workTimeRuleSetCore.wholeTimeExcluded && genericRestIntervals == workTimeRuleSetCore.genericRestIntervals && CollectionEquals(byDayOfWeekRestIntervalSets, workTimeRuleSetCore.byDayOfWeekRestIntervalSets) && CollectionEquals(byDateRestIntervalSets, workTimeRuleSetCore.byDateRestIntervalSets))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return HashCodeHelper.CalculateGeneric<int, int, bool, bool>(HashCodeHelper.CalculateGenericList<KeyValuePair<DayOfWeek, TimeIntervalSetCore>>((IEnumerable<KeyValuePair<DayOfWeek, TimeIntervalSetCore>>)byDayOfWeekRestIntervalSets), HashCodeHelper.CalculateGenericList<KeyValuePair<DateTime, TimeIntervalSetCore>>((IEnumerable<KeyValuePair<DateTime, TimeIntervalSetCore>>)byDateRestIntervalSets), workTimeOnly, wholeTimeExcluded);
		}
	}
	public struct TimeIntervalInMeasureUnits
	{
		private int begin;

		private int end;

		public int Begin => begin;

		public int End => end;

		public int Length => end - begin;

		public TimeIntervalInMeasureUnits(int begin, int end)
		{
			if (begin > end)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("The End value of a interval can not be greater than the Begin value.");
			}
			this.begin = begin;
			this.end = end;
		}

		public bool Contains(int timeInMeasureUnits)
		{
			if (Begin <= timeInMeasureUnits)
			{
				return timeInMeasureUnits < End;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

	{
		private static readonly string format;

		public static string Format => format;

		static FormatUtils()
		{
			format = (FrameworkVersions.IsNetCore3AndAbove() ? "G15" : "G");
		}

		public static string ToString(object value)
		{
			if (value is double num)
			{
				if (num == 0.0)
				{
					num = Math.Abs(0);
				}
				return num.ToString(Format);
			}
			return value.ToString();
		}

	{
		public override bool CanConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type sourceType)
		{
			if (!(sourceType == typeof(string)))
			{
				return base.CanConvertFrom(context, sourceType);
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override object ConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value)
		{
			if (!(value is string))
			{
				return base.ConvertFrom(context, culture, value);
			}
			return ObjectToStringConversion.StringToObject((string)value);
		}

		public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (!(destinationType == typeof(string)))
			{
				return base.ConvertTo(context, culture, value, destinationType);
			}
			return ObjectToStringConversion.ObjectToString(value);
		}
	}

	public class CohenSutherlandLineClipAlgorithm
	{
		private const int INSIDE = 0;

		private const int LEFT = 1;

		private const int RIGHT = 2;

		private const int TOP = 4;

		private const int BOTTOM = 8;

		private readonly double xMin;

		private readonly double yMin;

		private readonly double xMax;

		private readonly double yMax;

		public CohenSutherlandLineClipAlgorithm(double xMin, double yMin, double xMax, double yMax)
		{
			this.xMax = xMax;
			this.xMin = xMin;
			this.yMax = yMax;
			this.yMin = yMin;
		}

		private int ComputeOutCode(double x, double y)
		{
			int num = 0;
			if (x < xMin)
			{
				num |= 1;
			}
			else if (x > xMax)
			{
				num |= 2;
			}
			if (y < yMin)
			{
				num |= 4;
			}
			else if (y > yMax)
			{
				num |= 8;
			}
			return num;
		}

		public Tuple<double, double, double, double> GetCutLine(double x0, double y0, double x1, double y1)
		{
			int num = ComputeOutCode(x0, y0);
			int num2 = ComputeOutCode(x1, y1);
			bool flag = false;
			while (true)
			{
				if ((num | num2) == 0)
				{
					flag = true;
					break;
				}
				if ((num & num2) != 0)
				{
					break;
				}
				double num3 = double.NaN;
				double num4 = double.NaN;
				int num5 = ((num != 0) ? num : num2);
				if ((num5 & 8) != 0)
				{
					num3 = x0 + (x1 - x0) * (yMax - y0) / (y1 - y0);
					num4 = yMax;
				}
				else if ((num5 & 4) != 0)
				{
					num3 = x0 + (x1 - x0) * (yMin - y0) / (y1 - y0);
					num4 = yMin;
				}
				else if ((num5 & 2) != 0)
				{
					num4 = y0 + (y1 - y0) * (xMax - x0) / (x1 - x0);
					num3 = xMax;
				}
				else if ((num5 & 1) != 0)
				{
					num4 = y0 + (y1 - y0) * (xMin - x0) / (x1 - x0);
					num3 = xMin;
				}
				if (num5 == num)
				{
					x0 = num3;
					y0 = num4;
					num = ComputeOutCode(x0, y0);
				}
				else
				{
					x1 = num3;
					y1 = num4;
					num2 = ComputeOutCode(x1, y1);
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				return new Tuple<double, double, double, double>(x0, y0, x1, y1);
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
	public enum BubbleSizeUnitCore
	{
		AxisXMeasureUnit,
		Pixel
	}
	public static class BubbleUtils
	{
		internal const int MinimumMinSizeInPixels = 4;

		internal const int MinimumMaxSizeInPixels = 12;

		public const double MaxAutoSize = 0.2;

		public const double MinAutoSize = 0.05;

		private static Tuple<double, double> GetMinAxisLengthAndRange(GRealSize2D paneSize, double rangeDelta)
		{
			if (GeometricUtils.IsValidDouble(rangeDelta))
			{
				if (paneSize.Height < paneSize.Width)
				{
					double num = paneSize.Height / paneSize.Width;
					return new Tuple<double, double>(paneSize.Height, rangeDelta * num);
				}
				return new Tuple<double, double>(paneSize.Width, rangeDelta);
			}
			return null;
		}

		private static double GetAutomaticSize(GRealSize2D paneSize, double rangeDelta, double percent, int minimumPixels)
		{
			if (!paneSize.IsEmpty && paneSize.Width > 0.0 && paneSize.Height > 0.0)
			{
				Tuple<double, double> minAxisLengthAndRange = GetMinAxisLengthAndRange(paneSize, rangeDelta);
				if (minAxisLengthAndRange != null)
				{
					double num = percent * minAxisLengthAndRange.Item2;
					double num2 = minAxisLengthAndRange.Item1 / minAxisLengthAndRange.Item2;
					if (num2 * num < (double)minimumPixels)
					{
						return (double)minimumPixels / num2;
					}
					return num;
				}
			}
			return double.NaN;
		}

		public static double GetAutomaticMinSize(BubbleSizeUnitCore sizeUnit, GRealSize2D paneSize, double rangeDelta)
		{
			if (sizeUnit == BubbleSizeUnitCore.Pixel)
			{
				if (!paneSize.IsEmpty)
				{
					return Math.Max(4.0, Math.Min(paneSize.Width, paneSize.Height) * 0.05);
				}
				return double.NaN;
			}
			return GetAutomaticSize(paneSize, rangeDelta, 0.05, 4);
		}

		public static double GetAutomaticMaxSize(BubbleSizeUnitCore sizeUnit, GRealSize2D paneSize, double rangeDelta)
		{
			if (sizeUnit == BubbleSizeUnitCore.Pixel)
			{
				return Math.Max(12.0, Math.Min(paneSize.Width, paneSize.Height) * 0.2);
			}
			return GetAutomaticSize(paneSize, rangeDelta, 0.2, 12);
		}
	}
	public static class NameGenerator
	{
		private static bool TestName(IList<string> nameList, string name)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < nameList.Count; i++)
			{
				if (nameList[i] == name)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static string UniqueName(string baseName, IList<string> nameList, bool useFirstItemIndex = true)
		{
			int num = 1;
			string text = baseName + (useFirstItemIndex ? Convert.ToString(num) : "");
			while (!TestName(nameList, text))
			{
				text = baseName + Convert.ToString(++num);
			}
			return text;
		}
	}
	public static class ChartsCommonUtils
	{
		public static double IncrementDouble(double value)
		{
			if (double.IsNaN(value) || double.IsInfinity(value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			long num = BitConverter.DoubleToInt64Bits(value);
			if (value > 0.0)
			{
				return BitConverter.Int64BitsToDouble(num + 1);
			}
			if (value < 0.0)
			{
				return BitConverter.Int64BitsToDouble(num - 1);
			}
			return double.Epsilon;
		}

		public static double DecrementDouble(double value)
		{
			if (double.IsNaN(value) || double.IsInfinity(value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			long num = BitConverter.DoubleToInt64Bits(value);
			if (value > 0.0)
			{
				return BitConverter.Int64BitsToDouble(num - 1);
			}
			if (value < 0.0)
			{
				return BitConverter.Int64BitsToDouble(num + 1);
			}
			return -5E-324;
		}
	}
	public class DoubleLimitsUnionInfo
	{
		public List<DoubleLimits> UnionResult { get; set; }

		public bool FirstIntervalWasChanged { get; set; }

		public DoubleLimitsUnionInfo(List<DoubleLimits> union, bool firstIntervalWasChanged)
		{
			UnionResult = union;
			FirstIntervalWasChanged = firstIntervalWasChanged;
		}
	}
	public static class LimitsCalculator
	{
		private class LimitStartComparer : IComparer<DoubleLimits>
		{
			public int Compare(DoubleLimits x, DoubleLimits y)
			{
				if (x.Start < y.Start)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				if (x.Start > y.Start)
				{
					return 1;
				}
				return 0;
			}
		}

		public static DoubleLimitsUnionInfo CalculateUnion(List<List<DoubleLimits>> globalIntervals)
		{
			if (globalIntervals == null || globalIntervals.Count == 0)
			{
				return new DoubleLimitsUnionInfo(new List<DoubleLimits>(), firstIntervalWasChanged: false);
			}
			List<DoubleLimits> list = new List<DoubleLimits>();
			for (int i = 0; i < globalIntervals.Count; i++)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < globalIntervals[i].Count; j++)
				{
					list.Add(globalIntervals[i][j]);
				}
			}
			if (list.Count == 0)
			{
				return new DoubleLimitsUnionInfo(new List<DoubleLimits>(), firstIntervalWasChanged: false);
			}
			if (globalIntervals.Count > 1)
			{
				list.Sort(new LimitStartComparer());
			}
			List<DoubleLimits> list2 = new List<DoubleLimits>();
			double start = list[0].Start;
			double end = list[0].End;
			for (int k = 1; k < list.Count; k++)
			{
				if (end < list[k].Start)
				{
					list2.Add(new DoubleLimits(start, end));
					start = list[k].Start;
					end = list[k].End;
				}
				else if (end < list[k].End)
				{
					end = list[k].End;
				}
			}
			list2.Add(new DoubleLimits(start, end));
			bool firstIntervalWasChanged = !globalIntervals[0].SequenceEqual(list2);
			return new DoubleLimitsUnionInfo(list2, firstIntervalWasChanged);
		}
	}
	public static class AxisUtils
	{
		public static bool ShouldUpdateSkippingRangesWithoutPoints(IAxisData axisX, bool valueRangeChanged)
		{
			bool skipRangesWithoutPoints = axisX.DateTimeScaleOptions.SkipRangesWithoutPoints;
			if (!(valueRangeChanged && skipRangesWithoutPoints))
			{
				if (axisX.AxisScaleTypeMap.ScaleType == ActualScaleTypeCore.DateTime)
				{
					return skipRangesWithoutPoints != axisX.AxisScaleTypeMap.SkipGaps;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static object GetScaleMapNativeValue(IScaleMap map, double valueInternal)
		{
			if (map is IIntervalScaleMap)
			{
				return ((IIntervalScaleMap)map).InternalToNativeValue(map.Transformation.TransformBackward(valueInternal));
			}
			return map.InternalToNative(map.Transformation.TransformBackward(valueInternal));
		}
	}
	public static class ObjectToDoubleConverter
	{
		public static double ObjectToDouble(object obj)
		{
			if (obj != null)
			{
				if (PredefinedTypesHelper.IsNumericalType(obj.GetType()))
				{
					return Convert.ToDouble(obj);
				}
				if (obj is string && double.TryParse((string)obj, out var result))
				{
					return result;
				}
			}
			return double.NaN;
		}
	}
	public static class MathUtilsCore
	{
		public static double MinMax(double value, double firstBound, double secondBound)
		{
			double val = Math.Min(firstBound, secondBound);
			double val2 = Math.Max(firstBound, secondBound);
			return Math.Min(Math.Max(value, val), val2);
		}
	}
